battle.line: I don't know what I'm doing, but I'm doing it, buli!

couple_encourage1.line: Sis, what are you bulin here?

main2.line: Is there nothing for Bulin to do? Really? Then let's go play! Wheee!

main3.line: Commander, let's go dig for some treasure, buli~!

mission.line: Buli? What's the mission?

mission_complete.line: Rewards... Can I eat them, buli?

propose.line: Bulin has been caught~ Ahh, I'm blushing so much! What will I do! Let's buy some new toys and celebrate!

skill.line: My wrench is the wrench that will pierce the earth!

upgrade.line: [Cannot be enhanced]

login_ex.line: Commander, look! I got your office floor all sparkly-clean, buli! It feels even more like a secret base now!

main4_ex.line: If you keep working so late, I'll have to fix you up with my wrench, buli! It's for your own good!

main5_ex.line: I wanna go straight to the port's broadcasting station and tell everyone that you're my most valuable treasure, buli!

main6_ex.line: I made special, lovey-dovey coffee for you! That buli flavor will knock your socks off! ...Hm? Why is your face all scrunched up, buli?

touch2_ex.line: B-be careful, buli...

main2.line: Even though I look a bit like my sis now, she's still the only one in charge of super rares, bulin~

skill.line: Within my equipment is the power to end all creation!

win_mvp.line: Bulin! I've successfully buli buli'd the enemies!

login.line: Commander, look! My new outfit shines, like, bulibuliii! I'm shinier than the stars in the night sky!

lose.line: I'm all out of magic, buli...

main1.line: Bulin will protect the port, buli!

main2.line: Where's my magic wand, you ask? I use something much better: a magic wrench, buli!

touch2.line: M-my magic is being replenished, buli!

unlock.line: Bulibuli magical transformation! I'm Magical Girl Bulin, here to protect love and justice! I'm super awesome with my new powers, buli!

battle.line: Purin~! Don't stop until they kneel and cry!

detail.line: Staring at me all day won't turn you into an expert!

expedition.line: Yaaaay~! Commander! The girls who went out on a commission have come back! Let's drill something to celebrate!

feeling2.line: My sister is so dumb. When people talk about our colors, it's not about our hair, it's about ra... rari... ah, now I remember! Reality TV!

feeling3.line: I'll let you in on a little secret. My little sister keeps telling people that she's smarter than me. But truth is, she's dumber! I try to be nice and let her feel good about herself, like a big sister should. Ha!

feeling4.line: Whee~! I'm flying! So~ high! Hey, don't move! You'll have to catch me if I fall!

feeling5.line: You're not an average commander if you managed to conquer my heart. But I won't be shy or blush! Instead I'll give you a growl! Graaaah!

lose.line: So why am I on the battlefield anyway, purin?!

main1.line: Purin~! It's so big in here! There's so much room to run around!

main2.line: Oh right, it's not my job to just run around, is it? Purin~!

main3.line: Purin~? I'm too loud? Hmph, who cares what you think!

mission.line: Purin~! The next mission has been chosen for you!

mission_complete.line: I'm just heading out to fetch your rewards, purin! I promise I won't break them!

skill.line: My drill is the drill that will pierce the heavens!

touch.line: Purin~ You can't catch me!

touch2.line: Purin~ purin~! (Prototype Bulin MKII continues to spin faster)

unlock.line: Purin~! The herald of good fortune has arrived! Are you ready? Raise your hands and follow me... Purin~ purin~!

upgrade.line: [Cannot be enhanced]

gift_prefer.line: Flattering me won't get you anything!

battle.line: Purin! Behold my superpowered form!

main1.line: Purin! The port is sooo big! I can see every corner of it when I stand on my Super Drill MKII!

main2.line: Today's the day I'm gonna show my Prototype Super Drill MKII to everyone, purin! Will you be there, purin?

main3.line: Purin! It's time for my speech! ...What's it about? About my drill that pierces the heavens, obviously, purin!

touch.line: Purin! Are you ready to disembark with me, purin?

touch2.line: Purin? P-puriiin! Purin... *blushes*

unlock.line: Puriiin! The savior of the fleet disembarks, wielding a heaven-piercing drill in hand, purin! Heheh! I bet you're trembling with excitement at my latest and greatest work outfit, purin!

upgrade.line: [Purin! You cannot strengthen the Super Drill, purin!]

win_mvp.line: Purin! All the enemies were sooo shocked they ran away!

couple_encourage1.line: Bulin Brigade, busting through, bulin!

couple_encourage2.line: Let's make 'em taste the rainbow!

detail.line: If ever in doubt, just tell me to bonk it with my hammer, bulin!

expedition.line: Bulin! The commission team has returned with boatloads of rewards!

feeling1.line: You've lost your way, but don't give up! Pull yourself together, bulin!

feeling2.line: The other bulins are only one color, but I'm the whole rainbow! Which can only mean one thing: that I'm the strongest of the bunch, bulin!

feeling3.line: As thanks for always hanging with me, I'll let you borrow my Kitty Kabam Hammer for an hour, bulin! But don't use it for any mean stuff, okay?

feeling4.line: Are you sure you aren't hanging out with me too much, Commander? If this keeps up, the port will be in ruins soon, bulin!

feeling5.line: I was made to upgrade fleets, nothing more, and yet you're being so kind to me... I love you, Commander! Let me give you a special type of bonk, bulin! Hm? You'd rather not?

hp_warning.line: Oh heck! My health bar is glowing red, bulin!

skill.line: My hammer is the hammer that will bring down the stars, bulin!

touch.line: This bad boy is my "raison d'etre"! Be careful with it, or you'll get hurt, bulin!

main2.line: Heheh! Once we find Akashi's ledger, we'll have proof to pin on her, bulin!

main3.line: I'll keep your precious gems safe, bulin! Now let me help you calculate how much Akashi still owes, bulin!

touch2.line: Hm...? My chest doesn't hurt, so why'd you do that?

upgrade.line: No matter how tough the going gets, I will not let anyone down!

win_mvp.line: I did only what was expected of me. Everyone else deserves the rewards!

gift_prefer.line: Ah... Commander, thank you! I love this!

home.line: Commander, if you're tired, let me give you a massage.

login.line: According to the weather forecast, it's gonna be real sunny today.

main3.line: Does anyone need any help? ...Thank goodness, looks like everyone is doing well...

expedition.line: Work is finished...

feeling2.line: What is it, Commander? If you wanna have a chat with me then I doubt you'll have anything interesting to say...

feeling3.line: Hmm, how should I say this... If you're free, would you like to take a nap together?

feeling4.line: Commander, you don't seem like you've been sleeping well recently... Huh? It's because I keep moving over to your side of the bed?

feeling5.line: You're a real gentleman, Commander... but it's actually making me a little angry. Am I really... that unattractive to you?

login.line: Even you can't make me leave my room, Commander...

lose.line: What a pain... Might as well head back.

mail.line: New mail... Aren't you going to take a look?

main1.line: Don't you have anything to say? I'm not great at starting conversations...

main2.line: Oh, you want to know about my eyes? One of them is fake... Can you guess which?

main3.line: Everyone is back! That's good...

mission.line: Hm... We have some uncompleted missions, is that really fine?

mission_complete.line: Rewards have arrived... Looks like we did well...

profile.line: Mahan-class destroyer, Cassin. I get picked on for being top heavy and not being great at defending the skies... My left eye has nothing to do with the Solomon Islands, alright? Just leave it.

propose.line: Commander, you've been preparing this in secret this whole time? I'd have been fine with any kind of gift, but... thank you. I'm as happy as I can be.

touch.line: Mmm... I don't hate this feeling...

touch2.line: Are you interested in shut-in girls?

unlock.line: How do you do? I'm Cassin... If you have no business with me, I'd like to stay in the docks...

upgrade.line: Even if I get stronger... I'd rather stay in my room...

win_mvp.line: What? That was it?

gift_prefer.line: For me...? Oh, hmm... Thanks.

main2.line: I think Downes works here part-time. Just hope she doesn't kerplode anything...

main3.line: You could stock up on instant noodles so you won't have to go shopping for food for a good while. I think it's a good idea.

touch2.line: There's security cams in here, you know...

unlock.line: I know I said we'd go shopping after school, but walking is so exhausting... I'll just hitch a ride in this cart. Looks sturdy enough...

detail.line: Fwaah... Commander, I need to take another nap, so I'm leaving the rest to you...

main1.line: Mmh... just staying together quietly like this... might be pretty nice too.

main2.line: Wear my clothes properly? Eh...? Don't wanna~ More importantly, care for an Oxy Cola, Commander?

feeling4.line: Although I really shouldn't care... I still worry if my love will accept me like this... Huh?! Commander! When did you get here? No, it's nothing. I was just... t-t... talking to myself!

feeling5.line: Commander, um... what should I say... I... my body may... be full of holes... but my heart is whole... and I give it all... to you...

lose.line: Ow ow ow... My magazine's been...

touch.line: Ah, that's the spot, right there~

touch2.line: You looking to get bitten?

main2.line: Mississippi will bring me back home just fine if I get lost!

main3.line: Commander, have you seen Sara? I want to try my new camera!

mission.line: The mission area is so pretty~ C'mon, let's go take some photos!

mission_complete.line: The rewards are here~! Now we can buy new some film!

profile.line: I'm the first ship of the Gridley-class, and I was very active in the Pacific theater. But never mind that now, Commander. Want to look at photos of Sara?

propose.line: Commander, Commander! Strike a pose! 1... 2... 3! Cheese! ...That was a great shot! We'll get a copy each after we develop the film~

touch.line: Aaah, that tickles~! I can't keep the camera straight~

touch2.line: Commander! If you do that again, I'll photograph it and report it to the police~

unlock.line: Nice to meet you, Commander! I'm Gridley. I once escorted Saratoga~ She's such a cutie!

upgrade.line: Now I can snap even more photos of Sara!

win_mvp.line: Ten out of ten! Commander, Commander! Take a photo of me too!

gift_prefer.line: I'll give this to Saratoga! Thanks, Commander!

main1.line: Christmas special edition Saratoga photos, one thousand dollars each! Guhehe~ my fangirl power level increases during the holiday season!

main2.line: Commander, can you take some photos of me with Saratoga?

main3.line: Thanks for the waterproof camera, Commander! I'll be sure to take good care of it!

touch.line: What's in this bag? Guhehe~ an album of premium Saratoga photos! As long as I have this, she will always be at my side!

touch2.line: Uwaah! Don't take any pictures!

unlock.line: Commander, Merry Christmas! Guhehe~ Won't you attend my "Super Special Sexy Sara (tentative)" photoshoot event?

battle.line: C'mon, everyone~ Let's fight with all we've got today~☆!

detail.line: Ahh~ Commander! D-don't get so close all of a sudden!

expedition.line: No matter where they go, I'll always be my sisters' chealeader! C'mon, Commander! Lets go and greet them!

feeling1.line: I'll go cheer someone else on instead. I might not be coming back today!

feeling2.line: Cheering, outside of work? I don't... quite understand what you mean...

feeling3.line: You don't look very energetic, Commander. Should I pat you on the head to cheer you up?

feeling4.line: If you ever want me to, Commander, I-I would love to come and cheer you on any time...

feeling5.line: You. Can. Do. It. Co-man-der! L! O! V! E! Co-man-der! L! O! V! E! Did my cheers of love reach your heart?

home.line: Perfect! We've earned a flawless curtain call today!

login.line: Leave today's halftime cheering to me, Commander!

lose.line: Oh no... My cheering must not have worked...

mail.line: You've got new mail! Any inspirational messages to share?

main1.line: Even if it's time to rest, we've got to keep fighting and dancing. Never give up!

main2.line: Northampton thinks she can take me down? Hmph!

main3.line: Fight~ Come on~ Eagle Union~ ☆!

mission.line: We've still got unfinished missions, Commander!

mission_complete.line: I've got your rewards, Commander. Surely they must include some sort of surprise?

profile.line: I'm Craven, second ship of the Gridley-class, at your command. As a high speed torpedo destroyer, I was active in the Pacific theater with my little sisters, mainly tasked with night battle support.

propose.line: Commander, now we need to make a cheerleading team just for you. Hm? Of course I'll be the coach! Nobody else has feelings for you like I do!

touch.line: Commander, I can feel your encouragement. I'll work even harder!

touch2.line: E-even if you're just trying to encourage me, there's... there's this thing called being too passionate!

unlock.line: Second ship of the Gridley-class, Craven, reporting in. Leave the halftime cheering to me!

upgrade.line: Now I'll be able to cheer on everyone even harder!

win_mvp.line: Huh, I was just cheering everyone on... Oh well, this works too~

gift_prefer.line: Wow! Thanks, Commander! I'll cherish this.

main1.line: When you are overwhelmed by all this learning, go for a jog to relax yourself!

main2.line: If you're struggling with the material, then find a tutor. If that doesn't work, get special training...nothing can’t be solved through special training!

main3.line: The Commander has always been the best in my heart, so I have to be in his heart, too!

touch.line: These courses are too hard...Commander, can you tutor me?

touch2.line: I'm on fire!

unlock.line: I much rather cheer for my Commander than go to class...but no matter where I go, I will definitely give it my all! Commander, wait for me to come back as the top student of this school year.

battle.line: We have to fight? Guess I couldn't avoid it forever...

detail.line: Sorry, can we keep it brief? I need a new popsicle.

expedition.line: ...Oh, everyone's back. I'll go get some popsicles.

feeling1.line: (McCall continues licking her popsicle and acts like she didn't notice you.)

feeling2.line: I heard those Sakura Empire girls sit around and drink tea all afternoon. I'd like to try that some day!

feeling3.line: Tips for daydreaming? Empty your mind and don't think about anything. Don't forget about your popsicle before it melts, though...

feeling4.line: Want a taste of my popsicle, Commander? Ah, yeah, it'd be like an indirect kiss, but that's fine... Anyway, can I daydream for a bit and lean on your back?

feeling5.line: I used to hope that my days of just eating popsicles and daydreaming would go on forever. But after meeting you, Commander, I think I might have been wrong...

home.line: It's kinda hot in here, got anything to help me cool down?

login.line: Commander, can't I just sit around here for today instead?

lose.line: Whoa, I got so scared I dropped my popsicle...

mail.line: *Sigh* There's no end to all this mail...

main1.line: We all get along around here, don't you think? Care for a popsicle?

main2.line: Ahh... Hawaii was so hot. I felt like I was melting...

main3.line: ... Ah! Oh no! My popsicle melted.

mission.line: Missions, huh? Whatever happens, happens.

mission_complete.line: Help me pack up these rewards... Hey, can we have them sent to my house?

profile.line: I'm McCall, third ship of the Gridley-class. There isn't much special about me, except that I've lived as long as my big sisters. I'm just relieved know that they're doing well.

propose.line: My life's changed ever since I met you, Commander... I'm sure we'll get to do many new things together. But there's one thing I hope won't ever change: that I'll be together with you...

skill.line: Let's finish this before my popsicle melts!

touch.line: ... Are you trying to encourage me?

touch2.line: Ah, it's so hot...

unlock.line: Hello, Commander. Just call me McCall. I like to sleep, daydream, and eat popsicles. Please assign me somewhere peaceful, will you?

upgrade.line: Hm... It's nothing special.

win_mvp.line: "Slay the enemy while your blade is still warm"... Is that true for popsicles as well? Oh, it melted...

gift_prefer.line: I'd love this better if you unwrapped it for me, too.

battle.line: Lets finish this quick before I get hungry!

detail.line: Umm... Why are you always watching me do my warm-ups? Do you like watching me sweat?

expedition.line: I need to get some exercise... Commander, a commission just got completed, so could you send me out on the next one?

feeling1.line: Sorry, I've got some training to do, so I gotta go!

feeling2.line: Commander, is it really okay for you to sit around all day? Get outside and do some sports!

feeling3.line: Want me to teach you how to run faster, Commander? There's quite a lot to it, actually.

feeling4.line: I feel like I can run even farther when I'm next to you, Commander. What an incredible feeling!

feeling5.line: Commander, how about going on a jog with me? I want to share the beautiful scenery I find with you.

headtouch.line: Hm? Is this your way of... cheering me on?

home.line: Rest now so that we can sprint faster later!

hp_warning.line: Urgh! Need to go faster...

login.line: Commander, want to do some warm-ups with me?

lose.line: ... I need to get back before everyone starts worrying about me.

mail.line: You've got new mail. It's about that celebratory party, isn't it?

main1.line: Commander, want to work out a bit? Sitting for so long is terrible for your body!

main2.line: I thought we were going for some long distance trip at Wake Island again.

main3.line: I swear it wasn't my tummy making that noise!

mission.line: You've still got some missions to finish up, Commander! Put your back into it, it's the final stretch!

mission_complete.line: Phew~ I'm exhausted... Save some Oxy-cola for me when the rewards arrive!

profile.line: I'm Maury, the fourth ship of the Gridley-class destroyer squadron. Although I'm the youngest of my class, I'm also the fastest short-distance Union ship! I'm prone to getting hungry a lot? Well, they say that light meals make you live longer, don't they?

propose.line: No matter how fast I run, I can't escape my feelings for you, Commander...

touch.line: Are you helping me recover? ... Thank you...

touch2.line: ...!! Hey! There's a line you shouldn't cross when giving massages.

unlock.line: You can just call me Maury. As a track athlete, I hold the Union's speed record, reaching a maximum speed of 42.8 knots. Just don't make me run a marathon...

upgrade.line: Not enough... I can still go faster...!

win_mvp.line: Like I said, those guys can't keep up with me!

gift_prefer.line: *nom nom*... Phew! Thanks, Commander. I'll cherish this!

detail.line: I'd love to give you a hug, but I just got done working out, and I have to take a shower. You may not mind the sweat, but I... Well, it's embarrassing for me

expedition.line: The team that went out on a commission is back. I'll run out and welcome them back first.

feeling5.line: Commander, I found a route with some incredible scenery! We could run together from the starting point all the way to the finish line... That is, assuming you want to, of course.

headtouch.line: Heehee. I can still run even faster.

home.line: Fantastic work, Commander! You must be tired after going so far. Do you want a relaxing massage?

login.line: Arriving by your side at maximum speed! Whew... This isn't tiring at all, really. Just give me a call, and I'll be right by you, no matter how far away you are.

main1.line: I actually had a hunch that you were looking for me just now. That's what they call athlete's intuition!

main2.line: You've earned yourself a break. Do you want to go on a relaxing jog with me? Don't worry – if you run out of energy on the way, I'll carry you back!

main3.line: What a perfect day for some exercise! Commander, how about– *grumble*... Um, how about we grab a bite to charge our batteries?

mission.line: Commander! You should remember to check your unfinished missions. I'll help you once you're near the finish line.

mission_complete.line: That's the paperwork done, at last. What do you say to a little exercise to freshen up?

touch.line: This massage feels really nice... Can I give you one next?

touch2.line: You're massaging THIS spot?! ...Um, it's fine! I don't mind!

unlock.line: Maury, fourth ship of the Gridley-class destroyer squadron, is back with new equipment! I feel like I can run even faster than before! Commander, can we go for a test run?

battle.line: There's only a handful of enemies. Let's beat them with sheer numbers!

detail.line: I can move quickly, so I probably won't get hit. Well... even if I do, I'll... probably be fine.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed! Let's see what's next... Wow, there's so many! Almost one for each of my little sisters...

feeling1.line: S-sorry, I have to go check up on my little sisters...

feeling2.line: Whew... I need to take care of my sisters so much that I don't really have time to think about anything else...

feeling3.line: Commander, can you help me a little bit? Thank you... You're stronger than me, after all... I'm a little jealous.

feeling4.line: Out of all of us in the fleet... Who do you personally like the most, Commander? ... Counting me as well?

feeling5.line: Hm? You want to help me take care of my little sisters? There's a lot of them, and I could use the help, but... Are you really, REALLY sure? In that case... Can I think about it for a bit first...?

home.line: I'm back~ Wait, huh? Did another one of my little sisters join the fleet while I was gone?

login.line: Can you recognize me today, Commander? My sisters don't look like this!

lose.line: *Sob*... You bullies... My sisters will hurt you if they find out about this!

mail.line: Who has been writing so many letters to you, Commander? I'm a bit curious...

main1.line: Last time someone tried to impersonate me, one of my little sisters told them to name EVERY Fletcher-class ship. That's when they gave up the act~

main2.line: When I look at my little sisters, it makes me wonder... Maybe our parents were rabbits?

main3.line: ... Commander? Really... Are you thinking about one of my sisters again?

mission.line: I can go on missions with my sisters again. Give the order whenever you're ready, Commander!

mission_complete.line: I wonder if all my sisters can get an equal share of the rewards...

profile.line: I'm Fletcher, the big sister of all 175 Fletcher-class destroyers! As the main force of the destroyer fleet, I participated in all the important naval battles~

propose.line: A family, huh? ... I already have so many sisters, but you're special to me after all, Commander!

touch.line: My little sisters would probably like doing this too. Huh? Your hand would get sore from it?

touch2.line: C-Commander, please stop! What if my sisters see this...

unlock.line: Hm? You think we've met before? I get it... You know, I have over 100 sisters who look like me! I'll be following your orders from now on, Commander.

upgrade.line: Now I can take better care of my sisters!

win_mvp.line: I've heard that if you collect fifteen stars then one of your wishes will come true~!

gift_prefer.line: A-are you sure about this?! I mean, if it's possible... could all my sisters get one as well?!

battle.line: Ooh! I just got an idea!

couple_encourage1.line: An adventure? Let me join you! I've got a good idea!

couple_encourage2.line: Need help testing your equipment? I'm always available!

detail.line: I'm William D. Porter, and this is Happy D, my trusty partner! Together, we zip and zoom through the air without a fear in the– Whuaaahhh! Going too fast! I can't control it!

expedition.line: Commander, get on my Happy D and we'll go welcome the girls back! Ready? Supersonic takeoff, let's g– Whuaahhh!

feeling1.line: Man... I could go for something fun...

feeling2.line: I can prooobably fix up that report I splashed with soda using a hot iron... Whuah?! When'd you get here, Commander?! ...Ask about my report? Uh, it'll be done in a jiffy!

feeling3.line: I came up with an idea that fixed that mega-giga problem we had! Gimme some praise, Commander! ...Yay! I'll be sure to come up with something even better next time!

feeling4.line: Commander, get on my rigging, quick! Going on an adventure with friends without you just feels sad!

feeling5.line: I take proposing to you super seriously, y'know. I'd never fumble the bag on something as important as– Oh no! I said it! I was gonna propose to you tomorrow, and I just let it slip!

headtouch.line: A headpat a day keeps the bad luck away!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Huggies! Oopsie, I've got glue on my hands! Oh noes! Now we're totally joined together! Well, looks like we'll just have to "stick together" for a while now, huh? Heehee!

hp_warning.line: Uh-oh! Gotta think of something, quick!

login.line: *yawn*... I got here before the working day started! Surprised? ...Hey, what's with that "I don't buy it" look on your face? You know, I've got a hundred ideas to make sure I'm not late!

lose.line: Dangit! Blew it again...

mail.line: Got some letters for– Whuaahh! I tripped... The letters got everywhere... I'll pick 'em up right away!

main1.line: Oh shoot! I spilled my ice cream! Oh gosh, what do I do?! Gotta wipe it off... Happy, Happy, Happy D! In a flash, you'll be squeaky clean!

main2.line: I'm so sorry, Commander! I didn't spill paint on your new carpet on purpose or anything! Ugh... Could you just please get me out of this stuff?

main3.line: To cut a long story short, I dropped a bomb into the ocean where it can do no harm! ...Why did I have a bomb, you ask? Ahahaha... Look, it's a long story...

main4.line: Lookie, Commander! That hole in the ground is shaped just like me! Pretty cool, huh? Wait... Come to think of it, isn't this where I fell yesterday?

mission.line: Commander, you've still got missions to do! If you can't figure something out, I'm here to offer advice!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete?! Are we allowed to just breeze through them?!

profile.line: Eagle Union Fletcher-class destroyer William D. Porter, that's me! I've caused my fair bit of trouble before, but everything worked out okay in the end... Hey, wait, is it just me, or am I missing a torpedo?

propose.line: We finally made it to this point! Wait, where's the ring? D-don't tell me I dropped it?! ...What? It's on my other hand! Oh, you're right! Phew... Here I thought I'd gone and blundered again!

skill.line: Here comes a super-effectively good idea!

touch.line: You desperately want some help?! Fear not! I've got a good idea!

touch2.line: Ahahahaha! Th-that tickles! Okay, I'm sorry! I won't do it again!

unlock.line: We finally get to meet, Commander! Whoosh, wow, THUD! Oops, I miscalculated the landing point and nearly rammed into you with my Happy D here... Anyway! I'm the absolutely dazzling William D. Porter, and I'm joining you now with some absolutely amazing ideas!

upgrade.line: Ooh! I'm feeling SO motivated!

win_mvp.line: Woohoo! I'll admit, this turned out nothing like how I imagined it, but all's well that ends well with a surprise victory, right?

gift_prefer.line: Oh my gosh! You... You have no idea how much I wanted this!

feeling5_ex.line: I've been taking really good care of the stuff you gave me! What stuff? The memories I made with you, my sweetie, on our adventure, obviously!

headtouch_ex.line: I'm topped up on Commander energy! I've got the drive to do anything!

login_ex.line: Welcome, Commander! I've been waiting my butt off! Loads of fun stuff happened while you were gone, but doing fun stuff by yourself is no good! Heehee – come on, praise my good behavior!

main5_ex.line: We should totally ride the roller coaster! It'll be loads of fun! ...Wait, huh? Where are my tickets? Fine, dangit! Riding Happy D to race the roller coaster should be fun too!

main6_ex.line: Oh no! Happy D's out of energy and we're gonna fall! Commander, hold on to me! W-we'll make it out of this fine... won't we?!

main7_ex.line: Wonder where we should go next... You know what? You decide, Commander! You're bound to have a fun idea!

main8_ex.line: Whenever I'm by your side, I'm filled with endless courage! Next time WILL go better than the last!

touch_ex.line: I'm gonna sneak up behind you then leap into a hug! ...Shoot! Owwie...

touch2_ex.line: You can't wait a minute longer?! M-me neither!

feeling5.line: Commandeeer! Seeing you has totally swept away all my nervousness and worries! Lemme give you a little hug before I go and be a maid!

home.line: W-welcome back, Commander! Ugh, I'm in so much trouble! Please, you've gotta help me!

login.line: You're finally here, Commander! Happy D can be such a troublemaker, I tell you... What? I-it was me? But I just wanted to take a shortcut to the pop-up shop at maximum speed... Ahahaha...

lose.line: Up! Up! ...Whuah! Commander! Happy D won't do as I tell it to!

mail.line: You've got mail! Whaddya say this cute maid of yours reads it out for you?

main1.line: I made this appointment today to thank you for getting me outta trouble before, only to end up causing trouble for YOU... I'll make up for it by giving you double the maid service time!

main2.line: Where are you now, Commander? I'd appreciate your help with something... What trouble am I in, you ask? Uh, ahahaha... It'll cease to be trouble once you show up, I hope...

main3.line: Um, the hole in the clock tower wasn't my fault! I was just flying near it when suddenly... Hey, wait, why am I missing a torpedo?

main4.line: Hello? Commander? Do you hear me? Weird... Surely the phone line's not down 'cause of me... Oh! Commander! I thought I was in even deeper trouble for a sec there...

mission.line: Commander, it's time for your missions! I may have my hands tied right now, but I can still give you reminders!

touch.line: Oh no... Does this mean it's time for my punishment?

touch2.line: C-Commander?! When'd you get inside the booth?!

unlock.line: Commander, um, we agreed that I'd be a maid for a day, right? Ahahaha... See, I couldn't make it in time. Ran into a teensy bit of trouble, and, well... Basically, I need you to come help me!

battle.line: Little Beavers, full speed ahead at 31 knots! Keep an eye on your sides!

couple_encourage1.line: Beavers, full speed ahead at 31 knots!

couple_encourage2.line: Who's been naughty?

couple_encourage3.line: Justice will prevail!

detail.line: Weapons and gear are the iron fists of justice!

expedition.line: A commission of justice has just been completed!

feeling1.line: You're the embodiment of evil itself, Commander!

feeling2.line: Commander, there's still much injustice in this world, so we can't just stand around and do nothing!

feeling3.line: Being partners in justice is never easy. But you've got Ausburne by your side, so I'm sure we'll be fine!

feeling4.line: The path of justice is a lonely one. It's rare to have a partner on such a difficult path... What I mean is... I... D-do you want to read some stories about justice with me?

feeling5.line: In the stories I read, the hero always goes back to his normal life after defeating evil with his partners. I have to say, I feel a bit sad reading an ending like this...

home.line: Good work, everyone!

hp_warning.line: Justice will prevail!

login.line: Good day, Commander. Charles Ausburne, Captain of the Little Beavers, reporting in! Are there any naughty kids who need to be disciplined today?

lose.line: I'll be back! Justice will prevail! *Sob*...

mail.line: Your mail? Of course! We need help from others if we want to make this world a just one. Reply as soon as you can!

main1.line: Become a friend of justice with me!

main2.line: Justice is justice~!

main3.line: My sonar shows... it looks like your heart is beating extra fast, Commander!

mission.line: Commander, let's finish it in one go! Now is the chance to deliver swift justice!

mission_complete.line: Your rewards have arrived. It's always nice to be rewarded for your hard work, don't you think?

profile.line: I'm Charles Ausburne of the Fletcher-class, and the world famous Captain of the Little Beavers! I showed my true colors at the Cape of St. George. Want to be my partner in justice, Commander?

propose.line: ... Are you sure you want to give this... to me? You've really chosen me? Then I'll follow you until the end!

skill.line: Accept your punishment in the name of justice!

touch.line: Mmm, I feel the justice coming from you!

touch2.line: !!... Uh oh... You're evil, Commander!

unlock.line: Nice to meet you, Commander! I'm Charles Ausburne, Captain of the Little Beavers. Whoever picks on the hopeless and defenseless will receive their punishment in due time!

upgrade.line: This is the power of justice!

win_mvp.line: See? This is the real strength of the Little Beavers!

gift_prefer.line: This will be used for justice. Thank you.

feeling5_ex.line: "Even after banishing the forces of evil, the allies of justice did not separate. Instead, they were bound together by the ties formed through fighting alongside each other and lived happily ever after!" –Alrighty! That's the ending I came up with! Pretty awesome, huh?

home_ex.line: Good work out there, everyone! And Commander, upholding justice is fine and all, but don't forget to rest as well!

login_ex.line: Here comes Captain Ausburne of the Little Beavers! Let's give it our all today, as fellow allies of justice!

main4_ex.line: I heard that if you go on an adventure together with your fellow ally of justice, the two of you will be able to strengthen your bonds... A date? What's that supposed to be...?

main5_ex.line: Justice exists not only to defeat evil, but to also protect our precious here-and-now! Let's keep our beautiful oceans safe!

main6_ex.line: According to my radar, your heart is throbbing fast right now... Ah, wait, why is mine throbbing as well?

touch_ex.line: Wooah! I can feel the warmth of justice's power flowing through me!

touch2_ex.line: Uhh, erm, I don't think this counts as justice...

win_mvp_ex.line: Justice! Always! Wins! Heheh~

detail.line: Cannons and riggings make up the fist of justice. Honesty and bravery make up the beating heart of justice!

home.line: Good work, everyone! Hehe, even justice needs to rest~

hp_warning.line: Justice won't be defeated so easily!

login.line: Commander, Ausburne is ready to go at any time! I'll always be there to rush to the aid of people in need!

main1.line: Our allies of justice become more and more numerous! But, don't get overconfident just because we're getting stronger!

main2.line: Commander, don't be fooled by those evildoers who pretend to be righteous! With your heart of justice, you'll be able to see right through them!

main3.line: Woah, is this the "Superhero of Justice's Armaments" that Reno was talking about? It's freakin' cool!

touch.line: Haah! I'll transfer my power of justice to you, Commander!

touch2.line: *gasp*!! ...As a disciple of justice, how could you have such evil thoughts?!

unlock.line: Captain Ausburne of the Little Beavers, upgraded and ready to go! Heh heh, my new-and-improved justice isn't just for show! Evildoers are gonna be in for a bad time!

battle.line: I missed the Turkey Shoot last time, but this battle is mine!

detail.line: Don't touch my radar! It's our most effective weapon against the enemy during the night!

expedition.line: Another commission complete! I sure hope the girls didn't run into any kamikazes.

feeling1.line: You're so boring now, Commander...

feeling2.line: You're still upset about that prank? You're no fun!

feeling3.line: Commander, I want to always be able to play tricks on you, but... Do you hate me for that?

feeling4.line: What would you do if I told you I liked you? Hehe, I'm just joking~!

feeling5.line: Close your eyes, Commander~... *Kiss* Did you feel that? That wasn't me... Okay, it was!

home.line: Good work, Commander! Want me to help you relax? Don't worry, I won't play any tricks on you~!

login.line: What tricks should we play on the other girls today, Commander? Heehee~!

lose.line: Damn it! My prank failed! Ahh, Spence, get outta the way, I'll end up bumping into you!

mail.line: You've got new mail! I-I'm not hiding it this time!

main1.line: Commander, don't just stand there, come play with me!

main2.line: Hahaha, look! Spence's reactions are so hilarious!

main3.line: Since I don't know when I'll do something wrong, I'll just go ahead and apologize now.

mission.line: The game isn't over yet. Don't be lazy!

mission_complete.line: I'll take these rewards off your hands if you don't want them, Commander!

profile.line: I'm Thatcher from the Little Beavers. I'm named after Rear Admiral Henry K. Thatcher. Awesome, right? Aren't you surprised?

propose.line: Just so you know: you're totally wrong if you think my pranks will end just because I got this ring! My pranks are an expression of love. So, I'm expecting you to take~ good~ care~ of~ me~!

touch.line: I know what it is you really want to touch, weirdo!

touch2.line: Hoho? You wanna touch me there again?

unlock.line: Hi there, Commander! I'm Thatcher. Want to play a game with me?

upgrade.line: Aha! I came up with a new prank!

win_mvp.line: Pranking Tactics: super effective!

gift_prefer.line: This is really nice! ...Wait, are you trying to wrap me up in ribbons, too?!

battle.line: Sssh, be quiet! We need to coordinate with our sisters preparing to flank the enemy.

detail.line: Don't forget to keep your gear in working order, Commander!

expedition.line: The girls are back from their adventure!

main3.line: Commander, do your best! Believe in yourself, you're the greatest!

mission.line: Work hard to finish your missions, Commander~

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards, huh... Should I also prepare something for you, Commander?

profile.line: The Fletcher-class is pretty big, so it's not strange that you haven't heard of me. Though I had my fair share of dangerous moments, I managed to return peacefully. Right after that, I even went to live the Dragon Empery for a while! Is that why you think I look a bit bigger? Who knows~

propose.line: Commander, would you like me to keep cooking for you every day, even after a long, long time? Hm, you'd like there to be fewer weird dishes? Hehe, I guess I can manage that~

touch.line: Uhh... the black smoke coming from that side of the kitchen? Ahaha... ha... I have no idea what you're talking about~

touch2.line: C-Commander... so you're also interested in the racy stuff...

unlock.line: Hello Commander, I am the Fletcher-class destroyer, Mullany. From today onwards, we'll be spending a lot of time together. Please take good care of me!

upgrade.line: Ah! An inspiration for my new recipe!

win_mvp.line: I'm number one? Um... as long as I can be of help to you, I'll be happy...

gift_prefer.line: Wow! Is it someone's birthday or something?

feeling5.line: Cooking for someone else... is a whole different experience. Cooking for you? Hm, I'd say that's a bit of a heart-racing sensation, hehe~

headtouch.line: Commander, are you... interested in my new hairstyle?

login.line: Would you like to have some soup dumplings?

main1.line: nil

main2.line: nil

main3.line: nil

mission.line: Today's business is best done today, Commander.

touch.line: The elegance of ladies from the Empery, walking with their parasols opened, is a sight to behold. So, I picked up a few things from them - want to see?

touch2.line: C-Commander, some self-restraint, please...

unlock.line: What's with the weird look, Commander? Ah, I got this outfit while studying abroad in the Dragon Empery. Umm... does it suit me?

win_mvp.line: The things I learned in the Dragon Empery came in handy.

battle.line: Everyone, let's give it our all!

couple_encourage1.line: Lexington, I'm always here to protect you~

couple_encourage2.line: Dewey, take a close look at my skills~!

detail.line: Commander, who do you like more - Lexington, or Saratoga? Or... perhaps some other girl has caught your eye?

expedition.line: The military commission has been completed. Commander, why don't we head down together to welcome everyone back?

feeling1.line: Commander, listen up. If this continues on, I'll be keeping my distance from you...

feeling2.line: Commander, you're not too busy right now, are you? Umm, I'd like to... here, I have a little bit of candy for you~♪ Some sugar is good for the brain!

feeling3.line: Compared to Dewey, I'm only a tiny bit more... H-huh? I'm not chubby! Jeez, Commander, I'm not talking to you anymore!

feeling4.line: Commander, you're the type who likes it when there's a bit more to love, right? ... I'll drink plenty of milk and eat lots of candy every day so that I can be your ideal type~

feeling5.line: Commander, what's different about me today? Have you noticed yet? ...You still haven't noticed it? Hurry, hurry, hurry up and notice it, okay?

home.line: Commander, you're finally back~! Did you bring back some some delicious treats for us? Thank you so much! I'll be helping myself~♪

hp_warning.line: I'm... I'm still okay... probably...

login.line: Commander, welcome back. It's the start of a bright new day!

lose.line: Oops, guess I lost... Commander, can you give me some candy to cheer me up...?

mail.line: Hm? There seems to be some new mail... Hrmm... Ah! Now, this seems like some good news!

main1.line: I had a dream that I would one day share the stage with Lexington. If I could sing and dance just like her, which one of us would you support?

main2.line: *pouts* Another training exercise? You keep saying next time... I want to sortie and go on real missions with everyone else!

main3.line: Dewey really looks after me. Maybe she's also one of Lexington's fans, hehe~!

mission.line: New missions have been posted~ Let's hurry up and set sail! Just kidding, we still have plenty of time right now.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! It's a pretty good haul isn't it, Commander~

profile.line: I am Aylwin, from the Eagle Union. During the war, I carried out many operations as well as training exercises, and had some ties with both the Royal Navy and Iris Libre. I admire elegant, mature women like Lexington. Commander, I look forward to working with you!

propose.line: Commander, I don't mind if you have a thing for Lexington. But you have to swear that you absolutely love me, okay? I try my best every single day to be your ideal girl, so don't take your eyes off me, okay?

skill.line: Looks like it's time for Aylwin to get serious!

touch.line: Commander, do you need something~?

touch2.line: Jeez, Commander... That's a foul, you know?

unlock.line: Greetings, my name is Aylwin. I'm actually quite talented at nautical navigation, so please allow me to be your guide.

upgrade.line: Hmm... I don't particularly feel any different. Whatever, a gain is a gain~

win_mvp.line: Yay, I'm the MVP! Surely a wonderful commander like you would have something nice for me, right~

gift_prefer.line: A present...? I love it. Thank you, Commander!

battle.line: What I saw just now could prove useful for anti-submarine operations...

detail.line: I'm feeling a little peckish... Umm, cookies, candy, and... Ah, I musn't... I have to leave enough for Commander...

login.line: How do you do, Commander? How's that? I learned how to curtsy from the Royal Navy maids~

main1.line: Even though I spent a lot of time training with the submarines, it's a totally different experience to enjoy the sight underwater.

main2.line: This outfit was chosen painstakingly, you know? Commander, what do you think...?

main3.line: Want to go see Lexington's performance together next time? I'll even get your ticket for you if you'd like.

touch2.line: Commander, did you get some perverted ideas...?

unlock.line: So this is an aquarium... What a novel experience! Oh, also, I won't be your guide today as it's your turn to escort me around, Commander. Please don't get us lost, okay? Ehehe~

win_mvp.line: A most graceful and elegant victory. Ehehe, thank you for your praise~

battle.line: Combat mode, activate! Set sail!

couple_encourage1.line: This is the Little Beavers' justice mode!

detail.line: What are you staring at? I'm not going to transform...

expedition.line: Next time you're sending a commission, let Stanly handle the escort duty!

feeling1.line: Stanly is now operating in disappointment mode! Hmph!

feeling2.line: Stanly's in happy mode today – I can take on any task with a spring in my step!

feeling3.line: The other members of the Little Beaver Squad are fun to hang out with, but I still have the best time when I'm with you, Commander!

feeling4.line: As long as I'm with you, my happiness gauge will continue to fill up! So, Commander, please stay and play with me for a while.

feeling5.line: Warning, Stanly has entered the "will self-destruct if not within a 3-meter radius of Commander" mode... I-I'm serious! So, I'm going to make sure I'm never separated from you, heehee~

home.line: Yo... When'd you get back, Commander? Stanly's rest mode still needs a while to run its course.

hp_warning.line: C-convert to defense mode!

login.line: Stanly has entered work mode! By the way, it doesn't last very long.

lose.line: Crap, gotta switch to retreat mode pronto!

mail.line: There's a news update! Don't say I didn't tell you!

main1.line: Commander, join me in becoming a hero of justice... Bahaha! Just kidding!

main2.line: Commander, are you still in work mode? Jeez, don't keep me waiting much longer...

main3.line: Commander, your hair sure is funny! Let's give it a good twirl~!

mission.line: I wish I had some mode that would let me skip the daily grind...

mission_complete.line: Whoa! The rewards are here! Commander, let's go take a look!

profile.line: In the past, I've escorted many of my allies, and served in the Battle of Empress Augusta Bay as a member of the Little Beaver Squadron. As long as I'm in my serious mode, I'm really reliable in both day and night battles.

propose.line: Commander, your hand, please... Good, connection complete! From now on, we will be able to communicate telepathically! Heehee, do you feel how happy I am?

touch.line: Self-defense mode activating... Bahaha, you should've seen your face!

touch2.line: Sorry to disappoint, but I don't have a hot and bothered mode.

unlock.line: Good morning, Commander. I'm Stanly, a destroyer from the Eagle Union. I will follow your every order to bring you victory... Pffft! Bahaha! S-Sorry, this whole "serious introduction" thing totally cramps my style, haha!

upgrade.line: Strengthening complete! I'm gonna reward myself to a little rest and relaxation!

win_mvp.line: Heheh! MVP belongs to me!

gift_prefer.line: Oooh! I'm super satisfied!

battle.line: Let's get warmed up!

couple_encourage1.line: Fletcher, back me up!

detail.line: Baltimore...? Oh, Commander... I didn't notice you because I was training.

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. Commander, want to race me to the piers?

feeling1.line: Do whatever you want. I'm going back to training. See you.

feeling2.line: Commander, how about getting some exercise?

feeling3.line: Commander, want to go buy some workout equipment on our next day off? Using it properly will get you better results!

feeling4.line: Commander, I see you also appreciate the feeling of making gains. Mhm, we really do understand each other.

feeling5.line: It'd be fun to have someone who looks out after you and helps you out... Commander, let's get stronger together!

home.line: Here's a towel. Use it to wipe off your sweat.

hp_warning.line: Should've worked out harder...

login.line: Commander, can I train in your office?

lose.line: Well, that's awkward...

mail.line: New mail? I'll get it for you. Give me 10, no, 8 seconds.

main1.line: Commander, I'll show you some exercises. You can even do these while sitting down. Not moving around is bad for your health.

main2.line: There are very few restrictions to what you can do in kickboxing. However, it's not very useful in naval combat... so that's why it's just a hobby.

main3.line: I want to spar with the battleships. They all seem strong.

mission.line: Using missions to test your worth? I like that idea.

mission_complete.line: The feeling of testing my abilities is far better than any reward.

profile.line: Fletcher-class destroyer, Smalley. I did radar pickets, patrols, rescues, diplomatic functions, and basically a bit of everything. My hobbies...? Do I really have to repeat what I said before?

propose.line: Don't worry, Commander. We've worked hard together all this time, so I can guess what you're thinking. I understand your feelings... but I'm not sure how I should respond... Um, of course! If you're fine with me, I'd love to!

touch.line: Commander, want me to show you the ropes? It's good for self-defense.

touch2.line: Eat my... roundhouse kick!

unlock.line: Destroyer Smalley, reporting in. Interests: kickboxing.

upgrade.line: Thank you. My body feels lighter.

win_mvp.line: Hmm, not bad.

gift_prefer.line: For me...? Thanks.

detail.line: I can help everyone out and get some training in at the same time. This is the kind of work that I like.

home.line: Candy? Forget it, eating too much of that junk will just erase all your gains... Fine, just one...

login.line: Let's use this jack-o-lantern to decorate your office. I'm putting it right here.

main1.line: Rumors of wasabi-flavored candy? Never heard of it. I'm just the delivery witch.

main2.line: Ghosts and monsters? If they exist, line 'em up and I'll knock 'em down.

main3.line: My broom? Who needs to fly when you can just run faster.

touch.line: Is there anything you'd like me to deliver?

touch2.line: ...! Witch uppercut!

unlock.line: I am the courier of the night. In other words, it's my job to bring stuff straight to you, Commander. Here you go, this jack-o-lantern is for you.

battle.line: I, Halsey Powell, shall lead this fleet to victory!

detail.line: Ehehe~ See, Commander, you're totally into me after all, aren't you~?

expedition.line: The commission fleet is returning? I'll go greet them! ...That's right, the more you put yourself out there, the quicker you can make a name for yourself!

feeling1.line: Just you wait! When I become the most famous person at the port...!

feeling2.line: All right! I'm going to put my best foot forward for everyone to see!

feeling3.line: It might be hard to stand out from the rest of the Fletchers, but... Commander, I know you'll be able to come up with something!

feeling4.line: It's going to be hard to capture everyone's attention here, but... but... Yeah, I'll start by making sure I have your undivided attention!

feeling5.line: I like it when you shower me with attention, Commander~ Ehehe... However! At this rate, I'm going to end up as some simple-minded girl who can throw away her dreams as long as she gets to cling to you! ...Though that doesn't sound half bad... But, forget it! Ehehe!

home.line: Gah! Commander, I bet you took advantage of the fact that I wouldn't be around to go somewhere fun!

hp_warning.line: Am I really in a pinch...?

login.line: Staaaaaare... Commander doesn't look any different today!

lose.line: Awww... P-please don't look at meeee...

mail.line: Don't you forget, I'm the one who brought you the mail!

main1.line: Bad little submarines, come out, come out, wherever you are~

main2.line: I'm a bit jealous of the Little Beavers... If only I had the same legendary feats as them...

main3.line: Jeez, Commander, you have such a cute and capable Destroyer right next to you, but you're so absorbed in your work!

mission.line: Commander, it seems like you'll need a capable assistant after all... Ehehe, you need my talents, don't you~!

mission_complete.line: Don't forget that I helped you with that mission! Ehehe, vanilla ice cream is waiting for me~!

profile.line: There are a lot of us Fletchers, but nobody's done a better job of supporting than Halsey Powell! Whether it's anti-air or anti-sub, nobody out there can match me!

propose.line: With this ring, I'm totally going to capture everyone's attention! Hehe... my dreams are finally coming true... Huh? Commander, you want me to only capture your attention? Why's that?

touch.line: Commander, are you in a pickle? Do you need my help? Hehe, I'd be glad to give you a hand, but the cute little Halsey Powell won't work for free... Hmm, if you treat me to lots of tasty snacks, we have a deal!

touch2.line: Y-You can't do that...!

unlock.line: There you are, Commander! Ehehe~ Huh? You've never heard of me? Jeez, I'm Halsey Powell! Don't you forget it!

upgrade.line: I have to get stronger, and shine even brighter!

win_mvp.line: Mhmhm! Do bask in the heroic visage of your MVP, Halsey Powell!

gift_prefer.line: Ehehe, you really do love me, don't you, Commander?

detail.line: The Dragon Empery's lucky star is an old geezer? I see... W-wait! I don't want to be the lucky star anymore!

home.line: I've finished hanging up all the paper lanterns around the port! Hehe, now when everyone sees them, they'll praise the hardworking maiden who put them up - that's right, me!

login.line: Commander, Happy Spring Festival! Um, hey, where's my red envelope?

main1.line: I want to eat something sweet and fluffy...

main2.line: The Zodiac is really neat! But... why is there a dog and a rat on there but no cat?

main3.line: Commander, why don't we make a huge paper lantern? One that stands out from the rest!

touch.line: If you're ever in trouble, just leave it to your lucky star, Halsey Powell!

touch2.line: Commander, bad luck unto you!

unlock.line: Halsey Powell is making her debut as your lucky star for the Spring Festival! Commander, if you show me a fun time, you'll be blessed with good luck this year!

battle.line: Cast off! Let's go!

detail.line: I have an incredible power inside me that will burst forth to save everyone at that critical moment... Yeah! That would be badass!

expedition.line: Go greet the team coming back from commission? Easy peasy! Just watch me~

feeling1.line: Even if Commander is my enemy, I won't go soft!

feeling2.line: Whenever you're in trouble, just call my name! Then you can bet Cooper will be there to bail you out, Commander!

feeling3.line: Commander! Did I hear my name? Hah hah hah, just point me at the enemy and... You need me to deliver these documents? I'm not your errand girl!

feeling4.line: Sorry, Commander. I know you were looking for me, but I got held up with this black kitty cat. I hope you didn't worry about me... B-but, like, who could resist playing with a kitty cat...?

feeling5.line: Commander! From now on I'm staying here with you, whether you call for me or not. So you won't have to worry about a thing...! Huh? You think I'm the one who's gonna get in trouble? Nng, yeah, maybe... But that still means I gotta stay with you, Commander!

home.line: Commander, I took care of a whole bunch of things while you were gone! See these reports? I wrote them all wrong? What the...

hp_warning.line: I won't be afraid! Now more than ever, they need me!

login.line: It's nice to see your smiling face, Commander! Heh heh!

lose.line: One little setback won't get me down!

mail.line: A new message? Could it be a distress signal...? My Danger Antenna is tingling!

main1.line: Paperwork? How does that help in a fight?

main2.line: Aaahhh~ I just lose it whenever I see a kitty cat. Commander, let's keep one in the office, a black one!

main3.line: Hey... how long are we gonna stay in the office? I'm so bored...

mission.line: We won't be able to help anyone if you leave your missions unfinished!

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished! We're definitely making a difference!

profile.line: I'm an Allen M. Sumner-class destroyer, Cooper! I fought alongside Allen M. Sumner and Moale at Ormoc Bay, but I guess I didn't try hard enough... Nnng, damn it! How was I supposed to pick out anything like those oxygen torpedoes!

propose.line: Commander, who knew I was so important to you... I'm so happy! As long as I'm with you, then tomorrow... and the next day, and the day after that, I know I'll be able to do anything!

touch.line: Hey! Ready to move anytime!

touch2.line: Commander, do you understand what you're doing here?

unlock.line: Hey Commander, I'm Cooper! Let's join forces and fight for the future of the world! Booyah!

upgrade.line: Getting stronger is how I help more people!

win_mvp.line: Phew... What a nice feeling. Feels like victory.

gift_prefer.line: Thanks, Commander!

detail.line: I never thought a game of afternoon tennis would be so exhausting... Huh? What's up, Commander?

home.line: Wait up! Hold on! Gotta catch my breath...! Phew, whew...

hp_warning.line: Deuce! This ain't over!

login.line: Watch me beat this Sakura girl... then it's you and me, Commander!

main1.line: Ace shot! Yaaaaaah!

main2.line: This is for me? Alright...! Glug glug... Haah!

main3.line: A black kitty cat! Where is it...?! Hey now, don't distract me!

touch.line: Y-you probably shouldn't touch me. I'm all sweaty right now.

unlock.line: 30 to 15... Next match will be mine, you hear! Oh, Commander, are you here to play a round of tennis?

detail.line: Whew! It's freezing cold outside, but warm and cozy in here! Nothing beats an open fireplace in the winter~

expedition.line: I think the commission team's back. Let's invite them in here and we can all have a cozy Christmas together!

home.line: I'm not sure who'll end up getting this snowglobe, but I am sure they'll love it!

login.line: I get excited thinking about what kind of presents I might get! What stuff did you wish for, Commander?

mail.line: New mail, huh? You think it might be someone's Christmas wishlist?

main1.line: You'd be surprised how easy wrapping presents is! You just put it like this... take some wrapping paper... then a ribbon... aaand done!

main2.line: Man, I wish I could ride anywhere in a cool snowmobile like Minneapolis. "It's too dangerous for a kid to ride"? Hey! It's not like I'm a little baby or anything!

main3.line: I'm getting kinda bored... Hey, Commander, wanna play word association? With a Christmas theme, obviously!

touch.line: Are you feeling chilly? Come a little closer if you wanna warm up, then~

touch2.line: Hrmph... You're not fooling me with any "just wanted to warm my hands up" excuses!

unlock.line: Hm? I'm just wrapping up some presents! Can't just present them as-is, and all that. Hehe~ I could sure use a little help, Commander!

battle.line: Let's do this thing!

couple_encourage1.line: Hey look, Black Cats! Pfft! Just messing with you~

couple_encourage2.line: Is that you, sis? Never mind, wrong Laffey!

couple_encourage3.line: Oh man, those new stickers you've got? They're so cute!

couple_encourage4.line: If it ain't the ghost that popularized oversized sleeves!

detail.line: So Commander, do you like being the one cuddling, or the one being cuddled? Just wonderin'!

expedition.line: Commission completezo! Check it out, I categorized the rewards with some stickers!

feeling1.line: Okay, okay, calm yourself and I'll indulge you with a nice, heartwarming hug.

feeling2.line: My rigging's in tip-top condition! Counting on you to keep it that way, Commander! Hehe!

feeling3.line: I've finished all my combat drills, so I'm gonna use my break time to run down to the store! Oh, before I forget, here's a special sticker for you! It's all good if you wanna trade it with someone later.

feeling4.line: So, you doing anything special on your next day off? No? Perfect! Then mark that date your calendar. I'll bring the vidya and we can game all day!

feeling5.line: Zzz... Hmm? Commander? *yawn*... Guess I dozed off, whoops. Could you gimme a ride to the couch? ...No? Aww, why not?! We're buds, so what's the big deal? Zzz...

headtouch.line: Hmm?

home.line: Whoa! Hel-looo! The couch is all yours if you want it.

hp_warning.line: Owch! I'm not outta the game yet, though!

login.line: You're still in dreamland, huh? Hm... *blows*... Oh, hey! So you are awake!

lose.line: Oh crap, I really whiffed this one... Thank god for that near miss back there... Umm, I'll do better next time.

mail.line: New mail's come in! Gonna read it later? Gotcha, I'll put a sticker on it then.

main1.line: Okay, hear me out! Why don't we spruce up the office with some stickers? These here would look great on the walls and your desk!

main2.line: Man, it's crazy how much Fletcher cares for her sisters. Who, me? I, uhh, prefer a hands-off approach with my sisters!

main3.line: So this is what you do all day... You don't think I could become a commander too if I studied enough? Yeeeah, me neither. Heheh. Feel a little less tense now?

main4.line: You just yawned, didn't you, Commander? Just be honest and admit it~

mission.line: Beep boop, this is an automated deadpan mission reminder. Uncompleted missions detected. Do your job. Beep boop.

mission_complete.line: Mission completed! ...Wait a sec, this thing says I had zero involvement in it!

profile.line: I'm Allen M. Sumner, nameship of the class that succeeded the Fletcher class. We may not be as numerous as the Fletchers, but we've got a teensy edge over 'em in firepower and AA! Hell, I think it's no exaggeration to say we were the Eagle Union's strongest destroyers back in the war!

propose.line: One mystery remains: did I charm you, or did you charm me? Meh, don't really matter... All that's important is now we'll live happily ever after! Hehe~ I love you so much, Commander♡

touch.line: What's that? You cuddle with me? Go on, try it!

touch2.line: Hahaahh! Too slippery for you! Can't catch me!

unlock.line: I'm Eagle Union destroyer Allen M. Sumner! Just call me Allen! It's a pleasure, Commander! Anyway, I've heard you've got yummy food and cushy work here at this port. That true?

upgrade.line: Sweet! Burst of energy like this make me wanna do stretches!

win_mvp.line: Easy-breezy! That's another star on my record!

gift_prefer.line: Oooh! I'll take this!

battle_ex.line: I'm givin' it one-hundo percent!

detail_ex.line: You could go for some cuddling? Don't mind if I do! We're gonna cuddle 'till dawn breaks!

login_ex.line: Hwuh?! Wait, did I fall asleep? *yawn*... I might just call in sick today. Too lazy.

main5_ex.line: What do you mean "please help"? I'm your secretary, just tell me "get this done" like a commander would! ...Right, I'm on it.

mission_ex.line: A new mission? I could help, if you want. I'll get it done in a jiffy!

mission_complete_ex.line: Beep boop, this is an automated deadpan mission reminder. Mission rewards detected. Go claim them. Beep boop.

win_mvp_ex.line: This victory's for me and you, Commander! Ahaha!

detail.line: Thanks for popping in! By the way... I'll pay you back for the OJ later.

home.line: Hey, Commander, order a glass of OJ! ...No, it's for me! Staff can't just order drinks for themselves, y'know? That's weird.

login.line: Welcome, Commander! Uh, watch your step!

main1.line: Turns out North Carolina is like, a bunny girl expert! I never knew that.

main2.line: No, Cooper! No adult drinks, got it? Ask the commander to order you some juice instead! Hehehe~

main3.line: Sooo... You like bunny girls, Commander? Asking for a friend.

touch.line: You know what, it's comfier to sit and take it easy, so I'm gonna stay put for now.

touch2.line: Hey! You can't grope a staff member!

unlock.line: Welcome, Commander! I would fetch you our menu, but I've had a teensy accident here... Don't worry, I'll fix this somehow!

detail.line: Ahah! It's pretty fun to play a double-agent thief! Cracking down on crime in daylight, then thieving for the good of the people in moonlight... The two sides contrast nicely with each other and it's surprisingly invigorating!

feeling5.line: Ahah! I just got a great idea! Next time we get the chance, we should form, like, a super legendary phantom thief team. Think about it – we're as close as close gets, so our acting and teamwork would be smooth as butter! Give it some thought!

home.line: Hey! Welcome back, Commander! Quick, swap personas! We've got a case to do, partner!

login.line: PhantoM has come! The treasure I'll be stealing today is your heart! How's that for giving you palpitations?

mail.line: You've got a letter, Commander! ...Come to think of it, I should send out some calling cards, too.

main1.line: "The world-renowned phantom thief has come. The treasures I called out are now mine!" ...Yeah! I referenced some other movies and came up with this line. I'd say I nailed it!

main2.line: Leaving a calling card and putting your target on edge, then stealing their treasure with ease despite the high security... Now THAT'S a challenge worth taking on, heehee.

main3.line: A police officer and a phantom thief think and operate completely differently, but I'm the flexible type, so I can switch between the two like it's the most natural thing ever!

main4.line: You can change costumes from police to thief in an instant with just one easy trick. Wanna know it? I'll tell you if you're interested!

main5.line: Is there any treasure only I could steal? Shh, it's daytime, and I'm still a police officer! Let's save this convo for Miss Terious to answer later tonight! Heehee♪

touch.line: Sheesh, it's not easy playing your role, Commander. Do you need script revisions or direction? Don't be shy to ask for anything you need!

touch2.line: Heheh. Who's your favorite between policewoman Allen and phantom thief Allen?

unlock.line: Heheh! Policewoman who protects the city's order by day, vigilante who takes from the rich and gives to the poor by night! She is phantom thief Miss Terious, or PhantoM for short! Your riches are now mine! Your dumb little traps wouldn't catch me in a hundred years!

win_mvp.line: Ahahah! Another huge haul and another star on my treasure list!

battle.line: All right, since I've gotta take this flagship thing seriously... Let 'em have it, girls!

couple_encourage1.line: I'm gonna chill for just like, a little bit. Don't rat me out, 'kay?

couple_encourage2.line: Want some gum?

detail.line: Here to chillax and hang out, eh, Commander?

expedition.line: A commission's been completed. Just throwing that out there before I forget.

feeling1.line: Yeah, no, I'll find someplace less boring to hang out. Hit me up only if you've got business with me.

feeling2.line: You need help with something? I've got a bazillion sisters, why not try asking them first?

feeling3.line: Hm? Why do I always just sit and stare when you take me in as the secretary? Becaaaause... you never explicitly ask for help? If you need something done, just like, tell me? I'm not the most attentive person in the universe, so sorry for that.

feeling4.line: It's getting harder and harder to tune you out of my mind... No, I don't mean that in reference to like, work, my free time, or whatever... I mean you, Commander. I'll just keep my eyes on you for now.

feeling5.line: Well yeah, I've thought about love before? It's not alien to me. Although thinking about it drains too much brainpower and just makes me sleepy in the end. I'd rather just be with you, Commander, and figure it out over time.

headtouch.line: Okay, now I think I get why some girls have headpat addictions.

home.line: Hum-hmmhm~♪ Oh, welcome back.

hp_warning.line: All right, no more messing around...

login.line: Welcome to the circle of hell known as "the office." Relax, I'll lend a hand if the cauldron gets too hot for you.

lose.line: Crap. I went too easy on 'em...

mail.line: Kind of curious who sent that unread letter on your desk.

main1.line: Dang, you caught me spacing out at work. ...Oh? Maybe you didn't after all? Cool. I'll just get back to doing it then.

main2.line: Hey, how about a bit of jazz? Chill, I'm just getting up to put a song on. I'm not gonna bail on you or anything.

main3.line: Mind if I borrow your coat, Commander? Thanks. This will work great as a blanket.

mission.line: Hey, a new mission! Oh, whoops... I guess we've both gotta actually do work now that I've said that.

mission_complete.line: Finished a mission, huh? Cool, then let's take ten to veg out.

profile.line: My record's got the usual destroyer stuff. You know, did anti-air duty, hunted a submarine, and went on the odd rescue mission. So basically, I can do anything a destroyer should be able to, just don't expect me to singlehandedly save the day like some superhero.

propose.line: It's gonna be so tiring, dealing with the responsibilities that come with getting hitched... Just saying, that's all. Hehe, I can handle a bit of fatigue as long as I've got you, sweetheart.

touch.line: You want some gum? 'Kay. Mint or orange flavor?

touch2.line: Whoa! Talk about a blunt-ass approach...

unlock.line: Fletcher-class Stephen Potter here. You've probably met a million of my sisters already, so I'll spare you my life story. See you around.

upgrade.line: Welp, guess the Slacker Council has to disband for the day.

win_mvp.line: Cool beans. I wasn't trying to style on 'em, but I'll take any commendations I'll get.

gift_prefer.line: Whoa, getting exactly what you wanted all of a sudden's kinda scary! I'm super happy, though! Thank you♪

detail_ex.line: Got something you need from me? Sure, just say the word and you got it. Not a whole lot going on anyway, so maybe I'll do you a little favor~

login_ex.line: Welcome back to the little bit o' heaven known as "the office." Of course, heaven is wherever I am, right?

main4_ex.line: Listening to music really puts you in that efficient state. Oh, I was talking about gaming. I'm fallin' asleep over here at work anyway, so what's the harm in enjoying some beats?

main5_ex.line: Commander's jacket... *sniff, sniff*... Great, nice and clean. Go, me!

mission_ex.line: We've got new missions! Gotta do this stuff sooner or later, so why not get it outta the way now?

win_mvp_ex.line: Meh. Can't afford to let you down, and all that jazz.

detail.line: I've got bunny pajamas on top of a bunny girl costume. That's double the bunny right there.

headtouch.line: It's only human to want to touch the bun, I guess.

home.line: Oh, there's that collector's edition I ordered. What to do with these stickers... Guess I'll put 'em somewhere.

login.line: Heya. Wanna play a game? Mobile, console, or tabletop?

mail.line: Oh, new mail. Let's see here... Figures. This one's for you, Commander.

main1.line: Meowfficer plushes, Manjuu hand puppets... I never realized how much weird stuff I've amassed over the years.

main2.line: I invited Laffey over, thinking she'd be fun to chill with. Turns out she's just a sleep junkie, like Nicholas.

main3.line: Yeah, the place is a mess, but I'm used to it. It's way too much work to tidy up, so let's not.

touch.line: You want a bubblegum kiss? Sure. I've got plenty of flavors you can choose from.

touch2.line: I'm starting to think this outfit is a bit too inviting...

unlock.line: Welcome to my private retreat, where you can skip work and veg out all you want. And by "skip work" I mean "enjoy your regularly scheduled day off." Anyway, make yourself at home, Commander.

battle.line: N-not another battle...

couple_encourage1.line: P-please allow me... to escort you!

detail.line: This little guy is my friend, Mr. Bear. Umm... he's equipped with a lot of equipment. Take this right hand, for example... Wait, you can't aim at the Commander!

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Umm, if you need any help, I don't mind...

feeling1.line: Just like I thought, things are better without me around...

feeling2.line: Commander, umm... to tell the truth, there's something I... i-it's nothing... forget I said anything...

feeling3.line: Commander, are you curious about Mr. Bear? T-Then, I'll introduce him to you.

feeling4.line: Commander, um, could I have a bit of your time...? I wanted to get your input on what kinds of things I could do to improve upon Mr. Bear's specs...

feeling5.line: Commander, am I helpful to you? I'm not a bother, am I? ...Mm, every time I hear your words of reassurance, I can relax a bit... Thank you very much, Commander.

headtouch.line: Mr. Bear...? Oh, Commander... I don't think Mr. Bear meant to hit you, Commander...

home.line: Commander, umm... I don't know if these will be of any use, but... (Morrison hands you some files)

hp_warning.line: Mr. Bear, save me...!

login.line: Commander, ah, um, n-never mind...

lose.line: Oww... Ugh, I want to go back to port...

mail.line: Mr. Bear, bring the mail over to the Commander.

main1.line: I'd really like to get my hands on a few sets of the Iron Blood's rigging... Heh, hehehe...

main2.line: Y-yes, you called? ...You didn't...? I'm sorry...

main3.line: It's sunny out today... Though, it's not like sunny days are always good either.

mission.line: Commander, if you need any help completing the missions, I don't mind...

mission_complete.line: You completed the missions? That means that I'm free for the time being, right?

profile.line: I'm the Fletcher-class destroyer, Morrison. I participated in anti-submarine warfare and rescue missions with my allies... If there's anything you want me to do... I-I should be able to do it.

propose.line: Phew... I've worked hard to prepare myself for this moment, so it's okay. Commander, if it's you, I'm okay with it...! Breathe in... Breathe out... C-C-Commander, u-u-um, I-I-I've finished preparing my heart! I-I'll be in your care!

touch.line: Mr. Bear, why don't you greet the Commander? Yes, normally, just like this... P-please keep your paws to yourself!

touch2.line: M-Mr. Bear is on a rampage?!

unlock.line: Phew... Finally got here in one piece... Ah, um, are you the commander? My name is Morrison. Yes, the Fletcher-class Morrison with way too many sisters...

upgrade.line: I really don't think you need to go that far for someone like me...

win_mvp.line: Whew... That should give me a bit of leeway...

gift_prefer.line: Wh-why are you so nice to me...?

battle_ex.line: Mr. Bear, charge!

detail_ex.line: With this gel applied, Mr. Bear should be able to move just fine at sea as well... No way, he's nowhere near fast enough... Commander, what do you think I should do...?

expedition_ex.line: The commissions have been completed. Umm, Commander, let's go and greet everyone together...!

home_ex.line: Great work, Commander! Please let me handle the reports...!

login_ex.line: Commander, um, would it be okay for me to stay by your side today?

main2_ex.line: D-Did you call for me...? Yes! Leave whatever it is to me...!

main3_ex.line: It's sunny today. Sunny days are nice, aren't they? ...Yes!

main4_ex.line: In this operation, I can't let myself be a burden to either Mr. Bear or the Commander... Isn't that right, Birmingham?

mission_complete_ex.line: All done with the missions? Let's take a little break then...

touch_ex.line: Um, if there's anything I can help with... J-just let me know... okay?

touch2_ex.line: Ah, um, I'm so sorry... Mr. Bear is very sensitive to sudden movements, and he'll spring up to defend me...

win_mvp_ex.line: I should use this chance to perform some maintenance on Mr. Bear... Alright, done!

detail.line: Benson told me all about the ins and outs of Planet Bunny... Huh? Is something amiss?

headtouch.line: M-my ears are going to fall off...

home.line: Commander, would you like some tea...?

login.line: It's a bit embarrassing, but... it's surprisingly comfortable...

mail.line: Mr. Bear, take the mail to the Commander... Oh, Mr. Bear isn't here right now...

main1.line: I wonder if I should take Stanly's advice and turn Mr. Bear into "Rabbit Mode"...

main2.line: I'm so jealous of all the people that get to wear cute clothes... Y-you think I'm cute, too...?

main3.line: I-it's spicy? Was it Thatcher? No, it could have been Kalk...

touch.line: C-can I take a nap yet...?

touch2.line: Commander, um, please show some self-restraint...

unlock.line: Zzz... Commander? S-sorry, I fell asleep for a bit... Uh, umm, what would you like me to do...?

detail.line: "After much excruciating training, Morrison the Ninja turned the tables in battle to much awe, proving her own worth..." Oh, Commander. I was just reading the script. Want me to... demonstrate my ninjutsu?

feeling5.line: It was actually me who... came up with the idea of my shapeshifting ninjutsu turning me into a slightly different version of myself. I've heard that kind of contrast is exciting to people, so... Umm... Wh-what do you think, Commander?

headtouch.line: Whew... This feeling of inner peace... Yes, this is perfect for when you're training.

home.line: "Welcome back, Milord. Your ninja servant Morrison awaits your orders"... Ugh, this is so embarrassing...

login.line: My mind follows my will, and my shadow follows my form... Uhh, now I'll... change forms and become someone else...? Wait, why isn't it working? Oh, the drone's run out of battery!

main1.line: Mr. Bear's hologram isn't finished yet, so... he's not here for now.

main2.line: Shapeshifting ninjutsu, summoning ninjutsu, water hiding ninjutsu, earth hiding ninjutsu... Why do I need to use voice control when I can just press a button?

main3.line: This outfit? Ikazuchi and Inazuma suggested it – it's a professional ninja's attire. It's a bit embarrassing to wear, but... doesn't it make me look like a real ninja?

touch.line: Soobrazitelny developed this ninja simulator, while Fargo provided me with the drone. We really have... so many talented people here.

touch2.line: Eek! Th-that's not part of my ninjutsu!

unlock.line: This looks like the perfect place to film a ninja training scene... Ahem! Allow me to demonstrate my ninjutsu to you, Commander! Pl-please keep your eyes peeled! Transformation ninjutsu! Hiyah!

battle.line: Full module calibration complete. I'm loaded and ready for battle!

couple_encourage1.line: Try not to get too sloppy, Allen.

couple_encourage2.line: That's some cutting-edge tech you've got...

couple_encourage3.line: Got any pro tips for me about repairing?

detail.line: Breaking stuff is easy. Making stuff is not.

expedition.line: Commission complete. Any parts you don't need? Send 'em my way.

feeling1.line: I'd love to unscrew your thick skull and have a look at what's inside.

feeling2.line: Even minor flaws impact the quality of a product. You want high-end equipment? Make sure it's perfectly calibrated.

feeling3.line: Hey, Cooper, I finished that "morph item" you asked about... No, Allen! Stop plastering stickers all over my stuff!

feeling4.line: Yo, Commander, I scrounged up some spare parts and made you this steel medal on my day off. C'mere, I'll attach it to your uniform... Pfft! Looks pretty good on you!

feeling5.line: Listen, if you ever need something, just hit me up. Scratch that, uhh... You can hit me up anytime, for any reason. I just feel kinda lonely without you, you know? Ahem... Anyway!

headtouch.line: This hairpin? It's made from a repurposed binder clip. Is that so weird?

home.line: My hunch was right – this thing really is a millimeter off... Oh, hey there, Commander. Just who I was looking for. Could you have a look at this?

hp_warning.line: Oh, crap! That's gonna be a pain to repair!

login.line: You're late, Commander. I oughta build you an alarm clock that keeps ringing no matter what you do.
