lose.line: I've gotta do thorough rigging maintenance when I get back!

mail.line: Mail, eh... I could give your mailbox a makeover, if you want.

main1.line: Yo, Commander, you mind if I do some tinkering in here? Don't wanna disturb you, is all... All righty, I'll take that as a "yes."

main2.line: Why am I wearing just one stocking? Uhh, because I forgot to put the other one on. What does it matter, anyway? Clothes are just a bother.

main3.line: There's a loose screw under the bookcase... No biggie, I'll get it myself. And don't you dare try to sneak a dirty peek in while I'm doing it.

mission.line: New missions, huh? Ugh. I don't wanna get off my butt...

mission_complete.line: Need a pen to write the mission complete papers? Here, you can borrow mine.

profile.line: Thought about it some more, but I really don't have much else to tell you. On another note, wanna see the Allen M. Sumner-class miniature I made? Main battery, AA guns, even depth charges, it's all there. See?

propose.line: Here I thought you were dense, but I guess I was wrong. Oh yeah, I made this ring for you. It's no promise ring, but I still want you to have it... This thing's special to me, so don't even think about having me remake it for you.

touch.line: Keep the touching to a minimum, thanks.

touch2.line: This is your dirty-deeds-hand, huh? I'm gonna keep you armlocked until you say you're sorry.

unlock.line: I'm Ingraham, Eagle Union destroyer. Not much else to tell you, honestly... Anyhoo, good to meet you.

upgrade.line: Rigging upgrades, huh? Keep them coming, thanks.

win_mvp.line: Sweet! My rigging's perfectly tuned!

gift_prefer.line: Mm... Well, it's okay?

detail.line: Your job's simple. All you need to do is drink what I serve you and give feedback on the taste, mouthfeel, et cetera.

expedition.line: Commission complete. Let's see if they brought back anything I can use...

home.line: Once I've perfected this recipe, I'll give you a gold taste-tester medal for your efforts.

login.line: You're on time for once! That means you're due for a reward. I'll make your drink doubly sweet.

main1.line: All I asked Allen for was some label paper, and instead she dumped a billion different stickers on me...

main2.line: No, Cooper, that stuff's got alcohol in it. Put it back where you found it.

main3.line: Yeah, Allen made me wear this getup when she found out I'll be handling the bar counter... That said, I guess I don't really mind it.

touch2.line: Hey! Wow... Hope you like your lemonade with 30 times more lemon juice.

unlock.line: Hmm... Could use a little more sweetness, and a splash of the secret ingredient... Oh, you're here? Great. I appoint you as my first dedicated taste-tester, Commander. We're gonna come up with some novel and fresh drinks, you and I!

battle.line: Bristol Investigation Team, setting off!

couple_encourage1.line: Hehehe! Run a trial on this new gear, pretty please!

couple_encourage2.line: The next point of interest is where our adventure starts!

detail.line: Curious about my little helper? Hehehe. Well, Ingraham built it to assist me in exploration. Its name is Data 857!

expedition.line: A commission's been completed! Data 857, go see if the girls brought back any strange goodies. And watch out for k-kelp!

feeling1.line: Hmph... Our adventure went so badly all because you went and got the kelp curse put on you!

feeling2.line: The Dragon Empery's a land teeming with folklore and myths... Next time I see my Empery friends, I wanna hear all about them!

feeling3.line: If that'll be all, do you mind if I go for a stroll around port? ...Awesome! Come along, Data 857!

feeling4.line: Are you scared of the dark, Commander? Then just stick close to me, and my lantern will shoo the dark away! You've nothing to fear – I've trained for this!

feeling5.line: There are more mysteries in the world than Data 857 and I can ever hope to solve... It's a good thing I have you, Commander! We might never solve EVERY mystery, but together, we can solve a lot more!

headtouch.line: Sure, praise me for my investigator skills all you want~

home.line: Now's the perfect opportunity to look into the Commander, one of the port's many myster– Oh! Welcome back! Err, I'm not up to anything at all! Not yet, at least!

hp_warning.line: Zoinks! Don't put out my light!

login.line: Weapons check complete – I'm ready to go on an adventure! Get your mystery-solving gear on, Commander!

lose.line: Fiddlesticks! Agghh... No regrets...

mail.line: New mail? Could it be... a request to look into a paranormal case?

main1.line: Show the Commander what an awesome robot you are, Data 857! Let's start with your best feature – replay mode! List the results of our last investigation!

main2.line: I was told your desk can transform and your bookshelf has a secret mechanism... I'm disappointed neither of those are true.

main3.line: The forecast saaays... Awesome! It'll be sunny tomorrow! Can't go mystery-solving in the rain, you know!

mission.line: New missions are in, Commander! Maybe one of them involves investigating something!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! I'll write up a report of my findings right away!

profile.line: My history? Eh, it's honestly pretty unremarkable... Anyway, lemme tell you a story! Deep under the sea, there once lived a legendary monster that was as long as several school buses. When a ship sailed over it, the monster would open its jaws and swallow it whole...

propose.line: Hehehe! Now we're mystery-solving partners! We'll go wherever there are clues to be found, be they at sea, in the skies, or on land!

skill.line: Your biggest mistake was underestimating this investigator!

touch.line: My uniform looks pretty, doesn't it?

touch2.line: Are you possessed by an evil entity?! Then I have no choice... I've got to subdue you for everyone's safety!

unlock.line: The name is Bristol, Eagle Union destroyer! Well met, Commander! This port must be home to many mysteries... I will make it my duty to solve each and every one! Heheheh!

upgrade.line: Firepower upgrade complete! New depths to explore are now within my reach!

win_mvp.line: Crushing victory! Heheh! Now we can keep investigating in peace!

gift_prefer.line: With this, my investigations will be a breeze! Thanks!

headtouch_ex.line: Feels like you just charged me up with energy! Your touch is like magic, Commander~

home_ex.line: Nice going out there, Commander! Did you come across any places warranting an investigation?

login_ex.line: Investigation complete! Nothing seems out of order in the office. Welcome back, Commander!

lose_ex.line: There's... kelp on my head... Agghh... No regrets...

main4_ex.line: Kelp is really gross to me... Never mind eating it, I can't even touch the stuff!

main5_ex.line: Data 857 and I are ready to go, just give us the word! ...It's not time just yet? Fine... I'll check my gear again in the meanwhile!

touch_ex.line: My tie's all crooked? Thanks for telling me!

touch2_ex.line: S-so that's your favorite part of me, huh...

detail.line: Sorry for dropping in unannounced, Tai Yuan. I was just wondering, could I borrow some books from you again? Cool, thanks a bunch!

home.line: Cooper, I could use more soap liquid! ...Thanks! Come blow bubbles with me! Hehehe~

login.line: Investigator task for today: gather anecdotes about Dragon Empery legends and folklore! But that's for after I've enjoyed the festivities.

main1.line: Assuming a legend is a story embellished by people from many generations ago, then what is the kernel of truth that inspired it all?

main2.line: Where's Data 857? Ingraham's doing maintenance on it. The little bot deserves a break too once in a while.

main3.line: If the legends are true, then that makes this fish – the Kun – the biggest aquatic monster to ever exist!

touch.line: Allen picked these clothes out for me! Hehehe~ How do I look in them?

touch2.line: Whoa! Hey! Don't startle me like that!

unlock.line: Happy Lunar New Year, Commander! The time's finally come to look into the age-old legends from the Dragon Empery! The truth behind these legends is bound to be as fascinating as the legends themselves!

expedition.line: A commission's done? Alright, then I'll distract the horseman and buy you some time!

feeling5.line: You can have this head once we're back safely! Also, Data 857 and I are gonna write a memoir to commemorate this magnificent investigation, then... Hm? Don't jinx it by saying that? Heh! I've done this long enough to know how to survive!

headtouch.line: What? Is my hat coming off?

home.line: *pant*... *pant*... Out of the frying pan and into the fire... You okay, Commander?

login.line: You done warming up yet, Commander?! Then we gotta pick up the pace and run!

mail.line: A new letter? Data 857, keep the horseman busy for a bit!

main1.line: We could shake the horseman off easily, but the fun lies in staying just close enough to preserve the tension! Come on, Commander!

main2.line: They say the horseman goes away if you give him a pumpkin in place of a head... but where are we gonna find a pumpkin? We're better off just running!

main3.line: Commander, I'll give you this... head once we're back safely! If you want it, pick up the pace!

mission.line: What? A new mission? This is NOT the time or place for that!

mission_complete.line: A mission's been completed? Heehee! I just got done refueling my lantern, too!

touch.line: You want to hold this for me? It's a lot heavier than it looks.

touch2.line: Sorry, but my hands are full so we'll have to do this later!

unlock.line: Heheh! You're finally here, Commander! My current investigation is into this thing in my... Correction – into that thing that's chasing me! We gotta run, like, now!

upgrade.line: Aw yeah! My DEX leveled up!

battle.line: Hmph! Witness my newly obtained power!

couple_encourage1.line: Don't worry, I'm all grown up now!

detail.line: Wh-why have you been staring at me for so long?! Could it be that you're actually a perv—Oh, you're just examining my rigging? I-I don't believe you!

expedition.line: Go and greet the girls who just got back from their commission! And... Make sure you come back quick!

feeling1.line: Hmph! I don't even care anymore!

feeling2.line: Yorktown might trust you, but you won't win me over that easily! Hmph! ...You say you'll try to work on your worst qualities? W-well, either way, I'm watching you, bub!

feeling3.line: You wanna know why I'm staring at you now? Does it really matter?! Oh, I get it - you think I'm a stalker, right?! I'm just worried that you're gonna do something weird if I don't keep my eye on you!

feeling4.line: H-hmph! Since you've been good recently, I'll show my appreciation with a rare compliment! ...Th-that doesn't mean I've totally accepted you, though!

feeling5.line: Hmph! Every time I look away, you glue your eyes to some other girl... Hyah?! Wh-what's gotten into you?! O-okay, now your face is way too close to mine! I get what you're trying to say, alright?! Geez… That was seriously not the time for that.

headtouch.line: I've never understood why some girls at the port get so excited when you pat them on the head... That didn't mean I want you to touch me!

home.line: Why isn't the Commander back yet... Eep?! D-don't just sneak over without saying anything!

hp_warning.line: I can't stand this...!

login.line: Hmph! I don't care whether you're here or not, okay?!

lose.line: Aww, now the Commander is gonna lecture me... H-hey, you didn't hear anything from me!

mail.line: Commander! I brought your mail in for you!

main1.line: Stupid Commander, are you just gonna work all of our time away? ...I-I didn't say anything! You just do your own thing!

main2.line: How am I adjusting to my new rigging? Hmph, I'm just fine! Worry about me when it actually matters!

main3.line: Heheheh, now I can really show I-168 who's boss... Y-Yorktown, wait! I'm just trying to make friends with her, I swear!

mission.line: Stupid Commander! You're forgetting all these missions you haven't finished!

mission_complete.line: Excuse me! You've got something waiting for you to pick it up! ...I mean the mission rewards, idiot!

profile.line: Hmph. No matter what, I'm still me. Now I've told you all about Yorktown, there is nothing else you need to say. I-if you really wanna do anything for me... Err, I take that back!

propose.line: D-don't say a word, and just hug me, okay? But don't look at my face! And stop laughing! So this is what I get for being brave and baring my emotions to the person I like...

touch.line: Ack?! Don't touch me out of nowhere! You scared me!

touch2.line: Pervert! Degenerate! I'm gonna tell Yorktown... I-if Yorktown doesn't get mad at you, then I still have ways to get back at you!

unlock.line: Wh-what do you think you're looking at, pervert?! You say it's irresistible...? And you think I'm going to believe that?! Here I was thinking I'd introduce myself properly... I'm gonna remember this!

upgrade.line: Ugh, I can't say no to you...

win_mvp.line: I won! ...Wh-what?! Just so you know, your compliments don't make me happy at all!

gift_prefer.line: You can be pretty considerate sometimes, Commander.

detail_ex.line: L-look. I'll always be hard to deal with, so if you've got a problem—ack! Okay, okay, I get it! You're not the kind of person to change your mind, I get it! Geez... *blush*

home_ex.line: Hey, stupid Commander! I don't know how to brew tea, so I brought you some refreshing juice... I-If you're thirsty, then just drink it already!

login_ex.line: Finally, you're back! I was so tired of waiting... I-I mean, never mind! Whether you're here or not, I'm just fine!

main4_ex.line: Comman—H-hmph. I shouldn't interrupt your work... Besides, you look c-cute when you're focused on work... I-I didn't say anythiiing!

main5_ex.line: Test out my new rigging? A-alright, here goes! ...Ah. Th-that wasn't... I-it's your fault, Commander!

touch_ex.line: Wh-what the heck do you want...?

touch2_ex.line: P-perv... *blush*

detail.line: How long are you gonna stare? Do you l-like my swimsuit that much? ...Why am I not calling you a pervert? C-come on, you have to be teasing me now!

home.line: If you're tired, then I guess you can come here... H-hey, I'm saying you can sit NEXT to me! Dummy! U-ugh, forget it.

login.line: You're the one who invited me out, so why are you late?! ...Hmph!

main1.line: Beach volleyball? Eh, I'll pass... Wh-what? If you wanna play that bad, then go. See if I care! Hmph!

main2.line: You're giving me a drink? Look, buttering me up won't get you—Th-thank... you...

main3.line: Sims, wait! I am NOT on a date with the Commander! ...Darn it, Commander, back me up!

touch.line: Hyah?! W-was that on purpose?!

touch2.line: Pervert! Lecher! I'm never going to forgive you for that!

unlock.line: Hmph! I only promised to come to the beach because I was worried you'd be lonely! There's no deeper meaning—w-wait! What are you doing?! Stooop!

detail.line: It's really hard to work when you stare like that! Hwuh? You still haven't gotten the dessert you ordered...? I-it's almost done! Until then... I'll chat with you to pass the time!

home.line: Welcome back! M-master... Why do I have to call you that? Ugh!

login.line: Hyah?! My skirt! Ugh... This maid uniform is so frilly and hard to deal with. Wait, doesn't that make you a perv for coming here just to see it?!

main1.line: Fluffy fluffy, moe moe, meooow~... Is this spell really supposed to make food taste better? Sounds too easy to me... Hey, don't scarf it down! Was it actually good...?

main2.line: These shoes are just for the job. I definitely didn't get them so I could bring you your orders faster... Whoa?! I'm gonna fall – oww! H-hurry up and help me... Hey, watch where you're putting those hands!

main3.line: Apologies for the wait, Master. Here's the "Hammann Feeds You with Love Special"... Wh-who the hell put that on the menu?!

touch.line: I-I get it! You wanna hold hands, is that it? Look... I can do it for you just this once! Hmph!

touch2.line: P-pervert! I'm gonna punish you with REAL magic!

unlock.line: A-almost missed my chance... Ahem! N-newbie maid Hammann will... cast a scrumptious spell on you♡ Delicious, delicious, be delicious♪ Moe moe pyun! ...G-gosh, what am I doing?!

battle.line: First things first, we gotta beat the baddies... Yep, hurry...

couple_encourage1.line: Yep. I'm in great condition... What about you, Nevada?

couple_encourage2.line: Let's take a nap together after this... Yeah...

couple_encourage3.line: Laffey's ready, too. Let's launch together...

detail.line: Yeah... You're always looking after Laffey, Commander... That makes me happy...

expedition.line: The commission team returned... Did you know that already? Okay, then I'll go back and sleep...

feeling1.line: Why'd you wake me up... Do you need something, Commander...?

feeling2.line: Does Laffey look unmotivated? You're just imagining it... I'm so motivated... Zzzz...

feeling3.line: I'm not fully awake yet, but... My body and mind are ready for a fight...

feeling4.line: What do you think when you see Laffey... Nope, I don't care. Not one bit...

feeling5.line: Sometimes, even Laffey can change... But no matter how much I change, I'll never stop wanting to be with you, Commander...

headtouch.line: Commander...? You want to take a break...?

home.line: Commander... *yaaawn*... Welcome back... Zzzzz...

hp_warning.line: As long as I can shoot, I won't give up...

login.line: Yep, Laffey took a good nap, so I'm awake and ready for work... probably. What about you, Commander?

lose.line: My battle... isn't over yet... Nope.

mail.line: Commander, Laffey put your letters... right here.

main1.line: I wanted to sit on my rigging and fly directly to the academy, but that wouldn't work, so I ended up walking. I wish I could ride instead of walk...

main2.line: When Laffey needs to remember something, I can just type it into my display panel... So convenient.

main3.line: Does Laffey look stronger now? ...Because I can sleep sitting on my rigging? No? Hmm...

main4.line: This new cargo space is great... All of my favorite drinks are in there... Here. This one's cold, so you can have it...

main5.line: Don't worry about Laffey... Even when I'm asleep, I'm plenty alert... Yep...

mission.line: A new mission arrived. Commander, it's time for work... Aww, I have to, too?

mission_complete.line: We have rewards. Want to see them, Commander?

profile.line: ...Allen M. Sumner-class? That sounds right. Commander, do you like Laffey's new rigging? I'm not waiting for you to compliment me, or anything... Don't know why you'd think so...

propose.line: ...I'm only the Laffey I am now because of how much you care, Commander... Because you're always watching over me... Yep, I promise... Laffey will be together with you forever...

touch.line: When I sat down, I fell asleep... Nnh... It's okay, I won't fall down...

touch2.line: Commander... You really are a pervert...

unlock.line: *yawn*... Laffey's ready, raring, and more motivated than ever... My rigging is the only thing that changed, not me... So don't touch these ears, Commander. They're not real...

upgrade.line: ...Can I nap a little longer, please...?

win_mvp.line: I won... Back to sleep now...

gift_prefer.line: Thanks... I'll put it next to my pillow...

battle_ex.line: Laffey and the Commander are super motivated...

expedition_ex.line: Commission team's home... Just five more minutes of sleep... Nnh, but I wanna go see everyone with the Commander...

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, can I have a second? It's okay... Laffey just wants to nap next to you... I'll be quiet. Zzzz...

headtouch_ex.line: Zzzz... Mmnh...? Commander...? Zzzz...

home_ex.line: It's not like Laffey wants to be with you for a little longer... Nope, not at all.

hp_warning_ex.line: "The Ship That Would Not Die" won't go down that easy...

login_ex.line: Welcome back... No, I wasn't waiting for you to wake me up... Nuh-uh.

lose_ex.line: Urk... Sorry for worrying you, Commander... It's okay. I won't be disheartened...

main6_ex.line: When you're here, Laffey can relax... When I fall asleep, my body will go all limp, too...

main7_ex.line: Commander, want to join the napping club? Well.. You can nap with me even if you're not in the club...

main8_ex.line: Commander, lean on Laffey if you want... Actually... I'd rather lean on you...

mail_ex.line: Commander, don't forget to check your mail...

mission_ex.line: New missions... After we finish them together, I'm gonna take a nap... Yep, yep.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete... Hm? Laffey can have a reward, too? Okay... Then I want time alone with you, Commander...

touch_ex.line: I'm not thinking about how I want to put my head in your lap and fall asleep... Not one bit.

touch2_ex.line: You're so weird, Commander... But I guess I'm used to it now...

win_mvp_ex.line: Targets eliminated... Wanna go rest together, Commander?

detail.line: My uniform's covered in bunnies, my shoes have bunnies... I love it. Do you like it, Commander...?

expedition.line: Our commission team just got home. The pop-up shop... is about to get really busy...

feeling5.line: Can't get motivated to work... I'm not thinking of slacking off and going to see the Commander... Of course not. Obviously.

headtouch.line: Commander... I'm not eepy, I swear... Okay? Got it?

home.line: Commander, your order...? "Anything as long as I'm with Laffey"? Aw, thank you...

hp_warning.line: I almost slipped... Phew...

login.line: I haven't been looking all over the place for you... Nope, not at all.

lose.line: Oops, I spilled it... It's okay, though...

main1.line: Laffey's job... is to deliver food to the tables... It's not boring because you're here, Commander... Yep.

main2.line: If Ingraham made a conveyor belt to deliver the food, would Laffey not have to anymore...?

main3.line: I came to help out... so I'll keep doing my best... I'm not thinking about slacking off with Allen... Nope, not at all...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Commander, I'm gonna take a nap... Zzzz...

touch.line: My bouncy bunny ears look fun to touch...? Umm... I don't understand...

touch2.line: Commander, you pervert... You're gonna make my bunnies fall off...

unlock.line: Laffey's helping out around the pop-up shop... Commander, sit wherever you want... Any open seat is probably fine.

win_mvp.line: I won... Cheers, Commander...

detail.line: Honorable Lady Laffey owns a big castle full of... umm, pillows? I'm tired... I forgot the setting we agreed on...

feeling5.line: As my most important retainer, Commander... I mean, Magistrate, you'll always be mine... No, Laffey isn't trying to monopolize you. Nope, not at all...

headtouch.line: Magistrate, do you like my bunny ear headband that much...?

home.line: Yaaawn... When I wake up, my Magistrate is back... I'm happy. As a retainer of Honorable Lady Laffey of the Castle of the Bunnies, you can't leave my side without my permission...

login.line: Welcome back, Magistrate... How much of our tour do we have left? A whole day...? Can Laffey change the setting of her territory's size?

mail.line: The bunnies brought mail for you, Magistrate. Take it with you...

main1.line: Cute, fluffy bunnies... Warm and comfy... Magistrate, come pet them...

main2.line: The bunnies are sleeping... Everyone worked hard, so it's time to rest...

main3.line: You can decide where we go next, Magistrate... When are we going? We can think about that after a nap...

mission.line: The government of the Castle of the Bunnies needs our help... You are permitted to take care of it yourself, Magistrate...

mission_complete.line: Our government affairs are dealt with. Back to our tour...

touch.line: Magistrate, do you like cool places? It's nice and cool next to Laffey...

touch2.line: The knot came undone, so Laffey's clothes are about to fall off. Magistrate, you are a pervert...

unlock.line: Mmm, eepy... The honorable Lady Laffey of the Castle of the Bunnies requires rest... Commander... I mean, Magistrate... Our tour must wait for now...

battle.line: I'll protect everyone!

couple_encourage1.line: I'll keep you all safe!

couple_encourage2.line: Whoooa! A-a real ninja? For real?!

detail.line: I'm not particularly good at anything specific, but I'm confident I can protect people! Let me handle guarding the fleet, okay?

expedition.line: Mission complete. Commander, wanna go check it out?

feeling1.line: Looks like there's no need for me to protect you...

feeling2.line: A bodyguard doesn't just protect her charge – she also has to care for their everyday needs. If you have any requests, let me know, okay?

feeling3.line: You get nervous when I'm not around...? Aww, you got used to me being here so fast! Hehe!

feeling4.line: Suddenly, I feel like protecting you and being protected by you isn't enough for me... Huh? N-never mind, I didn't say anything. You didn't hear anything, right? Right?

feeling5.line: Ugh... Honestly, I was so confident in my ability to protect you that I thought that just being by your side would make me happy. B-but now you're letting me in even closer... It's so confusing! I don't know what to do anymore!

headtouch.line: Phew... Commander, umm, this is kinda embarrassing...

home.line: Good work today, Commander~ Grab a soda and relax a little!

hp_warning.line: Urk... I gotta stand strong...!

login.line: I'm right here, Commander. I already sorted out all of your work for today!

lose.line: I'll secure an escape route!

mail.line: Mail's here, Commander. Can I leave it right there?

main1.line: "The shinobi bursts from her cocoon like a graceful butterfly!" Yeah, that's where the shadowy protector shines best!

main2.line: Commander, how'd you like that movie we watched together? I thought the ninja in it was awesome! A silent watcher in the shadows, ever protecting their master... That's an ideal guard for you!

main3.line: Ahem. As your bodyguard, it's my responsibility to direct you to rest. So hurry and take a break! Leave that work to me, 'kay?

mission.line: We have a new mission... Should I go for this one?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! What rewards will we get? I can't wait to find out!

profile.line: I'm Bell, a Fletcher-class destroyer, and I'm a great bodyguard! When it comes to your safety, you can trust me, Commander.

propose.line: Commander, you're choosing me? Really? ...I-I'd be happy to, of course! I love you, Commander, and I want to be with you forever! ...Heheh. From now on, I can be your shadow – your NINJA! Because you're the person I want to protect most of all!

touch.line: Don't worry, it's okay. I'm right here by your side.

touch2.line: C-Commander, I dunno if this is a good idea...

unlock.line: Commander, it's an honor to finally make your acquaintance! I'm Bell, a Fletcher-class shipgirl, and I'll be your personal ninja... I mean, your bodyguard, from now on!

upgrade.line: I have to use this power to protect everyone...

win_mvp.line: Big sorry! Victory belongs to us, not you.

gift_prefer.line: You really know what I like, Commander!

detail_ex.line: You've always been protecting everyone in your own way... Kinda like the legendary ninjas I've seen in movies! Oh... Maybe ninja isn't all that apt a comparison for you...

expedition_ex.line: What rewards should we prepare for the people coming back from their commission trip?

feeling5_ex.line: There are so many girls who are more impressive than me. I mean, all I can do is bodyguard work... But you still accepted my feelings and chose me. That made me the happiest girl in the world! So happy that I can't even think of the words to express it!

home_ex.line: As a reward for going out to battle, would you like the red soda, or the blue one? Don't tell me to mix them both in one bottle.

login_ex.line: I'm right here, Commander. I organized your work for the day, so don't slack off, okay?

main4_ex.line: A ninja protects her lord – that's what I like most about them. Staying ever by your side like a shadow is just like how I am now, don't you think? Hehe!

main5_ex.line: I see... You take my presence for granted now. Heehee, I can hardly bear to leave your side, too!

main6_ex.line: Commander, you can't sleep here! Even if you're tired, no means no! ...Come on, at least go sleep in your room!

touch_ex.line: I'm holding hands with the Commander... Hehe...

touch2_ex.line: Commander, d-does it... have to be here?

win_mvp_ex.line: With the Commander's help, victory is an easy feat!

detail.line: There are rumors of a really attractive ranger coming by the tavern. Can you guess who it is? It's you, of course! Next drink's my treat.

feeling5.line: It's been so much fun spending time with you! U-umm, if you don't mind... Could you stay a while? This tavern needs an owner, or whatever... If it's okay with you, I want you to be here with me... forever and ever!

headtouch.line: Urk... Thanks for trying to make me feel better. Next time, I definitely won't trip over!

login.line: Commander, what are you ordering today? You'd like my recommendation? Hehe, okay!

main1.line: If you hadn't helped me, I would've been in real trouble... Oh! Some got on your clothes! You'd better get changed before they're all sticky, okay? I-I'll show you to a private room!

main2.line: Commander, let's take a walk to the river later. We could pan for gold!

main3.line: Lately, things around the saloon have gotten kinda restless... What if you stayed here to keep things orderly? We have a room and suitable pay!

mission.line: Phew... I can't let the Commander handle every problem that comes up. It's time for me to act!

mission_complete.line: Problem resolved! Commander, wanna see the rewards we got?

touch.line: Commander, do you want seconds?

touch2.line: Commander, I'm at work...

unlock.line: Welcome to our saloon... Oh, no! I can't hold all these mugs! ...C-Commander? Why are you here?

battle.line: Heheh, Miller the GOAT is ready to kick ass!

couple_encourage1.line: Hmm... Is that supposed to get the Commander's attention?

couple_encourage2.line: You call yourself a good girl?

detail.line: When the Commander usually wants lunch... Your favorite tea... The last time you praised me... Mm, I give it two stars. I'll start practicing my new cool look tomorrow – Aaaargh! H-how long have you been there?! Stop peeping when I'm journaling, stupid!

expedition.line: Oi, Commander! The commission team's back, so how about we go see them? I-I wanna help... I mean, I wanna help PRANK them!

feeling1.line: Hmph. I knew you wouldn't understand me – just like everyone else. I wouldn't... I wouldn't be sad about that...!

feeling2.line: Would I look badder if I had an arrogant smirk? Man, it's hard... Hwuh? C-Commander? No, I'm NOT practicing how to smirk like a bad girl! This is the wicked coolness this GOAT was born with!

feeling3.line: (Keeping up this bad-girl persona is going to be hard, but will the Commander like me if I don't?) 'Sup, Commander. Here to beg the GOAT to stop wreaking havoc on your life?

feeling4.line: Commander! Check out this new prank I thought of! It's really original... Whoa! Don't turn the page! "Being bad to attract the Commander's attention"? You must've misread it! Turn it back already! Uuugh... Give me back my notebook, please...

feeling5.line: Umm... Commander, I might not be as cool and bad as I present myself... Do you still like me, though? I'm so selfish and annoying... Huh? You think that's actually cuter?! C-cut that out! ...I like you too, okay?

headtouch.line: Hey! No touching the GOAT's head... Whoa, you listened?! Stay a little longer!

home.line: Miller the GOAT has cleaned up your office for you! ...Thanks? No thanking me! I didn't do it for you – I did it so I'd have more fun wrecking the place!

hp_warning.line: This GOAT never loses...!

login.line: Umm... O-oh! I-if it isn't the Commander! What's with the bucket in my hand? Uhh... Well, uh... It's kind of a mean prank, so I only put a LITTLE bit of water in it, but I don't want to get your documents wet... so I was just putting it away!

lose.line: Damn...! Does this mean I still haven't worked hard enough?!

mail.line: (Hmm... My notes say we should have work mail coming right about now...) Oh! Commander, you've got new mail! How do I always notice first? H-how should I know?!

main1.line: Heheh, I modded my uniform again today. Now I'm even badder... You think it's cute how I'm dressed up? Nuh-uh! Bad girls don't dress up cute!

main2.line: Hm? All of my sock holes are in the same spots? Yeah, duh, because I made them on purpose... Ack! I mean, they're all keepsakes from my dirtiest deeds! It's just a coincidence that they're all in the same spots! I did NOT do it on purpose!

main3.line: Heheheh! See those documents there, Commander? I shuffled them all out of order! Now you'll never find the important ones, 'cause they're on the bottom... WHAT?! That made it EASIER to plan out your work?!

mission.line: Commander... How do you still have so much work left over? ....Because you know I'll take care of it later? I-I'd never do that! It's the elves living in your floorboards! Th-that's gotta be it!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Wait, why are there only rewards for you? Bah, forget it. The GOAT needs no charity.

profile.line: Heheh, you wanna know more about this GOAT? I'm pretty famous for being a bad girl, ya know. ...People say I'm sweet and helpful?! WHO?! I can't have people spreading lies behind my back... Hwuh? Everyone did? Urrrg...

propose.line: Mm... If I take this, I'll have to act a certain way to keep your attention, won't I? I'll have to be a good girl, won't I? ...Y-you don't care, as long as everything's in moderation? Y-yeah, you're right! That's how the GOAT operates! I knew you'd understand me!

touch.line: Hm? What's the matter? Need something from the GOAT?

touch2.line: I-I may be a bad girl, but rules are rules! Go write an apology letter, NOW!

unlock.line: Heheh! The strongest, baddest girl in the port, Miller the GOAT has finally arrived! Hey you, are you ready to turn this place upside down?! ...B-bwuh? Why isn't the Commander saying anything? Was my carefully practiced greeting weird...?

upgrade.line: Yeeeeah! I'm the baddest girl around!

win_mvp.line: I told you I'm the strongest, baddest babe out there! (Heheh, this cool smirk is sure to steal the Commander's heart!)

gift_prefer.line: A p-present for me? If you care that much... I'll take it, okay?

detail_ex.line: Our relationship is totally different now, but that doesn't mean I'll be sweet forever! That said... If you like that more, I can try...?

feeling5_ex.line: When I'm with you now, I realize I don't have to act all bad... You'd accept me no matter how I am, wouldn't you? But that doesn't mean I'm giving up on badness! It's one of my charms, and you're cute when you're getting pranked... Ah, ignore that last part! Forget it!

headtouch_ex.line: I told you not to touch my head... Okay, fine, I guess I can let you just this once...

home_ex.line: (Alright, I'll use this new pose to capture the Commander's heart!) Welcome back, Commander! Wanna see my super-sick new pose?! Heheh, cool, right? ...Huh? Whaaat?! Y-you saw me practicing it? Aww...

login_ex.line: Hm? Commander, you're back? I-I wasn't waiting just for you, no! I just thought, since we're together and all, I should pick you up once in a while... Th-that's okay, right? Ugh, why are you laughing?!

main4_ex.line: I gotta work hard to keep up my cool bad-girl persona today! ...You like me more when I'm not pretending? Urgh... I-I mean, I have no idea what you're talking about!

main5_ex.line: Commander... Remember to eat regular meals and take breaks, okay? I-I'm just doing my job as your secretary, that's all!

main6_ex.line: Commander, try this coffee I made for you! Heheh, the wasabi I put in the mug startled you, right?! H-huh... You found it unique and interesting?!

touch_ex.line: Hmm? Your GOAT is right here~

touch2_ex.line: C-Commander... Just because we're together, that doesn't mean – Aah! That doesn't mean NEVER! ...Hyah?! A-anyway, not today!

detail.line: Why am I an experiment gone wrong when everyone else is a nurse or a doctor? Umm... 'Cause it's cool? I can't get your attention if I go along with all the other sheep! Heheh, besides, wouldn't it be unforgettable if the monster saved you?

expedition.line: You're going to see the commission team? Hmph. Then I'll have to buy time here!

feeling5.line: Heheh! I might be a monster, but as long as you know I'm a good girl... I mean, the baddest and coolest girl out there, it doesn't matter what anyone thinks! ...You think I look cute like this, too...? G-geez, now isn't the time for that!

headtouch.line: Mm! It feels weird? Well, what do you want me to do about it?

home.line: Where'd you go? You gotta tighten up – what if bad girls catch you and... Well, I guess the coolest, strongest, baddest, GOATiest experiment out there will have to save you~ (I could use an opportunity to show the Commander my skills!)

login.line: W-welcome back~ Did you find the exit? Oh, okay... (Maybe I should just make an exit? I don't wanna hurt the Commander, though.)

mail.line: Commander! New mail for you! Ugh, I told you to stop asking why I always know first!

main1.line: Commandeeer! My tail's cool as hell, right? *wag* *wag* ...Huh? I look like an attention-seeking kitten? Grrr... I'm a scary monster!

main2.line: It's okay, Commander, let this bad monster girl... that is, Miller the GOAT, rescue you! Just take my hand – Huh?! You can't get a grip?!

main3.line: Mmgh... Here, Commander. It took a lot of work to get these keys! I wanted the two of us to escape together, but there's no choice now! Hurry! I'll hold them back!

mission.line: Do you have missions to do? I didn't think you'd be so focused on work at a time like this...

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards... Do they have any clues to help us get out of this mess?

touch.line: Hm? Did you find a way out?

touch2.line: Hyah?! Th-these claws are sharp, so be careful...

unlock.line: Don't move, Commander! ...Heheh, looks like it's time for the GOAT to take the stage. That was a sick entrance, right?! Hm? N-no, I'm not here to help you out! I'm here to, uhh... Yeah, to take revenge on the scientists who experimented on me!

battle.line: All combat units have passed final inspections. Ready to engage.

couple_encourage1.line: That rigging... Uh, maybe it could use another round of testing?

couple_encourage2.line: Your new inventions are safe in my hands!

detail.line: The riskier and more unstable your machine is, the more meticulously it needs to be tested. That's why my job exists... I hope you provide good insurance, though.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission team just returned. I asked them to collect combat data for their equipment, so let's go greet them together.

feeling1.line: Don't get in the way of my work, please. You'll lower the reliability of my test results.

feeling2.line: Equipment performance and reliability must be tested in real combat. I've made preliminary assessments of the testing risks, so don't be worried.

feeling3.line: If it means removing all safety risks, I don't mind working overtime. You don't have to worry about me.

feeling4.line: Commander, I have a slight technical problem. I-if you don't mind... I could really use your advice. Umm, I think your advice... would give me the spark of inspiration I need...

feeling5.line: C-Commander, umm... Could I ask you to hold me for a while? I'm in the middle of an important test... That is, testing how important you are to me... I think I have a conclusion, too. To me, you are... irreplaceable.

headtouch.line: Huh?! O-oh no, one of the machines is throwing an error. I-I'd better go check it!

home.line: Commander, how are your missions going? I'll check all of your equipment again before you leave. Best have everything in tip-top condition, after all.

hp_warning.line: My defense systems need urgent maintenance!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. I've finished my routine inspections. Would you like to check behind me?

lose.line: It's my fault for not detecting our shortcomings sooner...

mail.line: Commander, new mail came for you. If you forget to pick it up, I'll remind you again later.

main1.line: Leave all equipment testing to me. I'll deal with any hidden risks.

main2.line: Test reports for this batch are complete. I recorded potential risks and improvements, and I await your review.

main3.line: Commander, did you read those test reports? The ones for torpedoes, main cannons, and aerial bombs. Do you think we should start with a smaller deployment? No worries – they all passed safety testing. The data doesn't lie.

mission.line: Commander, you have unfinished tasks. Doing them quickly will reduce the number of risks we face.

mission_complete.line: So you've finished your work before the deadline? Not bad. Leave the rest to me.

profile.line: I'm Clarence K. Bronson, a Fletcher-class destroyer and equipment tester working under the Eagle Union. If you have any new machines that haven't been vetted for stability, I'll examine and analyze it per my checklist to guarantee your safety.

propose.line: You want... to make an oath with me? Th-this is uncharted territory... I have to remove the risks! First, we must make sure the ring is my size... Would you please put it on my finger, Commander?

touch.line: You're... thanking me for my work? I-I was just... doing my job, that's all...

touch2.line: C-Commander...? Umm, this is going to interfere with my... sensor calibrations...

unlock.line: The name's Clarence K. Bronson. I'll be testing, evaluating, and improving equipment around the port starting today. If you ever need to be apprised of our tech status, ask me anytime.

upgrade.line: Equipment performance improved... I'll test its stability now.

win_mvp.line: Hmm... Well, my combat performance seems to be within the standard deviation.

gift_prefer.line: Oh, a gift! I-I definitely don't dislike it...

feeling5_ex.line: "Being with you is... s-so much fun!" Hmm, that one still sounded awkward... Let's go again. "Being with you is–" Huh? C-Commander?! H-how long have you been there?

headtouch_ex.line: Commander... Sh-should I take this to mean that I'm doing a good job?

login_ex.line: Commander, we'll be testing everything in your office today... Huh? Nothing is throwing up errors? Umm... A-an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure!

main4_ex.line: Commander, this next experiment is a complicated one. I don't know if I can do it alone... U-umm, could I ask for extra resource allocation?

main5_ex.line: I tested your bedding and found no hidden risks... How did I test them? Through direct use, of course.

main6_ex.line: Come with me, please. I have some equipment that requires testing outdoors, and I'll need your help... Also, I don't happen to have any plans after, sooo...

touch_ex.line: Do you need help? I'm available for you any time.

touch2_ex.line: I-I get it! You need me to test your limits!

detail.line: Rest assured, I know how to handle a whip quite well. Expect not pain, but... heart-warming stimulation. Just focus on the feeling and trust in me. I won't hurt you, I promise.

feeling5.line: Commander, are you satisfied with my services today? Will you leave with good memories of your time here? I won't stop until you've had too much fun to bear.

headtouch.line: D-don't expect all of this praise to earn you any hidden services, or anything...

home.line: You must be tired from that last mission. Let me help you relax a little.

login.line: Commander, it's time. First, I will introduce today's services. Umm... Oh, I don't have to? Okay... Then may I begin the test right away?

lose.line: I think our Commander is in need of some punishment.

main1.line: As a maid, I will do my work diligently. I won't stop even if you cry, okay? Of course, the safe word is a different story.

main2.line: What level of force would be best, I wonder? I think this calls for a few iterations of testing with you.

main3.line: You want chocolate? Okay. Open up... Test note: pain makes sweet food taste even better.

touch.line: Remember the safe word? If you don't say it, I'll keep going.

touch2.line: This is part of my special services, too...

unlock.line: Welcome, Commander. Your maid, Clarence K. Bronson, will serve you today. Rest easy and accept my special hospitality.

battle.line: I'm invincible now that I'm full! You can't stop me from fighting until I'm totally exhausted!

detail.line: M-my belly isn't fat at all, Commander! Ah, don't look at it!

expedition.line: Don't look at me like that, Commander. I'd take on commissions too if they gave snacks as rewards!

feeling1.line: Something to eat? I'm actually full right now. No thanks, Commander.

feeling2.line: Hmm? I only like commanders who can actually cook!

feeling3.line: Mmph... C-come on, surely you like your girls with a little more meat on them!

feeling4.line: Maybe I should lose some weight... What, isn't it normal to try and look good for the person you like? Besides, it's not like I'm really fat or anything!

feeling5.line: Commander, from now on, if I don't lose weight, then that's your fault! You have to take responsibility! How? By taking care of me for the rest of your life, of course!

home.line: Commander! What should we have first? Breakfast? Or lunch? Or maybe dinner~?

login.line: Commander~ Any fun things you want Omaha to do today?

lose.line: Wait until I come back with a full belly!

mail.line: You've got mail, Commander! Maybe it's the snacks I ordered yesterday?

main1.line: Ahh... I'm so hungry...

main2.line: You don't eat snacks, Commander? How dull your life must be!

main3.line: Have you eaten yet, Commander? Cause you don't look too great...

mission.line: Huh? A mission? Let me just finish these chips first...

mission_complete.line: Feed me, feed me! We'll talk about losing weight tomorrow!

profile.line: Omaha has arrived! I was born after the first World War, but as a reconnaissance ship, I've got a lifetime's worth of intel in my brain!

propose.line: Now we have a promise, Commander. You take care of the cooking, and I'll take care of the ea... housework! That way I can eat and still lose weight! I'm so smart!

skill.line: Oh no! I loaded my guns with snacks instead!

touch.line: Hm... I'm getting a bit chubby? No! I'll never give up my search for the most delicious food!

touch2.line: You're not "checking if I've gained weight" at all! You're just a big old pervert, Commander~!

unlock.line: Omaha-class cruiser - Omaha! Greetings, Commander! You could say that I'm a fleet veteran~!  Hehe~! So, since this is the first time we meet, shouldn't you celebrate by giving me some sort of gift?

upgrade.line: I got stronger, but I also got hungrier at the same time!

win_mvp.line: Oh yeah! There's no armor my guns can't penetrate!

gift_prefer.line: Whoa! This looks yummy... I mean, cute!

battle.line: Please pay attention, everyone! This is a good chance to get some real combat experience~

detail.line: Make sure you ask me any questions if you're lost before we head out!

expedition.line: It's almost time, Commander. I'll go ahead and welcome the girls back from their commission.

feeling1.line: I'm not a kid, okay!

feeling2.line: Commander, mature people like you need to pay attention on the job.

feeling3.line: You want to know more about me? Hmm... you may be the first person to treat me like an equal. I'm happy about that, I suppose.

feeling4.line: You've been taking it pretty easy recently, Commander... *Sigh*... I guess some of the blame is mine to share... It's hard to be strict with someone I like...

feeling5.line: You're calling me 'professor' in such an... interesting way when we're alone. Are you expecting to receive private lessons? You're just like a little kid, Commander...

home.line: You did quite well, Commander!

login.line: Hello, Commander. I've been waiting for you. Oh my, look at the time! Shouldn't we start the training now?

lose.line: Phew... That was close... I nearly...

mail.line: Your mail has been sorted. Remember to read your messages thoroughly, please!

main1.line: Shall we begin our training, Commander?

main2.line: For a beginner, every bit of training is very important~!

main3.line: My name is Raleigh, not... that! Also, don't forget the "Ms."!

mission.line: Commander, please don't forget about your unfinished missions!

mission_complete.line: Please don't forget to claim your mission rewards.

profile.line: I'm the training officer of the Omaha-class fleet - Raleigh. I'm going to be very strict with anyone who won't listen to what I say!

propose.line: To receive something so precious from a student... I should be ashamed to call myself a professional mentor... But you make me...

skill.line: Let me show you some textbook maneuvers.

touch.line: Please don't tug me like that... I'm not a kid!

touch2.line: I'm not immune to getting angry, you know... Co-man-der!

unlock.line: I'm Raleigh, the Omaha-class light cruiser. Please sign this contract here... There we go. I'm hoping we'll make a good team from now on, Commander.

upgrade.line: Now I can properly mentor you, Commander.

win_mvp.line: You can't use the same trick on me twice!

gift_prefer.line: For me? You really put thought into this, Commander.

battle.line: Fire at will! I have you covered!

detail.line: This information is confidential, so please keep it a closely guarded secret.

expedition.line: Though it may be tough for everyone, completing commissions like this will help raise our reputation. Let's start another one as soon as possible.

feeling1.line: Commander, I'm thinking of resigning because you just don't seem like you're worth the effort.

feeling2.line: Commander, my responsibility is to ensure that you have the upper hand in foreign affairs. Rest assured, I am an expert in that area.

feeling3.line: It feels like I've been managing your personal affairs more than foreign affairs lately, Commander... Surely this isn't on purpose, is it?

feeling4.line: Commander, a diplomat doesn't usually take on the role of a secretary... but I personally wish to deepen my relationship with you.

feeling5.line: I wish to fight only for you, to give you the upper hand... Maybe I am no longer suited to be the entire fleet's diplomat.

home.line: Good work, Commander. I will make sure that the results of your last battle come to good use.

login.line: You came just in time. A few files need your signature.

lose.line: Now we won't have an advantage during the negotiations...

mail.line: There's mail for you, Commander... Hm? Where was this sent from?

main1.line: It's important to communicate with other nations.

main2.line: Please don't stare at me in such a weird way.

main3.line: I may be a diplomat, but don't even think about underestimating my power.

mission.line: Completing missions is a good way to demonstrate our capabilities. Please take a look at some of the new missions.

mission_complete.line: Here is a summary of the rewards. Your confirmation, please, Commander.

profile.line: As the representative of the then newly constructed pre-war cruisers, I was put in charge of foreign diplomacy. That said, my firepower is never to be underestimated, so please put your mind at ease.

propose.line: Thank you, now I have more confidence in managing the fleet's affairs. Hm? I may act on your behalf for a little? What a pleasant joke. ... At any rate, I will not let you down.

skill.line: Deterrence is also a part of diplomacy...

touch.line: Are you interested in my tanned skin, Commander?

touch2.line: A diplomat is not the same thing as a secretary... Please, restrain yourself, Commander!

unlock.line: I am Brooklyn. I am an elite cruiser, so you may let me handle all foreign diplomacy matters.

upgrade.line: Power is the foundation of gunboat diplomacies. Thank you.

win_mvp.line: Now then, let us talk about reparations.

gift_prefer.line: Presents are an indispensable part of diplomacy. But either way, I'm glad to get a present from you, Commander.

battle.line: Look to the east! It's burning red!

couple_encourage1.line: C'mon, sis, brighten up a little.

couple_encourage2.line: Chicken? I'm a phoenix!

detail.line: What's the matter, Commander? You look kinda emotionless.

expedition.line: Commission completed... Hey, isn't it about time you let me head out on one?

feeling1.line: Get outta here, coward!

feeling2.line: Only those who aren't afraid of death deserve to live! Ahh, don't be afraid Commander, I don't mean that literally! What I meant to say is that it's not about living or dying, it's about what mindset you have!

feeling3.line: What's the matter? If you're okay with me then I can give you some advice!

feeling4.line: Although I respect that man, you're still you, Commander. As long as you're with me, I'm invincible!

feeling5.line: I see. It's no wonder that whenever I'm with you, I'm in such high spirits! I feel like my heart is on fire! This is it, this is love... I've never experienced this before...

home.line: Looks like we made it back safe and sound as usual today!

hp_warning.line: My hand is calling out to me to seize victory!

login.line: Hey, Commander! I'll protect you, like I always do!

lose.line: Tsk, I'll get you for this!

mail.line: Hey! Commander! Your mail is here!

main1.line: My motto is: "be the best at everything"!

main2.line: Is the sun bigger in Argentina?

main3.line: There's nothing more thrilling than coming back from the verge of death!

mission.line: How could you fall behind on something as simple as missions?

mission_complete.line: Looks like our well-deserved rewards have been delivered.

profile.line: I'm Phoenix. I once escorted a certain important person. Just like a phoenix, no matter what happens to me, I'll always come back from death! Throw all the dangerous missions you've got at me, I won't let you down!

propose.line: ... Thank you. I'll accept it. Also, um... I don't really know how to talk all sweet or flirt or anything like that, but now that you've chosen me, I promise I won't let you down!

touch.line: It's here, it's here! Want to head out now?

touch2.line: Hey~! Be a gentleman!

unlock.line: Are you the commander? I'm Phoenix. That's right, the legendary phoenix! Do you have what it takes to lead me?

upgrade.line: Alright! I've gotten stronger!

win_mvp.line: Hahah! Aren't there any strong enemies left for me to fight?

gift_prefer.line: Whoa! I've been gunning for this for a while! Thanks!

battle.line: The enemy can't hide from me.

couple_encourage1.line: Penny, cover me!

couple_encourage2.line: SG, full area scan! I will never let that tragedy repeat itself!

couple_encourage3.line: Chicky Unit... sounds kind of cute!

couple_encourage4.line: St. Louis, please take the battle a bit more seriously...

couple_encourage5.line: Honolulu, I'm here to back you up!

detail.line: I can't rely on this thing alone...

expedition.line: Hey, Commander, could I lend my SG radar to my sisters this time?

feeling1.line: SG, protect me...

feeling2.line: If only my recon could help the others...

feeling3.line: My expression? Ah... it's because I left while we were on the losing end of the war... I might just not be so used to peace and happiness. But don't worry, I'll be fine!

feeling4.line: I think I've been more at ease lately... No, I was just too tense up until now. It's all thanks to the courage you've given me by being beside me.

feeling5.line: I believe that you will bring us hope, Commander. This time, I'll fight to the end... Just the thought of saying goodbye to the person I love makes me feel like my heart will tear in half...

home.line: Did everyone make it back safe and sound? Good. But there's spare parts lying around in the docks now... I wonder why...

hp_warning.line: SG, lock on the enemy position!

login.line: ... Ah, welcome back, Commander. Sorry, I was just brooding over something.

lose.line: ... Please, save me... Ignore the enemy, just let them go...

mail.line: You've got new mail. It's important to stay in touch with your loved ones.

main1.line: Are you trying to hide, Commander? No matter where you hide, I know where you are.

main2.line: Commander, what should we do after the war?

main3.line: If only my guns could be as strong as my radar...

mission.line: Bit by bit we'll build the foundation for victory. We'll start by doing missions.

mission_complete.line: Resources are no good if they just pile up. We should make use of them.

profile.line: I was designed to be on par with heavy cruisers, but just my power alone isn't enough to save everyone... Commander, can you help me?

propose.line: A promise... from you, Commander? I see... I'm so happy...

touch.line: Hm? I'm fine. I'm just... a little distracted.

touch2.line: If this makes you feel good, then... I'm fine with it.

unlock.line: Nice to meet you, Commander. I'm Helena. My strong suit is enemy reconnaissance. Please... guide us towards victory.

upgrade.line: I'll use this power to protect everyone!

win_mvp.line: ... We actually won?

gift_prefer.line: I... kind of like this.

battle.line: I... want to win!

detail.line: St. Louis must've had a lot of fun making me try out so many clothes... Do you really think I look cute this way, Commander?

feeling5.line: Commander? You don't have to worry about me. I was just thinking about how I now have friends and a sweetheart who I can celebrate the new year together with, and how unbelievably happy it makes me.

home.line: Let me be part of the mission, Commander. My SG would surely be good to have.

login.line: It seems the New Year's spirit has swept over the entire fleet.

lose.line: It's okay, there's always the next time...!

main1.line: My New Year's wish is... that I'll be more courageous and positive, and that no harm will come to any of my friends...

main2.line: For this year's shrine visit, the whole Brooklyn-class, Cleveland, and her Knights of The Sea all went there together as one big family.

main3.line: It's snowing... I never realized how peaceful and beautiful snow can be.

touch.line: Huh? I was just thinking about what I should do during New Year's... There are so many things I want to do.

touch2.line: C-Commander, please stop...

unlock.line: I... want to be part of the new year festivities too. Oh, you don't have to worry about me. I'm no longer the fledgling I once was.

win_mvp.line: That's right...! You did a great job, me!

battle.line: I... want to win!

detail.line: In preparation for today, I got St. Louis to teach me how to dance. She laughed a lot at me, telling me I'm "such a klutz"... Ahah.

expedition.line: Commander, let's extend an invitation to the commission team to join us for the party.

feeling5.line: You and my friends have always taken care of, looked after, and protected me. But that can't go on forever. I want to stand beside you and become someone people can count on... So, could you wait for me just a little longer... please?

home.line: Commander, before we leave for the party, do you have any unfinished business?

login.line: Commander, the party is about to start.

lose.line: It's okay, there's always next time...!

mail.line: It seems you've got an invitation to another dance party... Hahah, you really are a superstar, Commander.

main1.line: Commander, you know something? It's thanks to you that I've become as cheerful as I am now. Ahah~

main2.line: I'm not going to be scared or hesitate ever again because you and my friends are always with me.

main3.line: My dance partner will be... No, it'll just be you, Commander. I have so many things I want to tell you.

mission.line: Commander, please go complete your missions. Don't worry, I'll be here waiting for you.

mission_complete.line: You really are incredible, Commander.

touch.line: I'm all ready, Commander. Shall we dance?

touch2.line: Eek?! ... Ah, sorry, did I step on your foot, Commander?

unlock.line: Um, Commander, could we... share a dance? I have things I want to tell you...

win_mvp.line: Yeah, that's right...! You're awesome, Helena!

battle.line: Keep calm and focus, Helena!

detail.line: I'm okay with wearing a swimsuit – we all wear them on the beach, after all. It's only when you look at me that I get all shy... It's a weird feeling.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. No, it wasn't my SG that told me, but a friend. As for who... that's a secret.

feeling5.line: Be confident, Helena. It's okay to fawn on the Commander. You started this when you mustered your courage, remember? So just... H-hey! Commander, would you mind... taking the lead for our date?

headtouch.line: Heehee... *blushes*

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. If you, uh, have a moment, we could go for a swim... I know you just got back from the ocean, but... still?

login.line: Whew... This breeze is lovely... Hey, Commander, for just a brief moment, I was thinking I could... be more daring around you...

lose.line: Commander, over here! I'll keep you safe!

mail.line: A letter has arrived. Do you want to read it now?

main1.line: SG, track the Commander's exact location. If we meet before I've mentally prepared myself for it, I might just freak out...

main2.line: I like "you're pretty" over "you're cute" as a compliment... Oh, that doesn't mean you can't say I'm cute or anything... It's obviously up to you to decide how to compliment me, Commander, you can even use both, so... *whimper*...

main3.line: Just tell me if anything feels wrong. It's my... No, it's all our job to ensure you don't have anything to worry about.

mission.line: Commander, please go complete your missions. Don't worry, I'll be here waiting for you.

mission_complete.line: You really are incredible, Commander.

touch.line: Mhm, I'm all ears. What is it, Commander?

touch2.line: Umm, I... *blushes*

unlock.line: Commander, what do you think... umm... about this swimsuit? Actually, umm, never mind. If I were to hear your impressions directly, I'd be too embarrassed to stand in front of you... So, would you mind, umm... secretly whispering it to me?

win_mvp.line: Thank you, SG. You help me push myself.

battle.line: I'm... okay!

detail.line: It's only natural that I want to make the best of this luxury bath. Whether I can do it or not is a different matter, though...

expedition.line: Uh-oh, the commission team is back... D-don't worry about me, you just go ahead and go out to meet them!

feeling5.line: It'll be fine, Helena. You'll get to bathe with the Commander in just a minute, and then... Hm? Open the door so you can come help? Oh, right! I'm so forgetful. I should've invited you in the first– Ah, be careful!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. The bath will be ready in a few moments. Wanna join me? Also, want to try letting me wash your back?

login.line: Since I'd never done this before, I researched everything from how to get ready to how to enter the bath, but in the end, nothing went as I'd planned... I should've just asked you in the first place.

mail.line: A letter? Ahh... Sorry, Commander, but please read that one yourself first.

main1.line: Bath items... Check. Same for the towels and bottles of sake... Oh, shoot, I forgot to pour the sak– Eek! The soap fell... I need to find it, and fast.

main2.line: I've never run a bath quite like this before. It takes a lot more than just courage to take on new things. You know, like composure, knowledge, handiness...

main3.line: Whew... This aroma of fruit and cypress makes me feel so relaxed. How about a whiff, Commander?

mission.line: There's no need to worry about the missions, Commander. We can take our time with them later.

mission_complete.line: You never cease to amaze me, Commander. Oh, I'm almost done over here, too! I think!

touch.line: The soap fell? Umm, where did it go?

touch2.line: Even though there's glass between us... *blushes*

unlock.line: Eek! C-Commander? Um, I'm fine! Nothing's wrong, I just tripped on– Wait, why did the smart glass turn off?! Oh nooo!

win_mvp.line: Whew... I worked up a sweat. Oh, I guess I should bathe again when we get back...

battle.line: I'm... going to win!

detail.line: I used to feel constant anxiety over if I'm capable or not, but nowadays... that anxiety's been overtaken by confidence, knowing all will be fine when you're with me. Heehee.

expedition.line: The commission team has come back. That's at least some weight off my mind.

feeling5.line: When I'm with you, I keep hoping you'll rely on me, but instead I'm the one who relies on you... It's sort of backwards, isn't it? Heehee... I'm so, so happy to be your wife, Commander.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. My SG told me that you were on your way, but I had to see you with my own eyes.

lose.line: It's okay, Helena. There's always next time...!

main1.line: I'll cook dinner tonight! And breakfast tomorrow, and dinner after that, and breakfast the day after– Oops! I blurted all that without thinking...

main2.line: Having experienced such bliss for a while now, I've started wishing for an even more blissful future... It's sort of selfish of me, but you don't mind, do you?

main3.line: I can't be reliant on my SG forever... Huh? So I should turn to you for help instead? ...Okay! I'll try to, at least...

touch.line: I should be fine if you, um, hold my hand for just another minute...

touch2.line: W-wait, I need time to prepare myself...

unlock.line: Wh-what do you think, Commander? Does it suit me? ...I never could've imagined getting to wear this even in my dreams, let alone experience the bliss I feel now... Thank you so, so much.

win_mvp.line: Don't get complacent, Helena... You've got to get even stronger!

battle.line: I'm... going to win!

detail.line: St. Louis always praises me like, "my, how you've grown" whenever I do anything... It's kind of embarrassing...

expedition.line: SG receiving message... A commission team has returned to port.

feeling5.line: I feel a bit more confident in myself when I'm with you, Commander. But I want more; I want to be the girl you rely on so I can be the center of your attention... It might be selfish to ask, but... will you love me?

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Let's get to work and do our best.

lose.line: It's okay, Helena. There's always next time...!

main1.line: You want to know what my new and improved SG is capable of? All right... Find a place to hide that nobody knows about. Hehehe~

main2.line: I think everyone would be better off living in the present without regrets than spend every day anxious about the future.

main3.line: It's not enough to focus only on improving my equipment. I need to become stronger to use it properly, too.

touch2.line: You really can't go around doing this, Commander!

unlock.line: This new equipment... might take some time to get used to... N-no, I'm sure I can handle it now! Commander, Helena will... meet your expectations!

win_mvp.line: Don't get complacent, Helena... You've got to get even stronger!

battle.line: I'll show you what the tons-of-guns doctrine is really worth!

detail.line: Ah, Commander's looking... I have to behave like a big sister!

expedition.line: Commander, the commission's done. Are we gonna go welcome the girls back?

feeling1.line: Sometimes I'm happy that I'm not actually your big sister...

feeling2.line: Being a big sister isn't just about looking like one, you need to have the personality of one as well. That's why you can depend on me all you want~!

feeling3.line: The bigger the better, don't you think? ...Hey! What are you staring at?! Gee, sorry for not being big enough, I guess!

feeling4.line: Are you fond of assertive big sister type characters? That is to say... someone like me...

feeling5.line: ... Huh? You want me to take the initiative? O-o-o-o-of course, I don't mind! I-I mean, I'm your big sister after all, so it's my job to guide you!

home.line: That's the Commander I know. No problem for you at all, right?

login.line: Commander, if you ever run into a problem, please tell me!

lose.line: Argh, this is bad... My big sister image is ruined...

mail.line: You've got new mail! I wonder if any of the messages are from my sisters...

main1.line: Not being a flagship sure is more peaceful...

main2.line: San Francisco was terrible to me! Just once is tolerable for accidental friendly fire, but she shot me well over ten times!

main3.line: Shooting down aircraft is my specialty. Want me to teach you how to do it, Commander?

mission.line: So, does this mean you're leaving all your unfinished missions to me, Commander?

mission_complete.line: Our mission rewards have arrived. I'll give my share of the rewards to my little sisters.

profile.line: I'm the anti-aircraft cruiser Atlanta... I was the flagship of the 10th and 11th Atlantic cruising fleet and I've taken part in nearly every military operation in the Pacific. Even the President has given me praise!

propose.line: Thank you... From now on I'll... What? You'd prefer it if I took the initiative and gave it to you instead? Y-you have a point... Okay then, should we do it again from the start?

touch.line: Mgh, don't touch me like that... My big sister image would be ruined!

touch2.line: *Eek* W-what are you doing?!

unlock.line: I'm the anti-aircraft cruiser Atlanta. Kept you waiting, huh, Commander? But from now on you can rest easy and let me handle everything!

upgrade.line: Let me handle things from now on!

win_mvp.line: All targets eliminated. Requesting new mission!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh, this is... Thanks a lot!

battle.line: Everyone... look after yourselves... and watch out for those mean submarines...

detail.line: The... old injury to my foot? Well... my foot's still a bit stiff, but I won't ever let myself drag everyone else down...!

expedition.line: Umm... Commander... there's a commission that's been completed...

feeling1.line: Don't come near me! ...Sorry, I think you're a little scary, Commander...

feeling2.line: I... often have nightmares about five brothers whose faces are all blurred, and they tell me to come with them... It's really scary...

feeling3.line: Commander, can I go to bed with you again tonight? ... I feel very safe when I sleep next to you...

feeling4.line: I'm not afraid of having nightmares anymore... b-but can I still sleep together with you, Commander...?

feeling5.line: Now when I dream about those five brothers... I can see their faces clearly, and they bless me with their smiles... But somehow it was so sad it almost made me cry... *Tearful sobbing*... Can I really live happily together with you, Commander? It's not just a dream, right...?

home.line: I'm really hoping this war will end soon... Once it's over, let's all go someplace together...

login.line: C-Commander... I'll always be w-waiting for you here...

lose.line: That hurts! ... I can't feel my left foot... Someone come save me....!

mail.line: Commander... excuse me... here's your mail...

main1.line: *Eek* Commander?! Y-you scared me...

main2.line: I want to be brave... But it's really hard...

main3.line: Commander, have I annoyed you in any way...?

mission.line: What? A mission? I don't mind as long as we aren't fighting submarines...

mission_complete.line: I don't need any rewards... just being here with everyone is enough for me...

profile.line: I-I'm Juneau, an Atlanta-class anti-aircraft cruiser... Because I have high anti-air capabilities, I was assigned to a Task Force, but I'm actually scared of getting shot... Unfortunately I couldn't make it back home from Espiritu Santo...

propose.line: ...Mhm, I have faith in you, Commander... I told the people in my dreams that I've found happiness and would do my best to live on for their sake as well... I'm truly... truly happy right now...

skill.line: Me too! I-I'll give it my best shot!

touch.line: Pl... please be gentle... I'm very susceptible to pain...

touch2.line: Mmh... *Whimper*...

unlock.line: I-I'm Juneau... I'm a cruiser... I'm scared of pain... *Sob* And I'm scared of you, Commander...!

upgrade.line: I'll... try to work harder...!

win_mvp.line: Phew... I almost got hit... *Sob*... I don't care about being the MVP... I'm just trying my best so I can come home in one piece...

gift_prefer.line: I can... have this? I-I'll cherish it like it's my baby! Aaaah, I can't believe I said that!

battle.line: I'll do everything I can to make these peaceful days last forever...!

detail.line: Oh, the sun's reflection in that lake looks amazing! Commander, can we go have a closer– Eek! ...Ugh, sorry for that. I almost tripped there because I'm not used to walking in a dress. Thank you for catching me...!

expedition.line: Oops, I got completely distracted by the scenery... Commander, a commission just got completed!

home.line: You could rest on the bench if your feet are sore, Commander. I'll figure out where we should go next in the meanwhile!

login.line: I've heard the scenery out back is stunning too. Commander, I-I'd love to snap some pictures of it with you, if you don't mind.

main1.line: Having seen your gentle side and petted these swans, it feels like my scaredy-cat self is no longer, you know? Heehee.

main2.line: Thank you for telling me I look good in this! San Juan really deserves credit for helping me get through my anxiety preparing for this date, including picking out this dress.

main3.line: Not only do I get the date of my dreams, but I also get to be in a picture just with you... I'm an extremely lucky person, aren't I? Aw gosh...

mission.line: Excuse me, Commander, I think you have new missions. I'll try to do my part in them!

mission_complete.line: That's quite a lot of mission rewards! This should be enough to buy gifts for San Diego and my friends.

touch.line: Aren't these frills pretty? I really like them too...

touch2.line: Oh... Oh gosh...

unlock.line: This swan is so soft and pettable... Heehee, it even let me put a ribbon on it. Now we have matching looks... Huh? You could take a picture of us? I-if it's not too much work then please, by all means!

win_mvp.line: Heehee. The swan is happy for us.

battle.line: I'll probably be fine, even if submarines show up...

detail.line: I'll need some getting used to my improved gear... but I swear I won't be a liability!

expedition.line: E-excuse me, Commander... A commission was just completed...

home.line: Great work out there, Commander... Won't you please take me with you next time? I want to fight side-by-side with everyone else...

login.line: Good morning, Commander... I'd be happy to do anything I can to help.

main1.line: What can I do to make this war end sooner... Oh, Commander? Wh-what are you doing here?

main2.line: Seeing how the rest of the fleet fights gives me goosebumps... I hope I can be like them one day...!

main3.line: San Diego is leagues better than me, despite being my little sister... No, I can't think that way! I have to keep working at it!

touch.line: Is this a reward for the work I've done? Aww, thank you!

touch2.line: Eep! P-please be gentle with me...

unlock.line: After all that painstaking work, I've f-finally managed to complete my retrofit! Even though I'm still afraid of getting hurt, I'll try to be brave for you, Commander!

upgrade.line: I owe it all to you, Commander!

win_mvp.line: This is entirely thanks to you, Commander! I'm happy to be the MVP, but I'm just more relieved that the battle's over...

battle.line: Full speed ahead! ... Ah, that was close... I almost tripped...

couple_encourage1.line: Sara, let's play!

couple_encourage2.line: Kaede's Legion? Sounds powerful!

detail.line: What's so interesting about this stuff? Let's go play instead~!

expedition.line: Commander, Commander! I think a commission's been completed!

feeling1.line: Don't come near me! Your stupidity is contagious!

feeling2.line: C'mon, Commander! Don't think too much, let's play!

feeling3.line: C'mon, Commander, let's have a race! Winner treats the loser to a snack!

feeling4.line: You often say mean stuff about me, but in reality you're actually having fun, aren't you~?

feeling5.line: I used to not really think about anything, but now all I can think about is you, Commander! ... Not that much has changed, though!

home.line: Commander, let's go get something duh-licious to eat!

hp_warning.line: They're actually trying to fight us?!

login.line: Hey, Commander, let's have an exciting water gun fight!

lose.line: Huh? Who's this? Where am I...? How did I lose?!

mail.line: Commander, new mail for you! Creases? N-no, I totally wasn't making paper planes out of your mail, okay?!

main1.line: Apparently people come looking for me after they've planted apple seeds... am I some kind of harvest god or something?!

main2.line: Battle stars? Are they really that amazing? I thought everyone had some?

main3.line: Come on, get motivated, now! Sit around like this and you'll go dumb!

mission.line: Bring on the missions, no matter how many there are!

mission_complete.line: Co-man-der! Look, look! We got some rewards!

profile.line: I'm San Diego! I've heard I'm second only to Enterprise for the most stars earned! ... I don't really know what a "star" is, but it sounds cool! What is it, Commander? ... A-merry-car? Is that some kind of secret code?

propose.line: Commander, I'm not dumb, I can tell that one's a fake! ...Huh? It's real?! Then does that mean... you're serious about this...?

skill.line: I'm not sure what's going on, but let's do it~!

touch.line: Hey, what are you looking for?

touch2.line: Hey, not so fast you pervert!

unlock.line: Hello~! I'm San Diego, the cruiser who earned the most stars in World War 2! Hehe, that's it for my introduction! I'm just too good!

upgrade.line: It feels like I got a little smarter!

win_mvp.line: I was just getting warmed up... Why are they surrendering already?

gift_prefer.line: Wow! This is amazing! Where did you get this?!

main1.line: That's strange, why's the microphone cord getting shorter and shorter?

main2.line: I don't really get it, but if I work hard, it'll be A-O-K!

main3.line: Commander, wanna sing a few songs as well? Ehehe, here, here! Wooaahh! (CRASH) W-who tripped me?

touch.line: The smartest person is the one who is the happiest! Ehehe, that's why San Diego is the smartest!

unlock.line: Merry Christmas! Super idol San Diego, making her dazzling debut! Commander, you must come to my performance! ...Venue?! What's that?

battle.line: San Diego, moving out! Go, go, go!

detail.line: Is my June bride look just the bestest or what!

feeling5.line: It's kinda weird, but I get this feeling like thinking of you makes me grow stronger, Commander! Wait, doesn't that mean I'm gonna change eventually? Nope! 'Cause I'm gonna be your number one!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Your sweetie San Diego's been waiting for you!

login.line: I've already finished today's work and did it all in a flash! Now c'mon, it's time to have fun!

main1.line: So, Commander! You mind having tonight's dinner microwaved? Is the bath at 50 degrees all cool with you? Don't answer, 'cause San Diego went and did it all already!

main2.line: Man, San Juan's such a worrywart~ I'll be just fine, 'cause I've got you, Commander! Everything's gonna be right as rain!

main3.line: I'll cheerlead for you, Commander! Hip, hip, hooray! One, two, three! Whoop-de-doo!

touch.line: Feel my Commander-smartifying sparkly beam!

touch2.line: Whoa, whoa, whoa!
