detail.line: Both in the past and present, being able to help your friends in various ways outside of battle is something to be happy about. Hm? You feel happy just from being with me...?

expedition.line: The girls seem to be back from their commissions. Good tidings arrive on the wind.

feeling5.line: I left the handkerchief I use to wipe my tears back at home. ...I had some trouble finding a good place to stow it away, and moreover, I don't feel like I'll be crying all that much. There's no need for you to worry, Commander.

headtouch.line: Pennsylvania? Oh, it's...

login.line: My desire to protect my friends... has been made possible here. Hehe, of course I'll continue to give it my all.

lose.line: Time to evacuate? Understood!

main1.line: If wearing this outfit means I can help my friends make wonderful memories, I don't mind doing it.

main2.line: Do you think I should try to learn some dance steps from a real dancer? Would it be okay if I asked California for help?

main3.line: Oh, Commander... there's something on your cheek. Let me wipe it off... and done.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have arrived. It's always nice to have extra supplies.

touch.line: Stay calm, Arizona...

touch2.line: Please keep this a secret from my sister...

unlock.line: I heard these clothes are from the Dragon Empery, but they're a bit... Umm, it's not that I dislike them, but the thought of you seeing me in them is rather embarrassing... B-but it's not like I'm going to start crying...

win_mvp.line: Dancing might not be my strong suit, but I know how to fight!

battle.line: March through the gates of hell! May our image be burned into the eyes of our enemies!

detail.line: You can look all you want. Just don't forget about your job.

expedition.line: The commission team is back? Allow me to show how they should really be handled.

feeling1.line: You really are helpless...

feeling2.line: My motto is, 'survival of the fittest'

feeling3.line: Commander, you are still too weak. Come and train with me, and I will turn you into a proper Commander!

feeling4.line: You're looking good these days. Hmm? Ah, not to worry. I've always stuck around with you. I don't want all the training to be in vain, after all.

feeling5.line: I'm used to your pace now after all this time. I've yet to get used to staying in a room all day... If anything happens to me because of this, it's all on you. Don't tell me you're gonna dodge the issue.

home.line: When is the next sortie?

login.line: Commander, it's time to roll!

lose.line: Yes. Yes! This is the kind of challenge I'm looking for!

mail.line: Commander, you've got new mail

main1.line: Commander! If you don't sortie, I'll bring the girls and head to new waters myself!

main2.line: I totally cannot comprehend why you're so easygoing...

main3.line: The secret to getting a better figure?... Cease with such jokes.

mission.line: Hurry and take care of the missions, will you?

mission_complete.line: Your rewards are here, Commander.

profile.line: I am the new type of battleship, Tennessee. In terms of combat, my waterline protection and hull armor have been upgraded, and my fire control systems have improved my fighting capabilities further. Commander, your orders?

propose.line: If I take this, it means I'm yours forever? Fine, but on one condition; I want none of that 'You'll get hurt if you're in the battlefield' crap. I need some action every now and then!

touch.line: Mm... 'Cute' doesn't quite fit me.

touch2.line: I'm not a 'Clear' target like in a game!

unlock.line: You're the Commander? Hmm... Looks like you have potential. I'm motivated enough to help with your dreams. Ah, that reminds me, I am Tennessee. Got it memorized?

upgrade.line: Like a full score and then some... Not bad.

win_mvp.line: This kind of battle is quite good

gift_prefer.line: Hahahaha! This is great! Thanks!

battle.line: Don't panic...Calm down... Let's go!

detail.line: Commander, I will do my best to meet everyone's expectations

expedition.line: Commander, the girls from the commissions have returned. Let me do one next time, please~

feeling1.line: Commander, I'll go play on my own now~

feeling2.line: You don't know if you can be friends with someone unless you tried to make them. Commander, wanna hang out together?

feeling3.line: *humming* Ah, Commander~ Just who I was looking for. I was thinking about taking you some place to have fun!

feeling4.line: We've already had fun throughout the docks. How about we go some place farther? Just the two of us... Heh heh heh...

feeling5.line: Tennesee said to me, 'You must be careful who you choose as a partner.' 'Once you do, tell me', she also said. Well, if it's you, Commander, she won't say a word, I think...

home.line: You looked great just now, Commander!

login.line: Weather, check. Wind, check. A fine sailing day, Commander.

lose.line: Oof... Big sis will lecture me for sure!

mail.line: It's new mail. Wanna open it up right away?

main1.line: I feel different from big sister? That's not true. She might not look it but she's actually kind

main2.line: Ah~ Big sis didn't say much today... Wha! N-nothing at all!

main3.line: Ah, where did my undies go? Eheh

mission.line: Commander, don't forget to do your missions!

mission_complete.line: Hahaha, this is good!

profile.line: Hello. I am the second of the Tennessee class battleships, California. I was once the flagship of the Pacific fleet, and was part of the Atlantic fleet as well. How about it? Bet you didn't expect that I was a popular one, did you? Hehe~

propose.line: Commander, where are we going to play today? ...WHA! ...Seriously, I don't... I'm happy and all, but please don't pull this again. You surprised me...

touch.line: This is comfy. Every time big sis scolds me, she comforts me with this afterwards as well.

touch2.line: Wait-... Commander! Where are you touching? Big sis wouldn't do this!

unlock.line: Hello, Commander. I am California. It's not good to brag, but I'm quite strong you know. Do look forward to it~

upgrade.line: Now I can reach for further waters~

win_mvp.line: Aaah... that was a great workout

gift_prefer.line: Wow, I love this! Thanks!

battle.line: I will not allow you to misbehave anymore... All guns, ready to fire a volley!

detail.line: Commander... Can you take your eyes off me?

expedition.line: A lot of oil and supplies have been shipped in. Looks like we got plenty of both for the next mission.

feeling1.line: Commander, please… don’t come any closer.

feeling2.line: I’m proud of my BIG SEVEN title. Unfortunately the battleship era is closing, and a new wave of ships are arriving...

feeling3.line: Commander, why do you care about me so much? Many people are afraid of me and keep their distance from me. Perhaps I've been too used to this. But recently, I’ve suddenly felt... so lonely.

feeling4.line: The Commander is willing to talk to someone as bad-tempered as me. Such a weirdo... I don't hate talking to the Commander, though.

feeling5.line: The Commander's compliment after the end of each battle is something which I crave for. Commander, can you... praise me a little more?

home.line: Making sure everyone returns home safely is also one of my duties.

hp_warning.line: The bridge was hit? Damage control, now!

login.line: Commander, you’ve rested long enough. When shall we weigh anchor?

lose.line: This is not the end of the line...

mail.line: You’ve got new mail. There may be news from my sisters...

main1.line: Commander, although aircraft carriers are really powerful, but battleships are not obsolete. They are indispensable!

main2.line: Amelia... She was a great woman, though she still cannot be found. Perhaps she is flying freely in another world...

main3.line: My poor sisters were hurt on that humiliating day. One day, I will have those invaders pay for what they have done!

mission.line: Whether you need fire support or fleet battle, please give the order Commander.

mission_complete.line: Commander, mission reward has been delivered.

profile.line: I'm the lead ship of the Colorado class. In order to gain an advantage in the decisive battle, I'm the first ship to be equipped with 406mm guns. BIG SEVEN... is the most honored title for us battleships.

propose.line: Unknowingly I’ve slowly become more dependent on you, Commander. With the power of the BIG SEVEN, I shall protect you until my dying breath.

skill.line: It's time to show you the true power of the BIG SEVEN!

touch.line: Commander, please don't touch the main gun that I was just using, you will affect my shooting accuracy.

touch2.line: Shall I load the Commander into a 406mm gun and fire him?

unlock.line: Are you the one calling me? Well, I've been waiting for this day for a long time. In the name of the BIG SEVEN, Eagle Union battleship Colorado, reporting in.

upgrade.line: Emm, as one of the BIG SEVEN, my powers are unquestionable. Although, timely enhancements are still a necessity.

win_mvp.line: Huh? Am I the MVP? Such a piece of cake for one of the BIG SEVEN.

gift_prefer.line: Is this meant to improve my temper? Well, I may as well accept it as a one-off...

battle.line: I can't let you get caught up in the battle... Shoo, hurry away!

detail.line: Commander, um... your gaze is making me a bit uncomfortable. My sisters might be different, but I'm not really used to having people look at me...

feeling5.line: Hm-hmm~♪ It's in pretty good condition today, just as you said. Um... would you mind if I played you one more song?

headtouch.line: ...Hehehe.

home.line: I want to perform for people, not a crowd of trees in the barren wilderness. I'll keep fighting in order to keep it that way... together with my sisters.

login.line: (If the Commander wasn't waiting for me, I'd have liked to stay like this for a bit longer...)

mail.line: So there's new mail. Maryland's as fast to act as always.

main1.line: The Big Five... Yet another name that we were proud to be called.

main2.line: I'm not sure what I'll do if there ever comes a time when I can take off my rigging, along the title of the Big Seven... I'm sure that that girl from the Sakura Empire is thinking the same thing.

main3.line: Where would I like to go? Well... if it's not too much to ask... that place where you can pet cats.

mission.line: Commander, there are still some missions left... Make sure you check on them later.

touch.line: It's already been tuned, Commander. Leave it be. It's as delicate as my main guns are.

touch2.line: Don't I feel... cold to the touch?

unlock.line: Hmm-hum-hum... So very cute~♪ ...Commander? Um, about that... Please do me a favor and forget you heard anything.

win_mvp.line: The fact that I can still be helpful to people makes me happy.

detail.line: Where do you wanna go next time? Ah, there are still some places you suggested to me that I haven't been to yet. Let's do those first. After that... could I suggest a few places?

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Will you be back... after you've gone to see them?

feeling5.line: You being here for us has helped us find new goals and pleasures. Yeah, I'm not talking about big stuff like being the strongest or world peace. I mean performing with friends, watching fireworks, and enjoying this beautiful view. I value the wonderful times we spend together more than anything else.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Have you seen my sisters? No, I'm not worried about them, just wondering if they'd tried to rope you into something. Heehee.

login.line: La-la-laa♪ ...Oh, it's a new song me and my sisters made. Thought I'd brush up on it a bit.

main1.line: I'll never get tired of this amazing view. I'd have been worse off if you hadn't told me about it.

main2.line: Do you not like getting tanned? Me neither, really. Don't tell anyone, though... If people knew, I'd look less reliable both as a Big Seven and as an older sister.

main3.line: "I'm conserving my stamina for the concert later"... Sounds like a believable excuse, but I don't think you'd buy it. In reality, I'm locking down a seat early for the fireworks show. Heheh.

mission.line: I wish I could tell you to forget your missions... Let's get them done so we can all watch the fireworks together.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Now we can enjoy the closing party with peace of mind.

touch.line: The sea breeze is starting to get colder. Should we put on some clothes?

touch2.line: Doing this while they're all still there...

unlock.line: You'd rather stay here and watch the sunset with me than bathe with the rest in the sea? You sure you wanna spend your beach day that way? Err, well... I'm fine with it if you are.

win_mvp.line: We won't go down. No matter what.

battle.line: Combat code red! Everyone, in position!

detail.line: Commander, I agree that my new main guns are cool, but you're staring at them an awful lot... It's not the guns you're looking at, it's me? Oh, I see... *blushes*

feeling5.line: You being here helps me stay true to myself in battle. I've always, um, felt drawn to your vision for the future... D-do you think you could tell me more about it today?

headtouch.line: Mhm...

home.line: You've made a small but resolute step toward our goal. Welcome back, Commander.

hp_warning.line: Dammit! It was a trap!

login.line: This is Colorado, standing by. Awaiting orders.

mail.line: Commander, you have a new letter. The stamp and the postmark are a mess...

main1.line: At this point, "Big Seven" is just a prestigious title, but that doesn't break my spirit. My era still isn't over yet.

main2.line: Do you think the sky being blue means anything? It means a lot to me. I mean, it's the same color as the sea... The world beyond is so interesting.

main3.line: A hot air balloon can cross a mountain, and an airplane can take you beyond the horizon. The view of the future is vast – how does it look to you, Commander?

skill.line: Aim all guns! Unleash full firepower!

touch.line: "Big-barreled guns gun down bugging brigade bigguns begging for beatings"... Your tongue twister makes less sense the more I think about it.

touch2.line: Maybe I should fire you off into space. Heh, I'm just kidding. Keep your warm hands on me a while longer.

unlock.line: You called, and I returned stronger, fiercer, and more complete. Now I await your orders. On my name as a Big Seven, I swear to decimate anyone who stands in your way.

win_mvp.line: I've waited long for a victory like this. Our glory shall never fade.

battle.line: Dear opponents, do NOT disappoint me!

couple_encourage1.line: I will protect you this time!

detail.line: Celebration? Honor? Nothing else except for battles will draw my attention.

expedition.line: Even though commissions are an important part of the war, but I'm just not interested in them.

feeling1.line: A saying that I recently heard from my sister, “Never protest your loyalty to the weak”.

feeling2.line: I don't know who granted us the title of BIG SEVEN. But if those two keep mentioning it non-stop, then the title should have some special meaning to it.

feeling3.line: The war cannot be won by a single person. Without true sisters fighting alongside you and a reliable backline supporting you, no matter how strong you are, your defeat is inevitable!

feeling4.line: Not all problems can be solved by fighting? Well, I don't really believe that... but you always seem to find a way to solve things. After all, you are my favorite Commander.

feeling5.line: Look into my eyes, as my most trusted companions, is it even necessary to use words to express the feelings I have for you in my heart?

home.line: Sigh, staying in port is so boring...

hp_warning.line: Now, this is a fun battle!

login.line: I think I smell gunpowder, has the battle started already? Pfft... turns out it was only Vestal cooking.

lose.line: If only Oklahoma was here...

mail.line: When writing a reply back, should I carry an anti-aircraft gun with me...

main1.line: Fighting beside my sisters is the happiest thing in the world!

main2.line: I hate foul play, only fair duels are real battles!

main3.line: Working? ...I don’t know much about that, I’ll just do whatever you tell me to do.

mission.line: If I don’t complete the mission, then I can’t get a battle star.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards... Darn, what a waste of time.

profile.line: Eagle Union Colorado class battleship, ship no. 2 “Maryland”. As one of the BIG SEVEN, I often attended various celebrations. I escaped the attack on Pearl Harbor from behind Oklahoma. After undergoing retrofit, I successfully completed counter strike attacks on the Sakura Empire Navy. I participated in Operation Magic Carpet and received a total of seven battle stars. Commander, I just saw gunfire over there...oh, nevermind it was the sunset.

propose.line: You really treasure these strange rings, do you? ...But since it's your decision, I'll go with it! From now on, I will protect you!

skill.line: No matter how many times it takes, I will sink you again!

touch.line: Commander, are we going into battle?

touch2.line: Commander, our fighting power is not in that area of expertise.

unlock.line: I am Maryland, a member of the BIG SEVEN. “Fighting Mary”, yes, that's what they call me! I heard there are many battles ahead. I look forward to them all!

upgrade.line: I really wanna try to shoot a volley from my main gun right now…

win_mvp.line: Haha! This is just the appetizer before the main course!

gift_prefer.line: I'll like this, right? Then I'll take it!

battle.line: I'm gonna pound you into dust!

detail.line: Oh yeah, how'd you like the concert me and my sisters put on earlier? I can give you a solo if you dig it – a little private show 'tween you and me.

expedition.line: Commission team's back. Man, look how giddy they are.

feeling5.line: You know how I feel even without having to put it into words. That means we've gotten so close, I'd trust you with my life. You're the reason I keep fighting, and... Gah, it's so embarrassing telling these things right to you!

headtouch.line: Hey! You're gonna mess up my hair!

home.line: You picked a good time to come back. The fireworks show literally just started.

login.line: Secured a good seat for the fireworks show for you. C'mon, sit!

lose.line: Tsk... Frickin' defeated.

mail.line: You've got your mail delivered out here... Sheesh, how much work do you have?

main1.line: West Virginia wanted to play a number for the kids. I thought, "Ugh, fine, as long as it gets the blood pumping" and agreed... What she didn't say was we were gonna do a nursery song!

main2.line: A beach performance oughta be big and exciting. If we can't all let loose, then it ain't relaxation!

main3.line: Ahh! Love a drink by the beach! You want one, Commander?

touch.line: Hey, wanna go swimming with... Whuh? Can't swim in my jeans? Who cares – I'll just take 'em off!

touch2.line: That was the tit – you ready for the tat?

unlock.line: Oh, hey, Commander – you here for a break, too? Relax, I won't rat you out to anyone else. Just kick back and enjoy the fireworks.

win_mvp.line: Hahaha! Now that was a perfect show!

battle.line: Strike first! Both with your shells AND fists!

detail.line: Since we're buds, will you fight with me? 'Course, you don't have to force yourself... Hm? Hahahaha! You've become a real fighter!

expedition.line: Gonna use those commission resources in the next battle, eh. Could use 'em in the NEXT next battle, y'know.

feeling5.line: I don't care if other people see me as a battle maniac, but I wanted to show you a different side of me... Although, I'll only go so far to not be myself. What do you think of me? I'll work hard in my own way depending on how you answer! Hahah!

home.line: Just imagining scenarios all day... Nah, that's not gonna work. You need to get your exercise in or you'll turn weak.

login.line: Fighting Mary has arrived! Just thought I'd say hello before I went off to the battlefield.

lose.line: Gah, they got me good...

mail.line: Oh, a letter. Alright, you write a reply while I replace the magazines on my AA guns.

main1.line: West Virginia can lull me to sleep in three minutes with her guitar... Huh? Colorado's violin does it in 30 seconds? H-how'd you know?!

main2.line: There's all kinds of battle freaks. There're those who charge in headfirst, those who fight one-on-one fair and square, and those who just blindly swing their fists around. Me? I dunno what kind I am!

main3.line: Ugh, work... You stick to what you know best, and I'll stick to what I do best – which means fighting!

mission.line: New missions... I hope you get a battle star of your own. Hahaha!

mission_complete.line: Rewards are here. Take 'em!

touch.line: We going into battle yet? Not that I'd mind shooting the breeze with you! Hahaha!

touch2.line: Ahh, this where your fighting strength is? Hahaha!

unlock.line: My retrofit is capital-D done! Hah, I generally know what's changed – the details, I'll discover in live battles! That alright with you?

win_mvp.line: You piles of junk aren't even worth mentioning!

battle.line: The humiliation I once suffered... I'll repay you double!

detail.line: Do not doubt my combat performance, Commander.

expedition.line: The commission fleet is really efficient. I hope the Commander can learn a thing or two about efficiency.

feeling1.line: Commander's laziness is almost beyond my bottom line.

feeling2.line: I was once seriously injured, but then I was greatly enhanced during the process for my repairs…

feeling3.line: I’m proud of my BIG SEVEN title. But aircraft carriers seem to be replacing us battleships in naval battles. I am losing myself in all this confusion: this strength that I possess... what is it for?

feeling4.line: After joining your fleet, the answer to my question has been gradually answered... This power of mine is destined to protect everyone including you, Commander. My strength still has its value, even if I'm no longer the heroine of the battlefield.

feeling5.line: Commander, you have become someone who can completely take charge on the battlefield. At last, my powers have found a worthy partner... What? A love confession? Don't you trick me to say that, you fool——

home.line: What a peaceful port, it reminds me of Hawaii before the war.

hp_warning.line: Getting hit by a torpedo... it feels bad.

login.line: You’re late... the exercise has already begun, hurry!

lose.line: I don't want to recall the humiliation I suffered on that day...!

mail.line: Could these be letters from my sisters?

main1.line: The combat exercise didn’t go well… Is the Commander being lazy again?

main2.line: I will never forget the humiliation I suffered on that day.

main3.line: On the night of the Surigao Strait, I witnessed the last moments of the Sakura Empire fleet... They truly are a worthy opponent...

mission.line: Carrying out missions is an important part of enhancing the strength of the fleet.

mission_complete.line: The mission was nicely executed, good one.

profile.line: During a "Naval Holiday", my sisters and I were honored amongst the world's strongest battleships. We were granted the high-profile title of - BIG SEVEN. Although times are changing, the three of us still have the strength to fight any enemy fleet in a decisive battle, please don't forget that.

propose.line: You’ve decided to perform a pledge ritual with me? Commander really made a bold decision... In that case, I will not let your expectation down. I'll guard you until the very end.

skill.line: Have a taste of my 406mm guns!

touch.line: This should be... a friendly gesture I suppose.

touch2.line: Commander, it seems you’re rather close to getting lectured by me.

unlock.line: It’s finally my time to show my strength... Under the guidance of fate, the third ship of Colorado class, West Virginia, reporting in.

upgrade.line: It seems the Spokane Cup this year will still be mine.

win_mvp.line: Have you seen this? This is the inevitably tragic ending of those who dare challenge the BIG SEVEN.

gift_prefer.line: Not bad... I'll treasure it.

battle.line: Sink or swim. Let's go.

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Hope they'll make it in time for our last song.

home.line: We've already started, but you've shown up at the perfect time. You're gonna like this next song, Commander.

login.line: Whew... You feeling the heat, Commander? Er, not the weather, I was talking about the performance... Alright, awesome.

lose.line: Guh... We almost had it...

main1.line: Mic test, mic test. Can you hear me clearly, Commander? What about you, Colorado and Maryland?

main2.line: While I usually play slightly more chill, calm tunes when I'm alone, this case obviously calls for something explosive.

main3.line: I always thought the ladies of the Royal Navy hated this genre... But as Rodney and more have shown, presumptions do you no good.

touch.line: A song request? Colorado, Maryland, we're playing the Commander's fave next.

touch2.line: I wasn't trying to tempt you into this...

unlock.line: Colorado, Maryland, you two ready to rock? Keep your cool! Commander, and everyone in the audience, get ready for the Big Seven's big performance!

win_mvp.line: Do not mess around with a Big Seven. Ever.

battle.line: It's time to face off!

expedition.line: It's unhealthy to overwork yourself, Commander. Let the rest of us greet the commission team.

headtouch.line: Look, I'm not Colorado...

home.line: You like it when the port is bustling? Fair enough. I don't mind either way as long as there's no fighting.

login.line: Still a while to go until the wargame starts... Hey, Commander. I've been waiting for you.

mail.line: It's about damn time Maryland learned how to file paperwork... Oh, Commander, there's a letter for you.

main1.line: Although I don't try to appear frail, it does work at tricking the enemy into thinking so. Just like that Sakura Empire Big Seven... Or am I wrong?

main2.line: "Wee Vee?" Ahahah. You're free to call be my whatever nickname you want.

main3.line: So, Commander, about that private training we talked about a while ago... You were thinking the same thing? Okay... Should we go, then?

touch.line: I accept your affection.

touch2.line: I hope you're ready to face the consequences. Now then... *blushes*

unlock.line: West Virginia, completing retrofit. Back when I joined the fleet, I said I'd show you my strength – now, after you've made me this much stronger, I feel humbled. Once more, Commander, my strength is yours.

battle.line: Don’t be overconfident, and try not to be so nervous while focusing on winning~

detail.line: Being stared like that makes me a bit shy...

expedition.line: The commission is over, they should be back soon~

feeling1.line: Commander, I'm gonna get angry.

feeling2.line: Commander remembers me~ Not that I’m boasting or anything, but I still have confidence in my low sense of existence. (smiles wryly)

feeling3.line: If you’re only going by appearances, every child in this fleet looks cute. But in terms of personality, they all have their unique quirks. To be honest, I am a bit envious of them. (strokes chin).

feeling4.line: I always believe there is nothing wrong with being ordinary. But after meeting you Commander, I want to change myself a little... after all, my sisters are all so charismatic~ Well.. Commander, are you fond of bunny girls?~

feeling5.line: Do you want to eat something later Commander? And then you can accompany me to go shopping, if you want to get something then let’s go together. Then... hehe... let’s take a walk in the park? Commander, everywhere I go as long as I’m with you will be just fine~

home.line: Ah, hold on, your collar is all messed up. Stand still while I fix it... there you go~ (waves).

hp_warning.line: Sisters, hold on!

login.line: Welcome back~

lose.line: Not so successful... let's try again next time.

mail.line: You’ve got new mail~

main1.line: What do I wear inside? It's not something that’s so significant

main2.line: If I think about it, I certainly have been to many places... seen many landscapes, and also parted ways with many people.

main3.line: Sometimes I get so envious of my younger sister Washington and how she’s so energetic all the time.

mission.line: It’s not good to leave tasks unfinished.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards were sent out, are you not going to pick it up?

profile.line: I am North Carolina class ship no.1. I can be considered the big sister battleship of the Eagle Union~ I don’t particularly like or dislike anything, so to speak. Even though I have fought in all kinds of engagements, I have not gained any fame... I am a little bit troubled by this.

propose.line: Well, your trust deserves to be rewarded... umm... Commander, do you like bunny girls?~

touch.line: Do you need help with something?

touch2.line: Not good...

unlock.line: North Carolina here, awaiting your dispatch. Although I may seem to have a bland personality compared to my sisters. But as the saying goes, no personality is still a personality, hehe. Anyways, awaiting your orders, sir.

upgrade.line: I'll try to work a bit harder~

win_mvp.line: If the Commander gives me a few praises, then I will be very happy~

gift_prefer.line: Are you sure? Th-thank you.

detail_ex.line: I know I may be lacking in individuality, but now that I understand your preferences a bit better... it's given me a new direction to work towards. Heehee~♪

feeling5_ex.line: I love you, Commander... Did that come off as too ordinary? Goodness... You think it's fine, and you want me to say it every day? Very well. I love you, Commander♡

headtouch_ex.line: Oh my... Even though I'm supposed to be the big sister~

home_ex.line: My, Commander, your clothes are looking a bit disheveled. Allow me... Heehee. As a reward, how about treating me to your first smile of the day?

login_ex.line: Good morning, Commander... Mm, this greeting is a bit lacking in individuality. Let me try over... Hello, Commander♡ It's time for some delicious "work time"♪

main4_ex.line: Hmm... would it be better if I had a more upbeat personality? Well, you still prefer the way I am right now the best, right?

main5_ex.line: Are you tired? Come, rest your head on my lap. Heehee, I was just looking for a way to get you to lean on me.

main6_ex.line: ...You want to know what I'm wearing under this? Oh, but you already know~♪ Yes, it's exactly what you think♡

touch_ex.line: I'm right here. Call on me anytime you need me.

touch2_ex.line: Commander... Aren't you being a bit too nervous?♪

detail.line: "Do I wear this all the time"? Maybe, maybe not. I'll leave the answer up to your imagination.

expedition.line: Maybe I should keep this outfit on and give the commission team a real surprise when they return... Hehehe~ I'm just joking.

feeling5.line: Commander, are you free today? We could go on a date somewhere. Not in this outfit, of course, just my regular one. Thank you for understanding. Hehehe~

headtouch.line: It's true – you need the ears, or you can't call yourself a bunny girl. Hehehe~

home.line: Could you help out with my ribbon? It's a bit too close for my liking... Ah, thank you.

login.line: Welcome back, dear! Is there anything you need a hand with?

main1.line: Whew. This feels so liberating! ...And not in any indecent sense, or anything.

main2.line: Did Washington manage a proper smile today? She's got features as sharp as a knife, so it's easy to misinterpret her expression.

main3.line: I am genuinely interested in bunny girl things, but it's quite awkward to actually tell people about them...

touch2.line: I'll take that to mean you really like this outfit, am I right? Hehehe~

unlock.line: Commander? Oh, umm, this is just, err, equipment changing practice... Also, I recall you saying you like bunny girls. You still do, right?

win_mvp.line: Victory isn't the result of individuality. It's the result of good teamwork. Hehehe~

feeling5.line: Are you nodding off? Come hither~ The cushion's a bit small, so hold onto my waist... Good night, Commander. May your dreams be full of hopping bunnies~

headtouch.line: You're putting sunscreen on my hair, too? Quite the peculiar preference...

home.line: My air cushion's a bit deflated... Good timing, Commander! Let's inflate it together.

login.line: Over here, Commander! I'm a bit shy to ask for this, but... Could you rub some sunscreen on me? On every inch, every nook and cranny of my back~

main1.line: You want to nap with me? Mmgh... There, over here, Commander. I made room for you on my air cushion.

main2.line: The sea breeze is making me sleepy... But you won't pull any frisky pranks on me while I nap, right? Right~?

main3.line: I saw all sorts of distinctive designs when I was picking out my swimsuit... But this is the one that sits right♪

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Oh, I didn't mean my sunscreen. Keep it up, please!

touch.line: Commander, a bit higher... To the right... Oh, you already put some there? Heheh, but you like touching me there, right?

touch2.line: Heehee. Be thorough over here, too♪

unlock.line: Commander, today I'm in a bunny swimsuit, see? You don't see how it's a bunny swimsuit...? Come closer and get a better look, then. Heheheh.

battle.line: Ok, let’s work out. (Snickers)

detail.line: Hmm, you want to know how well I fight?

expedition.line: Your memory can’t be worse than mine, right? The commission fleet has returned, won’t you go greet them?

feeling1.line: You are too weak, it’s no fun playing with you, go practice some more.

feeling2.line: What must I do to possess a good smile... think about the things I like? If so, I feel very happy even at the thought of winning against South Dakota... muahahaha...

feeling3.line: No, no, that’s not right. If we do it this way, won’t it end much the same like in the past? … Don’t try so hard? You sometimes say stuff like that… Hmm? That was a good smile from me just now?

feeling4.line: Lately, my smile has become more natural? Emm, huh (scratches head), I was recently trying to find a new hobby. While I was searching, I realized that being with you is not so bad… (whispers)

feeling5.line: I couldn’t help but smile when I saw you, this is the first time that I’m feeling this way... although, I also have other feelings rushing towards me. I suddenly want to see your expression when you are bullied by me—— Commander, stay with me for a while. (Laughs)

home.line: I’m glad that you didn’t get hurt—— What?! I don’t have feelings for you!

hp_warning.line: I won't let go of victories to my enemies!

login.line: Welcome back... how does my smile look? (Forcibly smiles)

lose.line: Oh, I will not forget you!

mail.line: Hey, your mail.

main1.line: My smile looks beautiful? You jerk... oops, keep smiling, keep smiling. Thank you for your compliments.

main2.line: Hey, that rigid South Dakota is still the same. Commander, you see, I am cuter than her.

main3.line: A true measurement of friendship is their actions and not their words, I don’t like people who are rhetorical in nature.

mission.line: A new mission? Haha, now my blood is boiling.

mission_complete.line: Go grab the reward yourself, I’m not interested.

profile.line: North Carolina class ship no. 2. I am Washington! The thing I like to do the most is to destroy my enemies. Recently, I am practicing on my smile. —— Battle record? I don’t really show off with such things, all in all, how’s my smile?

propose.line: Wait wait! We’re doing “that”, right? Is this your new way of teasing me!... Damn, you bastard, I’m not sure if I should cry or laugh about this...

skill.line: Out of my way. I'm ready to fight!

touch.line: Don’t touch me as if you’re trying to be intimate with me.

touch2.line: ...You wish to die? (Smiles)

unlock.line: Hello, Commander, I am Washington... my sister told me that I cannot be so rough once I join the fleet, so I am practicing my smile. Darn, why must I listen to her...

upgrade.line: It feels so good to become stronger.

win_mvp.line: Sure enough, I am happiest when all the foes are annihilated~

gift_prefer.line: Oh? Alright, who do you want me to send flying?

battle.line: We've got this in the bag, easily.

detail.line: Huh. Guess I can't help but crack a smile after having some good grub and a bit of liquor... Meaning, I don't gotta practice smiling anymore!

expedition.line: Crap, the commission team must be... Oh, you remembered? Full marks, Commander.

feeling5.line: Heheh, so then South Dakota and I just... Hang on, I feel like I'm talking to myself here! C'mon, tell me a funny story or something! I've smiled like you asked me to, so keep up your end of the deal...

home.line: Back safe and sound. Thank goodness... Uh, no? I-I wasn't... talking about you...

login.line: Wipe that stupid grin off your face. I know exactly what you're thinking! I am NOT gonna dress up like my sister today!

main1.line: W-welcome back, dear♪ ...Doesn't hit the same. How does North Carolina do it?

main2.line: South Dakota's on the piano, huh. I ain't got her level of finesse, so don't go comparing me to her... Wish I could play like that.

main3.line: Remember our deal, Commander – I'm coming along when you go around greeting people, got it?

mission.line: We've got a new mission. It'll do nicely as an after-dinner workout.

mission_complete.line: You claimed the rewards yet? ...Oh please, like I give a damn about that!

touch.line: Breaktime already? All right, take a load off.

touch2.line: What the–?! Are you drunk out of your mind?!

unlock.line: Sup, Commander? ...Looking good? I don't think this outfit's anything special... You better not be trying to cozy up to me, or I'll knock your teeth out!

win_mvp.line: Now this is something worth celebrating! Am I right?

detail.line: Hey... Quit staring at me. What's the big deal? It's just a nurse outfit. F-for your information, I'm just here to do my job... So stop fricking staring!

expedition.line: Finished a commission, did you? Hold off on that reception until your full-body examination is done.

feeling5.line: The hell? Why's your heartbeat through the roof? ...'Cause I'm standing next to you? L-look, I can't examine you without getting close! And I can't just leave you be, so I gotta nurse you even harder. I'll be tending to you the whole night, so brace yourself...

headtouch.line: Y-you're ill, so act like it, god dammit!

home.line: Stay right where I can see you– Ahem... What I mean is: Don't go wandering around at night. It's dangerous, and you're my patient.

login.line: (Gotta smile, gotta smile...) You ready, Commander? Save your files and all that so I can start examining your... Wh-what? Why're you looking at me like that?

mail.line: Was that the new letter alert? Are you still working at this hour? I'm confiscating that damn letter!

main1.line: Ugh. I happened to be on duty, that's all... Man, your temp really is going up. Better give you a thorough examination, then.

main2.line: You don't think the call-nurse button even beeped? Uh, of course it did, dumbass! Why would I be here if it didn't? Listen – beep-beep-beep! There, it beeped. Now shut up and let me continue my examination.

main3.line: Nurses gotta be nice to their patients, blah blah blah... If you don't do as I ask, you leave me no choice but to MAKE you comply.

mission.line: You've still got missions to do? Don't care, you need to rest right now.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards can wait, okay? Focus on the examination!

touch.line: Hold still, dammit. I'm examining you.

touch2.line: Oh boy, your condition's serious. This calls for emergency measures.

unlock.line: Yo, Commander. Called for a nurse, didn'tcha? ...You didn't? Bullcrap, you totally did! Listen up, you're a patient, so act like it – drop your damn work and let me examine you.

battle.line: Come at me with all you got!

couple_encourage1.line: I've got your back! Give 'em hell!

couple_encourage2.line: Sorry for putting you through trouble again.

couple_encourage3.line: The game is on, Enterprise!

couple_encourage4.line: You wanna go at this again, Washington?

couple_encourage5.line: Massachusetts, you have to take this battle seriously.

detail.line: South Dakota, standing by 24/7, Commander.

expedition.line: The commission teams are back... If it is necessary, send me off as well.

feeling1.line: ... I shall follow your orders.

feeling2.line: Your will is my command, Commander.

feeling3.line: I exist to help you achieve your goals, Commander. Other than that, I have no real value... A skirt? I've never worn something so fluffy before.

feeling4.line: Another way to live other than fighting? I... do not know what to do, Commander. I have always lived like this... Can you teach me?

feeling5.line: So this is your perspective, Commander... I choose how I live, was what you said... This time, I fight not for my duty, but for the sake of your smile, Commander.

home.line: Good fight out there, Commander.

hp_warning.line: I won't hold back now...!

login.line: Commander, your orders please.

lose.line: I am sorry, Commander... It's a shame...!

mail.line: There's new mail, Commander.

main1.line: In the darkness, my will was tempered. I fear nothing.

main2.line: As long as I am of use to Commander, I am fine with handing my credit over to others.

main3.line: Those who stand as Commander's enemies, are enemies all the same.

mission.line: Commander, please do not forget about completing the missions.

mission_complete.line: Commander, the mission rewards have arrived.

profile.line: Battleship of Eagle Union, South Dakota. When it comes to battlefields, I wish for you to not leave my side. I will protect you, Commander. 'The Strongest Shield'? Vain titles are worthless. There's meaning only in being useful.

propose.line: I feel warm when you're by my side, Commander. Your goals bring me the drive to fight. I become happy when I hear your words... I once offered you my shields. From now on... I give you my heart.

touch.line: I'm ready to move out anytime.

touch2.line: If this is what you want to do...

unlock.line: I am South Dakota, Commander. I shall become your shield and protect you from all cannon fire.

upgrade.line: My shields have become stronger

win_mvp.line: Partial victories aren't worth celebrating, Commander.

gift_prefer.line: You want me to remember so badly that you're giving me something this valuable, Commander?

detail.line: Aurora asked me to perform with her... I guess it can't hurt to try.

feeling5.line: Without you, I doubt I would've ever come to understand what splendor this world holds, or started playing the piano either... Commander, I'd like to play you a song that's important to me.

home.line: Everyone's back safe and sound. Now I can resume practicing with peace of mind.

login.line: What song should I play for you today...

main1.line: I can't get used to this flimsy dress. I'd rather wear my regular clothes...

main2.line: My cat goes for the keyboard when I'm not playing... Do you want to practice the piano too, kitty?

main3.line: We can express so much through music. I suppose that's fitting for someone bad at expressing their feelings like I am.

mission.line: Music and instruments are simply hobbies. We ought to prioritize our missions, Commander.

unlock.line: Massachusetts suggested I learn something useful that's unrelated to combat, so I started playing the piano... It seemed impossible at first, but after actually trying it, I've developed a pretty good feel for it.

battle.line: Behold the might of Indiana!

couple_encourage1.line: Hah! Imagine getting to fight alongside you!

detail.line: I'm surprised the port's got so much gym equipment! We should go work out, you and I, Commander. It'll put some muscle on your bones AND help clear your mind.

expedition.line: The commission team's back. I wonder if they had any good fights out there...

feeling1.line: Ugh... I hoped you'd be one of the few who'd be my equal and make me use my brain.

feeling2.line: The destroyers and submarines around here all clam up or look shocked when they see me... Did I do something wrong or what?

feeling3.line: Not only are you good with brain-intensive strategy, you've even got the chops for bodybuilding. AND you work pretty hard. Yeah, I've gotta hand it to you!

feeling4.line: ("The sun's rays embrace the Earth, and the moon's light kisses the sea. If you hadn't put your lips to mine, the meaning in Mother Nature's pretty work would cease to be." Alright, let's go with that. Now just to sneak it in between the pages of this training mag I'm gonna give the Commander...)

feeling5.line: Ahem... So, Commander, did you read that mag I gave you yet? What? You haven't?! ...Well, it's just, I kinda snuck a love letter in there... To hell with it! Read it NOW! One page at a time! Don't you dare flip through it!

headtouch.line: Hm? Need something?

home.line: Cool, you're back. Now drink this protein shake and feed your muscles!

hp_warning.line: I'm still in the fight!

login.line: Oh, you're back, Commander. Office work is sooo lame without you... How do you handle this day in, day out? I'd rather take on a hundred, no, a thousand enemies.

lose.line: It's alright. Retreating ain't the same thing as losing. We'll try again once we're stronger!

mail.line: Commander, you've got mail! Ah, and the mag I ordered has arrived, too.

main1.line: Copying childhood heroes doesn't make you brave. It just makes you a reckless moron.

main2.line: I brought you lunch, Commander! Steak, fruit salad, and a protein shake with kale! Healthy and nutritious stuff! ...Why are you giving me that weird look?

main3.line: Tactics? Yeah, I know those give you a battlefield advantage and all. But me, I like the thrill of fighting my foes head-on. Plus, ain't it more satisfying when you win that way?

mission.line: You've got to do your missions, Commander. Hm? You weren't expecting me to remind you? I may not look it, but I have a good sense of time.

mission_complete.line: We've got mission rewards waiting. I heard they're selling supplement lucky boxes and I feel like trying my luck.

profile.line: I'm Indiana, Eagle Union South Dakota-class battleship. That's about it, really. All you need to know is this – I will grind all your enemies into dust. Put it another way, nobody can mess with you as long as I'm around.

propose.line: Your answer's in this envelope? Alright, let's– Hang on, why'd you put it in an envelope? ...'Cause my feelings struck a chord with you? Oh, okay! Then on the ring goes! Now c'mon, stop standing there and make your vows with me!

touch.line: Hm? We got a combat mission?

touch2.line: I'm "muscular in other places, but squishy here"? Th-the hell are you talking about?!

unlock.line: South Dakota-class battleship Indiana, reporting for duty! ...No need to be so stiff and formal? Then... Nice to meetcha, Commander. You're on the victory train with me now, baby!

upgrade.line: Ahh! I can feel the power growing within me!

win_mvp.line: That was too easy! Gimme a more challenging fight next time!

gift_prefer.line: Hey, this looks like something that'll up my power!

expedition_ex.line: The commission team's back. Their mission went as smooth as it did thanks to your smart commanding.

feeling5_ex.line: Alright, I don't need to slip a love letter into EVERY mag... I-I know giving it right to you gets my feelings across better! But! Being married doesn't make embarrassing things any less embarrassing!

headtouch_ex.line: You really like petting my head, huh.

home_ex.line: Nice, you're back. I added some protein and muscle-building supplements in this one. Drink up!

login_ex.line: Look who's back. I sorted through your papers. It was boring as hell, but I put up with it just for you. Hahah!

main4_ex.line: I did a fantastic job with this paperwork? Well, yeah! Believe it or not, I always get straight A's! ...Why do you look so surprised?

main5_ex.line: Ugh... The stuff we did yesterday was so intense that I can't stand straight. Hm? Go ahead and take the day off? Hell no! You promised we'd go out today!

mission_complete_ex.line: Ah! Looks like you finished a mission. That's my sweetheart for ya – getting things done on the double. Good!

touch_ex.line: Yeah? Do you need a hand?

touch2_ex.line: Seriously? Have you STILL not felt me up enough?!

detail.line: That's that robbery case finally done and dusted. The bandits can cover the tavern's repair bill, heh. Now, you ready to receive your bounty?

feeling5.line: When we get tired of this, let's settle down for a stable, comfortable life. Ahem... Because you've supported me and made a place where I belong. What I'm trying to say is – you're the most important person in the world to me! Don't make me say another word!

headtouch.line: Cut it out! You're gonna mess up my hat!

home.line: Finished another task, huh? Have some beef jerky. It's got protein in it and fills your stamina right back up. Try a bite.

login.line: Watch your step, Commander. This place is falling apart and one wrong step could send you to the floor below. We've still gotta collect the cash and return it to the bank.

mail.line: That stuff floating through the air... Oh, here, Commander. Found a letter with your name on it.

main1.line: You can't arrest bandits with brawn alone. You need a general plan. How do you get in? How do you prevent them from getting away? You need to think on your feet – and you do that by having your boots on the scene! Hahaha!

main2.line: You think it was funny how they came up to me, swinging a knife, and I just shot 'em? Hahah! I've got the advantage at this range. Times are changing.

main3.line: It's never too late for justice, but I don't like delayed justice, so I deliver what's long overdue with a bullet!

mission_complete.line: You got 'em all done, huh? Hell of a good job, Commander! Lemme treat you to a drink!

touch.line: You digging my revolver? Ahh. It's been my partner for many years.

touch2.line: Urgh! Can you STOP doing this?! We're in public here!

unlock.line: Oh, look who's here. What am I doing here? Well, I figured through the roof was the fastest way in, so I punched a hole through the ceiling. The bandits are all down for the count, so let me take it from here.

win_mvp.line: If this is all you've got, you're not cut out for robbery!

battle.line: Everyone, Level 1 combat readiness! Set sail!

couple_encourage1.line: A larger-caliber Iowa? No, not quite...

couple_encourage2.line: As if I'd lose to some carriers!

couple_encourage3.line: Freedom and firepower: an unstoppable force!

couple_encourage4.line: Oh? Finally, a worthy opponent? How interesting~

couple_encourage5.line: We owe a lot to you, Miss Heroine.

detail.line: Thanks for finishing the equipment inspection. All systems nominal! ...Oh my, you seem to be unable to take your eyes off me~ Not that it bothers me though? Besides, don'tcha like this sort of stuff?

expedition.line: Your commission fleet's back. Are your words of praise not the best reward you can give them? Hehe~♪

feeling1.line: Ah, so you're the kind of person who makes girls cry. Yeah, you'd better feel bad about it.

feeling2.line: We'll only get in each other's way if we keep an ambivalent relationship. Say, don'tcha think getting touchy-feely might help break the ice? ...Just kidding~ See, you're already not as nervous~ Hehehe~♪

feeling3.line: Look at that, you're already starting to chat me up. So, what's on your mind today? Something a bit more technical? Small talk about daily life? ...Oh, you want me to choose?

feeling4.line: My my, look who's all run down today... I knew it, you've been overworking yourself. C'mere, lie down here and let me take care of you. Yeah, my thighs make for a pretty good pillow substitute huh? Don'tcha just love this kind of stuff~?

feeling5.line: Commander, would you prefer I take the lead, or would you rather do it? Hold up~ I'll see for myself when the time is right, so there's no need for you to answer in words. After all, don'tcha just love being toyed with~?

headtouch.line: Done having your fun yet? Hehe, now it's my turn~♪ Take a seat!

home.line: Wanna check the battle results~♪ Yeah? Who do you wanna start with? Oh, you'll do it yourself? I'll listen in while enjoying some ice cream over here.

hp_warning.line: I know just the thing to turn this situation around!

login.line: Glad you made it. Do you already have a plan for what you wanna do? And how do I factor into those plans?

lose.line: Unbelievable... I'm actually getting cornered?! ...I'm not gonna be able to sleep 'til I figure out how to set things straight!

mail.line: You've got new mail. Heh, dont'cha just love the anticipation~?

main1.line: Iowa versus Yamato, huh? A real classic. Don'tcha just love that kind of stuff?

main2.line: I go for the fruity stuff~ green apple, orange, and soda water. As for coffee... Not my favorite, I guess?

main3.line: How much stuff should I be doing as your secretary? ...Lemme think, how does 40% sound? If I did everything, wouldn't that make me the commander? Heh.

main4.line: About that matter... I must admit that you have a point, Commander. How about taking my suggestion next time though?

main5.line: It's now the age of carriers? ...Dunno about that. If carriers are able to evolve, what's to say that battleships can't also evolve?

main6.line: They call me Big J or the Black Dragon of the Eagle Union! ...What, got a problem with talking myself up a bit?

mission.line: Did you already accept this mission? Sounds good, let's take care of it together.

mission_complete.line: Since we already got the hard stuff out of the way, why not take a little break? It's gonna be pretty easy to prioritize whatever is left~

profile.line: I am battleship New Jersey, the indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union. When I say "indomitable," I'm not just tooting my own horn, hehe~♪ If you knew more about me, you'd know exactly what I'm talking about.

propose.line: Commander, I can already hear everything you're thinking. As long as you're fine with it, I don't have any objections~ After all, I still owe you a proper confession, don't I? Hehe, don'tcha think that's what mutual love is supposed to look like?

skill.line: Fire control, I'm counting on you!

touch.line: I'll take any work-related requests, but anything outside of that... won't come cheap. Just kidding~♪

touch2.line: Commander, don'tcha just love being put on the defensive? In more ways than one~♪

unlock.line: The indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union is none other than me, New Jersey! You're about to witness true power! Haha, just messing~♪ Don'tcha just love flashy introductions?

upgrade.line: Some say that the age of battleships is over. They haven't met the Iowa class.

win_mvp.line: Course: steady! Objective: completed! Enemies who can stop us: none! Heheh, don'tcha love it when things go smoothly?

gift_prefer.line: This is just what I wanted! Haha!

battle_ex.line: Honey's looking my way~! Let's do this!

detail_ex.line: ♪~What am I staring at so intently? You of course, honey. You're always ogling me up and down, so what's wrong with me also being mesmerized by you? Hehe~♡

home_ex.line: Welcome back from your sortie! Wanna celebrate the occasion with a kiss? ...Yeah, yeah, I know, I'll get started on the report~♪

login_ex.line: Hey there, honey~♪ What are we going to do today?

main1_ex.line: Might be fun scrapping with Yamato and Musashi. Honey, who do you think would win?

main2_ex.line: Honey, I love you and all, but you can't cut in line, okay? Especially when it's my ice cream that's coming out. If you're that thirsty, I have some juice for you.

main7_ex.line: A job well done, hooney~ You're totally amazing. All right, let's get started on the next job~

touch_ex.line: I was just looking for you, honey~ See, there's something I'd like you to buy for me... pretty please?

touch2_ex.line: I know, you absolutely love this kind of stuff, dontcha~ Ahaha~♪

detail.line: Can't take your eyes off me, huh? Nothing wrong with that though~ Just who do you think I am? Ahaha~♪

home.line: Shouldn't you be staring at those reports instead of at me? Alright, fine by me. Take a good look at this jump and spin. Oh, you liked that a whole lot, huh?

main1.line: Hey, you over there, you're blocking the view! Jeez, I was hoping to treat you to the best seats in the house, Commander.

main3.line: Keep the spotlight on me! That's right, keep your eyes on the red-hot dance of the Black Dragon, New Jersey!

main4.line: Being a superstar sure is exciting, isn't it? After all... I didn't come all the way from Planet Bunny for nothing! ...Err, that didn't come across right...

main5.line: Of course, this dance is something I'd only show you and my closest friends, hehe~

touch.line: Your honest feedback, please! Tell me what you really think, okay?

touch2.line: I never said you couldn't touch, but... try to mind the time and place, yeah?

unlock.line: One, two, jump! Woah, think I nailed it this time~♪ So, how many points would you give me for that? Naturally, a perfect 100, right? Don'tcha just love it when things go smoothly?

battle.line: I won't let my honey shed a single tear!

detail.line: What's up? Oh, are you taken by my swimsuit? Hahah, well, it is me you're looking at. Of course you'd be stunned! Besides, that's just proof of your superb taste, since you picked it!

expedition.line: Commission team's here! ...You're still putting on your sunscreen? Come ooon.

feeling5.line: Once we're done, I'll spread stuff on you! That chilly, slick, sticky stuff, nice and slow... Hahah! I thought you might like me doing this. Do you?

home.line: Good work out there! Oh, honey, you look a little burned. Hahaha, I'm kidding! Here, I'll get you a drink. Take it easy♪

login.line: It's a scorcher out there... Midsummer sunlight is rough no matter where you go. Honey, did you put on sunscreen? We'd better get some on you~ Hahaha♪

main1.line: Aloe works as sunscreen, too? Then get to putting it on me! ...Whoa, it's all slippery and sticky... Hyah?!

main2.line: Mm... I want ice cream now... Okay! Want one, honey? Don't worry– all of us Eagle Union ships brought ice cream.

main3.line: Wanna go see Ticonderoga with me later? Tanning is fun and all, but I'd love to lie down in a cool place. You decide, honey.

touch.line: I'm counting on you, honey!

touch2.line: Hyah?! Geez, honey. I know you like this stuff, but c'mon... *blushes*

home.line: Commander, you've grown but you haven't changed much. Alright, here's your reward~

main1.line: A weapon may be powerful, but if it can't be used properly, it won't be completely effective. It is the teacher's job to teach you how to use them! Physical education? I-I'll teach that again!

main2.line: I've only improved a few times before, and they were just small enhancements. Now that everyone is stronger, I can start getting some work done.

main3.line: Commander? I believe in you, so I'm letting you study on your own while I work on my planes. I'll get angry if you avoid your study this time, alright?

touch.line: Yeah yeah, Commander is totally not good without a Teacher here... Yup, can't help it~

touch2.line: Commander, can you help a teacher out here a little?... Eeek! ....Really?...

unlock.line: The modernization that had never happened has finally been completed! From now on, I, Ms. Ranger, will continue to teach as well~

win_mvp.line: If you engage in some special training with me, you'll withstand fatigue for a longer time, Commander! ...Eh? Why are you looking at me like that?

battle.line: Let's search for the light!

couple_encourage1.line: Just because you speak like an adult doesn't mean you are one!

couple_encourage2.line: What a long overdue reunion!

couple_encourage3.line: Spread your wings and fly, Enterprise!

couple_encourage4.line: Commander, do you like to spoil your girls?

couple_encourage5.line: 8 Talents? We're a pretty lively bunch!

detail.line: It's alright if you don't remember me...

expedition.line: What's wrong, little eagle? So, the commission team has returned? Commander, let us greet them.

feeling1.line: So you truly will leave me one day...

feeling2.line: I want to maintain the current superior-subordinate relationship, Commander... Don't mind me...

feeling3.line: Commander, you're weird... Even though I don't want to experience more painful departures, you keep stepping into my heart...

feeling4.line: Can I believe in you, Commander...? I mean, can I believe in myself this time...? I want... to try...

feeling5.line: Yes. I believe in you, Commander, as well as myself and the present day... The light beyond the darkness... I think I've finally found it

home.line: You're not hurt... That's good

hp_warning.line: The light is still far away...

login.line: Greetings, Commander. If there's a problem, please leave it to me.

lose.line: Please retreat first, Commander.

mail.line: My eagle got the mail. Please read it carefully.

main1.line: This eagle really likes being with me, but is it alright for me to feed it...?

main2.line: Commander, please do not confuse 42 with 24, no matter what

main3.line: If there's time, maybe you should spend it with my younger sisters... I'm fine on my own

mission.line: Your new missions have been organized, Commander.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have been delivered. Please check them.

profile.line:
Lead ship of the Yorktown class aircraft carriers, Yorktown. 
Abandoned...? It wasn't their fault, but I do not have the courage to reach out for light from that darkness. Will you leave me, Commander? Or will you guide me by my hand...?

propose.line: I had fallen into the darkness. It was you, Commander who gave me light and a helping hand which pulled me out of it. That's why this time, I, Yorktown, will give you my name. The name that shoulders the burden of liberty and peace...

touch.line: Commander, what happened?

touch2.line: Are you truly prepared to leave your mark on someone like me?

unlock.line: I am the lead ship of Yorktown class aircraft carriers, Yorktown. My name comes from the Siege of Yorktown... You know? In the Revolutionary War. Neutrality...? That's just a pre-war courtesy.

upgrade.line: Thanks...

win_mvp.line: If victory can bring peace, then I...!

gift_prefer.line: I thought I told you that going this far... is going to make me seriously...

battle.line: Uhhh, where am I?

detail.line: Come to think of it, Enterprise did tell me not to drink the blue stuff like A MILLION TIMES. But like, what's the dig beal, Commander?

expedition.line: You wanna sneak off to the harbor? Ugh, I TOLD you already, Commander, I'm *hic* not as think as you drunk I am!

feeling5.line: I mean, it's only natural for a good couple to be a little clingy, right? After all I've been through, I'm WAY too shy to make the first move. So that means YOU have to do it. Got it?

home.line: I'm not letting you leave until YOU have a drink with me, Commander.

hp_warning.line: Urk. I feel... a little sick...

login.line: You're late, Commander. You know what THAT means. One penalty drink!

lose.line: I, I have a feeling... like all the clout I had as a big sister is COMPLETELY GONE... after tonight...

mail.line: You can't go off with someone else until you finish drinking with ME, Commander!

main1.line: Enterprise is a good girl. So's Hornet. And Hammann. They all found their PLACE in this fleet. But me? The big sister? I'm HAPPY for them. And a teeeensy bit lonely.

main2.line: You know, Commander, looking back, I have some regrets. Like if I knew you were THIS good? I'd've been more HONEST with myself.

main3.line: Oh! Is that my cute little Hammann?! When did you get so BIG?! ...Oh, you're the Commander, aren't you? Have you seen Hammann?

mission.line: Now now, Commander, I'll be mad at you if you ditch these assignments.

mission_complete.line: Here's to a mission accomplished! CHEERS!

touch.line: Hey, Commander, you wanna hear some EMBARRASSING stories about Enterprise and Hornet? Oh, you'd rather hear mine? Hehe, THAT can be arranged.

touch2.line: OH! Commander, at least buy me a drink first!

unlock.line: Hey, Commander, are you lost? How about a drink? ... Huh? Drunk? Me? Oh, Commander, you're such a card. This is just grape juice... isn't it?

win_mvp.line: OOPSIE! What was that I just said in front of EVERYONE...?

battle.line: For our ideals...!

detail.line: The cathedral, the Holy Well, and... Commander, where's the next spot again?

expedition.line: What's the matter, my friend? I see, the commission team has returned? I'll let Hornet know.

feeling5.line: My true utopia... is the port that Enterprise and the others can call home. If there's ever a place that can bring me eternal peace... I'd think that it would be by your side, Commander.

login.line: Commander, how about taking a photo right here?

lose.line: Freedom... will never be extinguished...!

main1.line: What kind of souvenir do you think Hammann would like? ...A warding stone...?

main2.line: George is quite knowledgeable isn't she? Quite befitting of a Royal Knight, I'd say. Commander, why don't you tell me a bit about this place too?

main3.line: I quite like it here. All the places we visit have quite a unique atmosphere, whether in Iris Libre or in the Eagle Union... Hehe.

mission.line: New mission notifications? Why don't you let Hood handle it?

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have arrived. I'm excited to see what we got.

touch2.line: Am I... good enough for you?

unlock.line: Across seven steps, in a tower atop a hill, you'll find the king's resting place... Hehe. Will you come with me to Utopia, Commander? I'm joking, of course, but I am very glad we could make this journey together.

win_mvp.line: The purpose of my wings are to guide us towards peace––

battle.line: Please be careful, Commander.

detail.line: The sound of my pounding heart seems to be riding the breeze of happiness across this lake, all the way until it reaches your ears... No, what I should be saying is, I want you to hear it, Commander. Can you feel... my love for you?

expedition.line: The girls in the commission team have come back. Let's go greet... Ah, umm... M-maybe I shouldn't go in this outfit after all...?

feeling5.line: I, Yorktown, will always remain by your side. Through the moment when true peace finally arrives, through the bright and joyous days that follow after that, forever and ever...

headtouch.line: I'm not sure I did anything to deserve this reward... Heehee, just kidding~

home.line: Shall we do a quick debriefing first? We can save the celebratory toast... for when the two of us have some alone time, okay?

login.line: Good day, Commander. For today's agenda... Umm, did you perhaps need a change of pace? Heehee. In that case, allow me to accompany you.

lose.line: Don't worry, I'll be fine. Commander, let's try to keep a clear head, okay?

mail.line: Commander, new mail has arrived. Shall we go through it together?

main1.line: I've already prepared a drink for you, so just go ahead and lie down over there. I don't mind lending you my lap either should you need it~ Heehee.

main2.line: Just as you saved me, Commander, I'm sure you'll also lead the other girls into the light. For your sake – for the person who I cherish so dearly, I wish to become your strength.

main3.line: The wind seems to be picking up... Oh, Commander, shall we head back inside shortly? We'll have plenty of time to chat afterwards~ Heehee.

mission.line: ...Eagle? Mm, we have work, don't we? I need to strike while the iron is hot, before the Commander can get away~♪

mission_complete.line: What's wrong, Eagle? ...Hmm? The rewards are here? Heehee, I see~ It seems that you and Commander understand each other better now.

touch.line: What do you think about the texture of my clothes? Smooth and soft? ...Ah, um... I think that's my skin you're feeling there, not my clothes... *blushes*...

touch2.line: Do you hear that throbbing? It's the sound of my heartbeat, intertwining with yours–

unlock.line: This wedding dress, brimming with light, flutters like a feather in the wind... I'm sure that I'm still in a long, deep, slumber... That's right, Commander. The two of us are surely sharing a blissful dream together, heehee.

win_mvp.line: MVP? Hmm, I wonder what kind of reward I should ask for... Maybe I'll have the Commander pat me on the head as if I was a kid? Heehee~

battle.line: Venture forth!

couple_encourage1.line: Teaming up with old rivals doesn't feel so bad.

couple_encourage2.line: Time to show you the true meaning of invincibility!

couple_encourage3.line: Such a playful old partner!

couple_encourage4.line: Brave Eagles, we fight until the end!

couple_encourage5.line: Heh, want to square off against me?

couple_encourage6.line: We all know each other. Come on, let's go!

couple_encourage7.line: All right, let me see what you're made of!

couple_encourage8.line: I'm counting on you. Don't fall behind!

couple_encourage9.line: I feel like... if you were there, then Akagi could have...

couple_encourage10.line: So this is... the power of friendship...

detail.line: Want to look at my medal collection?

expedition.line: I've been on the battlefield for a long time, so I know about the importance of logistics. Commander, let's greet the girls who work hard behind the scenes.

feeling1.line: ...Commander, you don't seem to have enough courage

feeling2.line: It is my wish to live honestly and sincerely. That's why I'll speak my mind if I have something to say. You too should do the same without holding back.

feeling3.line: All the lights in the sky are stars, just as all the lights on the seas are enemies... Commander, will there be a day where there's no more fighting?

feeling4.line: There's no meaning in being peerless. As long as you are here, Commander, I can draw upon all of my strength. Let us end this war.

feeling5.line: What do you want to do after the war? --Me? I'll probably stick with you. I feel the safest out of battle when I'm with you. Will you... take me along with you?

home.line: It's one battle after another, huh...

hp_warning.line: Interesting...!

login.line: You've come. If it's fighting, I'm ready for it any time.

lose.line: I've lost after giving my all. I'm not regretting this...

mail.line: Commander, it's a new mail.

main1.line: Is it you, Commander? ...Recently, I'm thinking about whether or not I can engage in anti-submarine actions...

main2.line: Luck is also a part of strength? Then if possible, I'd like to impart some of it to my older sister.

main3.line: So long as we live, there are things that will never go our way. When we die, it must happen in a way that carries no regrets.

mission.line: Commander, your missions are not yet completed.  Hurry up and set off!

mission_complete.line: Commander, the rewards are here.

profile.line: I am the Yorktown class aircraft carrier, Enterprise. "Grey Ghost" is one of the many nicknames I have. My smoke-covered and bloodstained battle record is a reminder of my mission. I will continue to be victorious until the war ends.

propose.line: I carry with me the hopes and wills of the countless battlefields and goodbyes that I have experienced. Commander, are you prepared to shoulder them all? …I see. Then let us walk together until the end of our lives.

touch.line: What is it? Sortie time?

touch2.line: What the...?!

unlock.line: Second ship of the Yorktown class, Enterprise, reporting for duty. I will neither sympathize nor hold back with my enemies, and instead, I go all out. Such is my way.

upgrade.line: I will show you... what lies at the end of power

win_mvp.line: Commander, tell me. How many more do I have to sink?

gift_prefer.line: Thanks. I'm not usually the type to say that, but I'll pay it back by seizing victory on the battlefield.

detail.line: Be thankful for the past, have dreams for the future, and live life in the present!

main1.line: Merry Christmas! Is there anything you'd like as a present?

main2.line: Of course Santa Claus is real. Hmm? Right in front of you.

main3.line: A white Christmas, how beautiful... Eh? W-wait, Vestal, don't drag me back in! I'm not cold... I swear, I'm really not cold!

touch.line: Celebrate to your heart's content! These wonderful memories shall light your way during the darkest battles.

unlock.line: Merry Christmas, Commander! I shall be Santa Claus tonight, so make sure to hang up your stockings on the fireplace before going to sleep!

detail.line: Being able to enjoy this peaceful, festive holiday atmosphere is only possible because of everyone's continued hard work... Right, Commander?

home.line: There's no harm in taking a little break before the next battle, Commander.

login.line: Lanterns... should be hung up like this, right? Ah, Commander, you're here. I heard that they hang lanterns up to celebrate Lunar New Year in the Dragon Empery, so I gave it a try... You think it's fine? Festive, isn't it?

main1.line: My flight deck is also decorated with a theme from the Dragon Empery. Its colors represent joy and happiness. Not bad, huh.

main2.line: According to legend, a mythical beast called the "Nian" comes out during the Lunar New Year. It can be warded off by setting off a lot of firecrackers.

main3.line: I heard that it's customary in the Dragon Empery to hand out "red envelopes" during the New Year. Should I prepare some for the Union girls?

touch.line: Commander, it seems that this coat is big enough to accommodate two people. It's super warm - want to see for yourself?

unlock.line: So this is the traditional attire of the Dragon Empery? Hmm... it fits quite well. Oh? Custom-made bow and arrows… Interesting, let's see how far these arrows can fly.

battle.line: Enterprise, engage!

detail.line: Commander, are you doing well? Live long and prosper!

feeling1.line: Maybe I should just hit the road and never look back...

feeling5.line: Would you like to come with me, Commander? We can go anywhere in the world. Think of all the new people and cultures we could discover together on our trek!

home.line: Good work out there! Go ahead and take a break while the others are being inspected.

login.line: Ah, you're here. I'm ready to go whenever you are. Oh, can't be forgetting my helmet!

lose.line: Sometimes there really is a no-win scenario...

mail.line: Commander, there's an incoming message from fleet command.

main1.line: Commander? Recently... I've been thinking about how it would feel to be able to soar through the skies and stars... but that's not really possible. Sorry for making you listen to my idle thoughts.

main2.line: Vacation, huh... To be honest, I've been deployed in so many places during my lengthy service that sometimes even vacations feel like yet another mission...

main3.line: Recently, Essex has picked up biking as well. It'd be great to go out with everyone else next time.

touch.line: Would you also like to see my trusty steed?

unlock.line: Happy Anniversary! Commander, celebrate to your heart's content today! I'll be praying for our continued victories!

win_mvp.line: For the sake of freedom and the Azur Lane, I'll keep on winning!

battle.line: Enterprise, sallying forth! Let us crush our enemies!

detail.line: I do not believe that it is correct to wantonly resort to violence, even in the name of justice.

expedition.line: Would you like to greet the commission fleet? It's a good idea to get some exercise. Otherwise, Hornet's going to make fun of you.

home.line: Commander, thank you for your hard work. Let's get ready for the next operation.

login.line: Good day, Commander. There's still some time until the strategy meeting, so you should rest up while you still have the opportunity to.

lose.line: So I've... overstepped my limits...?

main1.line: I'm quite impressed by the Royal Maids. Aside from their combat prowess, they're also very good at a wide variety of other things.

main2.line: Vestal, what's the matter? ...No, I've been making sure to eat! Commander has been making all sorts... I mean, I cook from time to time as well!

main3.line: My eagle is quite attached to you, Commander. We should all get along just like you two. Hehe.

mission.line: We still have missions that haven't been completed. You should check on their progress.

touch.line: Commander, do you need me for something?

touch2.line: You wouldn't do this to Yorktown, would you...

unlock.line: There is no doubt in my mind that I was born to fight. For the azure lanes of liberty, Enterprise, engaging!

win_mvp.line: Our slight advantage seems to have given us the victory here.

detail.line: Right, I didn't get to ask you earlier since you were in a hurry, but what do you think about my outfit? I value your input just as much as I value that of Hornet and the others.

expedition.line: The girls in the commission fleet have returned? The formalities will have to wait then. I'll go welcome them back first.

home.line: Commander, you shouldn't overexert yourself... Hm, you should be the one saying that to me? I understand.

login.line: I'm Enterprise of the Eagle Union. Let's proceed to the event venue.

main1.line: I see, so this is how it's done. Next time, I'll have to learn how to make... Hm? Ahh, I was talking about ice cream. Do you want some, Commander?

main2.line: I'm used to emergency sorties. Even if I'm at a banquet, just give me the order and I'll scramble my planes.

main3.line: What about Independence? Ahh, she's a nice and adorable girl, just like Eagle. Good friends who heal my heart from the weariness of battle.

unlock.line: My ballgown? I don't normally get to wear clothes like these, so it took me a while to change. Ah, let's hurry to the venue. We shouldn't keep everyone else waiting.

win_mvp.line: May this victory serve as the ornament to a fine celebration.

battle.line: Come, spread your wings and fly!

detail.line: Ah, Commander, there's something I wanted to ask you about... What do you think about this pose? I want to do what I can so I don't sully your reputation.

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. Sorry, but could you welcome them back in my place?

home.line: Good work, Commander. Go ahead and take a break, I'll handle the follow-up work for the others.

login.line: Let's do our best today. I'll be cheering you on.

main1.line: Is that... Zuikaku? That's a pretty showy outfit... though I'm not exactly in a position to talk myself.

main2.line: Essex, be careful when you're charging ahead! ...Oh, um, I didn't mean to patronize, I just can't help but get a bit worried...

main3.line: You'd like to help me with the maintenance? Sure. To be honest, you might be better suited for this job. Ahaha~

touch.line: A photo op? Sure, but what kind of pose should I make?

touch2.line: That's against the rules, Commander.

unlock.line: Commander, did you come to watch the race? You know... I'd rather be down there competing than standing around over here. That feeling of being able to seize the wind... Don't you think that racing and sailing share the same essence?

win_mvp.line: First place, huh? Normally not much of a reason to celebrate, but since we're at a race, let's uncork the champagne.

battle.line: No matter where my foes appear, I'll take them down all the same!

detail.line: Thank you for letting me experience the stillness you can only find away from the battlefield, Commander. It's shown me... what's really worth protecting.

expedition.line: Commission team's come back. Let's go say hi and give them some souvenirs while we're at it.
