main1.line: Something nice is gonna happen today~ That's what I'm feeling!

main2.line: Why am I always smiling? Hehehe, because I've been having so much fun ever since I came here!

main3.line: The injuries I've sustained from combat? Hehehe, they don't hurt at all.

mission.line: Finish them all in one go!

mission_complete.line: Hehehe~ It's just human instinct to smile at the sight of money! Yeah, that's it! Smile, Commander~!

profile.line: I'm the Royal Navy M-class destroyer Musketeer! I was in the Battle of the North Cape! Commander, little Musketeer is gonna shoot straight through your dreary heart with a bang bang!

propose.line: Thank you, Commander! This is the best thing I've ever gotten! Hey, tell me: have I given you some good memories, too?

skill.line: Locked and loaded~! Ready to fire!

touch.line: Hehehe~! You've reloaded me with energy!

touch2.line: It's not like I *dislike* it, but... Yeah, I actually don't dislike it!

unlock.line: I am the M-class Destroyer, Musketeer! Hehe... I knew something good was going to happen today~ Commander, can you point me to where the port is? Here? Or over here?!

upgrade.line: Take aim~! Fire! Bang!

win_mvp.line: I'm gonna punch a hole straight through your heart~! Heheh, I've always wanted to say that!

gift_prefer.line: That's cheered me right up!

battle.line: Chaaarge! Ehehe, don't I sound like a flagship?

detail.line: Wales, someone can be small and still have a lot of potential, you know! Ehehe, Echo doesn't know what that means, but maybe they're words of praise~?

expedition.line: The commission girls are back~♪ Echo will go check if they brought any yummy snacks with them~

feeling1.line: Commander, people have said you've become a deadbeat, but what is a deadbeat even...? Hmm, in any event, Echo will do everything possible to make you more productive~ Let's begin by having you greet me properly~

feeling2.line: Commander, please be positive. Be like Echo: smile, and be happy~ Ehehe♪

feeling3.line: Commander, you can't give up so easily. You must get into shape~ Come on, take a stroll around the port with Echo~♪

feeling4.line: Echo made cookies~ Have a bite, Commander! ... It's too sweet for you? Ehehe, Hood said they have the signature "Echo flavor"~♪

feeling5.line: Commander, can we go someplace far away... *Yawn*, I must've been sleeptalking... Hm? So you're okay with going somewhere with Echo? Hooray! Let's go somewhere, then!

home.line: Would you like to eat snacks with Echo~? ... You aren't hungry? In that case... you can just watch me while I eat.

hp_warning.line: I need to hold out just a little longer... Edinburgh will come save me, I'm sure of it!

login.line: Ah, Commander~♪ Ehehe, you're back! You know, Echo was reaaaally lonely~ Hurry up and come play with me~

lose.line: Ugh... don't bully meee...

mail.line: Mail has arrived~♪ Maybe there are yummy snacks enclosed within it~ Ehehe~

main1.line: I made a promise to Edinburgh: I must return to port now and then, no matter how far away I go~♪

main2.line: Be it with my E-class sisters or strangers, I can make friends with anyone I have fun with, so don't worry about me!

main3.line: Echo is by your side, Commander! And if you give Echo a high-five, you might feel more motivated!

mission.line: Commander, we should finish our missions! It's not good to be negligent~♪ Aha, don't you agree that Echo's suuuuuper duper reliable~?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete~♪ Echo will bring you the rewards, Commander!

profile.line: I'm Echo, an E-class destroyer of the Royal Navy. I was in the Battle of the Denmark Strait along with Hood and Wales, after which I brought Wales safely back to port~ Ehehe, it's a memory I cherish! Oh, also, Edinburgh is really precious to me!

propose.line: What are we here for? I don't quite get what this is for... Okay, if you give me candy, then I will stay with you to the end! Okie dokie, I'll open my mouth, so please feed me candy~♪

skill.line: Here I come! Witness Echo's might!

touch.line: Commander, carry me like a princess! Echo's quite lightweight! ... Ahahaha~ Commander, that tickles~♪

touch2.line: Wha...? Hood said I shouldn't let people touch me there...

unlock.line: Hello, Commander~! Echo, reporting in! So, after I finish checking in, can I have a reward? Ehehe~♪ I loooove candy, you see~

upgrade.line: Ehehe~♪ I don't know if I've gotten stronger, but I'm grateful, Commander~♪

win_mvp.line: Wowee~♪ Echo got MVP? Ehehe~ So, you're basically praising me?

gift_prefer.line: You're giving Echo an amazing present like this? Yay! This is the best day ever!

battle.line: Lemme at 'em!

couple_encourage1.line: Hey! Z2, you'd better make Z1 behave!

detail.line: I was just looking for you, Commander! Let's do something fun.

expedition.line: The commission team's back? I'll go get them!

feeling1.line: You're no fun at all, Commander...

feeling2.line: My outfit? It's different because I served in some pretty frigid waters back in the day~ Heheh, it's pretty cool though, huh? What do you think?

feeling3.line: Y-you saw my room? Well, when I get too bored, I end up taking apart the furniture... and then I don't know how to put it back together. But why, though?

feeling4.line: Too noisy? Hmm, well, I'm just trying to get your attention. Everyone's really... Oh no, could I be bothering someone? I'd better go apologize!

feeling5.line: I've been good? Eheheh, that's all thanks to you, Commander. Since you've been giving me so much attention, I don't need to bother anyone else. I can just wait until you have time for me. Riiight?

home.line: I finished all the work you left here for me.

hp_warning.line: It's not time to retreat yet!

login.line: Commander, you kept me waiting so long I got mad and took apart your chair! Wh-what if I can't put it back together...?

lose.line: Oh noes... Sorry, Commander...

mail.line: Commander, I got the mail for you~ Heh heh. It was nothing. Don't mention it.

main1.line: Commander, let's build an igloo when it snows! I'm pretty good at those!

main2.line: Yippeeee! Yahoooo! Ah, Commander, errr~ Why am I horsing around like this? Just bored, I guess.

main3.line: All right, target acquired: daydreaming Commander. Eskimo head smasher! GO!

mission.line: A new mission? All right, a new mission!

mission_complete.line: Commander, here's all the mission rewards. Take a look at them already!

profile.line: I'm Tribal-class Destroyer Eskimo! During the war, I mostly served in the Home Fleet. I defeated Z19 at the Battle of Narvik, but then Z2 struck back at me... After that, I did good work in the Mediterranean.

propose.line: All right, I promise, Commander. I'll work hard, and be good. I won't cause any more trouble! Just keep on giving me more attention! Eheheh!

skill.line: All right! Have a taste of this!

touch.line: What's up, Commander? Time I get to work? All right, time I get to work!

touch2.line: Oh? Something on my coat?

unlock.line: Eskimo, Tribal-class Destroyer, is here! Oi, this fleet's not half bad! Nice to meet you, Commander!

upgrade.line: Yes! Now I'm feeling it!

win_mvp.line: Yes! I'm the MVP! Now cheer for me!

gift_prefer.line: What's this for? Thanks!

feeling5_ex.line: ....... Why am I not saying anything? Oh, did you want me to? I was trying to keep quiet so I wouldn't bother you, Commander. Buuut, if you insist... I'll flirt with you all I want~! Ehehe, remember, you were the one who asked~!

login_ex.line: Patience, patience... Ah, Commander, it's about time! I've missed you!

main1_ex.line: Commander, wanna go adventuring in the Northern Parliament's tundras when we get some time off? Don't worry about it, you'll be fine with me at your side!

main2_ex.line: Commander, is there anything I can help you with? All right, I'll just wait in this corner here and not bother you...

main3_ex.line: Target acquired: Commander's lap! Commencing tactical dive bombing!

touch_ex.line: Commander, I've actually been waiting for you to call me! So, what do you need done?

home.line: Woohoo, Commander's back! All right, let's go swim or something!

login.line: Commander, shhhh!

main1.line: Ehehe... You have no choice but to play with me! ...Commander! Oh, it's nothing!

main2.line: Miss Belfast and Dunkerque? You brought ice cream for me? Thanks a ton! Ah, got any for the Manjuu? Huh, what do you mean you're not falling for that?

main3.line: Commander, you done with work yet? You're not? Aw, I wanted to play...

touch.line: Oww! All right, please stop bonking me... I just got bored because you wouldn't play with me... Okay, okay, I won't bully the Manjuu anymore...

unlock.line: Oh woe, nobody wants to play with me because they're all too busy~ ...Oh, hello little Manjuu... Heheh, maybe I'll play a prank on you instead!

battle.line: Alright...! Let's go all-out!

couple_encourage1.line: Miss Hood, this time, I'll defend you properly!

couple_encourage2.line: It seems we're heading out together again!

detail.line: A change of clothes for the commander, the menus for tomorrow's meals... Oh, Commander. When did you get here? ...Don't mind me, I'm just doing some daily preparations~♪

expedition.line: Commander, would you like me to go greet the commissions team in your stead?

feeling1.line: ...If you keep this up, I'll be the only one left who's willing to keep looking after you, Commander...

feeling2.line: Commander, I've sworn to protect you and everyone else at the port. I'll use all my might to destroy anything that dares to hurt you!

feeling3.line: Commander, haven't you been working a bit too hard recently? You need to make sure to get some rest when you can... If you fly too close to the sun, your wings will melt, and you'll fall down, you know? ...Huh? What am I saying...?

feeling4.line: Mm... The more I stay by your side, the more I want to do your work in your stead... Do you think I'm getting a bit too attached to you...?

feeling5.line: "You, who are like the sun, make me feel your warmth just by being there. You, who are like the sun, make me afraid of being swallowed by your warmth." Commander, can I come... a bit closer to you?

headtouch.line: Hehehe. You know, this feels kind of nice.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. I cleaned up the room while you were away. ...N-no, there's no need to praise me. It really wasn't a big deal!

hp_warning.line: My torpedoes still aren't ready... I can hold out for a bit longer...!

login.line: Commander, did you just arrive? Hehe. There are documents on your desk. I'll have your tea ready in just a moment, so please get started on your work.

lose.line: If only I could have shot another volley of torpedoes...

mail.line: I've finished sorting out the new mail! Should I bring it over?

main1.line: Commander, please let me know when you head out! Whether it's an umbrella or a coat, I'll be sure to have it ready for you.

main2.line: Eskimo looks like she wants some attention... Commander, I'll do something about her, so please focus on your work. ...That's right, I can call Abercrombie over!

main3.line: I guess destroyers really have their limits... If only I had bigger guns or torpedoes... Oh, I was just talking to myself. Please don't mind me!

mission.line: There's a new mission. Let's do our best!

mission_complete.line: The mission's been completed! How wonderful!

profile.line: My history as a ship...? I escorted Hood and Warspite, and also participated in anti-submarine missions... Basically, I've been here and there and done this and that. I guess you could say I have quite a bit of experience? That being the case, feel free to call upon me, whether in battle or otherwise!

propose.line: Just as I've become unable to part with you, have you come to feel the same way about me? I'm so happy! From now on, I'll be sure... to ask you for lots of things♪

touch.line: Was there something you wanted me to do?

touch2.line: I-I'm not sure if we should be doing this...

unlock.line: Well met, Commander. I am Icarus, I-class destroyer from the Royal Navy. I specialize in escort and anti-submarine operations. I look forward to working with you.

upgrade.line: Mmh~ One step closer to achieving overwhelming firepower... Err, I mean, I'll be more useful to the commander!

win_mvp.line: We won! It's all thanks to you, Commander!

gift_prefer.line: You went out of your way to prepare this for me? I'm so incredibly grateful, Commander!

feeling5_ex.line: "You, who are like the sun..." No, that's not quite it. If I were to say what you are really like... Maybe a space heater? Warm to be around, without the danger of being burned... Look, even if I'm sticking to you this closely, I'm still not burned! Hehe~

headtouch_ex.line: Hehe~ Commander, your kindness puts me at ease.

login_ex.line: Oh, Commander. Did you just get here? I've prepared the schedule and documents on your desk, along with a glass of lemon water. It's got plenty of vitamins in it, so I hope you'll do your best!

main4_ex.line: Here Commander, your lunch! Ah, but you can't be a picky eater!

main5_ex.line: Wow, Hood is gorgeous as always... Hey Commander, you should follow her example too and act more gracefully!

main6_ex.line: Whenever I play hide-and-seek, I usually find everyone intuitively... Perhaps I'm better at it than I thought?

touch_ex.line: I'm right over here~ Please let me know if you need anything!

touch2_ex.line: If you're g-going to do something like this, shouldn't we go elsewhere...?

detail.line: I've already prepared your changes of clothing and daily necessities in advance. Make sure you don't neglect your health while I'm away participating in this exercise, alright?

home.line: I wonder if... I should just let the Royal Maids clean your room instead...

login.line: Commander, did you come by to check up on me? Though I might look like a patient, I'm actually perfectly fine~

main1.line: Looking out the window of this hospital room at the scenery is making me oddly emotional...

main2.line: These bandages and this IV are just here for practice. They're not the real deal, you know?

main3.line: It's hard to move around properly in this... I'm sure there will be an impact on my firepower, too...

touch.line: Even in this situation, I'm sure there is something that I can do for you, Commander.

touch2.line: C-Commander? We're in the medical facility, you know...

unlock.line: This is a special exercise for our on-site medical facilities! Well, that's what they said anyway, but isn't this kind of weird...? I feel like I'd rather be taking care of others, not the other way around...

detail.line: No matter how many times I see it, it never gets old... It's simply amazing that we're able to create amazing sets like this at the Port.

home.line: Commander, how would you like to join me in the shoot? I think I'd get more fired up if we're in the same shot... Hehe~

login.line: The manjuus and I are all ready to go! You can start taking pictures whenever you're ready.

main1.line: So this is what the submarine girls see while they battle... Hehe, the scenery down here is amazing.

main2.line: This swimsuit fits me nice and tight. It's so easy to move around in it!

main3.line: Oh, I caught you spacing out, Commander. I had the manjuus take a picture as proof, too. Why don't you take a look? Heehee~

touch2.line: W-We're still in the middle of the shoot, Commander!

unlock.line: "Let's go explore the ocean together! What special things will we be able to find today~?" Hehe, how's that, Commander?

detail.line: I cleaned your room earlier, and was pleasantly surprised to see that it was well-organized. Great work not leaving documents strewn about, Commander~

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. How about a break? I've prepared some cake for you. I do hope it's to your liking.

login.line: What a good little kitty cat you are~ Hold still, let me get that itch for you~ Same goes for you, Commander. Let me know if you've ever got an itch, I'll take care of it for you~

main1.line: Commander, it's time to eat. I put my all into the preparations! I... went too overboard? E-Err...

main2.line: Comparing me to the Royal Maids is like comparing night and day. There's no way I'd be able to measure up to true professionals.

main3.line: I think I understand your daily schedule now, Commander. These are part of the duties of a maid, aren't they?

touch.line: Commander? It seems you really enjoy touching people. Let's go tell everyone about this interest of yours!

touch2.line: Is this... also part of the duties of a maid?

unlock.line: I hope your work's going well, Commander! I've been here playing with these kitties since finishing my duties. Here, I brewed some fresh tea to help you recharge~

battle.line: Remember to mind your safety, even when you're fighting.

couple_encourage1.line: Do you need some assistance?

detail.line: I don't want any harm to come to Janus. Please take good care of her, and don't try to take advantage of her kindness.

expedition.line: The commission's done. Make sure to wash your hands after carrying things, or else our next meeting might be in the infirmary.

feeling1.line: I cannot comprehend people who do bad things yet act like all is right with the world... Yes, people such as you, Commander.

feeling2.line: Mhm, that should do it. Please be more careful next time. Oh, Commander? As you can see, I've just finished my treatment. Are you feeling unwell, or... just slacking off again?

feeling3.line: Try not to get yourself hurt when you're out on sortie. It's going to be a huge headache for me if you end up bedridden.

feeling4.line: Of course, it falls upon me to look after you should you get injured... And while that's rather troublesome, for some reason, I do find that prospect quite appealing... I wonder if I'm coming down with some weird illness myself...

feeling5.line: I wonder if there's a cure for my selfishness... Hey, Commander, what reason might one have to develop feelings for her patient? Hm? You want me to tell you? ...As if, you prat.

headtouch.line: What are you doing, may I ask?

home.line: Welcome back–– Oh my, you have some scratches on you. You shouldn't be so careless as to put yourself in danger... I'll treat you right now, so please stay still.

hp_warning.line: Nothing some emergency treatment can't fix!

login.line: I wonder if it is an acceptable thing to keep your secretary waiting like this.

lose.line: Let's withdraw. Phew... I'm glad we were able to rescue everyone in time.

mail.line: New mail has arrived. If you miss any response deadlines, I can't help you with that.

main1.line: Your nose is practically buried in your paperwork. If you don't want to live in a blurry world, I'd advise you to be mindful of your posture.

main2.line: When treating people, the emphasis should always be on the "people" part. Administering the port operates on the same principle. Though it's fine to be absorbed in your work, try not to neglect the people around you.

main3.line: Did Janus say anything weird to you lately? ...Nevermind. She's a kind-hearted girl, but sometimes acts without thinking. It can be a bit of a pain sometimes...

mission.line: Leaving work unfinished is like allowing an illness to go untreated. By the time things get unmanageable, it may already be too late. *sigh*... Why do people choose to be so irresponsible anyway?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Don't forget to look back on your work to see if there's room for improvement.

profile.line: I am Jervis, J-class destroyer. I participated in several operations with the Royal Navy. If you are inclined to sum up my service as "lucky"... I suppose I don't mind. It's normal for people to become fixated on what stands out most to them, no?

propose.line: Seeing as how you aren't a complete plank, I suppose I can give you an answer. Taking care of you isn't something I can't handle... Huh? You want me to say "I love you?" Y-you idiot... Maybe we can save that for next time...

touch.line: ...Let me see your hand. Good, there's nothing wrong with it.

touch2.line: Surely you're not going to say that was an "accident," are you?

unlock.line: I am Jervis, J-class destroyer of the Royal Navy, and my duty is to assist the injured. You seem to be in pretty good shape, Commander, so my services probably aren't needed? I'll be taking my leave for now.

upgrade.line: I do wonder if you're improving yourself while everyone else is getting stronger.

win_mvp.line: Is anyone injured? Please allow me to administer some basic treatment.

gift_prefer.line: Well. I don't dislike it.

detail_ex.line: Commander, do you keep a diary by any chance? See, I was thinking I'd do like Janus and record my day-to-day thoughts, and... No, you may absolutely not read it. You'll just have to live with that, I'm afraid.

expedition_ex.line: Is that all of the commission supplies? All right, now it's time to wash your hands. Go on – put them forth and I'll show you how it's done.

feeling5_ex.line: Could you come see me again later today? ...No, not for a checkup, but rather for a d-da– Look, you already know what I'm talking about. If you're interested, then just say it, please... Y-you idiot...

headtouch_ex.line: You just can't resist doing perverted things, can you?

home_ex.line: Look at you – you got hurt again! I'll have to use antiseptic. It's going to sting, but you have only yourself to blame for that.

login_ex.line: Making a girl wait for you isn't good manners, Commander.

main4_ex.line: Please try to curb your bad habits for the sake of your health. I'll keep an eye on you for however long it takes until all traces of them are gone.

mail_ex.line: You've received a new letter. Unless you have more urgent business, I advise you read it now.

mission_ex.line: You have a bunch of unfinished missions. Remember what I... *sigh*... Reminding you about everything has become a habit of mine.

mission_complete_ex.line: Oh, you completed a mission? Nicely done. You've proven your ability to commit to your duties.

touch2_ex.line: You idiot...

win_mvp_ex.line: The best type of victory is one without casualties.

detail.line: I'm helping out because the Maid Team is somewhat understaffed right now. What about my outfit...? Is there something wrong about wearing maid attire while performing maid duties?

feeling5.line: As a maid, I am able to take care of you even when you are not ill, yes? ...Not that I care though. I'm not interested in becoming your maid; it was merely a thought experiment... Yes, nothing more than that.

home.line: Since you have nothing better to do, why don't you lend a hand and help me hang up the rest of these sheets? Surely you didn't come here just to watch me work?

login.line: I thought a certain someone came here to slack off, but turns out they had spare time and wanted to help out, huh... I guess there's nothing stopping you.

main1.line: Janus went to participate in the "Maid Experience Day." A real hard worker, I tell you. If she runs into any problems, won't you quietly lend her a hand? ...But, don't bring me up at all.

main2.line: Are you seriously going to stay here until lunch? I'm telling you now, I only cook for my patients. If you're fine with that, you're free to do as you please.

main3.line: Huh?! Why'd the wind suddenly kick up...?! Phew, that was a close one... Maybe I should just have you keep an eye on this for me? Just in case~

touch.line: I'll be fine. I can still reach. More importantly, where have your eyes been wandering?

touch2.line: Seems like the sheets aren't the only things that need cleaning. Let's put that dirty mind of yours through the wash too.

unlock.line: Phew... That about does it. Next on the agenda is... Huh, Commander? What are you doing here?

battle.line: Don't worry, Janus, you can do this! You can totally handle those enemies!

detail.line: So much stuff happened today... Mm, I should record it down in my diary... C-Commander?! Th-this is just an ordinary diary... Sorry! I can't let you read it!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned... P-please allow me to come with you! ...Well, actually, it's fine if you don't...

feeling1.line: "I knew it... I can't do anything after all... or be of use to anyone..."

feeling2.line: "I still have trouble talking to people who aren't my J-class sister ships, but... I can at least greet the Commander normally now! I'll keep working hard to make sure I can help a lot more people from now on!"

feeling3.line: "Jervis said something terrible to the Commander again today... Even though I'm sure she didn't mean that... If I were to say something like that to the Commander... Actually, there's no way that'd ever happen..."

feeling4.line: "Spending time with the Commander is always so much fun, and I feel my courage growing as well... I hope that we'll always be together, tomorrow and every day after that... It might be wishful thinking, but I hope this silly dream of mine comes true..."

feeling5.line: "Whenever I can't be with the Commander, my chest aches... Jervis said this wasn't a sickness, but rather 'covetousness'... Am I a covetous girl? Do I crave the Commander's attention so badly...? Commander, I don't want to be a nuisance to you, but I don't know what I should do..."

headtouch.line: That feels so nice... Pweh?! S-so sorry! I was completely distracted by something else just now...

home.line: C-Commander! Great job on your sortie! Is there, um, anything I can do to help?

hp_warning.line: I mustn't drag the others down... I have to be strong!

login.line: ...Commander?! Wh-when did you... I mean, my apologies! Um... W-w-w-w-welcome back!

lose.line: Ugh... I lost... What's this tight feeling in my chest...?

mail.line: Commander, your mail is here! ...Phew, I'm glad I was able to deliver it to you promptly!

main1.line: (...I don't hear anything from the office... I'll end up disturbing the Commander if I walk in right now, won't I...)

main2.line: I hope the seas will remain calm today... and that my friends who have set sail will return home safely...

main3.line: Um, if Jervis happens to say something rude to you, please don't hold it against her! If, if anything, I'll apologize in her place!

mission.line: Commander, um, about the mission... S-sorry! I wasn't trying to specifically bring that up right now!

mission_complete.line: Wow, you're already done with your work? How impressive... I-it was only possible because of me...? Th-thank you! I'm glad I was able to be of help!

profile.line: H-hello, I'm Janus, a J-class destroyer from the Royal Navy... I'll work hard so that I can be of use to you and everyone else here! ...Ahh, I'm still so nervous...

propose.line: Huh? The two of us, oathbound? ...C-Commander, I never realized you... Oh, it's nothing! I'm so glad! I'll never stop working hard so that I can be of use to you, Commander!

touch.line: Hyeep?! ...S-sorry! That just startled me a bit...

touch2.line: *whimpers*... I-is this my punishment for being a burden...?

unlock.line: (Y-you can do it, Janus! It's just a simple greeting!) ...Ah, um! Commander, p-pleased to meet you! I am Janus of the J class! Please forgive me if my sudden visitation was discourteous to you in any way...

upgrade.line: Just getting stronger isn't good enough. I also have to keep working harder...

win_mvp.line: Did you see that, Commander? I, I did it!

gift_prefer.line: Is it really okay for me to keep this? I'll take good care of it!

detail_ex.line: Commander... D-do you still want to read my diary? I, I suppose that isn't an impossible proposition... Alright, I'm leaving a bookmark right here... But! You're absolutely not allowed to look past the marked page!

expedition_ex.line: The commission team has returned. Please allow me to come with you as well! I... I can do this now!

feeling5_ex.line: "The day we exchanged oaths was the happiest day of my life... I have to work harder in every aspect of my life so that this happiness may last forever! ...Oh, but if I let the Commander read this, then everything I wrote before will... >///<"

login_ex.line: Don't worry, Janus, you've already done this a whole bunch of times before... Ah, Commander, welcome back!

lose_ex.line: Commander, I'll be fine! I'm... not afraid of failure anymore like I used to be!

main4_ex.line: Are you sure I can come talk to you whenever I want? ...I, I see. I'll try my best to find a suitable time to come bother you then... Gah, that came out wrong! I didn't mean it that way...

main5_ex.line: Whenever I found myself too afraid to move forward, I used to try to encourage myself to keep my spirits up. But now, with you and my other friends at my side, I have all the courage I need and no longer need to resort to that. Ehehe.

mission_ex.line: Commander, the new missions are... Y-yes, if you require my assistance, I'll do my best to help out!

touch2_ex.line: I, I still don't think... I can handle stuff like this yet... Ugh...

detail.line: If I fill out my diary, it's just going to be chock-full of spooky stuff! Um, anyways, I'm just going to write down the non-scary things... "I ran into the Commander, and then we spent Halloween together..." ––That's good enough, right?

expedition.line: Hyeep?! ...Oh, that was just the commission fleet coming back? Thank you very much...

feeling5.line: "I ended up causing all sorts of trouble for the Commander... But I'm so glad we got to spend Halloween together, even despite all that apologising... Ugh, bad Janus! That doesn't count as a date... You have to get the Commander to agree beforehand..."

home.line: I'm a bad girl, aren't I? For wearing this to try to get Commander to notice me... A-actually, p-please don't look at me after all! *whimpers*...

login.line: I'll be just fine, I can handle going out alone on Halloween night... C-Commander, I'm sorry! I need your help after all...

lose.line: Jervis is going to be worried about me... Ugh...

main1.line: C-Commander, it's not your fault. I wasn't watching where I was going... No, I'm sure it was because I was too jumpy and ended up spooking the kitty...

main2.line: All my friends around the port are dressing up for Halloween, huh... By the way, what is this supposed to be a costume of? It has cat ears, but bat wings...

main3.line: Commander, are you not scared of Halloween? Well, when I think about it a bit more... I'm the only one who's scared of Halloween, aren't I? Oh no, I'm sorry for bringing up weird things...

mission.line: Commander, there's new mission here! Err, umm... I hope you can come back sooner... S-sorry!

touch.line: Don't you worry, Janus, there's nothing to be afraid of... Jervis and the Commander are here!

unlock.line: D-don't worry, Janus... There's no such thing as Halloween ghouls... Hyeep?! A c-cat?! *whimper*... Jervis, Commander, please come save me...!

battle.line: I hope my skirt's fine like this...

detail.line: Commander, don't look there! ...Phew... I-it's nothing! It's not like I hid my diary there, or anything... Eep...

expedition.line: The commission team is back? Okay! I'll go and meet them... right away...!

feeling5.line: "I brought the Commander to my room... I didn't want to be a distraction, but I did it anyway... You need to stop this, Janus! Jervis is going to worry about you! The Commander didn't teach you to be bad, so why did you turn out to be such a bad girl...?"

home.line: W-w-welcome back! Once I'm dressed, umm, could we leave together...?

login.line: Ah... I-I'm sorry for making you wait. Just a little longer...

main1.line: It's okay, Janus, the Commander's focused on work... But I must be a distraction, right? What do I do...?

main2.line: Jervis said she'd come and pick me up... I-if I don't get changed quickly, she might misunderstand the situation. Then, the Commander might get called weird names again...

main3.line: Oh, no! I don't think you're a bother or anything, Commander! Did it seem that way? Oh, no...

mission.line: A new mission? I see. You would have new missions, Commander... M-may I join you in taking care of them?

touch.line: Don't worry, Janus. The Commander won't do anything weird... Just don't worry!

touch2.line: I get it. It's my fault for making you wait... Ack! *blush*

unlock.line: It's okay, Janus. You're just getting dressed, so do it like usual, and everything will be fine... Hwuh? Commander? S-sorry! I'm the one who told you to keep your eyes closed, so why did I go and talk to you?!

detail.line: I wrote about my experiences with the Royal Maids in my diary. If y-you're interested in hearing about it... w-we can maybe read it together next time?

expedition.line: The commission team is back... Huh?! Y-you're going to make me greet them in this outfit? Umm, uhh... m-maybe next time?!

feeling5.line: "Hypothetically, if I were to become Commander's personal maid... I'd do the cooking, draw the bathwater, make the bed, and, umm... maybe also have to do this or that... Ahh, just thinking about it is making me blush..."

home.line: Commander, wh-where did you go just now...? I, I tried finding my way around in the dark by myself, b-but, I just can't do it...

login.line: *sniffles*... Had you not come to get me, Commander, I'd probably still be crouching in the same place...

main1.line: Maids are truly amazing... They spare no effort in providing the best service they possibly can...

main2.line: Being able to experience being a part of the Royal Maids firsthand was a lot of fun. I feel like I'm... a little more courageous now!

main3.line: Ark Royal is a very dependable person. She handles everything thrown at her with ease, and she's always looking after me and helping me out... I wish I could become as reliable and mature as she is...

touch.line: Th-thank you... Holding hands makes me feel a lot safer...

touch2.line: *whimpers*... I, I don't think we should be doing this...

unlock.line: It'll be alright, Janus! Nothing bad's going to happen to you just because the light went out and you're all alone... Umm... Hyeep?! C-Commander? D-did you come to pick me up because you were worried...?

detail.line: Commander, umm... C-can you go a little slower for me? I'm trying to memorise the rules... Ahm... Here, I'll just write them down...

feeling5.line: "The Commander tried so hard to teach me, but I didn't learn a thing... When we're that close, I can't focus on anything other than that. I can hardly even hear... Ugh, Janus! At this rate, you're just going to waste the Commander's valuable time!"

headtouch.line: You're trying to comfort me...? I-it's okay! I'm fine!

home.line: Welcome, Commander. I'll set up the pool table right away... Huh? Y-yes! I will get down first...

login.line: I'm sorry! Can we delay the pool lesson to another time...? Ahh... I'd really like to change into a different pair of tights...

main1.line: There are so many different ways to play pool... If not for you, I'd never have known.

main2.line: I came up here to escape these kitties, but my outfit, um... Ahh...

main3.line: Wow! All that in one shot... How long will it take me to get as good as you? I-I wonder if you'll keep teaching me... Ahh... Never mind...

touch.line: Umm, lower your waist, and spread your fingers... Eep... A-a little close...

touch2.line: Ahh... H-here? M-maybe that's not such a good idea...

unlock.line: Don't worry, Janus, they'll leave you alone soon... Hwah?! C-Commander? I-I'm sorry! I didn't come up here on purpose. These kitties just, umm, chased me...

detail.line: Oh... I wrote down some swimming tips in my diary and read them again and again... but then I got too overwhelmed to even remember them...

feeling5.line: (I spent the day in a wonderful place with the Commander... W-wait, Janus! Didn't you make a promise to swim together? And then you were so happy just to be with the Commander that it never happened. Well, at least the Commander had fun...I think...)

headtouch.line: Are you trying to encourage me? Th-thank you! I feel more confident now!

home.line: Y-you're finally back, Commander! Um, I was thinking about going out and looking for you... then I got too scared...

login.line: Commander, I-I... I'm too scared to go in by myself! C-could you please share some of your courage with me?!

main1.line: I should probably untie this part to get the sunscreen on, shouldn't I? W-wait, I don't mean it like THAT! Just that it would be easier without these strings in the way... Oh, gosh!

main2.line: Hyeep, the wind! What if my swimsuit blows away...? Ahh, Commander, I need you to pull this part tight for me!

main3.line: You like the view...? C-could you please tell me which view you're talking about?

touch.line: The sunscreen is nice and even now... Thank you, Commander! Heehee, I can finally swim without worrying!

touch2.line: Ah, umm! Y-you know, when I hold you like this... I don't feel scared anymore!

unlock.line: It'll be okay, Janus... it'll be okay! You're safe up here... so it'll be okay! Ahh, it's totally not okay... C-Commander, c-could you hold me steady... please?

detail.line: Ah... S-sorry! I was thinking about how I can remember every moment of this day, but the harder I try, the more I forget... D-do you think I should just focus on having fun? O-okay! I'll focus really hard on enjoying every single second with you!

feeling5.line: I was wondering if I should write this in my diary, but this time, I want to tell you directly! "Today's sunrise heralds a new future for you and me to walk together, hand in hand... I love you, Commander, now and forever."

headtouch.line: Will you pet me like that every day from now on?

home.line: Commander, the sun is rising. Hehe, it's my gift just for you...

login.line: Now that you're here holding my hand... I'm not as scared anymore!

main1.line: It's okay, Commander... I'm not scared anymore. All I feel is happiness like I've never felt before!

main2.line: You think I look like an angel...? Th-then I'll protect you forever as your guardian angel!

main3.line: As your partner, I'll always do my best to become braver and stronger until I'm worthy of you... Then, I can hold my head high as I walk alongside you!

touch.line: Th-the swing is swinging... Commander, hold my hand tightly! I'll do my best to protect you!

touch2.line: Moving is a little scary right now... L-let's do that after I get down, okay?

unlock.line: Keep cool, Janus. Just smile... Today's the most important day of your life. I-it's just... Commander, I'm scared of heights...

battle.line: Look, a bunch of mooks. Let's have a go.

couple_encourage1.line: Hey, don't try to steal my EXP!

detail.line: What's up? You need my help? Teehee~ Make it worth my time, and maybe I'll give you a hand.

expedition.line: Commission complete~ Well, Commander? You just gonna leave those girls hanging?

feeling1.line: Wooow, you've already gone bananas? Lame. Guess I'll go do something more fun~

feeling2.line: Oohh, you're here to see me? I'm honoured, but it'll take a little more than that to get on this mean little hero's good side~

feeling3.line: Oohh, paying me another visit? Let me guess – you don't have any friends to talk to, so now you've come to me for help? Teehee~ You poor, poor little thing~

feeling4.line: Aww, you really have it rough, Commander~ Are you just being nice to us all? Do you have to keep an eye on me? Ooor... Teehee~ I know exactly what's on your mind right now♪

feeling5.line: Y'know, Commander, a little bullying never hurt anyone. 'Cause look, I'm mean to you aaall the time, and you've never fought back. Hey, wait a sec... Do you LIKE my bullying? If you seriously do, your sick, degenerate ass is beyond redemption~ Pfft, ahaha♪

headtouch.line: Oohh, so you manipulate naive girls with headpats! Sorry, doesn't work on me~

home.line: Back with a victory under your belt. I'm starting to kinda get why people like you, Sidekickommander~

hp_warning.line: Like hell the hero's gonna go down to a bunch of trash mobs!

login.line: Aww. Just a few more seconds and you would've been late. We were sooo close~

lose.line: Aww, we lost! You better reflect on your mistakes when we get back, Sidekickommander.

mail.line: The inbox is nearly overflowing. Should I bother telling the Commander~? Teehee♪

main1.line: This? I'm a hero, and every hero needs a sword~

main2.line: Nice office you've got here~ When it's just you and your secretary, you can do whatever you want to her and nobody'd know. Teehee♪

main3.line: Hardy's adorkable~ Especially when she acts like a girl scout when in reality she's craving cake. Me? I'm not bothered by that so I do as I like.

mission.line: Heeey, you wouldn't leave quests unfinished, would you?

mission_complete.line: Fiiinally you finished a quest. Here's your "world's biggest procrastinator" trophy~

profile.line: Oh yeah? You wanna hear about my history? Heheh, if you insist. I escorted a bunch of battleshiiips, I was in Operation Excess and stuuuff... Honestly, what I really wanted was to enjoy the October sunlight in the comfort of a port~♪

propose.line: Aww, you're already throwing in the towel~? Heheh, it's no surprise your sidekick ass loses to a hero like me. When someone's as sad, pathetic, and hopeless as you, the love a hero like me can give you is the most you'll get♪

touch.line: Woow, so you're into cutting boards, Commander? Good to know, heehee~♪

touch2.line: Aww, why'd you stop? I thought you were gonna "correct" me? Teehee♪

unlock.line: Sooo... Hey you, derpy-looking grown-up over there. You wouldn't happen to be my Commander, would you? Laaame, but oh well~ The name's Hero, Royal Navy destroyer. Try not to let me down, okay~?

upgrade.line: Wooow, I thought you'd forgotten to raise my level~

win_mvp.line: MVP? Pfft, I can do this with my eyes closed♪

gift_prefer.line: I guess I'll behave nicely for you today, seeing as you got me a gift!

detail_ex.line: Commaaaander, I wanna eat cake! Not any old cake, either. I only want that super limited-edition one you got for Hardy that other time~♪ If you do that for me, who knows, maybe I'll return the favor~?

home_ex.line: Not bad at all. I suppose even a Sidekickommander needs some time in the limelight~

login_ex.line: Wooow, does time just mean nothing to you? Ooor... are you just that desperate to see me~? Teehee~

main4_ex.line: Nobody's forcing you to be the people's hero. A sidekick like you just has to be MY personal hero. Or, y'know, being my loyal little puppy works just as fine.

main5_ex.line: Hm? Isn't it obvious I'M gonna be the star of the next exercise? Teehee~ Or what, are you gonna try to correct me on that?

main6_ex.line: Oh yeah, aren't you a master of uncanny smiles? I wanna give Hans a little fright the next time we meet♪

touch_ex.line: Nobody's stopping you if you wanna be a bully. Teehee~

touch2_ex.line: Naughty girls who bully people need to be corrected mercilessly~ Am I right, Sidekickommander? Teehee♪

win_mvp_ex.line: Everyone knows the hero is the star of the show! Those nobodies never even stood a chance♪

expedition.line: The school festival supplies have arrived. You gonna help with those? I'll be there... in spirit♪

home.line: Wooow, your classes are over? Don't you wanna go out and play with your classmates?

login.line: Yesterday's subjects sure were tricky~ You done your homework yet, Commander? Need to copy mine? I'll let you, for a cost♪

main1.line: The school festival? Right, that's in a few weeks... Oh, you trying to find a partner to look around with? Teehee~ Bullseye, huh?

main2.line: School is sooo lame... You wanna swap notes with me next lesson? The teacher doesn't give a damn.

main3.line: You forgot your compasses? Aww, what a stupid but lovable Sidekickommander~ I guess it's time to be the hero who saves your day♪

touch.line: Lemme guess – praying for a peek at my undies? Teehee♪

touch2.line: Hang in there, Commander – school's not out just yet~ Teehee♡

unlock.line: Morning, Commander. Looks like our desks are right next to each other~ Whee~☆ Hmm? What's up? Is there something on my skirt? Teehee~♪

battle.line: Let the cleaning begin!

detail.line: Welcome to my little corner of the port! Whether something's bothering you or you just want to chat, my ears are always open. Your secrets are as safe as can be with this Royal Maid!

expedition.line: Oh, look at that, the commission team is back. You'd better go out and greet them.

feeling1.line: ...Keep this up, and I'm gonna have to clean YOU, Commander! That means purifying you from inside out, starting with your heart!

feeling2.line: *sigh*... You know, I just feel like I've not been particularly helpful to you, Commander. I've got a lot to learn from my maidly friends. But what's your take, Commander? What should I do to improve at my job?

feeling3.line: My friends are going to host a maid gathering to help deepen my understanding of a modern maid's duties, and I'm feeling kind of anxious... "Steer clear of any weird indoctrination"? Uh, I see...

feeling4.line: So, I went to the maid gathering... Good god! Commander, are modern maids all like that? ...Like who? Like Sirius and her ilk! Don't tell me I'M the one who's out of touch here!

feeling5.line: Ahh... Wait! C-Commander! You need to know that I'm a very normal and traditional girl! I'll only have... you know... with someone I love, and... G-god, what am I even saying?! *blushes*

headtouch.line: Oookay... Is this that "reward" people keep telling me about?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. What will it be? A massage, perhaps?

hp_warning.line: Eeeeek! There's so much dirt!

login.line: Good morning, Commander! I've finished sweeping your office! Have a productive day!

lose.line: Ugh, dammit... My pride as a Royal Maid has been tarnished...

mail.line: Commander, you have a new letter! I brought it straight to you!

main1.line: Commander, do you need any help? It doesn't have to be strictly housework-related. I can file paperwork, too. Probably.

main2.line: Maids these days are a lot different to my idea of what a maid should be. Like how many of them are so strangely... "service"-oriented. Yeah...

main3.line: Ding-dong! It's cleaning time! That means you need to leave the office! A battle between me and dust is about to unfold!

main4.line: I heard this is what the maid of the modern age wears, but isn't it kind of... Oh, wait. It must be another one of those trends...

mission.line: You've got a new list of targets to clean up. Get out there and deal with them!

mission_complete.line: Cleaning complete! Don't dally, go confirm your rewards!

profile.line: Nubian of the Tribal class extends you a greeting! Heheh, I'm not just a fully-fledged Royal Maid, I'm also a decorated and famous warship. When you need somebody to clean the seas, come straight to me!

propose.line: You're giving this... to me? O-okay, so you feel like this was the time to do it... Heheh, heheheh... In truth, I've had feelings for you for the longest... Ahem! What I meant to say is – I vow to be with you, now and forever!

touch.line: What's on your mind, Commander? ...Do "the thing"? What do you mean? I don't know what this "thing" even is...

touch2.line: Um, okay...? What the heck are you doing?!

unlock.line: I'm Nubian, and I'm good at housekeeping! Do you need my cleaning services, Commander? Uh, why do you look like you're about to cry? ...Normal maids like me are a rare gift? Uh, okay...

upgrade.line: Heheh! My cleaning skills have improved!

win_mvp.line: That's the cleaning done! Feels fresh!

gift_prefer.line: I really like this! Thanks, Commander!

feeling5_ex.line: Fooound you♡ Hooah! How's that? Did that hug cheer you up? If you need more, I can... What? It's fine to just act like myself? Wow. I really can't wrap my head around your tastes...

headtouch_ex.line: Heheh... Hehehehe... ♪

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! Heehee, what'll it be? Ear-cleaning? A lap pillow? Or maybe... you just want a nice and simple hug? Heehee!

login_ex.line: Morning, Commander! I'm ready to "serve" you now! What should we start with?

main5_ex.line: How'd you like me to serve you, Commander? I'll do anything you want, heehee. I've mastered all the in things with maids these days!

main6_ex.line: Heheh! Dido and a few others taught me all the basics of being a modern maid! What do you say – wanna try my special services package?

main7_ex.line: Ding-dong! It's cleaning time! Heh, if there's one thing I haven't forgotten, it's this! Now put on a mask and let's get your office looking sparkling clean!

main8_ex.line: Commander, how'd you feel if I wore a slightly shorter skirt? ...Huh? You like the way it is now? Really?

touch_ex.line: Huh? I mean... What'll it be first? Dinner? A bath? Or maybe... H-hey, why won't you let me finish?!

touch2_ex.line: Mmh♡ I'll let you have your way with me.

detail.line: Welcome to my brewing hut! If you want something, just let me know! I'm a fully-fledged potion maker and can concoct almost anything!

feeling5.line: Heheheh, is there a potion you want to make, Commander? I can make an elixir, a potion of happiness, anything you want. And of course, I'd be happy to join your party. Being with you is the best thing of all!

home.line: Heheh, I knew you'd become a regular here. So, what fascinating ingredients have you brought me this time?

login.line: Welcome to my brewing hut, Commander! I can make any potion you can think of as long as you have the right ingredients!

main1.line: Heheh, what potion do you want? Come on, don't be shy. I can even make a love potion if that's what you want.

main2.line: Heheh, you'd be surprised to know I did my research before choosing to become a potion maker. Pretty good foresight on my part, right?

main3.line: Why won't I call you "Hero"? Well... I'm not used to saying it yet, I guess. "Commander" feels much more natural!

main4.line: Come to think of it, maids and potion makers have some things in common... Huh? Wait, doesn't that make witch is the most popular profession among modern maids?

skill.line: Have a taste of this confusion potion!

touch.line: Uh-oh... No, no, no! It's gonna overflow!

touch2.line: Uh, what...? You're doing this NOW?!

unlock.line: I'm Nubian, the master concocter of magic potions! What kind of potion do you want, Commander? ...Huh? It's been so long since you visited a normal potion maker who brews using a cauldron so you don't know what to order? ...Come again?

detail.line: How would a modern maid get herself out of a sticky situation like this... Ask someone like Devonshire? Not a chance! If I asked, they'd know I'm behind the times!

feeling5.line: I can make chocolate just fine! It's simply making Valentine's chocolate like a modern maid that I failed at. When I make yours, I will NOT fail, no way! Not only does my pride as a Royal Maid hinge on it, but my love for you does, too!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. If you need a Royal Maid's service, just ask for anything other than chocolate. Teehee!

login.line: Sorry for the oopsie-woopsie in the kitchen! ...Okay, okay! I'll start cleaning up, so quit laughing!

main1.line: There's nothing to worry about, I can clean this up in a jiffy, just you watch! Believe it or not, housekeeping is my forte!

main2.line: Maids these days don't wear anything beneath their aprons? There's NO way that's true! Seriously? Some actually dress like that?!

main3.line: If at first you don't succeed, you try and try and try again! I wouldn't cut it as a traditional Royal Maid if I wasn't determined!

main4.line: Sorry, Commander, I made a big oopsie! ...H-how was that? Do I sound like a clumsy maid? I'm not cut out for this, am I?

touch.line: Are you TRYING to make the kitchen messier than it already is?!

touch2.line: Nooooo! Touching is fine, just don't lick me! ...Huh? That's NOT what you were doing?

unlock.line: Uh, teehee! I was trying to make chocolate, then I slipped for some reason! ...Hang on a minute! How did I slip? Even a modern clumsy maid wouldn't blunder like that... Would she?!

win_mvp.line: My chocolate-making was a bust, but this was a brilliant success!

battle.line: For the glory of the Royal Navy!

couple_encourage1.line: A party...? (Should I refuse, or...)

couple_encourage2.line: For the glory of the Royal Navy!

detail.line: I've drawn up some exercise plans for this week. Here is the first, here is the second, and here is a backup I made in case of inclement weather. And these... would be my personal notes. Don't pay them any mind.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned, Commander. Allow me to check the goods with you.

feeling1.line: Commander, are you also this rash on the battlefield?

feeling2.line: Ahem. Commander, requesting permission to join the next mission. (Phew... There have been a lot of parties lately, it would be rude to refuse directly, I'll use combat as an excuse...)

feeling3.line: (This is how the Commander processes documents. Better remember that...) Oh, me? No, I wasn't spacing out. I was just thinking about our next battle plan.

feeling4.line: C-Commander, I put the wrong document in here... Don't look at it, please... No, it's not a battle plan. It's my personal notes... (Goodness, how could I have forgotten my Commander research notes in there?!)

feeling5.line: I always feel uncomfortable in lively social situations. I tend to overthink things because I don't want to disappoint people, and then I end up not talking at all. *sigh*... This is the first time I've told anyone about this. I'm sorry you had to hear that embarrassing speech, but I had a feeling that the Commander I know wouldn't tease me...

headtouch.line: Ah. Mm... (Maybe I am too cold... Oh! The Commander pulled away...)

home.line: Commander, I made coffee. If you'd like some, feel free. (People are so good at this in movies. Why am I too awkward to do it?)

hp_warning.line: Things have changed. So must our plan.

login.line: Today's work plans, Commander. Documents to be processed are over there. If you have no questions, let's begin.

lose.line: Commander, execute plan B!

mail.line: I brought your mail.

main1.line: Are you holding a party in your office? Then I'll take my leave and go on patrol. (This is an opportunity to get to know the others, but a party's too much. I should just go on patrol...)

main2.line: About today's meeting... (I actually wanted to talk about something else, but it's safer to talk about work...) Huh? You'd prefer to talk about something non-work-related?

main3.line: Here's the latest combat report. Nothing is out of the ordinary, but feel free to take a look.

main4.line: ...Yes, I am the one who cleaned your desk. But you don't need to thank me; it was no big deal.

mission.line: Ah... Commander, here is your new mission list. Please take a look. (Our fingers just touched...)

mission_complete.line: Well done, Commander. Your mission rewards are right this way.

profile.line: My name is Trafalgar, Battle-class destroyer with the Royal Navy. Please leave strategic and operational work to me. ...That's my whole self-introduction.

propose.line: Okay... I want to explain my feelings with actions rather than words. From now on, I'll be ever by your side, protecting you with this very sword.

skill.line: Engrave this moment upon the sea's memory!

touch.line: My collar's wrinkled? Oh. Thank you.

touch2.line: Huh?! Wh-what are you... (How am I supposed to react at a time like this?!)

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander. I'm Trafalgar, a member of the Royal Navy. It's an honour. (Was that too cold? I didn't want to talk too much and sound rude...)

upgrade.line: Just you watch over my growth, Commander. (Did I sound too smug there?)

win_mvp.line: The glory of the Royal Navy shall never fade!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you so much! (Was I a little too excited...?)

detail_ex.line: I finished the plan for our, umm... date tomorrow. Please give it a good review. I made contingency plans for various emergencies, as well.

feeling5_ex.line: (The last method of attraction I tried didn't work too well... It must be because the Commander is so one-of-a-kind.) Oh, Commander... I'm not spacing out. I was just... thinking about you...

headtouch_ex.line: Mm, mmnh... Oh. I don't have a weird look on my face... do I?

home_ex.line: I made sweets... Would you like some? (Page 7, line 5 of my notes... I made exactly what it says the Commander likes. This should be perfect...)

login_ex.line: Before we start today's work, I want to say, umm... I missed you a lot. (I finally said it... The Commander looks happy, too!)

main5_ex.line: If everyone's coming to the party, then maybe I should give up my space... You want me to stay? But I'm not good at this stuff. It is okay if I just stay by your side?

main6_ex.line: Phew... The weather is lovely... D-do you mind me talking about it?

main7_ex.line: Commander, I organized the materials you requested. You look tired... Might I suggest a break first?
