main3.line: This necklaces suits me well...? Thank you for praising this unworthy maid, my honourable Master.

touch.line: Oh, my Master who has intoxicated me with passions so, it is an honour to have been chosen as your dance partner.

unlock.line: My dear, I changed into the new outfit as per your request. I would be most grateful were you to offer me words of praise, Master.

detail.line: Worry not, for I have come prepared for every occasion. Food, drinks, magazines, sunscreen, contingency combat armaments, life-saving equipment, and... a cat? Why are you here? ...Oh, umm, I was just talking to myself!

login.line: No matter where we are, I shall do my utmost to keep you safe. My honourable Master, simply enjoy yourself, however you please.

main1.line: My honourable Master, why are you staring at me so intently? Did this humble maid err somewhere?! ...I'm overthinking things...?

main2.line: Swimming? If... if you wouldn't mind teaching me... Um, sorry, a lowly maid has no right to request your valuable time...

main3.line: My honourable Master, are you tired? Something to rest on...? ...Um, if you wouldn't mind, then... feel free to use my body...!

touch.line: My honourable Master, allow me to protect you from the sun.

touch2.line: Understood. If you would like to see me in a bikini, then... Is, is that so? I'm terribly sorry... I prematurely jumped to conclusions yet again.

unlock.line: I've received ample advice from my colleagues in the Maid Team regarding swimwear etiquette. My honourable Master, are you pleased with my appearance?

detail.line: I made some Dragon Empery dishes, however they turned out quite... Pl-Please, do not be concerned! *This* year, I vow to make delectable food that shall suit the honourable Master's palate!

home.line: My outfit is unsafe to wear in windy weather? Are you concerned with my wellbeing and would not want me catching a cold? Oh, honourable Master, your thoughtfulness humbles me!

login.line: Happy Lunar New Year, honourable Master. I have made a cup of tea for you.

main1.line: My honourable Master, if you'll forgive my asking, have you eaten any unusually shaped, unstuffed gyoza? ...P-Pardon me, I was merely wondering...

main2.line: This naughty maid is deeply obliged to have the privilege of spending the holidays with her honourable Master.

touch.line: My perceptive Master, would there happen to be dust clinging to my dress...?

touch2.line: If you wish me to service you in these Dragon Empery garments, then... Oh, my apologies! I've made yet another careless assumption...

unlock.line: I have heard it is part of a maid's duties to dress to her honourable Master's liking over the holidays. Would this outfit happen to... satisfy the honourable Master's wishes?

battle.line: For my honourable Master!

detail.line: When I'm going through this hoop, it's easy for my ribbons to get tangled... Ah! Hm? You've been staring at me, honourable Master. Could it be...? If you happen to like seeing me like this...!

expedition.line: The commission list... Oh, I'm sorry, it was on the floor! I'll pick it up right now!

feeling5.line: Even this clumsy maid has managed to earn your love and find true happiness... It's all thanks to your mercy, honourable Master. In return, I give you all of me...

headtouch.line: Have you taken a liking to my bunny ears, my honourable Master?

home.line: Aah, my ribbon's tangled... honourable Master, umm, I must apologize for not being able to properly greet you... Please punish your stupid, clumsy maid!

login.line: Welcome back, honourable Master. I've put many hours into this dance, and now, I hope it will soothe your fatigue!

mail.line: Giving you mail while I'm in this state... Oh, don't worry! For you, honourable Master, I'll do it right!

main1.line: You are the only reason this clumsy maid can shine, my honourable Master. Because you've never left my side...

main2.line: I wanted to help make dinner, but I wonder if I'd only get in everyone's way, so...

main3.line: I made this outfit especially for you to see. Yes, I want to do everything I can to make your stay in this park as fun as possible!

touch.line: Your warmth... I swear, I'll engrave it deep into my heart. Touch me more, my honourable Master!

touch2.line: Even now... I'm ready, my honourable Master! Oh? That's not why you were touching me...?

unlock.line: To you, Honourable Master, I dedicate this dance of paradise. It is something I have spent a great deal of time practicing... I do hope that it is to your liking.

battle.line: May my unblemished heart cut open a path for you, my honourable Master!

feeling5.line: My honourable Master, please accept all that the name Sirius represents, be it past, present, or future... My name, all that I am, and all that I stand for are forever yours... That is my one true wish.

headtouch.line: M-my dear Master... My veil isn't dishevelled, is it? Whenever I feel your touch, I feel nothing but bliss...

home.line: Welcome back, my honourable Master. I've prepared tea and sweets... No, pardon me. Those aren't appropriate in such a time... But knowing I'm always doing something for you puts me at ease.

login.line: Today is a most special day... Ah, welcome back, my one and only Master. I am prepared for this special occasion, in both heart and body.

main1.line: I've practised my vows so many times over in my heart, but when the time comes to speak them... my voice trembles. I must train and discipline myself, so that I may convey my feelings to you no matter how wildly my heart races.

main2.line: The Head Maid said that today, I stand not as a maid, but as a bride. But what does acting like a bride mean? Serving you is all I know and all I want...

main3.line: Keep your back straight, your smile natural. Today is the most important day of your life, so you must act accordingly... Ah, m-my dear Master?! How long have you been there? I was so lost in thought, pardon me for not noticing you...

touch.line: Your hands are so warm, my Master... Their touch stills my racing heart. Thank you, my honourable Master.

touch2.line: M-Master, I... I fully understand what your touch means...!

unlock.line: Well met, my honourable Master. This dress represents all of my emotions. I am making my final preparations for the ceremony... Uhm, Master, do you... appreciate the way I look?

battle.line: All ships, forward...! Form up on me!

couple_encourage1.line: Right! Here I go... swiftly!

detail.line: Um, sorry I made such a mess... Sheffield tried to teach me how to clean, but I'm a lot worse at it than I expected... Ahaha...

expedition.line: Commander, the commission is nearly complete. If you head out now, you should be able to meet them as they return.

feeling1.line: Someone like me deserves a Commander like this...

feeling2.line: Commander, do you have something for me? I can handle anything... Oh, but only if you're okay with me...

feeling3.line: Fiji is always telling me to smile more. Is she right? Oh... Sorry, I must be boring you with this...

feeling4.line: The Commander told me to help Jamaica fix up her bike. Hehehe, it turned out to be a lot more fun than I thought... Oh, Commander, sorry... about that... just now...

feeling5.line: I think I'd probably be better off being all cool like Sheffield than trying to smile all the time like Fiji... Right? If I every so often let slip a smile that could catch the Commander's eye... Oh, um, forget everything I said just now!

home.line: Excellent work. I've prepared a report for you. Take a moment to look it over.

hp_warning.line: I have to get the others to safety, at least...!

login.line: Good morning. Here is your work for the day... *Sigh*...

lose.line: Sorry. If only I had tried harder...

mail.line: Commander, you have new mail. Oh, I've been checking about once per hour. So I don't think I've... no, I haven't missed any.

main1.line: Commander, let's work as hard as we ever do, eh?

main2.line: Commander, do you think a Lady of the Royal Navy should be more elegant? Not like the maids, I mean Fiji and Jamaica... They stand out quite a bit... is that alright?

main3.line: I envy the Knight Commander. If only I could comport myself so... Sorry about that. Forget I said anything.

mission.line: Commander, I've finished sorting out these tasks. Do look them over.

mission_complete.line: Commander, I've finished tallying up the mission rewards. Do look them over.

profile.line: I am Swiftsure, of the Royal Navy. I joined towards the end of the war, but with it winding down and fate taking some odd twists and turns, I wasn't able to perform as expected. If it pleases you, I will serve the fleet with everything I have. Oh, but if it doesn't, you need not worry about me...

propose.line: I'm really sorry about all this. Are you honestly okay with someone like me...? The way I am...? Umm, if you're alright with me, then I'll gladly be your partner! Commander, thank you so much!

skill.line: Get the timing right... I should be able to do this!

touch.line: As your secretary ship, I am responsibile for everything in all of the reports.

touch2.line: Commander, um... I think fleet regulations call this kind of thing "inappropriate..."

unlock.line: I am Swiftsure, a light cruiser of the Royal Navy... If it is not too much for one such as myself to ask, I would like to support your fleet in whatever way I can.

upgrade.line: Swiftsure, swiftly and surely, everyone is counting on you...!

win_mvp.line: Um, I... really tried...

gift_prefer.line: My apologies... Did I do something worthy of this reward?

detail.line: Unicorn, this is how you do this problem... Oh sorry, Commander, I'm currently helping the others study. Please make yourself feel at home.

login.line: Good morning. Here is the outline for today's course. Please make sure to review it.

mail.line: Commander, you have new mail. I've instructed the Manjuus to help fetch the mail for me even when I can't do it myself, so worry not.

main1.line: Fiji, don't you know that studying is good for you? Come on, Commander, care to back me up on this one?

main2.line: While I have served as a flagship before, that has nothing to do with what's going on now. I have to be humble and learn from everyone.

main3.line: I often see Edinburgh in the library. She's always grumbling about what's going on in the maid team or something...

touch.line: I look cute when wearing glasses...? Err... Um, that wasn't my intention...

touch2.line: Commander, I d-don't think you should be doing this at school... Ahh!

unlock.line: Commander, why are you here...? Me? Yes, as you can see, I'm still studying... I figured that acquiring knowledge would be the best way to make up for my lack of experience on the actual battlefield.

detail.line: Hmm, what should we do next? Why don't we see if there's anyone who needs help...? Just sitting here idly somehow doesn't feel quite right...

home.line: I just made a snowman with the others... Huh? Did you want to see it, Commander? Um, in that case... Oh, right! That snowman already got knocked down and remade into something else! You shouldn't look at the one I made...

login.line: Happy Lunar New Year, Commander. Why don't you set aside your work today and take some time off?

main1.line: Um, are you redecorating the office? Do you need me to help?

main2.line: I got some red envelopes as gifts from my seniors in the fleet. Ahaha... I'm not sure how I feel about this...

main3.line: Commander, the more free time everyone else has, the less free time you seem to― Um, oh my...

touch.line: If you're cold, p-please... feel free to use my shawl.

touch2.line: C-Commander... What if someone sees us...?!

unlock.line: I agreed to try on this outfit, but... I know these fancy outfits don't suit me... H-huh, I look gorgeous?! ...Thank you very much. Even if you're just trying to make me feel better, I appreciate it...

battle.line: Take a deep breath, Swiftsure... Everyone, please commence attack on the enemy!

detail.line: So I need to put this headband on... I wonder what kind of hairstyle would be good? Um, let's tie my hair up like this... Actually, maybe twintails would be better instead?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. If... If you'd like, please enjoy this refreshing beverage...

login.line: Commander, what will your first order be?

mail.line: Commander, there's new mail for you. I apologize, but I didn't have the time to check its contents beforehand. If it's alright with you, I'd like to check the contents with you, right now...!

main1.line: Commander, is something wrong? ...Is this outfit really too stimulating, like Sheffield said it was...? Or... is it actually too conservative, like Fiji said it was...?

main2.line: Everyone acts much more freely when they're at the beach. Do you think I should do the same? A-Alright, I'll give it a try... Y-Yo!

main3.line: When I'm helping Neptune, I feel like a completely different person. ...Oh. What would you like to have, Commander?

touch.line: Um... This outfit really is quite embarrassing...

touch2.line: ...Eek! C-Commander...!

unlock.line: W-welcome! ...Ugh, I'm still way too nervous... Ah, um! H-how may I serve you today, Commander...?

battle.line: Show them neither mercy nor pity...

couple_encourage1.line: Once more, altogether then.

detail.line: I am the Longbow of Crécy, and the Shield of the Realm... By your will, I am at your disposal.

expedition.line: Ah! Commander, I think the commission team is back.

feeling1.line: Commander, are you my... enemy?

feeling2.line: Commander, do you have something for me? I'm sure I can handle it.

feeling3.line: Commander, why are you laughing? Did something funny happen? Won't you please tell me too?

feeling4.line: You like sweet girls, do you, Commander? Well... hrrmm... What if I were to hug you like this? Would that make me seem sweeter?

feeling5.line: I'm very important to you, am I, Commander? ... Now what am I supposed to do with that? Treat you even sweeter than I do now?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Did you have a good fight?

hp_warning.line: Do I carry on? Or do I retreat?

login.line: Commander, back again same time as always, eh?

lose.line: I failed... No, it can't be...

mail.line: Mail call? I wonder what it is? Could it be your dismissal?

main1.line: A Maid? Me? Certainly not... But I do know how to make some simple dishes, and I suppose I could bring you some tea.

main2.line: I can see the water from here. Commander, do you like the ocean?

main3.line: Commander, are you daydreaming? What say... I join you and we daydream together?

mission.line: Dereliction of duty is grounds for court-martial... Maybe you should see to those missions?

mission_complete.line: I sorted through the mission rewards, but I'm not sure I did it right...

profile.line: I am a modified Dido-class... rather was it Bellona-class? ... Right then, you could say I'm quite well-travelled. Will you be sending me all over the world too?

propose.line: The way you treasure me gives me such warmth and solace... This is what true happiness is, isn't it? Commander, please, I beg you, let us share in even more happiness...

touch.line: Commander? Something about my body caught your attention, did it?

touch2.line: Commander, does that feel nice to... touch?

unlock.line: Err, you're... the Commander, yes? You don't know who I am? Ah, right, I've yet to introduce myself... I'm Black Prince of the Royal Navy... Will that suffice?

upgrade.line: Commander, have I really grown stronger?

win_mvp.line: They're a fleet of smouldering hulks... Not a single one left afloat.

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me? Thank you. I really like it!

battle.line: You dare disturb the Commander's vacation? You won't get away with that.

detail.line: Oh, is it that time already? I've prepared a few simple dishes. Commander, shall we invite the others to join us?

home.line: What's wrong, Commander? Are you still preoccupied with work?

login.line: I didn't think this swimsuit stood out, so I was surprised when you still found me right away...

mail.line: It's the mail? Don't tell me our vacation is over already...

main1.line: The sea is a tempestuous battlefield, and yet the beach is a relaxing Eden. What an incredible duality.

main2.line: Beach volleyball? I've heard it's quite fun. Do you think I could give it a try?

main3.line: The sand is so soft, so fine. It feels so pleasant between my toes...

touch.line: Are you tired, Commander?

touch2.line: Commander, the others are still here.

unlock.line: Sorry to keep you waiting, Commander. Thank you very much for taking me on vacation. Standing in front of you like this... is a little embarrassing... Nevertheless, what do you think of... my swimsuit?

detail.line: Too much sitting wears out one's legs. Stretching out like this... Aahhh, yes, that's much better.

home.line: The kitchen sure seems busy. What's going on... in there?

login.line: Commander, welcome home. Ooh, I just realized. I should probably be saying "Happy Lunar New Year," shouldn't I?

mail.line: Mail call... Must be some festival greetings? You're quite popular, Commander.

main1.line: Commander... Do you enjoy such nostalgic music?

main2.line: Hah... How should I spend this holiday? I think listening to music like this is quite nice... Aahh...

main3.line: It's a holiday. No need to move, no need to fight... Now why not make every day a holiday?

touch.line: Mmm... why not stretch out with me, Commander?

touch2.line: Is this... a festival custom?

unlock.line: A "qipao," is it? So this legendary dress from the Dragon Empery... Putting it on and enjoying some nostalgic music, makes me... Ahhh... Commander, might we relax like this a bit longer...?

battle.line: Disappear, like a fleeting bubble...!

detail.line: Um, sorry I got champagne all over you. I really feel bad about it... Next time, I'll be more careful.

feeling5.line: The way to treat those important to you... is to cherish them, and share all your joys and sorrows with them, right? Mm, I'm glad to be sharing all my joy with you right now.

home.line: Another victory? Mm, then another bottle is in order... Huh, what do you mean I don't need to pop so many?

login.line: Commander... Would you like some champagne? Don't worry, I know how much strength to put into it this time.

mail.line: Mail? Is it... a party invite? We're already at the party though...

main1.line: Dido and Sirius seem to be busy with something... Should I go help out too?

main2.line: If every day was a party and there was no fighting to be seen... that would be a pretty nice world.

main3.line: You're not supposed to shake the champagne bottle if you're trying to drink from it normally, huh... I see...

mission.line: What do you think the punishment for forgetting about your missions should be... One glass, or one bottle?

touch.line: Want another glass? Mm, coming right up~

touch2.line: Commander, are you drunk? What's the matter? Your hand's all hot.

unlock.line: You can't have a party without champagne, right? Now, if I remember right, you're meant to give it a good shake before popping the cork... Oh no! Look out, Commander!

win_mvp.line: Shall I uncork a bottle to celebrate the victory?

detail.line: Um, want to talk about something? Uh... I'm not exactly a great conversation starter, but... Huh, just go with the flow?

home.line: Commander, why don't you put your head down on the counter and take a nap?

login.line: I had Hermione prepare some hot tea beforehand. Feel free to have some if you're feeling worn out.

main1.line: You'd like me to mix a drink? ...I'm not sure I can do that... but I can serve pre-made stuff...

main2.line: You're not the only one who comes to unwind. Sometimes other shipgirls stop by, and if memory serves me properly, there are some real heavyweights who can down an entire mug like it's nothing...

main3.line: What's it like... to get sloshed? Do your eyes get all spinny? ...It's like, you're in a waking dream...?

touch.line: Want something to drink, Commander? I can only do the pre-made stuff though...

touch2.line: Are you sloshed? Maybe you should get in touch with Dido and the others...?

unlock.line: Oh... Welcome, Commander. Can I take your order...? Or maybe, you just wanted to kick back and relax? ...Either way is fine with me.

detail.line: No matter how much time passes, I won't forget the warmth you gave me – the warmth known as joy.

feeling5.line: While I don't know what's next for us yet, I know I'll keep this warmth from you close to my chest. And also... I know I'm going to make you very happy.

headtouch.line: This feels... so nice.

home.line: Here is a victory song I dedicate to you. Oh, so you noticed I'm not actually performing... I can't play the piano, so... yeah.

login.line: You're here, Commander. Mhm. I was waiting here the whole time.

main1.line: Are we going to hold the ceremony in a place as lovely as this? This is a hugely important day, so I want to be ready... Yeah, that's it... *blushes*

main2.line: Oh, my heel came loose... Hm? You'll put it back on for me? Well, um, the ribbon on my back is a little loose, too... Could you take care of that also?

main3.line: I've been getting a lot of help from you today... Hm? You feel like that's brought us closer? Yes, true... Ah, my cheeks feel so warm suddenly...

mission.line: Looks like... you still have missions to do. Shall we do them together?

mission_complete.line: I'll go inspect the rewards... Hm? You'll come with me? Sure thing.

touch.line: What do you say when making an oath? I can't think of anything... Commander, what kind of oath would you like?

touch2.line: Let me... warm you.

unlock.line: Commander, today's the day we make our vows, so could you make me do something for you? It'll make me feel warm, and... I want to feel that warmth a lot, lot more.

win_mvp.line: All the enemies have been eliminated. Don't worry, I didn't let a single speck of dirt ruin my dress.

battle.line: I will "clean up" the pests that seek to disrupt this concert.

couple_encourage1.line: Let's try to muster up a semblance of teamwork.

detail.line: Call you Producer? No thank you, Master works just fine for me. Or... would you prefer to be called a "pest?"

expedition.line: Do I need to pre-record a gunshot to remind you? ...A commission fleet has returned.

feeling1.line: To prevent harm from befalling the other members, I shall first eliminate you.

feeling2.line: I've had to suspend maid duties due to my idol unit activities. I will make up for lost time after this is done.

feeling3.line: I'm playing very well? Master, you are able to follow in my footsteps as well... as long as you dedicate yourself to practicing every day.

feeling4.line: I used to think that doing maid work would make other jobs seem trivial in comparison, but reality certainly had a very different message for me... If you dare tell anyone else about what I just said to you, I'll have to sew your lips together... Just kidding, don't take it that seriously.

feeling5.line: The girl who you like is not the maid or the shining star, but "Sheffield?" ...A stale confession, but thank you. I'll remember that.

home.line: Ah, Master, welcome back~ You heard a weird voice, you say? It must've been your imagination.

hp_warning.line: I still have a contingency plan.

login.line: I finished cleaning up the office before I have to head off for lessons. I'd appreciate it if you don't mess it up while I'm gone.

lose.line: This failure was due to my incompetence. Sincerest apologies.

mail.line: There's new mail. I'll make sure to respond to the fanmail.

main1.line: I heard that there are some folks out there who get aroused from being abused by their favorite idol... I'll never understand.

main2.line: Defeating enemies with song? Utterly unrealistic, but might make for an interesting school project.

main3.line: To be honest, I'm a bit jealous of Belfast. Her talents are boundless, beyond just being a maid.

mission.line: A new offer? I shall prepare myself then.

mission_complete.line: So these are the royalties? I'm sure the other members will be pleased.

profile.line: Town-class light cruiser, Sheffield. I am currently serving as an idol at Her Majesty's request. Do you have a problem with that?

propose.line: No matter what I am, I will always love you with all my heart and soul, my Master. ...I wasn't being facetious. Really.

skill.line: May my song bring you eternal rest...

touch.line: I may not have my gun with me, but you would still be wise to mind your conduct.

touch2.line: Surely you're aware of the consequences for doing such things to an idol?

unlock.line: I am Sheffield, from the Royal Maids. I will explain how this transpired to you, so please stop looking like the world has turned upside down.

upgrade.line: I shall commit myself fully regardless of the workplace.

win_mvp.line: The concert went well.

gift_prefer.line: How fascinating, I thought it inconceivable that Master would give me something like this.

battle.line: Flagship... is it? I, I can do this!

couple_encourage1.line: For the glory of the Royal Navy! Commence the attack!

couple_encourage2.line: Ever thought about rejoining the Maids?

detail.line: Never thought the story would turn out like this! Cannot wait for next week's issue... Huh?! M-Master! Ahem! How may I help you?

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. Please remember to welcome them back.

feeling1.line: Would you please be so kind as to maintain a distance of at least three metres from my person so that I may properly carry out my duties as a maid, "Master?"

feeling2.line: You should rest if you're feeling tired... Th-think about those of us working for you.

feeling3.line: Master, I've brought you a change of fresh white linens... You'd prefer green, like the color of my eyes? I, I see...

feeling4.line: You'd like to see me in my casual attire? D-didn't you say I'd look cute in anything? I'll leave it to your imagination then~

feeling5.line: I made your bed, warmed your sheets, and ye ended up working all night anyway... Oh no, I'm not mad in the slightest. Hard work is to be praised, after all~

home.line: That'll do. Take a rest now.

hp_warning.line: tha...that's it?

login.line: Welcome back, Master. I've prepared tea.

lose.line: Have to think on that one... Don't wanna lose again.

mail.line: Looks like we got new mail. I'll grab it.

main1.line: Newcastle, ye ask? She's like a big sister and that's all I have to say to you... nothing else!

main2.line: Sheffy's got a sharp tongue, but really she's a sweet lassie.

main3.line: You wouldn't happen to like manga or...? N-never mind. Forget I asked.

mission.line: A new mission is here. Please check it soon.

mission_complete.line: The rewards are here. I'll put 'em away for ye.

profile.line: I'm Glasgow, Southampton-class light cruiser of the Royal Navy. I fought in the Norwegian Campaign, escorted our ships through the Arctic, and participated in various other operations... B- but my eyes aren't that great. I oughta apologise to Imogen...

propose.line: And so I thank God for bestowing upon me the gift of our meeting... And we're done, eh? Time to go home...? Huh? S-seal the vow with a k-kiss?! B-but... I...!

touch.line: You have something for me?

touch2.line: Ah?! I-I must be going...!

unlock.line: I'm Glasgow, light cruiser part of the Southampton subclass of the Town class. I am honoured to be part of your fleet, Commander. I am at your service.

upgrade.line: Aye. I shall redouble my efforts.

win_mvp.line: Phew... That'd be enough for ye now, eh?

gift_prefer.line: *gasp*! Commander... I, I don't know what to say...

detail.line: Enterprise? I know her. We fought together at the Bay of Biscay, eh? Huh? There's another Enterprise...? I-I knew that!

expedition.line: Commission team's back. I'll go get 'em.

login.line: Good to see you back. I've only just got home from school meself. Oh... erm... the tea... just a moment.

main1.line: What's for lunch? How's this lunchbox here sound to ye? Just a little something I made meself...

main2.line: That Z23 from the Iron Blood's got a talent for teaching. Teacher or no. Not that I need the help.

main3.line: Borrowed this one from Ranger. Gotta finish it soon. It's the sequel to a story I've been waiting for.

touch.line: Ye want ta watch me doing my club work? Um, well, ye could say I'm in the "Go Home Club..."

unlock.line: Y-ye said ye wanted ta see me wear something different, so... But this is not "cosplay" or somesuch! I do actually go to school...! D-do ye like it?

battle.line: The enemy's been detected~

couple_encourage1.line: Dido, it's not good to worry so much

couple_encourage2.line: Miss Belfast, please allow me to watch and learn!

detail.line: I really admire the head of the Royal Maid, Miss Belfast... She can do anything and has a strong will to boot... I hope I can become like her one day.

expedition.line: Commander, let's put our work on hold and go to greet the team that's just returned from commissions.

feeling1.line: Commander, why are you so stubborn...

feeling2.line: Doesn't Dido worry a bit... too much? She works so hard, and I know you don't hate her, but... please, watch over her some more, Commander.

feeling3.line: Commander, are you working overtime today? Then I'll bring over some coffee. ...Um, it's not a bother, you know? After all, being by your side no matter what is a Royal Maid's duty.

feeling4.line: Commander, if it doesn't bother you, would you mind leaving your laundry to me? Washing our clothes together saves time, but more than that, I want you to personally feel how great your clothes feel after being hand-washed by the Royal Maids♪

feeling5.line: Whew... I've finished cleaning the room. Next... Oh, welcome back. I'll prepare your meal right now, so please wait a moment, Commander.

home.line: Commander. For the time being, you're forbidden from doing more work, okay? You need to make sure to take a break from now and then.

hp_warning.line: It seems I let my guard down...

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Did you sleep well?

lose.line: Oh my, what a failure...

mail.line: Is this mail for you, Commander...? I apologize. I'll leave it here.

main1.line: It's not good to strain yourself by overworking. How about splashing some water on your face to refresh yourself?

main2.line: It seems like the price for this ingredient has gone up... Commander, from now on, we'll have fewer dishes that use this.

main3.line: Commander, watching you easily handle your work makes me feel happy... I wonder why?

mission.line: Commander, the more you don't deal with your work now, the more you'll have to deal with later.

mission_complete.line: This mission's reward is quite sizeable. Congratulations, Commander!

profile.line: I'm Hermione, a Dido-class ship belonging to the Royal Navy. In the past... I chased after Bismarck and participated in anti-submarine warfare in Sardegna... Besides that, there's nothing worth mentioning. Commander, do you have any questions?

propose.line: You'd like for me to stay by your side, forever...? Of course, Commander. Taking care of you is my job, after all. Ah, would this be what's called a "confession"...? Yes, of course. Commander, I'll be in your care, from now, 'til the end of time.

touch.line: A fizzy drink? ...What am I going to do with you? I suppose you can have just one bottle, all right?

touch2.line: Commander, it's good to pay attention to the time and place when doing something like this, you know?

unlock.line: Good day. I am Hermione, from the Royal Maids. I'm delighted to make your acquaintance, Commander.

upgrade.line: My, have I gotten stronger?

win_mvp.line: I'm sure Commander will be elated~

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. I'll put this to good use.

feeling5_ex.line: Hmhm~♪ The room's all cleaned, time for... Oh, welcome back, Commander. I'll prepare your meal right away, so please wait a bit longer~

login_ex.line: Good morning, Commander. Hehe, you were sleeping so soundly, I couldn't bear to wake you up. Let's do our best today~

main1_ex.line: Commander, please come over here and lie on your side. I'll give you a wonderful Royal Navy-style massage~ Hehe.

main3_ex.line: This feeling of doing work with you, by your side... It feels really great. Yep~♪

touch_ex.line: A fizzy drink? ...I guess it can't be helped. Just one more, alright?

touch2_ex.line: Good grief, you never change...

detail.line: Commander... Even ships can get sick. Please, make sure to take care of yourself, alright?

home.line: Commander, please wait there for a moment. I'm examining someone else right now...

login.line: Hm? Commander, what brings you back here...? Umm, are you here to be... inspected?

main1.line: Gosh, Commander... If you pretend to be sick, even I'm going to get mad at you!

main2.line: Commander, don't you think this dress is a bit too small for me...? Um... I just feel like it doesn't fit me...

main3.line: Commander, please make sure that you pay attention to your own health. After all, I can't attend to you around the clock.

touch.line: Commander, let me perform an examination on you. Please come here and lie down on your side.

touch2.line: Are we... playing doctor?

unlock.line: My, what brings you here, Commander? Are you feeling unwell? That's no good... Why don't you come sit over here first? I'll start by taking your temperature...

detail.line: Actually... I bought this swimsuit back when it was on sale. I'm relieved that you like it...

home.line: I've prepared a cool, refreshing drink for you. Please enjoy.

login.line: Commander, please leave work at the office, and relax to your heart's content today.

main1.line: These waves feel so nice~ Why don't you dip your feet in too, Commander? ...Hm? A big wave is... Eek!

main2.line: Overexposure to the sun isn't good for your skin. Why don't we move somewhere else in a little bit?

main3.line: A nap? Y-yes! Please take your time and relax to your heart's content. If something happens, hm... don't worry, I'll make sure you wake up when that happens.

touch.line: Wow, the sea is so pretty~ ...Hmm? I'm even prettier than the sea...? Jeez, Commander... Don't get all sappy on me now.

unlock.line: Commander, I've brought the chair. If you don't want to get in the water, feel free to sit here. ...Hm, me? Of course, I will remain by your side.

detail.line: I changed into slightly more formal attire in preparation for us having afternoon tea together. Do you think... it doesn't suit me well...?

home.line: Before you continue with your work, please enjoy a delicious slice of cake and unwind a little~

login.line: I've finished brewing the tea. Commander, do be careful, as it is very hot.

main1.line: A while ago, Miss Belfast recommended these delicious and economical snacks. Commander, are they to your liking?

main2.line: The first thing that comes to mind when one speaks of "elegance" must surely be Miss Illustrious or Miss Hood. Oh, you'd include me as well? Hehe, I'm honoured~

main3.line: Commander, I see you've finally managed to relax a bit. I suppose inviting you for afternoon tea turned out to be very fruitful after all~

touch.line: Hm? You'd like another serving of tea? Sure, here you go~ Please let me know if there's anything you want~

unlock.line: Would you care for some afternoon tea, Commander? Heehee~ This is one of my little hobbies when I'm not performing my maid duties.

detail.line: My fellow Royal Maids drew inspiration from the Dragon Empery's traditional attire when crafting these clothes. I do hope you like them.

expedition.line: The commission team has brought back some quality herbs! I propose that we have some herb tea to celebrate.

feeling1.line: There has to be a cure for you out there somewhere... You're not beyond saving yet, I know it!

feeling5.line: Commander, how are you feeling today? I won't be giving you any medicine, but since food and medicine have the same root, I'll make sure to prepare some nutritious meals that you're sure to enjoy. Please leave it to me~♪

home.line: Breathing in these herbal fragrances is quite good for you. Commander, please feel free to relax.

mail.line: New mail has arrived. Did they procure the ingredients I asked for?

main1.line: It is often said that the best medicine is bitter, but I tried to make mine as sweet as possible to suit your tastes.

main2.line: I wonder what kinds of effects these herbs have... I should ask Dido later.

main3.line: I am quite proficient at following recipes and preparing ingredients. They're skills I often use as part of my work with the Royal Maids.

touch.line: Might you be... checking my pulse?

touch2.line: Commander...

unlock.line: How are you feeling, Commander? Hehe, I'm not wearing my usual nurse's gown right now, but I suppose this isn't much different~

battle.line: Interrupting a lady's date... How extremely senseless!

feeling5.line: ♪~ Commander, how did you enjoy our date? Me... Yes, I'm plenty satisfied. I hate to be selfish now, but part of me can't help but think... If only I could go on such lovely dates with you every day. Hahaha!

home.line: Thanks for all your hard work, Commander. Shall we see a movie? Rest a moment at a café? At the least, we should find somewhere we can take things slow.

login.line: Commander, over here! Oh, it's okay. I just arrived, myself. Let's forget all the stuffy formalities and have a fun Valentine's together.

main1.line: What do you think of when you hear Valentine's? Chocolate, of course. What chocolate do you like, Commander? All kinds? Heehee, that is a relief, but it makes things a little hard for me♪

main2.line: Am I blushing? Umm, I'm probably a little nervous... We're on a date, after all. How can you blame me for a bit of anxiety?

main3.line: At this time of year, shops that sell gift wrapping are busier than ever. Heehee, I'm sure you know why. ...Now that we're dating, maybe I have reason to go myself~

skill.line: Someone needs a lecture on manners.

touch.line: Here you go! Valentine's chocolate. ...You're surprised that I just gave it to you instead of picking the perfect moment? Please. Every moment with you is plenty romantic, so there was no need to.

touch2.line: Today... Heehee, well, it is a special day.

unlock.line: Commander, umm... Happy Valentine's Day! What do you think of my outfit? Hehe, it's perfect for a date, isn't it?

detail.line: I never dreamed that I'd get to meet you as I wear this dress, Commander. I'm so, so very happy...

feeling5.line: Hmhm~? The room's all cleaned, time for... Oh, welcome back, Commander. I'll prepare your meal right away, so please wait a bit longer~

home.line: Thank you for your hard work, Commander. Make sure to monitor your work-life balance. Otherwise, I may find a way to force you to rest... Hehehe♪

login.line: Commander, you look well. Is there anything at all I can help you with?

main1.line: Caring for your health, treasuring our life together... It doesn't feel like things have changed much, does it? I guess we've been the perfect team for a long time now.

main2.line: I've heard that spoiling people too much can make them lazy... But you'd never be lazy, Commander! Umm, so... It's okay to let me pamper you once in a while, okay?

main3.line: Commander, take it easy whenever you want to. I like you most when you're smiling without a care in the world♪

touch.line: Are you tired? You may rest your head in my lap, Commander.

touch2.line: M-may I seek your warmth, too...?

unlock.line: I'm so happy to have come this far with you, Commander. May this gorgeous sunrise watch over us for all time... I love you, Commander.

battle.line: Now, to steal Master's heart... with my dance!

couple_encourage1.line: It's okay to show off from time to time...!

couple_encourage2.line: If only I could present myself to the Master like that!

detail.line: Between my idol lessons and shows, training and my maid duties, all to be useful to you, Master... It's a lot of work? You want to reduce my workload...? P- please don't throw me away...!

expedition.line: Tashkent tells me the commission team is back.

feeling1.line: Did I let you down, Master? What a despicable maid I am...

feeling2.line: No longer a maid serving her master, I'm now an idol.I've learned so much from the other maids, but I'm still not sure if I can do this right...

feeling3.line: I look good in my idol outfit? Thank you so much, Master...! Oh, does that mean I'm not a maid anymore?! Master, you aren't going to abandon me, are you...?!

feeling4.line: You mean you're excited to see me as a maid, and as an idol...? Sorry, I misunderstood...

feeling5.line: I'm doing well as a maid, and as an idol...? I'm honoured by your praise! I'll keep working hard as an idol... No, I'll keep working hard in everything I do for you, Master!

home.line: Master, are you hurt? Do you feel okay? I may be an idol for now, but if you need me, I can still service you anytime...

hp_warning.line: I can't let the Master throw me away...!

login.line: Master, what would you have me do today? Idol things or maid things, I'll do anything you want!

lose.line: I can't sing as well as the Head Maid...

mail.line: Looks like some important mail, Master.

main1.line: Singing is more about conveying one's feelings than it is skill... So I will keep singing for you, Master...

main2.line: Madam Illustrious focuses so much on her footwork during dance practice... is it because of the mirror?

main3.line: My fellow maids, and the girls from the different camps come together to make a proper idol unit. It's truly amazing that you can bring all of us together, Master.

mission.line: We have a gig offer, Master. Won't you take a look?

mission_complete.line: Master, here are the rewards. It's all thanks to their hard work.

profile.line: I'm Dido, Royal Navy Light Cruiser. I'm but a lowly maid, and I never expected to be chosen to be an idol... But I'll do what I can!

propose.line: It's unthinkable that a lowly maid could shine onstage with all of you... But I will redouble my efforts to be worthy of the honour! All for the sake of my dearest Master!

skill.line: As an idol, for the Master...!

touch.line: You need only ask and I'll be happy to shake your hand, or whatever you may want!

touch2.line: Nnng...

unlock.line: I am the light cruiser, Dido, currently taking part in idol activities as part of the experimental Muse System. I learned more or less what idols are supposed to do from the others, so p-please... keep a close eye on me!

upgrade.line: I wonder if Albacore's idea could actually work...

win_mvp.line: I know I can do it if I work hard. I'll become an idol you can be proud of!

gift_prefer.line: I never thought I would receive a present from Master... I am simply overjoyed!

battle.line: Shall we go together?

couple_encourage1.line: I'm counting on you.

couple_encourage2.line: Aurora, we're together again.

couple_encourage3.line: Neptune... Um, sorry...

couple_encourage4.line: Did you say something...?

detail.line: Hmm... You're staring at me so much... Did you happen to want these gloves?

expedition.line: The commission has been completed, and now I'm supposed to welcome the fleet back... But what comes after that?

feeling1.line: Commander... aren't you acting a bit weird?

feeling2.line: I shall wait for you here tomorrow as well, just as you instructed, Commander.

feeling3.line: If I leave the uncompleted work here, I wonder if eventually, I won't have to do it anymore.

feeling4.line: Would you like some of the rosehip tea that Aurora taught me to make? ...It's too sour? Hmm... Maybe I accidentally added vinegar...

feeling5.line: No matter how much time passes, I will continue to wait for you here, Commander. No matter what, I'll always wait for you to come back.

headtouch.line: Nnh... Are you treating me like a child?

home.line: I am glad that you have returned safely, Commander.

hp_warning.line: I... can still do this!

login.line: Commander, are you going on a sortie? I shall stay here and await your return.

lose.line: I have been defeated. My sincerest apologies...

mail.line: Hmm... Ah, I knew I was forgetting something... Um... Right. The mail. Commander, I brought you the mail.

main1.line: Paperwork, paperwork... Where did I put it again? On that shelf? I can't seem to remember...

main2.line: Pepperpot? ...Why yes, I do think that food generally tastes better with a healthy pinch of pepper.

main3.line: I want to get along with U-410. ...Mm, with you here, Commander, I'm sure it will be fine.

mission.line: "Remind the commander if there are any unfinished missions." ...Got it. Commander, you have unfinished missions. What are they about? Umm...

mission_complete.line: "Remind the commander to collect the rewards for completed missions." ...Got it. Commander, please remember to collect your rewards. What rewards? Umm...

profile.line: I am Penelope of the Royal Navy, Arethusa-class light cruiser. I participated in a transport mission with Aurora and her companions in the K Fleet. There were difficult times, but I managed to pull through. If only I had noticed her back then...

propose.line: A promise ring... proof that you always want to stay with me? Mm... But, even without this, as long as you think of me, sometimes call for me, and look at me... that's all I need.

touch.line: ...Hm? Is something amiss? I do believe I've been doing everything to your specifications...

touch2.line: Hm...? Commander, what are you doing?

unlock.line: Arethusa-class light cruiser... Penelope, is my name. From now on, I will be your subordinate. I hope that you... can at least remember my name.

upgrade.line: Have I become stronger than before?

win_mvp.line: Commander, I followed your instructions and emerged victorious.

gift_prefer.line: I'll cherish this. Thank you.

expedition_ex.line: I will do anything you tell me to. It can be anything.

feeling1_ex.line: Commander, if this is what you desire, then...

login_ex.line: Commander, are you going on a sortie? ...Mm, I'll always be waiting for you.

main1_ex.line: Paperwork, paperwork... Mm, as you suggested, I put somewhere prominent, so I'll find it soon enough.

main3_ex.line: Mm, I'm getting along well with U-410. Commander, you should try to befriend her as well... Oh, you already have? I'm glad to hear that.

main4_ex.line: Galatea said that today's lucky colour is blue. ...Don't worry about it? Okay, I won't then. I believe you.

touch_ex.line: I will do anything you tell me to. It can be anything.

touch2_ex.line: Commander, if this is what you desire, then...

detail.line: Aurora also gave me this incense burner. It's supposed to be good for recovering from fatigue, so shall we give it a try together?

home.line: Commander, do you know about the Spring Festival? There are all kinds of interesting stories, and I'd like to hear more about that from you.

login.line: Happy Lunar New Year. I'm glad I can see you today.

main1.line: Haah... Commander, I'm sorry... At this rate, this incense... is going to make me fall asleep... Zzzzz

main2.line: The broth in the hotpot was as red as my clothes... It was a bit scary at first, but the food ended up being really delicious.

main3.line: The pattern on this fan was embroidered. I learned how to do it from Yat Sen and the others a while back, but my hands were trembling so much I made a mess of things... Ugh, I wonder how everyone does this so well.

touch.line: ...Hm? Already tired? You can lie down here if you'd like.

touch2.line: ...Um, Commander, I don't think... this is any way to conduct yourself.

unlock.line: Aurora chose this outfit for me because... the Spring Festival represents a time of celebration in the Dragon Empery, and red is the color that best symbolizes that. What do you think? Does this outfit... make you feel more festive?

detail.line: Here, I brought you your order. It's still frozen? Of course...? I never heated it up. Why...? You... never told me to...?

home.line: "Welcome back, Master. How are Mew today?" What do you think about my greeting...? 'Kay, I'll see you later then.

login.line: Did you call? Well, what do you want? ...You still need some more time? Call for me when you've decided.

main1.line: Here's the menu. Call me if you need me.

main2.line: No, that's not it? ...What do you mean by that? There's no way for me to know unless you show me...

main3.line: Sure, here's the pepper mill. How much do you want? ...Oops, I spilled it all...

touch.line: Did you want some headpats? Sure. Good job, Commander. *pat pat*

touch2.line: Commander, it's fine if you're banned from the store for this, right?

unlock.line: Welcome, welcome. I've been working here as a maid, just as you told me to. Umm... Call for me only when you're ready to order.

battle.line: Anti-air combat, commence! Master, please lower your head!

detail.line: Master, is there anything new you'd like to wear when you head out on missions? ...If that's what you'd like, please leave it to me! It so happens sewing is one of my specialties♪

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. I wonder how it went?

feeling1.line: I... Master, do you throw everyone to the wolves like this...?

feeling2.line: Hm-hmm~♪ Whenever, wherever, I'll be there to serve you as your maid. A-and please don't remind me of how I mess up sometimes...

feeling3.line: It may be an exaggeration to say "whenever, wherever," but... I simply wish to be there to serve you whenever you might need me... I'm sorry...

feeling4.line: If I do everything for you, you'll become incapable of doing anything for yourself? Am I that powerful of an existence...?

feeling5.line: I-I'll do everything for you, but in moderation... Wait! I'll just do my best to relieve some of your fatigue~ Roger! I'll make sure to exercise restraint!

home.line: Welcome back, Master! Let's make sure you don't overdo things and take a short break first~

hp_warning.line: Wh-where's the enemy?

login.line: Good morning to you, Master. Will you be starting off the day with some work?

lose.line: Redouble our rescue efforts! Master, please retreat and leave the others to me!

mail.line: I'm here to deliver this mail to you, Master.

main1.line: Fair winds and a following sea~ Master, if it's fine with you, please take me along in your next mission as well.

main2.line: There's nothing for me to do right now...? N-no way... Master, how could you do this to me...

main3.line: Master~ If you'd please change into– Y-you can't see the documents you're working on...? Ahh, I'm sorry!

mission.line: Master, there's a new mission for you! Y-you already knew about it? Oh...

mission_complete.line: Here are your rewards. Please check on them.

profile.line: I am the Dido-class anti-aircraft cruiser, Charybdis. With the motto, "Any task – anywhere," I performed my duties in different oceans across the world during the war. Master, whenever or wherever you need anything, just leave it to me!

propose.line: What's this, Master...? Y-you really weren't satisfied just having your fatigue relieved?! *sigh*... I-I mean, even without this ring... Oh! Is this a symbol of your permission for me to pamper you lots and lots more~? Heehee, my dear Master, of course I love you lots~

skill.line: Stay calm, it's time for our counterattack!

touch.line: Just leave it to me~♪

touch2.line: Master, is something wrong?

unlock.line: Dido-class light cruiser, Charybdis at your service. 'tis an honour to meet you in person, Master. May your everyday life be bathed in the warm sunlight, in the peaceful days that come.

upgrade.line: Behold my true power! Heehee.

win_mvp.line: An elegant victory, the way us Royal Maids do it... Ow! A-an undetonated shell...?

gift_prefer.line: Um, Master? Huh? This gift is for me?

detail_ex.line: Master, does it feel good~? Heehee, since we're fine on time, I'll keep on pampering you more and more~

feeling5_ex.line: Thank you for waiting, my dear Master. Heehee, you seem pretty tired... Hah! I'll pet you on the head today. Good work, good work~ I'm not going anywhere, so just sit tight and let my affection warm you up~!

home_ex.line: Master, allow me to take your coat~ Here's a towel, a warm cup of coffee, and a hug from me~

login_ex.line: Heehee, it's adorable how devoted you are to your job, Master~ Sorry, I'll go and prepare the documents right away.

lose_ex.line: I won't let you be swallowed up by the sea! Grab my hand!

main1_ex.line: May your mission today be successful, and may you return safe and sound... All right, Master. Everything is bound to go swimmingly!

main2_ex.line: I-is there really nothing I can do to help...? I can't believe you'd just leave me with nothing to do like this... There's no way this should be allowed... Masterrrr...

main3_ex.line: Master, let's check on this report together... You can't see the report because my chest is in the way? Oh goodness... I'm sorry...

mission_ex.line: Master, I've received word that there's a new mission for you. Though, it looks like you were already aware of it... I-it was Dido who informed you about it?!

touch_ex.line: Master? Whenever, wherever, please leave everything to me~!

touch2_ex.line: Oh Master, you~ Heehee♡

win_mvp_ex.line: I'll say it once again. Ahem... An elegant victory, just the way your maid does it!

battle.line: There's no pampering in store for you bunch, only punishment!

detail.line: This room is brimming with Dragon Empery style. Hmm... I'm not exactly sure how to explain it, but it sure is nice and relaxing.

home.line: *Pats thighs* Master, I'm right over here~ Heehee, you must be exhausted, right~

login.line: Goodness, what a troublesome master you are. Where have you been? I've been waiting to continue cleaning your ears~

mail.line: Your mail's here~ Please make sure you check it afterwards~♪

main1.line: Umm... Hmm... Oh no, I still haven't finished sewing the outfit Aurora requested... Dear me...

main2.line: My, someone is at the door... Oh, Master?! Please don't move, I'm not done working on your ears yet...

main3.line: Alright, Master~ I'll be cleaning your other ear now, so please turn around... Eek?!

mission_complete.line: The rewards have arrived without any issues. That's a relief~

touch.line: Ah, Master, please don't move around so much.

touch2.line: Ahhn...♡

unlock.line: *Pats thighs* Master, you poor thing~ Look how hard you've been working~ Hehe, hurry and come here so that I can pamper you~

win_mvp.line: Now, please allow me to continue pampering you once we return~

detail.line: Ugh... We haven't even done that much walking, but my feet are already sore... Changing into an outfit you're not used to isn't the easiest thing in the world. I wonder if Sirius and Black Prince are hanging in there...

expedition.line: The commission team is back, Commander. Ehehe.

login.line: Master, why don't you take the lead tonight? Heehee~

mail.line: The letter is right~ over~ here~! You don't see it?

main1.line: By the way, Master, who did you invite today? Umm, it doesn't particularly concern me, but Dido absolutely wanted to know.

main2.line: I wonder why Eagle is holding back so much? We went through the trouble of making all this delicious food, so...

main3.line: Isn't Sirius absolutely breathtaking in that dress? I know you've been staring at her too, Commander. Heehee~

touch.line: Did you want to shake your feet out as well?

touch2.line: This outfit makes me pretty irresistible, doesn't it?

unlock.line: Tis a pleasure to see you, Master. I am delighted to be your partner for today. ...Oh, I was just trying to sound prim and proper! You don't need to look at me with such pity in your eyes!

battle.line: For the safety and continued victory of my Master, I'll head out!

detail.line: Phew... This salty sea breeze feels wonderful, Master. Next time, I should bring the other ladies here to... Hmm... Do you have any ideas for what we should do? Maybe light a bonfire?

expedition.line: The girls of the commissions team have been swallowed by a whirlpool, you know... Just kidding~♪ Look, they've returned already.

login.line: Master~ Ahaha, that's right~♪ I'm always ecstatic to come to the beach~

main1.line: Eskimo, don't go overboard with your pranks...

main2.line: Master, it's shallow over here~ ...Hwaah?! T-that was a huge wave just now...

main3.line: Clear skies and a refreshing breeze... The perfect weather for pampering you, Master. Wouldn't you agree~?

touch.line: I'd love to come back here every year with you, Master.

unlock.line: As you can see, today's theme... is a seaside pampering, or something like that~ Heehee. I know you're no stranger to the sea, Commander, but today, we're here to play, not work. Just take it easy, and unwind~♪

win_mvp.line: I'll have you know, I'm not actually bad at fighting. Heehee~

battle.line: A one-on-one battle shall have to wait for another day.

couple_encourage1.line: Hmm... This is a way to duel as well.

detail.line: My liege, would you like to have a bout with me? Of course, not a serious match, but just something to deepen our bonds... Next time, since you've got other work to focus on, you say? Understood. Whenever you're ready, please let me know.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. To be rewarded for one's toils is precious indeed.

feeling1.line: Only those with pride have the privilege to wield a sword in a duel. My liege, you still have much work to do to earn it.

feeling2.line: Though I was christened after a goddess of war, I'm not particularly fond of it. The only value I find in wielding a sword is in the pure enjoyment of the world of duels.

feeling3.line: Once I grasp my blade, the only thing in my sight is my enemy. In that moment, the sole thought in my head is to devote my all to defeating them.

feeling4.line: It's unfair to judge victory or defeat based solely on swordsmanship unless those involved are experienced. What I'm saying is, what is your area of expertise, my liege? Of course I'm curious, but I was also wanting to try something that doesn't involve a sword.

feeling5.line: If you're interested in learning more about me, how about we spar for a bit to our hearts' content? There's nothing that brings closer than that. Hehe, I'll show up on time, but I'll leave the time and place to you. I'm sure you wouldn't play dirty with me, my liege. Would you?

headtouch.line: Is this how you show your gratitude toward your subordinates? Duly noted.

home.line: My liege, good work out there... Um, your cuff and collar are all ragged... How about changing out first?

hp_warning.line: Purge all distractions. I'll fight with a level head!

login.line: My liege, I've been waiting for you. Have you prepared to face your toughest enemy today – your work?

lose.line: While we may look past our failures, we must not ignore what led to them...

mail.line: Mail? Is it a challenge to a duel? Please prepare... Huh? That's not the case?

main1.line: I much prefer fighting one-on-one compared to the disorder of a melee. There's a huge difference between focusing on one enemy versus taking stock of the big picture, after all.

main2.line: Hm? There are marks of wear on these gloves? How careless of me. I shall prepare a new set right away.

main3.line: My liege, your expression... Did something bad happen? If you need someone to give you a push, I'd love to be of assistance.

mission.line: If you think of your missions as a duel with an invisible enemy, your efficiency will go up.

mission_complete.line: These are the rewards for your completed missions. Please accept them as the spoils of the victor.

profile.line: I am Bellona, a member of the improved Dido-class, the Bellona-class. As a member of the Royal Knights, I participated as an escort during transport missions as well as participating in the raid on Tirpitz. After that war, various things happened... Anyway, please feel free to entrust me with any mission you see fit.

propose.line: It is the destiny of man to wither away with the passage of time. ...However, even if my passions wither with the passing of time, I find that my emotions only mellow and become more robust, as if a fine vintage. You are the first person I've desired something more than swinging swords with, so... Please, don't let me down.

skill.line: Come, we'll settle this with a duel!

touch.line: Well then, I shall accept this duel... Oh, um, you were just giving me some work to do?

touch2.line: Shall I take this as a provocation?

unlock.line: I am Bellona, improved Dido-class light cruiser of the Royal Navy. If I am not mistaken, you are the Lord-Commander? I have stated my name and title as per our code. I hope you will do so as well, my liege.

upgrade.line: The stronger I get, the greater my odds of victory.

win_mvp.line: I present this victory to you with pleasure, my liege. Of course, it shan't be my last victory either.

gift_prefer.line: Thanks for this gift. I shall treasure it.

home_ex.line: My liege, good work out there. Here you go. I brought you a change of clothes so you can continue to maintain your appearance while you work on your documents.

login_ex.line: Welcome back. While I do not enjoy being outnumbered, it would be quite boorish of me to mouth off when there is a mountain of work to take care of. Let us do our best together.

main4_ex.line: You don't have to put in so much effort into maintaining your appearance to look nice, but... putting in some effort to straighten things out makes you look much cooler. Alright, I feel great standing here by your side. Hehe.

touch_ex.line: If you are planning on going far away, please allow me to escort you, my liege. Hm? No need to ask for permission, you say?

touch2_ex.line: Quite a strange way of asking someone on a date, if you ask me.

win_mvp_ex.line: Even this victory shan't be my last. I've already told you, haven't I? Hehe.

detail.line: I have always been curious about the kinds of work that Dido and the others always do. I had always thought that the work the maids did was not very difficult, but actually, it's quite comparable to fighting in a melee.

headtouch.line: Were you encouraging me? Please do not fret. My studies regarding the duties of a maid have been going quite swimmingly.

home.line: Welcome back, dear Master. Please take a nice rest until our next battle begins. Allow me to take your soiled clothes from you.

login.line: Good day to you, dear Master. Please give me your orders, whatever they may be. I am always ready to use my blade... Ahem, I am at your beck and call.

main1.line: When I think of the dust as my enemy in a duel... it's like fighting a phantom enemy that refuses to fight you face-to-face. I can only hope that there aren't that many.

main2.line: Hmm... These windows with bump marks are hard to remove, so they should be dealt with as an emergency... As for the furniture, let's just replace them.

main3.line: Looking at a room after a deep cleaning makes you feel a sense of accomplishment. The feeling of not even seeing a speck of dust feels as good as beating a very strong enemy in a duel.

touch.line: Let us clean up any unnecessary trash there might be.

touch2.line: You shouldn't underestimate the power of the Royal Maids.

unlock.line: My liege... No, excuse me, I should be calling you Master, right? Bellona of the Royal Maids, reporting in. My, you seem quite lost for words... I'll explain the situation to you later, so don't worry about it.

battle.line: Much easier than taking care of my friends...!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's make quick work of this!

detail.line: Doing the bare minimum is unacceptable, whether for the maid or for the master. Please pull yourself together.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Please go take a look, Master.

feeling1.line: I am only serving you because you are my master. There's nothing more to it.

feeling2.line: Please feel free to call upon me whenever you need something. Be it cleaning your office or cleaning the battlefield, anything from maid work to military affairs fall within my purview.

feeling3.line: There's a girl you're interested in? Well then, if you'd like me to investigate more about her, please tell me her name. While I'd criticize you for being tactless, if it's your order... You won't tell me? Understood...

feeling4.line: You want to know how to confess to a girl you're keen on... E-even if you ask me, I wouldn't know anything about that... Don't you think I'm the wrong person to ask about love?

feeling5.line: This has to be some kind of joke. You're just trying to make fun of me, aren't you? ...N-no way... Of all people, I can't believe the person you were interested in was me all along... I can't believe it...

headtouch.line: Wh-what is it...?

home.line: Good work out there. Master, please head on out for your debriefing.

hp_warning.line: Keep calm, and carry on...!

login.line: I see you've arrived, Master. Here is your schedule for the day.

lose.line: We lost... But it's not your fault, Master. I should've worked harder.

mail.line: You've got mail, Master. I'll bring it over right away.

main1.line: Given your current efficiency, it seems unlikely that you'll be able to finish your work today, Master. Since Emerald won't be of any use, shall I call upon some of the other Royal Maids for assistance?

main2.line: Glasgow, I really enjoyed the manga you recommended the other day. What would you recommend next... Master?! I'm not up to anything, I swear!

main3.line: Please leave the cleaning to me. I'll make sure to take care of it without getting in the way of your work.

mission.line: New missions are in. They'll be done in no time if we work together.

mission_complete.line: That's all I can do for you. I'll leave you to check on the rewards.

profile.line: I am Enterprise, an Emerald-class light cruiser belonging to the Royal Navy. In the great war, I participated in support, escort, and transport missions, and even participated in combat from time to time. At the Bay of Biscay... Ahem, forget I mentioned it.

propose.line: From the way the celebration hall is decorated, to the blessings I've received from my friends, there's nothing lacking... I, I truly can't believe that I'm exchanging vows with you, Master... Ahh, I must be dreaming...

skill.line: I'll wipe the floor with you all!

touch.line: Did you need my advice?

touch2.line: ...I'm going to get upset.

unlock.line: I am the Royal Maid, Enterprise. I have been assigned to this port starting today. As part of the maids, I am in charge of cleaning, and my hobby is reading about all kinds of trivia. That's all I have to report.

upgrade.line: Thank you for making me stronger, Master. I shall return this debt to you in battle.

win_mvp.line: We won. Didn't take much brainpower either.

gift_prefer.line: This can't count as a gift, right? It's totally a bribe...

battle_ex.line: This is just as important... as taking care of my Master!

detail_ex.line: Even if you say I'm too methodical... T-that's just the kind of girl I am, so I can't do anything about it. ...If you don't like it, why don't you just ask another girl to do it for you, huh?

feeling5_ex.line: You want to know how to invite someone you like on a date...? Huh, there's no way I'd tell you. I can't believe you'd ask someone you've exchanged vows with to tell you how to take other girls on dates... Huh?! T-then why don't we go on a date right now...? You should have told me that it was about me in the first place!

home_ex.line: Well done. Um, how about taking a short break before reviewing your plans...? Come on, look at how tired you are...

login_ex.line: Master, what will you start off with today? How about leaving your clerical duties to me and heading out to start with some training exercises?

main4_ex.line: You look like you're ready to take on the world. ...Sheffield told you that as well? I-I see... I'm not jealous at all, alright...?

main5_ex.line: I enjoy reading both manga and literature. Speaking of which, what are some of your favorite books?

main6_ex.line: You need something cleaned? Sure thing, I'm on my way...!

touch_ex.line: I-if you just want to chat, we can do it later...

touch2_ex.line: I'm sure you do this to the other girls too, don't you? That's why you're doing this to...W-wah?!

win_mvp_ex.line: We won. Master, thank you for always creating the best battle plans for us.

battle.line: Trust in your leadership and give the command!

couple_encourage1.line: Shall we fight together?

couple_encourage2.line: I won't abandon my Master. Teehee!

detail.line: You know, Master, I think only the most outstanding maid should have the right to serve her Master... What do you think?

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Master, I hope you aren't forgetting to welcome the team back? ...Good. I'm ready to depart any time.

feeling1.line: Don't ever think that I might leave you, Master. It is a maid's duty to care for her master, even if said master happens to be a little... wanting.

feeling2.line: Commander, you have a choice: me, or my friend and excellent Royal Maid Charybdis, who comes running whenever you need her? ...Heehee, you don't have to answer that. I just felt like asking.

feeling3.line: Is something wrong? Have you perhaps made a mistake, Master? Don't fret. Tell me everything, and let me think about it with you. No matter what, Master, you have our eternal respect as the great Commander♪

feeling4.line: You are the Master, and I am your personal maid. Why should there be any secrets between us? Heehee, don't you hide a thing. You want to rely on me more and leave more to me, don't you...?

feeling5.line: Heehee. Do you find yourself feeling that you can't do anything without me around? Poor Master. I'll just have to manage your everyday... Oh, I don't mind. I'm the only one who's seen your few shortcomings—your occasional spinelessness, indolence, and indecision. Yet even I still consider you the best Commander and the best Master ever~♡

headtouch.line: A reward, for little old me? Heehee, I'm delighted!

home.line: Don't worry about a thing. Everyone is safe at home in the port, and I'm prepared to devote myself to you. So... May I have my orders, Master? Heehee!

hp_warning.line: Do not fret, Master. I swear that I will return to your side.

login.line: Welcome home, Master. I got everything ready for you, so all you need to do is sit here... and get right to work!♪

lose.line: So this is how you look when you've been beaten... Heehee♡

mail.line: Master, you seem to be forgetting some mail addressed to you. Heehee, you're so forgetful!♪ But it's okay. I happened to bring it with me.

main1.line: Is there something you're looking for? I know where everything related to the Royal Maids' work is. Don't hesitate to ask.

main2.line: I couldn't help but notice that another girl was cleaning your office... Oh, it's fine, Master. But allow me to do it next time; I'm the maid taking care of you right now.

main3.line: I'm happy to help with whatever you can't or don't want to do. There's nothing wrong with accepting your shortcomings and relying on your maid♪

mission.line: Do you have unfinished business? That's no good... Allow me to help you, Master♪

mission_complete.line: Another mission complete. Heehee, I think your exploits are worthy of a medal.

profile.line: Dido-class anti-aircraft cruiser Scylla, ready to serve. I served as an escort carrier flagship in that war, but I was unable to perform any major exploits. But now... I am only a Royal Maid, here to devote heart and soul to you, Master.

propose.line: Have you finally found the determination to leave your everything to me? Heehee, of course I accept. Leave it all to your personal maid Scylla while you drown in my love forever and ever!♡

touch.line: Is something the matter? If there's anything I can do for you, please don't hesitate to ask.

touch2.line: A maid must be willing to give her everything to her Master. Please do as you wish.

unlock.line: Delighted to meet you, Master. Hopefully it is not too forward of me to greet you in such a manner. I am Scylla, Dido-class light cruiser. Heehee, as you can see, I am nothing more than an ordinary maid.

upgrade.line: Your favour is much appreciated, Master.

win_mvp.line: Please accept my sincere congratulations, Master.

gift_prefer.line: You're quite the flatterer, Master. Do you treat the other girls the same way?

detail_ex.line: Is there something you need me to do for you again? Yes, yes, I'll do it. Just be patient. I suppose... I'm the only person who knows that you can't do this, Master?

feeling5_ex.line: You're pushing yourself, aren't you? Heehee, don't bother anymore. Leave everything to me now, and let me see more of your pathetic side, Master... Everyone else knows the cool and composed Commander already. The Commander before me... is mine alone~♡

home_ex.line: Don't worry about a thing. Everyone is safe at home in the port. By the way, Master... Is it just me, or do you worry about the others more than you do me?

login_ex.line: Welcome home, Master. Do you... need me to tell you what must be done?

main4_ex.line: Dido is a bit of a problem for me. She never loses things, so she doesn't need me to find things for her. And since she's so capable, she never needs my help.

main5_ex.line: Master, if you have a lot of lost items, why don't we do a big hunt for all of them? I promise I'll find them all. Heehee, we won't need to trouble anyone else.

main6_ex.line: The more things you can't do yourself, the more you'll rely on me, and the more I'll get to manage you... I'm pulling your leg. Is that really the sort of life you want, Master?

mail_ex.line: Master, you seem to be forgetting some mail addressed to you. Heehee, don't worry. I'll remind you as many times as it takes.

mission_ex.line: My, Master. Should I really need to remind you to do such simple missions?

mission_complete_ex.line: Well done, Master~ Thanks to me, you've managed to complete your missions.

touch_ex.line: Let me see your indulgent side, Master♡

touch2_ex.line: Leave everything to your maid Scylla, my poor, adorable Master♡

win_mvp_ex.line: The Master who brings us victory, the Master who everyone praises, and... the Master only I know. Heehee♡

detail.line: I'm your maid, Master, so I'm glad to be used however you see fit. Or do you... want to be "used" yourself, Master? Heehee...

expedition.line: "Senpai," I'm about to show the other girls that look you had on your face. Are you sure you're ready for that? ...Heehee. Next time, don't forget to greet the commission team upon their return.

feeling5.line: There's no point trying to hide it, "Senpai." You're just going to have to give up and... Got you!♪ I could never show another girl how pitiful you look right now. But of course... If you would like the others to see, I would gladly obey♡

home.line: What brings you back here? Do you not have it in you to leave me alone? Or... Is there something you want me to do for you?

login.line: Welcome home, Master. Rather... "Senpai"? Did you finally remember our little promise?"

mail.line: "Senpai," your phone is ringing. Is that a call from someone? Such as... another girl, perhaps?

main1.line: "Senpai," do you need my notes from last class? I wrote all the important points, so it'll be just like you actually listened to the lecture!

main2.line: Where has Lady Argus gone? Oh, she's in remedial classes for failing grades? Goodness...

main3.line: We're just two good friends—in school, anyway. But outside this campus... Heehee, shall we call that our little secret?♡

main4.line: My, Glasgow, were you watching us? You were excited to see what Master's like at school, too, weren't you? Heehee, don't worry. I'll get plenty of pictures for you.

mission.line: This shameful begging isn't like the "Senpai" everyone relies on, now, is it? But it's okay... Leave this mission to me.

mission_complete.line: It seems you've finished all of your missions, "Senpai." Good job! You couldn't have done that with my help, right? Heehee!

touch.line: My eyes are up here, "Senpai"~♪

touch2.line: Is this the kind of stimulation you seek? Heehee, you're so naughty~♡

unlock.line: Did you come all this way just because I asked you to, Master? Or... would you prefer I call you "Senpai" here? If we're at school, then there's no reason for me to act maidly, now is there? Heeheehee♪

win_mvp.line: Well done, "Senpai." Look, everyone's cheering for you.

detail.line: I may be acting as your partner instead of your maid at the moment, but I mean to serve you the same either way. We must let everyone know that Scylla sees to your every need♪

feeling5.line: Outfits, manners... It was none other than I who so perfectly prepared you, Master. You can keep leaving everything to me – and I mean not just preparing for parties, but everything in your day-to-day life as well. Keep relying on me, my dear, beloved, valiant, and pitiful Master♥

home.line: You seem tense. Don't worry... I'll support you seamlessly, so just leave everything to me. Heehee...

login.line: Greetings, Master. ...You'd like to hold the leash for once? Heehee, the thing you should be holding is not the leash, but my hand♪

mail.line: Hm? A message, at a time like this... Heehee, do you think others are trying to take my role as your partner, Master?

main1.line: Are there any more preparations we need to do before the party? Heehee, I don't mind if not. I'm happy to get you good and ready, Master♪

main2.line: Did you practice dancing already? Who in the world did you... Oh, don't mind me. From now on, I'd just like you to practice with me and me alone.

main3.line: Master, your collar's already a mess after so little time apart from me. Allow me... Phew. I think you'd best stay by my side, Master.

main4.line: The outfit I picked out for you looks lovely on you... Heehee, next time you're not sure what to wear, come see me. Yes, it's perfectly okay to rely on me more, alright?

mission.line: Oh? The party is about to begin, and you still have missions left on the table? You're helpless... Allow me to assist you.

mission_complete.line: The mission is complete, and everyone knows now that you need me by your side. Heehee♥

touch.line: I'd be delighted to let you take my hand, Master.

touch2.line: Master, is the urge becoming irresistible? Heehee, show me how you really feel♥

unlock.line: Good evening, Master of mine. I hope I didn't make you wait long. Oh? That look on your face... Were you excited to walk on the red carpet with me, arm in arm?

win_mvp.line: Such a wonderful victory is worthy of walking on the red carpet, don't you think, Master?

detail.line: This outfit is very different from what I typically wear. The style of the Nile, I suppose... Master, I noticed you staring. Don't avert your eyes now.

feeling5.line: My, are you that worried about your daily deeds now? Don't worry. I accept every bit of you. My pitiful Master, my anxious Master, my poor Master, my sinful Master... All of them are mine♥

home.line: Welcome back, Master. If you'd like an appraisal of the previous battle, then don't hesitate to ask. Whether you'd like to rejoice in victory or be punished after defeat... Well, you just leave it all to me.

login.line: If you want to receive my judgment, then I'm more than happy to oblige. I'll even do it over and over until you're satisfied with the result... Heehee.

mail.line: There's mail for you. Reading it, replying to it... Add to your list of good deeds one at a time.

main1.line: Please, Master, show me your truest side. I'll do the same thing in return.
