mission_complete.line: That's quite a nice haul from the mission rewards. As expected of Commander, ever so hardworking.

profile.line: I am a member of the Royal Navy's Attacker-class escort carriers. Although I served in the Royal Navy, I was originally born in the Eagle Union and even stayed in the Dragon Empery for some time. I really dislike submarines, but I should be fine as long as we deal with them carefully~

propose.line: Commander, are you confessing to me? Hehe~ I'm very impressed that you're being so straightforward and brave~ But before I can reciprocate, can I propose something? Just for the two of us... a secret tea party...

touch.line: Commander, my aircraft are in ace condition, ready to deploy at any time!

touch2.line: This is no way to treat a lady~

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander. Escort carrier Chaser, reporting for duty. Rumour has it that the tea and refreshments prepared here are simply delicious. Of course, I look forward to meeting friends here who share my refined taste, hehe~

upgrade.line: My my, at this rate, I'm might even catch up to those regular carriers.

win_mvp.line: Even though I'm an escort carrier, I won't lose to the regular aircraft carriers when it comes to ability~

gift_prefer.line: Oh my. How thoughtful of you, Commander. In that case, I shall not bother with the formalities~♪

detail.line: After spending some time in the Empery, I started to realise that, in addition to black tea, I sometimes wanted to enjoy the fragrance of green tea as well.

feeling1.line: I have a commander who is as bitter as oversteeped green tea that has been left out and forgotten.

login.line: Hm? Commander, you're back~ Is there a story you'd like to hear from me today?

lose.line: Ugh... there's this saying that "for soldiers, both victory and defeat are standard issue."

main1.line: The Dragon Empery's traditional dances seem difficult to learn... Eh, you'd like to learn them with me? In that case, we should be able to learn them in no time~

main2.line: Eh, fireworks display? Um, I think I'll pass... I'm... not good around fire.

main3.line: (yawns) ... Ahh, I stayed up too late last night exchanging stories with the Empery girls, so I'm really sleepy...

mission_complete.line: Mhm! As expected, Commander, you've finished the mission! Hurry and see if we were rewarded with any tea~

skill.line: I see you~ Don't think you can run from me!

touch.line: Commander, do you like my qipao? Don't you think blonde hair matches the aesthetic of the dress quite well? Ehehe~

touch2.line: Oh dear... Commander, flirting is fine but please don't go overboard~

unlock.line: Does this dress from the Dragon Empery not suit me well? Though I was born in the Eagle Union and raised by the Royal Navy, my time in the Dragon Empery also left a deep impression upon me. Why don't we have a chat about their profound culture and tea? Hehe~

detail.line: Our work takes us to the far corners of the world. Keeping a game console on hand to stave off boredom is a good idea, isn't it?

feeling1.line: Commander? It wouldn't hurt to go outside and do something else every now and then, all right?

home.line: All right, time for me to grab that high score!

login.line: C'mon, Commander! Which stage are we gonna clear today?

main1.line: Long Island, down to host another raid next time? I want to get some new equipment~♪

main2.line: Bogue's pitches are way too overpowered... No matter how hard I try, I can only hit two or three out of ten...

main3.line: Listen to this, Commander! I learned how to cook from Mullany! ...Eh, I learned the wrong thing...?

touch2.line: Jeez... games aren't enough for you?

unlock.line: Heck yeah! Another achievement down! ...Huh? Good day, Commander. Is there something wrong with my appearance? Hehe, I'm from the Eagle Union after all, of course I'd know a thing or two about entertainment~♪

battle.line: Careful, now. The battlefield is no place to worry about fuel economy.

couple_encourage1.line: Time for a new experiment?

detail.line: The big mirror in my room? What about it? If I told you, "I just like mirrors," would that satisfy your curiosity?

expedition.line: Look, Commander... No, I'm not angry, I was just going to tell you a commission is done.

feeling1.line: You really are like a can of rancid surströmming.

feeling2.line: I can hear just fine, Commander, so don't go yelling in my ear, thanks...

feeling3.line: If you ask me, people should be able to say whatever they want... Oh, hello there, Commander. Just talking to myself.

feeling4.line: I'm a total moron... Why am I so rude to the Commander when I just want to be friends... I'm so, so stupid...

feeling5.line: How would I describe you? I dunno, I guess like a storm in the middle of a peaceful voyage... No, no, I didn't mean it like that... Sorry, what I meant to say is, um...

headtouch.line: ...Yeah?

home.line: One quick battle, and you're knackered already, Commander? You have the stamina of a beached whale.

hp_warning.line: ...I can't afford to mess around, huh.

login.line: There's some saying that goes, "the early bird catches the worm." ...If that's true, I guess you'd starve, Commander.

lose.line: Damn, we lost... Sorry.

mail.line: You've got mail. Nope, didn't bring it with me. Next time, ask, and I'll consider it.

main1.line: If you need my help with something, just say it. You do need to try and accomplish it on your own first, though.

main2.line: Work is like food, in a way; leave it sitting for too long and it goes bad. Just so you know.

main3.line: I heard Yuubari and Akashi get up to fun experiments in the lab. I kind of wanna see one. Kind of.

mission.line: What kind of lazy cat are you, just lounging around all day instead of doing missions?

mission_complete.line: Those mission rewards will expire if you don't claim them. Maybe.

profile.line: I'm Perseus, the Colossus-class light aircraft carrier. Sadly, I didn't enter service until the war had ended. Don't have much in the way of a reputation or experience as a result. Still, I'll try to do a good job. All right, is that good enough? *sigh*...

propose.line: Obviously I don't hate you, Commander. How could I, when I adore talking to you and being patted on the head? L-look, I'm trying to say... I love you. I mean it...

touch.line: Maybe try finishing your work before you "chat me up" or "interview me" or however you wanna sugarcoat it?

touch2.line: You must really want a seat at the naval jailhouse dinner table, huh?

unlock.line: I'm Perseus, from the Royal Navy. You can pronounce it "Per-see-us" if you want though... Well, whatever. Are we done here? Great. Nice meeting you.

upgrade.line: Thanks a bunch... Well, yeah, didn't you want a thank-you?

win_mvp.line: Looks like the enemy will have to, uh, try harder next time.

gift_prefer.line: You seem to know what I like, huh... Thank you.

detail_ex.line: Okay, fine. I use my mirror for conversation practice... Stop giggling, it's not funny.

expedition_ex.line: The commission team is back, Commander.

feeling5_ex.line: I've become able to just, you know, talk. Like a normal person. With you and other people, I mean. I owe you thanks for helping me come this far. I love you, Commander. I really do.

login_ex.line: There's that saying that goes, "the early bird catches the worm"... Uh, just try not to starve to death, Commander.

main1_ex.line: If you need my help with something, just say it. But first, try to accomplish it on your own. Or don't, that's fine.

main2_ex.line: Work is like food, they both have an expiry date. So, need any help finishing your food, so to speak?

main4_ex.line: Intrepid, can you see Perseus? No, I mean, the constellation.

touch_ex.line: So, are you up for a chat?

upgrade_ex.line: Thanks a bunch... Well, yeah, didn't you want a thank-you?

detail.line: I'm still learning, but I know how to give injections and stop a haemorrhage in theory. Can I practice my knowledge on you, Commander?

home.line: Your health is seriously concerning, Commander. Want me to get you some vitamins?

login.line: Honestly, I have no idea what sort of face to put on when pretending to be a nurse.

main1.line: It's noble to help those in need, but don't go overboard with it. What I'm trying to say is: unless you NEED my help, just make do on your own, Commander.

main2.line: Now to practice turning a gravely injured person over... You, I'm gonna need you to lie on your back.

main3.line: Nice new med tech. Commander, I want you to be my guinea pig– Excuse me, I mean, experiment assistant.

touch.line: You have a healthy look in your eyes, Commander.

touch2.line: You belong in the bed of a jail cell, not of a hospital.

unlock.line: I'm Perseus, I will be your nurse today. Use this button to call for me if you need anything... Yes? Did you need something?

detail.line: ...Lunar New Year's greetings? Right, those are a thing. Whew. Okay... Happy New Year, Commander. Keep on being the early bird, all right?

expedition.line: A commission's been completed. Oh well, nothing too important to our sleepy bird here.

headtouch.line: ...Oh. Now it's your responsibility to comb my hair.

home.line: Back at long last. Whew... You have more stamina than any person has any right to.

login.line: Hm? Did you give up on being the early bird? ...Me? I'm the spring worm that sleeps in.

mail.line: There's a Lunar New Year card with your name on it, Commander.

main1.line: Whew... Lunar New Year's a nice holiday. You can just lie down and someone will feed you... Hm? They won't?

main2.line: Looks like Theseus is into the hustle and bustle of the season. Though, I guess I'm the same when it comes down to it... *yaaawn*...

main3.line: A cannon to inaugurate the new year with? That's a neat idea... Crap, now I'm interested...

touch.line: ...Do you wanna lie down with me? Knock yourself out. Like they say, Lunar New Year is a holiday for resting.

touch2.line: ...Baozi... or rice cakes? C-Commander... *blushes*

unlock.line: Whew. Lunar New Year... Easy to grasp in various ways. Both the holiday and your tastes, I mean. Heehee.

upgrade.line: Yup, I got my red envelope. Here, this one's for you.

battle.line: With courage and loyalty, we shall prevail!

couple_encourage1.line: Elder Hermes, I'm right behind you!

couple_encourage2.line: Elder Centaur, don't push yourself too hard!

detail.line: You want to know about my appearance? Unlike Elder Centaur, my name is not based on a mythological creature. If I had to say, the land where those with my appearance lived in the ancient times when legends roamed the world... Oh, am I talking your head off?

expedition.line: The whispers of the wind... tell me that the girls have returned from their commissions. Let me know when you're ready to meet with them.

feeling1.line: Was there something amiss with the way I conducted myself...?

feeling2.line: As a Childe of the fleet, I can only hope to learn from the examples my Elders set in battle, as well as from how you manage the fleet. There is much for me to learn in terms of techniques, mental attitude, as well as everyday customs.

feeling3.line: Hmm... Perhaps I need a new way of addressing my Elders of the destroyer class... And then there are the blueprint ships as well... But they're still my Elders... What should I do...?

feeling4.line: Elder Commander, should I leave these documents over here? Urgh, I knew it would feel weird to call you that... Calling you one of my Elders doesn't feel respectful enough, and frankly, feels quite strange to say out loud...

feeling5.line: How should I address the Commander then? Lord Commander? I'm sure my Elders have much more intimate ways of address... Ugh, I can't believe I sabotaged myself from the start, even though I'd like to have a closer relationship... Maybe I should try a different approach, like a date or something...?

home.line: You did a great job, Commander. Please call for me if there's anything I can do to lighten your load.

hp_warning.line: I've got to dig my heels in... I don't want to be a burden to my Elders!

login.line: Light carrier, Albion, at your service. I await your orders.

lose.line: How did I manage... to be so clumsy...

mail.line: There seems to be some new mail... Would you like to take a look?

main1.line: If you require a change of pace, I would like to suggest taking a stroll through the forest with Elder Centaur. I would especially recommend the forest by the hills, as the wind there feels particularly nice. Hehehe.

main2.line: The ships of my class use a variety of arms in battle, so I don't think trying to copy their fighting style will be of much use to me. Instead, I can learn from their battle-readiness.

main3.line: Grey Ghost...? I'm not sure I can shoulder the burden of sharing a nickname with Elder Enterprise... I-if you're fine with it, I do suppose you can call me that, if you wish...

mission.line: Let us work towards the completion of your missions. It is by following your example that we shipgirls reach new heights.

mission_complete.line: The rewards for your completed missions are here. Should I... check the address to confirm whether they've arrived at the right place?

profile.line: I am the Royal Navy light carrier, Albion. I was constructed along with Centaur after that great war, and was one of the first aircraft carriers to carry out newly-developed tactics. Please watch over my growth under the tutelage of my Elders, Commander.

propose.line: A... Promise Ring? Um, I don't recall ever asking for one though... You're giving it to me because you love me? O-oh! Yes, I see! I apologise for being so thick-skulled that I didn't have an inkling of your feelings for me. Ehehe, thank you... very much. ♥

skill.line: Please watch what I can do, my dear Elders!

touch.line: U-um, go ahead... So long as you don't touch the rigging of my bow...

touch2.line: H-how embarrassing... Ugh...

unlock.line: My name is Albion, sister ship to light carrier Centaur. As a Childe to this fleet, I hope to receive guidance from everyone in this fleet–– Um, Commander, that also makes you one of my Elders, right?

upgrade.line: The strengthening was a success. Commander, please see for yourself how the ride feels next time we head out.

win_mvp.line: The unblemished Albion thus claims this victory!

gift_prefer.line: A gift bestowed upon me by my Elder... Heehee.

detail_ex.line: While Elder Centaur tends to take after our other Elders and follow what they do, I prefer to learn from them instead. Indeed, I prefer using my brain, just as you do.

expedition_ex.line: Commander, the girls have returned from their commission~ Heehee, that's not the whispers of the wind you're hearing, but rather my breath~ Did you enjoy it?

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, did you need me? I know you didn't call for me, but I could just feel it. As our hearts are now connected, I heard your desires upon the wind... Oh, m-my apologies for getting worked up on my own... Umm... love you, my dear.

home_ex.line: Well done, Commander. As for the after-action report... You'd like me to handle it? Naturally, I'd be delighted to!

login_ex.line: I want to be a more capable secretary like Elder Centaur... Oh, Commander, I'm awaiting your orders.

main4_ex.line: If I could instruct the others in my unique fighting style, we could perhaps implement new tactics in battle. It's certainly not because I want to be called an Elder myself or anything. Heehee.

main5_ex.line: Elder Enterprise really can do just about anything... Though if there's any area I can exceed her in, it's probably cooking, housework, or making my way through the forests like Centaur... Um, huh...?

main6_ex.line: Commander, could you tell me what your favourite book is? I was planning on studying your tastes, just as I have been doing with the other Elders here.

main7_ex.line: Secretary duties aren't so difficult after all now that I've gotten used to things. The bigger issue is how I can take the initiative... I suppose I'll start by taking on some of the Commander's work... Yes, I think that's exactly what I should do.

touch_ex.line: I shall indulge the inquisitive Commander's curiosity. Please, take my hand and hold it tight.

touch2_ex.line: Yes, Commander. Our hearts are connected, now and forever.

win_mvp_ex.line: Phew... It really does take lots of consistent effort to live up to my Elders' expectations. Nevertheless, the unblemished Albion thusly claims this victory!

detail.line: I-I apologise for making a fool of myself... If it's alright with you, can I tag along with you for a bit longer? I'm sure if I try hard enough, I'll be able to step on you more satisfactorily... But don't worry, I'm just playing a role.

feeling5.line: Commander, please continue serving me until the end of time. If you keep your end of the bargain, I swear that I... ehehe, will always take care of all your needs. Both faeries and vampires live long lives, so regardless, I'll always be with you~♪

home.line: Impeccable results. Oh, I suppose I should have a more condescending attitude towards you...? Umm, I suppose those were... passable results?

login.line: Tonight, I shall make a servant of you, Commander. Um... Excuse me, but could you do this favour for me please? *bows*

main1.line: Shall I become a faerie, a vampire, or even a succubus...? Hmm, I wonder, which of these do I see myself being?

main2.line: Elder Vampire has taken me under her tutelage, but it's quite difficult to walk in this outfit... Oh, I'd be just fine with you by my side, though.

main3.line: It feels quite awkward having to give you orders... You know what? You should be the one ordering me around after all. Just say the word, and it shall be done.

touch.line: This outfit is a bit too tight around certain places... Ugh...

touch2.line: So this is what you're like when you've been seduced... I'll have to keep this in mind... Whew... *blushes*

unlock.line: Ah, umm... If you keep staring at me like that... Oh, um, Commander, this is supposed to be a Royalty of the Night costume, right? In that case... Would you mind kneeling for me first?

win_mvp.line: A victory as unblemished as... Oh, I wonder if I can still say that in these black clothes... I-in any case, a victory is a victory!

detail.line: You can let me know if there's anything you ever need, Commander, whether it's for advertising or not. I would love a chance to see my seniors taking such charming photos...

feeling5.line: Heehee, I heard a little whisper just now. The breeze blowing against my ears and the wafting scent of flowers tell me that our hearts are connected, Commander. Do you hear it, too, Commander?

home.line: Thank you for your leadership in battle, Commander. Would you like tea? Our seniors in the Dragon Empery taught me, so I hope you like it...

login.line: I must learn to be a proper model, at least until I'm worthy of this dress... Oh. Welcome back, Commander. Do you have orders for me today?

main1.line: Feeling the nighttime breeze on the veranda, the comforting fragrance of flowers... Hm? You thought that looked good and took a picture? U-umm... Th-that's a little sudden, no? I wasn't even posing yet...

main2.line: Relaxing walks in the forest are nice, but there's a slightly more unique vibe right here. Do you feel it, Commander?

main3.line: Is it easy to move in this dress? Umm... Well, I can fight and do chores just fine... Oh, shall I wear it to secretary duty tomorrow? Hm? You won't be able to focus? But why...?

touch.line: Tickles a little... Do you want a photo like this, Commander?

touch2.line: C-Commander, perhaps we should show restraint for now...

unlock.line: Hand brushing my hair behind my ear, eyes toward the camera... Mm, filming promotional material isn't easy... Commander, will this do?

detail.line: I wanted to make you a tasty, healthy breakfast... Umm, when I was checking the milk temperature, I remembered your warmth, lost my wits for a moment, and... Well, I'm sorry...

feeling5.line: Waking up next to you, making breakfast together, and basking in the morning sun... Life feels so warm and happy. Is it too much to hope that every morning could be like this from now on? Am I being too greedy...?

headtouch.line: I don't have to worry about it too much? Okay... Thank you.

home.line: The smell of something burning woke you up? Um... Sorry. I burned the toast.

login.line: Ugh, I even spilled the milk... It's not on my clothes, is it? Phew. I'd better get this fixed up before the Commander wakes up... Huh? Commander, you're... already awake?

main1.line: Did you sleep well last night? I slept so soundly, and even had a warm dream – with you by my side... Would you like to know what it was about?

main2.line: You want to make breakfast with me? Umm, sure, I don't mind. I'm certain it'll taste better when we make it together.

main3.line: What a beautiful sunny day... Commander, what say we go out for a walk after breakfast?

mission.line: Missions? This early? Don't worry about me. I'll bring breakfast to you as soon as it's ready!

mission_complete.line: Commander, are you done with your missions? Great. I just made a new breakfast for you.

touch.line: C-Commander, may I have a good morning kiss? Oh, goodness... I managed to say it, but it's so embarrassing...

touch2.line: Huh? More milk...? Umm, Commander... Can it wait until after breakfast?

unlock.line: Good morning, Commander. Umm... I was excited to prepare a perfect breakfast for you, but I made some mistakes. Please wait a moment. I'll remake it in no time!

battle.line: The battle is on. Everyone, stick close to me!

detail.line: I spy with my little eye a naughty cat who's snuck into my room to snoop around for secrets... Got you! Hm? No, Commander, this the creature in question – not you.

expedition.line: The commission team's come back. Do you know what comes next, Commander?

feeling1.line: Don't cross that delicate line, Villainous Fiend – or else I'll do everyone a favour and eradicate you.

feeling2.line: Funny our paths should cross here, Commander. Were you looking for me, perchance? Heehee, you're like a doggy, sniffing around in search of its friends♪

feeling3.line: Care to join me? The woods are the perfect place for a tea party... Picnic? Hmm, I suppose it is more like a picnic, now that you say that...

feeling4.line: How's your evening, our Champion? Not too much work? Not feeling burnt out? Heehee. Do give me a call if you need anything. I'll do everything I can, and still consider the things I can't do.

feeling5.line: Eyes open for my marvellous... Heehee, oh, it's nothing important. I simply used an incantation that tells me whenever you're in a spot. Saves you the effort of having to tell me. Convenient, no?

home.line: Splendid work, our Eagle of Victory. Before you go reflect on your performance, shouldn't we celebrate this triumph first?

hp_warning.line: I will not... succumb so easily!

login.line: Good morning, Guardian Knight of the Port. Hope you slept well. You can call on us anytime if you need a word.

lose.line: Well, we lost... Commander, let's retreat for now and have another go later.

mail.line: Oh, this letter is addressed to you. I just assumed it was for me, since it arrived by homing pigeon.

main1.line: Hi there, Unicorn. Do you mind if I take little Yuni on a tour de dessert again? ...Huh? What is it? Did I say something odd?

main2.line: All this work piling up reminds me of herbs brewing in a cauldron... Eyes open, Commander. I'll have this done in a flash.

main3.line: They say to strike while the iron is hot, but I'd say strike even if it's not. What I'm driving at is: let's take a break and clean the office, shall we?

mission.line: Ah, missions... Got it. Shall we do them together, Commander?

mission_complete.line: Heehee. These are more rewards than you can shake a stick at. How lovely.

profile.line: Colossus-class light aircraft carrier Theseus, at your service. Sadly, I just barely missed my chance to fight in the war, but that's okay. Much like my namesake's ship, nothing will change who I am now.

propose.line: I understand. You've given me the ring, but aren't sure how to profess your love. I'll do the honour, just... Oh, you worked up the courage? W-well, that's good! Heehee. Did I do a good job?

skill.line: Eyes open for my might! Taaake THIS!

touch.line: I'm here and listening if you need someone to talk to♪

touch2.line: Whoa! What's gotten into you?

unlock.line: I am Theseus, Colossus-class light aircraft carrier. Well met, Shepherd of the Fleet. If you ever need someone to carry out combat, housework, or an incantation, just call my name.

upgrade.line: Eyes open for my newfound strength!

win_mvp.line: How'd I do? Did I successfully realise the plan you had in mind, Commander?

gift_prefer.line: Wow! A gift from my Champion! ...My eyes are wide open~♪

battle_ex.line: Eyes open for my – and the Commander's – prowess!

detail_ex.line: Ah yes, there's the black cat, hell-bent as always on spying on me... Heehee. Don't be alarmed, Commander. You are always welcome to my room.

expedition_ex.line: The commission team is back in port. I'm going make like a Sakura cat and beckon them to... I've got it wrong?

feeling5_ex.line: Oh, something on your mind, Commander? Heehee. I don't reckon you need an incantation. You're here for the sole purpose of seeing me, isn't that right? Missing me is still a problem, and I know when you have one of those.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, our Seagull of Victory. You've fought admirably. Do you want a pat on the head? Or should I recite an incantation that'll take you straight to dreamland?

login_ex.line: Good morning, my Honourable Knight. May luck be on our side today. Heehee.

main4_ex.line: Hey, Perseus! Are you in the mood for another tea party with Unicorn? Those biscuits we had last time were simply divine!

main5_ex.line: Office is all tidied up and I've struck upon the solution to our next task. It's time to... Wait! First, I have to brew some tea for you, Commander!

main6_ex.line: A swim in the river in the woods? Sounds good! I'll pack my tea set, biscuits, and... Hang on. This sounds an awful lot like a picnic to me...

touch_ex.line: Need something? Heehee, that's my cue. Eyes open, now!

touch2_ex.line: There, there. You're my sunshine, Commander.

win_mvp_ex.line: Victory is ours. Hehe, so, do you have any praise for me, my brave lion of a Commander?

detail.line: Eyes open for my catering skills, Commander! Oh, shoot, this is actually tough to balance... Maybe this is best left to the professional Royal Maids.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. I have some carp ornaments on hand, so... Yeah, let's go hand out some gifts!

login.line: Like the saying goes, the early bird catches the worm. We'd better get a move on before people snatch up all the food, Commander.

main1.line: Gosh, there are so many restaurants. Makes you want to check them all out, doesn't it, Commander?

main2.line: You're meant to have yum cha tea with these manjuus? Sounds questionable... These buns are a far cry from biscuits at a tea party.

main3.line: Unicorn, you and I have... quite different outfits. See, this is an Empery-style dress. The wings make me look a bit like a swan. Heehee.

touch2.line: Oh wow... *blushes*

unlock.line: Steaming hot manjuu buns, ready to be served! Let us have a big feast then gather rosebuds, Commander. Oh, a "holiday gathering" doesn't involve literal gathering?

battle.line: The battlefield... Heh, I'm getting all fired up!

couple_encourage1.line: Let us fight side by side!

couple_encourage2.line: Hrmh! Try as you wish, you won't beat me!

detail.line: There are many Royal Navy ships named "Eagle," and I will go great lengths to maintain its honourable reputation.

expedition.line: Commission complete. Let's go and offer the returning team some biscuits. Don't worry about me, I can do without.

feeling1.line: You're betraying everyone's trust in you by acting like this. Pull yourself together, for god's sake!

feeling2.line: People say I'm not great at socializing, a fact that I begrudge. But my social skills aside, I do know my manners.

feeling3.line: I'm not a frequent attendee at Royal Navy tea parties... Which isn't to say I don't want to, it's just... they bring out snacks at tea parties... What do you think I mean, Commander?! I'd gain weight, that's the problem! ...Sorry, I lost my cool for a sec there.

feeling4.line: Despite my low-calorie diet and daily rigorous exercise, my weight stays the same... *sigh*, I guess my past status as a battleship defines me more than I think... But why?! How does everyone else manage to lose weight just fine?!

feeling5.line: You are irreplaceable to me. Whatever becomes of me... Scratch that. I'll stay the way I am now, just for you. Because I think this is what made me equally irreplaceable to you. Am I right?

home.line: My body weight's still the same as it w– Oh! Commander! Didn't think you'd be back so soon. A-anyway, you'd better give our next mission plan a look!

hp_warning.line: A warrior of the Royal Navy won't back down so easily!

login.line: Great to see you! Based upon your punctuality, I can already tell that you're a responsible commander.

lose.line: Tsk, I've taken damage after fighting for so long... I'll need repairs when we return.

mail.line: There's mail for you. Don't forget to give it a look.

main1.line: Let's see what's on the menu today... Fruits and a vegetable salad. Ideal for a low-calorie diet.

main2.line: How much do I weigh? Ahem, you'd better drop this topic, or else...! Okay, I'm just exaggerating. But I hope you understand that it's a sensitive topic for me.

main3.line: A band of Iron Blood submarines ran away before I could as much as say hello. Again... Guess I'll have to come up with a good way of approaching them.

mission.line: There's still unfinished missions, Commander. We should get them done sooner rather than later.

mission_complete.line: Now that's the face of an accomplished commander. Good job.

profile.line: After having been converted from a battleship into an aircraft carrier, I provided much early experience for the Royal Navy's carrier forces, and my final moments were spent fighting on the battlefield. Though I met a noble warrior's end, I do wish I'd been done in by a cannon or an airstrike, rather than a submarine.

propose.line: I once met my final obstacle in the Suez Canal... But if you ever need saving, I will overcome any obstacle to get to you, Commander. This is my promise not just as a warrior, but as your lover.

touch.line: What is it? An invitation to get lunch? Hmm... Sorry, but could you go in my place?

touch2.line: You see, this is the reason why we have to teach people proper etiquette.

unlock.line: The name is Eagle. I intend to serve your fleet to the utmost of my abilities as a proud warrior of the Royal Navy.

upgrade.line: Enhancements, huh... I just wish they wouldn't affect my weight...

win_mvp.line: To show compassion to your foe is to put the safety of your allies at risk.

gift_prefer.line: Th-thank you... very much...

feeling5_ex.line: Weight and appearances don't bother me as much anymore. We, as ships, can't physically change much anyway, and you're happy with me no matter how I look. We are both irreplaceable to one another, after all.

home_ex.line: My body weight's still the same as it w– Oh, you're back, Commander. Yeah, it's been business as usual in here.

login_ex.line: Commander, if you're tired, you could've just stayed in bed, or arrived late if you wanted. All you need do is let me know about it.

main1_ex.line: Low-calorie diets are a healthy habit, Commander. You should give one a try sometime.

main2_ex.line: I don't really mind showing you my physical exam report. Just to you, Commander.

main3_ex.line: I've gotten better at talking to all the submarines. Knowing you for so long has helped me substantially improve my social skills.

touch_ex.line: An invitation for lunch, eh? With you watching over me, I think I can do it. Let's go.

touch2_ex.line: Despite my weight, I have little meat on my– Wh-what are you doing?!

upgrade_ex.line: That really hit the spot, thank you. No matter how hard the going may get, I will always keep advancing for you.

detail.line: I've come well prepared in hopes of learning the ropes of our infirmary.

home.line: "Weight Loss and Health Care Metholody," eh... Oh, ahem! Good to see you again, Commander. I-I was just reading medical literature, that's all!

login.line: Debrief me on your symptoms. Oh, that doesn't sound like what a doctor would say? Then how about... Do you feel ill?

main1.line: I've come up with a new, healthy diet that improves your physical stamina. Care to give it a try?

main2.line: Treating wounds and saving lives – being a doctor comes with great responsibility, but also great pride.

main3.line: Are you scared of needles, Commander? I understand. Then as part of this training, we should give you a shot, just so– Oh, okay, maybe we shouldn't.

touch.line: Let's take your temperature, just to be sure. Mind if I assist with that?

touch2.line: Umm... Are you feeling lightheaded, Commander? Do you need a thorough examination?

unlock.line: This may be an exercise, but even so I will give it my all. Right now, I am not just a Royal Navy warrior, but a medical resident as well. If you ever feel ill, come see me, Commander.

battle.line: Is that it? Hah! Swordfish squadron, prepare for battle!

couple_encourage1.line: I feel so strong now!

couple_encourage2.line: I've got to set an example for the others!

detail.line: Ark Royal, ready for inspection!

expedition.line: Commissions have been completed, Commander. If there are any cute destroyers in the fleet, allow me to welcome them back myself.

feeling1.line: You can't compare with the destroyers, Commander...

feeling2.line: I... I'm going to say this in advance, but... those destroyer girls... u-um... I mean... I kind of hold them dear... I know how to mind my manners... It's not... it's not a crime!

feeling3.line: I thought you were finally going to have me Court Martialed, Commander! I'm grateful to finally be recognized by you. It's nothing to be ashamed of? Commander, I, Ark Royal, will follow you forever!

feeling4.line: G-good grief... If you were the same size as those destroyers, Commander, I wouldn't be so embarrassed... I was fine with doing this with the little ones... but with you...

feeling5.line: If I were closer to you, Commander, I could get closer with the destroyers too... Of... of course, that can only happen with your approval. I'm more than happy to help you with destroyer inspections! Is that all right, commander?

home.line: Is it time for a break? I'm going to see my destroyer sisters then!

hp_warning.line: If only a destroyer would give me a hug!

login.line: Ready for orders, Commander. I am confident in any kind of battle!

lose.line: Damn, trapped!

mail.line: Do you need to me read out your mail, Commander?

main1.line: You look like you're busy, Commander. I won't bother you then. Let me know if you need anything.

main2.line: Commander, umm... can you tell the destroyers to come to my room? I'd like to give them presents.

main3.line: This is... So cute! *pat pat* Eh? Wh-when did you get here, Commander?!

mission.line: Commander, it's a soldier's duty to complete missions!

mission_complete.line: Commander, to leave your rewards unclaimed is disrespect to the mission.

profile.line:
Ark Royal, reporting in! I'm the first aircraft carrier specifically designed and built for the role in the Royal Navy, I'm proud of being a prototype to all other carriers that followed. 
 Little needs to be said about my feats against the Bismarck. Rather I must ask, are there any of those cute little destroyers in our fleet?

propose.line: I'll take care of all the destroyers from now on! No one can touch Commander or my destroyers. No one!

skill.line: It's time for you to leave!

touch.line: Your warm hands keep me energized to keep fighting, Commander!

touch2.line: Eh... Commander... please don't... Why are you doing this?!

unlock.line: Ark Royal, reporting in for duty! I am confident in all manners of battle. Why, it was I who managed to destroy Bismarck's rudder!

upgrade.line: Oh! oh! oh! Allow me to protect you, my destroyer friends!

win_mvp.line: An enemy who loses their ability to steer will be doomed!

gift_prefer.line: This is...! Your Excellency, how did you even know? Thank you so much!

battle_ex.line: Fulmar squadron, Swordfish squadron, prepare to launch!

detail_ex.line: Commander, I'll take care of the destroyers... Err, WE'LL take care of the destroyers! As long as we're around, no one can do them harm!

login_ex.line: Commander, I am ready to act. I mean ready to fight, of course! Let us show the enemy the might of a Royal Navy aircraft carrier!

main1_ex.line: What am I thinking? Oh, just about you, and the fleet.

main2_ex.line: You want to call the destroyer girls here to your office, do you...? Commander, this is a task you must entrust to me, Ark Royal!

main3_ex.line: The outfit Glorious, Acasta, and Ardent recommended... should go like this. One must be more careful next time.

main4_ex.line: That little submarine is missing again. Heavens, she's always stealing away into other people's rooms to play hide and seek...

touch2_ex.line: Commander! N-not here...!

win_mvp_ex.line: It is thanks to the Commander's guidance that I reach my full potential and seize victory!

detail.line: It is dangerous to let the destroyers play on the beach alone... I suggest setting aside time every day to allow them to frolic together.

login.line: Summer, huh... Commander, do you enjoy the summertime? I know I do.

main1.line: To be honest, Commander, I wanted to provide everyone with some toys to play with while on the beach, but don't know what would be well received. Could I go consult the destroyers to see what they think?

main2.line: Commander, why have you been staring at me this whole time? Huh, I'm "quite the beauty when I'm not running my mouth"...?!

main3.line: Some say that my tastes are a bit questionable, but I have complete confidence in my abilities as secretary ship. I'll take care of the work!

touch.line: Destroyers frolicking around in swimsuits? Where?! ...Commander, don't mess with me like that!

unlock.line: Nothing says summer like the sun, the beach, and destroyers... Ahem! Th-that's right! Even though we're relaxing, we still have to keep an eye out for enemy destroyers! Commander, I may be in a swimsuit, but I'm ready to sortie at any time!

battle.line: Time to get rid of some troublemakers!

detail.line: You need to inspect what's on my camera? Well... let's not worry about it until after the party. I promise I'll hand over every last negative!

home.line: Ooooooh! Brilliant! Perfect! – Ahem! Erm, well, that's right! This is just your average, everyday record keeping here. I'm not doing anything weird at all! No siree!

login.line: Commander, status report: all quiet over here.

main1.line: This camera is strictly for security recording purposes. You never know what might happen. Of course, I could also use it to record some tender moments.

main2.line: Are you cold, Commander? You can have my jacket.

main3.line: This party is so noisy, so rowdy. It's my responsibility to take watch over those sweet, innocent, little destroyer girls!

touch.line: Oh, don't worry about me. While everyone else sinks into the enrapturing atmosphere of the evening, someone has to stay sober and alert.

touch2.line: You want to dance with me? But, Commander, this... isn't this a little out of the ordinary?

unlock.line: One tends to let her guard down at a party like this, but worry not! Put the ball in my hands and let Ark Royal keep you safe!

detail.line: I can use this gun for ceremonial salutes, as well. I'll put her to good use at the banquet!

home.line: To be able to watch over the destro– The fleet here, that's the best new year's gift anyone could give me.

login.line: The more peaceful and inviting the atmosphere, the more one wants to protect it. What do you think, Commander?

main1.line: Oh those destroyers in their Eastern dresses... Ah, I was just thinking how captivating it all is. These New Year's celebrations really are splendid!

main2.line: I have already committed everything important about the New Year's programming to memory. If you need anything, Commander, do let me know.

main3.line: Wherever there is trouble, I shall be there! Such is my solemn oath as guardian of the new year!

touch.line: Commander, would you like to personally carry out the gun salute? Mind the recoil.

touch2.line: My neckline is off? Oh, thank you... Oh my, no, it doesn't go like this, does it?!

unlock.line: Commander, Happy New Year. Oh no, I'm not going hunting. I'm patrolling the port during the New Year's celebrations. Naturally, I volunteered for the job.

detail.line: I've been here a few times before. They've never seated me near destroyers due to my reputation... But that's fine. I anticipated as much.

home.line: I'm relieved to see the destroyers are back safe and sound. Wish I could be with them on dangerous missions... Ah, forget I said that. I'm not going anywhere, you hear?

login.line: Oh, you're back. Well, I'm not actually surprised – I saw you coming.

main1.line: Mmm, the smell of coffee beans... Don't give me that "wasn't expecting to hear that" look! Even I can appreciate a good cup of coffee!

main2.line: Wh-where'd you get that camera?! Oh god, don't tell me it's all over for me... What? That's your personal camera? Oh, I see... Phew.

main3.line: I record everything that goes on in here. Let's just say it's for security reasons. That's the only reason, you hear?! My conscience is clean!

touch.line: Sod off! I'm not letting anyone have my destroyer footage!

touch2.line: Commander, please, save it for another time. I'm trying to hear what the destroyers are talking about.

unlock.line: This is the place, Commander. What are you going to order? Me, I think I'll have the same as you... Yeah, so what? I just felt like grabbing a coffee with you for once.

feeling5.line: Here's an idea for after work is over – there's going to be a fireworks display at the park tonight. Ahem... Do you care to come with me, Commander?

headtouch.line: I'll let you touch me now, but do refrain from it when I need to reestablish order!

home.line: Oh, you're back. Came to check on the amusement park, did you? Everything is fine! Maintaining order is a piece of cake!

login.line: Do you have any plans today? Got any rides you want to go on? I can introduce you to some fun ones if you want.

main1.line: Stay in the queue! Don't cut ahead – it's dangerous! ...How's that, Commander? I don't come off as too bossy, do I?

main2.line: This height sign is meant to determine whether or not you're eligible to ride – it's not at all an excuse for me to get up close with destroyers! Want to see how you compare?

main3.line: Why I volunteered for the job of maintaining order? Because my heart beats for law and order! ...I'm a terrible liar, you say? Ahem, well...

mission.line: You ought to complete your missions before you spend the whole day making merry!

touch.line: My plans after I'm done maintaining order? Hmm... Don't have any yet.

touch2.line: Commander... N-now's not a good time for this!

unlock.line: Commander! Here to enjoy yourself? Me, I'm working tirelessly on keeping order around the amusement park! ...That sounds fun to you? Alright, then watch how it's done!

feeling5.line: Since we've grown so intimate, I assume it's now safe to tell you that I've become... r-r-rather intimate with the little destroyers too! Of course, you are still number one in my heart, Your Excellency!

home.line: Taking a leisure break, I assume? Then won't you accompany me to check on the little destroyers, Your Excellency?

mail.line: Allow me to read your letter aloud, Your Excellency.

main4.line: I brandish my rigging to protect this sacred moment in time!

touch.line: Interested in trying my home cooking? I've trained under the Royal Maids, and I'm 99% sure I can prepare a good meal!

unlock.line: I never thought a day would come when even I don such attire... Ahem. Your Excellency, I shall protect your happiness, as well as that of my destroyer sisters!

detail.line: Everyone has something dear they wouldn't give up for the world. Whatever yours may be, Commander, allow me to protect it with you!

home.line: I need to go check on the destroyers! I'll be right back, Commander!

login.line: At last you're here, Commander! Assign me any missions you need done!

main1.line: My Swordfish squadrons are in tip-top condition today! Likewise for my Fulmar squadrons!

main2.line: It is customarily destroyers that protect carriers, but there's nothing wrong with reversing that. Don't you agree?

main3.line: To protect what's close to you, you must always keep a watchful eye on the horizon. I trust you to do that, Commander.

touch.line: As long as I have your support, I can brave the battlefield without reserve!

touch2.line: Commander...? Excuse me, but what's gotten into you?!

unlock.line: Ark Royal retrofitting complete! Now I can protect you, my friends, and of course, the little destroyers, to the very end!

battle.line: Why cause unnecessary conflict?

couple_encourage1.line: You haven't changed one bit, Miss Saratoga.

couple_encourage2.line: May the light illuminate Kaede's Legion!

detail.line: Could you help me pick up that handkerchief...? I'd lose my balance if I try to pick it up myself...

expedition.line: The light shall disperses the fog of darkness. Oh? The girls are back!

feeling1.line: Not even my light can reach the darkness within your heart?

feeling2.line: Commander, what do you find most important in a girl? Seriously, could you look me in the eyes when we're speaking?

feeling3.line: Commander, while I'm like this, I take a special liking towards suprise night attacks. Seriously, I didn't mean it like that, but is the Commander into things like that?

feeling4.line: Commander... do you want to try... a soft landing?

feeling5.line: No matter what you ask of me, Commander, I'll accept it... So, Commander, please tell me how you feel about me.

home.line: Feeling tired? Relax for a while. How about a massage?

hp_warning.line: Don't panic, Commander. I'm here!

login.line: Greetings, Commander. I've tidied up a bit here. What do you think?

lose.line: Let's retreat, lest I lose my life...

mail.line: Here's your mail, Commander! Should I open it for you?

main1.line: Have you seen where did I put my planes? Oh? Right in front of me? Sorry, something blocked my line of sight.

main2.line: Commander... can you feel my heartbeat through the palm of your hand?

main3.line: Commander, why are you always staring at me? Am I that pretty?

mission.line: Commander, it's no good to leave missions unfinished.

mission_complete.line: Don't forget to collect your rewards, Commander!

profile.line: Greetings, Commander. I am the armored aircraft carrier Illustrious. I may seem gentle, but I have quite the temper. I single-handedly bullied the Italian fleet during the raid at Taranto.

propose.line: Even though light should be shared equally among us all, it's fine for you to have a bit more. After all, I've received something important from the Commander as well.

touch.line: It's as though... I've received your recognition, Commander. I feel so relieved.

touch2.line: Seriously, Commander, you're like a little kid.

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander! Aircraft carrier Illustrious reporting in! I pray that you will bring love and peace to this world. May the light be with you.

upgrade.line: This way we can radiate our brilliance even further.

win_mvp.line: The light shines upon our land of triumph.

gift_prefer.line: Commander, your feelings are what motivate me to work hard~

main1.line: Commander, how does it taste? Today’s scones are Edinburgh’s signature dish.

main2.line: Commander, black tea is supposed to be sipped~ At the very least, pay attention not to spill your drink.

main3.line: Compared to the glaring sunset, I prefer this bright and gentle sunlight, what about you Commander?

touch2.line: Commander, you can’t act this way… at the tea party.

unlock.line: Sun kissed skin, scrumptious snacks and delicious black tea. It’s as if both my mind and body have been rejuvenated— Commander, care to join me for some leisurely chit-chat?

detail.line: I always feel my heart racing when I wear a different outfit in front of you, Commander~

login.line: Good day, Commander. Are you ready to attend the ball?

main1.line: As dance partners, we should hold hands like this... Commander, can you feel my warmth?

main3.line: The orchestra has started playing~ Commander, would you like to dance with me?

touch.line: Did you want to talk, Commander? I'll always be here to listen to you~

touch2.line: Commander, being proud about doing something inappropriate doesn't make it any less inappropriate.

unlock.line: An invitation to the ball? Hehe, I would be honored to go... as long as you don't decline, Commander~

home.line: Good work out there, Commander. I've prepared some authentic incense for you. Why don't we close our eyes for a bit and uplift our spirits~

login.line: Greetings, Commander. Sorry for taking so long, but fixing my clothes took quite a bit of time... I'm not late, am I?

main1.line: I look like a princess from a foreign country? Hehe, you're making me blush...

main2.line: Commander, it is only because of you that we are able to experience so many different cultures. Being able to be at your side is my greatest pleasure~

main3.line: Commander, can I lean against you and rest for a while? This time, I want to listen to your heartbeat~

unlock.line: This is my first time wearing such exotic fashion, hehe~. Commander, if you like how I look, how about showing me off a little~?

detail.line: This festival may be a foreign custom to many of us here, but I think it's delightful we get to enjoy it nonetheless. And it's all thanks to your efforts, Commander. Hehe.

home.line: You're looking well. What good news have you brought Illustrious today?

login.line: How do you do, Commander? May this splendid holiday wash away all your worries.

main1.line: All these Iris flowers are not just for showy decoration, they make for some aromatherapy as well. Hehe.

main2.line: These Dragon Empery decorations all have a certain... unique charm to them, don't they?

main3.line: Commander, you absolutely must try the Empyreal cuisine the Royal Maids prepared. I've heard even Her Majesty praised the flavour. Hehehe.

touch.line: Is there something you would like to do with me?

touch2.line: Just this once, on this special day, I'll indulge your childishness~ Hehehe.

unlock.line: It is my honour to get to wear another faction's garments. However... this traditional Dragon Empery dress feels rather tight around the chest area...

battle.line: I devote this song to peace...

detail.line: No matter where you go, I want my melodies to follow you... As such, I've asked Formidable to record them. Just let her know whenever you'd like to hear one, Commander.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned, I see. Erm, then the next song I should play is...

headtouch.line: Heehee. Commander, is something wrong?

home.line: Commander, congratulations on another well-fought battle. You... would like me to play a tune for you? Heehee, then I hope this healing song meets your expectations.

login.line: Are you awake, Commander? I shall once again accompany you throughout your day.

lose.line: I know that kindness alone is not enough to win, and yet...

main1.line: Excuse me... Would you like to take a break? Haha, then I'll play a tune to help you relax—Oh. You'd prefer if we rested together...?

main2.line: So Indomitable didn't come, after all... No, I know that she and Formidable don't feel comfortable at these occasions. I told them they don't have to force themselves.

main3.line: Where did I learn to play the harp? Hmm... Heehee♪ Would you believe me if I self-studied, just like with singing?

touch.line: Please rest within this gentle melody, Commander.

touch2.line: Commander? ...Heehee, wait just a little longer.

unlock.line: A gentle melody for a peaceful celebration. Today, Commander, I offer this tune to you and the people of the port. May my melody please your ears♪

win_mvp.line: This tune, and this brilliance, will commemorate our triumphant return.

detail.line: Commander... Could you keep this little private study session a secret between you and me? Heehee, I'd like it to be a special memory for just the two of us.

feeling5.line: Thank you so much for taking time out of your busy schedule to help me. I know none of this is relevant to you... Hm? You say it's actually very important to learn this? Heehee, I agree♪

headtouch.line: Phew... Heehee, you learned how to do it just like the book says, Commander.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. If you're tired... I could rub your back for you?

login.line: Greetings, Commander... Heehee, your timing is impeccable. When you're ready, won't you come practice with me?

main1.line: When you're making milk from powder, it's important to drip a few drops on your hand to check the temperature. It doesn't feel hot, so I think it's ready for drinking. Here you go, Commander~

main2.line: Commander, could I try... holding you in my arms while I sing a lullaby? Heehee, I fancy myself a decent singer♪

main3.line: Hm? You came here just to find me? Because you think I have a "lovely motherliness" to me...?

mission.line: Commander, try not to get too focused on your practice. You should still have missions to complete.

touch2.line: C-Commander... Do you want to practice this, too...?

unlock.line: Oh, Commander? It's a pleasure to see you. Umm, I'm currently going over some... "extracurricular studies." If you have some time to spare, would you mind joining me?

detail.line: I'll always be with you no matter where you go, Commander!

home.line: Tired, Commander? Why not take a rest? Eh, on my lap? It can't be helped I guess.

login.line: Greetings, Commander. Did you have a good rest?

main1.line: When will true peace come to these waters?

main2.line: Commander, my heart is beating so fast. Can you feel it?

main3.line: You're always number one in my heart, Commander.

touch.line: Just whisper in my ear if you have anything to say~! *giggles*

touch2.line: I'm not opposed to intimacy, every now and then~!

unlock.line: The end of sorrow, the beginning of happiness, and the desire for eternity.

battle.line: Sigh, all that cannons and gunpowder can do is make is war even uglier...

couple_encourage1.line: Pleasure to meet again, little Ms. Flat-As-A-Pancake.

couple_encourage2.line: Illustrious, y-your bust is just too busty!

couple_encourage3.line: Let's bring your sister along for a tea party next time.

couple_encourage4.line: Can you talk like normal people?

detail.line: In both love and war, one should be brave~ So, be brave, and if you need support, I shall be there!

expedition.line: Stop loafing around! I promised the commission team that I'd use my planes to photograph the moment they entered the port!

feeling1.line: I'm fed up~! I'll knock you out stone cold!

feeling2.line: You know about me from the Battle of Trafalgar? Umm, aren't you thinking of somebody else? Please, Commander~ Who you're thinking of is totally unrelated to me.

feeling3.line: My part in the pursuit of Bismarck and Operation Tungsten? I was just in the mood to help, I wasn't at all trying to earn any honours.

feeling4.line: I'm not in such a great mood... Are you free, Commander? Great! Then let me dress you in something fabulous! Seeing beautiful things makes me feel better, you see!

feeling5.line: I wonder what the future you will be like, Commander~ Of course, I already quite like the way you are right now. ...Goodness, you're blushing ear to ear. How utterly adorable you are~

home.line: To celebrate your victory, why not wear this olive wreath? I'm certain it'll suit you.

hp_warning.line: Oh dear, I've let my guard down.

login.line: The quiet sea, the cool sea breeze... Even in this moment, the birth of new, beautiful things blesses us.

lose.line: Remaining dignified even in defeat: this is how one should lose a battle!

mail.line: Handwritten letters are so much better than typed ones. Don't you think it's interesting how you can deduce the author's emotions based on their handwriting, Commander?

main1.line: War is ugly. And this olive wreath is the symbol of peace and beauty.

main2.line: Tirpitz, if you won't come out and have fun with me then I'll bomb your room again!

main3.line: I don't like violence, but using it is often the quickest solution to many problems...

mission.line: Only I have the privilege of being selfish. Don't even think about pushing missions onto me.

mission_complete.line: Fine, but just this one time! I won't help you with your missions a second time!

profile.line: I'm Victorious, Illustrious-class aircraft carrier number two! From the Atlantic Ocean to the Indian Ocean, and even the Pacific... where the ocean breeze goes, I follow!

propose.line: Don't think too hard about it. Just follow my lead at your own pace. ...Come on, this is a day to celebrate, don't be so nervous~ From this day on, you'd better work hard to always please me!

skill.line: O beautiful world, sing to me a song!

touch.line: When you feel down, I also do. Come on, you have someone as beautiful as me beside you, so why not be happy?

touch2.line: Y-you just did "that," didn't you?! B-by "that," I mean...

unlock.line: I am the one called Victorious, Aircraft Carrier of the Royal Navy. Yes, sing my name as you herald the coming of the symbol of victory. As long as I am here, our endeavours shall be smooth!

upgrade.line: Words are not needed to praise me! It's not people's words that touch the heart, it's their actions!

win_mvp.line: When my foes have been this thoroughly defeated... not even I, the symbol of victory, can truly be glad.

gift_prefer.line: Quite thoughtful of you. Thank you.

battle.line: Since you messed up the day off I was so looking forward to, I'm going to have to punish you!

detail.line: Do you need advice from the beautiful Victorious? Whether it's fashion tips or relationship trouble, you can ask me anything~!

home.line: Phew, is the battle finally over? As I said, let's go out and have some fun!

login.line: Way! Too! Slow! Commander, what does your schedule look like today? Hurry up and finish so you can take me shopping!

main1.line: Rest is for the sake of being able to work better! Therefore, set aside that work and come play with me~!

main2.line: Tirpitz, come and play with me~ I won't do anything to you~!

main3.line: Stay in tip-top condition so you can work hard and play hard! That's my motto~!

touch.line: This outfit is surprisingly warm... Even in this kind of weather, I don't feel cold at all!

unlock.line: Hum~ dee dum♪~ I'm all dressed up, and my hair is perfect! Commander, I'm ready to go! Don't keep me waiting on a holiday!

battle.line: Let's teach them a harsh lesson!

detail.line: A few words of advice from me: Invitations should be sent early, the venue should be grandiose, the programme should be discussed with everyone, and your attire should be flamboyant — just like mine~♪

home.line: As a celebration of victory, why not decorate your office with this red New Year poster? Isn't it about time for a change in atmosphere?

login.line: ♪~ What should we start off with today?

main1.line: Having trouble deciding? If I was in your position, I'd just circle everything, then figure out the specifics later.

main2.line: Unicorn, what kind of outfit would you like for next time? I'll make it for you~

main3.line: I'll have an eye out for you, so if you need me for anything, just call~

mission.line: If you have any questions about your mission, you can always ask me. I'll be glad to give you my advice.

mission_complete.line: I shall guide you until the rewards are secure in your hands— so, why don't you hurry up and do that?

touch.line: I added a slight twist to my outfit this time. Can you spot what it is~?

touch2.line: Y-you put your work down just to do something like this?!

unlock.line: Are you preparing to hold an event for the port? Hehe, sounds like you could use my help. Don't worry, with someone as beautiful as me around, anything you do will surely be blessed with success!

win_mvp.line: A beautiful victory — now this is elegance~ Hehe~♪

battle.line: This is a bit hard to move in... Though I hardly need to lift a finger to achieve victory.

detail.line: A beautiful lady deserves beautiful surroundings. Oh, I'm joking♪ However beautiful the surroundings, I need you to be complete, Commander.

expedition.line: For the souvenirs... Oh! It's our turn to get souvenirs from the commission team.

home.line: To celebrate this victory... Oh, I'd better eat my watermelon now! Heehee♪

login.line: *huff puff*... The tea feels warmer than it should be because it's getting chilly outside... Should I just switch to iced tea instead?

main1.line: It's nice to for once have someone else tailor my clothes for me... I think I'll read up a little on Sakuran clothing when I return home.

main2.line: Invite Indomitable to come along next time? It'd be a hard idea to sell, because she feels just wearing a kimono is a chore. Though, maybe she will agree if YOU invite her?

main3.line: *Yaaawn*... Get me some dangos, Commander♪ I've heard they're a must-eat when you're gazing at the moon.

mission.line: Give being selfish a try, Commander. For example, you could decide, "I'm not doing any missions day!"

mission_complete.line: So, you completed a mission. I'll let you have this piece as your reward.

touch.line: I'll have another bath when I come back♪ Would you like to join me, Commander?

touch2.line: H-how forthright... *blushes*

unlock.line: *Yaaawn*... Basking in the autumnal night's wind while gazing at the moon is the very definition of elegance, is it not? Heehee. Right now, I am not acting as a Lady of the Royal Navy, but rather as an "ojou" of the Sakura Empire elegantly enjoying her tea... Hyeep! Hot?!

win_mvp.line: Elegantly, gracefully, and beautifully – that's how I will beat you up!

battle.line: Ladies of the Royal Navy have many virtues, but mercy to enemies is not one of them!

couple_encourage1.line: Illustrious, my dear sister, what would you say to a spot of tea after this?

couple_encourage2.line: Victorious, my dear sister, have I comported myself well today?

detail.line: ?! ... Ah, I was just doing a bit of tidying up. Please, come right in.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission is complete. Shall we go to the harbour and greet the team?

feeling1.line: I'm afraid I've contracted a disease that gives me a dreadful headache when you're nearby. Would you mind going someplace else?

feeling2.line: Commander, is there something required of me? If you have a moment, why not join me for a cup of tea?

feeling3.line: My big sisters Illustrious and Victorious, like so many other ships you've gathered here, vouch for what a great commander you are. Now come, let this cake be a symbol of our new friendship. Take a bite, won't you?

feeling4.line: Truthfully, even though I'm a Lady of the Royal Navy, I sometimes want to have a bit of fun too. A side of me that I can't normally show except to people close to me like Illustrious... Doesn't that make you want to get closer with me?

feeling5.line: Commander, good day to you ♪ Shall we share another cake today? The maids have prepared a dreadfully sweet treat for us! Hmm...? I decided to let my hair down a bit more for you, Commander. Hehehe, I wonder if you'll find me just as captivating a Formidable as I was before?

home.line: Hmm~♪ Hmm~♪ C-Commander! I am p-pleased that you have returned!

hp_warning.line: You are all to redouble your efforts!

login.line: Commander, you're uncharacteristically punctual today.

lose.line: Why you miserab- Ahem! You are truly worthy adversaries, but next time victory will be mine!

mail.line: Commander, I'm leaving the mail right here. Please don't forget to review it.

main1.line: Commander, if you're not making any progress on your work, why not take a break? I've prepared tea and crumpets.

main2.line: No harm in taking a rest while the Commander's dist– Heavens! Victorious! G-good day. Do you have some business with the Commander?

main3.line: On the day of my launch, hmm... What a shame... though I didn't do it on purpose... Well! All water under the bridge now, isn't it?

mission.line: Commander, please don't forget to review the mission list I prepared for you.

mission_complete.line: Commander, please don't forget to review the list of mission rewards.

profile.line: I am Formidable, third ship of the Illustrious class. I operated in the Mediterranean for a time, crossing swords with a certain Veneto. Thereafter, I found myself all across the Seven Seas. While my service record is not particularly impressive, I feel I made a small contribution to the war effort.

propose.line: I, Formidable, hereby dedicate my life to the love of my Commander, through good times and bad, rich times and poor... This is quite long, so I'll omit the rest~ Now then, Commander, it's your turn. I know it's a long vow but you are not to skip a single word ♪

touch.line: I must admit, Tirpitz is quite the hard nut to crack.

touch2.line: Commander, is this the appropriate way for one to behave?

unlock.line: Good day, Commander. I am Formidable, third ship of the Illustrious class. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

upgrade.line: Formidable shall not disappoint.

win_mvp.line: What a magnificent victory! Let us press the advantage.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you for your kindness, Commander.

detail_ex.line: The posters on the walls are all my favourite rock stars. I don't usually let anyone see them. You're a special exception, Commander~

expedition_ex.line: Ding dong ding dong ♪, incoming message from Formidable: Commission complete. Repeat. Commission complete.

home_ex.line: Commander, I'm going to catch a few winks on the sofa here. Wake me up if anyone comes calling.

login_ex.line: You're late, Commander. I've been waiting for ages!

main1_ex.line: That Ajax, she saw straight through me right away... And yet, I think we get along rather well. I've learned a lot from her.

main2_ex.line: Haah... I'm back. Those tea parties have some delicious snacks, sure, but they're so dreadfully uptight about bearing and deportment.... Hehehe, Commander, would you mind helping me with my shoes?

main3_ex.line: Commander, which of my sisters is more your type? The sweet and gentle Illustrious, or the passionate Victorious?

mail_ex.line: Commander, the mail is here. Would you mind getting it yourself?

mission_ex.line: Big Brother, I finished organizing your mission list ♪ ... Hehe, is that your type, Commander?

mission_complete_ex.line: Commander, do you want your mission rewards or do you want me? You have to choose! ... Hehe, just kidding~

touch_ex.line: Commander, don't you think Veneto looks a bit dim, cool as she might be?

touch2_ex.line: Commander, should I be angry? Positively inconsolable?

detail.line: Are you done warming up, Commander? Right then, into the water with you♪

home.line: I was simply waiting here for you. Don't think too much on it, Commander.

main1.line: Don't you find the atmosphere rather dreary...? What if we put on some rock... Er, something a little more stimulating?

main2.line: Hmm, that would be Hood. Even in a swimsuit she's the picture of nobility. Of course, that's nothing I'm not incapable of...

main3.line: Don't fret, Warspite. I wouldn't be able to swim without the Commander's help either!

touch.line: Huh? Illustrious?! Grr... You tricked me, Commander. Now you're in for it!

touch2.line: Okay, I see how it is. The salty sea air has gotten you all frisky, Commander. Hehehe...

unlock.line: A Lady of the Royal Navy exudes elegance even when wearing her swimsuit. Huh...? Y-you're not seeing it? Really... that's weird...

detail.line: What do you think of my outfit? I was only able to wear it with the help of Dido and the others...

home.line: Commander, are you still busy? I appreciate the work you've put in to prepare tonight's party.

login.line: Ahem. I see you are as punctual as ever. Thank you for attending the party.

main1.line: Sirius made a few errors at the beginning, but thanks to Dido, they were finally able to get me changed safely...

main2.line: Commander, your collar is all crooked. Here, come have a look in the mirror.

main3.line: I wonder what kind of dresses my sisters will wear... Ahem. I have no doubt that they will be splendrous indeed.

touch.line: You'd like a dance? Very well, Formidable shall be your partner.

touch2.line: Commander?! Th-the maids are still here!

unlock.line: Yes, this will do wonderfully! Thank you, ladies. Phew... Getting dressed is so dreadfully time-consuming... Ahem! How silly of me. I must not whine in the presence of others.

detail_ex.line: Would you please describe how gorgeous my dress is? Yes, and kindly don't stop until I feel I've heard enough ♪

home_ex.line: Commander, are you still busy? I'm afraid I can't be of much assistance, but I can give you a wink to keep your spirits up. Best of luck ♪

login_ex.line: Hehe~ I've waited for you all this time, Commander. I would've preferred it if you'd come a little sooner, though. Hehehe~

main1_ex.line: Has my hair gotten entangled? How?! I'm always going to such lengths to prevent it! What if Sirius is trying to– Oh, it's all right now? Th-thank you.

main2_ex.line: Come here for a moment, Commander! Let's straighten out your uniform... There! Perfect!

main3_ex.line: Commander, I'm sure my sisters all have splendrous dresses, but do not forget about your dear Formidable.

touch_ex.line: You'd like a dance? Certainly. Allow me to be your first, and hopefully, your favourite partner.

touch2_ex.line: Commander! I urge you to pat my head at once! Or else I will ignore you for the rest of the party!

detail.line: Heheh, I actually like the vibe of a classroom more than I expected. It feels oddly freeing.

feeling5.line: Commander, do you have any plans for lunch period? Me? Not really. Of course, doing nothing is fine. One adorable academy student is right in front of you – isn't that enough to satisfy you?

home.line: Oh, welcome back! ...What's this? You brought me lunch? Thank you so much!

login.line: Nnngh... Hnnh! Phew... Who made erasing chalk so difficult?! Huh? C-Commander? How long have you been standing there?!

main1.line: Nnnh... This patch of chalk is beyond my reach. If I stand on a chair... What? You think it can't possibly be that strong? You're making me angry, Commander.

main2.line: Commander, do you have any plans for lunch? Umm... If you don't, would you like to join me?

main3.line: Today's class was nothing a royal lady such as myself cannot handle. Umm, though I did struggle to understand some of it...

touch.line: Oh... Is there chalk residue on my shoulder? No? You just wanted to give me a massage? Th-thank you.

touch2.line: Eep?! What do you think you're doing?! You really expect me to believe you were just brushing chalk off? At least come up with a real excuse!

unlock.line: Good afternoon, Commander. Why am I still in class during lunch break? Heheh, as you can see, I'm on duty. Commander, won't you spend some time with me while I prepare for the next class?

win_mvp.line: Heheh, just call me the perfect student on duty!

detail_ex.line: Alone in the classroom with a student... What happens next? Heehee, don't worry, I already know. Your eyes have been glued to me for so long already!

home_ex.line: W-welcome back! I made a boxed lunch for you, Commander. Would you like it now?

main3_ex.line: Time spent with you is so peaceful and nice... Heehee, and I don't have to carry myself with the bearing of a royal lady, either. "I love you, Commander♪"

touch2_ex.line: Eep?! Commander, you'd better have a good explanation this time! ..."Sorry, honey sweetest"? Now you're just messing with me... Oh, forget it.

detail.line: I really just wanted to decorate a little and give you a private concert, and then maybe... Umm, anyway, I didn't expect to end up like this! My plans are in tatters!

expedition.line: The commission team is done. C-Commander, you'll stay with me, won't you...?

feeling5.line: Let's begin the show. But first... I need you to forget the state you saw me in! ...Huh? You don't want to, because you found it cute? Who taught you to be so corny... If that's how you feel, then I want you to remember how cute you found it forever... But you won't tell a soul, you hear me?!

headtouch.line: My hair's going to be such a mess... What? It already is?!

home.line: Can you please get this cat away from me?! I'm scared I'll hit it with the scissors... Hyaaah?! Don't pull there, please!

login.line: Goodness, Commander, how long are you going to stand there?! Hurry and... untangle this thing!

main1.line: Commander, why are you still standing there? Come sit next to me. Phew, my leg is sore from being in that position for so long... Could you massage it for me?

main2.line: I rehearsed these songs for you. If you'd like to make a request... Heheh, of course. They're all rock songs!

main3.line: You want to try my electric guitar? Okay, hold it like this, and put your hand here... Come on, Commander. You're not the one tied up – relax a little.

touch.line: How did I turn out like this, you ask? Gee, I'd like to know that, myself!

touch2.line: Do you not consider that taking advantage of me, Commander?!

unlock.line: Phew... Finally got the scissors... Wait, C-Commander?! Why are you here already?! Close the door quickly and look away... N-no, actually, come and help me untangle this ribbon!

headtouch_ex.line: ...That won't be enough to please me! Hmph!

main3_ex.line: I finished tuning, so I can finally start my solo concert♪ I prepared this just for you, so listen closely... It's not even started yet, and you're already watching so intently. Heehee, I really am your favorite, aren't I?

touch2_ex.line: Keep going, and you're in trouble! ...Apologize all you want, I'm not listening! Ahh...

battle.line: Elegantly... and gorgeously!

detail.line: My love, along with everyone else's, has been put into this dress. It's the most perfect and elegant attire for today! Well, it would be even more perfect if it had some rock-and-roll energy in it...

expedition.line: Our commission team is back. Mmm~ This is a good opportunity to stretch our legs...

feeling5.line: Hmm... Now that I've changed into this dress, I feel a little restless for some reason. If I mess up such an important day for everyone... Oh! I know! It's because there's so much riding on my efforts today... You think I can take it easy? I-if you say so... don't blame me for anything that happens, okay?

headtouch.line: C-Commander... I see you're doing your best, too.

home.line: Welcome home. I will elegantly take care of the rest for you, okay? Heehee♪

login.line: Welcome, Commander. Come and celebrate the big day with me. Heehee♪

mail.line: Your mail? Right here, of course!

main1.line: "Elegant and gorgeous, like a Royal lady." Hehe♪ Commander, you were just taken by the sight of me, weren't you?

main2.line: Shall we go to the venue together? I'm sure to get tired if I'm left to walk alone in this dress...

main3.line: (The Commander's been staring for a while... What part of me is so attention-grabbing? My legs? My chest? Hmm...)

mission.line: If you had to choose between me and your missions... y-you WOULD choose me, right?!

mission_complete.line: Big Brother, your mission rewards are riiight here, nya♪

touch.line: Be careful not to stain the dress, please!

touch2.line: Th-this is how our relationship is now, after all...

unlock.line: To both express my eternal love and gratitude to you and celebrate the wonderful days we've spent together, I will be joining in the port's celebration. ...Ahem, Commander? Tell me the next part!

win_mvp.line: I dedicate this wonderful victory to you, Commander!

detail_ex.line: "Formidable has become an elegant Royal lady and an esteemed songstress of the port." Commander, what do you think of that profile? Umm, it might overlap with my sisters a little, but... Wh-what? You think it's perfect?!

main3_ex.line: What have you been staring so fixedly at? ...You just wanted to make me ask? Well, that's just naughty.

touch_ex.line: You do love affection, don't you, Commander?♪

touch2_ex.line: Heehee. Commandeeer...♡

battle.line: Search and destroy!

couple_encourage1.line: This time, we fight together!

detail.line: Expect great things for me, for I am Glorious! Of... of course! I'll be your glory forever!

expedition.line: Commander, after your commissions are complete, you should... uh... hm... collect your rewards!

feeling1.line: Commander, you're making me feel uncomfortable.

feeling2.line: You can't be too careful in war... That being said...

feeling3.line: The kids in the sky have been working very hard. Can't they rest with me for a while? ... ... Commander, in times of war, is there no room for warmth?

feeling4.line: Commander, it's quite late. Why not rest a bit? I've made some black tea... Mail? It's in your tea, of course... *Zzzzz*

feeling5.line: Commander, if you are tired you can always rest in my embrace. Eh? Didn't you say yesterday that was the best way for you to recover?

home.line: You need to always keep your guard up, Commander.

hp_warning.line: Sm- smokescreen!

login.line: Today is a good day. Good weather puts you in a good mood to get work done!

lose.line: Next time, I'll scout out the enemy before we attack!

mail.line: I'll put the tea here... Mail? Ah, yes! There's new mail for you!

main1.line: Ardent and Acasta did the best they could, but I...

main2.line: I'll be more prudent in the future. Only then can I avoid meeting disaster again!

main3.line: Commander, glory and courage go hand in hand. However, Courage isn't the same thing as recklessness.

mission.line: Rest up and then finish your missions in one go!

mission_complete.line: I won't forget this time... *ahem* Commander, collect your rewards!

profile.line: I'm the Royal Navy's heavy crui... *ahem* ex-cruiser, now aircraft carrier, Glorious! I was just being careless when I was sunk by Scharnhorst and Gneisenau, not because they're better than me!

propose.line: If we face it together, there is nothing we can't overcome, Commander. Are you ready to accept your Glory?

skill.line: May victory and glory be ours... hopefully!

touch.line: Any guidance?

touch2.line: Commander, you're holding the glory of the Royal Navy

unlock.line: Royal Navy large crui– *ahem* aircraft carrier Glorious, reporting in! Commander, stand up straight, for your glory has arrived!

upgrade.line: Thank you, but power alone is not enough to win...

win_mvp.line: A glorious triumph!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. I am partial to things that shine!

detail.line: You're saying... that failures are just learning opportunities? Thanks, Commander, I do feel a lot better now.

home.line: Commander, remember to not let your guard down on your way home.

login.line: When I put on this uniform, my mood seems to lighten up compared to usual...
