main1.line: Commander, Ardent told me about some fascinating places. Want to go check them out after the operation is over?

main2.line: Commander, what would you consider an ideal school life?

main3.line: Even though I still have much to learn... I swear to bring you true glory one day, Commander.

touch2.line: Hey!! Commander, you scared the butterfly away...

unlock.line: Being able to occasionally have a peaceful school life... is something I could get used to. Commander, look at the markings on this butterfly - aren't they lovely?

detail.line: I shall strive to always be your beacon of glory, Commander! ...B-but, that doesn't sound convincing at all while I'm wearing this dress, does it...?

feeling5.line: Commander, if you're tired, feel free to rest in my lap. Not only is it ideal for you to replenish your energy, but it is also my duty to provide you succor.

home.line: Commander, don't let your guard down... Huh? I'm the one who looks more vulnerable right now?!

login.line: Commander, the glory of... the glory of the Royal Navy will...! F-forget it!

lose.line: I must gain a better grasp of the situation on the battlefield.

mail.line: The hot water is over here... Oh, the mail! Um... I'm so sorry, I could've sworn the mail was right there...

main1.line: Are you talking about Ark Royal...? Do you not think that it is appropriate for us adults to monitor the growth of our Destroyer sisters, even off the battlefield?

main2.line: I bought this outfit because I thought it looked gorgeous, but... then this happened... Wh-what do you mean I can just leave it like this?

main3.line: The scent of plums wafting upon the evening breeze is so calming... Oh no, I still have to finish my secretary duties!

touch.line: You don't want me catching a cold, is it? I appreciate your concern.

touch2.line: B-but, the glory of the Royal Navy... (blushes)

unlock.line: I heard that the Sakura Empire's traditional attire was really hard to put on... but the Dragon's Empery's outfits are even more... Huh?! Commander, p-please look away!

win_mvp.line: To Glorious goes the victory! Commander, thank you for your support!

battle.line: In Her Majesty's name, I shall vanquish the wrongdoers.

couple_encourage1.line: How's your day, my prim and proper sisters?

detail.line: Tea parties with the Illustrious sisters are fun... until it's my turn to brew tea. Do you know how this suppressed yearning feels, Commander?

expedition.line: The commission team has come back. You arriving on scene quickly to thank them is the best reward they could ask for.

feeling1.line: Surrender to darkness if you wish, but where should those who see you as their light go?

feeling2.line: My name suggests I'm vindictive: unwilling to offer mercy or compassion. In truth, I simply believe in my loyalties and convictions. As someone with great responsibility, surely you agree it's best not to fixate on the little things.

feeling3.line: What I desire is more than a mere symbol of victory – I crave someone who will answer my thoughts, sentiments, desires, and expectations. In other words... Indeed, if you do not know how to do so, why not try listening to my every word from now on? Heehee~♥

feeling4.line: Strong sentiments – be they faith or lust – do not necessarily lead to sin. There's no fun in being a slave to your conscience. If I were to offer myself to you, no strings attached whatsoever, gladly accepting is the right thing to do.

feeling5.line: Love arises from the human's primordial desire for companionship. Once someone beckons you, it only makes sense to cast aside your doubts, and indulge in that sweet, succulent euphoria... Heehee. Yet, you seem to have difficulty accepting this. Deny yourself all you want. Seeing how long you can fight your urges is fun in its own way.

headtouch.line: Excuse me? Do you want the same done to you? Heehee♥

home.line: Oh, welcome back... The stuff in your cup looks off? You mean the tea I brewed for you? Why?

hp_warning.line: Heehee. I'll get you for this.

login.line: May blessings find their way to you, Commander. Through who? Yes, who indeed.

lose.line: This defeat is like a stain on a white veil... Tiny, yet vexing.

mail.line: There's a letter for you. Remember, people have high hopes for you, and you're not one to disappoint.

main1.line: Why the long face? Concerned about your friends at sea, or simply stressed over work? Don't bottle up your feelings – let it all out.

main2.line: Tell me, among the four Illustrious sisters, whose tea is your favourite? ...Ah, you want to know mine? Hmm... I'd say it's the robust Assam.

main3.line: Showing neither mercy nor pity, never being appeased, stopping for nothing – that's what it means to be implacable. Perhaps you'd like to test me, Commander?

main4.line: Trouble concentrating, Commander? Let's get you back on track with a rousing distraction. Go on, take a look~♥

main5.line: Brain fog, you say? I may have just the cure – Royal Navy cuisine, enhanced with tongue-sizzling spice. Care for a taste?

mission.line: Are you tired of performing your neverending duty? Heehee. Here I thought you enjoyed it, considering how unswerving your commitment is.

mission_complete.line: A mission's been completed, has it? Heehee. May this bounty bring you joy one doesn't find every day.

profile.line: I was made as an improvement to the Illustrious class. Sadly, like many late arrivals to the war, my name is only an insignificant footnote in the chronicles of victory. Be that as it may... have you started thinking about how you're going to "use" me, Commander?

propose.line: You still deny yourself? Heehee, I understand. The shackles of inhibition are hard to break. Just close your eyes, relax, and empty your mind as I've taught you. I'm going to give you a mark of pleasure that will never go away♥

touch.line: People have many reasons for pursuing physical contact. What's yours, Commander?

touch2.line: Say, Commander... Are you just playing around, or are you being a sinful little thing? Heehee~♥

unlock.line: A most blessed meeting, Commander. I am Implacable, Royal Navy armoured carrier. There's no need to be in such a hurry to tell me about yourself. Your past, your future; your mind, and your body – heehee, shall all be revealed to me in due time. So, let's get to know each other, slowly but surely, little by little.

upgrade.line: A blessing, straight from you? Heehee. Allow me to give you my own blessings~

win_mvp.line: We should celebrate this triumph. After all, Lady Luck only lifts the hem of her dress to those who'll look♪

gift_prefer.line: What a magnanimous gesture this is... it makes me wonder if there isn't some ulterior motive? Heehee. An offering is made when one seeks to have a desire fulfilled. There's no shame in it~♪

battle_ex.line: On the Commander's name, I shall smite all who stand in our way.

detail_ex.line: If you're bored, we can go look if the canteen's offering anything new. Let's also pop down to the shop and see what's on sale. Heehee. If you want to kill time, might as well do it with me, right?

feeling5_ex.line: It's wrong to pray only for you and nobody else. However, you're the very person who pushed me in this direction. It is your mistake – do you know what you must do to rectify it? Yes, you do. You have to throw reason to the wayside and let your throbbing... heart take over. Heehee~♥

headtouch_ex.line: My prayers are with you, Commander. Now... and forever.

home_ex.line: Say... Isn't there even a chance you'll drink my tea? You could at least pretend to sip it to let me feel good about myself.

login_ex.line: While there are many who'll give their all for you, I'm the only one who can answer your prayers at the moment. Heehee♥

main6_ex.line: You're grimacing again... Fine. Come here and lie down. I'll help you let out all those woes and pent-up stress.

main7_ex.line: Idols, hmm? I suppose Illustrious and the rest have what it takes. I'd also say that you're like the entire fleet's idol, Commander. Heehee♥

main8_ex.line: I don't mind if you're biased or pick favourites, just don't look away when we're all to ourselves. If you do... Well, I'll put a curse on you. Heehee♥

main9_ex.line: Virtuous people losing their way, heroes giving in to corruption... Those who've grown bored of conventional stories find a guilty pleasure in such things.

main10_ex.line: While Illustrious is a great teacher during exercises, Indomitable seems hellbent on always cutting corners... Maybe they bore her and all she wants is to go home and chat over tea. Heehee.

touch_ex.line: Will you say the words, or do you want me to do it? Heehee♪

touch2_ex.line: You wouldn't hesitate on the battlefield, would you? Go on, show me how brave you are♥

win_mvp_ex.line: I dedicate this victory to you, my beloved Commander.

battle.line: It's time to see the results of your studies. Don't let me down♪

detail.line: Would you rather be a teacher or a pupil, Commander? Imagine being the pupil everyone looks up to, but you have naughty thoughts about your teacher... What a stimulating scenario that would be~♥

expedition.line: The supplies seem to have arrived. Hmm... Surely you don't plan on making poor little me fetch them?

headtouch.line: Oh my, are you trying to take advantage of me when I'm vulnerable~?

home.line: Commander, have you seen the tea I made earlier? No? Maybe a Royal Maid mistook it for something dubious and poured it down the sink...

login.line: You will surely have a blessed day. Why? Because I'm attracting all the bad luck♪

lose.line: Ugh... Sorry, I should've been more diligent.

main1.line: Gosh, I'm soaked... What a pain. Should I go get changed after all?

main2.line: As it turns out, the cafeteria's "ultra spicy" meal isn't very spicy at all. Maybe I'll make note of that on the next school survey.

main3.line: I assume you've already given some thought to how to deal with "eccentric" pupils? Heehee. I'm interested to see how you "educate" those who step out of line♥

touch.line: My button's come undone? Heehee, thanks. So, Commander... What are you really getting at here?

touch2.line: You've been waiting for this chance to make your move, haven't you? Heehee♥

unlock.line: Oh my... It seems I've shown you a rather unseemly side of me. Would you help me clean up here, Commander? You know... before any of the other girls find out. Heehee~♥

win_mvp.line: Nothing makes a teacher happier than seeing her pupils get good results♪

feeling5.line: It's all empty... Well, the night has only just begun. Instead of sharing empty words, let me help you release that pent-up fatigue with my own hands, okay?

headtouch.line: Mm... Phew. Wine tastes better when you drink from here, doesn't it? Heehee.

home.line: You look awfully tired... Why don't you come lean on me? I bet you I'm softer than any pillow.

login.line: Such a fine drink... is my blessing for you. May I propose a toast to our union?

main1.line: Oh, my... I spilled it. I'm such a mess now♥ Commander, can you clean me up?

main2.line: This hairpin is all the rage in the Dragon Empery. Does this different side of me awaken anything in you? Heehee.

main3.line: Your eyes look a little hazy. Are you drunk already? I made tea to help us sober up... Hmm? Wait, you sobered up already?

touch.line: Mm... Do I smell like wine now?

touch2.line: Mmnh... I'm starting to go numb... Oh, you'll relieve it for me? Well, I hope you'll take good care of me♥

unlock.line: I see that passionate look in your eyes... Do you crave this fine wine, or is there something more intoxicating you'd like to indulge in?

battle.line: Bad guys that disturb the peace will be dealt with, like this!

couple_encourage1.line: We'll mess them up in the name of love and peace! Understood!

couple_encourage2.line: If you're bored, why don't we play a game...?

couple_encourage3.line: Miss Sara, could you teach me a song?

couple_encourage4.line: Let us bring love and peace to this battlefield!

detail.line: Illustrious is steady in her steps!

expedition.line: Everyone has come back from their commission. I'll have to hurry to bring the refreshments out to them!

feeling1.line: Were my prayers for love and peace not even enough to reach the person closest by my side...?

feeling2.line: Commander, for the sake of love and peace, you mustn't quarrel with others, all right?

feeling3.line: Ah, Commander, wait a second... Here, use my handkerchief... Ehehe, there are some cake crumbs stuck on the corner of your mouth~

feeling4.line: I heard that sitting down to talk with someone can help relieve your worries. Commander, if there's anything bothering you, I'd be glad to hear you out.

feeling5.line: Commander, you seem to not be feeling well... Are you tired from working too much? Hm... Ah, Commander, here... *pat pat* What a sweet child~ I heard this will help you not be tired... right? Ehehe, don't you feel better already?

home.line: Good job, Commander. Would you like Illustrious to give you a back massage?

hp_warning.line: For the sake of love and peace, I must not be scared!

login.line: Good day, Commander. I helped organize a little bit based upon how you had things before. How does everything look?

lose.line: For the sake of a world of love and peace, next time... you won't get away!

mail.line: Commander, there's mail for you. Umm, where did I put it... Oh, there it is! Here!

main1.line: My planes? They're right here. Ehehe, everyone's so well-behaved.

main2.line: Commander, I'll be there for you any time you're feeling lonely.

main3.line: What an even more wonderful world it would be if everyone could understand each other.

mission.line: Commander, are you worried about the unfinished missions? Is there anything I can help you with?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Thanks to your efforts, we'll be able to further spread the light of love and peace!

profile.line: I am the world's first armoured aircraft carrier, ehehe. One day, I'll do my best for the glory of the Royal Navy!

propose.line: S-so this is a promise ring... such an important thing, for me...? Ehehe, thank you so much! I may still be immature, but I will work hard to become the person of your dreams. No, I'm sure I'll be able to do it~♪

skill.line: Holy light, pummel our enemies in the name of love and peace!

touch.line: Commander's hand is so big... much bigger than mine...

touch2.line: Is this some sort of new game...?

unlock.line: Good day to you, Commander. I am Illustrious of the Royal Navy. We'll spread the holy light of love and peace all across the ocean, right~♪

upgrade.line: With this, I'll be able to further spread the light of love and peace...

win_mvp.line: We're one step closer to a world of love and peace.

gift_prefer.line: You're always taking such good care of me, Commander~

battle.line: And now, a song of peace――

couple_encourage1.line: You like hugs...?

detail.line: One, two, one two, Ah... Thank you, Commander. I'm not sure why I just can't keep my balance...

expedition.line: It seems the commission team has returned. I wonder if they have the material for Victorious's clothes...?

feeling1.line: I do hope my song can return you to normal, Commander...

feeling2.line: To prepare for my idol activities, I borrowed some selections from Formidable's music collection. I find it rather noisy, but powerful, in a way that shakes my ears and in fact my whole body... Is that not right?

feeling3.line: At the Commander's request, I referenced a song by Comet and the girls. The gentle melody and soothing voices made me truly understand how idols can make people smile.

feeling4.line: I've been practicing with the other girls. I find I can sing gently, or energetically, and even smoothly... and it's all thanks to you, Commander. Hehehe.

feeling5.line: May my radiance touch you, Commander, and carry from the stage my song and dance of peace and love.

home.line: ♪~Ooh, welcome back, Commander. Can you give our new song a listen?

hp_warning.line: We can't let the light go out...!

login.line: Good day, Commander. What will we be practicing today?

lose.line: It seems the power of song alone was not enough...

mail.line: Reading fan letters is so delightful. What about your mail, Commander?

main1.line: What if we had a little tea party after our next practice?

main2.line: When one watches Tashkent and the girls dance so vivaciously, it makes one's heart pound. Hehehe.

main3.line: The theme of my costume is "the starry cosmos," isn't that romantic? How delightful. Hehe.

mission.line: Dido prepared this list of tasks for us. Do take a look at them, Commander.

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplisheed. Look over the rewards and... what's next on the schedule?

profile.line: I am the name ship of the Illustrious-class armored carriers... Oh, should I call myself "Idol Illustrious" now? I lack experience, but I will do what I must for the sake of peace.

propose.line: I can feel your support, and your hope for me... And I see your eyes full of happiness as you look upon the stage, and upon me, Commander. Hehehe.

skill.line: I will bring the light to you in song.

touch.line: Are we practicing for handshake events? All right, thank you very much, Commander.

touch2.line: Commander, do remember to maintain decorum when touching an idol.

unlock.line: I am the newest addition to the Muse System, Illustrious. Through my songs, I shall spread the light of love and peace— Don't you think that's a wonderful thing?

upgrade.line: It's not just about the shining image, it's also about conveying one's voice.

win_mvp.line: Our stage is brilliant and dazzling. Hehe~

gift_prefer.line: You've gone to such great lengths to get this for me... Thank you very much, Commander.

battle.line: M-me, flagship? Sounds like a pain in the... Err, it's nothing! I'll do it!

couple_encourage1.line: Sisters, let's do our best~

couple_encourage2.line: I swear to stand with you this time!

detail.line: My Illustrious-class sisters are all outstanding. Should you run into any problems, they would be more than glad to help... Me? Um, well, I suppose I wouldn't mind offering you some advice...

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I shall await your return, so you should go greet them soon.

feeling1.line: *sigh*... I knew I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up...

feeling2.line: Commander, are you busy right now? Oh, wow... You look totally lost in your work... Ahem, well then, I suppose I should leave you to it.

feeling3.line: My hobbies? Hmm... Honestly, I haven't given it much thought up until this point. Let's see... what I like isn't so much finding things to do, but rather finding ways of not doing anything.

feeling4.line: You should learn how to relax every once in a while precisely because you're always working so hard. Learning how to clear your mind and let go isn't as easy as it sounds. But don't worry if you can't do it right away, Commander. Hehe, I'll show you exactly how to do it next time~

feeling5.line: Hehe, I see you're also slack– Err, I mean, nourishing your body and soul. That pleases me greatly. Alright, let's continue practicing the art of clearing our minds on a regular basis! As for where to conduct the lessons... how about in my room?

headtouch.line: Hyah?! Gosh, how rude of you to interrupt my daydreaming!

home.line: Commander, congratulations on a most excellent sortie. Of course I wasn't doing nothing. I was praying for your success with all my might.

hp_warning.line: If this drags on, I'll seriously be in trouble...

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Ehh? You're going to start working already? Why not get into the zone first by, say, opening up the window and basking in the breeze?

lose.line: Seems like I'll be in the docks for a good while... Well, don't threaten me with a good time, I suppose.

mail.line: New mail? Are we being told to go on vacation? Huh, what do you mean that's not possible?

main1.line: Oh my, an invitation to a tea party? ...Though, I think I'll pass. Keeping up airs is soooo tiring.

main2.line: Sleep revitalizes the body, daydreaming revitalizes the mind, and strolling refreshes one's mood. I'll have you know, all forms of relaxation serve a purpose, and are DEFINITELY not slacking off.

main3.line: *Yaaawn*... Can't get motivated right now... Huh, work? I've already finished all of it.

mission.line: New missions, huh... Should be no problem at all for someone as experienced as you, right?

mission_complete.line: That's another mission taken care of! Hehe, you're pretty good at this, Commander.

profile.line: As the fourth member of the Illustrious class, of course I'd be somewhat different from my sisters... Hey, I'm talking about hangar capacity here, not service history or repair length.

propose.line: An oath ceremony? That sounds like something that could turn into a real pain in the ass... I'm not saying there's anything wrong with you, Commander. I mean, a ceremony is just for show, so it shouldn't matter if... Wh-why are you making me say something so embarrassing anyway?! Anyway, we're done here, so I'll be heading back!

skill.line: Maybe I should start to get serious...

touch.line: Did you need something? Though, it'd be great if you didn't...

touch2.line: Double my vacation time, buy me some sweets, and I'll keep this a secret. Hehe, not such a bad deal, right?

unlock.line: I am the fourth ship of the Illustrious class, armored carrier Indomitable. *Yawn*... I seem to be getting a bit drowsy... Would you mind if we continued this later?

upgrade.line: I've gotten stronger, but... maybe I shouldn't let anyone know that.

win_mvp.line: I'm the MVP? I wonder if I shouldn't have tried so hard...

gift_prefer.line: Oh, this seems like a pretty nifty way to pass the time. Thanks.

battle_ex.line: If it's for your sake, I suppose I can put in a bit more effort...

detail_ex.line: Should you run into any problems... You should come to me first, not my sisters... Y-yeah, I think I'm fine with that...

expedition_ex.line: The commission fleet seems to have come back. Hurry up and go– Err, I mean, let's go greet them together.

feeling5_ex.line: Let's see, the next things to do on our date are... chilling together indoors, leisurely enjoying some tea, then quietly arrange some flowers. Hm? You want to go outside? I, I think our schedule's already pretty packed. Look, every time we go outside on a date, my legs get all puffy the next day...

home_ex.line: I pray for the Commander's safe return... Ow, ow, ow... Who thought prayer could be such a painful thing... Oh my, is that you, Commander?

login_ex.line: Good day, Commander. Umm, uhh... M-maybe there's something I can help you out with?

lose_ex.line: Don't worry, I'm the type of girl who can bounce right back after a little nap.

main4_ex.line: Commander, did you want to go to the tea party? Um, in that case... Ugh, why is this so hard...

main5_ex.line: Did you sleep well yesterday? If you're tired, you might want to take a little nap or go on a stroll outside first. I'll accompany you~

main6_ex.line: Formidable won't let any of our other sisters see her cheeky side, but she's a lot more open around me for whatever reason... Well, there's not a whole lot we have in common anyway. Her taste in music is a bit... too noisy for my tastes.

touch_ex.line: I'm serious. Y-you can come see me even if you don't have any problems...

touch2_ex.line: You're such a bully...

win_mvp_ex.line: MVP, huh... Darn it, now I'm going to have to rest up to get my motivation back!

detail.line: Knowing how to brew tea is one of the essentials for the Royal Maids, no? Well, that's something even I can do. Though only once a day, no more than that.

home.line: The Royal Maids are always carrying all sorts of yummy snacks back and forth... I wonder how they can control themselves.

login.line: Welcome back, Master~♪ All righty, that's all my maid-motivation used up...

main1.line: What jobs am I capable of doing? Let's see... Oh, I can warm up the bed for you before you go to sleep?

main2.line: Now that I think about it, considering how capable you are as a commander, doing a maid's job should hardly be considered work, right? Maybe I'll have you take over the rest of my maid duties... Ahaha, well, it was worth a shot...

main3.line: I'm sure someone with THIS many maids would live an absolutely blessed lifestyle... Ugh, it's making me jealous the more I think about it...

touch.line: Are you trying to give me a massage? My shoulders were just starting to feel a bit stiff, so massage away~

touch2.line: I'm going to tell my sisters, you know?

unlock.line: *Sigh*... I thought changing into maid attire would break up the monotony, but just getting into these clothes has tired me out... Oh, Commander? You came at a good time. Shall we slack off together?

battle.line: Evildoers! I'm not scared of you!

couple_encourage1.line: F-for love and peace!

couple_encourage2.line: Hm? Umm... Are you okay? It looks like you're asleep...

detail.line: I hear that you're an evil taskmaster who punishes shipgirls when they don't do exactly as they're told... Hwah? That's not true? I dunno, you're kinda suspicious...

expedition.line: I heard there's tasty milk chocolate in the commission supplies... I-I didn't say anything. How about we go greet the commission team?

feeling1.line: I-I'm sorry! I-I'll listen better from now on, so don't get mad at me...

feeling2.line: Do you need something? Ladies of the Royal Navy are quite busy, I'll have you know—You say there's a party full of sweets? And we don't have to be all stuffy and formal? AND big sis Illustrious said I can go? Hmmm... O-okay, I'll go! I'll go!

feeling3.line: You want to know if ladies of the Royal Navy get tired? It's not so bad; we only have to constantly mind our manners and carry ourselves with elegance... Ugh, it's a hassle! I just wanna lie on the couch and eat candy—Ahem! F-forget you heard that!

feeling4.line: You're a lot like me, Commander. Every day is so full of things you must do, you're only able to do what you want to do in private. Even grown-ups have it rough... But it's okay! I will do whatever I can to help you! Not that I know exactly what that entails...

feeling5.line: I always thought you were a strict and scary person, so I acted cold to you... N-now I know that you're a good person and fun to be around! Commander, you're my best friend! Ehehe!

headtouch.line: Hawawah! D-do not rustle the hair of a proper lady!

home.line: While you were away, a few of the older girls visited. They all left messages, which I wrote down on this sheet of paper for you... (whispering) The Commander's really suspicious...

hp_warning.line: Don't hit me, don't hit me! Ah...

login.line: W-welcome back... I suppose I should start my etiquette training now, right? For example, practicing how I stand and sit...

lose.line: Th-the Commander's gonna lecture me... Urk...

mail.line: Commander, I brought your mail. I heard that's part of a secretary's job... I-is that right?

main1.line: I'm about to go to a tea party with the others... Commander, do you have a mirror? I want to make sure I'm looking sharp... No, you don't need to help me! I can do it myself.

main2.line: Little Bel, how much longer are you going to be? "It's only been three minutes"? You mean you've ALREADY taken three minutes!

main3.line: One of my Royal Maid sisters told me I'd turn "plump" if I ate too much cake. Does she think I believe these childish lies? ...C-Commander, that is a lie, right?!

mission.line: Missions? Can we eat candy if we finish them all?

mission_complete.line: Commander, the missions are all done now, so you should take a break. ...You're too busy? It must be hard being grown-up...

profile.line: Illustrious-class aircraft carrier number three, with a promising future of becoming an armoured carrier. Commander, I humbly request your aid in training me to become a proper lady... Huh? What kind of sweets do I like? Why are you asking me... I like all kinds of sweets!

propose.line: People tell me that you only give these to those you really care about... Does that mean I'm your best friend, too? Ehehe, I'm overjoyed! I'd better go tell big sis Illustrious about this!

touch.line: I-it is rude to touch a lady without her permission!

touch2.line: Just you wait! I'm gonna go tell big sis Illustrious aaall about all the bad things you did!

unlock.line: Hmm... Are you the so-called "Commander"? You don't look all that scary, but maybe this is what they call camouflage...? Hmm... I dunno... Oh! I'm the third Illustrious-class ship, Formidable. It's... a pleasure to meet you?

upgrade.line: Wooow. You can use airplanes for this, too?

win_mvp.line: Hmph. Do not underestimate Formidable!

gift_prefer.line: Woah, I've always wanted this! ...Ahem, I mean, umm... th-thank you very much!

detail_ex.line: Etiquette training does suck, but I'll keep doing my best to become a dependable lady of the Royal Navy! ...Ehehe, this is how I'll hide my true self in front of others so that only the people I really care about get to see the real me! Yep, that's perfect!

expedition_ex.line: Going out with you to greet the commission team... I know what this is! This is what they call a "grown-up date"! ...It's not?

headtouch_ex.line: Hawawah! I put so much effort into brushing my hair just right... You'd better get it back to how it was!

home_ex.line: Commander, come over here! There there, pat pat, good Commander! Hm? Big sis Illustrious taught me this! She said this is the best way to help you relax.

login_ex.line: Commander! You've finally returned! Did you bring that Iris dessert I said I wanted to try? ...Wow, thank you, Commander!

lose_ex.line: Urk... Commander, they're bullying meee...

main4_ex.line: At tea parties, you have to sit straight up and deal with all these dumb, annoying manners... But when I'm with you and my sisters, I can relax! I wish I could always eat tasty foods without a care!

main5_ex.line: Commander, you know one or two of Her Majesty's secrets, don't you? For example... Maybe she's not all that elegant in private? I promise I won't tell anyone else!

main6_ex.line: I recently learned about this "rock" genre of music. I rather like it! My sisters say it's not ladylike, but... What about you? Do you like "rock," Commander?

mail_ex.line: Commander, you've got mail! I brought it right away! Do you have a reward for me?

mission_ex.line: A new mission? If you're going to be busy, then I guess I'll have to pass the time alone... How sad.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete! Commander, shall we take a break? You look tired, so I'm worried about you...

touch_ex.line: If you're free right now, then let's have a tea party together! We can leave out all of the boring manners and stuff.

touch2_ex.line: I-i-i-it is far too soon for me to be participating in such acts!

win_mvp_ex.line: I won! Look, Commander, I'm in first place!

battle.line: Witness how a lady rocks and rolls!

couple_encourage1.line: Illustrious, I'm taking center stage today!

couple_encourage2.line: You won't outdo me today!

couple_encourage3.line: Let's liven up this show even more!

detail.line: Heheh♪ Commander, what do you think of my – huh? V-very cool? Ahem! At least let me finish asking first... *blush*

expedition.line: Ding dong, ding dong♪ The commission rewards have arrived. The equipment for our show came, too, so why don't we go look together?

feeling1.line: You think I looked despondent during my show? I can only imagine it's because of a certain someone who OBVIOUSLY doesn't get me... Eep?! You're getting too close! D-dummy! Okay, I forgive you! I forgive you!

feeling2.line: Commander? You're here early. Heehee, did you decide to come to rehearsal because you were just sooo excited to see my performance?

feeling3.line: Wow, you're really comparing my performances to Illustrious's? You've got some nerve! ...So? Obviously, I'm the winner... Ahem. I didn't say anything!

feeling4.line: Hmm? Why did I decide to join in the Muse System tests? Because I want to be true to myself. I don't need to act like a royal lady, I can play the music I like, and I get your attention... Heheh, doesn't it sound like a nice deal?

feeling5.line: Welcome, Commander. Are you here to watch my lessons again? Wait, is this... my promotional poster? Wow, I didn't think you enjoyed my shows THAT much! Of course! I'd be happy to show you my cutest side in return!

headtouch.line: I-I'll have you know I am working as an idol right now! Aah! Put that hand back! No pulling!

home.line: The intermission is over... Commander, I look forward to your support and your cheers!

hp_warning.line: Wha...?! Well, that's one way to play!

login.line: Hm? Commander, you're early. In that case... Maybe now is the perfect time to give you a taste of my solo performance♪

lose.line: We didn't rehearse well enough... Th-the next performance will be a perfect one, I swear!

mail.line: There's fan mail for you here, too, Commander. Don't forget to read it.

main1.line: What song will I choose? This one, of course! Feast your ears upon Formidable's own style of rock-and-roll! Don't you love that dynamic sound, Commander?

main2.line: Right this way, Commander... Why, you ask? Because I want you to get closer to me, of course!

main3.line: Illustrious's show was just breathtaking... Oh! I can't let her go uncontested! You'd best be an impartial judge, Commander!

mission.line: Here is today's mission list... No matter how busy you are, don't neglect those missions.

mission_complete.line: Heh heh heh... Which is more important? My performance, or a fat stack of mission rewards? Knowing you, I bet you'd place equal value on them.

profile.line: I, Formidable, shall bring my elegance as a Royal lady to the stage as a member of the idol group, Alizarin! From now on, I will do my best to express my unique style, so please look forward to my performance!

propose.line: This is... more support than I'd expect from just one fan. Is this how you feel when you see me on stage, Commander? Okay... I understand exactly what you're trying to say! I'll give you the most unique show you've ever seen to show you how I feel in return!

touch.line: Hmm? Do you want to be my number-one fan, Commander? Yeah! That must be it!

touch2.line: Commander, don't think you can get away with calling this a joke. Heheh, I won't let you explain it away.

unlock.line: Commander, third ship and idol of the Illustrious class, Formidable, humbly makes your acquaintance. Please do enjoy the show... Heehee, doesn't that just make you shudder with excitement?

upgrade.line: Now that's satisfying! Heheh♪

win_mvp.line: Heheh, a perfect performance! I think our group has made our feelings clear now.

gift_prefer.line: Th-this is... Commander, I've received your feelings, loud and clear!

battle.line: Please remain calm. The darkness will only make the stars shine brighter.

couple_encourage1.line: Terror, stay close to me.

couple_encourage2.line: Vampire, please imbibe wine – I mean, blood – with moderation...

couple_encourage3.line: Lady Warspite, I shall support you.

couple_encourage4.line: Saru Legion? What a fun name!

detail.line: I am not the harbinger of death... I am just..... guiding them after their times are up

expedition.line: I'm not particularly interested in embarking on commissions... The other girls always say I see weird stuff. I suppose it can't be helped... Anyway, your girls are back!

feeling1.line: Commander, if you fall into darkness, know that it will be me hunting your soul...

feeling2.line: It was hard to take care of my sister at the beginning, but I got used to it... used to being alone? I'm just used to the fear of it.

feeling3.line: Whenever I'm afraid, all I have to do is think of my little sister. It gives me the strength to push on. Even though my sister can't be without me, I can't be without her either.

feeling4.line: I'm afraid no longer. Being next to you, I'm willing to become the darkness to your light; And if that light were to swallow me... No, even if I was to be devoured, that would be fine too.

feeling5.line: Where there's light, there's darkness. Wherever you are, I'll be near. This isn't fate but the law of this world... It's nothing, it's just something that I've wanted to say for a long time, if I ever found someone who I truly liked.

home.line: The silence after a battle is divine. Take your time and rest.

hp_warning.line: The darkness is with us.

login.line: Commander, I'm always here, awaiting for your summons...

lose.line: Even if you manage to defeat me, you'll never escape the infinite darkness.

mail.line: Letters are what connect humans. Hold them dear.

main1.line: Did you just have an out-of-body experience?

main2.line: I'll always protect my little sisters.

main3.line: I have to say, this warmth, I don't dislike it.

mission.line: You'll experience an eternity of restlessness if you die with incomplete missions.

mission_complete.line: Rewards are but worldly possessions. It makes no difference to me whether you collect them or not.

profile.line:
Erebus, my name, sounds surreal?
My predecessor was a ship which carried explorers to the North Pole and never returned... like a journey into the abyss.
Please pay more attention to my sisters!

propose.line: Shadows chase after light, and light embraces the shadows. I've heard of foolish lovers who erase each other, but who can judge another's love? Isn't that right, Commander?

touch.line: Allow me to channel forth the whispers of the dead...

touch2.line: ... ... uh... ... I'm sorry, it seems like I was having an out-of-body experience.

unlock.line: Commander, is that you? I'm Erebus. I followed your voice and have come from afar.

upgrade.line: The purer the darkness, the calmer my mind.

win_mvp.line: Allow me to harvest the souls of our enemies.

gift_prefer.line: Thanks. Never thought I'd get something like this.

detail.line: I am still but a shadow. The only difference is, I've found a small, small thing to strive for.

home.line: Commander, would you like some sweets to replenish your energy?

main1.line: Commander, there's no need to be reserved. I still have a lot of chocolate.

main2.line: nil

main3.line: Commander, just being able to watch you like this, and give you chocolate, is enough to make me happy.

touch.line: I'm here, as always.

touch2.line: Were you able to touch happiness, Commander?

unlock.line: Those who embrace the shadows will find only an illusory happiness... But for me, that much is sufficient.

win_mvp.line: No matter how long the night, the dawn will come again...

detail.line: Terror really wanted to go to the Halloween party with me, but... I...

feeling5.line: Forming a contract with a witch will allow one of your wishes to come true. In return, your souls will forever be bound, unable to separate from one another... Commander, tell me... what is your wish?

home.line: I can hear the wailing of souls passing through the ever darkness... You want to know what they're saying...?

login.line: The Halloween event has started. But, I'm supposed to wait here until it's my time to come out.

main1.line: Legend has it that real monsters come out on Hallow's Eve... Shall we search for them?

main2.line: These festivities have diluted the ever darkness with noise and light... but it's not such a bad thing.

main3.line: T-trick or treat...? Oh, right, you can have this special bewitched candy.

touch2.line: Commander, have you been possessed by a perverted ghost?

unlock.line: "I am the witch of Hallow's Eve, here to guide your soul into the ever darkness"... that's what the concept of the Halloween witch is about, right?

battle.line: Even Terror... is getting terrified...

couple_encourage1.line: Sister, I'll do my best!

couple_encourage2.line: Can I jump around like a monkey too?

detail.line: Your eyes look just like those weirdo' eyes, Commander...

expedition.line: Commander, commissions are finished... You know, I lost my hand during a commission. It took everyone quite some time to help me find it...

feeling1.line: Terror is terrified of you, Commander.

feeling2.line: Aren't you afraid of me, Commander? My body feels cold... I am always depressed... I always feel.... like a corpse.

feeling3.line: I remember my sister being with me, ever since the very first time I opened my eyes... She's always been there for me. She's my only family...

feeling4.line: It's warm next to my sister, it's warm next to the Commander too... I feel like I just got a new family member... I'm so happy...

feeling5.line: Commander... please touch my heart... It has never beaten this fast... it has never been this hot... This is all... because of you, Commander...

home.line: Rub my head, Commander...

hp_warning.line: Terror... is getting terrified...

login.line: Commander... I've been wanting to talk... to you... about...

lose.line: *Cries*... I'll try to hold out until you tow me back to port, Commander...

mail.line: A letter... Would anyone write a letter to me?

main1.line: Commander, could you put away those peas? And the lawnmower……

main2.line: Is is that weird for me to have a 'heart'?

main3.line: Commander……are you……a wind player?

mission.line: How about some missions for exercise...? Otherwise my knee may break again...

mission_complete.line: *coo, coo*~! Commander, I've got your rewards...

profile.line:
I'm the second ship of the Erebus-class monitors.
The Abercrombie-class ships are no match for me and my sister... We spent a lot of time in the Dardanelles strait. Bombardment missions... piece of cake.

propose.line: Times like these, should I laugh, or should I cry? I'm... I'm not really sure... but Terror knows... I know I've never been this happy before...

touch.line: Can you feel... my warmth?

touch2.line: *Stares...*

unlock.line: Monitor ship... Terror... Abercrombie-class ships are no match for me and my sister... We spent a lot of time in the Dardanelles strait. Bombardment missions... piece of cake.

upgrade.line: I feel as if my body... is much more agile now.

win_mvp.line: Commander, I... I worked really hard. I didn't cause you any trouble, did I?

gift_prefer.line: Huh? For me? Th-thank you!

detail.line: "From the depths of Sheol, I emerge from eternal slumber to claim your soul" ... This line sounds like something my sister would say.

home.line: Trick-or-treating? I'm a little excited...

login.line: Boo! Scaring people... it's done like this, right?

main1.line: I wanted to spend some time with my sister, but she doesn't seem to be interested in Halloween...

main2.line: Today, everyone will be dressed up as monsters and witches, so I will fit in with them...

main3.line: Children will ask for candy from adults... but Terror is no longer a child- Eh? Candy, for me? Thank you...

touch.line: Commander's hand... is nice and warm...

touch2.line: If you keep touching, the bandages are going to come lose...

unlock.line: I have to dress up as a ghost for Halloween, but I'm not very good at making complicated costumes... Is something like this okay?

battle.line: Tee hee, what should I knock out first? Their bow? Turret? Engine?

couple_encourage1.line: Auntie Hood, I'm here to help!

couple_encourage2.line: Nobody does pranks better than me!

detail.line: It's so much fun to fire my gun~!

expedition.line: Target spotted, calculating trajectory... Bugger, it's just the commission team. Laaaame...

feeling1.line: Tee hee~ Commander, did you know you can use the Mark I as a blunt weapon? I'll show you! (Pow!)

feeling2.line: Tee hee~ How do you like my habanero curry? – Huh...? W-wait, Nelson! I didn't know that one was yours! – Don't hurt meeee!

feeling3.line: Oh, Commander~! Com-man-der! Coooommaaaandeeeer! What? It was nothing. I just wanted to see your face~ Tee hee~

feeling4.line: Feeling stressed out? Then try out my Mark I! Fire a shot for every worry you have to make them disappear with a bang! You'll get hooked on it!

feeling5.line: I wonder if I can combine you and my Mark I... Commander, for the next sortie, how about you sit atop it while issuing commands?

home.line: Hey, Commander~ Brought back anything gander-worthy? Like a piece of wreckage or parts from a crashed aircraft or something?

hp_warning.line: Whuaaah! My armour!

login.line: That loud bang? Tee hee~ You were gone for so long I was getting bored, so I let a shot loose~

lose.line: Tsk. Lame.

mail.line: Oh, have I hidden your mail~? Want it back? Then get some snacks and bar-ter for it! Bar-ter for it!

main1.line: My hobby's collecting shell casings~! Hey, don't you think shell casings are super cool?

main2.line: Top of the mornin', granny Hood!

main3.line: Whuaah! Hey, Wales! Granny Hood is giving me creepy looks~!

mission.line: Commander, there are new missions! Tee hee~ What'll we be sinking this time? I can't wait~

mission_complete.line: Commander, is the next mission gonna be as fun as the last one?

profile.line: I'm the Monitor Abercrombie. My sister and I used to help with shore bombardment around the Mediterranean Sea. Tee hee~ It's way more fun to shoot stationary targets~

propose.line: W-wow! Thanks! I'll never take it off! I-in exchange, take my Mark I! Roberts told me you're supposed to give your partner your dearest possession at times like these!

skill.line: Be torn to shreds by my shells!

touch.line: Commander, want some crisps? Here you go! ... Roberts, come here! I found the crook who ate your crisps!

touch2.line: Whuaaah!

unlock.line: Take THIS! – Oh, Commander? Tee hee~ I'm Abercrombie! Lovely weather today, eh~?

upgrade.line: Tee hee~ I might be loading a teensy bit too much gunpowder~

win_mvp.line: Kaboom! Ahaha~ You can't beat the Mark I!

gift_prefer.line: This is... wicked sick!

detail.line: Trick or treat! Give me candy, or you'll taste one of my pranks! Although, even if you give me some... well, you'll see for yourself! Tee hee~

home.line: I wonder how people would react if they got my custom-made horseradish candy~ Tee hee~!

login.line: Tee hee~ Who knows where I've planted my pumpkin surprise~

main1.line: Take a gander at my Halloween Mark I! Looks cracking, doesn't it!

main2.line: Nelson's wearing a Halloween costume?! Really?! Let me have a look at it, Commander!

main3.line: If only we had more holidays where you could cause mischief and get away with it scot-free~

touch.line: Shake hands with my Halloween Mark I! Come on, Mark I, show the Commander your special trick~!

touch2.line: Taste the retribution of my Mark I! (Pow!)

unlock.line: Kabooom! You thought it was a pumpkin, but it was me, Abercrombie, with my Mark I! Commander, did I scare you senseless? Muahaha!

detail.line: Carrot juice has just the perfect consistency. You can put anything you like in the glass, and nobody'll know!

home.line: Bring our customers their drinks, Manjuus! And be careful so you don't drop them!

login.line: ello there! How about a glass of delicious and nutritious carrot juice? ...Wait, stop, not that one! THIS one's for you! Phew... Disaster averted...

main1.line: Shaking the bottle? Pfft, that's the oldest trick in the book. I'll teach you a newer one, Commander!

main2.line: Oh bollocks! It's Nelson! Quick, Commander, I need a place to hide!

main3.line: You're silly, Erebus. All I asked for was a little inspiration, not the full recipe for some kind of magic potion!

touch.line: Bottoms up, like adults do! Drink up, Mark I!

unlock.line: Now for a ghost pepper while nobody's looking... Tee hee! Perfect! I wonder who'll be the lucky one to sip– C-Commander?! You didn't see anything suspicious... Right? Tee hee~

feeling5.line: Let's cuff you up! Tee hee, you're not going anywhere! Now you're a prisoner to me and me alone! I get to choose which ward you're going to. We'll never be apart again!

headtouch.line: How bold, patting the warden's head like this! I do like it... but I'm still arresting you! Tee hee! Don't give me lip about how it's "cowardly"!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! The shooting starts in a minute! But first, tell me about all the cool stuff you saw today!

login.line: Tee hee! You willingly went back into your cell? Looks like life on the outside wasn't what it used to be!

main1.line: Commander, have a gander at this! My Mark I got an original makeover! Isn't that lovely? This will surely be handy for the upcoming shoot when... Dangerous? Not at all! It's not loaded, see?

main2.line: Let's play a game of naval cat and mouse! You'll run away while we try to catch you. By the way, what do you think happens to the mouse when the cat catches it? ...How's that? Pretty strong acting, right?

main3.line: Escapees always end up cornered! Inmate 001, give up and surrender peacefully!

mission.line: Oh? A new mission? Did an inmate escape? Got it! Mark I Search Team, find them!

mission_complete.line: We caught the escaped inmate! Mission complete!

touch.line: Hm? You can bribe me with candy, but I'm still going to arrest you!

touch2.line: Whuaah! Wait, what are you doing?! We're still filming!

unlock.line: Found you! No criminals are escaping on my watch! You have the right to remain silent! Everything you say can and will be used against you in a court of law! Tee hee, now surrender peacefully, Commander!

win_mvp.line: Tee hee! There's no criminal who can escape ME!

detail.line: Huh? You think I'm cute? Aww! I did everything I could to give off a different vibe, so I wanted you to call me gorgeous or fashionable! Th-though I do still appreciate the compliment.

expedition.line: Commander, the girls who went on commission are back! Let's take them to the party with us!

headtouch.line: Whoa whoa! No rustling my hair! You're gonna mess it up!

home.line: Good work today, Commander! Let's take a little break before we go back to the party. I'll bring you a snack... I mean, hors d'oeuvres!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! Are you ready to dance with me?

lose.line: Ack... Maybe I'm not ready for this dress after all...?

main1.line: Let's see, the dance moves here... Left, right, and then... Huh? Is it left next, or was it right...? Whoa, whoa...?!

main2.line: Commander, umm, let's review a little more before the performance! Otherwise, I'm gonna step on your feet during the dance...

main3.line: C-Commander, I know I'm cute—I mean, pretty—in this dress, but it's embarrassing when you stare so much...

touch.line: Are you tired already, Commander? But we're about to dance...

touch2.line: C-Commander, we're at a party! Be a little more refined...!

unlock.line: Tadah! I've got a banquet dress! Heehee~ I decided to go with something refined and voguish this time, as opposed to cute! I mean, it's a dress fit for a banquet, so I think it makes me look pretty grown-up.

detail.line: I gotta gather my courage and invite big brother to the party today... Ah? B-big brother... Did you hear that? Oh...

home.line: No matter how busy you are, I'll always be waiting here for you.

login.line: Big brother... Did you come to listen to me practice? It makes me a little nervous, but I'm glad you're interested...

main1.line: Concerts are hard... I need to practice more. But if you're there, I'm sure it'll go well...

main2.line: It's a good thing Yuni can hold the sheet music... Hm? You'll help too, big brother? I dunno if I can practice while I look at your face...

main3.line: Big brother... What if we slacked off together? Indomitable told me about it. She says bad girls do it, heheh...

touch.line: Do you mind if I... ask you for something a little greedy...?

touch2.line: Big brother... W-we're all alone right now... ///

unlock.line: Big brother...? I was just practicing my trumpet, if you were wondering... Umm, what do you think? I hope you like my trumpeting...

detail.line: I raised all of my support skills to their maximum levels, so I'll be your best partner ever! Yuni can help, too. Hehehe!

expedition.line: The big sisters in the commission team came back! If we're lucky, they might have rare items...

feeling5.line: I heard forming a party with people you have high affection with makes your stats go up... And if it goes even higher, you get to... I-I'll do my best to raise our stats!

home.line: I'll heal you, big brother! Haaaah! ...I healed all your HP and cleared your debuffs! Phew...

login.line: Big brother, are we going to go dungeoneering again today...? I'll do my best to support you...!

lose.line: I-I'm out of MP... I can't use any healing magic now...

main1.line: Why does this staff have the Charm skill, anyway... What if I used it on... N-never mind! I-I shouldn't think of such things...

main2.line: Raising your weapon's level can lead to stronger healing effects... Huh? Z23, you think I shouldn't...?

main3.line: Huh? You can level up just by leaving the character over there and go AFK...? Laffey, your knowledge is incredible...

mission.line: If we clear more quests, we can win more healing items...!

mission_complete.line: Big brother, don't forget your quest rewards, okay?

touch.line: Do you have enough healing items? If you don't, I still have lots on hand...

touch2.line: O-oh, no... Did I accidentally cast Charm on you?!

unlock.line: Don't come any closer! Th-this is dangerous... Big brother?! Thank goodness... Please come save me!

win_mvp.line: Y-you can be MVP even when you play a support role? Did I really help that much? Hehe...

battle.line: I'll handle the cheering!

detail.line: Big brother, are you okay? If you're tired, tell me instead of pushing yourself. I can bring you snacks, or call others to come help... A-anything it takes to help you!

expedition.line: The girls who went out on commission are back! Big brother, wanna take a break before the next race starts?

home.line: Good work today, big brother. Me, Yuni, big sister Illustrious – all of us were waiting for you. Hehe!

login.line: Big brother! Give today all you've got... Fight ooon! Mmm... I-I'm okay... I can still cheer!

lose.line: *pant*... Nnngh... I can still...

main1.line: Do your best, big brother! Everyone in the stands is cheering alongside me!

main2.line: Umm... B-big brother! Hehe, big sister Illustrious brought iced tea for us! U-umm, I don't have any cups, so... do you mind if we both drink from this?

main3.line: Yuni's doing her best to cheer you on, too! Do you like the uniform I made for her?

touch.line: My tummy looks cold? Don't worry, I feel just fine.

touch2.line: B-big brother, this is really embarrassing...

unlock.line: Phew... *pant*... Big brother! F-fight on! Seeing you try your very hardest reminds me... that I need to do my best to cheer you on, too!

win_mvp.line: I'm not MVP – you are, for leading us. Ehehe, congratulations!

detail.line: You came just in time for the cake to finish baking. I didn't even have time to change out of my apron. Heehee, not that I'd mind at all if you... "accidentally" saw me in a state of disrobe.

expedition.line: Go ahead and greet everyone. I'll have sweets ready and waiting for their return!

feeling5.line: I'll never forget the ring you gave me, nor this special tea party... Heehee, not for as long as I live. Whenever I see this ring, I'll remember today's warmth and love. Let's make so many more beautiful memories together. I'll always be by your side, Commander.

headtouch.line: Hmm? Want me to feed you again?

home.line: You've been working so hard. Today's cake turned out perfect, so would you like a slice? Good! Open up so I can feed you~

login.line: Afternoon tea is ready, Commander. Let's enjoy some alone time♪

mail.line: Oh, new mail...? Want some tea while you read it?

main1.line: See how the ring sparkles in the sun? It's just as bright as your smile, heehee.

main2.line: Commander, you do love staring at me... Of course, I find your gaze reassuring.

main3.line: I hope my tea and snacks are to your liking, Commander.

mission.line: You have to take both your missions and afternoon tea seriously. I'll be cheering you on, Commander.

mission_complete.line: Good job. Just like dessert after tea, don't forget to enjoy your rewards for a job well done.

touch.line: Your hands are always so warm...

touch2.line: Heehee, Commander... Was cake not enough to satisfy you?

unlock.line: Commander, come and try this cake I made... Oh? Heehee, of course I know. That's the ring that symbolizes our eternal vow. I promise to cherish both you and the ring forever...

battle.line: Good weather, even better mood~ Let’s go!

couple_encourage1.line: Let’s give the enemy a taste of our might!

detail.line: Hehe, are you that lonely Commander?~

expedition.line: Hey~ The Commission fleet is back, stop sleeping!

feeling1.line: I thought the Commander would understand me...

feeling2.line: What’s in my hands? I think it’s called “Gohei” or something like that. It looks so pretty when swung back and forth, so I thought to grab it with me~

feeling3.line: Not sure how my sisters are faring… Although, since they are my sisters, I’m sure they’re prospering wherever they are!

feeling4.line: What type of girls do you like, Commander? Hmm? I’m just curious. Ha~ perhaps you’ve misunderstood me?

feeling5.line: I was implying something before? Regardless, no matter what type of girls you like, as long as you will like me in the future, then that’ll be just fine~ Hehehe.

home.line: First, you do this, then this....?! C-Commander, welcome back~ Hahaha, I wasn’t up to anything!

hp_warning.line: Looks like this isn’t the time to joke around...

login.line: Commander, how are ya feeling today?~

lose.line: That hurts so much… Commander, let’s run away!

mail.line: Here’s some mail~ ah… So it’s for the Commander...

main1.line: The weather today sure is beautiful, don’t you think, Commander?

main2.line: Listen up {namecode:14}, even if the Commander is a total loser, but I am totally (probably) reliable!

main3.line: Even if the Commander praises 100 times, that still won’t be too much... hmm, or perhaps 100 praises will be a bit tiresome to listen to.

mission.line: Commander, there are so many uncleared missions—— ahhh~!!! Were you being lazy again?

mission_complete.line: Commander, the mission rewards are here~ With me being here, perhaps there are more rewards now? Hehe.

profile.line: Yoohoo~ I am the destroyer who recently made the world tremble, call me {namecode:2}! Sorry, I’m not trying to be complacent, in fact, I was in many battles… although none of them are worth writing home about… I will continue to do better!

propose.line: Even though I said that the Commander would like me “in the future”, but it seems that “future” has become unexpectedly sooner~ Were you a bit shy when I asked you?~ Hehehe.

skill.line: Hmph, taste the power of the Special type Destroyers!

touch.line: Help with work? O right… Looking at the Commander being so idle, I almost forgot about work~

touch2.line: Wow! You scared me to death!

unlock.line: Yoohoo~ yours truly {namecode:2} class has arrived, so you’re the Commander? I'm looking forward to your guidance~

upgrade.line: Wow?! Excellent condition!

win_mvp.line: Uh-huh, I’m good right~

gift_prefer.line: Thanks, Commander! It's my lucky day!

battle.line: Let's finish this so I can make it to school!

detail.line: I didn't oversleep! I was just doing stuff I like and ended up losing track of time...

lose.line: Fight or run away to fight another day!

main2.line: The Fencing Club, the Reading Society, the Economics Association, the UFO Research Organization... Dang it, I wanna join them all!

main3.line: Belfast's going to hang out with Edinburgh after school... Maaan, I wish my sisters would come see me, too...

touch.line: Commander, you got any more work you need help with? I've gotta go walk the doggy in 15 minutes!

unlock.line: Oh no! I-I'm gonna be late for school! Y-you need to speed up too, doggy! *Pant*... *pant*... Why'd none of my sisters wake me up before they left?!

battle.line: It's so hot... Let's mop up the enemies quickly so we can go home...

detail.line: I-I feel my consciousness... flapping away...

home.line: N-nicely done!

login.line: C-come on in! ... Oops, I mean, welcome back, Commander!

main1.line: I did promise Akashi I'd be the mascot... but it kind of feels like she tricked me...

main2.line: Could you help me pick these up, Commander? Wearing this makes them... mmrgh... impossible to reach, you see...

main3.line: What? The forecast warned about high temperatures? ... That's no biggie, I've already gotten used to it being really hot...

touch.line: C-Commander, don't touch me... I'm going to lose my balance...

touch2.line: Wh-what? What the heck are you doing, Commander?

unlock.line: "C-come on in! We've got special offers for you!" ... W-wait, is this really what a "sexy mascot" would wear? It feels pretty different from what I was expecting... And boy, is it stuffy in this thing...

win_mvp.line: Heheh! Wearing this costume... doesn't impact my performance at aaaall!

battle.line: Maybe my tuba... is useful in battle after all...?

detail.line: Didn't think an instrument could be so fun! I have to teach others about the joy of music!

expedition.line: Tooooot! The commission team has come back, Commander! ... No surprise: this tuba's reminding potential is totally next-level♪

feeling5.line: If I ever perform on stage, will you be there to listen, Commander? Actually, it'd be even better if you could be my maestro~

home.line: Did my pre-sortie motivational song serve you well, Commander?

login.line: My marching solo will wake you up, Commander!

main1.line: Let me play you a motivational song, Commander! Tooooot! ... Wh-what? That's annoying...? Sorry!

main2.line: You should learn an instrument so we can play a song together, Commander!

main3.line: Oh yeah, what do you think about my dress, Commander? Does it suit me? I absolutely adore it, it's all fluffy and stuff!

touch.line: Do you wanna hear a song, Commander? You got it! Manjuus, you all ready to go?

touch2.line: Whuah! ... Don't expect me to feel bad if I smack you with this thing, Commander!

unlock.line: Check it out, Commander! What do you think? ... No, not my dress! I'm talking about the tuba! Want me to play a tune for you~?

win_mvp.line: Okay, let's play a victory march to celebrate... H-hey! Wait for meeee!

detail.line: I bear the hopes and expectations of all the Special-type destroyers. I can't afford to be anything less than perfect!

feeling5.line: Commander, to be honest, I know I don't stand out as much compared to the other girls. But as long as you're by my side, I can stay on stage and shine brighter than anyone else. So, please keep your eyes on me!

home.line: Ah, Commander, good work out there! Did you come to watch my performance? I saved a special seat for you~

login.line: Let's begin today's performance! 3, 2, 1, Start!

main1.line: Woah, look at all the sisters who came out to cheer me on! Hey, Ayanami, Inazuma, Ikazuchi! I'll do my best~!

main2.line: The other girls are putting on an absolutely dazzling show, but I can't let them out-do me!

main3.line: Commander, I'll give it my all out there, so don't take your eyes off me!

touch.line: Ooh, water! As expected, Commander, you knew that I'd be thirsty. Thank you~

unlock.line: The whole world's going to feel the tremors from my debut! I'm Fubuki, the Special-type idol!

detail.line: If my sisters saw me working hard... would they say something like "Fubuki's such a hard-working role model?" Ehe... ehehe... Ah, I'm so so sorry, I just spaced out for a bit!

home.line: This Oxy-cola goes to this table, and uhh, a few more minutes on this pizza, and umm... Ahhh! This would be so much easier with a clone of me here!

login.line: Commander... Err, I mean, welcome! What would you like to order~?

main1.line: Sigh... When will I be able to handle this job as easily as Miss Belfast does?

main2.line: You want to chat with me? Sure, as soon as I get finished with all this stuff... Ughh...

main3.line: Did someone call for me? Excuse me, I'll be right there! Oh hey, it's Akatsuki and the others!

touch.line: Commander, this bell is just for decoration...

touch2.line: Eep?! It's hard to keep my balance, so stop with that already!

unlock.line: Welcome, welcome! Oh, Commander! I've actually started working here part-time, but I'm still learning— Wooah?! Phew... Th-that was a close one...

feeling5.line: Ugh, I'm supposed to set an example for my class and impress you, yet here I am, hopelessly tangled up... Huh? It's fine in the end because you got to see quite the sight? Uhh... It feels like you're poking fun at me here...

headtouch.line: Weeehhh... Is this your way of cheering me up?

home.line: Welcome back! First thing's first – help, please? We can hang up the lanterns after that.

login.line: Ahahaha... I can't exactly greet you when I'm tangled up like this.

main1.line: I heard you'd be attending the mid-autumn festival, so I thought I'd get better at hanging up lanterns... Ahahaha... It's sooo hard!

main2.line: I was gonna hang this one there, and then that one over there, but then I got caught up in the wires and fell over!

main3.line: Commander! I know what you're thinking – you're gonna bully me now, aren't you? I've told you I'm super ticklish...

mission.line: New missions? Hey, wait! I'll help you, just untie me first!

touch.line: This is just, uh... an accident, that's all!

touch2.line: Not there, Commander!

unlock.line: C-Commander?! Aw, shoot... I, uh, can't explain this in just one sentence... Please, just help me!

battle.line: I have a little experience with leading a fleet, but...

couple_encourage1.line: Oh, Fubuki. So full of energy.

couple_encourage2.line: You're from... Planet Bunny?

couple_encourage3.line: Ready for your orders!

detail.line: Why does everyone want to touch my ears? What's so special about them...?

expedition.line: Sounds like the commission team has returned to port. I heard their footsteps.

feeling1.line: I, I don't want to hear your noise...

feeling2.line: I've not heard anything suspicious today... And that's a good thing.

feeling3.line: I don't like crowds. All the noise they make gives me headaches... I much prefer quiet places.

feeling4.line: We could share an umbrella on a rainy day, go for a walk, and just listen to the sound of the raindrops... Hm? Did I say something out loud just now?

feeling5.line: Can I snuggle you up for a minute? Thanks... I can hear your heart going ba-thump, ba-thump. It's really soothing~

headtouch.line: Eep?! S-stop it, that tickles...

home.line: *clap* *clap*... I'm glad you're back. Let's have some tea together.

hp_warning.line: This doesn't look promising...

login.line: I see, so that's how your footsteps sound... I'll commit it to memory.

lose.line: They beat us... I'll cover our retreat!

mail.line: Here's your letter. You should read it before it becomes old news.

main1.line: I like the scritchy-scratchy noise paper makes when you write on it. It's relaxing.

main2.line: Fubuki's always bursting with energy whenever I see her. I'm honestly impressed with her...

main3.line: A carrot? Uhh, no thanks? What do you think I am? A rabbit?

mission.line: More new missions... Ugh... Could I call over Fubuki for some extra help?

mission_complete.line: That noise... Sounds like our rewards are here.

profile.line: I'm Shirayuki, Fubuki-class destroyer number 2. I served Destroyer Squadron 3 during the war, and... that's pretty much all I have to say. I'll make myself useful to you and the rest of the fleet.

propose.line: Is your heart racing, Commander? That's okay, because mine is too. Hehehe~ So, do you promise to always, always be with me? You're not going to regret it? Great! Then we're wed now!

touch.line: Is there something you want to talk about, Commander?

touch2.line: Wh-what do you think you're doing?!

unlock.line: Fubuki-class number two, Shirayuki. I'm a bit quieter than my elder sister... Mm, pleased to meet you.

upgrade.line: Motivation overclocked! ...Is what Fubuki would say, I bet.

win_mvp.line: It's over? Phew... Looks like everyone's okay, too.

gift_prefer.line: A gift for me? I, I guess I'll take it then?

detail.line: Today it's my turn to look after the bunnies. No, I said "look after," not "be looked after by."

home.line: Come here, little bunny. There, that's a good girl... Phew. Finally got them all to settle down.

login.line: I recognize that sound. It's you, Commander! Heheh. I know it by heart.

main1.line: Maybe I should also bring some hay along with the carrots... No, Fubuki! You can't feed that stuff to a bunny!

main2.line: I guess the ears really are the first thing people go for when they see a bunny... No, I'm talking about bunnies, not me!

main3.line: Oh, to be a happy rabbit, spending my days eating, sleeping, and playing with humans...

touch.line: There's a lot you have to keep in mind when playing with a bunny. For starters...

touch2.line: R-rally, bunnies! Bite the commander!

unlock.line: Whoa now! There's enough food for everyone, so don't fight over it! ...Commander? Don't just stand there, give me a hand, please!

battle.line: What nice weather... That means the battle should go smoothly, right...

couple_encourage1.line: I wish I could be a bundle of positivity like you, Fubuki...

couple_encourage2.line: Can I stroke your ears? Just a little bit is fine...

couple_encourage3.line: Please be careful, Inazuma...

couple_encourage4.line: If I touch your fluffy tail... will that bring me good fortune?

detail.line: Oh, these bandages? They're just in case I bump into a tree branch again... B-but you don't need to worry about it! I'm already used to it...

expedition.line: Commander, the friends we sent out on commission have returned safely... Thank goodness they're fine...

feeling1.line: Commander, you're scary... P-please stay away from me...

feeling2.line: Thank you for accepting me here...! I will do my best to repay this act of kindness! B-but first, I need to not cause trouble for you...

feeling3.line: Commander, was I able to do something useful for the fleet today? ...I did a great job? Yay! I, I'll continue to give it my all...!

feeling4.line: After we're done with work, is it okay if I stay with you a bit longer, Commander? I think I've become a bit more confident, all because of... I mean, all thanks to you...

feeling5.line: C-C-Commander, th-there's something I really want to tell you! Um, uhh, I... Nevermind, s-sorry! ...*sniffle* I can't even get myself to say it in practice, how could I ever make the Commander know my feelings...

headtouch.line: I, I will be okay...

home.line: Commander, good job on your sortie! Um... you didn't get hurt, did you? Did everything go well with the battle? Oh, sorry, I must be bothering you again...

hp_warning.line: *sniffle*... I hate it when this happens...!

login.line: G-good morning, Commander... Is there anything I can help with today? I, um, would like to be more useful to you...

lose.line: You don't need a useless girl like me, right... I'm so sorry...

mail.line: C-Commander, new mail has arrived... Sh-should I go sort through them first...?

main1.line: Fubuki is as outgoing as ever... If only I could be brimming with positivity just like her... F-forget I said anything...

main2.line: My tail is warm and fluffy...? Um, p-please don't go touching it all of a sudden... I'm a bit sensitive there...

main3.line: Um, is the fog rolling in? Bad weather makes me feel really uneasy... I really hate bad weather...

main4.line: Naka and her sisters are the ones who make my tail look pretty and nice... I can't do it all by myself...

mission.line: You've been assigned new missions...? Commander, should I go with you to check on them?

mission_complete.line: Commander, the mission rewards have arrived... Should I go bring them in for you...?

profile.line: I am a Special Type I Destroyer from the Sakura Empire, Fubuki-class number four, Miyuki... Due to some bad luck, I was never able to be of use... B-but, Commander, please don't hate me! I, I'm sure I'll be able to do something useful for you!

propose.line: W-wow... C-Commander, I'm always down on myself, and keep causing trouble for you... But you still want to stay by my side? I, I see... Thank you very much! I also... have always, always loved you, Commander!

skill.line: I don't want to have to say goodbye ever again...!

touch.line: C-Commander, did I mess up...?

touch2.line: P-please, don't do that... at least not where others can see...

unlock.line: Is this... my new home? C-Commander, it's an h-honor to meet you... I'm one of the Sakura Empire's special-type destroyers... Number four of the Fubuki-class, Miyuki. P-please command me as you see fit... Eep...

upgrade.line: Th-thank you very much! ...I, I'll work twice as hard!

win_mvp.line: I hope I managed to do something useful...

gift_prefer.line: A g-gift for me? Thank you for your consideration! *bows*

detail_ex.line: Commander! When you go on your next mission, c-can you take me with you? I want to stay with you... I know I'll be able to make myself useful somehow!

feeling5_ex.line: My most heartfelt wish...? Well, just getting to spend every day with you is already enough to make me happy... Um, but if I have to make a wish, I'd like to always stay here, a place I can call home, with the person I love...

headtouch_ex.line: It, it doesn't hurt at all... I feel warm and fuzzy inside when you pat my head...

home_ex.line: Commander! I've been praying and praying for your safe return... *sniffle*... Thank goodness...

login_ex.line: *sniff* *sniff*... Ahhn... It's the Commander's scent... Commander, welcome back! I, um, I haven't been waiting that long for you, it's fine...

lose_ex.line: As long as I can return to the Commander's side...

main5_ex.line: I'm sunnier and more positive than before...? Fubuki told me the same thing... Ehehe...

main6_ex.line: I, I don't mind if you like touching my tail... I can do anything for your sake... *blushes*

main7_ex.line: The weather looks pretty bad outside... But I'll be fine! Because, you promised to always stay by my side... and to save me even if I get hurt...

main8_ex.line: Mmgh... Ahh... Hnng?! *pant* *pant*... C-Commander? I wasn't d-d-doing anything! I was just, umm... i-imagining what it was like for you to stroke my tail... s-so I can get ready for the real thing...

touch_ex.line: Is it okay if... Umm, we hold hands a bit longer...?

touch2_ex.line: I, um... I don't mind... *blushes*

win_mvp_ex.line: I did it... Finally... Ehehe!

detail.line: I have to be careful not to cut myself when chopping the vegetables... Otherwise, Commander will be worried about me...

expedition.line: Our friends who were out on a commission are back. But, it'll be a while until they'll stop by to restock, right?

feeling5.line: I wish I could still go shopping with you after the pop-up café event ends... Huh? We'll all still be together after that, so you don't mind going with me...? Ahh... Thank you... Thank you so much, Commander...

headtouch.line: Ehehe...

home.line: Commander, are you still working on the after-action report...? I'm so sorry I couldn't help you even though I'm supposed to be your secretary... Huh? I already did you a big favor when we were shopping? I see, that makes me feel better...

login.line: Commander, what are we going to go buy next?

mail.line: Commander, you've got new mail... Would it be better if I read through it first...?

main1.line: Do I like going shopping by myself? N-not really... The way people look at me is a bit scary... so I usually go with Fubuki or Shirayuki...

main2.line: Eek?! My tail got caught between the shelves... Nngh... Commander, please help me! *blushes*

main3.line: It's important to stock up on food, you know? Just in case we can't go shopping because of bad weather, like a typhoon or something...

main4.line: Commander, are you going to stop by the Sakura pop-up café next time? I learned to cook a new dish, so... I can deliver it to the dorms too if you'd like...

mission.line: There's a new mission... Go ahead and take a look at it. You don't need to worry about me...

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards are in... D-do you think we could go fetch them together...? *blushes*

touch.line: Eep...! What's wrong? Oh, I'm going to hurt myself if I keep rubbing the pointy part...? Oh, th-thank you...

unlock.line: Commander, I think the goods over here are a bit cheaper... Umm, I'm doing fine on my budget still, so we can pick out some more things to buy. A-also, I'll get to spend more time shopping with you... Ah, d-disregard that please... *blushes*

win_mvp.line: I want to be more useful to you, Commander...!

detail.line: Oh, Commander, kitties are gathering around... Do you think they're hungry? Hmm... Wait a second, okay? I can share just a little bit of my crepe...

feeling5.line: Today's fortune is, umm... that I can always be happy by your side, Commander? ...You'll always share your fortune with me? No! I love you, so I want you to keep your fortune with you...!

headtouch.line: Nnh... Don't pet my ears so much, or I'll get sleepy...

home.line: Commander, good work today! ...No, I haven't been waiting long. It's okay. Umm, here... This crepe's still warm.

login.line: H-hi, Commander... Are you sure we should be going on a date right now? Your work... Oh, you finished it? Th-thank goodness!

main1.line: The weather is nice, I'm not hurt... and I didn't drop my crepe... I-I'm sure your good fortune is outweighing my bad fortune, Commander! Yeah, that must be it...!

main2.line: A delicious crepe, a cute little fox plushie... Say, why did you give me this plushie? It's like me? Because it's smiling...? I-I'm only smiling because I'm on a date with you...

main3.line: I'm just happy to be able to go shopping with you after work, Commander... Oh, there's cream on your face. There, all clean... Oops! I didn't realize how close I was getting...

touch.line: C-Commander... Umm, do you want to hold hands...?

touch2.line: M-maybe not outside... Mm... L-let's go home first, okay...?

unlock.line: C-Commander, I'm ready any time... You think my outfit's cute...? Th-thank you... Heheh, I got it just for our date... Umm, I figured hiding my bandages might help ward off my bad luck...

detail.line: Commander... Do you like this outfit? U-umm, I dressed up like this to make mochi... I-if you like it, then I'll make mochi for you more often...

feeling5.line: I-I may have made a few mistakes, but I like... No... I love how you embrace me despite my clumsiness. I really love you...!

headtouch.line: Was there mochi on my head? I didn't even notice... It's a good thing you did!

home.line: I'm almost done cleaning! And then... we can make mochi together. Hehe... I just know it'll be the best mochi ever.

login.line: You wanna make mochi together...? Umm, it's a little cramped... Guess we'll have to huddle close...

main1.line: Ah, Commander, you can't eat that mochi. It fell on the floor... Hm? Five-second rule...? I'm pretty sure it's been longer.

main2.line: I got all flustered when I flipped the tray over, but you were so nice to me instead of getting mad... I'm really happy...

main3.line: Huh? Did I get sticky rice flour on me, too? Where... Hyah?! C-Commander? Umm, don't lick it off of me, please...

touch.line: You wanna see if there's any sticky rice flour on my tail? O-okay...

touch2.line: R-right here? Ah... Commander, you'll get sticky rice flour on yourself, too...

unlock.line: Eep! Aw, I fell... All the mochi I made for you is ruined... Huh? You'll help me clean up? Th-thank you, Commander!
