battle.line: Want to go... to Solomon?

couple_encourage1.line: I will protect you all.

couple_encourage2.line: Laffey, I've run out of oxy-cola again...

couple_encourage3.line: Long Island... don't get distracted on the battlefield.

couple_encourage4.line: I'm depending on you for aerial coverage.

detail.line: I've inspected the communication equipment. It won't cause any more problems...

expedition.line: Commander, a commission has finished.

feeling1.line: I don't really want to get any closer.

feeling2.line: Ayanami's impressions of Commander? I don't really know.

feeling3.line: Commander, you're always saying that my ears are cute... But why won't you touch them?

feeling4.line: If there's one thing that worries me... it would be when you are not at my side.

feeling5.line: I don't particularly... like or dislike combat. I just do what must be done. But if it's for you, Commander... maybe I can get a bit stronger.

headtouch.line: I don't really get it but... I'm a bit happy...

home.line: Commander, you're a little like me on the battlefield... That's... pretty cool.

hp_warning.line: I don't want... to be alone...

login.line: Commander, have you eaten yet? Here's some snacks.

lose.line: It's okay... I'll recover quickly.

mail.line: There's... new mail...

main1.line: {namecode:6}'s ears... are they cute? I don't understand... As long as you're happy, Commander!

main2.line: I've been having nightmares of all the girls getting lost... I'm certain that it's my fault, too...

main3.line: Commander? No, nothing. I just wanted to see if you were here or not.

mission.line: Commander, we've been notified of new missions.

mission_complete.line: The rewards for the previous mission are here.

profile.line: I am Ayanami, an improved Fubuki-class destroyer. I am not afraid of combat. Though just a destroyer, I can fight any enemy...

propose.line: Rest assured... This time, no matter what happens, I'll survive and return to you... because I'll always want to see you again...

skill.line: Bear witness to the true power of the "Demon"

touch.line: Uuu... it tickles...a bit.

touch2.line: Commander... please... don't touch there so much... It's making me feel weird...

unlock.line: I'm... Ayanami. I am often called the "Demon." Pleasure to meet you.

upgrade.line: My power is overflowing...

win_mvp.line: MVP? I don't really get it, but... thanks.

gift_prefer.line: Ayanami is... really happy, yes.

main1.line: Are these... sweets? Thank you. I will try them.

main2.line: There are fun things outside of combat and training too...

main3.line: If I stand on this pumpkin lantern... will I be closer to reaching the skies?

touch.line: I think... I like this costume.

touch2.line: Tonight, I am not a demon... but a witch!

unlock.line: I heard that... I need to wear a costume like this to participate in Halloween festivities. Commander... do I look cute?

battle.line: This song... fits the battlefield well.

detail.line: When I put on my headphones, the music flows and washes away everything in the world... except you...

expedition.line: Training and commissions... there''s no time to slack off...

login.line: Commander, before work starts, want to listen to music together?

main1.line: Commander, Javelin asked if I could play later. Is that okay?

main2.line: Commander, what kind of music do you like? I like... um, rock?

main3.line: Ikazuchi said she was playing something called a "mobage." Commander, do you know what that is?

mission_complete.line: I'm somewhat looking forward to today's rewards...

touch.line: Ayanami's riggings... can also become musical instruments. Commander, do you want to hear me play?

unlock.line: Commander, want to listen to music together? Do you like... this non-combat-oriented Ayanami?

win_mvp.line: "As long as you're smiling..." What does that mean?

detail.line: This outfit feels light and easy to move in, not bad at all... Very cute? Um... thank you...

feeling5.line: I wish you a happy and peaceful holiday~ Commander, I hope that we can continue being together like this forever...

login.line: Commander, the girls from the Dragon Empery seem to be having a banquet... Want to come with me to have a look?

main1.line: This year's zodiac animal is... Eh? Commander, did you see where the piglet ran off to?

main2.line: Commander, are we under attack? I hear a lot of explosions... Eh? So those are a form of celebration? That sounds interesting, yes...

main3.line: What is this "ding-a-ling" sound? It reminds me... of our New Year back home...

touch.line: Commander, this dress is made with really comfortable materials... Want to feel...?

touch2.line: Commander, you can't... lift that part...

unlock.line: Compared to the way we celebrate New Year in the Sakura Empire, the festivities of the Dragon Empery have a completely different atmosphere... But, I don't really mind the liveliness... Commander, do you like festivals?

detail.line: Training to be a waitress is something that Ayanami has never experienced before. It's very novel, yes...

feeling5.line: When I'm off work, I want to spend some time with you, Commander... I'll make you a special bento that I learned how to make at work... Is that okay, Commander?

home.line: Would you like a special combo meal to celebrate your safe return?

login.line: Commander, what would you like to order today? The menu is right here...

main1.line: Laffey said that it's important to diversify your diet. So... today, would you like something sweet, Commander?

main2.line: Javelin is always so energetic, no matter what she's doing. I'm a little jealous...

main3.line: Being a waitress... is harder work than I imagined...

touch.line: I should hold the serving platter... like this? Commander, are you trying to help me? It's okay, I think I can manage on my own.

unlock.line: "Welcome, Commander..." I should greet customers like this... yes?

battle.line: I'll show you the power... of Ayanami and her friends!

detail.line: Even though we were supposed to use our codenames, Kaga just went and spilled the beans. It's a bit troublesome when nobody is going to use them...

headtouch.line: They're ears, not horns...

login.line: Commander, want to join Ayanami in cover ops training? ...Hmm, actually, that seems futile.

lose.line: The concealment function that Yuubari added was not very useful...

mail.line: The mail's been... Oh, the members of the maid team responsible for protecting you have already looked it over. It's fine to open it.

main1.line: Those Cloak of Invisibility things that they have in the Royal Navy are really cool... they make me a bit jealous...

main2.line: When I need help, I usually turn to Shouhou or Zed. As for Fubuki... she always hears me out on a variety of stuff. I'm very thankful.

main3.line: This cloak that Yuubari developed for me... has a function that "always conceals its wearer's face." That's... probably good.

main4.line: Commander's office is always protected, and it is absolutely safe. There's no need to worry.

touch.line: Commander, want an apple? They're really good.

unlock.line: Ayanami here. Successfully infiltrated Commander's office. Oh... Commander saw me. Operation failed...

upgrade.line: This power... is for the sake of protecting my friends...!

win_mvp.line: The enemy's lookouts have been taken out succcessfully. Thank you, Commander.

battle.line: An idol's duty is to protect everyone's smiles!

detail.line: Z23 is always looking out for us... Even though she has her own schedule to worry about, she always helps us manage ours.

home.line: If I imagine performances to be like battles, and think of the audience as enemies... Err, wait, that's not going to work.

login.line: Commander, I'm currently practicing my dance routine. Want to watch?

main1.line: Singing and dancing are no problem for me, but smiling is hard... Javelin said that's what makes me cute though. Is that true, Commander?

main2.line: Commander, Z23 told me that rock n' roll and idols don't really go together. Do you think I could make metal cute?

main3.line: Fubuki seems to also be doing idol training. We should go see her... in a little bit.

main4.line: I never knew that there were so many things to do as an idol. I'm getting all fired up.

touch.line: Commander, this is what I learned from my lessons today.

unlock.line: I guess I'm making my idol debut? Um, Javelin and the others are making their debuts, so, I also had to... Commander, what are idols supposed to do normally?

win_mvp.line: Victory pose. Yeah.

detail.line: Now, I know that I'm not alone anymore... because you're here after all, Commander...

feeling5.line: I enjoy being with everyone, but... I'd also like to spend more time alone with you, Commander...

home.line: Commander... shall I rub your shoulders?

login.line: No matter where you go, Ayanami shall always walk three steps behind you. Commander... shall we go?

main1.line: I'm not sure... I understand the meaning of these clothes... but since you'd like me to wear them, I don't mind...

main2.line: Everyone was staring at me so excitedly... I'm not used to this...

touch.line: Commander, I like cuddling with you like this... It feels nice.

touch2.line: This feels... a bit weird after all... But, if you like it, I don't mind...

unlock.line: I'm still... your Ayanami... though I'm not very used to this outfit... Commander, does it suit me?

win_mvp.line: Commander, as long as you're by my side, I won't lose.

battle.line: It will be all right, Commander... Believe in me...

main1.line: Commander, I feel like I can work a bit harder when I'm with you...

main2.line: Being with everyone makes me happy... so I want to be able to stay together...

main3.line: Commander, if you leave me alone... I'll be hurt...

touch.line: Commander's hands... are so warm...

unlock.line: Ayanami, retrofit complete. I feel stronger, yes... Having that said, Commander, can you pat my head? I want to be pampered a bit...

win_mvp.line: If it is for everyone's sake... I am willing to become the "Demon."

battle.line: Destroyer Division Six, embark!

couple_encourage1.line: Together we shall shine a light on the darkness!

couple_encourage2.line: We will always be together!

detail.line: T-the reason I sleep with the lights on is because... i-it is not because I am afraid!

expedition.line: We may use my searchlight to find our way home! Huh? ... You have no need of it? R-really...?

feeling1.line: Commander, you must cheer up!

feeling2.line: I am a little worried... about {namecode:13} and {namecode:14}...

feeling3.line: Commander, do you perhaps wish to see my true right eye?

feeling4.line: I cannot sleep well without my sisters by my side... T-that is not to say I am lonely! I-it is because I am concerned about them!

feeling5.line: We Division Six destroyers have always been together! And... um, surely you will be together with me forever as well, Commander?

home.line: Commander~ Did you bring back any shiny items? ... Hm?! N-not at all, I am not asking simply because I want such things!

login.line: My name is {namecode:11}, I am the ninja who will banish all the darkness in the world! ... Whoa! Commander, w-when did you get here?!

lose.line: Damn... I-I shall get you next time...

mail.line: New mail for you! Uh... I will read it out loud for you!

main1.line: Sometimes I do not understand what {namecode:13} and {namecode:14} are trying to say...

main2.line: Can {namecode:12} find her way here on her own? It has me somewhat worried...

main3.line: W-w-what! Anyone would be shocked from suddenly seeing a person's shadow cast in the light in the middle of the night!

mission.line: The ocean at night is a little scary... N-nay, I am not scared! B-but may I propose we do missions during daytime? You must agree, right?!

mission_complete.line: Rewards~ rewards~!

profile.line: I am {namecode:11}, a special-type destroyer! Destroyer Division Six consisted of me and my sisters! I was the first to be built and the first to be sunk! The Battle of Guadalcanal? I-I was trying to cast my light on the enemy! I was by no means scared of them! ... Ahem, you shall witness how strong I truly am... that you will!

propose.line: A promise that binds us for eternity... I understand! Then I shall show you my true right eye, right this mo... T-there is no need for it? All I need to do is close my eyes instead? Re... really...?

touch.line: {namecode:12}... I really miss her...

touch2.line: S-should you touch me there again... then I will not be able to restrain myself!

unlock.line: I am {namecode:11}, the oldest ship of Destroyer Division Six! Well met, Commander. I sincerely hope you will let me rebuild Division Six! ... Huh?! You do not permit the formation of destroyer divisions?!

upgrade.line: As the oldest of my siblings, I must work even harder!

win_mvp.line: This is the true power of a ninja!

gift_prefer.line: Woah! This is awesome!

main2_ex.line: Hibiki, I won't let myself get lost over something like that ever again!

touch_ex.line: Hibiki? Oh, it's just you, Commander...

detail.line: I made friends of these bears on my journey! I suggest you try befriend them too, Commander... Er, forsooth!

home.line: To one day find Hibiki – that is the reason I set out upon this journey!

login.line: Being fully prepared is the key to going in the right direction! Say that again? The East lies *that* way?

main1.line: I've still not found Hibiki... I really do wonder when we'll meet again.

main2.line: It is thanks to my compass that I have arrived at the Northern Parliament! Huh? How long has the needle been frozen in place?!

main3.line: I'm curious as to how Ikazuchi and Inazuma are faring...

touch.line: Would you care to harken to one of my tales of valor?

touch2.line: Oooh, I feel myself warming up! I don't know why, though... Something about it feels strange.

unlock.line: Is this the place called the Northern Parliament?! It is colder than I thought... Th-thank goodness I brought gear for extreme environments! Hibiki, please wait a bit longer! Your sister is coming to see you!

detail.line: My companion and I have shared so many miles together... Hm, maybe next time I should call my cohorts to take her for a spin together!

home.line: My bond with my companion has grown even deeper!

login.line: Motoninja Akatsuki, reporting in! Commander, your orders please!

main1.line: My companion's lights are strong indeed, but I still find these night roads rather difficult...

main2.line: Back before I had broken her in, my companion here gave me a lot of trouble. But these days? We move as one and the same!

main3.line: Inazuma and Ikazuchi are going to be impressed with my companion!

touch.line: I'm afraid you can't ride her, Commander...

touch2.line: Wooooaaaahh!! I'm losing control!

unlock.line: What do you think, Commander? I have a brand new outfit and a brand new companion! I am no longer a plain old ninja... I am now a motoninja!

battle.line: No ambushes! Let us fight face to face!

detail.line: This obstacle will be child's play if I'm able to leverage my ninja skills... I-I'm going the right way this time, I'm sure of it!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned! Speaking of... Where did my presents for them go?

home.line: I could've sworn we met here just a minute ago... Wait, a-am I going in circles?!

login.line: These presents must all be delivered before the end of today... Commander, we should depart at once!

lose.line: I m-must maintain my posture...!

main1.line: I'm well acquainted with how to use a grappling hook! ...What? Oh no! The presents!

main2.line: Hmgh! Oh goodness... That's a long way down. C-Commander, how did we end up ascending so high?!

main3.line: Hibiki will deliver the remaining presents? Phew, that's good to know...

mission.line: The sp-spirits of Christmas roam the port at night? C-C-C-Commander! It takes more than that to perturb me, I'll have you know!

touch.line: Umm, C-Commander... You will stop my fall, won't you?!

touch2.line: C-careful, lest the rope come loose!

unlock.line: Look out! Move, Commander! ...Phew. To explain, I am helping Santa give out Christmas presents! Now excuse me, I cannot tarry here or I'll be late... Wait, have I come to the wrong place? WHAT?!

battle.line: I shall dance around our foes!

detail.line: Inazuma's elephant is quite the clever fellow. Heehee, let us see if it can catch this ball!

expedition.line: The commission team has– Oh no, oh no! ...That was close... Thank you for breaking my fall, Commander...

home.line: You've returned, Commander! Let us continue the performance! Hi-yaaah! Behold! Jutsu of Concealment!

login.line: I see... So it's called a performance, not an exhibition... Be that as it may, the show must go on!

main1.line: Ikazuchi, are you all right?! ...Phew... Don't make your sister worry like that!

main2.line: Behold! Jutsu of Flame Escape! ...*cough cough*! This darned pyrotechnic device is needlessly complicated!

main3.line: Don't just stand there, Hibiki – come and assist! ...Your anchor really contains a hidden camera?! ...You just made that up? Aghh! Hibikiiii!

mission.line: A mission, you say? It shall serve as a fine side act!

touch.line: Watch and be amazed, Commander!

touch2.line: H-hands off!

unlock.line: Welcome, Commander, to DesDiv 6's tent of entertainment! For our first act, I shall perform for you my most stunning ninjutsu! ..."Circus"? I've never heard of this word before!

win_mvp.line: My ninjutsu is no mere acrobatic act, it's authentic! ...At least I'm fairly sure it is!

battle.line: Heheh~ Hibiki is super strong~! If you don't believe me, just take a look at this~♪

couple_encourage1.line: Woah, are you a phoenix as well?

couple_encourage2.line: 6th DesDiv, set sail!

couple_encourage3.line: Maybe you're a real phoenix!

couple_encourage4.line: Akatsuki, let's do this, together!

couple_encourage5.line: Ikazuchi, be careful for unseen enemies!

couple_encourage6.line: Inazuma, be on the lookout for unseen enemies!

detail.line: Everyone in the 6th DesDiv is super unique! There's Ikazuchi, Inazuma, and we even have Akatsuki the ninja! I love everyone! Ehehe~

expedition.line: Ah, that's right, the commission fleet seems to have returned? Should I go with you to welcome them back?

feeling1.line: Commander, it seems like the only way to get you to open your eyes is to get a bit rough... *sigh*...

feeling2.line: I've been making Akatsuki worried all this time. I have to apologize to her properly, as well as thank her.

feeling3.line: Akatsuki, you've been pretty gung-ho about getting the 6th DesDiv back together... Well, the name's not that important as long as we're all together. That's what I think anyway~

feeling4.line: Ah, that reminds me! Commander, have you been taking care of yourself properly? We'd be in serious trouble if you got sick and collapsed or something... Well, even if that happened to you, Hibiki would tenderly nurse you back to health~♪

feeling5.line: Commander, why don't you tell me your story? I'm really interested! ...Why? No particular reason~ Haven't we exhausted all the other topics already? Ehehe~

home.line: Good work out there~ Well, having that said, you still have a lot of stuff that needs to be done... Ahaha...

hp_warning.line: I won't let it end like this!

login.line: Commander, did you just pop in~? All righty... Let's both get some good work done today!

lose.line: Awww... Looks like I'll have to go back to port for repairs...

mail.line: Mail? Show me as well! Show me!

main1.line: Verniy...? It has a nostalgic ring to it...

main2.line: I'm so glad that we can all be together again~♪

main3.line: If you don't need me for anything, I'm going to go play with Ikazuchi and Inazuma~

mission.line: We sure have all sorts of different missions, huh... Don't sweat it though! I'll help you out!

mission_complete.line: Missionnnn... complete! ...Hey, Commander, you should get pumped up too!

profile.line: I'm Hibiki, from the 6th DesDiv~♪ I fought in many battles with my friends, and even saw the end of things. That's good and all, but... having to go in for repairs at that time was a bit awkward... Ahaha...

propose.line: I've been waiting so long for this! Ehehe~ I love you, Commander! ...Ah, look at you getting all bashful~ But my turn's not over yet. I love love love you~! Ehehe~

touch.line: Yo! Did you call me, Commander?

touch2.line: Ah~! Commander, I bet you did that on purpose just now!

unlock.line: Nihihi~ We finally meet at last, Commander! The name's Hibiki! Don't you forget it!

upgrade.line: So this is that "leveling up" thing that Ikazuchi mentioned? Nihihi~

win_mvp.line: Heheh~ I'll be taking that gold star~!

gift_prefer.line: Woooah! Thanks a bunch, Commander!

detail.line: Well, um, y'see, sorry to keep you all waiting for so long. I do feel kinda bad about it, but since we're all here, let's cheer up and put the past behind us! That's right, look forward! Ehehe~!

headtouch.line: Want to know more about oni horn? Or this golden badge here?

home.line: Good work~ Even though it's the New Year's season, there's still a mountain of work to get through, isn't there~? Looks like I won't get to sleep the day away after all, *sniff*~

login.line: Commander, you haven't started working yet?

main1.line: Akatsuki, you went all the way to the South Pole to look for me?! W-well, I certainly didn't expect that...

main2.line: Just like me, Fubuki seems to also like being the center of attention. But for whatever reason, only she keeps getting herself into weird situations. Why is that?

main3.line: This brisk weather is nothing compared to the cold of the Northern Parliament! Huh? I'm comparing it to the wrong thing?

touch2.line: You couldn't control yourself because I looked too delicious? Commander, you beast~

unlock.line: New Year's finally comes to port! I, Hibiki of the 6th DesDiv, will be marking my new arrival in my New Year's attire! Commander, don't you dare change the channel - you've gotta watch my every move~!

battle.line: I see! So all we need to do is press that auto button in the top left and we'll be fine!

couple_encourage1.line: Destroyer Division Six... depart!

detail.line: If you bow deep and beg for it, I'll make your wishes basically come true! ... It didn't work? Um, well... that's because you haven't wished hard enough yet!

expedition.line: If you let a completed commission just sit there, does it gain any "interest"?

feeling1.line: I see! This means that if I just let myself get washed away by the ocean then I can come back home...

feeling2.line: Commander, if there's ever anything you don't understand, just ask me. After all, I've used up more oil than you ever will in your life.

feeling3.line: It's my birthday tomorrow. Have you gotten a gift for me yet? You didn't know it was my birthday? Ah, well... see that pendant over there? Buy it and give it to someone you like, I'm sure they'll be delighted!

feeling4.line: Commander! I found a sweet way to make a ton of money! Um, it says "if you invest 10,000 coins then I can recruit 2 more people for my startup, and you'll see a monthly 30% profit",stuff like that... But what's a "startup"...?

feeling5.line: I see! This thing making my heart race is called "love"! Alright, I understand. That means...! W-wha...? I feel so lightheaded... It feels like the world's spinning around me... Is this "love" too?

home.line: Times like these call for fine wine and good food! Hard work shouldn't go unnoticed and all that! Hm? Where do we get it from? From the dorm! There's plenty of it there!

login.line: I see! You just "logged in" didn't you? Human language sure is profound...

lose.line: I see...! Times like these you should P2GSOE2PTG4U! Pay to get someone else to play the game for you! Or you can just let me handle it instead!

mail.line: I see! This is that... thingy! The thing you need to bring with you to be let into that one chocolate factory!

main1.line: Almost as fast as {namecode:18}? So, the wind is faster than thunder and lighting?

main2.line: I see! So {namecode:14}-chan landed the "First Strike" in the World War!

main3.line: I see! So if I stay in the shipyard all the time I'll become a "Phoenix"! Yep, I'd be a... "Thunder Phoenix"...?

mission.line: You haven't finished the mission? ... That sounds about as bad as not finishing your job.

mission_complete.line: Come on! I'm the commander's secretary, but I can't claim rewards on his behalf?! What are the people in charge thinking!

profile.line: I'm {namecode:13}, an {namecode:11}-class destroyer. I may not look like it, but I'm a Sakura Empire veteran. Even {namecode:83} calls me... um, what was I called again? Anyways, it was something like that! You can count on me to do my job! Also, see that LIKE button? Give it a good tap and make sure to subscribe to my channel!

propose.line: Just gotta write my name here, right? ... Um, I don't think I get it... {namecode:14}-chan, care to explain this? ... "After you sign it, you'll belong to the commander forever"? Okay, got it!

skill.line: I see! This is the power that two sisters have!

touch.line: I see! This is one of those ordinary "greeting" things, right?

touch2.line: Uh, umm... is this what I think it is? I know full well the meaning of w-what you did! I-I see...

unlock.line: I am {namecode:13}…I’m simply not very talkative...I think you’ll be seeing a lot more of me in the future, Commander.

upgrade.line: I'd rather have my "ratings","likes",and "gimme" stats enhanced instead!

win_mvp.line: I see! Now this is what you should expect of someone as "prestigious" as me! Er, or was it "pretentious"...?

gift_prefer.line: Moar! Moar pl0x!

detail.line: If it's inevitable, then hopefully the Commander will only take a small bite…. no, wrong! It’s, it’s probably better if {namecode:13} can be spared just this one time!

main1.line: {namecode:13}, {namecode:13} still have a lot of anime to catch up on, Commander. At least let {namecode:13} finish the season she’s watching! Pretty please!

main2.line: It smells so, so good… {namecode:13} just can’t take it anymore and wants to have a bite.

main3.line: That being the case! What would {namecode:13} be like in another world… then?

touch.line: C-Commander, {namecode:13} is falling off from the plate, whoaaa—

touch2.line: Ha… So it turns out that the Commander already knew {namecode:13} is {namecode:13}...

unlock.line: {namecode:13}, {namecode:13} has been transformed into tea! What should we do! {namecode:14} and {namecode:13} will get slurped up by the Commander!

detail.line: Commander! If you get the Inazuma DLC, you'll have a full set of wings!

home.line: Going straight from grinding EXP to grinding at the party, huh? I'd expect nothing less of you, Commander!

login.line: Commander, finally decided to "log in," huh? Wanna join the party?

main1.line: I've brought a bunch of mouth-watering strawberries! Commander, wanna try one?

main2.line: We thought Akatsuki had gotten lost again, but Hibiki seems to have bumped into her. I see, I see, so that's what we call a "random encounter!"

main3.line: Don't you think this tooty manjuu is a bit annoying? ...You don't even see it, Commander?

touch.line: How am I supposed to fly with only one wing? ...Well, even if I had two, it probably still wouldn't work out!

unlock.line: I'm the fairy of thunder that shatters the night to herald the dawn! I see, I see! That is a good backstory! Commander, want to head to the party together?

battle.line: Hm... Huh?! We've been ambushed!

couple_encourage1.line: Hibiki...? Sorry, I thought you were someone else...

couple_encourage2.line: Destroyer Division Six... departing!

detail.line: Commander... it seems you're always holed up in your room...

expedition.line: Commander... your "gasoline" and "resources" have arrived.

feeling1.line: Commander, no matter what you may become, I will always be with you.

feeling2.line: Commander, I will assist you.

feeling3.line: A shared sorrow is one made half, and shared joy is one made double. So please feel free to talk to me about anything.

feeling4.line: Commander, no matter where you go, I will always be with you. ... However... I don't think I can... leave the boundaries of this screen...

feeling5.line: Commander, it's terrible for your body eat junk food all the time. How about cooking your own food once in a while? Hm? Don't worry, I'll taste test it together with you!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Even if you didn't "acquire new characters",I will always be here.

login.line: Is that... you, Commander? I can't believe you're logging in at this time of day... shouldn't you be doing something else?

lose.line: Phew... Commander... you're very good at running away...

mail.line: You have mailophobia? ... You don't have to be scared, I'm here with you.

main1.line: Commander, your biggest flaw is how kind you are.

main2.line: {namecode:40}... she's helped me quite a lot...

main3.line: "Salvaging" is my specialty!

mission.line: If you leave your missions unfinished forever... then you'll end up having to do this bad thing called "overtime".

mission_complete.line: This month's bonus pay won't be postponed into the next month.

profile.line: I am... the Sakura Empire's {namecode:11}-class type III destroyer, {namecode:14}. As the youngest of my class, I participated in a lot of battles in the World War. But I prefer escorts, transports, and rescues over combat. ... Commander? Would you like to have your head patted too?

propose.line: Commander... please feel at ease. I would never abandon you. Even if you've had enough and run away, I will always, always be waiting here for you.

skill.line: If only everyone were here with us...

touch.line: Commander... could you pat my head?

touch2.line: Commander... there's no medicine that can fix you.

unlock.line: Are you the commander...? You don't seem very reliable... Ah, sorry, my self-introduction. My name is... {namecode:14}.

upgrade.line: Phew... I'm glad that didn't hurt as much as I thought.

win_mvp.line: ... I'M the MVP? ... Is this fleet... doing okay?

gift_prefer.line: Nice one, Commander! 50 DKP plus!

detail.line: Mr. Commander, after you swallowed {namecode:14} up... you must be ready to sortie.

login.line: ...{namecode:14}’s heartfelt wish, has it been communicated? …Mr. Commander...

main1.line: Are you hungry… Mr. Commander?

main2.line: Are you trying to find {namecode:14}, Mr. Commander? {namecode:14} is right in front of you.

main3.line: Mr. Commander, you’re always so gentle...

touch.line: Mr. Commander, are we starting this… please accept all of {namecode:14}, both the good and the bad—

touch2.line: Mr. Commander, have you heard {namecode:14}’s heartfelt words? You’re really amazing Mr. Commander!

unlock.line: It doesn’t matter if {namecode:14} becomes Mr. Commander's dessert… but if {namecode:14} cannot be found, Mr. Commander will feel so devastated, perhaps he won’t be able to command the fleet… so… please! Please convey {namecode:14}'s heartfelt wish to Mr. Commander——

detail.line: Commander, you didn't just buy these clothes for me because Ikazuchi asked you to, right? It doesn't bother me. Not one bit...

feeling5.line: Commander, I know I'm super cute and all, but you'll develop social anxiety if you constantly cling to me and ignore everyone else. Since I'm also super responsible, you should go to the festival and enjoy the company of others.

home.line: Prioritizing work over Inazuma... Commander, you sure are a workaholic.

login.line: I was beginning to think that you forgot about our plans, Commander.

main1.line: Commander, I'd like some taiyaki. Is that okay?

main2.line: It feels unexpectedly nice to walk around without my shoes... Commander, why don't you try it too?

main3.line: Commander, you can go check out everyone's yukatas if you'd like. I'll look around by myself first.

touch.line: Commander, no matter how much you poke me, I won't have any Live2D.

unlock.line: I usually go to festivals with Ikazuchi, but this would be my first time going with you. Hmm? Where should we visit first?

detail.line: If you combine both of our wings, there might not be much room left on the screen... Why don't you edit it in and see for yourself, Commander?

home.line: Whether you are fighting, taking care of commissions, or just checking daily missions, I will always be waiting for you here.

login.line: Commander, I'm glad you haven't forgotten the promise you made with me and Ikazuchi.

main1.line: Akatsuki said she wanted to join us so we can have a 6th DesDiv get-together at the party, but she seems to have gotten lost on the way... I hope Hibiki is able to find her.

main2.line: "The moon is beautiful tonight" is supposed to be a pretty famous line, right? Eh... How'd you already know about it, Ikazuchi?

main3.line: Ikazuchi seems to have brought you some strawberries. Judging from your expression, I'm... supposed to bring you blueberries?

touch.line: Commander, shall I bring you something to eat or drink?

unlock.line: I'm the fairy of lightning that illuminates the stars in the night sky... So that's what we're going with, huh. Commander, will you accompany me to the party?

detail.line: I know I'm supposed to be a maid, but I actually can't do anything but make flower arrangements. But I guess it's fine since all you care about is the outfit, huh...

feeling5.line: I'm a maid, so it's normal for me to stick close to the person I serve. ...Yep, you don't have to lift a finger. As long as you rely on me, that's enough.

headtouch.line: Yep. Your hands... are very warm.

home.line: I'm so happy you made it back safe and sound. I've been waiting here for you for so long.

login.line: Huh? I'm supposed to be your maid for now, but you got here earlier than me... Uh, is it too late to serve you?

main1.line: I've been practicing with this incredible tool called PictureShop. It makes my flower arrangements look even better and motivates me to practice more.

main2.line: A purple rose suits me well. ...If you want to decorate your office with a few, go ahead and take some more.

main3.line: "If loving you is a sin, then I'll kill God if I have to!" ...That was a joke. That's kind of a quote, right? Yeah... Totally.

mission.line: You have new missions. My overtime alarms are practically blaring right now.

mission_complete.line: Mission completed, overtime fee received. Not too bad, right?

touch.line: Do you want to let me try cleaning your ears for you? Okay, lay your head in my lap...

touch2.line: Commander, you're always in such a hurry... But it's okay this time.

unlock.line: One, two... Mm. All done, Commander. Yep... I'll be your maid today. I don't know how to do much other than make flower arrangements, but I can stay by your side all day.

battle.line: L-l-l-look out, get out of the way! My breaks aren't working!

detail.line: Commander, what are you looking at? Hm? Come on, tell me...

expedition.line: Commander, while I was lost just earlier, I ran into some girls who'd just completed a commission...

feeling1.line: Huh...? I got lost and ended up next to the commander... I'd better run...

feeling2.line: Huh? Commander? Thank goodness~ I thought I'd gotten lost again... You saw me leave and come back here 5 times? *Giggles* Then today's a surprisingly lucky day~

feeling3.line: Huh...? Commander? I realized a while back that I'm always by your side, did you cast some kind of magic on me?

feeling4.line: *Whimper*... Commander, you're being mean... I thought I'd do something to you in return~ So I'll let you hug me...

feeling5.line: Commander, recently whenever I see you I've wanted to tell you something, and I try to catch up to you, but then I forget what I wanted to say... It has to be something important... But what could it be...

home.line: Commander, you didn't get lost out there? Wooow!

login.line: Huh? So this is where you were, Commander... *Giggles*

lose.line: Gah... ow ow... what in the world hit me...?

mail.line: Commander, there's mail!

main1.line: Commander, did you see my torpedo? ... It went off somewhere suddenly.

main2.line: Weird... lately I seem to forget what I'm forgetting... What am I gonna do...

main3.line: *Yawn*... So tired... I hope the commander isn't looking... so I'll sleep for a bit longer...

mission.line: We've got a job to do! This time I won't forget!

mission_complete.line: Commander, I brought... Huh, what's this in my hand?

profile.line: I'm the first ship of the {namecode:15}-class, but I was meant to be part of the {namecode:30}-class... Anyway, where am I? Why am I introducing myself...? I don't really know... But I hope I can be of service.

propose.line: Ah! Now I remember what I wanted to say! But... you said it first... even though I wanted to be the first to say it...

skill.line: Huh? Where are we? Oh no, it's the enemy!

touch.line: *Yawn*... I get so tired when people touch me...

touch2.line: Whua... it feels weird when you touch me like that...

unlock.line: Um, I'm {namecode:15}, the first ship of the {namecode:15}-class... Hello, Commander. My name is {namecode:15}... Huh? I just said that? Hm... I don't know how to get back home, so I guess I'll stay here. I hope I can be of service.

upgrade.line: Huh... Commander, where are we? My body feels so warm...

win_mvp.line: All ships, open fire! Wa... wait... we've already won?

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander!

lose.line: *Sob*... I messed up again...

main1.line: Commander, have you seen my torpedo...? Standing on it...? Wait... Oh noooo!

main3.line: Are you hungry, Commander? Umm, I have a sandwich... strawberry cake, and some coffee, if you want...

touch.line: Whooahhh! ... Gosh, that was too close... Thanks, Commander...

touch2.line: Eek! C-Commander! Look out!

unlock.line: H-here they come... Your order, and your cutesy dutesy maid... Whoaahh! I'm sorry! Look out!

detail.line: Hehe... You tried to help me up, and you ended up falling, too... Does your butt hurt, Commander? I can rub it if you need me to...

expedition.line: Oh, everyone's back from the commission. Umm, you won't get lost when you go greet them, right?

feeling5.line: Mm... I should be embarrassed right now, but seeing you smiling and covered in snow makes my heart all warm and fuzzy... Oh! I almost forgot what I wanted to tell you – "I love you, Commander!" Hehe, let's watch fireworks together all the time!

headtouch.line: *sob*... Are you trying to comfort me? But I'm happy to just sit with you for a while, too...

home.line: Oh, I'd better be more careful on our next date... Huh? You're back, Commander?

login.line: Ah. Commander, watch out for the lanterns... Hwuh? They fell already?

mail.line: Mail! Can I get it, Commander? Huh? You don't need me to?

main1.line: The fireworks are so pretty... Sitting and watching them with you is fun. I forgot all about the pain, hehe...

main2.line: Commander, where should we watch them next time? I promise I won't fall next time.

main3.line: That scared me... Hehe, but I got to get close to you, so it's okay~

mission.line: Ah! I was so focused on the fireworks that I almost forgot we had missions...

mission_complete.line: Commander, you have rewards. ...Huh? I left them here, didn't I? Hwuh? Where'd they go?

touch.line: Wow... Your hands are warm...

touch2.line: *sob*... Are you going to rub it better for me?

unlock.line: Owwie, I fell again... Huh? You fell, too? Just because you wanted to help me up? *sniffle*... I'm sorry...

detail.line: Commander, do you see me in a new light now? Good... My growth is proof of how hard I've been working.

expedition.line: I heard the commission team got back. Do you think they'll be surprised to see me NOT arrive late because I got lost?

feeling5.line: Phew... Okay, I think I can say it this time...! Ack! Commander? You didn't hear that, did you...? Forget it, let's do this! Ahem... I want to always be with you from now on! So... can you hug me, Commander?

headtouch.line: Mm... *yawn*... Ah! I almost fell asleep...

gift_prefer.line: Looks yummy!

hp_warning.line: We're gonna lose? That can't be~!

login.line: Commander, want a balloon? I have all kinds here!

main1.line: Yuugure, it's not every day we get to attend a party like this, so you should show off your stuff! Besides, you look super cute in your dress. Right? See~?

main2.line: If we tied a balloon to Shiratsuyu, she wouldn't get lost easily, right? After all, we'd be able to see it from anywhere.

main3.line: Who's been going around telling kids that you can fly if you tie a bunch of balloons together? ...Hatsushimo, can you stop giving them strange ideas?

touch.line: You want to be my dance partner? Ah, um! Sure, if you're fine with that.

touch2.line: Woah?! Ah, Commander, you made my balloon fly off...

unlock.line: Hope everyone enjoys the oodles of balloons I made for this party! Yeah, I'm sure the little girls will love 'em!

detail.line: Yuugure has come a long way. She's no longer the little girl constantly tugging at my sleeves asking for help.

home.line: Good work~ Here's your tea~

login.line: You seem pretty busy today too. But don't worry, I'll help you out~

main1.line: Yuugure's all grown up now. When I stand next to her, you can't even tell who's the older sister anymore! Ehehe...

main2.line: Wish I got as big an upgrade to my ability to take care of people as I did to my firepower. It's not just Yuugure, it's practically the entire 27th Destroyer Division... I just can't keep up with all of them.

main3.line: Here Commander, your lunchbox. I made a portion for Yuugure as well.

touch.line: Jeez, Commander, why are you tugging on my sleeve like Yuugure now?

unlock.line: Ah... So this is what it feels like to be retrofitted. I'll work harder for your sake, and for everyone in the 27th Destroyer Division~

battle.line: Everyone, follow the battle plan!

couple_encourage1.line: I'll do my best, I promise!

detail.line: Umm... exactly what do I need to do, to be able to see my sister again?

expedition.line: The commission is now complete! Lord Commander, would you like to try and build a new ship? Perhaps this time...

feeling1.line: Lord Commander, regarding tomorrow’s task— yes, I wish to confirm it all at once...

feeling2.line: Sister {namecode:30} treats me gently, as if I'm her real little sister... but...

feeling3.line: Ahh, it’s the Lord Commander! Why do I have smoke covered all over me? I’m not sure, I was trying to make coke pancakes.

feeling4.line: Ahh, it’s the Lord Commander! Eh, no it’s not. I didn’t mean to disappear like that... sorry, my mind simply wandered...

feeling5.line: A cool breeze is blowing, the whispers of the wind chimes in the gallery. Feels like a return to summer times with my sister... but, only this time it’s the Lord Commander sitting beside me.

home.line: ...Hmm? Is someone there? Sister, is that you? …Sorry, I was dreaming just now...

login.line: Lord Commander, you’ve worked hard today.

lose.line: Hmm… I have to bother {namecode:98} again...

mail.line: Lord Commander, here is your tea, cake and the latest mail.

main1.line: Rumor has it that we would be able to finish our mission before the pot of tea that we brew got cold? Eh, is this wine?

main2.line: Even if there is only the slimmest of hope, as long as you persevere, one day you will make it a reality.

main3.line: Is {namecode:85} coming? She has a mischievous look about her, I’m a little worried.

mission.line: Let’s brew a pot of tea first before we start our mission.

mission_complete.line: It would be great if our rewards can be confirmed as soon as the mission is completed.

profile.line: Second ship of {namecode:31} class Destroyer, {namecode:32}. A lot of people thinks that my sister and I are {namecode:30} class, but they are mistaken. My sister and I participated in many battles in the South Pacific. We helped protect the 4th and 5th Carrier Divisions. We were greatly taken care of by {namecode:98}. This time...I will stay by my sister’s side until the very end.

propose.line: Lord Commander... before my sister arrives, can I count on you? I can? Thank you... I will take care of the Commander and spend my entire life with you.

skill.line: For one day when we will eventually reunite...

touch.line: Eh... yes, I’m listening.

touch2.line: Lord Commander, what are you doing!

unlock.line: {namecode:31} class Destroyer {namecode:32}. I am open to your guidance, Lord Commander—— {namecode:30}? No, please do remember I'm {namecode:31} class. This is something I won't back down from!

upgrade.line: If only I could’ve been a little faster, perhaps {namecode:71} sister...

win_mvp.line: ...Victory? If only my sister is able to see it...

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. I'm sure Ariake would like this too.

detail_ex.line: I'm so glad we finally can be together, Ariake! All that time I spent worrying about when I'd be able to see you seems like a distant illusion now…

win_mvp_ex.line: Ariake, did you see that?

detail.line: Commander, Belfast taught me a lot about being a maid! ... But if Ariake saw me now, she'd probably be... shocked.

feeling3.line: I baked a Royal Navy-style cake! I'm certain this time it'll be a hit!

feeling5.line: A maid's job is to provide service and relieve people. ... Commander, do you find my service to be relieving?

home.line: Welcome back. I was going to hide my tail and ears, but Shoukaku told me I look cuter this way... B-but saying "meow, meow~" is too embarrassing for me...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've left your juice over here. As for the resources... I'm still sorting them... I'm sorry...

mail.line: I asked Maya to take a picture of me and send it to Ariake, and she did!

main1.line: Edinburgh taught me a lot as well... She seemed to make a number of mistakes, but I still appreciate her kindness!

main3.line: As soon as Mikasa saw me, she yelled "Scandalous! Taisho-era servitors would never wear skirts this frilly!"... Even though I wasn't born in the Taisho-era...

touch.line: Phew... I'm done sorting the resources... Now for the next task...

touch2.line: ... Commander, please don't do such things to me!

unlock.line: "I, Yuugure the maid, shall dedicate myself to Ariake, my sister, and you, Commander!"... Eek?! M-my skirt...!

win_mvp.line: "T-this glorious victory i-is in my Master's name!" ... *Whimper*... I can't deliver lines like these...

feeling5.line: My New Year's wish, huh? Um... if I had to say, it'd probably be to celebrate even more New Years with Commander and my sister...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. I'm about to go wish my sister a happy new year, as is customary in the Dragon Empery... Would you like to come with me?

mail.line: I'll leave the mail that just arrived over here. I wonder if my sister sent me a greeting card?

main1.line: Do they eat New Year's rice cake in the Dragon Empery as well? Perhaps they just eat whatever they feel like eating.

main2.line: A red envelope from you? Please don't forget to give one to my sister as well.

main3.line: Commander, our dreams will come true this year... right? N-no, I'm sure they will!

touch.line: I have to tell my sister about all the customs I learned from the Dragon Empery!

unlock.line: The Dragon Empery's New Year celebrations and new outfits are sure to lift everyone's spirits~ My sister will probably love this new dress as well. What do you think, Commander?

detail.line: When a girl wears a different outfit, your impression of her changes, doesn't it? I hope they can make a different outfit for Ariake, too...

feeling5.line: Commander, thank you for keeping me company until the party... C-could you take my hand and join me for a dance, like you would with an adult...?

headtouch.line: What's the matter...? "Am I nervous"? I-I'm fine... I think... It's just a bit embarrassing to show myself wearing these clothes to others...

home.line: Excellent work. I know the party is about to begin, but it's okay to rest a little... and have a snack before we head out.

login.line: I've heard parties are "a world of fun for adults." C-Commander, could you accompany me to this "world of fun for adults"...?

main1.line: It's beautiful when flower petals flicker in the wind, but also a little sad, in a way... Do you know what I mean, Commander?

main2.line: I-I'm fine with just juice! ... Ah, thank you!

main3.line: I feel like maybe I should bring back some sweets for Ariake... Huh? Am I not allowed to...?

touch.line: Once I've grown a little more, I'll be able to keep my composure even in places like these.

unlock.line: I finished changing, Commander. This dress is very pretty, but... isn't it missing something up top?

detail.line: I hope Ariake will like this Daruma doll...

home.line: Commander, want to try on this fox mask? ...Yes, it looks great on you~

login.line: Commander, if we don't hurry up, everything will be sold out.

main1.line: This looks pretty interesting, but so does this... Ah, but, which do you think is better, Commander?

main2.line: Huh? Ariake? I'm currently looking after Shiratsuyu. After all, someone has to keep an eye on her, right?

main3.line: A lucky bag lottery draw, huh? I wonder if Shigure is going to try her hand...

touch.line: Eh, my tail...? I, I'll be careful!

touch2.line: Commander, everyone's looking at us!

unlock.line: Woah... These stalls have all sorts of amazing things~ Commander, will you help me pick a gift out for Ariake? Hm, let's see... How about this Daruma doll?

detail.line: Commander, what do you think is the proper way to play on the beach? ...You want to hear my opinion instead? Um, I... I think I like the stuff the kids do...

home.line: Hatsuharu taught me that adding a twang of salt to watermelon brings out a completely different flavor. If you'd like to give it a try... It's great, isn't it? I'm glad you liked it!

login.line: The weather has been great all day. It's perfect for swimming or sunbathing.

main1.line: First, do some stretching... Okay! It's finally time for my debut match of beach volleyball, right? Ariake is watching me too, so I've got to do my best!

main2.line: Wearing a fancy swimsuit like this is a little embarrassing for me. C-Commander, do you think something easier to move around in like what Wakaba is wearing would be better?

main3.line: Making a sand castle is a lot harder than I expected... How did Takao and the others manage to build something like THAT...?

touch.line: Shall I bring you some fruit juice?

touch2.line: Mmgh... The sun's making me all sweaty... Hwaah?! Commander??

unlock.line: I was really looking forward to playing with you at the beach, Commander, so I changed into this swimsuit. Umm... Ariake told me that I had to choose something that was easy to move around in, and cute enough to make you lose your mind... Was she pulling my leg?

win_mvp.line: Battle complete. This is a victory that Ariake and the others can be proud of!

detail.line: Here you go, Commander. Um, your tea! It's Ariake's favorite kind, but I do not know if it will be to your liking or not...

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Commander, please make sure to stockpile our resources for construction.

feeling5.line: The gentle sea breeze, the warm sunlight, and the sound of waves upon the beach... Every day here at port is filled with happiness, because I can be together with both you and Ariake...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. I'm preparing tea for Ariake, so please wait a moment for me to bring you yours.

main1.line: I feel like I've gotten a little taller after my retrofit... and it makes Ariake seem shorter in comparison... Ugh...

main2.line: (whispers) Hatsushimo, you'll trouble Commander if you do that! ...I-I wasn't saying anything!

main3.line: Wakaba, Commander, I have some walnut daifuku for you. Um, huh...? You don't need the wrapping...?

unlock.line: Ariake-class destroyer, Yuugure, has completed retrofitting. Ehehe, from now on... Ariake and I will be in your care once more, Commander.

upgrade.line: Hiei, this time... I swear...!

win_mvp.line: Ariake, Commander, I did it! Mhm... I really won!

battle.line: Naught but death awaits those who oppose my master.

couple_encourage1.line: For the master...!

detail.line: Your Grace... Please don't stare at me so...

expedition.line: Your Grace, the fleet you dispatched on commission has returned as scheduled.

feeling1.line: ... Your orders?

feeling2.line: A true ninja has no need of emotion. She needs only her master's will to execute.

feeling3.line: While I struggle with Your Grace's concepts of "communication" and "games," still... I... can't say I dislike them.

feeling4.line: Your Grace, I beg your pardon. Recently I find myself distracted from the mission, thinking again and again about Your Grace's "communication." Please, you must punish me...

feeling5.line: So this is an "emotion"... before such things I had no problem keeping a clear head, but even now it seems not so wicked... Yes, this "emotion" drives a powerful need to stand by Your Grace's side, and it grows ever stronger.

home.line: Your Grace, are you tired? Is there any way I can be of assistance to you?

login.line: Your Grace, welcome home.

lose.line: Your Grace, it is time to retreat. I will cover your withdrawal.

mail.line: Your Grace, a letter has arrived.

main1.line: Hm...? Your Grace? Did you want me to say something?

main2.line: I am not sure what to say... But I would be happy to listen to anything Your Grace wishes to impart.

main3.line: The flower in my hair? It was a gift from Oyashio. Oyashio, she's... very colorful.

mission.line: Your Grace, a new mission has been issued.

mission_complete.line: Your Grace, mission rewards have been issued. Inspect them at your leisure.

profile.line: Third ship of the Kagerou-class, Kuroshio. As part of the 2nd Fleet and Destroyer Division 15, I joined in the Battle of the Java Sea, operations in the South Pacific, the Third Battle of the Solomon Islands, and other engagements until I was sunk during a transport mission. ... I will not let that happen again. I will commit all of my resources to ensure that I am of service to Your Grace.

propose.line: I once thought that absolute devotion to the mission was all there was to being a ninja, but I have learned so much from you, Commander... I, Kuroshio, from this point forward, am no longer your shadow alone, Commander, I am now your partner. And we will stand together until the end of our days.

touch.line: Kuroshio, awaiting orders.

touch2.line: As this body belongs to Your Grace, please do with it as you will... Nnng... Aaaah...

unlock.line: Third ship of the Kagerou-class, Kuroshio reporting in... I am here to carry out my master's will.

upgrade.line: I stand ready to execute your will.

win_mvp.line: I am Your Grace's shadow. I have no need of glory or acclaim.

gift_prefer.line: Did I earn this in any way?

battle.line: Come one, come all!

detail.line: Commander, don't I look ninja-like when I do this with my hands? Ehehe, that's because Kuro taught me~

expedition.line: Commander~ The commission's done.

feeling1.line: No matter what you do, Commander, Kuroshio has no problem following you... But I'm not so forgiving. For her sake, Commander, en garde!

feeling2.line: Commander, would you like to watch my show? By all means, come on over and take a seat~ The more the merrier, after all!

feeling3.line: As a ninja, my sister is always very serious... And since I'm a puppeteer, I always thought it would be nice to make her laugh sometimes. That's kind of a tall order though, ahaha...

feeling4.line: Commander, you're awesome. Not only do you know what I'm thinking, but you help me get through to everyone else... One day, I'm going to make Kuroshio laugh, and I know you'll definitely be there to see it!

feeling5.line: Commander, I thought it would be great to be as clear-headed as Kuroshio... But there's no way I could. I like Kuroshio, I like you, and I like puppet shows. That's just who I am.

home.line: Kuro, why don't you give the Commander a massage? Yes, I think hopping around the shoulders should do the trick?

login.line: Commander, how are you today? Would you care to enjoy one of my famous puppet shows? Come on! How about it?

lose.line: Ugh! Commander! Quickly, take the others and run!

mail.line: Commander, guess which torpedo has your mail in it? If you're wrong... well, it probably won't blow up♪

main1.line: Commander, will you come to watch my show when you have free time?

main2.line: Kuro is my dear friend! Her namesake is obvious, isn't it? My oh so serious big sister!

main3.line: Of course the strings are a puppetry thing. So why do I put torpedoes on them? Ahaha... Let's call it an old trade secret.

mission.line: Commander, let's go knock out one of those new missions~ I need to get some new material♪

mission_complete.line: Commander, the mission rewards are here~ Let me see if there's any props I can use in there♪

profile.line: I'm the fourth ship of the Kagerou-class, Oyashio. I've always been close with Kuroshio. She can tell you everything you need to know, so just ask her~♪ Oh, unless...? You'd rather I act it out for you?

propose.line: And so the Commander and Oyashio lived happily ever after for all the rest of their days... Ehehe, even if the audience might get sick of it, I'm hoping the rest of our story is a long, happy comedy♪

skill.line: The fun has only just begun, right~♪

touch.line: Commander, isn't it amazing how nurturing Oyashio is? ... Er! I'm talking about the ocean current!

touch2.line: Huh?! Grraagh! ... Oh, Commander, I'm sorry... that's just how we've been trained in this line of work...

unlock.line: My big sister is a ninja, and I'm a puppeteer. Isn't it amazing how diverse our world is~? I'm the fourth ship of the Kagerou-class, Oyashio. And with my puppet Kuro, I will dazzle you, Commander.

upgrade.line: Oooh! I just came up with a new idea for a show!

win_mvp.line: And thus, the Commander led our fleet to another victory! That's the end of this episode!

gift_prefer.line: Eheh~♪ As thanks, shall I act out a story for you?

battle.line: Shall I assume command? Understood! I won't disappoint you!

couple_encourage1.line: You can go faster than me？Really?!

couple_encourage2.line: Let's rush them down!

couple_encourage3.line: Is Planet Bunny a real place?! I must know!

couple_encourage4.line: I'll scout ahead, Suruga!

couple_encourage5.line: I'm... a starter ship, too? That's weird, because I don't really feel like one...

couple_encourage6.line: Takao! Do you think better of me now?

couple_encourage7.line: L-Lady Nagato?! I-i-it's an honor fighting alongside you!

detail.line: Houshou's carrot cake is just divine! I hope to taste it again sometime.

expedition.line: Hmm... Commission teams don't run into ambushes out at sea, do they...?

feeling1.line: If you manage to right all your wrongs, then maybe you'll earn my forgiveness!

feeling2.line: I am THE strongest destroyer! Or, so I'd like to think. But to truly become the strongest, I'll have to hone myself through my training and sorties!

feeling3.line: People often say I'm too hasty, but isn't swift decision-making supposed to be a good thing? Plus, if you don't fight with all you've got, it could come back to haunt you! Hehehe!

feeling4.line: Commander, what things motivate you to keep fighting? I'm just asking out of curiosity. Whatever they are, I will fight for them alongside you! ...Yes, I know, I swear not to get ahead of myself this time!

feeling5.line: Could we go somewhere together after finishing our work today? B-because, well, we hardly get any time for ourselves during office hours... Okay, look! I'm saying I want some alone time with you, Commander! Would you... oblige?

headtouch.line: Mweeehhh... Please, d-don't touch my ears! It makes me shooo weak... Aaaahh...

home.line: W-welcome back, Commander! ...No, it's nothing, really! I was just wondering when you'd return...

hp_warning.line: Don't die on me now, engines... Please hang in there!

login.line: Commander, you're not the type to dilly-dally around, are you? That makes two of us! We'd better begin our work for the day!

lose.line: I-I'll reflect upon my errors...

mail.line: Apropos of nothing, I think you should check your latest mail.

main1.line: My rigging calibration checks out. I'm fully prepared to sortie at your command!

main2.line: My shoes? They're quite special. In fact, these shoes are what allow me to go faster than everyone else! Ha-hah!

main3.line: The Sakura Empire is home to many sword-wielding shipgirls... If I ever get the chance, I'd love to borrow and swing someone else's sword for myself.

main4.line: Any two people can come to an understanding as long they're both willing to listen! That's what I've always believed!

mission.line: Aha! I spy with my little eye incomplete missions! Full speed ahead for those rewards! Right, Commander?

mission_complete.line: Mission completed! Quick, let's check what rewards we've earned!

profile.line: I'm Shimakaze, the sole Shimakaze-class destroyer! I boast the highest speed and best torpedo capabilities of all fleet destroyers – a pivotal part of any torpedo squadron! No type of operation is beyond my capabilities! Ha-hah!

propose.line: What is THIS?! Wasn't this meant to be an emergency mission briefing?! Wait, what's this ring...? I fell for it, hook, line, and sinker! But why trick me into coming? I would've agreed to it if you'd just told the truth!

skill.line: Maybe I should turn this into one of my secret moves!

touch.line: Huh? Have I done something incorrectly?

touch2.line: Eek! What has gotten into you?! If I didn't know any better, I'd think... Well, just this once, I'll turn a blind eye to it.

unlock.line: I am Shimakaze, the world's one and only Shimakaze-class destroyer! You must be the commander! Let us join forces and work towards our goals, together!

upgrade.line: I can become even faster... even stronger!

win_mvp.line: All right! Another first-place finish!

gift_prefer.line: This is exactly what I wanted! You're such a nice person, Commander!

battle_ex.line: In the event we lose, please don't take it out on me!

detail_ex.line: To protect what's dear, what matters isn't the weapon in your hands, but the will in your heart. Wouldn't you say that's true?

expedition_ex.line: I've confirmed the commission team's safe return to port! A peaceful journey is always best!

feeling5_ex.line: Sweetheart? I'd love to have dinner with you after work, then go shopping together. I wish we'd have more time for ourselves, even if I'd always want more of it. Hehehe~ Got to make the most of what we can get, though, right?

headtouch_ex.line: Mweeehhh...

home_ex.line: W-welcome back, Commander! I was wondering when you'd return.

login_ex.line: Good morning, my sweetheart! Hehehe♡ Time for your morning kiss, just... Oh, sorry, we're at work! As you were, Commander!

main5_ex.line: My rigging is in tip-top condition! I feel like I could take on the world today!

main6_ex.line: I'm not THE fastest – I just happen to be the fastest ship! After all, one should not ever outrun humility.

main7_ex.line: Long-range torpedo strikes are my specialty, but... I don't suppose there is any way this fleet can leverage that.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission completed! I went ahead and brought you the rewards!

touch_ex.line: How can I be of assistance, Commander?

touch2_ex.line: At least you didn't touch my ears. The outcome wouldn't have been worksafe... Ugh...

win_mvp_ex.line: The Shimakaze Fleet can make even the impossible happen!

battle.line: I'm truly in my element in this outfit!

detail.line: Commander! Why not play a round of Shipgirl Bounty Hunter? There are many nice prizes you can win!

home.line: Outstanding work! I will provide tonight's entertainment act! As soon as I come up with something entertaining... Hmm...

login.line: I'm positively brimming with energy! Tonight, let us "party hard," Commander!

main1.line: Abukuma invited me to go fishing with her! So, I'm going out to meet– Y-you think it's best if I change clothes first?

main2.line: Suruga! You should try a bunny girl costume too! ...Y-you wouldn't be caught dead in one? Isn't that a little extreme, even for an aversion?!

main3.line: These frills fit around my ears perfectly! Which is good, because I'd become lethargic if they were too tight...

touch.line: Would you like a refill, Commander?

touch2.line: There being no danger of skirt-flipping doesn't make this tolerable behavior!

unlock.line: Hippity hoppity! Grab a glass and have a sippity! Whew, I must say, this outfit was tricky to get into. Still, you made an exquisite pick, Commander!

win_mvp.line: I'm the fastest, strongest destroyer... And that's a fact!

detail.line: The sheer scale of this set is staggering! I've run around all over the place and still found no sign of the exit... What?! I've been going in circles all this time?!

expedition.line: The commission team has come back! But as it stands now, we can't meet them!

home.line: Ah, Commander! Heehee~ I stumbled across this delicious tea just earlier! Join me on a break and we'll drink it together!

login.line: After much thinking, I've realized that I'm not Alice, but rather the White Rabbit! So isn't it weird that I'm lost in here?

main1.line: Whoa! There's cake over there! Heehee... No, Commander! Finding the exit comes first, like I told you before!

main2.line: If Suruga was here, how would she... Wait, COULD Suruga even find a way out of this place? Because I am completely out of ideas!

main3.line: There's the exit! Watch, I'm going to make a mad dash for– Owie! Th-this is just a dang mirror!

mission.line: Laffey could find a way out if she were here... Whoa! Word of a new mission just came in!

touch.line: Mhm! Allow me to show you the right path to your destination!

touch2.line: At least it's not my... No, ears or not, it's embarrassing when you touch me like that!

unlock.line: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Why'd I end up here again?! Even though I've been running for a whole hour! ...Commander?! Waaaah, I'm so glad to see you! Please, help me get out of heeeeeeere!

win_mvp.line: Hippity hoppity! That's what happens when you underestimate me!

battle.line: I fight at peak performance even in this swimsuit!

detail.line: Hippity hoppity! Let's go for a swim in the sea! It'll be a boatload of fun, Commander!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! I just got back as well – from a long swim, in my case!

login.line: Please sit over here and relax, Commander! I'm going for a quick run around!

lose.line: I'm almost more scared of being pursued by sharks than the enemy...

main1.line: Naganami must surely hate getting her tail wet... One could say the same about my ears, I suppose.

main2.line: Now, now, Kii, please don't try to pressure Suruga into... Wow! You'll really let me take her place in the beach volleyball tournament?

main3.line: I don't need sunscreen – I can simply dart in and out of the shade! Fwoosh, fwoosh!

touch.line: Whatever it is you need, I'm all ears.

touch2.line: Do you think this is acceptable in broad daylight?! Please!

unlock.line: You can't keep sprinting across the sea forever. Sometimes, you need to rest and recover your strength. Speaking of, you may use my parasol if you like, Commander!

detail.line: Would you like a mooncake, Commander? This batch was made specifically for the occasion. I can personally vouch for their good taste!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned! I'll go deliver them a couple of mooncakes! Hippity hoppity!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Today is a day to celebrate with friends and family, so let us all get together and enjoy ourselves! I will join you, of course!

login.line: Hippity! This feels like a terribly unlucky day for me! ...Oh no! The mooncakes!

mail.line: One mooncake, two, three... Wait, a letter? Oh, right, I was supposed to deliver this to you, Commander!

main1.line: Kii! Who's the lady in your company? ...Oh! A friend of Suruga, I see! Say, could I ask you to tell me where she is? I'd like to share my mooncakes with her!

main2.line: These mooncakes aren't the biggest, but they are quite dense. I've only had one, yet I feel stuffed as a turkey!

main3.line: Whoa! Nice catch, little manjuus! Better pick these mooncakes up quickly, before... Oh no! Now that manjuu pounding mochi fell over!

touch.line: Ugh, running too fast can be dangerous after all... *sniffle*

touch2.line: Whoa! Commander?! Please! This is NOT how you're supposed to act!

unlock.line: Oh no! Commander, look out! ...Phew. That was really close. Apologies for my clear lack of attentiveness! I shouldn't have been in such a rush to deliver all these mooncakes...

detail.line: Perhaps I could just sleep until the contest ends... What? You still move unconsciously when you sleep? Oh, then I'd better stay sharp!

feeling5.line: I shouldn't play around with my Peepsy? Hmm... I'll think about it, if you play with me instead! Teehee~

hp_warning.line: Oh nooo! I hope they didn't bruise me!

lose.line: Waahhh...! Peepsy's nothing more than an alarm...!

main3.line: Commander, how do you say this word? "Try-yumf"? I dunno what that means, but I think I can do that by setting off Peepsy!
