propose.line: Is this shiny ring... for me? ... You'll take over Peepsy's role and protect me? Wow, that makes me feel super duper happy! Can I set off Peepsy to celebrate this?

skill.line: Show them what you're made of, Peepsy!

touch.line: Teehee~ Commander, do you wanna find out what it takes for me to set off Peepsy's alarm?

touch2.line: Eeeep...! I knew you're a dangerous stranger! Hear Peepsy roar!

unlock.line: You're the Commander? You look a bit suspicious, but... you don't seem dangerous anyhow. The name's Nagatsuki! Heh, if you underestimate me, you're gonna regret it!

upgrade.line: I'm feeling super excited!

win_mvp.line: W-we won...? Myahahah! You see that? Nagatsuki is all-powerful!

gift_prefer.line: Woah! Commander really isn't a bad person after all!

detail.line: Sure I'm wearing a maid costume, but I can't do any maid work with these kitty paw gloves on! Sooorry♪

home.line: Grr, that Royal Navy maid Belfast is always working... I'm gonna quit being a maid. Hehehe!

login.line: Welcome back, Master♪ Oh, you wanna hear that again? Sure, but first I want strawberry ice cream!

main1.line: I still have Peepsy with me~! I've just hidden it somewhere!

main2.line: What do maids even do...? Oh, I know! Commander, I'm thirsty! I want some tea! Hehehe!

main3.line: My kitty paws are really nice and soft. Don't you wanna feel them? Here you go! Kitty paws to the face!

touch.line: You really like maids, huh~ But just so you know, Peepsy's gonna go off if you keep poking me!

touch2.line: I totally forgot I can't set off Peepsy with these kitty paw gloves oooon!

unlock.line: Nagatsuki the kitty maid is at your service~ Do your best to not fall madly in love with my cute looks~! Hehe~

battle.line: That's the enemy... can we eat them?

detail.line: Commander, I still have lots of taiyaki, so I'm fine.

expedition.line: Commander, I'm heading out to welcome back the commission team! They promised they'd buy me some taiyaki!

feeling1.line: Ahh~ *Nom* (Mikazuki doesn't seem to notice you.)

feeling2.line: Commander, want to eat some taiyaki with me?

feeling3.line: Clothes are so annoying... I hate getting dressed... I just want to eat taiyaki...

feeling4.line: Always telling me to wear my clothes... you're just like my mom... But I still like you, Commander. Almost as much as I like taiyaki... Okay, Commander, help me get dressed.

feeling5.line: "Only really close people should help each other get dressed"? Are we not close, Commander? I love you, Commander. Do you not like me?

home.line: Ah... Commander, want some too? I've got more.

login.line: Commander? Wel~co~me back~! *Nom*... Delicious!

lose.line: I'm hungry...

mail.line: Commander, what's this package for? Can I pack up my taiyaki?

main1.line: I'm full... and sleepy... Commander, gimme a hug~

main2.line: I like taiyaki filled with bean paste even in their tail fins.

main3.line: Taiyaki looks like a fish... Fish live in the sea! Hm... the sea is on Earth! Earth is in space! Mm... so tasty!

mission.line: Commander, new missions!

mission_complete.line: Commander, does the reward include any taiyaki?

profile.line: I'm Mikazuki. I've got a lot of little and big sisters. We're all friends. I'm really good at escort and transport missions! Oh, and I love taiyaki! Do you want some too, Commander?

propose.line: A promise...? Does that mean you'll help me get dressed? I don't really get it... I should really do it on my own...? Commander, you're weird... I'm fine with you helping me get dressed, I told you before...

skill.line: You're not getting any of my taiyaki!

touch.line: Commander, want some? I don't mind sharing.

touch2.line: Oh, I dropped my taiyaki...

unlock.line: Aahh... Hm? Hmm? Co... main... der? I'm Mikazuki. Want some taiyaki? You can have half of mine.

upgrade.line: I ate... too much taiyaki... I'm stuffed...

win_mvp.line: Isn't it about time for a snack?

gift_prefer.line: That looks really tasty!

detail.line: Getting changed is a pain, but since everyone wanted to see me in a costume, I did it... Hip, hop.

home.line: I got so much candy... Mutsuki seems to really like them, so I'll give it all to her later.

login.line: Commander? If you don't give me taiyaki, I'll summon Minazuki~

main1.line: Bouncing around is exhausting. Commander, your lap please.

main2.line: Halloween is all about witches, pumpkins, and... delicious taiyaki! Ommfh!

main3.line: If the seal on my head gets removed, I'll turn into a real zombie... That's what Minazuki said, anyway.

touch.line: Commander, are you scared of zombies?

touch2.line: My outfit is all messed up now... even though it took so long to put on...

unlock.line: Mikazuki is supposed to be... a zombie? Um... hip... hop... Commander, trick or treaaaaat~

battle.line: Fair winds, good visibility... Mhm!

couple_encourage1.line: I hope I don't cause you any trouble this time...

couple_encourage2.line: Thank you for your instruction, Jintsuu!

couple_encourage3.line: L-let's all be careful here, okay?

detail.line: Commander... Um, I'm afraid I'm not very good with physical contact...

expedition.line: The commission fleet seems to have brought back a lot of rewards. Shall I help you bring them in?

feeling1.line: Commander, I'm so sorry I wasn't able to help you...

feeling2.line: I don't mind feeding seagulls, or petting cute little animals... So why can I not handle being touched by the commander... *sigh*...

feeling3.line: Commander, um... would you like to go feed the seagulls with me? ...Yay! Here, let me give you some bread... Uh oh, I'm sorry! It fell...

feeling4.line: Commander, if it's not too much to ask, could you please take my hand? I'd like to try to get used to being touched, so... please don't let go no matter what! I, I'll endure it all!!

feeling5.line: Thanks to your help, I've become a lot better at the touchy-feely stuff... Um, if it's not too much to ask, could you continue to "practice" it with me...?

headtouch.line: Eek?! P-please stop that...

home.line: Commander... Ehehe, to tell the truth, I was really wondering when you would come back...

hp_warning.line: I can... hold on a bit longer...!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. I hope that I was able to adequately prepare today's schedule. Is there anything else I can help you with...?

lose.line: Don't worry about me... More importantly, are the others safe...?

mail.line: Commander, I left the new mail on your desk.

main1.line: Commander, shall I open the window? You'll feel a lot fresher if it's nice and breezy, right?

main2.line: Please don't interrupt Yamakaze and Kawakaze's work... Um, if you want someone to play with, use me instead...

main3.line: I wonder if any seagulls will show up if we put some crumbs out by the window... Ehehe...

mission.line: Commander, um... Might there be anything I can help with?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! I'm so glad that I was able to be of help to you, Commander...!

profile.line: "Revised Shiratsuyu-class"... Yes, my sisters and I were called that. During that war, the four of us formed the 24th DesDiv... My memories from back then weren't all rainbows and sunshine though...

propose.line: Um, it's terribly embarrassing still, but... I finally managed to put the ring on...! Um... Commander... please allow me to stay at your side forever...!

touch.line: Um, excuse me...! You're getting... a bit too touchy-feely...

touch2.line: *sniffle* ...Commander...

unlock.line: I am the revised Shiratsuyu-class destroyer, Umikaze. Commander, I hope I will be able to support you and your fleet to the fullest of my abilities... I d-do hope we'll get along!

upgrade.line: Thank you for always looking after me...!

win_mvp.line: Ehehe... It was only made possible by everyone else's hard work...

gift_prefer.line: Huh? I-is it okay for me to accept something so extravagant...?

detail_ex.line: Um, Commander, I think... I can handle a bit more of the touchy-feely stuff...!

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, I hope you'll allow me to hug you... H-hup! Umm... Somehow, I thin k I'm getting too sleepy to... get any practice out of this... Zzz...

headtouch_ex.line: Ah, um... it's okay to do more of that head-patting thing...

home_ex.line: Commander, welcome back. Here are your documents, as well as some light snacks and drinks for you to enjoy... If there is anything else you need, please call for me right away.

login_ex.line: Good morning, Commander. I hope that I will be able to be of use to you today!

main1_ex.line: Commander, could you open the window? Ahh... The sea breeze is just right, refreshing but not blowing the documents away...

main2_ex.line: Yamakaze, if you want to play with Commander, please wait a bit... H-huh? I'm not trying to monopolize Commander...!

touch_ex.line: Ah, um, it's alright! I'm already used to your touch...!

touch2_ex.line: Ermm... Is this also a part of my training"...?

win_mvp_ex.line: Even one such as myself was able to obtain victory!

detail.line: Was I able to bring you even the slightest bit of therapeutic benefit, Commander?

home.line: Commander, would you like a shoulder massage? Ah, um, this level of contact is fine! I appreciate the courtesy!

login.line: Commander, today's your day off, so you don't have to work so hard, alright?

main1.line: Um... The socks are on a bit tight...

main2.line: Yamakaze gave me some sweets. Would you like some, Commander?

main3.line: A lot more of these bunnies look just like me, clad in black... Why is that, Commander?

touch.line: I, I'm not sure I can handle this kind of touching...

touch2.line: P-please don't bully me...

unlock.line: What's the matter, Commander? Oh, this outfit? ...Um, I heard that this outfit would bring you therapeutic benefits and hoped to try it on... Wh-what do you think? Does it feel therapeutic to you?

detail.line: Wooow... Look at all the seagulls gathering around that bread! They're so cute... Wonder if I could pet them... Ah! I-I'm sorry, I was having a little too much fun...

expedition.line: The girls out on the commission are back. I'll join you in going to greet them!

home.line: If you're tired from walking, we could take a break at that bench up there. Erm, I took the liberty of bringing some light handmade foods...

login.line: Commander, I hear seaside strolls are great for blue-skies days like today. I can show you around, if you'd like!

main1.line: The sunlight's a little harsh in the afternoons... Commander, w-would you like to come under my parasol with me? I-it may be useful practice for... physical affection, too.

main2.line: I was so excited and busy planning last night that I didn't get much sleep. When I relax, I get so sleepy... No, Umikaze, you have to try harder... Zzz...

main3.line: Yamakaze gets a plushie, but what souvenir would Kawakaze like? Commander, do you have any advice?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Ehehe... The seagulls seem happy, too.

touch.line: C'mon, Umikaze! You're brave enough to hold hands by now!

touch2.line: Eep! C-Commander...

unlock.line: Commander, it is my pleasure to accompany you today. Umm... What do you think? I decided to go for a different outfit this time... D-do you think it's cute?

win_mvp.line: Did I manage to help? Thank goodness!

battle.line: Woo! Follow my lead!

couple_encourage1.line: I'm rooting for you~!

couple_encourage2.line: Fighting now, questions later, Lady Mutsu!

detail.line: Hehe~ You wanna play with me, Commander?

expedition.line: Commander! Our commission buddies brought back heaps of good stuff!

feeling1.line: Grrrrr! (Yamakaze is wary of you.)

feeling2.line: When those mean Meowfficers gang up on me, I scare them off with a roar!

feeling3.line: Commander, Commander! I wanna play with you! We could call over Umikaze and Kawakaze, too!

feeling4.line: Could we please go to the zoo, Commander? I wanna listen to the cries seagulls, and bears, and dolphins!

feeling5.line: You're always so nice to me, so I'm gonna be nice back! If any baddies show up, I'll send them scurrying back to mama! ...Huh? You'll protect ME instead? But... why?

headtouch.line: Rooooar!

home.line: You're back? Here, the seat's all yours!

hp_warning.line: Owwieee...

login.line: Woooo! I'm pumped and ready to do some work!

lose.line: Bwaahh! Get me outta here!

mail.line: I've got your mail right here, Commander!

main1.line: If you don't play with me right now, I'm gonna roar at you! Fine... Rooooar!

main2.line: Hey, Kawakaze! Have some fun for once and come play with me and Umikaze!

main3.line: Being lazy is super lame, Commander! Come on, you've gotta work!

mission.line: New missions have come in! Let me at 'em!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Do I get a share of the loot?

profile.line: I was the flagship of DesDiv 24 during the war! Impressive, right? Oh, and don't get me confused for Arashi!

propose.line: Woohooooo! I feel I could explode with how happy I am! Not literally, obviously~ Commander, I love you so much!

touch.line: Do you wanna play knock-out boxing?

touch2.line: Argh! I'll turn you into red paste!

unlock.line: Roooaar! Shiratsuyu-class destroyer Yamakaze is here! ...So, um, I'm looking for this "Commander" person. Any idea where they might be? ...Oh! That's you, huh?

upgrade.line: Woohoo!

win_mvp.line: We won! Hip, hip! Hooray!

gift_prefer.line: Eheheh! Love you lots, Commander!

detail_ex.line: Heehee~ I love playing games with you, Commander~

expedition_ex.line: Commander! Our commission buddies brought back more goodies! I'll go give 'em a hand!

feeling5_ex.line: Commander! I'm here to play another game! Hehehe~ Whatever we do together, it's always so much fun! Oh, here, Umikaze shared some snacks with me! You can have aaaall of them!

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! Wanna sit? Heehee... You'll have to play with me first if you wanna take this spot!

login_ex.line: My motivation tanks are at max! Gimme a "let's go," Commander!

main1_ex.line: I'll promise to stop scaring you, but in exchange I wanna play with you more often!

main4_ex.line: Umikaze! I've got a bag full of breadcrumbs! Wanna go feed some seagulls?

touch_ex.line: What are we gonna do this time? More knock-out boxing? Sumo wrestling?

touch2_ex.line: I caught youuuu~♪

home.line: Commander! Can I borrow your seat for a sec again? Just one second, I promise!

login.line: I'm prepped and ready for my big trick! Woo!

mail.line: Presto! I've magically retrieved your mail!

main1.line: White doves should be part of any good magician's act!

main2.line: Watch closely! I'm now going to make this flower dis– What the?! Why'd it turn into a handkerchief?!

main3.line: Heehee! This trick's definitely going to stun Umikaze and Kawakaze... Stop it, Commander! No peeking!

touch.line: Come over here, Commander! I'm gonna show you my coin trick~

touch2.line: Woah! Stop trying to figure out my tricks!

couple_encourage1.line: And now, we're allies? ... Fine.

couple_encourage2.line: Lady Nagato, please be careful.

couple_encourage3.line: Let us work with each other's strengths!

detail.line: I like fishing. When fishing, you can just clear your mind and not think about anything.

expedition.line: A commission's done. Don't forget to read the report.

feeling1.line: In the end, you're just someone who can't exceed my expectations, Commander.

feeling2.line: In war, there is no right or wrong, no beauty or ugliness. This is true for both ally and enemy.

feeling3.line: Have you not experienced war, too? Then why do you still believe in fairy tales like justice, love, or harmony...?

feeling4.line: I abhor the stupidity and naïveté of those who refuse to face reality and continue shouting about their hopes and dreams. But you're not like that... are you?

feeling5.line: "Your dreams will come true if you don't give up on them"... Hmph, what a trite answer. But, if that's what you say...

home.line: What happens when the battle ends? The next one begins, that's all.

hp_warning.line: This pain... isn't enough to distract me!

login.line: Just another uneventful day.

lose.line: I'm still... afloat. If that's good or bad, who can say...

mail.line: Mail for you. Me? Not a fan of the stuff...

main1.line: Shells are weapons to silence one's enemies with. That's all they are, no matter how you sugarcoat it.

main2.line: If there's something you're wondering, ask Jintsuu. I'm... if I must say, I'd say I'm more like Sendai.

main3.line: Pretty cheerful gang you've got going with this fleet...

mission.line: New mission's appeared. ... What? Do I have to make small talk with you?

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards are here. Let's see if they were worth the time. But first, accept them.

profile.line: I'm Kawakaze, 3rd ship of the improved Shiratsuyu class, or simply the Umikaze class. Destroyer Division 24 comprised of my sisters and me during the war. Ah, Solomon... True, it is a place of many memories. The Iron Bottom Sound, Northampton, and the last thing I remember...

propose.line: I'm astonished that I'm doing this with you... We've been together so long that your wishful thinking has rubbed off on me... And for doing so, you'll take responsibility, won't you...?

skill.line: Relax. I will end this in an instant.

touch.line: How I feel about secretary work? Work is work, I don't have any preferences. Secretary or not, I don't care.

touch2.line: ... Now you've really done it...

unlock.line: The name's Kawakaze of the Shiratsuyu class. I have no intention of becoming your friend. Spare me your introduction.

upgrade.line: Getting stronger... feels okay.

win_mvp.line: The Solomon Islands... they call for me...

gift_prefer.line: ...Thank you. I don't receive gifts often, so... this is quite a quaint feeling.

login.line: Today might actually be an eventful day.

main1.line: On the battlefield, you swing your weapon and defeat the enemy, no more. Thinking about other things comes after the battle.

main2.line: Sendai, how about we have a match? As for our spectators... I suppose we could ask Jintsuu and the Commander.

main3.line: Seems having some cheerful people by your side might not be so bad.

touch.line: Do you like kendo, too? I'll work you to the bone to make you good at it. ... Huh? You don't wanna do it?

touch2.line: Phew... I was considering chopping off your hand, had you gone any further.

unlock.line: Mhm. Lightweight clothing makes it easier to fight. Thanks, Commander... "It looks cute on me"? W-well, thanks...

battle.line: Ready for battle! Awaiting orders, Commander!

detail.line: I may be a ninja and a guard, but I still get bored waiting for visitors all the time... What? You want me to take a nap and let you handle it? Are you being serious right now?

expedition.line: Commission complete. Ugh, I know I'm just going with you to check on them, but I worry about leaving my post...

feeling5.line: Is everyone enjoying their ideal version of the world? I guess I am. How it looks depends on the person, but in the end, we all love being in a world with you. Yes, that includes me.

home.line: The combat report is right here. I've been checking behind you ever since you got back. Hmm... I guess this outfit is for espionage, now that you mention it.

login.line: No matter where I am or the role I am given, my duty remains. I'll always endeavor for your sake.

main1.line: You brought me food? Thank you... Or is this just a bribe?

main2.line: I have to keep an eye on festival security as part of my duties, too. Wouldn't want you to burden yourself with that job when you're trying to have fun... not to mention the mental effort.

mission.line: New missions. Let's return to our respective duties for now, Commander.

touch2.line: I don't remember trying to seduce you...

unlock.line: ...Oh, it's you. This is a forbidden area, so even you can't... Okay, and you're coming in anyway. Hmm. Not sure what to do about this...

win_mvp.line: Trying to make an enemy of me? Naïve!

battle.line: I fight... for the one I love!

detail.line: I want you to pay Lady Nagato a visit from time to time. There's little I can do to ease her loneliness, but I believe that you can. Don't you worry, I know you'll still come to see me as well.

feeling5.line: "Your dreams will come true if you don't give up on them." They will, so let us make them real. I swear it to you upon all my being.

headtouch.line: What is it?

home.line: When the fighting ends, I will always be here waiting for you. Put your mind at rest.

login.line: Today is another day devoid of change. But nothing needs to change if I can happily remain by your side.

main1.line: The same sword that takes lives can also save them. It is my goal to become that: a sword that protects.

main2.line: You must not fixate on only either brains or brawn. The ideal leader is both wise and strong. Ahahah, here I am, paraphrasing Naka.

main3.line: You've got a cheerful gang going with this fleet. And you are a part of it, Commander.

mission.line: You have new missions. Shall we have a casual discourse while you review them?

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards are here. Hopefully, they'll have been worth our efforts.

touch.line: How I feel about secretary work? Work is work, that is all. I will gladly do anything for you.

touch2.line: It's humiliating to watch the other girls get ahead of me...

unlock.line: This must be the dream you've awaited so eagerly... Of course, I vowed to be with you until the end of our days. I shall take my rightful place beside you and your ideals. We are... together.

win_mvp.line: The Commander, Lady Nagato, and all my friends depend on me. I cannot afford to lose now.

battle.line: I-I'm supposed to give orders?! ... Whuah?! C-come on, everyone!

couple_encourage1.line: Yuugure, d-do you mind if I stay behind you...?

detail.line: Ugh... C-could you please not stare so much...?

expedition.line: The commission team just returned to port. Umm... I think we should go check on them...

feeling1.line: Everyone's been saying the Commander is a mean person... Commander, is that really true...?

feeling2.line: Why do I like to hide behind you...? Umm, that's because... I feel more comfortable with you leading the way, Commander...

feeling3.line: Ugh... It's so scary at night... Commander, w-when it gets late, could you pretty please lead me to the dorm...?

feeling4.line: I have many more fluffy friends than just Hoppy... Commander, would you like to come visit my House of Fluffs sometime later...?

feeling5.line: I'm not scared of the dark or planes when I'm with you, Commander... W-would you mind if, from now on, I walked ahead of you, rather than behind you...?

home.line: Well done on the last sortie, Commander... W-would you like to pet Hoppy? I-it's really comforting to stroke his fluffy fur...

hp_warning.line: I-I'm not going to give up!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander... Come on, Hoppy, say hi to the Commander.

lose.line: Ugh... S-stay away...!

mail.line: Your mail has arrived! Let's take a look at it, Commander!

main1.line: I feel safe around Yuugure. I enjoy playing and having sleepovers with her. I wish I had more friends like her...

main2.line: Oh no, a-another air raid?! ... Commander, please don't scare me like that!

main3.line: I'm always doing my best, trying to catch up to everyone... S-so please, don't ever leave me behind, okay...?

mission.line: We still have quite a few missions to complete... Commander, can you do it...?

mission_complete.line: A mission... Yes, it seems a mission has been completed! You're quite the go-getter, Commander...

profile.line: I'm Kiyonami, the eighth Yuugumo-class destroyer... I had improved anti-air capabilities, but neither Yuugure nor I could really deal with things in the air... Ugh... If only I'd done a better job back then... B-but even so, I did achieve a couple of things! Wh-what I'm getting at is that I'll do the best job I can...!

propose.line: Will we really be able to be together forever from now on...? That's great...! N-now, I learned from Yuugure that... the next thing I should do is close my eyes and wait for you to do something, right? O-okay!

skill.line: W-we will do this together, Hoppy!

touch.line: Hoppy is cute, isn't he? Ehehe~ He's always there with me when I go to bed.

touch2.line: I-I'm not sure why you're doing this... B-but please stop, it tickles, Commander...!

unlock.line: Yuugumo-class destroyer Kiyonami, r-reporting for duty... And this is my friend, Hoppy... I-it's nice to meet you! ... Ugh...

upgrade.line: Hoppy and I think we got a little stronger...

win_mvp.line: I-I got... first place? Y-you're... not just joking, right...?

gift_prefer.line: Th-thank you very much, Commander! I, umm... how should I even return the favor... Nngh...

detail.line: I'm not sure what wrapping paper to use for my presents... Ummhh... Could you help me pick out a good one, Commander...?

home.line: Well done on the last sortie. W-would you like a snack? I have gingerbread cookies and Christmas cake...

login.line: M-Merry Christmas, Commander! Phew... I think I said that right!

main1.line: I'm spending Christmas with Yuugure and some friends. D-do you want to be there with us too, Commander...?

main2.line: I've gotten presents for everyone I know. Th-that includes you, of course, Commander!

main3.line: All these warm lights at Christmas make me feel at ease... I wish it was Christmas all year round...

touch.line: Sometimes... Hoppy is on his own, but we always go to bed together at night.

touch2.line: Y-you'll make my hood come undone... Ugh...

unlock.line: S-sorry to keep you waiting... Yuugure and I picked out this outfit together. She said it "looked very Christmassy," but it doesn't look weird, right? ... Ugh...

battle.line: A real battle... I'll give it my all...!

detail.line: C-Commander, I haven't, um... disappointed you... have I?

expedition.line: Commander... a commission's been completed... I didn't get the time wrong... did I?

feeling1.line: I knew I probably wouldn't be of any use to you...

feeling2.line: Commander, is there something you wish me to do? I-is it possible I might have caused you trouble without realizing it?

feeling3.line: I'm trying my best not to cause trouble for people, but I don't know how... So instead I ended up making a lot of mistakes...

feeling4.line: Ever since I came to your base, I've started making considerably fewer mistakes... But even when I do, you don't get mad at me, so I've slowly but surely been able to get better... Also, when you encourage me by stroking my ears, your hand feels so warm...

feeling5.line: I'm timid and I often make mistakes, so I doubt I'll ever be very helpful to you, Commander... But I'm okay with that. Because what matters is...

home.line: Commander... you're not hurt, are you...?

login.line: Commander, I've sorted all your documents... You wanted your documents sorted... right?

lose.line: I've failed yet again...

mail.line: Commander, you have mail... Here... oh, wait, is it this one?

main1.line: I want to be useful to you, Commander, but if I cause you trouble instead... Then what will I do...

main2.line: If I cause you any trouble, I'll let you touch my ears and my tail, so please don't get mad at me...

main3.line: For this one you do this, then here you do... this... I think? I-I hope this will work...

mission.line: Commander, we have new missions. I'm certain it is a new one. I confirmed it myself...

mission_complete.line: Commander, I brought the mission rewards. I didn't make another mistake, did I...?

profile.line: I'm {namecode:125}, I'm the fifth ship of the {namecode:26}-class, I was constructed as part of the Circle Four Plan. But... I might be the least useful ship ever constructed... *Sob*...

propose.line: Even if they're a coward, even if they often make mistakes, what matters is telling your partner that you love them from the bottom of your heart, right...? This is the one thing I've believed ever since I was born... Okay, from now on I swear I'll always be with you, Commander...

skill.line: I-I'm not mistaken here, am I?!

touch.line: Commander? I'm worrying if I did something wrong today... I-I don't think... I have...

touch2.line: Eek?! C-Commander... you're seriously going to make me cry...

unlock.line: I'm {namecode:125}, the fifth ship of the {namecode:26}-class. I-I sincerely hope I can be of servish to... *Whimper*... I've made another mistake... Even though I practiced on it so much...

upgrade.line: Commander, whenever I think about failing to meet your expectations... it almost makes me start crying... *Sob*...

win_mvp.line: I hope I didn't cause any trouble for anyone...

battle.line: My s-skirt is gonna get blown away!

detail.line: Hyaa! C-Commander, when did you get here?

expedition.line: Commander! E-Everyone has come home safely!

feeling1.line: Commander, I wonder if you've been cursed...

feeling2.line: Back then, my sisters and I were all scattered to the winds... But, we are finally reunited again. It's a miracle...

feeling3.line: Aww.... m-my hair's all messed... Fusou's not here either, what should I do... Hm? You'd help me comb my hair? Thank you very much, Commander!

feeling4.line: Y-You'd like to watch my kagura dance? B-but, I still have a lot of practicing to do... Fusou said that rehearsals are just as important as practice...? I see! I... I'll do my best!

feeling5.line: C-Commander, please accept this! This is a protective good luck charm! "Marriage tie?" What do you mean...? C-Commander... you're a big bully...

home.line: Commander, you're safe! Thank goodness... my prayers were heard...

hp_warning.line: O gods, please give me guidance...!

login.line: Commander, w-welcome back!

lose.line: O gods, please save us!

mail.line: Commander, h-here... your letters...

main1.line: O gods, please bless this port so that everyone may come home safely.

main2.line: Yoizuki may seem cold, but she's very nice and is always thinking of everyone else!

main3.line: Good luck! I'll... be supporting you!

mission.line: C-Commander, umm... there are still missions left...

mission_complete.line: Commander, I've received the rewards!

profile.line: I am the ninth ship of the Akizuki-class destroyers, Harutsuki. Due to various circumstances, I wasn't able to do much, but... I'll make up for it this time, Commander!

propose.line: O gods, thank you very much for allowing me to meet Commander. I truly am blessed right now! So, um, Commander... though I'm still inexperienced, please take care of me!

skill.line: O gods, please watch over us!

touch.line: Commander? Would you like to try the sakura mochi that I made?

touch2.line: C-Commander! P-Please stop doing that... *sniffles*

unlock.line: I was guided here by the gods... Ah! M-My name is Harutsuki! Pleased to meet you!

upgrade.line: C-Can I truly become stronger like this?

win_mvp.line: Surely this must have been the gods' blessings.

gift_prefer.line: Th-thank you very much, Commander!

detail.line: Um, Commander... It's a bit embarrassing if you stare at me like that...

login.line: All right, that should be all the rehearsing I need... C-Commander?! Just now, were you... watching me the whole time?

main1.line: I practiced a lot for this... so I hope I can do a good job...

main2.line: Fusou and Yamashiro went out of their way to practice with me! I'll have to make sure to thank them after this...!

main3.line: Gods, please watch over everyone this year...

touch.line: Do you like this outfit that much?

touch2.line: P-please stop that, Commander! You're going to mess up my clothes...

unlock.line: Happy New Year, Commander! I am currently on my way to give a Kagura dance at the shrine. If you have time... would you like to come see it?

detail.line: Commander, this is a miraculous gel blessed by the gods! It's an amazing cleanser... Oh, no! There I go playing with it again... Focus, focus!

feeling5.line: Mmm... I was just washing your back, so why is my face burning? And why is my heart pounding? Th-this must be that concentration training that Fusou was telling me about! Ah... Concentrate, concentrate!

headtouch.line: U-umm... Oh, you want to fix my hair for me? Th-thank you very much, Commander!

home.line: C-Commander, you're back! Wait just a moment... Okay, the water's just fine! Hop right in and relax.

login.line: Ah, Commander, welcome back! I made this cleansing gel for you... Y-you think it's cute? I think so, too!

main1.line: Squish, squish... Squeeze, squeeze... Commander, look! I made a kitty out of the gel! Hehe, give it a poke.

main2.line: Commander, your bath is ready. Come right in! You'll have a great night's sleep after a bath this nice.

main3.line: Eww... It's supposed to be a cleansing gel, so why is it so sticky? C-Commander?! D-don't stare at me, please...

mission.line: A-a new mission, right now...? But I haven't gotten you to relax yet...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Back to relaxing you go, Commander...

touch.line: Take THAT! Now you're all wet and gooey, too~

touch2.line: C-Commander! It's too embarrassing!

unlock.line: C-Commander! Over here! Take a seat right here, please! Breathe in, relax... Okay, you're all ready! I'll cleanse you right away!

upgrade.line: Ooh! Now I can massage you even better!

battle.line: Be careful. Try to stay close to me.

detail.line: There is little I can do on my own. So, please, if I can assist in any way, don't be afraid to ask. I will help you.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Splendid work.

feeling1.line: I would prefer it if you'd stay away from me.

feeling2.line: Hm? I seem cold and distant to you? I've heard that from Harutsuki before... Oh, bother...

feeling3.line: I know that I can't always be by Harutsuki's side to help when she feels nervous. Yet, my body always acts on its own accord...

feeling4.line: You don't require my help, yet you keep me waiting by your side... Why is that? I don't quite understand...

feeling5.line: A "date"? What does that mean? ... It means we'll play together? Certainly, if that's what you wish. ... Why are you smiling? You're quite strange...

home.line: You must be tired. Should I prepare tea while you rest for a while, Commander?

login.line: You have returned, Commander. I have already sorted all your documents.

lose.line: They tricked us... Everyone, retreat! I will watch your backs...!

mail.line: Commander, I have left your mail here.

main1.line: Why I help people? I feel I should; therefore I do it... Is that strange?

main2.line: Some have mistaken me for a light cruiser... I wonder why... I don't look like one...

main3.line: "Forcing myself"? Not at all. If I were, my help would only have the opposite effect.

mission.line: We have received a mission. Is it something I may take care of?

mission_complete.line: I have brought the mission rewards. These should be all of them.

profile.line: I am the Akizuki-class destroyer Yoizuki. I specialize in anti-air combat. If you ever have any problems, please tell me. I will solve them quickly for you.

propose.line: This is how you've felt about me, Commander...? I've been slow to catch on, haven't I... But, do not worry, I pledge myself to you. I swear to always protect you, do exactly as you wish, and never again leave your side.

touch.line: Do you feel tired? Shall I give you a shoulder massage?

touch2.line: Commander, are you asking for a beating?

unlock.line: I'm honored to meet you, Commander. I have come to assist you. From now on, I can help you with your work whenever needed.

upgrade.line: This feels rather nice.

win_mvp.line: We have everyone to thank for this victory.

gift_prefer.line: A gift? Thank you very much. I appreciate your kindness.

detail.line: I received a good luck charm from Harutsuki... It's nice when someone offers you their blessings.

feeling5.line: Will you enter with me for the three-legged race? Don't worry, we're unbeatable as a pair.

home.line: All the entrants are strong candidates... I'll need to exert myself for the next event, too.

login.line: I registered for several sporting events. I must give it my all so I won't slow down my teammates...

main1.line: Harutsuki, slow down and match your pace with mine... One, two! One two!

main2.line: It's quite hot today, Commander. I brought a drink with me... I drank a little from it, but... would you like to have some?

main3.line: Ugh... My hair is being annoying... Harutsuki's not here, either... Excuse me, Commander, could you give me a hand?

touch.line: Commander, I'm completely soaked in sweat... You probably shouldn't touch me.

touch2.line: Are you taking advantage of me at a time like this? Are you mentally prepared for what comes next, Commander?

unlock.line: It's my turn? Hold on... Umm, could you please not stare at me like that? It's... making me feel uncomfortable.

detail.line: The noise of the firecrackers is said to repel a monster called the "Nian." As for why this monster only appears during Lunar New Year's, I'm not quite sure...

home.line: I'm aware that setting off firecrackers is an important Dragon Empery tradition. That said... This many firecrackers may be excessive.

login.line: Is there anything I can help you with, Commander? You seem busy as ever, even during the Lunar New Year, so...

main1.line: Yat Sen's dim sum is wonderful. I'm particularly fond of this meat bun she made.

main2.line: If lighting firecrackers sounds too frightening, would you like to light a firework instead?

main3.line: Make a fai chun? Sorry, such things are beyond my means. You may wish to ask Hanazuki or Suzutsuki instead.

touch.line: Don't worry, it's not very heavy. I'm capable of carrying it.

touch2.line: Perhaps the noise of the firecrackers can dispel your sinful thoughts too?

unlock.line: Mmh... Happy New Year. I'm working on hooking my friends up with these firecrackers... The bun I'm eating? I received it as a thank-you for my efforts.

battle.line: Muahaha, all ships… set sail!

couple_encourage1.line: 17th Destroyer fleet ready to take out the enemy!!

detail.line: O you mean this family emblem? I designed this myself, plus the clothes. I won’t accept any other comments except for “its cute”.

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned, did you forget?

feeling1.line: Stay away from me, stupidity is contagious.

feeling2.line: My fan? Its military issue, not some ordinary fan. It’s used by Admirals, so don’t underestimate me… hehehe. Hmm? I said nothing.

feeling3.line: {namecode:128} and {namecode:127} are both so whimsical and wandering around. Those girls sure don’t have the temperment of being in the Navy. They still need to lean on me, being their big sister. Such a headache...

feeling4.line: Actually, even though I don’t care that much and I have confidence in myself, for the sake of asking… do you think I’m independent enough?

feeling5.line: What, I just asked offhandedly, you sure are opinionated… forget it. I’ll still listen to what you got to say. Just you wait, one day I’ll impress you.

home.line: You’ve worked hard today, please get some rest.

hp_warning.line: Such a tactical mistake...

login.line: So slow, are you like a turtle who’s stumbled onto the battlefield?

lose.line: Damn, give me… victory. Win or lose, that’s the way of life in the Navy.

mail.line: You’ve got mail… hmm? You read it, I didn’t really focus on what was written, don’t mind me.

main1.line: That {namecode:128} girl, as my little sister she always acts superior to {namecode:127}, even more than I do, darn…

main2.line: If only we discovered Tusk, then {namecode:70}-sama would not… sigh, forget it, what’s important is the present

main3.line: Official documents? Let me see… hmm… ahh I see I see...

mission.line: I’ve organized all the missions… say what, you want me to clear them as well?!

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have been confirmed, I’ll leave the labor work of transporting it here to you.

profile.line: The 17th Destroyer fleet have been together for most of the time, and we participated in all sorts of sorties and operations for almost the entirety of the war. In the end I was with {namecode:70}-sama as we both made our last stand… to the end. So I don’t care about those little things.

propose.line: Commander, you’ve finally realized my greatness. To be frank… my ears are not twitching. I’m not that happy, shut up, let’s continue the ceremony!

touch.line: Don’t poke me unstoppingly, are you a monkey?

touch2.line: This type of things should not be tolerated, right? In that case, die...

unlock.line: So it turns out to be you, are you the Commander of the 17th Destroyer fleet from today onwards? You seem so ordinary. I am {namecode:19} class {namecode:142}, show me what you got, Commander.

upgrade.line: Thank you… my ears are twitching? Impossible, I’m not that happy at all.

win_mvp.line: We won… naturally, what’s there to gloat about?

gift_prefer.line: Mmhmm. Not bad, not bad. Quite thoughtful of you.

detail.line: You should know that I designed this outfit just by seeing the family crest here. Do you think it looks good?

feeling5.line: Look here, Christmas nowadays is a holiday that you celebrate with those who are important to you. You came here knowing that, didn't you? Me? I... don't particularly object...

login.line: Merry Christmas. I suppose I'll let you take it easy today.

mail.line: Another greeting card for you... Curse you, what a normie.

main1.line: {namecode:143}, stop frolicking around like a little kid, and don't pull on me either! Ugh... what am I going to do with you?

main2.line: I still have to prepare presents for the three stooges... Jeez, can't they be a bit more considerate towards their big sis normally? Oh well, I suppose that's how it should be.

main3.line: It's snowing... Hmm? It's not like I particularly want to play in the snow or anything, but if you want to so badly, I suppose I can tag along.

touch.line: Santa Claus? ... Hmph, I graduated from that fairy tale long ago.

unlock.line: Before you raise a fuss about it, let me just tell you this - the concept of "Christmas" already existed during the Sengoku period, so there's nothing weird about putting on a Christmas outfit!

battle.line: Let us do like rock stars do and turn it up to eleven!

detail.line: Of course they had music during the Sengoku period! ...But they didn't have rock bands? Listen, it's called "getting with the times."

expedition.line: What? Was I wrong? Hm... It's been quite some time since Tanikaze said she'd go receive the commission team... Hope nothing has happened to her...

home.line: Do we have any potential new band members? ...What? Nobody has even applied? Grrr... I suppose there's no point in getting mad at you for it, though...

login.line: Enough dilly-dallying! It's time to get on with today's rehearsal!

main1.line: Hamakaze said she won't join because it would "impact her academic performance"... Hmph! She doesn't know what she's missing out on!

main2.line: A band logo? Yes, and we'll use my family crest as the motif, of course!

main3.line: If you're going to rest, find something durable to sit on... I'm not "showing concern," just giving you instructions!

mission.line: Being a general is no excuse to skip out on rehears– Ahem! I mean missions.

mission_complete.line: You've brought the missions rewards? Splendid, Isokaze! I'll see to it you receive a castle for your efforts!

touch.line: Go on. Read the score and play the song like I taught you.

unlock.line: Ugh... Even though we finally got all our gear, we still need more band members... Commander! Stop complaining and come hither! From now on, you're a member of the Sengoku Shredders!

battle.line: I will lead the charge into batt... Hey, stop! Wait for me!

couple_encourage1.line: Hamakaze, follow my lead!

detail.line: One banner, one nation!

expedition.line: Our target: the base's docks! We must welcome back the commission team! Giddy-up, General!

feeling1.line: Hmph! I'm done playing with you! Hamakaze, Tanikaze, where are you?

feeling2.line: How I know so much? Urakaze-sama taught me everything about the warring states! She's really smart! But Hamakaze is still my best friend in the end! Heheheh~

feeling3.line: Western Army, attack! Fire on the Eastern Army! Our next move will be... Oh no! Hideaki was lured away! That's unfair, General! Darn, now I'm... *Sob*...

feeling4.line: General, let's play a game! Huh?! You've got work to do?! You really do? Do you want me to help? Then how about a massage? ...Hooray! I love you, General!

feeling5.line: General, Urakaze-sama seemed angry at me and said I've started being cold to Hamakaze! But I still want to play with you... So come on! Let's go play together with Hamakaze!

home.line: You make me proud, General! Hey, uh, listen! I have a report for you! You see...

hp_warning.line: I will never back down!

login.line: General! It's time to charge into battle!

lose.line: Hamakaze, Hamakaze where are you... You have to save me!

mail.line: General, I have a letter for you!

main1.line: General! Come play warring states with me! You can be... Ieyasu! I'll be Mitsunari!

main2.line: Hamakaze! Tanikaze! Let's depart! We're heading for the capital!

main3.line: Urakaze-sama, my coat has been torn again... Fix it for me!

mission.line: General! Put me in charge of the mission! I'll finish it you before you can say "set sail"!

mission_complete.line: General, our mission rewards are here! How much koku did we receive?

profile.line: I am Isokaze of DD17! In the past, you see, I've worked with Hamakaze, Urakaze, Tanikaze... oh, and Yukikaze! My service record stands second to none! And that's why you should put me in charge of your missions!

propose.line: General, if anyone starts being mean to you then tell me. Hamakaze and I will go and get revenge on them for you. We're here for you, because we're all friends!

touch.line: General, give me a piggyback ride! We must charge into the enemy stronghold!

touch2.line: Hahaha, that tickles~!

unlock.line: All units, attaaack! ...Wait a second, where am I?! Oh, I know you! Urakaze-sama said you're... the general! Hmph! I'm Isokaze, the one destined to become a general that will make the whole world tremble in fear!

upgrade.line: I am Isokaze, the leader of Destroyer Division 17!

win_mvp.line: Urakaze-sama, can you see my glorious victory?!

gift_prefer.line: Woahhh! Thank you, General!

detail.line: General, I want my red envelope!

feeling5.line: General, General! Make sure to wake me up for the New Year's shrine visit! Even if I sleep in, make sure to come get me! This year, we definitely need to go together!

login.line: General, Happy New Year!

main1.line: Woah! It's snowing! General, let's call everyone out and have a snowball fight!

main2.line: Why is everyone so sluggish during the winter? I think playing in the snow is suuuuper fun!

main3.line: General, General, look! It's a tiger! Rooooaarrr! Ahahaha~

mission_complete.line: General, what are these? New Year's presents?

touch.line: Huh? General, I'm not cold~ Ahaha, stop rubbing my belly, it tickles!

unlock.line: General, General, look! It's my New Year's outfit! Urakaze made it for me! Let's play a bunch of Sengoku wargames this year as well!

battle.line: The first smash hit is coming right up~!

home.line: For the General's return, an ode of celebration... Uhh, I was going to practice this song with Urakaze...

login.line: General! Let us dedicate our souls to the rehearsal today!

main1.line: Hamakaze, tutor me~ I was practicing so hard that I forgot to do my homework...

main2.line: General! What kind of outfit should I wear? A suit of armor? Just a chestplate...?

main3.line: "Straight to your heart! Love delivered on the spear's tip!" ...How's that, General? Just like an idol, right?

touch.line: This outfit is so fluttery... Being cute is nice and all, but I want to be badass...

unlock.line: General! I, Isokaze, have done my utmost to prepare the equipment! Now, with Lord Urakaze's presence, our Sengoku☆War-Band is complete! Of course, you are more than welcome to join our ranks, General!

win_mvp.line: Viiiiictorrrryyyyyy~! As the sun shines, so do I!

battle.line: This wind... is perfect for battle!

detail.line: This time too... I swear to protect my friends!

expedition.line: Well done... Commissions are hardly a big deal compared to Rat Transports, right?

feeling1.line: Stupid meatheaded Commander...

feeling2.line: Commander, history surely won't repeat itself... right?

feeling3.line: I hope one day... Destroyer Division 17 can reunite here...

feeling4.line: The breeze feels really nice today... But we can't afford to rest yet! Yamato... wait for me...

feeling5.line: For as long as the wind blows, I will always be by your side.

home.line: Great job. Did everyone do their job during the sortie?

login.line: Now's not the time to lose focus, Commander.

lose.line: I have to rescue the survivors...

mail.line: Reading through these reports should be your top priority.

main1.line: Tanikaze, until you finish your training, don't expect to get much beauty sleep!

main2.line: Though I may be but a single destroyer, I'll still do all I can to protect everyone.

main3.line: Bou-no-misaki... where it all came to an end...

mission.line: Our next mission is...

mission_complete.line: Your grades are going up, Commander.

profile.line: I'm Hamakaze, 13th Kagerou-class destroyer. Although I took part in quite a few battles, it feels like I spent more time rescuing friends than sinking foes... And now, I fight once more to protect my friends.

propose.line: M-maybe we should wait until it's all over... Th-that said, I'd feel bad if I rejected you now, so I'll have to accept it... Hey, stop laughing!

touch.line: Hm? What are you looking at, Commander?

touch2.line: Eek! ... Commander, just where do you think you're touching?

unlock.line: Hamakaze, 13th ship of the Kagerou-class destroyers, reporting for duty. Commander, try not to get my name wrong.

upgrade.line: The wind grows stronger.

win_mvp.line: Heheh! This is nothing spectacular for me!

gift_prefer.line: Th-thanks... I really appreciate it.

battle.line: Hm, hm... at this range, with these forces... we can win!

login.line: Commander, were you able to solve that question from yesterday?

main1.line: Urakaze, Isokaze, Tanikaze, have you all taken your seats? Then let's review the essentials of the last formula we studied.

main2.line: Improve yourself so that you can better protect those you care about. That's why I study as hard as I do.

main3.line: Here we'll use this equation, then do this... Hah, a trivial question like this is no issue for me.

touch.line: Commander, you won't find the answer underneath my skirt.

touch2.line: Commander, take your reading more seriously!

unlock.line: Learning is exciting. The joy of acquiring new knowledge, the sense of achievement from solving difficult problems... you'll understand once you try it. So, shall we study together, Commander?

win_mvp.line: That parabola... was beautiful...

detail.line: I do all the cooking while Tanikaze takes care of the cleaning. Are we the only staff, you wonder? No, we've got all these little guys helping us too!

home.line: Welcome! ...Oh, it's just you. Will you have the usual? Or do you wanna try the new menu items?

login.line: Come on in, Commander! I just worked out a new flavor and you're gonna try it right now!

main1.line: Welcome! I came up with this flavor after eating at tons of restaurants! No other store can match it!

main2.line: Tanikaze, could you come help me out in here once you're done cleaning?

main3.line: Does the little guy on this plate even have a name? I'm not sure...?

touch.line: I'd appreciate it if you'd leave your cutlery here after you're done eating.

touch2.line: You're not allowed inside the kitchen, Commander!

unlock.line: I'm experimenting with different flavors since we're running a pop-up café... Alright! I think I'll go with this one! Strap in, Commander, because you're about to do a lot of taste-testing!

main1.line: Could you stop poking my cheek, Tanikaze... Hey, stop! No poking there, especially!

main2.line: I love seeing my friends smile. That's why...

main3.line: It's not over yet... This time, I'll triumph... at Bou-no-misaki.

touch.line: Commander, I think you can see further if you do it like this.

touch2.line: Eek! ... Commander, this is unacceptable!

unlock.line: Commander, have you been having more fun since I arrived? ... I see, that's great! Ehehe... Hamakaze, getting hyped!

battle.line: Destroyer Division 17, setting sail! Huh? Did I get something wrong...?

couple_encourage1.line: Let's fight like we did in the Kula Gulf!

detail.line: Midway? I believe we won that battle... O-or am I wrong again?!

expedition.line: A team has returned to base, Commander.

feeling1.line: It's you... *Stares angrily*

feeling2.line: I still don't know very much about you, Commander.

feeling3.line: Usually valley winds are only there during noon, but I'm always here!

feeling4.line: Hehe~ You're wide open for attack! Poke~

feeling5.line: When I'm with you, it feels like time flows faster. Do you feel the same thing, Commander?

home.line: Wah! Welcome back!

login.line: I'm right here if you need me.

lose.line: What could I have done better...

mail.line: The winds have brought you new mail.

main1.line: Hamakaze-chan, you need to ease up a little! Pokey-poke~

main2.line: Y-Yukikaze's coming here? W-we should be able to get along... Hopefully...

main3.line: I always feel at ease when you're here with me, Commander.

mission.line: The mission isn't finished yet, Commander.

mission_complete.line: I knew you could do it, Commander.

touch2.line: Please, don't poke anything but my cheek!

upgrade.line: It's really windy today...

win_mvp.line: Did I do well enough to satisfy you, Commander?

gift_prefer.line: Woah, what's all this?

home.line: Commander, are you ready to go to the beach?

main1.line: Ugh... I want to invite Yukikaze, but... she's hard to approach...

main2.line: Commander, are my life jacket and float ring in order?

login.line: How's this? I'd say the place looks much cleaner now. Uh-oh... the bucket! ...Aww! I suppose I have more cleaning to do...

main1.line: W-welcome...! I'm practicing my waitress skills for when I have to do it for real! Thinking about it is a bit nerve-wracking...

main2.line: Having a vacuum-cleaning robot sure is convenient. Maybe I can go help Hamakaze with all the time it's freed up...

main3.line: I just realized... I've never given the little cutie that's always sitting on my head a name, have I...?

touch.line: Oh, you'll lend me a hand? Okay, then you can take my broom.

touch2.line: Eek! You almost made me knock over my bucket! Stop that!

unlock.line: Commander, I'm mopping the floor right now. Please watch your step, as it's quite slippery over there... Eek! Owch... I suppose I should've watched my own step... Ahaha...

main1.line: I really wonder... What might Urakaze-chan and Isokaze-chan be doing right now...

main2.line: Something good is going to happen today, Commander.

main3.line: You're a very warmhearted person, Commander.

touch.line: Wah! This time I'll poke you in return! Poke! Poke poke~!

touch2.line: Ah, I see! It's my turn now! Poke poke... Scratch scratch... Can I nap while you give me a piggyback, Commander? ...Zzzzz....

unlock.line: I am Tanikaze, the winds have carried me from valleys to mountaintops... Oh wow, a b-butterfly?! It really is a butterfly! Is this for me? Thank you, Commander!

couple_encourage1.line: This time... let's go home, together.

couple_encourage2.line: I also like cute girls. Hm? It's not the same?

couple_encourage3.line: I love to sing as well~

expedition.line: Isn't it about time to welcome the others back?

feeling1.line: Arashio... Where are you?

feeling2.line: Every time I look out into the horizon, memories of that time come flooding back to me...

feeling4.line: Commander, I'm at ease when I'm with you... But every time I think about Arashio, I get anxious again...

feeling5.line: Commander, you're somehow always able to put my heart at ease. But recently, I've discovered something else that scares me... Commander, you'll always stay by my side... right?

home.line: There is nothing more reassuring than being here. Commander, don't you think so too?

hp_warning.line: The situation... seems to not be ideal.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. If you don't want to set sail right away, why don't you rest first?

lose.line: If only I had upgraded my anti-air equipment a bit more...

main2.line: Happiness is a full belly and a good night's sleep.

main3.line: *Yawns* ...It's already so late, but Commander is still at it... Please make sure to take care of yourself.

mission.line: Commander, your missions... Please show some motivation once in a while.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards... can I use them to buy something to eat?

skill.line: This time... I won't fail again!

touch.line: Don't worry, I... am not afraid anymore!

touch2.line: What a weird feeling...

win_mvp.line: It seems that I accidentally did something awesome...

detail_ex.line: Michishio is here at this port, and you are too, Commander. I want to stay here forever.

main3_ex.line: Zzzzz... Commander...? Can I stay like this a little longer...? Good night, Commander... Zzzzz...

mail_ex.line: New mail... Should I try singing it aloud like Michishio does?

mission_complete_ex.line: The mission rewards... Let's bring some along for Ooshio.

touch_ex.line: I'll protect you, Commander.

detail.line: I wonder if I can find Arashio here at school...?

login.line: Commander, would you like some hot tea and a mikan orange?

main2.line: I can't finish all the food that everyone brought... Commander, if you don't mind, could you help finish mine?

main3.line: Even though we can't have a tea party during the winter, it's fun to sit around and chat with everyone inside the kotatsu.

touch.line: Hold hands...? Okay.

unlock.line: Happy New Year, Commander. I am here to spend the New Year with you. Would you be so kind as to first help me down from here?

win_mvp.line: For your sake, Commander, I shall do my best.

detail.line: *Bum* *Bum* *Bum*... The drums' sound makes me feel all fluttery... Oh, Commander, are you okay? I'm... not too heavy, am I?

main2.line: Um, Michishio chose this outfit, Arashio picked out this hair accessory, and Ooshio chose this anklet... Do you think they look good on me?

touch.line: The long and fluttery sleeves are beautiful, aren't they?

touch2.line: It's hard to dance like this...

Anyhow, why don'tcha tell me a bit 'bout this fleet?

skill.line: For the sake of the fleet~

That's when I joined the Battle of Leyte Gulf... Hmm, even though I'm pretty unlucky, I'm hoping everyone here will still be my friend!

propose.line: I've never been so happy before... But I know today is just the start of an even happier life, isn't it? It definitely is, isn't it, Commander♪

touch2.line: Aie! Commander... You're dirty...

couple_encourage1.line: Destroyer Division 8, let's all stick together now.

couple_encourage2.line: Asashio, I'm right by your side. Don't be scared.

mail.line: You've received mail. Shall we go see what it is, Commander?

main3.line: I've made you some tea. Take your time to savor it. By the way, is my tea-making ability to your liking?

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed. You did a great job, Commander!

propose.line: Commander, I won't say anything indecent, but there's one thing I want to tell you... Umm... I'll always be there to support you. Your side is the place where I truly belong.

skill.line: I'll keep everyone out of harm's way.

win_mvp.line: I'm awesome... Or so they say. But why?

gift_prefer.line: I really like this!

detail.line: Commander, come ski with me... Yeah, bring the Manjuus too...!

login.line: The best thing about winter... is skiing in the snow!

main1.line: Today, I will transform into a snow bunny!

main2.line: The snow is so sparkly and soft... it's very fun.

main3.line: You shouldn't underestimate me~ I've been practicing this whole time.

touch.line: Eep?! Commander, your hands are cold...

touch2.line: My outfit is thick, therefore wholesome...

unlock.line: It's snowing...! I've finished rallying the forces... so let us advance!

battle.line: Don't think too hard, just do your part and we'll win. Let's go!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's show them how veterans fight!

couple_encourage2.line: Shigure, don't get caught off guard.

detail.line: Oh, also, did you know my original name was "Destroyer No. 9"? ... I suppose it's a good thing they decided to change it.

expedition.line: Before you go collect those mission rewards, remember to give thanks to those who worked so hard for them.

feeling1.line: Could you acknowledge the error of your ways before other girls start thinking poorly of you?

feeling2.line: If you'd like, perhaps I could give you a wise lady's advice on how to interact with others?

feeling3.line: Different people must be treated in their own unique way. This is no secret to social success, but it will help make you more sociable.

feeling4.line: Ah, you should also take this amulet. It will make you more sociable. But beware: if you use it to hurt someone, you will be too.

feeling5.line: If something's on your mind, tell me. I may be old, but my experience has been useful for solving many problems. Besides, why would you hide anything from your partner? Ahah.

home.line: Admirable work out there. Have some tea and reflect on your tactics.

hp_warning.line: Agh... So this is why they say you can't flee from pain...

login.line: A commander should at the very least be on time. But considering your achievements up till now, you at least deserve some praise.

lose.line: It seems I have not kept up with the times...

mail.line: Check the new mail you received. Oh, also, I have a copy of it as well.

main1.line: I think Matsukaze feels compelled to worry about us so much, and sometimes we don't even know how we should respond...

main2.line: If you want to slack off all day, just resign. Oh, also, you have much work left to do.

main3.line: Kamikaze, could you stop teasing the Commander?

mission.line: Those with talent work a lot. Do not leave missions incomplete.

mission_complete.line: Well... I wasn't expecting this big of a reward.

profile.line: I'm Hatakaze, a Kamikaze-class destroyer. Oh, also, though my class might make me seem experienced, not only did I mainly engage in escort missions and achieve nothing spectacular, my story ends with my wish to fight the bitter end, like Kamikaze did, going unfulfilled. For someone like me, that's rather deplorable.

propose.line: It's me you want? But I'm not attractive, I'm just a bother who likes nagging about you... You're really not joking? I-if so... *Ahem*, then till the oceans of the world dry up, I will remain by your side.

skill.line: It seems to be my turn.

touch.line: Anti-air is crucial. Oh, also, the price one pays for negligence is much higher than you think.

touch2.line: ... Now if you'd just use that bravery for something else, my view of you might actually change.

unlock.line: You must be the Commander. I see... No, I'm not looking disgruntled. I'm Hatakaze of Destroyer Division 5. Oh, also, be ready. I will watch over you as your superior from now on.

upgrade.line: You needn't go so far for the likes of me... But I'm still grateful.

win_mvp.line: A victory is merely a victory. Garishness and applause are needless.

gift_prefer.line: Oh my. You're pretty considerate, aren't you? Thanks a lot.

battle.line: Hehehe~ Now it's my turn to take command!

detail.line: You've heard I've only been on transport missions? No, I-I've totally fought before too!

expedition.line: If you don't take commissions seriously then you'll be in serious trouble!

feeling1.line: Hmph. ...Leave me alone.

feeling2.line: It'd be a shame to not go out and play on a sunny day like this! Right? Let's head out~

feeling3.line: Oww... I tripped again... Can you give me a piggyback ride back home, Commander...?

feeling4.line: Fine... I'll start looking where I'm going and not run and jump so much... Doesn't it get boring for you, always walking like that...?

feeling5.line: I-is this a bride carry?! H-hehehe... But I still think I prefer your piggyback rides...

headtouch.line: Do you want to do my hair...?

home.line: The team has returned! Hehehe~ Welcome back, everyone~

hp_warning.line: C-could we retreat?!

login.line: C'mon, stop being so blue and be positively positive!

lose.line: All we can do is place our hopes on the next one...

mail.line: Hey, Commander... Can you read what's written in this letter for me...?

main1.line: Kongou-san and Haruna-san were so nice to me... You should be too, Commander!

main2.line: Doing Tokyo Express runs... wasn't any fun at all...

main3.line: Night battles are what Desron 2 do better than anyone else!

mission.line: Oh, we've got another mission...

mission_complete.line: Heeey! A commission's done!

profile.line: I'm Makinami, I belonged to Destroyer Division 31. Serving as Kongou-san's and Haruna-san's escort, I helped in tons of battles in the Pacific! ...Hehehe~ I gave the Eagle Union a real beating in the Battle of Tassafaronga!

propose.line: If you ever get hurt, I promise I'll carry YOU back home! So can you give me a piggyback ride now? Hehehe~

touch.line: Umm, Commander... I'm not slacking off on pur... Eeek?!

touch2.line: Commander, why are you suddenly glomping me?!

unlock.line: I'm Makinami, the Yuugumo-class destroyer! I surfed the waves to come here! I'll be counting on you, Commander!

upgrade.line: Heh heh~ I feel stronger!

win_mvp.line: I'm just the best ship ever~

gift_prefer.line: Woah! I really like this!

detail.line: I was running earlier and tripped on something... But Hamakaze helped me back up, and now I feel fine!

home.line: Oh right, it's almost time for class! I'm gonna need my notepad... Wait, huh? Where'd it go?

login.line: Hey, listen! I've heard there are these cool legendary things at school! Let's go check if they're true or not!

main1.line: Oh, it's Haruna! Hey, Harunaaaaa! Let's head to the classroom together~

main2.line: Hey, I know! We can trade snacks with each other, Commander! Lemme see what you brought for lunch~!

main3.line: Huh? You don't have any evening plans? In that case... Let's come up with something to do!

touch.line: You're gonna give me extra lessons, Commander? Hehe~ That sounds like fun!

touch2.line: W-wait, is this... Th-that "student and teacher" thing...?!

unlock.line: All right, everything looks good! I'm super excited and my batteries are fully charged! I'm heading out~!

battle.line: Foo, let's do our best?

couple_encourage1.line: Foo, don't be scared, it's just Shiranui's will-o'-the-wisp.

couple_encourage2.line: Weird thing? No, that's just Foo.

couple_encourage3.line: The 18th DesDiv... will come home safely this time.

detail.line: Kasumi can see lots of things that others can't, like Foo here, for example. Kasumi saw that Foo was all alone, so we became friends.

expedition.line: "The commission team has been waiting for Commander for a long, long time." ...That's what Foo told me.

feeling1.line: Don't be sad, Commander. Kasumi will be your friend.

feeling2.line: Foo can't handle being around lots of people, so Kasumi also dislikes crowded places...

feeling3.line: Commander, Foo and Kasumi will always stay by yourside, because you're our friend.

feeling4.line: Commander, do you want to watch a movie with Kasumi? Kasumi likes movies with lots of friends that look like Foo... Let's watch one together?

feeling5.line: Foo will chase away all the bad guys that Commander cannot see. Kasumi will also protect you. We'll always be together...

home.line: Foo, Commander's back. Commander, your tea.

hp_warning.line: Kasumi... is very strong when she gets serious!

login.line: Hello, Commander. Foo, say hi to Commander too, okay?

lose.line: Foo, make sure to... protect the others.

mail.line: It'd be nice if Foo could get the mail...

main1.line: Foo is my good friend. We're always together.

main2.line: Kasumi... gets tired easily... Commander, your chest is really comfortable.

main3.line: Foo is always scared around Shiranui... Commander, is there no way to help Foo not be afraid of her will-o'-the-wisps...?

mission.line: Foo told me... that there are still missions left, and that Commander should stop slacking off...

mission_complete.line: "Mission complete~ Good job, Commander, Kasumi will give you a reward" ...Foo, what are you saying...

profile.line: I'm Kasumi, from the Asashio-class. During Operation Rei-go, my friends and I did our best to complete our missions. Without them, I would not have been able to accomplish anything alone.

propose.line: Commander, you've given me the most precious gift. That's why I'll give it my all to become the person most precious to you. ...Foo, what's the matter? I have to act more lovey-dovey? Um, then... *kiss*... Like that?

touch.line: Commander, would you like to talk to Foo?

touch2.line: Commander, Foo is biting you.

unlock.line: I'm Kasumi. Commander, are you my friend?

upgrade.line: Foo, is Kasumi any different...?

win_mvp.line: Foo, we did it.

gift_prefer.line: For me...? Thank you. I like it.

detail.line: There's still a lot of the mochi Shiranui brought over... Commander, do you want some?

home.line: Foo, you want to eat some mochi too? ...I'm not sure that's possible, sorry.

login.line: Commander, Happy New Year's. Would you like... some piping hot red bean soup?

main1.line: The mochi inside red bean soup... is delicious and fun to play with. Seconds, please~♪

main2.line: Miss Ghost, would you like to be friends with Foo? ...Huh? You aren't really a ghost?

main3.line: I hope a new horror movie comes out during New Year's. Commander, I'd like to watch one with you.

touch.line: Commander, want some mochi? Say ahhn~

unlock.line: Warm and comforting clothes... Warm and comforting red bean soup... Ahh, I love New Year's.

detail.line: My bag is unzipped? Must be one of Foo's pranks. It's definitely not because Kasumi left in a hurry.

home.line: You're giving a speech at the opening ceremony? I wonder what you'll talk about...

login.line: You're right on time, Commander. Just like Foo and Kasumi.

main1.line: Foo follows Kasumi everywhere, to and from school, and even in class.

main2.line: There are will-o'-the-wisps around port... Maybe Foo can befriend them.

main3.line: I wish Foo could help me with my homework.

touch.line: I dropped something? Thanks for telling me, Commander.

touch2.line: Commander, Foo is jabbing at you.

unlock.line: Kasumi and Foo are excited about the new semester. Are you too, Commander?

detail.line: Kasumi is here, so Foo is never lonely. And Kasumi has lots of friends, so everything is good.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Kasumi brewed some tea. Have a cup.

login.line: Hello. Foo and Kasumi have been waiting for you.

main1.line: Kasumi wants to help people. Foo does, too. We're gonna try to be as helpful as we can.

main2.line: Kasumi has more energy than before. If you feel tired, just sit next to Kasumi and rest.

main3.line: Shiranui became a friend, so Foo isn't scared of her anymore.

touch.line: Foo said, "I wish I could talk to the commander too."

unlock.line: Kasumi thinks that her outfit has gotten a bit breezier. Foo said the same thing.

battle.line: Be careful, everyone. Watch out for the submarines...!

couple_encourage1.line: Anti-sub, anti-air patrol, be careful!

couple_encourage2.line: How does your garden fare today?

detail.line: I love the way countless flowers bloom vividly during the spring, but even so, I wouldn't want it to be spring all year long - that would be unfair to the flowers that only bloom in other seasons. Mhm, I'm sure the four seasons exist so that all flowers have a chance to bloom. Hehe~

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. Commander, should I bring some herbal tea with me to welcome them back?

feeling1.line: Commander, I do not wish to see you ostracized by anyone... But at this rate, I may not be able to do anything for you...

feeling2.line: The sun is shining brightly, and it's another beautiful day outside. Commander, if you aren't busy, would you like to view the flowers with me?

feeling3.line: It's embarrassing to admit it, but... I tried to pick up gardening several times but kept getting stuck because I couldn't decide what I wanted to grow... Commander, do you have any flowers that you're partial towards? I want to make up my mind this time!

feeling4.line: Some flowers bloom all year long while others are fleeting and ephemeral. Some are purely ornamental, while others have therapeutic uses... Commander, do you like flowers that bloom dazzlingly, or those that bloom silently and out of view? ...Ah, sorry, I'm not making any sense...

feeling5.line: Commander, I hope this is not too presumptuous of me, but may I decorate your office with some fresh flowers? I want to give you something that reminds you of me, even when I am absent... It's just a little selfish whim of mine, hehe~

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. The port is like our home now, nothing is more reassuring than being back here, right?

hp_warning.line: Ngh... As long as the others are safe...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Shall we continue our work? Should you have any concerns, please feel free to consult me. I shall do all I can to assist you.

lose.line: I see, because of my indecisiveness... I am terribly sorry for dragging everyone down...

mail.line: New mail seems to have arrived. If you need me to sort it for you, please let me know.

main1.line: Commander, do you prefer herbal tea, or black tea?

main2.line: Commander, Harutsuki seems to have gotten herself in some trouble. I'd like to check on her, so would you mind if I left you for a bit?

main3.line: "The sun in the west, the moon in the east, canola blossoms inbetween." I'd love to see this scenery myself.

mission.line: So many unfinished tasks... Commander, wh-where should we start?

mission_complete.line: Congratulations! As expected Commander, you've completed our missions with flying colors!

profile.line: I entered service during the tail end of the War as an Akizuki-class specialized for anti-air and anti-submarine capabilities... Err, I guess it was the Fuyutsuki-class... Or was it the Michitsuki-class... Err... S-sorry, I still have a lot to learn, so I'd greatly appreciate your guidance!

propose.line: I see that while my heart was still wavering, you've already made up yours. Then, I won't hesitate to reciprocate your feelings either... Hanazuki will gladly accept this ring. I'm so glad that I can be someone who is important to you...

skill.line: Hanazuki is here to offer support!

touch.line: Anything you need me to do, as long as it is within my abilities, I would gladly do for you.

touch2.line: Eek?! Um, if I may be so bold... this sort of behavior is... It would be best not to do this to the other girls...

unlock.line: I, destroyer Hanazuki from the Sakura Empire, would like to extend my humble greetings to you. As a member of the Akizuki class, I specialize in anti-air and anti-sub warfare, but please do not hesitate to call upon me where I am needed.

upgrade.line: I see, I see. That was quite educational.

win_mvp.line: It's only right that I offer my gratitude to everyone who fought alongside me.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much! This means so much to me!

detail_ex.line: This month's flower... and to combine that with some seasonal picks... but I can't just slap them all together like this. I'll have to narrow it down a bit more... Commander, wh-what do you think about this?

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, have you been watering the flowers in the office? ...It's important to me, because it gives me something to remember you by when you aren't here.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I followed Oyashio's advice and changed my ornamental flowers around a little. Is it to your liking?

login_ex.line: You've been working hard, Commander. The next thing I should be doing is... Ah, um, first, let's start by organizing the resources!

main1_ex.line: Commander, I prepared something special for you today... Umm, it's jasmine tea! I chose it because it's supposed to bring good luck, but...

main2_ex.line: Niizuki is fun to talk to, but... why does she act that way when around people who aren't her relatives...?

mission_ex.line: Commander, the next task is... H-how about this one?

touch2_ex.line: Ah...! Commander, um... It's not that you can't, but... at least give me some time to mentally prepare myself...

detail.line: Even though it's the same sea as always, watching the clouds with you while wearing this unusual outfit is filling me with novel sensations I've never felt before...

home.line: Are you weary, Commander? If so, why not try some of my lavender honey tea? It's great for recovering from fatigue.

login.line: Today may be my day off, but if there is anything I can do for you, please do not hesitate to call upon me.

main1.line: Look, Commander, that coral reef... Hehehe, the "flowers" in the sea are quite beautiful as well, aren't they?

main2.line: This swimsuit... took a lot of agonizing over, but I eventually made my decision... Commander, what do you think? Does it look good on me?

main3.line: Gah...! ...Ah, s-sorry! I was just looking at the ocean... and suddenly shifted into anti-submarine mode... I know I shouldn't be so uptight during time off!

touch.line: Do you need me to lend you a swim ring?

touch2.line: Eek?! Ehh?! S-sorry! Ah, um, Commander, the strap is...

unlock.line: I've heard some say that summer is the season of cherry blossoms, lotus petals, and sunflowers, but... If you ask me, being able to leisurely enjoy the breeze with you feels pretty good too. Hehe~

battle.line: Let us ring in the new year with a splendid victory!

detail.line: The floral patterns on the Dragon Empery's dresses are so pretty... How should I thank Miss Aurora for picking out such a wonderful selection?

expedition.line: Everyone in the commission fleet has returned. I've prepared some gifts for them... Oh, should I set off some firerackers first?

headtouch.line: Commander... *blushes*

home.line: Zzz... Nnh... Hwah?! C-Commander? I'm so sorry, I must've fallen asleep while waiting for you...

login.line: Please tell me which tasks you'd like to start with, and which events you'd like to attend.

main1.line: The entire port is filled with the gentle aroma of fresh flowers~ Even though it's not quite spring yet, doesn't this holiday carry a bit of that longing for the early arrival of spring?

main2.line: Hibiki, and Kasumi? Wh-what's the matter...? Recommended events? Um, um... errr... C-Commander, help me...

main3.line: nil

touch2.line: Commander, um... N-nevermind! It's nothing...!

unlock.line: What kinds of flowers should I decorate the office with for the Lunar New Year...? Ugh, I just can't decide! Um, Commander, will you be inspecting the interior? I'll show you around! Phew...

battle.line: I'm the flagship? All right, just leave it to me!

couple_encourage1.line: When we work together, the 2nd Torpedo Squadron will never lose!

couple_encourage2.line: It's an honor to fight at your side!

detail.line: I give off warm and fuzzy vibes? Ehehe, I've heard that from the others as well~ It's a little embarrassing... Nuh uh, I don't mind at all. I'm really glad to hear it!
