expedition.line: Commander, everyone in the commission fleet has come home. I'm sure they're all tired, so I'll go give them a warm hug!

feeling1.line: Commander, if there's anything bothering you, please let me know. I'll be waiting for you... as long as it takes...

feeling2.line: Everyone in the Mutsuki class is super fluffy and cute! Being at this port makes me so happy~!

feeling3.line: My tail is warm and fluffy, but Wakaba's is shinier in comparison... Hatsushimo's is slender, and Shimakaze's is tiny... Um, there are all different sorts!

feeling4.line: Oyashio taught me a little trick! If I remember properly, it goes a little like... this! This circle on your forehead is supposed to make you luckier when it comes to your love life, and also helps you become happier!

feeling5.line: Still not enough good fortune in your life? ...You leave me no other choice then! Even if you have bad luck, there's a way to compensate for it! I just have to pass it to you directly... Mmwah~

home.line: Commander, good job in battle! Hurry, come sit over here~ I'm going to give your shoulders a nice rub!

hp_warning.line: My friends are still fighting, so I can't afford to go down here!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! Um, Naganami will always be waiting for you right here! That's because, well... I'm happiest when I'm by your side!

lose.line: I'll have to work much harder if I want to become an ideal flagship...

mail.line: Commander, new mail has arrived. Here, I brought it for you. Maybe someone brought good tidings!

main1.line: Jintsuu is always so knowledgeable and reliable... I wish I could be just like her...

main2.line: Commander, can you let me be flagship next time? I'll work even harder, for the sake of everyone's happiness!

main3.line: Lately, everyone has been circulating rumors that hugging me or cuddling my tail has healing properties, like coming out of a bath. They're even saying that it can cure colds... There's no way that's true, right?!

mission.line: I can probably help out with transport missions, but as for other tasks... By the way, Commander, I see you tackling all sorts of different missions every day! That's really amazing!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Great work today! Come, come, don't be shy – come rest on this big fluffy pillow!

profile.line: I'm Naganami, fourth ship of the Yuugumo class. During the War, I was primarily involved in transport operations, but I did participate in some large-scale operations and even served as flagship. Any hardship on the battlefield can be overcome as long as you believe in one another... I just know it!

propose.line: Um... Commander, I thought we had grown a lot closer, but this still feels a bit awkward... Wh-what should I do? ...Ah! Commander, try hugging my tail! I'm sure its warmth and fluffiness will help you loosen up! Mhm!

skill.line: Try this torpedo strike on for size!

touch.line: I'm more than just a ball of fluff, you know? Look, it's my smile and my ability to bring warmth to others that counts~

touch2.line: C-Commander, it's still work hoursss...

unlock.line: So this place is the port? Huh... Oh, Commander! I'm the fourth ship of the Yuugumo class, Naganami. It's a pleasure to finally meet you! Um... what's my selling point... Love! I love you, and everyone else as well!

upgrade.line: The feeling of warmth and safety... this is what it feels like to get stronger... Commander, thank you very much!

win_mvp.line: I didn't even realize I got MVP... But, this was only possible because of everyone's hard work!

gift_prefer.line: You're giving something this wonderful to me...? Thank you so much, Commander!

detail.line: I want to be a maid who can bring happiness to everyone! ...I'm going to have to work even harder to make that happen...

feeling5.line: Commander, your entire body is radiating happiness – I can smell it! Huh? You want to try smelling my happiness? Um, in that case, come a bit closer... Even closer...

home.line: Commander... Um, I mean, Master! Welcome back! Whether you want to enjoy some refreshments, or take a nap on my tail... either way is fine!

login.line: I'll do my best to bring happiness to everyone at port, Commander! Just believe that one day, this place will be filled with happiness!

main1.line: This is the first time I've made sweets by hand. Commander, how are they? You'd like to have some more? Of course! I'll make them for you right away!

main2.line: Let's emulate the Royal Maids and form the Maids of the 2nd Torpedo Squadron! What do you think, commander?

main3.line: "Just spotting Naganami immediately causes one's mood to improve?" ...More weird rumors are circulating again... But if you believe that, Commander... Hehehe, I guess I'll believe it too!

touch.line: Being able to go about business as usual in this kind of outfit is no easy feat... Real maids are truly something...

touch2.line: Commander, at least let me set the tray down first! Eek! It's going to fall!

unlock.line: Akashi pushed me into getting this outfit, saying that it would surely make you happy, but... What do you think...?

battle.line: I, I'll do my best...!

detail.line: You feel a sense of relief when you see me? I'm not quite sure what you mean by that, but I'm glad that you're happy...

expedition.line: Commander, our friends have returned from their commission. Sh-should we head down to welcome them back?

feeling5.line: Commander, are you happy? ...I don't mean like in general, but... like, when we're together... Um... As for me, when it's just the two of us, I feel amazingly happy...♡

home.line: Do you like it when I massage your back with my feet like this, Commander? ...Not in that sense? I see... I don't really get it though...

login.line: Commander, did you come just to see me...? Ohh, for the first thing I see when I wake up to be you... I must be dreaming...!

mail.line: We've got new mail. I'm sure it's good news.

main1.line: My tail is fluffy and warm, and you can even use it as a blanket... At least, that's what Oyashio and the others keep saying. Would you like to give it a try, Commander?

main2.line: Commander, whenever I gaze at you, whenever I talk to you, I feel so at ease that I could go to sleep... Hm? You feel the same way about me?

main3.line: This outfit feels a bit tight around the chest... Um, Commander, p-please don't stare at me so much...

mission.line: Commander, your missions are of utmost importance... Mm, so I'll wait for you right here...

mission_complete.line: Great job on finishing your mission, Commander! Um, ahem! Don't you want to cuddle up with my big, fluffy tail...?

touch.line: It's not time for the party yet...? Then, um, let's stay like this for a bit longer...

touch2.line: *pant* *pant*...

unlock.line: There's still some time before the banquet begins, and I'm afraid I'm feeling a little sleepy... W-would you mind if I took a nap? Thank you...

battle.line: It's time for me to get serious...!

detail.line: The sound of my voice puts you at ease? Th-that's great... it was worth practicing ahead of time!

expedition.line: Commander, the girls are back from their commissions! I'll head out to greet them!

home.line: Commander, good work! I'm ready for you as well. Well then, um, let's get started. Ahem... A long, long time ago...

login.line: Tonight, I'll be putting all my heart into reading, all for your sake!

mail.line: Oh, there's some new mail for us! ...I wonder if it's the storybooks I had ordered.

main1.line: ...The end. Commander, for the next story, should I try speaking in a softer voice... Huh? Commander? Looks like you've already fallen asleep, hehe.

main2.line: I wanted to surprise you, so I'll be reading one of my personal favorites to you today. If there's something you want to listen to next time, please let me know, and I'll have it ready!

mission.line: No more~ No matter how much you want to keep listening to the story, you need to prioritize your missions first!

mission_complete.line: You've finished your missions! Good job with them. Since you held tight and worked hard to complete them, I've prepared lots of rewards for you~

touch.line: You want me to read the next story? S-sure, I'd love to!

touch2.line: I-I'm going to lose my place...!

unlock.line: I wanted to help you relieve some stress, so I thought I would read some folk tales to you... When I mentioned that, Akashi suggested these clothes to me... Wh-what do you think?

detail.line: Why am I dressed like this? Well, I can already make you all mine by wrapping you up with my tail, so I thought I should give myself to you in return...

feeling5.line: Whether it's chocolates or my tail, I'll use anything to make you happy! No, not just things – if using my own body and soul will do the trick, then I'll do it... I love you, Commander♡

home.line: Good work today, Commander! Before you taste your chocolate, taste me first! Umm... I-I just meant I wanted a hug...

login.line: Fluffy, fluffy... D-does my tail feel good? Does it make you happy?

main1.line: Commander, umm, can you breathe okay? You've been wrapped up in there for a while now, so if you can't... Y-you're fine? Okay!

main2.line: Ah. Are you not eating your chocolate because of my smell... Hm? It's more of a visual problem?

main3.line: After you touch my tail, can I have another hug? I-I'm nice and warm, so you'll be as comfy as can be!

touch.line: Fluff to your heart's content...

touch2.line: Do you feel so warm and fuzzy that you might... melt in my arms?

unlock.line: Commander? You stopped eating. Does it taste too bitter...? Oh no, if you don't like the chocolate I made, I... I-I can still make you happy in other ways!

battle.line: For the happiness of those we love!

detail.line: I'm by your side. Always have been, always will be. Your happiness is my happiness, Commander.

feeling5.line: In sickness and in health... No! You are already happy now, Commander, so... Healthy times aside, I don't know about... I-I'm sorry! Forget it, umm... Let's just be together forever!

home.line: Welcome home...d-dear! Calling you that now is still a little embarrassing!

login.line: It's amazing how happy I am just to be with you forever. Commander, let's enjoy another blissful day together!

main1.line: I've never done the san san kudo ceremony before. I hope I don't mess it up...

main2.line: My white kimono looks lovely? Why, thank you. I'll cherish the memory of it for all my life.

main3.line: Moving is rather difficult when I have to worry about my tail and the train... Heehee! That's another fond memory to look back on.

mission.line: It's time for a mission. I will naturally assist you. After all, finishing it early means more quality time with you!

mission_complete.line: Well done on another completed mission! Now we can spend some time together, just the two of us.

touch.line: You want to hold hands, don't you? I'd be happy to!

touch2.line: If you want to cuddle up with me and my tail, then...I don't mind. Indulge yourself.

unlock.line: Now that the big day is here, I'm awfully nervous... I-I'll be in your care now and forever, okay?

battle.line: May the odds ever be in your favor! Go forth!

couple_encourage1.line: Be careful out there!

couple_encourage2.line: I will be the one to protect my friends!

couple_encourage3.line: Isokaze, back me up!

detail.line: When my friends are counting on me, I can feel power surging within me that makes me feel like I can do anything!

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned! Lemme take home the extras!

feeling1.line: Commander, you're gonna make me hate you...

feeling2.line: I may come across as a braggart, but that's because I'm pretty reliable! "Oh, Suzutsuki, you saved me! I don't know what I would've done without you!" Yeah, I get that a lot~

feeling3.line: Commander, you can rely on me as well! ...What?! You think you can one-up me...?!

feeling4.line: Hmm... What would I like the commander to do for me? ...Make tea? Pack my lunch? Carry me back to the dorms after I fall asleep? ...Th-th-that's way too embarrassing!

feeling5.line: Commander, get over here! Hup~ ...Mmhmm, that's much cozier. Now it feels more like I'm relying on you, doesn't it? See, you'll also have to take good care of me from now on~ Just kidding~♪ Ahaha!

headtouch.line: Look, fluffy and super pattable, right? ...Hey, I'm talking about Pooky, not my ears!

home.line: Team A is directly under my command. Teams B and C will follow the plan, and then... Oh, Commander, when'd you get back?

hp_warning.line: The real fight's only getting started!

login.line: Welcome back! ...Got any new jobs? I'm down for anything!

lose.line: Guh... No matter what, we all have to make it back safely...!

mail.line: Huh? The envelope got torn? ...Ahaha... Sorry 'bout that, must've been Pooky...

main1.line: "The invincible Suzutsuki is here! Your attacks shall not put a scratch on me!" How'd that sound? Hya hah!

main2.line: Ahaha! You'd rather sit atop Commander's head instead of mine? Very well, go forth! Oh, but no pranks though!

main3.line: Commander, you sure have a lot of work, don't you~ Look, Isokaze, Urakaze, being a warlord or a general is a lot of hard work. A better job would be to become Commander's retainers!

mission.line: A tough mission, huh? Lemme take a look, maybe I can help out!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Commander, don't forget about the rewards!

profile.line: I'm Suzutsuki, Akizuki-class destroyer. I was a member of the 61st DesDiv along with Akizuki and Hatsuzuki, and escorted Musashi and participated in Noshiro's rescue mission! Not a shabby record, right? I had a close call at the Battle of Bou-no-Misaki when I got hit by two torpedoes, but I managed to survive until the end!

propose.line: Ahahaha... Being in a situation like this is quite nerve-racking, isn't it? ...I thought I had mentally prepared myself... Commander, you c-can handle the rest... right...?

touch.line: This marking on my right cheek? You haven't heard of it, Commander? It's the latest fashion trend! Here, I'll draw one on for you!

touch2.line: C-Commander! Jeez, there are some things that you shouldn't be doing!

unlock.line: Ahaha, Pooky, listen up, we're gonna live here from now on! Uhh... Third ship of the Akizuki-class, Suzutsuki, reporting in! I'll be the one to protect my comrades and you, Commander! Just kidding~♪

upgrade.line: Give me more power, so that I may protect everyone!

win_mvp.line: The enemy general’s head is mine~! Just kidding, ahaha~♪

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! Can I really have this?

detail_ex.line: Thanks, Commander! You were a great help! ...What's the matter? Are you the kind of person that gets really hyped up after being complimented?

feeling5_ex.line: I love being in your arms, Commander~ Ahh, I could roll around forever~ ...Wh-who's there?! ...D-d-do you need something from Suzutsuki?! ......Forget what you just saw, all right?! Seriously!

headtouch_ex.line: Commander, you can rub my ears if you want~

home_ex.line: Suzutsuki is unsinkable, and therefore, Commander is also undefeatable! ...Anyway, I know you'll come back safely no matter where you go! Welcome home~!

login_ex.line: Welcome back! Wanna make out instead of doing work today? Haha, just kidding~ ......Eh, you serious?!

main4_ex.line: Lady Mutsu, this is what you do with the sword... and this is how you wave the flag... Got it? Now you have everything you need for our mock Sengoku battles!

main5_ex.line: Pooky, what do you want to eat today? ...Ah! Jeez, now Pooky's attached to you now because you keep feeding him, Commander!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete! As for my payment, just let me to lie in your lap for a bit!

detail.line: I'm pretty refreshing and cool, right? Just like my name suggests~

feeling5.line: Phew... Playing by the beach is super fun, but after all the commotion, I could use some relaxation... Yup, I'm gonna lie down right here! Mm... Yeah, just stay put like that. Hehe~

home.line: Not enough people for a game of beach volleyball? All right! I'll go play some watermelon splitting with Georgia first!

login.line: Commander, time out! Look, the others have already started playing without you~ Fine, fine... I shall be the one to accompany you then!

main1.line: Do we have enough people to build a sand castle? Great, count me in as well! Wait, Commander, hold on!

main2.line: Pooky likes coming to the sea as well, isn't that right~? Ah, careful not to fall into the water!

main3.line: Agano's not here? That's too bad, I was looking forward to playing with her... Commander, why do you look so relieved? Hm? It's just my imagination?

touch.line: Woah?! ...Oh, it's you, Commander, you surprised me... Hibiki shoved a crab in my face earlier and it gave me a nasty pinch...

touch2.line: Jeez, Commander! What are you doing in front of this many people?!

unlock.line: Commander, over here! We're about to start without you! Ahaha, what would you like to do, Commander? Beach volleyball? Sandcastle building? We can also go relax in the water if you'd like!

battle.line: You ready, Pooky? Let's— go!

detail.line: These markings are the proof of my battle scars as a warrior... they're not just doodles! Ugh... I swear, I'll be back for revenge after I train some more!

expedition.line: The girls from the commission fleet are back! Darn it, I wish Hatsushimo could come with me!

login.line: Happy New Year, Commander!

mail.line: Suzutsuki, now reading the contents of your mail out loud!

main1.line: Aaahhhhh!! Jean Bart, you don't have to shank every shuttlecock out of existence!

main2.line: Pooky, I got some sunflower seeds from Hanazuki! Here, come and eat your fill~ Grow big and strong and scare the heck out of the commander~ Ahaha!

main3.line: I can't sit still during the New Year! After all, there are so many things going on that only happen during this time of year!

touch.line: Commander, make sure the matches continue smoothly!

unlock.line: I, Akizuki-class destroyer, Suzutsuki, shall not allow you to pass through these arches! Hwuh?! I missed the return again...!

battle.line: Enough talk! Have at you!

couple_encourage1.line: I have you covered!

detail.line: All you do is loaf around in here... Are you a commander, or a deadbeat?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I will see to the transport of the goods, and you to its inspection.

feeling1.line: I expect no betterment from you. Go on, let your name be irreversibly tarnished.

feeling2.line: What do you need from me? Make it quick.

feeling3.line: You need an attendant for your outing? Understoo– Wait, why would you need an attendant for a tour of your own port? ...You want to "hang out" with me? What does that mean?

feeling4.line: I cannot wrap my head around your need for an attendant when there are no hostiles at the port... Nor do I grasp this "hang out" business! Although I did enjoy our friendly exchange! E-e-end of report!

feeling5.line: All your talk of attendants and "hanging out" was just an attempt to seduce me, was it not? N-no, I mean nothing bad by it! Oh, forget it! You toyed with my heart, and now you must o-own up to it!

headtouch.line: What the–?! K-k-keep your hands off my ears!

home.line: No unauthorized persons entered the office in your absence. End of report.

hp_warning.line: When push comes to shove, retaliate...!

login.line: You came of your own accord. How fortunate... Never you mind. Get to work.

lose.line: We must start anew at boot camp...

mail.line: Correspondence has arrived. Don't come nagging later, saying I didn't inform you.

main1.line: How, I wonder, would one go about making Agano stop touching my ears...

main2.line: Urgh... Reading so much fine print text has given me a headache. Commander, requesting permission to rest...

main3.line: I like the quiet of the office, free from the jarring hum of propeller aircraft.

mission.line: To think a trivial task would have you up-ended like this... If you so insist it's impossible, then I will set an example.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Will you get a move on already and process the rewards?

profile.line: I served as flagship of Destroyer Division 29 within Destroyer Squadron 6. I performed various escort and transport missions. Leave any tasks of this nature to me. End of report.

propose.line: I don't know what to do at this ceremony! You insisted on it, so it's your responsibility to g-guide me through it! E-end of report...

touch.line: Whuah! Would you STOP tickling me?

touch2.line: Whuah?! Wh-wh-wha-what has gotten into you, fool?!

unlock.line: I am Kamikaze-class destroyer Oite, assuming my post starting today. I will perform my duties, and anything beyond that I will decide on a case-by-case basis. End of report.

upgrade.line: You have my gratitude.

win_mvp.line: All I did was perform my duty, as I said I would.

gift_prefer.line: You're more perceptive than I thought~

detail.line: Watch closely, Commander. You are about to witness what unyielding focus looks like... What?! I missed again?!

headtouch.line: Whuah! What are you doing?!

home.line: Truly, Kamikaze? You're certain I will become proficient faster if I wear a blindfold?

login.line: Oh, to hell with it! I will practice until I can effortlessly split this watermlon!

main1.line: Are we ready to start yet? ...Commander? Where are you? G-give me the signal, I'm waiting!

main2.line: Matsukaze made fried noodles! Oh, how mouthwateringly good they are! You ought to taste them for yourself, Commander.

main3.line: I'm much obliged for the help, Hatakaze! Now watch – I will cleave this watermelon in twain!

touch.line: Wh-what is it?

touch2.line: What in the name of–?! What is the matter with you?!

unlock.line: Commander, have you also come to play on the beach? You're telling me to be careful? Hmph, what misfortune could possibly befall me from a game of watermelon splitting... Gwaah?!

detail.line: The essence of the plum tree is best captured with erratic brush strokes... This is quite the elegant ink painting.

headtouch.line: Whuaah?! I've told you countless times! St-st-stop touching my ears!

home.line: Should you think of any good ideas for verses, tell me. I will write them down.

login.line: A New Year's poem... "Many riches will grace you soon – I want my new year's gift by noon"... No, this is backwards! I'm at the age where I'm the one who should give the young'uns gifts... Oh, Commander? When did you get back?

main1.line: "In the ninth year of Yonghe, and the year of the Water Ox..." Bah! The rest of the text is unintelligible to me...

main2.line: Writing a poem in seven steps? Is there a person on this earth capable of such a feat?

main3.line: Kamikaze, what should one offer the young'uns as a new year's gift, other than money?

touch.line: Eep! Y-y-you're doing this on purpose, aren't you?!

touch2.line: Eek?! Y-y-you reprobate! What's the matter with you?!

unlock.line: Happy New Year to you, Commander. To celebrate the season, I had these garments tailor-made for me, using traditional Dragon Empery clothes as a basis. I don't look... childish, do I?

battle.line: We can win this... Right?

couple_encourage1.line: I'll keep you safe, Hiryuu.

couple_encourage2.line: Watch beneath the waves, Makinami.

detail.line: I like being alone in my own room. What exactly do I do in my free time? ...I'm not telling you.

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Don't forget to say hi to them... Me? Uhh, I think I'll stay right here.

feeling1.line: I guess we're all fated to be alone. You, me, and everyone else...

feeling2.line: You want to be friends with me? Okay, but if I find out you're planning something bad... then I'll never talk to you again.

feeling3.line: You're not a bad person, so we can be friends... Do I wish I had more friends? I'm... not gonna tell you.

feeling4.line: There have been rumors of this girl with long hair and skin as pale as a ghost's who appears out of nowhere at port... In fact, I think she's right behind you, Commander... What do you mean that's not gonna fool you? Well, I thought I'd just spook you a little...

feeling5.line: You're fun to be with, Commander. A lot of fun. In fact, you're my best friend... Hehehe~ I wanna always be with you. Always.

headtouch.line: I'm not a pet, so don't treat me like one...

home.line: Good going, Commander... You heard a strange noise just now? Uhh... I'm sure it was just your imagination.

hp_warning.line: Watch beneath the waves...

login.line: *Yawn*... Oh. You scared away the birdies, Commander.

lose.line: Ugh. I'm really out of it today...

mail.line: Mail for the commander? Okay birdies, go fetch... No, please don't fight over who gets to do it.

main1.line: Could you not stare at me like that, Commander? I can't focus like this...

main2.line: You're on duty, so no chit-chatting with me allowed, okay? ...I mean, if you feel really lonely, then maybe...

main3.line: I like the satisfying toot-toot noise that recorders make... Do you wanna hear it? It'll have to be later, not now...

mission.line: Look at all these unfinished missions... You should really do something about them.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Wonder if I'll get a reward for my efforts...

profile.line: Kazagumo, Yuugumo-class destroyer number 3. I served the 10th Destroyer Squadron, mostly running transport missions and naval evacuations. These little birdies are my friends. My hobbies? I'm not telling you.

propose.line: I think... this is when you promise to never leave me. First you say it, then it's my turn... Hehehe~ Thank you. I love you.

skill.line: I wanna get this over with...

touch.line: Commander... What are you up to? (Kazagumo throws you a suspicious look.)

touch2.line: You'll be cursed for this...

unlock.line: Kazagumo, Yuugumo-class, reporting for duty. I hope I'll be able to get along well with everyone else here... Commander, you're not cooking up some dastardly plan, are you? You look rather questionable...

upgrade.line: Thanks, Commander.

win_mvp.line: It'd be great if we could keep winning...

gift_prefer.line: That looks pretty neat. ...Oh, it's for me? Thanks...

detail_ex.line: First, close the door... Thanks. Now please listen, Commander. I've been practicing a lot.

home_ex.line: You still wanna hear me play, even if I'm not good at it? But I'd rather not. Not when others are around...

login_ex.line: Hello, Commander. Let's have a good day today.

main1_ex.line: Try to focus on your work. Unlike me, you can concentrate even when someone's staring at you, right? Hehehe~

main2_ex.line: Are you feeling a little lonely? Hehehe~

main4_ex.line: Oh right, I have to go give Kinugasa her lunch box. I'll be back in a minute, Commander.

touch_ex.line: Commander... What are you up to? (Kazagumo throws you a considerate look.)

detail.line: I've practiced some more. I'll play you a song, if you'll listen... On second thought, maybe I won't.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. You didn't bring company... did you? Okay, good. I don't want others to hear how not-good I am at the recorder...

login.line: Zzz... What is it, Commander...? Me? The breeze was just too nice and I fell asleep...

main1.line: Weird... I played pretty well just a moment ago, but now I can't do it...

main2.line: The name of the song I just played? I'm not gonna tell you right now. After I've mastered it, all right?

main3.line: You're so nice, hanging out with me even after school... I'm not taking up your time, am I?

touch.line: Ugh... I lost track of the tempo because of that... Thanks, meanie.

touch2.line: Oh... Seriously, Commander? You're messing up my melody.

unlock.line: Toot~♪ Oh, Commander, did you hear me practicing my recorder? Umm, I'd appreciate it if you didn't tell the others.

win_mvp.line: I'm glad we won. Hehehe.

detail.line: Why am I out here all by myself? Because I get to be alone with... Oops, ignore that. I can't tell you...

expedition.line: The commission team came back. Go and meet them, Commander. I'll watch your things.

home.line: *blows* I'd better eat this ice cream before it melts... Would I get brain freeze if I just bit into it?

login.line: Who is that launching fireworks over there, I wonder? Watching from directly below seems dangerous, but I bet they look prettiest from there...

mail.line: If you really want some ice cream... Wait, you had it delivered with the mail? A-aww...

main1.line: You're tired from swimming? Take a break here with me. I'll watch over you, so you can even take a nap... if you want.

main2.line: Umm, actually, I've been practicing a new song. Want me to play—Ack, the fireworks! Maybe another time...!

main3.line: I wonder where Shimakaze went... How can she not be tired after playing on the beach all day?

mission_complete.line: You finished a mission. Is there a reward for me, too...?

touch.line: Does my swimsuit... look weird?

touch2.line: Huh...? Oh... *blushes*

unlock.line: *lick*... Oh, Commander, y-you're here for the fireworks? ...Want to watch them with me, then? I've got drinks. My ice cream? Umm... You can't have it.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Hmm... I wonder what they brought.

feeling5.line: I don't understand... It feels like I'm still yearning for more. My Master is by my side already... But I think I want you here with me forever. I just wish you could be...

home.line: Master, welcome back. You may choose: piping-hot tea, or a shoulder massage? ...You don't need anything? O-okay, well, we could always just chat...

login.line: Welcome back, Master. I brought you hot tea. ...You saw pretty flowers in the garden? I-I raised them in my spare time, so... I'm glad you like them.

mail.line: I put your mail right here, Master.

main1.line: Yep. I've been waiting here. ...For whom? Come on, you know... Don't tease me!

main2.line: Master, sit down. Here's your tea! ...You feel warm and happy after drinking it? Th-thank you...

main3.line: Play a song alongside the wind chimes...? Th-that may be hard... But if you want to hear it, then I'll try. D-don't make fun of me, though!

mission.line: Missions... We'll do them together, Master!

touch.line: Master, if you ever get lonely, just let me know. I know just what to do about it... Heehee, I think you and I are thinking the same thing.

touch2.line: Master, t-today is a good day, if you know... what I mean...

unlock.line: I'm doing lots of training. Gardening, making tea, stuff like that. Here's an example... Umm, do you want dinner, or a bath, or... Hm? I shouldn't practice that one?

upgrade.line: Thank you, Master.

battle.line: Vanguard Wakatsuki has arrived! Everyone, charge forward with me!

couple_encourage1.line: Let us fight for our Commander!

couple_encourage2.line: Allow me to escort you!

detail.line: Hyah! Hrah! ...Oh, Commander! As you can see, I was just practicing my swings! Would you like to join me?

expedition.line: A commission represents the trust of the requester. In other words, upholding that contract is righteous and good!

feeling1.line: Why did you have to leave me all alone? Did I do something wrong...?

feeling2.line: My reason for helping others, huh... Hmm, I've never actually given it that much thought before. How about you, Commander? I heard you've done so much for everyone here, so what's your reason for all that?

feeling3.line: Some people will turn their backs on their friends and their beliefs after gaining great power... You often read about these greedy powermongers in various stories! If I ever met someone like that one day... Hehe~

feeling4.line: Are you going somewhere, Commander? ...Th-then, bring me along with you too! I'll make myself useful somehow! ...Whenever you're not here, I... Oh, you're just going on a quick patrol around the port?!

feeling5.line: I shall protect you today, just as I do every day! ...Huh? I seem to be in an especially good mood today? Well, of course! Nothing makes me happier than being at your side and serving you faithfully!

headtouch.line: Is this my reward? Ehehe~

home.line: I am glad you've returned safely! Ehehe, I could hardly sit still while waiting for you to come back, Commander...

hp_warning.line: Woah, I've got to regain my balance!

login.line: Commander! Were you about to begin your work? Allow me to assist in whatever way I can! Do you have anything I'm able to do?

lose.line: I shall protect your rear, so hurry up and retreat!

mail.line: Commander, take a look at this! A top-secret letter has come! ...Oh, it's just an ordinary letter?

main1.line: Commander, please look over here! There're some little birdies by the windowsill... Aw, they flew off... Hmm, is there some way of approaching without scaring them away?

main2.line: Commander, is there any work I would be able to help with? I might not be able to understand a lot of these documents right now, but if I work at it enough, I'm sure I'll get the hang of it!

main3.line: I start to feel anxious when I'm not with my friends... Do you feel the same way when you're alone, Commander?

mission.line: Are you worried about this mission, Commander? Just let me take care of it then!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! I don't think I've done anything worthy of praise, but it does feel great to overcome obstacles together with you!

profile.line: Akizuki-class destroyer, Wakatsuki, is at your service! Like my sisters, I specialize in anti-air combat, but I'm no slouch when it comes to surface combat either! Don't you worry - I will never betray your orders, and will strive tirelessly to protect you!

propose.line: I see! So this is a symbol of my fealty to you! From now on, I swear to always remain by your side and to protect you with my life! If you ever need anything, just call my name. I'll do anything for you!

touch.line: My blade is very heavy, so please be careful!

touch2.line: Woah, woah! What are you doing, Commander? That's the kind of stuff you end up groveling on your knees and apologizing for!

unlock.line: I'm Akizuki-class destroyer Wakatsuki. I heard your summons and came promptly to aid you, Commander! Kindly call upon me whenever you have need of me.

upgrade.line: My body has become lighter and faster!

win_mvp.line: The victor has been decided! Drop your weapons and surrender! Hahaha!

gift_prefer.line: Much obliged!

battle_ex.line: With your vision, Commander, our victory is assured!

detail_ex.line: That voice... A friend is calling out to us! We can't abandon someone in their time of need, Commander! Let's go help them right away!

headtouch_ex.line: The more good things I do, the more rewards I'll get from you, right?

main4_ex.line: Look, Commander, the little birdies aren't afraid of me anymore! Ehehe, that's because I've been feeding them~

main5_ex.line: Commander, I still cannot make sense of these documents, but I can certainly run errands for you! Let me deliver these papers for you! ...I probably won't get the place mixed up this time!

main6_ex.line: Commander! I heard that a good way to develop a strong bond with someone is to spar with them! Want to give it a try? ...Huh? There's more than one way to do that?

touch2_ex.line: Commander, if you're doing this kind of stuff to other girls... I, I think you should stop that!

detail.line: If I do a good job, Musashi will pat my head! I've actually received a whole bunch of rewards today. Oh, you're going to reward me too, Commander? Hooray!

headtouch.line: Yay, I've been rewarded for my hard work! Ehehe~

home.line: I can't believe I made a fool of myself in front of you... I just wanted to help everyone out with the café, but ended up causing more trouble instead... Urgh...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! Allow me to show you to your seat! ...Oh, please watch out for the coffee spill!

main1.line: Commander, don't you think keeping a few birdies around will liven up the café?

main2.line: Haguro, are you okay? Is it my fault? ...Oh, you're fine? Thank goodness. If someone falls down because of me, I'd have to get on my knees and apologize...

main3.line: Commander, I just cleaned this area, so please watch your step! ...We can't afford for there to be any more victims!

touch.line: Yes, I'll be right out with your order!

touch2.line: I, I'm going to tell my friends on you!

unlock.line: Oh nooo! Look out, Commander! ...Oh, phew... I'm glad I didn't mess up your clothes because of my carelessness! Please forgive me for my blunder! I'll clean the floor up right away!

detail.line: Jin ji du li! Commander, look at this new stance I learned! Do you want to try it?

headtouch.line: You just touched a lucky blue sparrow, so your luck is about to be better than ever! Hehe!

home.line: Welcome back! With my blessings, everything's sure to work out for you today!

login.line: Blue Sparrow Wakatsuki has come to bring spring blessings! Happy new year, Commander!

main1.line: Ah! I-I'm okay now... Thanks for catching me, Commander... How can I repay you for helping me so early in the year?

main2.line: Why did I come so soon? Umm, as the Blue Sparrow, I'm here to bring good fortune for the new year, so I thought it'd be best if I came to you early!

main3.line: I'm keeping you all to myself on the first day of the new year, so I hope you don't mind if I stick to you like glue all day!

touch.line: D-don't tickle me, please, Commander! I'm losing balance!

touch2.line: Hyah?! Y-you're already losing patience this early in the new year?!

unlock.line: Blue Sparrow Wakatsuki is here! ...Commander, why are you just staring—Oh, no! I'm caught on the curtain... Aaaah!

battle.line: Go on, sink for me♪

couple_encourage1.line: Sp-spooky monsters don't exist, okay?!

couple_encourage2.line: I hope Chitose is doing okay.

couple_encourage3.line: Don't stray too far from me!

detail.line: Where are you looking, hmm? Heehee~ You didn't realize I was behind you? Oh, Commander, for a tactical genius, you sure can be inattentive♪

expedition.line: The commission team is back. I'll come along and welcome them back with you♪

feeling1.line: Huh? You're... not gonna pay attention to me? Why not, Commander? I don't understand... Uhh, should I say sorry, or something?

feeling2.line: (A note. It reads: I've gone somewhere far away. Please don't come looking for me. I hope you and everyone else have a good life. Yours truly, Hatsuzuki.)

feeling3.line: Did you think I was serious about going away? Oh. Well, uh... Sorry? I thought it'd be a funny prank – I didn't mean to actually make you worry... Ugh...

feeling4.line: I'm right here, and I'm not going anywhere. You don't have anything to worry about, Commander... I hope saying that while patting your head will make you calm down... Good. I know how important I am to you, so this should do the trick.

feeling5.line: Hehehe... Wait! I'M supposed to be comforting YOU, not the other way around! When did this happen? It's supposed to be MY turn to court you right now! ...Y-you can stop patting my head any time, you know... *blushes*

headtouch.line: I got this red string that will tie you and me together! Also, you can keep patting me♪

home.line: I'm first to welcome you back♪ Heehee~ No, that's not a given just because I'm your secretary~

hp_warning.line: I can take a lot of punishment, you know...!

login.line: I know this is your chair, but you'll let me sit on it if I ask, won't you? Great! Then, let's say only I can sit here♪

lose.line: We lost... Hmph.

mail.line: A letter... Is it really your secretary's job to read your letters before you do? Heehee.

main1.line: Say, Commander, aren't you forgetting something? Oh, I think you know what~ Try really, and you'll remember what you might've forgotten♪

main2.line: Are you in a pickle, Commander? Because if you are, you can ask me for help. Helping you is the whole reason I'm here~

main3.line: Honestly, Zuikaku is too laid-back. If she'd take my approach and go straight for you, you two would have a thing going by now... Heehee, it's better for me this way, though♪

mission.line: Want me to help with your missions? I bet you do. I'm your secretary, after all.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Don't you care about the rewards?

profile.line: I'm Hatsuzuki, Akizuki-class destroyer. During the war, I helped my allies and fought hard until I got ripped to shreds. I might just work my butt off again to help you, if need be... Th-there'll be no need for that? Oh...

propose.line: I knew it – you need me in your life♪ Now tell me, what's our life together gonna be like, going forward? Sugary sweet, or down and dirty? Either way sounds like pure bliss to me and I can't wait! Hehehehe♡

skill.line: Don't worry, I'm on the case♪

touch.line: Oh! Commander! ...No, it's nothing♪

touch2.line: Hmph. If you're gonna touch me, at least be honest about it...

unlock.line: Heehee, so this is where you were, Commander~ Hope you don't mind that I'm here now, too♪ Isn't it wonderful to have me so close to you? Also, you won't be able to run if I come any closer~

upgrade.line: Something tells me that you're reliant on me♪

win_mvp.line: MVP! Nobody says I can't hoard all the rewards from the Commander, right?

gift_prefer.line: I was going to have you guess what my favorite thing is... Ehehe, but since you already know, never mind~♪

battle_ex.line: I'll add this to the Commander's list of achievements!

detail_ex.line: Whooo's there? Heehee, the answer is me♪ You've fallen for another one of my tricks... There's someone behind me? Y-yeah, right, like I'll believe that!

feeling5_ex.line: Heheh, now hold still~ ...So what if I'm sitting on your lap? I'm still helping you with your job. If you really want me to get off, why don't you rest your head on my lap instead? Heehee♡

home_ex.line: We're more than just secretary and Commander – we share a fate. Which is to say, I'm your girlfriend, your partner... e-even your wife! So of course I'm first out to welcome you back♪

login_ex.line: I know what we can do if we both wanna sit in your chair – this. You can't move? Well, yeah, not with me right in your lap~ Heehee♪

main4_ex.line: You've forgotten again, Commander! ..."A date with me"? Wait, I don't remember anything about that... Did you just make that up? You dummy! *blushes*

main5_ex.line: I can't function when you're not around♪ Same with you, right? Ahaha! You're totally dependent on me~

main6_ex.line: Even if other girls start coming on to you... will you stay true to me? Hehehe... I mean, of course you would. You're madly in love with me, after all♡

mission_ex.line: Need help with your missions? Okey-dokey♪ Since I'm the only one who can do it right now~

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission rewards have arrived. Isn't that nice~♪

touch_ex.line: Hmm-hm♪ Are you wondering why I talk you up even if I don't need anything? Heehee~

touch2_ex.line: H-huh?! Wh-what's gotten into you all of a sudden...? *blushes*

win_mvp_ex.line: Maybe I could hoard not just the Commander's rewards, but the Commander as well... F-fine, if you say so...

expedition.line: Looks like the commission team's back. Are you really gonna go alone?

feeling5.line: Now I'm gonna snap pics of YOU in your cute swimsuit♪ Don't worry, I won't show them to anyone else! ...That's it, give me a big, big blush~

headtouch.line: Heeheehee♪

home.line: Welcome back with aaa... big splash! Heehee~ Get wet from head to toe!

login.line: Why don't you snap another? Oh, oh my~ You'll do it because you wanna, and not because I told you to?

main1.line: (Aaand set on home screen♪ Now the Commander will see my adorable swimsuit forever and ever♡)

main2.line: Hmph. Why are you looking at other girls? I'm not saying you can't, I just want you to look at ME right now.

main3.line: Silly Wakatsuki, if you wanna have fun, just change into a swimsuit and jump into the pool... Although, it's too late to nab the Commander now – I have exclusive dibs♪

touch.line: Ahahah! Are you teasing me back now?

touch2.line: I know I can't do anything about it... Still, I'm sorry they're not bigger...

unlock.line: Peace~♪ Do I look good in the pic? Don't I look so adorable you'll never wanna delete the photo, and have to stare at it every day to feel at ease? Heehee♪

win_mvp.line: Peace, peace♪ Tell me how perfect I am♪

expedition.line: Whuah?! Wh-what is it? The commission team's back? You should've just said so!

feeling5.line: You just can't help how much you love me, I know. You can't blame me for wanting to tease you, though! So, are you gonna even the score? Don't you wanna teeease your beloved Hatsuzuki? Be my guest♡ Heehee!

home.line: Welcome back! Heehee. Your seat is on the couch over there – and MY seat is on your lap♪

login.line: This is a special day for you and me, you know. Isn't it the obvious thing to throw a grand celebration and make merry? Heehee♪

main1.line: You're the one who said anything I like is fine, so it's too late to take it back now! Besides, you look like you wanna find out how it tastes... Don't play so hard to get!

main2.line: You're bound to get thirsty sooner or later after chatting with me for so long. Heheh. Hope you're grateful for how forward-thinking I am♪

main3.line: Now look, I'm going to pour it riiight– Eek! Y-you don't want the carpet to get dirty? Huh? Come again?

mission.line: You need motivation to do your missions? Heehee – alrighty, I'll comfort you as much as you need♪

mission_complete.line: Your mission rewards have arrived? But I'm not done indulging you...

touch.line: Ahaha♡ You'll have to come closeeer!

touch2.line: Y-you could lick that spot... *blushes*

unlock.line: You said anything's fine as long as I think it's good, right? Well, tadah! I'm going to give you a delectable, delicious drink! Watch closely now!

win_mvp.line: Hooray! Now if only you'd be mine, everything would be perfect, Commander!

detail.line: The snow is blessing our union, Commander~ Do you hear it? It's saying, "May your bond be as eternal and pristine as this world of snow!"

feeling5.line: Hey, do you want me to confess to you again? Okay, lean in a little closer and listen... I love you. So I'm giving all that I am to you... okay, Commander?

headtouch.line: This red string? Don't worry about it... The only red string I need is the one binding our hearts together♪

home.line: Commandeeer! If you don't hurry, I'll leave you in the dust. Heheh, just kidding~ I wouldn't abandon my beloved. But I did love seeing that concerned look on your face just now!

login.line: Look, Commander! Pretty, huh? No, I DON'T mean the scenery – I mean ME!

main1.line: Whether it's sweet love or toxic romance, I'm game for anything... More than that, I'm dying to experience it!

main2.line: Commander, come and hold the umbrella with me! Now we... spin it! Whooosh! Hahaha! Look at the snow swirling everywhere!

main3.line: Do you like this outfit? I picked the whole backdrop, too! Hehe, now take my hand, and let's wish to never be apart again♪

touch.line: My hands are a little cold... Can you warm me up, Commander?

touch2.line: Hyah?! W-we're not there yet... At least wait until we... *blushes*

unlock.line: Get a move on, Commander! I've been waiting here so we can cross together. I heard that, when two lovers cross this bridge together, their bond will last a lifetime! Heehee♪

battle.line: Show me what you've got!

detail.line: Hmph, know that I am a member of the glorious Kamikaze class! If you don't give me the respect I deserve... Oh? You made dango to share with me? Y-yes, yes, very thoughtful.

expedition.line: You there, Commander! I hear the commission team is back. If you don't want a solid blow to the stomach, you'd best make them treats and meet them in person!

feeling1.line: Mm... Don't disappoint me so much, please. That is all I have to say.

feeling2.line: Hmph. You underestimate me... Normally, I would punish you with a hundred punches... But very well. I'll let you get away with one this time.

feeling3.line: Work must always be done quickly and efficiently. Oh, come now, I'll be here to help you. That should keep you from running into any trouble. You may rely on me from now on.

feeling4.line: What? You finished your work before me...?! No, I mean, you must be going faster because of my help, or... A fluke! It must be a fluke, of course!

feeling5.line: Whoa! ...N-no, nothing's wrong. I wasn't just neglecting my work because I was so focused on you, or anything! I mean, uhh! Yeah! You're doing this on purpose to distract me, aren't you?! Fess up!

headtouch.line: Th-this is mortifying! Why don't I sink my fist into your stomach and see how you feel then?!

home.line: Commander? Finally returned, hm? You have some nerve, ignoring me—Oh, you didn't see me? But I'm right in front of you!

hp_warning.line: Th-this is far from enough to make a Kamikaze-class shipgirl submit!

login.line: So you finally arrive, Commander! What in the world were you... Hey! Do not ignore me!

lose.line: Rrrgh! I-I just held back a little, that's all!

mail.line: Mail's come for you, Commander. Don't just ignore it! Read it already!

main1.line: What? You made tea for me? H-hmm, how thoughtful... You deserve praise! Expect a New Year's gift in your future!

main2.line: There you go messing up again! Prepare to feel my iron fist... You say no, it hurts too much? I-I suppose I don't mean to hurt you... Very well. One painless tummy strike, incoming!

main3.line: Oite, where did you hide my shoes?! Oh... They were a mess, so you sorted them all into the shoe box for me? H-hmm... Well, er... Thank you.

mission.line: Hmm, Commander... Do you know how many missions you have piled up? They'll keep piling if you ignore them, so how about you get to work?!

mission_complete.line: Mm, wait a second... This mission is completed! Goodness. Don't neglect your rewards now.

profile.line: I am the eighth Kamikaze-class ship, Asanagi. They once rudely called me number fifteen, but either out of sympathy or because they recognized my power, they've given me a new name. Now, if you're to be my Commander, you'd best straighten up! Otherwise, I'll have to instill some gumption in you!

propose.line: Heheh, that you'd give me this must mean that you want to depend on me forever! What? No? You want ME to depend on YOU? Wh-who would ever rely on you?! ...I'll accept this ring, but I still won't do it!

skill.line: Get ready for a faceful of my fists of fury!

touch.line: Ah, right there... Mm~ Commander, you are just a master of massage.

touch2.line: And what do you think you're doing, fool?! Goodness... What is so fun about touching me?

unlock.line: Well, well... Hmph. What a weak little child you are! I am Asanagi, of the Kamikaze class! I will be your subordinate from today on, but listen well! Cause me trouble, I will jab you! Annoy me, I will strike you! Do anything unbefitting of your status as Commander, and your tummy shall know the wrath of my fist!

upgrade.line: Well, I suppose I feel a little stronger... Only a little! A little, I say!

win_mvp.line: This is your punishment for underestimating the Kamikaze class!

gift_prefer.line: You've got quite an eye for aesthetics! Mmhmm, that's worthy of praise!

battle_ex.line: Commander, let's punch their lights out!

detail_ex.line: I cannot deny that you've done much for me, Commander... How am I meant to repay you?

login_ex.line: Commander, you're late! You don't know how long I've been waiting... for you, patiently! Show me your gratitude!

main4_ex.line: You've made time for me tonight? I-I see... That's a good idea. I look forward to your companionship.

main5_ex.line: Matsukaze, I'll care for the Commander's worldly desires, so you don't need to worry—Why are you making that face at me?! D-do you mean to say I'm not capable?!

mission_ex.line: Mm, you still have some missions remaining. Did I not tell you that you'd start making mistakes if you worked yourself too much? I'll help you, so let's take it slow, now.

mission_complete_ex.line: This one, and this one too... All of them are done! Now that's our Commander for you!

touch_ex.line: Mmm~ Yes... Ouch, ouch! No! Bad place! Not there... Ow, owowowowowoww!!

touch2_ex.line: H-heheh! Do not underestimate my charms... Wait, you're stopping already?!

win_mvp_ex.line: Hrmm. Did I overdo things a little?

detail.line: It's not as if we fight at all hours. You'd be better off if you learned how to relax. As someone who leads shipgirls to battle over the sea, you'd benefit the most from learning how to enjoy the ocean.

home.line: Here, a towel. Your hair and clothes get wet during battles, don't they? Make sure you don't catch a cold.

login.line: Late again. You weren't out there playing with other girls on the beach, were you?

main1.line: If you fall for another shipgirl... you know what'll happen, don't you? My fists haven't dulled one bit.

main2.line: Say, Commander, why don't we take a break and watch the ocean over some tea? Calm seas are so relaxing.

main3.line: I notice you've been staring at my tummy...? Ah! Could it be... You plan to take your revenge over my previous punches?!

touch.line: Urgh, the sunlight is too strong... Don't blame me. I sunburn easily by nature!

touch2.line: Look how covetous you are~ Does the sight of me in a swimsuit excite you so?

unlock.line: *yaaawn*... Goodness me, there I go falling asleep. You understand how pleasant the sea breeze is, don't you? YOU calling ME a slacker!

win_mvp.line: Heheh, yes, yes! Continue to sing my praises!

battle.line: What an honor to fight with you all. Rest assured, I will accomplish the mission.

couple_encourage1.line: This is the might of a cutting-edge destroyer.

couple_encourage2.line: Wanna play in the snow?

detail.line: You're always staring at me – am I hard to approach? Huh? You're just waiting for the right time to come closer? I mean, I don't have a problem with you... I just need some time to get used to you.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission team is back. You want me to come along and welcome them? Sure.

feeling1.line: Sorry. You actually should keep your distance.

feeling2.line: Will you come with me to the zoo on our next day off? With you around, the animals shouldn't all run away from me. You're warm, and they like that...

feeling3.line: Hm? I smiled? I was simply thinking about you. D-don't give me that look... I'm not used to it...

feeling4.line: For a while now, my heart has started racing whenever I'm around you... I'm not even nervous, and yet...

feeling5.line: I think I understand why everyone likes you so much. I've been wanting to stay by your side for a while now... D-does that bother you? If not, I'm gonna sit next to you to take in your warmth... Heehee...

headtouch.line: Mmh... Your hand feels so warm... I'm not used to that...

home.line: Welcome back. I made you some tea. Oh, it's freezing cold? Yeah, I added a whole heap of ice... Was that a weird choice?

hp_warning.line: The fire is spreading!

login.line: I left a summary of today's tasks here. Yes, it's that many. Better get started. I'll help you out.

lose.line: Rigging is burning... Requesting permission to retreat!

mail.line: Commander, I've brought all your mail. Can I write you a letter too?

main1.line: This is a snow bear I made. You can have it if you want. I'll leave it here. It'll stand guard for you on when I'm not here.

main2.line: Mmh... Do you want a taste of this strawberry-flavored shaved ice? ...You like it? Heehee. Huh? No, I wasn't smiling. You're just seeing things... *blushes*

main3.line: Cats run away when they see me, but they're never afraid to walk up to you... I'm not jealous. Not jealous at all...

mission.line: Commander, you really can't put off your tasks any longer.

mission_complete.line: Great work. I had a look at the mission rewards. Get some rest now.

profile.line: I'm Suzunami, 10th destroyer of the Yuugumo class. I gave it my best in the great war, but didn't achieve much of note. Now I'll try my hardest to work with you to repel our enemies... and make friends with others in the fleet.

propose.line: Commander... I've never felt the way I do now. I'm so, so happy... Am I allowed to be this happy all day, every day?

touch.line: Do you know a good way to make friends with animals? Can you teach me?

touch2.line: Huh?! I-I'm not accustomed to... physical touch like this...

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander. I'm Suzunami of the Sakura Empire, 10th ship of the Yuugumo class of destroyers. I hope we can be, um... friends...

upgrade.line: Wow, thanks for making me stronger. I'll try to work harder from now... and try to be more cordial.

win_mvp.line: We won, Commander. I think I work pretty well in a team, don't I?

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander. Ehehe... Huh? I, I smiled?

detail_ex.line: Should you really stay with me all the time? If you're here too long, people will think we're unapproachable... No? Then it's fine. Heehee.

feeling5_ex.line: I can't go back to my old ways... I can't be away from your warmth, and I can't suppress this urge of always wanting to be with you. I'm very selfish, aren't I?

headtouch_ex.line: Your hand is really warm... I don't mind it.

home_ex.line: Welcome back. I made some tea for you. Don't worry, it's at a drinkable temperature for you. I'm not getting it wrong again.

login_ex.line: I'm gonna be right here beside you and we'll get this work done together. I feel more motivated when I'm next to you.

main4_ex.line: Ice cream hot pot? That sounds weird... Buuut, if you wanna try it, then I'll try it, too.

main5_ex.line: You're not gonna believe this – cats stopped avoiding me now. Heehee. I'm so happy. Must be because I've been around you for so long.

touch_ex.line: So you don't really know a good way to befriend animals either? Okay, in that case... we can look for one together.

touch2_ex.line: You, umm... Do you... like touching that?

detail.line: You stare way too much, Commander... You have to so you can see if everything's in order? Oh, okay...

feeling5.line: When I think about how I get to wear this dress, dance with you, and feel your warmth, it makes me so happy and excited... It's going to be a warming, wonderful night.

headtouch.line: Hm? Did my ribbon come undone?

home.line: I can't see the back in the mirror... Hm? Welcome back, Commander. Could you, um, check my dress from behind? I can't see it on my own.

login.line: You have work you just have to finish before the banquet? Okay. I'll help you with that after I'm done straightening out my dress.

lose.line: This is a mess... I don't think I'll make it to the party...

main1.line: This garter belt feels kind of tight... I don't want it to restrict my movement when we dance. Maybe I'll loosen it a little...

main2.line: I've heard there's going to be some really lavish shaved ice at the banquet. I can't wait. Do you wanna eat it with me?

main3.line: Do you think cats will be friendlier with me with this dress? Let's find some cats later and try it.

mission.line: You still have work to do? I'll help. It's best that we finish it before the banquet.

mission_complete.line: That's all the work finished. Let's head out once I've straightened out my dress.

touch.line: Eep! M-measure my waist? Fine, I guess... You just scared me when you came close out of nowhere... Here is the measuring tape.

touch2.line: Y-you think I should adjust this part more? Well, I can do that myself...

unlock.line: Sorry for calling you here this early, Commander... I was just hoping you could check if I'm wearing my dress right. I'm not a dress person, so...

battle.line: Kunoichi master Taekaze will take them by surprise!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's train together after this mission!

detail.line: Hmm? Your hat got blown off? Y-yeah, the wind sure is something today! You definitely didn't get it snatched away by a certain kunoichi...

expedition.line: I came back with the commission team! ...Why was I disguised as a supply box? Because ninja training, duh!

feeling1.line: Wow, you're really boring. I don't even wanna prank you at this point...

feeling2.line: A bonsai plant, a tree, or a manhole cover... What should I disguise myself as next? Any thoughts, Commander?

feeling3.line: Ninja training was sooo hard today! Commander, rub my shoulders for me... C-Commander? Why are you holding a log? Ack! I'm sorry! I accidentally used my substitution jutsu.

feeling4.line: Zzz... Zzzz.... Hah! I-I wasn't sleeping! Protecting her Commander is a kunoichi's duty! I'm going to stay right here by your side until you finish your work... I won't fall asleep, I swear... Zzzz...

feeling5.line: Heheh, so you've finally seen through my disguise! Better hug me quick, or I'll slip right out of your hands! ...Well? Hurry up... I'm trying so hard to let you catch me...

headtouch.line: Gaaaah, no no no! Number one rule of ninjas: you need to be unpredictable! I don't CARE how good it feels when you pet me, you can't... Ooh...

home.line: Wachaaa! Welcome back, Commander! Did that startle you? Heheh... Huh? You saw my tail?!

hp_warning.line: Ouchies! Gonna need some ointment for that one...

login.line: Bam, smoke bomb! Heheh, did my entrance startle you... *cough*! *cough* *hack*! The smoke... it's in my throat!

lose.line: Ugh, they saw through my disguise... Bam, substitution jutsu! Another successful escape!

mail.line: New mail arrives on swift winds! Will there be shocking news within? Open it and find out!

main1.line: I'm learning how to make these black pills! No, they're not ninja tools. They're tasty candy... Ahem, I mean nutritious soldier pills! Try eating one, Commander!

main2.line: Wow! You caught me! Too bad, though – bam, substitution jutsu! Hehe, try and get me again!

main3.line: Commander, look! I can walk on water... Gaaaah, I got distracted thinking about dinner BLRBLBLRF! Help meee!

mission.line: Got your mission requests here! Are they sneaky infiltrations? Or intel gathering? I can take care of any of them without leaving a trace!

mission_complete.line: Your mission rewards came! I'll just take these... Heheh, you'll have to catch me if you want them!

profile.line: I'm Taekaze, a Sakuran Yuugumo-class destroyer! I've never had the chance to show off my true power before, but now, you'll get to see it as my Commander! Don't blink – transformation jutsu!

propose.line: So this is the bond called love... Elusive but indestructible, just like the wind. But sometimes... even the elusive can be caught. Hold me tight, and I'll never leave your arms.

skill.line: Ninpo: Secret Wind Technique no Jutsu!

touch.line: D-don't grab my tail! Gaaah! Okay, I promise I won't disguise myself as your chair anymore!

touch2.line: Huh? Wha? Whaaaat?! C-C-Commander?!

unlock.line: Ba-duuum! This hide-and-seek game is over! The Yuugumo-class destroyer and kunoichi who floats on the wind sneaks onto the scene! Now that you've discovered me... Bam! Smoke bomb! Another successful escape!

upgrade.line: My ninja training has just begun!

win_mvp.line: Ever elusive, coming and going without a trace, the kunoichi master of disguise brings you ultimate victory once again!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! I've always wanted one of these!

detail_ex.line: Ack! You got me again! You know all of my hiding places now... This is no fair! Boooo, no fair!

feeling5_ex.line: I'll always be here for you, Commander. Today, tomorrow, the next day, and the next day... Basically forever! If you ever don't see me nearby, try looking closer!

headtouch_ex.line: That feels good. Touch me more... Even the best kunoichi need to relax...

home_ex.line: BOO! Heheh! That totally scared you, right?! I disguised my tail as a broom this time... Huh? You saw it wagging from far away? Th-the broom...?

login_ex.line: You're finally here! Commander, I'm ready to protect you all day! Mm... It's tough to do ninjutsu while I'm sticking to the ceiling... I think I'll just do it from your lap instead!

main4_ex.line: I already thought up my next disguise! A pillow would be a great idea, right? ...Why? Ahem... Because I'd be perfect for hugging while you sleep!

main5_ex.line: Commander, check out how my training went today! Heheh, heart-shaped bentos are part of my training, too!

main6_ex.line: ...You've noticed I disappear less often now? Yeah, duh. Because I need to be near you to protect you!

touch_ex.line: Rub my tail some more, Commander. A little higher... Ooh, yeah, right there... That's the stuff.

touch2_ex.line: I-I don't know what to do here... I'll just let you decide!

detail.line: I-I'll let go now, so you better catch me... Why are you opening your arms THERE? I can't fly that far!

feeling5.line: Phew, I'm finally safe... I-I actually know lots of escape tactics, but you showed up, so... Hehe, I thought the best way to get out would be for you to catch me in your arms!

headtouch.line: You're rubbing my ears right now? No fair... I seriously can't feel my arms!

home.line: Perfect timing! My arm's are getting numb. I don't think I can hang on...

login.line: Hyah?! Huh? Commander! H-help me out here, or you're gonna see something REALLY inappropriate!

main1.line: I was gonna hide in this tree outside your office and find the perfect chance to scare you. It was a flawless plan! ...So why did I mess up? It's your fault for not going the way I thought you would!

main2.line: Phew... Climbing is easy, but getting down is another story. C'mon, Taekaze, you can do this! Three, two, one... Never mind, it's too high up!

main3.line: Oops! My bag came untied and dropped my kunai everywhere! Ugh, now I'm in serious danger if I fall...

mission.line: New mission alert! Help me down before you go, please...

touch.line: Wawawawah! Don't pull there, or else... I-I'm gonna lose balance!

touch2.line: Hyah?! Commander... Why are you doing this when I'm struggling?!

unlock.line: Aaah, I'm gonna faaall! H-heheh... Morning, Commander... I-I'm just, uh, training right now! I wasn't trying to surprise you, or anything.

battle.line: Let's knock some fashion sense into these baddies!

couple_encourage1.line: Jeez... Remember to be more careful this time!

detail.line: My forte is coordinating the latest fashion trends with Sakuran-style attire! Since you're already here, Commander, come bask in my brilliance!

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Make sure to reward our girls appropriately for their hard work!

feeling1.line: It's alright, Commander. I've got terrible luck to begin with, so I'm already used to these things.

feeling2.line: A floral ribbon... frilly garter rings... glittery pink accessories... How should I put 'em together to make them pop? Aha! Commander, how about you decide?

feeling3.line: My ribbon keeps coming loose... Say, would you mind tying it back up for me? Why? Because, like, you're lucky, aren't you? Plus, you totally looove doing stuff like this, right?

feeling4.line: I feel like my luck's been on the up-and-up recently... I wonder if it's because of you? Heehee... don't take it as a compliment or anything though~♪

feeling5.line: Heeey. I bought some accessories for you, Commander. ...Th-they totally aren't for couples or anything! As if I'd lower my fashion sense like that!

headtouch.line: My horns are pretty cute, aren't they? C'mon, give 'em a feel. Can't hurt you with them even if I tried!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander~ Don't worry, I've been hard at work! Sooo... got any rewards for me?

hp_warning.line: My clothes are in tatters... Ugh, I seriously hate it when this happens!

login.line: Sup, Commander. Did I blow your mind with my fashion sense today?

lose.line: Ugh... I knew I needed more energy drinks!

mail.line: Oh my, what's this? Someone sent you a love letter? Mind if I take a gander, Commander~?

main1.line: Commander, the socks I'm wearing today look pretty edgy, huh? Wha... you can't tell the difference from before?! Th-then, you just have to take a closer look—!

main2.line: Chasing after trends is seriously lame. I've got to be the one who sets them. So, Commander, wanna come try out a new outfit I put together for you? I'm sure it'll look great on you!

main3.line: Ewww... another half-rotten fruit... Next time, I'll have you pick for me. 'Cause like, I know I can trust whatever you choose!

mission.line: Need help with your mission? Eh? Huuh? I was just being polite! If you really left it in my hands, the whole thing would just go kaput!

mission_complete.line: ...I actually managed to get the job done?! Commander... you really are lucky!

profile.line: I'm Fujinami, a destroyer from the Sakura Empire. I might be unlucky and tend to slip up from time to time, but I have absolute confidence in my fashion sense! Hehe, that's something you'd agree with too, right?

propose.line: Th-this is just... What? It's perfectly normal! I mean, like, you picked it out for me, so of course I'd wear it~♪ Heehee, after all, fashionable people look good no matter what they wear~♪

skill.line: I'll send you flying with my new kicks!

touch.line: The accessories I chose look spectacular, don't they? Ehehe, this is the epitome of Fujinami's unique fashion sense~♪

touch2.line: Eep! Wh-what are you doing all of a sudden? W-well, I guess I could show you the coordination of my undergarments...

unlock.line: Ehehe~ The name's Fujinami, a nice lass blessed by everything trendy! You'd better prepare yourself – starting today, I'm gonna show you the ins and outs of TRUE fashion!

upgrade.line: All my hard work has finally paid off?!

win_mvp.line: Yaaay, victory! Hey, hey, did you see my cinema moment?

gift_prefer.line: You put your feelings into this, so like, I really appreciate it.

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, I just realized something. No matter what I wear, you're always full of compliments... Does this mean you've completely fallen for me, from head to toe?

headtouch_ex.line: Are you, like, trying to share your good luck with me? Then, I'd be glad to take it~

home_ex.line: ...Hmm, what outfit should I wear to welcome the Commander back? ...Huh?! Y-you're back already?! D-d-don't peek! At least not until I'm done changing!

login_ex.line: Heheh, so you came to work wearing my hand-picked outfit... Then, you've earned yourself a most generous reward... Mmwah~♪

main4_ex.line: Commander, check out this fashion magazine! The colors that are gonna be trendy around the port tomorrow are... Wait, TOMORROW? Does that mean someone's already ahead of me?

main5_ex.line: Are you heading out later? I got you an umbrella. It's the same color as mine~♪

main6_ex.line: It feels like my bad luck's been melting away ever since I started being with you... B-but, Commander! To make sure nothing goes wrong for our date, I need to double– no, triple-check everything!

touch_ex.line: You like the coordination of my outfit, huh? Weeelll, I wouldn't mind taking it off to show you the details~♪

touch2_ex.line: No, no! You have to undo the ribbon first, and then you can remove the lace~ ...Ngh! C'mon, you've got to follow the steps!

feeling5.line: The secret behind "contrast" is... only you get to see ALL of me. The good, the bad, and everything in between... And it's exactly the package deal you signed up for, isn't it~?

headtouch.line: The highlight of this outfit isn't on the top of my head, you know. Focus your attention on the good parts, will you?

home.line: Oh, you're back early. Just couldn't hold back any longer, could you? I totally get it.

login.line: Good, you're here. So, give me your honest feedback. Don't you just love this sort of contrast?

main1.line: True fashion must be refined, inside and out! Even more so because it's an outfit only YOU get to see, Commander – that calls for extra care and attention~♪

main2.line: It looks a bit risqué, you say? Heheh~ then, that only means you've already burned this image of me into your memories.

main3.line: Phew... At least over here, I don't have to worry about getting rained on or slipping on a banana peel. Nngh! Hwuh?! Why'd the zipper suddenly get stuck?!

touch.line: No need to rush. I'll show you eeeverything, from top to bottom~

touch2.line: Mmgh... Ooh, Commander, you really get it...

unlock.line: Welcome to Fujinami's secret fashion lab~ Look, I put together a special ensemble just for you. So, what do you think? Pretty eye-popping, isn't it?

battle.line: Combat trial for new equipment... begin!

detail.line: Be they canisters or weaponry, my developments in them are the latest!

expedition.line: A commission is done! Hmm, I wonder if they brought us gifts...

feeling1.line: Master, could you just stay away from me?

feeling2.line: Master, what's on your mind when you stare at me? Hohoho, I'm rather perceptive, I'll have you know!

feeling3.line: I much prefer staying in the port than going on sorties. This is my home; by the blue seas, beneath the warm and dazzling sunlight... *Yawn*... Mmhh... Zzzz...

feeling4.line: What girls are your type, Master? Someone like me? You know, my type is people like you, Master~

feeling5.line: Do you want to nap with me, Master? Take this, it is my favorite pillow. Perhaps if you sleep on it, you will see me in your dreams. And if you do... Hehehe♪

home.line: Data collection complete. Now we shall use it to improve our gear.

hp_warning.line: Oww... No issue, as long as my equipment is fine...

login.line: With you by my side, Master, I have nothing to fear...!

lose.line: Dear me! ... Once I'm done developing new gear, I won't lose like this again!

mail.line: Hmm, this mail seems questionable... Master, I urge you to open it!

main1.line: *Yawn*...

main2.line: Melon bread? I'm extraordinarily curious as to how it tastes...

main3.line: The Gatos are terrifying... Why are such frightening submarines named after a catshark?

mission.line: You have incomplete missions... Hmm, it appears the results of my research will not be of any use...

mission_complete.line: Master, I believe it is time for a nap once you've finished your missions.

profile.line: I am Yuubari, Sakura Empire Yuubari-class light cruiser. I was developed under the constraints of a naval treaty, but this conversely allowed me to utilize a great number of new technologies. I served as the flagship of a Destroyer Squadron in the Pacific War. Hmm... I will need many oxygen torpedoes if I am to research them...

propose.line: I'm overjoyed♪ Starting today, every day when you wake up, the first thing you'll see in the morning is me~! Hehehe♪

skill.line: Feel the power of my advanced weapons!

touch.line: Your hand is so warm and gentle, Master~

touch2.line: Mmh... ugh... gah... stop, or I will bite!

unlock.line: I am light cruiser Yuubari. You say we've met before, Master? Hmm... b-but that's not possible... I don't have any sisters after all...

upgrade.line: Hmm... It seems to be a bit too tight in here...

win_mvp.line: Surely by now, you've begun to understand the importance of developing new gear, Master?

gift_prefer.line: Hawawa! I really like this~ Thank you, Master!

detail.line: Akashi is really enthusiastic about helping my research, but it feels like she has some ulterior motives...

home.line: Hehe, looks like the data collection went well this time too.

login.line: Master, are you here to help me gather data today?

lose.line: Hmm... Looks like I haven't upgraded my equipment enough...

main1.line: Research always comes with failure... but with your support, Master, all these difficulties will pass!

main2.line: Nnh... I'm a bit tired... Can I rest here for a while?

main3.line: The way I am now, I won't be afraid even if I run into a Gato-class, probably...

touch.line: Master, you have to remember to get some rest, all right?

touch2.line: Augh... I'm going to smack you!

unlock.line: I've finally finished developing my new equipment! Since we still have time, let's go and try it out in live combat right now, Master!

win_mvp.line: Master, have you realized the importance of having modernized equipment?

battle.line: Who is the enemy this time?

couple_encourage1.line: Hatsuharu, be more careful this time~ Hehehe~

detail.line: What kind of girl do you like, Commander? Hehe. Oh yeah?

expedition.line: Commissions? That's part of my job too.

feeling1.line: Come on, Commander, cheer up~!

feeling2.line: Hmm... What should I cook for my little sisters tonight?

feeling3.line: Commander? Oh, nothing. I just wanted to say hi!

feeling4.line: An escort? That's my specialty. And this time? Ah, going to port with you, undercover?!

feeling5.line: Yesterday, I saw a side of my sisters that I hadn't seen before... Commander, do you want to see a side of me you haven't before? Hm... what should I do?

home.line: It's great to see that you returned safe and sound, Commander~!

login.line: Hey, hey~ Commander, were you daydreaming again?

lose.line: *Cries* Commander, let's retreat...

mail.line: Hehe, Commander~! You've got new mail~!

main1.line: You need to change clothes after getting soaked... Hey, do you want to borrow mine?

main2.line: It's great that {namecode:47} is finally making friends, but...

main3.line: Commander~ Your face is so~ cute~!

mission.line: If it's just taking a break once in a while, I think I can let that go.

mission_complete.line: Wow, finished already? Well done, Commander!

profile.line: I'm the first ship of the {namecode:46}-class light cruisers from the Sakura Empire. I took part in various battles in the Solomon Seas and in the center Pacific. During Midway, I took over {namecode:91}'s role as flagship after she sank and then coordinated our retreat. In the end, though, I too met the fate of being sunk by a submarine...

propose.line: ... Hey~ Commander, are you ready? Okay, I'm closing my eyes...

touch.line: Have you run into any trouble, Commander?

touch2.line: Sometimes I really don't understand what you're trying to do, Commander...

unlock.line: Eheh, I'm {namecode:46}. Commader, have you been anticipating my arrival?

upgrade.line: Oxygen Torpedoes.....I want.......

win_mvp.line: I hope every battle goes as well as this one did~!

gift_prefer.line: Ehehe~ Thanks!

detail.line: Commander, how do you plan on spending your Spring Festival? Me? ...Well, chilling in my room with a cup of tea sounds pretty good, or reading a book, or rolling around. Ehehe~

feeling5.line: Whispering to you while cleaning your ear like this... kind of makes it seem like we're a couple, doesn't it? Hehe, forget I said anything. All right, all done. You can stay here and chat a bit more if you'd like~?

home.line: Look, Commander, the tea stalk is floating upright. I'm sure something good is going to happen today~

login.line: Commander, want some tea?

main1.line: Commander, have you seen Kinu? I told her I'd clean her ears, but she sure bailed quick... Seriously, what's wrong with cleaning your sister's ears...?

main2.line: Commander, you know, Abukuma started having tea with me, and will even let me clean her ears! Ehehe, th

touch.line: Commander, want me to clean your ears too? Sure, come here then~ *pat* *pat*

touch2.line: Jeez, Commander, don't blame me if I poke a hole in your eardrum~

unlock.line: Good evening, Commander. This room...? Ah, it's a special Dragon Empery-themed set I bought from Akashi's. It looks pretty snazzy and was on sale, so I picked it up. Ehehe~

battle.line: Nothing weird is going to pop out, right?

detail.line: *Cries*... I'm so glad that you're still this gentle with me, Commander...

expedition.line: The girls have completed their commissions! I hope they didn't bring anything strange back...

feeling1.line: Is Commander a demon?

feeling2.line: *Cries*... Are ghosts scary because they don't exist in this world?
