main2.line: I can handle anything you throw at me. I'll breeze through anything, whether it's a sortie or a bunch of paperwork.

main3.line: Not to be a glutton, but, since I've been working hard, can't you spare me an itty bitty treat? Haha, how about something sweet?

mission.line: You sure have a lot of work to get through... Even if I lend you a hand, it'll probably still take a while, huh~

mission_complete.line: That's it for the paperwork! Let's see if you left anything out... Ah, found a spot! Gimme a sec to look everything through!

profile.line: I'm the Agano-class light cruiser, Sakawa! I wasn't able to do a whole lot during that war, but... I'm so grateful to you and all my friends here at the port for giving me another chance to fight! Mhm!

propose.line: Ehehe, did you steal another glance at me just before you put the ring on my finger? ...Y-you didn't? Geez, and here I am trying to show you what a maiden in love looks like...

skill.line: I'll show you what I'm made of!

touch.line: You were staring at me just now, weren't you? I bet you were~

touch2.line: An accident, huh... I never said you had to apologize!

unlock.line: I'm Sakawa, Agano-class light cruiser♪ And you're the Commander? I see~ I get why Noshiro is so into you. I am, too!

upgrade.line: Now that's a power boost. Best way to test it would be with a real battle, no?

win_mvp.line: Victoryyy! Now's a good time to congratulate me, no? I'd say it is. Heehee.

gift_prefer.line: Ehehe~ You really, really love me, don't you~♪

battle_ex.line: I'm calling the shots~!

detail_ex.line: Wow, you came to see me again today! Oh, it was just a coincidence? Heehee, what a prankster you are~ You totally knew I'd be waiting right here for you~

expedition_ex.line: If we're going to go greet the commission team, how about bringing Noshiro along?

feeling5_ex.line: Aren't you dying to tell me how much you love me? Ehehe, I'm going to steal those words right from your lips, so you'd better think carefully about how to return my feelings. The longer you spend agonizing over it, the more my love for you deepens~

headtouch_ex.line: Alright, alright. Heehee~♡

home_ex.line: Welcome back! Let's finish reviewing the mission, and then you'll have some Sakura confections waiting for you!

login_ex.line: Good day, my dearest~♪ You look more energetic than usual today~

main4_ex.line: Ehehe, you're going to make me blush if you do that while we're still at work... Huh? I haven't been working for quite some time now? I, I totally knew that!

main5_ex.line: Want me to whip up a light snack for you? Hey, just because I like eating doesn't mean I don't know how to cook~♪

main6_ex.line: Noshiro is totally head-over-heels in love with you, but she just won't admit it... I don't get her at all. Heehee.

mission_ex.line: You let missions pile up just so you can spend more time working with me, didn't you~♪

mission_complete_ex.line: And that's all of 'em! See, everything's fine when we take things slow and steady~

touch2_ex.line: Please pay more attention to me... Okay?

win_mvp_ex.line: You're the best, Sakawa. You're amazing, Sakawa. I'm proud of you, Sakawa– What's wrong? Haven't decided what to say yet~?

detail.line: Happiness is a mouthful of sweets from the Sakura Islands~ Don't you also want to share a bit of this happiness with Sakawa? Here you go then~♪

expedition.line: We're giving Sakura confections to the commission team as a thank-you reward, right?

feeling5.line: M-my lips...? Even I'll get embarrassed if you suddenly try to kiss me, you know...? But, maybe we can go somewhere else later and–– Huh? There's something stuck to the corner of my lips?! Wh-what about the kiss...???

headtouch.line: I feel like I'm on top of the world~

home.line: Sorry to keep you waiting~ I've brought you your piping-hot tea! ...Oh my, I seem to have forgotten the teacups! Oh, um, what should I do...?

login.line: Come get your delicious and fluffy dango~ One for you, one for me, and we can share the last one~♪ Ehehe, goood morning~!

main1.line: Dangos are sooo good~ I could eat them for three days straight! But after that... I'd probably get sick of them and want some yatsuhashi instead~♪

main2.line: The stuff you ordered? ...Oh! I think I ate it by accident! Oh, silly me!

main3.line: Since we're trying to make our pop-up café the best it can be, I have to memorize the entire menu~ Heehee, I'll be making a whole lot of goodies later~

touch.line: Alright, what would you like to order?

touch2.line: Well, um... I suppose you just couldn't help it because of how cute I am, right...?

unlock.line: Welcome! Heehee, you came because you were just so keen to see me, am I right? Then I've got to make you feel real welcome♪

detail.line: Aww, you came to see me again! Are you sure you want to spend time with me, and not Noshiro? Heheh, do you feel guilty? It's okay~ We can always make it up to Noshiro after we have fun together♪

expedition.line: Ooh, you were just looking at me, weren't you? I was juuust about to let you know that the commission team's probably back by now♪

feeling5.line: Isn't it easier to tell someone how much you love, love, love them when you're alone together? Ehehe, of course it is~ You've been trying to say it for a while now, right, Commander? I'll let you go first. Say it loud enough for me to hear, now♪

home.line: Have a nice, cool popsicle after that heated battle! Heheh, was someone looking forward to an indirect kiss?

login.line: A cool summer's day in the forest~ One for me, one for you, and halfsies for the bears~ Ehehe, welcome back!♪

main1.line: Whoa! Commander, you're soaked. Oh, I know; were you and Noshiro shooting water guns? Ahaha!♪ She never holds back when it comes to play.

main2.line: Swimsuits aren't just for the beach. They work great for swimming in rivers, too. Hm? You aren't going to swim, Commander?

main3.line: There's going to be a big fireworks show later, right? I'll save room for the feast later♪

touch.line: Would you like one?

touch2.line: I-is this because I'm in a swimsuit...?

unlock.line: Wow, look how far you pursued me. You must have really, reeeally wanted to see me, huh, Commander~? Heheh, want a popsicle?

win_mvp.line: I'm strong, aren't I? Ahaha, a swimsuit won't get in the way of my fighting!

detail.line: Doesn't it make people really nervous to sing and perform in these huge venues? I'm not, though, since I'm with you~

feeling5.line: You come to watch every day 'cause you love me so much, right? Heheh, we're all alone right now, so you can say it as loud as you want. ...Whoa?! I-impressive... *blushes*

home.line: Party prep, strategy meetings, exercises... You're so busy, Commander. Should you reeeally spend so much time watching me practice?♪

login.line: What am I practicing right now? Heheh, just guess, Commander♪

main1.line: Agano's dress is so mature, isn't it? ...Mine, too? Well, I doubt it's like hers~

main2.line: Just between you and me, I've been practicing my piano instead of singing. Heheh, did I trick you?

main3.line: Ah! You were just staring at me!♪ Could it be... You brought me treats? Woohoo!

touch.line: Do you know a lot about music, Commander?

touch2.line: Are you doing that because I look a little more... mature today?

unlock.line: Laaa la-laaa♪ Oh, Commander. Here to see me again? I know you're madly in love and want to watch me practice, but people will think you're weird if you keep coming and going constantly. Heehee♪

win_mvp.line: After I finish my jaw-dropping performance... should I bow for the crowd, you think?

battle.line: Fight just like we rehearsed!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's do our best together.

couple_encourage2.line: I'll do my best, too. You don't have to tell me!

detail.line: Calmly reflect upon the lessons you've learned, and even a momentary performance will shine eternal. That is the kind of idol that I aspire to become.

expedition.line: The commission is complete. Just as you planned.

feeling1.line: Commander, this course of action will have negative effects on my training.

feeling2.line: Thank you for coming all this way to see my lesson. ...So? Was there anything I could do to improve my performance? Heehee.

feeling3.line: This is exclusive Alizarin merch and my autograph... Would you like to have them? Heehee, it's nice to be a little childish once in a while.

feeling4.line: You think I look cool when I sing? Th-thank you. Does that mean I'm still far from being consistent, though... Haha, I thought you might say that. You love praising me, don't you? *blush*

feeling5.line: This... is special merchandise just for you. Please take it... The red mark there is, umm... I kissed... Never mind! It's nothing!

headtouch.line: Hm? My hair's messed up? Thank you for telling me.

home.line: Nnh... Zzzz... Ah, C-Commander... Welcome back. I'm sorry, I just fell asleep... Do you have a new training mission for me?

hp_warning.line: Brace yourselves, everyone!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. I finished drawing up today's lesson plan. See? Oh... You say this is your job, not mine?

lose.line: Did I not train enough after all...?

mail.line: A letter...? Is it a new concert mission?

main1.line: I'm an idol, so I need to be even more mindful of my nutritional balance... Say, why don't you let me plan your meals for you too, Commander?

main2.line: Improvising is great and all, but doing things without a plan does make me uncomfortable...

main3.line: It's important to rest between your work, okay? Want me to bring you tea? Don't worry, I won't make it too hot.

mission.line: Do you need my help completing your missions, Commander? Heehee.

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished. You really are a reliable help.

profile.line: To meet Agano's and your expectations of me, I, light cruiser Noshiro, will do my best to complete this idol training mission. ...Was that good? Are you satisfied with me as a member of Alizarin?

propose.line: This day came so much sooner than I expected. ...I know. You're ready and raring for us to move on to greater heights, aren't you?

touch.line: Commander, you did that for the sake of instruction... right?

touch2.line: Please... cut it out...

unlock.line: Agano-class ship number two, Noshiro, will now begin the Muse System test. I'll put my all into both my idol work and my mission, so you have no reason to worry.

upgrade.line: I'm becoming even more refined.

win_mvp.line: With my singing voice and the courage given to me by the Commander, I cannot lose!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you. I'll cherish this gift.

battle.line: Allow me to set the stage for you.

couple_encourage1.line: Let's compete together at a more suitable time!

couple_encourage2.line: I'd love to see your latest clothing design.

detail.line: Hmm? My sleeve? Heehee, I made some corrections to it for aesthetics' sake. Don't worry – it won't get in the way in battle.

expedition.line: Commander, the girls on commission have returned to port. Let's go meet them. Supplies are vital on the front lines of war.

feeling1.line: Your taste in attire is a little worrying...

feeling2.line: My blade has no past – it descended unto the material world alongside me. However, its reason for existence is clear. It is here to aid me in protecting the people I love.

feeling3.line: I come to this courtyard often. Watching the flowers and birds, listening to the shishi-odoshi... Through this, I calm myself and nourish my spirit to hone my swordplay for the coming battle. Aren't you bored just sitting here, though? If there's anything you want to do, I'm all ears.

feeling4.line: You're still stuck on work? Being faithful to duty is a good thing, but relaxing and letting yourself recover is important. Here's a sachet I made. It'll calm your nerves and help you sleep... Go ahead and put it on, please.

feeling5.line: I made this charm for you, Commander. It'll protect you and ward off evil. Heheh, it's not enough on its own... but don't worry. I will train harder and endeavor to protect you with my blade as well.

headtouch.line: This hair accessory might look unusual, but I actually made it myself.

home.line: You've done great work, Commander. If you're tired, why not sit down and rest for a while? Whether you're commanding a battle or practicing martial arts, rest is vital.

hp_warning.line: Ngh... I can't fall... Not here!

login.line: Commander, how about a cup of tea or coffee before work? I always have a cup before training... It helps me focus and regulate my mood.

lose.line: We must retreat! Hurry, before anyone else gets hurt!

mail.line: The pattern on this envelope's wax seal might work on a skirt... Oh, I'm sorry. Just spaced out a little. Here's your mail, Commander.

main1.line: Did you lose a button? I'll sew it back on, so just stay still for me. Oh... We're a little close, huh? M-maybe you should take your shirt off instead...?

main2.line: Hm? I'm sharpening my blade right now, so please be careful. It'll hurt if you bump into it.

main3.line: If you're having trouble focusing, then how about a break? Efficient work only comes from ample rest.

main4.line: Are you curious about this? This is a bill for a commissioned kimono from Akashi. As for the price... Er, let's keep that a secret.

mission.line: Take your missions seriously, please. Oh, but don't forget to take regular breaks. I'll be sure to remind you.

mission_complete.line: Good work, Commander. How about a quick massage... Acupuncture? I do use needles often, but not for that... I use them to sew.

profile.line: I'm Watarase, a modified Agano-class light cruiser with the Sakura Empire. My first life ended without fulfilling any expected purpose... but I will use the new power I've been given to protect you and yours, Commander.

propose.line: Commander, do you know the legend of Princess Shirataki? The promise made between the weaving princess and her lover, the korinseki stone that witnessed it... What you just put on is our own korinseki. May this ring oversee our love to the end.

skill.line: With flowing shadow, pierce the waves!

touch.line: Hm? Curious about the fabric? If you like it, I'd be happy to make you an outfit with it.

touch2.line: Oh?! Commander, do you dislike my modifications here...?

unlock.line: I am light cruiser Watarase of the Sakura Empire. It is a pleasure to meet you, Commander. With this blade, I shall protect the honor of the fleet.

upgrade.line: This training session came with remarkable results. Phew... How about we all head to the training grounds and spar a little?

win_mvp.line: I'm happy that my blade could bring you victory, Commander.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much, Commander. I really like these.

detail_ex.line: Oh? You'll measure me? B-but... you want to order clothes for me? In that case, okay...

feeling5_ex.line: Am I slacking off on my training lately? Not at all, Commander. I simply believe that rest is just as important as work! Heehee, besides, I'm confident that I can protect you already. Love always wins, after all.

headtouch_ex.line: The way you pet me is almost calming.

home_ex.line: Come sit down and take a break. ...Heehee, lie down in my lap, if you'd like. Is the room too bright? Here... I'll shield your eyes.

login_ex.line: Commander, I'm leaving some coffee, tea, and a hanky for you. ...Hm? The pattern looks familiar? Heehee, that's because I embroidered a cute little version of you!

main5_ex.line: Hmm? Did you say something, Commander? Sorry, I'm learning a new type of embroidery to incorporate it into my next design... I think it'll turn out well.

main6_ex.line: Oh? If you want to hug me, let me put my blade down first. Okay, I'm all yours~ There... Is that as rousing as you'd hoped?

main7_ex.line: Ah, sorry. I wasn't spacing out – I just wanted to stare at you. Heehee, I finished my training, so I'm taking a break.

main8_ex.line: Heheh, did you already notice? The pattern I embroidered on the inside of your clothes symbolizes love. Cute, isn't it? Heehee.

mail_ex.line: Commander, a fabric order came along with the mail... Hm? You ordered it for me? Thank you!

mission_ex.line: Commander, it's almost time for missions... Hm? Did you let them pile up that fast? Heehee, okay. I'm happy to help.

touch_ex.line: You'd like me to teach you some martial arts soon...? I won't hold back just because you're my partner... Haha, I'm kidding!

touch2_ex.line: There's still much training left to come, Commander... Now isn't a good... Mmnh!

detail.line: I designed not just this outfit, but the carriage as well. Heehee, isn't it as dreamy as a fairy tale?

expedition.line: Commander, the commission team brought back spare fireworks.

feeling5.line: Commander, listen – the clock just struck midnight! But my magic won't disappear like in the fairy tales, and you won't have to search for me, my prince. I'll find you, return to your side, take your hand, and weave the perfect tale just for us!

headtouch.line: I made this crown to match my outfit, too~

home.line: Dancing is no easier than combat training. You must be tired, too, Commander. Please, come rest in my pumpkin carriage with me.

login.line: Commander, it's time for the fireworks to start. Let's leave our work and daily training until after they're done, okay?

lose.line: I'll need to improve the mobility of this outfit...

mail.line: There's a letter for you, Commander. If it's an invitation to a dance party, then may I join you as your partner?

main1.line: Is the carriage uncomfortable? This is my first time designing anything other than clothes, so there were a lot of unknowns...

main2.line: What if I just spirited you away in my carriage to watch the fireworks together? A little too selfish, perhaps?

main3.line: Want to guess what spell the fairy cast on me? Okay, I'll tell you. It lets me find you no matter where you are... Heehee, just kidding.

main4.line: Am I blushing? I-it's probably because of this... I do feel a little tipsy. Mind if I lean on your shoulder...?

mission.line: You're still working? But it's time for your break... Fine, I'll just have to help you. Once we're done, we're going to have fun together, got it?

mission_complete.line: Now that we're done with all that work, it's time to focus on enjoying the fireworks show♪

touch.line: Would you like to dance under the night sky? Just take my hand, Commander♪

touch2.line: Umm... P-people will see us here...

unlock.line: Commander! Oh... Umm, perhaps it would be more fitting to address you as "Milord" for this occasion? Since, you know, the two of us have the evening together... Now, if you don't mind, your hand please — Heehee, make sure to sit tight!

battle.line: Safe and healthy return, hale and hearty... S-setting sail now!

couple_encourage1.line: Daisen, your hair... Are you a bunny?

couple_encourage2.line: What is a "Planet Bunnyian," exactly...?

couple_encourage3.line: They make your shoulders stiff, too, right? Same!

detail.line: Ah, I can't see down to my legs... Urk... Hwuh?! C-Commander? Were you watching...? I'm sorry. I shouldn't have been training here... It's embarrassing to know that people can see me.

expedition.line: The commission team brought back so many supplies... I-is it because of my prayers, you think? Th-thank you! I'll keep doing my best to help out!

feeling1.line: C-Commander, you're scary... Eep...

feeling2.line: Commander, do you want to see me d-dance? I-I'll do my best! But... not now!

feeling3.line: I pray for your safety and happiness... This prayer isn't just for the sake of duty. It's... what I really want...

feeling4.line: I have to confess... I once prayed that you'd give me attention over the others... It looks like that came true, huh? I'm really happy... Ooh...

feeling5.line: Phew... If this is your desire, Commander, then I... I offer a dance of blessing to you! May it bring you safety and happiness... Here goes!

headtouch.line: Thanks to you... I feel a lot more confident now, Commander! Th-thank you so much!

home.line: C-Commander... You're not hurt? I made yomogi mochi! And... I even grew the mugwort myself! Umm, my little bunnies thought it was good, too!

hp_warning.line: Oww... That hurts...

login.line: Be good, don't run around so much... C-Commander?! Welcome back... Uh, umm, would you like to drink some carrot... I mean, eat some tea... o-oh, what am I saying...

lose.line: Aah... Commander, we need to retreat right away...

mail.line: The mail for you is right here. Do you like traditional letters, too...?

main1.line: I do want to talk with everyone more, b-but... I always mess it up. Can you help me practice, Commander?

main2.line: C-Commander... Umm... My bunnies want to stay here with us. Is that okay...? Th-thank you! They're grateful, too!

main3.line: Commander... Would you like to go hiking with me? Chatting with the critters in the mountains is r-really fun...

mission.line: Commander, h-have you finished your work? Oh, it's not like I doubt you... I'm just wondering if you're tired.

mission_complete.line: Yes, I've received all of your mission rewards for you. Please, take a look...

profile.line: I-I'm Ayase, a Sakura Empire light cruiser... I was originally planned to be Sendai-class, but I was canceled... So I'm very happy to be in your fleet now, Commander! I'll... I'll do my very best!

propose.line: C-calm down, Ayase...! C-Commander... I'm really, REALLY happy! Just once, give me this one opportunity to pray for us... *inhale*... *exhale*... "May our love continue as long as we breathe!"

touch.line: You want to hug my bunny, too...? O-okay! She says she wants to give you a big hug, too!

touch2.line: Hyah?! Wh-what? D-do you find this part of me strange, too...?

unlock.line: P-pleased to meet you, Commander... My name is Ayase, of the Sakura Empire... Umm, y-yes, once again, it's an honor to be here! I l-look forward to working with you! Ah! Umm, yes, I brought my pet bunny here... Good girl, good girl, go say hello to the Commander...

upgrade.line: Yes... I-I'll keep trying harder and harder!

win_mvp.line: Commander, the fleet has seized victory, and everyone made it home safe! Thank goodness...

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much, Commander! I really like it! Oh, and the bunnies seem to as well!

detail_ex.line: You want to watch me practice dancing? That's fine... b-but I'll get nervous with your eyes on me...

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, I've been learning a new dance... O-oh, no! It's not a prayer dance. It's meant to convey my love. I-if you don't mind, I'll perform it now. Please... watch me closely, Commander!

home_ex.line: Congratulations on a successful mission, Commander! Have these snacks I made and replenish your stamina... Do they taste good? Umm... I still haven't given them to my bunnies yet. I wanted you to be the first...

login_ex.line: You're finally home, Commander. My bunnies were so impatient to see you... Oh, and so was I.

main4_ex.line: M-my lap? ...N-no! I'm not against it, but... I won't be able to see your face if you do that...

main5_ex.line: Commander, the mountain critters want to see you so badly. Next time you're free, can we go visit them?

main6_ex.line: Commander... Umm, how do I post a "Juust"? I wanted to make records of our time together...

mail_ex.line: Hm? Did you bring the Commander's mail for us? Aww, who's a good girl?

touch_ex.line: U-umm... May I hold you, too, Commander?

touch2_ex.line: C-Commander... The bunnies are watching. Aah...

upgrade_ex.line: I'll protect everyone. Not just with prayer, but with my strength as well!

detail.line: May this party go smoothly, may everyone have a fun time, and may the Commander and I... Oh. There I go praying again... Huh? Y-you heard all of that?

expedition.line: The commission team brought supplies for the party! C-Commander, can you do inventory on it for me? Umm, I still haven't gotten my socks on yet...

feeling5.line: Wh-when I remember that you're here, I start shaking from nervousness... Not that I don't want you here! I-it's just... knowing you can see me... It makes me so nervous that I feel like my heart will jump out of my chest...

headtouch.line: A-are you telling me I shouldn't be so worried?

home.line: Commander... W-wait just a moment, please. I'll be dressed right away... Sorry. You offered to go to the dance party with me, and here I am wasting your time...

login.line: Huh? Is my bunny back...? Wait, C-Commander?! Awawa... Awawawa...

mail.line: There's mail for you, Commander. I'll go get – ack... I can't get my shoes on...

main1.line: Commander, c-can we practice a little more for tonight's party? I promise I won't step on your feet...

main2.line: Commander, umm... I don't really understand... how to tie this belt. Does this work...?

main3.line: I've never been to such a formal dance party. I-it's making me nervous... So, umm, thanks a lot for being so patient and staying by my side...

mission.line: More work... C-Commander, let me help! After all... It's my fault for wasting your time... Ooh...

mission_complete.line: Commander, our work is done! Let's hurry to the party! I'm really excited for it!

touch.line: C-Commander, did I dress wrong somehow?

touch2.line: Hyah?! Commander... M-my clothes are going to fall off...

unlock.line: C-Commander?! ...H-huh? It's already p-past the scheduled time? Awawa... B-but, I still haven't finished changing yet... I, umm... P-please give me just a minute!

battle.line: Let's end this before my seafood hot pot finishes cooking.

couple_encourage1.line: I brought fresh hot pot for everyone!

detail.line: Some people say goose barnacles shouldn't go in hot pot, but they taste great if you prepare them properly. I want everyone to try mine!

expedition.line: The commission team finished their job, and I have hot pot ready. Let's go greet them with it and have a big feast together.

feeling1.line: Commander... I made calming hot pot. Would you like some? Umm... I just want you to feel better...

feeling2.line: *sniff*... Your condition seems off right now. Are you sure you aren't overworking yourself to exhaustion? I'd better make a meal full of nutrients for you!

feeling3.line: I tried putting different seasonings in my hot pot this time. *sniff*... Hehe, I can smell excitement on you. You always look forward to my new creations, don't you?

feeling4.line: *sniff*... You smell really good right now, Commander... (Is it me, or is this smell... possessing me? I want to get closer... It's like I can't think straight anymore.)

feeling5.line: Commander, I've been searching for the perfect seasoning that can balance all flavors... and I think I've found it. It's the seasoning called love... When love overflows and simmers into the hot pot, the person you love is reflected in the flavor.

headtouch.line: Mm... Hehe. When you pet me, I imagine I must smell like I'm overflowing with joy.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. *sniff*... You smell like the ocean breeze. Very nice!

hp_warning.line: Things are just going to get worse at this rate...

login.line: Great work today, Commander! Hehe, this hot pot helps with fatigue. Give it a try!

lose.line: Defeat is ever so bitter...

mail.line: New mail came for you, Commander. *sniff*... It doesn't smell weird, so it should be safe to open.

main1.line: Have you ever made hot pot, Commander? What ingredients do you typically use? Call me next time you want to. It's even more fun as a team!

main2.line: Be a little bold in your selection of ingredients and cooking methods, and you might just discover a new recipe.

main3.line: (The Commander is making an odd face at my hot pot... Wait. Is the combination of tuna eyeballs and watermelon too much? It tasted good when I tried it, at least.)

mission.line: Commander, you still have untouched missions. Let me help you sort them out.

mission_complete.line: It's important to check your rewards, too. After all... you do love them, don't you? *sniff sniff*

profile.line: I am Minase, a Sendai-class light cruiser of the Sakura Empire, and I'd like to make Sakuran hot pot to warm your heart and soul. Trust me to take care of you from now on, Commander.

propose.line: This is the taste of love... It's more enticing than any other ingredient. Hehe... How blessed I am to know that I'll get to be with you forever, Commander.

touch.line: Hyah?! N-not my ears, please... Eep...

touch2.line: C-Commander! The kitchen is no place for that. Do you WANT me to spill the food?

unlock.line: There you are, Commander! *sniff*... Mm, you smell hungry. Don't worry, I'll bring fresh hot pot for you right away.

upgrade.line: *sniff*... Wow. I can distinguish scents even better than ever!

win_mvp.line: Looks like the seasoning of success will be going in today's pot.

gift_prefer.line: *sniff* *sniff*...this smell! It's the thing I've wanted this whole time! Thank you so much, Commander!

detail_ex.line: Huh? My hot pot tastes different from the usual? Hehe, I've actually been adjusting the recipe according to your mood. I can see even the slightest changes in your attitude, after all.

feeling5_ex.line: My scent? Commander, you can tell now...? Hmm... Even I can't discern it. Your scent has permeated mine for so long now that I can't tell the difference between us anymore.

headtouch_ex.line: You're a big fan of my hair, aren't you? Hehe, touch it all you want.

home_ex.line: Commander, welcome home. My hot pot of love is ready for you. Hmm? By hot pot of love, I mean one I've made just for you. Eat up, okay?

login_ex.line: Today is another day full of love. Hehe, I wish I could spend all my time wrapped up in your scent... Oh! The hot pot is almost ready! I'll dish up a serving for you first.

main4_ex.line: Hyah?! C-Commander! Don't play around while I'm cooking... Here, you can hold me in your arms. Getting to cook hot pot in my Commander's arms... I must smell of bliss right now.

main5_ex.line: Have you seen those double-headed straws with hearts in the middle? They're the perfect item for people in love! Hehe, want to try one out right now?

main6_ex.line: Ah, Commander? I'm choosing ingredients for today's hot pot right now. Did you pick something out? ...Hmm? You won't tell me? Come ooon, show me! Why are you being so secretive now? Hmph!

touch_ex.line: Commander... If you want to touch my ears that badly, then let me touch yours, too.

touch2_ex.line: Commander... My room is ready for the two of us♥

detail.line: Why am I meditating? Hmm... That's a secret. I can share it just with you, but listen – the roof of this shrine is the perfect place for meditation. Lie down here and close your eyes, and you'll discover the secret for yourself.

feeling5.line: I can start meditating easily when you're here, but if you're not, my mind tends to wander... Maybe the red string of fate has bound us too tightly to ever be untied.

headtouch.line: Mm, hehehe... Your hands are warm. It's very calming.

home.line: Zzz... Zzz... Nnh? Commander... Come take a break, would you? It'd be nice to have someone to meditate with.

login.line: The sunlight is warm, the view is lovely... The only thing that could make this better is a nice bowl of hot pot.

main1.line: When I'm meditating, these cute little creatures all start gathering around me. Heehee... Does this little fox want to train, too?

main2.line: Huh? You want me to try just jumping down when I leave? Hmm... That would be faster, but I didn't bring footwear. Oh? You'll go down first and catch me? Then... m-maybe we could try...

main3.line: Did you know that your senses sharpen while you meditate? For example, when you're sneaking glances at me... *sniff*... I can tell~

touch2.line: Eep?! C-Commander... Do you like fluffy things? Nnh... S-someone is going to see us if you keep that up!

unlock.line: Mmmm... That was a nice nap. *sniff*... Oh, Commander? I was just practicing meditation. This is the best place for it. Come and join me, if you'd like.

battle.line: Follow me! I shall pave the way for you!

detail.line: Perceiving the will of nature, wielding the might of thunder, grasping the causality of all things – that is my power. What you need in this moment is... What? To know what the weather will be like in an hour? That's really all you need?

expedition.line: The commission team is back. As my sea maps guided them, their holds must be brimming with treasure!

feeling1.line: I clearly misjudged you...

feeling2.line: Do you see the thunder over yonder? When the heavens brandish their might, the mortal world quakes in fear... Now, now, you needn't be afeard. I am your fortress.

feeling3.line: Commander! You didn't get shocked, did you?! I... I merely wished to channel the lightning to aid you, only for it to backfire... Grrgh...

feeling4.line: Heheheh... O fated one, my eyes behold the Thread of Causality that links us. Clearer is it than the trajectory of the stars, and as inescapable as thunder.

feeling5.line: Always have I kept these paired magatama with me, and solely to you do I entrust them, my fated one... Just take them! Who else could it be but you? And don't you dare lose them!

headtouch.line: Eek! How dare you touch my sacred horns... Mmgh!

home.line: O fated one, the currents whispered to me the time of your return! ...Yes, yes, I admit it! I had but a brief glance at your schedule!

hp_warning.line: My lightning... is out of control!

login.line: Secretary, you say? Hah, in other words, I am to serve you? If so fate dictates, I shall obey and minister to you.

lose.line: This is but a part of my self-cultivation as a messenger of heaven...

mail.line: O fated one, I have sorted your letters. It was only a small favor, thus you need not thank me.

main1.line: Such simple work scarcely demands much toil. O fated one, you do know how to implore me for aid, don't you?

main2.line: O fated one, behold the lightning that runs at my fingertips. This is a manifestation of nature, a– Eek! It shocked me! Urgh... How could this be...

main3.line: The wind rises from the tip of a blade of grass, a downpour cascading from the sky over yonder... This means rain will come ere long. Be prepared, fated one.

mission.line: (Hrmh... My fated one has forgotten about these missions... Should I speak up? Will I be seen as meddlesome if I do?)

mission_complete.line: O fated one, the "cause" of your missions has borne an "effect"... No, I'm merely informing you that it's time to check on your tasks.

profile.line: I am Kizu – an agent of the Divine Laws dispatched from heaven. Hm? What laws, specifically, you ask? Hrmh... The Law of Thunder, the Rule of Weather, and, um... Look, it doesn't matter!

propose.line: O fated one, let us swear an eternal vow with the heavens as our witnesses. Every daybreak and every dusk, each moment until all life breathes its last, I shall forever be with you.

touch.line: You... You miscreant! Urgh...

touch2.line: Eek! N-no... You can't... Mmph...

unlock.line: Kizu is my name, and destiny's hand led me hither to find my fated one... which is you! Heheheh – now bid me welcome with tears of gratitude! ...Why are you silent? Y-you know what – forget I said anything...

upgrade.line: My power has at last been made fully manifest... Y-you're not frightened by me, are you?

win_mvp.line: Our greatest weapon is our maps of the sea!

gift_prefer.line: A gift just for me? Heheh. How thoughtful of you!

detail_ex.line: Hrmm... I must sense what is on your mind and predict what you shall do, fated one... What you wish for right now... is to lie down with me!

feeling5_ex.line: O fated one, I have turned my two magatama into necklaces. Now, let us place them upon one another... Hereafter, even should we be worlds apart, the bond between us shall not be severed.

headtouch_ex.line: Mgh... Mmh... It has dawned on me that I've become accustomed to your touch...

home_ex.line: O fated one, I take it your journey hither was a calm one? This messenger from the heavens personally beheld it!

login_ex.line: O fated one, long have I waited so that I could first show myself to none other than you! ...M-my waiting certainly wasn't intentional, mind you!

main4_ex.line: (My fated one is updating the sea chart data... This is something I can assist with. I'd better speak up!)

main5_ex.line: O fated one, let us finish this paperwork and then share a meal, go out on a stroll, then return home... and be together forever! Heehee...

main6_ex.line: I can do more beyond predicting the weather. Behold! *bzzzt*... There! That raised the power of these electronics!

touch_ex.line: You enjoy this intimate contact, fated one? (Then I'd better... leap into your arms and let you hold me!)

touch2_ex.line: Whuh?! Y-you're doing this again... At least let me know before you start...

headtouch.line: What?! Fine, use what you will – it still won't make me budge!

home.line: Did... Did you come to laugh at me, fated one?! ...Ah, I misspoke! One more time!

login.line: Who are you?! Might you be... the lord of this mansion? So you heard the alarm and came hither... F-forget about how I look, will you?! Urgh!

main1.line: I-I know what you want! Information! But I won't give it to you! Not ever!

main2.line: (I cannot believe they're employing defenses as craven as these lasers! A play though this may be, that doesn't mean... Wait, where did they even find lasers that only dissolve clothes?!)

main3.line: That noise... The lasers must be charging! Heavens above... N-no! I can't afford to be hit by another!

touch.line: Wh-what is that you're holding? A laser pointer? ...W-wait, don't point it at me! Mrgh!

touch2.line: Eep! Wait... Not right now... I can't... Mrgh!

unlock.line: Wh-what are these lasers? My equipment, it's all... Urgh! How am I meant to continue my mission with my suit and gear all melted away?!

win_mvp.line: Having won in this attire... brings me no joy whatsoever!

battle.line: Let's mop them up all at once.

detail.line: Oh, my tail's leaking electricity again. It's your fault this time – your arrival got me a little excited, that's all... Heehee.

expedition.line: The commission team brought resources home. Hehe... That smile tells me you're quite satisfied with them.

feeling1.line: Commander, playing with you has gotten... boring.

feeling2.line: May I sit next to you? Don't say no just yet... There. My tail is wrapped around both of us now... Oh? Did I shock you again?

feeling3.line: Aww, are you going to stay with me for real this time? Great. Then I'll go ahead and clear my plans for the rest of the day!

feeling4.line: You've already made me lose interest in everything but you. Keep being interesting for me, okay, Commander? Otherwise... I might have to punish you.

feeling5.line: When I'm with you, I feel joy that I've never experienced before. Don't worry, Commander... I'll hold on tight and never let go again.

headtouch.line: Aww... Are you treating me like your pet? Heehee!

home.line: Good work today. Wanna rest your head in my lap for a bit?

hp_warning.line: I might've played around too much... Teehee!

login.line: Commander, would you like to touch my tail? I just finished grooming it... Hmm? It feels like it's crackling with electricity? Aw, am I leaking again?

lose.line: We'd better retreat... Let's run, Commander!

mail.line: You have mail. Want me to dispose of the boring and troublesome ones for you?

main1.line: When you space out, you look like such defenseless prey. If I lock this door now... Heehee!

main2.line: You have so many strange rules you have to follow... As far as I'm concerned, the only rule that should matter is, "What the Commander says, goes." Don't you think so?

main3.line: I just discovered that I can get all kinds of odd reactions from you just by talking. It's so much fun!

mission.line: You still have unfinished missions. I'll help you get them done lickety-split.

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished! How do you plan to reward my efforts, hmm?

profile.line: I'm Nayoro, she who can summon lightning even on sunny days. Hmm? Commander, I noticed you're staring at my tail... Wanna touch it? I'll try my best not to shock you.

propose.line: So the time has finally come. My heart is already yours, but in return... I'll be taking your heart, too. Through my own methods, of course!

touch.line: I'm ready to start fighting back, you know.

touch2.line: I'll pay you back double for that one!

unlock.line: Are you the Commander here? You look like you're easily taken advantage of... Don't worry, though. I'll "dispose" of anything or anyone who'd cause you trouble.

upgrade.line: I feel better than ever!

win_mvp.line: Easy win! All thanks to you, Commander.

gift_prefer.line: Hmm? Thank you! I'd love to have it.

detail_ex.line: Heehee... I haven't been able to stop myself from staring at you. You turned to look because you sensed how I feel, right? Aww... I love this cute side of you.

feeling5_ex.line: You just glanced at me, didn't you? I can tell when you're in need of some love. Heehee, come here and give me a hug!

headtouch_ex.line: Go on, touch me more.

home_ex.line: Welcome back. Need me to help you "recharge" a little? Heehee.

login_ex.line: I was just thinking about you too, Commander. Hehe, our hearts must be linked... On that note, would you like to touch my tail? It's in top form today!

main4_ex.line: Whenever you stretch, I'm reminded of a cat basking in the sunlight. It makes me want to scratch your chin... Hmm? You won't purr for me?

main5_ex.line: It's so nice to have you all to myself... Aw, are you still nervous about the electricity on my tail? But I thought your agonized struggling was your way of asking for attention.

main6_ex.line: Mm... I have to be thorough when it comes to tail maintenance. It's your favorite thing, after all, so I want it to feel good all the time.

touch_ex.line: What's wrong? Do you want another hug? Okay! Get over here, you.

touch2_ex.line: You don't need an excuse to do this anymore, you know. After all... I want more, too~

win_mvp_ex.line: We won! Since I worked so hard, why not reward me with some play time, Commander?

detail.line: I prepared this weapon just for today... Why are you staring? Are you hoping I'll use it on you? Heehee, of course I will.

feeling5.line: No matter when it is, no matter where we are, I always feel furtive eyes glancing at you... I suppose the only way to keep you safe is to keep you in arm's reach at all times, huh? Heehee!

headtouch.line: You caught me by surprise, Commander... Heehee.

home.line: You look a little tired... It's okay. Leave the rest of that trouble to me.

login.line: Heehee, I was worried that you'd gotten wrapped up in some trouble, but you made it on time after all. Any longer, and I would've come rushing to your aid!

main1.line: Let me stay with you and protect you, Commander. If you have anything else in mind, well... Zap!

main2.line: I'll control my electricity during battle so I just put our enemies to sleep. How long they sleep, well... That depends on them!

main3.line: My stun gun needs regular maintenance to stay in tip-top shape. Just like my tail, it's perfect for "convincing" you to stay with me forever~

mission.line: You have missions to do. Let's take care of that trouble together!

mission_complete.line: Missions complete. We might be the perfect combination!

touch.line: Are you worried about me? Don't be. I'll take care of the enemy in no time.

touch2.line: Do you like improvising like this, Commander? Heehee, guess I'd better play along.

unlock.line: Our rendezvous went smoothly enough... but it looks like we're being tailed by some unsavory folk. Shall we go take care of them? Don't worry – it'll be over in no time.

upgrade.line: Zzzap... Heehee, did that startle you?

battle.line: I have to do well in this battle!

detail.line: I'm a bit bored...

expedition.line: Commander! Ah... that hurts! I'm fine... I just wanted to tell you that commissions have been completed.

feeling1.line: (Furutaka ignores you as she passes by)

feeling2.line: Kako acts like that because she holds herself as the role model for heavy cruisers, but she's actually very gentle.

feeling3.line: Commander~ Oww! ...Ehehe... Thanks, I almost fell again. I'm trying to pay more attention so that I don't trip as much, but I was so happy that I let my guard down.

feeling4.line: Yeah... Being able to live with Kako and seeing my sisters from the Mikawa and 6th Fleet was always a dream of mine. Commander, you've made my dream come true. That's why... I'll do anything for you!

feeling5.line: If you're okay with this... then I don't mind, Commander. But... I've never been in a relationship before, so I don't know what it's like. Can you teach me?

home.line: Commander, I tripped again... Do you have a band-aid somewhere?

login.line: Commander, please be more careful when you open the door...

lose.line: We lost... Too bad...

mail.line: Sorry, Commander... I tripped and fell while getting the mail and now it's all wrinkled...

main1.line: Commander, Kako doesn't really hate you, so don't take it too personally.

main2.line: Um... because I'm not very smart, maybe Kako should take my place at meetings instead...

main3.line: Ouch...! Ahh, I'm fine... I just nodded off and bumped my head.

mission.line: A new mission, huh? Seems like it might be a bit tricky.

mission_complete.line: I bumped into something while getting the rewards... Oww...

profile.line: I'm the Furutaka-class heavy... Err, just call me Furutaka! I may not look it, but I participated in the First Battle of the Solomon Sea! I also helped my sister Aoba out a lot! In the end though, I rushed too far ahead and didn't make it back myself... Ehehe...

propose.line: I've never felt like this in my life before... But as long as I'm with you, I'll be able to feel this way more and more, right? I can't wait!

touch.line: What's up?

touch2.line: I never thought you'd take an interest in me, Commander... Frankly, I'm a bit happy~

unlock.line: Ah! Sorry for bumping into you... Huh? You're the Commander?! F-Furutaka, first ship of the Furutaka class, reporting for duty! Can you please forget what just happened? Ehehe...

upgrade.line: Thanks, Commander!

win_mvp.line: Eh? I'm the MVP?

gift_prefer.line: Thanks for getting my favorite gift, Commander!

battle.line: I'm much stronger than before!

couple_encourage1.line: Don't blame yourself, Aoba! It's fine.

expedition.line: It sure is nice weather, isn't it? I feel like taking a nap. Oh? The girls are back from commission~!

login.line: Commander, did you have a good rest? Me? Umm... I slept very well.

main1.line: I might have changed, but I'm still the same Furutaka, Commander!

main2.line: Ouch! Ah... I just bumped my head again...

main3.line: My hair feels a bit messy... maybe Kako can teach me how to tie it up.

touch.line: Commander~! Want to take a nap together?

touch2.line: Since you like me so much... I suppose it's okay~

unlock.line: What's wrong, Commander? Why are you staring at me like that? My body? Yes, some things seem to have gotten bigger... Want to take a look?

battle.line: In any case, I shall set the standard for heavy cruisers!

detail.line: If you want to say something, just give it to me straight!

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. Do you plan to sit here and wait for them to bring the resources to you?

feeling1.line: It seems that you'll never be able to earn my respect.

feeling2.line: I suppose I'll have to teach you how to behave in a respectable manner, Commander. Earning my acknowledgement is no easy feat, so I hope you've steeled yourself.

feeling3.line: To make this pose, put your hands here... What? You're embarrassed by me touching you? ...I'm blushing? Wh-what nonsense!

feeling4.line: You still have a long way to go, but I suppose you're doing well for now... Just how long do you plan to cling to me anyway? How despicable... it seems like you haven't learned anything yet.

feeling5.line: You've been learning quickly lately... About that... hm... If you want to experiment with me, I'm ready.

home.line: Taking a break? Well... since you put in your fair share of work, why don't you set the rest of these files aside for later?

login.line: Good timing, I just finished sorting your documents. Can you actually finish these?

lose.line: Tsk... Can't you work a bit harder?

mail.line: Mail's here. I'm surprised you have so many friends.

main1.line: This fleet is quite impressive, except for their commander.

main2.line: You made a mistake here. And here. Do I have to tell you how to do everything?

main3.line: I wonder how {namecode:55} is doing right now...

mission.line: New missions, Commander. Surely you can handle these.

mission_complete.line: So you can work hard as well, huh? Here are the rewards.

profile.line: Second ship of the {namecode:53}-class heavy cruisers, {namecode:54}! I was perhaps the first real heavy cruiser made for my country. Despite contributing to the first Battle of the Solomon Sea, I took too many risks and ended up being sunk by a submarine... My personality? I'm only like this when I'm around you. Open your eyes and learn the advantages of a real heavy cruiser!

propose.line: You've passed, but just barely! This is only the beginning... there's still a long way to go! What about me? If you want to spend the rest of your life with me, I'm ready!

skill.line: Let me show my true strength!

touch.line: Are you an idiot?

touch2.line: Why you little... Hello? Could I speak with the Military Police?

unlock.line: Second ship of the Furutaka-class, Kako, ready for orders. Why don't you show me whether you're worthy or not.

upgrade.line: I suppose I should thank you for this.

win_mvp.line: To think that you could do this much... I suppose I can offer you a word of praise.

gift_prefer.line: Hmm. Must've been a lucky guess.

detail.line: What do you want? Surely you didn't come to get lectured.

login.line: You're five minutes late, Commander!

main1.line: This is a step up from before, but you still messed up here. Are you doing this on purpose to get me angry?

main2.line: What am I writing? Your agenda, of course. Without it, you'd just slide right back to your old habits.

touch.line: I'll be here any time you have questions.

unlock.line: Performance upgraded, improvements complete. This way I can finally... *cough* Oh, it's nothing, Commander. I must simply be more strict with you in the future. Are you ready for your psychological examination?

win_mvp.line: Did you see that? This is the true power of our fleet!

battle.line: You're far too naive if you think  you can escape Aoba's eyes!

couple_encourage1.line: It's over... I'm definitely going to get yelled at again...

couple_encourage2.line: Furutaka... I'm so sorry for what happened back then...

couple_encourage3.line: 6th Fleet, set sail!

couple_encourage4.line: Let's see who has the better intuition!

detail.line: What's up? You know I charge for intel.

expedition.line: "Come see a magnificent view of girls hard at work!" ...Okay! Commander, let's pack some snacks and head to port to conduct some interviews!

feeling1.line: Maybe I should go conduct some interviews overseas...

feeling2.line: Commander, could you tell me how it feels to have such a large har- I mean, fleet?

feeling3.line: It's been a while since since I've been stationed here, so I've managed to get some good information from everyone. At first they thought you were a shady person, but you seemed to have earned their trust. Good for you!

feeling4.line: I've made my fair share of mistakes, so I thought I could help by leaving something to commemorate everyone's hard work. Sorry for saying something so unlike me... but, you made me drop my guard. Now, you have to answer my questions!

feeling5.line: Alright, I've decided. For all my precious friends here, I will record their lives! Does that include you? Oh you, don't you already know the answer to that?

home.line: Commander~ of the girls out on commission right now... who's your favorite?

hp_warning.line: It's not very funny when I'm the one on the news.

login.line: Hehe~ Commander, I saw that~!

lose.line: I... Aoba... shouldn't be getting upset over this!

mail.line: Commander, you're way to careless with information... Take it, it's your mail!

main1.line: I believe that hard work pays off, you know. Eh? Why was I following you yesterday? I don't ever recall doing anything like that~

main2.line: Say, Commander. If you let me interview you, I'll share some juicy gossip with you. Like... which girls might be looking your way~

main3.line: It's sure hard getting a scoop... Maybe... I should make some news myself!

mission.line: Missions? I'm just here to record your heroic image, Commander. Oh? I need to go too?

mission_complete.line: Commander, stop lazing around. Go get your rewards and let me take a picture!

profile.line: Hai hai! The name's Aoba! I spent most of my days in the 6th Fleet, took part in many battles with my sisters, and did my best to survive until the end. Let's drop this boring topic, shall we? I was a writer for the Navy once, so I've picked up a thing or two. Commander, anything juicy going on around you lately?

propose.line: Just to be clear, I'm not good at this kind of stuff... so don't expect me to say anything romantic... ever! Well, maybe just once... Um... I... l-l-love... you!

touch.line: Ah, a good idea, finally! This will definitely make the front page!

touch2.line: Commander... It's not wise to mess with reporters.

unlock.line: Hmm, hmm... I can smell it. This fleet is going to make the headlines! So you're the Commander, huh? Just let me, Aoba, gather all the information without holding back!

upgrade.line: I think I'm getting closer to my next big scoop. Thanks, Commander~!

win_mvp.line: Okay, time to get a quick word from the losing side. Eh? Leaving already?

gift_prefer.line: Hmhmm? Should I write a few nice words about you?

battle.line: Everyone! Stay alert, protect yourself, and don't be reckless!

couple_encourage1.line: Stop looking around, sister!

detail.line: Health comes first!

expedition.line: Commander, since you didn't go yourself, you should at least welcome back the girls who worked hard on the commission!

feeling1.line: It's not like I care what you do...

feeling2.line: Did you clean your room, Commander? Did you lock the door? Have you forgotten anything?

feeling3.line: Don't be too hard on my sister... She actually has a lot of guilt buried in her heart.

feeling4.line: I don't really like lecturing people... but I've gotten used to lecturing my sister, and you don't seem to mind. Eh? You actually appreciate it? Then... I guess I'll keep it up...

feeling5.line: Aoba is always so impatient! But she's my big sis, and she's very important to me. Just like you, Commander. You're precious to me as well!

home.line: Commander, it's important to balance work and rest. Since you just got back, why not take a quick break?

hp_warning.line: Don't panic. Get into formation!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! Did you get enough to eat? If you're still hungry, I can cook something for you!

lose.line: We need to call a meeting and review this performance...

mail.line: Commander, do I have to tell you to check your mail every single time?

main1.line: Did you rest well, Commander? Health comes first!

main2.line: I'm not sure if Aoba is getting enough rest... Please make sure to check up on her!

main3.line: Work hard, play hard! That's the secret to a happy life!

mission.line: Commander, work will only pile up if you keep putting it off!

mission_complete.line: Commander, leaving your rewards there won't make them grow.

profile.line: Good day, I'm Kinugasa! I was in the 6th Fleet with my sister Aoba before it was disbanded. We fought together in many battles, like Wake Island, the Coral Sea, and the Solomon Islands. I'm not as lucky as her though... Anyways, Commander, try not to overwork yourself! Rest is important too!

propose.line: Jeez, Commander. Your sleeves and collar are messy as always, even for such an important occasion. I'll lecture you later~ let's carry on with the ceremony!

touch.line: Commander, did you also come to wind down with some light stretching?

touch2.line: Please take a seat, Commander. We're going to discuss fleet discipline.

unlock.line: Pleased to meet you! I'm Kinugasa. Have you been eating and sleeping well,  Commander? Don't be like my big sis... Speaking of which, is she also here by any chance?

upgrade.line: Being wasteful is no good, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Everyone, don't let your guard down just because we won!

gift_prefer.line: Commander? Ah... my apologies, I almost started launching into another lecture... Thank you very much.

battle.line: I've already seen through your tricks, hehe.

couple_encourage1.line: Leave reconnaissance to me!

couple_encourage2.line: Let's take care of this and get back in one piece.~

detail.line: Knowledge is power. Not only in battle, but for everything else as well... right?

expedition.line: Hm... According to my seaplanes, it seems like the commissions team is almost here.

feeling1.line: I'm sorry. I'm not sure I can deal with someone like you...

feeling2.line: Let's see what my seaplanes' eyes have captured for me this time.

feeling3.line: Oh, are you curious about the intel I've gathered? Mm, like how everyone at the port feels about you? Just kidding, of course♪

feeling4.line: Mm... Even if there's something you really want to know, I can't just tell you... Right, how about this? You listen to one of my requests, and I'll tell you one thing you want to know in exchange. Hehehe♪

feeling5.line: Hehe. As payment for the secret I told you, you'll be taking me out on a date♪ ...No refunds allowed, of course.

headtouch.line: Are you trying to get my ears to spring up? Hehe~

home.line: Good work out there. Why don't you get started on the combat report? This experience will become the foundation for your next victory, after all.

hp_warning.line: This is nothing... This won't make me fall behind...!

login.line: Let's see... Well, it looks like you're right on time. Welcome back, Commander.

lose.line: It's because I wasn't able to get enough info on them...

mail.line: There's some new mail for you. Please make sure not to look over any new information.

main1.line: You want to know what people are saying about you? ...You know, if you're that curious, I suggest that you dig around a bit yourself.

main2.line: This is some juicy info here... Hm, I bet Aoba would love to hear about this~

main3.line: Just like the "eyes" on my seaplanes need maintenance, our eyes should be maintained properly as well. That way, we can make sure they work well when they need to.

mission.line: Commander, I don't think it's a good habit to neglect your duties.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards... Lots of things here, so I'll leave the accounting to you♪

profile.line: I'm the Tone-class heavy cruiser, Chikuma. I can carry more seaplanes than my heavy cruiser counterparts—you could say I've got plenty of eyes in the sky. I'm good at the art of knowing things, don't you think so? Hehehe.

propose.line: Are you disappointed that I'm not surprised at all? Don't be, I really am, you know? It's just that I'm so happy, it far exceeds any surprise I might've felt~♡ Hehehe~♪

skill.line: Knowledge is the key to victory♪

touch.line: If you want some help, you should organize the information first.

touch2.line: Looks like I've grasped another weakness of yours, Commander♪

unlock.line: I am Chikuma. Pleased to make your acquaintance. Well, that might be the case, but I already know a bit about you... My, are you curious? You'll find out before long, hehe.

upgrade.line: My reconnaissance abilities have grown even sharper~

win_mvp.line: As long as the intel is correct, victory is guaranteed... Ehe♪

gift_prefer.line: Oh my, did you do a bit of homework on me, Commander? Thank you~

detail_ex.line: Hm~? Are you curious about what I was doing? I was collecting info, of course. You unexpectedly have a lot of openings. Hehe~♡

feeling5_ex.line: Oh, are you asking me on a date? Mm~ What should I tell you in return... Hehehe, how about... the place I'd like to go today~?

home_ex.line: Good work out there. Leave the combat report to me. You... should relax for a bit. Hehe.

login_ex.line: Oh, it looks like you're up early today... Very praiseworthy of you, Commander.

main4_ex.line: Calm down, Commander. If there were rumors any floating around about you, I'd tell them off. You're even more worried now? My my...

main5_ex.line: So, about those affection points... Mm, well, I'm maxed out, but... would you like to find out about some of the other girls? Hehehe.

mission_ex.line: Well, whatever you might be worried about, let's focus on knocking that mission out together.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission rewards? Well... Hehe, let's check on them together.

touch_ex.line: My, what am I going to do with you... So, what is it that you'd like~?

touch2_ex.line: Your tastes... Hehehe, there's no way I wouldn't know by now, right~

win_mvp_ex.line: As long as I'm able to gather information with my seaplanes, this should be the expected result. Hehe.

detail.line: Usually, I don't share what I've learned from my Eyes with anyone... But if you beat me, or if you can provide something more interesting, I'd be happy to. Hehe.

feeling5.line: *sigh*... It wounds me to keep beating you, it really does... What to do? Maybe you could trade me something I'm interested in, instead? ...Hehe, you're being even more dense than usual~ What I'm most interested in YOU, and the secret information I have to offer is... the fact that we're on a date♪

headtouch.line: Oh, are you tired? Let's take a break.

home.line: Thank you for your efforts. I'm ever so taken by your unyielding spirit, despite your many losses. Hehe.

login.line: Welcome back. I prepared a delicious, refreshing drink for you. Partake, and perhaps we can continue our game.

main1.line: Hehe, there was one reason I won: I simply know you too well, observe you too keenly.

main2.line: Hmm? You didn't know about my Eyes until now? Hehe, don't underestimate me♪

main3.line: Your eyes are practically glued to my chest~ Do you want seconds? Here you go~♪

touch2.line: Oh, my~ Is this how you plan to win? Try all you like♪

unlock.line: Commander, would you like to share a drink... or play a game together? If you win, I'll share some secret intel that you're sure to love.

battle.line: Let's see the fruits of my daily training! All guns, open fire!

detail.line: Commander, acquiring intel is the first step to victory.

expedition.line: Commission complete! Is everyone putting forward their best effort?

feeling1.line: Stop slacking off, Commander!

feeling2.line: It is not unusual for a weaker force to defeat a stronger one in a naval battle. Victory or defeat is often decided by good judgment and split-second decision making. We must be thorough in our training in order to cultivate these abilities.

feeling3.line: Commander, remember to take breaks as needed. Your efficiency will be worse if you run out of stamina... Lap... pillow? It's fine by me... but will it really help you recover faster?

feeling4.line: I saw your light on, so I came to check on you. I had no idea you'd still be awake; even being a workaholic should have its limits! Come on, I'm not leaving until you fall asleep.

feeling5.line: Commander, I've finished processing those files. It's the end of the day, so why don't we grab dinner together? ... ... How's it taste?

headtouch.line: ... Please do this kind of thing to destroyers, not me...

home.line: This method of relaxing is inefficient. Why not try some of my specially-made energy drink?

login.line: Would you like some homemade pancakes, Commander?

lose.line: It's all because I neglected my daily training... Everyone, I'm sorry...

mail.line: New mail has arrived! Is this the latest training manual?

main1.line: If I get another chance... I'd like to pet Hatsukaze's head again.

main2.line: I've put on weight?! Commander... there are some things that even you shouldn't say.

main3.line: Bergall?! Phew... you were talking about someone else.

mission.line: Commander, please don't hesitate to ask for help!

mission_complete.line: Don't call it a day after finishing just one mission!

profile.line: I am {namecode:63}, of the Sakura Empire's {namecode:63}-class heavy cruisers. I participated in both the glorious victory of the Java Sea and the humiliating defeat at Leyte Gulf. Afterwards, I was struck by a torpedo and pursued by submarines. In the end, I could only watch from the South as my nation surrendered. It is hard to say whether that was fortune or misfortune. Anyways, Commander, you can always talk to me if something is on your mind.

propose.line: Commander, your body is no longer just yours alone. Make sure you take care of yourself properly... for me, okay?

skill.line: Burn this final sight into your memory!

touch.line: I'm supervising the destroyers' training right now. Please save it for later if it's not an emergency.

touch2.line: ... Commander, have some self-respect...

unlock.line: I am, {namecode:63}, first ship of the {namecode:63}-class heavy cruisers. Commander, is there anything I can help you with?

upgrade.line: I won't let such a small improvement get to my head.

win_mvp.line: This victory was made possible by everyone's efforts, not just my own!

gift_prefer.line: Commander, your feelings are reaching me.

battle.line: Hmph. Another bunch of blind idiots.

detail.line: What is it? Do you want to be my lackey?

expedition.line: Mmhmm. It's important to work hard! Well, unless you're me!

feeling1.line: I wasn't talking to you!

feeling2.line: Commander, you're going to be unpopular forever if you don't pay attention to your appearance.

feeling3.line: Hard work? Not at all. A genius like me doesn't need to work hard. I get stronger just by breathing.

feeling4.line: Huh? Commander? What are you doing at the training area so late? You were worried about me? I-I was just taking a walk because I was bored. You heard cannon fire? Th-that was...

feeling5.line: I can't be honest with myself... because I can't stand the thought of people seeing me work hard... except for you, Commander. No matter who I become, surely you would...

home.line: Good work. However, you won't be able to catch up to me with even ten times the effort!

login.line: I-I'm not training.. I'm just... being lazy and laughing at the other girls as they work up a sweat.

lose.line: Damn it... just what went wrong?

mail.line: You want your mail? Only if you beg me nicely~

main1.line: My sisters in the Fifth Fleet? I miss them a bit... err, just once in a blue moon!

main2.line: Ghosts on the training ground? W-what are you, a kid? Who'd believe something like that?

main3.line: Salt Lake City? I'm going to show her that Lady Luck doesn't bless the same person forever!

mission.line: Only an idiot would be unable to complete such an easy mission.

mission_complete.line: Heheh, looks like you couldn't have done this mission without me!

profile.line: I am {namecode:64}, second ship of the {namecode:63}-class heavy cruisers. Though I said second ship, I am no "little sister". I fought my way all around the Pacific, and served as flagship multiple times. I am greatest heavy cruiser - bear witness to my elegance and power!

propose.line: I know I have a hard time being honest with myself, but... I'll try my best to make you the happiest person in the world! I swear my name on it!

touch.line: Commander, are you feeling lonely? I just happen to have more spare time than I know what to do with~

touch2.line: I-idiot... you're that fascinated with me? At least tell me in advance...

unlock.line: I'm {namecode:64}, the first post-treaty heavy cruiser from the Sakura Empire. My design is the very definition of perfection! I'll be in your care from here on out!

upgrade.line: I'm even more flawless than before!

win_mvp.line: Hehe, this is only normal, of course.

gift_prefer.line: This is for me? I appreciate it a lot!

detail.line: A gift? It's not like I asked you to go and buy this for... Hahaaah, I guess you're so used to running around and getting things for me that you couldn't help yourself! Well... Sure, I'll take it!

expedition.line: The commission team is really working hard. Heheh, hurry and go check out those rewards.

home.line: Thanks for your hard work~ Oh, you brought back tons of spoils... O-of course, you are working, like, fifteen times harder than before. I know you're catching up to me... *blushes*

login.line: The perfect Nachi put together your daily schedule for you! Now, let's get some work done!

lose.line: I don't know what went wrong, but... Let's run away, Commander!

main1.line: Lately, I've been running into Haguro early in the mornings... Hm? You say I should train somewhere else? Good idea... Instead of the Sakura Empire dorm, I should come to your—no, I obviously can NOT do that!

main2.line: You're feeling anxious? Hmm... Why not try working or crafting something to take your mind off of it? Like, say, origami?

main3.line: Whoa, you're just openly slacking off... Heheh, then I'll just... NOT join you, obviously! C'mon, Commander! There's work to be done!

mission.line: These missions are so simple, they could be done instantly. I know I could, but surely even you can, Commander!

mission_complete.line: You didn't even need my help! Heheh♪

touch.line: Feeling lonely, Commander? Heheh, same here... Uh, I mean, I'm just so darn bored!

touch2.line: Hm? What's up... Hyah?! H-hey, did you just do that on purpose?!

unlock.line: Howzit? Now that my retrofit's all done, don't I look even more perfect than before? Maybe now, our ever-so-reserved Commander here will be super impressed by my new abilities~ Wh-what do you mean I've been staying up too late training with my rigging? W-we're not gonna talk about that!

win_mvp.line: Get on your knees and beg, and maybe I'll forgive you♪ See how tolerant I am?

battle.line: Everyone, advance! The fortunes of war are with us!

couple_encourage1.line: Myoukou, we finally get to fight together!

detail.line: No matter how much you stare at me, I won't get any stronger... Commander, wouldn't it be better for me to sortie?

expedition.line: Commander, the commission fleet has returned.

feeling1.line: Commander, if I am a nuisance to you, please let me know...

feeling2.line: Commander, you wish to survey my room? That's fine... but please give me a moment to tidy up first.

feeling3.line: U-um.. I'm not very dexterous, but I'd like you to have this origami crane that I made... though I'm not sure you can really call it a crane. I've always wanted to do something like this...

feeling4.line: Commander, what's the special occasion? You even brought my toiletry and wash towel to my bedside today... woooahh! It's already this late? I completely overslept!

feeling5.line: Sorry, Commander... when you weren't here, I started feeling uneasy and... before I knew it, I had already folded a hundred paper cranes... Um, that's weird, isn't it...

home.line: Commander, it's fine to rest every now and then, but please don't go overboard with it.

hp_warning.line: This is the hour of reckoning! Chaaarge!!

login.line: You're finally back... Commander, would you spare some time to spar with me?

lose.line: I... I can keep fighting!

mail.line: The postman has already finished their job. Commander, why don't you go take a look?

main1.line: "Let your victories not be decided by the strength of your equipment, but by your abilities." That is what Myoukou taught me.

main2.line: "Let those who think of the Sakura Empire also think of your name?" Hmm... Yes, that is a goal that I indeed have been working towards.

main3.line: Commander, thank you for training with me every day. I'll continue to refine myself!

mission.line: There are still a lot of missions left... Commander, I don't quite understand how to do some of these. I hope I'm not dragging you down...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Commander, why don't you go check the rewards first?

profile.line: I am Ashigara, third ship of the Myoukou-class heavy cruisers. I had the privilege and glory of representing the Sakura Empire in the Royals' Coronation Fleet Review. My habitability? W-well... some things must be sacrificed in order to survive on the battlefield.

propose.line: Commander, sneak attacks are against the rules... There's no one else around, right? Th-then... maybe it's okay to cling a little bit. Commander, you're so warm...

touch.line: I got this from Myoukou. I often record what she says, so I can listen to her words when I have free time. Eh? Is that weird?

touch2.line: Ack...! U-um... I need to ask Myoukou about what I should do in this situation...

unlock.line: Ashigara, reporting for duty. Commander, my blade shall cut down all your enemies.

upgrade.line: Yes! With this, I'm full of energy!

win_mvp.line: N-not bad... I suppose... *blushes*

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much, Commander.

battle.line: My appearances shouldn't affect my combat performance... In any case, let's advance!

detail.line: "There's no need to overexert yourself." That's what Myoukou told me, anyway. Commander, hopefully you're not pushing yourself too hard?

home.line: Phew... Let's take a break, Commander.

login.line: You'd like to train with me? Of course! Even dressed like this, I have no intention of losing!

main1.line: It's hard to put my hair up like this... Thanks to Myoukou's help, I was somehow able to manage...

main2.line: I can't sit here doing nothing all the time... Commander, if there's anything you need help with, please give me the order!

main3.line: This is how you do the lap pillow thing, right? I heard that it would help you recover from fatigue...

touch.line: Commander, is something bothering you?

touch2.line: Umm... C-Commander, Myoukou said that you shouldn't do stuff like this...

unlock.line: Phew... I finally managed to fix my dress... but I just can't seem to get used to it. Commander, how does my dress look? It's not strange, is it?

detail.line: I originally planned to bring headphones to listen to the soothing sound of Myoukou's... Err, I meant to say music! But, it might be more calming to just listen to the waves.

home.line: I heard there are lots of crabs hiding on this beach. I wonder if I can snag a couple...

login.line: The cool, pristine waves splashing across my skin... What a comforting sensation.

main1.line: Under the azure skies, the seagulls and crabs also thrive... the summer seaside also has life of its own.

main2.line: I promised to play beach volleyball with Myoukou and Nachi, but we have an odd number of people... Commander, why don't you join us?

main3.line: Myoukou, I brought my training equipment. Today's regimen is... Oh, I don't need it today?

touch.line: Commander, did you want to take a break? ...Ahem! H-h-how about a l-l-lap pillow?

touch2.line: Eep?! ...Oh, I had cream stuck on me? Th-thank you, Commander...

unlock.line: This whole "fashion coordination" concept is still a bit hard for me to wrap my head around, so I'm glad Nachi helped me pick out a swimsuit. Now, I just need to... Hey, Commander! Open your mouth! H-huh?! But this is what Nachi told me to do... is there some sort of problem?!

battle.line: Give me a bit, and I'll get to it!

couple_encourage1.line: I'll get'em, Myoukou!

couple_encourage2.line: I really hate standing out...

couple_encourage3.line: Maybe I shouldn't have taught you how to fold paper cranes...

detail.line: So sleepy... Hm? You wanna know why...? Erm, it's none of your business... Err, I guess it's not right for me to hide stuff from you, Commander... Alright, I'll fess up! I pulled an all-nighter playing video games!

expedition.line: Commissions completed. What are you staring at me like an idiot for? Let's head out and greet'em.

feeling1.line: ...I'll take care of you right here, right now. Just kidding, I'd hate to lower everyone else's morale around here.

feeling2.line: *Yaaaaawn*... So tired... Don't you feel tired at all? Don't force yourself too much, or ya'll set a bad example for other girls who'd follow the lead and overwork themselves.

feeling3.line: Well, it's time to keep watch over the Commander's sleeping hours... Huh? Y-you still haven't gone to sleep?! This wasn't supposed to... I-I'm, um... looking for someone to play video games together!

feeling4.line: Commander, I apologize for having lied to you... Truth is, I didn't pull an all-nighter playing video games, I was actually carrying out some late-night missions... D-does it matter what my excuse is? I could blame a tengu, and nobody would believe me anyway!

feeling5.line: Ahaha, Commander, it's not good to intrude on people at this hour. But, um... if you'd like, why don't you join me in playing some video games? Not like there are any missions left to take care of, and it doesn't look like you're able to fall asleep anyhow... I-it's not a bother for you, is it?

headtouch.line: Hmm...?

home.line: *Yaaawn*. Oh, you're back... Guess I'm done for now... Wait, there's more to do, isn't there...

hp_warning.line: Who cares about miracles, so long as I can protect my friends...!

login.line: Mornin'. Oh, you're already here? Aren't you the real diligent type...

lose.line: So frickin' annoying... Ugh, we're backing off for now.

mail.line: You've got some letters. Yeah, yeah. I'll go get'em for you.

main1.line: Ya need me to tidy up around here? Sure thing. Then, if you'd please leave the office for around fifteen minutes...

main2.line: *Yaaaaawn* I'm beat... Having Myoukou lecture me first thing in the morning, then having Ashigara fret over me... Well, of course I know it's for my sake, but...

main3.line: Hmm? Ya heading out? Then I'll—what? You don't mind if I come with you, right...?

mission.line: Here're your missions. I'm here focusing on the ones you've assigned me, so good luck on yours.

mission_complete.line: Hm? You've already finished your missions? Nice, good stuff.

profile.line: Myoukou-class heavy cruiser, Haguro here. As you can see, I'm just a normal heavy cruiser who made things happen during night battles and stuff in the Great War. A miracle ship...? I mean, I've been called that before, but... it's embarrassing to be called that to my face...

propose.line: A-a pledge ring?! This has to be some kind of joke... No way. I mean, I'm perfectly fine with it, but are you fine with me...? I-I mean... I'm a total night owl...

skill.line: See if you can spot me!

touch.line: Hmhmm~ Oh, 'sup Commander?

touch2.line: What the...???

unlock.line: Guess you're the Commander, huh... Wassup? I'm part of the team now or whatever. You just mind your own biz and I'll mind mine.

upgrade.line: So as long as you put something trendy on... Don't mind me.

win_mvp.line: Piece of cake. Not much else for me to say, really.

gift_prefer.line: Real nice stuff! Thanks a bunch, Commander!

detail_ex.line: What'll you be having me do today? Eh, you don't have anything in mind? You just want me to sleep for once... Is that my mission? Or are you trying to scold me like Myoukou? E-either way, I know it's for my sake, but...

expedition_ex.line: Commission completed. Now we need to welcome the girls back, right? Yeah, yeah. I know.

home_ex.line: Another win under your belt, huh? Nah, I'm not annoyed or anything, it's just... I'd like to prove my mettle on the battlefield instead of housesitting back here.
