login_ex.line: *Yaaawn*... Commander, you're always so early. What'll we be starting off with today?

lose_ex.line: I'll be sure to protect you at any cost, Commander...!

main4_ex.line: Whew... everything's sparkling clean now. Tidying up the office always lifts my spirits. Same goes for you, right?

main5_ex.line: Whenever I wake up early, I always end up bumping into Nachi, and the atmosphere always gets all awkward... Commander, you should watch out as well.

main6_ex.line: It's surprisingly a lot of work being your bodyguard. Not only do I have to watch out for your safety, but also for the other girls who try to... N-never mind what I just said...

mission_ex.line: You've still got some missions left. Plannin' on staying up late to finish 'em? Alright, but I'll stay here with you 'til you call it a day.

touch2_ex.line: Pfft, hahaha... No need to be nervous. I'm not the angry type like Myoukou.

win_mvp_ex.line: I'm the MVP this time around~! Whew, who would've thought a proper night's sleep would make such a difference?

detail.line: My skirt? Yeah, I'm wearing a skirt today... My skirt! S-stop, don't look! ...Ugh, what am I supposed to do about this now...

expedition.line: Commissions completed. What are you staring at me for, let's go greet'em already. ...You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine. Jeez.

home.line: You alright? Not hurt anywhere, are ya? Ehehe, I was just thinking that we could slack off together if you had happened to injure your foot as well.

login.line: Zzz... Oh no, I almost fell asleep while sitting down... Ah, Commander! Welcome back.

main1.line: Everyone's working together to clean up this pop-up café. It's designed specially to entertain you to the fullest, so everyone's working diligently... Perhaps too diligently, since that's why I slipped and hurt my foot.

main2.line: Musashi dotes on people so much, she's bound to spoil a bunch of girls rotten... I've always been rotten to the core, so I'll be fine, but... What about you, Commander? Would you like to be spoiled rotten?

main3.line: As our exemplar, Mikasa really is so frickin' cool... Compared to her, I'm just a clumsy brat... Ahaha...

touch.line: You want to treat my injury? T-thanks a lot... *blush*

touch2.line: W-what are you planning on doing to me...?

unlock.line: Ow! That freakin' stings... Can't believe I actually slipped on the stairs and hit my foot. Just how clumsy am I? ...Oh, Commander? Uh, welcome?

detail.line: If I move, you're gonna see everything... No, I don't want you to see my bits! Mmrgh!

feeling5.line: Good! Keep it up! Almost there! Aaand, failed again. Hmm... I'd feel better if you could at least take the chocolate, but it's just not gonna work out. Ahaha! Thanks for trying, Commander.

home.line: Really missed my chance to give out chocolate, huh? ...Hm? N-nobody said you were the one I was most excited to give chocolate to, okay, Commander?

login.line: Man, is there any way to get out of this thing... Hm? You'll stay with me until help comes, Commander? ...For real?

main1.line: It's a little cramped in here, but eh, I'll be fine. Akashi should be here soon... She'd lose money if nobody can play it, right?

main2.line: Yaaawn... My bad. I'm a little sleepy... This thing's ventilated, so don't worry about me.

main3.line: I wonder if Ashigara managed to give the Commander her chocolate. Pfft, I bet she'd tell me to focus on my own problems first... Yeeeah.

touch.line: M-move the claw carefully, okay? You'll crush the chocolate...

touch2.line: Wh-why are you going straight for THAT place?!

unlock.line: H-hey, help me out! ...No, I didn't come in here for fun. When I finished my security duty last night, I got to thinking about how I was going to give you chocolate for Valentine's and fell asleep. When I woke up, I was stuffed in this thing...

battle.line: Please leave combat to me. I shall not shame my title of being "The Strongest!"

detail.line: Small strokes fell great oaks, constant drops pierce through rock. Those who train through the most humdrum of days shall seize victory in the most critical of moments. That is my belief.

expedition.line: Your fleet has returned from commission. Want to welcome them back?

feeling1.line: A sword has no eyes. It would be wise to avoid approaching me casually.

feeling2.line: Do you need anything? If not, I'm going back to work.

feeling3.line: It might be pretty nice to just set aside my duties and have a relaxing conversation with you every once in a while, Commander.

feeling4.line: Recently, I haven't been able to keep my composure during training.. Just from thinking about you, my form becomes sloppy. If I am like this, would you still want to keep me by your side?

feeling5.line: No matter how badly I'm injured, I will make sure to always return to your side. So... Commander, could you always stay with me as well?

headtouch.line: ...I-is my hair a mess? Pardon me for showing you my unsightly side... I'll clean myself up right away!

home.line: I'm glad that you came back safe and sound.

hp_warning.line: Be still as water...!

login.line: {namecode:66} standing by. What are your orders?

lose.line: I was careless... I definitely will not fail next time!

mail.line: Commander, there's new mail. Shall I bring it for you?

main1.line: Even back in port, we must not lower our guard. Danger lurks around every corner.

main2.line: Commander, not even you could withstand my blade.

main3.line: Daily refinement means to continually strive towards your goals. Commander, may your focus never falter.

mission.line: New tasks have been assigned - would you like to confirm them?

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished! Are we going to collect the rewards?

profile.line: I am {namecode:66}, first ship of the {namecode:66}-class heavy cruisers. I may not look like it, but I have already crossed through countless battlefields. Please place your faith in my firepower and armor, and be at ease.

propose.line: For you to acknowledge me like this, Commander, is the greatest honor. From now on, this blade shall serve only you. Please continue to treat me kindly.

touch.line: E-enemies?! Oh... It was you, Commander? Apologies - my eyesight isn't the best.

touch2.line: Kyaa! You scared me... how shameless!

unlock.line: Are you the Commander? Please allow this lowly {namecode:66} to offer you what little strength she has.

upgrade.line: Power... flows through my blade!

win_mvp.line: Hm... Once again, I've cut a worthless object.

gift_prefer.line: A-are you sure you want to give something this nice to me?

feeling5_ex.line: I see... "Love" can make even the most invincible of warriors vulnerable, but it can also become the sharpest of blades that cuts through all hesitation... This is why a warrior mustn't fear love.

headtouch_ex.line: This goes against the principles of the warrior's path, but... w-with you, once in a while... I suppose it's fine...

login_ex.line: It felt like someone was watching me train... So it was you, Commander. If you're so interested, stay and watch for a while longer.

main4_ex.line: Phew... Another day's training complete. If you're interested, I could show you my newest technique. Or if you'd prefer to drink tea and relax with me... that, too, is acceptable.

main5_ex.line: Shall we patrol the port together? Even the sea breeze feels more refreshing when we walk together.

main6_ex.line: Excellent. Now that I've attained such martial mastery, nobody will ever be able to hurt you.

touch_ex.line: I knew it was you, Commander. There's no need to be so surprised. I know everything about you, down to the sound of your footsteps.

touch2_ex.line: C-Commander... You're trying to get me flustered for your own entertainment, aren't you?!

detail.line: I may have lost to Miss Saratoga in sandcastle building, but I shall redeem myself in beach volleyball.

home.line: Good work, Commander. ...What? Miss Saratoga is going to join Team Royal during the beach volleyball tournament? I see... a chance for payback has come!

login.line: Of course I can sympathize with the others. In this kind of heat, it is important to get some rest. However, we mustn’t neglect our training!

main1.line: Miss Saratoga wants to challenge me? Fine. Swimming, volleyball... just name it. I’ll take her on.

main2.line: Atago, did you bring my sunglasses?

main3.line: Relax, Commander. I didn’t bring this kendo sword to hit you with. It’s because I heard that someone from the Royal Navy is going to be here. Heh, just kidding. It’s because Atago is scared of ghosts~

touch.line: The younger girls are all so energetic... Commander, did you know you can tell their age by when they were launched?

touch2.line: Don’t touch me! I’m working on a sand castle... it has to be at least 70% bigger than Sara’s!

unlock.line: Commander, even I’ll get embarrassed if you keep staring at me like that... Eh? Why did I bring a volleyball? Did you not order me to bring it?

detail.line: Oh no, the ink... Commander, don't step on the paper!

login.line: Commander, welcome back. Pardon me for making a mess; I'll clean it up right away.

main1.line: Qipao? Atago picked it out, saying you like this kind of outfit. How is it?

main2.line: What? "Fortune" is the only thing that needs to be written? I thought I could write whatever I wanted...

main3.line: Commander, can I try writing your name next? Hm? No particular reason... I just felt like it.

touch.line: It would be great if I could really bring "Fortune" to Commander and everyone else with my calligraphy.

touch2.line: Commander?! I-I won't be able to write like this...!

unlock.line: Calligraphy is also a form of self-cultivation, so I am instructing the children... Commander, would you also like to join?

battle.line: I'll show you why they call me the "School's Strongest!"

detail.line: A balanced school life is a part of the responsibilites here. Surely, I will develop valuable and translatable skills through the process of going to school.

login.line: Woah! C-Commander? When did you get here? I-I'm sorry, I'm still not ready yet...

main1.line: Commander, even if you're at school, you can't slack off too much!

main2.line: What clubs am I interested in joining... I wonder if there's a kendo club...

main3.line: This uniform was supposed to fit, so why is it so tight... C-Commander?! What are you staring at!?

touch.line: This Woofy strap here? Atago gave it to me and said it'd help me look less uptight. Jeez, I'm not uptight at all...

unlock.line: Hmm... school life, huh? It's a fairly fresh experience for me. Would it be fine to pin my hair up like this? What do you think, Commander?

win_mvp.line: Phew... I suppose that's a good warm up.

detail.line: I will give my all to fulfill any task I've been assigned... B-but, Commander, could you not stare at me so much? It's a bit... embarrassing...

home.line: F-finally, you're back... With so many people staring at me, I was so hoping that you'd come back soon...

login.line: Sitting in this same pose is rather tiring, but this is also part of my training. After all, improving my flexibility should not be something that goes to waste...

main1.line: The flashes from the camera are a bit too bright, but worry not about me. Commander, I shall face down each and every challenge before me.

main2.line: I should try to maintain my smile at times like these? If you say so... then I shall do as you advised to the utmost of my ability.

main3.line: Commander, would you mind holding onto my parasol for a bit? I need to fix my hair accessory...

touch.line: I should change my pose to make it easier to take pictures? V-very well... Ugh... Th-this is too embarrassing after all...!

touch2.line: I, I'm still working right now...!

unlock.line: Ugh... S-such shameless attire... If not for Atago saying that it would benefit me to experience different things...! It looks good on me?! I, I see...

win_mvp.line: Calm your spirit and dedicate yourself to the task... I want to believe that this is part of my training!

battle.line: I, heavy cruiser Takao, shall be the exorcist's blade!

detail.line: We may be able to dart about freely here, but a battlefield isn't so unrestricted. Don't be arrogant over good results in exercises, and remember that it's important to learn from real experience. ...Say, Commander, why don't you join me for a while longer?

expedition.line: The commission fleet has made their return. Commander, wouldn't now be the ideal time to greet them?

home.line: Haaaah! ...Oh, you? I just finished dispatching the enemies here. Let's explore a little longer and take a break.

login.line: Commander, get behind me! They may just be set pieces, but it'll still hurt if you get hit by debris.

lose.line: Kh... Commander... I've made a mistake!

mail.line: A letter, hm? ...I almost sliced it by accident...

main1.line: Miss Kirishima taught me ninja techniques, and Miss Washington instructed me in martial arts. I will flinch from no foe!

main2.line: I can defeat enemies more quickly by using my rigging release technique, but that would endanger you, Commander. How can I respond if you're taken hostage? Kh...

main3.line: "Tentacle demon Observer, abomination of the deep! I, shipninja Takao, will strike you down!" Hm... Will this do for my fighting stance?

mission.line: ...I'll carry out any task you ask of me.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Claim your rewards, but beware of any devious traps.

touch.line: Commander, watch out! Sorry... My first reaction was to hold you in my arms. Hm? Something of mine is touching you? Ah...

touch2.line: C-Commander...?! Are you being possessed by some evil spell... Kh?!

unlock.line: My five senses are sharper than ever, perhaps even TOO sharp. No matter what trap awaits, my only way forward is to pierce through and focus on overcoming this trial... Haaah!

win_mvp.line: A little damage to my clothing won't affect me. As long as I have an arm to swing my blade, rigging to fire my cannons, and the will to fell my foes, I can fight on!

detail.line: Mental fortitude is all about discarding the false and embracing the true, conveying a unique message to another through one's bearing alone... Was that hard to understand? Then watch me, and you will surely understand.

feeling5.line: I try to keep my mind free of distractions, but your unwavering gaze is... perhaps a little unsettling. As I am now, if I keep eye contact with you for more than three seconds, I'll surely expose a weakness... Will you help me train my way through this, Commander?

headtouch.line: Am I still too tense? Apologies... I'm sure I'll be more confident once I have tried a few more outfits on.

home.line: Back already, Commander?! I-I was... in the middle of trying a new technique... Consider it a little sneak peek!

login.line: Hmm. Commander, I am prepared. I'll strike the perfect pose to show you true mental fortitude!

main1.line: I see. The more one self-cultivates, the more naturally one can face dangerous situations... Watch carefully. My performance displays true mastery, does it not?

main2.line: This fabric has such a different texture from the ones I usually wear. It's light, but when I wear it... I feel oddly sensitive.

main3.line: Am I cold? Don't worry about me. I can meditate under waterfalls in the winter, so this chill is nothing to me.

touch.line: Is this outfit really a best-seller? It doesn't leave much to the imagination...

touch2.line: Y-you're suddenly so forward!

unlock.line: Is this not supposed to be for the sake of self-cultivation? I've never seen training methods such as this... However, now that it's come to this, fleeing is not an option. I must lead by example by adapting to these strange circumstances!

battle.line: Will any of you be able to stop me today?

detail.line: I brought my katana with me in this wedding dress. It's just hiding somewhere that you cannot see.

feeling5.line: As someone who only lives for training, I'm really happy and lucky to be able to find and bond with you, Commander.

home.line: I'm slowly getting used to waiting for your inevitable return.

login.line: Commander, come and try my cooking.

mail.line: I just received a new mail.

main1.line: I think that each and every day we spend together is a blessing.

main2.line: After today's training, I will replenish our food supply... am I... a good wife? N-nothing.

main3.line: {namecode:67} said that my expressions have been softened recently, heehee, that's because now I smile whenever I think of you.

mission.line: Commander, don't get sloppy during the mission.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... I feel so happy after seeing the Commander's efforts.

touch.line: Commander, please focus on the work... or are you purposely teasing me just to see my troubled face?

touch2.line: C-Commander, we are still in the office...

unlock.line: Commander, I've been undertaking countless bride training sessions in order to prepare for this day. As your bride, I won't let you down.

battle.line: Naughty children need to be punished~

detail.line: You shouldn't ask about a maiden's weight so casually~ *giggles*

expedition.line: The commission fleet is back! Let's go give them a warm welcome.

feeling1.line: You've been naughty, Commander. Do you want to be punished so badly? *giggles*

feeling2.line: If you don't express your thoughts clearly, Commander, nobody will ever understand you.

feeling3.line: Commander, would you like me to clean your ears? Come on, don't be shy. Just leave it to me~

feeling4.line: It's all your fault, Commander... If you make such a cute face, I won't be able to keep my hands off of you...

feeling5.line: It's no good... I can't control myself anymore! Commander, won't you become mine? You don't have to worry about anything... All you have to do is listen to me, and I'll satisfy all your needs...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Are you tired? Come bury yourself in big sister's bosom~!

hp_warning.line: Looks like big sis needs to get a little serious.

login.line: Welcome back! What should we do today?

lose.line: Oh my... this is a bit troublesome...

mail.line: Ara~ new mail? I wonder who it's from.

main1.line: It seems like... my shoulders are always sore...

main2.line: Commander~ I can see you ogling me in a daze, you know?

main3.line: Hup! A little bug got into the room. You didn't see it? I'm confident in my good eyesight.

mission.line: Missions have been updated. Don't forget to take a look!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! I wonder what rewards we will get~?

profile.line: I'm {namecode:67}, the second ship of the {namecode:66}-class heavy cruisers and flagship of the Second Fleet. Many of my sisters have followed my banner into battle. No matter the mission, just leave everything to big sister here~!

propose.line: Oh my, you've caught me, Commander. Or should I say, I've finally caught you? Hehe~ I'll never let you go now!

skill.line: Oh my, how should I torment you today?

touch.line: Oh my~ Are you going to give me a massage?

touch2.line: You can touch me even more if you'd like... but there's no saying what might happen next... *giggles*

unlock.line: Oh my, what a cute commander! Please allow your big sister {namecode:67} to take good care of you from now on!

upgrade.line: My whole body feels... hot... Commander, can you stay with me for a bit?

win_mvp.line: Combat operations... complete! It's all thanks to your leadership, Commander!

gift_prefer.line: My, my~ You really understand a maiden's heart, don't you~ I really like this~

detail.line: Oh my, Commander... just what are you looking at~? Would you like me to bend over a bit more~?

expedition.line: Running commissions in this kind of heat is no easy feat. Let’s go properly reward our hardworking girls.

login.line: Phew... it sure is hot during the summer. Eh? Why is your face all red? Are you having heat stroke?

main1.line: Kendo sword and sunglasses... Takao, did you really come here for vacation?

main2.line: Commander, you can join me under my parasol if you get too hot.

main3.line: Commander, want to watch me play beach volleyball?

touch.line: The best type of swimsuit? Definitely a bikini. Don’t you agree, Commander?

touch2.line: Oh my. There may only be one Earth, but Commander certainly has two hands~.

unlock.line: The warm breeze that gently wraps around your skin, and delicate footsteps across the white sand... isn’t this the essence of summer? Commander, what does summer mean to you?

detail.line: Commander, would you like to pet the puppy? She seems to have taken a liking to you~

login.line: Commander, are you cold? Come and receive some warmth from your big sister~

main2.line: Commander, would you like to take a stroll with your big sister? I'd like some peace and quiet with just the two of us~

main3.line: Akashi-chan? Don't fall asleep on top of the commander~

touch.line: Just the two of us, enjoying the solace of winter together... doesn't it set just the right mood?

unlock.line: Oh my, it's begun to snow. Commander, should we find a nice, quiet place to enjoy the view?

battle.line: Hehe, misbehaving students will have to be punished~

detail.line: Since I'm wearing a different outfit, it'd only feel right if you called me something different as well... Commander, why don't you try calling me "senpai?" Hehe~

login.line: What should I pack in Commander's lunchbox today~?

main1.line: Clubs, huh? There's nothing that interests me. You know, I'm much fonder of attending the "Going Home Club" with you, Commander~

main2.line: Commander, learning more about you is so much more interesting than anything they teach at school~

main3.line: It'd be nice if going to school could teach Takao to soften up her uptight personality...

touch.line: Ehehe~ Commander, want to walk your big sister to school?

touch2.line: Oh my... Commander, do you really like this uniform so much? Well then, I suppose I wouldn't mind wearing it for you every day. Ehehe~

unlock.line: Student handbook, textbooks... twin guns, torpedoes... and what else... Huh? Commander, I'm just packing my bags for school... is there anything I'm missing?

battle.line: Commander~ Work hard on leading the fleet, okay♡

detail.line: I'm pretty sure it was on purpose, but these clothes are very revealing... Hehehe. Big sister thinks it's cute when you're honest like this.

feeling5.line: Commander, next time we take photos, I'm counting on you. That's right. We can spend some quality time together, just the two of us... For some reason, I get the feeling that we're going to end up with an album that's for your eyes only, hehe♡

login.line: Commander~ Please do your best today♡ *smooch*

main1.line: Commander, are you tired? Hehehe, why don't you lay down and rest for a bit? Where, you ask? Well of course... right here~♡

main2.line: Sigh, it's a pain to have to keep maintaining this pose... Commander, won't you help big sister up?

main3.line: Akashi, you said you wanted to publish a lingerie photobook starring me, right? Then... Commander, would you like to see those photos?

touch.line: Commander, keep at it~ Big sister is always by your side♡

unlock.line: So, you want big sister to be your "fleet queen"? You got it. But you'd better give it your all out there, or else I'll be upset with you!

win_mvp.line: Me being the fleet's showgirl, isn't this much to be expected~?

feeling5.line: If you make yourself any cuter than you already are, this full moon is going to make me go feral on you. I'll use my arms and legs like thiiis... and I'll "eat" you up! *smooch*♡

headtouch.line: Heehee. I'm not a dog right now, I'm a big wolf! You, on the other hand... you can be whatever you want, heehee.

home.line: Heehee. Truth be told, I've been tracking your scent for a long time so you can't get away from me.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! Ah, interested in my ears? Sorry, but they're sensitive, so you can only touch them a little.

main1.line: So cute... I'm going to pull you right toward me and then hug you suuuuper tightly– Whuh? I-I suddenly lost control of myself... Maybe it's due to the full moon.

main2.line: Awooo! Heehee. Apparently, when a wolf howls, it's saying, "This is my prey, so stay away!" Well, maybe comparing you to prey is a little inappropriate.

main3.line: You like how fluffy this feels? Well, what if I were to take my tail and coil it around you... or perhaps even wrap you up with it?

touch.line: Oh my. I look like this, and still you want to fawn on me? Fine by me♡

touch2.line: *sigh*... You're doing something very dangerous, Commander. But you know what? Let's continue♡

unlock.line: Awooo! Tonight is a full moon, so you'll want to be extra careful so I won't eat you up! ...Just kidding. Even if I were a werewolf, I'd still protect and keep you safe.

battle.line: Commander, please allow your big sister to take care of anything that stands in your way. Ehehe...

feeling5.line: I've calmed down compared to before? Well, that's because I know that you'd never leave my side, hehe~ Well then, come into my loving embrace~

home.line: Surely you must be tired. Come take a nap in big sister's lap~

login.line: Commander, you didn't go to sleep that long ago. Did you miss big sister that badly~?

main1.line: Even though I would be more than glad to allow you to feast your eyes upon me forever, you do need to get your work done~

main2.line: What should I cook today... Commander, what would you like to have?

main3.line: Commander, you're just too cute~ I just can't get enough of you~

touch.line: My, Commander, you're as spoiled as ever~ Here, come to big sister~

touch2.line: Dar~ling, if you continue like this, I won't be able to hold back any more~ Hehe... just kidding~

unlock.line: Commander... Ahh, from now on, shouldn't I call you "darling?" Come and hold my hand... Ah, at times like these, I just can't help but to want to eat you up, dar~ling~

win_mvp.line: As expected of my wonderful commander~

battle.line: Shall I tear them apart...?

detail.line: Would you stop staring at me like that? I can't promise my sword won't come your way...

expedition.line: Looks like... the commission is finished.

feeling1.line: If you get too close to me, I'll cut you down

feeling2.line: Didn't I already tell you? Don't talk to me if you don't have any business.

feeling3.line: I said don't talk to me if-... You want to know more about me? Fine... as you wish.

feeling4.line: Commander, you sure are a strange person. I've never felt anything like this before... but it's not all that bad. Hey, care to have a little chat with me?

feeling5.line: My dream is to one day conquer the sky and everything beneath it. When that day comes, would you still remain by my side?

headtouch.line: ...Seems pretty clear you weren't listening to me.

home.line: Combat operations over... Seems like we didn't encounter any worthy opponents today... again...

hp_warning.line: Hmph. Retreat? How laughable.

login.line: Commander, you want someone like me to keep you company today as well? What a strange person...

lose.line: ... It hurts... No, don't mind me.

mail.line: There's mail for you, Commander.

main1.line: We were doomed to stray from the path of righteousness the moment we took up arms. Commander, we can never become heroes.

main2.line: The South, Solomon Island, Leyte Gulf, and now this sea... Nothing ever changes...

main3.line: Being by Yamato is like a warm embrace that melts away my worries... I sometimes long for that feeling... N-no, it's not Iike that! I may have said that but, not in that way! But if I put it that way...

mission.line: Another mission... another battle.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Can I go back now?

profile.line: Maya, third ship of the Takao-class. My little sister and I are twins, but we're a good bit younger than our older sisters... Feel free to leave both the enemies in the sky and on the sea to me. You'll need to deal with those underwater yourself. And one final reminder: don't get too close to me or you might get hurt!

propose.line: I'm not very good at expressing my emotions... but despite that, you've never left my side. As long as you're willing to call for me, I will be able to continue fighting. Commander... I don't want to let go of your hand.

touch.line: Commander, you're getting on my nerves.

touch2.line: Stand still over there. I want to practice my swordsmanship.

unlock.line: I'm Maya, the one who will tear open the sky. You're the Commander...? Don't get too close... You might get hurt!

upgrade.line: Strength may breed sin, but for now, we have no other choice.

win_mvp.line: I shall slay anything that stands in my way, whether ghost or god!

gift_prefer.line: Mm... Thanks.

detail_ex.line: You want to see how I maintain my weapon? It's a very delicate thing, just like me. So, um, be careful.

feeling5_ex.line: A sword needs a scabbard... and I need you, Commander. As long as I'm here, nobody is ever going to hurt you.

headtouch_ex.line: You want to talk? I'm not much of a talker, but I'll listen quietly.

home_ex.line: You're back unscathed. That's good.

login_ex.line: You must swing your blade, or else your skill dulls and the many days you spent practicing are forgotten and wasted. But don't worry – come hell or high water, I'll be with you.

main4_ex.line: We have many days ahead of us, you say? Well, guess I should start learning about things other than fighting.

main5_ex.line: Now that I've sworn to protect you, I can never leave your side.

main6_ex.line: You think I'm strong enough as it is? I'm not. Nowhere near it. I can't afford to stop now if I want to be able to hold your hand forever.

touch_ex.line: Are you cold? Then come closer. You can borrow my scarf.

touch2_ex.line: ...I don't get this stuff, so if we could... Mmgh...

detail.line: I'm Maya, a professional assassin. To dispose of my target is why I'm here... Is this really my role, Commander? Alright. Seems easy.

feeling5.line: Mission failed... By law, the defeated must be thoroughly disposed of... Y-you'll take me under your wing? Well, since you're offering... I accept.

headtouch.line: Looks like you're ready to draw your blade. Let's see what you're made of.

home.line: You knew I was here as soon as you got back? Looks like that last victory didn't get to your head. Next time, I'll ambush you from a higher position... You won't spot me as easily then.

login.line: Only the winner will walk away from this. Commander, accept my challenge and draw your blade!

main1.line: These toy blades can't even cut through a breeze... Can I bring my own weapons, Commander?

main2.line: You're finished! Wha– How'd you stop my attack with just two fingers?! Such superhuman skill – able to surpass an assassin's speed!

main3.line: When an assassin is discovered by their target, they have two choices – vanish, or clash. I choose the latter. Fight me with all you have, Commander.

touch.line: You got this close without making a single sound... You're hiding your true strength, aren't you?

touch2.line: You... You're throwing me off!

unlock.line: Maya, searching for mission target... Hm? What's the target doing up here? Tsk... Well, you've found me, so we'll do it this way. Fight me, Commander!

battle.line: Fleet status confirmed... prepare to open fire!

couple_encourage1.line: I'll be in your care again~

couple_encourage2.line: Let's give it our all!

detail.line: Um, do I ever get bored...? Not particularly. Even if I'm not really doing anything, I enjoy getting to spend time with you, Commander.

expedition.line: Military commission, complete. Rewards, received... Aye! I've recorded everything!

feeling1.line: Commander, let's try to do our best?

feeling2.line: Commander, why don't you rest for a bit? Um, you'd like to hear me sing? Hmm, in that case...

feeling3.line: Commander, what would you like to have tonight? Um, you'd like me to decide? In that case, would you like vegetable cream stew or pork cutlets?

feeling4.line: Commander, there is nothing that makes me happier than being able to satisfy you.

feeling5.line: Commander, I'd do anything for you. Um, you'd do the same for me? Ehehe... that makes me really happy~

headtouch.line: Commander, I really like it when you pat my head~♪

home.line: Good work out there on your sortie. I'll handle the reports, so please take this time to get some rest.

hp_warning.line: I can... still keep going!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've taken the liberties of preparing your documents. Um... would you also like to have some refreshments?

lose.line: I can... still fight! I don't want to lose anyone ever again...!

mail.line: Commander, allow me to read the content of this letter to you.

main1.line: Commander, you're truly a kind person...

main2.line: Commander, you should pick a day when you're not too busy to come look at the dandelions with me.

main3.line: Commander, are you not well rested? As a matter of fact, I've actually been hard at work learning how to give massages, just to prepare for this moment! Here, don't be shy~

mission.line: Commander, I've finished sorting the list of new missions.

mission_complete.line: We've done it, Commander! That's another mission done without a hitch!

profile.line: I am the fourth ship of the Takao-class heavy cruisers, Choukai. As the former flagship of the 8th Fleet, I took part in many campaigns. Commander, you can entrust any task to me!

propose.line: Um, Commander, I never dreamt that you'd reciprocate my feelings, but... if this is your sincere desire, then I shall accept it. Commander, would you please seal our vows by helping me put this ring on?

skill.line: My kindness... is reserved for my friends only!

touch.line: Shall we go for a stroll before the sun goes down?

touch2.line: C-Commander, if that is what you so desire, then...

unlock.line: I'm Maya's sister, Choukai. I'm so glad to meet you. Um, by the way, we seem to have met before somewhere...

upgrade.line: Thank you very much, Commander. I shall use this power for your sake.

win_mvp.line: Let's triumphantly return home in high spirits!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. I'll treasure this.

detail_ex.line: Do you think I look a little more intimidating in combat? Hehe, when I'm with you, I know I can face even the most terrifying enemies without fear!

feeling5_ex.line: All of yesterday's memories and tomorrow's promises with you touch my heart... Hehe, I can't live without you now, Commander.

headtouch_ex.line: Rub, rub, pet, pet~ Can I touch you this time, Commander?

home_ex.line: You must be tired from that last sortie! Would you like to rest your head on my lap for a while?

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've already planned the day's tasks. If we finish everything on time... maybe you and I could go out on a date together?

main4_ex.line: Your meal is ready! I made all of your favorite foods. It's important to eat regular meals, so put that work aside for now!

main5_ex.line: There's a gentle wind blowing today... Commander, would you like to go sit in the courtyard with me? I made tea and snacks so we can enjoy a moment's quiet together.

main6_ex.line: Ah, Commander, don't move your head so much in my lap. I'll start cleaning your ears... How does it feel? Good?

touch_ex.line: Commander, I found a spot with a wonderful view. Let's go look at the sunset together.

touch2_ex.line: C-Commander, can it wait until we're in your room...?

battle.line: Focus... Give it your all!

detail.line: Lalala~♪ I feel so motivated just from having you by my side! ...Um, I'm not really sure if the extra motivation affects the quality of my work but... it's fine as long as you're pleased with my work~♪

expedition.line: The list of bounty we received from commissions? Sure! I'll bring it along with the menu!

headtouch.line: Eep?!

home.line: Please leave your paperwork on the counter, I'll take care of it later. I'd like for you to make yourself at home, Commander.

login.line: There's no need to worry about you, just focus on what I'm doing...? Alright! Then... please watch your feet♪

main1.line: You're even avoiding walking on the floor that I just finished wiping... My, how courteous of you, Commander~ Huh? It's because the floor's slippery...?

main2.line: Astoria's outfit's design is a bit out there... but is that the kind of outfit you prefer?

main3.line: Commander, how would you like a massage? It's special service for you, on the house!

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have arrived! I wonder if I should leave them for Maya to take, but... I am a bit concerned...

touch.line: If you're done with work, I'll see you off to the room.

touch2.line: Watch out for the floor? Did something happen? ...Wah?!

unlock.line: There, that's it for the entrance... Oh welcome, Commander! I've been cleaning, so give me a moment... I'll be right with you!

win_mvp.line: Maya, Takao, Atago! Look, we did it!

detail.line: My target is the legendary masterpiece in your possession... Is that it right behind you? Umm... Well. I guess someone like me could never comprehend such fine art!

feeling5.line: I'd rather steal your heart than any painting... Hehehe, that wasn't in the script – it's how I genuinely feel, Commander.

headtouch.line: These cat ears are a special eavesdropping gadget. Wearing them heightens my hearing!

home.line: Found me already, huh? Things don't look good for me... But maybe if it means I'll get to play a special game with you, it's not so bad after all.

login.line: I see you've got some "surprises" in store for me... But I won't be daunted!

main1.line: Umm... So if I stay still and don't touch the tripwire beams, you'll let me go? H-how much longer must I wait, then?!

main2.line: (Phew... I'm a little tired. Who knew this scene would be so demanding? And this pose... Oof.)

main3.line: All of the cameras are pointing at me... Does that mean I'm being observed from all angles?! O-oh, no! It's too embarrassing... Isn't one camera enough?

touch.line: Th-the tail is actually a sensor shaped like a cat tail! Umm... It's for detecting your location.

touch2.line: Hyah?! W-wait a second! Nobody told me there was a play-fighting scene!

unlock.line: Hyah!? So many laser tripwires... Phew... I managed to get through them, but what could possibly be next?

battle.line: I won't run away again... I swear it!

couple_encourage1.line: I can understand your pain.

couple_encourage2.line: Did I also...? No, I would never.

detail.line: Commander? Oh, I'm just preparing for the next lecture at the auditorium. Please don't worry about me, and continue your work as normal.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned to port. What's next? Shall I go with you to greet them?

feeling1.line: Mogami may often fail to recognize her own worth, but more and more people are starting to see how little you're worth.

feeling2.line: Would you like to learn more about the Mogami class? Very well, I'll be glad to explain everything from the top. Which one of us would you like to hear about first?

feeling3.line: You're... most interested in Suzuya? Of course, I'd be glad to give you the details... but just explaining things wouldn't be enough, right...?

feeling4.line: ...There's no point hiding it. I already know how you feel about me. Just shut up and... give in to your feelings already!

feeling5.line: Ahh... Commander, your gaze is so passionate... so I can finally tell you... I've always admired you... Huh?! What's this? I feel all fluttery...!

home.line: We must apply what we've learned to future battles. Shall I prioritize writing the report first?

hp_warning.line: As if this... would be enough to make me turn back!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Which job should we take on first?

lose.line: Ugh... I guess that's it...

mail.line: The mail has arrived. There's something for you, Commander... Ah...

main1.line: Commander is looking at... N-nothing, don't worry about it!

main2.line: Kumano, please don't make trouble for Mogami, all right? She's going to get a stomachache again...

main3.line: We're sometimes called the Suzuya class, but I still prefer being called the Mogami class. We all fought together during that war after all..

mission.line: I've arranged the status of our current missions. Please look over them.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have arrived. That is good news.

profile.line: I am Suzuya, third ship of the Mogami class. During that war, I fought alongside Mogami as a member of CruDiv 7. My last battle left me with a bit of regret... but I've been given a new beginning on this battlefield, and I'll fight alongside my new companions with a fresh outlook. I look forward to working with you.

propose.line: (whispers) Commander, when this ritual is over... you know what's next, right? Don't worry. I'll treat you better than anyone else. Isn't that right, darling~♡

touch.line: Commander... where do you think you're looking? Don't think I wouldn't notice... I could feel your gaze boring into me... Am I right?

touch2.line: Nnh... So this is what you were after from the very beginning... I knew it all along. I've always known, this entire time... Ehehehe~♡

unlock.line: I am Suzuya, Mogami-class heavy cruiser. I place myself under your command from this day forward.

upgrade.line: My abilities have been enhanced. Well done.

win_mvp.line: Congratulations. Eh, I'm the MVP...? Th-thank you very much...

gift_prefer.line: Commander, thanks a bunch. I'll keep this safe!

detail.line: Hmm? Oh, I'm just organizing your medical records. Keep on resting there, and I'll take care of you soon.

expedition.line: Has your commission team returned? Then I'll stop for now... I'll be back after I've welcomed them home.

feeling5.line: Aah... Just the two of us alone in a hospital room... Yes, I'll care for you more earnestly than anyone else ever would. After all, you're my one and only, my most beloved patient...

headtouch.line: Huh? S-such sudden touch... N-no, as your nurse, this level of touch should be alright, I'm sure!

home.line: Heehee, you're a little late. Come and lie down, now. It's not good for a patient to leave the nurse's side for so long.

login.line: Commander, it's time for your examination. I'll check your body temperature, blood pressure, and so much more... Where would you like to start?

mail.line: Commander, new mail just arrived for you. It might be your examination results, heehee... Allow me to nestle in and read it to you.

main1.line: It's so hard to take my eyes off you when you're sleeping... Yes, I know you're awake. I'm telling you that you should go to sleep, silly.

main2.line: Listening to your breath in a quiet hospital bed at night is so very relaxing... I wish I could take care of you forever...

main3.line: *pant*... Your eyes... are ever guided by the syringe in my hand...

mission.line: You have unfinished missions... Let me help. You won't recover until you get your bed rest.

mission_complete.line: Well done, Commander. You've finished both your missions and your physical therapy. As a reward, I made a nutritious meal for you.

touch.line: Ever since I became a nurse, your gaze has gotten more and more lascivious... Heheh, don't worry, I get it...

touch2.line: Mm... Let's wait until we're done and the door is locked, okay?

unlock.line: Suzuya, the Mogami-class heavy cruiser, will be the nurse taking care of you today. Heehee, let's have fun with this nighttime examination, shall we?

battle.line: Enemies spotted! Guess we're rollin' up our sleeves and squarin' off!

couple_encourage1.line: Yo, Mogami, let's hang out later!

couple_encourage2.line: Suzuya, you take that one!

couple_encourage3.line: Hot damn, your makeup game is on point!

detail.line: Yo, Commander! Hang out with me, now! Oh, is that a lollipop for me? 'Kay, some other time then! Nom!

expedition.line: Commission team's back, yo. Don't got time for rhymes, but let's go!

feeling1.line: You're lame, you know that? Not tryin' to be mean, or anything, just saying. Listen, I've got a couple ideas for how to unlamify you.

feeling2.line: Commandeeeeer, I'm boooored, let's do somethiiiing. Yeah, it's candy, so what? Not like I'll turn into a lardo from a single– Hey, oww!

feeling3.line: Commandeeeer, I'm lonelyyyy. We can do whatever, just hang out with meeee. "Find someone else?" Wow, rude much? I wanna hang with you! C'mooon!

feeling4.line: You'll finally hang with me? Hell yeah! Wish you would've just said so from the beginning! Anyway, where we goin'? Y'know, just the two of us~♡

feeling5.line: Y-you really like me?! Really, huh... Thing is, I actually love you, Commander... Seriously, though! I do!

home.line: You gonna review that last battle? Aight, cool, go ahead. Wait, I'm the one who's gotta do it?

hp_warning.line: I'll return to port if it's the last thing I do!

login.line: There you are, Commander! Nice, nice! So, what's up today? We hangin' out together? Just work? Figures...

lose.line: Payback's-a comin', ya hear?!

mail.line: You've got a new DM– Err, I mean, new mail! And don't go ghosting whoever sent it!

main1.line: Huh? Me takin' the battle seriously surprised you? Well, yeah, I get serious when the situation demands it.

main2.line: So, Commander, what kinda girls do ya like? Wait, lemme guess, I'm your type, aren't I? Ahah!

main3.line: Soooo bored... Hey, could ya get Suzuya up in this place? I wanna chat with her about my next shopping trip.

mission.line: Ugh, missions? You're probs better off hittin' up Suzuya...

mission_complete.line: Sooo tireeed... Oh, crap! Hey, unclaimed mission rewards! C'mon, man!

profile.line: Name's Kumano, Mogami-class heavy cruiser! Back in the war, I was Cruiser Division 7, workin' my ass off! Shame about what happened at the island in you-know-where, though... Welp, no point crying over spilt milk. Just gotta do better this time.

propose.line: Uhh, "I take you, to have and to hold, from this day forward"... How'd the rest go? Agh, screw it, it's too long and I'm makin' a fool of myself in front of everyone! You don't mind if we bail and go straight to our room, right, darling?

touch.line: Well, well! Caught you admirin', Commander! Hehehe, you don't gotta act innocent. If you wanna stare, stare all ya want!

touch2.line: Weeeell, someone's feeling frisky, huh? Totes fine with me. Go on, touch me 'till you're content~♡

unlock.line: Bam! Heavy cruiser, Kumano, ready for action~! Commander, pleased to meetcha~!

upgrade.line: Sweet! This'll get me more time in the limelight, yeah?

win_mvp.line: MVP, baybee! Hell yeah! Give it up for Kumano!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! Found something nice! Oh, it's for me? Woohoo!

detail.line: This is too revealing? Meh, not really~? I've seen submarines wearing more risqué stuff than this.

feeling5.line: Yo, Commandeeer, how'd ya like my bikini? Come closer if ya need a better look~ Yeah, you bet I'm tryin' to hit on you.

main1.line: Commandeeeer, what're you up to? Get over here already, c'mooon!

main2.line: I wanna see Mogami in a bikini! Don't you? I do, at least! And you? Same, right?

main3.line: Phew, I'm tired! Commandeeeer, massage my feet and shoulders! ...Err, I didn't ask you to massage THOSE!

touch.line: Candy? Nuh-uh, this is mine, and I ain't givin' it away! Hahahah!

touch2.line: Hah, I knew this would catch your eye! You're like a little kid~

unlock.line: It's time for Kumano's sexy swimsuit debut~! Just kidding~☆ Hey Commander, just where~ are~ you~ staring~? Ahaha~♡

battle.line: Now I'm PISSED! I'm gonna beat the crap outta you!

detail.line: Aw, for real?! You lucked out and chose the best possible card! Hrmm... Hang on, are you cheating, Commander? You ALWAYS pick out the good cards!

home.line: Ahah~ Back where we left off, Commander! So, which card are you gonna pick?

login.line: Psst, Suzuya! Commander's here! Hahah! Let's see you try to beat me this time, man!

main1.line: Hungry, Suzuya? Wanna order home delivery?

main2.line: Whatcha lookin' at, Commander? You more interested in me than the cards, or what?

main3.line: Taking your sweet time, huh. Mmh... Meh... *yaaawn*...

touch.line: Ahah! Is that your final answer?

touch2.line: You jelly, Suzuya? 'Cause you sure look it! Haha~

unlock.line: Now it's your turn, Commander! Which one's it gonna be~? You suuuure you wanna pick this card? ...I hear you, Suzuya! Stop tellin' the Commander what the cards are!

battle.line: I'm gonna evade all their attacks and dance around the– Oww!

detail.line: Who else are ya excited to see, besides me? Ahahah☆ Hey, I'm not jelly in the slightest. I know you, Commander. Just name like, 20 or 30 other people~

home.line: C'mon, take a seat~ I'mma give those weary bones a nice massage! Heheh, where should I start? Your shoulders, or your feet? Tickle tickle tickle♪

login.line: Welcome to my unveiling! Now let's see how many songs you can last before you fall for me~ Hahahah♡

mail.line: Aw crap, got an e-mail! Commander, pass me the phone!

main1.line: That's... Mikuma? When'd she become so damn hot and stylish? Sheeeesh... Even I'm swooning over here!

main2.line: Wanna see a rough rehearsal, Commander? Or are you gonna wait 'til the real deal?

main3.line: This dance is like, murder on your back. I'm gonna be recovering in bed tomorrow, so go easy on me~ "What're we gonna do then?" Hang out, duh! Ahah☆

mission_complete.line: We've got mission rewards~ Anything catch your eye?

touch.line: Ahah♡ Wait 'til I start shakin' it around~

touch2.line: Commander... Where's that hand of yours wanderin'...? ♡

unlock.line: Tadah! Get a load of my... dancer outfit! So, whaddya think? Ahaha~♡ Hey, Commander, where are those eyes wandering? Did ya see something ya like?

battle.line: Let us expel evil and bring purity to these blue seas.

detail.line: Ah, I'm feeling just fine, thank you. As a wanderer, my body is used to going days without eating or drinking... But you say the others would worry? Of course... *sigh*

expedition.line: The commission team is back. I can't wait to hear their stories, heehee.

feeling1.line: Normally, I would consider consigning people as immoral as you to death, but... I'm just joking. Please get a hold of yourself, Commander.

feeling2.line: Your care is appreciated, Commander. Whether it be battle, odd jobs, or caring for your affairs, please ask me for anything you may need.

feeling3.line: You'd like to know what I want? Well... Hmm... Ummm... I can't really think of anything, but don't presume I'm without desire. But... Hmm, this is a quandary.

feeling4.line: Commander, I came up with an answer to your question. Looking back, I've never felt... tied down. So I'd—oh, Commander? What's the matter?

feeling5.line: It seems my answer from before has you in a dilemma. But understand that, as long as it's you, I really don't mind... Oh, or do you happen to have other inclinations?

headtouch.line: Hmm, I'm not too sure about this...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to take a warm bath? It must be hard to meet with friends with the stench of battle still on you.

hp_warning.line: I mustn't inconvenience the Commander...!

login.line: Commander? You're quite early today. ...I, on the other hand, was tardy considering my role as your secretary ship, for which I apologize.

lose.line: Clearly... I've neglected my training.

mail.line: You have mail, Commander. Don't you think you should at least skim through it before you leave it in the box?

main1.line: Are you thirsty? If you'd like tea, I'll bring some right away... But you look like you need a nutritional drink.

main2.line: Looking for a diversion? You could take a little walk. Actually, there's a sacred mountain only three days away... Oh? That's too far for you?

main3.line: I don't just know about seals; I have some knowledge of feng shui dragon veins, too. There are other girls in the port who know much more than me, though, so I suppose you don't need to ask me... *glance*

main4.line: The Guardian Fox's little sister asks you questions incessantly? I suppose that would be difficult if you don't know the secret to victory. Commander, sometimes NOT answering is an option.

main5.line: Sometimes, fleeing from work and human relationships is a viable option. I won't tell you to forsake society, but maybe you could learn a little about the hermit mentality?

mission.line: You have a backlog of missions. Heehee, I understand. It's only human to procrastinate until right before your deadline.

mission_complete.line: You have some unchecked mission rewards. Heehee, don't worry. It's nice to watch them build up, isn't it?

profile.line: I am Unzen, a heavy cruiser made as part of the sixth shipbuilding plan. I'm unused to traversing this plane of existence, so I may lean on you for aid, Commander... But if you will accept me, I am more than happy to help—no, serve you. Heehee.

propose.line: I'm deeply honored by your proposal. While I don't feel deserving, I graciously accept... Heehee, it seems I'll have to train to be a bride, won't I, Commander?

skill.line: Boundless heaven and earth, expunge all sin and impurity––

touch.line: If I suit your needs, then please ask anything of me.

touch2.line: I know this training method... Would you like to try it on me, Commander?

unlock.line: The threads of fate stretch far, I see. I am heavy cruiser Unzen, and I shall avail myself of your hospitality for the time being. Ah, not that I am planning to leave you, Commander, but I do intend to take time off for personal matters every now and then. Heehee, I do enjoy letting the wanderlust take over.

upgrade.line: I'm even stronger now. Heheh.

win_mvp.line: Rokkou's manifestation, Kaimon's divinity. Victory comes as holy mounts rise through the clouds.

gift_prefer.line: Commander, you're really going to give this to me? I'll make sure to put it to good use.

battle_ex.line: Commander, I shall go and make quick work of these enemies.

detail_ex.line: *munch munch*... Commander, is something wrong? You say I eat a lot more than you'd expect? I believe in not wasting things, whether they're clouds and mist or the five grains. That's doubly true when I made it for you... Heehee.

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, do you have plans later? Oh, I don't plan to drag you around for weeks. Just one or two days... No! May I ask for just a few hours of your time... for a date?

home_ex.line: Phew... Now this is heavenly. Oh, Commander, well done on your most recent battle. Erm... I'm sorry, but I just got in, so if you don't mind...

login_ex.line: My, Commander. What a coincidence, us arriving at the office at the same time. Heehee, I'm kidding. We've been together since we left your room, after all♪

main6_ex.line: *sigh*... Looks like today isn't your day... I should cook something to raise your spirits later...

main7_ex.line: So you wish for a bit of a diversion? Okay, then... Commander, find me a place nearby where you and I can be alone for a while.

main8_ex.line: Reunited even when you're apart, growing ever closer without realizing... I think that describes our relationship well, Commander.

main9_ex.line: The Dragon God didn't like the sweets I made the other day... *sigh*... The word "flavorless" was used...

main10_ex.line: So you have relationships with other girls, too... Heehee, it's fine. I know that's just the kind of person you are, Commander. Isn't that right♪

touch_ex.line: I'm so helpful, aren't I? Am I a good girl? Heehee♪

touch2_ex.line: If you want me, then who am I to say no? Heehee...

win_mvp_ex.line: That was a difficult foe... is what I WOULD say, if not for your leadership, Commander. You made it easy.

home.line: Commander~ Welcome home~♥ I see, so this is what makes you happy? It seems I still have much to learn... Heehee.

login.line: Commander~ Heheh, come sit over here with me. It may be... a little cramped, but it's enough space for two, isn't it?

mail.line: It seems there are letters waiting for you. It's okay. You may enjoy your break first and read it later.

main1.line: Would you like to join me, Commander? Soak your feet and feel heaven and earth's energy through the land, sea, and ocean breeze...

main2.line: There are some underwater hot springs nearby. How about you and I visit them later? They're quite close—it's just two days if we swim.

main3.line: Commander, when you go on vacation, you should have fun. Yes, it's a rare opportunity to... move your body a little, don't you think?

touch.line: This feeling of liberation... I'd love to feel more of this place's energy with my bare skin... Oh, I can't?

touch2.line: You'd even do that out here...? Heehee♥

unlock.line: Commander~ Come over here~♥ Heehee, you look surprised... I don't think I'm dressed strangely at all. Or... is this swimsuit not enough to satisfy you, Commander?

win_mvp.line: A shipgirl's power isn't tied to appearances... In other words, victory will be just as easy in this swimwear!

detail.line: I've seen ninjutsu many times throughout my travels, but they were unlike those spoken of in the port. The world is more diverse than I ever imagined... Oh? You think the girls at port are telling me tall tales? Heehee, well, isn't that interesting...

feeling5.line: Imagine, if you will, that I was a ninja assailant whom you managed to detain. What would you do next in that situation, Commander? Show me, with your own hands, what you might do... Heehee♡

headtouch.line: I still have much training ahead of me...

home.line: It's good to see you've returned, Commander. I was just practicing my next jutsu. I did want to honor you for your services, but, well...

login.line: This is the ninja sage's ultimate transformation technique... Hyah! Commander, have I failed again...?

main1.line: You think I don't have to take this role so seriously? Honestly, I'm not sure what part of this you think is "serious"...

main2.line: It is a ninja's duty to come when her lord calls... I see. That must be why everyone is hiding in the ceiling of your office. Haha!

main3.line: The fact that you seem unmoved makes me wonder... Is this ninjutsu meant to be performed while tied up, after all?

touch.line: The rope is far too tight. I may have made... a mistake.

touch2.line: So you want to see me restrained, do you?

unlock.line: Ah, Commander... What a predicament you've discovered me in. Hoping to put my skills to the test, I attempted to imitate so-called "ninjutsu." No, not the temporary paralysis one – I was trying to use the transformation jutsu.

battle.line: Let us bring an end to our foes.

detail.line: Just as the water downstream is not the same as at its source, neither are people nor their homes the same as they once were. Do you concur with this notion, Commander?

expedition.line: Are you leaving to receive those returning from a commission? Then kindly allow me to accompany you.

feeling1.line: Flowers blossom beautifully, then inevitably scatter off – nothing in this world lasts forever...

feeling2.line: I thought I had seen everything there was to see in this life – until I met you...

feeling3.line: Even when subjected to something bitter, you accept your suffering with a smile. That, to me, is truly astounding. Won't you please allow me to gaze more at your beautiful smile?

feeling4.line: I will cherish the fleeting present and preserve in my heart even the smallest of happinesses – this truth that you bestowed upon me is more precious than any treasure.

feeling5.line: Like how cherry blossoms scatter to the wind, all living things are destined to one day become dust. However... it matters not how much time passes, for the memories we've made will always remain in my heart.

headtouch.line: Hm? Are you offering to tie up my hair?

home.line: Welcome home. Does anything ail you? Then please do not worry. I have prepared a medicinal meal for you.

hp_warning.line: *cough cough*... It seems I've overexerted myself.

login.line: Hm? Ah, it is you. No, it's nothing. It is good to be in peace.

lose.line: *cough cough*... We lie defeated... as dictated by destiny.

mail.line: One must not let useful information slip past. Your letter demands your attention.

main1.line: My mere presence makes you... relax, you say? Perhaps the aroma of my medicine has a soothing effect on your soul.

main2.line: Commander, do you perchance feel under the weather? Oh, no, that simply will not do. I shall make for you a medicinal dish, so please wait for just a while.

main3.line: You have never wavered in your path, whether or not you'd be rewarded for it... That takes such strength, and it is so beautiful.

mission.line: New missions have been bequeathed unto us. Do not rush – adhere to a plan.

mission_complete.line: Thus, your work stands completed. May I propose having a pleasant bath to reinvigorate? It would be you and me, all to ourselves.

profile.line: I am Asama – an improvement upon the Suzuya class of heavy cruisers, and a hollow being who never was. Even so, I wish to be with you in this fleeting, beautiful world until my last moment.

propose.line: I see that you've made up your mind. That being the case, I vow to take your hand, now and into eternity. The warmth that your hand imparts... it urges me to stay by your side and, together, behold the passing of the seasons.

skill.line: Look on with awe, then turn into ash.

touch.line: ...Dosage makes the difference between medicine and poison, Commander. Please exercise care.

touch2.line: Mmh... This delight, this affection that we share... It will remain with me for some time.

unlock.line: Are you the Commander? I am Asama, and long have I waited for you. *sigh*... Although joyous times are as fleeting as bubbles in water, I still wish to step into this brief dream with you.

upgrade.line: This strength you've given unto me... I fear losing it.

win_mvp.line: For a sideshow, it was quite entertaining.

gift_prefer.line: True joy is able to leave people speechless... I thank you.

feeling5_ex.line: Ah, the time we have to ourselves is all too short... However, even if we can be together for but a moment, the warmth of your embrace shall remain in my heart forevermore.

headtouch_ex.line: Heehee... Now your palm smells much like my medicine.

home_ex.line: Welcome home. Please... allow me to cherish this moment together for a little longer.

login_ex.line: Welcome back. Ah, I seem in good spirits, you say? Heehee. Yes, that's because all I need is you to be content.

main4_ex.line: Commander, may I please ask to hold your hand? Yes, you speak true... This world shall never wither away for as long as you draw breath.

main5_ex.line: May I... propose that we visit the hot springs together? I of course refer to the one that made you so... enthusiastic the last time.

mission_ex.line: Has another new task been given to you? Let us complete it as quickly as possible before it cuts into our private time.

mission_complete_ex.line: I see you've finished your task. Let us be on our way, then. The bath is ready for us.

touch_ex.line: This, you ask? Heehee... This is the mark that you left upon me.

touch2_ex.line: The marks that you gave me flower much like blossoms... only more beautiful.

detail.line: I've heard a tale... A tale of the spider woman who lures in travelers and then consumes their flesh when the chance arises. You need not fear, however. No such thing will happen to you for as long as I'm here. Heehee...

feeling5.line: It would be nice if one could simply flee from demons and monsters, but such is not the case in reality. Once you return to your senses, you may already be in my grasp. Heehee... Now, will you please come to me gently on this night most wonderful?

headtouch.line: Well? Do you feel that you were mistaken now? Heehee. There are no horns on my head after all, are there?

home.line: A most splendid result. Shall we take this chance for a bit of merriment? With a condition that, should you lose... I shall take possession of you.

login.line: Welcome, Commander. May I interest you in some tea if you're feeling thirsty? Heehee – I shall keep you company tonight.

main1.line: Hm? You saw an ill-boding thing, you say? Heehee. It was surely just your imagination. There is no one here but you and me.

main2.line: You're certain that the temari moved? Heehee. Your eyes are merely playing tricks on you. If it bothers you so, then may I suggest closing your eyes in my embrace for a while?

main3.line: It is said that shadows are reflections of the heart. One must wonder what form my attachment to you, my Commander, may take...

mission.line: We have been assigned new missions. Please, Commander, do be careful of spider's silk while walking the streets at night.

mission_complete.line: You've finished a mission? Then let us resume our play.

touch.line: Ah, do you wish to see the mark that you left upon me? Or perhaps... do you intend to give me a new one tonight?

touch2.line: Heehee... There is no escaping now, Commander... Mgh... Mmh...

unlock.line: Commander? Your expression seems to signal that you are not content with just ghost stories, yes? Ashamed am I to admit that I am still afraid... May I ask you to remain with me? There is something I wish to tell you.

battle.line: You shall not pass.

detail.line: Commander, I discovered treasure belonging to the Sea God today. They may look like mere seashells, but do you see how they shimmer in the light? Maybe they have powers we've yet to uncover!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned home. I hope they'll have many tales for me.

feeling1.line: Commander... Never mind. I'm a capable free spirit now, so I can handle it on my own.

feeling2.line: Commander, I found another sparkly treasure... Oh! It was just glass reflecting light, I guess...

feeling3.line: Commander, I found a new secret realm amidst my travels. I'll show it to nobody but you, so don't tell any of the other girls, okay?

feeling4.line: May I... hold your hand on our travels today? I'm not scared, or anything. It's just that... it feels a little warmer...

feeling5.line: The map of my travels is full of memories with you, Commander. Heehee, let's keep wandering all over the world and filling it up as we go. It's a promise♪

headtouch.line: Nngh... You're tickling my ear...

home.line: Commander, I just returned from my own wanderings, as well. I'll tell you all about it.

hp_warning.line: I... I won't lose!

login.line: I memorized the entire geography of the port. Commander, would you join me in the search for new realms?

lose.line: This is troubling... Can I ask for your help once more?

mail.line: Commander, mail just arrived. Umm... Do you think it could be a map of sacred mountains?

main1.line: Tonight, I'd like to go on a solo journey into the world of dreams. You'll come and check on me, won't you?

main2.line: Commander, I wove yesterday's wanderings into a melody for you. Allow me to play it now...

main3.line: Hmm? You say I just had a snack? That was then's snack – this one is now's snack.

mission.line: Commander, our wandering missions are still unfinished.

mission_complete.line: Your missions are done. We got lots of rare treasures, I see.

profile.line: I'm Unzen, a heavy cruiser. Capable as I am, I am free to roam the port as much as I please, but I'll be sure to call you if I find anything unusual.

propose.line: Commander, you... want to be with me forever? Of course, I'd be happy to! Your side is the destination of all of my travels. Hehe, I love you so much, Commander!

touch.line: Hold on tight to my hand, Commander. Now you won't get lost when we wander together.

touch2.line: What are you doing, Commander? It feels... funny...

unlock.line: I am Unzen – the windchaser, the cloudstrider, the one who wanders across the vast horizons... and yet I have somehow ended up floating to your side with a "fwooosh." Hrmm... the deep connection between us is mysterious indeed~♪

upgrade.line: Now I can journey even farther~

win_mvp.line: We won, Commander. Let's get back to journeying through new realms~

gift_prefer.line: You'd give this to me? It's beautiful...

feeling5_ex.line: Whenever I think of you, my heart gets all warm and fuzzy, and my fingertips play such pretty melodies... This is my love for you, Commander♪

headtouch_ex.line: Commander, please pet me more... It makes me very happy.

home_ex.line: Welcome home. I prepared tea, sweets, and a big hug for you. Which would you like first?

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. You promised to join me for a walk today – I hope you haven't forgotten!

main4_ex.line: My travel diary is full of all the things that have happened during our wanderings. Look at this page... Oh, and this one... Hehehehe...

main5_ex.line: Oof... I was running through the hall, and I ended up hitting a pillar. It hurts a little...

main6_ex.line: I wanna travel the world together... Hm? You're worried about work? Heehee, even if we go far away, I have ways to get your paperwork delivered in no time!

touch_ex.line: We can hold hands wherever we like from now on, okay?

touch2_ex.line: I-I'm not embarrassed anymore... as long as I'm with you...

battle.line: All units, battle formations!

couple_encourage1.line: Fast battleship squadron, sortieing！

couple_encourage2.line: Let's pursue victory together!

couple_encourage3.line: W-watch out for enemy fire!

couple_encourage4.line: Being popular... is best saved for when you're off the battlefield.

detail.line: The only value of war is the peace that follows it. I implore you to never forget this.

expedition.line: Phew... time to take a break. Commander, does black tea suit you?

feeling1.line: You do not deserve victory!

feeling2.line: Commander, please be at ease, for victory shall soon come.

feeling3.line: Will Zuikaku be fine on her own...? Mm... I'll watch her from here. From this distance, she probably won't notice me...

feeling4.line: I've heard that people are most likely to reveal their sentiments at twilight... I wonder if you're also like this?

feeling5.line: That Hiei, trying to throw a party again tonight... Commander, do you have time to keep me company there?

home.line: Good work out there. Were you able to achieve your tactical goals?

hp_warning.line: Now is the time to make our comeback!

login.line: Have you had enough rest? The fleet now awaits your orders.

lose.line: Please rest at ease. This situation can still be salvaged.

mail.line: Adjust your strategies in accordance with the new information.

main1.line: No way in hell a battleship like me is going to get taken out by some flimsy torpedo!

main2.line: Come! Let's destroy our enemies, pass through that measly canal, and return to the land where I was born!

main3.line: I take myself too seriously? No, you take yourself too lightly!

main4.line: Horns? Oh, these things? They're just decorations on the hat. I wouldn't look much like a member of the Sakura Empire without them, right?

mission.line: Do I need to go do it myself?

mission_complete.line: Excellent! We're one step closer towards our ultimate victory.

profile.line: Nameship of the Fast Battleships, flagship of the 7th Combined Fleet, and the last Sakura capital ship to be laid down overseas - that is me, Kongou!

propose.line: Since you've put so much effort into pursuing me so passionately, it is only fitting that I give you the proper respect. Come, you've earned my hand.

touch.line: Wh-what is it!? An emergency!?

touch2.line: Hey you, don't tell me you've been subjecting my sisters to such depravity as well!?

unlock.line: I am Kongou, lead ship of the Kongou-class battlecruisers. I shall illuminate the path that leads to victory!

upgrade.line: Phew... another trump card to add to my hand.

win_mvp.line: To be victorious is to be elegant!

gift_prefer.line: Understood. I'll accept this.

battle.line: Such a tasteless rabble!

home.line: Good work in your sorties today. If you're hungry, I don't mind splitting my dango with you.

login.line: Commander, are you well rested? There are still many hours to go.

main1.line: Commander, a break is not a break if you're constantly thinking about work. Besides, don't you think it's rude to be so preoccupied when you're supposed to be spending time with me?

main2.line: I'm used to always going out with my sisters, so to be able to spend time with you outside is rather novel for me.

main3.line: Commander, when the weather gets a bit warmer, why don't we go enjoy the cherry blossoms with my sisters?

touch.line: You're awestruck by my beauty? Hehe, something as obvious as that needs not even be said~

touch2.line: You... perhaps you're going to need a remedial course in basic etiquette.

unlock.line: We must fully live in the present, whether during work or during leisure - this is my mantra. Commander, shall we go for an outing together?

detail.line: This operating system is the fruit of Akashi and the others' hard work. Would you like to try it out... Actually, I guess it's best if you don't. Hehehe.

login.line: Have you rested enough? Let's get back to work, as gracefully as always.

main1.line: This syringe filled with Manjuu plushies is an advertising prop, but isn't it quite adorable? Hehe~♪

main2.line: In a way, saving lives directly like this feels more fulfilling than fighting enemies on the battlefield.

main3.line: Good work completing your duties, Commander. Would you like to get checked up? After all, I am a nurse right now. Hehe~♪

touch.line: Oh? Would a different pose be better?

touch2.line: It seems like you need some more intense treatment, Commander...

unlock.line: "Celebrity Endorsement of the Port Medical Facilities"... Hehehe, you've made a wise decision picking me. Commander, I can leave the ad shoot to you, right?

battle.line: I excel in both theory and practice!

detail.line: Walking with you and taking in the scenery is quite pleasant, actually. Say, how about showing me that vantage point with an apparently exquisite view Hiei spoke of earlier?

expedition.line: It appears the commission team has returned. Shall we treat them to the tea I bought from the school canteen?

feeling5.line: There is a number of school-related romantic things I hope to try at least once. For instance, walking home with my beloved, or making a lunch box and savouring it together... Oh, silly me, I've already done those! Heehee♪

home.line: Splendid work. I'd imagine Haruna went off to see her clubmates... As for me? I suppose I'm doing the same this very moment, my fellow going-straight-home clubmate.

login.line: Have you had a good rest, Commander? You've got a long day of school and office work ahead of you.

main1.line: This outing has reaffirmed to me the reason why we fight – to restore peace to all the world.

main2.line: Kirishima made this charm in her home economics class. It's quite well-made, don't you think?

main3.line: It seems the manjuus fell asleep. Heehee, seeing their adorable at-rest faces somehow makes me think of my sisters.

mission_complete.line: The fruits of missions form the foundation of victory, as someone wise once said.

touch.line: Oh, do I have a petal caught in my hair?

touch2.line: Excuse me, have you even considered how you're going to explain yourself to the Morals Committee?

unlock.line: It would be a shame to pass on this lovely weather, Commander. Why have a dull commute by train when you can enjoy a leisurely bicycle ride in the sunlight, hm? Heehee♪

win_mvp.line: Ah, the tailwind of victory. The very definition of envigorating, is it not?

battle.line: Ride the waves... elegantly, now!

detail.line: I know things can be too sudden to react to sometimes, but next time this happens, please try to help. In service of that, I'm going to have you learn to surf! Now, hold on to my hips, and... H-hey, wait a second!

expedition.line: Everyone from the commission team is back. Black tea seems a little inappropriate in this heat... Yeah, I think we should bring them ice-cold juice instead.

feeling5.line: I have to apologize. If not for that mishap, you and I could've been having fun surfing right now. ...You think the time we're spending together is more important than surfing? Gosh, do you have to say stuff like that out of nowhere...? *blush*

headtouch.line: Geez, if you have a free hand to pet me with, use it to hold on to the board instead... Hyah?!

home.line: Thanks for all your hard work. How about we take a break and enjoy the sea breeze?

login.line: I'm trying to ride the board correctly, but it's really hard... C-Commander, can I lean on you for balance?

mail.line: A letter... Phew! I managed to keep it from getting wet. Commander, you'd better read it quick.

main1.line: You think it's too soon to practice in the ocean? Heheh, I think I understand being scared of the ocean. But I'm here with you, so don't you worry, Commander.

main2.line: This board is much too small. Th-there's no way the two of us can... u-unless we stick really together...?

main3.line: I've shown you such an inelegant side of me... Commander, please keep this a secret just between us! I'll do anything!

mission.line: Relaxing on the beach is nice and all, but you have a pretty big backlog of missions...

mission_complete.line: Another mission completed. With these rewards... I could buy myself a new swimsuit!

touch.line: Commander, be careful you don't fall into the water.

touch2.line: Hyah?! Commander, now isn't the time for this...

unlock.line: That was a big wave... I need to balance better on my board, or else... Commander, can I take your hand – Hm? What's slippery? I have no idea what you're... Hyah?! My swimsuit?!

win_mvp.line: If only I could be this elegant during practice... O-oh! Don't mind me, Commander!

battle.line: Hehe, shall we go enjoy the festivities?

couple_encourage1.line: Are you still waiting for your sister?

detail.line: Hehe~ Which do you prefer: matcha, or black tea?

expedition.line: Welcome back, everyone. Hopefully, none of you encountered any suspicious people?

feeling1.line: What a pity...

feeling2.line: Ehehe~ Commander, is there something on your mind?

feeling3.line: That Kirishima... She's actually quite the popular one...

feeling4.line: Being able to see everyone's smiles at the banquet makes all the hard work and preparation worth it.

feeling5.line: Commander, after tonight's banquet... will you be free? Hehe, please look forward to it~

home.line: Welcome back. The tea has just been brewed to the right temperature.

hp_warning.line: Commander... It's too early to give up just yet!

login.line: There is nothing more relaxing than a banquet following a battle... By the way, Commander, I'm free after this...

lose.line: Was I bested...?

mail.line: Are all of these new letters? Thank you for your hard work.

main1.line: *Sigh*... Whenever Kirishima comes to a banquet, all those kids that tag along with her usually end up making a mess of things...

main2.line: When it comes to warfare, wisdom and courage are equally important. We can't count on another miracle if we discard proper planning and rely on blind courage.

main3.line: Commander, I'll be able to protect you, no matter the situation. Hehe, I am called an "Imperial Ship" because I have that capacity after all~♪

mission.line: Let's finish while we still have the momentum!

mission_complete.line: Hehe, shall we celebrate by holding a banquet tonight?

profile.line: I am Hiei, the first Kongou-class battleship born in the Land of the Rising Sun. As an Imperial Ship, I witnessed the growth of our mighty fleet, and led our forces into the Battle of the Solomon Sea. Commander, have you finished your preparations? The banquet is about to begin.
