hp_warning.line: Not bad! You are worthy of facing my full power!

login.line: Commander, why don't you warm up a bit before starting work?

lose.line: Kuh! I'll remember your face...

mail.line: Catch, it's your mail.

main1.line: Those puny carrier aircraft are "strong?" Nonsense. What's more, isn't it utterly insipid to fight without your own two hands?

main2.line: As a secretary, the most frustrating thing is not having anything to do. Commander, don't you have anything you need me to take care of?

main3.line: Amagi is a worthy rival, and the one who I respect the most. Even if you asked me to be her support, I would have no objections.

mission.line: Missions? If it's not combat-related, don't come looking for me.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards are here, huh? I'll go grab 'em. I could use a bit of exercise.

profile.line: I'm Kaga, second ship of the Tosa-class battleships. Built as an improvement to the Nagato-class, I was to serve as part of the Eight-Eight Fleet Program. Amagi... I would like to fight alongside her someday.

propose.line: To be able to trust someone who always has my back, to be able to fight without reservation... this has always been my dream! And for that someone to be you, what more could I ask for?

skill.line: Only the strong have the right to stand on the battlefield!

touch.line: Commander, don't you ever get tired of being in that cramped office all day? Why not come out with me for some fresh air?

touch2.line: ... Let me get a shot in first if you're going to do that!

unlock.line: Hmm... is this the next place for me to flex my might? Very well. I am Kaga - Battleship Kaga. Make no mistake of it.

upgrade.line: Ahaha! I won't disappoint you!

win_mvp.line: Too weak! Come back and face me again once you've had some more training.

gift_prefer.line: How'd you wind up like this?

battle.line: Hah, my rampage is soon to begin!

couple_encourage1.line: Together with me now, my sister!

couple_encourage2.line: I am still no match for you, Amagi.

detail.line: I hate the phrase, "it's how it's always been done." The same mistakes will forever be repeated as long as fools keep spouting it.

expedition.line: You don't expect me to announce when a commission team returns, do you?

feeling1.line: Weaklings belong behind the shorelines. I have no business with someone who cannot handle even a tidal wave.

feeling2.line: You are brave, lowering your guard around someone that could take your life at any moment. You say it's because you trust me? Hahahah. Trust. A fine word that is.

feeling3.line: You are an odd one, remaining unfazed in the presence of the Sakura Empire's ships. Still, I do enjoy exchanging stories with you. What have you in store for me today?

feeling4.line: When I am alone, I let no rules or regulations restrain me; I push my will through. However, when you are present, I feel compelled to follow the rules and act with prudence. You are really something else, Commander.

feeling5.line: Your ambitions and dreams are of no concern to me, but I know that you need me. Which, I admit, is also true in reverse. Our fates are intertwined, and we cannot afford to lose one another... Hahahah, isn't that right?

home.line: Did you see anything extraordinary on your expedition? You may find it inconsequential, but I am curious to know what you encountered.

hp_warning.line: Hahaha... Battles fraught with suspense are always the most interesting!

login.line: Give me an engaging task, should you find one, Commander.

lose.line: Gah, so even I overestimate my abilities at times...

mail.line: A letter, eh? I would be grateful if even a third of the information in it is credible.

main1.line: Brute force – the most primitive, but also most effective approach. That said, I much prefer fighting with words over swords.

main2.line: I do not shy away from using any trick required to achieve my goals. I would rather that than play by the rules and end up at the bottom of the sea.

main3.line: Stay behind if you cannot fight. The weak should know their place from the strong – this is the belief my sister holds.

main4.line: I am neither as forward-thinking as Amagi, nor as short-fused as my sister. What? What's incorrect? The part about my sister, or my description of myself?

mission.line: A leader chooses their mission, not the other way around. You should take this principle to heart, Commander.

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed, has it? Then don't loiter around, go and claim the rewards at once.

profile.line: I am Tosa, the first Tosa-class battleship. My construction began long ago, but its completion never came... I have been an aircraft carrier, a battleship, a weapons testbed, and a target; they worked and reworked me to the bone. But now I am here, in this form, and I will not disappoint you.

propose.line: Simply being given life in this world would've been enough for me, but now I've even been given a partner to spend said life with... Hmph, life is a long and arduous road, and I am happy that I get to walk it with you.

skill.line: Bear witness to who reigns supreme!

touch.line: Seeing as you have time to kill, why not practice your swordplay with me?

touch2.line: Acting on a momentary impulse can have deadly repercussions. I do hope you're not getting any outlandish ideas.

unlock.line: I am the nameship of the Tosa-class battleships, Tosa. I only serve those who I deem worthy. As for you... Well, I do not believe in making hasty judgments. For the time being, let me first assess your abilities.

upgrade.line: You have an eye for talent, Commander.

win_mvp.line: It's over already? Hmph, I expected more from them.

gift_prefer.line: You knew... I wouldn't be able to turn down something so precious... Hehe, quite the devious one, aren't you?

detail_ex.line: *Sigh*, that damn commander... If I'm not careful, then Kaga's going to... But wait, even Amagi isn't to be overlooked... Huh?! When'd you get there?!

expedition_ex.line: A commission team has returned. It would seem I've grown used to announcing this.

feeling5_ex.line: Lest you forget, no matter how great your ambitions may be, you are but a vulnerable human. If you are ever in danger, you must take cover and protect yourself. If misfortune befalling you strips me of my reason to move forward, I will hunt you down through the depths of hell or the pinnacles of heaven. Don't think you can escape from me, ahahaha!

home_ex.line: Why don't you tell me about something interesting that happened out there? I like hearing about that stuff.

login_ex.line: All right, hurry up and get to work. I'll find something to do.

main1_ex.line: Commander, you seem to be dealing with Amagi's bootlicker pretty well... Heh, actually, my sister's even harder to handle. Be grateful that you have me.

main2_ex.line: As ships, our purpose is to connect the hearts of mankind as well as the ocean's routes. No matter what shape we might take, that will always hold true. Even if we were born for the sake of war, that will always hold true.

main3_ex.line: Privacy...? As someone who is strong, isn't it only natural to protect someone who is weak such as you, wherever and whenever?

mail_ex.line: Mail? If it's a reassignment request, I'd just rip it up.

mission_ex.line: Missions? Let me see them.

mission_complete_ex.line: Oh, was that the mission completion notification? How was the payment?

touch_ex.line: You want to cross swords with me? We could, but... It would be a dull match if I don't go all-out, but then you are bound to suffer grave injuries... Hmm, what to do...

touch2_ex.line: Do not let your hand waver. Be more bold if you so wish. Hahaha!

detail.line: You should avoid swimming too much as you're so sickly, Amagi. How tragic it is, a ship such as you being so frail...

home.line: My sister is still on the way here? Hmph, then I will prepare you some food.

login.line: Whew... It's nice to get to play freely, but I must take heed of all the extra attention this swimsuit draws to me...

main1.line: The shrine maiden and her sister, frolicking in the water... A rare sight to be had.

main2.line: We could play a round of go if you are bored. I want a new opponent after playing against only my sister for so long.

main3.line: You're in need of a snack? Sorry, I only just got these from my sister. That said... we could exchange side dishes, I suppose...

touch2.line: Try this with my sister instead. Actually, don't; it would likely backfire on you...

unlock.line: An inspection? ...You're awfully gung-ho about your work considering how hot it is outside... Surely you wouldn't have some sort of ulterior motive?

detail.line: Let's join the festivities after this bath. Surprised I'm going to attend the banquet, are you? Hah, I really am. Someone has to look after you, after all.

expedition.line: Are you so distracted by my figure that you completely missed the commission that's been completed?

feeling5.line: My old self would never have imagined she'd one day be unclad in a bath, flirting with you. And yet, here I am, and I'm not afraid to change again for you. Heehee. We share a destiny, you and I – therefore, everything I do for you is for myself. That only makes sense, no?

headtouch.line: Do you like the sensation of moist skin?

home.line: You're back. Did anything amusing happen out there? If so, sit down and tell me about it.

login.line: You want me to come with you and enjoy the banquet? I could, but all merrymaking and no sharpening makes any blade grow dull – even yours.

lose.line: Being so exposed does you no favors in battle, it seems.

mail.line: Here's a letter with your name on it. I hope it isn't from my sister, demanding you take me to the banquet.

main1.line: I'd rather stay here than go to some party. That being said, I suppose I wouldn't mind going if it's with you. Nothing wrong in changing your mind sometimes, right?

main2.line: The view up here is pretty good. Maybe it will even give me new insight that'll help in battle... Insight which I will need to keep you safe.

main3.line: Here I thought this was a great place to wait out the banquet, yet you found me in no time. No matter. In a way, it's proof of how likeminded we are.

main4.line: Tell me, did my sister put you up to this? She didn't? Alright, then let's stay here a while longer. I want to make the most of this rare opportunity to enjoy the view on this cruise ship.

mission.line: I suggest finishing all your missions before the banquet commences.

mission_complete.line: Completed a mission, did you? Then don't forget to claim the rewards.

touch.line: What is it? Unless it's really important, save it for after I've put some clothes on.

touch2.line: Relax. I have no reason to stop you.

unlock.line: Commander? ...You were looking for me? Hah, you have the most atrocious luck. I've just started getting comfortable and I'm not leaving anytime soon. Besides, the banquet will be done in time even without my help... You seem to be enjoying yourself. How about you join me instead of merely staring?

win_mvp.line: An effortless victory, I see. How dull. I'm going back to take a bath.

battle.line: Musashi has arrived. Let us rid ourselves of haste and trepidation, for we shall advance with great solemnity.

couple_encourage1.line: Thank you for everything you've done.

couple_encourage2.line: Stand behind me!

couple_encourage3.line: Let us show them the might of the Yamato class.

couple_encourage4.line: With you supporting me, I can unsheath even more of my might!

detail.line: Those with great power have a responsibility to protect those beneath them. Even you, Commander, shall find protection beneath my shade. Hehe.

expedition.line: The children of the commission fleet have returned. I am unable to personally escort them back, but am nevertheless glad to see them safe and sound.

feeling1.line: If you insist on continuing down this path, I will not stop you. ...However, never forget that water can either support a ship, or capsize it.

feeling2.line: The more magnificent the tree, the more it incurs the wind's jealousy. Remember this well - the more you rise in renown and rank, the more you should watch your words and deeds.

feeling3.line: You've never seen me get mad? Hehe... Even the most docile of creatures know when to bare their fangs. You would do well not to judge one by their appearance. Having that said, it does take some extraordinary skill to make me angry.

feeling4.line: Every person has a sentimental side - the same is true for you, as it is for me... Do you wish to see that side of me? Hehe... That all depends on how hard you work for it.

feeling5.line: What's wrong? Are you still unable to find rest even within my bosom? Your anxiety and frustration are not easily set aside, you say? ...Hehe, cast your fears and doubts away and be at peace. As long as you are in Musashi's embrace, you shall be protected from all harm.

headtouch.line: A most courageous child... Hehe, I do not object...

home.line: It is good that you have returned safely. Take your time and rest first. To be human is to trudge forward while carrying karmic burden atop your shoulders. There is no need for haste, for plenty of trials still await you in the future.

hp_warning.line: No matter how dire things may be, I will always protect you!

login.line: Commander, what are your plans for the day? Should you have nothing in mind, I shall arrange your schedule in your stead.

lose.line: Do not overextend, and do not panic. I shall see to it that you are protected.

mail.line: I brought over this letter addressed to you. Please look it over.

main1.line: It is in the cuckoo bird's nature to chirp. If it does not do so, then all you need to do is wait. Hehe... Do you understand the rationale behind my words, Commander?

main2.line: Sometimes, it is more important to calm your mind and think about who your allies are than it is to exact vengeance on your enemies.

main3.line: If you are weary, you should not hesitate to rest. I shall protect you and take care of your duties in your absence.

main4.line: In my spare time... I enjoy foot baths. Soaking my feet in hot water seems to clear my head, despite the fact that the two cannot be farther apart. How curious...

main5.line: I sometimes see Shinano sound asleep here. May the pleasant dreams you give her last forever.

mission.line: A new mission? Take it one step at a time, and at a comfortable pace. Haste makes waste.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have arrived. Our stockpiles continue to grow more and more abundant.

profile.line: I am Musashi, the existence that was supposed to turn the tides in the Sakura Empire's favor during that war... But there is no point in lamenting the past, as it is not in my nature. All I know is, this time, I shall protect all that is dear to me, no matter the cost.

propose.line: Entrust all your anxieties, doubts, and fears to me, and focus your mind only on moving forward without hesitation. Come, let me become your bedrock, your foundation. My beloved Commander, nothing in existence shall ever tear you from me.

touch.line: Should you ever feel anxious or frightened, please come to me. Your safe haven is here.

touch2.line: How precious... If the warmth of one's touch is what you crave, then leap into my bosom. There is nothing to be ashamed of.

unlock.line: I am the Yamato-class battleship, Musashi. If it is my acknowledgment you seek, then quell the storms that rage across these seas with your magnificence. Hm? With a fleet as mighty as yours, even a weakling would find that task trivial.

upgrade.line: "Even the greatest trees start as small saplings." The smallest bit of effort today may one day become the weapon that shatters the enemy, the bulwark that protects what we love.

win_mvp.line: Do not allow yourself to become drunk off the nectar of victory.

gift_prefer.line: You were able to discover exactly what I like... What a sweet child...

expedition_ex.line: The children of the commission fleet have returned. If you are going to greet them, do bring me with you.

feeling5_ex.line: Return to my embrace after finishing today's work. What do I mean by "return," you ask? Exactly how it sounds. I wish to pamper... I mean, protect you from those who would take advantage of you in your sleep.

home_ex.line: You're back already? Did I not ask you to inform me beforehand so I can escort you personally...?

login_ex.line: Commander, I have already arranged your activities for the day. First off...

lose_ex.line: Fighting until the bitter end serves no purpose. Withdraw for now, and come back after regrouping your forces.

main6_ex.line: You find some of my colleagues difficult to deal with? Just bring me along next time. I shall teach them that an insult to you is an insult to me as well... Oh, that's not what you meant?

main7_ex.line: Phew... What a long day. Would you like to soak in the foot bath with me? I believe you've earned yourself a break.

main8_ex.line: My favorite food? It'd have to be sea bream. Especially freshly-fried sea bream tempura. Truly a wonderful taste not to be missed.

main9_ex.line: If you ever tire of petty formalities, allow me to handle the socializing for you. As always, I will make sure everything is done to perfection.

touch_ex.line: My lap awaits you. Hurry and come enjoy your respite.

touch2_ex.line: If this sensation is to your liking, you are welcome to dive in face-first. Hehe.

win_mvp_ex.line: Relax and bask in the afterglow of victory. Hehe.

battle.line: Let us expurgate those who would muddy this tidy place!

detail.line: Would you also like to help out with our pop-up café? Though, I don't mind if you just stay put over there. I can't help but worry when I am unable to see you...

home.line: Good job on your sortie. Go ahead and take a seat anywhere you want. After I take care of the rest of my chores, I shall come serve you personally. Hehe.

login.line: Would you like a savory appetizer, or perhaps something sweet? Hehe, open your mouth. Allow me to feed you.

lose.line: I'll have to tidy this mess up first...

main1.line: To celebrate this great victory, I shall see to it that our friends are served the finest refreshments. Hehe, naturally, it'll all be free of cost.

main2.line: The item you ordered was never delivered? Worry not, I think I understand the situation... Sakawa, I'd like to have a word with you.

main3.line: The girls have been giving it their all to make our pop-up café a success, and a few accidents are nothing we cannot overlook. If anyone feels aggrieved on this basis alone, then it is only fitting to teach them a lesson.

mission.line: Since you're here, put your troubles aside for now. We can worry about your mission later.

touch.line: Is someone's service unsatisfactory? I shall go remind her then... That's not it? You just need me to handle an extra order?

touch2.line: Comfort and solace await you in my bosom. No one shall be allowed to disturb you.

unlock.line: "Welcome back, Master." Rather, that's what all the children at the café were saying to you when they greeted you at the door. Hehe, is this some new custom?

battle.line: Let's meet them with a threefold assault.

detail.line: "The fox falls into the fortunate rabbit's trap," was it? Would you consider me the fox or the rabbit right now, I wonder? How fascinating... Heehee♥

expedition.line: The girls who went out on commission are back. Your welcome, and these prizes, will be a suitable reward for them.

feeling5.line: If you're tired of games, then come and relax with me. I won't bite – in fact, I know plenty of ways to satisfy you... Heehee, good, good♥

home.line: Have you gotten a good look around? Then sit, rest, and watch as I break a new record.

login.line: Well met. This bunny outfit I picked to suit your tastes, this water gun... Don't you think they're perfect for this amusement park? I suggest you simply enjoy yourself...

main1.line: I'm used to festival shooting games. Heehee, I know how good a shot you are. Why don't we have fun and test our skills together?

main2.line: Preparing so many waterpark attractions and entertainment for your friends... I admire your efforts, Commander.

main3.line: Just as you entertain us with this park, we'd like to treat your eyes with these different costumes. Of course, I'm able to offer more services...

main4.line: It's not the same as thunder-clad sword swings or cannon fire, but that makes it all the more challenging. Don't worry – just point me toward my enemy, and I'll do the rest.

main5.line: Missed again... This water gun's handling is poor at best. I have to wonder if Akashi made it, rather than Owari...

mission.line: New missions. No matter how treacherous the situation is, a calm response will be more than enough to handle them.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. May this bounty and these prizes reward your efforts.

touch.line: Are you more interested in my gun... or the fabric of my clothes? Heehee.

touch2.line: You know what they say about rabbits... don't you?♥

unlock.line: ...Hmph. Hitting such a target is but an easy feat for me... Commander, tell me which prize you want. I'll win it, along with all the other ones I've been asked to get.

win_mvp.line: A satisfying victory. Your joy and peace of mind are reward enough for me.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. As you expected, they bring great spoils. Let's welcome them together.

feeling5.line: Is something wrong? I sense hesitation... Do not be afraid of the hardships of your journey. As someone willing to give you everything, I'm happy to remove all obstacles from your path. All you must do is bravely march on to the promised future.

home.line: Welcome back. This time, I didn't misjudge the time of your return. Take a bath and relax yourself for now.

hp_warning.line: As long as I have a reason to keep fighting...

login.line: Good morning, my beloved. Before you consider your plans for the day, please enjoy a breakfast made with love.

lose.line: One mustn't be reckless in battle. Failure is but the foundation of success. Let's reform our offense and try once more.

mail.line: A letter... Hmm. From afar, it seems?

main1.line: The road may be long and treacherous, but if you keep on marching, you'll make your way to dawn. Only by continuing on, undaunted, can we find true beauty... I will journey with you, be the rock that you can lean on and take shelter behind. It's a blessing for me to be that person to you.

main2.line: In this long life, it's fun to stop and smell the flowers on the roadside once in a while... This time of year is bursting with life. Why not stop with me somewhere we can forget the 108 vices?

main3.line: What do you want for dinner? Or would you prefer a taste of romance instead? Don't worry. I won't disappoint you, my dear.

main4.line: Devote yourself to your ideals and the future you envision... As long as I'm by your side, you can rely on me for anything.

touch.line: This white dress... It has special meaning to you, doesn't it?

touch2.line: Heehee... Give me all that you are, my beloved. I'm already prepared to receive you.

unlock.line: Commander, the contract has been made according to your wishes. From now on, I will be your new refuge. Now, beloved Commander, are you prepared to live up to MY expectations?

win_mvp.line: I offer to you promised victory, my beloved. Hehe.

battle.line: The fate of our country rests upon this battle!

couple_encourage1.line: We fight together for humanity itself!

couple_encourage2.line: Steel yourself! And press the attack!

couple_encourage3.line: Never fear, the Sakura Empire is your ever steadfast ally.

couple_encourage4.line: Be careful. Misuse that power and we're worm food.

detail.line: A flagship must lead from the vanguard. This is a self-evident truth.

expedition.line: Without robust logistics, even the mightiest fleets will turn into a disorderly mob.

feeling1.line: You Showa-born brat!

feeling2.line: Thinking about how I won't see old friends from back in my day ever again, it's... Well, never mind. I have people who look up to me now, and I can't let them down!

feeling3.line: If you don't have a plan to end a war, then you'd better not start one to begin with!

feeling4.line: Yes, I can tell you've been working hard. B- but! That doesn't mean you get to start goldbricking now!

feeling5.line: You can't fire on all four boilers all the time. Listen, I'm going to look the other way while you take five... You've been wanting to nap on my lap? I-I guess that'd be okay...

home.line: Excellent! The scales of war are tipping in our favor!

hp_warning.line: Keep calm! This battle is far from over!

login.line: Until we've reclaimed our former glory, we must never stop pressing forward!

lose.line: So this what it must have felt like to suffer through the Battle of Dan-no-ura...

mail.line: No matter how many medals and honors I receive... Ehehe~♪

main1.line: The victory at Tsushima did not occur by chance.

main2.line: Royal cuisine? I'll pass... I've had enough of that.

main3.line: Those things flying through the sky... Err, they're called "ear-playings," right?

mission.line: Hmm, I'm in charge of today's fleet operations? Very well... the fate of our country rests... mmf! ... Why aren't you letting me speak?

mission_complete.line: Very well. I shall plunder... I mean, receive the spoils of victory!

profile.line: I am Mikasa, a Shikishima-type battleship, and last of the Six-Six Fleet shipbuilding program. I served as the flagship of the Combined Fleet, and won a glorious victory that honored the name of our country across the world.

propose.line: You still got a long way to go to earn my respect! ... Hehehe, so that's why I better stick by you♪ 'Til you're too good even for me.

skill.line: Let every ship do her utmost!

touch.line: Even the most hardworking people sometimes have lapses of judgment. It is my duty to admonish you in times like these.

touch2.line: You'd like me to be your dance partner at the next banquet? ... I-I suppose I have no choice...

unlock.line: I am the one who braved a hail of bullets and shells to return to my homeland with glory and victory. I am Mikasa, pre-dreadnought battleship of the Sakura Empire and flagship of the 1st Fleet, awaiting your command!

upgrade.line: Only the battlefield can separate the wheat from the chaff.

win_mvp.line: Through righteousness comes prosperity. Such is the will of the heavens.

gift_prefer.line: What a nostalgic feeling...

detail.line: Mm... what a pleasant breeze. A fine day to embark on a new journey.

feeling5.line: I was thinking, what if I was still a schoolgirl, meeting you for the first time beneath the dancing cherry blossoms before becoming inseparable sweethearts... A scenario like that, might have been nice.

home.line: Everyone has returned home safely. What a relief.

login.line: Mhm, a fine morning. Have you had breakfast yet?

main1.line: When I don this uniform, I feel like I'm being called to my more youthful days... Ah, that's right! It's that excitement of going on a trip for the first time as a kid! Hehe~

main2.line: Back then, many of us went abroad to study with the Royal Navy. Hm, you can't picture me doing that? Want to see for yourself? Well, we're just a few minutes from the Royal dorms though. Hahaha!

main3.line: Looking back, I sometimes miss those days... but right now, this fleet is where I belong.

touch2.line: Hey! Knock that off! You're going to make me drop my luggage...

unlock.line: I found quite the nostalgic outfit when I was cleaning my wardrobe. Let's see... "Prepare to come with me on a new journey!" How do I look, Commander?

detail.line: The cherry blossoms in full bloom are a beautiful sight to behold, no matter the era.

home.line: The flowering season waits for nobody. Feast your eyes upon this magnificence before the petals wither. Ahaha!

login.line: Mhm, clear skies and a gentle breeze. Fine weather indeed for admiring the flowers.

touch.line: Commander, I... Um, does this outfit look good on me? Come on, no need to be shy. Ahaha!

touch2.line: F-fine... I shall permit it, just a little.

unlock.line: It's about time for the flowers to bloom once more. Alas, how the time flies by... Ahem, Commander, let's see, would you like to go blossom-viewing with me?

detail.line: Sometimes, Kongou will drop by and talk with me about the Royal Navy while we enjoy the scenery... Commander, would you like to join us next time?

home.line: Have you finished your work? Excellent, then feel free to spend the rest of your day as you please!

login.line: Though it is said that spring is the season of restful slumber, sleeping in simply because you feel like it... is no good at all.

main1.line: What should I do on this well-earned vacation...? Assembling model ships? Housework? Travel? ...Too many things to do...

main2.line: Commander, do you think people would consider me slovenly if they saw me like this? No chance of that? Good, I see.

main3.line: Nagato, do not excessively concern yourself with the opinions of others. Simply set your worries aside and enjoy yourself.

touch.line: What's the matter? You want to give my clothes a rub? Haha, so you can tell the difference! Very good, very good!

touch2.line: Hey, hey, you're going to expose me at this rate.

unlock.line: Even I like to dress down and unwind from time to time. Oh? This is new and exciting for you? Well, you are welcome to come see more of it from now on! Hahaha!

expedition.line: Our commission team has returned. Get excited for some new menu items!

home.line: Excellent; you've returned in one piece! Ah, I suppose girls these days say, "Welcome home, Master!" Hmm... Maybe that sounds a bit too forced...

login.line: Mhm, things are nice and tidy as always. On three, everybody! One, two, three... Welcome, Commander!

main1.line: People will get bored sooner or later if our menu is nothing but Sakura-style confections... Should we add some curry or Western snacks?

main2.line: Mutsu, please! We all know you've got a sweet tooth, but the café's food is off-limits! We've got staff meals right over there.

main3.line: Say, I ought to put my skills to the test. What would you like to eat, Commander? It doesn't have to be from the menu either.

mission.line: I will take care of store management today. Commander, you focus on the mission.

touch.line: Maybe I ought to take your order myself. Hahaha!

touch2.line: Say, what kind of establishment do you think this is...?

unlock.line: Welcome to the Sakura Empire's pop-up café... Oh, Commander! Everyone's waiting for you. Now get your butt in here and experience the full extent of our fleet's hospitality! Don't be nervous, now! Hahaha!

win_mvp.line: Hahaha! Seems like we'll have to jazz up that celebratory menu, eh?

battle.line: Battleship Mikasa is here! Let's do this!

detail.line: "It's a little different from the other girls, but that just makes it suit me more," huh? Is it just me, or are you getting smoother by the day? Hah!

expedition.line: Oh, the commission team's back? Don't forget to get them some souvenirs while we're here.

home.line: Let's stop and take in the peace you've brought us. Getting proper rest between fierce battles is part of your job! Heheh.

login.line: Even a nostalgic town feels different by your side, Commander. Go on; lead the way!

main1.line: Huh, so this is the "Beauty Looking Back"... It's really embarrassing to hear you say that about me, though.

main2.line: They weren't kidding when they said "no road is long with good company." I just hope you're having a good time, too... Hahaha, that's what I like to hear!

main3.line: Hmm. So there are famous mountains, historical sites, and even temples and shrines... I dunno if we'll be able to see all of this now. I say this calls for a repeat trip!

mission.line: You plan the missions, and I'll plan the trip! ...Uh, how do you use this tablet, exactly?

mission_complete.line: Finished your mission? Good timing! I just finished checking out this tourist spot.

touch.line: Hm? You wanna hear the story behind this dress? Then get comfy and prepare for a lecture from your guide, Mikasa!

touch2.line: Hey! No touching the sash! ...Phew. That scared me, y'know.

unlock.line: I was worried when you said you wanted to go on a trip with me, but... I do like getting to go sight-seeing and try on new threads. Commander, let's enjoy this to the fullest! Hahaha!

battle.line: Vanquish all evil! Crush the enemy!

detail.line: Well, perfect timing. Hm... It looks like this size should fit you... As the one in charge, you can't neglect stocking up on necessities. Once we're in the middle of battle, even your best clothes can get all torn up in the blink of an eye. Make sure you to get some spares while we're still in the lull of peace.

home.line: You brought everyone back safely, without a hitch! Spectacularly done, I must say. Hahaha!

login.line: I can't get used to calling you "Dear" or you calling me "Honey"... Calling each other by what we already do would be easier? Very well, as long as you're fine with it...

lose.line: Are you telling me it's impossible, even with the Commander at my back...?

mail.line: Hehe♪ These medals and awards... are things I obtained with you by my side. Go ahead, burn the sight into your mind~

main1.line: My Commander, don't slack on your studies. If you'd like, I'd be happy to teach you personally.

main2.line: Tonight's menu... How about I make you naval curry that originates from a port I have an affinity with? Of course, it's simply exquisite.

main3.line: So those are "airplanes." The true potential of new things are often overlooked for quite some time. Do your best to not do the same.

mission.line: Oi! Don't doze off on me! I promise I'll let you rest after you read through the mission!

mission_complete.line: Very good. Well done! We're done with the mission! You really should teach Zuikaku and the others how you do it.

touch.line: Urgh, how in the world do you use this cellular phone thing? ...Grrrr...

touch2.line: You're working very hard, so I guess I'll allow this much...

unlock.line: I, battleship Mikasa, from now until eternity, pledge to you my undying love and devotion. May we help each other, encourage each other, and walk side-by-side on the same path. I hope to meet your expectations, as unworthy as I may be.

win_mvp.line: As long as you put your mind to it, there's no war you can't win! Redouble your efforts, and keep up the good work!

battle.line: Let's duke it out, fair and square!

couple_encourage1.line: You're the brains, I'm the brawn!

couple_encourage2.line: Don't be shy! Let's do this with flair!

couple_encourage3.line: Let's celebrate with a glass after we get back!

detail.line: Obviously I like being on the center stage with my massive cannons. Performance aside, their size alone boosts morale while intimidating the enemy. You get what I mean, Commander?

expedition.line: That last commission was kinda mediocre... Still, they deserve a congratulatory moment. Want to come with me?

feeling1.line: I'm so tired of bosses that can't handle their subordinates, like you.

feeling2.line: You okay, Commander? You've had this tired, stiff look on you for a while now... You're not getting rusty like Suruga, are you?

feeling3.line: Thought as much. I'll help you with your training, then! Come on, out of your room and into the fresh outdoors for some jogging! And later, we'll do some sparring!

feeling4.line: There's no fun in knocking a battle out of the park if nobody's there to witness it. Anyway, once this work is done, I'll go train with Hyuuga. After that, you, I, and Suruga will go for a drink with Ise! Sound good to you?

feeling5.line: People say you can push yourself harder if it's to protect someone. Then for everyone's sake, I, Kii, shall become the strongest battleship... Pfft, yeah right! Hahahahah!

home.line: I reckon we'll garner more fame by winning battles than by wasting time in port, don't you agree?

hp_warning.line: These guys are tougher than I expected!

login.line: Look who's finally clocked in, hahahah! My trigger finger's gotten itchy, so let's get on with a sortie already!

lose.line: Dammit... Not enough firepower for the job, huh?

mail.line: A letter, eh? If it's an open duel, then I accept their challenge! Oh, no duel, huh...

main1.line: Tell me if anyone starts picking on you. I'll put them in their place! And I mean it, for the most part, you hear?

main2.line: Mmghh! I'm feeling stiff after standing up for so long... What's up, Commander? Why are you blushing? ...My bra's coming off?

main3.line: Hey, Suruga! What do you say to going drinking with me and the gang once work is done? Figures, always so antisocial... When people invite you, you should go with it!

mission.line: A new mission? If it's about turning hostiles to scrap, I'll get it done!

mission_complete.line: We're wrapping up these missions nicely! Great!

profile.line: I am part of the Eighty-Eight Fleet Program: first ship of the Kii-class battleships, Kii. In short, I never got a chance to shine during the war because reasons... But now I have, and I'm going to use it to its fullest! If you have anything that needs doing, just say the word, Commander!

propose.line: I mean, we don't need to go that far. We're already dearly important to one another, aren't we? ...Don't worry, I'll still accept it! And of course, I'll keep on keeping you safe, just like I always have!

touch.line: Something on your mind? I might be able to help you with it.

touch2.line: "Friendly friskiness," is it? Hmm... Sure, I guess?

unlock.line: Battleship Kii, reporting for duty! Is it true that I'd be able to fight without holding back over here? Heh, good stuff! I look forward to what the future has in store, and you should keep your eyes on me as well!

upgrade.line: Let's see how strong I've really gotten. Send me into battle!

win_mvp.line: Victory's ours. Heheh, now that was refreshing all right.

gift_prefer.line: Not bad! I'll take it!

battle_ex.line: Come here! Let's fight to the last ship sailing!

login_ex.line: Look who's arrived early. Now then, where are we going on a sortie today?

main3_ex.line: Say, how about a little drink after the working day is done? Although since my drinking pals are coming along, I guess we'll have more than just a little! Hahahahah!

touch2_ex.line: Physical contact doesn't normally bother me, but you clearly did that on purpose!

win_mvp_ex.line: Now this is a victory I want the whole world to see! Hahahahah!

detail.line: Hey Suruga, let's go somewhere– Come on, don't be all "I like it indoors" and "I'd rather not draw attention," just come out and enjoy the summer with us!

home.line: Whoa, this drink is really good. Want a taste, Commander? Hehehe~

login.line: There you are, at last. Want to get something to eat, if you're hungry? Like dumplings, or a rice ball, or something.

main1.line: Akashi sure got that vending machine and stall set up quick... She's ingenious, but only when there's money to be made...

main2.line: Why the hesitation? It's just a pool. Nothing wrong with just swimming together with me, is there?

main3.line: Really looks like Amagi, Akagi, and all the rest are enjoying the summer. All thanks to you, Commander. You should be proud.

touch.line: Want to head to that other area? I'll come with you.

unlock.line: Refreshing drinks, delicious food, warm sunshine... and a pool to beat the heat? Heh, isn't this the essence of summer?

battle.line: Show me whatcha got! Ahahah♪

couple_encourage1.line: Hey, Kii, you wanna hang out after this is done?？

couple_encourage2.line: Man, your smarts are on, like, a whole other level...

detail.line: I let others do the thinking – me, I'm just the brawn, pretty much. Complicated stuff kinda goes over my head... Haha~♪ Bein' dumb has its benefits, y'know!

expedition.line: Oh, right, the commish team just got back. Aight, better tell the Commander~

feeling1.line: You're, like, kind of a crappy person. I just don't like being let down so much, y'know?

feeling2.line: Try not to ask too much from Kii 'n Suruga, aight? If you've got a problem, bring it to me first of all! I don't mind one bit.

feeling3.line: If I wasn't doing what I'm doing now, whaddya think I'd be doing? Me, I'd wanna run a shop dealin' in seasonal fruits and stuff... You feel me? We could totally set one up together.

feeling4.line: Ain't nothin' in the world people get right on their first try. War is like that, and love too – it becomes natural once you've practiced it... Whaddya mean, "What do you mean"? C'mon, Commander, put two and two together!

feeling5.line: Oh, man... I can't get you outta my head, and I can't focus 'cause of it... I give up... Whenever this kinda stuff happens, ya just gotta do or die and go straight for the goal! Commander, I l-love... *blushes* Wait, lemme get ready first!

headtouch.line: Hm? Whatcha doin'? You ain't gonna get three wishes for rubbing my head. Though, it does feel real nice!

home.line: Oh, 'sup, Commander? You sure look beat... Was the battle that much of a drag? How 'bout we go kick it at the teahouse to unwind?

hp_warning.line: I'm not 'boutta whine over a little damage and disgrace the Kii class...

login.line: Ah, Commander. Good timing. I just got some crazy fresh veggies. You wanna give 'em a taste?

lose.line: Maaan. This is seeeeriously lame~

mail.line: Commander, there's a letter for you. Better check it sooner than later.

main1.line: What? I messed up? Maaan, that's soooo lame... Huh? Commander?! How long 'ave you been there? S-stop lookin'!

main2.line: An operation? I'm not very book smart, but I'm guessin' you put a lot of thought into it? Alright, I'll get Suruga in here to explain it to me!

main3.line: You said you'd come 'n eat my home cooking, remember? You can bet yer behind it's gonna be good!

main4.line: Ughhh, I give up! I don't have any clue how to solve this puzzle! Kii! Come help!

mission.line: Huh? You've still got unfinished missions? What's up with that? Hmm... If you've got your hands full, I could help.

mission_complete.line: What's this? This mission's done and dusted... Unless I'm imagining it? Surely not.

profile.line: I'm Owari, Kii-class battleship number two! I was originally supposed to get built out, but that never happened for whatever random-ass reasons. Doesn't bother me one bit though. All that matters is, I'm gonna give it my all with you in charge~♪

propose.line: God! I just can't stop thinkin' about you, whatever I do, like you're literally stuck in my head... What I'm getting at is: I'm crazy for you! Might as well stop fighting it and... accept it, y'know?

skill.line: I'll show you hip and trendy~

touch.line: Yeah? You wanna hold hands with me? Sure thing~♪

touch2.line: So you get a kick outta touchin' me, huh? Good to know~♪

unlock.line: I'm Owari, and you must be the boss o' this here fleet... Nah, you're obviously the Commander! Ahahahah! Nice meetin' you!

upgrade.line: Woah, hot dayum... Is this stuff dope as hell or what?!

win_mvp.line: Don't ya dare diss the bonds between us!

gift_prefer.line: Woah, this is suuuper cute! Huh? You're giving it to me? Wooow~ you rock~♪

battle_ex.line: Watch this! I'm totally gonna style on 'em!

detail_ex.line: I'm not the sharpest tool in the shed, but I can at least keep up with you! ...'Cause, you know, love blinds people 'n all that? But love won't change me, it'll only turn one of us into a dummy. Haha♪

feeling5_ex.line: Dunno why, but I feel on edge when I stand next to you... like I'm not myself, somehow... Creeps me out. Wonder why I'm like this... Any ideas, Commander? ...Lovesickness, huh. What's that even mean?

login_ex.line: Hey, Commander, we'll hang out today, won't we? I've really been lookin' forward to this, so expect fun times ahead♪

main5_ex.line: When I look at you, I get all weak and squishy and stuff... Is this what bein' obsessed is like?

main6_ex.line: Askin' you for help every time I'm in a tough spot, that's not cool. I've gotta solve some problems on my own♪

main7_ex.line: We've got some crazy tasty veggies here at the port! Heck, I used some in my last recipe! Even harvested 'em myself, of course.

mission_ex.line: Hol' up! You've got unfinished missions?! You get sick or somethin', Commander? Or is the whole freakin' sky about to fall?!

mission_complete_ex.line: Oh hey, this mission here's all done too. Damn, Commander, you sure know how to bust yer butt.

touch2_ex.line: Uhhhh, there're people around, so... Phew, that was close. Like, even I feel awkward bein' watched by a ton of people...

win_mvp_ex.line: Howzat? See, now you understand how badass I can be, don't ya?

detail.line: I don't mind kickin' it with Kii and Suruga, but y'know, we could also keep relaxin' over here. If there's anything you want, these li'l guys will bring it right over~♪

home.line: Heya, Commander! Good goin' out there. Want a towel? A drink? Or maybe... a piece~ of~ me~?

login.line: Hehe, did I surprise ya, Commander? I think I threw together a pretty stylish bed... Wanna see for yerself?

main1.line: A barbecue's not a terrible idea, but if you ask me, it's fruit 'n ice cream weather right about now.

main2.line: A vacation on a floating bungalow sounds pretty dreamy~♪ Oh, but wait, what if that turns me into a total couch potato? That'd suck.

main3.line: I don't think anyone's gonna kill ya if you enjoy a little naptime with me... You down, Commander?

touch.line: Heheh, you like how that feels, don't ya?

touch2.line: What are ya plannin' to do next? I wanna see where this goes~♡

unlock.line: I love hammocks and water beds 'cause they make you feel like you're floating on waves. It's the most relaxing thing ever~♪ You oughta hop on and try for yourself, Commander~

detail.line: I got like, devilish servants creeping 'round in the dark, so you might wanna watch yourself... Keep you safe? Well, it'll cost you. Let's say... some seasonal fruits, how's that?

expedition.line: Sheesh! That looks mighty dangerous! Lemme have a look at it. A demoness can handle herself!

feeling5.line: You wish for... my love?! Daaamn, Comma– Ahem! My guest! That's nuts, just professin' your love like that to the lord of the house... O-okay, then the price is your lifelong freedom! 'Cause you're never leavin' my side♪

headtouch.line: Watch it so ya don't cut your fingers! If you spill any yummy-yummy blood of yours in the Dwelling of Demons, you're gettin' eaten! Probably.

home.line: You want a break? That's your wish, then? Aight, I'll grant your wish if you gimme a hug♪

login.line: Welcome back! So, figured out your wish to me yet? Anything's valid, remember that! Don't underestimate my abilities!

mail.line: I looked through all the letters addressed to you. They ain't cursed or nothin', so go ahead and read!

main1.line: The whip? Oh, it's for the naughty kids who don't keep their promises! It's got other uses too, 'course, like for instance... Hm? You wanna try it?

main2.line: Man, fresh veggies are so delish. You think so too? Cool, then wanna harvest the field with me later? ...What? Demons aren't supposed to eat veggies?!

main3.line: Huh? You wanna grant MY wish? Pretty gutsy proposal ya got there. Aight, I'm gonna think about my wish for later!

mission.line: Work ain't over yet? You shouldn't be workin' down here in the... Whatevs, I'll help ya out! In return, you gotta grab a bite with me after we're done!

mission_complete.line: Huh? Already finished your work? But I haven't lifted a finger yet... Oh well! Time to get some food!

touch.line: Huh? You sure you wanna get THAT close to me? Aight, then as the lord of this place, I allow you to sit here!

touch2.line: Already satisfied? Sure there ain't nothin' else you wanna do? Remember – I'll grant ANY wish you have♡

unlock.line: Welcome, guest, to the Dwelling of Demons. I own this place. I will grant you any wish in exchange for a suitable price... Yeah! Recited it all in one go! I'm so goated!

win_mvp.line: Here's the dub you wanted, Commander!

battle.line: The Suruga Fleet w-will not disappoint...!

couple_encourage1.line: Lady Nagato, I shall defend you!

couple_encourage2.line: Kaga, please... don't go overboard.

couple_encourage3.line: Amagi... I wish you could've been there for us...

couple_encourage4.line: If I wait just a little longer for my plan... No, I guess that's not happening...

couple_encourage5.line: Shimakaze! It's go time!

detail.line: I've noticed those Priority ships are strikingly individualis– Pardon, I mean they have striking personalities. Not that I'm jealous, or anything of the sort.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Shall we set out to greet them?

feeling1.line: *Sigh*... I set myself up for disappointment by expecting any decent treatment... Can I at least ask you to not go too hard on me?

feeling2.line: I hope to leverage my meager secretary abilities for the betterment of the fleet. I'm always ready for your orders, Commander.

feeling3.line: P-please! Offer your concern to other girls instead of me! You really don't need to constantly check how I'm doing just because I'm serving as your secretary!

feeling4.line: Look, I do appreciate your concern, but you saying that in front of everyone is embarrassing! Could you not put me on the spot like that again? That'd be great!

feeling5.line: *Sigh*...! People have their eyes glued to me wherever I go now, thanks to you... There are plenty of other ways to express your love without embarrassing me, you know! Please, Commander, I'd rather not deal with that again!

headtouch.line: I hope my horns were left alone... Phew, they were... Err, no! Never mind I said anything!

home.line: Nicely done out there. Please don't mind me, go ahead and take some time to relax.

hp_warning.line: Oh, for crying out loud! Just my luck!

login.line: Let's focus our attention on our work today. Don't be afraid to ask for my help, should you need it.

lose.line: Whatever, it's done and over now... Look, I don't want everyone to see this!

mail.line: It appears you have new mail. I'll confirm it on your behalf.

main1.line: I believe I'm better suited for a desk job where I can analyze data and draft new plans. The reason being my strengths lie in quickly reading, memorizing, and writing documents.

main2.line: Reckless hotheads and I don't get along particularly well. So I've learned first-hand through bad experiences with a certain someone... That is not to say I hate those kinds of people, however.

main3.line: I'm deeply grateful that you've elected me as your secretary. However, I would absolutely welcome the addition of more people to the office, as we're rather short-staffed with just me here.

main4.line: I'm not a fan of battling, but if anyone picks a fight with me, then a fight they'll get. We were made to wage war, and so that is our responsibility.

main5.line: Life is so peaceful at this port. For that, we can thank the many girls here who I don't hold as much as a candle to.

mission.line: I'd like to suggest completing these missions. It is your job to do as the commander, after all.

mission_complete.line: I've brought the mission rewards with me. Phew...

profile.line: I am Suruga, Kii-class battleship number three. I sadly wasn't constructed in time for that infamous war... It seems some threads of fate have led me to join this fleet, one I shall devote all my soul to. It is my pleasure to serve you.

propose.line: You have bizarre tastes in women, Commander... Anyway, this doesn't come as a shock to me; I've known for a long time that your feelings for me are sincere. I, Suruga, hereby accept your oath of love.

skill.line: I'm gonna smash you to pieces!

touch.line: I will do as you order me to, Commander.

touch2.line: Whuah?! What are you doing...?!

unlock.line: Battleship Suruga, reporting for duty. It would seem that some threads of fate connect me to this port... No, don't mind my rambling. Please disregard that.

upgrade.line: It's meaningless to fight if you cannot win. As such, a few enhancements may prove necessary.

win_mvp.line: Fools! I've– I mean, we've won!

gift_prefer.line: You even figured out what I like?! ...I, I really admire that...

battle_ex.line: I don't want to do this... but you leave me no choice!

detail_ex.line: I've said it time and time again: I'm not fit to be the joint exercise flagship or for any other prominent position! Why won't they listen when I say I'd screw it up horribly?! ...C-Commander?! Oh, ahh...

feeling5_ex.line: You know everything about me, from my horns to my personality. Since we're so intimate, I suppose it's needless to tell you... Actually, there's one thing I want to tell you: I will NOT go along with your flirting when we're in the office!

headtouch_ex.line: Headpats, headpatty pat, patty patty head, heady heady pat pat~ Ahahah!

home_ex.line: Welcome back. As much as I want you to be successful, I'm just as happy with everything staying the way it is.

login_ex.line: Don't be afraid to ask for my help if you need it. It is, after all, a secretary's job to support her Commander.

main1_ex.line: Too much work to process? We all know what a tough job it is to command a fleet. So please, let me give you some assistance.

main2_ex.line: We are who we are now thanks to you, Commander. And while not everyone respects you, they are grateful for what you do. You really should be proud of yourself for that. I-I feel more for you than just respect, though!

main3_ex.line: I don't mind fading into the background when I'm with my friends, but when I'm with you, I want everyone to see it. Heheh, in a friendly way, of course.

main4_ex.line: Once the war has ended, then we can discuss everything we'll do once the war ends. For now, we must focus all our efforts on fighting to eventually achieve peace.

mission_ex.line: Let's see here... I think you should review these missions.

mission_complete_ex.line: Bingo, this looks great. Commander, we've received stellar rewards!

touch2_ex.line: Hahah, I know how much you enjoy doing lewd things like this.

detail.line: I'm not much of a drinker, but I should at least have a little bit of social sake. What will you have, Commander? I could get you something alcohol-free right away.

headtouch.line: Y-you don't need to stare at me...

home.line: I owe my thanks to the girls who prepared this outfit for me. It'll help me get through the holidays without personally standing out. ...It'll have the opposite effect? Huh?!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. What do you say we take this day off and relax?

main1.line: You got this, Team Red! Mop the floor with those Team White clowns! ...Do you want to stay and watch TV with me, Commander? This match is definitely worth watching.

main2.line: I always end up oversleeping on the day after the holiday's over... *Sigh*... Me dropping the ball when it really matters is not funny at all.

main3.line: "Treasure every moment of peace you get," as someone once said. We're only simple "people", after all.

touch.line: I hardly ever get the chance to put this outfit on. Aren't you glad to see me wearing it, Commander? Hahaha~

unlock.line: Good morning, Commander. Everyone else seems to be dressed up on this day of celebration, so this shouldn't be a problem, right?

detail.line: Stupid Shimakaze... Why hasn't she showed up? She's the one who asked me for supplemental lessons...

home.line: It's good to see you again. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have reports to read through.

login.line: If you need my help, please inform me. For what it's worth, paperwork is one of my strong suits.

mail.line: You've got mail. Maybe next time I'll get Shimakaze to deliver it to you.

main1.line: You should probably not drink on the clock. You're meeting with Kii later today, remember?

main2.line: I'm a study machine when tests are coming up. Hehehe~ Also, did you know? It's harder to get all questions wrong than to get them all right.

main3.line: I'll draw unwanted attention if I do too good, so I should get this question wrong on purp– Err, nope, I didn't say anything!

touch2.line: A-at least give me a heads-up first!

unlock.line: Oh. Fancy meeting you here... Walk to school together? Uh, sure! I know the way, so please just follow me.

win_mvp.line: Yeah! That's proof my strength means something!

detail.line: Where's Kii gone off to? Actually, knowing her, she's spending Christmas drinking with her friends and having a great time. Me, I have better things to do than get drunk! Hehe.

home.line: Let me just... There, all set. Ah, welcome back, Commander.

login.line: I've left your present under the tree... Did you prepare a present for me as well?

main1.line: Shimakaze! Go get all the destroyers' presents and leave them under the tree!

main2.line: After a year of hard work, Christmas is finally upon us! And soon it'll be New Year's too! Whew.

main3.line: Would you like an oversized sock? You can use it when you want a bigger present. Hehe.

mission_complete.line: Try to keep an eye out so our presents don't get lost amid all the rewards.

touch.line: No sneak-peeking at what's inside!

unlock.line: This should do it. With how unremarkable my present is, I doubt it'll make any waves when the... Ack! Commander?! Why are you here?!

battle.line: Hehe... Don't interrupt my reading, please.

couple_encourage1.line: I already have the perfect wine to celebrate our coming victory.

detail.line: "Beneath the moonlight, shadows of flowers rustling, a path to be tread." Come, Commander. Let's walk amidst the flowers under the moon.

expedition.line: Oh, are the commission girls back? Hmm... Why don't we welcome them with ample drinks?

feeling1.line: You don't really understand my verses lately, do you? Even this fine wine has become too bitter to swallow...

feeling2.line: Which of these two drinks do you think is better? Hmm? They're both fine? Hehehe, so you enjoy tea and wine equally. You understand elegance, Commander.

feeling3.line: When I compose poetry, I tend to scrutinize every little word so I don't lose the rhythm. But when I get tipsy, I wear my heart on my sleeve. I'd like you to hear that some time, Commander.

feeling4.line: Hehe, it's a beautiful day, and I have the wine you liked so much. Yes, everything's ready for our feast... Now, Commander, sit – Ah. I just used that cup... I guess you wouldn't mind that though, would you?

feeling5.line: I feel as if you and I might have shared a bed last night... Why do I sound uncertain? Hehe, because we were drunk, of course. Our cups were full of moonlight, and flowers were all around... Why, I'd share a thousand cups of wine with you if only to savor that elegant moment.

headtouch.line: Hmm? How about you wait until I'm a little tipsier?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Want to relax with some Sakuran sake?

hp_warning.line: Hmph... I'll have to get serious.

login.line: Is that you, Commander? Hehe, I hope you didn't just come because you wanted one of my drinks... The weather is lovely. Let's indulge in the finer things – a boat ride on the lake, drinks, poetry...

lose.line: Life is full of ups and downs. Let's not dwell on every misstep.

mail.line: Hmm? Did the wine I ordered arrive? Hehe, just kidding. There's mail for you, Commander.

main1.line: Baijiu is too strong, but red wine is a touch too sour... If you're a drinker, how about you try some Sakuran sake? The aftertaste is to die for.

main2.line: A haiku suddenly appeared on the wall? Ah... I might've written that while I was drunk and excitable. I don't remember what I wrote... You liked it? Then recite it for me, please.

main3.line: "The lights are lit, on the islands far and near: the spring sea." How about you and I go on the lake and raise a toast?

mission.line: If you don't finish your work, you'll miss out on nature's beauty. Say goodbye to fun and elegance, I guess.

mission_complete.line: Did you finish your missions? Then let's go out on a boat together. I have the perfect drink for today's scenery.

profile.line: "Unheard of even in the legendary age of the awesome gods: Tatsuta River in scarlet, and the water flowing under it." I am Oumi, the fourth Kii-class battleship. Events prevented my completion once upon a time, but I've finally come. Will you be my quilt of autumn leaves, Commander?

propose.line: No matter how bland daily life can be, wine is enough to fill it with poetry. As long as flowers bloom in my heart, the whole world can be like a beautiful painting. Commander, let's keep walking through life's picture scroll together.

skill.line: Heehee, the scent of wine can be dangerous~

touch.line: Hehe. Ready to while away the time with me, Commander?

touch2.line: Heehee~ Commander, does this count as a refined matter?

unlock.line: Noble and majestic Commander, Oumi is here to serve... Hehe, I just wanted to say that. You don't care about boring formalities, do you? Instead, let's celebrate this meeting with a glass of wine.

upgrade.line: Oh yeah, that feels good. I feel ready to write a tanka.

win_mvp.line: Another battle done. Yaaawn... Time to go home, have a drink, and enjoy the scenery with the Commander...

gift_prefer.line: This is lovely! Close your eyes, Commander, so I can return the favor... Mwah!

detail_ex.line: I know exactly what I want to do... Drink? No. Recite poetry? Not that, either! Hehe, the correct answer would be to do both of those things with my Commander.

feeling5_ex.line: When we first met, I didn't think you'd understand the finer things. But you're not just refined – you're a maestro of romance. Now that I know that... I won't believe you when you say you did something because you were "too tipsy to think straight."

home_ex.line: Home already? Come and warm up with some hot sake I brought from a Sakuran brewery.

login_ex.line: Mm, I'm still a little dizzy... Did I drink too much last night? Oh, thank you for the turmeric... Let me lean on you until it clears up, okay?

main4_ex.line: "For your precious sake, once my eager life itself, was not dear to me." Umm, the next part was... D-don't stare, you're making it harder... Hm? "It may long, long years endure." Heehee, looks like you win...

main5_ex.line: ...You found a tanka on the wall? Yes, I wrote that there yesterday. I saw you sleeping, and I wanted to share my joy with you. Heehee.

main6_ex.line: Yaaawn... Hmm? Did I fall asleep in your arms again? Goodness, maybe I shouldn't drink so much... By the way, your hand is still on my tail. Hehe, does that make us even?

touch_ex.line: Hmm? Are you suggesting I come drink in your arms?

touch2_ex.line: Just a little more drink, and then... Heehee, what poetry will I leave on your body this time?

detail.line: I was practicing my escape artistry, but clearly I'm not good enough yet... Would you please come over and help me, Commander? Yep, just like that... Keep going...

feeling5.line: Come a little closer, Commander. Support me so I can relax... Hehe, got you! As punishment for not untying me right away, you're stuck with me until I'm satisfied.

headtouch.line: Hehe... Come over here, and you can touch me more freely.

home.line: Oh, you're finally back... Can you untie me this time, please?

login.line: As you can see, my escape technique isn't quite perfect. Can you get a little closer, please?

main1.line: Ugh... Tying the knot was hard enough. I'm amazed that it's even more difficult to untie... Commander, if you untie it for me, I'll teach you an even more enticing way to tie it.

main2.line: "In the sea of heaven, the waves of cloud arise. And the moon's ship is seen sailing, to hide in a forest of stars." That reminds me of when you and I sailed together. Um... Actually, maybe you should untie me before we reminisce?

main3.line: Frankly, I'm not sure how we can share a drink in this state. I mean, this posture doesn't lend itself to the act very well... Hehe, you're right! Desperate times do call for desperate measures, no?

mission.line: I'd really like to be untied right now, but your missions come first, I suppose...

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished, hmm? How did I know? Come closer, and I'll tell you.

touch.line: I hope you're not plotting anything evil right now...

touch2.line: Oh, my... You're certain that I can't move, aren't you? Of course, there's only one thing in this world that can truly bind me – and that's you.

unlock.line: Ngh... Hah... Commander, can you help me for a moment? ...Why don't you say anything? Don't tell me... you prefer me this way?

battle.line: Follow my lead, everybody!

detail.line: Commander, have you any new commands for me? I-if you wanted to play, you could always say so...

expedition.line: The commission team has returned! Naturally, it was my support from the rear that allowed everything to proceed so smoothly.

feeling1.line: I... really do not want to talk to you right now.

feeling2.line: I must act as your guardian, Commander! You must stay close behind me so you do not get lost!

feeling3.line: I-if I may be frank, I enjoy myself the most in your presence... But do not let anyone else hear that!

feeling4.line: I am incredibly powerful! But what if... IF a devilishly cunning enemy appeared, and I failed to protect everybody despite my best efforts... Would you think less of me, Commander?

feeling5.line: It is my duty to protect everybody. However... if I could do more than protect you... if I could embrace and tend to your every need... perhaps I would be more motivated.

headtouch.line: Mmmrgh... What an affront to my dignity! Th-this won't be happening again...

home.line: I completed a thorough patrol of the port during your absence, and discovered a place perfect for "strategic maintenance." I-it's not a playroom! Regardless, perhaps you would assist in my inspection if you are not otherwise engaged?

hp_warning.line: Urgh... I must... stay strong for everyone else!

login.line: Zzz... Uguh?! Oh, it is you! Ahem. The port is perfectly safe, thanks to my presence.

lose.line: Impossible!

mail.line: New mail? Hmm... It might be related to the port's resource allocation and long-term plans... I think you should prioritize this one.

main1.line: Before going out to battle, you must decide which snacks you will eat upon your return to rouse your motivation! That is what it means to win a battle before it is fought!

main2.line: Yes, another flawless patrol! The slides and swings are as safe as could be! Would you like to see for yourself, Commander?

main3.line: Everybody in the port is giving their utmost. Commander, let us work just as hard and become examples for all to aspire to!

mission.line: A new mission has appeared, Commander. Let us break through with a single push!

mission_complete.line: Did you see that? My presence makes any mission easy as pie!

profile.line: I am the Yamato-class battleship, Musashi! Fear not. I shall look after you, whether during work or play.

propose.line: Wh-what is the purpose of this stuffy ceremony?! Hrmh... Starting today, I shall make you my most important retainer and... Ahem! What I mean to say is that you are the best that there is! You will stay by my side for all eternity and listen to my every order! Promise me that!

touch.line: You wish to play with me? I-I suppose I can spare a little time.

touch2.line: S-such insolence... Hyah!

unlock.line: I am Musashi! Am I correct in thinking you are the Commander? Hmm... I fear I shall have to keep a close eye on you. From now on, I shall defend the peace of this port. As for you... you may simply hide behind me.

upgrade.line: I can protect you all the better now!

win_mvp.line: With my fortune and martial prowess, victory is but a foregone conclusion!

gift_prefer.line: You have brought me a reward? I suppose I can accept it!

feeling5_ex.line: I have recently been reflecting upon the true nature of "resolve." Ahem... My resolve to defend is not about self-sacrifice. Rather, it lies in my conviction to return home by any means. For the cherry blossoms in full bloom, for the delectable taiyaki... and for the person waiting for me.

headtouch_ex.line: Y-you really are a handful. You will spend more time with me to make up for this, won't you?

home_ex.line: Welcome back. I have prepared some refreshments to show my appreciation for your efforts. P-perhaps you would like to share them with me?

login_ex.line: Ah! You have shown yourself at last! I have crafted the schedule for today and left enough time for us to play together. So... make sure you do exactly as I tell you for the entire day!

main4_ex.line: I want you to hold my hand if you ever find yourself feeling uncertain. It will ease your fear.

main5_ex.line: Commander, you must try this taiyaki. I saved it just for you. It is vital that a leader maintains their vigor.

main6_ex.line: Once I have grown and become someone worthy of my name, I shall surely go on to defend even vaster seas. It is my wish that you will remain by my side, even then!

touch_ex.line: If you are tired, Commander, you may rest your head on my lap.

touch2_ex.line: Hrmh... If you wish to spend time with me, you only need say so...

battle.line: In the name of the wings of the sky: take off!

detail.line: You gonna ask if I wanna go for lunch?

expedition.line: I was actually designed with these types of missions in mind...

feeling1.line: So filthy... What? I'm not talking about you...

feeling2.line: Junyou is... I know I'm warning you about my own little sister, but she's really dangerous...

feeling3.line: My eyepatch? Kinda just started wearing it on a whim. Plenty of people out there who dress like pirates, you know?

feeling4.line: My opinion of you has improved a little bit. Just a little bit, you hear!

feeling5.line: I've sent out all my planes. Right now... there's just us two in here.

home.line: Planes, up on deck... It's time we all get ready.

login.line: Heheh... Let's get some good work done today, Commander.

lose.line: It's pretty hard to ignore the damage done to my planes...

mail.line: Doesn't matter if it's a pigeon or a plane delivering your mail, does it?

main1.line: Ah, Izumo... I'd like to meet her one day.

main2.line: I'm pretty sure mine are larger than Souryuu's...

main3.line: I'm slow-witted? Hmph, believe it or not, I'm a girl with a lot on her mind.

mission.line: A mission? As long as it ain't in the Marianas, I'll take it on...

mission_complete.line: If we keep earning honors, one day even I can become a full-fledged carrier...!

profile.line: I'm Hiyou, Hiyou-class aircraft carrier number one. I'm a light carrier, but my damage control and loading capacity are just as good as a regular carrier's. After Midway, I was a key part of the Mobile Fleet and fought hard to my very last battle...

propose.line: You've been real good to me, Commander... So, how about I be your lifelong partner from this day onwards...?

touch.line: I'm lightly armored, so, uh...

touch2.line: D-didn't I tell you I was lightly armored?!

unlock.line: Light carrier Hiyou reporting in. Commander, I won't have you looking down on the Hiyou class just 'cause we're light carriers!

upgrade.line: ... Seems my technique's gotten more refined.

win_mvp.line: It was all thanks to my little planes.

gift_prefer.line: Heh, you really get me.

battle.line: You're trying to get between me and the Commander... I'LL KILL YOU!

detail.line: Don't you think... we're bound to be together, Commander? Ahaha.

expedition.line: Hmph, those girls need to learn to read the room...

feeling1.line: Commander, don't tell me you want to break up?!

feeling2.line: The Marianas? I really... don't like it there...

feeling3.line: I know all your favorite things, Commander.

feeling4.line: Our first time together? I know it was ❀back then❀, but how could you not remember...?

feeling5.line: No! There's nothing wrong with me! I'm not sick! I'm not! It's just everyone else... why don't you remember!

home.line: I trust you brought my favorite, just ❀like always❀...?

login.line: Commander, I will ❀always❀ be with you.

lose.line: We lost? What are you saying, Commander? Don't you know Junyou ❀always❀ wins?

mail.line: Commander? Didn't I tell you not to write so many love letters~?

main1.line: I wonder how I can make you remember, Commander...

main2.line: Ryuujou... Where have I heard that name before...?

main3.line: It's not funny anymore! You have to remember, Commander! We've been together ❀since the very beginning❀!

mission.line: Oh, did you want to go on a date with me ❀again❀, Commander? What can I say...

mission_complete.line: That was a rich, full day. Now how about we go on a date somewhere?

profile.line: It's me, Junyou, your oldest friend! After those nasty girls tormented me so much, after all the fighting in the Aleutians, Santa Cruz, the Marianas, I finally got to see you again! I really don't know how you could have forgotten me... but please, hurry up and remember! Eheheh...

propose.line: Commander, you finally remembered... our ❀memories❀ and our ❀promise❀... Ahhh, I'm so touched... Hehe... Well then, just like we promised ❀back then❀...

touch.line: Commander? We've known each other for so long, you can be a little more forward...

touch2.line: I know exactly what you're thinking, Commander.

unlock.line: Oh, Commander, it's gotten so late. You've kept poor Junyou waiting. Let's go home together, ❀like always❀.

upgrade.line: My planes too...

win_mvp.line: Ahaha, when I feel the Commander's love for me, I can't help but go a bit overboard.

gift_prefer.line: You really remembered what I like!

battle.line: I'm not very skilled in real combat... but I shall not betray your expectations!

detail.line: You're like a kid sometimes, Commander... Come over here~

expedition.line: Commander, your girls have returned from commission. I'll welcome them back now, but you should hurry over as well.

feeling1.line: Is something the matter, Commander?

feeling2.line: Want to take a nap, Commander?

feeling3.line: I look a bit like a courtesan? Hehe~ Well then, mister, it seems like tonight shall be our one and only night together. Let us feel the warmth of our embrace, then let the memories fade to nothing. How does that sound?

feeling4.line: A prominent person once praised my beauty, but to be honest, I am not so sure about myself. But if Commander was to acknowledge me, perhaps I could find my confidence. So... Commander, am I beautiful?

feeling5.line: Commander, the moon is beautiful tonight, isn't it? I've prepared some drinks... would you like to stargaze together? I wouldn't do this for anyone else - this is a special service just for you, my dear.

home.line: Good work, Commander! Would you like dinner? A bath? Or perhaps... a drink first? Hehe~!

hp_warning.line: Looks like I can't afford to take it easy just yet.

login.line: Commander, have you eaten yet? No? Let me make something for you. You can't head to work without first preparing your body and mind!

lose.line: I'm so sorry, Commander...

mail.line: Commander, there's mail for you!

main1.line: Having long legs isn't necessarily a good thing. A high center of mass makes it easy to tip over...

main2.line: Commander, I prepared some snacks for us. Do you want to relax for a while?

main3.line: It's amazing to see how much my younger sisters have accomplished, but sometimes it makes me a bit sad to see everything they've gone through...

mission.line: You've got new missions, Commander. Care for a challenge this time?

mission_complete.line: Commander is sure forgetful, always needing my reminder just to claim the rewards.

profile.line: I guess you could say that I was the first aircraft carrier ever in the world. You could call me the eldest sister, or mother, of them all! Feel free to consult with me whenever you'd like, Commander. I'm always here for you.

propose.line: My dream is to one day settle down with the person I love and open a small bar somewhere... Now, it doesn't seem like my dream is so distant anymore. Right, my dear?

touch.line: Are you looking for me, Commander?

touch2.line: Ahh! ... Commander, that's naughty. You can't touch me there.

unlock.line: Ah, it's the Commander... My name is Houshou, and I'll be in your care from now on. Please leave the children of the fleet in my care. I won't let you down!

upgrade.line: Now I can help you even more, Commander!

win_mvp.line: Commander, will this be enough?

gift_prefer.line: My, oh my... You know exactly how to make a girl's heart quiver~

main1.line: At least for tonight, I wish you and I to pursue the happiness of being together...

main3.line: Master, what do you think of your Tanabata present? Are~ you~ satisfied~?

touch.line: Hehe... Master, if your heart races, then it's my victory~

touch2.line: The ephemeral autumn is but a fleeting dream

unlock.line: While everyone slips into sweet dreams from the night's festivities, the sound of gossamer sliding off of smooth skin reaches your ears... Hehe, would you like to spend this night under the stars with me, Master~?

battle.line: Don't worry, I'm prepared for everything!

couple_encourage1.line: If you want to get luckier, you'll have to eat more!

couple_encourage2.line: It's embarrassing when you call me your senior! Let's just play together instead!

detail.line: Commander, did you find something cool just now? Show it to me, please? Nnnngh...! Aww, I can't see anything... W-would it help if I tried hopping?

expedition.line: You all went on an adventure to a faraway place, right? So, did you bring any souvenirs back? Surely you brought back lots of shiny treasures and gold coins, right~♪

feeling1.line: Commander, are you struggling with negative thoughts? Can you tell me about them? I'll try to help you figure something out!

feeling2.line: Commander, if there's anything you'd like to do, I'll be there to support you! So, you can tell me about eeeeverything~ Okay?

feeling3.line: I had a feeling something good was going to happen today, and then... you were standing right in front of me! Chirp, chirp~♪ Isn't that lovely?

feeling4.line: Commander, let's play a game! Close your eyes, and open your mouth... Chirp~♪ So, do you know what I just fed you? ...Huh? It wasn't enough for you to really taste anything? Hmm, maybe the spoon I always use is too small...?

feeling5.line: Ehehe... Being together with you, Commander, is the greatest fortune I can ask for! So, I'll share some of my luck with you! Now, you'll be able to get any treasure you want, and all your dreams will surely come true~♪

headtouch.line: Chirp, chirp! I knew I could always count on you, Commander~♪

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Where'd you go today? Did you do anything fun? Chirp, chirp! Tell me, tell me!

hp_warning.line: I-it hurts... I, I don't think... I can move for much longer...

login.line: Good morning, Commander! Huh? You didn't eat breakfast yet? Aren't you hungry? Here, I brought you some hot tofu soup and senbei crackers! I can't finish it all on my own, so have as much as you'd like!

lose.line: Oh no, we've been beaten... I knew it was a mistake to let my guard down...

mail.line: Your mail's here! I'm sure it's good news!

main1.line: The last time I went to go look for some beautiful flowers, I ended up getting lost in the fog. But then, Unzen showed up and rescued me! Blessed be the Great Sage!

main2.line: If things ever get dicey, I can just dive into the water! I can totally endure something like that! ...Huh? Why don't I just swim to safety? W-well, umm... that's because I can't swim...
