main3.line: Commander, I had a weird dream about a gourd last night! In the dream, delicious rice kept pouring from the gourd, and no matter how much rice I ate, more would just keep coming out. You know how happy that made me? And then, the gourd was so big that when I crawled inside, I could fit easily!

mission.line: A new mission has been posted! So, where should we go next? And what are we gonna do? In any case, let's head out together right now! Yes, now! This very instant!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete~! Today's a lucky day as well, so let me see what our rewards are~!

profile.line: The port here is so huge! Everywhere I go, there are friends to be made and fun things to do, but I always find myself in new and unfamiliar places without even realizing it... Hmm? You want me to tell you more? Sure thing~♪ Then, come have a seat right next to me. You can listen to my stories while you eat~!

propose.line: What is this? Huh? You're really giving this to me? It's so sparkly and beautiful~! Hmm? I'm supposed to wear it? Like this? What am I supposed to do with it after putting it on? Eh? As long as I have it on, I'll never get lost?! Wow, I'm so happy I'll always be able to return to your side no matter where I go!

touch.line: Chirp~♪ What a warm and fuzzy feeling... Ahhhn... Ehehe~♪

touch2.line: Don't touch there! I'll get angry, you know!

unlock.line: Chirp, chirp! Here comes aircraft carrier Zuihou! I might be a carrier now, but I've also served as a tanker and submarine tender, which means I can do all sorts of useful things for you, Commander! ...Oh, right! This is for you! It's candy that'll bring you good luck!

upgrade.line: Luck smiles on me again! Thank you so much! In return, allow me to whip you up a tasty homemade meal!

win_mvp.line: Victory! Looks like today's another lucky day!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander! Want to stay for dinner? I'll make some really delicious rice for you!

battle_ex.line: Luck isn't the only thing that matters! Hard work is just as important!

detail_ex.line: Whee, Commander's picking me up! Oh, wow! I can see it now, from over your shoulder! Commander, what's that thing over there? Please tell me?

feeling5_ex.line: No matter what happens, I won't give up on my desire to be with you, Commander! As long as we're together, anything is possible!

headtouch_ex.line: You're the bestest, Commander!

home_ex.line: Commander?! You're back already? Ugh... I was going to pick you up, but then I took a wrong turn, and... Chirp, chirp...

login_ex.line: Commander, wasn't that rainbow we just saw simply beautiful? I'm sure something good's going to happen today!

lose_ex.line: I have to at least... return to the Commander's side!

main4_ex.line: Are you heading out, Commander? Can I come with you? ...Huh? There's something you'd like me to take care of? Gladly! I'll do whatever you ask of me~♪

main5_ex.line: Commander, how could you? You went out to play while I was busy... We're not talking anymore! ...Huh? You found something shiny and sparkly outside? I wonder what it might be... Let's go check it out!

main6_ex.line: Woah, what a beautiful gemstone! ...Huh? Am I still mad at you? N-no, but next time, you have to take me with you! Promise you'll tell me if something interesting happens!

touch_ex.line: Commander's shoulder... is so cozy… Zzzz…

touch2_ex.line: Nice and warm~ Soft and fuzzy~ Did you want to touch too, Commander? That's fine by me~

upgrade_ex.line: Commander, care for some tea? Oh wow, the tea stalk's standing up straight! I'm in luck today too!

win_mvp_ex.line: We won, Commander! I'm so happy! We're invincible as long as we're together!

detail.line: If we give lucky balloons to everybody, then the whole world will be lucky, right? Ehehe~ just thinking about it makes me feel warm and fuzzy inside, so giving out these balloons isn't tiring at all~♪

expedition.line: Commaaaander! Our friends are back! Maybe we'll get better rewards because of these lucky balloons~ Chirp, chirp~♪

feeling5.line: I wonder, was I able to successfully share a portion of my luck with you, Commander? Ehehe... For some reason, whenever I'm with you, it feels like I'll be happy forever and ever! And this must be the best kind of happiness, right? Chirp, chirp~♪

headtouch.line: Commander~ Ahhn, Commander~ Ehehe♪ Chirp, chirp~♪

home.line: Commander, I've been waiting for you? Chirp? Oh, umm... It's not like I chose to stay here because I'm scared of getting lost or anything! >.<

login.line: Commander, here's your lucky balloon! I'm giving the biggest one to you!

main1.line: Huh? Fweeeeeh! Th-the balloons are going to carry me awaaaaay!! Phew... Commander, thank you so much!

main2.line: The balloons are shiny and smooth in the sunlight! I love bright things! Chirp, chirp~♪

main3.line: Something good is going to happen today! I know because I can feel it! Chirp, chirp~♪ See? I'm holding this lucky balloon, and I get to spend the day with you! And that's a wonderful thing!

touch.line: Ehehe~ I'm flyyyying! Commander, you'll make sure to catch me, right?

touch2.line: Jeez... Stop that already. Bad Commander.

unlock.line: Commaaaaander~! Over here, over here! I'm right here! Chirp, chirp! Commander, come hand out balloons with me! Did you know these balloons can bring you good fortune? Here you go, the first one's for you!

battle.line: Sisters, charge! Let's show 'em who's the star o' this show!

detail.line: Ahh~ the folks always tell me, I'm gonna be a real beauty when I grow up~

expedition.line: A commission's all wrapped up~! Let's go welcome everyone back!

feeling1.line: Commander treats me like a li'l kid too... Yer makin' me sad...

feeling2.line: My children are all Shikigami - easy to store, but a pain to maintain! Y'all came at the right time - maintenance!

feeling3.line: I have no regrets 'bout what happened at the Coral Sea. I read we oughta accept our failures, else we won't learn from our mistakes! Eh? You think I'm amazin'?

feeling4.line: Commander, how do I become mature real fast? ...I'm fine as I am now? Really? But I'm always thinkin' I rely too much on you and my sisters...

feeling5.line: Mm... I got it now. Relyin' on others ain't such a bad thing! I won't be all jittery about growin' up faster now... Havin' that said though~ Commander, can I rely on ye even more now?

home.line: Need a rest? How 'bout I give your back a nice thumpin'?

login.line: I'll protect ya even if it means puttin' my own life at risk, Commander!

lose.line: How could I lose to those guys?

mail.line: Commander! The mail's right above ya~

main1.line: Ah, Commander, I'm ready to give it my all t'day as well! Let's go stick it to those bad guys!

main2.line: My big sis and Kaga are always lookin' after me, but one day, I wanna be more independent!

main3.line: Commander, the weather's real swell today! What's with the gloomy mug? Let's play together!

mission.line: Commander, there's new missions here!

mission_complete.line: I brought the mission rewards!

profile.line:
I'm Shouhou, first ship o' the Shouhou-class! 
The luck's a bit poor, but they ain't a thing I can do 'bout that.

propose.line: Eh? Commander, are y'sure this is going to the right girl? Someone as immature as me? ... I see, I've earned yer respect and recognition... Commander, from here on out, I'll do my best, so please continue to care for me!

touch.line: I don't really mind, but you shouldn't be doin' that to others.

touch2.line: Nnh... Stuff like this... is better saved for night~

unlock.line: Commander, Shouhou's the name. I don't have a lotta firepower or planes like those regular carriers, but there's plenty o' stuff I can do that they can't! A real pleasure to meet ya!

upgrade.line: I'm a li'l closer to becomin' an adult!

win_mvp.line: I've got the God o' Fortune by my side! Of course I'm gonna win!

gift_prefer.line: Wow! This is one of my favorite things! Thank you!

battle.line: Pumpkin Fleet, sortie!

main1.line: Trick or treat!

main2.line: Hehe, I’m a real beaut, aren’t I?

main3.line: All these crazy pumpkins... whose sorcery is this?

touch.line: Commander, it’s Halloween! Halloween!!

touch2.line: Commander, don’t! Nooo!! Those pumpkins will chase after anythin’ that touches them! Ahh!!

unlock.line: Waaaah! My candy! Candy is spillin’ everywhere! ...Wh-why are y’all chasin’ me? Commander, help me catch the pumpkin!

detail.line: Don't look so sad... I'll keep growing. I'm sure of it!

hp_warning.line: Sis... sisters...

main1.line: Commander, gimme a chance to prove myself!

main2.line: Why does everyone treat me like a kid when I'm already all grown up?

main3.line: Grown-ups need to play, too! Won't you play with me, Com~man~der?

touch.line: Commander, do ye like my Shikigami? They ain't the bitin' type, I swear!

touch2.line: I feel like I've definitely matured some! Commander, what do ya think?

unlock.line: Commander, how do I look now that I've grown up? Are ya fallin' in love with me already? Mhm, ye definitely are~

battle.line: Now, count up your sins!

detail.line: Milord, we cannot survive unless we fight!

expedition.line: Worldly things are of little significance! The only things that matter are spirit and resilience!

feeling1.line: No matter where you are, the top brass is all the same...

feeling2.line: Milord, when it comes to war, victory is more important than good or evil!

feeling3.line: Commander, feel free to rely on me as you please. Should you will it, I will execute any command.

feeling4.line: Commander, did you prepare this meal for me by yourself? In that case, I'll be more than glad to dig in! Mm... thanks for the food! Eh? You'll continue to cook for me when I come back!?

feeling5.line: Just being able to see your face before I sortie fills me to the brim with energy and makes me feel like I can't lose to anyone!

home.line: Don't break formation even when we head back to port! The glory of the Sakura Empire is in its meticulousness!

hp_warning.line: My life is burning bright!

login.line: A day off? Milord, my week only consists of Monday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Friday!

lose.line: Ugh... my body is all beat up...

mail.line: A telegram? Oh, it's not a combat report from Headquarters. I suppose there might be some value to reading it then.

main1.line: Odango... these delicacies will cause my heart to waver, so... Um, I suppose I can reward myself a little.... Mmmh! So delicious!

main2.line: When you're stressed out, you should go watch the fish swimming around peacefully in the aquarium. I'm not sure why, but it always calms me down.

main3.line: I fight for a just cause! No matter who stands before me, I swear to give it my all!

mission.line: A new mission is here! Whether it's combat or training, let's knock it out at the speed of sound!

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards are here! A bagel? Is this a snack for me? Thank you, Milord. Well then, let's move out!

profile.line: I am Ryuujou of the Sakura Empire, a seasoned warrior who has served in the First through Fourth Carrier Divisions, and participated in campaigns in the Phillipines, East Indies, Aleutian Islands, and Guadalcanal. I don't look the part...? Th-that must be because of that one incident at Iwate that stunted my growth! Milord, just you wait. I'll show you the extent of my capabilities!

propose.line: From now on, no matter what perils we might face, I will protect you with everything I have! Even if I sink to the bottom of the ocean, I will not permit any harm to come to you!

skill.line: As long as I am here, nothing shall stand in my way!

touch.line: Milord, please be careful. I am just as top-heavy as Illustrious.

touch2.line: Eek!!! Oh, it wasn't Saratoga after all. However, you seem to be even more mischievous than she is.

unlock.line: Milord, I am called Ryuujou, a ranger from the Land of the Rising Sun! I shall lay down my seven lives to mete out justice in your name!

upgrade.line: Thank you very much, Milord! Shall we go run a lap to test my new strength?

win_mvp.line: Despair... shall be your final destination!

gift_prefer.line: I would be grateful to receive any gift from you, Milord!

detail.line: It's good to always be ready for battle, but this isn't... so bad either, wouldn't you agree, Milord?

feeling5.line: These games and snacks are a sort of trial for me! Rest assured, Milord! My devotion will not be swayed by the likes of these items!

home.line: Splendid work, Milord! If you so like, come take it easy with me!

login.line: *yawn*... O-one moment! I'll get myself in order!

main1.line: I cannot believe how addictive this technological marvel of a game console can be...! B-but that's not to say it has no merits whatsoever! After all, if we could settle wars through these games, nobody would have to get hurt!

main3.line: C-can we really allow foodstuffs as devilishly tempting as these deep-fried chips of potato to exist in our society?!

touch.line: Zzzzz... Milord?! Are we being attacked?! ...I lowered my guard and fell asleep? Forgive me for this shameful display!

unlock.line: *yawn*... Finally, a good night's rest... Now, to pick up where I left off on that RPG... M-m-m-milord, why are you here?! I wasn't slacking off or anything, I w-w-was just... Ughh....

win_mvp.line: Milord! C-could you please consider rewarding me with some potato chips?

detail.line: The character I've created is a brave and honorable samurai, much like myself!

feeling5.line: Through this game, I've deepened my bond with my friends, and made fun memories with you, Milord... I-I won't deny it came at some cost to my discipline, but even so, I am glad I got into this game!

home.line: I always strive to do my best, be it with video games or whatever else! My ambition is to be like the legendary L.I.!

login.line: You came at a time most opportune, Milord! I would like you to join me for this Master Rank quest!

mail.line: A new electronic message? Could it be an invite to a party?

main1.line: Yes! I dug up a rare material! Haha! It's true what they say about you bringing luck, Milord!

main2.line: It's so convenient, being able to play a game anywhere you want, whenever you want... But I must have discipline! I must not let myself fall for temptation!

main3.line: My homework? Rest assured, Milord, I completed it some time ago, as one should!

touch.line: Do you wish to go on a hunt with me, Milord? Let me move over... There. Please, join me on the bench!

touch2.line: Whuah! Oh no... Milord, your action just led to my death. Why did you have to do that?

unlock.line: All right! Steady! Steadyyy! Gottem! Hahahah! Now I'll– M-Milord?! I-I'm just, umm... enjoying an after-school break!

win_mvp.line: Quest complete! And without using any continues, too!

battle.line: Watch! This shall be the highlight!

detail.line: Milord, let quickly us move on to the next attraction! Time waits for no one!

feeling5.line: Once I'm done showing you around here, I can take you to another attraction and– *tummy growls*... Oh, take a break, you say? O-of course! A break it is! Ideally, let's go to a place where we can eat while playing a game!

headtouch.line: Th-that tickles, Milord!

home.line: No! Milord! I understand you want to take the slide again, but please don't cut ahead in line! ...You don't know where the line starts since you just got back from a sortie? Oh, my apologies!

login.line: These slides are quite jumbled together, so reaching the peak without a guide is a very tall order. Milord, if you wish to take the slide again, allow me to be your guide!

main1.line: Go with the flow like a dragon, ride the waves like a dragon! ...Hm? Is there... not much of a difference between the two?

main2.line: There are not only submarines in the pool, but also mutant manjuus, you say? Rest assured, I shall make quick work of them!

main3.line: The stalls in this park sell pretty good food! If you're hungry, Milord, allow me to make a recommendation!

touch.line: Are you afraid of heights, Milord? If so, please sit behind me! I'll cover your eyes with my tail so you can't see below you!

touch2.line: Milord, just to be safe, hold on to me so you won't– Eek!

unlock.line: Milooord! *splash*... Heheh, behold the amusement park's crown jewel – the Meandering Megamanjuu Dragon Slide! If that's too long, it's also known as the Manjuu Octopus Slide. Personally, though, I think the former name is cooler!

battle.line: I've been pent up for a while. You'd better believe I'm going to give you a piece of my mind!

couple_encourage1.line: Let us go together!

couple_encourage2.line: You're from that time...

couple_encourage3.line: Houshou! Let's do our best together!

couple_encourage4.line: Ahhhh, please don't hug me right now!

detail.line: I learned the power of submarines firsthand in that great war. While it's too late to turn back now, I can't help but wonder how I would be perceived if I hadn't been remodeled into an aircraft carrier.

expedition.line: The commissions have been completed. I shall go ahead and greet them first. ...I hope their bounty is plentiful.

feeling1.line: Commander, for some reason, you seem really unapproachable...

feeling2.line: The sea of the Sakura Empire is nostalgic, but I also have murky and mixed feelings about it... No, that's got nothing to do with me right now. Focus, focus.

feeling3.line: Commander, are you interested in things like commendations or admonishments? ...N-No, it's nothing. I was just curious...

feeling4.line: I take pride in the honor I have earned with my two hands. And that honor becomes fuel for further progress. ...Th-Thus, Commander, I implore you to send me out on sorties more often!

feeling5.line: Commander, because I have been by your side, I have been able to demonstrate my true ability. Thus, would it be okay to be my true self when I am beside you...? M-My true self usually leaks out quite often? I-Is that so?!

home.line: Good work, Commander. Let's take a short break. ...But you shouldn't rest for too long, because we're going to review some battles right after this!

hp_warning.line: Ugh, at a time like this...!

login.line: You have kept me waiting... No, it's nothing. I can deal with this.

lose.line: I-I shall let you win just this once!

mail.line: A letter has arrived. I'm curious about its contents... Are you not?

main1.line: Looking after submarines is really rough... Th-This is from personal experience, so please believe me!

main2.line: It's in my personality to not care what humans may think about me. This is the attitude that us warships ought to have as warriors.

main3.line: From time to time, I become envious of the standard carriers... If only... I could be as strong as them...

mission.line: A new mission... If it's a directive from the top brass, let's take care of it right away.

mission_complete.line: We were able to handle the mission flawlessly thanks to your hard work, Commander.

profile.line: While I was able to set sail many times during my time both as a submarine tender and as a light carrier, in the end, I was unable to take even a single step away from port... No, nothing will happen if I just sit around like this. As I have stated many times, I, Ryuuhou, will bring you victory!

propose.line: I, Ryuuhou, vow to be at your side, through thick and thin... W-Well then, from now on, I will not hide any part of myself from you, so prepare yourself... okay?

touch.line: Commander, are you able to fathom this majestic outfit that impeccably balances both beauty and dignity?

touch2.line: Wicked thoughts, begone!

unlock.line: Remodeled Taigei-class Submarine Tender, Zuihou-class Light Carrier Ryuuhou, reporting for duty. I will strive to bring you victory, Commander! Yes, this time, I won't be held back by failures on my path to victory!

upgrade.line: I'm truly grateful for your kindness, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Unperturbed by both victory and defeat. This is my pride as a member of the Sakura Empire... hehe!

gift_prefer.line: Sorry for putting you to such trouble. I appreciate this so very much.

login_ex.line: You've kept me waiting this whole time... Commander, have you not eaten yet? Sh-shall I prepare something for you?

main2_ex.line: Commander, wouldn't it be best to ask for others' opinions every once in a while? I'm not the jealous type, you know.

main3_ex.line: I pledged to bring you victory, so please sortie me more often! ...I, I also want to attain victory for my own sake as well!

mission_ex.line: Hurry up and finish the new missions. Otherwise, people will say that I'm not carrying out my duties as secretary ship.

win_mvp_ex.line: Fantastic! We won!! ...What is it?! Am I not allowed to be proud of our accomplishments?

battle.line: Full force ahead for the Commander's victory!

detail.line: I control my carrier-based planes with this charm... A carrier cannot fight a foe face-to-face after all. This katana is merely a last resort.

home.line: You can leave the purification to me if Fusou and Yamashiro are both busy, all right? After all, I happen to be quite knowledgeable about that subject.

login.line: Good work, Commander. Please allow me to prepare the hamaya!

main1.line: The thing about Junyou is... Well, Commander, if something's bothering you, you can consult me, you know?

main2.line: Because I'm in Shigure's debt, I cook her some food from time to time. She's really a good girl, even if she doesn't always act like one.

main3.line: Commander, would you like to write an Ema? Even if your wishes don't get fulfilled, it's still great to just be able to write down your thoughts.

touch.line: Hehe... Commander, are you here to enjoy some sweet sake as well? Don't worry, you won't get drunk...

touch2.line: ...W-What are you planning...?

unlock.line: Commander, everyone seems to be busy with end-of-year preparations. If there is anything I can do to help, please let me know.

battle.line: I have to make sure to be careful...

couple_encourage1.line: Alright, alright... We'll go together.

couple_encourage2.line: D-Don't call out to me so endearingly...

couple_encourage3.line: I'm here. There's nothing to fear.

detail.line: Chiyoda and I are partners in carrying out shrine duties. Even though Chiyoda can be pretty annoying at times, there are still times she's fun to be around.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned safely. What a relief.

feeling1.line: Commander. Get away from Chiyoda. As far as you possibly can.

feeling2.line: The one thing I hope I never have to see again is the formation of a "decoy fleet"...

feeling3.line: I don't dislike having to pamper Chiyoda... If anything, I might actually find it quite endearing...

feeling4.line: Cooking, cleaning, even taking care of my things... Chiyoda takes care of it all. ... Basically, it's not that I can't do these tasks. If I put my mind to it, I can do it... I totally can...

feeling5.line: Commander, won't you rely on me some more? I'm actually pretty good at spoiling people, you know... Oh I know... would you like me to give you a lap pillow, or something...?

headtouch.line: Do you like touching my bangs like Chiyoda does?

home.line: I'm glad you're safe... I made a protective charm for you, and also one for Chiyoda. Please keep it safely inside your clothes.

hp_warning.line: This is bad... I hope Chiyoda... is alright...

login.line: Oh, you're here. There's some red bean jelly from Chiyoda on your desk. Feel free to take some.

lose.line: We're pulling back. Chiyoda, please be safe...

mail.line: There's a letter addressed to you. Please check it out.

main1.line: Isuzu... is quite a scaredy cat, but she's a good girl. But even that side of her is cute.

main2.line: Chiyoda always insists on doing my hair this way, so I let her. However, I always feel a bit apologetic for making her do so much...

main3.line: I'm at least confident in my Kagura dancing skills. If you get the chance, please come and watch.

mission.line: Here are some more missions. Isn't it bad to let them pile up like this?

mission_complete.line: The mission is... complete. That's good.

profile.line: Though Chiyoda and I were originally designed as seaplane tenders, during a certain war, we were remodeled into aircraft carriers. Whether it's due to my lack of skill or my inability to oppose the passing of time... I wasn't able to be of much use until the end.

propose.line: If that's how you feel about me, I'll gladly accept your feelings... I'll pray for your safety every day, and be your refuge from your daily hardships. I hope... you'll come look for me whenever you're feeling troubled, because I want to pamper you like I do with Chiyoda...

touch.line: Who?! ... Oh, it's you. I thought it was a prank from that pink-haired Union girl.

touch2.line: Hah?! Wait, no...!

unlock.line: I am Chitose, light carrier of the Sakura Empire. Commander, I look forward to receiving your guidance. By the way, is it true that Chiyoda is also here? ...Don't worry, I was merely inquiring.

upgrade.line: For the time being, thanks, Commander.

win_mvp.line: I'm glad... that I was able to be a help to everyone else.

gift_prefer.line: This is really nice. ...Thank you.

detail.line: Everyone becomes so rowdy when they get to the beach... I hope nothing bad happens today. Please, may enemy aircraft and volleyballs not come flying our way...

home.line: Commander, you're sweating so profusely. Are you okay? ...Here's a towel. Let me wipe you down.

login.line: The sun's rays are so harsh... I should go look for some awning to hide under...

main1.line: Isuzu, who told you that...? There aren't any ghosts here, don't worry. Go out and play.

main2.line: Chiyoda's quite the sore loser... She's like that even when it comes to building sand castles, so I can't even imagine how worked up she'd get over beach volleyball... If that pink-haired union girl is our opponent, I think I'll just sit out...

main3.line: The weather forecast says... it'll be clear until the evening... Mmn...

touch.line: That shaved ice looks really good... I guess there's a good reason cold treats are popular in the summer.

unlock.line: An order of coconut milk... and grilled sausage. Mm, that should do it. ...Hm? Commander? Are you here to place an order, or to get away from the heat?

detail.line: I'm so looking forward to seeing what Chiyoda's going to wear... I wanna take a picture with her... Yeah, we're definitely going to do that.

home.line: Are you tired? We still have a banquet to go to tonight, so you should rest while you still can... Oh, don't worry about me, I can get some rest right here... (*blushes*)

login.line: Did I keep you waiting? It took me an awfully long time to get ready... This always happens when Chiyoda isn't around...

main1.line: Are you busy, Commander? Ph-photo. I really want to take a photo with you...

main2.line: Up at the shrine, I use a fan to help out with Yamashiro and Fusou. With enough practice, you can do stuff... like this! H-how'd that look?

main3.line: Flying cranes are a symbol of good luck... Yeah, I'm sure that's true! Zuikaku said the same thing.

touch.line: Phew... It's sure hard to walk around with these long hems.

touch2.line: D-did you want to take a photo...?

unlock.line: I had this outfit custom-made just for today... Do you like it, Commander? Um, that's good then... (*whispers*) Booyah.

win_mvp.line: Even if I'm alone... No, Chiyoda and the Commander are waiting for me...!

detail.line: Washing yourself with tea should calm the body and mind, I'm told. How do I feel? Hmm... Yes, I think I'm relaxed. What about you?

feeling5.line: The delicate fragrance of tea has bound us together. From now on, whenever you smell it, will you remember what happened in this pond today? I'll always be here... waiting to share this tranquility with you.

headtouch.line: Are you fixing my hair? Mm... That feels nice.

home.line: Welcome back. Come over and sit... I'll whisk away your fatigue with the aroma of tea.

login.line: Oh, you're here. I'm just cleansing myself with tea... Come and enjoy the peace and quiet with me.

main1.line: Commander, is there anything you'd like to do after this cleansing? U-umm, you could... include me...

main2.line: Chiyoda told me that cleansing with tea will infuse you with its fragrance... Do you like this scent, Commander?

main3.line: Watching the ripples in the water, smelling the aroma of tea... and being with you. Nothing could be more relaxing.

mission_complete.line: All of your work is done. If you're tired, then come drink tea and relax alongside me...

touch.line: Was it the scent of tea that attracted you? Or was it... me?

touch2.line: Do you want to cleanse me...?

unlock.line: When I get free time, I like to come to this lotus pond to unwind... Commander, shall we cleanse ourselves with tea together?

battle.line: Let's kick some fine enemy butt on this wonderful day!

couple_encourage1.line: Big sis♪ Let's kick some fine enemy butt on this wonderful day☆

detail.line: I help Chitose out with her Shinto duties sometimes. You know, as a shrine maiden. ...Huh? You think I'd be more of a hindrance...?

expedition.line: Commander, the Commissions Team is back.

feeling1.line: Commander. Get away from Chitose. As far as you possibly can.

feeling2.line: I went to give Chitose some red bean jellies, but I ended up getting spoiled senseless by her instead... Oh, here's some for you. Please go ahead and try some.

feeling3.line: Commander, don't you want to try touching Chitose's hair too? Even though she prefers to keep her distance from others, if you ask, she absolutely won't be able to turn you down.

feeling4.line: Oh, the things I'd do for a lap pillow from Chitose right now♡. Seeing she isn't around right now, I guess I'll need a temporary replacement... Hm, maybe the Commander who's slacking off right now. Hey, if you don't want the others to find out you're slacking off, give up your lap to me~ Hehehe... Mmn~

feeling5.line: Y-yeah, I, I guess I've gotten pretty close to you... What would Chitose say if she saw you pampering me like this? Hm... If she saw us like this, she'd probably say, "I love both of you, so it's fine." or something. Yeah, she'd definitely say something like that! Hahaha!

headtouch.line: Hehehe~ Commander, do you prefer them long or short?

home.line: Looks like you didn't run into any trouble while I was gone. Hehe, it must be thanks to the protective charm I slipped inside your clothes~

hp_warning.line: Chitose, save me...

login.line: Today's another great day to show off my amazing prowess! Commander, let's get pumped!

lose.line: Ugh... I want to bury my face in Chitose's jugs...

mail.line: There's a letter addressed to you, Commander.

main1.line: Taaake that! ...Hmm? No reaction... Commander, sometimes you're so much like Chitose, it's honestly quite a letdown...

main2.line: Doesn't Chitose have really silky hair that smells just divine? Actually, I'm the one who takes care of it everyday.

main3.line: Whenever we rehearse the dance with Yamashiro and Fusou, some kind of trouble always occurs... Like something falling, or flying off somewhere. But really? I find it all to be pretty funny!

mission.line: You know, I think it's better to take care of missions as they come in. Yes?

mission_complete.line: You took care of the missions? Alright. While you take a break, I'm going to go check up on how Chitose's doing.

profile.line: Even though Chitose and I were seaplane tenders, after a loss in a certain battle, we were both remodeled into aircraft carriers. ...Even so, neither of us were able to be of much use until the end... Ahahaha....

propose.line: Now that you've given me this, you're going to be stuck pampering me senseless! You already are? I-I guess that's true... Well, feel free to request whatever you want from me in exchange!

touch.line: Am I so beautiful that I caught your eye? I'm flattered, but you should focus on your work for now~

touch2.line: Yikes?! If you had done this to Chitose instead, she'd have turned bright red from embarrassment!

unlock.line: Hehe, looks like I've kept you waiting! I am the renowned seaplane carrier– err, I mean, aircraft carrier, Chiyoda! In any case, I'll be staying here! Right, right, is my sister Chitose here as well?

upgrade.line: Oooh~ I really want to show the new and improved Chiyoda off to Chitose♡

win_mvp.line: Did you see that? Did you see how amazing I was?

gift_prefer.line: Isn't this the awesomest thing?! Thanks, Commander!

detail.line: Heehee... Commander, take this! A direct hit from my water gun! Oh, you got some saltwater in your mouth? I'm terribly sorry... So, Commander... tell me, how did it taste? Hahaha~

home.line: It's not like I was aiming for your face, you know? My hand just happened to slip, and the ball just happened to make contact with your face... C'mon, get over it. It's just an inflatable ball anyway!

login.line: Since we're here anyway, we've gotta enjoy the day to the fullest! We can start by playing with some balls. Catch, Commander!

main1.line: Hmm, beach volleyball? ... I'll use my powers to turn Saratoga into a holey woman! Ain't that right, Chitose?

main2.line: The summer sun, the sparkling sea... Stop lazing around and come play with me already, Chitose~

main3.line: Oh, Yamashiro and her sister came too. Wouldn't it be a good idea to team up with them? Well?

touch.line: The glamorous Chiyoda in a swimsuit~! No matter how breathtaking I might look, don't just stand there and stare like an idiot. C'mon, let's go and play~

touch2.line: If you're looking for something nice and round, I can throw this ball at your face, you know...?

unlock.line: Hehe~ If you don't have any other plans, then your only task... is to enjoy a holiday by the sea! Commander, have you switched into vacation mode yet?

feeling5.line: The scent and warmth of this wine are just like the hot passion between us... Commander, come a little closer so you can really feel it.

headtouch.line: Hehehe, I like it when you pet me... You really love my hair, don't you?

home.line: Welcome back! Need a cup? It'll warm you up and chase off your fatigue~

login.line: THERE you are, Commander! This time, I'm not taking no for an answer. Get over here and have a drink.

main1.line: Ahh... I'm getting a little hot. Is it the wine, or is it because you're so close...?

main2.line: Drinking warm wine in cool water... Gosh, it's such an awesome contrast! Come join me, Commander.

main3.line: This wine is just waiting for the perfect person to be shared with... Come on, you know I mean you, Commander! Hehe.

mission_complete.line: Missions complete! Cheers!

touch.line: Hmm? You're really staring... You want me more than the wine, don't you, Commander?

touch2.line: Heheh, got you, Commander! I'm not letting go 'til you reek of wine~

unlock.line: Oh, Commander! You finally found me! Hehe, I found this super-cool rest spot all on my own! Wanna drink with me?

upgrade.line: I'm stronger now! Gotta celebrate this one with a drink!

battle.line: Are you girls also trying to get close to Commander? Ahahaha!

couple_encourage1.line: Am I beautiful, Commander?

couple_encourage2.line: Look out for friendly fire~!

couple_encourage3.line: I'm very tolerant, you know...

couple_encourage4.line: Commander, are you testing Akagi's love~?

detail.line: Commander, are you keeping {namecode:91} in your most secret of thoughts? Mmm, how delightful~.

expedition.line: I was hoping that they wouldn’t have come back at all... Commander, I’ve already confirmed the completion of the commission. No more than a glance should be needed from you.

feeling1.line: If Commander was cut up into little pieces, he would never be able to leave Akagi’s side or break her heart ever again... Ahahaha!

feeling2.line: We were destined to meet. I knew at first sight that you were the one I’ve been looking for my whole life.

feeling3.line: You belong to me, and me only, Commander! That's something you should never forget, even if you are in charge of an entire fleet... Or else...

feeling4.line: Commander, why were you talking to that girl? Weren’t you coming to see {namecode:91}? She was tempting you? Then... {namecode:91} is going to make her disappear.

feeling5.line: Commander... With this, nothing will get between us ever again... Your embrace, your smile, your scent... all belong to me.

home.line: Five Minutes of Fate? You mean every five minutes that we spend together?

hp_warning.line: Ahahaha! I’m getting excited!

login.line: Ah, welcome back... Commander, if you had taken any more of your sweet time, I would have turned this place into a sea of fire~

lose.line: This wound is nothing compared to the thought of you abandoning me, Commander!

mail.line: Commander, who sent you this letter? A girl? Who is she?

main1.line: Commander, you’re so cute when you are hard at work. Just watching you makes me feel like I’ll overheat~

main2.line: Don’t make fun of me for being slow-footed. See? I’ve~ caught~ you~

main3.line: You smell like... that girl! Commander, Akagi needs to step out for a bit~

mission.line: A new mission... is another opportunity to deepen our bonds. *giggles*

mission_complete.line: Rewards? Being together with you, Commander, is all the reward I need.

profile.line: I am the glorious Akagi, the pride of the peerless First Carrier Division. With my famed air wing, I shall overcome any battle as long as you are with me. Yes, Commander, as long as we are together...

propose.line: I have waited an eternity for this day to come. No one shall be able to separate us ever again! My mind, body, and soul belong to you, as yours all belong to me. Haha... ahahahaha!

skill.line: My love is invincible! Ahaha... ahahaha!

touch.line: {namecode:91} loves you so, Commander~

touch2.line: If you so desire, I would not mind if you partake of me in front of all the others.

unlock.line: We finally meet, Commander. However, there appear be too many eyesores here. Please allow me to "clean up" a bit before we deepen our relationship. Hehehe~

upgrade.line: Commander, your love is filling up {namecode:91}'s chest...

win_mvp.line: I will do anything for Commander’s sake, even if I must slay a god.

gift_prefer.line: Oh no, what shall I do... At this rate, I shall have to surrender my heart to you~

detail.line: Akagi picked this swimsuit out just for you, Commander~! Are you falling in love with me even more deeply?

expedition.line: Has the commission fleet returned? If you're going, won't you take Akagi with you?

login.line: Ahh... Welcome back, my dear Commander. I wonder where you've been. Take your clothes off so I may know if the smell of vixens lingers on you~

main1.line: Commander, it's dangerous to be separated at sea. Please hold my hand tightly~

main2.line: Relax, Kaga. You're my only friend. You'll always have a place by my side.

main3.line: Wait until tonight, Commander. Kaga and I shall use our planes to hold a most spectacular fireworks show for you!

touch.line: Commander, what were you doing with that "Rodney" girl?

touch2.line: Commander, won't you come teach me how to swim? Oh? What did you just say~?

unlock.line: "When you gaze long into the abyss, the abyss also gazes into you." Commander, please do not forget that when you gaze at Akagi~ *giggles*

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to have dinner, a bath or... ahh, forget about that and eat me up first~

main1.line: Commander, we'll always be together, this year as well~

main2.line: Commander, I've finished this batch of paperwork. Is there anything else you'd like me to attend to? Of course, if you're tired, please tell me~

touch.line: Commander, you just spoke with that girl, didn't you? Just an "ordinary greeting?" Akagi understands... but if you get even an inch more "ordinary" with her, Akagi can't guarantee what will happen... Ahaha...

touch2.line: Ahaha... Akagi is always ready and willing~

unlock.line: Commander will always remain by Akagi's side... Right, "Gods?" Of course... Akagi will deal with the pests.... Ahaha...

battle.line: 1st CarDiv, Akagi, sallying forth~

detail.line: Commander, I knew you'd be busy at the party, so I waited until the very end for you. Now, your full and undivided attention shall belong to Akagi alone~ Hehe~♡

expedition.line: Who will you send to greet the commission fleet?

headtouch.line: Ah?! Commander...?!

home.line: A toast to your victorious return, Commander... Hehehe~

login.line: Have you awoken, Commander? Akagi will always be at your side~

lose.line: At least... protect my friends and compatriots...!

mail.line: A letter, huh? ...Hey, Commander? Just what kind of uncouth person would go out of their way to get between us at a time like this...?

main1.line: I will not do anything that would tarnish your reputation, but... if any meddlesome pests insisted on getting in your way... Ehehe...

main2.line: Indeed. While you were socializing, I made sure to strengthen our bonds with the other factions. At events like these, Shinano is horribly out of place, and if I may say so, the burden may be a bit too great for Nagato.

main3.line: Commander, why won't you get drunk with me already... Haah, even though Akagi has been so lonely for so long...

touch.line: Commander, there's a vacant seat right next to me~ Wouldn't you like to come a bit closer~?

touch2.line: It's just the two of us here... Yes, Commander, feel free to do whatever your heart so desires~

unlock.line: Commander, I've been waiting for you~ What a sinful one you are, to tempt Akagi like this for so long... But at long last, nobody will ever get between us again...♡

win_mvp.line: My love shall burn everything away~ Ahahahaha!!

battle.line: I shall burn everything away!

detail.line: Tonight, you are not allowed to meet with anyone other than me. Exchanging pleasantries...? Oh, are you not satisfied with "exchanging pleasantries" with Akagi alone? Hehehe~

expedition.line: The commission team has returned...? Excellent. You may go now.

home.line: A toast to your splendid victory, Commander... Hehe~

login.line: Commander, are you enjoying Akagi's banquet? If it is entertainment you desire... Ehehe. You can ask me for anything, you know?

main1.line: What's the matter, Commander? Hehe, worry not. Kaga will eliminate any pests that seek to squirm into our banquet tonight~

main2.line: Oh, would you look who showed up... Do remember to be on your best behavior tonight, 5th~ Car~ Div~♪

main3.line: Hiryuu, you're going to get tired from sitting in a kneeling position all night... As the Commander is perfectly relaxed here, you should also do likewise and enjoy yourself~

mission_complete.line: This reward... shall serve as an exquisite dessert to the banquet~

touch.line: Let us partake of each other's drink, Commander~

touch2.line: Ah, Commander... Ahahaha~♡

unlock.line: This banquet is my present to you... and your attendance is the greatest reward I could hope for~ Indeed, I shall not grant you leave tonight until you pass out. Ehehe... Ahahaha~♡

win_mvp.line: Nothing brings me more joy than being a cornerstone of the Commander's glory! Ahahahaha!

battle.line: I won't allow you to enter the Commander's sight...

detail.line: Shall we take a break? There's no rush; your journey is far from over. Of course, I couldn't be happier about that...♡

expedition.line: I've gotten word that the commission team is back. Yes, I'll arrange for someone to meet them. We wouldn't want to busy you over that, now, would we?

feeling5.line: Commander, I made a hotel reservation for us tonight! A town abundant with history, delicious foods, and a hidden hot spring to soothe your fatigue... Heehee, and we'll be sleeping in the same bed, of course!♡

headtouch.line: Heehee. What's the matter, Commander?

home.line: Would you like a cup of tea, Commander? Heehee, of course, I've already brought it—Yes, please. Drink it while it's still warm♡

login.line: Commander, would you like another? Okay, open up! Say ahh♪

mail.line: A letter... Heehee, perhaps it's from a girl who's jealous of our relationship?

main1.line: Commander, where are we going next? I'd love to go somewhere far away so that we can spend looots of time together~

main2.line: I'll treasure these clothes you gave me for a lifetime. Thanks again, Commander~

main3.line: Traveling through cities and nature, enjoying beautiful scenery... Heehee, what an elegant trip. Commander, are you having fun, too?

touch.line: Oh, you'd like to feed me? Okay! Aah♪

touch2.line: Just be patient until we can get a room together, Commander...

unlock.line: Commander, open up. Say ahh... Heehee, heheheheh... You're like a little baby♪ Receiving a lovely new outfit and seeing a different side of you... How blessed am I?

detail.line: Commander, we must be together at all times.You definitely cannot leave my side~

expedition.line: Looks like those troublesome nymphs have returned. Commander, Akagi will be right back~

feeling5.line: Ahh, Commander, you’re finally awake? Hm? Akagi didn’t do anything~ except lock you in so that we can stay together forever.

home.line: Commander, won’t you try some of Akagi’s hand-crafted tea? I added a little ingredient to make our love even sweeter~!

login.line: Commander, why do you smell like another woman? Oh, so it was her? Hehe... Akagi understands!

mail.line: Oh my, mail has arrived. Mm... it would seem that our superiors don’t suspect a thing.

main1.line: It would be great if Commander and Akagi were the only people left in the world~

main2.line: Commander, stop struggling. Akagi made this special chain, just for you~

main3.line: It’s human nature to want to possess something so special to you, Commander~ Ahaha~

mission.line: As long as we can be together, those commissions and tasks don’t really matter, right? You agree with me, don’t you?

mission_complete.line: Akagi knows that Commander wants to stay with her forever and ever, but the top brass will get suspicious if nothing ever gets done~

touch.line: Are you hungry, Commander? Akagi is going to cook now. Don’t even try to run away~!

touch2.line: Commander, you can’t resist any longer, right? Akagi feels the same way~

unlock.line: We should send out even more invites... This is the best way to rid ourselves of those pesky vixens all at once!

battle.line: Entertain me with your final struggles. Hehehe...

couple_encourage1.line: Sister, please take this seriously.

couple_encourage2.line: The First Carrier Division is not to be looked down upon!

couple_encourage3.line: I did not expect to be fighting alongside you all...

detail.line: Commander, if you keep looking at me like that, you’ll be eaten up.

expedition.line: The girls on commission have returned. Go on ahead, I will prepare some refreshments for them.

feeling1.line: It seems like you're not the hero I was looking for...

feeling2.line: The weak will be eliminated. If you cannot accept that, then simply become stronger.

feeling3.line: Should you be defeated one day, it simply means that you were too weak. That much is a fact of nature. Though... because you are mine, I would at least avenge you.

feeling4.line: I cannot comprehend these emotions... is this some sort of primal instinct?

feeling5.line: I have so much I want to say, but I forget them all the moment I see your face...

home.line: A fitting reward for the ears of our enemies. Let us enjoy the spoils of war leisurely.

hp_warning.line: It’s time for a death match! Heheh- hehehe!

login.line: Justice and righteousness are for the strong only. The weak can only weep in vain.

lose.line: This pain... I shall return it tenfold!

mail.line: Your mail is here. Try not to forget it next time.

main1.line: I shall conquer all, no matter who stands against me.

main2.line: Our enemies may be strong, but that is what makes them worth crushing. Heheh...

main3.line: The girls of the Fifth Carrier Division? They might amount to something if they work hard enough.

mission.line: Commander, stop slacking around. There are still missions to complete.

mission_complete.line: Here are the rewards, the fruits of your labor.

profile.line: I am {namecode:92}, from the First Carrier Division. I was originally designed to be a battleship, but fate had different plans or me. Enemies? I simply slaughter them, but only because it is my duty, not for fun.

propose.line: ... Is this for me? Hm... perhaps it is fate for the strong to be drawn to each other. If that is the case, I shall follow my instincts then. Hehehe~

skill.line: Only the strong may survive on the battlefield!

touch.line: Is there a problem?

touch2.line: ... Fine. If you say it helps you relax...

unlock.line: Will I be able to find a worthy foe here? Very well. I’m yours. Perhaps this, too, is destiny.

upgrade.line: Not bad. I’ve come up with some new combat techniques.

win_mvp.line: Such is the fate of the weak. Death, nothing more.

gift_prefer.line: Did Akagi tell you...? Err, I mean, thank you...

detail.line: Oh, Shoukaku was also doing this job, right? Even though she's also wearing the same outfit, she gives off completely different vibes than me...

home.line: Ugh... Having to hold this pose for so long is making my shoulders stiff...

login.line: Commander, it's fine! You don't need to worry about me! I can totally handle something like this!

main1.line: Hmm... I just can't pull the look off as well as Shoukaku... Is this the difference in our "girlish appeal?"

main2.line: Is this job just to sit here for the photo ops...? I thought I'd get to drive...

main3.line: Phew...! Keep it together, Zuikaku... You've gotta look your best in front of the camera!

touch.line: Hold this position a bit longer...? Mm, can't I ask for a slightly cooler pose...?

touch2.line: Commander, you're not doing this kind of stuff to the other girls, are you...?

unlock.line: Commander, I volunteered to take this job in order to help you out, but this outfit... did it always require such a high degree of exposure...?

expedition.line: Oh, the commission team is back! THAT was pretty darn fast.

feeling5.line: Hey. This is a secret between you and me – I actually care less about my track time and more about seeing you rooting for me... Oh, and don't tell that to Shoukaku!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Come join me for a break. Ahahah, you might think you don't need one, but people need maintenance, too!

login.line: There you are! Me and my sis were just having a break and preparing for the next race. "Heehee. Actually, I'm still running a check on your car."

main1.line: Count down to engine ignition... You're never catching up with me! Oh, Commander, uh, I'm not talking to myself, just... uh, rehearsing some cool-sounding lines... yeah, that's it!

main2.line: Can I count on you to cheer me on before the start? Heehee. With you rooting for me, I just know I'll win!

main3.line: You wanna take me out for a ride in your own car later? Sure! You don't mind taking the shotgun seat, do you? 'Cause I'm gonna be the driver! Heheh!

mission.line: Better get those unfinished missions done while you have the chance. You need all the time you can get on the race track!

mission_complete.line: You finish missions as fast as I drive my car! Hahaha! Now let's get a look at those rewards while we can!

touch.line: Yeah? Are you thirsty? I've got a drink if you need a sip.

touch2.line: Hey, uh... I want to conserve stamina, so let's save this for later...

unlock.line: Sis, how's my car lookin'? "All clear, ready to go at any time." Alrighty, just leave the rest to me! Commander, you're about to witness what I can accomplish from the cockpit!

win_mvp.line: Go for the checkered flags and let the engines roar!

battle.line: I'll tear down everything and everyone that stands between me and my Commander! AHAHAHAHA!

couple_encourage1.line: I will NOT tolerate any talk of bad luck!

detail.line: I belong to you, my Commander, body and soul...

expedition.line: Commission complete... But if you ordered it, my Commander, I would clear all of them for you... I must mean so much to my Commander.

feeling1.line: Those insects... Just a second, my Commander, I need to do something about these impudent little insects...

feeling2.line: I know everything, EVERYTHING there is to know about you, my Commander~ In fact, my Commander is my entire world.

feeling3.line: ... That gift she gave you? Oh, I threw that out. Why wouldn't I? Only my things belong on your desk~

feeling4.line: You forgot your coat? Well isn't my Commander forgetful... Don't worry about it, I'll go get your coat for you. Huh? The key to your quarters? Hehehe, you can keep it. Taihou has her ways.

feeling5.line: The bed and toiletries in your quarters? Of course they're mine. I should have thought of this before~ If you don't want me going in and out of your room all the time, we should just be sleeping together. Hehehe... please be gentle with me.

home.line: Mission accomplished! And let me say how fantastic you looked on the battlefield.

hp_warning.line: For my Commander, I have to win...!

login.line: Would you like to take a bath with me? Maybe you'd like to taste me? Orrr~ would you like to do it with me...? Ahahaha!

lose.line: Why aren't you dead... why won't you all just DIE?!

mail.line: My Commander, you've got mail~ I licked it very tho-rough-ly. It's safe.

main1.line: Hehehe, I would pull the moon from the sky for you, if you wanted it, my Commander.

main2.line: You like small ones, my Commander? Then I'm off to cull the big ones, hehehe...

main3.line: My Commander, you know you can never EVER lie to me. Or else...

mission.line: There's a new mission. Can we go?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete~ Want to go get the rewards?

profile.line: I'm a state-of-the-art aircraft carrier with extra reinforced armor. Just look at my flight deck and enclosed hangar. Amazing, aren't they? Hmm? What's this about carrying capacity and firefighting systems? Never mind that... Tell me, what do you think of my... body?

propose.line: It's finally on my finger! You know, I would have thrown this ring out long ago if it didn't have my name on it. Hehehe. Oh? How did I know about it? I tollld you, I know EVERYTHING about my Commander. And from now on I'm going to love EVERYTHING about you too~

skill.line: Now you can die happy, ahaha...

touch.line: Touch me more!

touch2.line: If you touch any other girls like this, I might have to punish you, my Commander.

unlock.line: This heat, and this throbbing... We meet at last, my dear Commander! I am Taihou, unworthy as I am, at your service♡

upgrade.line: Ahaha, now I can serve my Commander even better...

win_mvp.line: I dedicate this victory to my Commander!

gift_prefer.line: A-all I can do to show my gratitude is offer you my body! It may not be much, but please accept it!

battle.line: Are you the ones distracting my Commander from the party?

detail.line: Oh, how I envy you, kitty. If I were you, my Commander could hold me tight and never let go.

feeling5.line: Come, my Commander, this party is a perfect opportunity to proclaim our love to everyone, to let them all know that we belong only to one another.

home.line: My Commander, let me clean up the few remaining insects troubling you.

login.line: I've been waiting for you, my Commander.

main1.line: My Commander, you just stole a glance at another girl, didn't you?

main2.line: My Commander, if I were to drink a little too much, do you think you could take me home?

main3.line: My Commander, it's safe for you to attack me when no one's around~

touch.line: My Commander, how would you like to go for a stroll somewhere private?

touch2.line: Yesss, that's it, my Commander, give all your love and attention to Taihou alone...

unlock.line: You're taking so long to dress yourself, my Commander. Are you struggling to find something to match my dress? Hehe, it doesn't matter what you wear, you're always perfect to me♡

win_mvp.line: This is what happens when you get between me and my Commander!

detail.line: I wanted to borrow an Empyreal dress from Master Yat Sen, but it turns out we're not the same size~ So what could I do? I made it myself♡

home.line: I offer you a song of joy ♡ my Commander ♪

login.line: My Commander, do tell me what song I might serenade you with?

main1.line: For you, my Commander, I could face any challenge...! Oh, but that little gremlin from the Eagle Union... something must be done...

main2.line: If I can only keep my Commander's gaze fixed on me for just a little bit longer, all my efforts will have paid off~

main3.line: If only I could become like the women in those stories... those Empyreal romances Master Yat Sen spoke of~

touch.line: Did you enjoy my performance...? Oh, my Commander~ My efforts, seeking out Master Yat Sen, the study, the practice, all that hard work... it was truly worth it~!

unlock.line: Hehehe, I let Christmas and New Year's slip right by me, that I might use the Dragon Empery's Lunar New Year to capture my Commander's attentions... Oh, My Commander, won't you please enjoy the show I've prepared for you♡

couple_encourage1.line: Unlucky...? We won't be hearing that again!

detail.line: Would my Commander like to race? I would be happy to take care of the other racers to make sure you win first place... Oh... But why not?

login.line: My Commander, would you like a picture of me? Oh, not for promotional purposes, just for your "personal use..." Hehehe♡

main1.line: I don't care about prideful things like which carrier group I'm in. All that matters is that I'm willing to do anything for you, my Commander♡

main2.line: I could wait here for you forever, my Commander. But of course I would be happier to be at your side~ If you would let me... Oh, even if you don't want me to, I could still be at your side anytime♡

main3.line: Hehehe, the "race queen" is another of the Sakura Empire's great inventions~ Save your wonder, my Commander. Just keep your eyes fixed on Taihou♡

touch.line: I am here just to model for you, my Commander~

touch2.line: Hehe♡ My Commander~

unlock.line: Do I make a nice race queen, my Commander...? Hehe. With these proportions, and my fantastic outfit~♡ The others couldn't hope to compare with me!

battle.line: Anyone who would get between me and my Commander... should just disappear!

home.line: Club... activities? How could I let such insignificant matters get in the way of our precious time together, my Commander?

login.line: My Commander, would you like to go somewhere with Taihou? An after-school date, perhaps~♡

main1.line: My Commander, whatever your heart desires, no matter what it is, Taihou shall grant it to you~♡

main2.line: What am I writing about in my notebook...? You, of course~♡ Hehe, do you want to take a look?

main3.line: A-A-A-Albacore?! ...D-don't scare me like that, my Commander. I'm telling you, that girl can pop out from just about anywhere...

touch.line: Want a feel, Commander? ––Then, here you go~ The little kitty, or Taihou? Take your pick, hehe~♡

touch2.line: Taihou belongs to you, mind, body, and soul~ Heheh... Here, put your hands on me as you please~♡

unlock.line: Ehehe~ There is no greater bliss than being with you after classes are over, my Commander~ The kitty here seems to agree♡

win_mvp.line: Commander, nobody will get in the way of our date anymore~♡

battle.line: Sleep with the fishes!

detail.line: I rented out the whole beach for us. You know what that means... No matter where you go, you can't escape me! Hahaha, I'm just joking.

expedition.line: Another commission is done. You don't have to lift a finger, my Commander; leave it to me.

feeling5.line: My Commander, do you have plans? Wait... Do you mean you've set aside time for me? O-of course. We are on a date, after all... Goodness, how can I effectively optimize my time with my Commander?

home.line: Heehee, we're all alone again... I'm like putty in your hands right now, my Commander... Hahaha! Come right out and say anything you want to me.

login.line: You and I, walking on the beach together... I'm so happy that you're here with me, my Commander! Do you feel the same way?♥

lose.line: My Commander, I... I...!

mail.line: You have new mail. Heehee, does it smell like me...?

main1.line: This shirt? Actually, I snuck into your room and... Hm? I didn't say a thing♪

main2.line: You'd like to lie next to me and listen to the ocean? O-okay! If that's what you want, then I'll stay as long as you'd like... *blushes*

main3.line: I'd love to just get washed away to a deserted island with you... No, this is your home. Even I understand that much.

touch.line: Be careful not to catch a cold? Aww, my Commander, you're too sweet~♥

touch2.line: Come, my Commander...♥

unlock.line: A beach date, just me and my Commander... I could walk by your side forever—No, I can't be satisfied by this alone. And neither can you... Right, my Commander?♥

win_mvp.line: All who stand in my way are fated to oblivion♪

detail.line: Am I tired? Heavens, no! I've got plenty more rounds in me, and you... Um, my Commander? M-maybe you do need a break, after all...?

expedition.line: The commission is done~ Heehee, you should get up first, okay?♡

feeling5.line: My Commander~ You can have fun anytime and anywhere you want♡ But in return, tonight, you're mine alone... Heehee, and I want you tomorrow, and the day after, and... Actually, I'm never letting anyone else have you!

headtouch.line: My Commander~ Leave everything to me♡

home.line: Aah... Welcome back, my Commander~ I've been waiting here for you for so, so, sooo very long♡

login.line: Phew... You're too good at this, my Commander~ Once you've decided on your next move, call me, and I'll be there right away♡

main1.line: Where should I shoot, and how? Use your finger to guide me♡ I'm ready any time~

main2.line: If you want to go for a bank shot, then you need to calculate the angle it will bounce at to hit the pocket... M-my Commander?! This is getting too detailed for me to keep up!

main3.line: My Commander, you're spacing out again... Go ahead and aim. Don't mind me~ If you want, use me to balance your cue♡

mission.line: New missions are here~ Tch, what bad timing...

mission_complete.line: Missions complete~ My Commander, do you mean to say that I'm not reward enough for you?

touch.line: Is something the matter, my Commander? Aren't you supposed to be teaching me billiards right now?♡

touch2.line: My Commander♡ Love me more and more and more♡

unlock.line: Aah... I didn't think you'd agree to my offer for some extra "entertainment" together♡ Just the thought of you using your body to guide mine now... Heehee♡ I'm all yours to command.

battle.line: Ahahaha! Nothing will remain of you!

expedition.line: A commission has been completed~ There's no need to go welcome them back. After all, I already saw them back to their dorms~♪

feeling5.line: My Commander~ I'll have you accompany me all day, just as you promised~♡ Is there any place you'd like to go or anything you'd like to do? As long as we're together, anything is fine~♡ Ehehehe...

headtouch.line: C-Commander?! Ahhn, I can't believe you'd even treat me as a child~ ...Ehehe~♡

home.line: My Commander~ Are you having fun with your pest extermination? Please do enjoy yourself thoroughly, and leave the paperwork that comes after to me~♡

login.line: This pure white dress was crafted by yours truly. Now, my Commander, we can be together forever...! Ahhh, my Commander~♡

lose.line: My Commander, please do not leave my side...!!

main1.line: The defenses around your bedchamber are complete, my Commander. Nobody will be allowed to intrude on our love nest~♡

main2.line: This sound... Albacore?! N-n-n-no way, it couldn't be! My Commander, tell me you're jesting!

main3.line: Is something the matter, Commander? If you are unable to collect your thoughts outside, perhaps I can take you to somewhere a bit more private~

mission.line: Yes, new missions. I already know all about it~♡

mission_complete.line: My Commander, I shall fetch you everything you desire~ After all, there is no way I'd possibly burden you with such menial tasks~♡

touch2.line: I belong only to you, my Commander~♡

unlock.line: My Commander~ Do you like the location that I've chosen~? We have the entire evening to ourselves, free from the disturbance of anyone else...! Ahhh, my heart is throbbing even more vigorously than the ocean's waves~♡

battle.line: Though fate has been written, I shall fight until my soul's duty has been fulfilled...

detail.line: Mmh... True strength can shatter the chains of fate... or is this but the moon's reflection within the water... Mm...

expedition.line: Mmmm... The girls on commission are returning now... 'twould behoove you to forget them not...

feeling1.line: From here, this one sees not any light...

feeling2.line: To carry the burden of great expectations, yet unable to demonstrate the power to meet them... Such is fate's mockery of this one's existence...

feeling3.line: To see destiny, yet to be unable to change it; or to be ignorant to the turning of fate... Which is the greater misfortune?

feeling4.line: Long has this one dreamt... Tragic dreams that one wishes to never recall... Blissful dreams from which one hopes to never wake from... Even reality itself seems like just another dream.. Commander, is this truly reality, or yet another illusion?

feeling5.line: I once lamented my inability to shift the hand of fate... But now, and forever... as long as you are here...

headtouch.line: Aah... My ears are sensitive...

home.line: Nnnh... Your safe return... pleases me...

hp_warning.line: ...I shall not retreat...

login.line: Nnnh... You have returned. Long, eternal, has this one's wait been...

lose.line: Apologies... I have failed to meet your expectations...

mail.line: Dismiss not the letters bearing distant thoughts...

main1.line: Even the most beautiful flower is transient, to be scattered into the wind... But, 'tis better to bloom for but a moment than to wither eternally upon the vine.

main2.line: Do you wish to rest within this one's bosom? ...Yes, just as the little destroyers do...

main3.line: I would like to experience all this port has to offer... should it be possible...

main4.line: I have left the report here... Hmm... There are many errors? ...'twould seem that hasty deadlines are not this one's strong suit...

main5.line: Vrooom... Zzzzzz... Oh... Did I hit you by mistake? ...Sincerest apologies...

mission.line: This task... can it be completed in time...?

mission_complete.line: As long as you are here, there is nothing that cannot be accomplished...

profile.line: I am called Shinano, aircraft carrier of the Sakura Empire. I was to stand beside Yamato during that war, yet in the end... Alas, there is impermanence in all things, and nothing became of this one's life... May your guidance lead my fate to a different outcome...

propose.line: The memories forged at this port... have brought me great joy... Alas, from now on... I shall cherish my time with you through fates both joyful and painful... through weal and woe alike...

touch.line: Mmmm... Hm? ...I dozed off again? ...Sincerest apologies...

touch2.line: You musn't... Not there... Nnh...

unlock.line: This sensation... is that of reality... Was it you who awoke this one from her long slumber? Such is the inevitability of fate... Please allow Shinano, third ship of the Yamato-class, to guide you forward upon the right path.

upgrade.line: May this not end in futility...

win_mvp.line: Is this... my power...?

gift_prefer.line: This one shall cherish your gift...

feeling5_ex.line: Now that we have come so far, even fate cannot part us... This one can truly walk hand in hand with you. One could not ask for more...

headtouch_ex.line: Th-that spot is... sensitive... Mmmnh...

home_ex.line: Warmth rests on this one's palm... Have you returned? This one is delighted...

login_ex.line: Only by experiencing love can one know its sorrows... This one misses you so.

main6_ex.line: All good things are fleeting... However, every moment spent with you is as a thousand autumns...

main7_ex.line: If you grow weary, rest in this one's arms, and we may drift off to dreams together...

main8_ex.line: This one is becoming proficient at the tasks you've assigned... With you, I can overcome any difficulty.

touch_ex.line: Mm... May this one hold you and sleep a while longer? Zzzz...

touch2_ex.line: Nnh... May this sweet, gentle dream never end...

detail.line: Through the sojourn of the stars through the sky, through the waxing and waning of moons, fate remains immutable... In contrast, mortal dreams and realities alike seem like fleeting illusions...

home.line: *sigh*... Sincerest apologies for this unsightly display... The destroyer children were playing around and made a mess of my tail... How embarrassing...

login.line: The shimmering of the countless stars, the dancing lights of the banquet... This night... has only just begin... Zzzzz...

main1.line: Being able to enjoy tonight's banquet thusly... fills one with apprehension that this... may be yet another dream...

main2.line: Though I have long been the plaything of fate, it still allowed me to meet you... How strange and whimsical a thing it must be...

main3.line: Western spirits are a new experience for this one... Even this trifling amount... has already... gone to my head...

touch.line: Beauteous is the moon tonight... Are you in agreement...?

unlock.line: The moonlight dims beneath hazy clouds, and the lights of the night sky begin to shine... The moon, and this sake, are both intoxicating... Will you not enjoy this fine evening with me...?

detail.line: The attire you chose for this one...though beauteous, is rather revealing... This one cannot help but be embarrassed by cruel fate...

headtouch.line: Alas... This one's ears are sensitive...

home.line: Hopefully my form is not so burdensome as to break this... The task you have entrusted this one is difficult to bear, but I may beseech advice from Shoukaku and Taihou...

login.line: Mm... Nnh... Will this do...? This one offers wholehearted support in all your struggles... I pray for your first-round triumph...

main1.line: Gleaming chrome, roaring reverberations... Who emerged victorious? Alas, this one must apologize...for missing it...

main2.line: Subjected thusly to the eyes of many... The heart is elated, yet its tranquility is disturbed... Do you feel the heat this one feels...?

main3.line: Initially, this one wondered if you had ulterior motives...but knowing that this is to add flair to the race, I joyously accept this duty...

mission.line: Trite it may be, but your work is of vital import... See it done anon...

mission_complete.line: A prize of Western spirits... Alas, I suppose...this one must open it...?

touch.line: You want this one to change posture? Mm... If that is my destined task, then I will try...

touch2.line: As a reward for your valiant efforts...

unlock.line: Hnnh... Such clamors of merriment... Would this one be welcome amidst these festivities? Alas... If you so desire, how can this one refuse...?

detail.line: While the swimsuit is beautiful... Even when tied securely, just moving makes a mess of it... It's rather mortifying...

expedition.line: The commission team makes their return... This one asks that you greet them soon...

headtouch.line: You so persistently strike this one's weaknesses... Mmh...

home.line: If regarded as illusions that will eventually fade, one can even accept seas and skies that defy the laws of nature... If it is your desire, this one will make the last moments of your dreams eternal.

login.line: The swimsuit you requested is too small for this one... Mm... This one hopes it isn't too strange compared to the others...

main1.line: A lover's tryst, both in reality and in our dreams... Your loving and longing warm this one so much that it makes me sweat. Sorry you have to see this one like this...

main2.line: It was not this one's intent for my swimsuit to malfunction... Every time this one adjusts it, the next small motion throws it back into disarray... How can one escape this plight?

main3.line: If you desire a cool breeze... M-mm... By fanning this one's tail as such... Mm... Hopefully this does not simply blow hot air at you...

mission.line: Even in your dreams, you diligently fulfill your responsibilities... It is astounding.

mission_complete.line: An ever-growing pile of rewards... May this dream of your efforts being rewarded come true...

touch.line: An invitation to swim... This one will gladly join you...

touch2.line: This one graciously accepts your touch...

unlock.line: This world of pristine sand that you have envisioned, a mirage that fits only within the confines of a dream and a reverie... No matter how many times we meet here, this one finds herself drawn to this place again and again...

detail.line: You wish to know why this one has woven such a dream? This one only wishes to indulge in sweet dreams with you, to seek surprise and succor together...

feeling5.line: Even the most glorious magic must fade, in one last spectacular moment... However, if this one weaves this magic into dream, its wonder will be eternal... If you desire, come into my grotto... and we may be together forever...

headtouch.line: Hmm...? In this dream realm, this one will not fall asleep...

home.line: Do you wish to see this one's magic again...? Whatever it takes to soothe you...

login.line: This one welcomes your arrival... If you wish, you may stay in my grotto. This one will accompany you, of course...

lose.line: All fleeting dreams must come to an end...

main1.line: There wasn't much time to prepare, so this one's tail is unbrushed and messy... Please forgive me.

main2.line: This glass box is rather cramped... Fortunately, it did not affect the performance...

main3.line: Phantasmal, dancing lights and your passionate gaze... They make this one's self-control futile...

main4.line: Supposedly, this hand gesture conveys joy... Do you see the joy this one feels in your presence?

touch.line: Do you... wish to open this box?

touch2.line: Hmm... Your warmth reaches this one. Is this your own magic...?

unlock.line: As a flickering, quivering phantasm... Welcome to the dream this one made for you, Commander. Do you like this magic, in which this one appears in an instant?

win_mvp.line: Ah, what a perfect display of magic...

feeling5.line: Dreamier than reality, more potent than fantasy... This one knew your feelings already, but the intimacy of this experience... is irresistibly intoxicating.

headtouch.line: Mmnh, do you love this place? This one feels your ecstasy...

home.line: This one has waited for you... Oh, how the wind has carried your yearnings to my heart.

login.line: By sharing this liquor, we allow our senses to mingle, our minds to meld... Ah, it is too wonderful for words...

main1.line: Unprecedented ecstasy... Will you take the next step, share this bed with me, and weave new dreams together?

main2.line: Phew... This one is not asleep, but savoring your soft caress...

main3.line: Intoxicated, burning with affection... The bliss welling up in this one's heart belongs to the both of us...

touch.line: Our feelings are joined in perfect union...

touch2.line: Mm... The overlap of these rich flavors is... too heady to bear... Aaah...

unlock.line: Mmgh... We agreed to share this mysterious liquor together, yet this one seems to have partaken excessively... Though, a few drops still linger upon this one's lips, should you crave a taste...

battle.line: I'm the only one allowed to bully this slave!

detail.line: It's truly marvelous to be so loved and treasured by this slave. *giggle*

expedition.line: Slave, the commission's complete... You want to go with me? Oh all right. I can't say no to that face.

feeling1.line: It seems I've been too lenient with you...

feeling2.line: Haha, aren't we proud! From the moment I saw you, I knew you would be my slave!

feeling3.line: You're rather popular for a mere slave, aren't you? Hrrmm... what's this anxious feeling I have...?

feeling4.line: Hrmmm... he's my slave, but those women won't stop throwing themselves at him... even though he's my slave... and clearly mine alone.....

feeling5.line: Slave, you know you can always come to me if there's anything wrong. I'll gladly help you ....so don't go to anyone else. Don't talk to anyone else. Just be my slave, okay?

home.line: Ah what a fantastic job you've done today, slave. Bravo! Bravo!

hp_warning.line: Heheheh... how stimulating....!

login.line: If you sneak off without telling me one more time, I might just have to turn this place into a sea of fire.

lose.line: Hmph... You better not misunderstand, slave! I let them win!

mail.line: New mail... what's this? It's not for me!?

main1.line: With Amagi at my side, there is nothing we cannot do~ You are blessed indeed, my number one slave.

main2.line: Your profile is quite striking when you're working so diligently. Truly worthy of being my slave!

main3.line: Slave, while I don't mind you playing with your underlings, you must never forget to whom you answer.

mission.line: In the name of the eight million gods, hurry up and polish off a few more missions!

mission_complete.line: Mmmhmm, so many rewards, just as I would expect from my slave~

profile.line: I'm a battlecruiser... eh? Now that I mention it, am I no longer a warship? Hm, never mind. I am Akagi, and that's all that matters. Hehe. You must feel so honored to be my slave, hmm?

propose.line: This means you totally belong to me, and I shall give everything to you, right? Aha... hahahahaha! ...Slave.... I never would have imagined that owning you would make me so happy... Ahahahahahaaaa!

skill.line: How dare you harm my slave!

touch.line: Aren't you a clingy slave. Very well, I'll play with you~

touch2.line: *giggle* Seems I'll have to shackle you...

unlock.line: So you're the best this fleet has to offer? Well then, to please Amagi I'm going to have to start by dominating you. Hehehe.... How blessed you are. From this day forward, you're Akagi's number one slave.

upgrade.line: What a well-behaved slave you are~

win_mvp.line: Hmph. You insects have no right to bully my slave!

gift_prefer.line: Good, you should know exactly what your master wants~

battle.line: Give my concert your full attention~ Ahahaha!

couple_encourage1.line: I work with you out of respect for my Commander.

detail.line: I would do anything for you, my Commander. Yes, including this "idol" business... Hehehe.

expedition.line: The meddlesome pests are back... Commander, please excuse me for a moment?

feeling1.line: My Commander's apologetic screams are truly music to my ears... hehehe.

feeling2.line: Commander, did I hear you want to come see my show? I'm delighted~ Kaga, can you prepare a front row seat?

feeling3.line: Commander, if you wish it, I would perform forever for your eyes alone~ Indeed, this stage would belong only to my Commander for the rest of time♡

feeling4.line: We're at the point now that this group doesn't need any other girls... And I think I need to do a bit of "cleaning" for my Commander... Hehehehe...

feeling5.line: You want to get to know the other members? Hmm, if that is what my Commander wishes, I suppose I could accept it... But in return, Commander, you are only allowed to look at me♡

home.line: Commander, what would you say to a performance in your honor? Naturally, only Akagi would participate...

hp_warning.line: My love is far stronger than this!
