login.line: Commander, I wonder what's on the schedule for today? Hehehe.

lose.line: Gah... that was close. I can't let the Commander see me like this...

mail.line: A letter... Oh, Commander? It couldn't possibly be that you sent a fan letter to another girl...?

main1.line: I would like to know~ which girl you cheer for, Commander... I would really, REALLY like to know...

main2.line: This "idol" business is a little different, but it's no matter. Whatever my Commander wishes of me, I can do...

main3.line: Kaga, please cancel all of our lessons for the rest of the day. My time with my Commander is so precious, I refuse to waste a single second.

mission.line: Commander, is there a mission I might help you with?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. But I do hope that doesn't mean you will leave my side...?

profile.line: Sakura Empire Aircraft Carrier, Akagi, reporting in with a special equipment refit! Commander, things are a little different this time. I'm trying a little "idol" style for you. Won't you please be gentle with me? Hehehehe...

propose.line: Ahahahaha... all that I am now belongs to my Commander, and everything of my Commander now belongs to me... It will be just like my concerts: your eyes, your ears, even your heart is bound to me... Commander, I will never let you go...

skill.line: Ahaha, like dust in the wind.

touch.line: Commander, what are you waiting for? I'm ready for you, anytime, anyplace.

touch2.line: Don't mind the stares of the spectators in the stands. Take me however you please, my Commander... Hehehe♡

unlock.line: With the magicks of the Sakura Empire, changing my form like this is a trifle... Hehehe, Commander? Does this Akagi please you?

upgrade.line: Why, this is the strength of my love. Hehehe...

win_mvp.line: Oh my, did I incinerate all those fans clamoring for an encore?

gift_prefer.line: A gift, just for me? That makes me very happy.

battle.line: Surrender to my charms!

couple_encourage1.line: Aren't you a little bit too close to my Commander...?

detail.line: I would rather have been a solo act, but I still need to learn more about idols, and my Commander asked me to join the group... So for now, I bide my time... Hehehe♡

expedition.line: Commander, won't you go pick up the commission team...? I have a feeling that little Union girl is going to jump out and scare me if I go...

feeling1.line: Are you telling me I can't be an idol...?!

feeling2.line: To sing and dance for someone other than my Commander is...No, I just need to think of it another way. The idols are all for my Commander, only for my Commander. It's perfect...!

feeling3.line: Commander♡ My shoulders are sore from all my training~ Could you take me back to my room...? Actually, I think I'd rather rest in your room for a while, my Commander.

feeling4.line: Commander♡ I brought you my official idol merch. Of course, it's not something you could buy in a store, it's "special," just for you... Are you wondering what's "special" about it? Hehehe♪

feeling5.line: I have no interest in dazzling the people with my performance. But if my Commander wants to see me like that... Hehehehe♪ I'll do anything for you~

headtouch.line: C- Commander?! Ooh, you're treating me like a child now... hehehehe♡

home.line: My Commander♡ Are you here to watch me practice?

hp_warning.line: My Commander is watching...!

login.line: Commander~ What would you like me to do today?

lose.line: Grrgh, miserable insects...!

mail.line: A fan letter...? Who else should I talk to but my Commander?

main1.line: Hmph! This dance has some very difficult moves... I'll have to practice a lot more to give my best performance to my Commander!

main2.line: That Iron Blood girl's "healing" business that's all over her promotional materials... that's all fake, isn't it?

main3.line: My Commander♡ suddenly came to watch me practice... I feel like I could take on the world~!

mission.line: For the sake of my Commander, I can endure... no, I will gladly take any offer!

mission_complete.line: Hehehe, I've grown even more powerful from this job...!

profile.line: Sakura Empire armored carrier Taihou, reporting in to test the experimental "Muse System..." hehehe♡ My Commander need only ask and I will give anything, even my very life~

propose.line: Commander♡ What do you think of my new stage? And my outfit...? I will dazzle you over and over and over again with my beauty until you can't stand it anymore~ Ahahahahahaa!

skill.line: We'll have to get rid of these pests♪

touch.line: Hehehe♪ It seems this pose is powerful enough to draw my Commander's eye♡

touch2.line: Hehehe, it may be a scandal, but I don't care♡

unlock.line: With these clothes, and upon this stage... Ahaha... Ahahaha... Fate has ordained that my Commander shall fall for me here... Commander, please listen to the song of my love until the very end~♡

upgrade.line: I can't wait to show my Commander the results of my special training~

win_mvp.line: Ahahahaha! Bow down before the power of my love!

gift_prefer.line: Aahh... a present, from your heart to mine... Just as you have always cherished me, I shall keep your gift close to me at all times~

battle.line: Harrumph! With me at helm, victory is already assured!

couple_encourage1.line: No, no... I wasn't trying to say that you're wrong, but...!

couple_encourage2.line: There's no need to rush. The stream of time will carry victory to us!

detail.line: If you want to keep me company so badly... Well, I just happened to not have anyone to talk to, so you'll have to make do! In any case, let me start by telling you about my favorite kind of azalea––

expedition.line: The commission rewards are in~ I'm only responsible for informing you though, you'll have to carry the goods yourself~♪

feeling1.line: This simply won't do, Commander... I had no idea that the esteemed leader, the shining beacon of the fleet... would be such a decadent individual!

feeling2.line: How many times have I had to explain this to you before? I can do everything that an aircraft carrier is supposed to do, but I can't do anything outside of that because that's just what I used to be!

feeling3.line: Oh, Commander, what are you trying to do? Checking on that packed warehouse? Or just heading out for a stroll? Ah! Don't tell me... you're going on date with someone?! ...Hey, are you listening to me?

feeling4.line: Commander! I happened to discover something amazing! Tomorrow is a holiday, and there aren't many days like it, and by pure "coincidence," neither you or I have anything to do! So basically, I was thinking, what could the two of us do on such a rare and special day when we have nothing else to do? Haah, there are too many possibilities~!

feeling5.line: You know how in those books, if there's someone on your mind, it normally goes something like "your face gets all red and you can't find the words to say?" But, like, in my case, I just can't stop talking at all... Ah! I get it now! I'm not the one who's nervous, you are! ...Hey, are you listening to me?

headtouch.line: You think you can mess with my heart just by patting my head? How naive! ...If you remember to keep it up 365 days of the year, maybe you'll have a shot.

home.line: Ohh, you're back! So like, something totally weird happened while you were gone. A little bird got lost inside the office and it was really hard for us to guide it back out~ Your place seems to be really popular with the birdies–– Hey, are you listening?

hp_warning.line: Are you really going to let your all-important aircraft carrier get hit like this?!

login.line: Hello there, Commander! Today's workload is looking a bit heavy and I wonder if we might have to do some overtime but I'm sure if we get right down to business we'll be able to finish– Commander??

lose.line: We lost?! Even though I did everything I could?! Ugh... How could things have gone so wrong??

mail.line: New mail has arrived! Now then, is it something important? Perhaps, a mission notice? Or maybe...? Darn it, hurry up and open it up already~

main1.line: Skip bombing? I must admit, it was quite an imaginative tactic. The Eagle Union was even able to give one as cute and strong as me a headache! Ahahaha!

main2.line: If you're tired, just let me handle the paperwork. Nobody would notice the difference if I forged your signature... Ah, uh, that was obviously just a joke!

main3.line: I left half a cake for you on your desk. Why only half, you ask? Well, that's because... I already ate the other half! Ahahaha!

mission.line: Hrrrrmm... Don't tell me you still have unfinished missions lying around?

mission_complete.line: Quite satisfactory! With such abundant rewards, you'll be able to further expand your scope of work and have even more missions assigned to you! But... Hehe, are you able to shoulder that immense workload?

profile.line: Let's give you some tips for how to get along with a cute and cheerful girl: First, you'd better not find any of her conversations boring! Second, don't make her do any lame chores like carrying stuff around! Finally, ask nicely, don't try to boss her around! All right, that's it for the first lesson, but there will be more in the future... Hey, are you listening?!

propose.line: You keep squirming away from me but today I'll make sure you absolutely listen to every single word. Got it? Good! Ahem! I, Katsuragi, am bound by oath to you, and swear to always be at your side through joy or hardship! ...Mm, excellent. Now, it's your turn to repeat that back to me!

touch.line: What's the matter? Oh, you need me for something? Well, seeing how earnestly you're beseeching my aid, I have no choice but to at least consider it~

touch2.line: Heheh, I know you don't have the gumption to–– W-wait, stop that! Y-y-y-you're going to have to take responsibility at this rate, don't you know?!

unlock.line: Hello there, Commander! I'm the Unryuu-class aircraft carrier, Katsuragi. I'm not just a carrier, I'm a full-fledged aircraft carrier, meaning that I can do everything that an aircraft carrier is supposed to do! I'm not telling ya what I don't like, but as for hobbies, I've got a whole buncha those~ For example... (1 minute later) ...So yeah! Hey, Commander, are you still listening?

upgrade.line: Mhm, that's more like it! I'll offer you some words of praise for recognizing my worth!

win_mvp.line: Oh~hohoho~ How could you absolute nobodies hope to win against the might of a true aircraft carrier such as myself~

gift_prefer.line: What a flatterer you are... Hmph! But, I shall accept your gift anyway~♪

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, how has work been recently? Are you doing well? And how did you like that cake? Oh, and do you know where you want to go for next weekend's date? ...Hehe, every time I see you, I just can't stop myself~ But first of all, I'll have you answer each and every one of my questions~♪

headtouch_ex.line: Uhhh... So, how far are we into those 365 days? Well, seeing how I can't remember, let's start over from day one.

login_ex.line: Good mooorning, Commander! So, I have good news and bad news for you today. The bad news is, you've got a ton of work lined up. The good news is, I'm willing to help out! Do you understand the importance of this?

main2_ex.line: One document, two documents, three documents... What am I doing? Seeing how there's nothing for me to do at the moment, I thought I'd count your files to pass the time!

main3_ex.line: Commander, I brought two different flavors of cake this time! You choose the one you want first, and I'll take the other one! Of course, we could also share them half-and-half!

touch_ex.line: So tell me, what is this super important, ultra difficult mission that you cannot entrust to anyone but Katsuragi?

touch2_ex.line: Hwaah?! D-don't you know that you need to give me time to prepare myself before doing stuff like that? *blush*

win_mvp_ex.line: Oh~ho~ho! With you commanding from the rear, victory was all but assured!

detail.line: You came here looking for someone to talk to, right? I suppose I can keep you company then, but you should make sure you go around and deepen your bonds with everyone else too! ...Except Junyou, watch out for that one!

home.line: Woohoo, you're back, Commander! Bring any goodies back for me and the girls? I'm already so excited I can't calm down!

login.line: Hellooooo, Commander! Are we starting work today with some of that festive spirit? I didn't just bring my festive spirit with me today, I came ready with the whole package, outfit and all! I'll be happy as long as you can feel that holiday cheer~!

main1.line: When the fireworks climb high into the sky and go "kaboom," I can feel my excitement doing the very same thing! Ahahaha!

main2.line: Commander, are you totally into my getup? You are, aren't you! Aha, I totally knew it! Come and feast your eyes all you want then~♪

mission.line: Missions? Can't you let it rest for a day and just enjoy the day off??

mission_complete.line: Excellent! With these earnings, we'll be able to eat as much as we want... Well yeah, I know that! We need to share with everyone else too! ...B-but, I'd be really happy if you treated me to a little something... Please?

unlock.line: It's– summer– festival– time–!! Uhh, well, maybe it's a bit too late for a "summer" festival, so maybe a regular festival is fine? Well, the important thing is that you have lots of fun, Commander! Because I sure as heck will!

win_mvp.line: Victory is mine! That's how a real carrier does things, duh!

battle.line: I might be in a swimsuit, but I'm just as strong as ever!

detail.line: Nobody else is around, so I guess you gotta talk to me, Commander! ...Hm? You don't want to take the lead? If I lead the conversation, I might never stop talking, y'know.

expedition.line: Ooh! The commission team came home! I'd love to let you go and greet them by yourself, but they might think something's up if you go alone dressed like that, so I'll join you♪

home.line: Hey, you're back! So you're hot, right? Right? Of course you are! It's a little weird to get in the pool right after coming back from the sea, but forget that! Jump right in☆

login.line: Hello hello, Commander! Boy, it's hot~ Or so I WOULD say, but we're already dressed for the heat. The only cooler places we could go would be your air-conditioned office or a restaurant freezer. So I'm gonna try a different approach! Okay, c'mon in and cool off with me!

mail.line: New mail? I'll go get it... Whoa, whoa, whoa, ack, bad, bad, bad! ...Phew... I slipped and almost dropped the mail in the pool...

main1.line: Fire! Drive them back! ...There's no point sitting around in the water all day, so I decided to have the shikigami and manjuu do a mock battle. Wanna join in, Commander?

main2.line: Want a cold one? Or like a chilly, icy, brain-freezy one? The choice is yours, Commander!

main3.line: Don't you love this view? You can actually see the beach—and all the other girls in swimsuits—from here, so it's easy to see all the girls looking for you, Commander... Hey, what's wrong?! Did you see something scary?

mission.line: You STILL have missions left? ...Are you even listening?

mission_complete.line: Nice! With all these rewards, we can rebuild the swimming pool until everyone can fit in! ...Shame we can't make it a rooftop pool~

touch.line: Aha☆ Fascinated by me and my swimsuit?

touch2.line: Yeah, I might be a little lacking compared to the other girls... What do you want me to do about it, though?

unlock.line: Mmmh~ When it gets real hot, whether you're a shipgirl or an ordinary person, the place to go to cool down is always either the mountains or the beach, right? But what if I told you, that when you're at a rooftop pool, you not only get the great views of climbing up a mountain, but also the refreshing coolness of splashing around in the water? Am I right or am I right, Commander? ...Heeeey, are you even listening?!

win_mvp.line: Aircraft carrier Katsuragi wins again! ...Ahahaha, my victories are your victories, too, Commander.

battle.line: You'll regret ruining my sweet time with my Commander... Heehee...

couple_encourage1.line: Slave? The Commander is MINE!

detail.line: Do those big-boobied women... distract you, my Commander? Heehee... When I grow up, I'm gonna be the center of your world, and I'll never let you ogle any other girl again~

expedition.line: The commission team is back? Since they do it all for you, I'll come along and thank them~

feeling1.line: Is my love still not enough? That's fine. I've got ways to express much, muuuch more of my love...

feeling2.line: There's nothing I won't do for you, my Commander~ Simply say the word, and I'll write you another 100 love letters♥

feeling3.line: I have to get my hands on the key to the office... Oh, hi, my Commander~ Clumsy Taihou left something in your office. Can I borrow your key and go get it? I'll be right back, I promise~

feeling4.line: My Commander, won't you go on a date with me? I'm only a child, so all those grown-ups would never suspect it's actually a date~ Heehee❤

feeling5.line: What's wrong? Is it not a given that you should care for a prepubescent child? It makes sense for us to live in the same room – nobody would bat an eye at that! Heehee~ I won't let anyone take you from me, my Commander♥

headtouch.line: Heehee~ Oh, my Commander~♥

home.line: Back already? Did you miss me that much? Heehee... I know eeeverything about you~

hp_warning.line: Why is that stupid, stupid moron here? Why, why, why?!

login.line: Heehee... I've waited here this whole time for you~

lose.line: It's your fault my Commander is sulking... It's ALL your fault!

mail.line: You've received a new letter... Oh, I was just testing it for poison~

main1.line: That Akagi, she sincerely treats you as her slave? Heehee... Let's see if I can't wring an apology out of her~

main2.line: Has anyone else ever gifted you a toy, my Commander? Oh, no reason... I just thought I'd ask.

main3.line: My Commander, do tell me when you'd like a break. I'll go and hang an "on break" sign on the office door immediately. That will ensure nobody comes and disturbs you~

mission.line: A mission? Why should I let something so insignificant detract from my time with you? Just delegate it to someone else~

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. You wanted to finish it with me, didn't you? Heehee~ Getting work done while spending time with me is truly two birds with one stone♪

profile.line: I am the Sakura Empire's cutting-edge armored carrier. No bombs, torpedoes, or anything else can even scratch me. My Commander, I will systematically eliminate all who dare threaten you.

propose.line: So you finally admit it~ Even if our relationship stays the same, this officially proves that I've stolen your heart, my Commander~ You are the love of my life, now and forever♥

touch.line: Ah, a show of affection~ You make me so happy, my Commander❤

touch2.line: I get it, my Commander. You just couldn't wait any longer❤

unlock.line: I've finally found you, my Commander~ Why do you keep avoiding me? Is my love not enough for you? Then take this – a token of my unrestrained love~❤

upgrade.line: You are head over heels for me after all~❤

win_mvp.line: This fate is what befalls all who get between me and my Commander~

gift_prefer.line: I'm glad to hear that you love me sooo very much❤

home_ex.line: Could you please lie down for me, my Commander? See, this is what's called a "lap pillow" and it helps you really unwind~

login_ex.line: I've been waiting for you this whooole time, my darling~♥

main4_ex.line: What's your favorite food? I can make it for you~ I'm a little girl with lots of spare time, so I can practice whichever dish you like.

main5_ex.line: Do you feel worn out, my Commander? I'll get you a snack to munch on~ I'll also feed you it, so you can simply lie back and relax.

touch_ex.line: Heehee... You can't forget about my touch, can you? ♥

win_mvp_ex.line: Heehee... Now I can finally be alone with my Commander~❤

battle.line: Go forth. This one believes in you all...!

couple_encourage1.line: Remember to get ample sleep.

detail.line: Hmm? You're interested in this one's pillow? That is understandable, but this is actually my rigging... Why do you look surprised?

expedition.line: *yaaawn*... The commission team has returned... Mm, let this one wash my face first...

feeling1.line: Clearly, this one must educate you...!

feeling2.line: Hm? You're here, too... Have you come to take a nap? Oh, you're just here to think about your problems? Mmm... Okay, then this one will nap for a little while you do...

feeling3.line: Ngh... This one is too worried to sleep... What problem troubles you so? Fate? Hmm, this sounds complicated... But this one does not believe in it... Well, I don't think I do...

feeling4.line: Commander, may this one... s-sleep by your side tonight? Lately, nightmares have plagued me... Wh-why are you laughing? You're the one bothering this one about fate...!

feeling5.line: With you, this one can feel at ease... Nightmares scare me no longer... Yes, let's keep sleeping together♪

headtouch.line: Mmm, mmnh, nnh... G-gentle on the ears, please...

home.line: Zzzz... Heehee... Fruit candy, cheese, sweet melon... Mm? Oh. You're back... Zzzz.

hp_warning.line: Ah...! Th-this one mustn't lose...!

login.line: *yawn*... Greetings... As you can see, this one is searching for the perfect place for an afternoon nap...

lose.line: I-is this defeat...?

mail.line: Here is your mail. Messages carried here from distant places must be important.

main1.line: Mm... Your office is undoubtedly the perfect place to sleep. Allow this one just five more minutes...

main2.line: Would you like to dream together? Wonderful... Hm? How do you know that my dream... Could it be?! H-how embarrassing...!

main3.line: This one cannot sleep... The sound of you flipping pages was just incessant! Come rest with me...

mission.line: Zzzz... If this is a dream, then why has a mission... Ah! A new mission...?!

mission_complete.line: *yaaaaawn*... Th-this one completed the mission! Please handle the cleanup work... Zzz...

profile.line: ...Yes, this one is Shinano. Everything else can wait. The world is unpredictable, and the future is unknowable. Let things come as they may, and let this one drift off into the world of dreams...

propose.line: This... is proof of our vow... Then this one will do everything in my power. Let's see all of our dreams for a happy future come true... together.

touch.line: Zzzzz... Heehee... D-do not tickle...

touch2.line: Sit, you! This calls for a lecture!

unlock.line: You... are the one this one has seen in my dreams. Wonderful... This one feels relaxed around you... But it seems you need this one's guidance, don't you?

upgrade.line: This one feels a sudden surge of motivation, yet the thought of a sleepless night... Nnh, how troubling...

win_mvp.line: An easy win... *yawn*... Off to sleep...

gift_prefer.line: Woah! This is really nice!

feeling5_ex.line: Heehee, Commander, do you want to nap together? This one made a lovely dream and wants to share it with you♪

home_ex.line: Zzzzz... Oh, you're back... There are snacks, sweets, and tea... Relax as you please.

login_ex.line: *yawn*... Good day... Allow this little one to lay on the sofa in your office again...

main4_ex.line: This way, Commander... *hug*... Mm, this one wanted to try lying in your arms. Such a warm embrace... is the ideal bed, indeed...

main5_ex.line: If dreams can be created... then we could make the perfect amusement park just for us... Heehee♪

touch_ex.line: ...Hm? Shall we drift off to dreams together?

battle.line: Everyone, carry out your part of the plan, and bring victory to the Commander!

couple_encourage1.line: Thank you for always looking after me, Kaga.

couple_encourage2.line: Let us dedicate this victory to the Commander.

couple_encourage3.line: Since the Great Veteran is still fighting, perhaps I'll have to step up as well.

couple_encourage4.line: Lady Nagato, you, too, have changed greatly.

couple_encourage5.line: I'm glad to see that Akagi's juniors seem just as capable.

detail.line: Commander, even now, do you still seek a plan where "nobody has to get hurt"? Heehee... I understand perfectly.

expedition.line: Commander, a commission has been completed. Shall we head down to meet our friends at the warehouse?

feeling1.line: Times change... and so do people.

feeling2.line: Commander, I used to worry about how I should face my friends, and how to situate myself in this new environment... But after seeing you again, I quickly realized that those doubts and worries had no basis for being in the first place.

feeling3.line: Commander, the next time you head out to battle, please allow me to accompany you. I no longer wish to stay huddled in the rear, waiting for your return. I want to stand with you, along with all our other friends.

feeling4.line: In my eyes, you are the panacea that cures any and all of my ailments. But as the saying goes, the strongest medicine can also be the deadliest poison... Heehee. Even were that the case, I would still gladly drink every last drop.

feeling5.line: "Since time immemorial, unto a future eternal, the sun and moon hang in the firmament. As long as that firmament still stands, so too will my love." Heehee... Commander, do you understand what I'm trying to say?

headtouch.line: Commander, your hands... have grown so much stronger than before.

home.line: Commander, let us celebrate your triumphant return. Heehee. Perhaps the tacit understanding we share is the key to your continued victories.

hp_warning.line: Ahaha... Time to switch to a more effective strategy.

login.line: Commander, it is good to see you. I have already devised a plan for today's operations. Please have a look, if you would.

lose.line: A disadvantageous situation. Commander, I recommend that we ease up on the offensive and regroup before continuing to fight.

mail.line: Commander, new mail has arrived. I'm sending it over via carrier-based aircraft, so please take a look when you have time.

main1.line: Commander, isn't it interesting how these "carrier-based aircraft" have completely altered the landscape of war?

main2.line: Commander, if it's not too much trouble, I'd like to ask your opinion on something... Do you think that I'm not spending enough time with Akagi? How do you think I should rectify this?

main3.line: ...Oh, the medicine cabinet is empty. Time to restock... Hm? Commander? Oh, it's not that. I only take tonics now.

main4.line: Kaga came to visit me the other day. From battlecruisers to aircraft carriers, the two of us are both riding the waves of the changing times into the future. Heehee. Naturally, I'll have to work hard so that I don't get left behind.

mission.line: Heehee. I've already put together a plan for the next mission. Would you like to look it over, Commander?

mission_complete.line: Let these rewards pave the way towards your next great achievement. Yes... I'll have to come up with some plan to procure us even greater rewards...

profile.line: Who could have imagined that such a frail, sickly girl would be able to attain a new form, and once again sail upon the clear, blue seas? I would like to express my sincerest gratitude to you, Commander, as well as all my friends who never gave up hope. Yes, I, Amagi, have returned to you.

propose.line: I am no longer the weak and naive Amagi that I was before... just as you are no longer the same naive Commander you were before. And so, I vow to never leave your side again. The world remains in turmoil, Commander, so let us join hands and continue our good work.

skill.line: Now then, let us take flight.

touch.line: Commander, if you are tired, come and rest awhile. Would you like to use my tail as your pillow?

touch2.line: Commander, I think you should hold off on that for a little while...

unlock.line: I, aircraft carrier Amagi, am here to pay my respects. Time marches on, and the world has changed profoundly in my absence... Commander, what manner of enemy do we now face? Heehee. There's no need to worry yourself about my health this time. I'm fine now.

upgrade.line: This power... I will make sure to put it to good use.

win_mvp.line: May this victory be the foundation for our next. Impeccable leadership as always, Commander.

gift_prefer.line: What an adorable little present... Thank you very much, Commander.

detail_ex.line: "No matter how much things change, the Commander always remains the same." —Indeed, I could hardly ask for better news upon my return.

feeling5_ex.line: "O brilliant moon in the sky, though your light fills my eyes, you remain distant and untouchable." ...Though in this case, the moon known as Amagi is already at your side... Isn't that right, Commander?

login_ex.line: Commander, please avail yourself of this newly-arrived, freshly-brewed tea. How about a cup before you start work?

main5_ex.line: Commander, the fact that you have a massive amount of work is even more reason for you to learn to strike a good work-life balance. Right now, you should be relaxing – and I don't intend to budge on this point.

main6_ex.line: My, you've bested me in this match... Haha, of course I was not going easy on you, Commander. You've simply grown to the point where you are now able to outwit me.

main7_ex.line: Dango, yokan, or castella cake... What should I have today? Deciding is such a hassle. Commander, could you help weigh in on this matter?

main8_ex.line: Commander, would you like to go on patrol around the port with me later? I'm very eager to see what has changed here since last time.

touch_ex.line: You really do act like a rambunctious child at times, Commander... Heehee~

touch2_ex.line: Heehee... Have you gotten bolder knowing that my constitution has improved?

detail.line: Commander, many unknowns yet lurk in the depths of this castle. Should you be willing, I would like to accompany you on your next exploration.

expedition.line: The commission team might've brought back something surprising. Commander, shall we go take a look together?

feeling5.line: Commander, in this fleeting, illusory castle, there are no other people besides the two of us. So, please set aside your burdens, let your troubles melt away, and enjoy this moment of peace and joy with me...

headtouch.line: Hmm? Commander... Am I not keeping you entertained?

home.line: You have returned victorious, just as I predicted. I have already called for a celebration, so please follow me to the venue, if you would.

login.line: Commander, welcome to Castle Amagi. Please set aside your worries and revel to your heart's content.

mail.line: Commander, your mail has arrived. Umm... If you don't mind, maybe we could share the throne and read them together?

main1.line: Hmm? You've noticed that it's been clear and sunny every day here since you arrived? Heehee... How observant of you. I would expect nothing less.

main2.line: "A chance encounter between a world-weary castellan and a lost visitor"... Hmm, don't you think that makes for a wonderful fairy tale theme?

main3.line: Since you're already in a dreamland paradise, why not take advantage of the opportunity fully and indulge yourself? Heeehee... Commander, shall we try all the sweets here together? Starting with the yokan~

main4.line: I am in charge of all the keys to the doors here that cannot be opened. I would be glad to give these keys to you, as long as you fulfill my wishes. So, Commander... One wish per key. Does that sound like a good deal?

mission.line: A new mission, huh? Worry not, for I am with you.

mission_complete.line: Commander, there's nothing to worry about. All your missions have already been completed. All you need to do now is rest and relax.

touch.line: Hmm... Commander, I do believe I've already caught a glimpse of your true intentions. Heehee.

touch2.line: Ahhn... Commander... I, don't have to rein in my urges any longer, right...?

unlock.line: So you've finally come, Commander. I have been waiting for you— Ahem. Heehee, please step forward. In this castle of dreams, this throne... belongs to you and me equally.

detail.line: Will you continue watching me dance, Commander? Or would you like to join me and feel the pounding of my heart for yourself?

feeling5.line: These bubbles are meant to fizzle out in an instant, but they're still wrapping around us. They stretch and expand, but they stick close to us. Yes, they remind me of our bond, Commander.

headtouch.line: Aah... Even underwater, I can feel the warmth of your palm, Commander.

home.line: Did you see that? The surface of the water was glowing so gently, as if it were welcoming you back... Hehe, all that time I spent waiting was nothing more than sweet torment.

login.line: Commander, I want you to keep gazing at me with those eyes and touching me with those hands. I will... return the favor.

main1.line: The ripples I make with my fingers represent the feelings I hope will reach you, Commander. Don't they look beautiful as they shimmer in the water?

main2.line: The waters are so quiet. I can hear the racing of my own heart as I sense your presence, Commander. Can you feel my heartbeat too?

main3.line: Hehehe, would you like to know how mermaids swish their tails? Come a little closer, Commander, and I'll show you.

main4.line: We finally have time to take in the underwater scenery. Would you like to take a tour of the area with me, Commander?

touch2.line: Commander... Were you hoping to exchange oxygen with me?

unlock.line: These deep, dark waters are a world of my own creation – a stage you won't find anywhere else. Commander, I ask that you put aside your worries from the surface for a while and enjoy yourself to your heart's content here.

detail.line: You may not change, Commander, but I need to. To be someone who's worthy of standing by your side, to be able to protect everyone for as long as I can... I must improve on myself, little by little.

feeling5.line: The flowers of spring, rains of summer, leaves of autumn, and snows of winter... There would be no greater honor than to walk by your side and experience all of these things with you. May we never be separated again, Commander.

headtouch.line: Well, well...

home.line: Triumph is all but expected by now, so there's no need to celebrate? Is that so? Heehee, then I'll just celebrate your safe return. I do consider that more worthy of joy, regardless.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Allow me to present today's special brew... That's right. It's the same tea we picked out just recently.

main1.line: Perfect timing, Commander. Take a break and let me handle your affairs. Behind every great Commander is a great wife, no?

main2.line: For my next move... *sigh*... I'm no match for you, Commander. You've taught me a lot today, heehee.

main3.line: *grumble*... Oh, no. Thinking of today's dinner has made me hungry already. I'm sorry you had to hear that...

main4.line: Your daily work, combat, caring for everyone at port... With all due respect, Commander, don't you think you should worry about your own health rather than mine?

touch.line: Please guide me, Commander.

touch2.line: You're such a flirt...

unlock.line: "In joy and in sorrow, in sickness and in health..." Commander? Heehee, this isn't foreshadowing. You don't need to worry about your beloved Amagi anymore.

win_mvp.line: Brilliant leadership, as always. We must use this victory to pave the way to greater endeavors.

battle.line: Let the Commander's light illuminate the deepest dark.

couple_encourage1.line: We finally get to fight together. Why do you seem so glum?

couple_encourage2.line: Good day to you, Unzen. Let's fight elegantly.

detail.line: Commander, I'm shaping ashes for a tea ceremony. You push them with this special tool, make a little mountain with them... See? Heehee, someone's watching a little too intently.

expedition.line: Are you going to meet the commission team? I've prepared a welcoming ceremony, so allow me to join you.

feeling1.line: ...I thought my Commander to be perfect, but now you're as timid as the waning moon. How... fascinating♥

feeling2.line: I hear my sister has been causing you trouble. Don't worry... My aromas will send all evil things running for the hills.

feeling3.line: It's perfect weather for a flower-viewing. May I trouble you to join me in the fun, my Commander?

feeling4.line: *sniff*... Aah... Your scent has permeated me. How can I keep it to myself forever, I wonder? I know... If I can just keep you by my side forever, then that will do the trick.

feeling5.line: When I'm with you, I don't feel lonely anymore. Why is that? Is it your fingers? Your gaze, or your lips? Or... all of you? I want to keep you forever, Commander... And I do mean forever...

headtouch.line: Aww, are you loving on me right now, my Commander? Heehee...

home.line: Welcome back! You weren't bored in my absence, were you? Did you sense my... longing for you, at all?

hp_warning.line: This is the moment in which I'm most beautiful!

login.line: Good day, Commander. Today's fragrance is named "morning dew"... Savor this fleeting aroma with me.

lose.line: The weather today is hardly suitable for violence.

mail.line: You have new mail. Heehee, I gave it a scent for you. Do you like it?

main1.line: Commander, when do you think fleeting life is the most beautiful? A flower's first bloom? The lush growth of leaves? Or the falling of those leaves? Heehee, maybe the moment we return to dust is the most beautiful of all...

main2.line: Goodness, the cutest critters always avoid me. It's as if they're scared... I wonder why?

main3.line: Beautiful... heehee, I accidentally dropped my tea whisk into the brazier. See, Commander? The way the bamboo strands are warped... Doesn't it resemble the last dance of life?

main4.line: You have such a good relationship with my sister, don't you? Heehee... I see. Not as a pet and its owner, but as two equal human beings?

mission.line: New missions, hmm? If they relate to ceremony at all, then don't hesitate to ask for my help.

mission_complete.line: All done♪ As a reward for your efforts, may I burn a new stick of incense?

profile.line: It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Hakuhou, a Sakuran Project G14 aircraft carrier. Born from picturesque fantasy, I've finally come to your side. Please disrobe so that I may instill you with my refreshing aroma.

propose.line: I'm so... so happy... You really do care for me, don't you? Oh...? Are you sleepy, my Commander? Then rest a while. I'll stay here with you throughout this eternal night...

skill.line: Sleep, sleep, and never feel pain again...

touch.line: Oh, do you like my scent? Do you know what part of me smells the best, I wonder? Heehee...

touch2.line: Interested in me, are you? Hehe...

unlock.line: I've been waiting for you! You know, it's tradition to light incense to welcome distinguished guests. That should tell you how delighted I am to meet you today, Commander.

upgrade.line: My etiquette is perfection personified.

win_mvp.line: Rest in these depths, never to laugh or cry again...

gift_prefer.line: Heheh... What an interesting offering~♪ I shall cherish it~

detail_ex.line: How can I keep you to myself for all eternity? I would cast aside my status, possessions, and all, just to make you mine...

feeling5_ex.line: I admire everything about you... Your fingers, your lips, your gaze... My mysterious, beloved Commander, what are you made of? Please, show me...♡

headtouch_ex.line: Mm... Ah... This isn't enough. I need... so much more...

home_ex.line: Welcome back, my Commander. I can't help but notice... there's an unfamiliar scent on you. Heehee, let me just purify you for a moment.

login_ex.line: You'll always return to me, won't you, my Commander? Now and forever, alive or otherwise...

main5_ex.line: I'm delighted that you want to be mine, and I'll accept no outside objections to our union...

main6_ex.line: My Commander, you'll never leave me... How can I be so certain? Heehee, that's a bit of a secret...

main7_ex.line: I have a collection of ceramics. They're so beautiful that they take my breath away, but when I touch them, they shatter to bits...

main8_ex.line: You look sleepy, my Commander. Let me put you to sleep~ Yes, close your eyes... Good night, my love. My beloved, cherished, dearest Commander...

touch_ex.line: I'm tired of silly small talk about the weather and the seasons. My Commander... Why don't we try something a little unconventional?

touch2_ex.line: My Commander, it's time you fill the void inside me...

detail.line: I've clearly picked the wrong role this time... Next time, can I be the noblewoman who is plagued by unrequited love and resorts to using poison? Heehee, it's just a game, so you don't have to take it too seriously.

feeling5.line: It all makes sense now. My "assassination attempt" failed because you already knew how I felt. Heehee, but my love will endure in your heart even if my body turns to ash... Isn't that right?

headtouch.line: Have I pleased you, my lord?

home.line: Back so soon? Why is your blade unsheathed? That's dangerous, so you'd best put it away... If I begged desperately, you would have mercy on me, wouldn't you?

login.line: You have me in your clutches now. What will you do to me? ...Oh. You'll release me? That's... unexpected.

main1.line: My lord, do you have any advice for this failed assassin? For example, techniques to improve my stealth... Heehee, you think I should try harder to hide my malice first? I can't believe that's what did me in.

main2.line: How did I pinpoint your location so easily? It's because of the scent I left on you, of course!

main3.line: You still have a lot of rope left over, I see... Please make good use of my love for you, my lord.

main4.line: *pant*... *pant*... I'm trying to offer my everything to you. Is there no room for mercy?

mission.line: New missions require your attention, my lord. Allow me to join you, and I'm sure I can help.

touch.line: Caught you! Hehe, that's for approaching me so carelessly.

touch2.line: You're my captive now, my lord... Heehee.

unlock.line: You amaze me, my lord. Not only have you foiled this kunoichi's assassination plot, but you've also repaid my treachery with kindness and mercy... Heehee, you wouldn't reject my desire to remain here and serve you, would you? My lord...

battle.line: Let us be as a great wave!

detail.line: You'd like to see my liquid form? Heehee, not yet. But if you're so desperate, then I expect you to at least prepare hundreds of cherry blossom trees to line my path – Ah! You're not seriously going to do it, are you? Hey! Get back here!

expedition.line: Come, it's time to greet the commission team.... But first, would you help me straighten out my clothes?

feeling1.line: The bell sounds oddly dull... Did I entrust it to the wrong person, after all?

feeling2.line: If you run into a problem, try to figure it out yourself first. If you really can't solve it on your own, come to me. I like solving worthwhile problems... Ahem. Emphasis on "worthwhile."

feeling3.line: The flavor is a little too strong for me... What's that? It's a limited-edition dish?! Th-then I suppose I could try more... *munch, munch*... It's not bad... Let me have another bite.

feeling4.line: Aww, did you miss me already? O-oh, you just touched the bell by accident? Well, I'm here now, so I'll stay a little longer. You'd best be grateful!

feeling5.line: How did you feel about today's tea, soup, and bath water, Commander? Don't look so puzzled – I'm just asking because I prepared all of it for you... personally.

headtouch.line: You don't think it's impolite at all to do this to me? Hmm... But it does feel nice, so I'll let it go just this once.

home.line: Commander, did you remember to buy me the most expensive dessert? You won't get past me with a half-hearted answer.

hp_warning.line: Tch, what insolence! You'll pay a high price for this!

login.line: If you need my aid, just touch the bell I gave you before. Oh, but it wouldn't hurt if you also said, "Please, Big Sister, I need your help!"

lose.line: We LOST? So my mastery of water is too gentle yet...

mail.line: Ah, new mail? See if there are any bills addressed to me, please. I've been splurging a little bit lately...

main1.line: I recently bought a bunch of antiques. They were expensive, but I thought they suited my status well. Come to my place, and you can get a good look at them.

main2.line: None of the goods around here are of high quality or notable origin. I'd rather not keep them... Huh? They're expensive? Then they must have some other value...

main3.line: Th-thunder?! You must be awfully scared, Commander. Big Sister will stay right here to protect you. Hold on tightly... Actually, let me be the one to hold you!

mission.line: You still have more work to do? Remember, if you need my help, you must first say, "Please, Big Sister, I need your help!" Ah yes, very good!

mission_complete.line: What? You finished your missions already?! S-so you managed it without my help, after all...

profile.line: I am Unryuu, wielder of water and the first ship of the Sakura Empire's Unryuu-class aircraft carriers. Ahem... Commander, you may gaze upon my beautiful form and etch it into your memory forevermore.

propose.line: You'd like to keep this symbol of our bond forever? How greedy of you. But I am your dear Big Sister Unryuu, after all. Now... I promise that I will always be by your side, until all the water in the world runs dry...

touch.line: Oh? Best be careful, now. Touch me carelessly, and your sleeves might just get wet.

touch2.line: Huh? H-hold it... The flowing waters won't forget this, you know.

unlock.line: Your reputation precedes you, Commander. I am Unryuu... Heehee, stunned, are we? Such a grand performance perfectly suits me. Take this bell as a token of our friendship, Commander. I hope you won't disappoint me.

upgrade.line: Phew... The flowing waters permeate my whole being.

win_mvp.line: Over already? I haven't even used my full power yet.

gift_prefer.line: Oh, goodness! Ahem... I graciously accept. Your taste isn't so bad, Commander.

detail_ex.line: Would you like to know how it feels to snuggle up with water? Heehee, then give your big sister a big hug!

feeling5_ex.line: This bell has fulfilled its purpose, so you don't need to ring it anymore. From now on, even without this simple token, I'll come to you whenever your heart aches for me.

headtouch_ex.line: Mm... Touch as much as you like. But if you mess up my hair, you're the one who has to fix it for me.

home_ex.line: You're back. Come and try these snacks I prepared. These aren't easy to come by, no matter how rich you are. Savor them, and thank me from the depths of your heart.

login_ex.line: Oh, you're here. Hehe, I could hear the bell jingling from afar. I trust you're ready to spend a wonderful day with me?

main4_ex.line: Why am I not wearing that limited-edition dress we bought yesterday? Aww, Commander, you still don't understand. Expensive clothes need careful maintenance, and sometimes, the best maintenance means not wearing them at all!

main5_ex.line: If you're tired from work, come to me, and I'll wash your stress away with a relaxing current. Nobody gets this service but you, Commander.

main6_ex.line: Hehe, I splurged on a set of nice lacquerware. They're all works of art, so their value is sure to go up – not that I'm trying to profit off of them. If they DO go up in value, then... Huh?! They're already being mass-produced?!

touch_ex.line: Commander, your hands are all dry. Shall I moisturize them for you?

touch2_ex.line: Hey, Commander... Do you hear the sound of water flowing?

feeling5.line: Hmm? Do I spy anxiety in those eyes? Hehe, I guess you need to experience my full power before we go... Prepare to be conquered by the power of water, Commander.

headtouch.line: Yeees? Would you like to go on a little mission together?

home.line: Did you bring a mission back for your poor big sister? Hehe, tell me more.

login.line: The mission begins. Commander, shall we play a little game first? Heehee... Try to find me before I blend into the night...

main1.line: Heehee. Just this once, I'll forgive you for looking down on me. Now let go of my hand, please.

main2.line: Am I cold? Not especially. I'm trying to accomplish great things, so I hardly have time to be bothered by... Achoo! I-I said I'm not cold!

main3.line: Before we do our missions, let's enjoy a fancy dinner, buy some accessories... What does that have to do with missions? Why, everything, of course! How could I complete a mission when I'm not in the right mood?

touch.line: Were you just begging for attention? Would you be that lonely if I departed for my mission? Heehee.

touch2.line: Would you like to try... sinking a little deeper?

unlock.line: This mission is a piece of cake. There's no obstacle that water can't penetrate, nor any wall that it can't permeate. Watch as I break through your so-called impenetrable defenses!

feeling5.line: Hmm? Do I spy anxiety in those eyes? Hehe, I guess you need to experience my full power before we go... Prepare to be conquered by the power of water, Commander.

headtouch.line: Yeees? Would you like to go on a little mission together?

home.line: Did you bring a mission back for your poor big sister? Hehe, tell me more.

login.line: The mission begins. Commander, shall we play a little game first? Heehee... Try to find me before I blend into the night...

main1.line: Heehee. Just this once, I'll forgive you for looking down on me. Now let go of my hand, please.

main2.line: Am I cold? Not especially. I'm trying to accomplish great things, so I hardly have time to be bothered by... Achoo! I-I said I'm not cold!

main3.line: Before we do our missions, let's enjoy a fancy dinner, buy some accessories... What does that have to do with missions? Why, everything, of course! How could I complete a mission when I'm not in the right mood?

touch.line: Were you just begging for attention? Would you be that lonely if I departed for my mission? Heehee.

touch2.line: Would you like to try... sinking a little deeper?

unlock.line: This mission is a piece of cake. There's no obstacle that water can't penetrate, nor any wall that it can't permeate. Watch as I break through your so-called impenetrable defenses!

battle.line: I'll give it my best shot~

couple_encourage1.line: I don't want your candy! ... Go awaaaay!

couple_encourage2.line: Aren't I suuuper amazing? I am, aren't I?

detail.line: Did you want to see me? Hehehe~ That makes me super happy~

expedition.line: Are you gonna welcome back the commission team? I wanna go with you! Surely I can come along?

feeling1.line: It's all because I'm not trying hard enough, isn't it...

feeling2.line: Enemies? I won't let any get away~ I'll beat the heck outta each and every one of 'em!

feeling3.line: Would you like... a massage? A shoulder rub? Or maybe you want to use my thighs as a pillow? Hehehe~

feeling4.line: Do you think I'm cute? ... Hehehe~ C'mon, say it one more time~

feeling5.line: I can't be without you anymore... You can't be without me either, right? Say it, c'mon~ Hehehe~

home.line: Nice work~ Maybe I should give you a massage... Mmh, how is it? Am I good? Hehehe~

hp_warning.line: I-it'll take more than this to scare me!

login.line: Commander! I've been waiting sooooo long for you!

lose.line: Oww, it hurts... I wanna go back to the Commander...

mail.line: Your mail? I already brought it here! See? Aren't I smart~?

main1.line: I made hot tea for you! I'm so great, aren't I?

main2.line: I went through your paperwork! Hehehe~ Maybe you could pat me on the head as a reward~

main3.line: *Giggle*... What are you looking at~?

mission.line: A mission? I can help! I'll give it 100%~

mission_complete.line: I've brought the mission rewards~ Give me your praise, Commander~

profile.line: Destroyers, carriers, battleships, I'll sink 'em all with one shot~! Hey, Commander, aren't I amazing? I am, right?

propose.line: From now on, you'll always be mine~ I wanna hear your praise, and I wanna make lots and lots of dear memories with you~

touch.line: Do you want me to help you relax?

touch2.line: Hehehe~ I don't mind at all, as long as you praise me~

unlock.line: I'm I-19! Commaaandeeer! I-19's been waiting so, so long for you~!

upgrade.line: You can praise me more~

win_mvp.line: Now the Commander will hopefully praise me... Hehehe~

gift_prefer.line: This is for me? Ehehe... That makes me really happy, Commander.

detail.line: I should make some friends? But I don't need any~! You're the only person I need!

login.line: School's so boring... I'd rather be by your side, Commander~ Hehehe~

mail.line: Mail? I hope it's not an angry letter from some teacher...

main1.line: Eek! The wind nearly... Hmm? Were you trying to sneak a peek~?

main2.line: Commander, help me with my extra lessons...

main3.line: Do you like my outfit, Commander? Is it cute? Hehehe~

touch.line: Hehehe~ Do you wanna walk to and from school with me?

touch2.line: No touching until everyone else has gone home...

unlock.line: Aww, do I have to go to school? ... Oh, Commander! Are you here to see me off?

detail.line: Sleeping while cuddling Mr. Torpedo is the best~ Ehehe~

home.line: Mr. Torpedo, the Commader's back... Zzz...

login.line: Zzz... I want to keep sleeping...

mail.line: Are you my new pillow? Zzz...

main1.line: A red one, a yellow one, a green one... there are sooo many pillows~

main2.line: Commander, do you want to try cuddling Mr. Torpedo? It'll feel really good~

main3.line: Zzz... Don't take Mr. Torpedo away...

mission.line: Missions? Sure, after I wake up~

touch.line: Geez, I'm not a body pillow...

touch2.line: Don't you think I'm way more cuddlable than Mr. Torpedo? Ehehe~

unlock.line: So sleepy... Hey, Commandeeer? Do you wanna nap with me and my torpedo?

detail.line: Does this outfit excite you? Hehehe~ You can stare all you want, you know~

home.line: Well done, Commander~ I've been waiting for you here this whole time! Hehehe~ Aren't I great?

login.line: I'm here to serve you for the whole day! Just tell me if there's anything you want me to do~

main1.line: Here! A glass of hot milk for you! Aren't I super duper great?

main2.line: Commander, which do you like better, bunnies or cats? Hehehe~

main3.line: Hmm, there's a lot of girls dressed like bunnies right now... I'll try to be your most favorite one!

touch.line: I picked up a few massage techniques! Hehehe~ Want me to try them on you, Commander?

touch2.line: It feels a little weird, doing this in a bunny outfit...

unlock.line: I thought I'd try on this bunny costume! Hehehe, do you like it? If you think it's cute, I wanna hear you say it~

battle.line: Who might be our lucky girl today~?

couple_encourage1.line: Don't be afraid! We're allies now!

couple_encourage2.line: Remember to do your warm-ups, or you'll get cramps, Idol of The Drydock~

detail.line: Tans are a sign of good health! So why not come with me and sunbathe a bit?

expedition.line: A commission's done! Put me on the team for the next one! Disrupting trade is what I do best! Hehehe~

feeling1.line: Commander? Never mind, must've been the wind. Hahaha!

feeling2.line: Commence dive! Target spotted! Fire torpedoes! Kaboooom! See? It's pretty easy! Why don't you give it a try too?

feeling3.line: Commander, wanna see which of us can hold their breath longest? The winner gets a massage from the loser! How's that sound?

feeling4.line: I wonder when you'll notice that... um... that... your suit has a button loose! What were you expecting me to say? Hehehe~

feeling5.line: Hey, let me borrow your shoulders... Jumpity! Hehehe~ Light as a feather, right? Bring me to the office, if you will!

home.line: Huh? Commander, I think your hairline's starting to recede... Ahahaha! I'm just kidding with you!

hp_warning.line: Ahaha... This might be bad...

login.line: Jumpity! ... Hehe~ Did I spook you, Commander?

lose.line: Oh, shoot... I messed up...

mail.line: What about your mail? It was past the deadline, so I disposed of it... Juuust kidding! Here you go, read it~

main1.line: "What's up with my ears"? Hm? Do you wanna feel them?

main2.line: Sorting paperwork... Ugh, so boring... Hey, why don't we play beach volleyball instead?

main3.line: Maybe I should go for a swim~ Oh, I know! Commander, wanna have a swimming competition to see who's faster? Hehehe~

mission.line: A new mission's arrived! Phew, this'll be a good chance to move around a bit!

mission_complete.line: When I see those ships coming in with our rewards, my heart shakes with the impulse to sink them... Just kidding~! I'd never do that! Hahaha, let's check out what we got!

profile.line: Question! Which Sakura Empire submarine was the first to sink an Eagle Union merchant ship? You guessed it, this clever little cutie I-26 did! ... What happened after that, you ask? Let's leave the past behind us and focus on the present! *Giggle*

propose.line: I was wondering when this day would come, but I never would've thought it'd be today... I feel so happy that I could swim 100 laps around the port! Yeah! In fact, let's go swimming right now, together!

touch.line: Hm? Need any help doing your warm-ups?

propose.line: Commander, I'm sure that you will be able to create that world... where everyone can smile from the bottom of their heart... As for me, I can't think of anything happier than being with you right now.

skill.line: Can you predict where I'm going to attack from?

touch.line: It's important to warm up before diving. Commander, let's do some exercises together.

feeling2.line: Commander, thank you for coming to see me today. Because of you, I'll have some extra spring in my step. Hehe~

feeling3.line: ...Is Commander really not coming today..? I'm going to die of loneliness... ... C-Commander?! Did you hear me just now??

feeling5.line: Ahhn... Commander, you've come to see me again... Today... today, you won't leave my side this time, right? Commander, if you stay with me, I'll never be lonely ever again!

main3.line: Commander... Commander...? Are you still asleep? I'm getting a bit worried...

mission_complete.line: These are the fruits of everyone's efforts. Make sure to receive them with pride.

profile.line: I'm the Type-B class cruiser submarine, I-25. I'm at my best when it comes to reconnaissance and disrupting shipping routes. I've also been in some... pretty daring operations. Hehe~ Commander, you can count on me.

touch.line: Haah... I'm being filled to the brim with your energy, Commander...

touch2.line: Commander, do you... like this kind of sensation...?

main3.line: There's nothing wrong with I-19, right... The next time I-26 calls everyone to play, I'll go check on her.

touch.line: Haah... as long as you're by my side, I feel safe and sound.

touch2.line: Woahh... Commander...

headtouch.line: Please... rub my ears as well...

login.line: Uhh... C-Commander, are you done making your rounds yet? ...Haah... thanks for filling me up with your energy today...

main1.line: Thank you, everyone, for preparing all this Spring Festival food. Right, time to dig in... Ah, um, is it okay to start eating?

main2.line: The Manjuus and Meowfficers are also busy preparing for the Spring Festival... Thanks for all the hard work~♪

main3.line: If it's going to take a while to make your rounds, go get my sister instead... Actually, wait, can I come with you?

touch2.line: M-my sister's going to get jealous...

battle.line: They didn't find me, right...?

couple_encourage1.line: Who works best with 58...

detail.line: Eep?! Oh, C-Commander... did you need something?

feeling2.line: If you don't want to get caught up in bothersome things, it's probably better to be like thin air and not stand out...

feeling3.line: Everyone in the fleet gets along so well... Ehe... hehehe... Um, it's nothing... l-leave me alone...

touch2.line: Eeek?! W-what do you want?!

login.line: Commander, how can I help you, nya~

main1.line: There sure are a lot of people at this party, nya. Maybe I should open up a booth here, nya.

touch.line: Hmm? Do you wanna use our well-known photography hall, nya?

mission_complete.line: Nyahaha~ Just as I expected from you, Commander. I'll put the mission rewards to good use, nya~

touch2.line: Nyahaha? Did you remember just how charming I am, nya?

feeling3.line: You think I'm weird, do you? Heheh, maybe I am... Just remember: there are only so many things a regular submarine can do. That's something I learned during my short time in service.

feeling4.line: I've gotten closer to the carrier's aircraft now, and it's all thanks to you. I've never been this happy before in my life. Thank you, Commander!

profile.line: I'm I-13, formally known as the Type A Mod. 2 cruiser submarine model thirteen. Some people call me the fifth of the Type A model, but I was really just an upgraded model that could store Seirans. Sounds cool, doesn't it? Well, sadly, I didn't achieve much of note...

propose.line: A... Hellcat? An Avenger? Even a Hurricane, and all these other planes?! You... went out and borrowed them all just for me? Oh, Commander... I love you so much I can't even think straight...!

skill.line: Here it comes... Everything I'm capable of!

touch.line: I'm okay with lending you my Seiran, but it's veeeeery expensive! Break it, and I'll be really angry, okay?

touch2.line: Don't make me pepper you with my Seiran's machine guns.

unlock.line: Hi, Commander. I'm the aviation submarine I-13. My hobbies include aircraft and gazing up at the sky! Also, this is my friend, my Seiran. I'm glad to meet you.

upgrade.line: Maybe I can fit a few more Seirans once I get stronger?

win_mvp.line: This victory will be a great help to our other fleets.

gift_prefer.line: Thanks a bunch~

detail_ex.line: When we visited the aircraft exhibit, I was spouting off facts and trivia the whole time... That didn't bore you, did it? ...Oh, you liked it? R-really? Heehee...

feeling5_ex.line: No matter how little strength one person has, you find surprising ways to leverage it, Commander! Being with you and doing my best at everything makes me so happy.

headtouch_ex.line: Heehee – headpat me all you want!

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! I got tickets for the aircraft exhibition. We should go there if you have the time!

login_ex.line: The skies are ever blue and beautiful, Commander! I'd love to take you for a sky ride with my Seiran.

main4_ex.line: I'm used to looking at the sky from the sea. I wonder what it's like to look at the sea from the sky... Don't you think it'd be a breathtaking view?

main5_ex.line: What's your favorite color, Commander? ...Huh? The color I am? Oh, well, that's just... Heehee♪

main6_ex.line: Fighters hide in the clouds, and submarines hide under the water. Both are fantastic for launching a surprise attack!

touch_ex.line: Up we... go! You're curious about my horns, aren't you, Commander? Touch them if you want!

touch2_ex.line: Whuah?! C-Commander! No surprises, please!

detail.line: Commander, have you ever done animal observation reports? I swim with fish in the sea all the time, but I've never observed an animal up close like this before... It's really fascinating!

feeling5.line: The sky and the sea come together into one up here. Everything's dyed blue. Heehee – I wish we could look at this view forever and ever.

headtouch.line: Hrmph... I'm standing higher up, so why am I the one getting headpatted?!

home.line: You should come up here. You can really feel the breeze up here. It'll blow all your fatigue away! Come on, I'll help you take off your jacket.

login.line: Are you heading home, too, Commander? Heehee – alright, then come to me. The view here is mindblowing. You can see all kinds of stuff from up high. Heehee... I took my shoes off so I won't slip, so don't worry about me.

main1.line: The roundy-head's an octopus♪ The longy-head, yes, that's a squid♪ Let's find out what friends we'll meet today♪

main2.line: Be careful of poisonous fish, Commander. Like the pufferfish, and the striped eel catfish, and the manta ray... Luckily, we don't have to worry about them here!

main3.line: Can't even find one with my Seiran... Oh, I was talking about clams. I used to do clam-digging at the beach long ago. I remember my feet getting stuck in the mud, which wasn't nice...

touch.line: What is it, Commander? Do you wanna observe with me?

touch2.line: C-Commander! You'll make me lose my balance... It'll really hurt if I fall from here!

unlock.line: So high up... But it's okay, Commander – I have a good sense of balance. Anyway, wanna see what's down there?

battle.line: I'm taking the lead? Okay, I'll be sublime about it.

couple_encourage1.line: Dragon God, let us dance!

detail.line: Alright, let me reintroduce you – this is Kotama, my seadrake rigging! It deserves part of the credit for my sublime victories. Hm? No, my sublime dancing is solely my own effort!

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Seems they got a pretty sublime haul, too... Hm? Precognition? No, no, I just saw them while diving. Telling the future is not one of my abilities.

feeling1.line: Move discreetly and dive stealthily... Can't find me, can't find me...

feeling2.line: Mh... Hm?! Hang on, is... Is that first-grade sea urchin you've got there?! Heheh! I knew it was a good idea to come with you! Man, you're the best!

feeling3.line: Diving with you is so much fun. That reminds me, when we were in the water just earlier and a school of pilchards showed up, you were looking at me instead of the fish, weren't you?

feeling4.line: Spacing is hugely important in the Sakuran arts. From the fingertips stopping for just a moment, to a pause where a breath is taken, there's a thousand words and feelings put into each one. If you wanna learn about my dancing, start by following my steps! Come on, Commander! Let's dance!

feeling5.line: Hmm... If you ask me, I think the feeling of love is the world's sublimest miracle. It's like the excitement of finding a beautiful coral reef deep underwater, then turning around to see you right next to me.

headtouch.line: Hmgh?! Urgh... Mgh... Don't do that while I'm eating sea urchins!

home.line: Must've been a sublime battle. How do I know? Because I had front row seats in the water and witnessed it from start to finish.

hp_warning.line: Bloodshed is what makes a battle so sublime!

login.line: What, time for work already? The sea is as sublime as lapis lazuli, and the breeze is calm... Can't we change that "regular meeting" in the schedule into a diving session?

lose.line: This is not the kind of "going down" I wanted to do!

mail.line: A letter's arrived. You'd better stop ignoring it before I sublimely claim it for myself.

main1.line: The clouds today look a bit like sand patterns on the sea floor... I've got it – it must mean the sea is calling for me! Come on, we're going diving once you finish your work!

main2.line: Knock... Another knock... Is that the sound of someone practicing kagura? I'm going to go and have a look, Commander!

main3.line: ...Ahh! Man, I love diving! Oh, you've been looking for me for a long time? Uh... Ahaha... Oopsie. I forgot the time.

main4.line: If you're asking what the sublimest place I've seen under the water is... Hmph. That's obviously a secret. If you want to see it, you'll have to spend more time with me and the sea.

mission.line: Look at all these unfinished missions... I think I'm going to go diving!

mission_complete.line: Were you looking for me? Heheh. I snuck through the water and got here first.

profile.line: I'm I-404, Sakuran large submarine aircraft carrier; the biggest, sublimest submarine in the world; the boat that fights alongside a seadrake. I'm also the strongest precisely because I was never completed. Heheh – got anything to say about that?

propose.line: Heheh. You still don't get it, huh? You are mine even without this ring. Still, this is a great opportunity for you to finally realize it – that my essence is cut into you and your whole body.

skill.line: May your body be pierced into a bottomless abyss!

touch.line: Swim or dance? I can do both! But whichever it's going to be, we better start now!

touch2.line: Heehee. I know exactly what you want. Alright, if you want to make me yours, you've got to do it with your own two hands♪

unlock.line: I'm I-404, Sakura Empire submarine. I crossed depth after depth to answer your call, and now I'm here. Hmph! I demand cheers! Feast your eyes on my glorious wave-spanning might!

upgrade.line: Oho... You're saying I can still get stronger and sublimer?

win_mvp.line: With sublimity, my enemy was vanquished. Kotama also had fun.

gift_prefer.line: Ahaha. Pretty sublime. This is exactly what I wanted! Thanks♪

detail_ex.line: An underwater stage with dancing waves is the ideal place for my grand performance. Oh, and while I'm at it, how about I show you how to make some waterspouts?

feeling5_ex.line: My treasure and sublimest possession of all is... my time spent with you. Now, come on, let's dance! No need for difficult moves – just follow your heart's beat and mine, and feel the wonderfully sublime rhythm!

headtouch_ex.line: Nom... This sea urchin is so fresh and tasty! I'll feed you a bite, so come on – open your mouth♪

home_ex.line: Another sublime victory for us. You, once this is done, your spare time is going to me and the ocean.

login_ex.line: You've arrived. So, how do you want me to conquer you today?

main5_ex.line: Wow, look at all those fish swimming in circles around you. You know, I bet they're so enthusiastic about you because you're mine.

main6_ex.line: Have a look at this new dance I came up with! ...Well? So sublime you don't even have words for it, right? ...Okay, enough with the silence – say something! See? Kotama thinks it's amazing!

main7_ex.line: You look grumpy. What's the matter? Is it work? Or are you hungry? Want me to treat you to a nice sea urchin dish? A real premium, sublime one.

main8_ex.line: Heheh. I dedicate this next dance to you alone♪

touch_ex.line: Hm? We just went for a dive, and now you wanna go for another? Fine by me. I'll come along wherever you want to go.

touch2_ex.line: You've "humiliated" me time and time again, and I've actually sucked it all up... Heheh – this is starting to get dicey.

detail.line: With us working together, I'm confident we'll sublimely beat this place! I've also got this to prevent myself from screami– What?! A trap?!

feeling5.line: Do you think I'm completely at your mercy right now? Inside, my heart is screaming for me to conquer and make you mine right here, right now. Beating the haunted house – hmph, that's just a side objective now♥

headtouch.line: That's good... *slurp*... Ah! Crap! I got saliva on it!

home.line: Alright, Commander, are we resuming our haunted house adventure? Great! Now come here and untie me already.

login.line: These ropes are pretty fun. I can swing around wildly and they won't– Ack! My face nearly smacked into the floor there! Hey! Why'd you have to pull on the ropes all of a sudden?!

main1.line: This stupid gag is so annoying! Sure, there's no worry about biting my tongue, but it won't even let me speak properly!

main2.line: Using these ropes is so much easier than bending the waves! See? Just like this – I can move however I want!

main3.line: It makes no sense for a haunted house to have such a dangerous trap... By the way, since I'm managing to hang so sublimely, can't you feed me a little sea urchin to reward my efforts?

main4.line: I'm tired after all this... Before we resume our adventure... I'm just going to have a sublime little nap... Zzz...

touch.line: Commander, witness my sublime rope dance!

touch2.line: You'd rather conquer me instead of the haunted house? Hey! Stop messing around!

unlock.line: Commander! Help me out here! Can't believe I walked into a trap while trying to beat this place... Ugh! This suuucks!

detail.line: Mmf! Mmfmmf! Mmmgghh... Mmmff!

expedition.line: Mmhh! Mmffmf♪

feeling1.line: Mmf... Mmh... Mmmh... Zzz...

feeling2.line: Mmf! Mmfmmf! Mmmgghh... Mmmff!

feeling3.line: Mmgh... Mmmffmf! Mmmfff! Mmmgghh?!

feeling4.line: Mmmff... Mgh?! Mrmmff?!

feeling5.line: Mmh... *slurp*... Mmh, mgh?! Mmmfff!

headtouch.line: Mmh... *slurp*... Mmh, mgh?! Mmmfff!

home.line: Mmgh... Mmf! Mmffmh, mmghmmff!

login.line: Mmgh... Mmmffmf! Mmmfff! Mmmgghh?!

lose.line: Mmhh! Mmffmf♪

mail.line: Mmmff... Mgh?! Mrmmff?!

main1.line: Mmgh... Mmf! Mmffmh, mmghmmff!

main2.line: Mmgh... Mmmffmf! Mmmfff! Mmmgghh?!

main3.line: Mmmff... Mgh?! Mrmmff?!

main4.line: Mmf... Mmh... Mmmh... Zzz...

mission.line: Mmmff... Mgh?! Mrmmff?!

mission_complete.line: Mmhh! Mmffmf♪

propose.line: Mmmff... Mgh?! Mrmmff?!

touch.line: Mmhh! Mmffmf♪

touch2.line: Mmmff... Mgh?! Mrmmff?!

unlock.line: Mmf! Mmfmmf! Mmmgghh... Mmmff!

upgrade.line: Mmf... Mmh... Mmmh... Zzz...

win_mvp.line: Mmf... Mmh... Mmmh... Zzz...

battle.line: Anti-air combat... commencing!

couple_encourage1.line: I've brought your armaments!

detail.line: My weapon? ...Hyah! Eh? I look really cool? D-don't say that, I barely know how to use it...

expedition.line: The commission team has returned safely. Let's go greet them. Having that said, I'm used to being in their position though, not the other way around~

feeling1.line: I can bring you all the supplies in the world, but you don't seem to be capable of using them well...

feeling2.line: My rigging is a bit different from that of the other girls. Want to learn more...? Mm, why don't you come take a seat on my deck then?

feeling3.line: I often play with the little destroyers. Like this... I put one on each shoulder and pretend like I'm some giant monster or robot... Yes, it's quite fun~♪

feeling4.line: Commander, if you're tired, why not take a bath? Afterwards, if you enjoy some fresh milk, you'll be sure to feel— C-Commander?? What's wrong? Should I take you to the infirmary...?

feeling5.line: Phew... Ah, Commander, are you feeling better now? I've brought iced milk, sweets, and everyone's well-wishes. Ehehe~ If you'd like me to wash your back again, just let me know.

headtouch.line: Oh...! S-sorry, did I hit you with my tail...?

home.line: Phew... Oh, Commander, welcome back. I just finished stashing the supplies that the others brought back into the warehouse. The inventory? Um... please give me a moment.

hp_warning.line: It's just a scratch... Don't worry, I can keep going!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Is there anything I can transport... Err, I mean, is there anything I can help you with...?

lose.line: Ugh... It's hard for me to keep up with the actual warships...

mail.line: There's a letter on this pile of supplies...? Oh, it's addressed to you, Commander. Here you go.

main1.line: 1, 2, 3... Commander, the supplies you've given me to transport are all accounted for. Hm? It's all right, you don't have to get everyone to help me carry it. It's not very heavy...

main2.line: ♪~ Commander, I brought you your tea. Adding a bit of milk will give it a Royal Navy flair... how about it?

main3.line: Commander, how about decorating your window with a windchime? Enjoying a refreshing breeze while enjoying this delicate sound will surely make you feel better~

mission.line: Do you still have missions to complete? Please be mindful of the deadlines.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete~ That's one fewer thing to worry about.

profile.line: My name is Kashino. My favorite hobby is relaxing in the hot springs, and my weight and height are... Ack, that's not what I'm supposed to be saying! Excuse me... Um, I was the ship that was created to transport the Yamato-class's 40cm Type 94 gun, but I also participated in various transport missions before finally being sunk by a submarine... Hmm, is that good enough...?

propose.line: As a munition ship, I may not be very useful in combat. However, as long as you believe in me and cherish me... I'll try to be as useful as I can in other ways...! Mhm!

touch.line: Am I carrying main guns again? ...Ah, sorry, I spaced out a bit...

touch2.line: Eek?! Commander?!

unlock.line: Well met, Commander. I am Kashino, munition ship of the Sakura Empire. Hmm... I may be a rather peculiar ship, but... if there's anything I can help with, please entrust it to me... is that acceptable?

upgrade.line: Hmm... Was I supposed to feel different...?

win_mvp.line: This sense of elation is rather mysterious... Mm...

gift_prefer.line: This is... for me? Thank you very much!

detail_ex.line: ♪～Commander, do you like Western-style Sakura confections? I'll currently deciding on what to pack you for lunch, ehehe~

expedition_ex.line: I'll help bring back the supplies from the commission fleet! Commander, please look after our hardworking girls!

feeling5_ex.line: Ahh~ That feels so good... Commander, thank you so much. I really appreciate the massage... Now, it's my turn to do all sorts of things for you, right? Ehehe~♪

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Is there something I can help you with today?

main1_ex.line: You want to take me to the hot springs on our next day off? Really?! I'm so happy to hear that!

main2_ex.line: Milky Manjuu...? Are you talking about that drink that used to be popular? I can make it if you'd like.

main3_ex.line: ...Mm... Nnh... S-sorry, this sometimes happen when I listen to the windchimes... Zzz...

touch2_ex.line: Oh my... C-Commander...

win_mvp_ex.line: The munitions I brought paid off~♪

detail.line: If there's anything lacking about these hot springs, it's the fact that this place is too small... If you're not careful, it's easy to slip or to bump into various things...

home.line: I've kept the fresh milk in the fridge back there. After you've finished bathing, please feel free to help yourself~

login.line: Commander, are you enjoying the water? Yes, I love the hot springs here~

lose.line: Oww... My luck isn't so good today...

mail.line: By the way, Commander, there was a letter for you... Sorry, I forgot to report it earlier...

main1.line: Phew... That feels so good... My shoulders aren't stiff anymore~ Commander, thank you for telling me about this place~

main2.line: M-my swimsuit, um... Commander's going to see... Erm, please disregard that!

main3.line: A nice bottle of milk after a refreshing soak really hits the spot~ Let's get another bottle later~♪ ...Um, I knocked the first one over when I slipped earlier...

touch.line: Shall I... wash your back for you?

touch2.line: Th-they're pretty heavy, right...?

unlock.line: Ack... Owww... My apologies, Commander, I seem to have slipped on something... At times, it's hard to notice things I'm about to step on... Ugh...

battle.line: Want to see how a maid fights? Get ready!

detail.line: Being a maid is a lot harder than I thought... I can do physical labor and simple chores just fine, but deep cleaning never goes well.

expedition.line: The commission team is back! Uh, umm... I can't exactly greet them like this, can I...?

headtouch.line: Oh, I... c-can't get out this way, either...

home.line: Nnngh! Haah, haah... I just can't get out. They said this store was built well, but this isn't especially reassuring, is it...?

login.line: Commander, if there's anything I can help you with—Oh. Erm, maybe I'm the one who needs help...

lose.line: Honestly, this outfit is more suited to service than combat...

mail.line: Hnnngh... Mail's here! I had to struggle to pick that one up!
