main1.line: How did this happen, you say? Well, um... I'm not too sure, myself. You say this doesn't normally happen? Ooh...

main2.line: The ingredients are on the shelves, and the snacks are in the fridge. There's cold milk in there, too, so feel free to help yourself.

main3.line: Honestly, it's really hard to maintain this posture. Umm, b-because they're really heavy... *blush*

mission.line: W-we've been issued a new mission! Commander, let us check at once!

touch.line: Commander?! P-please don't pull on the door right now, or... Hyah?!

touch2.line: Ah, watch your step... (BANG!) Hyah?! C-Commander?!

unlock.line: Hyah?! U-Umm, I can't get out... Oh, Commander?! I'm sorry! I tripped while I was cleaning, and I ended up stuck in here! Umm... What do I do now...

win_mvp.line: Phew... I'm glad I took extra-special care to avoid messing anything up.

detail.line: I'm glad you know so much about instruments, Commander~ I didn't know the correct playing posture, so I could never play just right... Y-you say it's not a posture problem?

expedition.line: It looks like the commission team has returned. Umm... May I call them over for a rehearsal...?

headtouch.line: Ah... *blushes*

home.line: ♪~ Sit the body in my lap, hold the neck with my left hand, the bachi in my right... Hm? Commander? Is something about me bothering you?

login.line: ♪~ How did you like my performance, Commander? Hehehe, I somehow feel like I'm both making progress and hitting a plateau... What exactly am I doing wrong?

lose.line: Hwah?! I-I accidentally stepped on my kimono...

mail.line: There's a letter among the gifts...? Oh, it's addressed to you, Commander.

main1.line: *inhale*... *exhale*... Don't think too much, just do as you practiced... You'll do just fine, Kashino...!

main2.line: By the way, I call this set the geisha party! Hehehe, I put more effort into the name since I was going to invite you♪

main3.line: You say it's a little hot...? I-I didn't turn up the heat... Maybe it's just because of the lighting and atmosphere...?

touch.line: You'll show me how to do it right? Thank you, Commander...

touch2.line: F-forgive me... *blushes*

unlock.line: ♪~ Commander, how'd that sound? Hmm... I just started learning last minute, so I guess things aren't coming together after all... But, why do I sound off-pitch even though I'm playing everything exactly the way I was taught...?

win_mvp.line: Commander, wasn't that perfect?! ...O-only my fighting was?

battle.line: Th-this feels so inappropriate!

detail.line: There are lots of stalls here, so I'll probably fill up pretty quickly if I try the food at just a few... Just exercise and it'll be fine? Well, I suppose so...

expedition.line: The commission team is back! Oh gosh... I can't face them dressed like this...

feeling5.line: Have fun at the amusement park with everyone else? No, no, I promise I'm already having a lot of fun, entertaining you and the other guests! Also, since I'm dressed like this... at least wait until we're alone, okay?

headtouch.line: Whew... That helped me calm down a little.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Can I interest you in some milk? It was squeezed and bottled just this morning.

login.line: W-would you like a bottle of milk? Thanks for your patronage! Oh, don't worry about paying – this one's free, as thanks for all you do, Commander.

mail.line: A new letter? *sigh*... I can't be expected to transport things while dressed like this...

main1.line: Commander, what would you like to drink after a tour around the park? ...Hm? Anything served by me will be fine? O-oh gosh...

main2.line: Th-thanks for your order! That's one cold milk, one gomme syrup, and a sprinkle of my love... Wait, what?!

main3.line: *pant*... *pant*... Standing like this all day is actually pretty hard... No, not because I'm embarrassed or because it's hot, but because the sign is pretty heavy, and so are my... N-never mind, forget it!

mission.line: Umm, Commander... You have unfinished missions.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. As for the rewards... I-I think I'll wait here while you do it...

touch.line: C-can I take your order?

touch2.line: Wh-what should I do?

unlock.line: W-welcome... A bottle of milk is just as good after swimming in the pool as it is after bathing in a hot spring... Umm, should I really be wearing this? You seem to be blushing, Commander...

win_mvp.line: How about another bottle to celebrate this victory? Although, it's milk and not champagne, so...

detail.line: Fubuki seems to have drawn "Misfortune" at the fortune-telling shrine, but she doesn't really seem to mind... Me? "Small blessing." I'm glad.

feeling5.line: What I'd like to do this year? I'd like to continue being with you as well as my friends... That doesn't count? Um... in that case, I'd like to watch the petals with you during the spring? Is that better?

home.line: During New Year's, there are many interesting-looking events. Ayanami would like to try going to some...

login.line: During holidays, everyone always has lots of fun. Of course, Ayanami is also having lots of fun...

main1.line: New Year's outfits... are very pretty, but they're hard to move around in... Ayanami still isn't used to it yet...

main2.line: Snowflakes are very beautiful, but, they melt as soon as they land in your palm.

main3.line: This year as well... I hope to stay together with everyone, and Commander as well.

main4.line: New Year's isn't complete... without ozoni. It's piping hot. Please have some if you'd like.

touch.line: Ayanami... isn't cold.

touch2.line: Please do not mess up my clothes... Otherwise, Ayanami would not know how to fix them...

unlock.line: Commander, Happy New Year's. In this coming year, please continue to look after me...

battle.line: Let us go with grace and elegance.

detail.line: Commander, you'd like to dance with Ayanami next? I'm not very good at dancing though... I'll try not to step on your feet, I guess...

login.line: "It is unbefitting to keep a lady waiting." —That was just a joke. Commander, welcome back.

lose.line: I can't... let it end like this...!

main1.line: Z23 seems to be fitting in just fine, but... I'm still a bit nervous. Commander, don't leave me alone.

main2.line: To get rid of my nerves... maybe I should try releasing the †Force† like that one person taught me... Is that a bad idea?

main3.line: Listening to the piano makes me a bit sleepy... Commander, you're not getting sleepy?

touch.line: ...Ah! Ayanami... is awake now...

touch2.line: Commander... you're acting a bit weird...

unlock.line: Commander, thank you for coming to the party. Ayanami... has been waiting for you. ...I look a bit scary? I'm not sure I get it... I guess.

win_mvp.line: "I'll become the life of the party!" ...I'm sure Fubuki would say something like that.

detail.line: I've inspected the voicechat equipment. It won't cause any more problems...

home.line: Well done on that battle. Ayanami has a "battle" to return to as well.

login.line: Do you want to play co-op, Commander? Okay. First, you must take this controller.

main1.line: If Ayanami dies... the fate of the villagers falls upon... the ghost gamer...

main2.line: I have a feeling Little Bel is the best gamer among the Royal Maids...

main3.line: Could you turn up the AC, please? If the room stays this hot, Ayanami will evaporate...

main4.line: Oh no! Commander, it's a trap! Good thing we managed to avoid it.

touch.line: Is this gamer fuel for me? Thank you.

unlock.line: No, Ryuujou! Samurai builds should stay back during the boss! ...Oh, welcome, Commander. I'm busy with this game right now, so just make yourself at home or something.

win_mvp.line: V for victory. From Ayanami.

battle.line: Kurogane Greatsword: Hullbreaker-Style!

detail.line: Using qing-gong to fly into the air, or firing huge sword beams... I don't know about other people, but Ayanami can't do stuff like that...

expedition.line: Commission complete. It's time to repair and resupply up.

lose.line: This doesn't seem to work in IRL battles...

mail.line: A messenger pigeon... isn't coming. It's just normal mail for you, Commander.

main1.line: Just changing into this outfit makes me feel like I'm much stronger at melee combat. It's just a feeling though, yes...

main2.line: Ayanami's stats are well-rounded. Javelin put all her points into external kung-fu, and Z23 put all hers into internal kung-fu. Those are crappy builds.

main3.line: Akatsuki seems to be observing me with great interest... I think I should explain things to her before there's some weird misunderstanding...

mission.line: Commander, there's a new mission. ...I don't mean inside the game.

mission_complete.line: Your rewards are here, yes. Don't forget to check them.

touch.line: If this was the real deal, all the nearby flora would have turned into sharp blades... But since this is just Ayanami's rigging, that's not happening, I guess.

touch2.line: This is a "breach of etiquette," I guess?

unlock.line: I have equipped a full set of Dragon Empery Wuxia gear, yes. It may not look as cool as the in-game version, but this pleases the Ayanami. Heh.

win_mvp.line: The lonesome and tragic Ayanami continues her journey, unable to find a single worthy foe.

detail.line: Ayanami messed up the order once... I thought Zed would chew me out, but she ended up encouraging me instead...

expedition.line: A new shipment of food has arrived. Ayanami will go help out.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Here's your large cola, ice-cold. Please enjoy, yes.

login.line: Come on in, Commander. We're having a special discount campaign today, so... take your pick.

mail.line: There's a delivery order... When I come back, I'd like to bring a portion for Javelin too.

main1.line: If you're not sure what to order, Laffey's favorite Teriyaki Twisters, Zed's recommended french fries, and cola make a great combo.

main2.line: I like my cola ice-cold. How about you, Commander?

main3.line: Hm... Does this combo go better with ketchup or barbecue sauce... Do you know, Laffey?

mission.line: Commander, if you're tired from your mission, how about enjoying some cola? Ayanami will treat you.

mission_complete.line: I see, you're all done with your work... Ayanami has to work hard too, yes.

touch.line: Commander, care for another cup of cola?

touch2.line: Ayanami... is still working...

unlock.line: Welcome. Ayanami will be taking your order, yes. Will this be dine-in, or to-go? I would personally recommend the cola.

battle.line: When it comes to multi-hit combos, Ayanami has the upper hand, yes!

detail.line: I've seen through this dungeon's layout, yes. I've honed my senses by training with the legendary L.I., so you can count on me.

expedition.line: ...Oh. The commission team's back. I'm sure it'll be a Great Success.

home.line: Welcome back, yes. First, we must cleanse Laffey's debuffs. Oh, she's just sleeping...?

login.line: Ultimate Ability: Dynamic Kick! ...Oh, good morning, Commander. I was just practicing my ultimate ability... Thankfully it didn't hit you, yes.

mail.line: A message from Akashi? Probably should take it with a grain of salt, yes.

main1.line: Sorry about the dungeon repair costs... There goes all of Zed's equipment funds... *sigh*...

main2.line: By the way, Commander, what kind of role do you want to play? It'd be nice if you could play some sort of healer to support us.

main3.line: Look at that...! It's a Meowfficer dressed up as a monster! Can you get EXP from defeating it?

mission.line: This quest looks pretty tough, yes. But if we all do our best, I'm sure we'll be able to clear it!

mission_complete.line: The bonus rewards are in. We should set it aside for Zed's gear.

touch.line: Commander, can you help me practice my ultimate ability?

touch2.line: Commander... *blushes*

unlock.line: Ultimate Ability: Dynamic Kick! ...Oh, I used my skill on the wrong target. Sorry, can we try that again?

win_mvp.line: Your own body is the mightiest weapon. Javelin has yet to learn this, heh.

battle.line: My rigging... is ready!

detail.line: Commander, would you like to dance? ...Mm, I'll be fine, as long as I follow the beat like a rhythm game. I can handle this, yes!

expedition.line: Looks like the commission's done, yes. Shall we head out together?

home.line: Kyaa~ Ayanami is falling in love all over again... Huh? That kind of line doesn't suit me at all...?

login.line: Phew... I'll be meeting up with the girls later, yes. Are you also heading back to the venue, Commander?

lose.line: Understood. Retreating immediately!

mail.line: The mail's here. I wonder who put it here?

main1.line: If anything happens, I will protect you with my bare hands. I have a lot of experience playing fighter classes in games.

main2.line: Did Laffey already go to sleep? Speaking of which, I'm starting to feel drowsy as well... I wanna go back to my room and roll around in bed.

main3.line: It's good to get my homework done? Oh, this isn't my homework. Umm, it's not like you can get any paperwork done during a party either.

mission.line: There's still work left to do. Commander, let's hop to it after the party's over.

mission_complete.line: Huh? Mission rewards are here? Commander, did you finish work while chatting with me...?

touch.line: Commander? What's the matter?

touch2.line: You're also into that... I guess?

unlock.line: *fidget, fidget*... Oh, how's the party? Yes, I get a little angsty when I'm without a weapon... I envy your ability to stay calm no matter what.

win_mvp.line: Please praise me more for this splendid victory, yes...

detail.line: You feel embarrassed? That's okay... I've embarrassed myself in front of you countless times... No, it's nothing.

expedition.line: Our commission team is back. Er... Should we get out already?

feeling5.line: I think you're right – I have gotten more expressive these days. I can even say that I love you with ease... But even in this state of undress, I feel awfully hot. Maybe I've been in the bath too long...

home.line: Phew. The wind is blowing hard, but I don't feel chilly at all. I guess I won't have to worry about you catching a cold here, heheh.

login.line: Commander, there's no need to force yourself. Staying in a hot bath for too long can be bad for you. Me? No, I'm fine... Probably...

mail.line: Your letters... Ah, be careful not to get them wet.

main1.line: If you want your towel back, then tell me you love me ten times! ...Sakawa would say something like that. She's a little bit of a tease.

main2.line: It's not that I'm being straightforward because we're alone – I just think it's hard to cover up my feelings when I'm so physically exposed. Gotta let it all hang out in the bath... right?

main3.line: If you like hot spring baths, then how about we go on a hot spring tour some time? The Sakura Empire would be good for it... I think visiting all of the world's famous hot springs would also make for a great vacation.

mission.line: Do you have missions to do? Go take care of them. I'll wait for you here.

mission_complete.line: Mission completed. Don't you think it's weird that I'm the one telling you this?

touch.line: That's enough mischief from you. Heheh.

touch2.line: You want me to take my towel off too so that we're even? G-goodness...

unlock.line: Basking in the summer night's air and chatting with someone I love, all under the moonlight... Now this is a nice bath. By the way... did you know you dropped your towel?

win_mvp.line: We'll wash away our fatigue in the hot spring later. We're almost done here.

battle.line: Ride the wind and break the waves! Feuer!

couple_encourage1.line: Your smile is so fake.

couple_encourage2.line: Ha, follow me, you monkeys!

detail.line: Fast and strong, that's me!

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Straighten up, you have to greet the hardworking girls with your best smile.

feeling1.line: How disappointing, Commander. You’re no fun at all.

feeling2.line: What’s up, Commander? Are you enjoying your everyday life with me? I sure am.

feeling3.line: Life is short, Commander, and I want to live life on the edge. If you are going to be my partner, you have to keep up. Now, let’s see that smile!

feeling4.line: Even if the world was coming to an end, I have nothing to fear. As long as you are at my side, I can continue to laugh.

feeling5.line: Now that I think about it, the apocalypse is often associated with wild romances, or couples who cling to each other until the bitter end. Commander, why don’t we become as Adam and Eve?

home.line: Nice expression you've got there. Wasn't that battle simply exhilarating?

hp_warning.line: What are you all afraid of?

login.line: Come, let us brawl!

lose.line: Not bad, fellas...

mail.line: Hey, you have new mail. Don’t drop it!

main1.line: Let's see who can do this paperwork faster~!

main2.line: My full name is Leberecht Maass, but you can call me Z1.

main3.line: Do your best, Commander. I'll always be by your side~!

mission.line: We have a new mission. How about we take it on together?

mission_complete.line: Our teamwork is unbeatable! Let’s go check out those mission rewards.

profile.line: I’m not like the other so-called "big sisters." I am Z1, the eldest of all Iron Blood destroyers, and bear countless resposibilities upon my shoulders. Rest assured, Commander, because the invincible Z1 is at your side.

propose.line: Once you are with someone, you can no longer only think to take care of yourself. Though I can no longer cry or laugh to my heart’s desire, I do not regret becoming yours at all, Commander.

touch.line: Don’t be so wishy-washy if you’re greeting someone.

touch2.line: You want some "hard love," is that it?

unlock.line: Rejoice, Commander! Allow me, Z1, to handle all your problems from now on!

upgrade.line: Hah, this feels pretty good!

win_mvp.line: Hah hah hah! The great Z1 is unrivaled!

gift_prefer.line: Vielen Dank. This is just what I wanted.

detail.line: Bringing weapons to school is merely for self-defense purposes. There are always some bold fool who wishes to taunt Z1-sama!

main1.line: The homework was finished in a flash, hehe, naturally for my Z1-sama!

main2.line: I did not break classroom rules! It’s just that the teacher is too boring, I recommend to everyone that I should teach the class, then...

main3.line: Hehehe, stuff written on books may not always be correct!

touch.line: Naturally, only the Commander can be called my most desirable partner!

touch2.line: People say when your head is pointed by a gun, your brain starts spinning. Commander, care to have a try?

unlock.line: Because she’s the Z1, her results will of course be NO.1! Hehe, no matter where she goes, Z1-sama will always be the best!

detail.line: Heheh~ The mighty Z1 can get even stronger and faster!

login.line: You're finally here! Come on, I want to start brawling already!

main1.line: Even my work productivity has doubled! Commander, can you even keep up with me~?

main2.line: Viersechs, if you want a name, let me choose a great one for you: "Iron Blood Warrior Princess, Ritter der Walküre!" ...H-huh? You don't like it?!

main3.line: Commander, do you feel like you can't get anything done without me? Ahahaha~!

touch.line: Commander, I can't have you being this listless! Allow the great Z1 to pump you up!

unlock.line: Hmm... So this is a retrofit, huh? Not bad! Rejoice once more, Commander, for no task or enemy is too daunting for the new and improved Z1!

battle.line: Be wary of ambushes and try not to overextend yourselves.

couple_encourage1.line: Please don't take it too far, Lebe. The cleanup would be annoying.

couple_encourage2.line: Ride the waves and sail the... Never mind I said anything.

detail.line: Commander, I have a question, do you have a thing for making others dress up in fancy clothes?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Naturally, we should greet and praise them for their hard work. I can accompany you, if need be.

feeling1.line: I don't mind being near you, but I'm afraid that Lebe does.

feeling2.line: Is there anything you wish to know about Lebe, Commander? Oh, you're more interested in me? You're quite the curious one. Please give me a minute to think.

feeling3.line: You want to make small talk again? Why? You should know that the only answers I ever offer are nods and affirmations. Could it be that you actually like canned responses like that?

feeling4.line: You are a commander with many strange ideas, but that may just be the perfect fit for a person with Lebe for an arm like me.

feeling5.line: Commander, if you wish to take our relationship to the next level, simply keep being yourself; say what you want to, and do what you want to. That is all I need from you.

home.line: I've put together an after-action report, as you ordered. Please have a look.

hp_warning.line: My magazine is flooding... which is quite bad.

login.line: Commander, I have a question: why do you always arrive later than me?

lose.line: I'll cover everyone. I'm quite good at these things, owing to Lebe's help. You may rest easy.

mail.line: You have mail. I propose that you open and read it as soon as possible. You are prone to forgetting about it, otherwise.

main1.line: Commander, please try not to be as reckless as Lebe. It would be annoying to have to knock you out, and I don't particularly like getting physical with a superior officer.

main2.line: I'll bring you a fresh batch of paperwork if you have nothing better to do. I hope you're ready.

main3.line: This little one is Lebe. Yes, you heard that correctly; this is Lebe. Isn't she cute?

mission.line: We've received new missions. I organized them to give you a solid overview. You're welcome.

mission_complete.line: I'll obey if you order me to claim the mission rewards, but my opinion of you will worsen. Is that an acceptable tradeoff to you?

profile.line: I am Georg Thiele, otherwise known as Z2, a Type 1934 destroyer built as an experiment. I was to make quick work of adversaries using my excellent mobility, or at least that was the plan... I'd rather not elaborate. Please forget I said that.

propose.line: So this is marriage. I never thought I'd form an unbreakable bond with someone... What was that? I'm blushing? Umm... could you please take a photo of me right now? I've never seen myself red in the face before.

skill.line: I can still go faster. Just a bit more.

touch.line: Oh, absolutely, I agree wholeheartedly. Now, what's our next task?

touch2.line: Among all actions that take bravery, this would, in my honest opinion, be the worst kind.

unlock.line: I am Z2, Georg Thiele, awaiting your orders. However, if your orders are flawed, please allow me to reconsider them. May our relationship be productive.

upgrade.line: Won't I develop some sort of flaw if I get even stronger?

win_mvp.line: There are countless examples of seizing defeat from the jaws of victory. Let us not underestimate our foes.

gift_prefer.line: A gift? I don't remember doing anything to warrant that from you, Commander...

detail.line: You'd like to know how I spend my free time? Your inquisitiveness truly boggles the mind, Commander.

feeling5.line: Are you having trouble breaking the ice, Commander? Then allow me to ask the question on your mind. Would you like to go somewhere with me?

home.line: Welcome back. Please forgive me for greeting you with such an inhospitable look. It is not acceptable behavior on my part. Wait just a moment, please. I will massage my face into a better expression.

main1.line: Hm? Are you staring at me in hopes of making me initiate conversation? Apologies, but I'm afraid that won't happen.

main2.line: Do I have any other expressions? A better question is: do you deserve a different expression? ...I'm joking, of course. I'm just too lazy to make any other face. That is all.

main3.line: Take this opportunity to go outside and take a breather, Commander. I mean, you won't be completing all this work any time soon anyway.

touch.line: A stroll through the city? I fear we'd be mistaken for a couple, so I must kindly decline.

touch2.line: Allow me to reiterate: Lebe does bite if provoked.

unlock.line: Commander, I do wonder if your order to "come dressed in new clothes" was simply your way of saying "I want to see you in a casual outfit." No matter the case, I'm happy to oblige.

detail.line: When we're together like this... Yes, it does undeniably look like a "date."

home.line: Good work on your sortie. Would you like to recharge with some sweets? For the time being, I set these aside for your enjoyment.

login.line: Commander, keeping young maidens waiting isn't something you should be proud of.

main1.line: Lebe, I know festivals are fun, but I think you're having a bit too much fun...

main2.line: "A carp becoming a dragon?" ...Lebe, do you want me to teach you what that means?

main3.line: Festivals, delicious food, and wondrous scenery... Yes, I finally understand the miraculous "summer" that my Sakura Empire friends spoke of.

touch.line: If you wanted to talk to me, wouldn't it be better if you at least had a topic in mind? Heh.

touch2.line: Commander, I'm not going to accept an excuse as flimsy as "I needed to fix your clothes."

unlock.line: Being able to see you all flabbergasted makes changing into this outfit worth it. Are you going to keep standing there like a scarecrow? Come over here~ Who knows, we might even be able to see the fireworks from this spot.

battle.line: Prepare to launch! I think nothing will go wrong...

couple_encourage1.line: You're so cool! I wish I could be like you... *sob*...

couple_encourage2.line: Fei Yuen... You're so good at art...

couple_encourage3.line: We're going to win... together!

detail.line: C-Commander, of course... *sniffle*... You found me again. I'm okay, just let me be alone for now... Ahh, actually, stay with meee...

expedition.line: The commission team came back to us. I'll go inventory the supplies!

feeling1.line: Say... Commander, if you're in a bad mood, I could lend you my coat. Hide in there, and nobody will find you...

feeling2.line: Commander, I'm sorry. I messed up again...! Basically, I tripped up and made a mess of your documents. I'll organize them right away... *sniffle*... Huh? You want to treat my bruises first? Thank you...!

feeling3.line: In this book, the prince and princess get separated... I'd draw a much better ending for them. Do you have any ideas? Umm... Maybe we could draw it together?

feeling4.line: A-am I doing a good job? Really?! Okay... Umm, may I have a hug, then? A reward for my good work. Oh... *sniffle*... It's so very warm in your arms.

feeling5.line: I used to be so worried that I'd never do anything right. But you accept me, praise me, and never abandon me... *sniffle*... I'm going to do my best and get better at my job... as long as you let me stay by your side forever!

headtouch.line: Pet me more, Commander.

home.line: Good work, Commander. Umm... I can go on missions, too, you know. I-I'll prepare well so I'm not a bother!

hp_warning.line: Urk... I'll be left behind at this rate...

login.line: Commander... *sniffle* W-welcome back... I thought I'd done something wrong and made you leave forever. Ooh... I'm sorry, it's hard to stop crying once I've started...

lose.line: Aww... I'll try harder next time, I promise. Don't leave me behind...

mail.line: I brought your mail. I even sorted it...

main1.line: I-I did the paperwork, but I'd like to look over it again... Show it to you first? Okay... It's perfect?! Oh, thank goodness!

main2.line: Commander, umm, look at this birdie and rose living happily ever after that I drew... The ending of this book I'm reading was so sad that I wanted to redraw it... Hmm? The bird is right here. Does it not look like one...?

main3.line: Commander, umm... May I sit here? No real reason, I just wanted to be near you...

mission.line: Commander, your missions aren't done yet. I can help... No, I'm not tired. As long as I can be with you, I'll never tire.

mission_complete.line: Missions are done... Say, umm, now that you have time, what if we read a book together?

profile.line: I'm the Iron Blood's Type 1934A destroyer, Z9, Wolfgang Zenker... I promise I'll fight and work better than I did before, so don't abandon me...

propose.line: Commander? If you're giving me this, that must mean... you'll never leave me, doesn't it? You also want to see me smile more...? *sob*... Ahh, umm, oh no... I need to hold back these tears!

skill.line: I'll do this, and I'll do it right!

touch.line: Commander, where are you going? Oh... Just getting water? Okay, I-I'll come with you!

touch2.line: Eep?! U-umm... I-is that an order?

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander. I'm Z9, a destroyer from the Iron Blood, also known as Wolfgang Zenker... I'll do anything I can to help you. Please, just don't abandon me... *sniffle*

upgrade.line: Keep getting better. Never let the Commander down!

win_mvp.line: Phew... I won. Commander, did I help out? H-hehe...

gift_prefer.line: Ehehe... Thank you, Commander. I really love this...

detail_ex.line: *sniffle*... I should've done better, Commander, I'm sorry... May I still hug you despite my failure? Oh, thank you...

feeling5_ex.line: You think I cry less often now...? Y-you're right! I think your help has done wonders for me, and besides... Just as you encourage me with your warm hugs, I want to be able to encourage you with my smile...! Hehe...

headtouch_ex.line: Hehe... I love you, Commander...

home_ex.line: Zzz... Huh? C-Commander, welcome back! I'm sorry... I fell asleep in your chair. Umm... Your scent just relaxes me so.

login_ex.line: I did some of your work before you got here... Oh? Nothing looks wrong? Hehe, I'm glad to have helped♪

lose_ex.line: *sob*... It hurts. I want to go back to the Commander...

main4_ex.line: I drew us together... H-here you go. This one's me, see? No, it's not a puppy!

main5_ex.line: The coffee tastes salty...? Did I mix up salt and sugar again... Urk, I was so busy thinking about you that I didn't even notice.

main6_ex.line: Huh? It won't affect your work if I sit in your lap? I-in that case... I-I'd be happy to...!

touch_ex.line: May my hugs soothe you as well as yours do me!

touch2_ex.line: U-umm... If that's what you'd like, Commander, ahh...

win_mvp_ex.line: We won! I'll try to do even better next time...!

detail.line: You think it's weird for me to dress like this, too, don't you? *sniffle*... J-just don't leave me... Ohh, what do I do? I wanna hide in my coat...

expedition.line: Drink supplies just came. I'll bring you the new flavor right away!

feeling5.line: Try this one, too, Commander... I left it for last because it's not one of our big sellers, but... I-I wanted to share my favorite one with you. It's sweeter and tastier when I drink it with you... Hehe.

headtouch.line: Okay... I'll do my very best!

home.line: Commander, thank you for your hard work! Are you thirsty? D-does it make you want to order a drink?

login.line: How about a drink before you start work? I-I'll go get... Aaah! I almost fell over... *sniffle*...

mail.line: Mail for you... I-it's okay! I promise it's not wet!

main1.line: Huh? I did a good job? Thank you... *sniffle*... I'm so happy to have your approval...

main2.line: It's weird... I usually feel relaxed around you, but lately, I'm so nervous... Is it because of this outfit? *sniffle*...

main3.line: If you want to try our new drink, I'll prepare it right away... Oh, I don't mean the stuff in this glass! I-I'll just go get some fresh stuff...

touch.line: You don't mind that I'm a little sticky...?

touch2.line: Ah?! I-is this because I'm a little different today...?

unlock.line: Commander, umm... Would you like to try our new drink? It's very sweet and tasty... Ahh, why am I so nervous? I need to do better...

battle.line: Huh? ...What? Me?

couple_encourage1.line: I-I said leave it to me!

couple_encourage2.line: What's a demon king? ...My role?

couple_encourage3.line: Z23, help... I wanna go home...

detail.line: Bleugh... The sun is a deadly laser... If it melts me like chocolate, I won't be able to help the Commander anymore...

expedition.line: They're back from their commission...? Oof, being outside all day must be rough...

feeling1.line: I think I'm just gonna head out... Hahaha...

feeling2.line: I-I-I'm not nervous! See how I'm smiling like I rehearsed a thousand times... Wait, d-don't stare...

feeling3.line: Finally... I can breathe easy next to the Commander...

feeling4.line: If I suddenly faint, I want you to catch me... I'd be so embarrassed that I might die, yes, but if I'm gonna die, I'd like it to be in your arms... No, I didn't mean it like that!

feeling5.line: I thought I wouldn't have to be nervous with you anymore. But my heart is beating so fast, and I'm so short of breath... Why? Commander, do you know why?

headtouch.line: Heeeek?! I-I'll do my job, really...

home.line: M-Mandy, welcome home~... I-I'm doing my job, I swear! It's just taking a while.

hp_warning.line: W-wait, am I anemic?

login.line: Morning, Mandy! Ready already~? I-i-i-if we're working... I've steeled my heart!

lose.line: Ahh... This is why I never want to go out...

mail.line: I organized your mail... I-I'm doing a great job, aren't I?!

main1.line: Commander... C-can I go home now? I'm sorry... I said I wanted to help, but I really just wanna go home...

main2.line: Do you like my outfit? Special, isn't it? ...D-do you have to think about it for that long?

main3.line: I wish I could just play games all day forever. You must agree, right? Then we could stay up all night together, and... Ack! I'm sorry! There I go fantasizing again...

mission.line: Mandy, do your missions, or else... O-or else nothing, I guess...

mission_complete.line: Y-you finished your missions? Did I help...?

profile.line: I'm Z11, Bernd von Arnim of the Iron Blood... M-make me your secretary, Mandy! I can game with you and clean your office! I-I'm not just asking because I hate going outside, or anything!

propose.line: I-I know this is just a prank... I see it all the time. Things would never go the way I dream they would that easi–y-you're serious?! Ah, aaah... I think I'm having a heart attack... I'm so happy I might die!

touch.line: Hyaaaah?! Wh-wh-what's going on?!

touch2.line: Y-you're gonna make me melt...!

unlock.line: Hi hi♪ I'm Z11, the Iron Blood's own Bernd von Arnim! Nice to meetcha, Mandy! ...A-ahahaha... It leaves a good impression if I act really happy to see you, right?! Huh? I-it doesn't tell you anything about me? I'm sorry!

upgrade.line: I-I'm stronger now? Really...?

win_mvp.line: *pant*... I'm still alive?

gift_prefer.line: C-Commander, you even knew all that about me...?! Ahh... ahhh...*blushes*

detail_ex.line: W-work is hard, but I'll do my best to finish it! For the Commander's sake!

feeling5_ex.line: I've been thinking, and thinking, and thinking of how to get you to like me more... But I'm so stupid, I can't figure anything out! Commander, tell me how! Tell meee!

headtouch_ex.line: Urk... C-Careful, Commander. This might get addictive...

home_ex.line: Welcome back! Umm, I brought my game console... Heheh, I just wanna spend more time with you, is all...

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I'll help you work. Hehe... If I pretend it's a date, it's no big deal.

main4_ex.line: C-Commander... If you have time later, can we game together? Just a little won't interfere with your work, right...?

main5_ex.line: Would the Commander like me more if I wore cuter clothes? Hmm... What's your type, I wonder...

main6_ex.line: I-I've studied dates plenty! Take a look at this plan I stayed up all night making! If we do exactly what it says, I think it'll work out...!

mail_ex.line: MORE mail...? Y-you're so popular, Commander! No, I'm not jealous... Not jealous at all!

touch_ex.line: Eep?! I-I'm sorry, I'm still not used to this...

touch2_ex.line: I-if you're up for it...

win_mvp_ex.line: A victory for me and the Commander! Heheh, we won, right?

detail.line: I wanted to serve you and help here so I could afford a game, but... Work is hard, and I'm losing more money from breaking stuff than I am making money... Thank goodness I have you, Commander. I-I'll do everything I can to pay you back!

expedition.line: C-commissions? But I've already worked so hard today...

feeling5.line: If you like how this looks on me... I-I can wear it again for you. That isn't enough to repay your kindness, though... Ahh, what do I do...

headtouch.line: T-touch me all you want...! Consider it my thanks for your help!

home.line: Ahh... Commander, s-sit anywhere you like! I've been out of my room for so long that I'm totally unstable... I don't wanna work anymore...

login.line: C-Commandeeer! You finally came to help?! ...Huh? You paid off all the things I broke? Oh, thank you, thank you!

main1.line: I hear that game I want is a two-player game. I-if you want, maybe you and I could...?

main2.line: Part of the reason I wanted to help out was because the outfit was cute... What do you think? Does it look good on me? Ahh, I'm sorry... I guess now isn't an appropriate time...

main3.line: You paid off my debts AND bought the game for me? Ah, aaah... Commander, you're too nice to me... How can I ever repay you?

touch.line: I-I'm sorry... Let me just curl up in a ball and die...

touch2.line: Huh? Y-you like me, even when I'm like this...? Th-thank you...

unlock.line: I wanted to help at the pop-up shop so I could buy a special-edition game, but I ended up in debt somehow. Commander, help... I'll do anything...

detail.line: I-I'm not taking no for an answer! It's dangerous out there, and you'll be safer and comfier here, getting your checkup... I've got my eye on you, Mandy.

feeling5.line: My goal was to keep you from leaving this place, but... I-I want to leave with you. I'd rather have a heart than be the protagonist of any story!

headtouch.line: (Bleugh... I'm supposed to stay in character, b-but... who can blame a girl for enjoying a little fun?)

home.line: Mandy? You came... Want a checkup? O-or do you wanna rest with me? I'm game for either... U-umm, as long as it doesn't mean going outside.

login.line: O-outdoor activity time is over! Mandy, can you... be good and come with me for your routine checkup?

main1.line: I-it's time for your examination, so you'll need to take your clothes off for... Umm... I-I actually don't know how to do a medical exam, but just strip for me, okay...?

main2.line: Don't ever go to the areas marked red on the map, okay?! I-I'm not brave enough to go, myself... Let's just pretend they don't exist.

main3.line: Commander... Can we play a game together? U-umm, I'm trying to convince myself that this place is safe... because game worlds are scarier...

touch.line: S-sudden PvP?! I-I-I...

touch2.line: Mmm... I-I guess nobody says you CAN'T do this with a nurse, so... I-if you want, then I don't mind...

unlock.line: C-cut it out, Mandy! I saw you breaking into the nurse station... and trying to snatch those keys! S-stop resisting and let me examine you... H-huh? Does this mean I can touch you all I want?!

battle.line: We're going in fast! Focus on their core! Go!

couple_encourage1.line: Don't cry now! Wanna talk about it?

couple_encourage2.line: The plan is... Hey, don't go rushing in!

detail.line: Interesting. So this is what they mean by attrition warfare... Ah, it's you, Commander. I was just watching a military TV show. We consultants need to stay up to date on the latest tactics to give innovative advice, you see!

expedition.line: Commander, if you want to solve a financial difficulty, start by considering how your cash flow... Hm? A goods inspection first of all? Um, that's kind of outside the field of consultancy.

feeling1.line: *sigh*... Not even you can keep up with the groundbreaking genius of my strategic mind...

feeling2.line: Commander, make me your development advisor! We'll start by expanding into maritime tourism, leisure industries, and niche food industries. Within three years, I'll turn the port into the world's biggest corporation!

feeling3.line: See – doesn't my advice work wonders? Heheh. This is just scratching the surface, I'll have you know. Remember: You can always come to me with questions! I'll answer to the best of my knowledge and offer the best solution I can!

feeling4.line: Speaking as your personal consultant, you ought to put your work down for a moment and do some relaxing activities with me. I know you doubt me, but don't give me that look! This is for YOUR sake! Now come on, let's start with a warm hug! How about it?

feeling5.line: Commander, have you heard of the "palpitation syndrome" that's been all the buzz lately? It apparently makes you way more productive. Wanna try it? You put your hand here, like this... Did you feel my palpitations? Hm? Aww, you can be so cute! Let me guess... you feel the same excitement as I do, don't you?

headtouch.line: Nice sunglasses, aren't they? They're optimized with funnel analysis!

home.line: Here, have a taste of my specialty nerve-soothing drink! You see, milk has a calming effect, and tea relieves stress, so... "That's just milk tea"? Why, yes, it IS milk tea!

hp_warning.line: Watch out for depth charges!

login.line: I think we should remodel your office using my expertise, heehee. Based on the latest studies on residential environments, I suggest you move your desk 3.5 degrees to the southeast for improved productivity.

lose.line: Defeat? No, no, no – it's called showing them your weakness to then catch them off guard!

mail.line: I've marked your mail to denote priority and the like! There are seven types in all, and... Hm? There are so many marks that they're effectively useless? Uhh... This is actually just to practice my sorting skills!

main1.line: Are you drafting the next operation? I think we should start by researching the enemy's psychology... How do we do that, you ask? Ah, well... it's a long-term commitment...

main2.line: Hey, you, the workaholic! Eat some fruit. It's got vitamins that help soothe your nerves, and it's already washed. Come on, open wide!

main3.line: I conducted some detailed research on the market's seasonal prices and bought this fluffy accessory! I love it! You can hug it to sleep whenever you want! I recommend it if you want to do just that!

mission.line: Commander, a new mission list has arrived. Allow me, your professional consultant, to provide you with some reasonable solutions!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Exemplary work, Commander. Why don't we wind down by playing a game? ...You think I play games too much? Tsk-tsk-tsk, you're clearly not in the know. Games are an excellent way of relieving stress!

profile.line: Iron Blood destroyer Z13, cross-sector consultant, at your service. I offer professional solutions for everything you can think of, from port construction to combat deployments.

propose.line: I've been doing a lot of research into the psychology of love, and I think you made the optimum choice by going for me. How can I prove it? Well, right now, I can't! That's because all the love hormones are flooding my head with thoughts of you! Heehee♡

touch.line: Here's an easy stress relief trick you can do in your office! Start by taking six and a half deep breaths, then... What? How to take half a breath? That's the important part of this trick! Come on, do it with me!

touch2.line: Wow, don't you think this is a horrible way of relieving stress? ...I'm kidding! Go on, keep at it!

unlock.line: Heheh, I'm Erich Koellner, otherwise known as Z13. I know you like the back of my hand, Commander, and I've set up some long and short-term stretch goals for you. We'll discuss the details later when we have the time♪

upgrade.line: More or less the same as in my combat simulations. Heehee.

win_mvp.line: An effortless win! You get that and more when you leave it to me!

gift_prefer.line: I really like this! Commander, did you run a funnel analysis on me?

detail_ex.line: Oh, Commander! I'm just researching the behavioral science of love here. Heehee – it so happens I'm on the part about lust, and there's a surprising amount of depth to it. How about we both read it and see if all the theories hold up in practice? Heheh♡

expedition_ex.line: Commander, the commission fleet is back! Allow me to handle the resource management side of things.

feeling5_ex.line: Commander! I've come up with a plan to manage our relationship. Firstly, we have to share a hug every day to uphold our intimacy; secondly, we need to express our love to one another to stay holden to our commitment; thirdly, we need to engage in... activities to maintain our passion. I think you get what I'm hinting at!

headtouch_ex.line: According to theories on emotional management, patting someone's head like this makes them... Mmh... Your hand feels so nice I totally forgot what I was gonna say.

home_ex.line: Commander, I made coffee for you. Just remember that while coffee does keep you awake, you shouldn't drink too much of it. I've been studying nutritional science and I know a thing or two, so I'm gonna start making healthy, refreshing drinks for you every day!

login_ex.line: Commander, based on the latest findings in residential environment research, we should move your desk about 20 centimeters closer to your window. It'll give you just the right amount of sunlight. You just sit back and relax and I'll do it!

main4_ex.line: Commander, you need an optimal recovery position to get the most out of your rest. There's an easy one, actually – just lie down, then place your head in my lap... There we go!

main5_ex.line: You want everyone at the port to get more friendly? Okay, then you'll have to work on improving cross-field integration! There are lots of ways to do it, but in short, make them share more meals. If you'll be present, let me know when in advance and I'll come with you!

main6_ex.line: My outfit's pretty good, don't you think? It's made to strictly comply with the rule of thirds and color theory. Hm? It's "puppy-like" on the whole? Heheh, maybe you like puppies like me, then, huh?

touch_ex.line: A massage? Yeah, of course! If I give you advice, I sure as heckfire can give you a... Hm? You want to give ME a massage?

touch2_ex.line: No need to hold yourself back – you can go a little further. Through the lens of love in practice, this is a perfectly normal thing!

detail.line: That Long Island, I swear... It's like she doesn't grasp the importance of holding on to areas. I would fire a barrage of advice her way, but getting up would be such a pain... I know! I'll type out a message with my feet!

feeling5.line: Hey, Commander! Heehee – you know, we're having drinks and watching a stream – isn't this basically a date? ...What? No, 'cause we're on the clock? Well, we're on a date in secret, then! Doesn't the notion of a secret office romance make your heart race? Heheh.

headtouch.line: Wear a sleep mask and experience what it's like to have my vision blocked? Sounds interesting. Heehee!

home.line: Commander, efficiency matters even when conducting inspections. I've come up with some plans for you and divided the office into four sections and... What? You're not here to watch? So... are you here to see me, then?

login.line: Hm? You here to watch me work? I'm not slacking on the job! This is what's called a strategic break period!

main1.line: According to the latest research, wearing matching clothes – uniforms, maid outfits, et cetera – sharply increases team synergy! How about we make it a port-wide thing? You, of course, can wear whatever you want.

main2.line: Do you like this color? I can strategically change my clothes if you're not a fan, but if you are... want me to paint some hearts on your nails, too?

main3.line: Come on, Commander, you of all people should know how important a work-life balance is! Take a seat already and... Oh, no vacant seats? Alright, then why don't you just take mine and I'll get real comfy on your lap?

touch.line: You asking to borrow my ID card? Sure thing, although I can't use my hands right now since I'm waiting for my nail polish to dry. Just go ahead and take it by yourself♪

touch2.line: My cubicle is in a bit of a blind spot, so we can get up to anything we want and nobody will ever know!

unlock.line: ...Yes, I know I'm on the clock, but taking productive breaks helps raise your working efficiency afterward! You should take one, too – come sit and kill time wi– Ahem! I mean, come sit and have a break with me!

battle.line: E-everyone... Fight according to the plan, please...

couple_encourage1.line: D-don't be afraid... I won't leave you behind!

couple_encourage2.line: C-can you teach me to be an extrovert?

detail.line: Every night, I think of all kinds of things... I start to dwell on things, and I overanalyze, and I can't fall asleep... Before I know it, it's morning already.

expedition.line: Commander... I think the commission team is back... Huh? We're going to see them? As in, I have to go, too?!

feeling1.line: Eep?! C-Commander...

feeling2.line: Hyah?! S-sorry, I didn't mean to do that... I-I slept so poorly last night, and... Huh? I can sleep in your office? Like... now?

feeling3.line: (The Commander is always so nice to me, accepting me despite all my flaws... How am I ever supposed to repay that kindness?)

feeling4.line: When I'm with you, I feel more relaxed than ever... It's a strange, but special feeling. I want to be even closer...

feeling5.line: I can sleep next to you whenever I'm tired? Wait... You'll even hold me?! I-in that case... could you hold me right now? Hyah! C-Commander... I love you... Zzzz...

headtouch.line: Aah?! Commander... Mm, that feels nice... Very relaxing... Zzzz.

home.line: (The Commander just yawned... Are you working overtime again? Did I make trouble by not doing enough on my own?! Ah... I-I can't bring myself to ask...)

hp_warning.line: Urk... I-I don't know if I can take much more...

login.line: Hyah?! *rumble*... C-Commander, how long have you been here... C-close your mouth, Little Ihn! No growling at the Commander!

lose.line: *sob*... Commander... L-Little Ihn is still screaming...

mail.line: C-Commander, you have new mail... Oh, wait. First, I'd better make sure there's nothing wrong with it...

main1.line: Someone asked me directions earlier, but I overthought it so much that I couldn't give them a good answer... Little Ihn had to show them the way. If only I could give her a speech module...

main2.line: A riddle contest? Oh... Yeah, I did win one of those recently. All I did was write down my logical analysis and conclusions for each scenario based on the possibilities...

main3.line: C-Commander... May I join the physical training today? Um... If I push myself to my limit, it's really easy to fall asleep...

mission.line: C-Commander, you still have missions to do... Umm, if we combine the two of these, I think our efficiency would go way up...

mission_complete.line: W-we finished all of those missions... We didn't miss any, right? There aren't any hidden objectives, or...?

profile.line: G-good morning, Commander... I'm Z14, a Type 1934A-class destroyer under the Iron Blood... I'm good at things like rapidly memorizing information and decoding ciphers, but... I'm not super great at physical activities.

propose.line: A-am I dreaming right now? Would someone like you... really fall for someone like me? B-but I've always secretly hoped that this would happen. Ooh... I'm so happy that I... I don't even know what I'm saying anymore... *sob*

touch.line: Y-you wanna try petting Little Ihn? I think she's taken a liking to you...

touch2.line: Eep?! Wh-what's going on? A-are you doing something weird to me?!

unlock.line: C-Commander... I'm Z14, an Iron Blood destroyer... *rumble* Oh! Th-this here is Little Ihn... She can't speak, but she's really smart...

upgrade.line: Is it just me, or is my brain working better, too...?

win_mvp.line: The enemy's plan was easy to read... Almost too easy. Wait, is this a trap?!

gift_prefer.line: Huh? F-for me...? Thank you, Commander...

detail_ex.line: Commander! From now on... may I sleep in your office?! Huh? You'll come to my room and stay with me until I fall asleep...? B-but if you do that, I'll start thinking of other stuff...

feeling5_ex.line: Little Ihn, can you sneak this into the Commander's... Hyah?! C-Commander, when did you get here? Umm, this is just... a little gift full of my love for you! I-I hope you like it...

headtouch_ex.line: Mm... Hehehe... Keep doing that, Commander... I-I need you to pet me for at LEAST ten minutes!

home_ex.line: Commander, welcome back! Mmm... I feel so safe with you... N-next time you sortie, take me with you!

login_ex.line: Whoa whoa whoa?! L-Little Ihn, let the Commander go... H-hey, I wanna hug the Commander, too... I'm not letting go!

main4_ex.line: I-I know you SAY I can nap in your office, but if you work overtime, then I should stay up with you!

main5_ex.line: Commander, have you heard of "quantum speed reading"? They say it helps you absorb books faster... O-of course I know it's fake, but what if you managed to master something like that? Would you... not need me anymore?

main6_ex.line: You look really sleepy... Since you usually let me sleep in your arms, I'll do my best to hold you in mine this time... C-come here!

mail_ex.line: Y-you got more mail... Commander, I should check it first from now on. Then, if there's a bomb inside... you won't get hurt...

touch_ex.line: Hehehe... Th-that tickles... Huh? This is smiling practice? And you're gonna go even harder now? No, wait... Aaaah!

touch2_ex.line: S-so this is what lovers do... Okay... Let's do it...

detail.line: C-Commander... I'm sorry! I picked out a swimsuit and practiced my best smile for you, but you ended up having to save me... Th-thank you so much!

feeling5.line: Warm sunlight, a nice breeze... When you're not here, I never notice these things. Commander... May I continue to stay by your side?

headtouch.line: *sob*... Thank you, Commander... C-can you console me a little longer?

home.line: As long as you're here, I won't be scared! E-even if those seagulls come begging for food again... I'll say no this time!

login.line: C-Commander, where are you...? Oh, Commander... Is that really you?! I'm not dreaming? Thank goodness...

main1.line: I-I'm still embarrassed walking around in this swimsuit, so... I tried taking a shortcut to our meeting spot, but then I got lost... *sob*

main2.line: At first, there were only two seagulls... I thought they were hungry, so I shared some of my bread, and then... And then...

main3.line: Umm... I wanted to use these sunglasses as a disguise... Huh? You can still tell it's me?!

touch.line: Ah?! Wh-whoooa?! Y-you're bridal carrying me?! Being rescued like this is just... Aaah!

touch2.line: Hyah?! I-I'm still a little scared...

unlock.line: Eep... I-I don't have any more food... Leave me alone already, please! C-Commander, help... I'm lost, and these birds won't listen to me!

battle.line: Get ready to be wowed!

couple_encourage1.line: Don't be scared, don't be scared~ I'm not a baddie~

detail.line: You've been staring at me for a while... Are you having naughty thoughts? I'm gonna report you... Hahaha, just kidding! I welcome your gaze, Commander~

expedition.line: Oh, the commission team is almost back... I guess we won't be alone much longer. Too bad... I'm sure neither of us has had our fill yet~

feeling1.line: If you keep hiding from me, I'm going to lose my patience with you, Commander!

feeling2.line: Feel free to order me to do anything~ Even the most ridiculous request... I'm ready to please♥

feeling3.line: It's really pouring outside... I guess we'll just have to hang out alone in your office... Hmm? You have an umbrella, and you'll walk me home? W-wait... Why'd you get so close?!

feeling4.line: Um, so... Commander, I think I... Come on, you know what I'm trying to say... Ugh, how can it be so hard to say three little words?

feeling5.line: Commander... Do you think love feels like having broken brakes? Like, I know I REALLY need to stop... but I can't stop the urge to crash into you!

headtouch.line: Petting?! If you're doing that... then you'd better be ready to take responsibility!

home.line: Oh hey, you're back! Hmm? Why am I stuck like this? Well, my ride broke down again... Help me out, please!

hp_warning.line: M-my boiler's water supply pipe is failing!

login.line: Aw, you finally came to see me! I await your orders. No matter what you want, I'll do it. Oh... Paperwork, huh?

lose.line: Ugh, I can't move... Why'd it break down all of a sudden?!

mail.line: Commander, your mail's right heeere♪ Go ahead and take it. Just be careful you don't touch anything else... Hehe!

main1.line: You'll fix my ride for me? You're totally saying that so you can go home with me, right? I can tell... Huh? Wait, you're actually bringing a toolbox?

main2.line: You wanna talk in more detail about this tomorrow? Sure~ I mean, we could go really in-depth right now, if you waaanted...

main3.line: When you're off work, how about you ride home with me? Don't worry – nothing will go wrong this time! I'll take you on my bicycle, so there's no danger at all!

mission.line: Commander, your work isn't done yet. Hurry up and finish it so we can do something more fun!

mission_complete.line: Your rewards are here~ But doesn't it leave you wanting a better reward, maybe from... me? Hahaha, did I guess right?

profile.line: I'm the Iron Blood destroyer Z15. I don't know why, but my ride tends to malfunction a lot... If you don't want me to be in danger, you'd better keep those eyes on me!

propose.line: Haha... Wow, what a good dream that was. The Commander's face, the feeling of that ring... Wait, that wasn't a dream?! Oh, man... Wh-what am I even supposed to say?!

touch.line: Pure, innocent girls like me have nooo idea what's going on in that head of yours~

touch2.line: C-Commander, what's gotten into... Hyah?! I-I'm heating up... My boiler might explode...

unlock.line: I'm Z15 – a destroyer from the Iron Blood. Just looking at you makes my heart race... Hehe, how about we go somewhere together? We've got so much more to discuss~

upgrade.line: My power is overflowing~

win_mvp.line: Don't you think top performers like me deserve a little reward?

gift_prefer.line: You gave me such a nice gift... I'd better find a way to thank you♪

feeling5_ex.line: It's time I was honest with you. No matter how much time passes, even if I'm reborn, I'll never let go of you. Heehee, that's just how deep my love for you is♥

headtouch_ex.line: Mmm... That feels good. Touch me more, if you want...

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander~ I waited all day for you... Hehe, you look like you've still got energy. That means you don't need a break before we get started... right?

login_ex.line: I'm so hot, I feel like I could melt! All because I saw you, Commander...

main4_ex.line: You want me to go on your next trip? Now that sounds dangerous~ After all, you and I will be alone in a cramped space... Hm? You're worried about something else?

main5_ex.line: Lately, I've started overheating every time we hang out... You'd better pour your coolant all over me!

main6_ex.line: My finger got caught in the door! You'd better kiss it better for me... Just kidding! All I really wanted was to hold hands~

touch_ex.line: I can tell exactly what you're thinking, Commander~

touch2_ex.line: *pant*... This is my favorite part♥

feeling5.line: I bet it'd be even more exciting if we were rolling around in here together... Losing our balance, but never letting go of each other, floating and sinking and bouncing together... Aah, I can't hold back much longer♥

home.line: Commander, get in here and play with me! Hehe, once you're inside, I'm never letting you go~ It'll be so much fun to roll around together!

login.line: Oh nooo, I fell again~ It's so hard to keep my balance in here... Hmm? Did I just catch you staring at clumsy little me, Commander?

main1.line: It's so fun how this ball bobs up and down... Whoa! Hehe, it's hard to stay balanced, though... I'm totally not hitting you on purpose♪

main2.line: The water around here is nice and cool... Oh, oooh! I can feel everything from the fish swimming around to the heat in your hands!

main3.line: Commander, you're not looking at ME, are you? Are you... counting the fish and birds around? Geez, shouldn't you be focusing on getting closer to me?

touch.line: *pant*... Please, I need a little break... Stop pushing the ball around for a bit. Everything's spinning...

touch2.line: Commander~ Feel how bouncy it is when you touch? I can feel your warmth through it, too.

unlock.line: Commandeeer! I finally made it to you. Seems like there's something wrong with the exit of this ball... Anyway, I'm stuck in here. Can you help me out?

battle.line: We brawlin'? Helllll yeahhh!!

couple_encourage1.line: Uhh, w-we're cool, right...

couple_encourage2.line: H-Hipper, it's you, right?

couple_encourage3.line: If YOU'RE a shark, then I'm a huge shark! Raaawr!

detail.line: The best way to get your enemies to chill out is to beat the crap outta them! Isn't that right, Commander?

expedition.line: Our friends from the commission team have returned! Uhh, how many people were there again? I can't really see from here...

feeling1.line: Tell me who's bullying you! Don't be scared! I'm gonna get payback for you!

feeling2.line: I'm no good with the complicated stuff, but all I know is, you beat up the bad guys and protect the good guys – can't go wrong with that, right? As for who's good and who's bad, I can tell with just a glance!

feeling3.line: There are all sorts of bad guys out there. Some can be reasoned with, others won't repent until you threaten them with a good beatdown. Then, there are the real assholes who force me to get serious... Well, you already know what happens to them!

feeling4.line: Commander, if you ever turn into a bad guy one day, I'd have to steel my heart and beat the evil out of you... That's why you should work hard to be a good person beloved by everyone, so something like that never has to happen!

feeling5.line: Oh, Commander! Hehehe, just seeing you is getting me all fired up~! So, we sortieing today? Just leave it to me! Now if you had some sweet candy for me, I'd be even more fired up!

home.line: You're back? Heh, I'm sure you had a blast on that sortie. You get to slug it out with all kinds of enemies! ...You didn't just hide in the back, did you?

hp_warning.line: Barely a scratch! Like hell I'd let that scare me!

login.line: Stop right there, scoundrel! What are you doing sifting through the Commander's room–– Huh? Oh, it's you, Commander.

lose.line: Don't hold me back! Those bastards made my friends cry... and I'm not gonna forgive them!

mail.line: Mail? You talking about this flimsy envelope here? I brought it with me, but is it really that important?

main1.line: Gross, all the letters are so close together that my eyes are getting sore... I give up, I'm getting all cross-eyed...

main2.line: I'll chew you up and grind you to itty-bitty pieces! Hehehe, thanks for the candy, Commander! Got any more for me?

main3.line: Commander, if you start getting drowsy, lemme give you a good chomp! That'll get you on your feet real fast! ...Eh? That's a no-go?

mission.line: Missions? Ugh, there's only boring stuff here... Get me out!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! So now we gotta stamp everything right here? Lemme do it!

profile.line: I'm the one-and-only Friedrich Eckoldt, Iron Blood destroyer, but you can just call me Z16. If only I had gotten a better look back then, I wouldn't have... Ah, screw it! This time, I'll make sure I don't get friend and foe mixed up!

propose.line: Commander, this must be one of those special rings that let you talk to the other person wearing it no matter how far the two of you are apart, right? Huh? It's just a normal ring? I see... Hmph! But that doesn't matter! Even without a ring like that, I can sense if you're ever in danger and rush to your aid at any time!

touch.line: Huh? Why are you touching me all of a sudden?

touch2.line: Eyy! Where are you stickin' those hands?!

unlock.line: Hey, you over there, you're the Commander, aren't you? That's right, I've checked my papers a bazillion times already! I'm the one-and-only Iron Blood destroyer Z16, also known as Friedrich Eckoldt! Heh heh, I can't wait to get my hands dirty, so hurry up and sortie me already!

upgrade.line: Heh heh, you'd better get ready for what I'm about to do!

win_mvp.line: Heheh, number one goes to the one-and-only ME!

gift_prefer.line: Woooah! I looove this!

battle_ex.line: I'll tear you to shreds!

detail_ex.line: Commander, you can do the thinkin' with your noggin, and I'll do the thumpin' with my fists! Ehehe, the two of us make a good team!

home_ex.line: Ugh, took you long enough. There's nothing to do here in the office except that stupid headache-causing paperwork... Next time, bring me along to your sortie! You'd better keep your promise!

login_ex.line: Yo, Commander! Hehe, didn't get the wrong person this time~ Let's get started with the day's work!

main4_ex.line: Commander, these mint candies are out of this world! Here, I'll give you one! Huh? You're not supposed to bite on them?

main5_ex.line: Commander... Commander! If you ignore me, I'm gonna bite you! ...Hmph. I was just joking around, but that's what you get when you don't pay attention to me. I don't really bite...

mail_ex.line: I left the flimsy ol' envelope over there on the desk.

mission_ex.line: A mission? Freaking boring... Well, whatever, I don't mind doing it for you, Commander!
