detail.line: Even off duty, I cannot remove this claw, as it is a symbol of my dignity! ...What do I do if I need to pick something up? Th-that's your job, you foolish mortal!

login.line: Are you all rested up? I'll give you the privilege of keeping me entertained today! Consider this your greatest honor, mortal!

main1.line: I shall reward you with a taste of this black fruit! Open your mouth, foolish mortal!

touch.line: Do you want to stay by my side tht badly? Heheh~

touch2.line: Th-there are some things you just shouldn't do! I hope you're ready for some punishment, foolish mortal!

unlock.line: Come, human! The rite of festivities is upon us! Come hither, and let us revel in this foreign holiday together!

detail.line: When facing human opponents, it would hardly be a fair contest if I didn't convert my claws into bandages... It definitely had nothing to do with me breaking a whole bunch of racquets or anything like that.

home.line: Whether on the battlefield or inside the stadium, the fruit of victory is sweet indeed! Even a foolish mortal such as you is privy to that knowledge, right? ♪

login.line: Tell me what plans you have for the day, mortal. I've decided – you shall bear witness to my dominion over this stadium, and burn those memories into your eyes!

main1.line: Not half bad, for a human. It appears that the time has come to unleash my sealed power––

main2.line: Picking up balls is beneath someone as exalted as me! ...Oww! Fine, fine, I get it! Stop chewing me out already, Zed!

main3.line: As a r-reward for defeating me, I shall grant you the privilege of giving me directions for the day! Bask in this glory, foolish mortal!

touch.line: Heh heh... Excellent!

touch2.line: I, I did not mean THIS kind of reward...!

unlock.line: Heh heh... As expected, you couldn't even last for a second! Winning too easily takes all the fun out of it... You, the mortal over there, I'll give you the honor of being my next opponent!

win_mvp.line: Bow down before my might!

detail.line: Come the night of a thousand demons, the ashen red queen shall rise from the underworld! She will lead an army of lost souls and bring chaos to the world! ...That's the idea, anyway. Well? Do you think it's cool?

expedition.line: Ah, the commission rewards... Hmph. What I want is a dark chocolate treat of– There is none? Then you will get me one, mortal! ...I don't care if you buy it from Akashi's store!

home.line: Oh, you're back, mortal... Hm? Tired, are you? Very well, I permit you to rest at my mansion. Worry not, the beds are surprisingly snug.

login.line: Behold, mortal! I got this special costume and these ornaments just for this day! The black and red are befitting of the night of demons... What do you mean I "hardly look different"?!

main1.line: Give me tribute if you don't want to get cursed! As for what that entails... I desire whipped cream or a chocolate cream cake!

main2.line: Dammit, this binding spell holds the Force of my retainers who sleep in the abyss... Never mind. I should avoid using the term "Force"...

main3.line: (If I had my claws, the Commander would point out I could break free on my own... Anyway, it's fine like this! Just need to wait for the mortal to get close before I perform my trick...)

mission.line: You can't do this mission yourself, pathetic human? Hmph. Fine, I shall do it my– Grrrr...

touch.line: Human, would you have preferred a more witchy design? ...N-no, I'm absolutely not asking about your personal tastes! *blushes*

touch2.line: Whuh?! Th-there's nothing hidden... I-I-I never said I'd play any tricks!

unlock.line: "Sing your praises to the Fiend of Crimson Darkness, Z24!" ... Hmm, maybe I should go with "Bow down in astonishment!"... Ah, yes! Mortal, you've come at a most opportune time! Hurry and tell me what you think of my new catchphrase! ...Actually, get me down from here first!

win_mvp.line: I did the tricking. You, mortal, should prepare the treat!

battle.line: Z25, currently searching for enemy ships!

couple_encourage1.line: Sis, let's do our best together!

detail.line: Mr. Anchor, what must I do to become as outstanding as my sister...?

expedition.line: The commission team is already waiting at the harbor. Shall I welcome them back?

feeling1.line: Mr. Anchor... I don't want to be here anymore...

feeling2.line: Even though I told the commander not to worry, I still worry that I won't be able to meet expectations or adapt to this new environment. Mr. Anchor, will I be able to perform well?

feeling3.line: Now, all my peers see me as being dedicated and responsible, and want to sortie or go on commissions with me. Commander also feels more at ease when I am around. Mr. Anchor, I've managed to make it!

feeling4.line: Recently, I've become more and more conscious of the commander. When we are together, I simply can't seem to calm down. Mr. Anchor... what should I do...?

feeling5.line: Ehehe... Haah, it's still no good. Mr. Anchor, sorry for making you act like the commander and practice with me for so long. I give up... just being like this should be good enough... Eh... w-wait... Commander?

home.line: Good work, everyone. Let's use this time to also check the status of all the equipment.

hp_warning.line: I can hang on a bit longer...

login.line: You're right on time. Well then, I should also get fired up.

lose.line: This battle... I'll have to reflect upon it thoroughly...

mail.line: New mail has arrived... it would be unfortunate if you glossed over something important!

main1.line: Z23... is probably engrossed in her studies right now...

main2.line: Research plans... commission schedule... Ugh... this is no time to be getting sleepy...

main3.line: This thing here? He- it's really just an ordinary toy!

mission.line: Don't procrastinate on your missions. Hurry up and get them taken care of!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Well? What are your next plans?

profile.line: From my sister Z23 forth, we were all assigned code names. However, no matter what I am called or where I am deployed, I shall fulfill my duties!

propose.line: So, you heard everything that I said to Mr. Anchor.... Ughh, I'm such an idiot! However, I'm really happy that you chose to give this to me. Th-there's no going back on this!

touch.line: Zzz.... woah! Sorry, I shouldn't have been daydreaming...

touch2.line: Oooh! ...If that was on purpose, you'd better grit your teeth!

unlock.line: Type 1936A destroyer Z25, reporting in. Please be at ease, I shall do my utmost in battle.

upgrade.line: Becoming stronger... should allow me to get a little closer to Z23.

win_mvp.line: Not bad, let's keep this same tempo going!

gift_prefer.line: I, I guess I'll take it!

detail.line: Mr. Anchor has to sit out in the sun as well, or he will get moldy.

home.line: Commander, which girl are you staring at this time?

login.line: Phew... It's been a long time since I've been able to enjoy such a refreshing breeze.

main1.line: Volleyball? Or how about swimming! I won't lose, no matter what you pick!

main2.line: Liven up! Don't tell me you're tired already!

main3.line: It's time to let these Royals witness the tactics and teamwork of the Iron Blood! Heheh~

touch.line: I'm not tired yet, there's no need for you to massage- Ooh... that feels pretty good...

touch2.line: S-sink!!

unlock.line: Even at the beach, we cannot afford to be careless! Commander, have you adequately prepared for today's activities?

battle.line: All ships, follow the vanguard's lead! Oh, I guess that means follow me!

couple_encourage1.line: Please don't stray too far from me!

detail.line: I hate snowstorms. One was the reason I got separated from my allies and captured by the enemy...

expedition.line: The commission team is back! They've really done it this time... Nono, I mean, they've done a good job!

feeling1.line: Commander, you're a failure!

feeling2.line: What I do when a foe's aiming at me? Well... I pray that they fire at someone else by accident! If they don't, I pray again that their torpedoes don't hit me!

feeling3.line: Commander, you did a great job, like always! Continue to do your best tomorrow as well! ...You can tell that I'm complimenting you right now, no?

feeling4.line: Maintaining a good work-life balance is very important! That's why I'll be watching you on your days off to make sure you don't do any work! This is me telling you to get enough rest.

feeling5.line: Commander! I was observing your work, and it looks like you can do just fine without my supervision! What a good job you've done. You're stellar! I'm very proud of you.

home.line: Commander, here's some coffee! ...S-sugar? Hmm... I wonder if 10 cubes will be enough...

hp_warning.line: I wonder where Z25 and the others went...

login.line: Sorry, but only authorized personnel are allowed into the office... Oh, I guess you're authorized to enter. Welcome back! Let's give it our all!

lose.line: We ended up losing... I'm really sorry, everyone!

mail.line: Here's the latest intel! Please give it a look, Commander!

main1.line: Commander, slacking off is absolutely prohibited! ...You've already finished your work? I-in that case... Well done!

main2.line: Zed's good at studying, and Lebe's good at sports... so I should aim to... study while playing sports? W-will I manage?

main3.line: I wonder if Z25's Mr. Anchor is actually alive... I mean, she's always talking to it, so...

mission.line: New damn missions have co– Err, I mean! Commander, please hurry up and check out the new missions!

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed! If Zed were here, she'd say... "Commander, you've done well!"

profile.line: So you want to hear about my history? Absolutely! As the Iron Blood Type 1936A destroyer, Z26, I escorted Hipper and Scheer, and disrupted shipping with Z25 and the others. While doing so, I was defeated... and that's that!

propose.line: "I take you, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, until death do us part." ...I was able to recite it from memory! Now it's your turn... right?

touch.line: If you need assistance, just give me the order! ...Err, I mean, please let me know!

touch2.line: No lewdness allowed! Ever! Full stop!

unlock.line: I'm the Iron Blood destroyer, Z26! I look forward to working with you! ...All right, that should do just fine as an introduction...!

upgrade.line: I'm very grabbed! ...No, I mean, I'm very grateful!

win_mvp.line: Continue making your best endeavors! ...Um, I mean, well done, everyone!

gift_prefer.line: Well done, Commander! I mean, uhh, thank you!

detail.line: Spee really likes these bugle crunches a whole lot. Do you like them too, Commander? Then, open up, I'll chuck a few in for you!

home.line: You thirsty, Commander? I've got Cola, milk, and even the fizzy stuff Hipper and Eugen drink when they come over to play. They're all in that mini-fridge over there, so take whatever you want!

login.line: Sorry to keep you waiting! These are all my belongings! ...I mean, uhh, these are all my snacks and games!

main1.line: U96 pwned me again! Maybe I should practice more with Ryuujou before challenging her... Oh, Commander, I'm talking about a fighting game I've been playing with U96 and the others!

main2.line: If you're tired, you should try hugging Sharky and taking a nap! ...Ah, I meant that Sharky pillow on the bed!

main3.line: My sisters are always telling me not to spend too much time gaming. But since it's my day off, does it reallly matter how much I play?

touch.line: Press this button to start a new game! ...Um, Commander, weren't you asking about where the start button is?

unlock.line: Commander, welcome to my pad! Ah, give me a sec, let me go grab all the snacks and drinks and games!

battle.line: Everyone, please follow my lead!

couple_encourage1.line: Sis, you're way too strict with Commander~

couple_encourage2.line: Z24, I have no idea what you're talking about...

couple_encourage3.line: Z25, shall we go take a look at Mr. Anchor?

couple_encourage4.line: Let's calm down and take things one step at a time!

couple_encourage5.line: Scharnhorst, you look so cool when you're out there fighting!

detail.line: Commander, look at this torpedo! I drew a funny face on it! Cute, isn't it?

expedition.line: Commission complete! Commander, if you're busy, I'll go welcome back the commission team!

feeling1.line: I'll continue to support you until you reflect on your behavior and regain everyone's trust. Don't give up!

feeling2.line: I wonder what the little birdies are talking about from their tree branch up there... I've always wanted to know...

feeling3.line: Did you want to take it easy for a bit? Sure, I don't mind covering for you. But, there's no replacement for the work you do... so please take care of it later~

feeling4.line: Did you finish your work today? Mmhmm! As a reward, I'll give you a hug~♪ Good job, good job~

feeling5.line: Are you tired, Commander? Here, come put your head in my lap. Please lie down and have a pleasant dream, until all your fatigue and worries melt away one by one~

headtouch.line: Ehehe, let me pat your head too~

home.line: Good work, Commander! Here's a hug for your safe return!

hp_warning.line: A fearsome foe... Everyone, be careful!

login.line: Ah... Commander, I'm sure you had your reasons for being late! Anyway, it's fine, don't worry about it! Let's just work hard starting right now!

lose.line: There's no need to feel down. Since we managed to retreat safely, there will always be a next time!

mail.line: The little birdies brought me a letter~ Should I read it aloud for you?

main1.line: I want to play with cute animals all day long~

main2.line: This big old office feels a bit empty, but it's also refreshing and helps me focus on work!

main3.line: If you finish all your work on time, I'll make some delicious sweets for you~

mission.line: Looks like we have some new missions... Any tasks to go play with Meowfficers?

mission_complete.line: Another mission completed flawlessly! As a reward, I'll give you a hug~♪

profile.line: As a lead ship, I may not be as qualified as my sisters due to my armament... As a result, I've come to value problem-solving in other ways rather than directly fighting.

propose.line: I never thought I'd get something like this from you, Commander... I'm overjoyed! Please dote on me as much as you'd like from now on! No matter what, I'll always be there for you!

touch.line: Please go to sleep already! You can wait until later to finish the work!

touch2.line: All the girls will hate you if you do stuff like this, you know?

unlock.line: Pleased to meet you, Commander! I'm the one in the exact middle of the Type 1936A destroyers, Z28! My mission is to support you to the best of my abilities!

upgrade.line: Mmm... if only they could make my rigging a little cuter as well...

win_mvp.line: We won! Commander, you're really awesome!

gift_prefer.line: Are you giving this to me? ...Wow, thank you so much, Commander!

detail.line: Should I make offerings at the shrine first, or play hanetsuki with my friends...? Ugh, there are just so many things I want to do!

home.line: I'm going to give this daruma doll a cuter expression! Um... the brush... where'd the brush go...

login.line: Hello, Commander. I thought you were still hiding inside the kotatsu. Ehehe~

main1.line: Commander, look at this lifelike tail! Doesn't this make me look like one of those girls from the Sakura Empire?

main2.line: Hmm, why does this lion have a scary face? ...Wouldn't it be better if he's cute...?

main3.line: Commander, want to try some New Year dango? ...Here, open your mouth, say ahhn~

touch.line: All tuckered out from playing? Let's take a break then! I'll wake you up if there's an exciting event going on!

touch2.line: Promise me you won't do this any more, okay?

unlock.line: Commander, Happy New Year! Is there anything you'd like to do on New Year's Day? Say, why don't we try doing all of that stuff, all at once~?

detail.line: Doesn't being surrounded by animals just make you want more to come? Why, I'd call it... Critter Crossing!

home.line: Commander, welcome back. You'd better hurry up, or you'll be too late for food! Even the animals are gunning for whatever they can eat...

login.line: Salutations, Commander. The party's just getting started, so get out there and have some fun~

mail.line: Huh? A little birdie brought us a letter. Let's see what's inside!

main1.line: Commander, don't worry about your own outfit just because I'm wearing a dress. Be comfy!

main2.line: We don't need a dress code. If you come to the party, what you wear is the dress code! Wear whatever you like, everyone.

main3.line: Wow... Missus Deer, Mister Squirrel, the birdies, and Mister Raccoon... Even guests not from the fleet are here to party!

touch.line: Did you want to pet me instead of the animals? I guess that's fine~

unlock.line: Prosit, Commander! I think these wild animals were attracted by the champagne's aroma. But they're well-behaved and like being petted. Do you want to be petted too, Commander?

battle.line: Let's give it our all! We're the best~!

detail.line: Huh? Commander, why are you in my room? ...Eh?! I'm the one who got the room wrong?

expedition.line: We interrupt this broadcast to bring you a special message... Commissions have returned, Commander~

feeling1.line: You're not the commander I was hoping for...

feeling2.line: When it comes to the Iron Blood, the cool one would have to be Z1. The sexy would definitely be Eugen. As for who is the most idol-like, that would be none other than me, the dancing and singing Ms. 35!

feeling3.line: Commander is a bit like the idol of the fleet. Just by being there, you bring hope to everyone. I want to become the same kind of idol!

feeling4.line: Now that I think about it... Commander, do you know what a produzent is? It's like the agent for an idol. Commander, if you have time to spare, I'd like you to become my P~

feeling5.line: Commander, I am only able to perform my best when I am with you. Whether it's in combat or on stage, I am always at my best. That's why I can say... I can't be without you~

home.line: Commander, are you tired? You should come watch my performance to help you recover!

hp_warning.line: Everyone, let's make another push!

login.line: Hallihallo~ Commander, did you dream of me last night?

lose.line: Don't lose hope, everyone! We'll have another chance!

mail.line: Commander, there's mail for you~

main1.line: Commander, look look, a bunny! Isn't it so cute?

main2.line: Just before, I went to see the Lexington sisters' Konzert. You can definitely tell that they are professionals.

main3.line: Commander, what kind of performance do you like? Tell me so I can go learn it~

mission_complete.line: As expected of you, Commander! What bountiful rewards~

profile.line: The lead ship of the 1936B-class is none other than me, though there were only three of us to begin with... I carried out many artillery and minelaying operations in the Baltic Sea, but in the end, accidentally ran into our own mines along with Z36. Yes, the same as this one down here... Eh? Why is it here?!

propose.line: It's a promise, Commander. When I become an idol, you'll become my P, okay? Until I become the top superstar... No, even after that, always be my P~

skill.line: I won't let you have your way~

touch.line: Commander, what's the matter? Eh, I made a mistake on this document? ...Ah, it's true! Oops, sorry~

touch2.line: Commander, I might be playing it cool, but you've already lost my affection points.

unlock.line: Commander, my fellow fleetmembers, hello~! I am the singing and dancing Z35! Pleased to meet you!

upgrade.line: Commander, you sure are a person of great insight!

win_mvp.line: Großartig! Everyone did a great job!

gift_prefer.line: As expected, Commander! You really get me~

detail.line: Eheh~ No matter what outfit you put me in, the singing and dancing idol will always function at 100 percent!

home.line: Commander, did you see a black hanetsuki shuttlecock around here somewhere? I was practicing with it a bit too much... I guess it's not here after all...?

login.line: One of the prizes for this New Year's raffle is a sea mine raffle? Ehh... I don't really want that...

main1.line: I invited Z36 to come with me, but why does she never take me up on it...?

main2.line: What better way to kick off the New Year's celebration than with a Konzert! That's right!

main3.line: If I was to capture the various sights and sounds of the Sakura New Year's celebration and turn it into a show... Ehehe, might just be a great idea!

touch.line: Commander, do you have any advice for this New Year project?

touch2.line: Commander, I won't drop my smile, but my respect for you has dropped significantly~

unlock.line: Commander, and all my fellow friends of the fleet, Happy New Year's! This time, your favorite idol Z35 will be presenting a brand new Sakura-themed collaboration, "Projekt Kirschblüte!" Everyone, thank you for your continued support!

battle.line: For my memories with the Commander! Heheh☆

detail.line: Thanks for helping me snap pics for my scrapbook! Heh, we had so much fun together. Did you get good memories out of it, too, Commander...?

expedition.line: It's time for your favorite maid's reminder service! Ding-diiing♪ The commission team's back!

home.line: Instead of performing onstage, I'm performing just for you in the pop-up shop, Commander♪ As for what I'll do... Heehee, why don't you give me your order first?

login.line: When you're in this restaurant, is it cool if I call you Master instead of Commander? Oh, you think it's not that kind of restaurant? Okay, but still...

main1.line: Once my album is done, Z36's comes next... Ah! Imagine if, as soon as you took a picture of her, new memories appeared out of thin air in her mind...! Pssh, just kidding♪

main2.line: Tonight, there's gonna be an idol Konzert with me, Z36, San Diego, Guam, and all the C Class girls! Heheh, you're staying with me until then♪

main3.line: "Sniffle... Can I, a maid, ever truly be with my Master...?" Okay, Commander. What should a Master say next?

mission_complete.line: "Say, Commander, can you help me with my homework back at my place after school...?" In return, I'll grab your rewards for you♪

touch.line: Whoa, whoa! I'm not a real maid! I don't DO cleaning!

touch2.line: Wait, is my affinity level high enough for... A-at least give me time to mentally prepare! *blush*

unlock.line: "Welcome, my beloved Master♡ Heehee, I've been waiting here for you for sooo long!" Heheh, did you get good pics this time? My beloved Master♪

win_mvp.line: We just made another awesome memory together, Master♪

feeling5.line: My new mission is to stay by your side forever – both to gain your power of love and to protect you! And no, that wasn't a rehearsed line. That's how I really feel♪

home.line: Another peaceful day, thanks to you and me! Heheh☆

login.line: Welcome back, Commander~ I'll cast a spell to give you energy! First, let's interlock our fingers, aaand... feel your heart skip a beat!♪

main1.line: My set this time has a deep-blue sky! Pretty, right? It'll be awesome for my next Konzert!

main2.line: My performance and charms are no joke, huh? It's just a matter of time until my next real show♪

main3.line: Idols have to work hard on the stage, yeah, but time with you is just as important~ How about we go back to that amusement park after my next show? I can't wait for our next date♪

touch.line: Wanna feel my magic wand, Commander? Heheh☆

touch2.line: Whoa?! Commander, have the evil forces lurking in this park infected you...?

unlock.line: In pursuit of being an even greater idol, I prepared this new outfit! "With my magic and passionate heart, I'll bring you joy☆" Heheh, did you like that one, Commander?

battle.line: Seal... released! Come! I'll burn the power of a Devilish Idol into your retina! Shazam!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's have our devilish duet! Huh?! Fünf, come baaack!

detail.line: Hmhmm~ what do you think about my bewitching heterochromatic eyes? H-hey! They're not contacts!

expedition.line: My long-departed kindred have finally returned to us from their commission. Let us greet them with hearts full of gratitude!

feeling1.line: My bewitching eyes have foreseen your imminent destruction!

feeling2.line: Heheh~ Finally, someone able to see on the same wavelength as the Devilish Idol herself! Now, become my fan!

feeling3.line: Heheh~ allow me to engrave the seal of the Devilish Idol upon your flesh! W-wait, I'm not done making the stamp yet!

feeling4.line: Those who share the seal of the Devilish Idol shall have their fate cosmically bound with mine! That means... I kind of like you! Ehehe~

feeling5.line: Gah... Commander, when I'm with you, I can feel endless power welling up from deep within me, even without releasing my seal. Perhaps this is the "love" I have for you, ehehe~♪

headtouch.line: Bear witness to my devilish procession! Wh-what... Commander, I won't grow any taller if you keep patting me like that!

home.line: Phew... Huff... Why am I so worn out? Heh, that's because I've been practicing my powers of bewitchment! Ahhh, fine, fine! I was practicing for my performance...

hp_warning.line: Gah... power overwhelming...!

login.line: Ohh, you came at just the right time! Hm, want to listen to my brand new song? It's called "Devilish Overture!"

lose.line: Ugh... a Devilish Idol never loses...!

mail.line: A letter from one of my worshippers? Hmph... it's addressed to you, Commander.

main1.line: Commander, have you seen Fünf? I granted her some of my devilish powers, but then suddenly lost the ability to detect her with my bewitching eyes... Huh? Oh, she's right there?

main2.line: Nobody can resist the bewitching songs of the Devilish Idol!

main3.line: Whether it's on the battlefield or on the stage, once I release my sealed powers, nothing can get in my way~!

mission.line: Aldebaran has illuminated our path forward! Everyone, the time to act is now!

mission_complete.line: The stars have rewarded our efforts. Blink and you'll miss the opportunity, Commander!

profile.line: I am the Bremen-born destroyer Z36, known by many as the Devilish Idol! My friends and I travelled throughout the Baltic Sea, but eventually I was dragged into that deep, black abyss... Hmph. In any case, I'll bring you victory with my powers of bewitchment!

propose.line: I can feel it... my devilish soul resonating with yours, Commander...! Okay, I've decided! Until the end of time, whether on the battlefield or on the stage, I shall remain by your side, and use my devilish powers for you only! Commander, you'll always stay with me, right?

skill.line: I'll engrave my devilish powers of bewitchment upon your body!

touch.line: W-wait! Even if it's you, Commander, I won't let you unwrap- I mean, unseal my powers! No way! Nuu~!

touch2.line: You'll get hexed for casually touching the Devilish Idol's body!

unlock.line: Hm hm~ so you're my Commander? Our meeting must have been ordained by the Fates. By the Iron Blood coursing through my veins, the Devilish Idol Z36 binds herself to your service! Shazam!

upgrade.line: My devilish powers of bewitchment... have further awakened within me!

win_mvp.line: This victory was ordained by the Fates! Yes, that means it was inevitable!

gift_prefer.line: If this is some new offering... Oh, don't mind if I do~♪

battle.line: The battle with Dark Requiem is mine to fight!

couple_encourage1.line: Huh? Z36, are you supposed to be a devil, too...?

detail.line: Dark Requiem – DR, for short. Treacherous scoundrels who delight in deceiving the masses... Hm? I mean the enemies we fight with at sea daily, of course.

expedition.line: Our allies are back from their commission. Heheheh, DR could not foil their mission this time!

feeling1.line: Hmm... So the dark encroaches even into you...

feeling2.line: Augur of Destiny, be aware that the Fellowship of Justice has investigated you and is considering for a leadership position! Hm? Who investigated you? Me, of course!

feeling3.line: Plotting, strategies... All of it is so small and frivolous before my eternal demon eye! Like mere ants... Huh? W-wait! I'm not saying YOU'RE like that, Commander!

feeling4.line: Behold, Augur of Destiny, the avatar I designed for you! In your left hand, a devil-summoning magical book! With your right, you wield a magic circle that can subvert the laws of this very world! On your back, twin wings of white and black! ...I-it's cool as hell, right?!

feeling5.line: Come, Augur of Destiny, and place your hand on mine! I will now link our hearts... Oooh! This feeling... Heheheh! I knew it! You cannot resist the charms of this rebel against evil!

headtouch.line: Gaaah! Stop touching my head! You're ruining my power to detect darkness!

home.line: Heheheh... My servants, Delaman and Dulce, informed me of your arrival, giving me time to make sweets! Come, eat your fill!

hp_warning.line: Kh! My barrier has been broken?!

login.line: Ooh! Augur of Destiny, come! ...Hey, you're late! H-hurry and help me uncover the evil conspiracies of Dark Requiem, the organization of darkness!

lose.line: Kh... Has this happened because of the stirring of my left eye's seal?

mail.line: My demon eye has already seen the contents of your mail... Ack, I'm kidding! I wouldn't peep at your mail!

main1.line: Interested in why they call me the rebel against evil? Well, I parted ways with the bad guys and dealt a major wound to them... Hm? Who are the bad guys? Sh-shut up! No more questions! I haven't put that much thought into my backstory...

main2.line: Where are my familiars? Heheh, Dulce has shapeshifted into this bag I'm wearing, and Delaman is the eyepatch that seals my demon eye as we speak. Heheh, cute, right? I designed it all... Ahem, TAMED them myself!

main3.line: Augur of Destiny, tell me something! When you fight enemies, do you have a... personal boss battle theme? I'd pick something jazzy for you... Yeah! Jazz is great for symbolizing the confidence of the Fellowship of Justice!

mission.line: Have caution, Augur of Destiny! If you do not complete your missions, then I will be unable to see my justice done!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. The rewards... Mmm, it'll take too long to check all of these... I leave this job to you, Augur of Destiny!

profile.line: You may approach, Augur of Destiny! I am the Iron Blood's Z43, most powerful devil in all the world, descended to protect you from Dark Requiem... Heheheh, be proud of this fated encounter!

propose.line: Ahem. Yes, I was trying to get your attention... Huh? You like this, Commander? ...Ack, ahem! Do you wish to renew our covenant? A covenant for all eternity, one that can never be broken–wh-what?! You agreed that easily?!

skill.line: Let them witness our true power!

touch.line: Kh! You've broken my barrier?

touch2.line: C-C-Commander! At this rate, my magic will run wild and destroy the very fabric of the world!

unlock.line: Heheh... You may approach, Augur of Destiny. Z43, the demon-eyed devil, rebel against evil, she who chases the light even when cursed with wings of dark, welcomes you!

upgrade.line: Heheheh... My magic grows ever stronger!

win_mvp.line: The glory of victory is mine – and by extension, yours!

gift_prefer.line: Heheheh... This seems to be imbued with immense magical power...

feeling5_ex.line: I know I say a lot of nonsense, and I often brag about my strength... Maybe I'm just trying to escape the fact that I'm powerless to change reality. But now... I won't ever let you go! And I won't let anything bad ever happen to you!

headtouch_ex.line: Heheheh... F-feels good, huh?!

home_ex.line: Augur of Destiny, sit down and rest! We got the couch nice and ready for you to relax! ...Who is "we"? Heheheh, my servants Delaman and Dulce, of course!

login_ex.line: Comma–no, Augur of Destiny! Why are you always so late? It makes me so nervous that I can't even sleep in!

main4_ex.line: Augur of Destiny, Delaman has taken a liking to you! Wanna put on an eyepatch with Delaman's essence in it? I made it myself, so it's extra cool!

main5_ex.line: You really don't find me strange... Huh? You actually like that? H-hmph! Because of your presence, I might just be able to reside in this world for a long time!

main6_ex.line: A-aaah, finally... Finally! Thanks to your patient teaching, I can finally check the rewards all by myself! Heheheh, leave it to me next time!

mission_complete_ex.line: Heheh. Is this my reward for seeing my justice through? Then let's see what we've got! Uh... Oh, I don't get any of this... C-Commander, help!

touch_ex.line: Heheheh, I feel the pulsing of magic!

touch2_ex.line: A-are you trying to make my magic overflow again...?

win_mvp_ex.line: Heh heh heh... This is the power I gained from joining hands with the Augur of Destiny!

expedition.line: My demon eye beholds... Ah, yes! The return of our commission-bound comrades!

feeling5.line: Alone in our secret base... My fantasies have become reality... Aargh, damn it! If not for this stubborn bandage, it'd be perfect... Ugh...

home.line: Welcome back to our own secret base! Umm... M-my math homework is really hard... Can you help me out?

login.line: Heed my words, Augur of Destiny! Now that you've discovered my secret base... you may come and hang out any time you want!

mail.line: Huh? How has mail come when my base is secret? Augur of Destiny, do you wield some sort of mail-collecting magic?

main1.line: I'm just trying to put this bandage on to seal my magic as usual... Why can't I get it on today?! Have the late nights working on homework ruined my control over magic?

main2.line: The papers on the slide up there? Heheh, those would be my magical sigils, my plan for justice, and a guide to lead lost lambs... h-heeey! Commander, don't leave!

main3.line: Mmmgh... No matter how I try, I can't do it! Augur of Destiny, hear my command! Wrap my bandages right for me! ...I-I know! This is a TRIAL!

touch.line: Y-you still don't have it wrapped, Commander?

touch2.line: T-time out a sec! Don't tie it theeere!

unlock.line: Why can't I wrap this damn bandage... Hnnngh! Ow, ow, ouch! ...Huh? Comma–A-Augur of Destiny, help me! My magic-suppressing bandages have taken on a mind of their own...!

battle.line: For not fleeing upon seeing my visage, I applaud both your courage and your stupidity.

couple_encourage1.line: After this battle ends, please teach me to make today's lunch.

couple_encourage2.line: Ill suited as I am for an idol's name... Please do not try to call me something cutesy.

couple_encourage3.line: Do remember, trying too hard can sometimes backfire.

detail.line: Z46 is but a codename, not my actual name. For a ship, something like a name should be unimportant, but...

expedition.line: Waiting at the harbor for dispatched ships to return... is something I’ve ever experienced before.

feeling1.line: Perhaps what I seek... cannot be found here.

feeling2.line: The journey to find a name has lead me to this place.

feeling3.line: Friendship, enmity, love, hate... these are things that I have never experienced prior to coming here.

feeling4.line: The sea breeze caressing my cheeks, the crashing of waves resounding in my ear. The laughter echoing on the beach, the footprints left in the sand. The rays of summer shimmering overhead, the fluttering sails of ships about to return... What an unforgettable scenery.

feeling5.line: To be needed, yearned for, trusted, and loved... "I" am a cloth dyed by your color. My beloved, please bestow a name upon me.

home.line: Is the battle over, or has it just begun?

hp_warning.line: What doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.

login.line: This world is so different that from what I was expecting. How interesting!

lose.line: Go and boast to the world. Be proud that you have bested me even once.

mail.line: Receiving mail is proof of the expectations and trust that people have in you.

main1.line: I have experienced neither failure nor suffering. Consequently, I have accomplished nothing.

main2.line: A name is not merely a label. It is also proof that one exists in this world.

main3.line: The things I have yet to experience and understand are as numerous as the countless stars in the night sky.

mission.line: Unknown beings and new acquaintances... let us sally forth to meet them!

mission_complete.line: Freedom and fortune only favor the hardworking.

profile.line: Iron Blood Z-class destroyer, 1936-C Type. Four other sister ships were planned for construction, but only Z47 and I were built. I wasn’t even completed by the end of the war, and was scrapped without ever being finished. One day, I hope to be called not as Z46, but by a true name.

propose.line: My beloved, I have long awaited this day. What name have you decided to bestow upon me?

skill.line: The unworthy are fated to drown in this world.

touch.line: Being able to be touched is proof of one’s existence.

touch2.line: If your desire is righteous, then why do your hands tremble?

unlock.line: Are you the one who summoned me? I am... unfortunately, still without a name. You may call me Z46 for now though.

upgrade.line: Though this is but a trivial thing, I'll return the favor for your consideration.

win_mvp.line: Am I too strong? Or are you all too weak?

gift_prefer.line: With utmost sincerity, I accept your kind wishes.

detail.line: The tide ebbs and flows, leaving behind an unforgettable summer experience.

home.line: Have you prepared yourself? Then let us proceed to our next battlefield. This battle shall thusly be dubbed: "Soaking in the Shallows!"

login.line: The midsummer seaside is full of the unknown... Let's go explore it together!

main1.line: The hot summer and the refreshing ice... what a wonderful contradiction.

main2.line: Trust your instincts and your courage. They will guide you forward.

main3.line: No matter how many times, I will always believe in your words. I can always trust that you will guide me down the right path.

touch.line: I truly do exist, and am needed by everyone...

touch2.line: Why... is there hesitation in your eyes?

unlock.line: The bustling beach, clamoring with waves of joyfulness... experiencing this kind of summer is a first for me, but I don't dislike it...

detail.line: I wish to run as fast as a leopard, and fly to great heights like a soaring bird.

feeling5.line: Whatever color you may wish to bestow upon my existence – be it black, red, or blue, I shall accept it all. My beloved, please bestow upon me my name, the identity you choose to bless me with.

home.line: Steel yourselves for this upcoming battle! Intense fights await, at our next sports meet!

main1.line: To compete with others and prove your worth, through different means than fighting battles... To be crowned "champion," 'tis a great feeling.

main2.line: Even in this little academy, there are so many things to do and see...

main3.line: Whether your sweat is falling on the track, or your words are encouraging others, all of this is an unforgettable experience.

touch.line: Just a small piece of paper... can create such a profound tie between people... this "scavenger hunt" is more interesting than I thought.

touch2.line: Where are your fingers... Is there really anything worth exploring right there?

unlock.line: Through the sweat and tears, striving for your goals. Rejoice in victory, sink within defeat... How fascinating, this "sports meet" may be.

battle.line: In front of tens and thousands of adoring fans... I must do my very best.

detail.line: Countless days and nights of hard work congeal into a single flash of brilliance onstage. Like a shooting star, leaving only a fleeting trail of light—

expedition.line: A commission fleet has returned to port. I wish for them to see me as I am now, as a beloved idol.

feeling5.line: Anxiety and nervousness gather along with the light upon this stage, and the colors of my heart cannot be concealed... O you who I love, are these feelings reaching you?

home.line: The stage is yet another battlefield, where wars are fought not with steel and fire, but with our charm and earnest desire.

login.line: As long as your eyes are fixed upon me; Upon this stage I shall sing bravely.

lose.line: Have my lessons been so insufficient; or are my emotions simply deficient?

main1.line: The star-lit stage is another world of its own, an ajar door to the unknown that now beckons me...

main2.line: My dear friend, there is no reason to worry about me. All of this was made possible by Z23, Z35, Graf Spee, Admiral Hipper... We are all connected by the bonds of the Iron Blood.

main3.line: Take heed of where the other performers and your audience are looking? ...I see. I understand why such a thing is important, but can you explain to me why it is called the "Evil Eye?"

touch.line: My singing voice... is proof of my existence.

unlock.line: Dancing beams of light, shimmering on-stage; uplifted voices, joined as one by song... Upon this unknown stage, my heart doth flutter... Yet this sensation, is quite refreshing.

win_mvp.line: Let us sing this song of celebration; For our friends' displays of dedication.

home.line: I have no desire to be a burden upon my peers... Before devoting myself to this craft, I shall continue to observe.

login.line: I eagerly await the completion of this next piece... It's as if my soul resonates with this craft.

main1.line: The festival to herald the arrival of spring is sanguine, filled with joy, fanfare, and deliciousness. None may resist its delights.

main2.line: Sister of my friend, please wait a bit longer. The preparation process is difficult to control.

main3.line: After this piece is complete, will you mount it? The more delicate the art, the more strict the protection must be...

touch.line: Allow me to complete this seal, and it may be of great use to you.

touch2.line: Are you trying to stick something onto me?

unlock.line: "Jianzhi," the art of breathing life into works of cut paper... is a world beyond my imagination. If these decorations are said to usher in blessings... are they akin to a coat-of-arms or a holy seal?

detail.line: Even Lord Bismarck's statue cannot be cleaned satisfactorily... Too ashamed am I to face my Iron Blood friends, but this war against dust, I shall not suspend.

home.line: Hrmm... The more I clean, the more the dust grows. Will this battle never cease because dust yet remains on my tool's fleece?

login.line: Upon my pride, this dust shall know no succor. Hm? Did I say something weird just now?

main1.line: How does one eradicate something as infinitesimal yet as innumerable as dust? ...It's impossible? That, I cannot accept. To do so would invalidate my very existence.

main2.line: The process of making things beautiful and pure through cleaning is wonderful indeed. Call upon me if there is some place you want cleaned.

main3.line: "If dust is allowed to remain, it will eventually become a mountain." Does this not mean that all the dust I sweep will also become a mountain? I cannot allow that, and that is why I must eradicate it all.

touch.line: The manjuus are doing their best to help out. I would appreciate it if you could do the same.

touch2.line: Oh, thank you. I was just thinking I needed a lift to reach that high spot.

unlock.line: Cast your eyes upon this bit of dust. As I was entrusted with the cleaning, I shall not allow this dust to remain. Will you also join me in this battle?

main1.line: nil

main2.line: nil

main3.line: nil

battle.line: This blows. Let's just get it over with.

couple_encourage1.line: "Bewitching eyes"... That's adorkable.

couple_encourage2.line: "Fellowship of Justice"? When'd you establish a fandom?

couple_encourage3.line: Hey, how do you say this word?

detail.line: I like messaging you by phone. Feels like we're never apart this way.

expedition.line: Commission team's back. I DM'd 'em a "welcome back." Tossed you a DM, too, you know...

feeling1.line: Not even leaving me on read... You're straight-up ignoring me again...

feeling2.line: When you message people daily on this app, a cute li'l rabbit appears and keeps growing. Chat with me every day so the rabbit can grow, Mandy. Pretty please.

feeling3.line: Um... I tossed you DM, so why won't you take your eyes off me? It feels REALLY awkward...

feeling4.line: Mgh... Wearing this eyepatch all day is so tiring. Hm? Hey, don't take it off. It's an essential part of my fit. Appreciate the concern, though. You're really kind, you know that?

feeling5.line: We can both use this app, y'know. To send DM's to each other, to share what we're up to at any given moment... Hm? You don't need an app for that when we're already together all the time? I mean... Yeah, true.

headtouch.line: Will I gain a few inches if you keep headpatting me?

home.line: Look who's finally back. Did you read my DM yet? ...Oh, had your hands full commanding the battle. Fair enoughski.

hp_warning.line: Annoying... So damn stupid...

login.line: You're here, Mandy. I was just browsing the newest hairpins. Look pretty cute, don't they?

lose.line: I didn't feel like actually trying, that's all. It feels cringe.

mail.line: You've got a DM from a stranger. Also a DM from me. Read it.

main1.line: My phone's almost outta battery... Um, Mandy, what should I do? ...What? Charge it up with static electricity? Seriously? Your jokes are so cringe. Although, it did cheer me up a bit, somehow.

main2.line: Mandy, check out this funny meme I found. What? You don't get it? Okay, uh, want me to explain it to you?

main3.line: Hey, uh... Do you think I'm a cold person? I'm not TRYING to be. I just don't know how to talk to people... Really? You don't? Phew, good.

mission.line: You've got unfinished missions? I'll set a few reminder alarms, then.

mission_complete.line: Sooo, about those mission rewards... I should've got 'em all with me...

profile.line: I'm Z47 from the Iron Blood. I like Juustagramming, fashion, and keeping up with trends. IRL convos are my kryptonite, so just shoot me a DM if you need me. Don't worry, I'll see it – you're at the top of my contacts.

propose.line: Whoa... You're gonna repeat what you usually say in DM, but IRL this time... Oh geesh... I-I'mma be real, dumping THAT much love on me all at once is gonna give me an overload...

touch.line: Yeah? Found anything funny?

touch2.line: Whuh? The heck is this...?

unlock.line: I'm Z47. Whew... Do you wanna add each other? Hm? My avatar? It's a black and white kitty. Looks just like my hairpin.

upgrade.line: Can I hurt the baddies more if I get my vroom-vroom on?

win_mvp.line: Victory. Gonna post this to Juustagram and get a ton of likes.

gift_prefer.line: C-can I really have this...? I'm so, so happy...

detail_ex.line: A nickname? I mean, I'm fine with whatever. Z47, Forse, sweetheart, GF... Call me whatever you want.

expedition_ex.line: Yo, commission team's back. I DM'd you about it, but since you check so rarely, I figured I'd notify you the old school way, too.

feeling5_ex.line: Heehee... I hope I'll see you in my dreams by sleeping with you, holding hands... That'll put me in an amazing mood tomorrow.

headtouch_ex.line: Hm? Heehee...

home_ex.line: Oh, Mandy! Yeah, I just dropped my phone to hug you. That's how much I missed you.

login_ex.line: Hey, look who's here. I'll put my phone down if you come and cuddle with me.

main4_ex.line: I, um, found this recipe online and gave it a shot... It's my first try, so I dunno if it's any good... W-wanna give it a taste?

main5_ex.line: Gee, I'd love to watch a movie! If only someone would ask me on a date! I might just put down my phone and say yes! *stares eagerly*...

main6_ex.line: Mandy, check this out. This here's our plans for today – ride a Ferris wheel, munch some marshmallows, and tour the amusement park while holding hands. Sure is a busy schedule, eh? Better set out as soon as we can!

mission_ex.line: Missions, eh. Let's see what's left on the to-do list...

touch_ex.line: Mgh... It might look like I'm always browsing, but truth be told, I'm always thinking about you.

touch2_ex.line: That feels sooo good, Mandy. I want more...

win_mvp_ex.line: I'm the MVP. I'm da best. Heehee.

feeling5.line: Really? You'll piggyback me home to make up for checking out other girls? That's, like... not necessary? Let's just play a li'l longer then hold hands on the way home.

headtouch.line: Ah. This is a breeze to you, I see.

home.line: You'll play on the seesaw with me, won't you? I've still got fun to squeeze out of it.

login.line: This time for sure I'mma plop down and launch you sky high!

main1.line: I can push harder if I take off my shoes? I dunno, sounds like you're trying to trick me.

main2.line: Ugh... *rubs eyes*... My eyepatch? It's got nothing to do with us playing. It's just what's in fashion right now... Use eyedrops if my eyes are hurting? Eyedrops are the LAST thing I'll use, thanks.

main3.line: I'm a bit angy 'cause I can't use my phone during classes. Luckily, playing with you makes me feel all yippee.

touch.line: Easy, Mandy! Take it easy! Whoooaaa!

touch2.line: Mmh... Soft, aren't they?

unlock.line: Mandy, you getting distracted? No looking around on my watch. I've put down my phone for once, and I want you to only look at me while we're on the see-saw.

detail.line: Aaand hit! Sheesh, that one sure went flying... Is that a home run?

feeling5.line: I won! Mandy, did you see that grand slam I pulled off?! ...Hm? Reward me? 'Kay... Then could you hug and carry me back home? I'm all out of juice, so...

headtouch.line: My hair ornaments? Eugen put 'em on for me. You think they're cute? Good. She did say they'd catch your eye when you step up as the pitcher.

home.line: Welcome back, Mandy. The pitcher's mound is free. Oh, don't worry – I'd never let one of my hits hurt you.

login.line: Observe the trajectory... Determine the time to hit... And then... Hiyah! I got it! ...What? Start running? I'm supposed to do a lap around this place?!

main1.line: Kay, I've got the rules all worked out now. You explained 'em way better than the breakdown I found on my phone.

main2.line: So mind-numbing, doing these practice swings by myself... Oh, you'll root for me on the side? I guess that'd be... nice...

main3.line: Yeah, I can bat even with my eyepatch on. Plus, isn't it way more lit if I hit a home run with one eye closed?

touch.line: Aw man, that's my third strike... Does that mean I'm out?

touch2.line: What?! H-hey, we're playing a game here!

unlock.line: Stand here, raise the bat, and do a full swing when the ball comes flying – that's what Mandy just told me. Eyes open... for my full power.

battle.line: Thunderheart, unleash the burst!

couple_encourage1.line: Rawr! How'd I sound?

couple_encourage2.line: Whoa! What energy drink do you drink?

detail.line: Are you a rigging geek, by any chance? I love that stuff, so tell me all you know! ...Uh-huh. Huh? What? Whoa, slow down! You're making it too complicated for me!

expedition.line: The commission team's back! Let me go with them next time! I specialize in long-distance missions, so I swear I'll be useful!

feeling1.line: Listen! You can't keep skipping out on exercise!

feeling2.line: Do you play any sports? ...Ohh, that one! I'm pretty dang good at that, so we should totally play together sometime!

feeling3.line: I applied for the port's parkour contest! Be there and cheer for me! All I need is you in the audience and that first-place spot will be in the bag!

feeling4.line: Regensburg tweaked Thunderheart a bit and now it can read people's minds! Right now, you're thinking about... Huh... Why's it not showing anything? Maybe I gotta get closer... Um, uh, why are you hugging me?

feeling5.line: I'm here, Commander! Need anything? ...So what if it's not a big deal? I'll come running as soon as you call for me, and that's that!

headtouch.line: Did my Thunderheart here catch your eye? Heh, it's a mask that lets me see the essence of everything! Pretty sick, huh? ...How does it do that? I'm, uh, trying to figure that out myself!

home.line: Where'd your sortie take you this time? Ohh, that's a place I've never been before... So, saw anything fun? Had any good food? I can zip-zoom over and have a look!

hp_warning.line: Is my Thunderheart broken or something?

login.line: Oh, you're here! So is all this stuff work that you have to do? Let's see here... Hey, this looks kinda fun! Let me take a shot at it!

lose.line: Are we sortieing, Commander? They run all they want – I'll still catch up and whoop 'em good!

mail.line: Whoosh! Here I am with your letter, Commander!

main1.line: What's that on the ceiling? A bug I've never seen before? Lemme climb up and have a look at– What? DON'T climb the bookshelf?

main2.line: Hey! Commander! There's this dessert that's exploded in popularity! You should try it! I got curious, so I went and bought some from the shopping district! ...Yeah, obviously I ran there!

main3.line: Takeoff! And landing! How was that, Commander? The Kong Vault is pretty sick, huh? Heheh! ...Well, yeah, I'm just practicing. I know I'm not allowed to do parkour in your office!

main4.line: Let's open the window and get some fresh air in. Good air brings good vibes, and good vibes bring... Ow! I got sand in my eye! ...You'll blow it out for me? Umm, thanks... *blushes*

mission.line: You've got new missions, Commander... Hey, how do you do this thing?

mission_complete.line: Great work! I already checked the rewards, so you just lie down and... Huh? I did it wrong? Ugh, alright, then show me how it's done!

profile.line: I'm Z52 from Iron Blood, and long-distance ops are my specialty. I didn't get to fight in the war, but I've done plenty of combat sims! Heehee. Now I'm here to help you out!

propose.line: Oh gosh! I'm the happiest girl alive! Thank you, Commander! I'll treasure it always! ...Commander? Hellooo? Was I too fast with my super happy spin? Oh no! Sorry! I shouldn't have gotten so excited! Sit down and I'll get you some water!

touch.line: What is it? Found any fun stuff? Let me have a look!

touch2.line: Wh-what?! Why are you so keen on touching this?

unlock.line: Z52, reporting for duuuuaaahh! Shouldn't have run so faaast! ...Phew. Hah! So you're the Commander? You look capable enough! Just throw me your orders when you want someone for work or for a fight!

upgrade.line: There's no obstacle I can't run through!

win_mvp.line: Whaddya think? Blows you away how awesome I am, right? Heheh!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh... What is it? Can I open it up right now?

detail_ex.line: Hm? Unusually laid-back today? Well, that's 'cause I was just in a parkour contest and I'm aching for some rest. Besides, isn't it nice to just relax with each other sometimes?

feeling5_ex.line: I swear to keep you safe, Commander! Doesn't matter what enemies or obstacles come your way, I'll drop everything else and come running right to you! And no, I didn't pick that line up from somewhere, that's just how I really, truly feel!

headtouch_ex.line: Yeah! That motivated me! Now I've got the drive to do anything!

home_ex.line: Look ooouuut! ...I had the idea of running out to meet you at max speed, and then you arrived sooner than expected and I couldn't really stop. Heehee...

login_ex.line: I organized your documents, so check and see if– I got it wrong again?! But I worked so hard! Fine... Then show me how to do it right! I'll get it next time, I promise!

main5_ex.line: Zzz... Huh? Did I doze off? Dang it! I promised to help with your work... Wait, was it you who put this blanket on me?

main6_ex.line: So, Commander, U-31 instructed me on how to protect you, and I wanna put it to the test as soon as... Huh? There's no need for that? Why not?

main7_ex.line: Hey, your brow's furrowed. Something on your mind? Come here and let's blow those troubles away! Oh, I know! Wanna go for a run? It'll make you forget all the bad stuff!

main8_ex.line: You hungry, Commander? Want me to go buy you something? How about some crispy chicken or schweinshaxe? With my speed, I guarantee it'll arrive still piping hot!

touch_ex.line: What's that? A scratch? I probably got it while practicing parkour... A band-aid? I don't need one... B-but... Thanks.

touch2_ex.line: Whuh? Yeah, I guess I am pretty big... *blushes*

detail.line: Motorcycles are pretty cool – and more fun than I thought! You should ride with me after I finish work!

feeling5.line: I'll go with you wherever you want – to the shop to chat, on a ride, or even to the raffle! As long as you're jumping for joy by the end of tonight, that's all I care about!

headtouch.line: Is my hair all ruffled up 'cause of my helmet?

home.line: Did you just get here? ...What? You wanted to check if I'd gotten lost? Um, well... Thanks!

login.line: Uhh, just a sec. I'm putting on this anti-slipping silicone tape on my clothes... Yup! I went to the shopping district to buy this stuff, and that's why I was late!

main1.line: I've never worked wearing this outfit before, so it's pretty novel. Wonder what the job itself is about... Hm? You're making a face like you know what! C'mon, tell me!

main2.line: I've wanted to see what it feels like to ride a motorcycle, so I took a ride on one! Buuut... I think I prefer going fast with my own two legs.

main3.line: Oh, these? They're raffle tickets. I brought some, hoping we could check out the raffle event later. Speaking of which, what prizes does the raffle even have?

main4.line: Here! Pick a drink. Z47 said they're both tasty as heck, so I bought one of each!

touch.line: You'll carry my stuff for me? Thanks!

touch2.line: Th-that's where you stick the tape? I thought it should go on my clothes...

unlock.line: Let's see... Where's the shop again? It should be... Oh, Commander! I'm not late, am I? I ran here as fast as I could!

detail.line: I got my hands on new gear! Isn't this surfboard the coolest thing ever? Hehe, wanna see just how fast I can surf on this baby?

feeling5.line: Don't worry, Commander! Even if you come empty-handed, I'll have everything you could ever need! Ehehe, let's keep speeding ahead together from now on!

headtouch.line: Whoa?! M-my hat's gonna blow awaaay! Hehe... Thanks for catching it, Commander!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! The sunlight is strong today – let's go snorkeling! See? I brought diving gear, too!

login.line: Whoosh... I'm here! Are you ready to go swimming with me? Hm? Don't worry! I brought plenty of gear! Let's get going already!

main1.line: What do you feel like doing now, Commander? Roller skating, surfing, or snorkeling? Oh, hey, let's just do all of them! Go, go, go!

main2.line: Can we try tandem surfing together? Just relax and hold on to my waist. Here we go!

main3.line: If you go fast enough, you can leave all your troubles in the sea! Let's pick up the pace, Commander! ...Huh? Did you say something? I'm going too fast! I can't hear you!

touch.line: Which gear do you want? Hurry and choose so we can go!

touch2.line: Whoa?! C-Commander?! Th-this isn't how you play in the ocean...

unlock.line: Whoooa! Commander, watch out! Phew... Good thing I didn't crash into you. Good reflex... Oh! Since we're here, why don't you come play in the water with me?

battle.line: I don't have time to waste on you small fry.

detail.line: What's your deal? ...Oh, I know! You're madly in love, and now you can't take your eyes off me? You should've just said so~

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Aren't you going to check what they brought back?

feeling1.line: *sigh*... This is all you've got? You're nothing like the stories claim.

feeling2.line: You're in luck, Commander. It's not every day someone as cute and talented as me joins your fleet. Heehee~♪

feeling3.line: I wish we shipgirls could all move underwater like submarines. Still, better to move freely on the water than to be stuck on land like you. Heehee~

feeling4.line: Hey! Who left this thing lying in the corridor? Someone could trip and get hurt! ...I don't need your help! I'm not some klutz who stumbles everywhere she goes!

feeling5.line: Hey, why don't we go on a date today? ...Did that really throw you for a loop? Hah, I knew it would... W-wait, you have a list of spots to go? You prepared all that in advance?! Ugh... Okay, you got me this time...

headtouch.line: What are you even trying to do?

home.line: How was your sortie? The breeze didn't get to your head, did it? Good to hear.

hp_warning.line: Nobody warned me the enemy was THIS strong!

login.line: Put your nose to the grindstone, Commander, and you may just impress your secretary.

lose.line: How could I have messed up so badly?! This has to be some kind of mistake!

mail.line: You're really so helpless you need your secretary to fetch your mail, huh... W-wait, didn't I get this just a minute ago?

main1.line: Wrong document. Not this one either. Where is that damn... ARGHHH! Now they're all out of order!

main2.line: You keep a bunch of spare uniforms around, don't you? 'Cause if you get splashed by a wave during a sortie, well... Heehee♪

main3.line: Looks like some paperwork is too troublesome even for the legendary Commander~ Let me see at what's so hard about... Err, yeah, this is all nonsense to me...

mission.line: This mission should be a cakewalk for you, no?

mission_complete.line: You STILL haven't touched your mission rewards... It's nearly been a whole day now!

profile.line: Feast your eyes. You're looking at none other than Type 1937J destroyer Otto von Alvensleben! Well, what do you think? Why are you being so silent? This is the part where you're supposed to heap praise upon me!

propose.line: Whoa, whoa, whoa! This is WAY too sudden! I-I mean, not that I don't want to... No, that doesn't mean I don't mind! Ugh... You're obviously teasing me, but why am I fine with that?!

skill.line: Think you can keep up with me?

touch.line: Hmm? Wow, Commander, I never thought you wanted to do "that" with me~?

touch2.line: W-wait, time out! Y-you can't be serious about this, right?!

unlock.line: Oh? I've heard no shortage of heroic tales about you, but you sure look spindly in person. Then again, I suppose it only makes sense for you chessmasters to be more brain than brawn. I'm Otto von Alvensleben, Iron Blood destroyer. Let's see what you can do.

upgrade.line: In a real rush to make me stronger, huh? Heehee♪

win_mvp.line: I could do this with my eyes closed.

gift_prefer.line: This is pretty nice. I think I'll take it~

login_ex.line: Well, well, if it isn't you. Are you gonna try to impress me with your hustle again?

main4_ex.line: A table of contents... Not a bad idea. I can sort them according to their listed order, and... W-wait, my labels are all wrong?

main5_ex.line: Being the secretary's easy! Whatever problems come our way, you solve them... Come again? Oh, I'm not saying my hands are free, not at all!

touch_ex.line: Wh-what are you driving at?

touch2_ex.line: I already know there's no beating you...

battle.line: No other choice– gotta fight like this!

detail.line: Grrr... Once I find out who's behind this prank, they'll have hell to pay!

home.line: Had your fun? Hmph, I can tell you've been messing around with a bunch of girls.

login.line: Morning, Commander. I feel on top of the world today, so don't worry about me. Yeah, I... I'm totally fine...

mail.line: Yeah, you've got new mail... But do I look like I'm in any position to fetch it for you...?

main1.line: Why are you just standing there watching me? Is this funny to you– watching me struggle, trying to break free?

main2.line: There's a sign outside, warning people to stay away because of traps? S-someone must've put that up AFTER I got ensnared! There's no way in hell I didn't see it!

main3.line: Hmph. This isn't a problem if I imagine it's a quirky hammock. I'm resting here, that's all... Ugghh... G-get the sun out of my eyes...

mission_complete.line: You finished a mission? So? What's that got to do with my situation?

touch.line: St-stop shaking the vines!

touch2.line: Th-th-there's a line, and you've crossed it!

unlock.line: Hmph! You really think this brainless trap can keep me entangled forever? I don't need your help! I can break free by myself! ...Umm, what the hell? Why can't I do it?!

battle.line: Y-you're telling me to fight like THIS?!

detail.line: Hrrnngghh! Agh... This dumb tape gets tighter the harder I try to break it! Commander, I'm gonna tire myself out if you don't help me soon!

headtouch.line: Huh?! I know you did that on purpose! And I'm powerless to resist... Stop ruffling up my hair!

home.line: You're finally back, Commander! So, did you find a way to help me with this? You didn't? Okay, well... Huh?! Why do you need me to tell you why I bound myself up?!

login.line: Commander! Why are you just staring? Long story short, I ended up like this by accident! There's no kinky reason for it! Ugh! Stop wondering about it and just undo these binds!

mail.line: A new letter? I'll go and get it for you if you'll help me with... Huh? You just want me to read it aloud to you?!

main1.line: Why there's a pillow on the sofa? I think it's pretty obvious! It's so my head won't hurt while holding this pose and... Wait, were you goading me into saying it?!

main2.line: Commander! You've been staring for a while now! Have you still not figured it out?

main3.line: (Ugh. It's so humiliating to be seen like this. I doubt I'll be able to free myself, so I'll just have to rely on the Commander... but I don't want it to be known how I ended up like this. What should I do?!)

touch.line: So you finally figured out what to do! I knew I could count on... What? Why am I bound even tighter than before?!

touch2.line: Eek! H-how could you do this to someone who's in need of help?!

unlock.line: Urgh... I can't get them off... Huh?! C-Commander?! When did you get here?! This just, um... It just kind of happened! Help me get loose!

upgrade.line: I should be able to break free now that I'm stronger... Okay, that's tight!

battle.line: It's time to see what we learned from our training... and make our enemies tremble before us!

detail.line: Remember, it’s unwise to place too much faith into the numbers.

expedition.line: The girls have returned from commissions. Please welcome them back in a timely manner.

feeling1.line: Alright, time for me to punish you.

feeling2.line: Hey! What were you trying to do? Don't be shy... just tell me.

feeling3.line: And I thought you were a good child, Commander... I guess you can still be trained... Hehe...

feeling4.line: Hmm? I do you like you very much, in many different ways... I'm going to teach you all kinds of things from now on... Hehe...

feeling5.line: To train someone, the trainer must also give the trainee some love, otherwise... Yes, Commander, I love you. Come, let's continue. What should we try next?

home.line: Good work, Commander. Let’s quickly review the previous battle.

login.line: Now then, let us begin today’s training.

lose.line: Tsk... Do we still not have enough anti-air?

mail.line: Remember to read new mail as soon as possible. It’s rude to make people wait.

main1.line: Making an expression like that... are you after some of big sister’s rough affection?

main2.line: You should never ask about a woman’s age, Commander.

main3.line: Whipping doesn’t actually hurt that much once you’re used to it. Want to give it a go?

mission.line: Let's see what mission is up next.

mission_complete.line: Oh? Mission complete? Well done, Commander. Don't forget to collect your rewards!

profile.line:
I'm the first ship of the Königsberg-class light cruisers, Königsberg. I began serving in the Iron Blood Navy a long time ago.
I've participated in far more training and transporting missions than actual combat, so feel free to refer to me as your teacher. Understood?

propose.line: Commander, you’re the best! The best what? Pet? Companion? Or maybe... lover~?

skill.line: Hmm, do you want some lessons from me too?

touch.line: Oh? You seem fairly energetic today. Let's do some more training.

touch2.line: Oh my? That’s not how you do it. Should I teach you the proper way to touch a girl?

unlock.line: So you’re the commander? You have such a cute face! Hehe... let big sister take "good care" of you from now on~

upgrade.line: I think I get the hang of it! Commander, come with me for a second!

win_mvp.line: Hmph, so that’s all they amounted to.

gift_prefer.line: You seem to always know what a girl wants~ I shall accept this, then.

battle.line: Let me show you my true power... Here I come!

detail.line: Ahaha~ Are you that interested in me,  Commander?

expedition.line: The girls have returned from commission! Let's go welcome back our money- I mean... the girls!

feeling1.line: I don't want to play with you anymore...

feeling2.line: Wow~! Are you here to play with me, Commander?

feeling3.line: I don't like being cooped up in the house, nor do I like that pesky Truant! When I look at it that way... isn't this my destiny?

feeling4.line: My chest tightens whenever I think about you, Commander. Why is that?

feeling5.line: I asked my sister about it, and she said that this feeling is called "love." It feels a bit painful, but it also makes me very happy.

home.line: Good work, Commander~! Why not take a break... and play with me!

login.line: Ehehe... I have a feeling something good will happen today!

lose.line: Uu... I let my guard down...

mail.line: There's new mail! I wonder who it is?

main1.line: La~ la~ la~ When is the next battle?

main2.line: Is.. is there a storm coming?

main3.line: Boring~ boring! How do you expect me to stay quiet?

mission.line: Mission~ Mission~ It's time to make some money~!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Hurry up, let's collect those rewards!

profile.line: I am the second ship of the Königsberg-class light cruisers, Karlsruhe! I participated in battles as the flagship of an Iron Blood torpedo squadron. I hate cold weather, storms, and that pesky Truant...

propose.line: I feel happy whenever I think about you, but I miss you whenever I can't see you. Overall, I'm still glad that I fell in love with you!

skill.line: I have a feeling this one's gonna hit!

touch.line: Nyahaha! That tickles!

touch2.line: Nya? Why do I feel so hot where you touched me...?

unlock.line: Hi, it's me, Karlsruhe! Please take good care of me, Commander.

upgrade.line: I've found the strength to continue exploring afar.

win_mvp.line: Eh? I won?

gift_prefer.line: Yaaay! You're the best, Commander!

login.line: Commander, let's put our best foot forward and work hard today!

main2.line: I'll give any storm a good thrashing! Hyaah!

main3.line: Commander, are you interested in me? Ehehe, us Königsberg sisters are famous for our good looks~!

touch.line: Did you call? If you want to play, I'm down any time!

unlock.line: Commander, take a look at my new rigging! Doesn't it look all shiny and strong? Now, I feel like I can weather any storm... probably!

battle.line: Enemy fleet spotted! Prepare torpedoes!

detail.line: Commander, what kind of data are you looking for?

expedition.line: Your fleet has returned from their commission. Should I join you for the inspection?

feeling1.line: Workplace harassment is a crime, Commander...

feeling2.line: Is there anything that I can help with? Please let me know.

feeling3.line: I'm so glad that you are an approachable superior. I can't really handle short-tempered people.

feeling4.line: To... to prevent you from harassing my sisters... I-I will... (blushes)

feeling5.line: J-jeez... Am I really the only one who can rein you in, Commander? Just let me handle all your affairs, private or public. Wh-what? I'm not trying to make you my property!

home.line: Good work, Commander. The next thing on the agenda is...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Here is today's schedule. Please look it over.

lose.line: Ugh... I failed again. P-please don't dismantle me...

mail.line: There's new mail for you, Commander. Please take a look.

main1.line: Ah... We went over budget again this month...

main2.line: Königsberg, stop teasing the Commander! Be careful or you might just awaken some weird fetish of his...

main3.line: Karlsruhe, Commander is very busy right now. Can't you stop bothering him and just play by yourself?

mission.line: New missions have been posted. Shall I add them to today's schedule?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Shall I take an inventory of the rewards?

profile.line:
I'm the third ship of the Königsberg-class light cruisers, Köln. Our slender bodies are something that we're all very proud of.
I once circumnavigated the world, and participated in operations in the Baltic Sea and North Sea. You can count on me for any type of operations, defense or assault!

propose.line: With this... I can get much closer to Commander! A-ahem... it's nothing! Thank you, Commander, I won't let you down.

touch.line: Eh? New instructions, Commander?

touch2.line: Commander... You realize that harrassing one's subordinates is despicable, right?

unlock.line: You seem like a wise Commander. I'm Köln. Please rest assured and let me take care of your work.

upgrade.line: Commander, you're a very kind person... for taking care of your subordinates.

win_mvp.line: Phew... This performance... should be acceptable?

gift_prefer.line: I-is it really okay for me to accept this?

detail.line: Data aside, if there's anything else you'd like to know, please don't hesitate to ask.

login.line: Today's task list. I've taken the liberty of sorting them in order of priority. Please review them.

main1.line: Detailed planning ensured the efficient completion of one's work. Commander, next on the list is――

main2.line: Such desk work demands a quiet and peaceful atmosphere. Well, I suppose that means I should hope my sisters don't come barging in...

main3.line: Commander, what would you say to coming by the Tactical Classroom to observe some lessons in your free time?

touch.line: Don't you have more important things to be doing than staring at me or chatting with me?

touch2.line: ...From time to time, one should consider the rumors spreading around the port about oneself, Commander...

unlock.line: Hmm... I feel like I can work even more efficiently than before. Commander, please rest assured, I will never betray your expectations.

battle.line: Ahh~! I'm so nervous I could faint...

detail.line: C-commander... Please don't stare at me...

expedition.line: Ah, Commander! Fishy told me that the girls have returned from their commission...

feeling1.line: Stay... stay away...!

feeling2.line: Commander, y-you called for me? Ah... a d-d-date??! ... (faints)

feeling3.line: I won't faint anymore after I've gotten used to it... Also, Commander, being with you... makes me really happy.

feeling4.line: For the longest time, only Fishy would keep me company. Commander... for you to accept me... I'm so happy!

feeling5.line: Fishy... you're on lookout duty... I've got something very important to tell Commander... Don't let anyone in...

home.line: Commander's aroma is so calming...

login.line: Wel... welcome back, Commander. I've arranged your documents...

lose.line: Wah... I'll be bitten... It's scary! I'm not going!

mail.line: Commander, Fishy brought in some new mail...

main1.line: Eek! I think I saw something...

main2.line: I'll... I'll try my best!

main3.line: Commander... is there anything else I can help with?

mission.line: Commander... you've been assigned new missions...

mission_complete.line: Ah- Wah! Commander, your rewards have arrived...

profile.line:
Um... I'm... Leipzig, the first ship of the Leipzig-class...
One time, I collided with Eugen because of some thick fog... I hope she doesn't still hate me...

propose.line: I'm so glad that you returned my feelings, Commander. I'll do my best... not to faint in front of you anymore.

touch.line: Is this training for learning how to not faint? I'll.. see what I can do...

touch2.line: Uuu... I really won't be able to move like this... what should I do?

unlock.line: Co- Commander... I'm Leipzig. I black out frequently due to malnutrition, but... I'll do my best to finish the tasks assigned to me...

upgrade.line: Th-thanks for your concern, Commander!

win_mvp.line: I feel stronger with Commander around...

gift_prefer.line: Haah~ Th-thank you so much, Commander! I'm so happy I might faint...

battle.line: I'm still a bit nervous, but... I'll do my best!

detail.line: Commander... Um, could you look at the pamphlet instead of at me...?

expedition.line: Did Fishy go to welcome the commission fleet back...?

feeling5.line: Err, umm... If you're ready, I'd be glad to take your order, Commander... I'd like to know more about your tastes, and what you like... Th-that's okay, isn't it?

home.line: Commander, you must be tired from your battle! Um... Why don't you come in and relax for a bit?

login.line: W-welcome home, Master! ...Um, w-would you like to take a look at our menu?

lose.line: I'm so sorry, Commander... I, I'll do better next time!

mail.line: The mail's here. Thank you, Miss Eugen!

main1.line: What happened to Fishy? Um, I asked Miss Eugen to take care of it...

main2.line: Eat well, rest well, and... then you'll never be defeated in battle, right...?

main3.line: Commander, um, are you sure you're okay with me? Someone else will take over the shift soon according to the schedule...

touch.line: Do you need me to get you another menu...?

touch2.line: ...You'll be okay, Leipzig... You'll be okay!!

unlock.line: Commander, ah, um... We have all new items on the menu, and they're on sale for a limited time only... P-please give them a try! Phew... Th-thank goodness, I managed to not flub it...

win_mvp.line: It's all because everyone was with me... including you too, Commander!

battle.line: I'm pretty nervous... but I'll do my best!

detail.line: Fishy looks a bit intimidating, but he's really kind! ... Well... I might be the only one he's kind to... Sorry...

expedition.line: Commander, would you mind if I took Fishy with us on a walk to the harbor? The commission team returned, and I want to go greet them.

login.line: Phew... Commander, I, I organized your files!

lose.line: I'm so sorry, Commander... I-I'll try harder next time!

main1.line: You're right, a nutritious diet is important... Do you have any... um, yummy recommendations...?

main2.line: Despite how Fishy looks, he really does have his own thoughts and feelings. But it seems I'm the only person who understands what he says...

main3.line: It's okay, Fishy. Commander is just a little busy right now...

mission.line: C-Commander...! Commandeeeer! Don't forget your missions!

mission_complete.line: Commander, Fishy brought us the mission rewards. Thank you, Fishy~

touch.line: Unghh... Get a grip, me! I can't faint now...!

touch2.line: Eek! I-I managed to not faint...! Thank you, Commander!

unlock.line: I feel like Fishy is a lot more capable than before, but I don't feel much different... M-maybe Fishy was the one to get a retrofit instead of me?!

battle.line: Everyone, p-please exercise your own judgment...?

couple_encourage1.line: Let's focus on the fight!

detail.line: Why are you here by yourself, Commander? ...W-were you perhaps waiting for everyone else to leave...?! Oh, you weren't?

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. You should know what to do without me reminding you, right?

feeling1.line: You... really are an eyesore...
