feeling2.line: I wonder if Leipzig fell down somewhere... Commander, let's go look for her... I mean, would you like to come with me?

feeling3.line: You want me to teach you how to make Brötchen? I don't mind, but I must warn you that I have high standards... Wait, are you perhaps using this as an excuse to get closer to me...?!

feeling4.line: Commander, we've been spending more and more time together recently... Ugh, you really were planning something weird after all... At this rate, I... I'll be... Fine with it...?

feeling5.line: Now that I think about it more, Commander, you haven't tried doing anything weird to me. If anything, you've treated me really nicely and it's somehow reassuring to be with you... Even if you tried to have your way with me, I don't think I'd... Wh-wh-wh-what am I saying?! P-please forget I ever said anything...!

headtouch.line: Eek?! Suddenly touching my head like that... Commander, you're thinking of doing something weird, aren't you...?! Am, am I wrong?

home.line: I know you're tired from your sortie, Commander, but please hang in there a bit longer for everyone else's sake... I mean, if you could...

hp_warning.line: Ah... Oww...

login.line: It is time to begin working. C-Commander, please give it your all...!

lose.line: How could this happen... It surely must've been my fault... I'm so sorry...

mail.line: You have new mail, Commander. I hope it's not a glitter bomb...

main1.line: Commander, do you like Brötchen? I see... Th-then, if work goes well, I... I'll make some for you!

main2.line: I wonder if there's anything that can be done about Leipzig always collapsing... Ph-physical exercises, you say? Commander, are you planning to do something weird to Leipzig?!

main3.line: Am I being too hard on you? What should I do... If I was to make you upset with me... W-well, I'm sure it's fine, since you're probably thinking up all kinds of weird things right now...!

mission.line: There's a new mission, Commander. Did you get the previous one sorted out yet?

mission_complete.line: Did you finish all your missions? As expected of the commander...

profile.line: Though I received many modifications during the war, I never was able to put any of it to good use... But, there aren't many ships in the Iron Blood with longer service histories than me? I, I can't even believe it myself...

propose.line: I, I know already... I'll do whatever you say... so please don't look at me! It's embarrassing... So embarrassing that it's driving me crazy... I, I wish this would end already! ...Hauu...

touch.line: Are... are you trying to condition me to be less cautious by touching me...?!

touch2.line: Aaah?! Wh-what are you doing all of a sudden, Commander?!

unlock.line: I am the second ship of the Leipzig-class, Nürnberg. Starting today, I shall serve you to the best of my abilities... Is that acceptable?

upgrade.line: I hope all this hard work pays off...

win_mvp.line: Huh? I'm number one? That's rather... unexpected, isn't it?

gift_prefer.line: It looks so expensive... Are you really giving this to me?

battle_ex.line: Commander, your orders please...!

headtouch_ex.line: Hyah?! H-how many times have I told you not to suddenly pat my head! You're going to give me weird ideas... Hwaaah?! I, I didn't say anything!!

login_ex.line: Come on, Commander, let's do our best in service of the fleet today! I'll be right there at your side!

main1_ex.line: The brötchen...? No, it's not ready yet! I don't care who it is, you'll have to wait two more minutes!

main3_ex.line: Slacking off again? Looks like I'll have to give you some p-punishment... Hauu...

touch_ex.line: Ngh... This is just... accidental contact... There's no deeper meaning to this...!

win_mvp_ex.line: I'm number one! Ehehe... Wh-what's wrong with gloating every now and then?!

detail.line: Hmm... Commander, can you come help me pick out a good souvenir for everyone back in the Iron Blood?

home.line: Commander, please hang in there a bit longer. Let's take a break after we get to the next destination.

login.line: Commander, let's head out if you've already finished getting ready? There are lots of places I'd like to go today.

mail.line: Commander, why don't we write a postcard as well?

main1.line: I wish Leipzig was here as well... Well, she's never been good with crowded places though...

main2.line: I never knew the Sakura Empire's food was this delicious... Yeah, I'll have to ask my friends how to make these.

main3.line: The Sakura Empire's traditional outfits are so beautiful... Eek?! Commander?! Where were you staring at just now?!

touch.line: Y-you want to hold my hand?! ...Are you sure it's just so we don't get separated...?

unlock.line: Since you so readily accepted my invitation to go on a vacation together, you must be planning to... Ahh, what I meant is, we can leave at any time if you're ready...!

battle.line: Go get 'em! Follow my lead!

couple_encourage1.line: Gauntlet gang, represent!

couple_encourage2.line: You know ninjutsu? The real deal?

detail.line: Why do I run like that? Ah, well, I was inspired by a comic I read. Makes me look pretty badass, doesn't it?

expedition.line: Heads up, Commander! Commish team's back, so you know what that means!

feeling1.line: You're pissin' me off to no end. Either sort yourself out, or leave me the hell alone!

feeling2.line: Swamped with work, I'm guessin'? Need a hand? Fighting's not all I'm good for – I can do simple paperwork too, y'know.

feeling3.line: To what do I owe this cuppa joe? ...The paperwork I did earlier? Ahahah, thanks! I'll have just a dash of milk.

feeling4.line: Let's not think in terms of favors-for-favors and just help each other out when we need it, like homies do! Nice and simple that way, too!

feeling5.line: Nobody matches my wavelength better than you. You and I, we're the OTP... Oh, guess that also makes us the port's number one power couple!

headtouch.line: Huh? The hell are you doin'?

home.line: Sweet, you're back. Run into any tough foes out there?

hp_warning.line: I take hits like this for breakfast! Try harder!

login.line: Aw yeah, I'm feelin' it today! Let's knock out all the paperwork in one go!

lose.line: Welp, guess this one's fubared. My bad...

mail.line: New mail, yo! You really oughta make it a habit to check your mailbox.

main1.line: Hooh! Hah! And just for good measure... Whupah! Suddenly felt like doing a backflip, that's all. Hope I didn't startle ya there.

main2.line: If I catch you slackin', your forehead's getting a whackin'. Relaaaax, I'll be gentle.

main3.line: I just want the next chapter of this comic I'm reading to come out! But it's a weekly release, so all I can do is wait...

mission.line: Guess what – new missions just dropped. We doin' 'em, or?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! You gonna do the math for my share of the rewards next? Hahah.

profile.line: I'm Magdeburg, Iron Blood light cruiser. Don't got much of a record to boast about, but meh, what matters is the fact I'm here right now. If you need a problem fixed or someone's ass kicked, hit me up!

propose.line: Honestly, I didn't plan for this at all... I doubt I've even got the kind of charm you deserve. No, no, I'm not turnin' you down! I absolutely love you, it's just... Well... Ahh, to hell with it! I can't find the right words!

skill.line: Open up for a knuckle sandwich! ...Err, I mean a cannon volley!

touch.line: You wanna bump fists? Aight! Bam!

touch2.line: I'll choose to believe that was just an accident...

unlock.line: Yo! Iron Blood light cruiser Magdeburg here! Gimme a fistbump to celebrate us becomin' homies! Wait, uhh... Got these metal gauntlets on, so go easy for your own sake.

upgrade.line: Send me into battle and we'll find out if I really got stronger or not!

win_mvp.line: Hell yeah! This calls for a victory somersault!

gift_prefer.line: Woah, you're giving me something real amazing! I'll have to think of some way to return the favor.

detail_ex.line: Too slow, Commander! Hahaha! To be fair, keepin' up with my pace ain't easy. I can teach you a way to run faster, if you're interested.

feeling5_ex.line: Now that we've gone from homies to like, hand-holding homies, I don't know where to take things from here... "Don't worry about it?" Yeah, guess you're right! We got to this point by just going with the flow, so let's stick to that!

headtouch_ex.line: Huh? Uhh... Guess I don't mind...

home_ex.line: Good, you're back! I won't even have to lift a finger if you keep this performance up! Ahahaha!

login_ex.line: Oh yeah, I'm in the zone! So, what are we doin' today, buddy?

main4_ex.line: Commander, why don't ya try a somersault for yourself? Don't be scared now, I'll catch you to make sure you don't get hurt.

main5_ex.line: You slackin' again? Heheh, well, that's a forehead-flicking right there! ...Oh, crap, did I overdo it? Sorry, buddy. I'll go easy on ya next time.

mission_ex.line: Every new mission's a new challenge! C'mon, let's get it done!

touch_ex.line: Brofist coming at you! Intercept! Hahahaha!

touch2_ex.line: Hm? Whuh...? I can't put my finger on what I'm feeling here...

battle.line: First thing's first – these meddlesome assholes have got to go!

detail.line: You being a cute li'l cat doesn't change the fact you've been naughty. Learned your lesson yet? Good, then don't let that happen again.

expedition.line: Commish team has returned? Ah, crap! I'd better put on some coffee, quick!

feeling5.line: First these li'l cats make a mess of the place, then I'm forced to lecture 'em on it. Pain in my ass... Ahem. Listen... If I ever end up doing something similar to these guys... would you try to... N-nah, never mind I said anything!

headtouch.line: I'm trying to clean here, dammit!

home.line: Your battle's already over, while there's no end in sight to mine... *sigh*...

login.line: Wish I could say "I'll be right with you!" but I've got this mess to deal with... Ugh, this sucks ass.

lose.line: Aw damn. I blew it...

mail.line: Left your mail on the desk. Don't forget to read it.

main1.line: Okay, cats can be kinda cute when they're behaving... But that's how they getcha! You let your guard down, and that's when they strike!

main2.line: Ulrich, come gimme a hand here... Whaddya mean no way?! Just 'cause they refuse to play with you?!

main3.line: I don't mind helping 'round the café, but I never signed up to clean messes like this... I figured cats would be, y'know, cute and docile...

mission.line: Commander and I are leavin' to take care of a new mission. You cats better behave while we're out!

mission_complete.line: Whew... That's that mission done. Now to focus on this again...

touch.line: You're gonna help me out? Great, thanks!

touch2.line: What, you trying to get me to grab you by the neck like this cat here?

unlock.line: You little...! Look what a damn mess you made! And I'm the one who's gotta clean it up now! ...Oh. Perfect timing, Commander. Could use a hand with the floor here, after what this little turd did.

win_mvp.line: Victory is meowrs! ...N-no! Slip of the tongue, that's all...

battle.line: On me!

detail.line: Seagulls in the sky, salty breezes down below. I've seen 'em tons of times in comics before, and I guess the real deal's just what you'd expect... Hey, let's climb a mountain on our next vacay!

expedition.line: Commish team's back in port. Enough cloudgazin', Commander, let's go see 'em!

home.line: Good work, homie! C'mere and recharge those batteries with an ice-cold soda!

login.line: Our goal today is just to have a real good time! Got it? Ya can't go thinkin' 'bout work all day long.

lose.line: I messed up bigtime... Sorry...

main1.line: Look at this dope view... Ya tend to overlook Mother Nature if ya don't stop and smell the roses! I'mma invite Bismarck and company here sometime.

main2.line: Why you checkin' out my hands? ...Hm? Guess it is your first time seein' 'em without gauntlets on! Ahahahah!

main3.line: Much as I love sunbathing, ya gotta wear sunscreen if ya don't want a nasty sunburn. Hold still for a sec and I'll put some on your back.

mission.line: New missions just arrived. Time to change gears and get 'em done!

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished! The fruits of our labor are waitin', homie.

touch.line: You gonna rub sunscreen on me? Thanks, homie!

touch2.line: Wow, you sure got some nerve...

unlock.line: Here's an idea – how 'bout putting down the camera and actually enjoyin' the open sea? I'll move the swim ring so you can chill in the breeze with me!

win_mvp.line: Aww yeah! Gimme a victory brofist!

battle.line: An entertaining battle awaits us♡

detail.line: "Don't assume I'm fond of you, pitiable human." You have the sweet scent of a bud that wishes to blossom, dear human. The kind of scent that Emden adores.

expedition.line: New supplies have arrived. A traveling swan needs sustenance – when her stomach growls, she has little choice but to "borrow" food from a passerby.

feeling1.line: Oh dear. It seems Emden got carried away. Such a pity... Her only darling human, broken by her own hands.

feeling2.line: A lovable pet should not be unwaveringly obedient, but rather a source of continued delight to its master. "Fawn on me in a way I enjoy, my sweet human♪"

feeling3.line: Insistent on being a disobedient little human, aren't you? "I like seeing a sweet human struggle so. Heehee."

feeling4.line: "In truth, Emden has wanted to shackle you down from the outset, human." Obedience gained by force is worthless. I shall patiently wait for you to submit to me of your own accord, my darling human.

feeling5.line: One finds the world's greatest comfort not in a cage of steel, but in a cradle of love and submission. Have no fear, my darling human. Give your body and soul to Emden, and your woes and troubles will all disappear in due time♡

headtouch.line: Why do you stroke my head? That is something a master does to her pet. Perhaps what you did was the inverse of this idea?

home.line: You've returned to safety, now won't you close your eyes and rest? It's important that you get your beauty sleep, my darling human.

hp_warning.line: If you wish to defeat Emden, you must use your every drop of strength♪

login.line: Welcome home, my darling human. Where shall your conquest take you today, and what foes shall you smite?

lose.line: One can hardly call this a desired outcome, dear human. "I get the impression you ordered a sortie without a moment of preparation."

mail.line: You have a letter, dear human. Would you be good and read it aloud to Emden?

main1.line: Trying to make a human submit through force only gains you its resentment. Only by breaking the human's spirit can you make its whole being your own.

main2.line: "When you're at a loss, how about you get up and move instead of just sitting in your chair?" Emden cannot bear to see you rack your brains all day, dear human. Heehee.

main3.line: You, my dear hardworking human, deserve a reward. You are hereby granted the privilege of massaging Emden's shoulders. Use neither too little nor too much force, and henceforth, kindly do it without me telling you to first.

mission.line: New orders from your superiors. Supposing that someday no one is left to give you orders, where will you go then, dear human?

mission_complete.line: Ah, mission rewards. Emden need not tell you how best to use them, right, my darling human?

profile.line: I am the Swan of the East, also known as Emden, the Dresden-class light cruiser. "And I am Emden of the Königsberg class – member of the High Seas Fleet. We are Emden. Remember our name."

propose.line: Have you at long last learned your place? Heehee, as much as I enjoy seeing your cute struggling, you're more lovely when you submit♡ Now, lie in my cradle of love and embrace an eternal slumber. "Emden will cuddle you forever and ever. You won't want to leave♥"

touch.line: You would use force to subjugate a defenseless girl? Heehee, unfortunately for you, Emden stands on top, and you crawl down below, dear human. This is an unchangeable fact.

touch2.line: Is this your way of saying that you long to be put in a cage? "Do you wish to be flayed 'til your skin gives way to bone?"

unlock.line: Heehee, it is you that summoned Emden, isn't it, my darling human? I shall make real your every desire if only you surrender yourself. "Heehee. Submit to Emden. Submit to us."

upgrade.line: Thank you for this strength, my darling human. "You make good decisions sometimes! Heeheehee♪"

win_mvp.line: The battle is over. All you who are out of Emden's range may now take your leave.

gift_prefer.line: You certainly know how to work for my affection now, my darling human~

detail_ex.line: Yees? What does my beloved, darling human need of Emden? Based on that lonely look... I assume you yearn for my lips♡ "Or maybe what you want is to be held in Emden's embrace? Heehee~"

headtouch_ex.line: "You're starting to like your own subordinacy, aren't you? Heehee~"

home_ex.line: Oh, I wonder how I shall nurse my dear tired human♡ "Only Emden may decide – you have no say in this matter, human♥"

login_ex.line: "You're late, human. How are you going to make it up to Emden, hmm?" Emden hopes for an apology through your words and actions, darling. Heehee♡

lose_ex.line: I had high hopes for you... Alas, it seems your charm is your only merit, my dear human.

main4_ex.line: The smell of guilt is in the air... Emden can read your mind like an open book, human." Emden graciously accepts the fact that you're procrastinating, darling♡

main5_ex.line: Come hither, my darling human. Heehee♪ I see you're still reluctant to receive a headpatting♡

main6_ex.line: "Hard at work, I see. You must be dying to experience Emden's punishment. Heehee~ You do find such joy in it, after all♥"

mission_ex.line: "Nobody can impede your progress... but Emden is a different case. Now go and finish your missions, wretched human♥"

touch_ex.line: Have you forgotten, my dear human? The use of force will not change your standing in relation to Emden. "Or are you implying you've come to enjoy this arrangement?"

touch2_ex.line: "You're just begging to be spoiled, human♥" Emden shall caress you until you're whisked away to sleep♡

win_mvp_ex.line: "Nothing beats reducing an eyesore of an opponent to dust♥" Your sinking shall further my dear human's and my glory♡

detail.line: What you see is not theatrics, my darling human. Emden has merely adopted a more suitable form for handling a vassal. Vampirism has nothing to do with it. Heehee♡

expedition.line: The errand girls have returned. Let us see what they've brought... "Well, well. These aren't half-bad spoils."

headtouch.line: "You have some gall, human." Emden can tolerate a dash of self-indulgence♡

home.line: It matters not whither you flee, for you will inevitably return hither, my dear human♡ "After all, a human that's wholeheartedly submitted to Emden can never truly escape. Heehee♥"

login.line: "You're late, human." How will you make recompense for the time you kept Emden waiting, hmm? My darling human♡

mail.line: There is a letter for you. Emden shall read it first, then you may take it after, my darling human.

main1.line: Vampire hunters... A rather barbarous kind, aren't they? "They will learn who truly rules the night."

main2.line: You may borrow my human if you wish, Yorck. Please do keep in mind, though, that you are only BORROWING my human.

main3.line: By all means, use your holy artifacts as a means of meager resistance. "I will savor every moment as I slowly crush your rebellious spirit♥"

mission.line: A new mission has come in. Have no fear, my darling human. The night shall show you the way.

mission_complete.line: Mission completed. You have done well, my darling human. You are hereby given the privilege of sharing a toast with Emden.

touch.line: Embrace the night, and the night shall embrace you. "Now, are you ready to offer yourself?"

touch2.line: Close your eyes and let Emden show you a dream. A rapturous dream wherein all is possible. "A paradise of perpetual night."

unlock.line: Raise your head, my darling human. O lost soul, you have three options – become Emden's meal, become Emden's prisoner... "Or become Emden's vassal. Our vassal♥"

detail.line: The scent you exude smells sweeter and richer than all the flowers here, my dear human. Your fragrance is one I adore so much.

expedition.line: Those commission girls have returned. "Rejoice, human, for Emden is content with this alone."

headtouch.line: You're so endearing when you're scared, my darling human.

home.line: My darling human♡ Why don't you have a peaceful slumber beneath the moonlight? "Sleep, and we will cosset you in your dreams♥"

login.line: Welcome, my darling human♡ Have you come, hoping to see Emden? "Or have you come to answer Emden's summons? Heehee♥"

main1.line: Emden aches with eagerness when you let your indecision show, my dear human. "How I wish I could grab and drag you under the water♥"

main2.line: "You've earned a reward, my sweet human." Open your mouth and savor Emden's nectarous taste♡

main3.line: Look down and inspect your reflection closely, my dear human. Much unlike Emden, you must carve out your own path if you're to survive. Heehee.

mission.line: You've received new missions. Accept your fate and carry them out. You may defy your superiors, but you cannot defy Emden.

mission_complete.line: What a well-behaved pet you are. Have yourself a reward, my darling human.

touch.line: Much like attempting to top me, grasping for the moon within a lake's reflection is a futile endeavor. Heehee.

touch2.line: You seem to believe you're in control of Emden... "When in fact it's Emden who controls you♥"

unlock.line: Welcome, my darling human. Are you looking for something? If it is Emden you seek, you have already found her. "We, Emden, are before your very eyes."

win_mvp.line: "You really thought the likes of you could best Emden?" Neither you nor my dear human could dream of overcoming Emden. Heehee♡

detail.line: You give off a scent of curiosity and expectation, dear human. "Such a sweet and delectable smell. Heehee. It gladdens me."

expedition.line: Supplies have arrived, dear human. I urge you to claim them at once. "You will need them on your voyage. Use them carefully."

feeling5.line: Emden arranged this cruise just for you, my darling human. Let Emden guide you and feel the joy of letting Emden take care of everything♡ "Don't resist it. Revel in the ultimate bliss that Emden provides♥"

headtouch.line: Heehee, has our change in standing perhaps emboldened you? "Or do you actually think this will curry favor with Emden?"

home.line: Welcome back, my darling human♡ "Emden shall give you a peaceful dream♥"

login.line: We are ready for you now, my darling human. Would you like to a whole new world today? "Or perhaps you want to search for the end of the known world?"

main1.line: You look lost, my darling human. Do you really find my schedule table that interesting? "Or are you simply engrossed in the service that Emden provides?"

main2.line: Are you unsure where to go, dear human? Emden shall assist you. "Know that this is a kindness done unto you, human."

main3.line: "You must beg Emden if you want to know when and where this cruise will change course. If Emden finds your appeal satisfactory, I'll consider telling you. Heehee♥"

touch.line: Emden stands on top of you even whilst serving as receptionists, dear human. "And still, you boldly try to take a step further."

touch2.line: "Come with Emden♥" Clear your mind completely and relish in the paradise Emden has created♡

unlock.line: Welcome, my darling human. We are Emden, the receptionists that shall guide your way. You can go anywhere you'd like... as long as you give us an offering♡ "Even to an unsullied paradise that is not of this world"♥

win_mvp.line: A victory just as planned. Heehee. You're very talented. "Do you seek to pursue all-out war next?"

detail.line: The dusklight's glow on the water's surface, the way your eyes are fixed on Emden alone... "'Tis the picture of undeniable perfection."

feeling5.line: From now on, my darling human, Emden shall be all you ever see. You are fated to stay by Emden's side, forever... "Fated to be enthralled by Emden's presence, forever~♥"

headtouch.line: "Is this some attempt at flattery, or your way of comforting me?" Either way, Emden will gladly accept it~♪

home.line: To reward you for a triumphant return, Emden will spend some quality time with you~♡ "But be sure to stretch and warm up before you go into the water~♥"

login.line: Which Emden would you prefer to take a picture of right now, my darling human? "Make sure your photos do Emden's beauty justice."

main1.line: The light is growing dimmer... Now is the time, my darling human. Use your lens to drape this golden veil over Emden.

main2.line: Try for a slightly lower angle... Yes, like you're looking up at Emden... "Only by following Emden's advice shall you snap the perfect masterpiece."

main3.line: "Your attention is drifting again..." Are you charmed by Emden's beauty? Or perhaps thinking about how to take the photo that would please Emden the most? Heehee, you need not say it. Your eyes tell me everything~♡

mission.line: There's a new mission. Shall we handle it now, or finish this photoshoot first? "The choice is yours, but be sure to make a decision that will please Emden."

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. But, forget the rewards. Emden is more curious about the photos you took.

touch.line: You wish to direct which pose I'll take? How bold of you, my darling human~♡ "Show Emden what pose you have in mind...♥"

touch2.line: Such an audacious pose... You're looking for an angle that brings out both light and shadow, are you? "Heheh... Emden will grant you that which you desire~♥"

unlock.line: Were you drawn here by the seaspray and my alluring figure, my darling human? Heehee... From now on, your lens and your gaze belong to Emden only~♡ "Revel in this great honor, human~♥"

detail.line: The dusklight's glow on the water's surface, the way your eyes are fixed on Emden alone... "'Tis the picture of undeniable perfection."

feeling5.line: From now on, my darling human, Emden shall be all you ever see. You are fated to stay by Emden's side, forever... "Fated to be enthralled by Emden's presence, forever~♥"

headtouch.line: "Is this some attempt at flattery, or your way of comforting me?" Either way, Emden will gladly accept it~♪

home.line: To reward you for a triumphant return, Emden will spend some quality time with you~♡ "But be sure to stretch and warm up before you go into the water~♥"

login.line: Which Emden would you prefer to take a picture of right now, my darling human? "Make sure your photos do Emden's beauty justice."

main1.line: The light is growing dimmer... Now is the time, my darling human. Use your lens to drape this golden veil over Emden.

main2.line: Try for a slightly lower angle... Yes, like you're looking up at Emden... "Only by following Emden's advice shall you snap the perfect masterpiece."

main3.line: "Your attention is drifting again..." Are you charmed by Emden's beauty? Or perhaps thinking about how to take the photo that would please Emden the most? Heehee, you need not say it. Your eyes tell me everything~♡

mission.line: There's a new mission. Shall we handle it now, or finish this photoshoot first? "The choice is yours, but be sure to make a decision that will please Emden."

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. But, forget the rewards. Emden is more curious about the photos you took.

touch.line: You wish to direct which pose I'll take? How bold of you, my darling human~♡ "Show Emden what pose you have in mind...♥"

touch2.line: Such an audacious pose... You're looking for an angle that brings out both light and shadow, are you? "Heheh... Emden will grant you that which you desire~♥"

unlock.line: Were you drawn here by the seaspray and my alluring figure, my darling human? Heehee... From now on, your lens and your gaze belong to Emden only~♡ "Revel in this great honor, human~♥"

asmr_001.line:
Human? My precious, sweet human? What is on your mind right now?
"You stand before Emden, staring blankly..."
Seeing you like this...
Makes me absolutely salivate♡ "Absolutely salivate♥"

asmr_002.line:
Breathe in... Breathe out... Inhale, exhale... Inhale, exhale...
"You need to relax before we start warming up."
Shall Emden help you? My sweet human, heheh♡

asmr_003.line:
Embrace Emden tightly, darling human. This is a very important trust exercise we have to do before we dip into the water.
"Face Emden head on, and embrace lovingly♥"
Heheh... Hold Emden tight... Hard and firm enough to mess Emden up.

asmr_004.line:
Let my embrace slowly... gradually... guide your body...
"Being embraced by Emden... Feels amazing, does it not?"
Look at me now... Do you see who holds you in her arms now?
That's right, it's Emden... "Pay it no mind... Emden is right here on this side, too."

asmr_005.line:
Next, I'll reward you for all your hard work, my diligent, darling human.
"Bask in the sweet delights only Emden can offer you."
Emden will thoroughly pamper you...♡ "Emden will utterly pamper you...♥"

asmr_006.line:
Heheh, let us begin, then...
"A special lesson only a good, hardworking Commander gets to experience..."
Are you ready? "Is your heart racing?♥"

asmr_007.line:
Heheheh... Commendable work, my darling human.
Heheheh, allow us to cheer you on.
Keep it up...♡ Keep it up...♡ "Expect a generous reward from Emden♥"

asmr_008.line:
Can you feel Emden's hands...? I feel your racing heart, darling human.
"It thumps and throbs... Is it excitement for what's to come, or perhaps...?"
Are you relishing in anticipation of what Emden is about to do with you?
Darling human♡ "Darling human♥"

asmr_009.line:
Let us swim together, dear human... But before we begin, Emden will warm you with her body.
Come closer, a little closer... Share your desires with Emden...
"And then join Emden..."
Let yourself go and fall...♡ "Let it all go and fall...♥"

asmr_010.line:
That should be enough preparation. Won't you show Emden the fruits of your training...?
"Now, are you prepared to entrust yourself to Emden?"
Are you ready to devote everything to Emden?
Make your choice, little human♡ "Emden leaves the choice in your hands, little human♥"

battle.line: I'll take care to stay out of collision range!

detail.line: Commander? Are you hurt? Not even a scratch? I just got worried you might have h-had an accident on the way here...

expedition.line: The commission team is back. I'd better not retrieve the rewards, or some will magically disappear...

feeling1.line: This is all my fault for wishing for a good Commander...

feeling2.line: I'll state this upfront: I'm feeble, clumsy, cursed with terrible luck, and I doubt I'll be much of any use to you...

feeling3.line: None of my shells ever land. Even when I take another shot, it just misses. All I do is waste ammunition... *sigh*...

feeling4.line: You've been kind to me this whole time not because I'm useful, but because you pity me, isn't that right? I only wish I could do anything in return...

feeling5.line: Nothing I've sincerely wished for has ever come true. All I can do for you is this... I wish to be miserable! I wish to go through sorrows with you, Commander! ...This should bring you happiness.

headtouch.line: Ahh...

home.line: Welcome back. You came home safe and sound because I wished that you'd get battered and bruised. My wishes never, ever come true, you see...

hp_warning.line: W-we're gonna collide!

login.line: No rain today, I assume? I see... So there was no point in me bringing an umbrella.

lose.line: Sure enough, all battles I partake in end in defeat...

mail.line: I hope this letter has good news for you, and bad news for me...

main1.line: It could rain today. You see, when I say it's going to rain, the weather always turns sunny...

main2.line: My rigging is so intimidating... Strong though it may be, it's no good in the hands of someone helpless like me.

main3.line: After all my efforts, there's no less work than when I started... But if I give up, your workload might increase instead... Ughhh...

mission.line: Commander, here is the mission list. Whew...

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have come in. You should verify them, Commander. Making me do it is a bad idea...

profile.line: I'm Elbing, Pillau-class cruiser of the Iron Blood. I'm on the small side for a cruiser, and my service history is a disappointment. My armor is paper and my firepower is pathetic. My only redeeming traits are my speed and range...

propose.line: A promise ring?! B-but that'd make us both happy, when I explicitly... I see now. The wish must've come true because I wished for your happiness, not my own. Thank goodness... *sniffle*... I'm so glad it came true!

skill.line: It won't matter if I can't hit them...!

touch.line: Maybe I could help with... No, I'm good for absolutely nothing.

touch2.line: Y-you flatter me...

unlock.line: I'm Elbing, Iron Blood cruiser. I know you're going to shun me since I'm worthless in a battle... You're not going to do that? Ah, right... The only thing I have going for me is how disposable I am...

upgrade.line: Why strengthen me of all people...?

win_mvp.line: I... I'm the MVP? You don't have to hold back for my sake... I just don't have what it takes to be the MVP...

gift_prefer.line: F-for me? Are you sure?

detail_ex.line: Oh gosh! I'm so sorry! I shouldn't have thrown the door open! I thought there's no way you're in here, but lo and behold, you were standing right at the entrance...

expedition_ex.line: Are you sure you want me to fetch the commission rewards? Items on the list might get lost somehow if I do it...

feeling5_ex.line: I'm going to have an awful day today. It's going to rain, the restaurant I booked a table at will close early, same for the movie theater after that, and you'll receive urgent work that keeps you busy all night... That should do it! Thanks for waiting while I recited all that.

home_ex.line: Of course your wellbeing is important to me, but I try not to think about it. I mean, wishing for your safety only puts you in danger. Simply not worrying about you is the best way to ensure nothing bad happens...

login_ex.line: You think it's going to rain today? I see... I brought my umbrella, hoping the weather would clear up. H-hopefully this will be a sunny day.

main4_ex.line: We should go on a date since it's sunny? Um, sure! I'll bring my umbrella to ensure this nice weather sticks around for the whole day!

main5_ex.line: Destroyers usually have cute little riggings... Something like what they have would suit me better. Heehee.

main6_ex.line: Is there any way I can help? As long as it's something I can handle and will make your job easier...

mission_complete_ex.line: New mission rewards! I wonder wh-what we've received.

touch_ex.line: If there's any way I can help, I'll try.

touch2_ex.line: Ahh...

win_mvp_ex.line: You really don't need to work so hard to make me the MVP, Commander. Because if I'm the top performer, that's a bad sign...

detail.line: I'm better suited for a role like... a messenger of misfortune who puts a curse on you. Don't you think so too, Commander?

home.line: Eek! Oww... I tore my pantyhose again... Sorry for how terrible I look, Commander. You hate to see this, don't you...?

login.line: You should be on this throne, not me, Commander. Let me get up so we can swap– Aahh!

main1.line: This is what happens when you stretch your clothes past their limit... It's not my fault? Yes it is, because I'm a bad fit for this role...

main2.line: I'd be helpless even in the role of a maid. All I would do is mess up constantly and be a burden to you...

main3.line: At the risk of sounding rude... Emden should be doing this, not a trainwreck like me.

touch.line: What is your bidding, Commander?

touch2.line: Mmh... Ahh...

unlock.line: As the mistress of this manor, I c-command thee to kneel... No, of course. I mean, what authority do I have to issue commands? I'm better suited to be a maid than a mistress...

detail.line: I'm worried I might wish for something that negatively affects you in my dreams... You doubt my curse extends to my dreams? Maybe not, but I'll have forgotten what I wished for once I wake up, so you can never be sure...

expedition.line: The commission team is back? Right, yeah... I'd forgotten. It's not their bedtime yet.

home.line: Whew... I made a wish that you'd come back dead tired, which is why you're full of energy. Although... that'll only make it harder for you to fall asleep, won't it?

login.line: Since we can't fall asleep, we could always cuddle together... or not... I know you'd say no if I... Oh, we can?

main1.line: Mmh... Ahh... Ohh... Hahh... S-Sorry... Am I too close?

main2.line: I guess I should try to stay still... I don't want to bump into you by accident... You can change positions if you want. I-I can handle a bump or two...

main3.line: If you really can't sleep, should I whisper into your ear like Emden did? Alright, let me just turn over to... Eep!

touch.line: What is it, Commander?

touch2.line: Mmh! Ahh... Hahh... Ohh... Hah...

unlock.line: Are you also having trouble sleeping, Commander? I-I thought so... It must be because I was praying for you to have sweet dreams... Look what I've done – now, neither of us can fall asleep... Urgh...

win_mvp.line: This is either a fluke... or I'm dreaming.

battle.line: As long as I'm fighting I won't have to have weird thoughts!

detail.line: Lunar New Year is a day that brings good luck, because even a girl like me gets to be with you... Huh? It's nothing to do with luck, and entirely because I worked so hard for it? T-true... *blushes*

expedition.line: (The commission team is back. So I'll have to stay like this while the Commander goes and greets them... Oh, gosh...)

feeling5.line: This lantern wards off evil spirits, so I should make a wish? Oh... I won't, because my good and bad luck will probably just offset each other, so wish on my behalf... No, don't tell me your wish or it won't come true. Just wish for what your heart wants... *blushes*

home.line: Did you get the photos printed? Oh, you don't need to show me! They'll stop being cute if I get too excited about them...

login.line: Have we already started, Commander? ...You're looking for an angle to get a cute shot of me? M-me... cute... Oh, gosh... *blushes*

main1.line: (The Commander's staring so much... No, probably at the camera moreso than me... So it's okay... Oh gosh...)

main2.line: What about me do you think is so cute? I-I'm not saying I AM cute... Whew... I-if you want to take pictures, just go ahead...

main3.line: You'll share your Lunar New Year luck with me? Th-thanks... I'll do my best to live up to your hopes this year!

mission_complete.line: Hey, mission rewards have arrived. I'm fine staying like this, but are you?

touch.line: Look into the camera with a confident smile? L-like this?

touch2.line: Th-this angle might be a liiittle bit... *blushes*

unlock.line: G-good day, Commander. I'm ready to be your model... Ugh, there's probably going to be an accident if I wish that you'll take cute photos... Better clear my head just to be sure.

battle.line: Deploying rigging! Now, tremble in fear!

couple_encourage1.line: Support us, Regina!

couple_encourage2.line: Your sorcery isn't needed. Just leave this to me!

detail.line: Well, well. So even you have a hard time handling my rigging. Unsurprising, a mere human cannot tame its great power. Heehee.

expedition.line: (Roooar!) Silence, Regina! ...What's that? The commission team is back?

feeling1.line: In the end, you humans deserve to be on the collar side of the leash. Know your place!

feeling2.line: Hahaha! I never thought it would be so funny to see an inferior being pushing their luck. Do not misunderstand; me disciplining my rigging and you giving me orders are two very different things.

feeling3.line: You're not half bad for a human. Even I acknowledge that, which is why I deign to obey your orders. What of it, you ask? I hope you don't think of me as below you in anything but name only.

feeling4.line: I won't accept it... I won't! I refuse to believe that commands from someone like YOU would draw out more of my power—What? You say this is your power, not mine? No... Do you mean to say... You're stronger than me?!

feeling5.line: To think that I, Regensburg, would lose to this... this Commander! What manner of monster are you?! If I continue to let you draw out my strength, that will make me your subordinate... This can't be!

headtouch.line: Wha?!

home.line: Tch, putting me through all this... No, I'm not talking about you. This is a problem between me and my rigging.

hp_warning.line: I shall not... be defeated by lesser beings!

login.line: Hey, you're right on time. I wonder if you were born dutiful, or if someone had to whip it into you... Either way, get to work.

lose.line: How could I lose to this... trash?!

mail.line: We've got a new message. What did Eisen break this time, Regina? ...Oh, it's something else?

main1.line: (Roooar...) What, Regina? Is it feeding time? Shouldn't you be taking a break as well?

main2.line: Our balance sheet is... What kind of operation are you running here? Don't tell me you think it's okay to overlook such wastefulness.

main3.line: Every faction has its own ways of breaking in their rigging. It's something you also might want to pick up on, just in case. Even if they won't help you fight, they might come in handy some other way.

mission.line: Let your superior do the fighting, and in the meantime, you may do your so-called missions. It's decided then.

mission_complete.line: Rewards? Shame you won't get the chance to hoard them. Hahahaha!

profile.line: Iron Blood light cruiser, Regensburg. While I have no particular history to speak of, I'll prove that I'm not so easily controlled by you. Regina, let's show our inferiors what we're made of! (Roooar!)

propose.line: Kh! Why am I... unable to refuse a lower being such as you...? Damn it, how did you become... stronger, and more superior? ..A ring? Do you mean to tie me down?!

touch.line: Want to try petting Regina?

touch2.line: Someone needs to be disciplined...

unlock.line: I am the Iron Blood light cruiser Regensburg, wielder of the Darksteel Dragon— and I already know all of your tricks. Hahaha, do not think I will be so easily manipulated like the other girls! (Roooar!)

upgrade.line: Heheh. Are you sure you want to consolidate my power at the top of the food chain even further?

win_mvp.line: (Roooar!) Now do you understand where you sit on the food chain?

gift_prefer.line: Step aside, Regina. This is Commander's gift to me. ...Good grief, is it really that precious?

battle_ex.line: Good. Draw out even more of my power!

detail_ex.line: I don't need your help. Relying on you any more would soil the name of Regensburg– stop trying to help without my permission already!

expedition_ex.line: The commission team is here. It's time to do your job.

feeling5_ex.line: (If the Commander gave me an order right now, I'd obey without protest... Rgh, what shame! I ought to be able to crush the Commander between my fingers at a given moment, but I'm like a mere servant!)

login_ex.line: (Roooar!) I've been waiting. I already know how dutiful you are. Go on; get to your next job.

main4_ex.line: (Roooar...) What? Did you get spooked by the smaller riggings again? Hmph. Regina, you ought to know that your appearance is meant to symbolize the might of a superior being...

main5_ex.line: Looks like my piggy bank is full again. Hmph, don't underestimate savings. Every little bit counts, and every penny saved is a penny earned!

main6_ex.line: (Someday, I will find the Commander's weakness and prove my superiority... Until then, I'll have to cope with this!)

mission_ex.line: Missions? Hmph, I'll help you. It'll make me stronger, too.

mission_complete_ex.line: (So many mission rewards... Commander, just how far have you surpassed me?!)

touch_ex.line: (Roooar...) Regina? You've... taken a liking to the Commander?!

touch2_ex.line: Kh...! This frustrates me to no end, but...!

win_mvp_ex.line: (Roooar!) This elation, this sense of fulfillment... Is this the feeling of a victory wrought by the Commander?!

expedition.line: (Grooooowl...) Oh, is the commission team back already?

feeling5.line: (You're looking at girls other than myself? Impossible! I'm clearly best-suited to be your... Huh?! What the hell am I thinking? How could I be... experiencing jealousy?!)

home.line: Looks like Regina's having a good time with its friends. Why don't you take a break as well? Surely you're not trying to test the limits of your weary body.

login.line: Hehe, even someone like you is powerless before my allure. Those ruled by their emotions are easy to control, just like riggings.

lose.line: If only Regina were here, I wouldn't be bested by... the likes of you!

main1.line: Hm? What are you trying to... Hyeep?! G-get your hands off my tail this instant! Didn't you hear me?!

main2.line: (Rooooar...) Looks like Regina's gone pretty far out to sea. Hope it doesn't run into any trouble.

main3.line: Since you're here at the beach, surely you have a thing or two you'd like to do? Come on, let yourself loose already.

mission.line: A job? What job could be more important than enjoying your time off at the beach?

mission_complete.line: One can never get enough rewards. Same is always true regardless of what form they come in.

touch.line: (That's right! Bare your weaknesses to me as I pretend to be subservient...!)

touch2.line: Huh?! Wh-why do you know where my weak spot is...?!

unlock.line: Wanted to feast your eyes on this, didn't you? Haha, there's no point trying to deny it. All your petty desires are clear as day to me, so why not just be honest about it?

detail.line: If we discipline the rigging as such, even if they do not become fully subservient... Hey, are you listening? Wh-why are you staring?!

expedition.line: Put the supplies the commission team brought here for now. We'll inventory the old stuff, and then we can sort them out.

feeling5.line: Heh. You know, this style of discipline might work on lesser beings such as yourself, too... What?! You think I'm the one who needs to be disciplined?! U-unthinkable! I am superior – surely I can't lose to you again...!

headtouch.line: A-a greater being such as I need no flattery!

home.line: You got home and came straight here? How obedient. Check this area for me, then.

login.line: You're the one who offered to help me clean this place, so work! Or do you need discipline, too?

main1.line: More pocket change... I've found quite a bit. Go find a piggy bank to put all this in, Commander.

main2.line: I'd best go check on Regina. I had to leave her outside given how cramped it is in here... You ought to take a break, too. Go out for fresh air, if you want.

main3.line: ...Leave that stuff for now. It might be useful for disciplining naughty rigging.

touch.line: What? Do you require my teachings as your superior?

touch2.line: Tch! K-keep this up, and I...!

unlock.line: Hmm... Who knew this stuff was in a warehouse, of all places? Heh, I think this will help quite a bit with disciplining that rigging that gave you so much trouble.

battle.line: I'm not losing, not today.

couple_encourage1.line: Can you teach me to do my makeup better?

couple_encourage2.line: How about we check out that shop we were talking about?

couple_encourage3.line: Maid work sure is tough~

couple_encourage4.line: You should try this new juice I got!

detail.line: Whoa~ So you're the kind of person to pry into someone's private junk right off the bat? Heheh♪ I don't mind sharing with you. You just have to tell me your own secrets in return.

expedition.line: The commission girls are back. I hope they brought some fun gifts!

feeling1.line: Ahaha... I-I don't really get what you're saying. Should I look it up?

feeling2.line: I'm kinda bored. I had plans to go out with Dido, Zara, Pittsburgh, and Hipper later... You wanna come with, Commander?

feeling3.line: (Hmm... The Commander's been a little cold to me lately. Does my makeup look bad, or...) Huh? O-oh, aren't you supposed to be reading paperwork? Why are you staring at me now...?

feeling4.line: Huh? You think I suddenly look cuter? ...Heheh, I might've used a little magic... Just kidding♪ All I did was fix my makeup when you weren't looking. Do you like this lip gloss more? Get a closer look, if you want.

feeling5.line: Hey, Commander~ I hear there's a way to test someone's willpower. See, if I sit in your lap like this and give you a hug... If you last long enough, I'll give you a little reward♥

headtouch.line: Huh? ...Whuh? What's gotten into you?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander~♪ Did anything cool happen today? Come on, you know you wanna gossip.

hp_warning.line: I can't let the Commander see me like this!

login.line: You came right on time. It kinda feels like we're meeting up for a date, huh?

lose.line: What the hell? This is the worst day EVER!

mail.line: Hmm? Was that sound an unread mail notification?

main1.line: You want to see my nails? Okay... Let's intertwine our fingers... Your skin tone looks great complimented by mine, Commander.

main2.line: Liverpool told me about this popular restaurant's new drink menu. Gee, I sure wish I had someone to go with me♪ ...Aww, you will? Thank you!

main3.line: I want to open my own shop someday, but I don't know what kind... Oh, you're interested? Then how about we brainstorm together?

mission.line: You still haven't done your work? Heheh♪ About time you asked me for help, don't you think?

mission_complete.line: Ooh. Finished your missions, huh... Wanna check those rewards while they're still fresh in your mind?

profile.line: I'm Duisburg of the Iron Blood, and I've got all kinds of hobbies. Good-looking and good-tasting food, collecting cute and elaborate accessories... I'd love to open my own little shop one day. But right now, I only have eyes for you, Commander♪

propose.line: Do you already wanna use the reward I promised you before? Heheh, feels like a bit of a waste, doesn't it? After all, I'd do whatever you wanted even without you using up your token... But it's too late to go back now. Let's get even closer♥

touch.line: Ooh, what is it? Got some gossip for me?

touch2.line: C-Commander... No, I won't believe you if you say that was an accident.

unlock.line: Well, well, we finally met. Commander, right? I'm Duisburg. Let's be great friends, okay? Heheh♪

upgrade.line: Well, well. You made me stronger AND cuter!

win_mvp.line: All thanks to everyone's help, heheh♪

gift_prefer.line: I see you've been quietly observing my preferences? Thank you...

detail_ex.line: What do you wanna know about me today? Trade one of your secrets, and I'll tell you anything... Huh? Wh-why that... What do you want to know that for?!

feeling5_ex.line: Hmm... I'm no good at straightforward confessions. But I also feel bad, since you've been so proactive, so maybe I should try... Ahem. I-I love you. I always have... H-how was that?! You knew? So I didn't have to push myself to say it? Wh-what kind of answer is that?!

headtouch_ex.line: Heheh. That look in your eyes told me everything.

home_ex.line: Welcome back~ Want a hug? Here, bury that head right in my arms♥

login_ex.line: Commandeeer♪ Heheh, I've been waiting for you. After work, how about we go out? On a date♥

main4_ex.line: That look in your eyes is suspicious... Hmm? You're just looking at the waist of my outfit? O-okay, do you want a closer look...?

main5_ex.line: Hey, Commander♪ I bought a new drink. They say the theme is "young love." Wanna drink it together?

main6_ex.line: I hear that if you do business alongside someone you love, it deepens your bond... How about a coffee shop, Commander? Sound good? I agree♥

touch_ex.line: Th-that tickles... What's got you so worked up?

touch2_ex.line: Heheh... If you've got a good enough excuse for me...♥

feeling5.line: I know I'm only calling you Master during training, but... i-if you like it... I could keep doing that? Even after I finally open that shop I want... I'll say it whenever you want me to...

headtouch.line: Feels good, doesn't it? Yeah, I thought you might think so.

home.line: Welcome back, Master. What drink would you... *sigh*... As if. We barely have any left at this time of day.

login.line: Welcome back... Master. Huh? More passionately? I-I get it...! P-please continue to train me...

main1.line: M-Master... I'm okay. I'm the one who came up with this idea, anyway... Please keep training me, f-for the sake of the pop-up shop... Okay?

main2.line: Don't you think this outfit's going a little TOO far? I know I'm the one who picked the wrong box of clothes, but surely you've noticed I'm not wearing this intentionally, right?!

main3.line: W-wait... You want me to serve you drinks like this? No way, I can't do it...! I can't!

touch.line: Ah?! ...I-if it please you, Master...

touch2.line: You did that because I'm "too cute"? Bad excuse! I won't let you get away with saying that a second time... Okay?!

unlock.line: C-Commander... Huh? If we're training, I should call you Master...? M-Master... You don't have to stare. Let's just get started, please...

win_mvp.line: O-obviously, I only won because of the Commander... I-I'm just telling the truth! That wasn't part of the training!

battle.line: Compared to Jutland, a battle like this is mere child’s play.

couple_encourage1.line: Who are you calling flat?!

couple_encourage2.line: Please begin your performance, Glowworm!

detail.line: What are you looking at, idiot? Get out of my room!

expedition.line: You idiot! You still haven’t remembered what you forgot about yet?

feeling1.line: You piece of trash! I told you to stay out of my sight!

feeling2.line: Huh? You can’t even do something like that? Are you an idiot?

feeling3.line: Huh? Worried about me? Having an idiot like you worry about me doesn’t make me happy at all.

feeling4.line: Huh? Who would ever have a crush on you? I’m only tagging along because Eugen wanted to have dinner with you. Don’t get the wrong idea, idiot!

feeling5.line: Huh? Who would ever fall in love with you? I’m only here to drop off something I found during sortie, per regulations. Huh?! A ring? Who would wear something like that?!

home.line: Idiot! If you had already returned, why didn’t you come to see me? Hah? Who would be worried about you?

login.line: Idiot, so you rolled out of bed? Haah? What are you fantasizing about? I only happened to bump into you while patrolling the port.

lose.line: C-c-c-curses! I can’t stand this, ahh!

mail.line: Are you too stupid to realize that you have new mail?

main1.line: Blücher, I will definitely protect you this time.

main2.line: Hah? A novice like you wants to challenge my cruiser-commanding skills?

main3.line: Hah? Are the Schweinshaxe and beer ready yet? How many servings do we need? Idiot! Is your brain just an ornament?

mission.line: Don’t get distracted in the middle of a mission, you idiot!

mission_complete.line: Idiot! Hurry up and collect your rewards! Why are you showing it off to me?

profile.line: I am Admiral Hipper, the Iron Blood heavy cruiser named after the undefeated Admiral Franz von Hipper. I have participated in countless battles and given them my all. The Barents Sea? That only happened because Admiral Kummetz was even dumber than you.

propose.line: Huh? Why must I wear something like this? Whatever... I’m in a good mood for a change. You’re going to take care of me forever? Hmph! Isn’t that what you’re supposed to do?

skill.line: Huh? Who gave you permission to resist?

touch.line: Huh? Did I give you permission to touch me?

touch2.line: Huh?! You stupid, moronic, block-headed idiot! Go die! Sink yourself in the Kiel Bay right now!

unlock.line: Huh? You are the commander? Is the war effort going so poorly these days that they’re letting anyone become a commander?

upgrade.line: Hah? Did you think something like this would impress me?

win_mvp.line: Hmph. Just today, I shall allow you to praise me a little.

gift_prefer.line: Haah?! You think something like that would make me happy?!

battle.line: Thanks for making me work up a sweat!

detail.line: I can feel your gaze, you know... Would you stop ogling me like a painting? ...Huh?! "You can't take your eyes off me"? You say the stupidest damn things!

expedition.line: Let me guess, you still haven't realized what's escaped your memory? ...Wrong! It's the commission, not which stores I want to visit!

feeling5.line: For the record, I never wanted to go here. This trip is for you – to reward all your hard work and give you a break... Huh? Me, enjoying my time with you? Wh-who decided it's got anything to do with you? I have the right to enjoy my visit irrespective of you!

home.line: Whew, we're back. Time to dig in to some food before heading back to the onsen. You're worn out, and I'm just as worn out as you are!

login.line: Which onsen do you want to go to today? I'd like to visit as many as possible so I can tell Eugen and the others all about the fancy places we've been to.

lose.line: This isn't much of a story to tell the others... Ugh...!

mail.line: There's a letter for you. Wow, that's a nice postcard... Never mind that, just read what it says already!

main1.line: I've heard this type of kimono is famous. Makes sense, considering how much skill an artisan needs to create patterns and colors this complex.

main2.line: It's wonderful feeling the breeze on your skin after getting out of the hot spring. It's so soothing, so cooling. You know what I mean, right?

main3.line: Hmph! Eugen can poke fun at me all she wants – this is NOT a date! She's not gonna be so smug when I gloat about how great the hot springs were. "It was sooo good! I left feeling like a new person," and so on!

mission.line: I don't care what spots you want to check out, focus on your damn missions! You're keeping ME waiting too, remember?!

mission_complete.line: Whoop-de-doo, you finished a mission. Good for you. Stop dawdling and go collect the rewards!

touch.line: Huh?! Grabbing a girl's hand without warning is a great way to startle her! At least tell me first!

touch2.line: Yeah, I figured you'd like the pattern of– What the–?!

unlock.line: W-well? Does this kimono look good on me? ...R-really? Duh, I know it looks GREAT on me! Who really cares what you think... C-can't be me... No, I didn't say anything!

upgrade.line: Isn't this much to be expected?

win_mvp.line: We won. Heh, I'm willing to give you the credit for the victory today.

battle.line: Know your place, or get out of my sight!

feeling5.line: Only a huge idiot like you could get me to hang around... D-don't get a big head about it! I just think it's not so bad fighting alongside you! ...Aaargh, look what you've got me saying! Just wait until I get my hands on you!

headtouch.line: H-hey, who gave you permission to touch me?! Wh-why, you... You're going to pay for that one!

home.line: You're FINALLY back? ...What? I-I wasn't worried about you, no, you stupid, clumsy dummy! If you come back late again, I'll give you something to REALLY worry about!

login.line: What're you dawdling there for, dummy? I didn't get stronger just so you could laze around! Get up and get this battle situation sorted out! I'm not waiting any longer!

main1.line: What? You wanna know if I'M ready? Don't be stupid! As if I'd ever slack off – you're the one who needs to get off your butt and keep up with me!

main2.line: I left some food on your desk, so you'd better check it out! You don't get to neglect yourself just because you're busy!

main3.line: Come over here, dummy. You look pale. Are you okay? Don't get any weird thoughts – I'm just worried because we need you in top condition for the next battle!

touch.line: Hey, if I'm the one who got retrofitted, why are YOU the one acting overconfident? Going around touching me all willy-nilly... I'd better teach you a lesson!

touch2.line: Idiot! Big dummy! How dare you... I-I'm gonna feed you to the fishes!

unlock.line: Hmph. Don't look at me like you missed me, or something! All I did was get my retrofit and come back stronger than ever... I-I wasn't waiting around for you to come looking for me! I was just passing through, you dummy!

battle.line: As long as you keep your eyes on me, I'm toooootally invincible!

couple_encourage1.line: C'mon, Hipper! There's nothing wrong with admitting you're in love!

couple_encourage2.line: Heheh☆ I'm gonna make you a blondie!

detail.line: I only joined this fleet 'cause I'm so in love with you, Commander! You feel the exact same way about me, don't you~? Heheh☆

expedition.line: The commission team is back~ Wonder if they found any goodies out there?

feeling1.line: Something's wrong with you... but I still love you!

feeling2.line: Heheh☆ What a beautiful day~ Hop on my rigging and we'll go have a wild time, Commander!

feeling3.line: Heheh☆ Every time we touch, my heart beats so fast and I swear I could fly! Oh wait, my rigging actually does take me higher♪

feeling4.line: I need hugs from you to get the energy to do anything... Heehee~ Hold me closer~ Clooooooooser!

feeling5.line: Heheh☆ I love you so, so, soooo much, Commander! When can we go on a date again? Next month? Next week? Tomorrow? I can't wait that long, so let's go on one in five minutes! Hehehehe~

home.line: Heheh☆ Welcome back, Commander! Gimme a hug~! Ehehe~

hp_warning.line: Anything's possible when you have love!

login.line: Heheh☆ Doesn't seeing me make you all happy?

lose.line: Bweh... Only a kiss from my Commander can get me back on my feet...

mail.line: Heheh☆ You've got new messages... including a love letter from me! Don't forget to read it!

main1.line: Hipper, don't you wanna cuddle with the Commander too?

main2.line: Aim for the Commander's heart aaand... all-love assault!

main3.line: Being able to meet you is like a dream come true! Mmhmm, I've never been happier!

mission.line: Heheh☆ It's time we started practicing the art of love, Commander!

mission_complete.line: Heheh☆ Another unforgettable memory made with you!

profile.line: Heheh☆ I'm Blücher of Iron Blood, second ship of the Admiral Hipper class~ Yup, I'm the one who got totally whooped by fortress guns in Operation Weserübung! And you, Commander, are the source of my endless happiness~

propose.line: Heheh☆ I've waited forever for this day! So, are you ready to embrace every last bit of me, Commander? Me... I'm as ready as can be♪

skill.line: Look what my love for my Commander can do!

touch.line: It's me, the girl who's more in love with you today than she was yesterday~

touch2.line: Heheh☆ No comparing me to anyone else~♪

unlock.line: Heheh☆ It's me, Blücher, reporting in to serve my sweet, sweet Commander♪

upgrade.line: Heheh☆ Have you fallen even deeper in love with me?

win_mvp.line: Heheh☆ Crushiiing victory!

gift_prefer.line: Heheh☆ It smells like Commander!

detail_ex.line: Commander, I know you gave me this ring 'cause you love me! I love you super duper ultra much too! Heheh☆

login_ex.line: Heheh☆ Now begins another day of lovey-dovey cuddling and flirting together♪♪

main4_ex.line: You don't have to be as flirty as Eugen, buuut... Heheh☆ Just don't become as nitpicky as Hipper, Commander.

main5_ex.line: Plot a course for my Commander aaand... full speed ahead! Heheh☆ You can't escape my love!

touch_ex.line: It's me, the girl who's so in love with you it's literally impossible to love you any more than this~

touch2_ex.line: Oh, Commander~ I'm gonna close my eyes for you, 'kay?

win_mvp_ex.line: Heheh☆ Hey, Eugen~ Look who's the MVP~

battle.line: Gotta take it carefully here!

detail.line: Commandeeer! I'm heading where you are, so you'd better catch me! ...Heheh☆ Nice one! I love you!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! ...Okaaay, I know I need to watch my speed and not get carried away.

login.line: Heheh☆ Mountains are peak fun, aren't they, Commander?

lose.line: Even I can't have it my way all the time. Hmph...

main1.line: Everyone keeps telling me to "watch where I'm going!" First, it was Hipper, now even Köln's saying it!

main2.line: You'll stand in for Eugen and watch over me today, won't you? Or should I watch over you instead, sweetheart? Heheh☆

main3.line: You feeling hot or cold, Commander? My outfit's all breezy, but you make my heart race and my body all warm♪

touch.line: Which do I look more like – a bunny, or a mountain hare?

touch2.line: Hehehe–eeehh? Oh shooooot! I'm gonna fall!

unlock.line: Heheheh☆ You're lagging behind, Commander! Pick up the pace or you'll be left behind! Just kidding~ I'll slow down for you so we can stick together!

battle.line: Dragon knight! Los, los!

detail.line: I've wanted to soar the skies together with you before, but I never imagined we'd be doing it on a dragon. Heheh☆ Hold on to me tightly, Commander! You might fall off if you– Whoooah!

expedition.line: Hmm... Being on this dragon gives me a great view of where everyone is! Let's go say hi to the girls!

feeling5.line: You wanna visit all kinds of places with me,? Heheh♡ Of course we can! Where do you wanna go, my super sweet sweetheart? My dragon can take us anywhere in this vast, vast world! Whenever you're ready, let's go!

home.line: I-I'm back, and I'm still alive...

login.line: Heh, heheh... Commander, you ready to mount the dragon and feel the breeze?

lose.line: Hrmgh... Being a dragon knight is sooo hard! Commander, the only way to cure my hurt feelings is for you to kiss me!

mail.line: New letter for... No, no, no! Don't use your fire breath on it! My love letter to the Commander is in there!

main1.line: You don't think I FEEL like a soldier of the Demon King? Hmph. I do wanna learn to look like one, but– No, no, no! I'm gonna fall again!

main2.line: Heheheh☆ You're safe with me, my number one sweetie! How's that? Don't you feel super duper safe around me? ...Not at all? Aww...

main3.line: Dragon's breath! Did you feel the heat? Heheheh☆ My love for you burns just as bright as the dragon's– Whoa, whoooa!

mission.line: Heh, heheh☆ Come on, get those missions done and come rescue me!

mission_complete.line: Heheh☆ We made a nice, new, and slightly chaotic memory together!

touch.line: Commander, do you wanna steer the dragon? I'll let you do anything you want! Well... probably!

touch2.line: Huh?! You wanna do it NOW? A-at least wait until my dragon has taken off smoothly...

unlock.line: Heheh☆ I'm Blücher, dragon knight of the Demon King's army! ...Not riding the dragon so much as being dragged along by it? Well, I guess... Whoaaah! The dragon won't obey me! Commander, heeelp!

detail.line: Commander! I've still got time, so let's go somewhere! How about downtown? Or the arcade? Or maybe... Huh?! You're gonna go home and do homework of all things?!

feeling5.line: Commander, you can always rest your head on my lap whenever you feel tired. My thighs are a VIP seat exclusively for you, my super-duper mega sweetheart! ...But it's late? Doesn't matter to me! As long you're with me, I'm fine with staying here until morning!

headtouch.line: I won't settle with just some headpats for my reward! Okay, as punishment for you, you have to let me hug you for 10 minutes straight!

home.line: Heheh☆ Commander, I studied reeeally hard today! Take me on a date after school as a reward for my hard work!

login.line: Heheh☆ Commandeeer! Why are you sitting all the way over there? Come closer! Closer, closer! There we go! Now I can give you a biiig hug!

main1.line: Commander! Look! The sunset is so beautiful today! We can't just let something so picturesque go to waste – come here and let's take a selfie! Three, two, one – cheese!

main2.line: Surprise examination! Let's see what your note on my contact profile says... Huh? You didn't write anything?! Well, in that case... Write "I love you so, so, so, sooo much, Blücher"!

main3.line: Commander, lower your head for a sec. I'm gonna wipe your sweaty forehead. Hm? My hanky? I use this thing all the time, y'know! You can have it if you want it!

touch.line: Heehee! This massage is... kinda making me feel ticklish! Ahahah! Hey, not there! Ahahahahaha!

touch2.line: Eek! We're still in class, you know... Heehee – if that's how you want it, then two can play at that game!

unlock.line: Heheh☆ I KNEW you'd come to see me, Commander! Next time, you don't need to rush to my side after getting my message, okay? I'll give you as much time as you need, because the last thing I wanna do is tire you out, my super-duper mega sweetheart!

battle.line: All ships, open fire!

couple_encourage1.line: You Eagle Union reporters sure do run fast!

couple_encourage2.line: Is it a tradition for you all to be so flat?

couple_encourage3.line: Let's see how long you can keep up that "elegance"...

couple_encourage4.line: Chicken Squad? Whatever, I'll play along...

detail.line: Hmm? Check up? Vielen Dank~

expedition.line: Commission completed? Let's see if there is anything interesting to report.

feeling1.line: Mind getting out of my sight? You're a bit of an eyesore.

feeling2.line: ... I don't smile enough? Commander... care to see if you can make me?

feeling3.line: Commander~ I love you. Just kidding. Did your heart skip a beat?

feeling4.line: Ich liebe dich~ is this a joke or the truth? Why don't you decide for yourself~

feeling5.line: ... Why did I laugh? Because it's funny to see you look so confused, Commander... This smile is truly from the bottom of my heart!

home.line: Commander, won't you shower and relax with me for a while?

hp_warning.line: Ahhh... how interesting!

login.line: Hmm~ What is it? How would you like me to train you today?

lose.line: Hehehe... now you've done it...

mail.line: There's new mail. Hehe~

main1.line: If you overwork yourself too much... you ~ will ~ die.

main2.line: Lucky ship? Are you mocking me?

main3.line: Operation Rheinübung? Looking back, that was how it all began for me.

mission.line: Missions... aren't there any interesting ones?

mission_complete.line: Commander, the rewards. My portion? Not interested~

profile.line: I am Prinz Eugen, the miracle of the Third Reich and the third ship of the Admiral Hipper-class heavy cruisers. I will survive any battle, no matter how fierce. Luck? You sure have some guts.

propose.line: So this is the answer you're giving me? What shall I do? What a dense commander. I have long stopped being the empty person I was before. Did you forget that you were the one who changed me?

skill.line: It's not enough. I. Want. MORE!

touch.line: Have you finished having your fun?

touch2.line: Now then, it's my turn to have a taste of you.

unlock.line: Hmm... so you're the Commander? How long can you keep me amused? I'm looking forward to it.

upgrade.line: This feeling... isn't half bad.

win_mvp.line: *Yawns* ... Battleships? Nothing but small fry.

gift_prefer.line: Danke~

detail.line: Woah! I got a pretty dark tan after playing with Wales all day...

login.line: Commander, I am practicing my smile. Someone said it looks unnatural, but what do you think?

mail.line: More mail? Any from Hipper or Bismarck? Ah, they're all for you, Commander... How boring...

main1.line: Wales, someone is going to break your hand again if you keep messing with Bismarck! I won't plead for you this time...

main2.line: Despite her devil-may-care attitude, Wales is actually quite reliable. In fact, she helps me all the time, even though we were once enemies...

main3.line: I went and told Hipper about our beach day, and all she said was, 'Why do I need to be jealous about your thin, lewd, and non-combat-ready swimming suit?' Haha, that's so like her!

touch.line: Commander, have you seen Wales? That rascal, she ditched me again!

touch2.line: There are a lot of good things about Wales, but please avoid picking up her bad habits.

unlock.line: Relaxing on a float, gently licking my lips... is this really the most popular photo pose for the beach? Wales, you’re not teasing me again, are you?

detail.line: Frohes neues Jahr~ This is how we say we say "Happy New Year" in the Iron Blood.

login.line: Ahh, Commander, wel~come~ home~

mail.line: New Year's greetings, huh? Aren't you the popular one~

main1.line: Commander~ let's have a drink~ and two more drinks~ ahh... let's keep going~

main2.line: Hey Commander, why don't we call everyone over and drink together~

main3.line: The Sakura Empire's sake is truly delicious~ Next time, why don't we ask those stingy girls to let us try some liquor from the Dragon Empery~

mission_complete.line: Commander, did the rewards have any tasty drinks?

touch.line: You want to drink this? Not~ gonna~ share~

unlock.line: So this is the Sakura Empire's New Year? Hehe, how interesting~ Commander, since it's the New Year, why don't you put aside all those papers and have a drink with me?

battle.line: Tsk... These fools need to learn how to read a room.

detail.line: Hehe... Commander, that's quite the scandalous expression you've got there... Are you sure you're not drunk, with how red your face is~?

home.line: Come on, don't be so tense. Just let go and relax.

login.line: Commander, did you come to have a drink?

main1.line: Compared to those other stuffy, teetotaling banquets, something a bit more... liberated like this one is much more enjoyable. Don't you agree, Commander?

main2.line: So, what do you like about me? My personality... or my body? If you lie, I'll make you take a shot~

main3.line: The Sakura Empire's liquors certainly have a distinctive flavor, but when a girl wants to cut loose, it's gotta be one of the classics~

touch.line: Pfft... You're just too cute when you act all bashful but still can't resist trying to ogle me, ahaha~!

touch2.line: You~ lewd~ beast~ Ahahaha~!

unlock.line: ... Huh? Commander, is that you? Me, drunk? No way... *hic*... If I was, Commander, then what are you planning to do to me? Hehe...

expedition.line: Commissions completed. Hehe, don't you want to go check up on them together?

home.line: Make sure you clean every last bit. ...Hehe, I'm talking about the machine, of course.

login.line: Commander, you're working pretty hard. Hehehe, take care not to wear yourself out~♪

lose.line: So this is what happens when you let your guard down...

main1.line: Here, let's pop a bottle to practice uncorking the celebratory champagne~ What's wrong, Commander? Are you not going to drink?

main2.line: Heinrich wants to compete in the race? How very like her... Wait a second, does she even know how to drive?

main3.line: Why don't you try getting changed into something too, Hipper? You know the Commander's secretly looking forward to it, right? ...If you want, I'll even lend you the outfit I'm wearing.

touch2.line: Just like that~♡

unlock.line: Viel Glück~ Are you having a good time, Commander? Just know that the only person I'm cheering for... is you~

win_mvp.line: I'm the MVP? Hehehe, what did you expect?

battle.line: Way to ruin the mood...!

detail.line: Would you like me to call you something else? Hmm, how about "mein Schatz♡"—Well? Hehehe♪

home.line: Let's celebrate the wonderful outing we had together, Commander~ It'd be such a waste to not drink one more glass... hmm? Is something wrong? Cat got your tongue?

login.line: "Welcome back. What'll be your order?" Is that what you were expecting? Heehee.

main1.line: Hehe. What are you all nervous for? Why don't you sit down at the counter? Here's the wine I recommend.

main2.line: You know, when we ran into Hipper the other day on our day out, she started sulking and turned beet-red the moment she saw your face. I wonder why? Heehee.

main3.line: It's customary to pour wine into a wine glass, but I'd like to try a different container. I wonder how I'd make a cocktail out of it.

mission_complete.line: Though I doubt the rewards can beat this moment, shouldn't you go pick them up anyway?

touch2.line: Hehehe, don't be in such a hurry. The night has only just begun♡

unlock.line: Guten Abend~ So, what do you think? Pretty great view, right? Hehe, I was talking about the night scenery outside, you know~?

win_mvp.line: Everything is sweeter with a bit of beer. Ehehe~

detail.line: This sport is a lot more taxing than I thought... I'm in such breathable clothes, and I'm still soaked from sweat. Commander, do you have any bright ideas?

expedition.line: The commission is done? I wonder if they brought those electrolyte drinks I asked for...

feeling5.line: You've been staring for a while now... Commander, was getting invited to practice all a part of your plan? Okay... Then let's practice our "touchdowns" together even more, why don't we?♥

home.line: *sigh*... Hnngh~ Welcome back, Commander. I just finished my training, and I'm all sweaty now... Heheh, hey, wanna go clean up in the shower together?

login.line: Phew... Commander, there you are. Hey, can my touchdown song go like this? "Mutig, stark, siegesklar!"

mail.line: A message? At a time like this?

main1.line: Phew... I am tired, but it's not that bad. After all, my reliable Commander is here to soothe me! How? With a kiss, of course♥ Heheh!

main2.line: Hey, do we have any cooler clothes? I always get really sweaty during games... It's fine because you'll wipe it up for me? Well, isn't that reassuring?

main3.line: Do you think we can use touchdowns in any other situations? For example, if I get on top of you like this... Heheh, ahahaha! Look at you blushing. I guess I scored, huh?

mission.line: Hmm, it looks like you've got some unfinished training tasks. Want me to check them out with you?

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards might not be as glamorous as winning the big game, but don't forget to grab them, too.

touch.line: A massage? I'm fine. Besides, wouldn't it bother you that I'm so sweaty?

touch2.line: Commander, I'm still in the middle of the game. At least control yourself until half-time♥

unlock.line: *pant*... Quarterback Prinz Eugen scores a touchdown. I can't believe I'm the one charging in now... Commander, can you bring me water and a towel? I'm getting a little sticky from all this sweat...

detail.line: You honestly hold your liquor much better than I expected... Ah, no, I'm your personal bunny girl – heehee. By the way, want another glass?

feeling5.line: Es ist interessant... Heehee. You know, it's unusual for a person not to have a second side like you. Come here. I need to "watch" you on a deeper level.

headtouch.line: Hoping to distract me? Heheh. You're gravely mistaken if you think it'll be that easy.

home.line: Oh, you're back. Let's pick up where we left off. I've selected several brands of whiskey. Which one will you be trying first?

login.line: You've seen me drunk before, haven't you? Well, now it's time for ME to see YOU drunk.

main1.line: Well, well, look who doesn't seem drunk in the slightest. Let's see if you're really made of stronger stuff♪

main2.line: Pretty nice mood in here, don't you think? Also... We're all to ourselves. No need to hold yourself back any longer.

main3.line: I've heard drinking several alcohols mixed together gets you wasted easily, but don't even think about trying it. Heh – I'll be happy with just seeing you tipsy.

touch.line: Seems we got physically close without realizing it... Heh. This is the perfect distance for watching you.

touch2.line: So you finally feel like revealing your true self? Nicht schlecht♪
