unlock.line: You sure seem to be enjoying yourself, Commander. Heehee – what amusing thing will you do next, I wonder? ...Me? Don't pay me any mind. I just want to see what you're like when you're drunk!

win_mvp.line: We should pop a bottle to celebrate. You won't let a single drop go to waste, right, Commander?

detail.line: In Ironblood, we also use animal nicknames to call our lovers, like teddy bear or little bunny or something else. So Commander, do you want me to call you teddy bear or little bunny?

home.line: Commander, the bathtub has been filled with hot water, so who goes first, or…?

login.line: Commander, you did not happen to peek at other girls while on the way here, right? ~~

mail.line: Receiving a lot of mails….after all, you're the Commander, a really popular one, huh.

main1.line: Ugh... my body suddenly feels so weak... I’d only recover if you give me a kiss, Commander.

main2.line: Don’t overstretch yourself at work ~ otherwise… my loneliness will drive me to tease you.

main3.line: I feel so lucky right now --- why you ask? Take--a--guess, dear?

mission.line: All these missions….you pick Commander...I’m ready for them all~

touch.line: I know what’s on your mind, Commander...but we need to focus on work right now.

unlock.line: If fate brought us together, then it has my thanks… I look forward to our future together~

battle.line: I'm going to enjoy mopping you all up~

detail.line: It's times like these... where I simply must punish you.

expedition.line: Hmph, so our little lambs managed to complete their commission. What a pleasant surprise.

feeling1.line: I have no interest in you anymore... I should find myself a new pet.

feeling2.line: There is no thrill like waging war with a grin on your face! There's no way a lowly animal like you could ever understand that! Ahahahaha!

feeling3.line: Lowly animal, root around for all you are worth to find something worthy of my attention. Ahahahaha~

feeling4.line: A lion doesn't concern itself with the bleating of sheep. But... I do find you interesting for a lowly animal. If you amuse me some more, maybe I will listen to your wishes.

feeling5.line: For keeping me amused this long, I shall grant you the privilege of holding me. Why are you still standing there? Have you never heard of a princess carry? Princess~ carry!

home.line: Pay attention, you idiot! Just because we're back at port doesn't mean that you're done.

hp_warning.line: Do not underestimate the great Deutschland!

login.line: You sure took your sweet time. Just where were you rooting around?

lose.line: I'd sink to the bottom of the ocean before surrending to you animals!

mail.line: You've received a letter in that lowly animal language of yours. Fetch~

main1.line: It seems like I must speak in a way that even lowly animals can understand.

main2.line: Hahaha! I didn't even need to fire my gun to scare off those cruisers~

main3.line: If you insist on standing around like an idiot, I'm just going to leave.

mission.line: Mission! There's no entry for "incomplete" in my dictionary!

mission_complete.line: Hurry up and fetch the rewards for me~

profile.line: Hmph! I'm Deutschland, the first ship of the Deutschland-class! A prestigious individual such as myself wouldn't be sent into smaller battles. As such, it's only natural that I don't have many of these petty achievements. It's called spiritual leadership! Hmph! Lützow? ...Shut up! Like I'd care about that!

propose.line: I never thought the day would come when I pledge myself to a lowly animal. I've never felt anything like this before... but it's unexpectedly fun. Ahahaha~! From now on, you're my vehicle number two! You should be grateful!

touch.line: You just never learn, do you? Do you want to taste my whip again that badly~?

touch2.line: Hmm? It seems like you're enjoying yourself... do you get off to this kind of stuff?

unlock.line: From now on, you are Deutschland's servant! You should feel honored. Also, don't answer me with "mhm." You will answer me with "yes, ma'am" from now on. Are we clear?

upgrade.line: Aren't you the obedient animal~

win_mvp.line: Even though the enemies were no big deal... what a pompous affair.

gift_prefer.line: Hmm~♪ Not too bad!

battle.line: I shall engrave my name into your bones!

detail.line: Slave, come here... Do not fear, these little bats won't hurt you.

home.line: You've done well for a slave. Come forth, I shall give you a little reward.

main1.line: Imbecile! I only wore this costume as a hobby. Who gave you permission to serve me such a repulsive beverage?

main3.line: Slave, help me get off my throne. Shorty? You imbecilic swine, do you think this is funny?

touch.line: Slave, offer your neck to me so that I may feed... Ahahaha! Imbecile, surely you didn't take me seriously!

unlock.line: For such a lowly animal, your taste is not bad... That's right, I am Deutschland, Demon Princess of the Iron Blood and Mistress of the Night! Plebeians, no, my slaves, I shall grant you an opportunity to swear fealty to me with a kiss!

win_mvp.line: Scream in agony! Tremble in fear! Kneel before me! Ahahaha!

detail.line: Lazy swine, don't cut corners. Anything less than a perfectly uniform application of sunscreen is unacceptable!

home.line: What's with that lax expression of yours as soon as you get back... Ho ho, do you need your master to "tighten up" those loose morals of yours?

login.line: Way! Too! Slow! Are you trying to get my pristine skin sunburnt?

main1.line: Plebeian, fetch those two towels over there and wipe my body dry.

main2.line: If your eyes wander any lower, they will get detached from their sockets. I say, there is no remedy for being uncultured swine~

main3.line: A lifebuoy? What would I use that for? Plebeian, were you not going to carry me on your back while swimming?

touch.line: To think that a plebeian would look at me with such a hungry, bestial expression. A lewd beast like this needs a thorough flogging.

touch2.line: Ho ho, it looks like this lowly swine cannot even control its basest desires.

unlock.line: One must not neglect sunscreen during the summer... Plebeian, if you wish to serve your master, prostrate yourself and yell "I beg of you, Queen Deutschland" three times, and I might consider giving you an opportunity. Ahahaha~

detail.line: What belongs to my lowly animal also belongs to me. Therefore, the stronger my lowly animal's fleet is, the clearer the proof of my excellence is.

home.line: Let's be clear here, I was not waiting for you. I simply can't show off the full extent of my grandeur as a master without the presence of my lowly animal.

login.line: Still sluggish as always. But because I'm in a pretty decent mood today, I'll forgive you!

lose.line: I have a banquet to attend, so I have no time to let myself get dragged through the mud by you lot~

mail.line: Getting mail right now sure spoils the mood. Let me see those!

main1.line: Lowly animal, you may offer your opinion about me and Graf Spee's dresses. Hmph, I bet your vocabulary doesn't include anything beyond "cute," ahahaha!

main2.line: Ehh? Graf Spee is actually talking to people from other factions...? I hope she's not being bullied... I'll have to give them a stern warning just in case...

main3.line: Tell me, lowly animal, why does everyone greet me instead of cowering in fear? ...Because they like me? R-really... Hmph. As a spiritual leader, it's only natural to be respected by all!

mission.line: Missions? What mission could possibly be more important than accompanying your master to the banquet?

mission_complete.line: Hmph... After seeing these rewards, I'll let you live.

touch.line: Dancing? Aha~ I just knew you'd come to me with this request, so I prac... err, prepared beforehand!

unlock.line: I seem pleased? Of course I am. Why wouldn't I be when my sweet little sister will be joining us at the party? Now shape up and entertain your master, you lowly animal! Ahahahaha!

win_mvp.line: You should feel honored to have the privilege of being ravaged by the one-and-only Deutschland while she is in a good mood!

detail.line: The decor in here is truly sumptuous... Hahahah! It further raises the pedestal of eminence atop which I sit! Isn't that right, lowly animal? Ahahahaha!

home.line: You lowly animal! For how long do you intend to ignore me?!

login.line: There you are, lowly animal. Now help me take off these heels! Strolling around in these things is so tiresome...

main1.line: If Spee wasn't so dear to me, I would've never even *considered* building a snowman!

main2.line: Oh lowly animal, your master is hungry. I've heard that the Dragon Empery's cuisine is very delectable... You know what to do now, yes? Ahahahahah!

main3.line: So much noise... Oh lowly animal, go outside and check what happened!

touch.line: Are you trying to touch my stole? I have no memory of granting a lowly animal permission to do that!

touch2.line: Hahah, do you yearn for my punishment that badly, lowly animal?

unlock.line: Why are so many people out and about during a holiday? ...That's it! Lowly animal, was it your idea to prepare all this to surprise me...?! Heh... Hehe, that's right, don't you dare disappoint me!

battle.line: For the honor and prosperity of Iron Blood, and for even greater glory!

couple_encourage1.line: Stay away from me...

couple_encourage2.line: You're still a dirty sadist, I see.

couple_encourage3.line: It's an honor to fight alongside you again.

detail.line: No matter how poor the odds are, I will always head for the battlefield. ...That way people will admire me.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed? That means they weren't ambushed. Thank goodness.

feeling1.line: No matter how you treat me, Commander, I will obey you...

feeling2.line: I sailed alone, fought alone, and sunk alone... Although I am who I am, didn't I still contribute to Iron Blood's cause?

feeling3.line: These hands are for grasping victory... Even though I will never again be able to hug the people important to me, what's done is done.

feeling4.line: Commander, rather than sink all alone, will I be able to face my final moments together with you this time?

feeling5.line: No matter how much I fight, I can't fill the void in my heart... And being away from you is the reason why...

headtouch.line: Commander, could you not ruffle up my hair like that...?

home.line: Commander, you've confirmed the port isn't being blockaded, right?

hp_warning.line: I have to hold out just a little longer...!

login.line: I will fight for you till the very end.

lose.line: We've lost... But I'm not giving up! It's not over yet!

mail.line: This letter... Thank goodness, it has nothing to do with Renown.

main1.line: Wars don't exist for mindless slaughter, they exist for victory.

main2.line: One's first battle being their last... That sort of thing isn't all that unusual for us Iron Blood ships.

main3.line: Give talking to people... a try? I've always been alone, so what am I supposed to talk about...

mission.line: Once we've been assigned a mission, we must complete it, no matter what it is.

mission_complete.line: I see that, unlike me in the past, you actually finished your mission.

profile.line: Admiral Graf Spee, Deutschland-class armored cruiser number 3 of the Iron Blood Navy. I was attacked by Royal Navy cruisers and then took refuge in Montevideo, but in the end I scuttled myself... Commander, this time I'm going to fight! To the very end!

propose.line: Although I cannot hug you, you can hug me... Hey, Commander, just for a little longer... hold me tight like this...

skill.line: In the name of all that is dear to me!

touch.line: It's sunny today? Yeah... just like it was back on the Río de la Plata.

touch2.line: Commander, may I hug you, even though my hands are like this?

unlock.line: No matter where I go, the war never ends... Deutschland-class armored ship number 3, Admiral Graf Spee, reporting for duty.

upgrade.line: So this is... power...

win_mvp.line: How long will this victory actually last...

gift_prefer.line: Thank you... It's perfect for a long journey.

battle.line: Don't go around disturbing the girls at the academy.

detail.line: I'm trying hard to learn about everyday things. Living a normal life is not so simple, compared to fighting...

feeling5.line: Does getting a hug from me like this cheer you up a little, Commander?

login.line: Eugen taught me how to use makeup, but... does it actually make me look pretty...?

lose.line: Can I... count on you...?

mail.line: This mail... it's not another one of Ajax's pranks, is it?!

main1.line: My pantyhose? Ajax gave me them as an enrollment gift... I examined them very thoroughly and didn't find anything weird, but I doubt they're just a normal pair of stockings...

main2.line: Viersechs doesn't like picture books? I see... Everyone else in the Z-class seems to like them, though...

main3.line: Hipper? Want some snacks? I get it. "Not really" means "yes" in your dictionary. Okay, say "aah."

touch.line: Deutschland? Could you stop using your megaphone to shout "people who harass the girl with my phone will be expelled"... It's embarrassing, and more importantly, it's really distracting...

touch2.line: ...You're making me angry.

unlock.line: I sailed alone, fought alone, and then I was sunk while being alone. Now I found a new beginning... Hmm? Commander, you've been staring and laughing at me since the beginning… do you want to eat this?

battle.line: To protect everyone who has shown me so much kindness... I won't let you take a step closer!

detail.line: I'm so glad that I can finally practice cooking! I want to give something back to all the kindhearted people here!

home.line: Welcome back! Cellphones are totally amazing, aren't they? No matter where we are, we can contact each other with the press of a button!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! Um... I heard from Ajax that you have a very "special" hobby... but what kind of hobby is it?

lose.line: I knew it... this totally reduces my fighting capabilities...

mail.line: Prinz Eugen is surprisingly clumsy with this kind of stuff. She's still chicken-pecking with one finger.

main1.line: Ajax... You're not pulling my leg this time, are you?

main2.line: Hipper is a totally different person on the internet compared to how she is in real life. Maybe she just has trouble expressing herself around people she cares about...

main3.line: Miss Illustrious, could you teach me how to make tea? Admiral Hipper invited me to a tea party between the Royal Navy and Iron Blood, but I've never brewed tea before...

touch.line: Thanks to Juustagram, even people like me who aren't very sociable can still chat with everyone... Oh look, Graf Zeppelin just made a new post!

touch2.line: Commander, I want to give you a hug too~

unlock.line: I never dreamt that I'd be able to don this outfit and live a normal, peaceful life... Thank you, Commander...

win_mvp.line: Commander, can you take a picture to celebrate me getting MVP? I want to show it to my friends!

battle.line: I will not let you disrupt the party for everyone else!

detail.line: A ballroom dance...? Sorry, but I don't really know how to... I just need to follow your steps? O-okay, then I could... give it a try.

feeling5.line: Thanks to all the friends I have now, I don't feel lonely anymore. And my encounter with you might be the happiest moment of my life. Ahahah~

home.line: Not everyone in the Royal Navy is like Ajax. I can actually have a productive conversation with most of them...

login.line: So this is where you were. There are so many people in the hall, and I was worried about what I'd do if I'd lost you...

mail.line: I know the party is still going on, but you still have to check your new mail.

main1.line: Ajax... She's not planning something weird for the party, is she?

main2.line: Everyone here is having so much fun... I could never even imagine my past self being at a place like this.

main3.line: Commander, my friends are calling for me. Could you excuse me for a bit?

touch.line: Commander, am I in time with your steps?

touch2.line: Commander, people are staring at us.

unlock.line: It's so fancy, so formal... Is this a "party"? I'm not sure I'll be able to fit in... But if you'll go with me, Commander, I'll give it a try!

battle.line: We're not done with the lesson yet...

detail.line: My sister's always pushing this "for the glory of Iron Blood" stuff onto me. Can't she do this idol stuff herself...?

feeling5.line: There was a time when I wanted nothing more than to break these claws off my hand. But now, I feel pretty good about all this "idol" stuff... Commander, I never thought it could ever live like this. Hehe.

home.line: "Commander, you did so well...! Commander, keep at it...!" That should be idolish enough, right?

login.line: Commander, do you mind if I practice here?

lose.line: Have we been spending too much time on idol lessons...?

mail.line: Commander, I got a new offer. Should I take it?

main1.line: Um... Maybe it's because I'm so used to working with everyone, but I feel like it's actually pretty easy being onstage.

main2.line: Commander, do you think you can stop my sister from getting everyone to hold up those "World's♡Cutest" signs when I go on? It's really embarrassing...

main3.line: Idols are there to make people smile... I never thought I could do something like that.

touch.line: These hands are no longer weapons of war, but for returning the admiration of my fans. Right, I can do this...!

touch2.line: Commander, have you forgotten what my hands can do?

unlock.line: My sister just wouldn't stop bugging me, so I finally caved and agreed to do this... Anyways, all I have to do is get up on stage and sing, right?

win_mvp.line: Commander, can we go home now?

battle.line: I'm gonna show you what I'm made of!

couple_encourage1.line: You'd better not drag me down!

detail.line: ...My guitar sounds a bit off today... Huh, try tuning it? Nah, that's not it, I just have to warm up a bit more...

expedition.line: What are you spacing out for? The commission fleet is back, and you're coming with me!

feeling1.line: Huh? There's no way I'd be able to work with an imbecile like you!

feeling2.line: I'm just laying this out there - if we're going to do it, then we're going to do it properly! I don't want a half-baked job... Hey, pay attention!

feeling3.line: Here, my schedule... Huh?! Look, anyone can do this kind of simple bookkeeping. It's not like I need you or anything!

feeling4.line: Ahh, ahh... I'm doing pretty good today... H-huh?! Who gave you permission to watch me?! I just happened to have some free time, that's all! Go away and take care of your own work!

feeling5.line: So, what's next on the agenda? You should already know, right? ...If you know, then hurry up and spit it out! Screw you! Stop teasing me already...!

home.line: Haah?! You big idiot, you took so long to come back that I was getting worr... Wait, what the heck am I saying?!

hp_warning.line: I'm not done yet!

login.line: Lessons are finally done for the day. Good grief, why'd I ever agree to do this...!

lose.line: Gaaah! I'll remember this!!

mail.line: Huh? Shouldn't you be in charge of vetting the fanmail?!

main1.line: Hey idiot, tell me what's next on my schedule! How long do you intend to keep me waiting?

main2.line: Deutschland, it's fine to be proud of your sister, but have some self-control! ...Jeez, you're so lucky to have such a reliable sister... Meanwhile, look what I'm stuck with...

main3.line: Huh? Who asked you to be my publicist? I'll earn my own fans!

mission.line: Mission or offer, it's all the same to me. Let's just get it out of the way!

mission_complete.line: Rewards, huh... It'd be better if Eugen wasn't constantly trying to get on my nerves...

profile.line: I'm the mightiest heavy cruiser in the world, Admiral Hipper of the Iron Blood. It's not like I wanted to do this or anything, I just had no say in the matter.

propose.line: H-huh?! Who would want a ring like this... Guh...! F-fine, you can p-put it on... Happy now? Let's wrap this up already. The stage we're aiming to be on is much loftier than this!

skill.line: I'll have you pay close attention to my performance!

touch.line: Haah? Who gave you permission to touch me?!

touch2.line: H-haah?! You did that on purpose, didn't you?!

unlock.line: Huh? Why are you staring at me like I'm some weirdo? I'll have you know, it's not like I wanted to do this or anything!

upgrade.line: Eugen, just you wait! I'll show you what I'm capable of!

win_mvp.line: If that's the best you can do, I should've just stayed home!

gift_prefer.line: You know exactly what I want, huh? Thank you~♪ Mwah~

battle.line: You stand in our way...? Then you will suffer!

detail.line: Everyone is enjoying these idol activities, but aren't you forgetting about our weapons? I shouldn't worry about them...?

expedition.line: The commission girls are back. Would you like to try, Commander? Line up for hugs, everyone~

feeling1.line: Would you like to be my "enemy," Commander...? Hehehe... hehehehehehe...!!!

feeling2.line: Everyone is working so hard at this idol business, for your sake~ Me? Of course I am~ My smile and my joy, it's all for you, Commander... Hehehe♪

feeling3.line: I feel a certain emptiness after working at this idol thing for a while... Maybe it's the combat... could it be because I can't sink as many as I used to...?

feeling4.line: Knowing that the Commander is watching me sing brings some fulfillment to my empty heart. Maybe... as you give me your time, you also give me your life... is that the feeling?

feeling5.line: I thought slaughtering my enemies was the only way to make me feel better, but you taught me another way, Commander. I never thought you'd be able to change me. You really must... pay for that♡

headtouch.line: Headpats, is it~?

home.line: Well fought. I got you a little something to eat, just as a way of saying thanks for all the training~

hp_warning.line: You're in the way... and you will pay!

login.line: Commander, what am I doing today? Orders please.

lose.line: Hm... I still think we should be fighting with conventional weapons.

mail.line: You've got mail~ I wonder what's inside?

main1.line: First I heal everyone with my soothing song, then I shred them with its power. Hehehe, I know how it works.

main2.line: That Sakura girl, she's fragile; she can't take many hits... What can I do to help her?

main3.line: I must pour my heart into my song... I may not be very good, but I'll try my best.

mission.line: A combat mission? Yes! I'd love to join~

mission_complete.line: You've been working just as hard as me. Good job, Commander~

profile.line: I am Iron Blood Cruiser Roon. I'm currently equipped with special "Muse System" rather than my usual loadout. It's definitely "special," but it is combat ready, and I can't wait to tear something apart with it. Thank you for this, Commander.

propose.line: "Something too perfect and beautiful to destroy."――I never knew my concert could be so great. I want to perform more, to shine more, to take more and more of your time, Commander... until it runs out♪ Hehehe...

touch.line: You want a hug? Sure, any time~

touch2.line: Let's enjoy some "intimacy" a little later~

unlock.line: Heavy cruiser Roon, reporting for idol activities and associated experimental equipment testing. Today, we fight not with fire and sword, but with the power of song.

upgrade.line: There is something intruiging about using sound as a weapon~

win_mvp.line: Oooh this feeling... when I tear them to pieces...!

gift_prefer.line: Wooow! Thank you so much!

battle.line: Let 'em have it, girls! Los! Los!

couple_encourage1.line: Bad Eisen! Stop trying to scare people!

couple_encourage2.line: Team Armored Ships, comin' at ya!

detail.line: What's a good way to make Eisen look less threatening... Hmm, maybe some cute stickers would do the trick?

expedition.line: The commission team's back! Put me on the next one, please? Come on, coach!

feeling1.line: I don't know what made you this way, but if nobody else is gonna fix you, then I will! Just shut up and grab hold of my hand!

feeling2.line: A past free of regrets paves the way for the future! Wow, that makes me sound super sophisticated! Hahahah! Am I right, Eisen? Right, Commander?

feeling3.line: I just love listening to people talk about their history. Wish I had one... If I did, what'd it be like? I'm having fun just imagining it!

feeling4.line: Tell me more about yourself, Commander! Tell me what it's like to lead a fleet, or some funny mistake you've made! Come on, tell me, I wanna know!

feeling5.line: You down to go on another date today? When? Sometime later, I guess? Where? We'll cross that bridge when we get to it! No point in planning everything in advance! C'mon, with me!

headtouch.line: Woo!

home.line: Sortieing sounds a heck of a lot more fun than rusting away in port, don'tcha think? Take me out on the next one, come on!

hp_warning.line: I'm not done for just yet!

login.line: Welcome back! Let's get fired up and do this thing! Hahahah!

lose.line: Wait, we lost? How the heck?!

mail.line: Bad Eisen! Stop munching on the mail! The Commander will get in trouble!

main1.line: My gut tells me the papers you're looking for are right here! ...Aww, I was wrong?

main2.line: There's plenty girls in other factions who don't have a history, huh! I thought it was just an Iron Blood thing.

main3.line: Sure, Peter gives me a lot of flak, but honestly, I dunno how I'd manage to get anything done! Hahahah!

mission.line: A new mission? Say no more! I'll kerpow all the enemies to kingdom come!

mission_complete.line: So much paperwork and signing-off just for finishing one mission... My soul's boutta leave my body... Anyway, here's the rewards...

profile.line: An introduction? You got it! My name's Prinz Heinrich, I'm a P-class armored ship. What else is there... Hmmmm... Eisen! Hey, Eisen, any ideas what to tell the Commander?

propose.line: Hmm, I think you're supposed to follow the ring up with something else... Oh, now I remember what! *kiss*... Hahahah! I'm so glad to be with you, Commander!

skill.line: My intuition tells me to just do it!

touch.line: Mmmhh! Aahhh... Don't you ever get restless, working as much as you do, Commander? Get up and we'll take a jog down the hall!

touch2.line: Stop RIGHT there! This is where I draw the line!

unlock.line: Hello there, Commander~! I'm the P-class armored ship, Prinz Heinrich. My little friend here is called Eisen... Hey, Eisen! Introduce yourself to the commander normally... Wait, how many times have I told you not to chew on others' clothes?!

upgrade.line: I feel the powah!

win_mvp.line: Sweet victory! Not to mention MVP! Hahahah!

gift_prefer.line: Woah, I've always wanted this! Thanks a bunch!

detail_ex.line: Whoa, whoa, you need to hold still, Eisen! Otherwise I'll mess up the sticker placement! Hey, Commander, gimme a hand here~!

expedition_ex.line: I sent the commission team off to the dorm! You said I could I do that, remember?

home_ex.line: All right, so, you either have to send me on a sortie, or hang out with me! Time to choose, Commander!

login_ex.line: Welcome back! Let's get this show on the road, Commander!

main1_ex.line: What have we here? The paperwork you're looking for? Hahahah, see? I told you you could count on my intuition!

main2_ex.line: Whoa, it's like a party in here! What're you all chatting about? "What if I'd actually been built"? Hey, as long as I could still come see you, I'm fine with any kind of past~

main3_ex.line: Come at me then, Miss Spiritual Leader! Let's see if you're hot stuff or not! ...Oh, it's a video game rivalry thing.

mission_complete_ex.line: You're a meanie, making me do this office work which I'm no good at! ...We'll go claim the rewards together in just a bit? Fine, I'll hang in there for now...

touch_ex.line: I see you yawning there, Commander. What do you say to taking a refreshing little stroll outside?

touch2_ex.line: Whuah?! Geesh, Commander, I know who you are, okay?

detail.line: Where Eisen's gone? It's New Year's after all, so I let him out to play. He's a good boy! He won't harm anyone.

home.line: Apparently, you're meant to yell "tamaya" when they launch the fireworks! Dunno why that is, but sounds fun! ...What? That's only in the summer?

login.line: I've heard the Sakura Empire has loads of fun New Year customs! We've got to check 'em out together, Commander!

main1.line: Strasser gave me an envelope with cash inside! She said it's a Sakura Empire and Dragon Empery tradition! Commander, you gimme one too~

main2.line: Let's crank it up to eleven for New Year's! Even Spee's out there having fun with the gang!

main3.line: Can't we leave all the office work for later and get dressed for a snowball fight? I promised Lebe I'd come!

touch.line: You in the mood for an outdoor stroll? Hahahah, I'll be just fine in the cold, don't worry.

touch2.line: Hey! Hold it right there! I'm gonna doodle on your face as payback for that!

unlock.line: Phew... Changing into these clothes took quite a long time~ So, how does it look? A fine mixing of different cultures, wouldn't you agree? Ahaha, Happy New Year, Commander!

detail.line: Commander, I will save you if start drowning, but that doesn't mean you shouldn't try to save yourself first! Listen, I'll teach you all you'll need to know!

login.line: Morning, Commander! You here today for a swim, or to check girls out? Hahaha!

main1.line: Can rabbits swim, or can they not? I wonder if... Wait, why am I letting this question distract me?

main2.line: Eisen, stop it! That's my swimsuit lace, you can't pull on... Oh gosh! Don't look, Commander!

main3.line: Thanks for keeping an eye on everyone, Béarn! You're doing good work!

touch.line: You want me to swim with you? Hahaha~ Sure thing!

unlock.line: *ptwee*! Remember: safety first! Commander, you've got to do your stretches before going in the pool! Be thorough, or I'll get mad at you!

detail.line: The stage set's taken a real beating, but that's not entirely my fault. You could kinda say Eisen threw a fit, and... yeah.

home.line: How's the school doing? If you see anyone trying to pick a fight, tell me, Commander. Heh!

login.line: Morning! ...Come on, Commander, say it like you mean it! Lemme hear you put some diaphragm into it!

mail.line: There's a letter for you. Do you think it's a love letter, or a challenge to a brawl?

main1.line: The banners say, "Undefeatable – The world is mine." Basically, I'm as tough as they come, 'cause I rule this school!

main2.line: Aw, crap! It's Strasser... No, wait, it's the Morals Committee! Please, no more catch-up lessons!

main3.line: If I find any juvies, I'll whoop their butts! Hey, wait a sec... Aren't we juvies, too? Hiryuu! Explain this to me!

touch.line: Hm? You got me bread from the canteen? Thanks~

touch2.line: Commander?! Hrmh, you picked the wrong girl to mess with!

unlock.line: Listen up, Commander! I'm the one in charge of this school's seedy underbelly here at this port, so you'd better do what I tell you to! In return, I'll offer you my protection! Ahaha~♪

win_mvp.line: Now do you get who owns this place?

detail.line: The idol girls sing before a crowd all the time, which takes serious guts! Do you think I've got what it takes to be an idol, Commander? Not quite? Why the heck not?!

expedition.line: The commission team's back? Eisen, go with the Commander and give 'em a warm welcome!

home.line: Great timing, Commander. I was just about to start singing! Since you're already here, stick around and listen♪

login.line: Welcome, Commander. The party's already started. Quick, grab a chair and sit down! You too, Eisen!

main1.line: No one told me I'd sing for THIS big a crowd! Strasser, bail me out!

main2.line: What?! Bismarck and Tirpitz are in the crowd?! Oh shoot, this is nerve-racking! Commander, do you know any quick ways to calm down?!

main3.line: Where'd Ulrich go? She's supposed to provide accompaniment! ...Hm? What'd you say? Our genres don't mesh?

touch.line: Has my dress got you bewitched? Heheh~ You'll make the other girls jealous if you keep ogling me~

touch2.line: Whoa! You're dead drunk, aren'tcha? Eisen, fetch the bouncer!

unlock.line: Alrighty, I'm gonna sing a song for you now! Surprised by how jazzy and womanly I can be, are you? Ahahah!

battle.line: Ho-kay! Warm-ups done, now let's do this thing!

couple_encourage1.line: Smash through 'em, Heinrich!

detail.line: Why're you always staring off in the distance, Commander? Got something on your mind? Maybe I can help you with it.

expedition.line: Hello? A commission's done. The girls brought back a ton of stuff, so I helped them out with it.

feeling1.line: You're such a lame-ass... I'm gonna go hang with someone else.

feeling2.line: Let's start by checking out the depot. There's bound to be peeps there who need a hand or just wanna hang out.

feeling3.line: Heya, Commander, I got those documents you asked for... Took longer than you expected? Yeah, uhh... I ran into Magdeburg and went jogging with her, then Heinrich and I played with Eisen, and after that... Yeah, I kinda lost track of time...

feeling4.line: Seeing other people happy makes me happy too~ That's why I love both helping people and hanging out with 'em equally. Other girls have said we're the same in that regard, you and I. You just love seeing people happy too, right?

feeling5.line: Sooo, how 'bout say we look around for people in need of a helping hand? There ain't no problem we can't solve together. And if nobody needs help, we can just hang out instead.

headtouch.line: Huh? I don't recall doing anything to earn a headpat, but okay.

home.line: Ever thought about setting up an outdoors office space, Commander? The warm sunshine and fresh air's waiting for you outside!

hp_warning.line: My comeback is-a coming in round two!

login.line: Come on. Time to get motivated, Commander.

lose.line: Retreating already? Guess I'll do the same...

mail.line: Yo, your mailbox is full. Want me to empty it for you?

main1.line: This hourglass is real neat. Let's reset it and watch the sand go again. And again... Welp, that got old fast. Now 'scuse me while I go rummage through your desk for other cool gadgets.

main2.line: Sheesh, that's a crazy amount of paperwork on your desk. Wait, can't we just feed 'em to the shredder and be done with it? ...No? Fine, I won't do it then.

main3.line: Don't you ever feel fed up, doing the same task for hours at a time? I'd give up after like, thirty minutes.

main4.line: You know how Heinrich nicknamed her rigging "Eisen"? I'm thinking about naming mine too.

mission.line: The mission list grows ever longer... I say we just put it through the paper shredder, honestly.

mission_complete.line: Hey, Commander, the mission rewards are piling up at the pier.

profile.line: Heya, I'm P-class armored cruiser Prinz Adalbert. All P-class ships are a force to be reckoned with, at least according to Heinrich. So yeah, if you need some nasties taken care of, just gimme a call~

propose.line: Does this mean we're like, super duper besties? ...Even more than that? Huh... Super duper ultra mega besties then? Let's go with that, and promise each other we'll always be together~

touch.line: Mind helping out with my training, Commander?

touch2.line: You can't go 'round doing this to girls, Commander.

unlock.line: Made it safely to port! Time to have a look around. Question is, where to start... Hm? Are you the Commander? All right. 'ello, nice to meet you, and all that jazz. See you around~

upgrade.line: Woo! Yeah! Feeling stronger already!

win_mvp.line: K.O.! The enemies are all down for the count!

gift_prefer.line: Woahhh, it's lovely! Thank you, Commander~

detail_ex.line: Yeah, hey... Hmm... Huh? Me? I'm as carefree as can be. What about you? Something you wanna get off your chest?

feeling5_ex.line: You down to hang out with me today? Ah, right, you've got work... Tell you what, I'll help you with it. First order of business: putting a smile on your face~

headtouch_ex.line: Huh? This is praise, right? Thanks.

home_ex.line: I'm gonna open the window and get some fresh air in here. C'mon! Breathe in, breathe out!

login_ex.line: Howdy. Finished charging your batteries? I can help if you still need more energy.

main5_ex.line: Man, your desk is just loaded with neat stuff. Hehehe, ain't never a dull moment in your office~

main6_ex.line: I'm like a human shredder, tearing paperwork you don't wanna do into ribbons... Hmm. You sure you can still manage with this amount?

main7_ex.line: It's not so bad doing the same task all day when you've got someone to vibe with~

main8_ex.line: Heard Strasser sat Heinrich down and made her read a book for once. Maybe I should find something to read before bedtime.

touch_ex.line: I was thinking I'd do something fun with you before today's training. Yeah, THAT kinda fun.

touch2_ex.line: You've really got a, uh, keen interest in women's bodies.

detail.line: How'd I end up here, lying down on the counter...? Think I closed up shop then got all sleepy... *yawn*... Truth be told... I'm still pretty sleepy.

expedition.line: Those girls you sent out are back? I'll whip up some drinks for them later.

home.line: We're meant to be closed for the day, but I'm all ears if you've got any requests~

login.line: Welcome, Commander! It's kind of odd saying "welcome" when I'm lying down, but hey.

mail.line: Mail always finds its way to you wherever you go, huh?

main1.line: Taking orders, moving dishes, and cleaning tables, that's this job in a nutshell. Never gets boring as long as you do 'em in rotation!

main2.line: Honestly, not a fan of the liquor menu. All the drinks on there make my head spin...

main3.line: Earlier today, I was caught gawking at my coworkers while they were mixing drinks. I was so distracted that Bismarck herself called me out for it.

mission.line: We've still got missions to do! See? You do need my help~

mission_complete.line: Finished a mission, huh? I say you've earned yourself a drink.

touch.line: I'm no marionette, ya hear!

touch2.line: This stuff won't fly during open hours, ya hear?

unlock.line: Zzz... Huh? Did I doze off? I just meant to rest my eyes for a sec after closing up, but look how long I slept... Hang on, why are you still here, Commander?

detail.line: I tripped 'cause I was playing with bubbles. I got so engrossed that I covered the whole bathroom in the stuff, and you know the rest. I've learned my lesson now!

expedition.line: A commission's been completed? So that's why they brought a new basket. Anyhow, check this out, Commander!

feeling5.line: Man, it's good you were here! I always knew we could overcome any adversity as long as we were together. Well, maybe calling falling over "an adversity" is a bit much... Hey, uh, why are you staring daggers through me?

headtouch.line: Hm? You wanna wash my hair? Cool. Go right ahead!

home.line: Hey, don't rush your way into the tub. Take it slow so you won't slip like I did.

login.line: Boy, am I glad you're here, Commander... even if I definitely won't trip again. For sure.

mail.line: Huh? What's a letter for you doing in here? Aw crap! It's gonna get soaked!

main1.line: Mgh! Hngh! This soap is so bubbly! I'm gonna need your help to wash them away.

main2.line: You can stop it with that concerned look already. My rear don't hurt anymore. Also, sitting to wash is pretty comfy – you should give it a try.

main3.line: What's the rush, Commander? Take it easy. If you start to trip, I'll catch you.

mission.line: The mission list? Oh, I almost forgot. What can I say? It got too wet to read.

mission_complete.line: It's fine 'cause you finished that mission? Oh. Then someone's gotta go claim the rewards!

touch.line: You'll scrub my back? Go on.

touch2.line: Is this the kind of scenario that gets you fired up?

unlock.line: Oh, good timing. Pass me the shampoo bottle over– Whooooaaaa! Ow, oww... Hey, uh, Commander, could you help me get back up on my feet?

upgrade.line: Wow! Doubt I'll be tripping again now!

detail.line: (The Commander's too smart to get fooled by this trick... Wait, that expression... I've been seen through already? Huh...)

feeling5.line: Your eyes are moving away from my hat... and onto my face... Y'know, Commander, are you really looking to get outta here? Or... Or have you been after me this whole time?!

headtouch.line: Hmm. I can't move too much before the show starts. If the critters under my hat get spooked... there's not gonna be anything I can do.

home.line: Mind you're not wasting your energy, Commander. No one knows how to open that exit 'cept me! Mmh, though I guess I could escort you out if you figure out the trick I'm about to show you. How does it sound?

login.line: I'm gonna give this performance my all, seeing as I got you to come watch. But d'you mind helping me track down my escaped rabbit first?

main1.line: Watch closely... You see this coin here? ...Poof! Which hand do you think it's in now? Oops, you got it wrong. You're not gonna see through my trick that easily!

main2.line: Huh? The fireworks machine went off? Don't tell me you found the machine hidden behind the curtain? Ah, shoot! I said too much...

main3.line: What're you looking at, Commander? My hat, the stage... No, you're staring at my bunny ears and tail, right? That's not where I'm hiding my magical secrets!

touch.line: What's that? You wanna check my hat? Sure, go ahead... Be careful, though. If you stick your hand in there, you might not be able to get it back out.

touch2.line: You wanna search for the secrets behind my magic? Sure thing – Take it nice and slow.

unlock.line: Huh? Damn... You made it to the magician's training hall. Alright. I'll let ya be the first to see my new trick.

battle.line: Time to earn your paycheck, Commander.

detail.line: You're free to regard me as a tool – a means to exert your power. Heehee. I don't mind.

expedition.line: Those girls have returned from their commission. You commanded them wisely. Heehee.

feeling1.line: Heehee. You may be a worthless, hopeless imbecile, but I still have use for you.

feeling2.line: Kindly tell me if there's something you want me to do. Likewise, I'll suggest new things I can do as I come up with them.

feeling3.line: There are certain things only you can do, so try not to become too dependent on me. Having said that... I wouldn't refuse if you offered to become my puppet.

feeling4.line: You really have a charismatic aura that draws people in. It's why you're deserving of my loyalty... or should I say, my love. Heehee.

feeling5.line: Isn't it high time you picked the location of our next date? You are the Commander, your job is to lead us shipgirls. Or would you rather I gave you a list of candidate locations, as per usual? ...W-well? Which will it be?

home.line: Welcome back. Next time you bring me on a sortie, please make it as good as the one just now was.

hp_warning.line: Seems like covering our rear is my only strong suit.

login.line: Excuse me for being so early, heehee. Now, show me that leadership of yours and make me happy.

lose.line: How unfortunate... If only we had more backbone.

mail.line: There's a letter for you. The most I can do is hand it to you, sadly. Heehee.

main1.line: Spee, if it's friends you want, I can be yours. We'll have so much fun together. Heehee♪

main2.line: That I serve someone is all that matters, not whom I serve. It could just as well be Emden as it could be you. Though admittedly, very few are able to command me.

main3.line: You look strapped for work, which I'm quite happy about. The more things I do for you, the easier your job becomes. Isn't that the best arrangement one could want?

mission.line: It's of no concern to me if some missions sit and gather dust, but what's your plan for them, Commander?

mission_complete.line: Letting the mission rewards pile up to collect them all in one fell swoop once is more satisfying, don't you agree?

profile.line: I'm Yorck, Iron Blood cruiser. While I've hardly a single feat to boast about, I have many strengths I can offer you. It's your choice whether or not to accept them, though♪

propose.line: From planning the ceremony to sending out invitations, you left it all to me. Do I take that to mean you're ready to be mine? Say it, then. "I take Yorck to have and to hold from this day forward." Let me hear that resolve, that desire of yours♥

skill.line: Hope you like being chopped to pieces. Heehee♪

touch.line: Hmm? Are you trying to chat me up, or issue an order?

touch2.line: Oh, I see... You want the same done to you, hmm♥

unlock.line: The name's Yorck – I'm a cruiser. As of today, I'm in your hands. State your orders, and I will make my goals and desires one and the same as your directives. A wonderful arrangement, no? Heehee.

upgrade.line: Why, you... I must say, I'm pleasantly surprised. Heehee.

win_mvp.line: What will you do next? Keep advancing, or call it quits and pull back?

gift_prefer.line: Were you perhaps influenced by my preferences, or...

detail_ex.line: Before you state your business, I'd like to ask a question. Are you here to speak with Yorck, the subordinate, or me, your wife in marriage?

home_ex.line: Tenacious and brave in the face of incoming attacks... I see. There's always so much to learn from your strategies.

login_ex.line: Ah, you're right on time, as you said you would be. I do fancy a person true to their word. Heehee.

main4_ex.line: nil

main7_ex.line: You want me to call you something else? I'm fine with either "Commander" or "Leader." "Master" is on the table too, if that's your thing.

touch_ex.line: You're requesting my aid without even realizing it, aren't you? Heehee.

touch2_ex.line: You know, I think I like it when you somewhat force yourself onto me. Heehee♥

win_mvp_ex.line: After all the faith you've put in me, this is the least I can do.

battle.line: There shall be left no trace of your existence.

detail.line: Acting as though I control you is surprisingly enjoyable. Thank you for this one night of indulgence, Commander.

home.line: Oh my. You've returned with a small navy's worth of glory. That's my Commander.

login.line: Your office chair pales in comparison to my throne. Don't you want to sit on it for yourself?

main1.line: Let's put Deutschland to the test and see who compels the most people... No, I meant between her and you, Commander.

main2.line: A vampire hunter, you say? I wonder whether Seydlitz could make it all the way here without your aid.

touch.line: Should it not be you who decides what to do, not me?

touch2.line: Oh. Oh my...

unlock.line: "Foolish, pitiable creature. Kneel before your Goddess!" Heehee! Hahahah, ahahahaha♥ You're the Commander, silly. You don't need to play along unless you want to.

win_mvp.line: You expected anything different? Victory is par for the course when you're a Goddess.

detail.line: Waiting and watching for your next move is a new experience for me. Of course, I'm more than happy to let you give me commands, too♥

feeling5.line: Heehee, it's about time for tonight's main event, isn't it? As Commander, you can't afford to back down... Oh, have you decided to obey someone else's commands for once? ...Make your decision now, okay? It's not nice to keep a woman in suspense.

home.line: Oh? You changed clothes... I see you have "armor" for our little contest, too, Commander♪

login.line: Oh, there you are, Commander. Nobody else is around, you know. What comes next, I wonder...? I can't wait to find out, heehee.

main1.line: Wow, what a nice view. Is there anything you... want me to do for you? And I don't mean just for tonight♥

main2.line: Heheh, it's time to take it easy, okay? Empty that little brain of yours and just stare at me.

main3.line: "Honey." "Darling." "My dearly beloved Commander." Which do you prefer? Or do you like them all? Heheheh, I'm game for anything. I'll just follow your orders♥

touch.line: Heehee, did you think of any fun ideas? I'll gladly do whatever you'd like!

touch2.line: Do whatever you want. Heehee♥

unlock.line: This is armored cruiser Yorck, and I'm ready for a night with you, Commander. My "armor" today – my outfit, if you'd prefer – is made to be enticingly light AND stimulate your desire... Heehee, don't expect to get away from me easily tonight♥

win_mvp.line: What a satisfying victory. Shall we continue, or should we go somewhere a little more private?

battle.line: I'm giving it my all!

detail.line: When I look at Hipper, I tend to get the feeling that I'm more mature than she is... Is it just me? Look, Hipper's getting all sulky again♪

expedition.line: Looks like they're done with commissions. I wonder if they'll take me with them if I ask nicely...

feeling1.line: Sigh... what an absolute disappointment.

feeling2.line: Commander, got anything to spill about the recent mission? I mean, it's been pretty boring only reading books these days. So, has anything interesting happened?

feeling3.line: The Commander was still working when I got up from my nap. I wonder if they're getting enough rest... Well, it doesn't look that bad at least.

feeling4.line: If nobody told you to stop working, you'd just keep working without rest, so I'll let you know when it's snack time. Got it? I want you to take a break, and I also want to eat some snacks.

feeling5.line: Thank you for telling me all these interesting stories. One day, I want to head out to the huge ocean, and see all kinds of sights. Of course, you'll be with me when I do, won't you? ...Hehehe, I'm looking forward to it.

headtouch.line: Treating me like a child... I see. Then come at me with all you've got.

home.line: Commander, don't you think it's about time for snack time? Hehehe, keep it coming.

hp_warning.line: It's not over yet...!

login.line: Good morning. Good luck with your work. I'll be here reading a book until you finish.

lose.line: So this is what defeat tastes like... Don't expect this to happen next time...!

mail.line: There's some new mail. Make sure to check on it before you end up forgetting.

main1.line: Alright, all that's left to do is put my finger on my lips like this... Tehehe, seeing your expression made putting this pose on completely worth it.

main2.line: I can't wait until the day I can set sail with my friends... I mean, it's boring, spending all day stuck in here...

main3.line: I don't get what people find tasty about alcohol. Even smelling the stuff makes me feel all dizzy.

mission.line: Here's a new mission. Let me know when you want some help.

mission_complete.line: You're sharing the reward with me? Thank you.

profile.line: I'm Prinz Eugen, third ship of the Admiral Hipper class. I like to read books all day since I'm still too young to go outdoors much. Uhh, I don't like beer... Is there anything else you wanna know?

propose.line: Do you really need to ask me about my response when you should know what it is already? "The promised future I'd like to fulfill with you..." ...I can't hear you. Come on, speak louder! Even louder than that!

skill.line: Hehe, seems like a good time to use this.

touch.line: Whew... That shower left me feeling super refreshed... Yawn... Commander? Did you want to take a nap together?

touch2.line: This is what people mean when they say, "You can't judge a book by its cover." Hehehe~

unlock.line: Are you the Commander? I'm Prinz Eugen, Iron Blood heavy cruiser. Let's shake hands and be friends~ I'm looking forward to having a lot of fun. Heehee~

upgrade.line: That felt nice. I'll expect more from you next time.

win_mvp.line: This doesn't feel half bad. Teehee☆

gift_prefer.line: Did my sister tell you? Thank you very much. It means a lot to me.

detail_ex.line: I was out to console Hipper, but now you're jealous of her? Hehe, you're both so high maintenance.

home_ex.line: What is it? You look ravenous, as if you want something more than just a snack. What, I'm just making fun of you♪

login_ex.line: Oh, already done with work? Then how about you play with me instead of reading a book?

main4_ex.line: Mein Schatz... My Darling~ I felt it was fitting to use grown-up words for my dear grown-up Commander. Hehe, what are you blushing so much for.

main5_ex.line: It's not boring at all being in this place when I'm together with you... That's how I've come to feel.

main6_ex.line: What do you mean, I should get over it and force it down, Hipper you dummy. It's over... my head is spinning...

mission_ex.line: I was free, so I took care of part of the mission for you.

touch_ex.line: Mmn, isn't it a bit early... Let me sleep in a bit longer... Zzz

touch2_ex.line: So is this how adults play together? Hehehe~

win_mvp_ex.line: It wasn't a big deal for me.

battle.line: I'll do whatever it takes for my friends!

couple_encourage1.line: You don't need to watch over me all the time...

couple_encourage2.line: You're not a meanie... right?

couple_encourage3.line: W-will you be my friend?

detail.line: I'll keep you safe when danger shows up. That's just what friends do for each other!

expedition.line: Wow, look at all these rewards! Are these all from the commission team?

feeling1.line: Please, Commander... don't leave me all alone...

feeling2.line: You're the first friend I've made since I came here. Hehehe, I thought you'd be too scared of my big steel hands. I try to only use them to scare bad people.

feeling3.line: Ajax is a good friend. We play together all the time. But Deutschland says she's a big meanie... Also, what does it mean when Ajax calls someone her "piggy"?

feeling4.line: Thanks for always being here for me, Commander! I've made tons of friends, and I'm getting better at fighting... Life here is so much fun! Hehehe, can I give you a hug as thanks? Hehehe~

feeling5.line: You're my best friend and I love you, Commander! I wanna pinky promise with you that we'll be friends forever! But I guess that'd be hard since my hands are so big... Okay, how about shaking my pinky instead?

headtouch.line: Whuah! Y-you surprised me there...

home.line: Zzz... Mgh... Commander... When will you be back...?

hp_warning.line: I, I can't take much more...

login.line: Oh, welcome back, Commander. I'm glad I'm not alone anymore. Hehehe...

lose.line: Ugghh... I wanna go home, Commander...

mail.line: Here's a letter for you, Commander. Darn it, the envelope is so small it's hard to hold on to...

main1.line: You're so focused on work that we barely have time to play... *sigh*... But I know I shouldn't annoy you, because I'm a good girl!

main2.line: Commander, put this on. There we go! Now you can use steel hands of your own!

main3.line: Talking to my friends is fun! We talk about food, funny stories, and even... Hehehe, well, everything!

main4.line: Oh, it's totally empty... Um, this bag of snacks, I mean. The crunchy cones. Can I go to Akashi's store and buy more? Please?

main5.line: World's... Cutest...? Deutschland, why do you have this sign?

mission.line: Will you stay with me after our missions are done, Commander? I-if there are still lots to go, then forget I asked...

mission_complete.line: A mission's been completed? Alright! I wonder if I'll ever get to help with them one day...

profile.line: I'm Admiral Graf Spee, Deutschland-class armored cruiser of the Iron Blood. I'm stronger than regular heavy cruisers because I've got a bigger bore than them!

propose.line: Weee! I'm flying! Now I'm even taller than you! ...There we go... Hehehe, um, can you keep hugging me? Also, you have to super-duper promise you'll always stay with me!

touch.line: Give me another hug, Commander! Hehehe...

touch2.line: Um, Deutschland said she'll tear you limb from limb if you touch me here... I-it's okay, I'll make sure she doesn't!

unlock.line: Hi. I'm Admiral Graf Spee, from the Iron Blood. Umm... I hope I can make lots of friends here... Will you be my friend, Commander?

upgrade.line: I'll use this new strength to protect my friends!

win_mvp.line: We've taken out all the baddies, Commander. That means there's no one left to bully us.

gift_prefer.line: Wooow, amazing! I love you!

battle_ex.line: I'll do whatever it takes for my friends, especially my best friend, the Commander!

detail_ex.line: Honestly, I don't like fighting much... But I know we have to defeat the baddies so me and my friends can all play together every day!

headtouch_ex.line: Hehehe, this makes me happy...

home_ex.line: Zzz... Zzzzz... The Commander's still not home... I just wanna see you again...

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! Hehehe, I want my daily hug now!

main6_ex.line: Oh. Don't worry about me, Commander! I'm a good girl and I'd never distract you when you're trying to work!

main7_ex.line: Do you want some snacks too? Okay! ...Oh, wait, I need to take the steel hands off...

main8_ex.line: I've made lots of new friends, but I promise I'll never forget about you, Commander! Because you're my best friend ever!

main9_ex.line: Hey, look, it's Little Renown! Renown, over here! ...Huh? She's ignoring me... Was that really not Renown after all?

mail_ex.line: Hehehe, I've gotten better with my steel hands... Oops! I gripped too hard and squashed your mail! S-sorry...

mission_ex.line: Do you have new missions, Commander? I wanna help with them, even if just a little!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. Hehehe, even if it wasn't much, I did manage to help!

touch_ex.line: I love it when you hug me...

touch2_ex.line: Hm? What's special about this part of me? Do you do this with everyone else too...?

battle.line: The time hath come for tough love!

couple_encourage1.line: Goodness, you can be such a child...

detail.line: It was love that brought us together, and it is love that binds us to this fate of being together forever and ever. Heehee♥

expedition.line: The commission team? They must be back from their voyage full of love.

feeling1.line: Goodness me. All this time, you've been a naughty child who just won't listen... I suppose some kids are born to be unruly.

feeling2.line: Heehee. That face you're making just screams "pleeease coddle me." Well, ask and I shall give – come into my arms. I'm always ready to give you my love.

feeling3.line: Sometimes, when I'm with you, my heart starts aching for love. Heehee, well, little one? Will you help me out?

feeling4.line: I feel your love deep inside of me, little one... But, please remember that loving me means to love yourself, okay? Then again, it's okay if you forget. When you do, I'll give you my love again♥

feeling5.line: Can you feel it, little one? All the love inside of me is on the brim of bursting forth. Heehee, we're going to make so much love together!

headtouch.line: Heehee, oh, you silly little thing – shouldn't it be ME doing this to you?

home.line: Welcome back, little one. Heehee, seeing you work so hard to teach people about love is making me tremble with happiness!

hp_warning.line: Now you're making me mad!

login.line: Are you ready, little one? "Ready for what"? Heehee... To lean in close and hear my words of love.

lose.line: Oh dear... Perhaps I got a little too carried away.

mail.line: There's a new letter for you. Aren't you going to read it? There could be a new sheet music in there for you, little one!

main1.line: Did you sleep well last night? Heehee, looks like you did. Then let's go out and spread the good word of love to all we know!

main2.line: Ahh, love and music are such wonderful things. I want to make songs about loving yourself, loving your friends, loving strangers, and loving your passions and play them to the world!

main3.line: That radiant love radiating out from your heart... It touches me so much, I'm compelled to write a love song for you.

mission.line: There's still work to do on these missions. You can't put our preaching of love on the backburner!

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards are here? Heehee, sounds like our efforts have been repaid by love.

profile.line: I am Friedrich Carl of Iron Blood, that's all you need to know... My goodness, little one, don't be so hung up on the details. A great mission of filling the world with love awaits us!

propose.line: Finally, the day has come for us to acknowledge each other's love. Now, take your proof of love and put it on me. Heehee... Tonight, I'm going to show you a deeper, more wonderful kind of love... darling♥

touch.line: Would you like to hear music bursting with love, little one?

touch2.line: I understand. I shall fill you up with love, little one♥

unlock.line: I am Friedrich Carl, P-class armored cruiser and the embodiment of love. Come, little one – let us get to the core truth of love and bring happiness to the whole world.

upgrade.line: My love grows stronger, and so do I.

win_mvp.line: We are one step closer to realizing a world brimming with love!

gift_prefer.line: Heehee... I can feel how deep your love is~ Thank you~

feeling5_ex.line: Even though we're already a couple, my love for you just keeps growing. No-no, you don't need to do anything. You can just relax and slowly bask in all the love I have for you, little one♥

headtouch_ex.line: Heehee, it's quite fun being on the receiving end of this.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, dear little one♥ No matter how far you go, I know you'll always come back.

login_ex.line: There you are, my dear little one! The world is now on course toward the love-filled future that we dream of.

main4_ex.line: Heehee, your love is just as strong as mine at this point. Yet it's still not enough. Together, we're going to cultivate an even bigger, stronger love♥

main5_ex.line: Every second I spend with you gives me new inspiration about love. Do you want to hear a snippet?

touch_ex.line: Do you want to create a passionate musical number?

touch2_ex.line: Heehee, your appetite for love really is bottomless, little one.

feeling5.line: Heehee, you're a greedy but lovable little rascal. Seems playing a game with me just isn't enough – you want ALL of my love! Well, you'll get it! All the pleasure and love in the world belongs you to, my dear little one.

headtouch.line: Heehee. Mischievous as ever, aren't you?

home.line: My, straight back to me as soon as you're back at the port. You're such a sweet little thing. Heehee, should we continue our game while I hold you tight?

login.line: Great timing, dear little one! Heehee, I just got done setting up the game. Do you wanna play?

main1.line: My, my, you REALLY want to win. Are you that thirsty for my love reward?

main2.line: Does playing this game with me make you happy? ...Oh? You could play this all day? Me too♥

main3.line: It's lovely how our tastes in video games are so similar. This must be what they mean by "lovebirds of a feather flock together."

mission.line: You haven't finished these missions yet. Do that first, then we can continue our love-filled game.

touch.line: You better not be thinking you'll win through cheap tricks!

touch2.line: Heehee. Now it's time for a hands-on round of the game of love♥

unlock.line: Alright, little one! Now that we have some time off, why don't we play a game? If you win, I might just give you... the reward of love♥

detail.line: Even the power of love might not be able to beat the summer heat... Well, that's not true. Your love saved me from the heat, after all. Love wins again♥

feeling5.line: The bed's already soaked with sweat. I'll have to lie on my back... Don't forget to apply your love here, too, little one♥

home.line: Ah, you're finally here, little one. I feel like I'm drying out from the heat of the sun and my love...

login.line: Mmm... I feel the love slipping between your fingers. It's even hotter than the scorching sun...

main1.line: *sigh*... I just want to jump in... No, I need to wait, or else the sunscreen will go to waste.

main2.line: Hmm? Didn't you just put some on me? Is the heat making you lose your wits, little one? Heehee.

main3.line: If you're tired, then lie down with me. Is it too cramped? I'm sure the power of love can fix that little problem♥

mission.line: Missions? Under the blazing sun? Spreading the word of love is a difficult path...

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards~ See if there's anything that can cool me down in there.

touch.line: Be a little bolder, if you want. Heehee♥

touch2.line: There, too...? Well, love does need to be applied evenly♥

unlock.line: Are you ready, my beloved little one? I'm giving you all of me, so apply your love – the sunscreen – ever so thoroughly, so gently, please.

battle.line: Aufführung beginnt!

couple_encourage1.line: You should cut back on the sweets a little.

couple_encourage2.line: Heheh, if you're amping up the energy, then I won't be bested either!

detail.line: I'm in top form right now. If you insist, though, what part of me do you want to examine? My voice? My stage performance? Or my general "condition"?

expedition.line: The commission is complete? Sounds like fun is waiting just around the corner. I'll go greet them with you.

feeling1.line: If you don't get your job done, I'll punish you... Kidding! Hm? You wanna know how you'll get punished? Keep thinking weirdo thoughts like that, and you won't get to be our producer anymore.

feeling2.line: You've been working hard these days. Yeah... I can reward you for that. For example, an idol's massage...? Oh, you don't want to trouble me? You're such a little sweetheart, Commander.

feeling3.line: Commander, I notice you're keeping your distance today. You can't guide me from that far away, can you? Come closer. Take in the sight of my movements, my gaze, and every little change in expression.

feeling4.line: Liiisten, Commander... *exhale*... What was I doing? I'm just practicing my breathing for when I sing. Now, one more tiiime... *exhale*... You feel the force of my breath on your neck, don't you?♥

feeling5.line: Ever since the day you became my producer, our fates became one. Keep supporting me forever from now on, okay? My singing, dancing, and performances are all just for you, Commander. Heehee♥

headtouch.line: Hmph, someone went and messed up my hair and makeup... You're gonna pay the price for that later.

home.line: Commander, what do you want to do now that I have a break between lessons? Go on a date? Or maybe throw in some... private instruction?

hp_warning.line: Heh... You're nothing but noise to me.

login.line: You sure showed up early today, Commander. Are you here to observe us rehearse, or were you that desperate to see me? Surely you don't expect me to believe that this was for "educational purposes"~

lose.line: Maybe I should put more effort into being an idol...

mail.line: New mail, huh? Think it's fan mail? I don't care much about your average fan mail, but if it's a love letter from you? Then I'm interested.

main1.line: Try and give me a stage I can shine even better on. I'll reward you handsomely♪

main2.line: Luck and ability are both important to idols. Of course, I've got both!

main3.line: When you hear my voice, don't you feel me... engulfing your heart and soul?

main4.line: Oh? There's peeping, and then there's this. If you wanna see me that bad... then look all you want. Heehee.

mission.line: Are you just gonna keep staring at me instead of checking on your missions? Heheh... Are an idol's charms just that irresistible?

mission_complete.line: Your mission rewards won't run away, but don't think I'll let YOU get away without checking them, got it?

profile.line: Third ship of the Admiral Hipper-class ships, Prinz Eugen. Right now, I'm a member of the idol group Alizarin, too. Heheh, do you love me more than ever now? Well, keep your head on straight until my performance starts!

propose.line: Directly confessing to a subordinate, and an idol at that... You're not much of a producer, Commander. Haha! As for whether I'll accept this... You've known the answer for a long time now, right? Keep those eyes fixed only on me from now on!

skill.line: The opening performance isn't over yet!

touch.line: Commander? Have you fallen head-over-heels for my idol form?

touch2.line: Touching an idol? I'd better scream for help... Just kidding! As you wish, I'll let you get a little taste... Heheh♥

unlock.line: I am heavy cruiser idol Prinz Eugen, a participant in the Muse System experiment. You look interested in my outfit, Commander. Heheheh... You can expect my usual exploits and more!

upgrade.line: Hard work doesn't lie... This is the result of my training, for sure.

win_mvp.line: Maybe we should ramp up the difficulty of those lessons...

gift_prefer.line: You know exactly what I want, huh? Thank you~♪ Mwah~

battle.line: Set sail! Protect the abyssal kingdom!

detail.line: Commander! How do you like my kingdom? It's still pretty small, but with your help, it will become something truly legendary!

expedition.line: The commission team is back? I hope they brought some fun toys along.

feeling1.line: Hmph! You're a meanie who won't even drink juice with me. I'm sending you to toy prison so you can think about what you've done!

feeling2.line: You want my approval that much? Okay, then start by giving me some yummy snacks and fun toys to play with!

feeling3.line: Commander, let's play hide-and-seek! It'll be your super-special trial!

feeling4.line: Aww... Where'd you go, Commander? My kingdom needs you...

feeling5.line: I've come to a decision, Commander! You're going to play with me forever and... No, wait, you're going to be my servant and serve me forever! Got it?

headtouch.line: Hmph! The god of the sea doesn't yield so easily... Mrgh... Ah...

home.line: Heheh. You're back, huh? Have you brought offerings for the god of the sea? ...I'm talking about that! The juice in your hand!

hp_warning.line: This is nothing for me!

login.line: Oh, it's you! Do you wanna see my toy– I mean, my abyssal kingdom?

lose.line: They cheated, that's all... It... It had nothing to do with my short feet or being unable to catch up with them!

mail.line: Huh? A new letter? Can you read it out to me?

main1.line: This juice is so sweet. It's so much better than those adult drinks, isn't it? Heheh! It has to be!

main2.line: Commander, come walk with– No, I mean, tour my kingdom with me!

main3.line: You've not given me enough snack offerings, Commander. Hm? I'll get cavities if I eat too much? I-I don't care! I'm not scared of cavities!

mission.line: You still have unfinished work to do, don't you? You're not allowed to be lazy! Go get it done then come play with me!

mission_complete.line: And this is why I picked you, Commander. Go get your rewards. Oh, and pour me some juice to celebrate!

profile.line: All the territory I can see from up on my throne belongs to me! That includes you, obviously! Now kneel before me! Ahahahaha!

propose.line: Today is a special day! I've made up my mind – you're not just gonna be my servant, you're also gonna be my trusted knight! Your job will obviously be to protect me, your lord, but also... to always play with me!

skill.line: Feel the power of the god of the sea!

touch.line: Hm? Do you have an offering for the god of the sea?

touch2.line: Whoa! Th-there's a limit to how much rudeness I'll tolerate! I'm going to smack you with my treasured sword!

unlock.line: Heheh! I'm gonna show you how amazing the god of the sea is! ...Huh? Why are you laughing! Stop it! Don't you treat me like some kid!

upgrade.line: I've grown stronger! Time to celebrate with some juice! ...*cough cough*! I drank too fast and it got in my lungs... *cough*...

win_mvp.line: Hahaha! Do you get it now? That's the power of the god of the sea! ...Hm? Why are you laughing, Commander?

gift_prefer.line: Wow, you're giving this to me? ...I-if you insist, I suppose I wouldn't mind. Heheh~♪

detail_ex.line: This is my toy castle– Err, the palace of my abyssal kingdom! But now it's also your house... By that I mean, your knightly guard station! Stop laughing!

feeling5_ex.line: You know, my favorite thing is playing with y– I mean, governing my abyssal kingdom with you! Look, you know what I'm trying to say! I've grown used to you looking after and protecting me, so you'd better never leave me!

headtouch_ex.line: This is just... Don't tell anyone about this, okay?!

home_ex.line: Welcome back! What kind of juice do you have this time? ...Ahem! I'm asking 'cause I wanna drink it with you! I just want us to relax, that's all.

login_ex.line: Ah, my knight is here. Do you wanna pla– I mean, tour the kingdom? We could also sit on the throne together.

main4_ex.line: Playing with you is my favorite thing... Huh? Y-you didn't hear that, did you?!

main5_ex.line: Maybe I should make my throne bigger. It needs to be big enough to fit us both.

main6_ex.line: Listen, you! Just because I treat you differently doesn't mean you get to treat me like a child!

touch_ex.line: Doing this to me isn't your job! Your job is to protect me!

touch2_ex.line: Th-that tickles! You are so discourteous! I'm gonna punish you!

battle.line: It's time for your physical!

detail.line: If you were in a hospital ghost story, who would you be happiest to see show up? Girls like me, of course! Right?! Hahaha! I knew you and I thought alike!

expedition.line: Commander, the commission team returned. I wanted to ask them about that paranormal commission, so do you want to come with?

feeling1.line: *siiigh*... I'm tired of your stories, Commander. They aren't scary at all.

feeling2.line: Heeehehehe! It's Nurse Moritz, making her midnight rounds! I'll keep you nice and safe, Commander~

feeling3.line: An infinite hallway in front of the infirmary, making it so you can never leave? Commander, is it real?! Where is it? I gotta see it right now!

feeling4.line: Aah, hahaha... I dreamed of that dark, scary infirmary... Yeah, the one you were telling me about! I could feel everything, even the fear and suffocating feelings you described... I love it... Heeehehehe!

feeling5.line: Hmm... Why does my heart race whenever you're near? Could it be... that I'm in a trance from a real-life ghost story?!

headtouch.line: Hmm?! Commander... Are you trying out that old urban legend about how getting headpats makes you stop growing?

home.line: Are you injured? I can wrap up your wounds just like a beautiful gift... Hm? Do I actually know how to treat wounds? Oh, I have some secondhand knowledge.

hp_warning.line: Heheheh... I'll survive this, even if you don't!

login.line: Roooar! Hahaha! Did that scare you? You'd better toughen up those nerves, Commander. How about I help you... through desensitization? Heeehehehe!

lose.line: No! I'm not done yet!

mail.line: New mail?! It's not from the spooky never-ending medical record cabinet, is it? Even head nurses need their rest!

main1.line: Commander, have you heard the tale of the head nurse without a shadow who floats in the night? Bristol and the others run away every time they see a white nurse uniform now. Heeehehehe!

main2.line: What kind of story could scare you, I wonder... Let's find out right now!

main3.line: An elegant upper-class demon... Hmm, I think a head nurse with a scary laugh is way better. Z9 gave me that descriptor personally! Hahaha!

mission.line: Commander, missions just came in. Heeehehehe!! Let's go see if they're scary!

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished! Hm... Are there any ghost stories about finishing missions?

profile.line: I'm Prinz Moritz. P-class armored cruiser, Iron Blood. I guess that makes me an upper-class demon? It doesn't matter if you know who I am. I much prefer researching and writing spooky stories over engaging with high society. Heeehehehe!

propose.line: I see... So this is the oath of love. I totally get it! Hahaha! Commander! Let's create a world of scary stories, full of chills, thrills, and love! Heeehehehe!

touch.line: These are just the necessary props to play my role. What role, you ask? The spooky nurse, of course.

touch2.line: Huh?! Aaah! I-is this... Wait, do you feel that way about me? Whaaat?!

unlock.line: I'm Prinz Moritz, lover of ghost stories and a P-class armored ship under the Iron Blood banner. Oh, and I have another title... the Nurse of Nighttime Spooks! Ready for a full physical, Commander? Heeehehehe!

upgrade.line: Ooh... Now I can write scarier stories!

win_mvp.line: Heeehehehe, how disappointing! I can hardly feel anything from you!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! How did you know I needed one of these? Now I can research even more urban legends!

feeling5_ex.line: In my head, the Nurse of Nighttime Spooks is as cold as a scalpel and dangerously unhinged! But lately, my character seems to have... more emotion to her. Could it be that you're the cause? Heeehehehe!

headtouch_ex.line: C-Commander?! I really did stop growing! What are you going to do about this? *sniffle*... Oh♡ Did I scare you? Heeehehehe, you know that stuff isn't real!

home_ex.line: Commander, I've mastered all sorts of nursing know-how! I know how to stop bleeding, apply bandages, and more... Will you let me test my knowledge on you now? Heeehehehe!

login_ex.line: The Nurse of Nighttime Spooks' special treatment only works at night, you know. I'll put you right to sleep and lull you into my realm of ghostly dreams♪

main4_ex.line: Heeehehehe... I added a recurring character based on YOU to my new ghost story collection! I haven't planned the details yet, but I'll have you help me out, Commander!

main5_ex.line: I had a great idea! If I take all the daily antics and mishaps that happen at port and put them in my own original world, I could make amazing new ghost stories!

main6_ex.line: Heeehehehe! Welcome to my supernatural artifact museum. Which would you like to try today, Commander?

touch_ex.line: Could it be... that you want a meek and obedient head nurse, Commander?

touch2_ex.line: Commander... Shouldn't it be time for the head nurse to be giving YOU a proper examination? Heeehehehe♡

detail.line: Prinz Moritz? No, no – that was my last incarnation's name. My true name is... irrelevant! Call me Miss Genie.

feeling5.line: Heeehehehe! I'd best begin preparing for my ultimate wish~ Commander, have you thought of a way to satisfy me? A fun ghost story, or getting nice and close, or perhaps even... Mwah!

headtouch.line: Heheh, there you go... Now you're getting the hang of it!

home.line: Welcome back. Ready to grant my wishes yet? Huh? I still haven't told you them? Heeehehehe! But wishes never come true if you speak them aloud, remember? Use that brain of yours!

login.line: Since time immemorial, I've granted countless wishes... So this time, you'll be the one to grant mine! Fun, right? Heeehehehe!

main1.line: Commander, I wish you'd stop staring at the night sky! Oh... Wait, that didn't count.

main2.line: Want a hint? Well, too bad! I could consider it if you came over and entertained me, though. Heeehehehe!

main3.line: That story you told me was pretty good. I suppose I could count that as a wish granted... Heeehehehe! Nobody said I only had one wish, though~

touch.line: The secret to getting your wishes granted is to please me! Heeehehehe!

touch2.line: Huh?! H-h-how did you know what my wish was?!

unlock.line: Are you the one who summoned me? I'm the genie of the lamp, and I thank you for freeing me. As a reward... let's play a game together.

battle.line: Let us trample the shattered remnants of our enemies!

detail.line: Only those who have not been scarred would laugh at someone else's.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Seriously, you ought to let me and my little sister handle this stuff.
