feeling1.line: Cowards have no right to stand on the battlefield!

feeling2.line: If only I didn't need to care about anything other than becoming stronger or defeating more enemies. But, reality isn't so simple...

feeling3.line: You've got a pretty nice fleet here. Being here makes me feel like giving it my all.

feeling4.line: Hey there, Commander! I just went to train with the other girls. Everyone is full of energy, all thanks to how reliable you are. I'm really taking a liking to this place.

feeling5.line: I've never retreated - not because I'm fearless, but because I've always had a reason to keep fighting. In the past, it was for the Iron Blood. Now, it's for your sake, Commander... I mean, your fleet's sake!

home.line: Not bad at all. Seems like you're getting used to battle.

hp_warning.line: I shall fight until the last bullet!

login.line: You're back? Good timing. I'm just about to test my guns.

lose.line: I won't lose next time!

mail.line: You've got mail, Commander. You're quite the popular one, aren't you?

main1.line: Those lightweight aircraft carriers simply can't match our combat abilities!

main2.line: Do me a favor and remind our friends not to sail directly in front of me... I might not be able to resist firing at them...

main3.line: "The Ugly Sisters"? Hmph, it's not a bad name... Sounds like a good name for this war, too...

mission.line: Missions? Let's take care of them in one fell swoop.

mission_complete.line: Rewards? Hah, now that's what I'm looking forward to.

profile.line: I’m Scharnhorst. I will stand until the last moment of any battle. This is my determination, as well as my pride. Leave all the fighting to me!

propose.line: Don't worry. For the fleet, and for you, Commander, I'll learn to protect myself and be less reckless than before. But, as always, please continue counting on me for combat!

skill.line: Anton, Bruno, Caesar... Cannons at the ready!

touch.line: I'll never back down!

touch2.line: Stand right there, Commander. If you can take a shot from me, I'll forgive you...

unlock.line: In Scharnhorst's dictionary, the word "retreat" simply doesn't exist! You're the Commander? Let me see what you've got.

upgrade.line: I'm looking forward to the next battle!

win_mvp.line: If there's anything worthy of my trust, it's my cannon!

gift_prefer.line: You've got good taste. Thank you.

battle.line: Just so happens I'm bored. You maggots are gonna fix that!

detail.line: Gneisenau "convinced" me to wear this dress and do "something unrelated to fighting for once." She didn't really let me decline. That's the long and short of it.

feeling5.line: Whenever I stop and think about what I can *do*, besides charging into battle, it makes me feel just slightly uneasy... But I believe I'll find the answer someday, as long as I'm with you.

home.line: Looks like you're busy as ever, even during the holidays.

login.line: Haahh... Guess it *is* true that sitting for too long makes you feel tired...

main1.line: Firecrackers? If you need something flashy and loud, why not do it with a cannon salute instead of those toys? It's more impressive, to boot.

main2.line: I'm really fond of the intense gaze my grimalkin has. Hahah, relax, she's a good girl. Just don't get on her bad side.

main3.line: The Royal Maids are helping out with the cooking? Hmph, that head maid sure has a finger in every pie.

touch.line: If a *snowball* fight is all we're doing then I'll pass.

touch2.line: Well, well, guess you're raring to play with my grimalkin.

unlock.line: A festival, huh? Going for days without fighting is boring, not to mention not my style. C'mon, Commander, isn't there *something* exciting I can do during this "Lunar New Year" festival?

battle.line: Truth only exists within the guns' range.

detail.line: My duty is to support my big sister who is always charging too far ahead. Admittedly, it gets a little irritating at times.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed! Care to inspect the results?

feeling1.line: I assumed you were more intelligent, Commander...

feeling2.line: Is it urgent? I prefer simple and effective forms of communication.

feeling3.line: "The Ugly Sisters..." Though we were given that epithet for our achievements, it still hurts a little. Commander, do you think I'm ugly?

feeling4.line: Without realizing it, I've come to enjoy supporting both my sister and you, Commander.

feeling5.line: The present flies by like an arrow, but the future always arrives too late. I hope that one day, I will be able to see the future that you and I create.

home.line: Welcome back. Please take it easy for a while.

hp_warning.line: All ships, remember to stay alert!

login.line: Welcome back. Ready to get back to work? I've prepared everything you need, Commander.

lose.line: I let my guard down...

mail.line: Commander, there's mail for you. I'll leave it here.

main1.line: You mustn't put off until tomorrow what you can do today. Please take that to heart.

main2.line: One forgets the cruelty of war after being at peace for too long. The opposite... is true as well, isn't it?

main3.line: Looking back at it, it's unbelievable that I would mistake that prideful princess as an old-fashioned knight.

mission.line: A mission? Let me do some planning for you...

mission_complete.line: Rewards distributed. Please accept them when you have a moment.

profile.line: I'm Gneisenau. Though I'm not as bellicose as my sister, I'm still confident about my combat capabilities. As some of the best ships the Iron Blood has to offer, we hold the record of being the only battlecruisers to sink a standard aircraft carrier. Your faith in us will not be misplaced.

propose.line: A promise, huh? Long ago, I would have despised the notion of being tied down to emotions... but it doesn't seem so bad now.

touch.line: Isn't it amazing how different people can come to different conclusions about the same topic?

touch2.line: Commander, Anton is locked on, you can't escape now.

unlock.line: Hello, Commander, I'm Gneisenau. Though my big sister is a bit reckless, we're actually an invincible team. I hope I will be able to sail with her as often as possible!

upgrade.line: It's fine as long as you haven't let power cloud your judgement...

win_mvp.line: Sorry, this is war. There's no room for mercy.

gift_prefer.line: Your kindness is much appreciated.

detail.line: Everyone wants to be a witch for Halloween, so I chose something a little bit different. After seeing your reaction, Commander, I think I chose correctly. Hehehe...

home.line: You say you see ghosts and goblins all around me? ... I think you need a break. Getting into the Halloween spirit is all well and good, but you can't overdo it.

login.line: At first I was too embarrassed to wear something like this, but I went along with it and after wearing it for a while, I must say I'm starting to see things in a different light...

main1.line: If only my sister were here... Now if we had some sort of pumpkin-smashing gunnery competition, that would have gotten her attention.

main2.line: This holiday certainly is well suited to us "Ugly Sisters," isn't it?

main3.line: My tail? Oh it just came with the costume... Still, I'd prefer if you didn't touch it.

touch.line: While I haven't prepared any candy, I do have a "treat" for you to enjoy. Would you like to try? I'm afraid there may be some pain involved... Hehehe...

touch2.line: Eek?! Commander, does someone want to be "punished?"

unlock.line: These Halloween festivities are quite interesting, in a good way. Getting dressed up in these costumes isn't such a bad experience either. Commander, what do you think of my costume?

battle.line: Achtung! Reduce them to scrap!

couple_encourage1.line: Miladies! Allow me to protect you!

detail.line: Commandant, I do understand our mission at this port, but I hope to one day move up and fight for humanity's– Forgive me, I should have held my tongue.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned to port! Commandant, please have a look!

feeling1.line: This is all because I'm a worthless maggot... Commandant, I beg for your forgiveness!

feeling2.line: If you'll forgive my audacity, I have a request. Commandant, please give me more orders! I will do anything you require of me!

feeling3.line: I have complete faith in your decisions. Except... the worry that my service isn't all you hoped for lingers in the back of my mind. But, rest assured, it will not hinder me in combat!

feeling4.line: Spend my day off however I want...? While that does sound nice, I'm not sure what I want to do is good in your eyes, Commandant... But if that's your order, I will follow it!

feeling5.line: Y-you wish to go on a date? With me, of all people? ...Forgive me, I should not question an order from you, Commandant! I will make every step towards ensuring a thoroughly enjoyable date!

headtouch.line: Salute! What are your orders?

home.line: A salute to your return, Commandant! Phew... I take it your battle was an honorable one, as always?

hp_warning.line: Miladies! Take cover behind me!

login.line: Salute! I put my faith in your guidance as always, Commandant!

lose.line: I failed by not following my orders... What a disgrace!

mail.line: Salute! I've brought your newly-arrived letter!

main1.line: Lützow! Stop that before you distract the Commandant! ...Well, Commandant, I do believe getting distracted is a bad thing...

main2.line: I've no grand ambitions of being hailed as a hero. My heart's only desire is to serve you faithfully, Commandant.

main3.line: People who doubt their comrades deserve to be shunned. If they must doubt anyone, it should be themselves.

mission.line: You have unfinished missions, Commandant! It may be wisest to do the newest ones first.

mission_complete.line: You have received mission rewards! Whew... I'm glad it went off without a hitch. Outstanding work, Commandant.

profile.line: I am Seydlitz, Iron Blood battlecruiser! My tenacity is my pride, my conquests are my glory, and executing your orders is my mission! I await your orders, Commandant!

propose.line: While I am overjoyed by your offer of marriage, I'm worried if my answer won't be to your– No! Of course I'm not turning you down! What I mean is, I don't know whether to say "gladly," or "I love you." You may decide if you'd like, Commandant!

skill.line: You will not sink me! I won't allow it!

touch.line: Salute! Your orders, Commandant!

touch2.line: C-Commandant?!

unlock.line: Salute, Commandant! Iron Blood battlecruiser Seydlitz reporting in! Inexperienced though I may be, as of today I am proud to serve this port in the pursuit of honor and glory!

upgrade.line: You've made me stronger, Commandant! You have my thanks!

win_mvp.line: Commandant, your in-person commanding was a thing to behold! Frankly, however, I don't believe I can say the same of my own performance...

gift_prefer.line: Commandant?! Wh-why are you giving me something so precious out of the blue...

detail_ex.line: Commandant, you need not be concerned about me. I am being myself, as one is obliged to be.

feeling5_ex.line: Good lord... I should've prepared better before asking you on a date... Oh, no, nothing's wrong! I-it's just... Your immediate "yes" made my heart flutter in surprise, Commandant!

headtouch_ex.line: Look, you don't– Ahem. Commandant, I'd rather you treated me as a soldier, not as a lady!

home_ex.line: I sensed you may be thirsty, so I went ahead and made tea! W-would you like a cup?

login_ex.line: As always, I aim to please you today, Commandant! ...I-if I inconvenience you in any way, please do inform me.

lose_ex.line: Commandant! Miladies! Please make your escape while I hold the line!

main4_ex.line: Please assign me a task, Commandant! ...Y-you've already finished all your work? Oh, I see...

main5_ex.line: Commandant, suppose I were to behave less like a soldier and more like a regular woman... Would you prefer that?

main6_ex.line: You're very kind, Commandant, being willing to give ear to my opinions. Meanwhile, I feel I don't even deserve to have opinions...

mission_ex.line: Commandant! Please advise which mission I should start with!

touch_ex.line: I'll gladly listen if you wish to confide in me!

touch2_ex.line: W-well, if I'm your type, then I suppose... Pardon, it's nothing, Commandant!

win_mvp_ex.line: Thank you for this high honor! This victory goes to my comrades and the Commandant!

battle.line: Die, monsters! You don't belong in this world!

detail.line: Once the fighting ends, so does the role of a vampire hunter... Is that truly what I, or rather, the power within me, wants?

home.line: A castle of this size must have numerous ways in and out. Commandant, we should take this route if you're in a hurry.

login.line: It's time to breach the castle, Commandant. I shall lead the way!

mail.line: I have your new letter right here, Commandant.

main1.line: I've got you now, Lützow! Say your prayers, for it's time you paid for the Commandant's lost productivity!

main2.line: I'm more than just a shipgirl, I'm now the blade that cuts down all evil. This duty, granted unto me, shall be carried out!

main3.line: You'd like meat for dinner today? Certainly. The question is, how do we procure meat out here...

touch.line: We know not what beasts lurk in the shadows... Mgh...

touch2.line: Such frightening armor... Eek!

unlock.line: There it is – Dracula's Castle, brought into this world by chaos itself... On my honor, I swear I will put an end to the divine bloodline!

win_mvp.line: Salute! Oh, dammit, I dropped the bounty... Apologies. I will clearly need to practice my posing...

detail.line: My banquet attire pales in comparison to everyone else's... If you could create my ideal look, what would it be like, Commandant?

home.line: Exemplary work, Commandant. Have you tried the food on offer this evening yet? I'm sure you're going to love it!

login.line: Let us begin, Commandant. Your work for today has started.

main1.line: On my name and pride, I promise to find us a place to relax while you mingle with the other guests!

main2.line: Commandant, suppose I were to behave less like a soldier and more like a regular woman... Would you prefer that?

main3.line: This way, my fair ladies... I'll be leaving your side momentarily to accustom myself to this place, Commandant. Excuse me for a while.

touch.line: A-at your service, Commandant!

touch2.line: I feel I'm ill-suited to be your partner this evening... Do you desire me, regardless?

unlock.line: How do I look, Commandant? I thought you may like seeing me in a dress, however I don't know if this is what you desired or not...

win_mvp.line: Victory can be seized even in a dress... I'm now confident this is what you desired, Commandant!

battle.line: Time to exert all my strength and individualism!

detail.line: Whew... Wearing clothes like this is quite new to me. Oh, but rest assured, Commandant – I will strive to become one with the streetwear! ...Just be myself, you say? Understood!

feeling5.line: Go on a date wearing this? Heehee, I will take that to mean you like seeing me in such a novel outfit. Then please, go ahead and ask me on a date! I will do all I can to live up to your hopes and give you an unforgettable experience!

home.line: Welcome back from your patrol, Commandant! Allow me to pour you a drink!

login.line: Just a moment... There, I've struck my pose! Awaiting your next orders, Commandant!

mail.line: Ah, you've received a letter, Commander.

main1.line: In case you're wondering... I did indeed pick out this streetwear by myself. Now that you have this information, what do you make of it, Commandant?

main2.line: The graffiti, you ask? I thought I'd opt for a backdrop that complemented my outfit! You asked to see me in a fresh look, and I answered to the best of my abilities.

main3.line: Commandant, please have a drink. The last bottle was much too cold, but this one is just the right temperature... I thought of everything, you say? Th-thank you!

touch.line: Commandant, won't you take a picture with me? This feels like a great occasion for it!

touch2.line: Th-this isn't exactly how I pictured our day off...

unlock.line: Salutations, Commandant! ...You think I look like a totally different person? Haha! You're right – I decided to change up my look for once. Oh, today looks like a hot day, so I brought drinks. Take one!

win_mvp.line: Streetwear is not only comfortable, but visually striking as well. Whew... Do you share my view, Commandant?

battle.line: Hold on tightly! I'm turning the speed up to the max!

detail.line: (*sigh*... Why did I have to get the role of a villain? It's so cruel to have me be betrayed by the Commandant...)

feeling5.line: You want me to abandon my mission? Because it's "not too late to change my ways"? Thank you, Commandant... I'll place my trust in you.

headtouch.line: My sunglasses? Oh, they're not for hiding from the police, I just wear them because I think they're stylish... They make me look really reliable?! Ahaha, that's good to know...

home.line: Commandant, where were you?! We need to escape now, before the– Police sirens?! Oh no... Were you an undercover officer this whole time?!

login.line: You've come. Allow me to verify the code phrase. "Mission impossible" – what comes next? ...Okay, your code is correct. I can lower my guard, then. Whew... Here I thought the police had shown up.

lose.line: We've got a rat! The deal's off!

main1.line: Once this matter is done with, I'm going to leave the Organization and return to a normal life. Would you like to come with me, Commandant?

main2.line: Commandant, I know missions always come to an end, but the bond we've forged will never break... right?!

main3.line: ...And that concludes my contingency plans for everything that may happen. Have I lived up to your expectations, Commandant?

touch.line: I modified this motorcycle myself. It can even catch up to a carrier's aircraft if I go full throttle!

touch2.line: Mgh... A strip-search does not need to be THIS thorough...

unlock.line: You're the person the Organization sent to extract me, Commandant? Great. The plan went smoothly and I got the goods. We can evac using the planned route.

battle.line: Ugh... What did I do to deserve this big-ass responsibility...

couple_encourage1.line: Queen of the Royal Navy? Uh-huh, I see...

couple_encourage2.line: You know the drill – safety first!

couple_encourage3.line: Who cares what your name is anyway?

couple_encourage4.line: I'm a good girl. Unlike you.

detail.line: Could you NOT call me without a reason? ...You know what, on second thought... If you're bored, chat with me.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. We don't have to go out and meet them, do we?

feeling1.line: Ugh... I hate this place. I hate this place so much.

feeling2.line: Don't feel like doing a dang thing today... Hey, Commander, what do you do to get through the day when you've got no energy?

feeling3.line: You follow a schedule? It's all about getting into habits, huh... I getcha. Can you show me what yours is like?

feeling4.line: Can't you, you know, ignore a schedule if there's a ton of work on it? ...No? A schedule sounds pretty awful then. Just do like me and do whatever you want~

feeling5.line: Hey, Commander, how about we run away together? ...I'm just kidding with you. Don't get all worked up. All I want is for you to forget all your troubles when we're alone together~

headtouch.line: I'm not sleepy. That was just a li'l yawn... *yaaawn*...

home.line: You're back! It's kinda boring when you're not around.

hp_warning.line: Nuh-uh, I don't feel a thing!

login.line: G'morning. Hey, can I sit down a li'l longer? This chair is just too comfy.

lose.line: Welp, we lost... This blows. I'm heading home.

mail.line: Here's your mail. No need to thank me, I just picked it up on the way.

main1.line: Why won't you let me sleep in the office? Because that interferes with your work? Huh... And that's a bad thing?

main2.line: Hey, show me what you're working on... It's just a bunch of random charts and numbers. 'Kay, have it back.

main3.line: If you can't find me in the office, I'm likely out and about somewhere. Don't worry, I'll be back before you know it. Probably.

mission.line: A mission? Miss me with that. You'll be fine on your own anyway.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Why're you giving me that look? You're the one who got it done, not me.

profile.line: Hey, I'm Iron Blood battlecruiser Lützow. I was part of the High Seas Fleet, and... I forgot what I was gonna say. Eh, whatever, I'll probably remember after I've had a nap.

propose.line: Carefree as I am, we're stuck together now~ Stuck together by means of this ring, anyway. You're the only person I'll take orders from, and I expect you to do me a few favors in return~

touch.line: You wanna hug this fella? Go ahead. Only a quickie though, okay?

touch2.line: Geesh, you're more daring than I took you for. Imagine that.

unlock.line: *yawn*... Hm? Who are you? Can you point me to the Commander? ...YOU'RE the Commander? Heehee, all right, saves me the effort of looking for you. I'm Lützow, Iron Blood battlecruiser. Since we're done here, I'm gonna take my leave~

upgrade.line: Hm? Am I stronger now? Doesn't feel like it, honestly.

win_mvp.line: Zzz... Ahh, I'm so sleepy. Is the battle over yet?

gift_prefer.line: Hm? What's this? ...If you're giving this to me, then don't expect to get it back. Is that alright with you?

battle_ex.line: This is my chance to shine! ...But I don't need to take it.

detail_ex.line: Need something? Wait... Now's a bad time. I've got urgent business. By that I mean: chat with me!

login_ex.line: G'morning. What I'm putting in the paper shredder? Just your schedule for today. We're gonna have a good time instead♪

main4_ex.line: Since I can't sleep in your office, I'll do it in your private quarters instead. Or is that also a no-go? Heheh, if it is, just say it♪

main5_ex.line: Need a hand there? All right. I could help you with... not much, it seems. I'll just take a nap instead.

main6_ex.line: What I'm doing? Looking 'round for places we can go to on a date. Ooh, this looks promising! Let's go there the next time you're free.

touch2_ex.line: Mrmh, mmh... Heehee, payback!

win_mvp_ex.line: *yaaawn*... We're finished here, Commander. Let's move on.

detail.line: This looks kinda like a ball dress, doesn't it? So make like at a ball and ask me for a dance. Whether I accept or not hinges on your ability to persuade, though~

feeling5.line: Gaze into my eyes, Commander... Yeah, the script says I have you under my spell, so just keep gazing~ By the way, vampires drink blood through the neck, right? 'Cause I want a taste~ Nom♪

home.line: You're under my complete control, and will always come back to me... Heehee, I call this plot device "the curse of Dracula's Castle."

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Now where's my crimson elixir? As in, my daily glass of wine~

main1.line: Garlic? Crosses? Those don't work on me... Those are meant to repel a vampire? Well then, I'm throwing those weaknesses right out the window.

main2.line: Seydlitz, the key to acting is to fully immerse yourself in your role. You don't have to think about it too hard.

main3.line: Hrmph. I'm trying my absolute best here, and you're not even looking, Commander... I'll just have to MAKE you pay attention!

touch.line: Aww, come ooon. I'm comfy right where I am – don't make me get up.

touch2.line: When a human feels bliss, that's when their blood tastes sweetest♪

unlock.line: "Have you come to accept your fate, human? Heehee~" ...Don't just stand there, Commander. Say something!

win_mvp.line: You brought this upon yourselves, opponents. Why must you make me spill blood?

detail.line: Invite Seydlitz and the gang next time? I mean, if you want their company, do it yourself. You're the only person I wanna invite. Heehee.

home.line: Your food's gone cold. You gonna heat it up, or end up burning it? Either way, it's your move♪

login.line: *yaaawn*... Yeah, what? Eating makes me sleepy. You're not seriously gonna do paperwork today, are you?

main1.line: Eww, you're gonna drink coffee with that, Tallinn? Here, lemme educate you a little. See, you're meant to have this with a cold glass of beer. Heehee♪

main2.line: I'm eating, so save the work talk for later. No food for you until your job is done, okay?

main3.line: Ahahahah! Deutschland seriously can't handle hot food? C'mon, Commander, go blow on it for her. Meanwhile, I'll keep your food safe and secure in my belly♪

touch.line: You want seconds? I'll order some in a bit.

touch2.line: Sooo~ You saying you wanna eat me, too?

unlock.line: Om, nom... Hmm. Hey! This is pretty good! I mean, of course it's good – it's Empery cuisine! Commander, open wide and I'll give you a dumpling alley oop. Say "aah"!

win_mvp.line: One more to recharge my batteries! Nom!

headtouch.line: Oh. You knew I was just pretending to sleep?

home.line: Welcome back. Come here and I'll take good care of you♪

login.line: Good luck with your work today. Me? I'm just gonna lie here and relax. Bride's privilege, you know? Hehehe~

main1.line: Geesh, the schedule looks packed. If you ask little ol' me politely I might give you a hand... Huh? O-okay, let's start with this document... Bleh, I feel like I just dug my own grave.

main2.line: It's weird. I'm just watching you go through your paperwork... and yet I don't feel bored in the slightest...

main3.line: *yawn*, I may not be bored, but I'm so tired I can't move a muscle. I want the princess treatment, Commander.

touch.line: My dress has come loose~ Fix it please~

touch2.line: I'm... I'm sleeping, so I don't mind... *murmur*...

unlock.line: *yawn*, finally, I get to lie down. Tell you what, I'm gonna have a nap... Hm? The ceremony's still not over? Hrmh... Look, it's not important. You should just come lie next to me, Commander!

battle.line: The smell of gunpowder... Yes, I have returned to the battlefield once more!

couple_encourage1.line: Hmm, let's go for a drink when we return.

detail.line: This music box? Ah, it lost its voice many years ago, but I figured it'd be a shame to throw it out, so I held onto it.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned to port. Hurry and go see them - you made a promise, and ought not to break it.

feeling1.line: Further displays of weakness will only earn you more contempt from me.

feeling2.line: I love antiques. When I look at them, I feel as if I'm being transported back to a bygone era. But, for me, the word "past" refers to something far, far more distant.

feeling3.line: My love for antiques is akin to a yearning for something one cannot have. "If I were born in that era, how would my life have been different"...I wonder if thinking this way is just human nature?

feeling4.line: Have you ever wanted to go back in time? To feel nostalgia from your youth, experience something again, or resolve something you regret..? Do you ever think about those things?

feeling5.line: So your desire for a better future outweighs your nostalgia for your past? Quite the astute answer. Then, promise me this—don't stop until you reach that future you dream of. If you ever feel like giving up, I'll be there to remind you of this promise you made with me.

home.line: Have you returned safely? The battlefield is cruel indeed. Do not allow a single victory to make you forget that fact.

hp_warning.line: Hardly even a scratch.

login.line: Looks like you showed up to work on time. Though it may be your duty, your strength of will is admirable.

lose.line: Valhalla will have to wait... For now, we retreat!

mail.line: Here's some mail for you. Oh... Don't mind me. I suddenly felt like putting pen to parchment for some reason...

main1.line: I would like you to hold on to the armaments I've used instead of throwing them out. That way, when I look upon them, I will be able to remember those who fought at my side.

main2.line: Let me check that list one more time. I'd like to prevent any failures from small mistakes getting overlooked.

main3.line: That object on your desk looks like quite the antique. Where did you get it? Oh, it's no big deal, it just happened to catch my eye...

mission.line: We've been issued a new mission. Let us strive to not let the other party down.

mission_complete.line: Done with the mission already? You work pretty efficiently.

profile.line: I am the Iron Blood battlecruiser, Brünhilde. I am a Plan Z ship that was never completed, just like some of my fellow ships you've met already. I shall fulfill my duties to the utmost of my abilities, so you need not worry when entrusting missions to me.

propose.line: One day, when I look at this ring engraved with the runes of time, I may remember the moment we first met. Let us hone one another as we press forward, as bearers of the same great responsibility...

touch.line: Cut to the chase. I prefer keeping things to the point.

touch2.line: I wonder when I'll be able to fix this nasty habit of yours.

unlock.line: I am battlecruiser Brünhilde, Walküre of the Iron Blood. As fellow bearers of great responsibility, let us hone one another as we press forward.

upgrade.line: Thank you. Call upon me for your next sortie.

win_mvp.line: I won't let anyone down, regardless of who it may be.

gift_prefer.line: Quite tasteful. Where did you get this?

home_ex.line: So you've returned safely. The fact that you've returned from countless battles unscathed proves that you are no ordinary human. Hehehe.

lose_ex.line: I admire your determination to cross over... but our time has not yet come. Let us retreat.

main4_ex.line: That pen looks like it's been pretty well-used... Ahem, Commander. Would you mind telling me the story behind that pen? I'd really like to know...

main5_ex.line: Rather than questions such as, "Does Valhalla exist," or "Where do souls go after death?"... What matters to me is that I hold the hand of my beloved as long as my heart still beats.

touch_ex.line: I want you to share your feelings with me, whether they are good or bad.

touch2_ex.line: *sigh*... Just do what you want...

win_mvp_ex.line: Even should I sortie a thousand times, I shall not fall short of my expectations. Because they are your expectations, Commander..

battle.line: Victory at all costs!

detail.line: Not only are we supposed to run with our hands tied behind our backs, but we're also supposed to jump and carry bread in our mouths while we're at it... This so-called "sports meet" is probably more entertaining for the crowd than for us.

home.line: ...What an interesting texture. ...Oh, Commander, thanks for setting the bread up again.

login.line: Oh, you're back? Judging from how much you're sweating, your battle must've been grueling as well... In any case, want to help untie this rope first?

lose.line: I guess even I have my off-days...

main1.line: Ägir, why don't you try this bread-eating race? Don't say you can't do it, do it for the Commander, won't you?

main2.line: Was that... Isuzu and some Meowfficers that just sprinted past us? What kind of event are they participating in...?

main3.line: Racing is a sport that originated a long time ago. Try as I might, however, I can't understand all of the weird rules that have been added to it...

touch.line: I'm grateful that you brought me something to drink, but I can't exactly bring it up to my mouth right now...

touch2.line: You're really such a... Once you untie this binding, I'm going to give you a piece of my mind.

unlock.line: Hah! This donut now belongs to Brünhilde! Alright, now for the finish line... C-Commander? Sorry, but there's no time for chit-chat... I'll be going now!

win_mvp.line: Heh. This point now belongs to me!

battle.line: A Walküre's spear points the way to victory!

couple_encourage1.line: Don't underestimate how important minor details can be.

couple_encourage2.line: Walküres, form up! Today, we seize victory!

detail.line: The daily action plans I provide should be 99% consistent with the plans you make yourself, not because of predictive powers, but because I've tracked your actions. A logical conclusion based on analysis of ample data.

expedition.line: The personnel in charge of the commission are back at port. I made a reward list for you.

feeling1.line: You've strayed so far from my calculations. Hmph... Fine. I'll devise a stricter plan to get you back on track as soon as possible.

feeling2.line: My desire is for you to rely on me. Hmph, this doesn't come just from confidence in my own abilities, but also because I exist for you to rely on me.

feeling3.line: (The Commander replaced the flowers in the office with calla lilies today. We're the only ones in and out of the office lately. Is this your attempt at getting me to deduce the meaning of those flowers? Calla lilies mean "pure and pious love"... Eep!)

feeling4.line: (The Commander said my name 93 times today. Upon staring at me for up to a minute without looking away, the Commander's uncertainty and body heat rose. I knew it... You're in love with me!)

feeling5.line: Hm? Why did I call you here so suddenly? Based on your recent behavior, I judged that now was your ideal time to confess to me... Huh? You just happened to change the flowers that day? And when you stared at me and heated up, that was just because overtime had you exhausted? N-no, that can't be...!

headtouch.line: How cute.

home.line: Hmm? Why did you return at a time inconsistent with my calculations? Give me details... It took extra time for you to buy me a gift? Oh... I-I see...

hp_warning.line: This is within the expected range of damage. Continue the battle!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. I've already prepared a daily action plan for you. Feel free to reference it.

lose.line: Did I overlook something...?

mail.line: You have new mail. Beyond the contents of the mail, there's much to be gleaned from the sender's name and address, the ink they used, their handwriting, and more.

main1.line: All so-called foreknowledge and omniscience are simply the result of finding every last detail and applying adequate analysis and deduction. From my point of view, you're very capable of the same.

main2.line: I monitor every last one of your movements, specifically because I have the responsibility to protect you and look after you, though I must accept that my own desires differ... Yes. I trust you understand.

main3.line: Here's the file you were looking for, Commander. Hm? How did know? I saw your gaze shift to the desk, and then unconsciously moved to gather the scattered documents. Simple as can be, no?

mission.line: Commander, do your missions in the order of priorities I've assigned. Ensure they do not affect other plans adversely.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Please accept your rewards quickly... Also, I should thank you for following the proposal I made.

profile.line: I am Alvitr of the Iron Blood, a warrior come to serve you and a companion come to accompany you. How do I know so much about you? Heheh... That would be the result of analyzing existing information, efficient and precise observation, and rigorous deduction.

propose.line: You think I didn't calculate this moment long ago? W-well... You're right. I was so focused on your every little move that I'd already removed this possibility from my deductions... Phew. Basically, umm... What a welcome surprise!

touch.line: There's dust on me? ...Thank you. (whispering) So this is how the Commander justifies touching people...

touch2.line: I... couldn't have predicted this... *blush*

unlock.line: I'm Alvitr, O-class battlecruiser and Walküre of the Iron Blood. My name symbolizes ultimate wisdom, and I plan to prove the worthiness of that name. You may rely on me – I will manage your affairs now.

upgrade.line: Changing the present means changing the future.

win_mvp.line: A victory based on thorough calculation and deduction.

gift_prefer.line: Did you figure out what I like from watching me? I like that.

feeling5_ex.line: Phew... Commander, I know I'm late saying this, but... Well, I love you very much. My love reaches to the end of eternity and Valhalla beyond... engraved firmly in the passage of time.

home_ex.line: Your time of return differs from the necessary time I calculated for your battle command... Did you think I would say that sincerely? Nice try. I got you a gift in return this time.

login_ex.line: Welcome back. I have already put together an action plan for you based on your recent routines. Once you're ready, let's see it put into action.

main4_ex.line: Hmm? Why'd I put an ice pack and wrist brace on the table? Well... You've blinked especially hard eleven times, and you rubbed your thumb joint seven times. These items can help relieve your troubles.

main5_ex.line: Your breathing frequency, blood flow, and heart rate are all rising to the point that you're shaking. I see, I'll go start the shower–Hm? That's not it? You're just realizing how much paperwork you have left to do...?

main6_ex.line: (My failed deduction led to me revealing my feelings first, but now that I think about it, I haven't properly confessed. What now, Alvitr? Do you put it all out there?)

touch_ex.line: Yes, I'm right here.

touch2_ex.line: This is how you like to touch me, yes? Heh, I knew it.

feeling5.line: Sometimes, using our limited ingenuity to play little tricks on someone we love can make life more fun. Huh? You've been waiting outside the door for me to get ready with exactly that in mind? A-aah...

headtouch.line: You'd tie up my hair for me? Thanks.

home.line: Hmm... Off again. Did you have detention, or something? Oh, that thing in your hand... I see. You bought ice cream for me.

login.line: You're just in time. Let's start reviewing today's lesson results. Heh, I'll be the perfect aide for you.

main1.line: You also noticed the sound the air conditioner was making and brought a toolbox to come fix it? ...You're getting more and more conscientious, Commander.

main2.line: The heat makes it impossible to think straight. For example... I can't tell if how you're reacting is because of the heat, or because of seeing me like this...

main3.line: I have one question for you to ruminate over, Commander. Did I predict that you'd come to the staff room at this time?

touch.line: I think you should take off your jacket, too.

touch2.line: Just as impatient as I expected... *blush*

unlock.line: Oh, Commander. You may have noticed that the air conditioner is busted. I surmised from its volume levels that it was at its limit, but now that it's broken... life has become a struggle.

battle.line: All according to plan... Commence combat!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's seize a perfectly planned victory!

detail.line: I already simulated this move in my brain. Next, you'll... W-wait, that's not what I thought you'd... I have to recalculate this... A-am I going to lose?!

expedition.line: The commission fleet is back on schedule, and their goods have been inspected. Here's the list for your perusal.

feeling1.line: You do nothing but disrupt my plans. It's troubling.

feeling2.line: Commander, I've finished preparing a battle plan for your review. Please provide any revisions in the next thirty minutes.

feeling3.line: Your tactics come so far out of left field that they throw my strategy into disarray. What a Commander you are... Let me think! I'll turn the tables here, I promise!

feeling4.line: It's hard to focus on work when you stare at me... Umm... I guess that's my own problem, though...

feeling5.line: All of my plans fall into disarray when it comes to you lately... It's not your fault! I just can't control my feelings well. I need to calm down more, but just thinking about you drives me crazy... You must understand, surely.

headtouch.line: Huh?! D-don't do that without warning, please!

home.line: Commander, you're home later than expected. Did you run into any issues? Huh? You were just taking a little walk? D-did my schedule unduly stress you? I'll fix it right now!

hp_warning.line: It's all under control!

login.line: Commander, I sorted files for review by priority. Just check them in order, and you'll be fine.

lose.line: The situation has changed?! I-I'll revise my strategy right away...

mail.line: Commander, it's time to check your mail. Please begin as soon as possible.

main1.line: Commander, I've planned our next mission's defensive deployments and offensive routes. There are six things I need you to check on, though, so please take a look.

main2.line: You need a pen? You can have the grey one in the blue pen holder... Put it back when you're done, please.

main3.line: I've simulated this strategy countless times. It should be theoretically perfect... Ugh, I still need backup plans.

mission.line: Commander, please finish your missions soon. Else they'll conflict with other work I have scheduled for you later.

mission_complete.line: Finished ahead of schedule? Then you've earned a good break until our next assignment.

profile.line: I'm Admiral Zenker, a battlecruiser for the Iron Blood. My birth here was unexpected, but as you've given me a reason to exist, I plan to live up to your lofty expectations of me.

propose.line: I've rehearsed every little word and action of this little moment so many times now, but when I'm faced with you, I realize it was all unnecessary... There are so many things I want to say to you, but I don't know where to start. Commander... Please, let me take my whole lifetime to share it all with you!

skill.line: Dance in the palm of my hand!

touch.line: Commander, your next affair is... a last-minute appointment? Okay, I'll handle your work... Wait, it's a date with me?! I-I wasn't informed of thiiis!

touch2.line: W-wait, not that yet... M-my heart isn't ready!

unlock.line: Battlecruiser Admiral Zenker reporting for duty. I've put together a strategy based on the port's current conditions, so if you'd take a look at that first... Huh? You want me to go on a tour first?! W-wait, this doesn't fall under the twelve potential scenarios I planned for!

upgrade.line: These power-ups are, of course, all part of the plan.

win_mvp.line: Perfect. The rest of the operation should go just as I planned.

gift_prefer.line: Oh... Goodness, I love it, thank you! I never thought you'd get me this...

detail_ex.line: Did you learn a new trick?! If I learned this, I could take the enemy by surprise and land another... Oh, not you, of course. After all, you're my... Urk, you already know what I want to say...

feeling5_ex.line: I take pride in my maturity and reason, but they don't help at all when I'm with you... Now I find myself HOPING for little surprises. Thank you, Commander... You made me realize that the most important thing in life isn't the perfect plan, but time with the people you love.

headtouch_ex.line: Wait, my hair's not done yet... U-umm, okay, you can touch it...

home_ex.line: Commander, you're home later than expected. Did you run into any issues? I-I was worried about you... Heehee, you did come home safe, so I'll get back to work.

login_ex.line: According to the schedule, we have reports first... B-but first, can I have a minute of your time for a... a hug?

main4_ex.line: Commander, you've been working long enough... Take a break while you have time. I'll make you a cup of coffee.

main5_ex.line: ...Tickets for the exhibition this weekend? Yes, I'd love to join you... Oh, but I had plans for Saturday. Hmm... I've changed my plans. I did it the moment you invited me!

main6_ex.line: Commander, where's that pen I gave you? It was definitely here before... Huh? You take it everywhere with you? I see... That's great!

touch_ex.line: Your next plan is... a date with me... I haven't made detailed plans, so it's up to you to decide what happens... Okay?

touch2_ex.line: Following your heart instead of a plan... is nice once in a while.

detail.line: You think my lines and performance are perfect? Well, I did practice a lot on my own... This is the first time anyone's ever taken my rehearsals seriously.

feeling5.line: Why won't I look you in the eye? Umm... The script does say that I should, but when I do, I suddenly forget my lines. Um, let me try again... Nope! Not happening...

headtouch.line: Too bad for you, you'll never get a look inside my mind. Heh.

home.line: Commander, isn't it your break time? Are you sure you can change your plans just to help me practice lines? ...You just wanted to be with me? Heh, you always know just how to surprise me...

login.line: Urgh, the light... Ah, you're here. Still haven't given up yet, I presume? Wait, I don't think that came out right. It's hard to be mean when I'm dealing with you.

main1.line: There are a whole lot of people out there who wanna see you dead. Why waste time on little old me? I'll never give you my true identity.

main2.line: You know your measly interrogation isn't enough. This will amount to nothing.

main3.line: This is my first time being in a movie. It's fun to prepare and perform with everyone. I just wish people would stop being late and disrupting plans.

touch.line: You can leave the cuffs as they are – they don't hurt. It's easier to get immersed in the role, too... Are you worried about me, Commander?

touch2.line: Ack?! Are we ad-libbing?! U-umm, let me think of how to react to this... Hmm...

unlock.line: You want me to spill the beans? Heh. Hate to disappoint you... Phew... Did that sound good? I thought up other responses I could try, too.

battle.line: Follow me, not Eugen. Come – we shall face our opponents, no matter how numerous they may be!

couple_encourage1.line: Tirpitz... forgive me...

couple_encourage2.line: Eugen, don't go overboard with your games.

couple_encourage3.line: No one can stop the march of the Iron Blood.

detail.line: Is there something on my face?

expedition.line: ... The commission team has returned. I'll go greet them first.

feeling1.line: Stay out of my sight.

feeling2.line: I am not so easily impressed.

feeling3.line: You're not a bad commander... What? Is it so strange for me to give compliments? ... You're simply overreacting.

feeling4.line: Why are you staring at me? Do I have something on my face? I'm pretty, you say...? Um, thank you...

feeling5.line: I... know that I'm not the best with words, but.. I want you to know that... I enjoy being at your side...

home.line: You've done well. You've earned your rest.

hp_warning.line: Everyone, get behind me.

login.line: I look forward to working with you.

lose.line: For tarnishing my pride... next time, you will pay with your lives.

mail.line: Be diligent about checking your mail.

main1.line: Is there a problem? Perhaps my combat experience could prove useful?

main2.line: "Operation Rheinübung?" I don't have fond memories of it...

main3.line: Such a slovenly expression, Commander. Now! Lift your chin, puff out your chest, and let me see those eyes! Hut!

mission.line: Those who cannot finish their missions have no right to stand on the battleground.

mission_complete.line: I'm leaving the mission rewards over here...

profile.line: I am the Iron Blood battleship entrusted with the name Bismarck. Allow me to prove that Iron Blood engineering is the finest in the world, no matter the battlefield. Eager to see for yourself?

propose.line: ... Commander, what kind of expression should I have at a time like this? I should... just smile?

skill.line: Truth can only be found within our range!

touch.line: Keep your hands to yourself.

touch2.line: I... am not good at expressing myself. Please do not tease me on purpose...

unlock.line: Guten Tag, I am Bismarck. I have fought many foes on many fronts. You may call upon me whenever there is a problem.

upgrade.line: Danke.

win_mvp.line: Such honors may please a weakling, but I am strong.

gift_prefer.line: Why, this is...! Danke schön!

detail.line: Apologies, Commander. Am I acting differently from usual? At times, I don't even know which is the real me...

expedition.line: Once the commission fleet has finished dropping off their supplies, let's invite them to the banquet as well.

feeling5.line: In front of my compatriots, I always had to be adamant, solemnly spearheading the march of the Iron Blood. To be the leader of the Iron Blood's indomitable fleet, I had to lock away the Bismarck that struggled to express herself... But when I'm with you, Commander, I can set aside that burden, just for a little bit...

home.line: Let us raise our glasses to the heroes who have returned from battle.

login.line: How's your work coming along, Commander?

mail.line: Even at the most lavish banquet, it is your responsibility as commander to be well-informed should the situation change.

main1.line: Commander, would you invite Tirpitz for me? Apologies, I'm... still not sure how to ask her myself.

main2.line: I can keep a lot of people satisfied merely by sitting here with a smile... but only because of my status as the fleet leader of the Iron Blood.

main3.line: As a leader, I must sometimes say and do things that I do not believe in. Commander, I hope you never lose sight of who you are.

mission.line: Having unfinished work will turn even the finest wine into vinegar. Isn't that right, Commander?

mission_complete.line: A decoration for the banquet? Splendid work.

touch.line: A dance...? Oh, no, I wouldn't turn one down, I just haven't been asked until now...

touch2.line: C-Commander... don't tease me like that...

unlock.line: My sincerest apologies for the delay, Commander. Ah, excuse me... as the fleet leader of the Iron Blood, I'm expected to wear this outfit to various formal occasions. Just putting it on seems to make me inadvertently change the way I speak...

battle.line: I can take on any number of them!

detail.line: I feel far more at ease here than when I'm busy with research or the Iron Blood. I really hope that you feel the same way that I do.

expedition.line: Looks like the fleet has returned from their commissions... Thiele, I'll leave them to you.

feeling5.line: I never thought I'd be standing in front of you in this outfit like this. Still, whether it was fated or not, I'm glad that you were able to see a different side of me... Hm. This cup's on me. Please, enjoy yourself, hehe.

home.line: This cup is a prize for the hero who has graciously returned from the battlefield.

login.line: Oops, I almost wrote down "the usual" for your order... Ahem, what would you like?

mail.line: Here's your mail. I... hope it's not an order of coffee from Mainz...

main1.line: Truthfully speaking, this outfit feels more like that of a waitress than that of a maid... Though, I've been told there's not really much of a difference...

main2.line: Tirpitz, compile today's sales data and send it to Friedrich. Figuring out what to do with the data we've collected is her specialty.

mission.line: A new mission... I wonder who would be the best fit for it.

mission_complete.line: The remunerations for the missions we've completed are here. I'm sure Graf and the others will be ecstatic to hear.

touch.line: Eugen did tell me she wanted me to try this "physical contact" thing with you.

unlock.line: Welcome, what would you like to order? ...If you want, we can drop this charade. I'm not used to being a waiter anyway, so I prefer it this way. Hehe.

win_mvp.line: Data collection is complete. Take solace in the fact that you'll be useful after your demise.

detail.line: Why I chose this? Because of Eugen's advice – "If you're bad at expressing your feelings with words, do it with actions instead." I simply did what she suggested.

expedition.line: Please receive the commission team on my behalf. Dressed like this, well...

feeling5.line: Even with Eugen's advice, I had to rack my brains to come up with a way to express my love through actions. Unfortunately, it also ended in failure... Close your eyes, will you? *smooch*... Now it's all good. Frohe Weihnachten.

headtouch.line: Consider this a thank-you for tying up my hair.

home.line: Outstanding work, Commander. Take a break, then once you're done, could you help me here?

login.line: Wrapping myself up right in front of you... It's rather odd, don't you think?

mail.line: Did your letter come with a seasonal greeting card?

main1.line: I'll admit, I've had a little to drink. It's my first time doing something like this, and a bit of alcohol helps me feel more natural and empowered, I suppose?

main2.line: This was my chance to give you a surprise... If only I hadn't made that noise, this would've gone very differently.

main3.line: Do you like this outfit? As long as you like it, it has done its job as a present.

mission.line: Share the burden of your unfinished missions with me. The sooner they're done, the longer we can enjoy this holiday.

mission_complete.line: Is it just me, or are our rewards better than usual?

touch.line: Do you want my help with the unwrapping?

touch2.line: Although my present turned out half-baked, as long as you're happy with it...

unlock.line: C-Commander? Well, as you see, I was wrapping your Christmas present, but now the surprise has been spoiled. I suppose this moment calls for a "Merry Christmas," hmm?

battle.line: Gather under our banner!

detail.line: Have you decided where we'll go on our honeymoon? Oh, I'm not trying to rush you, I just thought I'd offer some advice if you couldn't decide. Maybe that's being too... proactive of me.

expedition.line: Let's speak to the commission te– Wait, no, I can't go out looking like this. They'll be shocked.

feeling5.line: I thought getting wed would make it easier for me to make expressions – as it turns out, that's not the case. That said, I feel more true to myself, and I've gotten more feelings I want to express... Fine just the way I am? That's good... because I like you this way, too... *blushes*

home.line: You okay? Didn't push yourself too hard? ...I'm only imitating the way you show concern for me. I suppose I failed to pull it off at all. Heehee.

login.line: There doesn't need to be only one leader. The position of assistant to you is very important. So am I, you say? Yes, you're right.

mail.line: Read your new letter. It no doubt contains equally important information to me.

main1.line: Being the leader of Iron Blood, I'm used to walking the red carpet. This occasion, however, is a first for me. I am wholly reliant on your help for this entire day. Heehee.

main2.line: Don't rush yourself – follow the path of your ideals at a steady pace. There is plenty time for both of us.

main3.line: It's incredible that there's always something we can both talk about. Not just fighting or leadership, but also music, hobbies, and daily life. It's embarrassing to admit, but there aren't many people I can have such profound conversations with.

touch.line: The ring you gave me is right here. Do you want to... touch it?

touch2.line: Bride dresses really do make you... No, never mind. Um, continue... *blushes*

unlock.line: You've arrived, Commander – or rather, my sweetheart in eternal vow. I know I can't wear a stiff expression forever, but when I think about the days to come under your guidance, I feel so needy all of a sudden. Yes, it's like you say... just keep smiling.

win_mvp.line: I offer you this brilliant victory – to decorate our journey of glory.

battle.line: Commander, I shall fight for your sake.

couple_encourage1.line: Sorrow is a mask unbefitting your countenance, sister.

detail.line: Choose your enemies carefully, Commander.

expedition.line: The commission seems to be complete... Next time, why don't you let me go? I'm a little curious.

feeling1.line: In the end... are you just another incompetent fool, unable to command me?

feeling2.line: I have already grown used to the cold solitude of the North. At this point, it's natural for me to have no expectations.

feeling3.line: Those who have nothing to lose also have nothing to fear... But is this kind of bravery really anything to be proud of?

feeling4.line: The worst feeling in the world is not knowing whether to continue waiting or to give up hope. Commander, are you someone worth waiting for?

feeling5.line: Ahh... I see. I thought I was used to the cold and embraced it, but that was just because I had forgotten the joy of human interaction and the warmth of being with someone... But now I remember...

home.line: Commander, you should show your face on the battlefield more often. If you stay behind your desk for too long, you may one day forget the meaning of life.

hp_warning.line: No one would protect those who asked for their own destruction.

login.line: Once you get used to waiting, you lose sight of what you were waiting for.

lose.line: So this is... the frustration that comes from failure and fear.

mail.line: More mail for you... Ah, I'm envious.

main1.line: Big sister... Now that you mention it, I think I might actually have one... Ah... I've already started to forget.

main2.line: Can you comprehend how it feels to watch the battlefield from afar, unable to do anything but lament the cruelty of war?

main3.line: Strategic reasons? I was installed with cannons... but they were never meant to be fired. Ironic, isn't it?

mission.line: Finish your missions properly. Perhaps you will one day realize the joy of having any purpose at all.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards... how nice.

profile.line: It's a bit hot... Ah, sorry. I am Tirpitz. Because I was stuck in the north by myself for so long, people suddenly started calling me the "Lonely Queen of the North." If you think it's a good nickname, then you do not fully understand... how soulless those words are.

propose.line: Ahh... so this is the warmth of one's beating heart... It's melting the cold and despair remaining within me. Danke sehr, Commander. The "Queen of the North" is no longer alone.

touch.line: Are you cold?

touch2.line: I'll think of how to deal with you later.

unlock.line: I was imprisoned in the north for so long, unable to return home, and now you want me to follow you? ...Very well. It is up to you to show me the world.

upgrade.line: If you have no opponents, all the might in the world is meaningless.

win_mvp.line: So this... is the taste of victory.

gift_prefer.line: This feeling of joy is... Thank you.

feeling5_ex.line: In my endless waiting, I've looked forward to the end of the bitter cold thousands of times, hoping for the moment when all the despair, anguish, and loneliness will disappear. Now, my wish has finally come true, because I have you by my side.

login_ex.line: You're finally here, Commander... My waiting was worth it.

main4_ex.line: It used to be so easy to bear with the loneliness... Now that I have you, even a single second of it feels unbelievably long.

main5_ex.line: Sometimes, when I leave home, I can't help but think that someone is waiting for me... It makes the passage of time suddenly feel so much faster.

main6_ex.line: You are my morning sun that melts the winter ice... Let me stay with you, if only for a little longer.

touch_ex.line: Your body is... delightfully warm.

touch2_ex.line: ...Can you not wait even a moment longer? Well, I feel the same way...

detail.line: Commander, enjoy yourself to the fullest. Our hard-fought battles are for the sake of peaceful moments like these... and our hard-earned breaks provide us with will to keep fighting.

login.line: Commander, there's no need to rush yourself. There is meaning in simply waiting for you.

main1.line: As long as you're by my side, even looking off into the horizon is meaningful.

main2.line: Some of my colleagues seem to mistake me for some unapproachable ice queen... Perhaps playing beach volleyball with them would help...

main3.line: The sunset and the beach at night are wonderful views. When you're done with work, want to accompany me for a walk along the shore?

mission.line: Even I can't get fired up about doing missions during the summer... because it's too hot...

touch.line: It's a bit stuffy... Commander, would you mind turning up the air conditioner?

touch2.line: Even though it's summer... there are still some things you shouldn't do...

unlock.line: In the past, I never saw summer as more than a hot and humid slog... But now? My outfit probably says it all... Let's go, everyone's already waiting for us at the beach.

detail.line: Truthfully, I still have a hard time conversing with Bismarck... But at least now, time is on our side. There will be plenty of things for us to talk about in the future, wouldn't you agree?

expedition.line: Commander, it seems like another commission has been completed. Go ahead and take care of it; I'll be waiting for you right here.

home.line: Commander, do you wish to know how I feel about Bismarck?

login.line: So you've come, Commander. Don't be anxious, the night is still young.

mail.line: We're getting all these requests to dance with you, Commander. Maybe I should put in one as well?

main1.line: In the past, the word "sister" meant nothing to me. But the moment I laid eyes on her, I knew in my heart... Yes, she is indeed my sister.

main2.line: Behold, she basks in everyone's adoring gaze as they orbit around her upon the resplendent firmament of the stage, as if she is the center of the universe... But you and I both know, that is not where she wants to be.

main3.line: Waiting for her to find us instead of taking the initiative to find her might be a bit of my nasty streak showing, but I'm still the little sister here. I have that right, don't I?

mission.line: Do we have new missions? Don't worry, Bismarck won't mind waiting a bit longer.

mission_complete.line: Commander, we don't have too many of these banquets, so don't get too anxious about work. Let's have something to eat first.

unlock.line: I bet Bismarck must've been thinking about how to invite me to the party, but ended up asking you to do it, Commander. Hehe... Let's get going soon. It's best not to keep her waiting.

win_mvp.line: If she was here... how would she have fought this battle?

detail.line: My Sakura Empire friends told me that the pine tree is like an anchor point for the gods. Much like what you are to me, Commander... Oh, just talking to myself. Hahah.

login.line: I waited for you, Commander. Now let us go and wish everyone a happy New Year, before aircraft come chasing after us.

main1.line: I must give my regards to my sister... But how I should face her, I do not know. Could you come with me, Commander?

main2.line: Alabama proposed playing a type of badminton enjoyed around New Year's. I suppose that could be fun. ...The loser will have ink rubbed on their face? On second thought, I will pass.

main3.line: I've long been used to the cold, but sometimes, I find myself reaching out towards the warmth... Commander, can I... come a little closer?

touch.line: It feels warm... A nice change of pace.

touch2.line: *sigh*... Could you please mind your manners in public?

unlock.line: They have a peculiar way of wishing a happy New Year in the Sakura Empire. In line with their traditions, I've put on this new outfit. I hope it doesn't... look strange on me. ...You like it? I see... That being the case, I'll keep wearing it for the time

detail.line: I cannot picture Bismarck going out on a date... I know I'm the one who asked you to come, but I didn't foresee she and I both would be so lacking in social grace.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. While I'm used to being kept waiting, being kept in suspense is something I can scarcely put up with.

login.line: No need to rush, Commander – we have plenty of time. If there's one thing I'm used to, it's waiting.

main1.line: Having you all to myself fills my heart with joy, even when we're simply killing time.

main2.line: I used to envy Hipper's and Eugen's closeness. Now Bismarck and I get along better than ever, thanks to you.

main3.line: Indeed, this is a happy reunion. Having something to look forward to can warm the heart on even the most frigid winter nights.

touch.line: You should sit down if your feet ache. It's true Bismarck overexerts herself, but that's no reason for you to do the same.

unlock.line: It's all right, I just got here myself. I will say, it's strangely reassuring to know I'm not the only one nervous on this day.

win_mvp.line: This ends now.

detail.line: I will become your biggest supporter so you may run with all you have.

feeling5.line: It's almost showtime. Whether you will earn new glory or face setbacks, I'll be here, waiting for the start of your next journey.

home.line: Your lap time is getting better and better... I need to pick up the pace as well.

login.line: Park your car here, Commander. Your next tires are ready, so let's get them swapped out.

main1.line: A change of tires will let you exhibit your fullest potential. Give me a minute... I'll be done before you know it.

main2.line: Your invitation to enter the race together thawed the frost inside my heart... Ah, this brings back memories.

main3.line: Whew... This is a bit tricky... Hm? You'll give me a hand? Okay, then give me your hands. Don't let go... until I tell you to.

touch.line: Don't worry. It's just moving a tire. I can do it.

touch2.line: At least save it for after the training...

unlock.line: Congratulations on your new record, Commander. This glory alone has given meaning to my time spent waiting. Now, rest assured while I do maintenance on your car.

win_mvp.line: Heehee. This glory belongs to you who gave it your all. I merely did what was expected of me.

battle.line: ...Tsk. This ammo is wasted on you lot!

couple_encourage1.line: Looks like you and I are dancing to different tunes.

couple_encourage2.line: If you're interested in something, just face it head-on, young lady.

detail.line: If you want peace of mind, just don't bother worrying about anyone else. We may be born into this world, but our keels and souls aren't at the mercy of others.

expedition.line: The fleet's returned from their commissions. Hurry up and decide whether you or I go and greet them.

feeling1.line: You sowed these seeds yourself. It's your mess to clean up, not mine.

feeling2.line: Trust is like a poison—once it enters your body, it destroys you. The only way to protect yourself is to be wary of others.

feeling3.line: Working for you is not the same as trusting you. The fact that you can command so many people... Or rather, be adored by so many, means you of all people should understand.

feeling4.line: You spineless fool who doesn't even know how to doubt others... I've come to realize that you've spread deeper and deeper through me, just like a poison. Tsk... I'll return the favor, mark my words.

feeling5.line: I told you I'd return the favor. Yep, I'll suck the poison out of you before it has a chance to spread throughout your body. This is my duty... my responsibility, for the person who did the same for me. But maybe I'm already too late? Hehehe...

headtouch.line: Hmph. You don't make any damn sense.

home.line: Everyone made it back, huh? Not bad.

hp_warning.line: If you don't plan on dying here, then focus up!

login.line: You're here. See that massive pile of paperwork on your desk? The two of us will be spending lots of quality time here until that's taken care of.

lose.line: I'll back off since we lost, but don't count on it happening again.

mail.line: There's some mail. Looks like it contains confidential information... I see.

main1.line: You want to know more about my rigging? Sure, I can move it like I want to, but there are times when it's pretty troublesome.

main2.line: The Mysteries of the Port? Just leave it as it is. That's the only way it'll continue to keep your curiosity piqued, isn't it.

main3.line: Think for yourself... Though you can't live selfishly, you need to live for the sake of something you really desire. That way, even if you die, it won't be in vain.

main4.line: It might be a surprise for you, but I do have hobbies I enjoy. And it's not like I become a different person when I do.

mission.line: Missions, huh? Whether we do them or not is up to you. That is your freedom.

mission_complete.line: The rewards have arrived. Kick back and enjoy the moment. You're going to miss out on it if you don't, and all that'll be left is emptiness.

profile.line: My name is Ulrich von Hutten. So long as you call me that, that is who I am. A name is nothing more than that.

propose.line: Embrace it, drown in it... Just as you put the curse of trust on me, I'll place it on you. Trust... Let the poison called affection consume you. Become just like me. Don't you know? You and I are already one.

skill.line: Get lost, you're in the way.

touch.line: If you've got something to say, spit it out. I'll hear you out.

touch2.line: I'm not sure whether I should praise you or teach you your place...

unlock.line: I am Ulrich von Hutten, the symbol of the Iron Blood's hopes and regrets. Whether my arrival is a cause for celebration or for despair is up to you to decide. I shall respond in kind.

upgrade.line: In order to create a peaceful world where power is not needed, what you need is power. How paradoxical... Oh, don't mind me.

win_mvp.line: ...Piss off, weaklings. Just thinking about the amount of ammo I've wasted on you sorry lot makes me want to vomit.

gift_prefer.line: Turning this down would be a terrible waste. Hmph.

battle_ex.line: I'll mow all of you down!

detail_ex.line: What's wrong? Did something happen? You're not acting like yourself... Trust in others like you trust in me, that's how you'll put those girls at ease. Of course, the same goes for me.

expedition_ex.line: Looks like the fleet is back after their commissions. Don't you want to look at their beaming smiles?

feeling5_ex.line: Stay still. Don't wander away. I can't leave the one I absolutely adore alone. If someone actually tried to tear the two of us apart... Hehehe... Let's just say, I'd tell them to eat shit.

headtouch_ex.line: Does being pampered like this irritate you?

home_ex.line: Are you alright? ...I don't doubt my ability to take care of my subordinates' safety, but I can't help but worry about you... Tell me, are you really alright?

login_ex.line: You finally showed up... but you're not needed anymore. Hehehe. Don't just stand there in shock, guess what I did for you.

lose_ex.line: I was able to bring everyone back... safely.

main5_ex.line: Even though you do so well when I pamper you, you refuse to be pampered when you're not doing well... Hmph. You're just like those little kitties in the most peculiar ways...

main6_ex.line: If you're really dying to find out what's behind the Mysteries of the Port, I won't stop you. I'll even accompany you. It'll be a good way of spending time with you.

main7_ex.line: Focus more on myself? It seems like you don't understand. It's because I'm focusing on myself that I do all these things for you.

main8_ex.line: When you neglect your health, think about the people who would be sad if you collapsed. I, for one, don't want to feel sad.

mail_ex.line: Here's some mail for you. I broke the seals for you, is that alright?

mission_ex.line: There's a new mission. I did the parts I could help out with. I'll leave the rest to you.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. Feeling a bit tired? Let's take a break until you've recovered enough energy.

touch_ex.line: This is how our relationship together is. I don't know why you're getting all flustered about it at this point...

touch2_ex.line: Do you want to find out which of us has less self-restraint?

win_mvp_ex.line: I want you to tell me whether you're satisfied with my performance or not.

headtouch.line: The little'uns really like when you do this to them.

home.line: *Glug, glug* ...Ahh, that hits the spot. Tsk, it's already empty... Sorry, mind grabbing me another can?

login.line: What's going on with you today? Spill it.

lose.line: Tsk, they got me...

main1.line: I really need to head back, but the little'un just... *sigh* what a pain in the ass.

main2.line: The fan outside is so frickin' loud, but I really need my alone time... Huh? Who put these damn stickers here...?

main3.line: You already know what I'll do to people who start shit inside, don't you? ...Yep. I'll give them their one warning.

main4.line: I'm not really worried about Elbe causing trouble. Surprisingly, she knows when to stop. ...Well, at least she's not my main source of worry.

mission.line: So, you accept a mission and then immediately begin procrastinating...? What a piece of work you are. Want me to do the same thing to you?

touch.line: "Welcome back, Master. May I take your order?" ...You happy with that?

touch2.line: Tsk... Again with that shit just 'cuz we're here? What a pain in the ass...

unlock.line: *sigh* Do you really have to bother me during my break? ...It's a joke, no need to take it so seriously. I was looking for someone to kill some time with anyway.

win_mvp.line: Looks like things worked out just fine.

detail.line: Listen. Don't let other people distract you when you're on the track. Forget about overtaking others and just focus on driving the best you can drive. You'll finish with fewer regrets that way.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Now go talk to them. Cheering them on is your job.

home.line: You look like you're in good shape. Hmph, so I worried for nothing.

login.line: Make it clear – do you want support, or a scolding? Standing around doing nothing isn't my style.

lose.line: Just hope the girls rooting for us won't be disappointed by this... Tsk. I hate putting up appearances.

mail.line: A letter... Just go check it and don't mind me.

main1.line: Seeing as you've got nothing better to do, go give the girls some refreshments. It'll cheer 'em up, knowing that you're here.

main2.line: Maintaining hardware is one thing we Iron Blood excel at. We're expert tamers, both of machinery and riggings.

main3.line: Wonder when we're gonna rehearse for the victory party performance... I should go talk to Hipper and Eugen after my shift's over.

touch.line: Are you gonna race, too? Then I'll at least give you some pointers and support.

touch2.line: Hmph. You're a hopeless case.

unlock.line: That was a pretty good race – reckon you'll get first place next time, though? ...Hmh. Easier said than done. You know they won't settle for second place – and hopefully neither will you, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Hope this will be a good morale boost.

expedition.line: Go check on the commission first. Don't worry, I won't leave.

feeling5.line: Living a simple life, going home with you every day and staying by your side... Heh. If this is a dream, I never want to wake up. Guess I'm addicted to you now.

headtouch.line: Doing whatever you want just because you're my senior, huh... Pfft, heheh.

home.line: You look tired. Did you run into trouble out there? I'm happy to listen, if you'd like to talk.

login.line: Got any plans today? You don't have to answer right away – we'll have time to talk on the way home.

main1.line: Yeah, I got your message. "I'm busy, so I'll be late." The "go home without me" part was unnecessary.

main2.line: I found a few shops you might like. If you want, we could take a detour... Not that you'd ever refuse.

main3.line: You must be tired, but if I let you lie in my lap right now, we'll get home even later... Or was that what you wanted all along?

main4.line: I'm not mad. I just waited a little... but if you'll treat me to something to make up for it, I won't say no.

mission.line: Hm? Another reminder? Did an urgent mission come up, or something?

mission_complete.line: Looks like you're being rewarded after being worked so hard.

touch.line: Is this how seniors are supposed to treat younger students?

touch2.line: Just because nobody's here... Is this what you were after all along?

unlock.line: Hm? You look like you've seen a ghost... Oh, you thought I'd have gone home by now? Heh... Who cares? It's not like I've got anything better to do.

battle.line: Tch... Causing trouble for the Commander, are you?

detail.line: Now you want to escape? It's too late. Once caught in a web, a butterfly has no escape. You've poisoned me, and now, it's time I return the favor.

feeling5.line: It all started out with simple eye contact. We went from there to trust, to acceptance, and finally, to unstoppable free-fall. Before I knew it, I'd already swallowed the poison called love. Now, even the closest intimacy is just a temporary fix for me. But I must have it... All we can do now is keep indulging in it.

headtouch.line: Want to feel more? Just watch out for these hairpins.

home.line: Doing okay? Even in this attire, I can always rush to your aid... What? You want a cup of coffee first? Fine. Come to my room, and you can have it... It's just instant coffee, though.

login.line: Oh, you're here? You're all mine today. Work? Leave it for once. Nothing is more important than you and me right now.

main1.line: Are you taken by the sight of me? Heh... Seeing that look on your face made all this effort worthwhile.

main2.line: Got a problem? Let me know, and I'll get rid of whatever obstacles are in your way.

main3.line: Want to know where I put my rigging? Heh, I don't really need it right now. Or else... is there something you want to try with it?

main4.line: Fate tied us together long ago. Call it the red string, the silver string, whatever – it binds us forever now.

touch.line: Take my hand and fall into this web with me.

touch2.line: Hmph... Why do you still test me? Or is this just the kind of foreplay you like?

unlock.line: Hmph, so the day has finally come... I'm not surprised. I knew from the day we met that this would happen. After all... the poison called love is both a blessing and a curse.

battle.line: Adequate preparation is half the battle.

detail.line: All troubles that occur either have a reason or a trigger. Unless there are innocents tangled up in the problem, it's best to lay low and wait.

expedition.line: The girls have returned from their commissions. I'm sure the morale of the girls at the port will go up if you go out and greet them personally.

feeling1.line: I'll serve my duties as your subordinate, but don't expect me to be all smiles while doing so.

feeling2.line: Nobody, not even I, can meddle with your thoughts. Of course, due to our differences in standing, values, and information, I may disagree with you from time to time. But I will never disparage your authority over me.

feeling3.line: I might not approve of all of your decisions, but I do admire your resolution. You are exactly as a commander should be.

feeling4.line: Commander, how are your plans looking today? ...Ah, I'm not talking about work, but about your personal matters. Frankly, I simply wished to invite you to tea if we both happened to be free.

feeling5.line: Maybe because we have good chemistry together, but I feel very comfortable being around you, whether for work or for personal matters. Even if we disagree on something, we come to understand each other's positions very quickly. I hope we can continue getting along just as well as we have.

home.line: Good work out there. Will you take a break? Or are you planning on getting right back to another mission? Either way, I'll be here for you.

hp_warning.line: You're quite skilled, but I won't fall that easily!

login.line: Hm, I'm glad to see that you're as chipper as ever. Keep it up.

lose.line: I'll be back with some payback. Nobody likes to stay a loser.
