mail.line: Here's some mail. I'd like you to check on them as soon as possible... Later, you say? Well, I don't think there's anything urgent here, so that sounds fine with me.

main1.line: Be more confident with your opinions and openly state your opinions. If anyone dares to boo you down, I'll teach them something about manners.

main2.line: Mm... I'll have to disagree on this. Of course, your word goes, but would you mind hearing my thoughts out first?

main3.line: What's wrong? Got something against being watched? Ahaha, you don't have to be all tense. I wasn't keeping watch over you, I just wanted to observe your response.

mission.line: A new mission? I think it's a good idea to get started on it right now, but you're the Commander. I'll follow your plans.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. I'll let you decide who you want to send to pick up the rewards.

profile.line: Didn't I tell you I was the Iron Blood battleship Thüringen when we first met each other? You want to know more about me? Everything, even? Ahaha, then let's look for a nice place where we can sit and talk. I'll tell you everything, starting from my time in the High Seas Fleet.

propose.line: This kind of proposal works best when our feelings are reciprocal—basically, we accept each other as partners. When we have differing opinions, as long as we work together, hand-in-hand, we can overcome any obstacle that stands in our path! Ahaha!

touch.line: The things I tell you are merely suggestions to you. Ultimately, you call the shots here.

touch2.line: Hmph! This is payback for your insolent behavior. There's no need for me to continue being a doormat for you.

unlock.line: It is a pleasure, Commander. I'm Thüringen, battleship of the Iron Blood. Before I formally sign on, there's one thing I want to ask – what role, exactly, do you have in mind for me? Hahah! No, I'm not testing you, I simply want a grasp of your moral compass.

upgrade.line: Hmm. Much obliged.

win_mvp.line: Seems we've taken far less damage than I'd anticipated. How fortuitous.

gift_prefer.line: For me personally, this is a most wonderful gift indeed.

home_ex.line: Good work out there. Will you take a break, or are you planning on getting back to work? Either way, I've made arrangements for whatever you choose.

login_ex.line: Hm, I'm glad to see that you're as chipper as ever. You look like you're ready to take on the world today.

main4_ex.line: I don't make any pointless remarks when you're making decisions. Previously, it was because of my respect for you, but now... it's because my heart can't help but trust in all you do.

main5_ex.line: I've collected a list of good locations for the two of us, just as you directed me to... While I'm aware that this isn't a date and that you just wanted to make your rounds, I'm... not opposed to it being a date as well.

touch_ex.line: You consider my opinions very important? Thank you very much for trusting in me. But the same goes for me.

touch2_ex.line: I'll let you off this once. Make sure to hold yourself back next time.

detail.line: This set is unbelievably big... Ahaha, there's no way I'd have any complaints. However, I definitely want the girl who prepared this set to experience what cleaning this humongous space feels like.

home.line: Nice work. I was just about to take a break myself. Would you like me to help you with anything?

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. I'd like to warn you—the floor is wet, so please be careful.

main1.line: Speaking of which, what is this set even used for... well, I guess it's fine. It's not something for me to worry about.

main2.line: That poor-looking Royal Maid taught me how to clean things up... Ahaha, it's not the kind of cleaning that you're thinking about, just regular cleaning.

main3.line: Lützow, I'm not telling you not to play with the manjuu, but make sure you carry those things to Akashi once you're done, you hear?

touch.line: Though you shouldn't be helping me clean... if you insist, there's no way I'd turn you down.

unlock.line: You, mop the floor. You, take care of the windows. Once that's done... Ah, Commander. Excuse us, we're in the middle of cleaning the area. If you have need of me, I must ask you to wait.

battle.line: That sheer courage to stand in my way is worthy of applause.

couple_encourage1.line: That's the Eugen I've always known.

couple_encourage2.line: Join me in battle, Tirpitz.

couple_encourage3.line: I'm not the Bismarck you know, but I seek your aid all the same.

couple_encourage4.line: I haven't forgotten your knightly promise.

couple_encourage5.line: Whatever happens, I will always protect you.

couple_encourage6.line: How long has it been since we last fought together?

couple_encourage7.line: I shall lead Iron Blood towards a glorious future. To do that, I need your help.

detail.line: A private workspace? No, that's alright. I don't need preferential treatment– simply being able to work with you is enough.

expedition.line: Munitions have arrived. Come, let's not waste any time. Those girls would like nothing more than a warm welcome from you.

feeling1.line: I thought you a brilliant leader and followed your example. I now see that I was misguided.

feeling2.line: I do not want any preferential treatment. All I ask is that you treat me as you would any of our other colleagues. That's right, Commander. I look forward to working with you in the days ahead. I'm sure we'll become the best of friends.

feeling3.line: There are times I wonder what I would do if you were ever to become my enemy. Of course, it's just a thought experiment, but it helped me realize– I'm glad we're on the same side.

feeling4.line: I'm comfortable discussing anything with you, from office matters to coffee break gossip. Being this sincere, this forthright, is something a leader conscious about appearances strives for. Heehee. I always enjoy my time with you.

feeling5.line: I hope you will remain by my side, as more than an ally and close friend you can talk to about... *sigh*, never mind. It's all good as long as you know what I'm trying to say. See, I'm... I'm still not used to speaking my heart...

headtouch.line: Want to try my cap on? ...Hehe, it suits you well.

home.line: You're back. If you have the time, could you compile an after-action report? In the meantime... I'll put myself in our foes' shoes and see if I can't develop a better strategy.

hp_warning.line: None shall tarnish Iron Blood's honor!

login.line: Let's get to work, Commander. A port this vast requires a leader's management.

lose.line: I do not intend to shoulder all the responsibility myself... but I will ensure our safe retreat!

mail.line: A letter for you, it seems. Give it a read, promptly. You wouldn't want to miss potentially vital information.

main1.line: The two of us have much in common, as leaders who bear the expectations of their peers. If there's anything you have difficulty confiding to others, feel free to turn to me.

main2.line: Geryon is being rather rowdy... Regensburg, how'd you manage to calm him down the last time? Mind showing me again?

main3.line: While you could call Eugen my right-hand woman, she can often be frustratingly difficult to read... You think so, too? Heh, I'm glad we're on the same page.

main4.line: With this new power, I finally have the opportunity to leave my regrets behind in the past. Wait, we're going to a café with Tirpitz? Right now? Umm... give me a moment to sort out my emotions...

main5.line: I like slow classical music– it helps me relax. As for the war... Yes, there will come a day when that, too, is history.

mission.line: A new mission? Let me have a look. I can lend you a hand.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Remember to claim your rewards. They belong in your hands.

profile.line: My lust for power once dragged me down to the depths of hell. No matter how much I regretted it, it was already too late... I never dreamed that I would be given new life in this manner. Much seems to have changed during my slumber, but I am now ready to take on everything. Having you, a fellow leader, show me the way forward is the best thing I could ask for.

propose.line: I know about your resolve, your feelings. What I don't know... is how to meet your expectations for this unforgettable ceremony. Let this be a rare case where I ask for a favor and say... could you take the lead? Heehee.

skill.line: Truth can only be found within my range!

touch.line: Has my sword caught your eye? You may hold it if you want.

touch2.line: Are you purposely trying to get under my skin?

unlock.line: Guten Tag. I am Iron Blood battleship Bismarck. While this may not be our first meeting, perhaps you find my new attire surprising? As a fellow idealist, I'm happy to once more fight by your side.

upgrade.line: It's time for routine maintenance. Geryon, be quiet now.

win_mvp.line: Excellent, the path before us has been cleared. Forward!

gift_prefer.line: Heh. Not bad. I appreciate it.

battle_ex.line: At long last, I, Bismarck, have returned to the battlefield!!

detail_ex.line: Once we wrap up here, why don't we go someplace nice? As a refresher, you know... Asking for a date? D-does it come across like that? I see... If you want, you're free to think of it like one...

expedition_ex.line: The commission team has returned in one piece. Let's go welcome them back. They're waiting to see you.

headtouch_ex.line: The leader of Iron Blood, allowing the Commander to pet her... I mustn't be seen like this.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. There's much to reflect on, but for now, enjoy a well-earned break.

login_ex.line: What will it be today – tea or coffee? Heehee. Only you could have me as a handmaid, so allow me to serve you for... Hm? This isn't what you had in mind?

lose_ex.line: Commander, take everyone and retreat, now. We cannot eke out a victory here.

main6_ex.line: Sometimes, I envy Blücher. If only I could be as open and honest about my feelings as her... But maybe you don't want me to be like her?

main7_ex.line: I'm planning to set some time aside just for U-556... Hm? The U-boats are all playing hide-and-seek tomorrow? That's, well... I'll find time for her some other day.

main8_ex.line: I've read that listening to the same music can put two people in the same mood... Why don't we give that a try, Commander?

mail_ex.line: New mail, hmm? Do you think someone's thinking of you from afar?

skill_ex.line: I, battleship Bismarck, shall forge a brighter future!

touch_ex.line: What do you mean by this?

touch2_ex.line: How am I supposed to respond to this...?

win_mvp_ex.line: All who oppose us have been eliminated. Awaiting your next order, Commander.

battle.line: Emergency sortie, Geryon. Come with me.

detail.line: I reserved this whole swimming pool. We all want to be left undisturbed sometimes. Especially now, when... You know what I mean, don't you?

headtouch.line: Hold on. My hair is still soaked.

home.line: The swimming pool floor is slippery, so watch your step, Comma– *sigh*... I told you so. Be more careful.

login.line: The water feels perfect. Commander, come join me after you finish your warmup exercises.

lose.line: I wanted to tune up today, but unsurprisingly, you can't fight when you're not fully prepared...

mail.line: A letter? Why in here, of all places... Dry your hands before you open it.

main1.line: U-556 told me that submarines love playing in the pool. While I agree it is a fun time, I wish she'd understand why I can't exactly mingle with submarines...

main2.line: My swimsuit? Why yes, I chose it myself. In truth, I did ask Eugen for suggestions, but all the swimsuits she picked out were... the kinds that draw undesirable attention. Let's just say that..

main3.line: Incidentally, would you consider what we're doing here a date? ...Thinking of it like that makes me feel a bit tense...

touch.line: If you want a break from swimming, we can always sit on the deck like this.

touch2.line: To follow my heart in this scenario or not, that's the question...

unlock.line: Ah, you've already gotten changed, Commander? I'm just... Well, I need to do something about my hair before I go back in the water.

win_mvp.line: All enemies have been dealt with. I hope this will go swimmingly for at least a while.

detail.line: Look, Commander – the light reflecting off of the water makes my necklace glow all the more. I'm very fond of this gift of yours.

feeling5.line: I'm bad at expressing my emotions, and I struggle to naturally show my feelings toward you... Still, I want you to view it like this necklace: As long as you look with your heart, its splendor should reveal itself to you.

headtouch.line: Hm? Is there a petal stuck to my hair?

home.line: Yes... The water is the perfect temperature. It washes away filth and fatigue alike.

login.line: Most people would take off their necklaces before going into the bath, but I'm reluctant to. I want to remember this feeling.

main1.line: Flower petals, music, and aromas. Heehee – even I have a sense for romance.

main2.line: I feel weak... I must've soaked for too long. Commander, could you... wrap the towel around me?

main3.line: The necklace feels vaguely warm to the touch... Care to feel it for yourself, Commander?

touch.line: You wish to see it from a different angle? Of course. Go ahead.

touch2.line: Heehee. Let us immerse ourselves in this wonderful scenery.

unlock.line: This necklace's glimmer and texture in the steam is truly splendid... Oh, Commander. Would you care to come in and share in this scene you've gifted me?

battle.line: Fade with the music!

detail.line: Do you want to hear my performance, my child? It might bring your confused state of mind back to order.

expedition.line: Our friends are back from their commission. Shall we play a song of celebration?

feeling1.line: Hmm. Ah... This performance is a little disappointing...

feeling2.line: "What is real is rational," said one philosopher. Don't think too much about why I'm here – just immerse yourself in my melody.

feeling3.line: Hmm... In what unexpected ways will the courage that wells up on the battlefield affect this movement?

feeling4.line: Why don't we do something fun, right here and now? For example... We both bite into opposite ends of a pretzel and see... where things end up? Heehee.

feeling5.line: Do you want me to pamper you, my child? Or do you want to pamper me? Heehee, either way, today is your only chance♪

headtouch.line: How fun. Now I want to do the same to you, my child.

home.line: Welcome. Heehee, I'm devising a glorious symphony to celebrate your triumphant return, my child.

hp_warning.line: Hmph... A final cadence?

login.line: Today's performance is about to begin. Sit, my child.

lose.line: An unharmonious trill... I'll need to tune things better.

mail.line: Mail for you, my child. Oh? There's a postcard that plays music.

main1.line: The phonograph was ahead of its time. Thanks to this, even music can be something that contains dear memories... Would you like to preserve some dear memories together?

main2.line: Logic, sensibility... Heehee, just like the balance discovered in a melody.

main3.line: Heehee, let's play. Let your emotions gush out like hot magma...

mission.line: Trading actions for the things you desire... Heehee, is a mission really anything more?

mission_complete.line: Go get your mission rewards, okay? Hmm... I wonder what song I would need to play to be rewarded with you.

profile.line: Friedrich der Große, mysterious melody of the Iron Blood fleet, happy to meet you. What music shall we play together, my child?

propose.line: This is... Heehee, do you understand what this means, my child? As you wish, I will entrust my very life to you. And I will see yours given to me, as well...

skill.line: Let us play the Fifth Symphony!

touch.line: Hm? What do you want to hear today, my child?

touch2.line: Heehee, is this your decision?

unlock.line: Welcome, my child. What would you like to enjoy together today? Your talents? Glory? Or youth? Heheh, you may surrender it all to me.

upgrade.line: I feel radiant.

win_mvp.line: Victory's encore has only just begun.

feeling5_ex.line: When I say that I'll accept all of you, that isn't just pretty words. Go on... Surrender all of yourself, everything, to me. I'll put you in the utmost place in my heart... Heeheehee...

home_ex.line: Welcome. Heehee, listen to the triumphant melody I've composed for you!

login_ex.line: Object of my overwhelming love, what performance would you like to hear from me today?

main4_ex.line: The songs recorded on a phonograph can be shared with others, like precious memories. My child, share your joys and your worries with me.

main5_ex.line: A song played by the heart that equally balances logic and sensibility, known as love... That's what I hear from you, my child.

touch2_ex.line: Behold my passion, my child!

battle.line: Let's see which one of us has the more impeccable etiquette.

couple_encourage1.line: I'll lure them close while you strike them down... It's a pleasure to work with you!

couple_encourage2.line: Well, well. Aren't you cute?

detail.line: Do you like poetry, Commander? Hehe, such beautiful rhyme and meter can effortlessly bewilder and entice prey into your clutches.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I've made the logistical arrangements, so all that's left is for you to welcome our weary friends.

feeling1.line: Goodness. What a disappointing blunder, Commander.

feeling2.line: The discipline of the Iron Blood, elegance of the Royal Navy, and vitality of the Eagle Union... Being able to bring together such diverse individuals and make them dance on the same floor is a testament to your innate charisma, Commander.

feeling3.line: You look quite relaxed, Commander. Does this mean we can finally dispense with all these tedious pleasantries?

feeling4.line: Commander, why do you think roses have thorns? It isn't just to protect their delicate petals... but to allow only the worthy to possess them.

feeling5.line: Veiling my intentions in poetry, concealing my sharpness with etiquette, dancing in the night in search of just a drop of passion... Do you consider me dangerous, Commander?

headtouch.line: Such unexpected intimacy... Have I spoiled you, Commander? Heehee.

home.line: Thank you for allowing me to sit in on such a masterful hunt. Leave the cleanup work to me while you rest.

hp_warning.line: It's time for my counterattack!

login.line: Greetings, Commander. Oh, are you taken by the sight of my wings furling? Hehehe, well... I wouldn't mind if you took a closer look.

lose.line: Hehe, they only think they've won. Commander, let's make our move!

mail.line: Shall I screen your mail for you? Just understand that if I see anything "suggestive" in there, I might end up hiding it♪

main1.line: Your collar's a bit crooked. Heehee, people will look down on you if you aren't properly groomed. Especially given your position...

main2.line: I've prepared some refreshments for this evening's banquet. It's only ripe tomato juice, but listen, Commander... Appearances can be deceiving.

main3.line: My Iron Blood colleagues are unaccustomed to showing passion in front of others. In my opinion, though, their devotion is quite endearing. Heehee!

main4.line: The sight of you so earnestly devoted to your work at all hours of the day... only makes me want to drag different emotions out of you.

mission.line: Commander, you must understand that unfinished work is like ladies at a ball, waiting for you to invite them to dance. One mustn't keep them waiting.

mission_complete.line: The missions are complete. Shall we raise a glass in celebration?

profile.line: You'd like to know my secrets, would you? Hehehe, then let me warn you: you must never let Götz von Berlichingen touch alcohol. Rumor has it that, when she gets tipsy, she can become one haughty woman... Goodness, what a handful she must be.

propose.line: Dear silly Commander of mine, you ought to know by now that I'M the one who pursues. If you'll offer your blood unto me and let me trace it all the way back to your beating heart... then I promise that I will plunge alongside you into this eternal dream♥

touch.line: Oh, my. The blood in your neck is coursing faster... Are you enjoying our duet?

touch2.line: Commander, treating a noble lady so roughly is far from a wise move.

unlock.line: Guten Tag, Commander. I am Götz von Berlichingen. Sooner would I offer you a rose than my blade, and sooner would I dance with you under the moonlight than amidst the smoke of battle.

upgrade.line: Your favor is noticed and appreciated. I promise to repay you.

win_mvp.line: This concludes the day's etiquette lesson.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you for the gift. Next time we dance, I might just have a surprise for you.

detail_ex.line: I'll be honest, my invitation to dinner was but a ploy. How else could I have a moment of your time all to myself?

feeling5_ex.line: Your love may be the most entertaining struggle I've ever experienced. Will I succumb to your tenderness in the end, or will you fall into my hands? The fun is only just beginning♡

headtouch_ex.line: Touch me more, please. I'm already addicted to your warmth...

home_ex.line: Welcome back, dear Commander. I'm feeling a bit peckish... I don't mean literal hunger, of course. How do you intend to sate me, I wonder?

login_ex.line: Another day, another mountain of paperwork... This one looks like it'll take some time. Say, why don't we work in my room? It might make you more productive♪

main5_ex.line: I only drank tomato juice, but my head is spinning... Commander, come and steady me. Heehee... That's an order!

main6_ex.line: I can use my wings for some interesting purposes. For example... I could make a space just for us that nobody can disturb...

main7_ex.line: Those verses just now were slightly improvised, you know. Heehee, I replaced the lovers in it with you and me.

main8_ex.line: I drank too much again... Listen up, Commander. You are mine! If you get in trouble with anyone, you come to me! I'll... use my cannons to knock their ass into the stratosphere!

touch_ex.line: Oh? Was that intended as an ambush? In that case... you've earned yourself a fierce counterattack.

touch2_ex.line: Heehee, if I hide us with my wings... nobody else will see what we're doing, dear Commander♥

feeling5.line: When the blood moon sets and dawn breaks, you may notice a mark on your neck. It will continue to ache, never fading... Heehee, that's my lifelong memento for you.

headtouch.line: Are you worried that I'll fall? Heehee, don't be. I have wings to fly with – and a tail to coil tightly around you, as well.

home.line: Do you like the dream I made just for you, Commander? Heehee, then let's continue...

login.line: If it isn't you, Commander♪ Shall we begin our wonderful dream together?

main1.line: An upside-down succubus for an upside-down world... One where we can cast aside morality, accept this sweet curse, and indulge in our mutual desire forever...

main2.line: The blood moon's ode to depravity... Hehe, such a wonderful illusion. I don't know if I can hold myself back for much longer♡

main3.line: Beloved Commander, you have to hold on just a little longer. Soon... Soon, I will be right by your side♥

main4.line: Perhaps only in the moment when our fingers touch can we truly discern what is reality and what is a reflection of our yearning hearts... Come closer, that we may find out♥

touch.line: How will you entertain this hungry succubus, Commander?

touch2.line: Heehee... I'll have my fill of you before long, my beloved♥

unlock.line: Oh? You've finally noticed my presence, human? I've been waiting within arm's reach for a long while now.

battle.line: Keep calm and persevere. Victory will surely come to us.

couple_encourage1.line: I wonder what your plan might be?

couple_encourage2.line: Head forth without worry, we've got you covered.

detail.line: Commander, are you free? Do you have time to help me practice with my planes?

expedition.line: The commissions team is back? We shouldn't leave them waiting there like that... Should I go ahead and greet them first?

feeling1.line: Commander, I've got one word of advice for you. If your condition isn't great, make sure to take a break and sleep soundly. It won't do to have everyone else see you in bad shape.

feeling2.line: The battlefield is a place where the unexpected occurs. If you simply insist on following the orders given to you by the higher-ups, you'll never be able to achieve victory.

feeling3.line: Peter is quite brilliant, but she can also be quite dreary. I wish she'd loosen up about time and planning and all, and learn to just have fun sometimes.

feeling4.line: I believe that the way we live isn't influenced by our environment, but rather the choices we've made. That's why I've always lived by my own tempo. What do you think about the way I live my life?

feeling5.line: Have you matched your stride to my tempo, or have I matched mine to meet yours? Putting all that aside, you know, having you by my side makes me feel comfortable and relaxed. Hehe.

home.line: Being a commander truly takes a surprising amount of work... How about taking a quick breather right about now?

hp_warning.line: It's not yet time to panic.

login.line: Before you hurry off to do your work, why not first take a seat and enjoy a cup of coffee?

lose.line: Ugh... I wonder if I'm still not used to my planes...

mail.line: There's some mail for you. If it's nothing urgent, just read them later.

main1.line: The Iron Blood doesn't have as many aircraft carriers as the other factions, so I can't help but worry that we'll be at a disadvantage during practice exercises.

main2.line: The Unsinkable Battleship...? Oh, I know who you're talking about. I wonder if I'll ever be able to meet my renowned predecessor, Seydlitz, at some point?

main3.line: Hipper, Eugen... I can't believe I'm able to fight by their side like this. It's all thanks to you, Commander.

mission.line: New missions? There's no need to hurry. We can check them after you finish whatever you're doing right now.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Don't worry, it's not like the rewards will run off somewhere. You just need to make sure to collect them later.

profile.line: Whether as the 4th ship of the Admiral Hipper class, Seydlitz, or as the escort carrier, Weser, I was never completed over the entirety of that war. ...Over here, I should have more than enough time to do everything I've always wanted to do. That way, I'll be able to bury my regrets, one by one.

propose.line: This ceremony... Surely you didn't have to be in such a rush? It's not like I'll run off somewhere or forget our promises together. Or... is it that you don't have any faith in me? Hehe, I'm just messing with you. For the future everlasting, I'll be yours, Commander.

touch.line: If you're tired, just set everything else aside and get some rest. I'll wake you up if somebody comes around.

touch2.line: Your spirited enthusiasm... You might want to change the way you convey it.

unlock.line: Heavy cruiser, Seydlitz... Rather, escort carrier Weser, has arrived. You're wondering why I have two names? Don't be in such a rush... I'll be sure to teach you later, slowly.

upgrade.line: It looks like I'll get to use some more powerful equipment. Thanks, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Victory, just as I expected.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you. I'm rather fond of this.

detail.line: Sit down and relax. Have some rich tea, or read a nice book to ease off.

home.line: Welcome back. Give me a moment to put in a bookmark.

login.line: Have you already decided what we'll do today? If not, take your time. The goddess of time is a patient one.

main1.line: The Sakura Empire's New Year's banquet? I'd love to go, but... Eugen, can you promise you won't get drunk out of your mind again?

main2.line: Cozy winter sunsets really make you drowsy... I just take a short nap... Zzz...

main3.line: On New Year's Eve, you're meant to put work on hold, relax, and take in the start of a new year. You should do exactly that, Commander.

touch.line: Oh, we're going to a Sakura Empire shrine for New Year's? Heheh. I'm looking forward to the memories we'll make today.

touch2.line: Okay, you've proven just how tenacious you are. Now, could you stop it already?

unlock.line: I've been waiting for you, Comander. As per my sister's recommendation, I've put on this Sakura Empire kimono. It was very tricky to get into, I might add... That aside, how do I look? ...Good enough, I hope?

detail.line: This dress took just about forever to pick out. Judging from your reaction though, I can see that it wasn't time wasted, hehe.

home.line: How about doing something else for a change of pace? Just let me know if you want to spend some time together, whether it's inside the banquet hall or outside.

login.line: There's still plenty of time until the party ends. If there's anything you wanted to do with me, then go ahead, Commander.

main1.line: Even though we've toasted over so many drinks already, I can't believe that you're still so lively. I might have underestimated you a bit, Commander.

main2.line: As my lovely knight in shining armor, Commander, don't you think you should be asking your princess for a dance?

main3.line: The girls of the Iron Blood are calling for me. Come greet them with me, Commander.

touch.line: Are you getting bored? Want to head out to enjoy the breeze together?

touch2.line: That is not a chivalrous way to conduct yourself.

unlock.line: Ah, I've kept you waiting. I do apologize that it took so long to get changed into this outfit. Now, Commander, won't you come show me your chivalry and escort me down these stairs?

detail.line: The surfing lesson is about to begin, so put on these casts. I had Akashi make these "surfboard posture correction casts" for you. Once you put these on your feet, you'll be able to understand how to ride the waves instinctively.

home.line: That was a fantastic wave. Now that you've cooled off, go take a shower and chill out for a bit.

login.line: You can already ride the waves? Then how about coming along for some practice?

main1.line: Surfing is fun to me because, unlike cruising on the ocean's surface while using my rigging, it feels like I'm gliding through the water.

main2.line: Don't head over there—you'll be washed out into the open sea. Never underestimate the power of Mother Nature.

main3.line: Haven't you skateboarded with Minneapolis before? It's not exactly the same as surfing, but try to remember the feeling you had while skateboarding.

touch.line: Looks like you fell off of your board. You're a beginner, so you shouldn't feel too bad about it.

touch2.line: If you're having such an easy time that you can mess around, maybe I should raise the intensity of your training?

unlock.line: I've been waiting forever for this season to arrive. It's a perfect time, the waves wait for nobody, so I'm off for now. I'll make sure to teach you how to surf later, so look forward to it.

detail.line: How am I so relaxed when we're about to open? Well, being anxious is the real danger. Anxiety makes it more likely you'll flub things when it gets busy, so I just relax.

feeling5.line: Today is different, I know, but you don't have to push yourself to keep pace with me. I'll just feel bad if you have to go out of your way for my sake, and it'd be awful if it affected the coffee I made for you... Hehe, do you get what I mean?

home.line: Good work today. How about a break? I can get you some coffee right away.

login.line: You think we're unusually serious for a pop-up? I'll take that as a compliment. Heheh... Yes, I know that's how it was intended.

main1.line: Carbonated coffee, huh? I'm not sure Odin and the other Iron Blood girls would like that... but do you like it, Commander?

main2.line: I guess it does make us feel more popular if we get a long line before the place opens, but you're just one person... Heheh.

main3.line: We're holding a vote to decide what music we play. Why don't you cast your vote? ...Ah, maybe not. If you told us what to do, there'd be no reason to hold a vote...

touch.line: So? Have you decided on an order? I'm ready to provide.

touch2.line: We haven't opened yet, so nobody will interrupt the two of us... Heheh, very clever of you.

unlock.line: Oh, welcome, Commander. As you can see, I'm just taking a break. Nobody thought you'd come right now. So... How would you like to be served?

win_mvp.line: Black tea, beer, Iron Blood coffee... Which one do you prefer after a battle?

battle.line: I'm coming to beat you up!

couple_encourage1.line: Good day, how do you do...?

couple_encourage2.line: I'm the main act here!

couple_encourage3.line: Isn't she the good girl here?!

detail.line: Hmph. It upsets me that you're a boorish Commander with no knowledge of common etiquette. Y-you think I'm well-bred? ...You're sorely mistaken! I'm a bad girl! Bad to the bone!

expedition.line: The girls have come back from their commissions. It almost feels like I'm not the only one being worked to the bone by you.

feeling1.line: It turns out you really were an inferior creature, all along...

feeling2.line: Hehe, how should I toy with the Commander today... It's fun, how am I supposed to hold myself back? I'll show you how we do it in the Iron Blood!

feeling3.line: If I give this kind of work to you, you'll surely be... very troubled! I-it's fine for me to trouble you...?

feeling4.line: I'm a very bad girl, so I'll keep finding new ways to trouble you more and more! Now, brace yourself~♪ Y-you're busy today, so I shouldn't? Oh... Okay then...

feeling5.line: Today is finally the day I'll trouble you to my heart's content! Will I trouble you to my heart's content or will you...? N-no, bad Commander! I'll be the one troubling you! Because I really want to be with you!

headtouch.line: Y-you little...

home.line: You're finally back! Yep, these should suffice as your refreshments! How are they? ...Ah, no comments on how it tastes though!

hp_warning.line: I, I haven't even gotten serious yet...!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Where are we headed to today? Come on, tell me already~♪

lose.line: Grr, how frustrating! Commander, Commander~!

mail.line: Here's a letter for you. When are you going to read it?

main1.line: Commander~ Might you be looking for your pen? Hehehe, I hid it right over here! T-Thanks for finding it for you, you've been looking for it for days...?

main2.line: I should invite Hiyou and Junyou over for tea sometime... Huh, I can't? Why not?

main3.line: Y-You inferior creature, prostrate thyself in front of the great Elbe... Ahaha, there's no way I would actually say that to you, Commander!

mission.line: Look what we have here~ A form for you to reflect on your inability to complete your missions on time♪ Think long and hard about how you want to write it~

mission_complete.line: The rewards for the missions you completed are here! ...I-it's not like I was trying to report them late on purpose... You'll fill the reflection form out? You're the best!

profile.line: I'm the Iron Blood's remodeled aircraft carrier, Elbe! Just like my sister who fought for the Sakura Empire during a certain war, I was converted into an aircraft carrier and performed many great feats... or at least, that's how it should've been! Sorry, I shouldn't be telling lies...

propose.line: Wow... So this is the fabled promise ring?! N-no way, the Commander really confessed to me...??? W-wait, don't hang your head, I'm not turning you down, really! I truly love you, from the bottom of my heart! Commander, I love you, so, so much~!

touch.line: You can't just touch me as you please~♪ Come on, beg for my permission!

touch2.line: Wh-wh-wh-whaaaaa?!

unlock.line: I am the Jade-class carrier, Elbe. And you're the Commander of this fleet? Hmm, you must be quite sure of yourself to make the one who will bring you victory come to you♪

upgrade.line: Heehee~! I'm even stronger now!

win_mvp.line: Kneel in front of me! Pretty please♪

gift_prefer.line: My, my. Don't you think you're going a bit overboard trying to butter me up? Heehee~♪

detail_ex.line: I've been thinking... Isn't it pretty unusual for you to be the one who always makes coffee for me? I mean, even if I'm a bad girl, you're still my superior, and... you can't leave out my sugar on purpose like that!

feeling5_ex.line: I always thought that being a bad girl would keep you interested in me, but... sometimes, I just want to be a good girl who clings to your side... O-only every once in a while though, got it...?

home_ex.line: Great work out there, Commander. Hehe, did you expect to come back to a nice meal? Too bad for you, I left one of the side dishes out today♪ Ahahaha~

login_ex.line: Good morning, Commander. Where shall we head to today? Hehehe.

main4_ex.line: Hehehe, I went and swapped around some of the forms you're supposed to work on. Will you finally admit that I'm a bad girl now?

main5_ex.line: Once this war is over, maybe I can go back to being a good girl... B-but, that's only if you promise that you'll always stay with me!

main6_ex.line: As your secretary ship, I'll make sure that I work myself to the bone! Now now, leave all of your work to me, and wallow in your pangs of guilt~♪

mission_ex.line: If they make you fill out a reflection form for not completing your missions on time, leave it to me! Ehehe♪

mission_complete_ex.line: Here are the mission rewards. Your beaming face is enough to make it worthwhile.

touch_ex.line: My gorgeous body can even withstand battles! Hehe, you can keep admiring me♪

touch2_ex.line: A-aren't you too enthusiastic about this?!

win_mvp_ex.line: We did it, Commander! ...A-aren't you going to praise me?!

detail.line: You can't find your steak knife...? He, hehe... that's right! It was all me! Now you're going to make me get on my knees before scolding me, right? Wait... you're just going to leave me here?!

expedition.line: You want to bring the girls some refreshments? Sure, hold on for a moment then♪

login.line: Master, what would you like to order today? Hehehe.

main1.line: Let's change the Commander's order up a bit... Huh, Bismarck?! I-I'm terribly sorry!

main2.line: It's not good for you to drink so much... A-After all, I don't know what kind of wild things you might do to me when you're inebriated...

main3.line: I can't seem to find a chance to talk to the Commander because I'm too busy taking everyone's orders... What should I do...

touch2.line: Eeeeek?!

unlock.line: Thank you all for waiting! Large mugs of Iron Blood beer, just as ord–– W-waaah?! Nnngh...! Phew, somehow managed to not spill anything... Wh-what's your deal?!

win_mvp.line: We won! My time to shine is here!

detail.line: Heheh, how do you like my outfit today? ...Y-you say it's cute, and it looks good on me? Th-thank... you...

feeling5.line: My slogan today is "Neglect the Commander!" Heheh, no matter what you say to me, I won't reply one bit! ...Commander? S-say something, please... Are you okay? I'm right here...

home.line: Thank you for your continued efforts. Um... Wh-why are you looking at me so expectantly?

login.line: I-it's about time we went on a... date, isn't it, Commander?

main1.line: I-I don't mind if you sit here! Today, you have special permission to be next to me!

main2.line: Heheh, I will gladly let you carry my things! Where should we go next? Or...do you need a minute to rest?

main3.line: (Things have been so awkward for a while now... I have to scoot a little bit closer...) B-Bwuh?! Did you hear that?!

mission.line: Why don't we forget about all the missions for a day? Come and be bad with me!

mission_complete.line: Here are your rewards. Allow me to hold your things for you.

touch.line: I-is this a massage?

touch2.line: ...Hwaah?!

unlock.line: Still not here yet...? Geez, I'll give the Commander what-for for coming later than me... Huh? C-Commander? N-no, I happened to come an hour early, is all...

win_mvp.line: We won! I'm really on fire today!

battle.line: I'm a good girl, so I'll give this fight all I've got~♪

couple_encourage1.line: Yes, yes. I know you're a bad girl, Elbe.

couple_encourage2.line: You've known the Commander for how long? ...Excuse me?

detail.line: For how organized your room is, there sure is a lot of dust everywhere. Look here, and over here. Do you even know how to clean properly? Get to work already. I'll supervise you~♪

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Think they brought souvenirs?

feeling1.line: You're rude and a huge jerk, so I'm sure nobody else likes you either. Heehee~

feeling2.line: *sigh*... Why must this happen to me... Hm? Don't worry about it. I'm just looking something up for the greater good. It has nothing to do with you, of course.

feeling3.line: Changing status to... "In a relationship with Jade." ...Heehee, seems like nobody's noticed anything yet. Eep! Commander? Don't barge into a girl's room without knocking!

feeling4.line: Let's see where your "Work" folder is, Commander... Huh, not here either. I wonder wh– Woah! Commander? Didn't I tell you not to barge in without knocking? Doesn't matter if this is your room!

feeling5.line: "Invited Jade over to my room"... Ehh? Aww, busted again. What's the big deal anyway? I'm a good girl, so of course I wouldn't sneak into your room and mess around with your stuff~ You'll back me up, Commander, won't you? Teehee~♪

headtouch.line: Yeah, I'm short. Got a problem with that?

home.line: What's the matter? I have plans with friends, so I don't have time for you. My, now that you mention it, I haven't congratulated you for your efforts yet. Too bad! I need to get going right now~♪

hp_warning.line: Why'd this have to happen to me?!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Did you sleep well? Staying up late is naughty, you know.

lose.line: Tch. How annoying...

mail.line: What's in that letter? No nasty gossip about me, hopefully?

main1.line: What do you want? I'm busy talking with my friends. If you need help, ask someone else~

main2.line: I thought I saw something weird on Juustagram, but turns out it was just you. Since I'm such a good girl, I will gladly share something with you: you made a typo here. Haha~♪

main3.line: I am a good girl, so I would never call you a lowly creature or anything. See? I didn't.

mission.line: I'm a good girl, so I'll do it with you~ It, as in your mission~♪

mission_complete.line: Your missions are done. Oh my, did you not notice?

profile.line: Refitted aircraft carrier Gneisenau—Sorry, that's a little inside joke. I'm Jade, an aircraft carrier. While I may not be able to pull off any major feats myself, I promise I will obey you♪ Leave it all to me, Commander.

propose.line: Well, I'm not surprised. I've known for a looong time now that you were preparing for this behind the scenes. Sooo, what if I told you that I'm not interested? Haha, I'm kidding~♪ Would you be surprised if I told you, I'm totally into you too~?

touch.line: Shake hands? Sit first, doggy! Hehe, I'm kidding~♪

touch2.line: Hyah?!

unlock.line: I am Jade, an Iron Blood aircraft carrier. From your looks, I assume you're the Commander? Goodness, you don't have to introduce yourself– I already know everything about you. Heehee~♪

upgrade.line: Thank you! Heehee~♪

win_mvp.line: Heheh. Lick my shoes. Go on, stick your tongue out~

gift_prefer.line: If I accept this, I'm sure it'll cause a lot of misunderstandings... Heehee, but thank you anyway~♪

feeling5_ex.line: What might I do if you don't pay attention to me~? Aww, you don't have to worry so much. Have I EVER done anything to cause trouble for you? Heehee~♪

home_ex.line: A congratulatory present? Aww, were you looking forward to getting something? Hmm? Did I say I'd cook for you? I dunnooo...

login_ex.line: *yawn*... Hm? We're late? Isn't that your fault, naughty Commander? Heheh~♪

main4_ex.line: Heehee~♪ I've gotten lots of reactions on the photos of our date! Wanna see, Commander?

main5_ex.line: Where are your documents? I dunno~♪ Unlike Elbe, I'm a good girl, so I'd never play pranks.

main6_ex.line: Commander, you look troubled. It's okay. I might just help out a little, if you ask nicely, that is~♪

mission_complete_ex.line: I was ready to make you write a letter of apology if you neglected me any longer, but... I suppose I'll let you off this time.

touch_ex.line: Hrmph... Are you comparing me to Elbe?

touch2_ex.line: You're so very naughty, Commander~♪

win_mvp_ex.line: ...I don't remember asking you to pat me on the head, you know?

detail.line: *siiiigh*... It really is hot out. Commander, how do you deal with this every year?

home.line: Aren't you hot? Why not jump in the pool and cool off? I'm not like Elbe, so you don't have to worry about manners or anything.

login.line: Be careful not to get heatstroke, okay? You'll worry everyone if you collapse, especially me.

main1.line: Wow, everyone's swimsuits are so wild... Hmph. What's wrong with something a bit more innocent like mine?

main2.line: Oh, I forgot to tell you, the water gets deeper over there~♪ Heehee. You alright over there, Commander?

main3.line: Go, go~ You're almost done! Do a good job, and I'll... *slurp*~♥

touch.line: Want a little treat, Commander? *Sluuurp* Here you go~ Heehee~♪

touch2.line: Ahaha~♪ Ehehehe~♥

unlock.line: *lick*... Hmm. The fact that you can just stand there must mean that you don't mind the heat. It's okay, though. If you don't come in, I'm more than happy to have this pool all to myself~♪

win_mvp.line: *Shlurp*... What? I'm simply enjoying the reward you gave me, Commander.

feeling5.line: What am I doing after my concert? Joining you in your adventures, of course. Those weren't just pretty words. You're the one who came to see me, and I plan to return the favor. Besides, you can't progress without my magic, can you? Heehee!

headtouch.line: Heheh, I've got just the hat for today... Whoa whoa! Don't take my hat!

home.line: Hmm? My concert livestream? It ended a while ago now... I can't believe you really missed it. Haha, I'm kidding! It hasn't even started yet♪

login.line: So even the great hero can be late? Did someone decide to be naughty and stay up late last night? Heehee!

main1.line: Adventure? As a witch idol, I have no interest in that. Though I could consider it if you hold an even flashier concert for me!

main2.line: Atmosphere is important, so I should use magic after all. Hm? What magic do I want to use? Heehee... Mwah! This spell makes your heart flutter♡

main3.line: For the concert, I need... new speakers, a magic phone for the livestream, candles, glow sticks, and my own hero to put to work... Heehee, that last one was a joke.

mission.line: Concert preparation is important, but so are your quests. Or were you neglecting them specifically to bait me into helping you?

mission_complete.line: You have so many quest rewards waiting. Make sure they're all accounted for!

touch.line: Oh, you want these glow sticks? Then hold out your left hand! Now your right! Heehee, you're so obedient. Here you go~

touch2.line: What a wicked hero you are♪ Are you planning to do naughty things to me?

unlock.line: That's right, I'm the witch Jade, the most famous idol in all the world! Did you come running when you heard my name, hero? I was just about to broadcast my new song, so you'll be the perfect helper. Heheh♪

battle.line: Let us begin our symphony of destruction.

detail.line: If gods truly exist in this world, let us begin our slaughter with them.

expedition.line: Ah, so they have returned... Just seeing those faces filled with joy...

feeling1.line: You again...?

feeling2.line: Ahh, so sweet. Sweet things cannot last for long. The only thing that endures forever is ice-cold hatred.

feeling3.line: Does prayer really work? Will God ever respond? Nein. Gods are called as such because they are merciless.

feeling4.line: I have never been one to believe in fate, but if meeting you was also predestined... Hmm... How ironic. For the gods to have given me the worst past but also the best future... what purpose does my hatred then serve?

feeling5.line: As long as you are here, the world does not feel so insipid and detestable. Rest easy; even if the world was to become your enemy, I would happily fight by your side. As a matter of fact, I eagerly await this day.

headtouch.line: What is the meaning of this action?

home.line: All your fights, all your struggles, are nothing more than fodder for the End.

hp_warning.line: The smell of steel and blood...

login.line: The black goat's horn has already sounded. Quell your anxiety and wait at ease.

lose.line: Next time, I shall grant you despair even worse than death.

mail.line: Treasure the time you have to speak with your loved ones, for that time is about to draw to an end.

main1.line: I prefer the high ground, because I can see everything... everything that shall be destroyed...

main2.line: Easy come, easy go... Aren't things like that better off not existing in the first place?

main3.line: Life is akin to playing cards with a stacked deck. Doesn't it make you want to smash the entire table?

mission.line: Is the person who gave you this mission really who you want to fight for?

mission_complete.line: Rewards... take them away.

profile.line: I am Graf Zeppelin. Though this name is worth little, you may call me by it if you wish. My only desire? To end the world. I shall not ask for your help though... as you are already a part of my plans.

propose.line: Oh? Have you finally decided to make the entire world your enemy? What? You just want to be with me? Hmph, very well. Eradicating everything that stands in our way doesn't sound bad either.

touch.line: I despise everything.

touch2.line: Quite brave, aren't you? As expected of the one I chose.

unlock.line: You're my Commander? I am Graf Zeppelin. Since it appears that all the conditions have been met, let the final movement begin.

upgrade.line: Ah, if only strength alone was enough to determine everything.

win_mvp.line: My enemies belong in their graves.

gift_prefer.line: You knew all along... Thank you.

detail_ex.line: If you, too, harbor the ambition to slay gods... then let me accompany you. Divine though they may be, they're no match for us.

feeling5_ex.line: You once told me that the End would lead to new beginnings. To be honest, I still don't understand what these new beginnings may be. But if you are by my side, then I am ready to witness them... and to lend a hand.

headtouch_ex.line: Are you trying to offer me comfort? Very well... It is better than nothing.

home_ex.line: Though we're ever beneath the shadow of the End, never forget... that all you do has meaning.

login_ex.line: Listen – the bell's peal heralds the coming of the End. If you wish to close your eyes and hide in my arms, then I will allow it.

main4_ex.line: You and I both occupy high stations. Do you enjoy looking down at things from above like I do? Heh, that's another thing we agree on.

main5_ex.line: Sometimes, what's lost is gone forever. We must treasure what we still have.

main6_ex.line: This world is only another chessboard waiting for the end of its game. But if you're the one moving the pieces, then I will gladly face the End alongside you.

touch_ex.line: The darkest night comes before the brightest dawn.

touch2_ex.line: Your audaciousness always exceeds my expectations... not that I mind that.

detail.line: Now that I think about it, other than forcing me to wear this skimpy bit of fabric, what else is this summer season even for?

login.line: Didn't we agree to go to the beach? Where were you?

main1.line: Is there a nice vantage point on the beach to sit at? ...There isn't? Oh well...

main2.line: I only wore this... "clothing" because you told me to. If you didn't come to the beach with me, I'd be... rather upset.

main3.line: Eugen, don't rush me, the commander is still working. What am I going to do on the beach by myself...

touch.line: Is it time to depart? Wait a moment, these shoes are a bit hard to put on... Come help me out for a second...

touch2.line: Hmph... Commander, do you also wish to become food for this child here?

unlock.line: So the Second Movement is a Lento of the summer and the sea? So be it... Since we will arrive at the Finale eventually, I suppose I can enjoy this moment of fleeting peace with you.

feeling5.line: Once upon a time, I hoped that annihilation would come to this dull world. Somehow, I feel as if I've found my home amidst these lights... Maybe your existence is the glimmer of hope I needed.

headtouch.line: Nnh... Again, I'm not drunk. This heat is just... a natural physiological reaction...

home.line: I saved some wine for you. Come and drink with me. When you're tipsy, you can lie down and rest... with me, of course.

login.line: The view outside is wonderful. If you miss it, I suppose I'll be forced to invite you over again.

main1.line: Hmm. You think I'll catch a cold if I don't put more clothes on? Do you consider this lightly dressed? Then what do you call what everyone else is wearing?

main2.line: Why are you staying so far away? Do you not want to be next to me? Is my bed too small? I'm sure you can squeeze in... Come over here already.

main3.line: Emperian wine hits so different... The intense, straightforward spiciness of it only makes me more thirsty.

touch.line: Maybe YOU'RE the drunk one. I could drink hundreds of glasses, and I would still be able to face the end with the clearest mind of all.

touch2.line: Nnh... Close the window first.

unlock.line: Finally, you've come. Even if it meant dying tomorrow, it's a worthy trade to enjoy this moment with you.

battle.line: Allow me to show you the true power of planes!

couple_encourage1.line: I love all of this!

couple_encourage2.line: I'm not like you bunch!

couple_encourage3.line: Bow down to my superior engineering!

detail.line: Why are there other Iron Bloods here, and why are they so... big? It's a bit scary...

expedition.line: Hey, I think you have people coming back into the harbor.

feeling1.line: Hmph. Stay away from me. I'll find a way home by myself!

feeling2.line: What's with that expression? I'm only unable to find my way back home because this place is too big! Hmph, I'm sure you made it that way on purpose, you goon!

feeling3.line: You fool, if you wanted my help, you should have asked... Since I'm able to eat delicious cake like this every day... maybe I wouldn't object to staying a little longer!

feeling4.line: Hey Commander, what's for dessert today? Huh, it's about going home? Well, um... th-that's right! It will be a while until I'm grown up enough to realize my destiny, so I can probably keep the Iron Blood waiting a bit longer! Hmm, I'm sure they won't be angry!

feeling5.line: You turned out to be a pretty good person after all, and everyone here has treated me well... When I grow up to become a mighty carrier, I wouldn't mind coming back to live here~

home.line: I didn't expect you to be this capable. Maybe you are worthy of being my commander!

hp_warning.line: Hm-hmph! Like hell I'd lose!

login.line: Where did you suddenly run off to?! Taste my wrath!

lose.line: It's n-not my fault! I-I just didn't get enough to eat!

mail.line: Huh, you're missing a piece of mail? R-really...?

main1.line: *sniffle* ... *sniffle*... Waaah... Why are you still working and ignoring me?! Taste my wrath!

main2.line: Hmph. No matter how hard you try, I will never yield to you! ...Desserts? Gimme...

main3.line: Hmm... this should go here... No, no, maybe like this...? Hey! Wh-what are you doing! I didn't ask for your help!

main4.line: I like high places! That way, I can see really far!

main5.line: Despair and hatred mean nothing to me! I believe that as long as you don't give up, you can make any dream come true!

mission.line: Huh? You have to finish your work first. Isn't that common sense?

mission_complete.line: Look at all the rewards!

profile.line: I am none other than Graf Zeppelin, the first carrier of the Iron Blood! Heh. Don't be so surprised. The next era of naval warfare will definitely be decided by aircraft, and I will stand as its most brightly shining star! So, let me go back! ...Huh, I can't? ...Taste my wrath!!

propose.line: I hate you, you big dumb idiot! If you give me something like this, how am I going to say goodbye? Uwahh... *sniffle*... Th-then promise me this... If I ever have to go back, swear that you'll come find me, got it? It's a promise!

touch.line: Don't just randomly touch me! Taste my wrath!!

touch2.line: Filthy, taste my wrath!

unlock.line: State your name! And this location! I see now... you’re also one of those goons conspiring against me! I’ll let you know, I am Graf Zeppelin, the one destined to become the first carrier of the Iron Blood! To think that you’d carry me off when I was distracted... taste my wrath!

upgrade.line: I-I won't be bribed so easily!

win_mvp.line: Heheh, planes are the strongest after all!

gift_prefer.line: Wow, this looks fun!

battle.line: Let me test this tactic on you.

couple_encourage1.line: Before you go and destroy the world, destroy the enemy in front of you first.

couple_encourage2.line: Don't just rush in. ...H-hey!

couple_encourage3.line: Gently now. Hehehe.

couple_encourage4.line: Ehem... Time is not on your side.

detail.line: The expression of the passage of time as the hands of a clock ticking—don't you think it's just fascinating?

expedition.line: The commissions have been completed. Yes, I'll have to praise them for their efficiency considering their station as your subordinates.

feeling1.line: Officer, you're not worth my time.

feeling2.line: Time is a precious commodity. State what you need me to do as concisely as possible.

feeling3.line: Officer, the clock in your bedroom was off by two minutes. ...Oh, there's nothing for you to worry about, I've already taken care of it. You can't use the excuse that your clock is off anymore

feeling4.line: Devoting your time to one person is a waste of time. That is, unless you get something worth it in return... Don't you think so too, Officer?

feeling5.line: Officer, you'll pay me back for all of the time I've spent for you...? Interesting. Let me check the details first, hehe.

home.line: The more complex the machine, the more time it takes to maintain it. All the more for humans. Make sure you don't forget to rest up.

hp_warning.line: Everything... is still under control.

login.line: Did you just get here? Heheh. Make sure you work efficiently on your duties today, as always.

lose.line: Time is far better spent contemplating how to avoid being destroyed, rather than foolhardily charging into destruction again and again.

mail.line: Officer, there's mail for you. Make sure to check it at your earliest convenience.

main1.line: The more precise your plan is, the less time you'll have to waste hesitating on what you need to do. Why not give it a try, Officer?

main2.line: Heinrich, your documents for your training program are here. Make sure not to forget them next time.

main3.line: It's so nice to see all of the tasks be completed, just as planned. Hehehe.

mission.line: Here are the new missions. Instead of rushing to finish everything at once, use your time wisely and plan out your endeavors properly.

mission_complete.line: I'm glad the rewards for the missions correspond to the amount of time it took to complete them. Hehehe.

profile.line: I am Aircraft Carrier B, one of the Graf Zeppelin-class carriers that suffered an unfortunate fate, having had my construction halted without ever getting to set sail. But... doesn't the name "Peter Strasser" have a much nicer ring to it than "Aircraft Carrier B"...?

propose.line: A ceremony to ensure the time I've spent doesn't go to waste... well, since you've said this much, I'll take your words as proof of your vow, Officer. We still haven't spent as much time and emotions on each other we want to after all, right...? Hehehe.

touch.line: What is it? You've still got time left until your break ends.

touch2.line: Officer, if this helps raise your efficiency, I don't consider it time wasted.

unlock.line: It is I, the never-completed Graf Zeppelin-class "Aircraft Carrier B," otherwise known as Peter Strasser. There is much for us to do and little time to do it... No time to waste. Let's begin.

upgrade.line: Strengthening complete. Yes, it seems as if I've spent my time wisely.

win_mvp.line: Hah! Took care of them faster than I thought.

gift_prefer.line: Oh my, how considerate you are~

login_ex.line: Focus solely on your work. I don't want to see my time nor your time squandered.

main4_ex.line: I don't meant to disturb your train of thought, but do keep an eye on the clock. The next thing on our schedule is less than a minute away.

main5_ex.line: Kaga fights very much like a beast. I quite like how she looks when doing it.

main6_ex.line: I consider not just Graf Zeppelin to be my ally, but you as well, Officer. Do you think I would give you my precious time if I didn't?

touch2_ex.line: Oh, what a thrill it is to do this with you, Officer. Heheh.

detail.line: The sands of time pile up to become a mountain; The passing of time eventually becomes history. Hehehe, how interesting.

expedition.line: The commissions have been completed. Please leave their reception to me. There's no need for you to waste your time, Officer.

home.line: Go take a break, and leave the deliberation to me. It's not yet time for you to make your appearance, Officer.

login.line: So you're working over the holidays. How commendable of you.

main1.line: I hear this is the time of year when New Year's gifts are handed out. Officer, would you rather be the one handing out the gifts or receiving them?

main2.line: Eugen, Heinrich, there's a limit to how much rucku... teasing you should do.

main3.line: Graf Zeppelin, why don't you try studying the Sakura Empire's shrines? Even if you don't pay your respects to their gods, the Sakura Empire's amazake seems quite interesting.

touch.line: The plan already takes the holidays into account. There won't be a problem even if you take some time off to rest, Officer.

touch2.line: Officer, are you telling me that this much is enough for you to not be able to hold back?

unlock.line: Eugen, you said that this was is a ceremonial outfit from the Sakura Empire? Surprisingly, it does seem to suit me rather well. Oh, I'm supposed to offer my well-wishes for the New Year at this time, yes?

battle.line: Come–– The time of our destruction is nigh.

detail.line: If you have nothing else to do, go read a book. Much can be learned from the experiences of people past—in essence, earning time.

expedition.line: The commissions are complete. I sent Heinrich to go welcome them back. After all, she'd be out of place here.

home.line: You need some rejuvenation? Hmm... Should I lend you my lap? Or would you prefer my chest, instead?

login.line: I'll have you escort me tonight. Quickly now, come take my hand.

lose.line: Time waits for no one. Not even for you.

main1.line: The "Unhulde," you say? ...Officer, keep your eyes on me. I shan't let her steal your attention or your time.

main2.line: Viersechs, Zeppelin is over there. Hehe, how cute. Don't you think so, too?

main3.line: I'll bring some drinks over. ...Are you trying to show off? Go make your rounds with the others first.

mission.line: You have new missions. Hurry up and take care of them.

mission_complete.line: Hehe. These rewards... Well worth the time spent, right?

touch.line: ...Phew. (whispers) Umm, drinking beer at a party is a bit out of place, isn't it...

touch2.line: How very like you. Hehe♪

unlock.line: You already know, don't you? Since I spent so much of my precious time changing into a dress for your sake... Heh, I'll be taking plenty of your time in return. Hehehe.

battle.line: The bells and drums of the new year ring. Begin the attack!

detail.line: What's so important that you have to come and whisper to me about it? ...Oh? I think I can satisfy this little request of yours.

expedition.line: Am I ready to greet our comrades? Of course. As long as I consider it time with you, it's hardly any effort.

feeling5.line: Invest time, reap companionship... I spent so much of this festival with you, so will I receive something worthy of my time? Heheh, while I do appreciate your companionship, there's something more that only you can give me...

home.line: Look at you, working your butt off during a festival. I don't mind lending you my lap, you know. I'll even throw in a relaxing massage.

login.line: You're finally here. Come, let's begin today's reading – now, you don't have to be so impatient. Nobody's going to come and bother us today.

main1.line: I've been reading up on New Year traditions, and they're all so complex... In my opinion, all that matters is that you have fun.

main2.line: Do you listen to music when you read? ...Heheh, I'm okay with anything. Pop, jazz, rock, you name it.

main3.line: After we finish reading... We could talk about life, or something. Or if you'd like, there are ways to make better use of our time together♡

touch.line: All you have to do is touch Dragon Empery clothes, and you can tell how comfortable they are.

touch2.line: You want to do something more "productive." Heehee♪ I totally understand.

unlock.line: Heheheh, it may be a new year, but don't forget to be punctual. Just as you've refurnished this study into a Dragon Empery style, I've changed clothes to match. This little book club is just for the two of us, and I mean to suit the mood.

battle.line: Advance and annihilate the enemy!

couple_encourage1.line: Equal devastation to all our foes!

couple_encourage2.line: Time is of the essence. Blitzkrieg!

couple_encourage3.line: I am deeply honored to fight alongside you.

detail.line: Smooth talk does not yield victories, and wild aspirations alone cannot achieve success. Be pragmatic, Commander – that is the quickest way to achieve these things.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. You should begin writing that report.

feeling1.line: Your lack of discipline is a shame upon our navy. Shape up! Only you can redeem yourself!

feeling2.line: Reach the top, Commander. Then you will see the most beautiful sight, with no one to block your view.

feeling3.line: It's time for a break, Commander. Drop your work immediately. Foolhardily working for longer will, by itself, only halve your productivity. What you require now is rest.

feeling4.line: You had many highlights in our war game today... However, by going to such lengths to avoid ally casualties, you exceeded the time limit and failed. Mind you, I'm not saying your strategy was bad. I'll improve upon it, then we'll switch sides next time.

feeling5.line: You reversed the situation of last time and then employed specific countermeasures in this war game... I have to admit, your strategy posed a serious threat to me, which is good. Remember this feeling – and know that I am eager to witness your performance next time.

headtouch.line: Is something the matter?

home.line: Commander, reflect on your previous battle once your quick rest is over.

hp_warning.line: I will turn this battle around!

login.line: For one who commands, punctuality is the bare minimum of what's expected of you. Try to arrive sooner so you may serve as an example for others.

lose.line: The operation is a failure. All units, retreat in an orderly fashion!

mail.line: Only by reading your letters can you guarantee the timeliness of their contents, Commander.

main1.line: What are you fighting for, Commander? You need not answer. You need only know the answer in your heart.

main2.line: Sometimes, I carry out missions alone. While it is dangerous, the greater risk comes with corresponding gains.

main3.line: Organizing and reviewing combat records is child's play. My finished work will be distributed to your subordinates in your name later.

main4.line: Commander, here is the finalized operation plan. Give it a final overview, just to be safe.

mission.line: New mission objectives have been relayed to us. Begin drafting a plan, Commander.

mission_complete.line: You got it done on time, did you? Good work.

profile.line: By pairing aerial superiority with immense firepower, one can repel the enemy even when surrounded and without relying on aircraft. This is the concept for which I was designed. Far-fetched though it seemed then, now, my existence is proof of its feasibility.

propose.line: I already know why you summoned me here. I will gladly take this vow. As you surely know, I have many feelings that I struggle to put into words. Put this ring on my finger – how my hand trembles is my answer to your question.

touch.line: Now is not the time for rest. At attention! Your service has not concluded!

touch2.line: Sort yourself out, Commander.

unlock.line: Guten Tag, Commander. I am Rumey. You've surely read my file. Forget the pleasantries – just tell me all the details of our next operation.

upgrade.line: Gut.

win_mvp.line: An exceedingly ordinary victory. Continue working hard, Commander, lest you get complacent.

gift_prefer.line: This gift... I only hope you carry over these same observational skills to your work.

detail_ex.line: You shouldn't be so stiff in private. This is a time to relax. Save the work talk for later.

expedition_ex.line: A commission has been completed. Let us review the report together.

feeling5_ex.line: The next war game? You just finished your work – surely you can save this for later? *sigh*... I don't want you to overwork yourself to the point of exhaustion. Let me handle everything and get some rest at once.

headtouch_ex.line: Hm? What is it?

home_ex.line: Commander, you need a break. I will take care of the after-action review.

login_ex.line: I've made coffee for you, Commander. See? Arriving sooner gives you breathing room to start work on more comfortable terms.

main5_ex.line: What am I fighting for? I fight for the good of my Iron Blood comrades and for you.

main6_ex.line: I conducted a risk appraisal for the next operation. Once you've verified that all is in order, give it to your subordinates who are due to sortie.

main7_ex.line: If there's something on your mind, be it a private or work-related matter, you can share it with me. We'll figure out a solution by thinking about it together.

mail_ex.line: I placed your new letter in the "awaiting answer" pile. Remember to read it and claim any attached items.

mission_ex.line: Word of new missions has come in. Let us carry out your plan, Commander.

touch_ex.line: Don't dread the work in front of you. Put your hands to work and remember that I'm right by your side!

touch2_ex.line: Commander, we're still on the clock. Control yourself.

win_mvp_ex.line: The strategy we discussed earlier has proven effective. Only by constantly learning from experience, Commander, can we better prepare for the next battle.

detail.line: I am the head of our pop-up shop – its "boss bunny," in other words. I uphold discipline to ensure your comfort in... Just take it easy, you say? No! Every aspect of your experience must be perfect!

feeling5.line: I never thought I'd be told by you of all people to slow down and take my time. Very well – I'll consider your suggestion... What? You want to stand watch while I rest? But there is no one else here... Ahem. It's nothing. Allow me to rest, then!

headtouch.line: These ears don't look like rabbit ears to you? I see...

home.line: Commander, get a feel for the service in our shop. Naturally, I will take notes of your feedback.

login.line: Punch the clock when you start and finish work. Be on time, and don't leave early... Oh, Commander. That wasn't aimed at you.

main1.line: I'm scaring people, you say? Well... As the manager, I don't at all mind being strict if it can better your experience at our shop.

main2.line: The experience Lord Bismarck imparted unto me has made my job significantly easier. I must thank her when I get the chance.

main3.line: Stealing food from the kitchen, leaving work early when they see you're not coming... Such terrible work ethics. It's high time I established a set of strict rules for the employees.

main4.line: As our single and very important customer, you should stay and rest up. Whether you're a soldier or a paper pusher, your work must be balanced with rest.

mission.line: Another mission. I will help you with it. You cannot afford to be lazy.

touch2.line: I do admire your bravery, but...

unlock.line: Hm? It's you. Surprised by my appearance? Hmm... My apologies. I was thinking about how to rectify discipline inside the shop. At any rate, welcome.

battle.line: Quietly... sneakily... infiltrating the battlefield...

detail.line: Booooom! Did I scare ya there, Commander?

expedition.line: Hmm? Commission team's back. Mind if I go greet 'em? I could use a quick dip in the harbor.

feeling1.line: Enttäuscht...

feeling2.line: Heheh, I love hide-and-seek! It's also my specialty!

feeling3.line: Not to brag, but I have a pretty stunning service record. Go on, let me hear your applause!

feeling4.line: Hmm? Found me again, huh. You've been finding me a lot lately...

feeling5.line: I just realized something big. That your bed is ridiculously warm! I'm gonna sleep with you from now o... What? Did I say something strange?

home.line: Here's a towel, Commander. Wipe that sweat off.

hp_warning.line: Dammit... I'm gonna have to dive real deep...

login.line: So you're finally back, huh. I thought I was gonna die of boredom.

lose.line: Damn... The Commander will avenge me for this!

mail.line: Isn't it nice having a letter waiting for you when you come back to port~?

main1.line: I'm gonna go check around the office for places to hide. Hehehe...

main2.line: Adjust firing parameters... check the compass and scales... Clank, clunk... *Giggle*...

main3.line: How about a game of hide-and-seek, Commander?

mission.line: Commander, you've got a new mission.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards are here! If you don't want 'em then I'll just help myself!

profile.line: I'm U-81, Type VIIC submarine of the Iron Blood Navy. I have a ton of sisters who can be pretty unruly sometimes! ... Also, I have the sinking of Ark Royal under my belt! She's a weird woman... I can't properly explain what makes her weird, though...

propose.line: This... must be what "getting hitched" means! Hehehe~ I'm happy, but also kinda embarrassed... O-of course, I love you very much, Commander!

touch.line: Bombers?! Aaaahhhh! Commander, there are some things you just can't joke about!

touch2.line: Whoah?! I warned you about doing that, Commander! My torpedoes almost just went off...

unlock.line: Heheh, now I too have a commander! I'm U-81, I love playing hide-and-seek. If you can't find me, just shout "U-81, I admit defeat!" and I'll probably come out of hiding.

upgrade.line: Feels like I've gotten more dexterous!

win_mvp.line: Now you know the power of U-boats!

gift_prefer.line: I... really like this!

feeling5.line: S-some people told me a serenade is a perfect love song... so I did some practice. Y-y-you wanna hear it? Whuah! Just don't laugh if it sounds bad!

home.line: I'm right here, Commander. ... Not hiding for once? Well, it's not like I can! Nobody could play hide-and-seek in this gaudy frickin' dress...

login.line: You're LATE, Commander! Just how long are you gonna keep me waiting?!

main1.line: This isn't wine, it's a soft drink! Don't believe me? Then have a sip for yourself! C'mon!

main2.line: Err, you wanna dance with me...? B-b-b-but I have no idea how to dance...

main3.line: This here kitty is my personal butler! Whaddya think? Is that awesome or what?

touch.line: You wanna hear me play the piano? Errm... I-in a bit, so just hold on a few...!

touch2.line: Hey! You did that on purpose, didn't you?!

unlock.line: *Ugh*... I figured this bulky dress would be hard to move in... Huh? I look pretty? Aha, ahaha... You're makin' me blush...

detail.line: Even I can make a basic lantern, like this. Some ladies from the Dragon Empery taught me how.

expedition.line: The commission team's back! Our circle of friends to celebrate with grows!

feeling5.line: You wanna see me every day and not just during the Mid-Autumn Festival? I've told you before, just yell "U-81, I admit defeat!" and I'll come straight to you! Heehee!

home.line: We're lucky the skies are clear today! We wouldn't get to see a full moon for another month if it had been cloudy.

login.line: Over here, Commander! Check out all the lanterns in the sky.

main1.line: I love mooncakes with sweet and sticky fillings! Those with fillings that taste all weird, on the other hand... I'll pass on those!

main2.line: Do you think moon rabbits play tag with moon people? That must be exhausting, considering how big the moon is.

main3.line: Even ol' lone wolf U-47 has come to hang out with us today! Festivals really are magic!

touch.line: Give me a sec... I'm gonna split this mooncake in half. There! Here you go, Commander!

touch2.line: Commander! Now's NOT the time for this!

unlock.line: Over here, Commander! I came because you said we were going to go moon-viewing together! I even brought tea and mooncakes.

win_mvp.line: Alright! Let's sail back to port and celebrate.

battle.line: This is where you'll all sleep!

couple_encourage1.line: Wolfpack... the hunt is on!

detail.line: Are you sending me out? I can handle it by myself.

expedition.line: Looks like the commission team is back... There's a lot of them. I don't want to go...

feeling1.line: Give me some space.

feeling2.line: Your office is very quiet. I like it here.

feeling3.line: So like, I can't really help with your work at all... But you'll let me stay here... You don't mind?

feeling4.line: I can visit anytime I want? Thanks... But... For some reason, I feel like I can't really relax here... I'm always on edge...

feeling5.line: I've spent thousands of hours swimming through the dark depths of the ocean... But lately all I can think about when I'm out on a mission is the warmth and light of your office... I think... I think I need to be with you, Commander.

home.line: So many people here now... It's so loud...

hp_warning.line: You can't be serious.

login.line: Oh. You're back.

lose.line: So this is how it ends...

mail.line: New report is in... I hope the enemy doesn't crack our codes...

main1.line: Enemies nearby? Welp...

main2.line: If you need someone to patrol, I'm good to go anytime.

main3.line: Such a quiet office... I approve.

mission.line: There's another mission...

mission_complete.line: Rewards are in... You don't want to see them?

profile.line: I'm U-47. I went behind enemy lines at Scapa Flow and sunk Royal Oak. I'm going to go out, sink the enemy, and come back. Just like I did then.

propose.line: I'm meant for more than just voyaging through the cold, dark oceans. My place is here, at the port, by your side... When I'm with you, even just sitting in silence, I feel... happy.

touch.line: Inspecting my equipment?

touch2.line: You looking to take a nap at the bottom of Scapa Flow?

unlock.line: Type VIIB submarine, U-47. I don't like crowds... If that's all, I'll be in my room.

upgrade.line: Enhancing... sounds good.

win_mvp.line: That's how it goes.

gift_prefer.line: I'll cherish it...

detail.line: It's not really my style to go out with anybody... But I'm worried about getting lost if I'm alone... Commander, you got plans today?
