feeling5.line: Under the sea or up on land, it doesn't really matter... As long as you're with me, it's beautiful.

home.line: Phew... The view up here on land isn't as bad as I thought.

login.line: Ah, you're here. Me...? Pretty much the same. I just got back.

mail.line: Mail? ... Is it that postcard we sent?

main1.line: Nearsighted? No... there are no lenses in them.

main2.line: If you're thirsty... You can have half.

main3.line: My outfit? My friends picked it out for me. I don't usually think about that stuff...

touch.line: I don't know my way around on land, so... You're my guide.

touch2.line: How about I take you on a trip to the bottom of the sea? It's really pretty down there too.

unlock.line: I haven't seen much of the world on land... Commander, want to explore it with me?

detail.line: Another sortie? I'll be right out. ...It's fine, I can go dressed like this.

feeling5.line: It's nice to be left alone, but the feeling I get when I'm with you... it feels almost addictive.

home.line: They're looking for me? Tell them to stop worrying. I'm fine.

login.line: ...You found me. Of course.

main1.line: I'm a little more talkative now? Huh... I just find I have more to talk about with you.

main2.line: The party...? I wouldn't know what to do with myself out there.

main3.line: I'm always stuck with a bunch of noisy girls: U-73, U-81, U-101... But even though I like it quiet, I really don't mind them that much.

touch.line: Here's to you, for taking good care of me.

touch2.line: Should I sober you up?

unlock.line: Sigh... I'd much rather be in a nice, quiet place like this over the din and clamor of the venue... Wouldn't you agree, Commander? I see. Well, come sit here then.

detail.line: Why the outfit? It's our theme, I guess. Isn't this what maids wear?

expedition.line: Commission rewards, huh... Sorry, can't fit those in my backpack.

feeling5.line: Wanna hang after my shift's over? I'm thinking we could, uhh, go somewhere and unwind. Dunno where yet... Open for suggestions.

home.line: Check out the Iron Blood's shop when you're craving pastries. It's laid-back and comfy... (Plus you'll get to see me...)

login.line: Welcome back, Master... You'd like to talk? About what?

lose.line: Need to hurry back...!

mail.line: Is this... an order? Oh, it's just new mail for you.

main1.line: If that's all, then I'm off for another delivery. It's nice, working solo.

main2.line: Hey, um... You okay, Icarus? Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you...

main3.line: Here, our phone number. Call us and we'll deliver to your office in 1 minute or less.

mission.line: I see new delivery missions have come in.

mission_complete.line: That's... a lot of mission rewards.

touch.line: This coffee is for the patrons. I'll brew some for you later.

touch2.line: No more service from me today, then.

unlock.line: Coming through! Steer clear! Oh, it's you, Commander. Talk to you later – I've got coffee to deliver.

win_mvp.line: I'm done cleaning, I guess.

battle.line: Hope this will end quietly again...

detail.line: "It is I, U-47, servant of the Mistress"... Okay, that's pretty cringe to say out loud...

expedition.line: Our commission team is back. Go say hi to them for me. Oh, and don't tell anyone I'm here.

feeling5.line: I read this love story featuring a vampire and a human. It was actually pretty good. If you're free, we could read it together.

home.line: Heya, Commander. You tired? I can get up if you need to lie down.

login.line: Mgh... Did they find me? Oh, it's just you. Welcome back, Commander.

lose.line: Overextended, huh... Figures.

mail.line: The bats outside the window are screeching again... Oh, they've brought a letter.

main1.line: I'm so not cut out for the role of a vampire's servant. Chilling in a corner is more my thing...

main2.line: You interested in this tome on vampire myths, Commander? ...What about me? Meh.

main3.line: U-73, why are you coming up to me with this weird potion? ...Garlic juice? Thing is, I'm not a real vampire, so...

mission.line: Another mission just came in? ...Five more minutes, then I'll do it.

mission_complete.line: Rewards from a mission just arrived. Want me to have a look?

touch.line: I can help, as long as it's nothing too crazy.

touch2.line: You're just asking for a bite to the neck.

unlock.line: An empty study with a cushy couch. The perfect place to relax. Whew... Go ahead and read a book if you want, Commander. If that'll be all then I'm gonna take a nap.

win_mvp.line: Better head home now before dawn breaks.

battle.line: Going underwa– Hey, stop pulling!

detail.line: Lützow digs the kitchen. Me, I'm content to just gather ingredients... You doubt that? The kitchen's much more work than this.

home.line: There you are. Heehee... I heard you're meant to take it real easy today. Hope we can do that together...

login.line: I'll try again and catch a feisty one. Wait here, Commander.

main1.line: This Dragon Empery dress is cozy and flexible. Lets me do anything with ease. Commander, if you have a New Year's wish, let me know.

main2.line: The Four Unbreakables are making something? Like, food? If not that, then what?

main3.line: Couldn't catch a carp, but Akashi's lightning-quick manjuu team caught tons of other fish we can have tonight... Am I miffed? Not really.

mission_complete.line: So, rewards. Can I take some? Lots of stuff there, the banquet won't use up everything.

touch.line: You want a closer look? One sec... Huh? You didn't mean the fish?

touch2.line: Woah! (U-47 got pulled back the moment before you could touch her.) Oh, s-sorry. I promise I wasn't trying to get away.

unlock.line: Nice. I've found a legendary luck-bringing carp, like... Oh. I almost had it, too... Sorry, Commander.

win_mvp.line: A happy victory for a happy new year, I guess.

battle.line: I hope I don't mess this up...

detail.line: Pennies are said to bring good luck, so I saved a bunch in my piggybank... but that didn't seem to do much for me...

expedition.line: Commander... a commission's done, by the looks of it.

feeling1.line: It's just my luck to run into a commander like you...

feeling2.line: You need something, Commander?

feeling3.line: You wanna be friends with me? But I'm a bad luck magnet, and that might be annoying for... Nnh, why are you patting me on the head all of a sudden...

feeling4.line: My true feelings are the most important...? I... want to be of service to you... because you're always so nice to me...

feeling5.line: I always thought it'd be best if I stayed away from people so my bad luck doesn't bother them. But you want to stay with me regardless... That makes me so happy... I love you... Commander.

home.line: Commander, you made it back safely! Thank goodness...

hp_warning.line: How unfortunate...

login.line: Commander, nothing bad happened to you before you got here, right?

lose.line: Sigh... I'm used to it...

mail.line: Commander, mail for you.

main1.line: I've only heard about "The First Fun Time" from my predecessors... I wasn't around for it.

main2.line: When you're a bad luck magnet, you probably shouldn't get close to people. That way, you won't cause them trouble...

main3.line: I'll try to be the best secretary I can. It's the one thing... I don't want to fail at...

mission.line: Commander, I'm pretty sure we've got new missions... Probably, I think...

mission_complete.line: Here are the mission rewards, Commander.

profile.line: I'm U-557, Iron Blood Type VIIC submarine... I went on four sorties during the war, sinking six merchant ships plus Galatea. The day after I sank her, an allied ship mistook me for a Royal Navy ship and collided with me... I had a few accidents before that too, so maybe I'm just cursed with bad luck...

propose.line: The most fortunate time in my whole life was when first I met you, Commander... If we're together, I'm sure I'll be able to gain some more luck. I'm kind of... excited about that.

skill.line: Let's hope these hit their target...

touch.line: What is it, Commander...? Wait, don't tell me... I've messed up again...?

touch2.line: What... was that... It felt weird...

unlock.line: Type VIIC submarine, U-557, reporting in. I'm a bad luck magnet, so feel free to forget about and ignore me... As far as missions go... I'll give them my best shot.

upgrade.line: Maybe this'll improve my luck too...

win_mvp.line: Victory... Is this what they mean by "the tides turning"?

gift_prefer.line: Commander, what's gotten into you?

battle.line: There is no escape!

couple_encourage1.line: Lord Bismarck! Let's give the enemy a beautiful thrashing!

couple_encourage2.line: Sorry, I don't really want to be around you...

couple_encourage3.line: Tirpitz! Watch this!

detail.line: Grrryyeeaaaargh! Come at mee!! Haaaah... haaaah... sometimes I get stuck in war mode and need to calm myself down. Ahahahahaa!

expedition.line: The girls are back from commission! Should we go greet them?

feeling1.line: Please don't make that face again... okay?

feeling2.line: Lord Bismarck! I'm here to play! Oh, huh...?

feeling3.line: Commander, you wanna see how I dive? Heh heh, Lord Bismarck said it looked pretty good. I'm proud of myself too.

feeling4.line: Waaahh! Why won't Lord Bismarck hug me? She said I'm too childish! ... Hey, do you wanna sub in for her, Commander? — Eheheh, you really understand me!

feeling5.line: Commander, you and Lord Bismarck are the most important people to me! Without you, I would lose all will to fight... so if you could stay with me forever, that would make me happy...

home.line: Commander, I took out a whole bunch of books while you were gone and I kiiinda forgot where they go... Erm, sorry... Eheheheh...

hp_warning.line: D-don't lose control at a time like this!

login.line: Welcome back! Don't you feel super pumped on a day like this?

lose.line: I won't fail like I did before... never again!

mail.line: Beepbeepbeep! U-556 has received new information!

main1.line: Commander, if you don't play with me I'm just going to go find Lord Bismarck

main2.line: Commander, let's go swimming! Don't worry, I'll keep you safe!

main3.line: Commander, sitting too long is bad for your health!

mission.line: Ugh, there's still a mission to do.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! So can we go play now?

profile.line: I swore an oath to Neptune himself, that I would protect Lord Bismarck from danger, no matter where she encountered it! ... But there are still some things I can't handle by myself. Ahahaha...

propose.line: I hereby declare before Neptune that I will protect the Commander, no matter the place, no matter the challenge! ... Heh heh. I believe you'll find I'm more reliable than you think, Commander!

touch.line: Come on, Commander. Can we go play with Lord Bismarck?

touch2.line: Hey! Commander, don't run away!

unlock.line: Ahoy! Type VIIC submarine U-556 here! This is my home port, no question! Oh, right, is Lord Bismarck here?

upgrade.line: The open sea. I have arrived!

win_mvp.line: Ha-haa! Nike stands with us!

gift_prefer.line: Ehehe~ Vielen Dank, Commander!

detail.line: Hey, Commander, can we go check out the kitchen? ... Oh, they're really busy in there? I guess we better not get in their way...

feeling5.line: Awww, it's lights out after the party? But I'm not done playing. ... Hey, Commander, won't you play with me a bit more? Eheheh~ I love you, Commander!

home.line: Where are you always running off to, Commander? Come play with me!

login.line: I've heard parties are suuuuuuuuuuper fun! I can't wait!!

main1.line: Don't give me that face, kitty. Here, look, it's my finger. It's over here! ... Now it's over here!

main2.line: Commander, have you seen Lord Bismarck? Can we go look for her?

main3.line: Om nom nom. Delicious! This is really good! Here, Commander, try some!

touch.line: Where should we go next?

touch2.line: Hmph! Don't think you're gonna get away with that!

unlock.line: It's me, U-556, all prettied up! Eheheheh, we're gonna have lots of fun at this party, Commander! Come on, let's go!

battle.line: Like a torpedo, I always hit my mark!

detail.line: Ahahaha! Riding a horse is fuuun! If you ever need any help, Commander, just say the word! I'll teach you how to ride like a pro!

expedition.line: Any scoundrels out there who'd try to steal from the commission team? Probably not! Commander, the girls are back!

feeling5.line: Nobody's ever gonna steal my precious treasure from me – by that I mean you! Heehee! Wherever you go, I'll always protect you, just like I swore – at sea, on land, or in the sky!

home.line: Let's see... Commander! You can rest inside the carriage if you're tired! Just hope you don't mind it being a bit cramped and bumpy. Heehee.

login.line: "Heheheh! Either ya keep the goods or ya keep yer lives!" How was that? Don't I play a villain perfectly? Heh, then I can act just fine if the situation calls for it!

mail.line: I've got a wanted poster with a bounty right here! Just kidding. Take a look at your new mail!

main1.line: Bleh... Eagle Union coffee is so bitter... Is this even real coffee? Hm? Take this chocolate as a palate cleanser? Thanks, Commander!

main2.line: No manjuu's gonna stop me! Follow me, Commander! We just have to ride to the next campsite and we'll be fine!

main3.line: Riding a horse is easy peasy compared to riding a rigging! Heheh! I'll EASILY live up to your and Bismarck's expectations!

touch.line: Now to reload while still holding the reins... Whoaaa! Oh man, this is really hard...

touch2.line: Whoa, whoa! C-Commander, that was risky! *blushes*

unlock.line: I'm still Parzival of the Seas, even on land! Lord Bismarck entrusted me with these goods and I'm gonna keep them safe! Now step up and try your luck, hooligans!

win_mvp.line: Oh yeah! We shook 'em off! Let's get back to our original course, Commander!

battle.line: The leader of wolfpacks, that's me!

couple_encourage1.line: U-boats, it's our time to shine!

detail.line: Now, now, Commander, don't stress over everything~ I'm sure it'll all go fine.

expedition.line: Commission complete! Great job, everyone!

feeling1.line: Uh... My friends are waiting for me, so sorry, gotta scamper.

feeling2.line: Oh? Finally managed to catch a break, Commander? Then let's go for a quick stroll, shall we?

feeling3.line: The wild U-73 approaches quietly, waiting for her chance, and then POUNCES! ... Hahaha, I caught you, Commander!

feeling4.line: I suppose you've fallen for me at last? Then stay by my side forever, Commander!

feeling5.line: True, I can't guarantee I'll be speedy when I dive... but no matter what, you'll be mine, Commander! Especially your heart! Hahah!

home.line: Good to see you! Let me handle things for you while you get some rest~

hp_warning.line: Mein Leben! Better perform emergency maneuvers...

login.line: Howdy-do, Commander! Welcome back! I'm all good to go and ready to sortie! Just give me the order.

lose.line: Oh nooo...! Ahaha... How the heck could we lose...

mail.line: Mail's just arrived~ Oh, do you want me to read it on your behalf?

main1.line: When you're underwater all day, sometimes you just wanna resurface and smash through the waves! ... Hey, Commander, wanna go for a quick dive in the ocean?

main2.line: I'd rather be diving in the ocean and feeling the thrill of being near the enemy than stuck at port staring into space all day...

main3.line: Isn't it fun to hear what's on somebody's mind and help them with it? ... Maybe I ought to open a psychiatric booth. Anyway, Reichspfennig for your thoughts, Commander?

mission.line: So, we've got a mission. Let's do it together, Commander!

mission_complete.line: With my support, we could finish these missions with our eyes closed!

profile.line: I'm U-73, the Iron Blood submarine that completed lots of missions and served as the leader of several wolfpacks!

propose.line: Ahah, I didn't think this would happen so fast, but now you're a part of me! Relax, just let me handle everything for you! I'll take care of you for the rest of your life~

touch.line: What is it? Got something I could help with? C'mon, tell me something.

touch2.line: Uh-huh. So, Commander, how many gut-punch torpedoes do you want for dessert?

unlock.line: U-73 of the Iron Blood, reporting for duty! If there's anything that needs doing, just leave it to me!

upgrade.line: Now my shots will be even more on point! Heh heh~

win_mvp.line: Heheh! Did you see how strong I am?

gift_prefer.line: This is all for me? You sure know how to make a girl happy, Commander~♪

battle.line: Time for an experiment on you numskulls!

login.line: Now we add some of this, then– Whuah! Don't surprise me like that, Commander! You nearly just caused an accident!

main1.line: Now we raise the heat slightly, then... Oh, God! I-it's on fire!

main2.line: Experiments necessitate preciseness. Being even one 100th of a milliliter off affects the result!

main3.line: The glamor of this lab coat drew me to the science room! ... Huh? This ISN'T a lab coat? Aha, ahahahaha...

touch.line: Hey, Commander? No intimacy right now, okay? I'm fine-tuning this compound, you see...

touch2.line: You wanna be the target of my experimental fuel-powered torpedoes?

unlock.line: It's time for science class with U-73! Now, Commander, let's try out an exhilarating and positively fascinating experiment!

battle.line: Looks like I've found the ingredients for my concoction!

detail.line: Decided I'd try on this Dragon Empery dress, in light of the season! Does it look good on me? Hehehe~

login.line: You wanna learn the formula? Sure thing! First you mix the contents of these beakers, then... Wait, are your hands shaking? Hahaha! Come on, it'll be fine – I'm right here!

main1.line: And for the last step, we raise the heat a few degrees. See, brewing tea is like doing science – it takes precision.

main2.line: Might it be possible to make tea from a chemical concoction? Hmm... It wouldn't really feel like tea if you made it that way... So that's tricky...

main3.line: You think I seem more ladylike than usual? Heh! That's exactly what I set out to do!

touch.line: You'd like a refill? Coming right up!

touch2.line: Seems you desire a "special" kind of concoction, huh.

unlock.line: In today's chemistry lesson, we'll learn how to make a warming cup of tea and an optional concoction to enhance its flavor! Will you do the honor of taste-testing it, Commander?

battle.line: My boat torpedoes are ready!

detail.line: You know about those Union girls who call themselves "Solomon Knights" or something? Well, it has a nice ring to it... All righty, Commander, I'm an "Undersea Knight" from now on, got it?

expedition.line: The commission fleet is back? All righty, I'll go pick 'em up!

feeling1.line: I'm going for a ride! Tschüss~

feeling2.line: When I put in my headphones and rev the engines, I can outrun all my worries. Lemme tell you, Commander, it's one hell of a feeling.

feeling3.line: Y'know, I really want to have an all-out race with the other factions' subs. I just know it's gonna get my blood pumping! How about it, Commander, wanna do me a favor?

feeling4.line: Commander, hurry up and hop on! There's a school of incredibly rare and beautiful fish passing by today! Who knows how long we'd have to wait if we missed this opportunity!

feeling5.line: Commander, look who's back! Hehe, seems like you've fallen in love with Great Shark, huh? All right, get on. Today, I'm going to show you a real special place!

home.line: Commander, want me to drop you off at the dorm so you can get some rest?

hp_warning.line: Looks like I've gotta pick up the pace...!

login.line: Commander, just hit me up next time and I'll give you a ride, okay?

lose.line: Couldn't get out of the way in time...

mail.line: Hello! Your local courier U-101 has new mail for you~ Hahaha!

main1.line: Ah, Commander, wait just a sec. I've gotta finish fine-tuning Great Shark. We can go afterwards.

main2.line: Great Shark is land-capable, you know. Well, just not as fast. Don't ask why it works that way!

main3.line: What kind of music do you like to listen to on trips, Commander? Have any recommendations?

mission.line: You have a new task? Want me to take you to where you need to go?

mission_complete.line: Commander, I've brought the rewards!

profile.line: I'm U-101, one of the Iron Blood's 7th U-Boat Flotilla. I took part in four wolfpack operations. You could say that disrupting the enemy supply lines is my specialty - I even received a Knight's Cross! My hobby is going on long rides with Great Shark. Commander, wanna come with me?

propose.line: Don't worry, Commander. As long as you're somewhere Great Shark can get to, call me any time. I swear I'll come for you!

touch.line: Hop on, Commander, and make sure to hold on to my waist tight! It won't be my fault if you fall off~

touch2.line: ...Commander?! Sic 'em, Great Shark!

unlock.line: Hey! You! That commander over there! How 'bout coming for a ride on my Great Shark? I'll show you a real thrillin' time!

upgrade.line: I feel the need for speed!

win_mvp.line: Booyah! Number one!

gift_prefer.line: Woow... You're a nice person, Commander!

detail.line: It feels nice to kick back and enjoy some good music!

expedition.line: It's pretty far from here to the piers. Commander, how about we take Great Shark out for a spin?

feeling5.line: I don't know why, but when it's just the two of us in the band room, my chest starts fluttering like I'm sick... but I'm so glad... Aghh!! I'm gonna go take Great Shark out for a spin!

home.line: Good work out there, Commander. Let's put on something chill~

login.line: Commander, let's put on some music!

main1.line: Commander, I recently started learning the trombone, hehe. I'm not very good at it, but it's still pretty interesting. Wanna listen~?

main2.line: If I was able to play this thing underwater, I'd be able to perform for the fishes! Too bad, though... Guess I'll have to settle for the fish in the aquarium!

main3.line: Even though we U-boats hang out together regularly, studying together at school feels rather special!

mission.line: Commander, there's a ton of homework today.

mission_complete.line: Commander, I'm all done with my homework. Let's go for a ride!

touch.line: Commander, how about becoming the band conductor?

touch2.line: Woah! I almost smashed this over your head...

unlock.line: Commander, welcome to the school band! Why'd I join the band? The reason's simple – there's no Motorbike Club at school, haha! Just kidding~! Actually, I'm quite fond of music as well, heh.

battle.line: Oh boy, here we go! Listen up, folks! It's lunchtime!

detail.line: Hehe, been oglin' me for some time, haven'tcha, Commander? I noticed ages ago!

expedition.line: Commission team's back safe and sound~ Let's go check out those rewards.

feeling1.line: Sure can't count on you, huh, Commander. Guess that's cute in a way, though?

feeling2.line: You want a fun hunt, ya need good chums, else it's not happening~

feeling3.line: Hey, you're pretty chill~ I'm feelin' like this is the start of a good relationship~

feeling4.line: Commander, your cunning plans won't work on me. Cause 9 times outta 10, I know just what you're thinking.

feeling5.line: I think we oughta get to know each other more intimately~ Whaddya say, Com-man-der? Ahahahah! Look at you, blushing! Oh, that's hilarious!

home.line: Mumph... Oh, you're back? Want some corned beef?

hp_warning.line: You're not half-bad...

login.line: Always happy to see ya, Commander. Today's lookin' like it'll be fun.

lose.line: Oopsie... Guess I messed up a calculation...

mail.line: Commander, got news for ya from headquarters~

main1.line: This tail connector's not just for show. When plugged into my rigging: bam, gives me perfect control.

main2.line: When I'm fighting, you can stare at me to your heart's content, y'know? Hehehe~

main3.line: I just LOVE seeing my enemies squirming about, trying to get away from my attacks~ Ahahahah~!

mission.line: Ya figure we got any new missions, possibly involving hunting?

mission_complete.line: Commander, check out this mound of rewards we got~!

profile.line: I'm U-522, Type IXC sub, from the glorious 2nd U-boat Flotilla. You need long-distance commerce raiding, I'm your girl. Anti-sub escorts do put me in one helluva pickle, though. Anyways, keep those eyes peeled for my combat performance~

propose.line: I'm kinda worried about your future, what with how dang easy it is to read you, Commander~ But it's cool, I'll always be with you, so do keep counting on me, 'kay? Ahahahah~

touch.line: You feelin' like some hide and seek? I'm game. I always win, y'see.

touch2.line: Tail - no touch! Bad Commander! That's my sensitive spot!

unlock.line: Hmm... you're the commander 'round here, eh? I'm U-522, Iron Blood submarine, reporting for duty. Anyhoo, heard this here port's like a party. I'm eager to join in on it. Heheheh~

upgrade.line: Sehr gut!

win_mvp.line: That's all? Laaaame. I wanna have more fun~

gift_prefer.line: Oh, wow. You really do know what I'm into! You deserve a little reward~

battle.line: I'm a shaaaark. Raaaawr.

detail.line: I'm not a garlic bulb, I'm a shaaaark. Fear meeee. Raaaawr.

expedition.line: Commander, someone's come back to pooort.

feeling1.line: Why won't you play with me...

feeling2.line: You mean my Enigma machine doesn't have any use anymore? Okey-dokey, then let's play a game of decipheriiiing.

feeling3.line: Believe it or not, this hairstyle was born with meeeee. Mhm, I'm a shaaaark. Raaaawr!

feeling4.line: Bulldog's really smart. Playing with her is fun. Next time, you should come play with us tooooo.

feeling5.line: The Commander is my friend. I'll give you some of my codebooks. That way it'll be fine even if I forget mine. Yup-yup.

home.line: Commander, your office is so booooring.

hp_warning.line: U-110's awesoooome. I'm not giving uuuuup.

login.line: Commander, did you bring swirly-whirly candies?

lose.line: Codebooks, where are my codebooks... Goodie, they're safe...

mail.line: I'll take care of your encrypted maaaail.

main1.line: Codebooks, codebooks... Oops, I forgot them in the dorm.

main2.line: Commander, let's plaaaaay. Leeeeetttt'ssss plaaaaaayyyy.

main3.line: I got lectured for pretending to be a shark... But I still had fun.

mission.line: Commander, once your mission's doooone, let's plaaaaay.

mission_complete.line: Rawr! I've brought the mission rewaaaaards.

profile.line: I'm U-110, Iron Blood Type IXB submarine, and I'm really good at commerce raiding. The Enigma machine I've got in my backpack is awesome. I'm awesome too, I just left my codebooks and charts behind...

propose.line: Commander is so nice to me. I love you. U-110's gonna bite anyone who messes with you. U-110's scaaaryyy. Raaaaaawr!

touch.line: Commander, I'll give you a swirly-whirly if you play with meeee.

touch2.line: Nom! (U-110 bit your finger.)

unlock.line: Raaaawr. U-110 is a shaaaark. Fear meeee. Mess with me and I'll bite yooouuu.

upgrade.line: U-110's super scaryyyyy.

win_mvp.line: Raaaawr. U-110 scared the enemies awaaaay.

gift_prefer.line: Commander, friend.

detail.line: This hat is not a bulb of garlic, but a shark. A scary shaaaark. Raaawr.

home.line: Commander, why does everyone like flicking U-110's hair?

login.line: Commander, let's go to school together?

mail.line: U-110 has learned a new codebreaking method. Want me to try it on the mail?

main1.line: U-110 learned from school that there are actually many kinds of Enigma machines... School is coooool.

main2.line: Raaaawr, raaaawr, raaaawr! Amazon said I can't rawr at school, so U-110 will rawr when hanging out with Commander.

main3.line: Bulldog says it's no fun to play with U-110, but she always plays with U-110 anyway. What a nice girl.

mission.line: The homework is strong... but U-110 is stronger. That's why I'll finish it all.

mission_complete.line: Commander, U-110 has defeated the homework. I'm strooong!

touch.line: Hm, this outfit is very cute, and U-110 likes it a lot. However, it makes me not scary. That makes me a cute shark. Raaaawr.

unlock.line: Whenever I play games with Bulldog, I always end up losing. Frustratinggg. That's why... I'll study hard. One day, I'll winnnn.

detail.line: Look at these flowers in my hair. No, they're noooot garlic flowers.

home.line: I can't be a shark in this dress... But my friends here are still shaaarks. Raaaawr.

login.line: Are you waiting on U-110 too, Commander?

main1.line: I've hidden the codebooks. They're not getting them this time.

main2.line: I put on these wings. I've become a flying shark. Raaawr.

main3.line: Why wasn't my invitation encrypted? Everyone knows I like decrypting stuff...

touch.line: Bulldog gave me swirly-whirlieeees. Want one, Commander?

unlock.line: I have to wear beautiful clothes to a party, or so Bulldog said. So, I had everyone help me pick out beautiful clothes. Commander, I'm beautiful, right? Eh... cute?

battle.line: U-boats don't mess around on the staaage.

detail.line: I'm garniiished, not garliiic. Hrmph... Raaawr!

main1.line: I dropped my lyrics sheet... But I still have my codebooks, so we're fine. ...We're not fine?

main2.line: "Hear the terrifying melody of the Lord of Sharkness, ruler of the dark abyss. Raaawr." ...It loses all its scare factor when I go raaawr? Raaawr...

main3.line: You and me, let's do a song battle, Albacooore. ...Nobody can hear you sing underwater, dummy.

mission.line: After our recital is done, I wanna play a gaaame.

mission_complete.line: Rawr! I brought you some supplieees.

touch.line: If you don't behave, you'll get munched ooon.

touch2.line: Munch! (U-110's baby sharks bit you.)

unlock.line: The horned idol U-110 splashes onto the staaage. I'll sing all the baddies to obliviooon. I'm scaaary. Raaawr. Raaawr♪

detail.line: I lost to Bulldog again... Commander, it's time for special trainiiing. We'll doodle her face into oblivion.

home.line: Let's build a snowman. Or a shiver of snowshaaarks. ...There's no such thing as a snowshark?

login.line: New Year's is a lucky daaay. I'll get lots of swirly-whirlieees. Do you have any, Commander?

main1.line: Everyone's talking about their year-first dreams... I dreamed I turned into a big shark. Raaawr.

main2.line: I've got you a New Year's card with encrypted teeext. I can decipher it for yooou.

main3.line: Bulldog drew the art on my paddle. She's a really good artist.

touch.line: I'm no bunny, I'm a shaaark. A scary shark that'll bite yooou. Raaawr.

unlock.line: Commander, happy new yeeear. I'm no bunny, I'm a shaaark. Not a cute shark, but a crimson, scaaary shark. Raaawr.

detail.line: Are you cold, Commander? Borrow my coooat. Ah... Achoo! Ugh... R-raaawr...

home.line: I don't know if it's spring or even winter... Bulldog said it could even be summer. What season actually is it?

login.line: You want to help? Okay, go pick the mushrooms over there. Don't eat any behind my back. Raaawr.

main1.line: "Couplet"? The left and right scrolls both say kind of the same thing... So it's a code?

main2.line: Lützow told me to say "aah," but I said "raaawr" and she made a funny face. Raaawr?

main3.line: I'll decorate with the inedible mushrooms. Can I... put some by your office windows?

touch.line: Nom! (U-110 took a bite of her mochi cake.)

touch2.line: Nom? (U-110 has sunk her teeth into your sleeve and won't let you go.)

unlock.line: I'm gathering mushrooms, not garlic cloooves. The edible ones are gonna go in a hearty hot pot that'll warm me and my frieeends. Raaawr.

win_mvp.line: Raaawr. Have a mushroom for your hard work, Commander.

battle.line: Time to get huntin'!

couple_encourage1.line: There ain't no escaping the wolfpack!

detail.line: Yeah, what? You fancy how a U-boat in her off time looks?

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Good thing those sheep didn't get eaten by wolves, eh.

feeling1.line: You know where you belong? In a shark's stomach. Meh, whatever.

feeling2.line: During most my missions I'm honestly just bored out of my mind and pray I find somethin' worth my time. If you ever feel bored, go hit up some of the U-boats at port.

feeling3.line: If ya think U-boat combat is that fascinating, you could always come with me on the next sortie. Oh wait, you can't stay underwater all that long, can ya? Then how's about I teach you how to dive like a pro?

feeling4.line: You can get onto my rigging while I'm surfaced, can'tcha? Don't worry, I ain't gonna just dump ya in the middle of the ocean. So, how's that sound? Wanna ride with me?

feeling5.line: Someday I wanna take you with me on a trip across the sea, just the two of us. We could write a journal as we go and make a book or even movie out of it... Actually, that'd be weird, so let's not. But as long as we make some fond memories, I'm happy.

home.line: Lemme see that map, Commander... All right, cool... 'Kay, so the spot I marked would be perfect for an ambush next sortie. If ya need it done, just hit me up.

hp_warning.line: Should probably retreat while I still can, I guess!

login.line: Look who's early. Here I was hoping to see you panicking over being late.

lose.line: Whatever. Next time's gonna be much better.

mail.line: That mailbox is gonna get full sooner or later. And don't say I didn't warn ya.

main1.line: It's not the foes you can see that you should fear, it's the ones you can't see. Like us U-boats, for instance...

main2.line: Step one: dive. Step two: wait. While we U-boats can hold our breaths for ages, sometimes I just like goin' for a leisurely swim.

main3.line: "The Oak-Leaves Patrol"... Heheh, that's got a nice ring to it. Still, all we really did was make a pack and go huntin' for targets.

mission.line: What's this? Still got unfinished missions, do we?

mission_complete.line: So, what is it? Need someone to fetch ya those rewards?

profile.line: The name's U-96, Iron Blood Type VIIC U-boat, part of the 7th U-boat Flotilla. I made some real juicy contributions over my 11 patrols in the war. Never did fare well against aircraft, though... But don't let that worry ya, Commander. I'm still an ace, and I ain't never gonna let ya down.

propose.line: You got me, I'll give ya that much... But I've still got the chance to strike back. Close your eyes! ...Mwah! Heheh, hit ya right in the heart with that one, didn't I?

touch.line: Did ya need something, or?

touch2.line: What? You seriously like touching me here?

unlock.line: Sup. I'm U-96, Type VIIC U-boat and member of the famous Vorwärts wolfpack. Hehe, I'll have you drowning in reports of my success soon enough.

upgrade.line: Oh man, I can't wait for the next sortie.

win_mvp.line: Now do ya see what an ace is capable of?

gift_prefer.line: Hey, this is awesome!

battle_ex.line: I'm goin' straight for the kill!

detail_ex.line: Hm-hmm-hm♪... What? This is how I always look. The hell are ya getting all prude for?

home_ex.line: You got the map, Commander? No, not that, THIS one. You don't get it? It's the route we'll be taking for our date.

login_ex.line: Oh, there you are. You're the only person who's capable of making me clock in this early, ya know that?

main1_ex.line: Foes you can't see aren't so scary if ya got friends to watch your back. Yeah, like those surface ship buddies of yours.

main4_ex.line: Ahahaha, Lebe's getting schooled by Thiele again! Ah, and if ya ever want me to school you, I could do that.

main5_ex.line: Mix together some lemon juice, coffee, and rum, and ya get... Hold up, are you seriously considering drinking this? It ain't really meant for consumption, though...

mail_ex.line: If ya don't wanna dig through your mailbox, I could do it for ya.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission rewards, comin' through. Nah, I fetched 'em just 'cause I felt like doing it.

touch_ex.line: Ya need somethin'? Let's hear it then.

touch2_ex.line: Mgh... Ohh...

win_mvp_ex.line: I told you, remember? "Swimming in reports of my success," and I delivered. Mwah!

detail.line: This getup's real comfy and easy to move around in. Plus, I'm in my own room, and it's not like it matters if you see.

home.line: Right, so, I just read up on this new strat. You should help me practice it!

login.line: The snacks and drinks are on the side. Go ahead, help yourself to whatever you want. No need to be polite.

mail.line: A new notification?! Oh, it's just your mail. I thought I was getting a challenge from L.I. or something.

main1.line: If you wanna beat me, go practice for a few years and then come back, Warrior from the Land of the Rising Sun. Ahaha~

main2.line: Um... wait a sec, I think I heard some weird noise. Don't tell me U-81's bunch snuck into my room again while playing hide-and-seek...

main3.line: I'm a pretty big fan of the Dragon Sisters, y'know? How should I put it... They work hard, and you can't ever hate 'em. Isn't that right?

touch.line: How about another match? All right! There's gonna be a punishment for the loser~

unlock.line: Nice timing. I just finished an intense battle. The result...? Of course I won. What? Did you want to have a match against me?

detail.line: Yeah, what? You fancy how an exercising U-boat looks?

expedition.line: Commission team's back. Guess we'd better go get into gear.

home.line: Try to lift somethin' too heavy and it'll only hurt ya. Not like I'm worried you'll do literally that – choose your enemy, is all I'm saying... Hah, guess I am worrying after all...

login.line: I'm gonna get it this– Ah! Whew... Always showing up at just the wrong time... To hell with it. Let's get started on our workout.

main1.line: Is that Northern Parliament girl using just one hand...? I'm frickin' speechless. What kinda crazy workout routine has she been doing?

main2.line: Hey, you'll get outta shape if ya sit on your ass all day. Want me to show ya how it's done?

main3.line: Grit is the name of the submarine game. I can work out here every day, no problem. I can coach you every day too, if ya want.

touch2.line: I'll remember that... You're getting what's coming to ya later!

unlock.line: Mmgh... Guh... Ahhh! These things are heavier than they look... Oh, there you are. You work out too, do ya? Feel free to join me if you've not just come to tease me.

win_mvp.line: Victory iiis... mine!

detail.line: I'm no shut-in or nothing, but standing all day in the blazin' sun is gonna be the death of me... You feel the same? Then do me a solid and gimme a massage in a bit.

feeling5.line: What, you want me to root for you to pump you up? Is that why you made me wear all this? Fine. C'mon, you can do it. You're the best Commander there ever was. Now get out there! Pedal to the metal from start to finish!

home.line: Hm? You tryna reward me? Hang on, why should I be rewarded when YOU just got back from a sortie? Should be the other way 'round, no?

login.line: Yo. Here for an inspection? Or to spectate? Or maybe you wanna cheer on the gals with me? Do whatever you wanna.

main1.line: I'm not worried 'cause I know you're gonna win. But, if you were to lose, don't worry – I'll win in your stead. Hahah!

main2.line: I can root for you anywhere and everywhere. On the stage, on the track, even on this bad boy – so, got a particular place in mind?

main3.line: Should I be cool, or just do like usual and be tough... Hm? Nah, it's nothin', I'm just thinking about what kind of cheering on will make ya the happiest.

touch.line: No boots? Yeah, 'cause it'd get hot as hell, standin' around in those. You oughta take that suit of yours off if you're sweating, too.

touch2.line: I swear, people like you... Huh? Oh, you went for THOSE... *blushes*

unlock.line: Sup. If it isn't our Commander. Got bored already because you shattered all your previous records? Or, did you run into some mechanical issues? ...Huh, you're here to ask for my support? Did the butterscotch get to your brain or what? Despite the way I look, I've been on the sidelines cheering you on this whole time.

win_mvp.line: Heh. Open another bottle of champagne for me when we get back, will ya?

battle.line: Wanna hazard a guess where I'll appear from~?

couple_encourage1.line: Wolfpack, let's mess 'em up!

detail.line: My rigging's got bits that'll hurt ya, so watch yourself if ya wanna feel it.

expedition.line: Commission team's back? I'll go greet 'em! Better that than be bored to death in this office!

feeling1.line: Miss me with your lame ass! Laterrr!

feeling2.line: So here's the dorm, here's the academy, and here's the office... Gotcha. Now I've got a pretty good idea of where everything is!

feeling3.line: Check out my massive rigging, it's big enough for two people! Hop on and I'll take ya some place far away!

feeling4.line: When ya go on missions in remote oceans, ya gotta live with being alone for days in a row... But I've got this photo of you in your sleep to help stave off the loneliness! Heheh~

feeling5.line: Sometimes I just wanna be right beside you, sometimes I just wanna hide and watch ya struggle to find me. Y'know, I think I'm in love! You made me feel this way, and you'll own up to it, won'tcha? Hehehe~

home.line: The deep sea hunter's back, baby! Didn't score any prey, but I just caught me an slacking commander! Heheh!

hp_warning.line: Oh crap! Might be time to dive back down and hide...

login.line: Oh, hey! I'm going out, so call if ya need somethin'! Gonna go for a dive!

lose.line: Well damn. Better luck next hunt, huh...

mail.line: Look at that, new mail! Wonder if it's from across the pond.

main1.line: Can't I get a free pass if just say the paperwork's up and vanished? No? Figures.

main2.line: They say teamwork makes the dream work! So let's round up some more peeps to do this paperwork!

main3.line: Touch my tail without warning, and I'll whip your ass with the tail end of my rigging! ...Hey, I'm kidding! Hahahahah!

mission.line: New mission, huh? I'm on it! ...What? We're not disruptin' cargo lanes?

mission_complete.line: Mission's been completed! Guess I didn't have much to do with it though... Lame.

profile.line: Difference between us Type IX's and the Type VII's is that we're bigger and can go farther! We hide where they'll least expect us... then BAM! Torpedo 'em to smithereens! ...The what in Hudson Bay? They just made that up for that movie! The real me was still alive and kickin'!

propose.line: I knew this day was comin', but I'm still feeling all giddy! Thank you for this, my lazy but adorable Commander! I'll always be with you from this day onward!

touch.line: How d'ya like my glossy, wet skin~?

touch2.line: You got a kink for submarines or somethin', Commander? Well, well...

unlock.line: I'm the hunter that prances across the open seas, U-37! ...Huh? Is the commander here always this spaced out? Well, I've given you my name already, so catch ya later~!

upgrade.line: Now that's a nice boost to my swimming skills!

win_mvp.line: We are so throwin' a party when we get back!

gift_prefer.line: Huh? Is this for me?! No givesies backsies, alright?!

detail_ex.line: Did ya know that when someone's partner is a loose cannon, that means said person's pretty dangerous, too?

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, y'know what gets me more excited than anything else? It's workin' out the perfect ambush with you and catchin' the baddies with their pants down! But, before we set out, we'll need to do a "strategy briefing" first. Get what I mean?

headtouch_ex.line: Heh, you can ruffle it up if ya want. Feels chummy, and I like that!

home_ex.line: Ya know what I look forward to the most while out at sea? Returning to the port and getting my hands on you! Heehee!

login_ex.line: Heehee, you're under arrest! I've been lyin' here in wait for you! Whaddya think? The deep sea hunter really caught ya off guard, eh?

main4_ex.line: I sure as hell ain't raring to do any work, but since you're bustin' your ass, I gotta put in some effort, too! And as thanks, you gotta gimme all your break time!

main5_ex.line: You wouldn't believe what's out there under the sea! Sometimes you even run into glowy deep-sea creatures! Wanna see some? Alright, you and me, let's go!

main6_ex.line: We've known each other for ages now, and you're still fascinated by my tail? C'mon, don'tcha wanna touch my nice, warm skin instead of my cold tail?

touch_ex.line: You checkin' my body temp? Heh, I'm not one to get sick easily... Ah-ah-achoo!

touch2_ex.line: Well, if you love it that much... Heh. Be ready for some payback.

detail.line: Now then, my dear visitor, I would like to play for you a little song... Heheh, go figure, I'm good at this whole mimicry thing!

feeling5.line: Playing music's a way for you to express your feelings... I, uh, might still only be able to play beginner songs, but... you feel the emotion in 'em, right?

home.line: All right, I'm goin' out to– Oh crap, oh no! ...Phew, thanks, Commander. Nearly tripped right there... Mad respect to the Sakura Empire girls who can walk around in this stuff like it's nothing...

login.line: Hey! Happy New Year, Commander! Lessee here... Just tryin' to think of a fitting New Year's song...

main1.line: These clothes keep slippin' off... Annoying for me, but just the way you like it, am I right~? Heheh~

main2.line: My U-boat buds agreed to play this thing called "hanetsuki"! U-110 sure seems excited about it... Hang on, can I even play in these tight clothes?

main3.line: An electric guitar would really be more my style, y'know? Would kinda clash with this getup, though. Ahah.

touch.line: Hehehe~ I've got pretty slick skin if I do say so myself.

touch2.line: Whoa there, lost all self-control, have ya, Commander~?

unlock.line: Now then, please lend your ears to this song I shall offer you... Wait, Commander, are you spacing out again? Even though I went through all this trouble to learn this song from my friends in the Sakura fleet... Please pay attention, okay? I'm starting over...

detail.line: Partner, our top-priority mission for the near future is to keep a real close look on some punks: The Spark Speeders, and the... the Loosey Boozers... Pfft. Their races have been gettin' wilder and wilder, and it's time we did somethin' about it. Heheh, that name tickled my funny bone...

feeling5.line: Hell yeah, Partner, gimme five! Bangin' job on completing the mission! ...Click! Heh! You can't get away from me now that we're cuffed together! ...Huh? We don't have the key? Heehee, well, then we'll just spend the rest of our lives chained together!

headtouch.line: Hey, take it easy. I'll take off my hat so ya can pat my head all ya want.

home.line: Nice, nice! You did some damn good work today. Hop on and I'll drive ya back home. And don't worry – it's a movie prop, sure, but I AM licensed to drive it!

login.line: You're here early, Commander! Let's go for a ride before the shooting starts. Remember to hold on tight to me, and don't let the high speeds freak ya out.

main1.line: Take these gloves, Partner. The two of us'll bring back peace to the port's streets! ...Heh, me talkin' all seriously for once must be a nice change of pace for ya.

main2.line: I'm not 'boutta lose in a race to some punks off the street! C'mon, get on, Partner! We're gonna show 'em how committed we are to maintaining road safety!

main3.line: All streets bow to the king that is road safety! Whenever you're chasin' down thugs, remember to stay safe, Partner!

touch.line: Pretty tight fit, ain't it? Makes me look like a real true and blue cop.

touch2.line: Heehee, real bold – you askin' to be put in cuffs?

unlock.line: There ya are, Partner! I'm tellin' ya, these punks running around the port are getting bolder and bolder. It's time someone cracked down on 'em! Anyway, I'll handle this stuff like usual – you go and do your thing, Partner.

battle.line: There's nothing to worry about. Just take it easy.

couple_encourage1.line: There's no escaping the wolfpack!

couple_encourage2.line: Yeah, that's it! Draw the enemy closer!

detail.line: I think it's good for a submarine to act a bit more mysterious. Wouldn't you agree, Commander?

expedition.line: The commission team has come back in one piece. That's nice to see.

feeling1.line: I just don't know what to do with inconsiderate jerks like you.

feeling2.line: A submarine must be slippery, elusive. You know, an unknown threat lurking beneath the surface. Hehehe...

feeling3.line: Patience is the most valuable trait a submarine can have. What lengths would you go, how long would you wait for someone dear to you, Commander? Hehehe~

feeling4.line: I've got someone on the hook. What do I mean by that? You'll have to wait to find out. That's part of what being patient is about.

feeling5.line: Why don't we start dating, Commander? ...What's this out of the blue? I've taken my sweet time preparing, and this is the time to strike! Hehehe, now give yourself to me~♡

home.line: Haste makes waste. Take it easy, yeah?

hp_warning.line: No more playing nice...!

login.line: Oh, you're back. Ready to start chipping away at this mountain of paperwork?

lose.line: There's no turning this battle around... We should probably retreat.

mail.line: Letting your mail pile up just to read through it all at once might feel rewarding, but it's not very productive.

main1.line: Sauerkraut juice is a great pick-me-up. Give it a try and see for yourself.

main2.line: Penelope? Oh right, she works here too. Take good care of her, you hear?

main3.line: You can't figure out what that report says? Let me see... What, I'm too close to you? Hmm... Well, my bad~

mission.line: Do you find it thrilling to put off your missions until the last minute?

mission_complete.line: Accomplishing a mission can be the reward in and of itself. Receiving tangible things is a nice bonus, though.

profile.line: For an Iron Blood "wolf," I don't have much to boast about. I went on a few patrols and the odd rescue mission, but that's about it... I just wish my career would've ended out at sea instead of docked at port.

propose.line: Ooh, I see you've been preparing something of your own. So, have you made your mind? You'll live the rest of your days happily with me? ...Great, then we're all set♪

touch.line: Just give me the signal when you wanna slack off. Hehehe~

touch2.line: Are you saying you find my body "too good to pass up?"

unlock.line: Formally, I'm the Type VIIC submarine U-410. But you, Commander, can call me whatever resonates with your heart. You heard that right: just let your heart decide. Hehehe~

upgrade.line: Bolstering your combat abilities is always a good move.

win_mvp.line: You'll need to do better than that, my surface ship friends.

gift_prefer.line: I'm a little curious how long you agonized over this gift.

detail.line: Can't think of a good present? Hmm. Might I suggest a handwritten letter? I think that gets your feelings across pretty well.

home.line: Take it nice and easy. No point stressing out on a holiday.

login.line: While there's no huge stack of paperwork awaiting you, there's no shortage of other things we need to do.

main1.line: We were playing hide-and-seek earlier, and get this: U-81 hid herself inside a snowman. That girl is on a completely different level.

main2.line: I wonder what Penelope's up to... I might just go and check.

main3.line: It's really hard to hang these up on my own. Would you let me ride your shoulders, Commander?

touch.line: Is this your idea of a New Year's gift?

touch2.line: Whoa there. A little too excited from all the festivities, aren't we?

unlock.line: Happy Lunar New Year. Have you cooked up a scheme for this year's festival? Hehehe~ I'm of course talking about giving out New Year's gifts and hanging up decorations. I've devised a master plan of my own.

headtouch.line: Thanks for the backing, Commander.

home.line: Did my cheerleading before the sortie do its job?

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Are you ready to practice with me?

main1.line: As long as you know someone is rooting for you, be it through cheerleading or whatever, you'll perform better than you would otherwise.

main2.line: Keep it up! Keep it up! Coooommander! Heheh! How was that? Do you at least feel a little supported? ...You don't want it look like you're staring? Oh, sorry about that♡

main3.line: You want me to do a peppy holler and hoot? I... Yeah, I dunno about that...

touch.line: Oh, so my cheerleading is "distracting" you, is it?

unlock.line: And for my finishing move... maybe something like this? Heehee. What do your eyes think, Commander?

win_mvp.line: Aren't I supposed to be cheerleading, not taking the lead? Heehee.

battle.line: Now's my time to shine!

couple_encourage1.line: The wolfpack rides into battle on their riggings!

detail.line: The manual for this industrial-grade AC says... Hmm. Let's just skip to pushing this big red button... Oh no, what's happening?! How do I turn it off?!

expedition.line: The commission team is back! I'll go say hi!

feeling1.line: You'll have to become a saint if you want my forgiveness! To start with... Lemme think... Okay, first of all, you've gotta get on everyone's good side.

feeling2.line: I don't understand this instruction manual! But that's okay, I'll just go with my gut until I figure it out!

feeling3.line: If only I had a button that autocompleted one day's work. If I did, I'd press it for you every single day... No, don't be greedy, Commander! One press a day is all you'd get!

feeling4.line: Remember how you said we'd do something together next time you're free? You don't? Hrmph... You definitely did, though! Whatever, we're doing it now! We're going surfing!

feeling5.line: Commander, would you mind if we did... everything together? You know, working, eating, swimming, napping... Everything! Please? ...Wahoo!

headtouch.line: There's no button on my forehead, so stop that!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Hmm... Wouldn't it be nice if we could just push a button to open your office door remotely?

hp_warning.line: Ow, ow, ow! Stop hitting me!

login.line: Hi, Commander! What are we doing today? I'm fired up and ready to do some work!

lose.line: Oh fudge! I'm gonna push the emergency resurface button! They're not watching me, are they?!

mail.line: You've got new mail! I'll open it for y– Oh... I guess should've asked you for permission first...

main1.line: Can I push this button? ...No? What about this one? Also no? Laaame...

main2.line: Oh, someone's at the door! Hello? Who is it? ...Huh? There's nobody here? Maybe I was just hearing things...

main3.line: Your documents are printed and good to go! ...The cover and back are swapped around? Oops, uh... I'll go look for the manual...

mission.line: Oh geez, so many missions... I'll help you with them so we have more time to play later! Let's go!

mission_complete.line: I heard you finished a mission! That means more time for us to hang out, right? Hehehe~

profile.line: You've heard about Iron Blood's wolfpacks, right? Guess what: I'm a wolf, too! Or I was, until the day I had a little accident... Wait, no, forget I even said that! I'm still a deadly predator! Keep your expectations high for me!

propose.line: Hehehe~ I'm so happy right now I can't even think straight! I could just fall right into your arms! You make me feel like the happiest girl in the world! Hehehehe~

touch.line: Out of things to do, Commander? Then it's time to have fun with me!

touch2.line: Huh? Are you having dirty thoughts right now?

unlock.line: Commander! Yeah, you! Get back here! You're supposed to greet me! Listen up, I'm the Iron Blood submarine U-1206, and I'll be serving here starting today! And don't forget next time!

upgrade.line: My intuition just got keener!

win_mvp.line: We did it! Wait, shouldn't I get some sort of prize for being the MVP?

gift_prefer.line: Whoa! This looks really fun!

detail_ex.line: Okay, so... I'm meant to press this blue button instead of the red one on the AC... Achoo! Aww, dang it... I pressed the red one without even thinking about it!

feeling5_ex.line: Commander! Do you have time right now? Then come play with me! I remember you saying you would! Oh, we're gonna have so, sooo much fun later!

headtouch_ex.line: Hehehe, I like this!

home_ex.line: Open sesame! Kidding~ I'll just open the door like normal for you!

login_ex.line: Hey, Commander! We're gonna hang out again after work is over, remember that!

main1_ex.line: I've got an idea! Hehehe, lemme just push this button... There we go! Fan's on now! Enjoy that cool air!

main3_ex.line: Your documents are printed and good to go! I made sure to read the instructions this time! ...Agh, the text is on both sides of the paper! How'd this happen?!

main4_ex.line: I've got an idea! Hehehe, lemme just push this button... There we go! Fan's on now! Enjoy that cool air!

main6_ex.line: Your documents are printed and good to go! I made sure to read the instructions this time! ...Agh, the text is on both sides of the paper! How'd this happen?!

mail_ex.line: You've got new mail! I'll open it for y– Phew. I nearly did it again... Here you are! Your unopened mail!

touch_ex.line: It's always you touching me! Let me touch you for once!

touch2_ex.line: Hehehe~ Don't be shy~

win_mvp_ex.line: Victory! Hehehe! We did it, Commander!

detail.line: Is this a soda fountain? Guess I just press the button to make drinks come out! Clickity! ...Oh shoot! I forgot to put a cup down first!

expedition.line: The commission girls are back in port! I'll start prepping some drinks!

home.line: Hehehe~ Wouldn't you say I deserve a tip for my top-tier service?

login.line: Welcome inside, Commander! Will it be coffee or milk tea? Or maybe... a little pick-me-up?

main1.line: Elbe! Need a hand with serving all these drinks? I'll help!

main2.line: We're offering a special deal: one-on-one chat time with a maid! Completely free of charge!

main3.line: The service button? Sure, I'll press it right– Wait, I'm dumb! That means a customer's calling for me!

touch.line: I hope you're not trying to ogle me like a perv!

touch2.line: It's NOT okay to wanna do p-pervy stuff to maids!

unlock.line: Welcome! Oh, Hey, Commander! Heheh, so how do you like my maid getup? Looks pretty nice, if I do say so myself!

battle.line: Heheh! You're getting no mercy from me!

detail.line: It's time for your security check! You can never be too sure when it comes to these things. Hold still, now. I'm gonna give you a full-body search!

expedition.line: Oh, the commission team is back. Let's head out and meet them together! That way you can do your thing, and I can keep you in my sight.

feeling1.line: I feel like taking a leave from being your personal bodyguard.

feeling2.line: What kind of hair do you like? Twin ponytails? Straight and long? Or maybe side ponytails like mine are your favorite?

feeling3.line: You don't know what this is? It's able to capture any and all sound in your quarters and your office. It's essential to ensuring your safety!

feeling4.line: Y'know, I picked up you saying some weird things in your sleep. Wanna know what? Give me a nice hug and I'll tell you♪

feeling5.line: I've got plenty of strengths as it stands, but maaaybe I could stand to be a little more mature. You don't think so? Ahah! I see, I see. I'm in your strike zone, is what you're saying. I knew you had an eye for quality, Commander♪

headtouch.line: Heeey, you can't be content with JUST a headpat. You wanna go further, don'tcha?

home.line: Welcome back. You sit over there and I'll go lock the door! Hm? Why lock the door? It's to keep you safe, duh!

hp_warning.line: Oookay, this is getting dodgy...

login.line: Hey, you're here! Hold still for a sec. I'm gonna give you a smell check, then a patdown... Alright, looks like nobody's wiretapped you.

lose.line: H-hey! Didn't they use weapons that're against the rules?!

mail.line: Check complete. Your letter is perfectly safe! Buuut, I had to confiscate a few ones that came in suspicious pink envelopes♪

main1.line: Yup, there're shifty girls trying to approach you alright. But that's no biggie. I'll keep my eyes on you and make sure nobody pulls anything on you!

main2.line: Hold it, Commander! Stay right there! *sniff sniff*... Hmm. You've got a smell on you – but whose? Ahah! It's just mine!

main3.line: For a while now, I've been feeling lazy during the day but then full of energy come nighttime. I should pick up the night shift... and keep you safe from right by your bedside♪

mission.line: Oh, Commander, you've got unfinished missions. Before you ask – of course I'll help!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Want a reward? Or would you rather have me?

profile.line: Name's U-31. I'm an Iron Blood VIIA-type submarine. Fighting and ensuring your safety are my middle names! Let me be your personal bodyguard for now. I'll keep any shifty girls at arm's length from you!

propose.line: The time is finally here. I've been holding myself back for so long! Heehee. I've been pondering ways to pop the question, only for you to get to the finish line first! Gosh, I'm so happy I can't think straight. You'll just have to take the lead and do as you please♡

skill.line: Sink to the bottom of the sea!

touch.line: Is this a sign, asking for your daily security check?

touch2.line: You best not be thinking anything rude like, "I wish they were bigger"!

unlock.line: Ahah! You must be that "Commander," right? I felt all fidgety inside the moment I saw you. You and I are gonna be SUCH close friends♡

upgrade.line: I've gotten even stronger! And I couldn't have done it without your guidance.

win_mvp.line: Woe is me for being so dang strong!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! You mean I can really have this? Hooray! I'll give you a special reward tonight~

feeling5_ex.line: Hey, which would you choose between plain milk and chocolate milk? It's gotta be chocolate milk, right? Ahah! Chocolate milk is just like me – titillating, multi-layered, and rich... Do you want a taste?

headtouch_ex.line: Heheh! Come closer if you wanna!

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Go on and get comfortable. Don't worry, I'll make sure nobody interrupts me for– I mean, interrupts YOU for a while♪

login_ex.line: *sniff sniff*... *sniff sniff*... Heheh. Once again, my odor is the only one I smell on you. Good to know you didn't get caught up in any "risky" business.

main4_ex.line: Hmm? Well, yeah, I'm clinging to you because I'm your bodyguard! If that makes it hard to walk, so be it! I've got to be ready to protect you from every which way♪

main5_ex.line: Commander, time for a surprise inspection! Let me check if your phone's been wiretapped. Alrighty... There, I set our selfie together as your wallpaper!

main6_ex.line: Heehee. I've already sent all those ne'er-do-wells packing. Use this opportunity to give me a biiig hug!

touch_ex.line: What's up? Do you want a hug?

touch2_ex.line: Eek! G-gosh, THAT was exciting...

feeling5.line: It's not easy, chasing off naughty girls who wanna mess with you while also attending classes every day. I wanna stay here and relax for a bit before we head home. You don't mind, do you? Think of it as a reward for my hard work!

headtouch.line: Mmh! Heehee. Keep going if you wanna.

home.line: This is a cozy little spot. You oughta come lie down if you're feeling tired. There's no rush for us to get home, y'know.

login.line: Maaan, you know how to keep a girl waiting! Make it up to me by fanning me. I wanna cool off a bit.

main1.line: Ahah! You look like you're about to pass out! Want some candy to wake you up? Right in your mouth, like... this! Pretty sweet, huh?

main2.line: Man, it's kinda hot in here. I suppose they do they turn off the AC after classes are over... Anyhoo, it's just you and me now – you don't HAVE to keep your coat on, just so you know.

main3.line: Try and guess what flavor this candy is. Get it right, and I might give you a "treat." Ahah! Don't act like you don't know what I mean by "treat."

touch.line: Mgh... Want me to shift over a bit?

touch2.line: Do you like the way I look?

unlock.line: Why I didn't leave after classes were over? 'Cause I wanted to wait for you to come pick me up, duh! And I waited a looong time! Heehee, now that we're alone... maybe we could do something fun together!

battle.line: Wait, I'm the flagship? I don't like the responsibility, so let's get this over with!

couple_encourage1.line: I wanna get this done quickly so we can take it easy!

couple_encourage2.line: Heh! The wolfpack comes when you least expect it!

detail.line: Whenever you wanna raise efficiency or save energy, I'm your girl. I can even teach you my tricks to recharge your batteries in a flash.

expedition.line: Commander, a commission's done. I'll hold the fort while you go and collect the stuff.

feeling1.line: Ugh... So tiring. Seriously, working with you is exhausting. Since I don't even get basic time to kick back, I'm gonna have to reconsider this job.

feeling2.line: You've got an interesting work ethic, Commander. Could be more efficient, but hey. Teaching you my energy-saving method would be too much work, so it's fine the way things are now.

feeling3.line: I recently realized that I get less time to unwind after working with you... What's weird is it makes me tired, but I'm fine with it. Pretty novel feeling for me. I'll have to read up about this!

feeling4.line: Here, I made you some hot chocolate... Hm? Tastes sweet? Yeah, I added some syrup I've been reading about... Ah, never mind the deets! I just took some measures to efficiently replenish your energy 'cause you looked drained.

feeling5.line: I thought being in love would take too much time and effort to be worth it. With you, though, I don't think that at all. If anything, I naturally feel like giving even more to you.

headtouch.line: Mmh... Your hand is so nice and warm.

home.line: Mission complete. Just in the nick of time. 'Kay, so, let's go find a sunny place and have a little break.

hp_warning.line: Dammit... Let my guard down... but I'm still in the game!

login.line: Whew. Nice work. Man, I really gotta find a cozier place to lie down than the bottom of the sea. Mmgh...

lose.line: Hmm. Can't afford to get too sloppy, eh. I'll take it a little more seriously next time. Dealing with the aftermath sucks, and I'd hate to make you do that, Commander.

mail.line: Commander, new letter's here. I'm only gonna notify you about this once since it's such a chore.

main1.line: Commander, your office couch is placed perfectly for me to take a nap in the warm sunlight. Mind if I borrow it? It won't interfere with your work, promise!

main2.line: Check out this best desserts list I just found. This pudding looks like the perfect thing for recharging my batteries. Will you buy some for me? In exchange, I'll do some good work... for five minutes.

main3.line: Your working efficiency still stands to be improved. I mean, look, you could change your schedule to this and free up an hour for rest. A healthy work ethic ensures long-term combat ability, you know?

mission.line: Yo, Commander, you've got a boatload of unfinished missions. It's a lot of effort, I know, but someone's gotta do 'em before things get real bad.

mission_complete.line: Not in a rush to collect those mission rewards, huh? Looks like we're both the laid-back type.

profile.line: I was part of all kinds of operations, and that busy bee lifestyle just wasn't for me. That's why I'll be taking things at my own speed at this port. I'm gonna rest when I want to and wrap things up quickly when I gotta fight. The perfect, comfy rhythm of life!

propose.line: Hm? Wedding? Man, formal occasions are such a chore... Eh, it's a vow shared with you, so I'll take it seriously. Let me be with you, now and forever.

skill.line: This is how you fight in power-saving mode!

touch.line: Hey, I'm in a comfy spot here, so don't ruin it for me.

touch2.line: C-Commander?! Don't do that while I'm resting!

unlock.line: *yawn*... Guess it's work day again. Or maybe you and I can skip work together. Either way, gimme your orders.

upgrade.line: Hmm. Feels like I'm lighter on my feet.

win_mvp.line: Heh! Did you see that? My fighting skills are outta this world.

gift_prefer.line: Hm? You bought this just for me? Wow... You remembered just what I like.

detail_ex.line: I'm a pro when it comes to saving energy, but I have tons of it to spend just on you. Don't go around telling people that, though.

feeling5_ex.line: Did you know that my favorite part of the day isn't naptime, but rather the time I spend staring while you work? As much as I think you need to ease off, seeing you in action always moves my heart.

headtouch_ex.line: Hey. You said you'd let me rest today... Then again, your hands are really warm. I guess you could keep going for just a little while.

home_ex.line: I'm getting some solid work done, aren't I? It's cause I'm doing it in the most efficient way. Anyway, as a reward, let me rest on your shoulder!

login_ex.line: Whew. Perfect timing, Commander. I just found a sweet place to lie down. Wanna go there with me? It's way more refreshing than coffee, I guarantee it.

main4_ex.line: I moved your couch so the sun can shine on us both. Come here and we'll have a relaxing afternoon together.

main5_ex.line: Were you spying on me sleeping AGAIN? Heh. If you're tired, just say it. I can give you a lap pillow at least every once in a while.

main6_ex.line: I've been feeling so incredibly at ease when you're around lately. It's probably 'cause... Never mind. It's too embarrassing to say out loud!

touch_ex.line: Commander, you wanna get lazy with me?

touch2_ex.line: Commander, I know we're an item, but... you know, it's just... Like, at least... Hey! That's not what I'm getting at!

feeling5.line: I may not look it, but I'm overjoyed to be in the same play as you. Although, playing a secret agent pretending to be a tour guide... Ugh. It's so much work. At least you're covering for me, so all my hard work feels worth it. Hey, what do you say we... go on a real date next time?

headtouch.line: Ahem. Pardon me, I'm supposed to be working right now...

home.line: It's finally over... Having to act like this is so exhausting. I guess it's not so bad if you think of this like a special date between you and me. I still want a more laid-back role next time, though.

login.line: Hello and welcome aboard our sightseeing bus. Today, we'll be... Ugh. I've had enough. No one's here yet anyway, so can't we just keep it real? This "trip" is gonna get interesting soon.

mail.line: Dear passenger, the latest edition of Tourist's Digest is here. I've sorted it for you, putting the most important destination info at the very top.

main1.line: This uniform sucks... Just gotta bear with it so I don't get found out. Hey, do you think I look like a proper tour guide?

main2.line: The next stop is... Psst, I'll take you to that secret base before they catch on to us. But first, want some sweets?

main3.line: Are you still thinking about the script? Hmm... You could add a scene with some chemistry between the tour guide and the customer. I think it'll make the "trip" more natural.

mission.line: Pardon me, but you can't put your feet up yet. You still have missions to be focusing on, no?

mission_complete.line: Oh, you finished a mission? Great, but my mission's still ongoing.

touch.line: Mmh... This uniform doesn't fit right... Dear passenger, this is not the time or place for this!

touch2.line: C-Commander! You can't do that now! ...Hey, cut it out!

unlock.line: Ahem... Excuse me, since you've come aboard on our special sightseeing tour, please do try to keep up with me. Rest assured, this bus is perfectly safe and I can promise you a good time.

battle.line: Silence spreads...

detail.line: My audio library has all of the sounds I've collected... and some of my own. You can listen any time you want... [I recorded them just for you~ o(*//▿//*)q]

expedition.line: The sound of the homecoming horn... Should I go with you to record your reunion?

feeling1.line: U-umm... I prefer to be alone... [<(_ _)>]

feeling2.line: Commander... Talk more, please? [Voice capture progress: 25%! >w<]

feeling3.line: Sometimes... I hear whale song... It's such a rare thing, but none of it compares to your voice, Commander... I must record more... [o(*//▿//*)q]

feeling4.line: Commander, this track is corrupted... Twenty-four seconds of it are blank now. When I can't hear your voice, time feels ever so slow... [っ ̯ -。]

feeling5.line: Listen... Your greetings, idle chatter, commands, and even your heartbeat and breathing... All of my world is filled entirely with you... [o(*//▿//*)q]

headtouch.line: Mm... More... Mooore... [o(*//▿//*)q]

home.line: Good work today, Commander... I recorded something while I was waiting. [The sound of the waves! >w<]

hp_warning.line: Oww... I got hurt...

login.line: I'm happy... to see you again. Oh. Here's a note... [Can I record the sound of you breathing, please? >w<]

lose.line: Bawww... [っ ̯ -。]

mail.line: I canceled out all that extra noise, Commander... [Time to check your mail! >w<]

main1.line: Commander, I heard you yawn just now... Did you not sleep well last night? If so, umm... [Can I sleep with you? o(*//▿//*)q]

main2.line: Commander, what sounds will you make for me today...? [>w<]

main3.line: Do you like this melody? Then stay here... and listen to my song.

main4.line: Am I recording? Yeah, I am... I got the sound of you breathing... [(o°▿°)o]

mission.line: Mm... Missions... [Hurry! ☆(>o<)]

mission_complete.line: Rewards... What do you want, Commander? [A day with me, maybe?! >w<]

profile.line: I'm known as U-2501, Iron Blood's blade of the deep... I was born to bring new tactics to life. Let me dedicate all that I am... to you.

propose.line: Yes... [I do!] From now on, even the shared silence between us... will be all mine. Nobody can ever erase it... It'll be safe forever.

touch.line: Mmm... My heart is pounding... [o(*//▿//*)q]

touch2.line: Nnh... It's going to capture my voice, too... [Recording permissions not unlocked yet! o(*//▿//*)q]

unlock.line: Commander... I'm U-2501. I'm recording the audio of our first meeting... to be an important part of my collection. Here's a note for you... [I'm really happy to meet you, Commander! >w<]

upgrade.line: My audio library grows... [>w<]

win_mvp.line: Do you... like the sounds of victory?

gift_prefer.line: Thank you... [I looove it! >w<]

detail_ex.line: Hum hum♪... Are you enchanted by my voice, Commander? [>w<]

feeling5_ex.line: I was so used to silence, the depths, and solitude... until I heard your voice. It's given me something incredible, like I've never had before... [o(*//▿//*)q]

headtouch_ex.line: Your heart is beating really fast... Do you like me? [I love you, too! o(*//▿//*)q]

home_ex.line: Commander, I missed you... My recording will prove it... [Oh, I'm too embarrassed! o(*//▿//*)q]

login_ex.line: I wanna hear you greet me, Commander... [o(*//▿//*)q]

main5_ex.line: The sound of the rain drowns out noise, so we can do whatever we want... [o(*//▿//*)q]

main6_ex.line: Hush. I'm the only other person here... Can you hear it? Our heartbeats are united...

main7_ex.line: Mm, you can be rougher... Squeeze and hold on tight... [Now it's perfect! >w<]

main8_ex.line: Commander... May I lose myself in your voice? [o(*//▿//*)q]

mission_ex.line: Commander, it's time to get to work... [>w<]

mission_complete_ex.line: Mm... Wanna check your rewards for yourself?

touch_ex.line: Mm... You can keep going... [I love it! o(*//▿//*)q]

touch2_ex.line: Mm... Hngh... D-don't record this...

win_mvp_ex.line: Say it again... Tell me I did a good job again... [>w<]

feeling5.line: This curtain of water may blur the scenery... but it makes sounds even clearer for me... Close your eyes, open your ears. Listen to the sound of the water parting... and my heart beating just for you... [o(*//▿//*)q]

headtouch.line: Since you're here... I won't have to worry about my hair getting caught while I change clothes... [>w<]

home.line: I hear the sounds of the sea, sun, and wind coming from you... Come closer and let me help you get changed... [☆(>o<)]

login.line: Hum hum♪... Hmm? Commander... Would you like to listen to the water with me?

main1.line: Hush. The sound of the water... and your stifled breathing... I've got it now.

main2.line: Commander... Treasures don't normally surface on their own, but this time, I'll make an exception for you... [o(*//▿//*)q]

main3.line: The water is chilly, but your hands are warm... Hold me. [Hold me suuuper tight! >w<]

main4.line: Commander, are you more focused on the water curtain... or the sound of my heart? [o(*//▿//*)q]

mission.line: I-it's time... We'd better get to business soon... [o(*//▿//*)q]

mission_complete.line: You can claim your rewards... however you like, Commander... [o(*//▿//*)q]

touch.line: Did I not put this on right...? [☆(>o<)]

touch2.line: Mmm... Your hand reached me... Phew...

unlock.line: Commander, I'm changing clothes... You don't have to look away. Open up the curtain of water, and I'm right here... [o(*//▿//*)q]

detail.line: I'm SO returning these kitties to Akashi... Although, I'd feel really guilty if I did that... Ugh, what's a girl to do...

home.line: Don't forget to keep your dorms nice and stocked up... Just like these kitties...

login.line: How tiring... I should go take a break now. I'll have to check if Z26 and the others did their homework later...

main1.line: Hey, Z28! Stop treating the Meowfficers like pets! Look, I know they seem like pets in more ways than one!

main2.line: Javelin and her friends aren't too keen about coffee. Heh, that proves that they're still just kids.

main3.line: So that's where you're hiding! Gotcha! ...What? I'm totally not wasting time playing hide-and-seek with the U-boats!

touch.line: Commander, would you like something to drink?

touch2.line: Wh-what are you trying to do?!

unlock.line: *sigh*... Taking care of Meowfficers is more work than you'd think... They're awfully needy for support units. Commander, make absolute sure you don't turn out like them.

win_mvp.line: Whether in battles or in missions or in studies, diligence begets success!

battle.line: Let's zone in, everyone!

detail.line: You need a lot of money, whether you're trying to reforge your gear or buying a new set... How am I supposed to get that much gold anyway...?

expedition.line: The commission rewards seem to have come in. Not that it'll solve this problem though...

home.line: W-welcome back... I'm still trying to get back what I lost... Sorry... Ugh, I can't let myself cry over this!

login.line: *sigh*... I knew I should've made some extra preparations before chancing Akashi's upgrades...

lose.line: Ugh... What am I supposed to do with this kind of gear...

mail.line: New mail? I hope it's a quest invitation...

main1.line: I knew from the beginning that this might happen, but still... Ugh, I hope I'm not going to be a complete liability to the others...

main2.line: You think it'd be a good idea for me to class-change to Fighter? I mean... I'm not as flexible as Ayanami!

main3.line: My DEF stat is solid enough. Look, I have no problem fighting even in a swimsuit.

mission.line: Javelin, that quest might be a bit too tough. Wait, it's to cover my equipment costs...?

mission_complete.line: Jeez, Laffey! Don't accidentally set our rewards on fire!

touch.line: I'll have to head back to the Guild to pick up another quest...

touch2.line: Ugh... Why now of all times...?

unlock.line: N-no way... I lost the gear I worked so hard for because the upgrade failed, and now I'm completely out of gold... Ugh, I'm going to have to go farm the dungeon all over again...
