win_mvp.line: I have to work harder to get gold and farm up a new set of gear!

detail.line: Dress, ready. Hair, done. Accessories... all set. Hmm? I should be more relaxed? That won't do, Commander. If we're going to be dance partners, everything must be in perfect order!

expedition.line: Why don't we check on the status of our commissions before the dance?

headtouch.line: Commander... Do you realize how hard it is to style my hair like this?

home.line: We still have time before the dance. Let's take it easy and relax for a while, Commander.

login.line: It's almost time for the dance to start. Commander, are you ready? Leave it all to me today.

lose.line: Looks like I wasn't prepared enough... Aww...

mail.line: Look how many invitations you've gotten, Commander. Aren't you popular? Hehehe.

main1.line: Everyone's out there livening up the party. It's a little weird to read or work all alone, don't you think...?

main2.line: Is Javelin doing okay? During our last rehearsal together—Oh, I'm so worried. I'm gonna practice a little more!

main3.line: Dancing isn't something you can learn to do just from reading a book. You have to experience it yourself, and prepare for any problems that might arise. That's right– I've done everything I needed to in advance, and am ready for your invitation at any moment.

mission.line: Just for today, Commander, I don't mind you putting off your missions for a while.

mission_complete.line: This is... exactly what I'd expect from my Commander.

touch.line: Commander, would you like something to drink?

touch2.line: Th-this isn't something that a tactful person would do.

unlock.line: Sure, I've worn black dresses in the past, but this time I decided to incorporate a bit of red and white, per Eugen's suggestion. This is sure to invite the Commander to dance wi– C-Commander?! Did you just get here? I see. Uhh... How do you like my dress?

win_mvp.line: An invitation to dance? ...Sure, I'd be glad to! Heehee~♪

detail.line: My outfit? Javelin and the others picked it out for me. They said it would help me stay calm... Did I look more focused than usual just now? Y-you mean it?!

headtouch.line: Are you trying to comfort me? I-I'm fine! I'll have this mastered in no time!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Hm? You want to see my writing? G-give me a little longer! I'll get the hang of it soon!

login.line: Commander, I was just... Ahem! Getting used to using a brush, that's all! Now I'm getting serious!

lose.line: Ugh, this is hard... Maybe I should go back to the beginner's books.

main1.line: Huh? You think I'm cute when I'm practicing calligraphy...? Geez... The important part is what I'm writing, not me!

main2.line: Neat handwriting is essential... Want to join me, Commander? I'll grind up more ink, so sit down right here for me.

main3.line: The Emperians taught me that, if you can be calm and focused, the brush will naturally paint the image in your mind... Ah, dang it! Why did I draw you?!

mission.line: I can practice just fine on my own. Don't you think you should pay more attention to your unfinished tasks?

mission_complete.line: You finished your work? Umm... I'm almost done, too! I think.

touch.line: Oh, did I get this part wrong? Urgh... This is harder than I thought it would be.

touch2.line: You're gonna show me how to use a brush? W-wait... Where do you think you're putting that thing?!

unlock.line: Oh, Commander? Do you want to practice calligraphy with me? ...You think it looks more like drawing than writing? G-geez!

win_mvp.line: See? I told you I could write well!

battle.line: What are you all fighting for?

couple_encourage1.line: Stop running around, and stay by my side!

couple_encourage2.line: Remember, you can never be too careful on the battlefield.

couple_encourage3.line: Let's see those guts! Great! Just like that!

detail.line: Commander, what would you like to know?

expedition.line: Great, everyone returned home safely!

feeling1.line: Commander, it's bloomring season for the hawthorne I grew around the Bohai Gulf. Can we go back and take a look?

feeling2.line: Commander, we have to fight to protect the things we care about. This isn't really a question of personal preference.

feeling3.line: Even if the day comes when I am no longer needed on the battlefield, I still want to watch over the Bohai Sea. I want to always be able to see the waters, dyed a shimmering vermillion in the sunset.

feeling4.line: Commander, rest assured that wherever you go, I will be there to protect you. Huh? Isn't it obvious, you're mine after all...

feeling5.line: I'm so blessed to have met you, Commander. I've made so many friends and so many memories... Hey, Commander, once I complete my duty as one of the "Four Unbreakables," let's go travel around the world together!

home.line: Why don't you take a break? It's not good to be too stressed out.

hp_warning.line: Commander, concentrate and be extra careful!

login.line: Wow! Today's schedule looks packed. Let's work hard today!

lose.line: Everyone, regroup. We can't retreat like this!

mail.line: Commander, you have new mail. Should I unseal it for you?

main1.line: Woah, this is my first time seeing a battleship!

main2.line: Where did Fu Shun run off to? Would it really kill her to do as I say every now and then?

main3.line: My sisters - Fu Shun, Chang Chun, and Tai Yuan - are all my pride and joy!

mission.line: Protecting the peace isn't just about fighting - you'll have to do these missions too.

mission_complete.line: Keep up the effort, don't slack off just yet!

profile.line: I am the nameship of the An Shan-class destroyers, and one of the Dragon Empery's first-generation "Four Unbreakables." As the flagship, I participated in many naval exercises, carried out surveillance, and engaged in confrontations, leaving behind lasting achievements that I can be proud of. Though I never participated in live combat, I am the destroyer with the most miles under her belt in the entire world!

propose.line: Commander, my body and soul, all of my life, belongs to you from now on. Make sure to take responsibility properly.

skill.line: Let the protection of heaven surround the brave!

touch.line: Commander... Hehe~ doing this occasionally is not all that bad.

touch2.line: Hey-! My sisters are going to see us...

unlock.line: Destroyer, An Shan, reporting for duty! I shall protect my sisters and you, Commander!

upgrade.line: Now I'll be better equipped to deal with ruffians like De Haven...

win_mvp.line: Commander, being able to help you out is the greatest!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander. I wanted something just like this.

battle.line: Onward to a new battlefield!

detail.line: You put salty toppings into your milk tea? Even spicy things too? Th-that's heresy! You mustn't put anything into boba that would tarnish its flavor!

expedition.line: Who's over there? ...Oh, it's the commission fleet! They're back!

login.line: Commander, this time, can we take... a more scenic route back? It's okay? Ehehe, I thought you'd have some free time until the next thing on your schedule~

main1.line: I wonder how my sisters are doing... Oh, right... I've got to set that stuff aside when I'm with you.

main2.line: Commander, are you awake? Hehe, you look just like Gremyashchy when you're sleeping~♪

main3.line: Are you done with your drink already? Well, you can have some of mine– Wait, oh... Um, don't worry about it though! I'd hate for you to go thirsty! ...S-seriously, I don't mind...

mission_complete.line: You'll have to stay tuned if you want to see what the rewards are, Commander!

touch2.line: The sunset sure is beautiful, huh? Ahaha~

unlock.line: "Boundless is the beauty of evening's glow, but alas––" ...Oh, that doesn't have any special meaning, I've just been hanging around Hai Tien too much. (*whispers*) But, it's true... Our time together is far too short, just like the evening light...

win_mvp.line: Seize victory from the evening's light!

battle.line: I'll show you what an all-rounder is capable of!

detail.line: You want to know more about the four of us, huh? Fu Shun's a bit of a daredevil, Chang Chun has too many "great ideas," and Tai Yuan should really put herself out there a bit more. ...Hm? Me? Well... What do you think about me? Hehe~

home.line: Commander, if you're feeling run down, you've got to tell me.

login.line: There's a lot of work to get through today, but it's nothing the two of us together can't handle!

main1.line: nil

main2.line: Talking to the Gnevny-class girls really brings back old memories~

main3.line: Fu Shun isn't up to some mischief again, is she... Hmm, do you think I'm worrying a bit too much about my sisters?

touch.line: Ehehe~♪ Urk... No, no more of that! I'm gonna float off to cloud nine!

touch2.line: Eek! ...Th-this is going to be a bad influence on my sisters if they see us...

unlock.line: An Shan, retrofitting complete! With this new power, Commander, I'll protect both you and my sisters! But first... Umm, I need to double-check how these missiles work...!

win_mvp.line: S-sometimes, even I want to look cool in front of my sisters... Ahem! Forget I said that!

battle.line: Sis', it's not a drill this time!

couple_encourage1.line: I have nothing to fear as long as my big sister is here!

couple_encourage2.line: Tai Yuan, did you manage to learn it?

detail.line: Commander, if there's something you want to find out, I'd be glad to investigate with you~

expedition.line: All the stuff that I wanted? I brought them back with me. Uhh, this doesn't count as smuggling, right?

feeling1.line: Yikes! Chang Chun, Tai Yuan, Commander is coming!

feeling2.line: What's up, Commander? No no, I didn't break anything... Eh, all the windows in the academy broke? Uh... I think it's the doing of one of those evil spirits... probably?

feeling3.line: *slaps rocket* Commander, this bad boy will take you all the way over the sky. Isn't it a beaut? I made it myself. Coming down? Don't worry about that, Chang Chun and I will be there to catch you.

feeling4.line: Commander, good morning! Ehh, what was I doing last night? Why are you asking me? I didn't do anything bad! Your office looks like a werewolf got loose in it? No, no, it wasn't me. It was probably, uh, a werewolf!

feeling5.line: My secret base lies right over yonder. Pretty, huh? This is my most important secret! Eh? I just happened to tell you on a whim! I definitely wasn't planning anything.

home.line: Well then, let's continue investigating the mysteries of the port~ Chang Chun, you coming?

hp_warning.line: Tsk... Looks like I'll have to show them my final form!

login.line: Today's Fu Shun is all fired up and ready to go!

lose.line: Ugh... Sis'... where are you?

mail.line: It doesn't look important, so I won't bother Commander.

main1.line: If I give this to Tai Yuan, I'm sure she will be very happy!

main2.line: A ghost ship that emerges from the frozen waters of the Arctic at midnight? Certainly, I've heard this rumor before.

main3.line: Although Chang Chun is my younger sister, she has taught me a lot!

mission.line: Go forth and complete those quests!

mission_complete.line: Quest complete! There's a black smoke coming from the port? Are you sure, Commander? I don't see anything~

profile.line: The name's Fu Shun, second ship of the An Shan-class destroyers and one of the first-generation "Four Unbreakables." Rezkiy? That was my birth name. Even though I accomplished a lot, I unfortunately never experienced actual combat. The closest I got was that one time, when An Shan and I almost opened fire! Anyway, please let me fight to my heart's content on the battlefield!

propose.line: Commander, so we're a family now... Well then, can I borrow the keys to the warehouse? I'm begging you! Just for one day!

skill.line: Let the flames of heaven dazzle all in our way!

touch.line: Woah! Um... I just happened to be, uh, scratching my back! Yeah, I'm definitely not hiding anything!

touch2.line: Woah! Commander, are you frisking me? I'm not hiding anything!

unlock.line: Destroyer Fu Shun, reporting in! Uhh... where's Chang Chun? She was clearly behind me just a minute ago...

upgrade.line: My power level can keep going up!

win_mvp.line: Hehe~ this isn't even my final form!

gift_prefer.line: Hahaha! Imagine the things I could do with this!

battle.line: Nobody will care if we make a ruckus beating up on the enemy, right?

detail.line: "Mysteries of the Port – Case of the Disappearing Baozi!" ...How did rumors like that start circulating already?! Well done! ...I, I'll explain things to everyone later!

expedition.line: Looks like there was some all-purpose flour included in the rewards... Are the girls planning to make baozi skins from scratch?

home.line: Shh! An Shan is coming this way... If she finds out, it's game over for us!

login.line: Happy New Year, Commander! Wait, hold on a minute! How did you get up here without a ladder?!

main1.line: How am I going to get down from here? Please, these heights are nothing! Oh, actually, umm... Commander, I might need some help from you after we're all done here after all...

main2.line: Chang Chun shot me a glance just now... It's fine; given her personality, no chance she sells us out!

main3.line: Hahaha! Commander, this baozi is for you! Enjoy the taste of the spoils of victory! ...Huh? It's super spicy? How could that be? The one I grabbed isn't spicy at all...

touch.line: Wanna give it a try, Commander? Nothing's more fun than successfully pulling off a prank!

touch2.line: Wh-whooooa! If we fall off, our cover's gonna get blown!

unlock.line: Heh-hey! Just hooked us another baozi~! We're in for one heckuva haul today! ...Eh? Huh, Commander?! Th-this is, uhh... yeah, we're just playing a normal game... totally...

battle.line: Sic 'em all!

detail.line: Check it out! My new rigging looks sooo overpowered, doesn't it? Yeah, I agree!

feeling5.line: Commandeeer! Commander! I renovated my secret base! I even had a table and chairs custom-made for you! Come on, sit down! ...My secret base looks an awful lot like your office? Heheheh... That's good ghost story material right there! I dig it!

headtouch.line: Bet you think I've gotten stronger, too! Heehee!

home.line: Good timing, Commander! Now the port's whole mystery-solving gang has gathered!

hp_warning.line: Hmph! It'll take more than that to beat me!

login.line: Commander, tell me what my tasks are for today! I'll get 'em done in a jiffy then head out on an adventure!

lose.line: Nooo! They beat us, Commander! I'll get 'em next time, I swear!

main1.line: I heard they found the footprints of some kind of cryptid! I'm gonna go see what they– Hey, what are you doing? You didn't just notify An Shan, did you?!

main2.line: Heheh! With access to this much firepower, solving even the biggest mysteries will be a breeze!

main3.line: An Shan, Chang Chun, Tai Yuan, and you, my most treasured commander – I will protect you all!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! ...Huh? You just heard an explosion? ...Th-that was probably your fault!

touch.line: My outfit's changed a lot, don't you think? If I had to sum it up, I'd say it's gotten easier to adventure in!

touch2.line: Heeey! I told you I'm not hiding anything! There's a limit to how careful you should be!

unlock.line: Fu Shun – retrofitting complete! Reporting in! Commander, if something happens and you need someone reliable, I'm your girl!

win_mvp.line: Heheh! I return to you with victory in hand, Commander!

battle.line: Why must we... fight each other?

couple_encourage1.line: Understood, I'll intercept the enemy with everything I have!

couple_encourage2.line: Don't just flail around, if you get scared, just hide behind your big sis!

detail.line: I definitely am not hiding the stuff that Fu Shun secretly bought.

expedition.line: Commisson complete! Looks like someone has snacks for me!

feeling1.line: Commander... that's unacceptable...

feeling2.line: I heard that Prince Rupert's drops can be used to ward off the evil monsters that come out at night, so I told Fu Shun. The windows at the academy are gone? I-I have no idea what you're talking about~

feeling3.line: Hey Commander, how'd you get in here? Secret base? Ehehe~ I have no idea what you're talking about~ Oh, by the way, have you seen my snacks? W-wait, you can't eat that!

feeling4.line: Commander, the beach behind the academy is perfect for swimming. Uh, I wasn't making plans or anything! I was just playing around with my binoculars when I saw the swim ring that Commander had bought, ehehe~

feeling5.line: You want me to take off my cosplay? Ehehe~ I suppose I can, but you'll have to do what I say!

home.line: I'll help give everyone a massage! Pain, pain, fly away~

hp_warning.line: Now things are getting interesting~

login.line: Good morning, Commander~ Ehehe, looks like it's not even morning anymore though~

lose.line: Wow, I think I goofed up~

mail.line: New mail, huh? Seems like the perfect thickness to stick under this wobbly table.

main1.line: The four of us are authentic noblewomen, you know~

main2.line: During the summer, Tai Yuan will make a breezier version for me, so there's no problem.

main3.line: Fu Shun, I heard that terrifying monsters appear in the academy after the sun goes down.

mission.line: Missions... are also very important.

mission_complete.line: Next up is... Ehh? What's that burning smell coming from the warehouse? Ah, my snack...

profile.line: I am Chang Chun, the third ship of the Dragon Empery's An Shan-class destroyers, and one of the "Four Unbreakables." As one of the pillars of the Empery's navy, I played a pivotal role in the training of personnel. Eh? Fu Shun is getting into trouble again? An Shan is going to be worried...

propose.line: If you never leave my side, I can consider your request~ Just kidding! Your gullibility is a good thing though~

skill.line: Let the seven heavenly mansions align for the coming of the white tiger!

touch.line: Commander, if you like this outfit, I'll ask Tai Yuan to make a set for you as well.

touch2.line: Commander, is this the type of person that you are?

unlock.line: Destroyer Chang Chun has arrived~ No, I'm not afraid of the cold~ I just like being warm and cozy~

upgrade.line: When do I get missiles?

win_mvp.line: Clear skies and calm waters today as well~

gift_prefer.line: You're cute, Commander~

detail.line: Fu Shun said she's planning to blast apart an underwater volcano to turn the entire ocean into a hot spring... Thankfully, I don't think the water is getting any warmer~

login.line: A day's plan starts in the morning, a year's plan starts in the spring, and a life's plan with diligence. Commander, make sure to work hard, okay? I'll be cheering you on quietly from my dreams~

main1.line: Commander, An Shan and Fu Shun are making dumplings tonight. What kind of filling would you like?

main2.line: Commander, let me massage your shoulders~

main3.line: Fu Shun, do you still not have enough firecrackers? How would I know if this is enough to boil the entire sea?

touch.line: Tai Yuan has recently taken a liking to resting against me while reading. Commander, would you like to try it as well?

unlock.line: Ta-da! My pajamas are finally finished! Now to snuggle up until I'm all warm! Eh~ Ehhh? But sis, I don't want to get out! Ack, did Tai Yuan purposely make this tail big and thick to make it easier for you?

detail.line: Today, I'm a bunny, not a tiger. When the time is right, I can pull these big floofy ears over to cover my own ears~ But of course, they'll pop right off if you tug too hard.

expedition.line: Has the commission team returned? Want me to bring some baozi over to them? Oh right, I'll let you in to a little secret – I know how to tell between the regular kind and the super-spicy kind~

home.line: Hmm, we don't have very many of Fu Shun's super firecrackers left... Commander, got any interesting fireworks on you?

login.line: Commander, Happy New Year~! My next line is... got any red envelopes for me? Ehehe~

mail.line: Did we get new mail? Looks like a New Year's postcard came in too. Let's check it out, Commander!

main1.line: Fu Shun's always loved setting off firecrackers, but she wasn't there with that crowd this year. Heehee, do you want to know why, Commander?

main2.line: Please continue to look after An Shan this year as well. Oh, right, should I give you a little "assistance" in that regard? Heehee~

main3.line: Stremitelny's challenging me to a snowball fight? Hmm... I think I'll pass. Getting soaked in this outfit would be a huge pain in the butt...

mission.line: Hmm? You still have work during Lunar New Year? ...In that case, I'll give you the same mission that An Shan gave me: "Don't stay in your room through the entire holiday!"

mission_complete.line: All done with the mission? Then... wanna head back inside and chill?

touch.line: Feels great when you floof these ears, right? Tai Yuan was the one who made these. I'm glad I have such a resourceful little sister~

touch2.line: Eep! Cold! Stop bullying people, Commander!

unlock.line: Commander, hurry up and plug your ears! Th-this isn't a joke! Um... Seriously, that big ol' doozy over there is about to blow!

detail.line: If we were to put this into video game terms... It's like I just got epic SSR gear! That's why you can count on me even more, Commander!

home.line: Good job out there, Commander. Need me to do that "pain, pain, fly away" thing again?

login.line: Commander, y'know what they say about a day's plans starting in the morning, but that adage is probably true even if it isn't morning.

main1.line: Fu Shun, if An Shan finds out that you're making micromissiles, she's gonna be so pissed.

main2.line: Hmm... It does feel rather breezy behind my head without my hood...

main3.line: Missiles versus naval guns? Eh, there's no point comparing things from two different eras~

touch.line: My gear's not the only thing different about me! I've got a new look too! Heh~

touch2.line: Y'know, Commander... I always knew this was the kind of person you are...

unlock.line: All done with my retrofit~ Now, time to test out my new toys... Err, I mean, time to test the firepower of my new armaments! Oh, watch your head, Commander! Wouldn't want one of the missiles to lock onto you.

upgrade.line: Missiles, huh... I wonder if I'm stronger now.

battle.line: L-live combat... I have to do my best...

couple_encourage1.line: To help An Shan, I have to do my best...

couple_encourage2.line: Fu Shun, you're charging up too fas- Ahh!

detail.line: Fu Shun just asked me to tell her about the Philadelphia Experiment. Commander, would you like me to tell you about it too?

expedition.line: Eek! Someone came back... Oh, An Shan, I'm fine...

feeling1.line: An Shan, I... I'm a bit scared...

feeling2.line: Comm... Commander? Um, sorry, Chang Chun needs me for something right now!

feeling3.line: Commander, other than my sisters, you're my first friend. S-so, um, whatever you do, please do not get inside Fu Shun's home-made missile!

feeling4.line: Commander, are you in here? Eh? I'm not just walking around.. Um, I just got a little lonely... and wanted to see your face...

feeling5.line: Commander... even though I'm immature, I will work harder. So, um... please wait for me... Y-you'll be waiting for me to surpass my sisters? Th-thank you!

home.line: I can finally settle down. W-wait... Fu Shun, where are you dragging me off to?

hp_warning.line: Eh...? U-um... what should I do...

login.line: H-hey, Commander. I was too absorbed in reading that I lost track of the time...

lose.line: Um... as expected, I still have a long way to go...

mail.line: C-commander, there's new mail. Perhaps Fu Shun should... um, never mind...

main1.line: F-Frank Knox? I don't want to run into her again...

main2.line: An Shan is so hardworking... When can I be of help to her?

main3.line: What am I reading right now? "Miscellaneous Morsels from Youyang." Chang Chun gave it to me...

mission.line: This mission... looks quite difficult. Will we be able to do it?

mission_complete.line: D-does this mean I've matured a little?

profile.line: Um... I'm Tai Yuan, fourth ship of the An Shan-class and a first-generation member of the Dragon Empery's "Four Unbreakables." I originally was named "Ji Lin." My sisters and I were the mainstay of the Empery's navy for decades, serving in many operations and helping rebuild the strength of the navy. The "Nuclear Physics Hypothesis" is a very interesting book... It would be nice if my sisters liked it too...

propose.line: Thanks, Commander... Even though I'm still not very reliable, from now on, you can count on me!

skill.line: Let the heavens focus our minds, so we can adapt to any situation!

touch.line: Commander, what kind of books do you like to read?

touch2.line: W-w-woah... C-commander, please don't do that...

unlock.line: I... I'm Tai Yuan, a destroyer. Commander, have you seen my sisters?

upgrade.line: U-um... it's still a bit scary...

win_mvp.line: Um... is this good enough?

gift_prefer.line: C-can I really have it?

detail.line: Commander, did you know? The Dragon Empery has an ancient legend about the monster known as the "Nian." During the Spring Festival, every household will hang up couplets and set off firecrackers to ward it off.

feeling5.line: During the Spring Festival, relatives will all gather to celebrate a reunion. Th-this year, I'd like to have a reunion with my sisters and you, Commander... is that okay?

home.line: Ah, Commander, welcome back... I'm making a lantern... Would you mind helping me hang it up?

login.line: Fu Shun gets really excited around the Spring Festival, and will even drag Chang Chun and me around...

main1.line: F-Fu Shun, it... it's dangerous to take apart firecrackers like that... Eh? You're doing an experiment?

main2.line: This year's couplet... Um, Commander, can you help me brainstorm ideas?

main3.line: Chang Chun, it's a once-in-a-year occasion, it's not good to stay inside your room all day...

touch.line: I made this outfit myself. My sisters all said it looks good, ehehe...

touch2.line: C-commander... if you keep messing around, someone's going to get mad!

unlock.line: O-on behalf of the An Shan class, we wish a prosperous, happy, and healthy new year to Commander, and to everyone here at port... Umm... even though I made this outfit, I feel a bit embarrassed wearing it... Eh? It looks good on me? Um... th-thank you...

detail.line: Very comfy, very supportive, just the right size... Hmm, is this too casual for my report? What do you think, Commander?

feeling5.line: The closer we get... the louder my heart beats, and the hotter I feel... You think that's normal? O-okay... That's a relief.

headtouch.line: I'm still not sleepy. Let's chat for a little while!

home.line: Are you tired? If so, this is a good time to rest... U-umm, I think we might be a little too close...?

login.line: Zzzz... Hm? Commander... Ah, the bed and cushion are so soft that I fell right asleep...

main1.line: You can use this as a pillow or a cushion, so it's like two birds with one stone. Come and try it already!

main2.line: Commander, I read this book called The World Inside a Pillow. It's about a pillow that gives you good dreams... You want to know more? Okay, I'll tell you all about it!

main3.line: I made the pajamas and headband myself! Ah... You wanna get a closer look? O-okay! I'm just a little nervous, that's all...!

touch.line: Yeah, it feels really good to hug it like this~ You should try it... Hwuh?! I-I don't think I'm as huggable as the cushion...

touch2.line: Mmm... Hyah?! C-Commander, umm... Maybe not here...

unlock.line: Commander? Did Ting An tell you to try out this ergonomic cushion, too? Okay, I'll make room... There, okay! Come lie down with me!

battle.line: Allow me to demonstrate Xuanwu's true power!

detail.line: "To tread Xuanwu's path is to be as tough as steel yet flexible as grass." ––Therefore, to truly be strong requires not only physical prowess, but also a keen intellect. Would you agree, Commander?

feeling5.line: Now that I've some time to think things through, surpassing my sisters is only just the first step. Beyond that, the road ahead is incredibly long... Commander, will you walk with me to my next destination?

home.line: ...Phew, you're back safe and sound. What a relief.

login.line: Good morning, Commander. I'm ready to resolve any crisis with you.

main1.line: I may have acquired new equipment, but that's actually given me more things to be mindful of... Hmm? That's part of what it means to be thoughtful and contemplative? Hmm... what an enlightening point of view.

main2.line: As I am now, I surely have the power to fight alongside An Shan! My next goal is... Well, I'm still in the process of thinking about it!

main3.line: The more you know, the more things you have to be worried about... Hmm? Only confident people have the self-awareness to harbor such doubts? Ehehe~ Thank you for the encouragement.

touch2.line: Oh, wow... C-Commander, so this is what you were into after all...

unlock.line: Phew... Tai Yuan, retrofit complete. Thanks for supporting me this whole time, Commander. With this new equipment, I'll be able to get one step closer to catching up to my sisters.

upgrade.line: "A job well-done begins with the proper tools." ––A good first step, if I must say so myself!

win_mvp.line: Mm. A victory well within my calculations.

battle.line: Combat... calls for great firepower, just like cooking!

couple_encourage1.line: Would it kill ya to stop trying to drag me outside...

detail.line: Tips for stir-frying? You need high heat, and oil! That's how you get that rich, wok hei flavor!

expedition.line: The commission team is back, huh... I'll go prep a banquet. Everyone's gonna be able to eat to their heart's content.

feeling1.line: Commander... You have no appreciation for my cooking...

feeling2.line: Hungry? I've prepared osmanthus cake, roast duck, crawfish, pan-fried bao, and... Hmm? Where'd I get all this food? Uhh... just business as usual for me, you know?

feeling3.line: ...You really enjoyed my cooking? Oh, uh, thank you very much... Well then, um, would you like to try some other stuff? I have Buddha's Temptation, cabbage in supreme soup, and–– Huh? It's too much effort? For the important task of serving you, is this not completely appropriate?

feeling4.line: I can prepare any dish for you, seasoned any way you want it! I've always heard that cooking exists to bring joy to others, and I want to do my very best to make you happy!

feeling5.line: I've packed your lunch. Ehehe, you'll find a new surprise waiting for you. I made it just for you, based on your favorite ingredients and flavors–– It's super delicious? Phew, glad to hear that! Then, umm... would you mind if I made it for you every day~?

headtouch.line: H-how am I supposed to read the recipe like this...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander... Umm, are you hungry? ...You are, but you don't know what to eat? Then, how about a full course of the Eight Great Cuisines?!

hp_warning.line: Bweeeehhh! It's going to burn!!

login.line: ...Uhh, welcome? You wanna see today's menu? Here you go! Just lemme know if anything catches your eye! Recommendations? Uhh, I have so many specialties, I'll have to think about that one...

lose.line: Ugh... That was a bust... Was it because I wasn't able to adjust the heat properly?

mail.line: There's mail addressed to you, Commander. Don't forget to read it–– Hm, I wonder if we got any letters with recipes inside...

main1.line: ...Me, go on a vacation outdoors? Ehh... I think I'll pass. Not really interested in that... What AM I interested in, you ask? Researching recipes, of course! Recently, I've come across a method of making red-braised pork belly even more delicious! Wanna give it a try, Commander?

main2.line: Xiaolongbao with chocolate filling? Mapo tofu with strawberry jam?! ...Gaaaaah, I've had it! From now on, only people with business here are allowed inside the kitchen!

main3.line: ...You want to observe me while I cook? That's fine and all, but if you pull any funny business like Fu Shun... I'm being too strict? Nonsense! You're being too lax, Commander! The kitchen is a battlefield!

mission.line: We've got new work. Are you sure you want to leave it for later? Can you just take care of it now? I'll have dim sum waiting for you when you're done.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards are in. Don't forget to pick 'em up. As for what's inside... we'll probably be able to buy all sorts of fancy, high-end ingredients~♪

profile.line: Dragon Empery destroyer, Lung Wu. I'll pass on the fighting and paperwork stuff, but if you need anything food-related, just leave it to me! So, what's your favorite type of cooking? Grilling, frying, stir-frying, broiling, steaming? You name it, I'll cook it!

propose.line: Th-this is... Really?! G-give me a moment to get my thoughts straight... I mean, I can't do anything other than cook... *huff* *huff*... Alright, Commander... If you don't mind, I'll be in charge of all your meals from now on, and make sure everything is healthy and delicious!

skill.line: The quest for supreme flavor never ceases~

touch.line: Feeling peckish? I have spring rolls right here. That ought to fill you up a little bit.

touch2.line: ...Steamed, stir-fried, deep-fried, or pressure cooked. Take your pick.

unlock.line: The name's Lung Wu... Dragon Empery destroyer. Um... uhh... have you seen Hu Pen around? Also... which way is it to the kitchen?

upgrade.line: Did it work...? Mm, good... Oh! I've gotten even better at controlling the heat now!

win_mvp.line: We won...? Phew... Now, I'll be able to head back and research new recipes...

gift_prefer.line: Whoa! Is this for me? That's amazing!

feeling5_ex.line: ...Huh? You don't need me to make lunch for you for the time being? Wh-why?! Did you get tired of my cooking? ––Hmm? It's because you've been putting on too much weight? Phew... You had me scared for a moment there...

headtouch_ex.line: Commander, I'm not some little kid... Do you really like patting my head that much?

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! I've prepared a special homecoming feast for you! By the way, please try the new dishes I've been developing~♪

login_ex.line: You've kept me waiting! Even after I cooked all these dishes for you–– It's way too much? It's just going to go to waste since you can't finish it? Don't worry about that! I already have an idea in mind~

main4_ex.line: ...I'm tipsy? Nonsense... Uhh... I just ate some drunken crab, that's all... Also, Commander... aren't you hungry? I made... some mapo tofu, spicy boiled beef, and mala chicken... If that's not enough, I can also whip up a hotpot...

main5_ex.line: Ugh, didn't make enough rice... It's all because the food pairs too well with rice, and I inadvertently ended up wolfing down eight bowls... Huh? Commander?! Did you hear what I just said? ...Uhh, it's just because I didn't want to waste food, that's all!

main6_ex.line: You think I've been leaning too much into one type of cuisine? I suppose that's true... I don't usually take the initiative to cook Sichuan food since it's on the spicy side... Hm? The boiled beef I made earlier was really good? Huh, I don't seem to recall making that recently...

mail_ex.line: Commander, you've got new mail. Hmm... I took a quick glance, and yeah, it's a total wall of text... Yeah, I think I'll go make some dim sum instead~

mission_ex.line: You've got new missions. After you finish up, I'll whip you up something sweet as a reward. As for what specifically... You're fine with tangyuan, right?

mission_complete_ex.line: Done with your missions? Well done, Commander~ As promised, here's a bowl of fresh tangyuan~ ...Hmm, it's still piping hot, so let me cool it down for you first~♪

touch_ex.line: Do you like my tail? You think it's cute? Really? (*wags vigorously*)

touch2_ex.line: I'm not sure... this is the best place for that...

feeling5.line: Commander, on this special day of coming together as a family... You kept us company, and we enjoyed a delicious feast together and watched the fireworks... You have no idea how happy that makes me~♪

headtouch.line: Nngh... If my hair gets all messy, you'll be responsible for combing it back...

home.line: Welcome back! Want some tanghulu? Ning Hai and Ping Hai brought some over. They're really tasty~

login.line: Happy New Year, Commander. Hmm? Lucky money present for me? Thank you very much... That makes me very happy~♪

mail.line: So many messages... Are they all cards wishing you a happy new year?

main1.line: What in the world is this baozi?! The texture of the dough, the exquisite flavor of the filling! I hate to admit this, but it's better than what I can make! I, I need to research this later...!

main2.line: Commander, I hope everything goes well this coming year~ Ehehe. Please let me handle all of your daily meals as well. I'll make sure everything is delicious and healthy~♪

main3.line: Heehee~ I snuck into the kitchen earlier to make those spring rolls I put on your desk. ..Too spicy? Spicy is good! You're supposed to welcome the new year with a bang! Ugh, my head is spinning... Who swapped out all the cooking wine in the kitchen with Hua Tiao wine?

mission.line: New missions, huh? Let's work together to get things taken care of. The food's gonna go cold if we take too long.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Let's count up the rewards, then head back to enjoy a nice New Year feast!

touch.line: Hmm? Commander, want some baozi?

touch2.line: Commander... H-Hu Pen can still see us...

unlock.line: Happy New Year, Commander... Having that said, the others said they had a surprise for me, but then ended up banning me from the kitchen... I didn't do anything bad, did I? I'm real worried... Can't I at least take a look at what's going on there? Ugh... How about you go check it out in my stead? P-pretty please, Commander!

detail.line: I didn't think you'd invite me to go diving with you... Well, umm... the world beyond the kitchen is surprisingly fun... *blushes*

expedition.line: Looks like the commission team is coming back. Hrmm... I can't cook anything for them right now...

feeling5.line: For someone like me who spends all day in the kitchen, getting to see this beautiful aquatic landscape and these magnificent corals is such a rare experience... Thanks to you, my most, most, most beloved Commander... I, I was able to see something so wonderful...

headtouch.line: Commander, my hat's going to get washed away...

home.line: Hmm? You've been picking up the trash around here to help protect the coral reefs? Thanks for doing that! I'll treat you to some delicious food when we're back~♪

login.line: Commander, you're finally here! Let me help you adjust your diving mask!

main1.line: Please be considerate of the delicate ecosystem of the corals and all the other marine life, and don't go around touching things carelessly... Huh? Oh, um, it's something I learned while talking to the submarine girls.

main2.line: Since you're the one who invited me, I had to do my part and dress up a bit... Huh? I look c-cute? ...Oh, um... th-thank you... *blushes*

main3.line: To keep this ocean scenery as beautiful as always, let's do our best to clean up all the garbage! If we work at it enough, we might even be able to improve the environment one day!

touch.line: Eek... Commander, could you go grab my hat?

touch2.line: S-slowly, please... T-try not to bump into the corals, okay? *blushes*

unlock.line: Woah, the corals look so pretty as they swish and sway... There's a whole world of color underneath the sea... I can come visit again any time I'd like? Thank you so much, Commander!

win_mvp.line: We won! Phew... I hope I'll get to enjoy the ocean with Commander now...

battle.line: Hu Pen, charging straight ahead!

couple_encourage1.line: Lung Wu, let's do this together!

couple_encourage2.line: Twin tiger combo! Rooooar!

detail.line: Kitty Kabam Punch, at the ready! Huuuh? That name's already taken? Seriously, there are girls here with the same naming sense as me??

expedition.line: The commission team is back! Time to call up the kitchen!

feeling1.line: Hmph! Who are you calling grumpy? I'm not grumpy! ...Eh? You'll give me a stuffed tiger doll? Hooray! Thanks, Commander!

feeling2.line: Commander, have you heard the news? Apparently, the mold for the key to your office has been going around for quite some time! The other day, I saw... Hwuuuuh? When'd the wall grow freakin' ears?!

feeling3.line: Mwahaha... I know about all sorts of rumors, Commander~ What do you wanna hear about first? That one time I made a total mess of the kitchen? Sure, you got it–– Eeehhhh? Ehhhhhh?!

feeling4.line: "There are lots of talented girls at this port, so I should try learning from them"? I mean, you're not wrong, but a tiger's gonna do as a tiger pleases! Hehe, I'm sure you'll support me, won't you?

feeling5.line: Speaking of talented girls at the port... I'm definitely one of them! Commander, thanks for believing in me and supporting me! I'll continue to work even harder from here on out!

headtouch.line: Pat a tiger on the head, and nothin' but good fortune will follow you! Ehehe~

home.line: Welcome back~ I whipped up some snacks for you! Come on over and give 'em a taste!

hp_warning.line: Crap, that wasn't supposed to happen!

login.line: Quietly now, stealthily... Fwaaah! C-Commander, g-good morning! Just gettin' this out of the way, but I totally didn't oversleep, you hear?

lose.line: Oopsies... Looks like I goofed up a little... Teehee~☆

mail.line: I've got mail for you, Commander!

main1.line: Roooooar! When the tiger roars, forests shiver and mountains quake! ...Huh? I'm not a real tiger, and the only forest here is a few stalks of bamboo? Ehh, let's not sweat the small details. What matters most is the vibes!

main2.line: Lung Wu's a bit too obsessed with food, don'tcha think? Maybe I should go help give her a hand... Huh? What do you mean I'm too helpful for my own good?!

main3.line: Anyways! Here's the plan: I'm gonna help Lung Wu finish up her dishes, and then we're gonna go outside and play! You help as well, Commander!

main4.line: Why'd I go with Kitty Kabam Punch instead of Tiger Kabam Punch? Well, uhh, it doesn't roll off the tongue the same way...

mission.line: Horses might be respectable opponents, but there's nothin' respectable about horsing around on the job! That's why you've gotta finish your missions on time!

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards are in! Hurry up and go take a look!

profile.line: The name's Hu Pen, and I'm a member of the Dragon Empery's Lung Wu-class destroyers! This tiger can handle any task for you, no matter how trivial! ...Heehee~ What'd ya think? Did I come off as having the awesomeness of a tiger?

propose.line: Ehehe, I can tell that you're always helping me out! You're the only person who has the patience to sit down with me and teach me things over and over again... So that's why you're a super-important person to me!

touch.line: Oh, um, about that! Can you please keep that whole sleeping-in thing a secret from my sis? Thanks a million, Commander! You're the best~!

touch2.line: Woooah! ...Woaaaooaaaaoaaah!

unlock.line: Gooooood morning, Commander! I am Hu Pen of the Dragon Empery! Yeoooowch! Gah, just stubbed my freakin' toe...

upgrade.line: I'm freakin' awesome! Groooooar!

win_mvp.line: This tiger is strong! Grooar!

gift_prefer.line: Wooow! You can really tell what a tiger's thinking, huh, Commander?

detail_ex.line: Kitty Kabam Punch, Rev I, at the ready! ––Huh? Is there a Rev II? Ehehe, no idea!

feeling5_ex.line: There are lots of talented people all around the port... and I'm one of them, aren't I? ...I still have a lot left to learn? Ehehe~ In that case, I look forward to you teaching me a whole lot more stuff!

login_ex.line: Quietly now, stealthily... Woah! Why are you conked out in the office? Hey, you can't be doing that!

main5_ex.line: I'm a fully-fledged kitchen assistant now! You can place your trust in my cooking skills even more now~

main6_ex.line: Heheh~ Commander, I've come up with another amazing plan! I'll be the head chef, you'll be my assistant, and Lung Wu won't be allowed inside the kitchen!

main7_ex.line: Uwaaahh! I surrender, I surrender! There are way too many dishes to make, and I can't possibly keep up! I give up on cooking!

touch_ex.line: Ehehe~ If you promise to change your bad habits, I won't spill the beans on you pulling an all-nighter yesterday! ––Mmhmm, negotiation complete!

touch2_ex.line: ...Woah, woah! Just because you do this stuff all the time doesn't mean it's the new normal!

home.line: Oh! Commander, you're back! Here, I bought some xiaolongbao while I was on break~

login.line: Quietly now, stealthily... Wahey! How was that? Starstruck by my mighty Lion Dance mode?

main1.line: The lion is a lucky beast that drowns out disasters~ But then, so is the tiger! If you spend your Lunar New Year with me, you're sure to have good luck!

main2.line: To do a proper Lion Dance, you need both a head and a tail. Oh! Commander, wanna come join me?

main3.line: Left, right, left, right... Ehehe! You're in perfect sync with me~! All righty, let's go have a dance-off with Lung Wu!

touch.line: Commander, you wanna be the head? Fine by me! We're basically in sync with each other without even having to say anything, so I know it'll work out!

touch2.line: Hwaaah! H-hey, I'm in the middle of the Lion Dance right now!

unlock.line: Let's usher in the New Year with the sound of gongs and firecrackers~! Whaddya think? Lion dances are pretty awesome, aren't they? So, Commander, who's got more oomph in their dance steps? Me, or Lung Wu? C'mon, hurry up and decide~!

win_mvp.line: Ehehe~ I'm a better dancer, aren't I?

battle.line: Let us embark on an epic adventure!

detail.line: Mmrp... Hrnnh... Zzzzz... Gah! L-Lady Yuen would not just randomly fall asleep! Hey, I said I wasn't sleeping!

expedition.line: Our friends in the commission fleet have returned! Ehehe~ I wonder what sort of souvenirs they've brought back for Lady Yuen~

feeling1.line: Commander, at this rate... Lady Yuen isn't going to want to take you on adventures anymore...

feeling2.line: Oh, Commander. I was about to go out on an adventure with Fu Shun. Hmm? Don't go overboard with the pranks? Pranks? What could you possibly be talking about? I have no idea...

feeling3.line: Commander~ Come play with me! You can't because you have work? Why's that? C'mon, come play, come plaaaay! Lady Yuen abandoned today's adventure to play with you, you know? So, set all that work aside and come play with me!

feeling4.line: Commander! Lady Yuen has finished tidying the bookshelf! ...Hm? You pulled those books out because you were planning to reference them? S-sorry! I didn't do it on purpose... I, I was just trying to be helpful... *sniffle*

feeling5.line: Commander! Would you like to go on an adventure with Lady Yuen? ...Hm? You still have work left to do? I shall patiently wait for you to finish then! ...You'll treat me to a reward for being on my best behavior, won't you? Ehehe~ You're the best, Commander~♪

headtouch.line: T-to think that you'd pet Lady Yuen's head without her express permission... But, that feels nice... S-so, I shall allow you to continue that for a bit longer!

home.line: Hmm? Oh, you've returned. Did you remember to bring a souvenir for Lady Yuen?

hp_warning.line: Lady Yuen's great adventure... isn't going to end here!

login.line: La la la~♪ Have you returned? Then, shall we begin with today's work? Naturally, Lady Yuen is already good to go!

lose.line: It, it's just one little loss... Lady Yuen would certainly not cry over something as minor as that!

mail.line: All of these are letters addressed to you, Commander! Don't forget to read them!

main1.line: Commander~ Come take a look! Master Hai Tien taught me how to draw this! Hmm? I'm good at drawing monsters? B-but... I was trying to draw a picture of you... *sniffle*...

main2.line: Commander~ Let's go on an adventure together! What is an adventure, you ask? Hmm... for example, a quest to replace all the sugar in the kitchen with salt? No, it's not just a prank!

main3.line: Lady Yuen shall assist you in placing all these sorted documents onto the shelves... Hwaah?! Owww... Everything's a total mess now... I'm sorry, Commander, I was just trying to help...

mission.line: W-woaahh... What a crazy long list of missions... Commander, Lady Yuen shall assist you!

mission_complete.line: Commander! A whole bunch of supplies are piling up in front of the port! Hurry up and pick up the rewards so you can buy a present for Lady Yuen!

profile.line: I am Lady Fei Yuen, Chang Feng-class destroyer. Despite my appearance, I'm quite an adept "adventurer"! If you're interested, Commander, I would not mind passing down my knowledge! Of course, I wouldn't snitch on you either, heehee~

propose.line: You're giving this to me? Ehehe... That makes me so happy! There's a lot I still don't understand about this, but basically, you'll play with me forever and ever as long as I put this around my finger, right? See, it's on already! So, stay with me forever, Commander!

touch.line: Hmm? What's the matter, Commander? Oh, did you finally decide to accompany Lady Yuen on an adventure?

touch2.line: Commander... Did you break?

unlock.line: Fei Yuen of the Dragon Empery's Chang Feng-class destroyers is at your service! And, you're supposed to be my Commander? Heheh~ Then, please refer to me as Lady Yuen from now on~♪ Do so, and I shall protect you and take you on grand adventures!

upgrade.line: Woooooah! I can feel power coursing through me!

win_mvp.line: Hmmhmm~ And this is what happens to those who look down upon Lady Yuen~

gift_prefer.line: Yay, a present! Hehe, you're the best, Commander.

feeling5_ex.line: Zzzz... *yaaaawn*... For whatever reason, I always get sleepy when I'm around you... Oh! I know why! It must be because your scent makes me super relaxed... Zzzzzz...

headtouch_ex.line: Y-you can touch me even more, you know... Ehehehe~♪

home_ex.line: Welcome back~! If you got hurt anywhere, allow me to nurse you back to health– ...Hm? You're perfectly fine? Well, that's good to hear~♪

login_ex.line: Commander, you're finally back! I've been waiting a really long time for you, you know?

main4_ex.line: Commander... I accidentally knocked over a flower vase and a desk lamp... I just wanted to help tidy things up a bit... I wasn't trying to do it on purpose...

main5_ex.line: Just sitting next to you is already helpful? Then, um... what if I hold onto your arm like this? That's really helpful? Ehehe~ Yaay~♪

main6_ex.line: Why haven't I been going on any adventures lately? Well, adventures are fun and all, but spending time with you is even more fun~

touch_ex.line: Lady Yuen's cheeks are soft and squishy? Ehehe, yours are too, Commander~♪

touch2_ex.line: Hmm, this kind of stuff makes you happy? ...Then, umm, it makes me happy too!

expedition.line: Hmm? Commander, it seems that the commission team has returned already. Look, they're over there~

headtouch.line: Ehehe~ Pat my head more~ Wait, no! Help me down from here first!

home.line: W-welcome back, Commander! Would you like an apple?

login.line: Waaah... You're back, Commander? Can you hurry and get me down from here...?

mail.line: Commander~ Lady Yuen sees that there's new mail addressed to you~

main1.line: Why am I hanging off a drying rack? Umm... Well, actually... I was just having an adventure in the kitchen and got caught... S-sorry... After that? And, umm, I won't do it again...

main2.line: Fireworks! Fireworks! If you leave me like this, I'm going to miss the fireworks show! At least turn the rack towards where they're going to be setting them off!

main3.line: My outfit is... cute and classy? Ehehe, it's a Lunar New Year gift that the others got for me. Also, I heard something about "Damascus silk"... Commander, do you know anything about that?

main4.line: What is that sign the manjuu is holding up supposed to mean?! I totally wasn't trying to sneak snacks from the kitchen...!

mission_complete.line: Lady Yuen sees no shortage of goods piled up in front of the port. Is that our New Year's gift?

touch.line: Ahahahaha! Stop poking my tummy already! It tickles!

touch2.line: Okay, but... please get me down from here first! We can do whatever you want after that!

unlock.line: H-Happy New Year, Commander... Umm, uhh... C-could you please help me down first? ....Waah, I promise I won't have any more "adventures" in the kitchen...

expedition.line: The team we sent out just came back! I hope they found the legendary sweet strawberries I put on the list.

feeling5.line: Hehehe, having you here makes boiling syrup way more fun... Whoa?! O-oh, no, the syrup is burning!

headtouch.line: There's candy in my hair? Then you should taste it, Commander! Is it good?

home.line: W-wait a second! I'm about to coat them with sugar! I won't mess up this time... Ack?! Nooo, I've been hit!

login.line: Open up, Commander... Aren't Lady Yuen's candied strawberries delicious? Hehe, so, are you ready to relax a bit with me?

main1.line: *sniffle*... I won't cause trouble on my adventures anymore, I promise! Huh? Just by adventuring, I'm already causing trouble? I-I didn't know that!

main2.line: Now that I'm trying it, I think I'm really good at making candy! It's just that the pot is a little burnt, there's syrup everywhere, and the strawberries are a bit mushy...

main3.line: Come to think of it, what if I replaced some of the strawberries with chili peppers? Ack?! N-no, Commander, I wasn't thinking up a prank!

touch.line: Heh heh heh. I'll cover you in syrup next, Commander!

touch2.line: W-w-wait, Commander! My hands are all sticky right now! At least let me wash them...

unlock.line: "Making enough candied strawberries for everyone at port?" Waaah, i-it's too much hard work! I don't wanna!

upgrade.line: Wait... I can make more candied strawberries now? But I don't wannaaaa!

battle.line: Very well. Everything has been prepared to perfection~♪

couple_encourage1.line: Don't cause trouble for the others, okay~?

couple_encourage2.line: Huh? Cleaning, with a gun?

detail.line: Oh, Commander... I've been posting videos on Juustagram giving people housework tips, and the responses have surprisingly been very positive! I'm really glad I've been able to do something to help others!

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. It's a tough job out there, so I'll go bring some tea and snacks out to them.

feeling1.line: ...You really ought to tidy up your office more.

feeling2.line: Though Fei Yuen and Fu Po tend to leave a mess in their wake and I have to pick up after them, they're still so, so adorable~♪ What do you think about those two, Commander?

feeling3.line: Commander, I put some snacks on your desk. Please make sure you wash your hands first before eating, though. If there's anything else you'd like to have, just let me know. I'll cook anything you want~♪

feeling4.line: Oh, just give me a minute to finish folding your laundry— Huh? Th-this is your, umm... Oh my.... *blushes*

feeling5.line: Commander, I've finished washing your sheets and airing out your mattress. I hope you'll be able to sleep well tonight, accompanied by the fragrance of the sun... And maybe, you'll even carry my sincere sentiments towards you into your restful slumber... Ehehe~

headtouch.line: Heehee. Isn't this scarf-folded-into-kitty-ears cute~?

home.line: Commander, thank you for your hard work. I've prepared a fresh change of clothes for you, so please get changed at your convenience and rest awhile~

hp_warning.line: Ugh... It hurts... and my skirt's getting dirty too...

login.line: Commander, please give me a moment? I'm still tidying up the room... I know it's already sparkly clean, but... I just can't help myself!

lose.line: It's hard to see through the fog... I'm so sorry...

mail.line: There's a letter addressed to you, Commander. Don't forget to reply~

main1.line: Commander, I've brought you tea and snacks. They might not be anywhere as good as Lung Wu's, but please don't hold that against me. I'm also working hard to improve my cooking!

main2.line: Commander, Fei Yuen and Fu Po aren't roughhousing around in your office, right? Phew... I'm just glad they're not causing you trouble.

main3.line: Um... Commander, would you happen to have a ladder or something of the sort? I'd like to... dust off some of the cobwebs on the ceiling. Hmm? You'd like to help too? Okay~ I'll grab you a rag and a duster.

mission.line: Commander, you still have some missions left to complete. I've compiled them all here, so please work through them as soon as you can~

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. I washed and hung out the blankets and sheets, so now you'll be able to enjoy a good night's rest~

profile.line: I am Chang Feng, lead ship of the Dragon Empery's Chang Feng-class destroyers. Word has it that my sisters have been quite a handful for you, so I do believe a scolding is called for~

propose.line: I suppose this makes us loving members of a new family now... From now on, I'll keep the house nice and clean for you every day, waiting for you to come home to me. Heehee~

touch.line: My apron's still dusty from all the cleaning, so maybe it's best not to touch me too much right now...

touch2.line: Hwuh?! P-please don't do something like that so flippantly... I, I'll have you take responsibility, you know!

unlock.line: Good day, Commander. I am Chang Feng, name ship of the Chang Feng-class destroyers. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance. Should you need anything done, be it missions or housework, please leave it to me~♪

upgrade.line: May I wield this power to be of even greater service to you.

win_mvp.line: A clean victory! I'm so happy for you~!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander. How can I possibly return the favor... Give me some time to think about it!

detail_ex.line: If you do this, then this... you'll be able to fold your laundry quickly and neatly. Convenient, right? More time to spare is more time to spend with you, Commander~

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, I've made the bed for you— Hmm? What's wrong? You'd like me to stay with you...? Sure, I don't mind~ But first, let me take a shower, then change into some clean pajamas~♪

headtouch_ex.line: Mmhmm~ Getting headpats from you always fills me with motivation~

home_ex.line: Commander, I know you've been hard at work. Would you like to unwind by taking a bath? I've already made the tub nice and clean for you, and I'll even give you a massage if you'd like~

login_ex.line: The documents have been organized, the desk has been wiped clean, and tea is ready... Now, Commander will be able to work with peace of mind~

main4_ex.line: Hm? I'm reading the recipes for your favorite dishes, given to me by Lung Wu. If I can memorize them all, we won't have to go out to eat anymore~ After all, I can just make them for you at home~♪

main5_ex.line: Why is this place such a mess...? Oh, I see. Fei Yuen and Fu Po came by? Well, I suppose I'll clean up first. The scolding can wait until later. Heehee.

main6_ex.line: Commander, do you have a ladder I can borrow? I'd like to dust off the top of the bookshelves... Huh? Y-you can just lift me up? O-okay then... *blushes*

touch_ex.line: Hm? What's wrong? Are you in a bad mood? Come to me, then... There, there~ Everything will be okay~

touch2_ex.line: Please don't do this in public, Commander... At least wait until it's just the two of us... Hauuu... *blushes*

detail.line: There's a lifehack when it comes to wiping windows, so I'll make a Juustagram post about it later. Oh, but Commander, if you ever need a window wiped down, just let me know~

feeling5.line: This red plum branch is for you, Commander. I pray that it brings you, peace, fortune, joy, and smooth sailing. Hopefully, the warmth of spring will return to us sooner as well.

headtouch.line: Mhm! I'll give this spring cleaning my all!

home.line: Phew... And now, for the finishing stroke... Ehehe, Commander, this little heart is for you. Thanks for all your hard work~

login.line: Commander, the New Year is just around the corner, isn't it? Hm? You haven't started on your spring cleaning yet? Well, I'd be more than glad to lend you a hand~

main1.line: I've almost finished preparations for our New Year banquet. Will you join us for dinner on New Year's Eve?

main2.line: Fei Yuen and Fu Po? Heehee, don't worry. I gave them an earful for knocking over your vase earlier~

main3.line: I'd like to nudge that bottom-most lantern over a bit. Do you think you could help me, Commander? ...Putting up lanterns together during the New Year really does make the two of us feel like a family...

touch.line: It's pretty cold out there, isn't it? I have the heater on, so come on in~

touch2.line: Commander, you can't do that... I'm still in the middle of spring cleaning!

unlock.line: Oh, Commander~ Please give me a moment; Fei Yuen, Fu Po, and I are still finishing up our spring cleaning. Why don't you come inside for now and have some warm tea?

detail.line: Once I've finished cleaning and my sisters settle down a bit, I usually enjoy making some tea and taking time to enjoy the scenery. You don't find that boring, do you?

feeling5.line: Even though I have tasted this tea every day, it somehow seems different today~ Mellower, sweeter, with a gentle aftertaste... Could it be that this tea set has imbued the tea with greater fragrance than usual... or, is it thanks to you being here that this moment is sweeter and more joyous?

headtouch.line: Yes, this is my cat-eared scarf. I thought you'd like it, Commander. Ehehe~

home.line: Commander, please have some tea. It's just the right temperature to be enjoyed~

login.line: Commander, I've finished preparing the tea and snacks. Yes, this is the Ru-ware tea set I told you about the other day! A wonderful work of art, wouldn't you agree?

main1.line: Commander, please take a look at this~♪ Don't you think these flowers match perfectly with this Ru-ware vase? Ru-ware ceramics are very hard to make, which is why we must put even more effort into picking out the perfect flowers and arranging them to bring out its beauty!

main2.line: I've been fascinated with Ru-ware celadon as of late, so I've been reading up on them. Commander, would you like to read about them together?

main3.line: Commander, I see you've been appreciating this Ru-ware tea set with great care. Have you taken a liking to it? ...I had a hunch you'd like it, so I bought an identical set just for you~♪

mission.line: I thought we'd be able to share a relaxing afternoon together, so I didn't expect there to be a mission... It must be hard having your job, Commander. Please let me know if there's anything I can do.

mission_complete.line: Finally, the mission has been completed. Are you hungry? Would you like me to make something?

touch.line: "After the rain's passing comes blue skies, after the cloud's parting comes new hues." ...The colors of the glaze on Ru-ware celadon are truly beautiful. In fact, I've drawn inspiration from them for this outfit. Do you like how I look?

touch2.line: Oh my.... *blushes*... Commander, could you please... put the teacup down first...?

unlock.line: Commander, this is the new Ru-ware tea set I just purchased. Absolutely beautiful, isn't it? We have a custom to bring out the best things for those you care about, which is why I decided to invite you~♪

battle.line: Heh heh~! My plan is PERFECT! Let's freakin' gooooo!

couple_encourage1.line: Sis, I'm heading off!

couple_encourage2.line: Ehehe~ Let's sneak over to the kitchen later!

detail.line: Now I'll glue this to the Commander's fountain pen... Whuh? Commander?! When'd you get here?! N-nothing, I wasn't doing anything at all! Wait, why's my hand... stuck to my clothes? Commander, help meeee!!

expedition.line: The commission team is back! Go greet them right away! ...And in the meantime, I'll... I-it's nothing, I didn't say anything!

feeling1.line: You're going to chew me out again, aren't you...? W-well, in that case, maybe I just won't play with you anymore...

feeling2.line: It's not my fault the cup fell over! The wind from the AC was just too strong! ...Okay, okay! I get it! Stop looking at me like that! It was my fault! I'll go clean it up...

feeling3.line: Waaah... Commander, sis chewed me out again... and said that I'm not allowed to play pranks on people anymore... Waah! (Wait a sec, what if I peel down the inner layer of Commander's cap and slip a little froggy inside...)

feeling4.line: All done! Look, Commander! I've finished drafting an epic adventure plan for Fei Yuen and Fu Shun! Pretty amazing isn't it? ...Hm? It'd be better if I did it this way? ...Huh, you're totally right... Wait, Commander? Since when could you decipher my drawings?!

feeling5.line: ...How'd you spoil my prank yet again?! W-wait, stop going through my pockets! ...Here, it's just my favorite candy! I'll share some with you!

headtouch.line: Ehehe... Step one: get you to lower your guard~ Heehee~

home.line: ...Commander!! Boo!! Hehe, did I scare ya? Huh? N-not at all? Because my shadow gave it away?! No freaking waaaay!

hp_warning.line: Owww! Stop hitting me! Waaah!!

login.line: You're here, Commander! Here's a nice and soft cushion for you to sit down on~ Hurry up and sit down already! ...Huh? Why isn't the cushion making a sound?!

lose.line: Uwaaaaah! Sis, Commander, help meeeee!

mail.line: Commander, your mail is— WoooOOOah! Phew, nearly slipped and fell... Ugh, who the heck splashed water here?! ...Oh, maybe it was me...

main1.line: AHHHH!! Commander! What are you doing with my notebook?! Give it back to me! All my secret plans are in it... Hey! It's not a doodle pad!!

main2.line: Ehehe~ Well, well. Aren't you the most perfect plan I've ever cooked up. I'll just wait until sis goes to do her cleaning to sneak away, then— Huh? Commander?! Why did you bring Chang Feng here?!

main3.line: While you're busy with work, I'm gonna tie your shoelaces together~ Wait, huh?! You don't have any laces?!

mission.line: Commander, hurry up and finish up your missions! I put your itinerary in the desk drawer— Wait, huh? You went and got it just like that?! But what happened to all the balloons?!

mission_complete.line: It's all thanks to me and my plan, right? Ehehe~ Wh-what do you mean, my scribbles made no sense to you at all?!

profile.line: I'm Fu Po, second of the Chang Feng-class destroyers! Ehehe~ By the way, I stuck a little surprise on you— Wait, huh? Why's it on the ground... I'll go pick it up... How come a bug toy is running so fast!?

propose.line: Is this some kind of new prank item or something? Lemme see... Wait, huh? Is this what I think it is? HUH?! It's for ME?!

skill.line: Ehehe, I just came up with a GREAT idea!

touch.line: AHH! You stuck something weird on me! Where is it?!

touch2.line: You're a meanie, Commander!

unlock.line: Heya, Commander! Fu Po, cleverest of the Chang Feng-class destroyers, is reporting in! One look at this place, and my brain's already overflowing with prank ideas... Err, I mean, uh, plans! Battleplan ideas!

upgrade.line: I'm suuuuuuper strong now! ...I think!

win_mvp.line: Ehehe~ That's the ever-so-clever Fu Po for you!

gift_prefer.line: Oh, this! I've had my eyes on this! Thanks, Commander!

detail_ex.line: I'll just glue these pieces of paper together, then draw a little sump'n sump'n on it... and voila! What an ingenious idea! ...AH! Commander! Don't touch that—AHHHHH!! Our hands are stuck together now! What do we do?!!

expedition_ex.line: The commission team's back! Let's go greet them! ...Oh, give me just a sec. Lemme grab some prank items to give them a little scare... Huh? No good? Aww...

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, let's go grab some cake together! Ehehe, this time for sure, my plan will— Hey, hey! Don't just swallow the thing in one go! I wrote you something on a slip of paper! Spit it out!

headtouch_ex.line: H-hey! I didn't even do anything!

home_ex.line: ...Welcome back! Pa-POW! ...Huh? Why isn't the popper going off? Lemme see—WHUUUUAH!! Why'd it explode all of a sudden?! That was freakin' scary...

login_ex.line: (......Why aren't you heaping praise on me yet?! I even prepared a surprise for you by putting away all your documents! ...Huh? Wh-what's going on? Why do you have such a stern look on your face...?)

main4_ex.line: Commander, take a look at my next plan! It's already perfect, but I'm willing to take your input! ...Huh? What do you mean you don't get it? You're right here, and Fei Yuen's right here...

main5_ex.line: Commander, I made a matcha latte for you~! Ehehe, I'm not playing around this time, so go ahead and drink it! ...Huh?! Is it really that nasty? Let me try, then... *cough* *hack*! BLEHHH... Wait, was that a can of wasabi powder?!

main6_ex.line: While you're busy with work, I'm gonna replace your shoes with cute animal plushie slippers... H-hey, I can't get them off...! Commander, lift your feet up!

touch_ex.line: I'll just sneak up behind the Commander and— Huh?! How'd you know I was there! Nooo! Now I'm being hugged!!

touch2_ex.line: Wh-what is this?! This wasn't in the plaaaan!

detail.line: Commander, you're not leaving yet? You're drawing too much attention if you stay here! Oh, right! Why don't you hide under the desk here with me and join in on my New Year's prank... I mean, uh, New Year's surprise!

expedition.line: The commission team is back! Go greet them right away! ...And in the meantime, I'll... I-it's nothing, I didn't say anything!

feeling5.line: D-don't worry! Times like these are when you gotta learn to think on the fly! If Chang Feng asks, tell her that we were playing hide-and-seek! That'll cover everything up perfectly! Promise me!

headtouch.line: Commander, your hands smell real nice... *gasp*, I bet you've been sneaking food!

home.line: Waaah! Commander, if you stand there, everyone's going to start gathering here! Ugh, looks like I'm going to have to resort to my backup plan... W-wait, are those footsteps I hear?!

login.line: Huh? How did the Commander see through my plan so easily? Ugh, I thought it was absolutely foolproof... Just where did I go wrong?

mail.line: Commander, your mail is— WoooOOOah! Phew, nearly slipped and fell... Ugh, who the heck splashed water here?! ...Oh, maybe it was me...

main1.line: So, what do you think? This night stealth cloak of mine is pretty cool, huh? Heh heh~ It's not just cool, by the way. It also helps me blend into the darkness... but only if you turn off the lights!

main2.line: Drat! How did Fei Yuen manage to find me as well?! How long have you known— Wait, Fei Yuen! Shhh! Keep it down, or... Oh no, I already hear Chang Feng's footsteps! Commander, save meeee!!

main3.line: Heh heh, want me to give you a rundown on my plan? Take a look. So, this is me hiding in the kitchen. After lights out... No! This is me wearing my stealth cloak! Not a monster!!

mission.line: Commander, hurry up and finish up your missions! I put your itinerary in the desk drawer— Wait, huh? You went and got it just like that?! But what happened to all the balloons?!

mission_complete.line: It's all thanks to me and my plan, right? Ehehe~ Wh-what do you mean, my scribbles made no sense to you at all?!

touch.line: You like my stealth cloak that much? Well, maybe if tonight's plan goes well, I'll give it to you as a present!

touch2.line: H-hey! No pranks here! The strings are gonna come undone!

unlock.line: Oh... Well, shoot, you found me... Shhhhh! Don't tell anyone that I'm here though! Seriously, Commander, I'm begging you!

battle.line: Ancestors... Yat Sen shall now do her part as well.

couple_encourage1.line: I'm so glad I can be with everyone again, just as before.

detail.line: Is there anything else you would like to know about me, Commander?

expedition.line: The girls have already returned from commission. Aren't we going to greet them?

feeling1.line: Commander... You don't seem to be the one I've been waiting for...

feeling2.line: Commander... Could you be... *that* person?

feeling3.line: I am overjoyed to be able to return to your side once more, Commander.

feeling4.line: My past? Those... are stories for your ears only, Commander.

feeling5.line: When I look at your face, I sometimes forget to breathe... What a strange sensation.

headtouch.line: I am no longer the crybaby that I once was.

home.line: Ahh, home is such a warm place.

hp_warning.line: I have already witnessed true hell.

login.line: We meet again, Commander. Do not worry, I shall stay by your side as promised.

lose.line: Give up? Why would I do that? I am not the same fragile Yat Sen as before.

mail.line: The mail? It's on your desk, Commander.

main1.line: Ning Hai's steamed buns? Mm... they still have the same nostalgic flavor.

main2.line: Only by remembering the lessons of the past can we move towards a brighter future.

main3.line: Sometimes, I miss those days when I used to train together with all my sisters...

mission.line: New missions have been assigned! I have finished preparations and am awaiting your orders.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards counted and ready for your review... me? No, there's nothing I want...

profile.line: Yat Sen of the First Fleet of the Dragon Empery, reporting in. I heard that my sisters have already arrived. This time, I promise that I will not leave your side.

propose.line: This... is the power of our bond? Every moment we are together is like a dream, one that I am afraid of waking up from. No... it is no matter. From now on, I shall always be by your side.

touch.line: What's wrong? Please don't have any strange expectations of me.

touch2.line: To do such a thing to a woman... Surely Commander is prepared to suffer the consequences.

unlock.line: This is the moment I have long waited for... I am Yat Sen, from the First Fleet of the Dragon Empery. Please allow me to be at your service once more.

upgrade.line: If only I was able to become this strong sooner, then perhaps...

win_mvp.line: As the wind blows anew, I can feel my presence once more.

gift_prefer.line: You put a lot of effort into this. Yes, I can tell.

detail.line: This is rather embarrassing, but... Chen Hai somehow found out that I'd be meeting with you, so she made me change into this outfit... S-so, how does it look on me?

headtouch.line: Do you find my hairstyle... appealing?

home.line: Thank you for your service. I happen to have my tea set with me, so if you don't mind, I can steep some tea leaves for you.

login.line: Commander, Happy New Year. I arrived not too long ago, so please take a seat right next to me.

mail.line: The mail? An Shan said that if anything new arrives, she'll drop by to bring it over.

main1.line: Being able to spend peaceful days with my friends fills me with warmth and happiness. Spending time with you... is yet another special kind of happiness.

main2.line: Thanks to you, the port's Lunar New Year celebration has become more and more lively each year. As a result, there are more and more kids we have to keep an eye on... I suppose that's one of the downsides of being too blessed?

main3.line: Um... Commander, were you staring at me just now? Oh, umm, I wasn't trying to blame you or anything. Actually, I find myself doing the same thing every now and then...

mission.line: Do you still have missions left to do? If it's urgent, please allow me to help.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have already arrived safely at port. There's no need to worry yourself.

touch.line: Just by putting our hands together like this, you can already feel the warmth spreading.

touch2.line: Wh-what if one of our friends passes by...?

unlock.line: I am truly honored to be able to share this wondrous scenery with you on such a festive occasion, Commander. Umm... I'm not just saying that out of courtesy. We rarely get opportunities like this, so I'm somewhat flattered...

detail.line: The whispers of a babbling creek and the soft breath of nature– indeed, they put one's heart at ease... Oh my, I totally spaced out just now. Please forgive me...

home.line: I understand very well that your work must be handled expeditiously. There is no need to blame yourself; please enjoy this cup of tea, as well as this moment's respite with me.

login.line: Commander, the tea is almost ready. Please wait just a bit longer.

mail.line: I heard that the mail just arrived back at the port. Shall we head back shortly to check on it?

main1.line: Everyone has different tastes– some prefer a richer fragrance, while others prefer a lighter aroma. What do you prefer, Commander?

main2.line: That Harbin... Had my friends not stopped her, she would've bought up all the tea leaves in the store. Maybe I should ask Ting An for help the next time...

main3.line: Commander, I see you've finished your cup of tea. Shall I fill it back up for you? Oh, please be careful, as this is freshly brewed.

mission.line: More work to take care of? There's no need to rush things. Just work at your usual pace. I'll still be here when you're done.

mission_complete.line: I see you've finished your missions without a hitch. Commander, I do hope you strike a proper balance between work and leisure.

touch.line: You want to help pour a cup for me? Then, I shall graciously take you up on that.

touch2.line: P-please wait a moment... I'm still trying to finish brewing tea... *blushes*

unlock.line: I am honored that you could make time in your busy schedule to accept my invitation... Hmm? There's no need to be so formal? Heehee. Well, the tea happens to be ready now, so please sit down next to me~

detail.line: I struggled over which swimsuit to wear for quite a while. I always want to show you my best side, but I worry that it might not be to your liking... Heehee, but I can tell that you're more than satisfied today.

feeling5.line: Bonds as firm as the mountains and sea... Commander, you are the peak upon which my heart perches, while I am the river flowing down from it – ever embracing you, quietly yet lovingly.

headtouch.line: Like a spring rain, silently nourishing all it touches...

home.line: Heehee, was it the sea breeze that brought you back to me?

login.line: I've come to see you again today, as promised. Shall we stroll along the coast together? There's so much I want to discuss...

main1.line: Commander. If you'd keep your eyes on me just a little longer... I'd be very happy.

main2.line: There are seashells all over the beach. Why don't we gather a few together to decorate our tea table?

main3.line: I've never worn such a revealing swimsuit... I wasn't ready for you to see it, but the wind blew my top open, and now... W-well, do you like it?

touch.line: My top is soaked. Maybe we'd best stop, Commander...

touch2.line: Hyah... Are you trying to help me up? B-be gentle, please...

unlock.line: The tide murmurs softly, the gulls fly low, and the sea breeze blows gently... Ahh, m-my clothes... Commander, um, could you please not stare at me like that...

battle.line: As long as you're with me, there's nothing that Yat Sen cannot do.

feeling5.line: Even if we are to be separated, our hearts will always beat as one. Do you feel the same way about me, my dear? Hehe~

home.line: Awaiting the return of a loved one... is a warm feeling.

main1.line: For us to walk hand in hand until we become old... is my greatest wish.
