main2.line: I am now able to move forward without doubts... and it's all thanks to you, dear.

main3.line: I never realized it before, but being by your side like this, watching Ping Hai and Ning Hai grow, and seeing the merriment of the other Dragon Empery children... makes me see that I am truly blessed.

touch.line: Is something the matter, dear? Yat Sen is always there for you. Yes, no matter what.

touch2.line: P-Please don't be so hasty, dear... at least, wait until we get back to our room...

unlock.line: Commander, thank you for waiting for me. Though I am unworthy of this honor, thank you so much...

detail.line: If I told you that there's much I still want to learn about you... Would you entertain my request? Heehee~

home.line: Indeed, home is the place that truly makes your heart feel at ease.

login.line: Commander, welcome back. I am by your side, just as always. May all your endeavors proceed smoothly today.

main1.line: Ying Swei and Chao Ho... To outsiders, those two girls might seem like they don't get along very well. But, people who understand them will find their antics delightful and amusing. Heehee.

main2.line: We cannot rely on the same old set of experiences when facing the challenges of a brand new era. I believe that with your keen judgment, Commander, you will be able to distinguish between right and wrong, and arrive at your own conclusions.

main3.line: In the past, I used to pray that I would become stronger. Now, I pray that I may understand both the warmth and coldness of this world. Naturally, I would like to experience those things to better accompany you and my other friends, heehee.

touch.line: Did you need me? I am willing to hear you out at any time.

touch2.line: All inappropriate conduct will be held to account.

unlock.line: There's no need to worry, Commander. I will be fine now. Please allow me to serve you once more in this new form.

battle.line: I'll never hold back against our enemies!

couple_encourage1.line: Ping Hai! Stop eating my buns!

detail.line: What is it? You want to watch a martial arts performance?

expedition.line: Commander, the prior commission should be finished just about now.

feeling1.line: As if I'd eat your buns!

feeling2.line: Come on! What's going on with this month's expenses?! Why are these buns here... Have I eaten? Not yet... Fine, let's eat together.

feeling3.line: Don't always try to change the subject to buns when we're discussing serious business, Commander! Do I look like I can be bought that easily? Ooo... mmm.... So delicious!

feeling4.line: You won't trick me this time! I'm telling you... Eh? You like me? Wait, th-this must be your new way of tricking me! Uu...

feeling5.line: There's an old saying in our nation: "It's easy to go from a life of frugality to one of extravagance, but not the other way around." I hope that the one I like would not turn me into a frivolous... wh-wh-why would I say that I like you? You must have heard me wrong.

home.line: I just finished steaming these buns. Why not relax and have a quick snack?

hp_warning.line: Persevere!

login.line: Where were you? Lazing around again?! Did you bring me any food...? Hmph. Let's get to work.

lose.line: My abilities... are inadequate...

mail.line: Reading the mail in a timely manner is a common courtesy. Make sure to properly respond as well!

main1.line: Even if you put a giant plate of steamed buns on the table in front of me, I won't relax...

main2.line: Commander, I would rather see you and the fleet become stronger instead of just myself.

main3.line: You cannot protect your loved ones if you neglect your training.

mission.line: Missions won't complete themselves if you are daydreaming. Let's get going!

mission_complete.line: Rewards have been counted. We could buy a huge stack of steamed buns... *ahem* The list is here, Commander.

profile.line: I'm Ning Hai, the first ship of the Ning Hai-class! In order to revive our nation's navy, we have been living as frugally as possible. If you waste our efforts, Commander, I'm going to be very angry with you!

propose.line: ... Since you trust me so much, Commander, why don't we plan ahead? The next focus of our fleet is... cost cutting! We've got to maintain the fleet by minimizing expenses, and... Hey! Don't run away!

skill.line: I'll show you the power of kung fu!

touch.line: What, you want to have a go with me?

touch2.line: *sigh* I won't forgive you, even if you beg God for forgiveness and bribe me with a lifetime supply of steamed buns.

unlock.line: You're the Commander? Well, from this day forward, I'll take the duty of supervising the fleet. I hope you'll coopera... Buns? Thank you, I'll help myself.

upgrade.line: I've got to work even harder to balance the fleet's income and expenses.

win_mvp.line: Everyone must aspire to outperform me!

gift_prefer.line: Don't think this means you get to slack off! Tch... O-okay, you get ten minutes!

battle.line: You're not taking my fried noodles from me!

detail.line: How'd I even get lost...? My map of the local sea should be perfectly accurate...

login.line: *panting*... S-sorry, Commander... I wound up on some weird uninhabited island... *panting*... I swam away for dear life and finally made it back... *panting*...

main1.line: I wanna geh closer to tha firrwurks... Lemme wide on your shouldersh, Commander~! Err... N-no! I'm not drunk!

main2.line: Come here, Ping Hai. Let me take care of that stain on your lips.

main3.line: Ping Hai! You can't get careless just because we're not in batt– Blurph!

touch.line: I'm tired and my muscles hurt... But it was all worth it for that awesome beachside barbeque!

touch2.line: Calm down, Commander, I'm trying to watch the fireworks... Your shoulders hurt? Come on, I'm not that heavy!

unlock.line: Summer's all about the beach! And the beach is all about good food! Let's find something good to eat, Commander.

upgrade.line: My summer appetite empowers me!

win_mvp.line: I want another helping of seafood with fried noodles!

main1.line: Oh gosh, mooncake! Yes! Om nom nom nom!

main2.line: It's a holiday, so nobody will mind if I drink a little... right? *gulp*, *gulp*... Ahahaha... Something here smells like sweet osmanthus~!

main3.line: Da Bao, Baobao, do you want some mooncake too? Here you go.

touch.line: The whole family's all gathered for the Mid-Autumn Festival! Happy holidays, Commander!

touch2.line: For the last time! I'm not a bunny girl, I'm a moon rabbit! Got it?!

unlock.line: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! By the way, I heard that if you prayed to the moon today, you'll become as pretty as the Goddess of the Moon! ...Eh, you're really doing it?!

battle.line: Is making me sing during a battle some kind of weird fetish thing?!

detail.line: Look, all this idol stuff is just work, okay! Don't start thinking I actually enjoy it!

expedition.line: The commission's done? Okay then, take five. Commander, you should probably go out and meet them.

feeling5.line: Sigh... turns out the more idol stuff I have to do, the less time I get to spend with the Commander... Commander, um, say...? Do you think you could be our manager...?

home.line: Nice work out there, got a request you want me to sing?

login.line: Thank you very m–! It's you, Commander.

lose.line: Oh, my outfit...

mail.line: There's so many fan letters...! Being an idol is so exhausting...

main1.line: C- Commander... "Jia you! ☆" Was that cute enough...? Don't look at me like that! This is serious business right here!

main2.line: After studying all that kung fu, Idol dancing is a piece of cake for me and Ping Hai! Hah hah!

main3.line: Oh, right! Commander, next time me and Ping Hai put out a single, we'll definitely save you one.

mission.line: A new offer...? Heh, hehehehe... Sure, I'll keep packing in as much work as my schedule can take!

mission_complete.line: The fans make me really happy, sure, but next time I'll have to teach them how to save money!

touch.line: Don't worry, I'm wearing shorts underneath. And anyway if somebody tried something gross, I've got a roundhouse kick with their name on it!

touch2.line: Roundhouse kick!

unlock.line: We haven't had to worry as much about things like food since we joined the fleet, but that doesn't mean we can just throw money around...! Anyway, I'm the older of the "Dragon Sisters," Ning Hai! Great to be here!

win_mvp.line: It feels... even better than I expected.

battle.line: Stop interfering with our vacation, you scrapheaps!

detail.line: Ping Hai can get away with it, but I can't believe YOU don't have a clear schedule for this vacation, Commander... Forget it, I'll make you one!

feeling5.line: H-Huh? Hey! Why do *you* have my tourist magazine, Commander? The red circle on the shrine that "makes lovers get married"? L-Look, I only marked it because I wanted to check it out while we're here, that's all!

home.line: You're late! We're going to the next tourist attraction right now!

login.line: Where should we go next?

main1.line: Hmph. Sure, we got this vacation for free, but we can't squander our money... Ping Hai! Don't go off ordering food! You too, Commander!

main2.line: I've vaguely felt it since way back, but the Sakura Empire and Dragon Empery are similar in a lot of ways. But also dissimilar in many ways, obviously. Those are what feel fresh.

mission.line: We have to visit *all* the places I've outlined in my schedule, Commander. And don't you think about giving up already!

mission_complete.line: This one's really expensive... But we do need a souvenir to take back home... Fine, we'll buy it!

touch.line: It's so crowded over here... Listen, um, could you hold my hand? ... I mean, with me.

unlock.line: Commander, what are you spacing out for? Over here! They say that you'll have good fortune if you give this thing a shake!

win_mvp.line: You're willing to go *any* lengths to anger me, aren't you?

battle.line: You're not getting this cake!

detail.line: Yat Sen, Ping Hai, and I made this cake for the party, with the help of some other girls. It had to be big enough to feed everyone... But a big baozi probably would have been better than a big cake... Ahem! N-never mind.

home.line: A party this fancy must have cost a lot... Hm... Fine! The money's spent, so we might as well enjoy ourselves!

login.line: This cake is for you, Commander! T-take it!

main1.line: Da Bao! Bring the next slice over here! Pay attention!

main2.line: I told her not to, but I'm still worried Ping Hai is going to gobble up the cake before she finishes passing it out... I better go keep an eye on her!

main3.line: While handing out all this cake I realized just how many friends Ping Hai and I have made lately... Heh heh.

touch.line: Passing out the cake...? That's not a job for a commander! Leave it to me and Ping Hai, and of course Da Bao and Baobao!

touch2.line: Waaah! C-Commander! What if I drop the cake?!

unlock.line: Yat Sen said this look would be best for a party, but, is it really okay? I'm not used to having my hair down like this...

detail.line: I never knew pandas are omnivores. I'd always thought they only ate bamboo...

home.line: The mommy panda is pretty wary of letting people near her babies... What would her caretakers do in this situation?

login.line: Commander! Good timing! Could you go get some bamboo?

main1.line: Have some bamboo too, Da Bao. Eat it slowly now, so you don't choke!

main2.line: These cubs might not look all that heavy, but they weigh a lot for their size.

main3.line: You can't just play all day, Ping! There are charity missions to do, don't forget that! Same for you, Commander!

touch.line: A baozi? You're not supposed to feed pandas with stuff you'd feed Ping! ...It's for me? In that case, th-thanks...

unlock.line: Good boy. Chew thoroughly before you swallow. I never thought I'd help with a charity event for nature, but Da Bao's made a lot of new friends because of it. Keep up the good work, Commander and Ping!

couple_encourage1.line: Ping Hai, you'd better not let that crab get away!

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Perfect, just in time for a get-together meal!

home.line: You couldn't have picked a better time to get back~! The baozi are fresh off the stove, so if you're hungry, grab a basket!

login.line: Oh, a customer! ...Uhh, I mean, welcome back, Commander! Got work today? Well, let's get it taken care of so we can enjoy our New Year's banquet!

mail.line: Commander, you've got mail. At this time of year, it's probably New Year's well-wishes, right? It'd be rude of you not to reply~

main1.line: Today's main dish is drunken octopus! Here's the Shaoxing wine, but... Drunken octopus, drunken octopus... Woah! The octopus is jetting away?!

main2.line: Do you like how my outfit looks? Heehee~ This was the New Year's present that everyone picked out for me, and I gave it a little unique touch! I'm still missing a stocking? Th-this modification is just to make it easier to record the orders!

main3.line: Hmm? I made too much food? ...Nonsense! I might encourage being thrifty every other day of the year, but I'm going all-out today! It's the New Year after all, and you don't mess around with the New Year's banquet. So, I'm going all out!

main4.line: Commander, look forward to the lavish banquet I'm going to prepare for you! ...Don't worry, I've got things under control. S-seriously, I said I can handle this!

mission.line: Hmm? New mission? So, what's the plan, Commander? Gonna take care of it now?

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards, collected and accounted for! Hmm... What's this... I think I can incorporate this into my banquet menu?

touch.line: Hyeep?! H-hold on, the bowls are gonna fall! ...Jeez, this isn't the time to start clinging to me!

touch2.line: ...H-hey, mind the time and place, okay? Ping Hai is here, you know?!

unlock.line: Woah! Da Bao, lend me a hand here! Don't let that octopus get away! ...Oh, Commander, Happy Lunar New Year! Uhh, the kitchen prep's going fine... Huh? You're gonna help? Heheh~ don't worry about us! Just leave everything here to me 'n Ping!

battle.line: I'll be everyone's role model!

detail.line: In order to save money, I'll have to cook with the most affordable ingredients I can get... Commander, come taste test this for me~

main1.line: Commander, if I catch you slacking off, you'll get a taste of my new karate chops.

main2.line: If I don't cheer up a bit, who is Commander and Pinghai going to depend on- Ah, I didn't mean it like that!

main3.line: Commander, don't just sit there all day, come here and do some aerobics with me to loosen up!

touch.line: Where in the world did Bunbun get these fancy glasses... I hope he's not trying to become a pandit.

unlock.line: Yes! … this feels good. Thank you, Commander. In order to live up to your expectations, from now on, I will be more serious around you, Commander. Hey, don't run!

battle.line: Do I get any tasty food for winning?

couple_encourage1.line: Big sister! Do you want some buns?

detail.line: What are you looking at, Commander?

expedition.line: Commander, Commander! Big sister said that I have to tell you whenever a commission is finished.

feeling1.line: Commander... are you one of those "bad guys" that big sister talks about?

feeling2.line: Big sister always says that we are too poor to have food in the pot, but every time I open the lid, there’s always food in there! What’s the deal with that?

feeling3.line: Big sister said I shouldn’t be alone with Commander... is it because she wants the buns all for herself? Then, I shall come visit Commander more often from now on!

feeling4.line: Big sister told me that finding someone who can feed me is more important than finding someone I like. Since I like Commander and get plenty of food, there shouldn’t be any problems.

feeling5.line: I will be satisfied as long as I can be with Commander all the time, and just see my sister every now and then. Hmm? Big Sister would cry? Why?

home.line: Whenever big sister is tired, the only way to make her happy is by giving her steamed buns. Do you want some, Commander?

hp_warning.line: I'm hungry...

login.line: Commander, have you eaten yet? You can’t work on an empty stomach.

lose.line: Big sister, where are you?

mail.line: Big sister says that checking the mail in a timely manner is a common courtesy! Commander, want to read these?

main1.line: Socks? Big sister said we should spend less money, so we share one pair together...

main2.line: Kung Fu? Big sister said we could earn some Coins by performing on the street, so I learned that too...

main3.line: Pandas? On our heads? They're also sisters!

mission.line: Big sister says that missions won’t complete themselves if I’m daydreaming. Does that mean they will if I practice kung fu?

mission_complete.line: So many rewards, Commander! Can we trade them for buns?

profile.line: I'm Ning Hai, the first ship of the Ning Hai-class. Big sister told me to say this when I was introducing myself. Ah? I'm Ping Hai? That's right! Then... I'm Ping Hai, the first ship of the Ning Hai-class... I'm wrong again? This is so confusing...

propose.line: Does this mean that I should only listen to Commander from now on instead of my big sister? ...Make my own decision? Hm... then, I shall listen to both of you.

touch.line: Commander, do you also want a hug? I hug my big sister all the time.

touch2.line: Big sister told me to beat up any bad guys that I come across. But what is a bad guy?

unlock.line: Commander? Big sister told me that commanders who can’t even put food on the table are no good. Can you support yourself? ...Then, how about me?

upgrade.line: I'm... hungry!

win_mvp.line: Number one? Does that taste good?

gift_prefer.line: My sister says I shouldn't accept gifts, but we can make an exception for you, can't we?

battle.line: Will you give me food if we win this? Pretty please?

detail.line: Big sister and I got lost on on this strange island and saw some weird stuff... What was weird about it? Look, it was really weird, that's all!

login.line: B-big sister, where are we...? And where is everyone...? Eek! I-I think I just heard something... Oh, right, this place is uninhabited.

main1.line: Liquor chocolates? Wait, no, big sister! You shouldn't eat those...!

main2.line: Big sister told me the dining table is a battlefield of its own, so I'm gonna stay on my guard!

main3.line: Aww... I wanna ride on the Commander's shoulders too...

touch.line: D-don't stare at me like that... Fine, I'll give you a third of my ice cream... Ugh, okay, half! But no more than that!

unlock.line: Shaved ice is better than steamed buns, fireworks are prettier than shaved ice, and more precious than fireworks is...

upgrade.line: Fried noodles! Grilled fish! Ice cream!

win_mvp.line: Hey Commander, I wanna have croquettes today!

main1.line: Om nom... Hey, Commander, what flavor of mooncake do you like?

main2.line: Just so you know, Commander, I'm an unrivaled champion at hammering mooncake!

main3.line: The sweet osmanthus cakes my sister made smell delicious. You want one, Commander?

touch.line: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! Do you wanna make a traditional lantern, Commander?

touch2.line: I feel like I could hop all the way up to the moon in this outfit...

unlock.line: Commander, happy Mid-Autumn Festival! I have mooncakes, pomegranates, and osmanthus cakes... Mm... This holiday is the best!

detail.line: I think big sister really likes her idol outfit.

expedition.line: Commander, can I go with you to welcome everyone home?

feeling5.line: Being an idol with my big sister is so much fun. And it's been a really long time since I've seen her so happy... but I'd be even happier with you, Commander.

login.line: Commander, are you here for my show?

lose.line: Big sister, my clothes ripped... sew them for me...

mail.line: Commander, can you help me reply to all this fan mail? I can't do it all by myself...

main1.line: Big sister says all I need to do is be myself up on stage, but the truth is I don't know how to be myself unless she tells me...

main2.line: Commander, do you think I should try doing kung fu up on stage? Like this.. hiyaa!

main3.line: I think everybody really likes Baobao. Let me do a show with Baobao next time!

mission.line: Big sister says more offers means more money...

mission_complete.line: They gave me so much good stuff to eat. I love it!

touch.line: Commander, you want to get up on stage with me?

touch2.line: I think I'm wearing it right?

unlock.line: Big sister says that even though we have some money now, we still have to save as much as we can. Um... Anyway, I'm the younger "Dragon Sister," Ping Hai. Erm... I'm kind of hungry. Do you maybe have something to eat?

detail.line: Big sister made a stupidly jam-packed schedule. Just looking at it makes me sleepy... But there's apparently lots of tasty food by the tourist attractions, so I'm coming along!

home.line: Commander, I wanna eat some tempura!

login.line: Commander, I wanna try the Sakura Empire's take on ramen!

main1.line: Big sister said this is a prize vacation, so we can't try out all the local restaurants... What even is a "prize vacation"?

main2.line: Big sister looks thrilled to get to enjoy a vacation! Seeing her smile, and getting to eat so much good food, has me feeling thrilled too!

main3.line: Let go of my jacket, big sister~! I've not finished my food yet! Give it a try you too, it's really yummy!

mission.line: There's so much tasty food I want to try!

touch.line: The goal of our vacation? Mine is to try *all* of the Sakura Empire's yummiest food!

unlock.line: The Sakura Empire has lots of delicious food that I've never tried before! Yeah! It's a great place!

detail.line: Just like Ning Hai's, me and the girls made my cake with love. It's a chao ji da strawberry cake... I wonder how many days it would take for me to eat by myself...? Hehehe.

home.line: I'm... so hungry... Maybe just a little bite... No! Ning Hai told me not to!

login.line: Here's your cake. Eat up. Ning Hai is passing out blueberry cake, but I've got strawberry.

main1.line: Baobao, where do I bring the next slice...?

main2.line: There's going to be so much good stuff at the party... Commander, they have to have some baozi, don't they?!

main3.line: Ning Hai always says I need to make more friends... But really I have so many friends already!

touch.line: Ning Hai told me to pass out my cake without bothering the Commander!

touch2.line: Mm. I've known for a long time, my sister and I are very different in that department.

unlock.line: There's always a lot of delicious food at these parties! But, my sister said I'm not allowed to have any cake until everyone's gotten their slice... Baobao, let's be on our best behavior!

detail.line: Commander, let's take these pandas back to port! ...We're not allowed? Aww...

home.line: I'm gonna take a bunch of pics of these cute pandas and show them to people around the port!

login.line: Big sister told me to look after these pandas! Does that mean I should play with them?

main1.line: Look at the camera! I'm gonna take a group photo!

main2.line: Do you wanna pet the pandas too, Commander?

main3.line: Eat lots, Baobao! Then you'll grow up to be as big as your buddy!

touch.line: I'm not allowed to feed them baozi? Okay, I'll keep that in mind...

unlock.line: Cheese! That came out looking good! Hehehe~ I'm really glad to be a part of this charity event for nature, along with you and my sister! Baobao is really glad too!

couple_encourage1.line: Sis, your octopus is getting away!

expedition.line: Commission complete, Commander! You should go take some dim sum out to our friends! Let's see... Does baozi sound good?

headtouch.line: Hmm? How am I supposed to chop the veggies like this? ...Oh, Commander, you should probably keep your fingers away from the kitchen knife.

home.line: Commander, are you hungry? If you want a snack, I've got some baozi. Want one?

login.line: For our ingredients, we've got crab, octopus, and fish... Commander, got a dish you're interested in?

mail.line: Commander, you've got new mail. I can't help you right now, so you'll have to remember to check it yourself.

main1.line: My sis said today is a huge opportunity to show off our culinary skills. So, what would you like to eat? As long as you can imagine it, we can whip it up for you~

main2.line: My new outfit? My sister and Chi An picked it out for me. Look at this~ Hiyaah~! Look how easy it is to move around! ...Hm? It looks good on me, but I should refrain from doing any kung fu? Why's that?

main3.line: Baobao, the hammer's dangerous, so put it down right now! Huh? The crab's making a beeline towards the Commander? Oh no, it's too late... Your hand's all red... *huff, huff*... Pain, pain, go away~! All better now?

mission_complete.line: Commander, new rewards have come in! Do you think there might be some handy cooking ingredients inside?

touch.line: You ARE hungry, aren't you? I'll have food ready in a moment... Umm, sorry, but I can't exactly go give you a hug right now.

touch2.line: ...Hm? I don't mind. But... I can't guarantee that my sister won't give you a walloping~

unlock.line: You can't have a hearty banquet without crab meat! Which is why... I'm not letting you get away! Oh, Commander, did you want to lend a hand? It's okay though, my sister and I have got things under wrap here.

main1.line: My sister bought another pair of socks again, but then gave them to me... Could it be that she actually wants to wear them?

main2.line: Baobao, stop jumping onto Commander's head to practice shadowboxing...

main3.line: You want me to stop doing high kicks? Why though?

touch.line: Commander, why are you putting my sister and I on opposite sides of the door? Huh? Exorcism?

unlock.line: Hi~ya! Hmm... this feels... nothing special. Baobao looks happy though... Never mind, Commander, Ping Hai is hungry!

win_mvp.line: Commander, I want to eat something yummy when I get back!

battle.line: Purge all evil. Become as a stalwart blade.

couple_encourage1.line: Sister, don't let the enemy get away with underestimating us.

couple_encourage2.line: Let's do this, together!

detail.line: Going by launch date, one could say that I am actually Chao Ho's older sister... But alas, since she wants that role so badly, she can have it. Besides, being the "little sister" comes with perks of its own. Hehe~♪

expedition.line: The expedition fleet is back. Don't forget to reward all our hardworking friends.

feeling1.line: ...I have nothing to say to you.

feeling2.line: Chao Ho should be doing her usual training just about now. Commander, why don't we go take a little field trip? Hehe~

feeling3.line: Chao Ho has been complaining to you that I've been pushing my chores onto her, hasn't she? Don't listen to her. I've just been instructing my little sister, who has stubbornly been running away from her responsibilities, about the realities of being an adult. Hehe~

feeling4.line: "Whenever I'm with the commander, I get all excited and can't figure out why... but, but..." Oh, ahem... I'd appreciate it if you could act like I was just talking to myself.

feeling5.line: There are a lot of things I'd like to say to you, but whenever I'm in front of you, it's like the words just won't come out... I'm afraid I'll have to write my feelings out for you, so please don't laugh.

headtouch.line: If you mess up my hair, I'll have you style it for me for a week starting tomorrow, you hear?

home.line: I'm sure there are a lot of things you're dying to tell me. But that can wait until after you've rested up.

hp_warning.line: We will not, cannot, back down here...!

login.line: The ever-industrious commander, right on time today. Hey... have you seriously never thought about playing hooky?

lose.line: Do I not have enough power... to stop the enemy's advance?

mail.line: You've got new mail... You know, stone-cold printed text doesn't have that same human touch as something handwritten.

main1.line: Chao Ho, if you want to be seen as the big sister, you're going to have to do things yourself instead of relying on the commander. Heehee~♪

main2.line: Reminder from Ying Swei~ You've had your head in the clouds for a while~

main3.line: Are you interested in the Four Treasures of the Study? I'd be glad to instruct you. Hehe, not to boast, but I'm quite confident in my abilities.

mission.line: Commander, we've got new missions. If Chao Ho was here, I'm sure she'd be nagging you to kingdom come. Hehe~

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Now, if I could just enjoy a meal, soak in the bath, and then get into bed... that would be the life. Hehe~

profile.line: I am the second ship of the Chao Ho-class protected cruisers, Ying Swei. I'm also Chao Ho's sister. By the way, if you see the two of us bickering, don't be alarmed. It's nothing more than our way of expressing affection for one another. Hehe~♪

propose.line: Ink does not fade with the passage of time... I wrote my feelings down with the hope that they also may never fade. I now offer these words to you, along with myself.

touch.line: If you're tired, you should go ahead and rest. Collapsing due to overwork is inefficient.

touch2.line: Wouldn't it be a great time for me to tell everyone how much of a pervert you are? If you want me to reconsider, you'll have to make me a little promise first. Hehe~

unlock.line: It is a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I am the elder of the Chao Ho sisters, Ying Swei. Hmm, Chao Ho said that she's the big sister? Hmm, I guess you're not as gullible as she is. Hehe~♪

upgrade.line: Indeed. You must be strong if you wish to protect what is dear to you.

win_mvp.line: I'll wait until I get back before declaring victory.

gift_prefer.line: One good turn deserves another. Allow me to reciprocate this generous gift.

feeling5_ex.line: Though I no longer communicate with you through writing, I feel like we understand each other much better now. Please continue to share your feelings with me, be they amorous or anxious.

headtouch_ex.line: I like the way you stroke my hair, ehehe~♡ ...Ah, no, I didn't say anything.

login_ex.line: We've got a lot of work to do today. Thanks in advance for your cooperation. ...Hehe, don't even think about slacking off~

main4_ex.line: Commander, in your times of need, please also call upon Chao Ho, not just me.

main5_ex.line: I've brought you a most sophisticated cup of lapsang souchong tea, hehe~

detail.line: Chao Ho thinks up the couplets, and I write them down. Don't you think we make a good team? Besides, seeing Chao Ho's brows furrow in thought is super cute... Anyway, let's think up some lines together later.

home.line: In the warm spring breeze, snow melts and life blooms anew. Spring is the season of life.

login.line: The warmth of spring often lulls many into oversleeping... But, Commander, it seems like you're accustomed to waking up early?

main1.line: Miss Yat Sen, I'll help you prepare the food for tonight's reunion dinner. What about the fish? I'll start it up if you'd like.

main2.line: I never thought I'd be able to enjoy the company of my sister and all our friends like this... Yes, it's all thanks to you, Commander.

main3.line: Fu Shun, if you throw any more firecrackers into the pond... I'll change your seat to be right next to that lotus~♪

touch.line: Since it's the Spring Festival, how about taking a break?

touch2.line: The excitement of the festival seems to have gone to your head. Hehe~

unlock.line: Happy New Year, Commander. I've come to deliver you blessings for this coming year... Next, you're going to ask for a red envelope, right? Hehe, just teasing~

win_mvp.line: A~ job~ well~ done~♪ ...Hehe, did you like that?

detail.line: This year, Hai Tien is in charge of coming up with the Spring Festival couplets, I'll be doing the calligraphy, and Chao Ho is handling the decorations. An all brawn, no brain job like that is perfect for my sister, isn't it? Heehee~♪

feeling5.line: I already apologized to Chao Ho about what happened today. Oh right, Commander, do you have some time to spare after the evening banquet? I have some things to tell you, but only if we're alone! Because, it's a little embarrassing... Ah, but I'll have to apologize to her again for making a move behind her back, heehee~♪

home.line: Nngh~ My legs sure are sore... Oh, Commander, you're back. Say... would you mind helping me out a little?

login.line: An old saying goes, "it's better to be lucky than it is to be punctual." Since you've come at quite the fortuitous moment, why not come sit next to me and enjoy the show? As for what's going on over here, don't sweat the small details~♪

mail.line: Got some mail for you, Commander, but it's not easy for me to move right now. I'll just leave it on the table for you.

main1.line: What's the matter, Chao Ho? Still haven't been able to get your stuff back? ...I tricked you? What could you possibly be talking about?

main2.line: We're almost completely out of ink for our Spring Festival couplets. Commander, mind helping me grind up the inkstick? I'm a bit busy right now, but I'll make a cup of tea for you later.

main3.line: The goods Akashi sent over sure are convenient. There's the mechanical errand-running Manjuus, the automatic fireworks launchers, and the lion dancers as well... I'm sure Fu Shun and her gals would have an absolute blast with these.

touch.line: You also want to try playing a prank on Chao Ho? Sure, but don't go too overboard~

touch2.line: Commander, are you sure you want to do this with Chao Ho watching? I never knew you had kinks like that...

unlock.line: Commander, Happy New Year! Chao Ho and I are preparing for this year's Spring Festival, and as you can see... we're in the middle of a little "intermission." Hehe, don't worry, there's nothing you need to help out with. Just take a seat over there and enjoy the show~

detail.line: Chao Ho and I picked out this swimsuit together. It shows off my curves... Ahem, forget I said that. Anyway, do you like it?

feeling5.line: Commander, we're reflected in the pool. Heehee, can you try coming a little closer? I want to see your reflection snuggling close to me. And... I want to see if you only have eyes for me♪

headtouch.line: Ah... Commander, you got my hair wet...

home.line: Phew... You're back. You look tired, so sit down with me and just feel the water on your skin for a while.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Do you have any plans? Heehee, if you've got the time... come join me for a game in the pool!

main1.line: Isn't this swan float just adorable? If you like it... then come and sit next to me♪

main2.line: Hm? Commander... Your eyes are practically glued to me. Do you prefer this outfit?

main3.line: Sunshine, a pool, and you... I wish every day could be this relaxed. If only I could keep you... Ahem... How am I supposed to express my feelings without pen and paper?

touch.line: Heehee... I could lose hours watching the ripples with you.

touch2.line: Keep doing that with me, and you'll face serious consequences... Oh, I mean falling into the pool, of course♡

unlock.line: Heehee, if it isn't the Commander. Your timing is perfect~ I was thinking I might take a break here... While you're here, why don't you rest in the pool with me?

detail.line: Don't you think I've become even more reliable? Hehe, there's no need to say it. I can already tell from the look in your eyes.

feeling5.line: There are so many things I want to say that I'll probably take up all of your free time... Hehe, anyway, where should I begin?

headtouch.line: You want to pat my head? That's fine by me, but in return, you'll have to brush my hair for the next two weeks.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. If you have any entertaining thoughts today, I'll be your best listener. Hehe, but first, take a break... Tell me all about it after.

login.line: You're very punctual, as usual. If you're in the mood to play hooky at all... I could help you get your work done early?

mail.line: You have mail. I suppose your period of rest is coming to a quick end... Would you like me to sort them out first?

main1.line: It's not as if your work will ever end. Put down your pen for a moment and try the tea I made, would you?

main2.line: I'd be happy to teach you about the Four Treasures of the Study. My brushwork is much steadier now, and I've gotten better at teaching!

main3.line: Chao Ho is secretly practicing her dance steps again. Wanna go watch with me? Heehee!

mission.line: Let's get these missions done before Chao Ho finds out. Otherwise, she'll start nagging you like a mom again.

mission_complete.line: Missions complete! All that's left to make the perfect day is to eat together, take a bath, and go right to sleep... What do you think, Commander? Heehee.

touch.line: Hehe, is that all you've got? Personally... I'm willing to go much further~

touch2.line: Well, well. I've caught you red-handed again. Hehe, if you want me to keep quiet... then you'll have to spend the entire weekend with me.

unlock.line: My retrofitting is complete! Don't I look a little stronger than before? Regardless, I hope you'll guide me as you always have, Commander.

battle.line: P-purge all evil... Ah, screw it, will you die already?!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's do this thing!

couple_encourage2.line: I'm glad we have such stalwart companions!

detail.line: Why do people think Ying Swei is the big sister?! ...Am I that immature in comparison?! Commander, what's your take on this?

expedition.line: The commission fleet's back? Y-yeah, we did send one out earlier, huh... Wh-what, I didn't forget about that!

feeling1.line: Don't talk to me like you know me!

feeling2.line: I still haven't practiced my dance today... Commander?! I, I won't let you peek!

feeling3.line: Commander! Ying Swei... Ying Swei... she threatened to not share Ning Hai's steamed buns with me! And said I have to clean the room today! H-hurry up and do something about her!

feeling4.line: Um, Ying Swei said you don't like short-tempered girls, so I'll try to act a bit mellower! So, um, please don't hate me... Hey, wh-what are you laughing for?! Don't get all uppity with me!

feeling5.line: About my new dance, um... I want you to name it, since you'll be the first person who gets to see it. So... how about it? Y-you don't have to come if you don't want to! ...Ugh! I mean, you have to come! No matter what! Even if you don't want to! Jeez!

headtouch.line: Ahhhh!! You're gonna mess it up, so stop touching already!

home.line: All right, nobody's here, right? Maybe I'll practice my dance steps a little... Ehh?! Huh... Wh-when'd you get back?!

hp_warning.line: It's time to get serious! I'll make them pay for underestimating me!

login.line: H-hey, you're late! I was worried about you, darn it!

lose.line: Guh... Am I still not strong enough yet...?

mail.line: Commander, hurry up and check your mail before it starts growing moss!

main1.line: Let Ying Swei handle the public side of things! I, uh, I'll support her from the sidelines! ...Wait, wouldn't that make me seem like the little sister then?!

main2.line: H-how long are you going to keep dawdling around in front of me? Can you just sit down and get your work done?! Eh? ...What the heck are you saying?! It's not like I really care what you're doing or anything...!

main3.line: Only through perseverance can we reach our desired outcome! ...Th-those are Ying Swei's words, not mine!

mission.line: We've got new missions! Hurry up and take a look! Otherwise, Ying Swei is going to complain about me nagging again!

mission_complete.line: That mission was a piece of cake! ...W-well, I suppose your efforts helped!

profile.line: I'm the name ship of the Chao Ho-class protected cruisers, Chao Ho! As for my history... who the heck knows! Specs? Dunno about that either! Stop asking about this stuff already!

propose.line: At a time like this, I'm supposed to say "may we hold hands and hope to live forever with one another" or something like that, right... Ahh, I can't remember this stuff! A-anyway, you have to take good care of me from now on! Got it?!

skill.line: Be captivated by my song and dance!

touch.line: ...What are you trying to do?!

touch2.line: Eeek?! Y-y-y-y-you pervert! Degenerate!

unlock.line: I'm Chao Ho, lead ship of the Chao Ho-class cruisers! Don't you forget it! Oh, and no matter what Ying Swei says, don't let her trick you into thinking I'm the little sister!

upgrade.line: H-hey, I look a bit more reliable now, don't I?

win_mvp.line: Hmph! I'll say this again! Don't you dare violate our oceans!

gift_prefer.line: It's mine now! I'm not giving it back!

detail_ex.line: Who's the big sister of the Chao Ho class? That's right! I'm Ying Swei's big sister~♪ I'm glad you understand now!

feeling1_ex.line: H-hey, you're not comparing me to Ying Swei, are you...

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, um, I'm not just your partner, but I'm also your big sister... or, at least I want to be! S-so, if I want to be pampered a bit... Yeah, pamper me! J-j-just a little!

headtouch_ex.line: Hmph. Fine, I'll let you touch me, but you better be grateful.

login_ex.line: What took you so long?! Are you trying to make me worry on purpose, you dolt...

main1_ex.line: You're leaving this assignment to me? G-got it! I'll show you what a capable big sis I am!

main2_ex.line: .........You haven't moved a muscle for quite some time now! S-say something to me every now and then! ...O-otherwise, I'll get worried...

main4_ex.line: Mm, fish and chips~♪ Even the Royal Navy has some pretty good food~

mail_ex.line: That mission was a piece of cake, wouldn't you agree?

mission_ex.line: We've got new missions! ...Wh-what is it? Are you not gonna do anything unless I nag like your mother?

mission_complete_ex.line: That mission was a piece of cake, wouldn't you agree?

touch_ex.line: Hyah?! I-I know you and I do this stuff all the time, but it's still so embarrassing!

touch2_ex.line: H-hey, you're not comparing me to Ying Swei, are you...

detail.line: That Ying Swei... Even though she knows I'm not good with the literary stuff, she still made me think up spring couplets... If it wasn't for her sake... Commander, come here and help me think of lines as well!

home.line: Don't worry, this tree is real sturdy and won't break with just one person on it... Hey, wait, are you calling me fat?!

login.line: You're late, Commander! Jeez, we're all supposed to get together for the New Year, so stop running around!

main1.line: My performance for the Spring Festival banquet? ...I-i-it's not like I'm nervous or anything! I've practiced over and over!

main2.line: I wish my sister was as demure and well-behaved as Tai Yuan... Yeah, Ying Swei, I'm talking about you! Stop laughing!

main3.line: Commander, it's really cold tonight around the time of the banquet. If you catch a cold, um, I'm going to have to take care of you, and that would be a hassle... So, um, yeah!

touch.line: ...D-don't scare me like that!

touch2.line: Y-you're gonna get eaten up by the Nian beast!

unlock.line: Happy New Year, Commander! This red envelope is my gift to you... after all, that's my responsibility as a big sister! Anyway, hurry up and take it!

detail.line: Ahhhhh jeez, what's wrong with these pipsqueaks?! I swear they're running from me on purpose... I knew it! This is all Ying Swei's fault! I knew she had an ulterior motive for assigning an "easy" job like decorating to me...!

feeling5.line: Umm, you don't need to be that worried about me. I'm used to Ying Swei playing pranks on me by now, and besides, she already said she's sorry... Well, if you insist on apologizing on her behalf, um... then, go on a date with me after this! ...You're fine with that? Heehee, I'm gonna make Ying Swei soooo jealous for what she did to me today~♪

home.line: Ugh, my back and legs are all sore... Commander, hang in there a bit longer for my sake, alright? I'm done for... I need to rest first...

login.line: Almost got it... Huh? Commander, what are you doing here all of a sudden? Hey, get back here, you dumb bird! Now look what you did! It got away because of you! Ughhh, why is this even happening?!

mail.line: Why's there a letter addressed to you in a place like this? Did you misplace it or something?

main1.line: Ying! Swei! I know you're behind all this, so get these little guys to knock it off already!

main2.line: Commander, um... Can you try to make things less awkward? You know, the two of us hiding under a table like this, umm... might cause some serious misunderstandings...

main3.line: I wonder how the decorations for the other parts of the port are coming along... Huh? You've already taken care of everything? W-wow, you're pretty reliable, huh...

touch.line: I, I didn't touch you on purpose, okay? I'm sorry! It's all because this little bugger here made me do it...

touch2.line: Y-y-y-y-y-you pervert! I can't believe you'd take advantage of another person's misery like this...!

unlock.line: Happy... New Year... Commander... Gah, this isn't the time for pleasantries! And you, help me catch the dumb fluffball that ran off with our ornaments! Jeez, why is this happening when I'm in the middle of getting ready for the Spring Festival?!

detail.line: Where on earth did it go... Ahem. We can play later, okay? I'm in the middle of something important... Geez! I'm not going anywhere, and my swimsuit DEFINITELY won't disappear into thin air!

feeling5.line: You're right next to me, but I can't bring myself to do anything... Huh? You noticed it right away?! Y-you didn't have to politely look away every time, then... You can look at me all you want...

headtouch.line: (Wh-what do you think you're doing? That almost blew my cover!)

home.line: Phew... Finally back? That must have been a rough battle. I'll make room for you, so get some rest in.

login.line: You're back? Then relax here for a while, if you want. ...You want to play with me? Sure... Huh? My swimsuit! N-no, now isn't a good time!

main1.line: My swan float? I mean, it's cute, isn't it? If you want to sit... Promise you won't turn toward me, and I'll let you!

main2.line: (You've been staring for a while... Do you know? What do I do if you know? This is way too embarrassing!)

main3.line: The pool is nice, the sunshine is pleasant, and I have you... I should be so happy right now. Why did this have to happen right now?!

touch.line: Oh, man... Ack! I was just looking at the ripples in the water!

touch2.line: Mmh?! Don't touch me out of nowhere... What if I fall?!

unlock.line: H-hey, you, warn me before you come in next time! I was just looking for my swimsuit... F-forget it, okay? I'm not trying to chase you out! If you're coming in, then come in already!

detail.line: Do I look more like an older sister now, Commander? Hmph! Now nobody will think Ying Swei is the older one! H-hey, quit laughing!

feeling5.line: New clothes, new steps, and it's all for you... That's why I staked my pride on making it all perfect! I mean, you know that, don't you?! If you tease me and act like it's not perfect... I'll never forgive you!

headtouch.line: H-honestly, you're too much... Okay, but just a little.

home.line: Oh? You're back? ...No, I was NOT waiting for you! I just happened to finish my drills!

login.line: Hmm, right on time. Very nice. As the older sister, I have to commend your punctuality.

main1.line: Why are you looking at me like that? Don't tell me... Heheh, you've finally realized how awesome of an older sister I am?

main2.line: Hey... If anything is bothering you, you could... you could talk to me about it... I-I'm not worried about you. I just don't want it to affect your work!

main3.line: Your documents are a mess! Yeah, yeah, I'll clean it up for you. But I'm not doing it for your sake!

mission.line: You have new missions! I'll keep an eye on everything. Get them done quickly so you can get some rest!

mission_complete.line: Easy-peasy! I was totally reliable, wasn't I? O-of course, you deserve most of the credit...

touch.line: Hyah?! Wh-why are you getting so close to me?!

touch2.line: Hyah?! Wh-wh-what are you doing, dummy?! Now isn't the time to be doing that!

unlock.line: Chao Ho's back, and she's better than ever! Hmph! Now my strength and my authority as the older sister are unquestionable!

battle.line: Is the only way to end war... through more war?

couple_encourage1.line: Don't worry, I'll be fine.

detail.line: "It is easier to relate with the despair of a wilting flower than the beauty of a blooming flower." ...Do you think I'm being too sentimental?

expedition.line: It looks like the girls have returned from their commissions. Make sure you show them your gratitude.

feeling1.line: Please do not talk to me. I wish to be alone.

feeling2.line: The beautiful part about poems is not only their rhymes and coupling, but also the many thoughts hidden between the lines... Do you have an interest in the path of poetry, Commander?

feeling3.line: There are many forms of poetry, including the bold and uninhibited "Boundless Waves" style, as well as the gentle and reserved "Country Jade" style. Which do you prefer, Commander?

feeling4.line: *Sigh*... Oh, my apologies, Commander. I'm perfectly fine. It's just that... I recently read some excellently-composed poems about "reminiscence." I suppose I found them to be... extremely relatable.

feeling5.line: As a commander, the winds of war may one day take you far, far away... But no matter where you are, please remember –– we will always be together under the same night sky.

headtouch.line: Hm? I feel perfectly fine though?

home.line: Commander, good work in your operation. I have prepared some nutritious tremella lotus soup for you. Please dig in... Um, did I make it too sweet...?

hp_warning.line: The fog's rolling in...?!

login.line: "Time is worth its measure in gold." Commander, if you don't start your work by now, you'll end up wasting the entire day.

lose.line: I see... "Even horses can stumble."

mail.line: Every word and letter written on this paper is a deep thought from far away...

main1.line: Looks like Hai Chi is just as energetic as always. Oh... Is she a bother to you, Commander?

main2.line: I left a manuscript of poetry on your desk, Commander. If you would please peruse it when you have the time.

main3.line: What shall we do for dinner? Hmm... How about some mapo tofu?

mission.line: Commander, please make sure you remember to complete all your missions today.

mission_complete.line: Good work completing your missions. I'm sure the rewards will be great as well.

profile.line: I am Hai Tien, a Hai Tien-class protected cruiser from the Dragon Empery. There's not much to say about my past except perhaps... that fate was unkind to me.

propose.line: "Being able to find one's soulmate in the flowing river of time is the greatest blessing in life." Wait, um, that means we're more than just good friends.... Err, umm, I'm okay with that too... I mean, wait, give me a second to sort out my thoughts... P-please, just a moment!

skill.line: "Even mountains will move before an unbreakable spirit!"

touch.line: Oh, my apologies... I was thinking about the book of poems I was reading earlier. What can I do for you?

touch2.line: H-how shameless of you...!

unlock.line: Pleased to meet you, Commander. I am Hai Tien of the Dragon Empery. As a newcomer who knows not the customs of this place, please bear with me should I make any blunders.

upgrade.line: "To do a good job, a craftman must first have the right tools." Thank you very much, Commander.

win_mvp.line: "War stains the land for a thousand miles, bullets salting the earth in its wake." ...When will the flames of war finally be snuffed out?

gift_prefer.line: I swear, I will repay this kindness someday!

feeling5_ex.line: It is quite natural for me to be in high spirits. After all, my beloved is by my side, your warmth imbuing me with a happiness that overflows without cessation. What cause could I possibly have to be displeased? And just like me, I hope that as long as I remain by your side, your precious smile will never fade away~♪

headtouch_ex.line: Hmph... I'm not a child anymore...

login_ex.line: Let what should be done today not burden you tomorrow. Commander, let's both strive to reject procrastination.

main4_ex.line: The Dragon Empery has produced countless beautiful works that evoke the imagery of love, such as red beans symbolizing fidelity, and the ever-famous mandarin ducks... Hehe, maybe we should recite some love poem together, Commander?

touch_ex.line: Whether you'd like to discuss some poetry or simply chat for a bit, I'd love to spend some time with you.

touch2_ex.line: Ah, um, at least let me prepare myself...

win_mvp_ex.line: It would appear that the winds of fortune favor us today. Hehe~

home.line: "Lotus flowers blooming in a clear pond, clouds flowing through the air, a sage descends from their dwelling, playing music and dancing about." ...Hehe, Hai Chi's dance is something worth appreciating. If that sounds interesting to you, why don't we go watch her together?

login.line: Good morning, Commander. It's still early in the morning; why not rest a bit more?

main1.line: Just looking at all the carp in the pool, full of vigor and vitality, seems to uplift my spirit as well.

main2.line: I finished writing my couplet for the Lunar New Year, and Ying Swei is preparing to transcribe it. She even said, "We made it through without relying on Chao Ho." Looks like the two get along well.

main3.line: I've prepared some splendid dishes for the upcoming Spring Festival banquet. Sweet and sour fish, braised pork feet, and dongpo pork... Yep, they all look good!

touch.line: You'll hold this for me? Why, thank you very much.

touch2.line: My, it looks like this drunkard has set their sights on something other than alcohol.

unlock.line: What a serendipitous meeting this is, Commander. I was simply searching for a place where I could leisurely enjoy my poetry manuscript. Since fate has brought both of us here, why don't we accompany each other for a while?

detail.line: I know a thing or two about playing the pipa, but holding this position is rather difficult... not to mention, embarrassing...

headtouch.line: I put quite a bit of time and effort into making these hair ornaments. They're pretty, aren't they?

home.line: Hai Chi's special dance lessons should've helped out a little bit... What do you think, Commander?

login.line: Commander, umm... Next, I would like to humbly offer you a dance... Sorry, but, umm... I'm still a bit nervous about this...

main1.line: Huh? Y-you want me to try making this pose as well? Um, Hai Chi, I'm not sure about that... Can't we go with something a bit easier?

main2.line: If only I were a real apsaras who could fly freely through the skies... Hmm, maybe those are the kinds of wishes that gave birth to airplanes.

main3.line: Eep! Why'd the wind pick up all of a sudden?! ...Come to think of it, this apsaras outfit is rather... breezy... *blushes*

touch.line: Umm, I'll be alright. I can endure this. If you agree that I'm not a weak little girl, please put up with my wilfulness a bit longer.

touch2.line: I-it's not very courteous of you to take advantage of another's vulnerability...

unlock.line: Through dance of gossamer silk, the apsaras' grace soars... Oh, I'm simply reciting something I just happened to pick up on. What do you think, Commander? If I've captured your attention, I suppose this was worth our while~

detail.line: Strange rumors seem to have surfaced that "a ghostly woman has appeared in the forest, floating upon a strange-sounding wind"... Um, Commander, why are you staring at me like that...?

home.line: Commander, need a little pick-me-up? I happened to make some extra shaobing earlier–– Oh, they're too sweet?

login.line: The scenery tonight is wonderful, is it not? The two of us sneaking off under the hustle and bustle of the festivities to enjoy some alone time... Doesn't it feel a bit like a tryst?

main1.line: "Upon the water's surface, algae intersects with shadows of bamboo and cypress." Gods and ghosts aside, an outing during a night like this is certainly an experience to remember. And what's more, you're here too...

main2.line: Vampires, Frankenstein, and witches... No matter where you go, there will always be so many legends of oddities and monsters. Isn't that interesting?

main3.line: So basically, if the kids say "trick or treat" to me, I have to give them candy? I see... Do you think these shaobing will suffice?

mission.line: Today is a day to rest our weary wings, so why don't we set aside work for the time being?

touch.line: H-hold hands...?

touch2.line: S-so this is what you were after the entire time, Commander?!

unlock.line: Sorry to keep you waiting. It took quite some time to prepare my dress as well as this lantern... Yes, when you said we would go on a "night stroll," I made some preparations in accordance to what my ancestors once did. Now then, shall we set off?

feeling5.line: "Delicious foods are common, but a true friend is rare. Even more, a lover you can spend the good times with..." Hm? That look on your face... Heehee, it looks like you understand how I feel.

headtouch.line: Umm, you're not supposed to knead me like I'm dough...

home.line: Thanks for your hard work today, Commander. I brought pastries. ...Oh? The sweetness level is perfect? I'm glad to hear that♪

login.line: Today's afternoon tea time will combine crispy pastries and sencha-brewed green tea... Phew, I'm already excited for it.

main1.line: The old philosophers tell us to eat finely ground grain and finely chopped meat. In other words, all foods – including pastries – should be healthy and intricate.

main2.line: Did you know that being "not TOO sweet" is one of the highest praises for sweets? Heehee, do my pastries suit your palate, Commander?

main3.line: "Even if your teeth fall out, eat pastries without reserve." Never be ashamed to enjoy what you like, Commander.

mission.line: You have unfinished missions, you know. Do your best to finish them, and I'll give you a reward.

mission_complete.line: Heehee, you did your missions! How about I feed you my newest pastry in return?♪

touch.line: Oh... Are you still hungry?

touch2.line: Th-that isn't mochi...

unlock.line: Welcome back, Commander. I made some tasty pastries for you. ...Huh? You want the one in my chest? Th-that doesn't count.

battle.line: "A war to end all wars" ...Even if this idea is futile, it is all I can do to protect the people I love!

detail.line: At some point, I started to find myself filled with happiness whenever I was around you. Perhaps this is the true essence of "sharing drinks, holding hands, growing old together, so that the years flow by harmoniously."

feeling5.line: "Pity unto the mandarin ducks, cherished are the years. The earth aged, the skies desolate. Yet nevertheless, life after life, together they come, to fly as a pair." ...Commander, do you understand the meaning of my words?

headtouch.line: Hmm... Commander, I wonder why you look so brave and gallant today... P-perhaps it is because I am at your side?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've prepared a nutritious medicinal decoction of mountain yam and goji berries for you... but this time, I made it sweet enough to suit your tastes!

login.line: You're here, Commander. To commemorate this auspicious day, I've brought some mutual-joy cakes. I hope you find them to your liking.

lose.line: I already promised... to never give up.

main1.line: Commander, is there anything you'd like for dinner? ...Hm? You'll go with my recommendation? Well, umm... How about something nourishing, like oysters, or mutton?

main2.line: Umm... I r-recently wrote a short story, and the main characters are the two of us... W-would you like to give it a read?

main3.line: "At dawn I gaze at the sky and at dusk, the clouds. Whether in motion or at rest, I find your countenance on my mind." ...Huh? A t-translation? Oh, umm... it means, that I, umm... that I'm thinking about you at all times! *blushes*

mission.line: Commander, don't forget to finish your work. I'll be right here to help you.

mission_complete.line: Have you finished your missions? I'll help you record down the rewards.

touch.line: You want to hold hands with me? Then, umm... Please do so, firmly.

touch2.line: C-Commander, I, I'm ready for this...!

unlock.line: "Dragon-shaped jade comb in hand, tied is her hair with gold ribbons and phoenix's hairpin" ...Thank you for waiting for me, Commander. Long have I dreamt for this moment to come true... Please allow me to remain by your side forevermore. N-now then, I believe the next thing for us to do is... c-consumate... *blushes*

win_mvp.line: "An end to all wars, when peace prevails over the seas." The future you desire will come to pass, and I shall witness it with you.

battle.line: Forward in formation! "Let not a single scrap of armor remain of our enemies!"

couple_encourage1.line: Stay focused, sis!

detail.line: Are you a cat person, Commander? Cats are actually quite clever. If you're ever struggling to choose between two things, just let a cat decide. The results may surprise you!

expedition.line: Those girls you sent out have returned! I've readied a small meal for them. An army can't march on an empty stomach, you know!

feeling1.line: Hmph. Everything you've done and said, I'll hold against you forever!

feeling2.line: I wonder what gift I should buy for Hai Tien on my next trip... Wait, I've got it! The same as usual – a yummy snack!

feeling3.line: If I'll ever have to make a tough life decision, I'll face it with solemn courage and thrust forward, like a river current cleaving through land! ....Hoo! Haah!

feeling4.line: We have a saying in the Dragon Empery, "the time spent sharpening your axe is made back multifold on the job." In other words, taking some time to rest makes you more productive in the end! So, with that in mind... How about we go on a journey right now?

feeling5.line: If I've put you off with my habit to say whatever pops into my mind, then... sorry! Then again, you've known me for so long you must be used to it by now. Right? Hehehe~

headtouch.line: You like my hair ornament? Thanks, but no touching, please.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Did the sortie take you far from home? Did anything interesting happen? Come on, I wanna know!

hp_warning.line: Gah... Don't you dare underestimate me!

login.line: "A sharp mind is honed through diligence and dulled by indolence." Commander, you'd better get ready to give it your all today!

lose.line: Bweh... I'll get you for this!

mail.line: Commander! A horseback messenger brought this – a letter for you!

main1.line: Do you have any interest in Dragon Empery's traditional opera? In that case, I'd be glad to show you an example. What sort of piece would you want me to perform?

main2.line: My sister's pretty reserved, but I don't shy away from speaking my mind. Comes as naturally to me as breathing!

main3.line: The Dragon Empery has a proverb that goes, "it is never too late for the noble to take revenge," but personally, I disagree! If you don't set wrongdoers straight right away, they'll only be emboldened!

mission.line: You've got new missions! I'll do the navigating!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Might I interest you in a dramatic performance during breaktime?

profile.line: I'm Hai Chi, Hai Tien-class protected cruiser number two. With how different we are, you almost wouldn't believe Hai Tien and I are sisters. She likes staying indoors and reading, while I prefer getting out and going places! "Wiser is she who travels ten thousand miles than she who reads ten thousand books," after all!

propose.line: Oh my gosh! Is this for me? Hehehe~ Know that you're in safe hands with me. I promise you're not gonna regret this decision! If you didn't know, I'm the world's best housewife, bar none! Now, with our vows made, let's get started packing our belongings and go on a productivity-boosting honeymoon!

skill.line: Hi-yah! We'll scatter you like petals in the current!

touch.line: Commander, if there's anything on your mind, just say it to me straight away!

touch2.line: Oh, you are so gonna get an earful from my sister for this!

unlock.line: You're the Commander? Hahah, I've heard all about you! Oh right, I forgot to introduce myself! I'm Hai Chi, Hai Tien-class cruiser. My two favorite things are traditional opera and going on trips! ...But, let's cut the chit-chat. You'll learn more about me soon enough anyway!

upgrade.line: "Spare no expense. Even a dull blade can shine bright," right?

win_mvp.line: "When I take the reins, none may stand before me!"

gift_prefer.line: Commander, thank you for the gift! Hmm... I wonder how I can return the favor...

home_ex.line: Where'd you go this time, Commander? The stories about your journeys are as interesting to me as dramatic operas!

login_ex.line: Let's get to work, Commander! The faster we get it done, the sooner we can do other stuff! It's as easy as that!

main4_ex.line: Commander! You should definitely come watch my next spear dance performance! I guarantee your jaw will drop when you see it! Hehehe~

main5_ex.line: "Reward the righteous and punish the wicked, and you will live neither indebted nor in regret." That's my motto! You can't go easy on wrongdoers – they'll only keep pushing the boundary of what they can get away with!

touch2_ex.line: Being upfront about your feelings is good, b-but I'd appreciate at least a little restraint!

detail.line: For this part, I guess I should pose like... this? Ah, you're back, Commander? Perfect! Could you watch for a sec and tell me if my moves are on-point?

home.line: "Clouds of fog sail the air as pond lotuses bloom. The mountain recluse descends from the sky to play a melody." My sis composed this little poem on the spur of the moment and I wrote it down!

login.line: Welcome, Commander! I'll be performing a Dragon Empery dance at the port later today. Wanna come watch?

main1.line: This act – known as the "behind-back pipa" – takes serious skill. You can't pull it off with half-baked effort!

main2.line: Allow me to play you a song on my pipa! Full disclosure though: I only started learning it a while ago. If something sounds off, don't be afraid to point it out!

main3.line: Struggling with poetic rhymes? Ask my sis, she can produce ten verses without even thinking about it! No, seriously!

touch.line: You've fallen for my goddess-like looks, haven't you~? Hehehe, it's okay to come out and admit it~

touch2.line: Ugh, Commander! This is NOT how you treat a goddess!

unlock.line: Look, Commander! I've become a goddess from the Dragon Empery's folklore! Hehehe! Let me perform for you a song and dance number I just learned!

battle.line: Strike while the iron is hot~♪

couple_encourage1.line: You certainly have a different way of doing things.

detail.line: What's on your mind? If you're ever feeling indecisive, lost, or anxious about the future... you can always come talk to me~

expedition.line: The girls from the commission team have returned. Naturally, you should go express your gratitude to them. Cultivating harmonious relationships is important, you know?

feeling1.line: Jeez... I know I said you could always come to me if you had any worries on your mind, but... If this is how you're going to be... *sigh*, oh well...

feeling2.line: The girls are saying that I can make any problem melt right away? Heehee... I think they're exaggerating a bit. I'm simply a good listener, nothing more~

feeling3.line: Even though I choose to be everyone's listener, there's a reason why I don't make suggestions or decisions for them. "True knowledge lies in knowing that there are things you do not know." Heehee... Commander, this is an adage you understand well, right?

feeling4.line: Oh my... Did you want to vent your frustrations? I'm glad you remembered what I said. Heehee. In return, you wouldn't mind if I try to get to know you a bit more... intimately, would you?

feeling5.line: ...By the way, Commander, do you think you'd be willing to lend me an ear now? I won't take too much of your time. Umm... Actually, this time, um... it's about plans for this year's Qixi festival...

headtouch.line: Why don't you let me pat your head instead, Commander~

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Oh, your collar's all messed up... Heehee. That should do the trick.

hp_warning.line: This has gotten rather troublesome...

login.line: Good day. You seem to be in high spirits today, heehee. I'm sure today's work will go smoothly.

lose.line: Soldiers know well both the sweetness of victory and the bitterness of defeat. The more important thing is to try again.

mail.line: There's new mail for you. Oh, looks like my cookbook has arrived as well~

main1.line: It is said that war is the art of deception, but in reality, the resources at your disposal are limited. Do you seek to make micro-level changes, or do you seek macro-level stability? This.... is the difference between a tactician and a strategist.

main2.line: I do enjoy a good game of Go. ...No, I don't particularly care for the tense clash of wits. It's just nice to have a pleasant conversation with my opponent.

main3.line: ...Now, this is quite unfortunate. Even Fu Shun doesn't want me going into the kitchen. Do you think you could help me improve my cooking skills, Commander?

mission.line: Commander, please remember to complete your missions. The greatest advantages begin with small steps taken daily.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Slowly but steadily, this is how great advantages are accrued.

profile.line: I am Chi An of the Dragon Empery. I am a light cruiser created through an improvement upon the design of the Novara-class cruisers. As for how I came to be... Have you ever heard of the designation, CNT-65? Hehe, I'm actually a lot more knowledgeable than you would expect~♪

propose.line: An important discussion, hmm? Heehee. Is this what you meant? My, I suppose I was caught off guard this time by your bold and decisive move. Though, I do hope you've prepared yourself, because my counterattack is going to be even more passionate~♡

skill.line: The flow of battle is mine to control!

touch.line: Oh my, are you interested in trying some of my home cooking? "Anything but that"? Aww...

touch2.line: Oh... My, oh my... Heehee. How wonderfully daring of you~♪

unlock.line: Greetings. I am Chi An, light cruiser of the Dragon Empery. Now that we've gotten these stiff introductions out of the way... Commander, should you ever have any worries on your mind from now on, you can always turn to me~♪

upgrade.line: Mm. That feels pretty nice~♪

win_mvp.line: Strategies devised in the command tent can determine the outcome of battles waged thousands of miles away~♪

gift_prefer.line: Aww, isn't that cute?

detail_ex.line: Care for a game of Go? No matter what you might have on your mind, the board is the perfect place to vent.

feeling5_ex.line: Out of curiosity, Commander, are you free today? Would you like to spend the Qixi Festival with me? ...It's too early for that? Hmm, are you sure there isn't something wrong with your calendar? Because according to my calendar, today is Qixi, and so is tomorrow, and the day after... Every day is Qixi, you know...

login_ex.line: Good day. Are you ready to take care of today's work? Heehee. I'll lend you my full assistance.

main4_ex.line: You managed to win by half a point with Chen Hai? Oh, I doubt it's solely because I instructed you well. But, a win is a win... So, can I expect a reward from you?

main5_ex.line: Thanks to your special training course, I was finally able to earn permission to enter the kitchen. Mmhmm~♪

touch_ex.line: You'll teach me how to cook? I'm so glad to hear that~

touch2_ex.line: Oh my, surely you don't think I'd just let you end it there~?

detail.line: How do you think our lovely little cruise will end? In the festive and bustling streets, in a wondrous display of fireworks, or amidst the endless lanterns illuminating the river? Let's take in all the sights and sounds until the very end, together. How does that sound? Heehee~

feeling5.line: You've made me a very happy girl, you know? Look, we got to enjoy this wonderful scenery, and also shared this night cruise together... Hah, how nice it would be if we could be together like this... forever.

home.line: Oh my, the rivers converge here once more. Now then, Commander, what sights did you witness along your particular route? I'm simply dying to know~

login.line: Commander, you're right on time. Hurry, let's enjoy a night cruise along the lively river~♪

main1.line: Um... Ehh? There's a branch in the river up ahead? Should we go left... or right? I can't believe a strategist such as myself can get lost like this... Ugh, stop making fun of me already and help me figure out which route will be more interesting to traverse~

main2.line: Come to think of it, the flower lanterns floating down the river are said to contain everyone's wishes for a smooth year to come. Seeing all the lanterns gathering around us like this makes me think that our relationship will follow suit as well... Heehee~♪

main3.line: Oh, look~ There's a row of food stalls next to the pier over there. I have a feeling we'll be able to find lots of novel food! Want to head over there in a bit and buy something? Of course, I'd share with you~♪

touch.line: Hmm? You'd like to share a flower lantern with me? Of course that's fine, but... you'll have to come sit in my lap~

touch2.line: Oh my... I know exactly what you're thinking~♪

unlock.line: May blessings reach you this coming spring. Hm? My outfit? Heehee. Since the ever-so-busy Commander came to see me on this special occasion, I naturally had to put in some effort too– Now then, set aside all your worries, and come enjoy this wonderful evening with me~♪

detail.line: Oh? Do you find this whole "traveler and nobility" shtick a little awkward? But everyone dressed up for it! Relax and role-play a little, Commander.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Let's get back to this after we've welcomed them, okay?

feeling5.line: Heehee... Destined partner, traveler from my dreams... If the fates so favor our love, then why don't you turn this sojourn into a permanent one? Let us weave a future together in this palace.

headtouch.line: Your tenderness always warms my heart, Commander.

home.line: You must be tired from your journey. Don't be afraid~ There's a soft, fluffy bed with your name on it right here.

login.line: Oh, it's you. Heehee, even the winds and sands can't stop my destined partner's arrival.

mail.line: You've got new mail... A call to new adventure, perhaps?

main1.line: I know you've seen much in your travels, but surely you must need a peaceful place of rest. Maybe here is the place for you to unload your burdens.

main2.line: If you find this exposition plain, then why don't we do it over a game or an exotic meal... Oh? You don't want my cooking? Aww, but why?

main3.line: Everything here is so perfect, yet I know that you will someday leave... Ah, how I wish you could stay...

mission.line: Do you still have unfinished tasks? Heehee, then let me help you take care of them all. Then we can resume our fun...

touch.line: Hm? Do you have a question for me? I'm happy to answer~

touch2.line: Oh, my... This traveler is a naughty one.

unlock.line: Phew... Fancy seeing the person of my dreams AFTER I've woken up! Heehee, if this is as fate decrees... Weary traveler, come to me and rest your tired legs.

battle.line: Commander, I... I want you to pay close attention to us!

couple_encourage1.line: So, help a girl out? What's trendy and fashionable these days?

couple_encourage2.line: Wanna go hang out after this?

detail.line: I heard washing pots and pans with lemon water is good for removing stains... Huh? It'll just make them corrode faster?

expedition.line: Looks like the commission fleet has returned. Shall I go bring them the sweets that I made?

feeling1.line: S-stop staring at my forehead already! I'll have you know, it's a trendy hairstyle! Got a problem with that? Hmph!

feeling2.line: Chi An said that I'm always talking about you...? N-nonsense! Wh-why would I be going on and on about you in public anyway? Hmph!

feeling3.line: Commander, are you trying to make coffee by any chance? Make sure the water doesn't get any hotter than 96 °C, or else the brew will go bitter. Wh-what are you looking at?! I just don't you to waste the coffee!

feeling4.line: I've been craving sweets a lot recently, so let's look into why this might be happening... Craving sweets is often associated with falling in love...? Huh? Wait, does this mean I'm falling in love with the Com— Commander?! H-how long have you been here?!

feeling5.line: You want me to try being nicer to you? It's not like I'm trying to be particularly harsh with you or anything... Like, I'm pretty normal in front of everyone else, but when it comes to you... I get all nervous and my heart starts pounding real fast, and even if I try to be nice to you, I can't... I'm not normally like that at all, so it has to be all your fault! Hmph!

headtouch.line: Ermm... Wh-what's your deal? You're messing up my hair... H-hey, stop staring at my forehead!

home.line: Welcome back, and good work out there. H-huh? Why am I being so nice to you all of a sudden?! I just wanted to say something nice b-because it looked like you were having a rough time! ...Hmph! I knew I should've just kept being strict with you!

hp_warning.line: You dare underestimate me? I'll have you know, I drank ginseng root coffee this morning!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. I hope you came to work ready to give it your all. Naturally, I'm already in tip-top condition.

lose.line: Is everyone okay? Please pull back to avoid further damage!

mail.line: Commander, there's new mail for you. I'd urge you to read and reply as soon as possible.

main1.line: The creativity of the desserts in this cookbook makes them all look so appetizing... What, you want to try them? O-of course I don't mind making these to share. M-maybe I'll make some for you too! Hmph!

main2.line: Apparently, certain colors are associated with different emotions, so I've color-coded your files to help you organize them more effectively. See, watch me find exactly what you need— Wait, huh? No way... Is this method not useful after all...?

main3.line: Hmph! Stop staring at me and focus on your work! Huh?! I wouldn't notice if I wasn't also staring at you? Wh-who would ever want to stare at you?! Hmph!

mission.line: Commander, you're not done with your missions, are you? ...It, it isn't because I'm concerned about you or anything! ...That's right! I have to keep a close eye on you because you're a known slacker!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Let's take it easy for now and have some honey water. I've been keeping this super-special honey stashed away for years! ...Huh? Expiration date? Honey doesn't expire... does it?

profile.line: I am Hai Yung of the Dragon Empery. I hope to be on good terms with everyone in this port. You? O-of course I intend to b-be on good terms with you! Just professionally, though! It's not like I want to be friends with you or anything! Hmph!

propose.line: I fully understand what you're trying to convey by giving me this gift. Which means, during these moments, I need to seriously and carefully consider your feelings and respond to them... So yes, I'd be glad to accept this.
