Thank you for accepting me for who I am... b-but it's too late for take-backs now, got it?! So hurry up and put it on already! Hmph!

touch.line: That's right, I came up with this fashionable ensemble all on my own! If you want some advice... maybe I could lend you an ear!

touch2.line: Eek! P-please stop that! They're not going to get any bigger no matter how much you touch! Even I know that!

unlock.line: Please to meet you. I am Hai Yung. If you really are a first-rate commander, I assume you already know who I am? Huh? You don't? Hmph... Well, I'll have you understand sooner rather than later! In any case, if you need anything done, just leave it to me!

upgrade.line: Heh. Look, I'm even stronger than before. Try not to rely on me too much, got it? Well, umm... actually, it's okay to rely on me just a little bit!

win_mvp.line: It's only natural that the victory is mine. Y-you were watching me closely, right?

gift_prefer.line: Th-this is so thoughtful... Hmph. Thank you.

feeling5_ex.line: I thought that the heart-throbbing honeymoon phase was supposed to be short-lived... so why does my heart still pound like crazy whenever I'm near the Commander? ...Ugh, whatever, forget that stupid book! What's more important is that we can both move forward into the future while being truly happy!

headtouch_ex.line: Ugh, I knew you had something against my forehead— Huh? You LIKE it? ...S-seriously?!

home_ex.line: Welcome back. I brought you tea and some towels. Dry yourself off, take a seat, and relax... I'm being pretty thoughtful? W-well, yeah! I want to try being more open and straightforward... Hey, what's with that look on your face?!

login_ex.line: Commander, I trust you're in tip-top shape to begin today's work. Before that, though, do you notice something different about me? Heheh, right, it's my makeup. After all, I... A-actually, it's not like I wanted to get dolled up or anything! Ahh, jeez! Fine, I just wanted to give you a little surprise, okay? Hmph!

main4_ex.line: I'm taking some sweets over to Chen Hai and her friends shortly, but there aren't any for you! ...H-hey, why do you look so disappointed? Here, I baked a caramel cake for you instead as a way of expressing my feelings! So go get it yourself!

main5_ex.line: What's wrong? You look awfully beat. Has work been too stressful? Here, give me your hand... I read a book that says, holding hands with someone is a good way to relieve stress. So, do you feel better?

main6_ex.line: I've already completed my work to perfection, so what's wrong with me looking at you? You, on the other hand... Seeing as how you still have time to pay attention to me, have YOU finished your work?

touch_ex.line: So you finally noticed what's different about me? ...I-it's not like I did it or anything because you said you liked it or anything! Hmph!

touch2_ex.line: Just because this isn't the first time we are doing this... doesn't make it any less embarrassing! Jeez!

detail.line: Hmm... If I raise my arms a bit and turn slightly to the side, I'll probably look slimmer...? Wh-what? I-I didn't say anything! I was just thinking of how to get the photo to come out better!

feeling5.line: I've been putting a lot of effort into researching fashion and photography recently, and I look pretty good today as a result of that hard work, right? B-by the way, I heard that photos taken under maple leaves symbolize eternal love... I-it's not like I planned this out or anything! It's just something I happened to notice!

headtouch.line: Did you only notice my hairstyle? You really ought to appreciate my clothes more too! ...I, I just want to make sure my aesthetic sense isn't off, that's all! Hmph!

home.line: There you are, Commander. I was just reading up on how a wider aperture lens is good for enhancing the atmosphere, making it easier to take close-up shots. Want to try taking some photos?

login.line: You came at just the right time, Commander. The scenery here is quite wonderful, so how about going on a stroll with me to soak it all in? Though, umm... It might be a bit hard to move around in this dress... Wh-what do you think?

main1.line: Commander, why don't we take a photo together? Come a little closer then. The lighting here is the best... I-it's not like I made preparations for this or anything! Isn't that obvious? Hmph!

main2.line: This place really is breathtaking, huh? Next time, I should invite the others as well... Hey, I never said I wasn't going to invite you! It's just... I already brought you here the first time, right?

main3.line: You know what they say... "You have to get closer to really make your photos pop." So, umm... Hey, Commander, can you come a bit closer? Just for the sake of the photos...

touch.line: Oh, are you f-fixing my clothes? Thanks...

touch2.line: D-did the design of my clothes catch your eye?

unlock.line: Very well, Commander, I'll leave the photography to you. I entrust you to capture my grace and elegance and record it into memory! Just so you're clear though, th-this is just an outfit that's in vogue... It's not like I chose to wear it for you or anything!

battle.line: This scent can chew through bone.

couple_encourage1.line: Care to try my freshly made perfume?

detail.line: My silken mask? It blocks off unwanted smells and protects my olfactory sense. Thanks to it, I can better focus on your smell when I remove it.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission team has brought back smells from afar.

feeling1.line: My silken mask can block off not just unwanted smells, but pushy individuals as well.

feeling2.line: It will take a little while for our scents to fully combine into one.

feeling3.line: Perhaps I'll look different from what you imagine once I take off my silken mask. Heehee. Watch closely. This is my everything laid bare...

feeling4.line: *sniff sniff*... Mmh... You have a deep and unique complexity, yet your essence is so warm... Truly, I can't get enough of it.

feeling5.line: My scent has already seeped into every little inch of your skin... There's no escaping it anymore.

headtouch.line: Commander, if you continue this, I fear I may... Heehee♥

home.line: Stress causes one to emit an astringent, bitter odor akin to overly concentrated aromatic oil. You must rest adequately so your scent may return to its mellow state.

hp_warning.line: Finally, a "smell" that stirs my interest.

login.line: You're here. Come closer... and let me imprint your scent upon my memory.

lose.line: Gunpowder smoke and rust... Such bitter smells.

mail.line: A letter has arrived from afar. Will you read it now?

main1.line: You smell exceptionally delicious today, Commander.

main2.line: Turning a lethal poison into an alluring perfume – that is the art of a perfumist, Commander.

main3.line: Now, repeat after me. Breathe in and let the fragrant mist diffuse... then slowly exhale. Feel my scent with your heart♡

mission.line: There are missions awaiting your "mixing," Commander.

mission_complete.line: A mission has been successfully "mixed." Now just to take in the rewards.

profile.line: I am Hai Chou, a perfumer. No secrets elude my sense of smell. For instance, it tells me that your heart is throbbing right now, and that your body is releasing a sweet pheromone. I want it all to myself.

propose.line: Mmh... I wish to apply both my mixed perfume and my concocted "poison" on you... Hmm? The antidote? Why, that's me, of course♡ Ahh...

touch.line: Say, have you noticed that my fragrance has already filled the air around you?

touch2.line: Heehee... This is my favorite spot to test fragrances on. Do you not believe me? Then try smelling your fingertips.

unlock.line: I am Hai Chou, a perfumer from the Dragon Empery. The scent upon your person... is quite intriguing. I do hope our cooperation is fruitful.

upgrade.line: The line between perfume and poison is drawn by a minuscule difference in dosage.

win_mvp.line: The aroma of victory is always so intoxicating.

gift_prefer.line: This is a lovely present. I should make it up to you somehow... Heehee.

feeling5_ex.line: I've at last obtained the scent I've been dreaming of... This perfume, based on the theme of love, was made with your odor as the foundation♪

headtouch_ex.line: I've mixed a new aroma that makes one crave a hug. Care to try it?

home_ex.line: *sniff sniff*... The smell of gunpowder smoke, the sea, and fatigue... Relax. Soon you will only smell my scent.

login_ex.line: Trying to decipher your scent is unexpectedly fun. When you're strong, you're as steadfast and alluring as a cedar, and when you're gentle, you're like a vetiver... Even though I know you so intimately, you still surprise me with these new scents.

main4_ex.line: Even through my silken mask, I can clearly discern the smell of your breath. It's a piercingly clear smell, like hoarfrost...

main5_ex.line: Come closer, Commander. Your emotions emit different scents... For instance, this sense of confusion – it's utterly delectable.

main6_ex.line: I used ambergris saved for a special occasion in my latest perfume. Come close and smell it for yourself. I'm curious to see how long its lingering smell will stay on you...♡

touch_ex.line: You can't be without me anymore, Commander♥

touch2_ex.line: Mmh... It's getting sweeter and deeper... Heehee – the scent on your fingertips, I mean♡

detail.line: The wrinkles on the bed, the lingering scent of perfume... They silently recount what took place prior, Commander♡

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I've made a calming perfume, so bring it to them as a gift.

feeling5.line: Your love, your trust... It all serves as crucial inspiration for me, and I will let no one else have it. No one but me is allowed to fulfill your whole being♡

headtouch.line: Huh? I'd just finished with my hair, and now you do this... Is it perhaps because you find me more alluring with my hair down?

home.line: You look rather tired. Since we have time, I'll keep you company a while longer. Now, come here...

login.line: Did the curious smell on your person bring you back? ...Hm? You wish to savor it some more? Heehee. Your wish is my command...

main1.line: I know that look. The fragrance of my specially made perfume has captivated you.

main2.line: Something smells dangerous yet alluring, you say? Well, was it the danger that drew you in, or did you stay because of the allure?

main3.line: You can try to feign composure, but your expression betrays you. Look here and here... You remember everything that I did.

touch.line: Are you this clingy? Keep this up, and I won't be able to let you go... Commander♡

touch2.line: Since you're so passionate... I'll let you have your fun one more time♡

unlock.line: You're awake? Judging from your appearance... I wonder if our previous rendezvous has left you unsatisfied?

upgrade.line: Now... we can have all the fun we want.

detail.line: The wrinkles on the bed, the lingering scent of perfume... They silently recount what took place prior, Commander♡

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I've made a calming perfume, so bring it to them as a gift.

feeling5.line: Your love, your trust... It all serves as crucial inspiration for me, and I will let no one else have it. No one but me is allowed to fulfill your whole being♡

headtouch.line: Huh? I'd just finished with my hair, and now you do this... Is it perhaps because you find me more alluring with my hair down?

home.line: You look rather tired. Since we have time, I'll keep you company a while longer. Now, come here...

login.line: Did the curious smell on your person bring you back? ...Hm? You wish to savor it some more? Heehee. Your wish is my command...

main1.line: I know that look. The fragrance of my specially made perfume has captivated you.

main2.line: Something smells dangerous yet alluring, you say? Well, was it the danger that drew you in, or did you stay because of the allure?

main3.line: You can try to feign composure, but your expression betrays you. Look here and here... You remember everything that I did.

touch.line: Are you this clingy? Keep this up, and I won't be able to let you go... Commander♡

touch2.line: Since you're so passionate... I'll let you have your fun one more time♡

unlock.line: You're awake? Judging from your appearance... I wonder if our previous rendezvous has left you unsatisfied?

upgrade.line: Now... we can have all the fun we want.

asmr_001.line: I'm not sure if I should let you see my face right now... Oh? You really want to? IN that case... Will this satisfy you?

asmr_002.line: What's wrong? Do you prefer when I let my hair down? Or... do you have something else in mind?

asmr_003.line: You're staring... Searching for the marks you left on me? Heehee.

asmr_004.line: Mm, your fingers... *sniff*... I see. Are you that fascinated by this aroma?

asmr_005.line: Still tired? Then come to me. Closer, now... Hehe, isn't the perfume I just sprayed just captivating?

asmr_006.line: Ah?! So you still haven't learned your lesson... Well, I'll just have to really drill it into you.

asmr_007.line: Heehee. After so many little scuffles... you've gotten really good at finding my weaknesses.

asmr_008.line: Are you trying to make a mess of my hair, or my bedsheets? Pick one. We have plenty of time... I can always clean up later.

asmr_009.line: Oh my, what do we have here? Heehee, now that you've made a mess of me... you'll have to find a way to make amends.

asmr_010.line: Here is my scent – it's going to cling to you now. No matter where you go today, it will be a constant reminder of this moment... and of me.

battle.line: Our enemies? You mean those tasteless rubes?

couple_encourage1.line: You call those old rags "clothing"? Get rid of them and let me tailor something for you!

couple_encourage2.line: When designing clothes, you ought to incorporate new elements.

detail.line: I'm designing the next season's fashion – do you have something to discuss with me? ...Not really? Alright, then could you fetch me the fashion magazine lying over there? Since you have nothing better to do.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned on time. I'm concentrating on designing new fashion, so kindly fetch and inspect the supplies by yourself.

feeling1.line: Your naval cap is poorly shaped, your uniform's shoulders don't fit, and your pants are sagging... God, your fashion sense is just... Here, a list of proposed improvements. Take it and leave.

feeling2.line: The moment you had the best sense? Good question. When you appointed me as your secretary, perhaps?

feeling3.line: I don't chat with you because I want to. I'm just concerned that you may not grasp my fashion principles. Still, I'll admit that having conversations with you is enjoyable.

feeling4.line: I'll fix your uniform, so hold still for a second. After all, I understand your appeal better than anyone else. There. Now you're all good.

feeling5.line: As the times change, so do people's aesthetic tastes. I was once ready to chase the ever-changing trends of fashion... then you showed me something different: The truth that there is some unchanging beauty in the world.

headtouch.line: Is squandering time like this a hobby of yours?

home.line: You've returned earlier than expected, so I assume your mission went quite well. Similarly, I've finished most of my work. I just need to review a few more... Oh, get me a cup of coffee, would you?

hp_warning.line: It will take more than that to defeat me.

login.line: You've arrived. I'll say, your fashion sense has improved somewhat. Keep wearing my suggested outfits and you'll be like a new person in no time. Heehee.

lose.line: Uncultured swine. This is not over, you hear me?

mail.line: It's time to check your mail. Don't forget.

main1.line: I'm busy. Whatever you want, it'll have to wait. Also, Commander, your schedule says that you should be focusing on your paperwork, not sitting here lounging around.

main2.line: You want some fashionable and comfortable clothes, do you? Find someone else, then. It's not in my style to compromise for the sake of comfort.

main3.line: Perfect clothing not only changes your outward appearance, it also gives you inner strength. As a professional, my every stitch and every thread must be flawless.

mission.line: My schedule for later is packed, so make it snappy with those missions of yours.

mission_complete.line: Impressive – you finished your missions on time. A reward, you say? Heehee. I suggest finishing your work ahead of instead of on schedule next time. If you can manage that... Well, I'll consider a reward.

profile.line: I am Chien Wu, of the Dragon Empery. Yes, I have little to speak of in the way of service history, but never mind that – just see me for who I am now.

propose.line: For me? It'll go well with my attire... Heehee. I suppose I've rubbed off on you, because your tastes are getting better all the time. Go on, don't just stand there – put it on my finger.

touch.line: Is this your way of complimenting my attire? It's gorgeous, I know. I went through great pains to cut the cloth just... Pardon? It was ME you were complimenting?

touch2.line: Interested in this, are you? Do you want to go a step further? Then you'll have to work for it♥

unlock.line: It's a pleasure to meet you. I am Chien Wu. I take it you're this port's Commander? I see you're wearing a fairly elegant uniform, although it could be improved in a few ways. We have 30 minutes left for this meeting... That's just enough to tailor you a new set of clothes.

upgrade.line: Allow me to demonstrate the perfect combination of fashion and power.

win_mvp.line: It's over already? That was more fun than I anticipated.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you. You have good taste.

detail_ex.line: These outfits I designed for myself, and here is a list of elements that you like. It was just for reference. I didn't use the ones that didn't match or were too tacky.

expedition_ex.line: The commission team has returned. Remember to inspect the wares. I'll go as soon as I finish drawing out this design.

feeling5_ex.line: I used to only care about clothes and the wearer's looks. Now, I place more importance on the wearer themselves. You've changed my perception, and that's allowed me to create even more perfect garments. For that, I'm grateful, Commander.

headtouch_ex.line: Using your time on such pointless things again? Remember to comb out my hair later.

home_ex.line: Get me some coffee with... No, I knew you'd be too busy to remember, so I already made my own. Hmm... Why does it taste so odd? I could've sworn I made it the right way...

login_ex.line: You've arrived... Why aren't you wearing the clothes I made? ...You want to keep them in pristine condition? There's no point – I can always just make more. I made those clothes just for you, so go and put them on right now.

main4_ex.line: I'm busy, so keep it brief. Mh... No, I can set some time aside just for you.

main5_ex.line: Your collar is too tight? Let's see if I can change it... I'm not compromising for the sake of comfort, I'm simply not opposed to some variety.

main6_ex.line: You want to try your hand at sewing? It just so happens I have a minute. Here, take this sewing kit. Oh, and please be careful not to prick your fingers.

mission_ex.line: Get started on your missions. Finish them ahead of schedule and I'll give you a reward.

mission_complete_ex.line: You completed your missions? Alright, come here for your reward. Iiit's... a chocolate sandwich! Heehee. What did you imagine you were going to get? The pleasure of doing something to me?

touch_ex.line: You want to see me in a different style of dress? Sure. While I'm at it, I'll prepare a matching set of clothes for you.

touch2_ex.line: There are clothes better suited for this occasion... Heehee. Satisfy me and I'll let you see them♥

detail.line: This perfume is your favorite? Good taste. It goes well with my dress for tonight, so I'll be sure to use it.

feeling5.line: My outfit looks different to what you're used to? Well, I'm coming with you this time, so naturally I need to dress accordingly. While on the topic... Your tuxedo being eye-catching isn't as important as it matching my look♥

headtouch.line: Do you like this accessory? I'll make a brooch version of it for you. It would go perfectly on that empty breast pocket on your tuxedo.

home.line: I can't believe you're still this busy before the party. *sigh*... Take a break. There's some free real estate on your tuxedo, so I'll go get some accessories for you.

login.line: You're here quite early. Judging by that look, this design of mine is a hit. Heehee♪

main1.line: If you have something to say, now's the time. I'm almost finished here, so I could certainly have a chat with you.

main2.line: Oh? The train of my dress is a mess? It's hard to fix if I have to reach behind me, so give me a hand.

main3.line: Tired, are you? While you're free to rest on the bed, you'll first have to take off your tuxedo. So it doesn't... get wrinkles, you know?

mission.line: We'll be late to the party at this rate, so get those missions done quickly. I'll help you... depending on how sincerely you ask for it, I suppose.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Let's get going now.

touch.line: Are you trying to help adjust my outfit? Or... were you doing something else?

touch2.line: If you want it that badly, wait until after the party. There'll be plenty of time then♥

unlock.line: There's still time. Let's set out once I've finished adjusting my dress... If you have nothing better to do, at least put on some tea.

detail.line: Hey, Commander, you smell like my perfume... Perhaps we mingled a little too closely at the party.

feeling5.line: Since we don't often get to spend time together, we should make the most of... Hmm? I stepped on my dress's train? Yes, I suppose keeping the dress on is inconvenient... Heehee. Were you expecting something different?

headtouch.line: Well, I'm off duty anyway, so I guess it's fine to be a little dishevelled.

home.line: Your tuxedo has too much going on, making it hard to take off? Sounds like a you problem. Fine, I'll help you take– Hey, you feel warm to the touch... Is that because you've drank, or is it... something else?

login.line: There is no work to be done, so I'm going to rest tomorrow... Say, if you're not busy, how about you stay the night?

main1.line: Anything you want to do during our break? Depending on your answer, I might even let you do it to me♥

main2.line: I put on high heels and sacrificed comfort for looks, so standing around for extended periods is pretty tiring... If you're not busy, might I ask for a foot massage, hmm?

main3.line: You want to peel off my stockings? Ah, you and your tedious ideas... Fine, come here♥

mission.line: Yet another mission? What a mood-ruiner... I'll give you 30 minutes. Finish it before then.

mission_complete.line: I see you completed a mission. Now your time is mine♥

touch.line: Huh? Are you trying to mess with me? My, you've grown quite bold.

touch2.line: Careful, or you'll ruin my... Hah! Kidding. The party has ended, so I'll let you have your way this time♥

unlock.line: Don't just stare – help me... Look, I meant that in the "help me balance" sense... Are you trying to take my shoes off?

detail.line: Come closer... That's it – you can see all the fine details at this distance. Heehee. Seems like you grasp the meaning of the hidden design elements – right, Commander?

feeling5.line: If you don't have any feedback, then could you acknowledge this special permission I've granted you? Carefully memorize the aesthetic, the texture, and the feel in your heart and on your fingertips... Okay?

headtouch.line: Hah... Is this your way of expressing affirmation? I'll graciously turn a blind eye to it this time.

home.line: You're a little late. Oh well – I used the time to tweak a few minor things anyway. Now, tell me what you think. I want to hear your first impression.

login.line: Finally, you're here. Do you know what you should do? Put on some coffee, first of all. Straighten up. You don't have all the time in the world to watch from the side.

main1.line: Designing the back straps took quite a lot of work. Now, I'll give you a chance – feel it with your fingers, then give me your appraisal.

main2.line: Why aren't you saying anything? Can't find the right words? Or are you so content that you're left speechless? Use your words. I don't like having to guess.

main3.line: Take a seat and observe again from this angle. Appreciate how it fits and how it looks from new angles and different lighting. Oh, and don't rush it with your feedback. We have plenty of time.

mission.line: Don't you still have missions left? Go and get them done. I'll reserve your observation session for when you come back.

mission_complete.line: You finished your missions? Excellent. Let's resume our observation session, then.

touch.line: Heehee... You have a keen eye. Yes, I paid special attention to this design.

touch2.line: Mgh... Seems I've more than met your expections...

unlock.line: Come here instead of staring blankly at the door. It took me all night to tailor-sew these details. It should perfectly meet everything you requested... Come closer and I'll listen to your important feedback before anything else.

battle.line: This battle is but part of the carving process...

couple_encourage1.line: I don't need such elaborate accessories. A single jade pendant will suffice.

couple_encourage2.line: I understand, budgeting is important... but how can I say no to a gem that touches my heart?

detail.line: Commander... Are you looking at me as a person, or are you sizing me up like a jewel?

expedition.line: I prepared hot water and food for the commission team. It may not be much, but I hope they understand... it's the thought that counts...

feeling1.line: A dust-covered jade can be polished, but what of a neglected heart? Ugh... Forget it.

feeling2.line: Pardon me... When I see a true gem of a person, I can't take my eyes off of them.

feeling3.line: They say that warm jade is smooth and soft... It reminds me of you.

feeling4.line: I carved this pendant while recalling the warmth of your hands. Do you think I've managed to replicate your warmth?

feeling5.line: An uncut gem requires a master's touch to truly shine. Tell me, Commander... Do you know the passion you've ignited within me?

headtouch.line: Your touch... Are you trying to share your warmth with me, a cold jade?

home.line: Are you tired? Come, lean on me and rest for a while... May my warm embrace ease your weariness, if only a little.

hp_warning.line: A maidenly jewel shatters – bone-chilling cold awaits.

login.line: The tea's aroma is just starting to fade, but the leaves are still warm. You came at the perfect time, Commander.

lose.line: Broken jade can still be carved anew... and this failure is much the same.

mail.line: Mail? I hope the jade I ordered came in...

main1.line: Commander, new jade has just arrived on the market. Care to appraise it with me? If you find any you like, I'll negotiate on the price.

main2.line: This jade is lustrous and radiant, like your eyes when you're lost in thought... Ah, I'm sorry. I misspoke...

main3.line: My jade collection could fetch a very pretty penny, but I would never give them to someone who doesn't know their true value. Basically... Umm, could you help me bear the expenses of maintaining my collection?

mission.line: Commander, there are still some uncut jade waiting for you to carve them.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. I'm sure the rewards won't disappoint.

profile.line: I am Chang Wu, a heavy cruiser of the Dragon Empery. Tell me, Commander – in your eyes, am I worthy of being considered a precious gem?

propose.line: The contract is sealed. Now I shape not jade, but a heart – I'll be by your side forever, bringing warmth and comfort like a treasured jewel...

skill.line: With one stroke, a gem is carved – its brilliance revealed.

touch.line: Even when appreciating fine jade, one must adhere to certain principles...

touch2.line: Commander, um... Moderation, you know...

unlock.line: I am Chang Wu, a jade carver from the Dragon Empery. Having crafted countless pieces of jade, I considered myself wise and knowledgeable... until I glimpsed your elegance and eminence. Thus, I have come to realize... that what I considered treasures, are naught but stones.

upgrade.line: There's no need to hide the sharpness of my skills any longer.

win_mvp.line: Even stones with natural beauty must be carved to reveal their true splendor.

gift_prefer.line: Excellent quality. I knew you were a fellow connoisseur, Commander.

detail_ex.line: Commander, the most important part of learning jade carving is to calm the mind. Follow my guidance and feel the rhythm in your body... Yes, very good...

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, look at the pendant I made for you... When carving it, I could think of nothing but your face. I traced every curve with my palm over and over, poring over every last detail... Do you think I'm, um... shameless... For being so honest with you?

headtouch_ex.line: Your warmth... is more reassuring than the finest jade.

home_ex.line: So you've returned. My fingertips felt cold before, but your embrace has warmed me...

login_ex.line: Beautiful jade has spiritual properties because of the care given to it by its keeper. Commander, by watching you each day... one could say that I'm nurturing jade, too.

main4_ex.line: I carved a new piece of warm jade. Would you like to see? Good... You can take a closer look, you know...

main5_ex.line: I don't mind if you just sit there. That alone... is the most beautiful view of all, in my eyes.

main6_ex.line: Jade must be touched to be truly transformed... Commander, will you give me the same attention?

touch_ex.line: Won't you... stay by me just a little longer?

touch2_ex.line: Mm... You won't find any jade there...

detail.line: Forget work for a while... Let's watch the plum blossoms scatter and enjoy a moment's peace together.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Commander, go and greet them now... but don't forget about the romantic mood in here, okay?

feeling5.line: See the fallen plum blossoms... Commander, will you cherish them? This scenery, this night, and our feelings...

headtouch.line: Your hands are always so warm...

home.line: When I saw the sky getting dark, I knew you'd come back soon.

login.line: Which will you embrace, Commander? These plum blossoms, or me?

main1.line: Which seems more disheveled? The branches by my bed, or my hair...?

main2.line: Commander, would you say... that the scenery before you is worthy of a closer look?

main3.line: I've guarded these plum branches from dusk 'til night, such that you might view them... and me as well, of course...

touch.line: Hmm? That technique... Are you trying to polish your favorite jewel?

touch2.line: Even for an appraisal, this is... Ah... Mm...

unlock.line: Serene is this room, and pleasing is this plum-blossom fragrance, yet... why are you yet to come inside? Here, the aroma of flowers is rich, only awaiting the arrival of the spring breeze—

battle.line: From glyphs sixfold, all principles arise. Master them, and all of creation is yours to command.

couple_encourage1.line: Harbin, hands off my osmanthus wine!

couple_encourage2.line: Shhh! Don't tell the Commander that I don't like bitter or spicy food!

detail.line: You'd like to get to know me better...? Just know that what I am about to tell you can be either fact or fiction. One's heart is not something that can be penetrated so easily~

expedition.line: Commander, you should go welcome back the girls in the commission fleet. I've prepared some thank-you gifts for them, and would appreciate if you... I-it's not like I'd be too embarrassed to deliver them myself!

feeling1.line: Looks like you're not what you were chalked up to be. Though, I never should've expected anything greater in the first place.

feeling2.line: Commander, I've brought you today's itinerary. Please take a look– Why, yes. Underneath that is my personal schedule... Hmm? Why do I have so many additional training sessions? That's because... it's far too soon to start becoming complacent.

feeling3.line: Heehee. It's rare to see you have spare time on your hands... Would you like to enjoy some sweet osmanthus wine with me? Though, this particular cup has been made to suit my tastes– C-Commander?! How come your eyes are glazing over after just one sip...?! Even though I only added half a jar of sugar...?!

feeling4.line: Sometimes, I wonder if I, as an unfinished ship that was nothing more than a plan, can truly be of use... With no history to speak of, I often feel as if this power I possess is nothing more than a fleeting dream... Will I truly be able to protect everyone? Will I truly be able... to protect you?

feeling5.line: I try to come off as strong and confident to others, but around you, I can finally take my mask off and reveal my weaknesses and insecurities... How strange it all is... Commander, do you mind if I stay like this for a bit longer? Your embrace... is so very warm.

headtouch.line: ...Ahhn~ W-wait, I'm not some child who needs to be comforted...

home.line: Kun above, Zhen below. Obstacles give way, and good fortune arrives. ...See, I performed a divination for you, and you've returned safe and sound.

hp_warning.line: ...Surely I can muster more than this!

login.line: You've returned? I've already placed today's itinerary on your desk, and stand ready for any operation– Hm? I've done well to prepare for a rainy day? It seems rather inappropriate to praise me with such words given the situation at hand?

lose.line: ...What a miscalculation. I was one step behind.

mail.line: I've sorted through the mail for you. I've set the important material aside, so please make sure to look over it.

main1.line: Though I use these hexagrams to divine heaven's will, such results are not to be believed blindly. After all, there exist special individuals who can challenge destiny. And you, Commander, are one such individual.

main2.line: Remain patient, and do not sway even in the face of change. As the situation develops, your opportunity will inevitably arise... Huh? You don't think this reading is accurate? You want to know how it pertains to the r-relationship between us? ...Th-the result probably wouldn't change!

main3.line: Fu Shun and Fei Yuen are such energetic girls... It's n-not like I'm trying to dote on them or anything. ...Huh? I always give off different vibes around them than when I'm with you? I mean, those girls are my family, and you, umm... I guess you kind of count too?

mission.line: Here's a list of today's missions. You said you intended to knock everything out right away, so–– Where shall we begin?

mission_complete.line: Here are the rewards for completing our objectives. Please take a look, Commander.

profile.line: I am Huan Ch'ang, battlecruiser of the Dragon Empery. Though the past cannot be rewritten... Kun above, Kan below – success in all things to come... Heehee. I took this opportunity to divine the future, and I see only good things to come.

propose.line: This has to be... some kind of prank, right? Wait, no... Xun above, Gen below... To a young lady, congratulations are in order... Huh? Are you serious? W-wait, give me a moment to process this... Um, ahem... C-Commander, thank you... For accepting my weaknesses, for taking my hand and granting me new strength... F-from now on, we'll always be together, until the icy depths do us part.

skill.line: Break their formation, and cut off their command!

touch.line: ...If you don't need anything from me, I will return to my training.

touch2.line: Today's reading said that prurient acts shall be met with terrible fates. Are you sure you wish to continue with that?

unlock.line: I am Huan Ch'ang, battlecruiser of the Dragon Empery. And you must be the Commander I've heard so much about? Now that I've seen you in person... Heehee. Does your mettle measure up to your vaunted name? Very well. Allow me to be the judge of that.

upgrade.line: Heehee. This power... shall become your sturdiest pillar.

win_mvp.line: And thus, heaven's will be done. A splendid victory indeed.

gift_prefer.line: Hm. You went all-out just to flatter me...

home_ex.line: Well fought out there. You didn't get hurt, did you? ...Even if you say that, I'm still a bit worried. Mind if I do a little check-up? ––Hm? Why didn't I just do a divination? Um, well... I was too worried about you to focus on that...

login_ex.line: Heehee. You're back? What would you like to start the day with? ...Don't worry. No matter what you decide, I'll be right there with you.

main4_ex.line: Lung Wu's mastery of the culinary arts is certainly impressive, but she could stand to gain a greater appreciation for sweetness... Hm? What do I think is the proper amount of sweetness? I mean, one can of sugar would be the bare minimum...

main5_ex.line: Hm? You're wondering why I can tolerate the bitterness and spice of alcohol, but can't handle bitter melon or chili peppers? Those are completely different things–– Wait! How'd you find out about that?!

main6_ex.line: ...I knew it, you can no longer tell the fortunes of those too close to you. What am I sighing over? ...Take a look at this. It's the hexagram for your love life. What in the world is this convoluted web? Surely there must be some kind of mistake...

mission_ex.line: Looks like we've got new work. ...You're tired? I guess a short break can't hurt.

mission_complete_ex.line: Commander, the rewards are in. Want to do a quick look-around?

touch_ex.line: If you don't need me for anything, I'll go back to divining your future, okay?

touch2_ex.line: ...We're still outside, you know?! At least... wait until we get back!

feeling5.line: Hmm? Am I cold in this outfit? Not particularly~ See, take my hands – warm, aren't they? That's just how I'm built. If you're cold, however... You're always welcome to come give me a hug~

home.line: Congratulations on the successful operation, Commander. Let me do a quick inspection... Mm. Everything looks fine. Just a bit of soot on your clothes, but otherwise... thank goodness you've returned safely.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Hm? You think that I tend to give off rather... grim vibes? My apologies. I'll try to be more mindful of that in the future...

main1.line: Hm? Why did I choose this spot? ...B-because, it's embarrassing to be in this outfit! I wanted to go somewhere without a lot of people, but before I knew it, I made the place seem as if it was haunted...

main2.line: You brought me some warmed osmanthus wine? Ehehe... I'll be helping myself then~ Eep! Hot! D-don't say a word about this to anyone, you hear? I totally do not have a sensitive tongue!

main3.line: I made some new masks to match my new outfit, but I can't decide on which one to wear... Oh, I know! Why don't you help me pick one out?

touch.line: Hmm? If there's anything you need me for, please do not hesitate to let me know. Anytime, anywhere.

touch2.line: Heehee~♪ Right here? How bold... and awfully reminiscent of a certain Empery ghost story~

unlock.line: Happy New Year, Commander. Hmm? I look a bit different from usual? Why of course, it's because it was chosen to suit your tastes by none other than Chi An. Even this mask is brand new. I look "like a fairy from the sacred mountains," you say? I wonder... who taught you to say something like that?

win_mvp.line: Alas, how can the light from fireflies above rotten grass ever compare to the brilliance of the moon above?

battle.line: The moment the enemies let their guard down–– is the moment you strike!

couple_encourage1.line: My, some familiar faces.

detail.line: If you're not busy, then... come here, let's play a match of Go? No need to have a turn timer or keep track of winners and losers. Let's just kill some time, hehe.

expedition.line: The commission fleet is back, huh... Increasing our stockpiles, replenishing our forces, adding another card to our hand. A good play indeed.

feeling1.line: Seems like I set the bar too high for you.

feeling2.line: The more you win, the harder it'll be for you to review your own moves objectively. Even if you're winning, never forget to continue studying your past experiences.

feeling3.line: War isn't fair. Backstab your enemy. Think two or three steps ahead of them, read their every move. Then... BAM! Victory comes just like that. Hehe.

feeling4.line: I'm starting to get bored of our regular old sessions of Go. Let's spice things up a little bit... I know just the thing. How about, if you can take a game off me, I'll grant you one wish.

feeling5.line: Oh my, how could a seasoned strategist like me make such a silly blunder... Hehe, in any case, congratulations on your win. As promised, I'll grant you your one wish. Anything goes. Hehehe...

headtouch.line: I must say... this behavior is rather unexpected.

home.line: Good job on making it back in one piece. I went over your last battle, and while it was excellent overall, there are many areas that can still be improved... So let's review those right now?

hp_warning.line: Nothing ventured, nothing gained...!

login.line: How's the port supposed to run when the decisionmaker's seat is vacant? C'mon, sit down already.

lose.line: Ugh, just one move behind... While I hate conceding defeat, there won't be a next time. Hehe...

mail.line: A competent commander should never neglect potentially important information.

main1.line: Are you deep in thought about something? Or... just spacing out? Oh, I see. You're trying to look cute, hehe.

main2.line: My eyes look a bit scary when I'm thinking about something? ...How do you know that isn't just one of my many faces?

main3.line: Feign strength if you must, feign weakness if you must. Whatever the case, do not ever let your enemy see through your trump card.

mission.line: Don't forget to finish up your missions. When it comes back to bite you in the ass, it'll already be too late.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Now that you've removed another obstacle in front of you, what will your next move be?

profile.line: I am the Dragon Empery's first seaplane carrier, Chen Hai. I've received many other "firsts," but those aren't exactly honors. I still have a long way to go before I can match up to real aircraft carriers.

propose.line: What's this? ...Hehe, I didn't expect this sneak attack from you... Or rather, you're the only person who could pull something like this off. Looking at it that way, maybe I had predicted this all along... right?

skill.line: Exploit their weaknesses, and catch them by surprise!

touch.line: What's the matter? ...You're not here just to have a little chat, are you?

touch2.line: You certainly have guts.

unlock.line: So you're the brains behind the operation here, huh? ...Hehe, I finally get to meet the legendary Commander face-to-face. It's an honor to be able to work with you. I trust you'll live up to your lofty expectations?

upgrade.line: I prefer being the one pulling the strings, but fine.

win_mvp.line: The enemy has lost their will to fight. Heh, guess that's all they had to show.

gift_prefer.line: This gift comes from the heart, doesn't it? I shall graciously accept it.

feeling5_ex.line: You'd like to challenge me to another match today? Very well, but let's up the ante this time. The loser is responsible for deciding how the two of us will spend our time together after the match. I also would like to take my hands off the reins every now and then, so I'll try my best to win. Hehe~

login_ex.line: Oh my, you seem to be quite energetic today. I was hoping to be able to bemuse myself with your sleepy expression, but alas, it was not to be. Hehe~

main4_ex.line: The game of Go has already spread far beyond the Dragon Empery. It is a pity, however, that regional variations in rules make it difficult to thoroughly enjoy a session.

main5_ex.line: Not all surprise attacks must be executed from behind. For example, if I suddenly get right up to your face like this –– doesn't that get your heart racing? Hehe~

mission_ex.line: Even divine beings are not omnipotent... For example, look, you've forgotten to finish a mission.

touch_ex.line: Even if we're just making small talk, the most mundane of moments can become splashed with brilliant colors.

touch2_ex.line: It appears you are in need of some "special discipline."

detail.line: Did my collection catch your eye? Hehe, very well, there's a lot more of that in the back room. I wouldn't mind showing you around if you'd like~

feeling5.line: Do you know what I value most of everything inside this room? It's not the luxurious interior or my opulent collections – Indeed, it is none other than you, Commander~♪

headtouch.line: Do be mindful of who the host is, and who the guest is~

home.line: "Yes, excellent. Just stick to the plan, just as I told you." Oh, welcome back. That phone call...? It's a secret~

login.line: Now that you're here, please make yourself at home. Don't worry, Commander, this one's on me.

mail.line: A letter arriving at a time like this? Talk about spoiling the mood...

main1.line: I already have a worthy opponent in front of me, but too bad we don't have a Go board and some pieces to play with... Ah, but worry not, I'll fetch them later.

main2.line: Commander, what's your favorite collection here? Porcelain? Jade? Calligraphy? Or perhaps... this entire estate? Hehe~

main3.line: Hai Chi's flower spear and Chao Ho's solo dance... Tonight's performance will be spectacular indeed. It would be nice to have someone accompanying me who has a fine eye for the arts... Do you understand what I'm getting at, Commander?

mission.line: Commander, you're currently my guest. The fact that you're still preoccupied with work does not impress me.

mission_complete.line: Oh my, when did you complete your missions? Not too shabby, Commander.

touch.line: Would you like to try this rotary dial phone? You might not be used to operating something like it, so try to be careful not to make mistakes.

touch2.line: It would appear that you need a reminder as to who the host is here.

unlock.line: You're here, Commander, just as promised. How do you like the atmosphere in here? Hehe, take a seat and enjoy the tea slowly. After all, we have plenty of time~

detail.line: Few things are more blissful than a refreshing soak on a sweltering day. Your clothes might get wet, but... don't you think it's well worth it?

feeling5.line: ...So, do you have any plans today? No games, no bartering. Just the two of us - alone on a day off. You have all the initiative in your hands, Commander. You're not going to let it go to waste, are you? Hehe...

home.line: You're completely soaked with sweat... I see, the sweltering heat outside must've taken its toll on you. Come in, and cool off.

login.line: During this moment of respite, set aside all your plans and calculations. Once you've rested sufficiently, you can always pick up where you left off.

main1.line: Come with an open heart, and leave fulfilled. Now that you've freed yourself from the shackles of the daily grind, clear your mind and enjoy this occasion to the fullest~

main2.line: Hai Chi? I'm sure she's playing in the water with some friends she just met. Did you want to go look for her?

main3.line: Ripples in the water, the glow of the autumnal sun, and the flickering of rainbows... If Hai Tien were here, I'm sure I would be hearing one of her poems.

touch.line: What's the matter? If it's about work, let's save it for later, alright?

touch2.line: Oh my, Commander. You're a bit lacking in self-control~

unlock.line: Oh my, if it isn't the Commander... Have you also come to escape the heat? What a serendipitous meeting... Or, did you perhaps have some other goal in mind? Heehee...

feeling5.line: The embroidery I hold here is my "gift" to you. I'm not good at expressing my emotions, so I'd like to take the opportunity to do so using this handkerchief... Hm? You'll carry it with you at all times? Heehee. I'm overjoyed to hear that.

headtouch.line: You haven't changed one bit...

home.line: Good work, Commander. Once I'm done with my handiwork here, I will play for you a song of victory.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Hm? What kind of embroidery am I working on right now? Pardon me for keeping it a secret. You'll see as soon as I'm done.

main1.line: Maybe playing Go in a serene place like this will allow me to hone my skills even further... Commander, if you have time later, would you mind having a match with me?

main2.line: "Beautiful embroidery draws the orioles from their willowy perches" ...How profound. I still have a long way to go when it comes to this art.

main3.line: The art of embroidery requires the patience to make precise stitches, just as strategizing requires the patience to make precise decisions...

mission_complete.line: Looks like you've completed your mission with no issues. Please rest here for a moment. I'll have your gift ready shortly.

touch.line: Hmm? Are you interested in my Three-Azures embroidery?

touch2.line: You still require some work when it comes to self-discipline.

unlock.line: Oh, Commander, have you come to see me? Yes, as you can see, I've been studying the art of embroidery– Just like Go, it helps me organize my thoughts and see things from a broader perspective. Why don't you give it a try as well, Commander? Heehee~

feeling5.line: They say the wise must never allow themselves to be held captive by love. I used to agree... but now, nothing brings me greater joy than planning the rest of my life by your side. I look forward to our future together, my Commander... My beloved.

headtouch.line: You are allowed to lift this red veil only once... Because what comes after that is what truly matters.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander... A strategist such as I ought to act with moderation, but I could not hold back the desire to see what face you would make when you lay eyes on me... And yes, I saw just what I expected I would. Heehee.

login.line: I have been expecting you, Commander... This is a touch different from how I usually carry myself... Heheh, I am glad you like it.

main1.line: "May I be your star, and you be my moon, our lights shining bright together every night..." Have my feelings gotten through to you, Commander?

main2.line: I have simulated many possible futures with you by my side, Commander... But the way my heart is racing now defies all of my calculations.

main3.line: I once thought myself an unrivaled strategist. Yet I now realize my most brilliant scheme of all... was making your heart throb for me alone...

touch.line: My only wish is for us to grow old together, hand in hand...

touch2.line: A strategist such as I must never be taken off guard... But this time, it's my turn to be on the offensive.

unlock.line: With the red veil lifted, join me and let us sip of this nuptial wine to celebrate our union. As for how we are to spend the rest of this day... I leave that to your discretion, Commander. What say you?

detail.line: Heehee... With so many reliable allies here, victory or defeat start to seem less important to me than the contents of tonight's menu.

feeling5.line: You know, I've been thinking... If I really went to live in the mountains, I'd like the two of us to find a nice place with beautiful scenery, build a home of our own, and grow old together in a peaceful world. We'd enjoy tea between rounds of Go, spending our time leisurely without a worry in sight... It might be a bit early to contemplate these things, but I look forward to that day with all my heart.

home.line: A triumphant return. Your commanding back there was simply unparalleled. Now then, Commander, please unwind while enjoying this tea.

login.line: Hmm...? My, it looks like I've finally caught you dozing off, Commander. Heehee. So, how was it? Did you have sweet dreams? If you don't mind, I'd love it if you could share what you saw with me~

lose.line: Haha... You may have bested me fair and square this time... But next time, your luck won't last.

main1.line: In retrospect, triumphing over others and triumphing over yourself are two completely different things... Simply scratching the surface of my "self's" limits was enough to give me an awakening.

main2.line: I would like to see with my own eyes what kind of world the peaceful paradise you envision is like.

main3.line: A world in turmoil calls for a schemer with a number of tricks up her sleeve. A world at peace, however, calls for honest, hardworking builders. When that day comes, I will take my leave and retire to the mountains. Such a life suits me better. Haha...

touch.line: Commander, care for a round of Go? Just treat it as some light entertainment on the board game known as "life," okay? Heehee.

touch2.line: Ahaha... I can't believe I'm being manhandled in such a frivolous manner... Commander, I'll have to extract some "compensation" from you in return~

unlock.line: Just as promised, I present myself before you in a brand new form. Heehee... Since we have plenty of time, why don't you come take a seat, enjoy the fragrance of tea with me, and envision our future?

win_mvp.line: Phew... Finally, peace and quiet can return once more.

battle.line: In other words, we can go all-out now, right?

couple_encourage1.line: Would you please teach me how to use a seaplane?

detail.line: That reminds me, a while ago, I raised my hand to try to join one of the Eagle Union girls' parties, but they all looked at me like I was crazy... Is there anything wrong with that?

expedition.line: The friends from the commission fleet are back. Wanna throw a little party for them?

feeling1.line: No matter what happens, life must continue on. Just let it go...

feeling2.line: People are always gonna be hesitant to let someone barge into their group, no matter how cordial you try to be. Luckily, I know someone who can help me make some inroads with the folks here. Isn't that right, Commander? Help a buddy out, won'tcha?

feeling3.line: So, not too long ago, I went to a haunted house with my friends for the first time. Pretty cool and all, but the best part was seeing the looks of panic on everyone's faces. Tell me, Commander, are ya 'fraid of ghosts?

feeling4.line: After hanging out with my buddies for a while, I've come to realize that it's pretty hard to stand out from the crowd... But, maybe there's some way of getting a head start– Hmm? Oh, I was just talking to myself, so don't worry too much about it. By the way, Commander, you interested in what the girls have been saying about you lately?

feeling5.line: After knowing me for so long, you should already be aware that I'm not actually that well-behaved. As for the reason why... That'd be your fault, Commander. Aren't you the one who introduced me to so many ways of "acting up?" Heehee~ In other words, I'll need you to take responsibility~

headtouch.line: Commander? Is this my reward for being a good girl? Heheheh...

home.line: Hmm? Commander, what were you doing just now? Don't tell me you were off partying behind my back... Heehee, just kidding~

hp_warning.line: Ugh, I let my guard down...

login.line: Commander, are you still working? ...C'mon, let's play hooky. A little bit of fun won't kill you~

lose.line: I'll remember this humiliation... and pay it back twofold!

mail.line: New mail's in. Come to think of it, Commander, don't you get invited to all sorts of events? Think you can bring me along next time?

main1.line: Commander, how do you normally reward yourself? Maybe binge out on a sumptuous meal? Or stay up late playing around? As for me, I... Err, I just wanted a point of reference, yeah!

main2.line: Be courteous to others so that they will listen to you respectfully. As for those unwilling to give you that respect, there are always more "direct" methods you can employ~

main3.line: Mapo tofu? There are hundreds of ways of preparing tofu, and there's no rule saying it has to be spicy. Besides, I'm not great with spicy food...

mission.line: I've heard that some missions can be quite fun. Commander, mind if I tag along next time?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. So, does that mean I can shoot the breeze for a while?

profile.line: I am a seaplane tender of the Dragon Empery, just like Chen Hai. Unfortunately, my treasured blade was never completed, and I was condemned to a life of mediocrity... But let's not dwell on my dark past. Commander, didn't you promise that the two of us would find lots of fun things to do?

propose.line: I don't expect to occupy the front and foremost spot in your heart; but seeing as how the two of us have exchanged vows, I will be very, very angry should you run around and desert me. So angry, in fact, that I have no idea what I might do. Heehee. But, it's simple, really. Just be good to me, Commander~

skill.line: If you won't listen to reason, then you can talk to my fist!

touch.line: Meh, don't sweat it. Even if I slack off right now, nobody's gonna find out.

touch2.line: So basically, I'm allowed to exercise self-defense now, right?

unlock.line: Commander, it is an honor to meet you. I am Hwah Jah of the Dragon Empery. Now that it's just the two of us here, I'll get straight to the point – Ahem... Is there, um... anything, y'know, super exciting or fun going on around these parts?

upgrade.line: I won't let you down, Commander. Not after the goodwill you've shown me.

win_mvp.line: Heh. The character "Jah" in my name symbolizes number one. Quite apropos if I must say so myself.

gift_prefer.line: I'll always remember this kindness.

battle_ex.line: Thanks to you, Commander, I'm able to go all-out.

headtouch_ex.line: Whoa. That one got my heart racing~♪

home_ex.line: By any chance, were you flirting with other girls while you were out? ...Heehee, I was just messing with you. I wanted to see how you'd react, that's all~♪

login_ex.line: There's not a whole lot of stuff to get through today, Commander. Why don't we come up with some plans for what we can do afterwards?

main4_ex.line: Thwap. ...Oh, I didn't need anything from you. I just felt like giving you a good smack over the head with a fan for no reason. Heehee, no harm no foul, right?

touch_ex.line: So I was thinking... If you aren't busy, how about we head out and have some fun with our friends~♪

touch2_ex.line: Ooh? Commander, you're gutsier than I gave you credit for.

win_mvp_ex.line: Credit for the greatest contribution should belong to you, Commander.

detail.line: Hmm? You think this outfit's a bit too revealing? Weird. I thought it's pretty in line with what everyone else is wearing... Besides, what's wrong with standing out a little?

home.line: Boo! ...Guess I couldn't spook you at all, Commander. Maybe I should take a page from Fu Shun's playbook next time and bring a flashlight...

login.line: You're back? Let's go find our other friends and see if they're up to anything interesting.

main1.line: The mandarin duck hotpot, as its name implies, is a special hotpot for couples... Just kidding. Actually, this partition is just to accommodate people's different tastes.

main2.line: Hmm? Hai Tien made an incredibly spicy baozi? I sure hope she marked it properly...

main3.line: The jiangshi in the movies all hop around due to the whole rigor mortis thing. So, it's kinda like this... hip, hop. Err, umm... this feels a little inappropriate.

touch.line: I'm not actually dead, y'know, so I can't just make my hands turn ice-cold.

touch2.line: You're gonna be cursed if you remove the seal...

unlock.line: I am Hwah Jah, now in zombie form. It is an honor to see you– hmm? What's wrong, Commander? Everyone else is getting dressed up for the occasion, so I figured I'd get in on the action too... Is there something wrong with that?

feeling5.line: Lacquerware cradles pearls and jade just as the courtyard cradles the splendor of spring. Similarly, I made space in my heart for a one-of-a-kind treasure... I mean you, of course.

headtouch.line: Whoa... You're even more mischievous than me, Commander~

home.line: I'm wondering what accessory would go best with this outfit. Do you have any suggestions for me, Commander?

login.line: You've got a sharp eye, Commander – you noticed my treasure in no time. It took over a hundred polishings and the addition of powdered shells and gold leaf to bring out such refined, understated luster.

main1.line: The true beauty of lacquerware lies in the time and care it takes to bring forth its captivating sheen... It's a lot like human relationships, don't you think?

main2.line: "Though I've scored a thousand trees in pursuit of lacquer, my jar has yet to fill." Collecting lacquer demands great effort – we must cherish each and every artisanal piece.

main3.line: Do I look excited for our next trip? That's because I am! You and I might just discover the perfect view for my next lacquerware piece, after all!

touch.line: Come and feel the texture of this lacquerware for yourself. I think you'll love it♪

touch2.line: Hyah... Try not to jostle the table, okay?

unlock.line: Oh, Commander. I'm just doing some last-minute tidying up before the trip. By the way, I've never shown you this lacquered jewelry box, have I? It's one of my most prized possessions. Go on and take a look. Shall we go on a deep dive into its many wonders together?

detail.line: Oh, right! So, I've recently discovered the joys of throwing house parties. I get to bounce all kinds of crazy ideas and opinions off with everyone else, and it's created a brand-new explosion of possibilities~♪

expedition.line: The commission team's back? Perfect, I've just finished preparing their thank-you presents. Pretty awesome timing on my part, huh?

feeling5.line: I might have changed in certain regards, but you like me this way as well, right? Heehee. After all, this is what I've picked up from following your "guidance"~♪ Now then, I hope you'll continue to take on the responsibility of looking after me in the future, yes?

headtouch.line: Oh my... Does this mean I've been an extra good girl recently? Heehee, just kidding~

home.line: Finally back, Commander? So, I found a fun-looking place that seems pretty promising... If you're not too busy, wanna come with? I think we could both go for a change of pace, right?

login.line: Commander, I know your job is important and all, but like, can we please do something a bit more fun and exciting?

mail.line: New mail? Hopefully we get an invitation to do something fun and exciting, rather than the usual boring administrative stuff. Wanna go through it together, Commander?

main1.line: Oh, Commander! If I ever get the opportunity to open a teahouse, I'd like to incorporate some elements of street performance, like fire jugglers! Wouldn't that be a great way to attract customers? Huh... you think that'd spoil the entire atmosphere?

main2.line: I still believe in treating others with courtesy and speaking with sincerity, just as always. However, I think I can be a bit more "persuasive" now towards those who don't want to sit down and have a civil discussion~

main3.line: Ultra-spicy hotpot? Haha... Sure, I did say I'm more receptive to new experiences than before, but... I'm afraid I'll have to pass on that one...

mission.line: Got something fun and exciting for me to do? Lemme give you a hand, just as always~♪

mission_complete.line: Hmm? All done with work? Heehee. In that case, if you have nothing else scheduled, how about letting me suggest something?

touch.line: Hmm? Wanna head outside and shoot the breeze?

touch2.line: Um... Are you testing how "open" I'm willing to be?

unlock.line: As you can see, Commander, I've completed my retrofitting. So, umm, are you surprised by my new appearance? Don't worry, though. I'll always be the same Hwah Jah you know and love~ Though, if I had to pick something different about myself... I might be a bit more open towards some fun and exciting things~♪

battle.line: Fight to your heart's content. I shall watch your backs, everyone.

couple_encourage1.line: Don't worry. We're all with you now.

detail.line: Akashi has a monopoly on this port's commerce, and she seems to have some unscrupulous dealings every now and then. Now, if I could muscle my way into– Hmm? These are the regulations? Boo...

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. It seems we've gotten some equipment in addition to the regular awards. Hmm, let me appraise it to see how much it's worth...

feeling1.line: As the old saying goes, time reveals the character of one's true heart. No matter how well you wear your disguise, you will be seen through sooner or later.

feeling2.line: Woah... Commander, you have decorations from every corner of the world in your office... Were they all gifts from your friends around the port? Heehee, you must be quite the charmer~

feeling3.line: Are any of your friends interested in some of the Dragon Empery's collectibles? If so, I'd appreciate it if you could introduce them to me~♪

feeling4.line: This is my present to you, as thanks for helping me out a while ago. Go ahead and take it – there's no need to be polite. It's not like I'm planning anything in particular; I just wanted to return the favor, that's all. Everything here is pretty mundane stuff helpful in your daily work, so there's nothing for you to worry about.

feeling5.line: Once the war is over, I want to open a little shop and sell antiques and paintings. Heehee, by combining my sharp business senses with your connections, we should be able to live pretty laid-back lives. How does that pitch sound to you, Commander?

home.line: Well done on your sortie. During your absence, I took it upon myself to seek out the items in need of restocking discussed earlier... Please take a look at the details here.

hp_warning.line: Hmm... With this, I might have to consider some higher-risk options...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Heehee, please make the important decisions while you're still clear-headed.

lose.line: Hmm... I must say, these losses are rather severe...

mail.line: Your mail's here, Commander. The contents might seem useless, but you never know where business opportunities lay hidden.

main1.line: Pay close attention to your checkbook, and remember that a penny saved is a penny earned. Hmm? There are too many people here who always want it all? ...Ahaha, how awfully capricious of them...

main2.line: Were you planning to upgrade the equipment in your office any time soon? If so, would you mind letting me take care of it? I'll be sure to meet all your needs at the lowest budget.

main3.line: Commander, have you read today's news? Keeping your eyes out for the latest developments puts you in a prime position to capitalize on opportunities of all sorts, in business and battle alike.

mission.line: Commander, you've got a new mission. I suppose this is a "primitive" form of capital acquisition...?

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have arrived. Heehee, now how should we use them to turn a greater profit?

profile.line: I am Ting An of the Dragon Empery's First Fleet. I once served as a seaplane tender before being converted into a transport ship. Outside of that... Oh, I wonder if little Yat Sen is here? I'm sure that girl must've grown a lot since I last saw her. Heehee~

propose.line: When it comes to relationships, you can't deal in profits and losses, or expect returns on your investments. I'm sure you thought carefully before deciding to give this to me... Yes, I understand. And my answer to you is, I accept. Allow me to repay your feelings with my eternal devotion~♡

skill.line: It's time to close up shop!

touch.line: What about my outfit? Oh, hmm... I suppose they are rather breezy...

touch2.line: Jeez... If you keep this up, I won't give you any more advice...

unlock.line: So you're the Commander, yes? I've heard your name whispered far and wide. I am Ting An of the Dragon Empery; may our relationship be a fruitful one. Oh, this mountain of stuff next to me? Just consider it... a little business gift of sorts?

upgrade.line: I will not let the Commander's "investment" go to waste.

win_mvp.line: Another sailing route made safe. Hmm... maybe I can use this opportunity to establish a new trade route...?

gift_prefer.line: You have a discerning eye. Heheh, I'll gladly accept it.

home_ex.line: Oh, do you remember the statement I gave you earlier? Some new ideas suddenly dawned upon me... Since nothing has been implemented yet, shall we give it another pass?

login_ex.line: How are you feeling, Commander? If there are no problems, let's get started with today's work.

main4_ex.line: Old-fashioned decorations accentuate your refinement, whereas modern decorations attest to your good taste. Combining the two appropriately can leave a good impression on those who visit, Commander.

main5_ex.line: This article is... 'The Commander's Preference on Secretary Ship Selection'... It seems that one of your friends wrote it. Heehee, how intriguing.

touch2_ex.line: Commander, right now... might not be the best time for that.

detail.line: Why does this store have to make dough from scratch instead of using premade wrappers? ...Why is this sort of commitment necessary...?

home.line: Welcome back. Take these presents as a token of my appreciation for helping me out. Please, I don't want to feel like I'm always in your debt.

login.line: *pant* *pant*... Phew. I didn't know that kneading dough took so much physical endurance... Urgh, I'm all sweaty now...

main1.line: For the last step, I had Ning Hai and Ping Hai steam the baozi. Though I did learn a few things from watching them, the amount of heat and length of cooking time still seem hard to master...

main2.line: Hai Tien said she wanted some baozi stuffed entirely with chilies... But if Hwah Jah were to get her hands on one, I'm sure that scene would be a total disaster...

main3.line: Oh right, I heard that some Dragon Empery antiques arrived at Akashi's shop. If you're worried about buying counterfeits, I can come with you.

touch.line: Commander, do you also know how to make these? Wow... You really know how to do everything...

touch2.line: Ugh, now there's flour all over me...

unlock.line: I see, so this is how you're supposed to knead dough... Hmm? Commander? As you can see, I'm currently trying to make baozi. Would you like to help out?

battle.line: Urk... I need to be careful!

detail.line: *sigh*... To win a share in the swimsuit market, you need to do more than just come up with the perfect design and cost. You also have to try them on yourself and experience real use-case situations to suit customers' needs... I-isn't that right, Commander?

expedition.line: I think the commission team is back. Commander, umm, try not to take too long when you go... *pant*...

feeling5.line: After we check things out here, where will we go next? ...You'll show me around all the rides? Hmm, that does sound like a good rehearsal for when I wear this swimsuit around you again... Ah... N-no, I promise, I'll do my best!

home.line: Good work, Commander! Ahaha, isn't it hard to go out without anyone noticing? If not for this convenient room, I doubt we'd even be able to meet up like this... Phew.

login.line: *pant*... It's not that far, but just walking has me exhausted... Is it because I was putting so much effort into staying undercover?

lose.line: *pant*... It's really hard to fight without blowing my cover...

main1.line: Don't worry, Commander. Everyone else should be asleep right now, and the girls on patrol won't notice us... right? Eep...!

main2.line: (The Commander and I are just doing market research... Yeah! It's necessary for business! Surely I'm not awakening to something and getting pleasure out of this... Surely!)

main3.line: C-Commander? If you're cold, we could huddle under my coat? I'm also a little... Achoo!

mission.line: When you complete missions, everyone doing business at the port profits. We appreciate all you do.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Where should I invest next...?

touch.line: Sh-should we snap another pic?

touch2.line: *pant*... Commander, if we make any noise, someone will... Hyah?!

unlock.line: Umm... Alright, time to take a photo in the on-set mirror and send it to Commander... And there. Just as Commander said, it'd be disastrous if my new swimsuit's design were to get leaked... B-but if I don't do this, our plans will totally be ruined!

win_mvp.line: We won! Oh, maybe I should show off this new swimsuit at the victory party!

battle.line: What are you all fighting for?

couple_encourage1.line: Stop running around, and stay by my side!

couple_encourage2.line: Remember, you can never be too careful on the battlefield.

couple_encourage3.line: Let's see those guts! Great! Just like that!

detail.line: Commander, what would you like to know?

expedition.line: Great, everyone returned home safely!

feeling1.line: Commander, it's bloomring season for the hawthorne I grew around the Bohai Gulf. Can we go back and take a look?

feeling2.line: Commander, we have to fight to protect the things we care about. This isn't really a question of personal preference.

feeling3.line: Even if the day comes when I am no longer needed on the battlefield, I still want to watch over the Bohai Sea. I want to always be able to see the waters, dyed a shimmering vermillion in the sunset.

feeling4.line: Commander, rest assured that wherever you go, I will be there to protect you. Huh? Isn't it obvious, you're mine after all...

feeling5.line: I'm so blessed to have met you, Commander. I've made so many friends and so many memories... Hey, Commander, once I complete my duty as one of the "Four Unbreakables," let's go travel around the world together!

home.line: Why don't you take a break? It's not good to be too stressed out.

hp_warning.line: Commander, concentrate and be extra careful!

login.line: Wow! Today's schedule looks packed. Let's work hard today!

lose.line: Everyone, regroup. We can't retreat like this!

mail.line: Commander, you have new mail. Should I unseal it for you?

main1.line: Woah, this is my first time seeing a battleship!

main2.line: Where did Fu Shun run off to? Would it really kill her to do as I say every now and then?

main3.line: My sisters - Fu Shun, Chang Chun, and Tai Yuan - are all my pride and joy!

mission.line: Protecting the peace isn't just about fighting - you'll have to do these missions too.

mission_complete.line: Keep up the effort, don't slack off just yet!

profile.line: I am the nameship of the An Shan-class destroyers, and one of the Dragon Empery's first-generation "Four Unbreakables." As the flagship, I participated in many naval exercises, carried out surveillance, and engaged in confrontations, leaving behind lasting achievements that I can be proud of. Though I never participated in live combat, I am the destroyer with the most miles under her belt in the entire world!

propose.line: Commander, my body and soul, all of my life, belongs to you from now on. Make sure to take responsibility properly.

skill.line: Let the protection of heaven surround the brave!

touch.line: Commander... Hehe~ doing this occasionally is not all that bad.

touch2.line: Hey-! My sisters are going to see us...

unlock.line: Destroyer, An Shan, reporting for duty! I shall protect my sisters and you, Commander!

upgrade.line: Now I'll be better equipped to deal with ruffians like De Haven...

win_mvp.line: Commander, being able to help you out is the greatest!

battle.line: What are you all fighting for?

couple_encourage1.line: Stop running around, and stay by my side!

couple_encourage2.line: Remember, you can never be too careful on the battlefield.

feeling3.line: Even if the day comes when I am no longer needed on the battlefield, I still want to watch over the Bohai Sea. I want to always be able to see the waters, dyed a shimmering vermillion in the sunset.

touch2.line: Hey-! My sisters are going to see us...

upgrade.line: Now I'll be better equipped to deal with ruffians like De Haven...

win_mvp.line: Commander, being able to help you out is the greatest!

battle.line: In Commander's name, I sortie!

detail.line: Commander, I'm currently on patrol. Do you have any new instructions for me?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned! I'm so glad that everyone came back safely.

feeling1.line: Commander, I don't think that... Nevermind, your subordinate shall follow your order.

feeling2.line: Rest assured, Commander. This subordinate shall always be loyal to you.

feeling3.line: Commander, if you plan on going out, please let me be your bodyguard!

feeling4.line: Commander, I'm really flattered that you treat me so well... You feel safe when I'm by your side? Understood. Your subordinate shall work harder in that regard!

feeling5.line: Commander, are you heading out? Do you need a bodyguard... Oh, it's just a civilian errand? N-no! Even if it's just across the street, y-you never know what hazards lie in wait... S-so, let's go together!

home.line: Commander, an inquiry arrived while you were gone. Do you want to look it over?

hp_warning.line: This isn't how it was supposed to be...

login.line: Salutations! Carabiniere welcomes you, Commander!

lose.line: Ugh... th-this subordinate will accept any punishment!

mail.line: Commander, the mailbox seems to be filling up.

main1.line: Royal submarines have always been elusive and mercurial. They've gotten the better of me in the past...

main2.line: My gun? I'm telling you, it's real! I just don't have it loaded.

main3.line: "Don't disturb during work hours." I put this sign up so you can have your peace of mind!

mission.line: Commander, there are still tasks that need to be finished. Do you require anything of me?

mission_complete.line: The missions are done, and we have quite the rewards to show for it. If there were some non-material rewards though...

profile.line: As a member of the Soldati-class destroyers, I served as the leader of the 12th Destroyer Squadron and led my compatriots through many battles. No matter when or where, I shall give it my all to complete any mission!

propose.line: From now on, this subordinate shall serve you for life! ...That's not what it means? Um, then... I see! B-but, can someone like me really be your partner?

touch.line: Sì!

touch2.line: P-please don't tease your subordinates like that!

unlock.line: Flagship Veneto's escort, Carabiniere of the Sardegna Empire, reporting for duty! As your subordinate, I will carry out your orders and complete any mission!

upgrade.line: I shall definitely become a better subordinate!

win_mvp.line: Victory is ours!

gift_prefer.line: Th-thank you very much!

detail.line: I can't help but to feel a little different when I put on these clothes. I know it's supposed to feel light and refreshing, but instead I feel defenseless and nervous...

feeling5.line: I once said I wanted to be your bodyguard, but when we're walking together like this, it feels like you're guarding me instead. Would this be dereliction of duty...? Ah! I wasn't saying that I disapproved of it! *sigh*...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. W-would you like to accompany me on a walk while we both have some time off? S-sorry, I hope I'm not being pushy...

lose.line: Ugh... I s-suppose I'm not cut out for this after all...

main1.line: If you're thirsty, I brought some water. Here you go!

main2.line: The warm sunlight, the gentle breeze, and an ice pop to beat the heat! That's the spirit of midsummer!
