main3.line: Commander, I heard from a friend that all girls have multiple facets... When I changed into this outfit that I'd absolutely never wear normally... it, it was as if something awakened within me...

mission.line: Wouldn't it be better to finish the missions first...

touch.line: Commander! Err, I mean, good day?

unlock.line: Lady Veneto advised me to enjoy my time off by changing into something befitting the occasion... Um, Commander, I d-don't look strange, do I?

battle.line: Rest easy knowing I won't let you down, Commander!

couple_encourage1.line: You don't need to be so formal with me, you know.

couple_encourage2.line: *gasp*! W-we're on the same side now, right...?

detail.line: Anything GB can help you with? I'm the oldest among my siblings and can do absolutely anything! Go on, let's hear it!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned!

feeling1.line: Sadly, there's no cure for your chronic hopelessness, Commander.

feeling2.line: Hmm... I wonder how long it'll be before I become a fine lady like Veneto...

feeling3.line: I was born in the historic port of Livorno, a dreamy city on the gorgeous Sardegnian west coast! You should visit it with me if you ever get the chance, Commander!

feeling4.line: You only find my floundering endearing and cute because you make me flounder so much! ...Th-th-that said, I'm perfectly fine with being called c-cute...

feeling5.line: If you and I had met under different circumstances, like as classmates... then maybe we'd be in a typical romantic relationship... J-just thinking out loud, that's all!

headtouch.line: H-hey! I've grown out of headpats! They don't work on me, nuh-uh!

home.line: How about a victory hug for everyone? Would that make me seem more mature?

hp_warning.line: Oh no! Deploy smokescreens!

login.line: It's the start of a lively day! Keep at it, Commander! I-I'd better get ready for work too!

lose.line: Dangit... You won't discourage me so easily!

mail.line: Here, I brought your mail, Commander.

main1.line: S-Simoom isn't around here, is she? Ahem! Not to imply I'm afraid of her, my question simply stems from a sincere desire for amity and courtliness.

main2.line: Oh goodness! Seriously, could you not pull weird faces while I'm trying to work?

main3.line: Commander, would you care for a delectable dessert? I personally recommend tiramisu!

mission.line: Hm? New mission directives? But I'm not ready yet... Oh, they're not for me?

mission_complete.line: Mission completed. Now where's the rewards report?

profile.line: I'm Vincenzo Gioberti, the second Alfredo Oriani-class destroyer. I stood shoulder-to-shoulder with valiant cruisers in many battles across– Huh? That's not quite right? Okay, my completion was a bit behind, but I was second to be launched among my siblings, so I do qualify as a bona fide big sister!

propose.line: You want to... get engaged with me?! B-b-b-but I...! Calm down, GB! Don't get too excited, be cool and graceful like a big sister and respond with grazia! Okay, now... I say, Commander, would you be a darling and put the ring on my finger?

touch.line: Huh? I've not done anything weird, have I?

touch2.line: Whuah?! You're a real creep, Commander...

unlock.line: I am Vincenzo Gioberti of Sardegna! ...Eh, my name's hard to remember? ...Hmm, how about just "GB" then? That's a bit easier, right?

upgrade.line: One step closer to blooming into a gorgeous signorina!

win_mvp.line: Hehe, easy as pizza pie! Err, I mean... Of course, just as expected! Nothing to get excited over!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! This is... Ahem! Thank you, Commander!

detail.line: You may drink to your heart's content today! Worry not, just put it on my tab! ...Huh? The drinks were free to begin with?

home.line: I'm a signorina – I do of course understand if you're too busy for pleasantries, Commander. Having said that... You should at least tell me before you go out, all right?

login.line: A refill, if you would, Manjuu waiter! Likewise for the Commander's glass, please! Now let me just... Hup... Ugh, these bar stools are sure are tall...

main1.line: This "for adults only" drink has gott my attention... Could I at least have a taste?

main2.line: Commander, as this is an informal gathering, you are free to say whatever you please! I am a grown lady, and I can handle it!

main3.line: We have some lovely tiramisu resting on the counter, Libeccio! Call over Maestrale and we'll all savor it together!

touch.line: Fare un brindisi! Indeed, this is how a signorina raises a toast.

touch2.line: You'll never receive another party invitation from me again!

unlock.line: "To refuse a fair signorina's invitation would be most uncouth"... Hehe~ Now, Commander, would you like to partake in some refreshments? Rest assured, they're all non-alcoholic♪

battle.line: As the flagship... I've got to boost everyone's morale... Roar...!

couple_encourage1.line: Libeccio, w-w-wait for me...!

detail.line: If only Libeccio was here... I wouldn't have to agonize over how to talk to the commander...

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. The dockhead is looking rather crowded...

feeling1.line: Keep your distance from me! Shoo, shoo...!!

feeling2.line: Libeccio, please don't bother the commander in the middle of work hours... Here, I'll make a syllabus of the times when the commander is available. Mm, that should be right... hopefully.

feeling3.line: Commander... Please look over this. It's a table of our recent mission earnings... I hope it can be of help to you...

feeling4.line: ...Commander? Why'd you come all the way... t-to talk to me? Um, right now, I'm a bit... err, I mean, yes, I'm available! I'm available, but I can't... Sorry...!

feeling5.line: Um, Commander, please take this...! Libeccio told me that if there ever was something I'd never be able to say... to put it down in a picture book! P-please take a look...!

headtouch.line: Wh-what's going on...?

home.line: How to make tea... Um, take the teabag and steep it in hot water... Commander, p-please let it sit for a few minutes...

hp_warning.line: What should I do...? What should I do?!

login.line: Greetings, greetings... G-good morning to you, Commander...

lose.line: I've been defeated... What should I be saying...?

mail.line: The mail, where'd I put the mail...? Phew, I almost forgot it after all the time I spent organizing it...

main1.line: What do I think of Libeccio? ...She's my precious little sister. She can be a bit of a klutz at times though, ehehe...

main2.line: The documents I was just working on are over here, and the already-finished ones are here... Ah, it's not that I couldn't find them, I just thought it'd be more efficient to remind myself out loud... S-sorry... *blushes*

main3.line: Commander, you must be tired... Ahh, just thinking about it makes me nervous...

mission.line: Are you going to... continue working on your high-priority missions? Err, I mean... let, let me help you!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Umm, should I go help you confirm the rewards after all...?

profile.line: I am the name ship of the Maestrale-class destroyers, Maestrale. During that war, I remember hitting a naval mine and having to return to port for repairs... The rest of my history? Umm, I, I don't think there's anything else...

propose.line: Wh-what should I be saying during a wedding ceremony? ...Um, I don't need to say anything at all? Well then... *kiss* Th-that's fine too, right...?

touch.line: D-did I say something inappropriate?

touch2.line: ...Wh-what is the meaning of this?!

unlock.line: Now lift the rim of your skirt and bow... Ahem! I'm Maestrale, d-destroyer from the Sardegna Empire. Greetings to you and your fleet, Commander. I hope I did that right...

upgrade.line: Shelling, torpedoes, and reloading... I must become stronger in all aspects...

win_mvp.line: My thoughts about getting MVP? ......Uh, umm, it's nice...?

gift_prefer.line: Goodness... Th-thank you! Oh, I don't even know what to say...

battle_ex.line: Everyone, p-please do your best...!

detail_ex.line: I really l-like talking to you, Commander... Even though I'm usually the one answering questions, but... I'd actually like to get to know more about you......

home_ex.line: Welcome back. I've been studying how to make tea from the Royal Maids. Oh, but keep it a secret from Libeccio, okay...?

login_ex.line: Good day... Th-there's no need to be so formal? I, I see... th-thanks then...

main1_ex.line: L-Libeccio isn't here today, so... Commander, how about we go somewhere t-together?!

main2_ex.line: The mission supplies are over here, the reward list is over here, and the ring box that Commander gave me is... Oh... *blushes*

touch_ex.line: Commander, need a hand?

touch2_ex.line: Ehehe... Commander...

win_mvp_ex.line: We did it! Commander, thank you very much! *nods*

detail.line: Though I'm not able to build the Colosseum like Lady Veneto can, when it comes to the Leaning Tower, a cathedral, or a basilica... Um, I can kind of get the rough shape down!

home.line: Commander, did you come all the way here to see me? Th-thanks for your concern...

login.line: Greetings, greetings... Err, umm, Commander, w-want to sit down?

main1.line: Veneto's Colosseum is truly spectacular... I wish I could fill in the other half...

main2.line: Libeccio, stop trying to drag me around.. You can go hang out with the commander instead.

main3.line: The letters I etch into the sand are immediately washed away by the waves. I see, this is what they mean when they say "write your worries on the beach"...

touch.line: Commander, did you want to get buried in the sand just like these manjuu? I'll see what I can do then...

touch2.line: P-please stop that...!

unlock.line: It's way too crowded on the beach... I'd much rather be– Oh, Commander? Are you not good with crowded places either...?

battle.line: I'm the flagship! Everyone, lesgooooo~!

couple_encourage1.line: Sis, follow my lead!

detail.line: Now that I'm here, Maestrale's gonna make a whole lotta friends! ...Oh, right, Commander! Are you getting along with my sis?

expedition.line: Commission complete! Duuuuude, look at the loot!

feeling1.line: Knock knock! Yeah, I'm gonna keep thwacking you around until you behave!

feeling2.line: I wish I could get Maestrale some more friends! Commander, got any ideas?

feeling3.line: Commander, I'm here to play! You're not busy right now, right? Ehehe, after all, Maestrale made this... silly-bus for me? In any case, it seems right!

feeling4.line: Ehhh... Spend more time with me, Commander! What do I even want to do...? I don't care! Anything!

feeling5.line: Commander! I'm here to play again! I don't care what you're doing! I'm gonna cling to you today no matter what! Heh~ heh~!

headtouch.line: Hold your horsies, Commander! Lemme take my hat off first... Now, pat me!

home.line: Commander, look! Lookie lookie at what I found! It's the teabags that my sis always uses to make you tea! I wanna try it too!

hp_warning.line: Woah! An enemy ambush!

login.line: Ciao! Commander, let's give it our all today as well!

lose.line: Starting emergency rescue procedures! Commander, make sure you keep me safe!

mail.line: Mail time! Mail time! Whooooo~!

main1.line: Maestrale's super good at organizing documents, isn't she? When I try to do it, they just end up messier and messier~

main2.line: My hair's silver on the outside and blue on the inside! Beautiful, isn't it?

main3.line: Commander, look over here! Kapow! Whew, a direct hit~! Ahaha!

mission.line: It's mission time! All I have to do is check off the box next to 'em, right... Of course that was a joke!

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards huh... I may or may not have helped myself to a little when Maestrale wasn't looking... Ehehe~

profile.line: During that war, I was the pride and joy of the Sardegna Empire, Libeccio! ...Eh, I was the first of my sisters to retire? Booo! Commander, why do you have to rub salt in the wound!

propose.line: What a beautiful ring! If I put this on, it means that I'll be able to cling to you as much as I want, right? It's a promise!

skill.line: Let's have some fun over here~!

touch.line: Hey, what's the matter? Did something happen~?

touch2.line: Smooth and flat, huh? Just like my big sis!

unlock.line: Ciao! The name's Libeccio! It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander! Let's be real good friends from here on out!

upgrade.line: Such powerrrr! Time to show off to Maestrale!

win_mvp.line: The MVP is all mine! Commander, gimme a reward!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh, yeah, I love this! Thanks!

detail_ex.line: My sister and I both like you a lot, Commander! We love you! Ehehe~ Commander, do you love us as well?

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! Hey, teach me something! Maestrale told me I should learn something that can help you out!

login_ex.line: Ciao! Commander, let's dial it up to 11 today as well! Woohoo~!

main1_ex.line: I did my best to help you organize your documents! Ehehe! Commander, what should I do next?

main2_ex.line: Behold the Eternal Light of Sardegna! ...Uhh, what color is an eternal light, and how do you hold it? ...I wonder if Veneto will tell me...

main3_ex.line: Commander, throw the ball over here! Woohoo! Let's continue our anti-air exercises!

touch_ex.line: Commander, is my sister doing alright?

detail.line: How the heck do you make a sand castle? Like this? Or maybe... like this...? Gaaaah! I give up!

headtouch.line: Yes, pat me to your heart's content!

home.line: Glub... Blub...! Blehhh, it's so salty... My kickboard flipped over in the blink of an eye... I guess I really shouldn't head out until the waves calm down a little!

login.line: One, two three, four... All righty, I'm all done warming up! Time to head down into the water~!

main1.line: Sailor Libeccio, ready to head out! Captain da Recco, when do we begin the timber-shivering?

main2.line: How can I get Maestrale to join us in the fun and games? ...Hmm, take some beautiful conch shells over to her?

main3.line: Commander, look at that! So many footprints in the sand along the beach... Huuuh?! Th-they got washed away just like that...

touch.line: Get on, Commander! We're going on a field trip!

touch2.line: Commander, what kind of game is this~?

unlock.line: Libeccio's heading towards the sea! Commander, let's go to where all the excitement is!

battle.line: Captain da Recco, setting sail!

couple_encourage1.line: Eep! You again...

couple_encourage2.line: Andiamo, to uncharted waters!

detail.line: This course is a no-go because there's no resupply point along it? Okay, then how about this one? ...Also a no-go; ocean currents are too strong? Stop being such a darn naysayer, Commander!

expedition.line: A commission's been completed! What do you say we try a different course for the next one?

feeling1.line: I'm going on a voyage! Without you! Buh-bye!

feeling2.line: Ahoy, Commander! Today's a perfect day to go on a voyage! First, we just have to plot a course!

feeling3.line: By Neptune's name! Look, Commander, there's an uncharted area on our map! Who knows what secrets it holds! We should go there on our next voyage!

feeling4.line: "If you help me out enough, I'll consider taking that route"? Whoa, you mean it?! Sign me up as your assistant!

feeling5.line: We've got a date coming up, you and I! Since I am the veteran navigator here, I'll do the course plotting... I mean, itinerary planning! ...You wanna do that yourself? Hmm... All right, I'll leave it to you!

headtouch.line: Ow! Don't pull on my hairband!

home.line: Let's see, where should I plot a course to next...

hp_warning.line: Oops!

login.line: Ahoy! Good to see you again, Commander! Let's have a look at today's cruising plans!

lose.line: Err, what? Did I take us on the wrong course?

mail.line: New mail's come in! Maybe it's got info on the latest course developments?

main1.line: Commander, got any maps lying around? I'm not gonna mess with them, I just wanna draw some lines, plot a few courses, that sorta stuff!

main2.line: Hey, could I have a look at your medal collection? I'm just curious which and how many you have!

main3.line: Why does everyone just take the same exact route over and over? There's so, so much ocean to see out there!

mission.line: Get those missions done, on the double! I'll be stuck idling in port forever otherwise!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Can we go on a voyage now? What do you mean?! I thought we had a deal!

profile.line: I'm a navigator, and let me tell you, I'm phenomenal! I fought hard alongside lots of my friends, and even made it through the war in one piece. My run-in with Force Q though, that was just blind luck!

propose.line: What's it mean to "link our hearts"? Will I know where you are when I'm out at sea, without even using a compass? Ahaha! If only it were so easy, am I right?

touch.line: Will you check out the course I plotted after I finish this work? Sweet! I'll have it done in no time!

touch2.line: I may be short, but I'm stacked! Bada bing!

unlock.line: The port's newest arrival, that's-a me! Fun-sized navigator Nicoloso da Recco salutes you, Commander! Andiamo, towards uncharted waters!

upgrade.line: To the horizon and beyond!

win_mvp.line: That's that annoying bunch dealt with! Now we can explore in peace!

gift_prefer.line: Bravo! Thank you, thank you!

detail_ex.line: This course will get us caught in a storm? And this one will get us shipwrecked? Dangit, why?! I thought I had it all planned out...

expedition_ex.line: A commission's been completed! It ain't easy, plotting new courses all the time.

feeling5_ex.line: I've worked out a course for our date! It goes to a nice, kinda remote little corner of the sea! Now it's your job to find some souvenirs for everyone!

home_ex.line: Hmm, where should I plot a course to next... Any suggestions, Commander?

login_ex.line: Ahoy-ahoy, Commander! Did you know? It's a perfect day for a voyage! Let's go on one right now!

main1_ex.line: I bought a new map! ...No, I paid for it myself, out of my own pocket. Making maps is what I do for a hobby!

main3_ex.line: Nice medal collection, Commander! I've gotta show these to my Sardegnian friends!

detail.line: Be sure to stop by later, Commander! We'll split a melon and each have a slice!

home.line: Ahoy! Wanna join my sister here under the sand?

login.line: The weather's perfect for a voyage, but Captain da Recco's seaside funtime takes precedence! Come on over and we'll play a game, Commander!

main1.line: Oh, I've gotta put on a blindfold too? No problem! I'll still nail that watermelon! Just make sure it stays in place!

main2.line: I remember hearing the Dragon Empery's got something similar to this, just with a rock instead of a melon!

main3.line: Remember to stay hydrated! Just because you're near the ocean doesn't mean you won't get thirsty!

touch.line: Wanna pick up a bat and try for yourself?

touch2.line: Oh shoot! Watch out – airborne bat!

unlock.line: I know this one! It's that Sakura Empire watermelon-smashing game! Just put the melon over there, Commander! ...Relax, it'll be fine! Have some faith in my navigator's intuition! Ready? Then let's go!

win_mvp.line: Woohoo! Good thing I smashed that melon! ...Huh? What do you mean it's not a ceremony to boost your luck?

battle.line: Have faith in my orders! They will lead you to victory!

couple_encourage1.line: You don't have a monopoly on speed, you know!

detail.line: Look, I know most people would panic if they were suddenly told to manage every last facet of a fleet, but I'm one of those few who have what it takes... Right?

expedition.line: Commission supplies have arrived! Allow me the honor of processing them!

feeling1.line: You're a terrible Commander, but if I can produce results in spite of you, people will think I'm really talented! There's always a silver lining, I tell you!

feeling2.line: I've accepted a plethora of errands and consultations with other girls today. Soon I will be the talk of the port, and every– What do you mean this schedule is infeasible? Don't you know? Nothing is impossible for me!

feeling3.line: You came at just the right time, Commander! You see, um... Thing is, I could use a lot of help. I simply don't have enough time to run all those errands I promised to... I know, I know, but you'd be helping everyone out, not just me!

feeling4.line: Phew... Without your help, I would've fled the port out of sheer shame before nightfall, fated to forever roam some cold corner of the ocean... Truly, I thank you from the bottom of my heart, Commander!

feeling5.line: Now I get it! I can earn more recognition if I focus on you, plus then I won't have to worry about breaking promises. So with that in mind, will you let me take care of all your problems whenever they arise? ...I'm begging on my knees here, please don't turn me down.

headtouch.line: My cap is NOT just for show!

home.line: Dammit... I've barely gotten anything done while the Commander was out... This is gonna reflect so badly on me... Ahem! Commander! Welcome back!

hp_warning.line: No big deal! I can keep going!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! I am ready to begin my secretarial duties and take on work from you!

lose.line: We're defeated... My dignity has been destroyed and the fleet's reputation will plummet, dooming it to fade into obscurity... Oh, err, I didn't say anything!

mail.line: Your trusty secretary brings you new mail, right on schedule!

main1.line: Hmm, how should I process these documents... It's okay, I know what I'm doing, Commander! Seriously, just let me handle it!

main2.line: I'm going out for a while, Commander! When you've got a schedule as packed as Captain Pompey's, you can't afford to sit around on your butt all day!

main3.line: If I do a bad job here, the Commander's gonna make me resign and then ostracize me... Uh, I didn't say anything! Just dealing with a minor problem here! Y-yeah, that's all!

mission.line: I'll take care of all these new missions, Commander! ...Wh-what's with that look? Wait... You're signaling that you doubt my ability, aren't you?!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! ...And unsurprisingly, I could've never accomplished it alone... Ahaha...

profile.line: I'm Pompeo Magno of the Capitani Romani-class from the Sardegna Empire! My speed and firepower make me suited for any kind of mission, and what I lack in protection I more than make up for with agility!

propose.line: Just as the capital wasn't built in one day, it takes time for people to form close bonds. Okay, I know that's an odd example! Basically, what I'm saying is: I'll make a concentrated effort to spend quality time with you so we'll become better acquainted! Otherwise I'll feel like you wasted this ring on me!

skill.line: Nothing is impossible for Captain Pompey!

touch.line: When you need my help, just grab my hand and hold it tight!

touch2.line: I-I-I am NOT some easy girl!

unlock.line: Captain Pompey the Great has arrived at port! ...Err! Ahem! Good day to you, Commander! I am Pompeo Magno of the Sardegna Empire! Assign any and all work to me and I'll have it done in the blink of an eye!

upgrade.line: The greater your ability, the more responsibilities you deserve!

win_mvp.line: Captain Pompey the Great has once more led her allies to a spectacular victory!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander! Heheh, it's good to see my hard work being recognized for once~

detail_ex.line: As you know, I have a laundry list of errands I must run for my friends, so I'll be unable to give you my attention for some time... Please, I just messing with you! I'd never leave you out in the cold!

feeling5_ex.line: Hey! You know that place popular with couples I brought up the other day? Don't say the name, it's on the tip of my tongue! It's... Hrmmm... Sigh, I can't remember... But you know what? You can make the first move and decide where we'll go for once. Hehehe~

login_ex.line: Welcome back to the office, Commander! Your secretary and sweetheart is ready to take on any work you can throw at her!

lose_ex.line: We're defeated... My dignity has been crushed... Commander, take me someplace far away where we can be alone...

main4_ex.line: Hey, Commander, some girls were asking for help earlier. Should we go see what's up? ...N-no, I'm definitely not craving more recognition! Helping people benefits us both!

main5_ex.line: ...Wait a sec! If the Commander stays this immersed in work, I'll soon be cast aside and deprived of affection... Uh, it's nothing! I was just thinking we should go on a date! To, you know, deepen our bonds and stuff! Please?!

touch_ex.line: When you need comforting, just hold my hand! Heheh!

touch2_ex.line: Wait, I'm still not ready for this! ...No, I mean, I'm just saying... I've never done it before, but I'll figure it out somehow!

win_mvp_ex.line: Captain Pompey the Great – and her great Commander – have once more led their allies to victory!

detail.line: If I'd known the Commander would find me like this, I would've hid under the piano top before I dozed off... Err, nothing! Just talking to myself!

expedition.line: The commission team brought back new components, and there are way too many to sort through... But that's okay! I like a challenge!

headtouch.line: What's with the kiddy treatment?!

home.line: Zzz... I've gotta finish all the errands I took on before the Commander gets back... Zzz...

login.line: Hi, Commander! I'm fully rested, as you can see. So, it's time to go looking for people who need a hand and do them some favors!

lose.line: I'm dead tired... Commander, lower the top for me... I need a break from real life right now...

mail.line: New mail? Might be our performance evaluation... C-come here and let me have a look at it!

main1.line: Remember to get the literature Impero asked for... and the picture books for Maestrale and Libeccio... and to buy soda for Archerfish... Zzz...

main2.line: Do you know how to play the piano, Commander? Err, this is just a model piano. The keys don't work.

main3.line: I remember now! Someone asked me to reorganize this place! And since you're already here, you should help me– I mean, help all of us by tidying up with me!

mission.line: There are new missions? Okay, I'll note that down and sort those out later!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! ...And I've not even gotten started on them yet... Wait, did you finish ALL the missions before I could attempt them?!

touch.line: Wait, stop! There's not enough room for both of us!

touch2.line: For the last time, there's not enough room for both of us! PLEASE get it into your head!

unlock.line: *yawn*... Nothing's impossible when you've got Captain Pompey... Hmm? Commander? Wait, I fell asleep? Seems I did... Drat, I forgot what I even came here for...

win_mvp.line: Victory! ...Wait, I just realized, we played for fun and still won!

battle.line: We're live, so remember to look photogenic!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's see who can snap the best photos!

couple_encourage2.line: Hey, you wanna trade scoops?

detail.line: If you wanna know others' secrets, you gotta give me something of equal value. Don't worry 'bout getting duped – I deal fair and square!

expedition.line: The commission team is back! I'm gonna go snap some group photos!

feeling1.line: I-I-I'm so sorry! I'll stop with my journalism if it offends you! Just please show mercy!

feeling2.line: Commander~ Think you could make some time for a Q&A later? It'll be basic stuff! You know, hobbies, likes, your taste in girls, things like that!

feeling3.line: Just between you and me, info about you is currently worth... this much! Heheheh! Interested? Then lemme interview you some more~

feeling4.line: Hm? You like me? Ahahahah! I'm nobody special, I'm just a smalltime journalist who loves gossip~ Forget about me – who else do you fancy? That's valuable information!

feeling5.line: The more I learn about you, the less I wanna share my knowledge with others... even though I could make big bucks by selling it... I think I might've fallen for you, Commander! S-s-settle down, Alfredo! G-g-get a hold of yourself!

headtouch.line: What's this? You trying to score points with me?

home.line: Cheese! Welcome back! I snapped a photo of you and the fleet looking badass out there! It's gonna blow up in the news! ...In a good way! Heehee!

hp_warning.line: D-don't lash out at me just 'cause I'm a journalist!

login.line: Morning, Commander! It's the perfect day for a close cov– I mean! For work! In more ways than one. Heheh...

lose.line: I-I guess I'll hide this blunder at the back of the newspaper...

mail.line: A confidential letter... It'd make for a juicy story, but top-secret stuff has to stay that way!

main1.line: Wherever you'll find scoops, you'll find me! Heehee~

main2.line: You feel like you're being watched? Weeell, I'll bet that's just your fatigue speaking! Yup, hundo percent sure of it!

main3.line: So you wanna become a mature big sister, do ya, GB? Heh, I've got heaps of pics of girls like that. Although, I guess photos won't really help you achieve that goal.

mission.line: New missions? If we're talking quick errands, I can do 'em!

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed! ...So, Commander, what are your thoughts on this latest development?

profile.line: It's-a me, Alfredo Oriani, name ship of my class of destroyers! Conserve vowels and just call me Alfredo! Go ahead and send me to the front where all the action is – I've covered world wars, you know! Heheh!

propose.line: Hold up! This doesn't make any sense! I'm just a gossip-loving, devil-may-care, occasionally ill-mannered journalist, Commander! You have zero reason to marry someone like... Nononono! I'm not saying I hate you in any way! Oh geez, if I don't cool off now I'm gonna frickin' explode! I accept the ring, okay?! We'll talk later!

touch.line: My camera's inner workings are top secret! No peeking!

touch2.line: Whuah! ...Dammit, I didn't have time to snap an incriminating pic!

unlock.line: Whoa! Here comes the mastermind behind the curtains, the one mark I really want to use all means possible to investigate – the legendary Commander! Let's get on to the interview, but first, allow me to introduce myself! The name's Alfredo Oriani! I'm a journalist, as you see!

upgrade.line: Nice! Lens aligned, picture perfect!

win_mvp.line: First question: how does it feel to be the– Wait, what? I'M the MVP?!

gift_prefer.line: Hmm... I might have to put in a few good words for you in my next article...

detail_ex.line: You curious about another girl? I could look into her if you wa– Wait a sec! You better not be thinking about cheating on me!

expedition_ex.line: The commission team has returned! I'mma go snap a group photo of them! Come along, Commander!

feeling5_ex.line: Oho? You look bored out of your mind, Commander! Tell you what, I know this spot at the port with a killer view – how 'bout we head there and take some pics? Plus a date selfie while we're there... Of course I'm not gonna sell them to anyone! I just want new things for my personal collection, that's all...

headtouch_ex.line: You know how to make a girl happy~ Heehee~

home_ex.line: Look into the camera, Commander! Cheese! This shot of your heroic return is going into my collection!

login_ex.line: Morning, Commander! Time to do what we each do best!

main4_ex.line: It's not easy finding new scoops! Especially at this port where competition is stiff. You gotta help me out, Commander! Someone's gonna overtake me if you don't!

main5_ex.line: Huh. Turns out, I've snapped a bunch of photos of you hard at work... I'll make a solo exhibition out of these at some point! ...Huh? That's a no-go? Why?

main6_ex.line: I forget I'm the name ship of my class all the time! Guess it's 'cause I'm kinda childish compared to the oldest sisters from other classes, plus I'm a shortie... Still, you married me, so that's gotta mean I have SOME unique charm!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete! Today's headline: "The Commander and Alfredo Overcome Tough Task Together"!

touch_ex.line: There's yesterday's combat report, here's some random outdoors photos I took, and this... Ummm! Forget you saw that!

touch2_ex.line: H-hold your horses! I need to mentally prepare first!

win_mvp_ex.line: Commander, I'm the MVP! Come stand next to me for a victory selfie!

battle.line: This is Alfredo, reporting live on– Hey, the battlefield's no place to fret over dresses!

detail.line: Tadah! Heehee, what'd ya think of my dance? I got advice from my Sardegnian friends on how to blend in with the crowd while gathering scoops! Although I may have gone a bit overkill with it...

feeling5.line: Let's see today's hottest article... "You Won't Believe Who's the Commander's Dance Partner"... W-wait, it's ME?! It's over... This is gonna spread around the port like wildfire... "It's fine, I'm here with you"? Um... Excuse me, I need to go cool off my burning hot face!

headtouch.line: You typically ask for a dance by holding someone's hand, not by patting their head...

home.line: Oh yes, this is a good angle! This photo's gonna make a good... C-C-Commander?! When'd you get here?! I'm not up to anything, nuh-uh! I-I need to get back to rehearsing my dance!

login.line: Commander, tell us who you'd most like to dance with today! ...You can't say? Figures it wouldn't be so easy... Well, we'd better find you a dance partner soon!

mail.line: A new letter? It might be a personal invitation for you! Let's find out!

main1.line: There are crowds of girls vying to be your partner, Commander! That heartwarming piece of info comes from yours truly♪

main2.line: GB! I snapped a bunch of photos of ladies being ladies! Here! Feel free to reference it~

main3.line: Commander! I've got gorgeous pics of Sardegnian girls mid-rehearsal! Interested? ...Then you know what I want in return. Heehee~

touch.line: Aha! So I move my feet like... Hang on, why am I here learning dance moves from you?!

touch2.line: I'm not hiding anything! There's nothing I CAN hide to begin with! Use your common sense!

unlock.line: Found you, Commander! How would you grade this outfit of mine? ...No, no, I wasn't asking if it looked cute or pretty, I wanted to know if I was wearing it right in the first place! You know what though, I think I'll take those compliments~

battle.line: Enemy spotted... Commencing attack!

couple_encourage1.line: O-on to a new journey... Ugh, I can't say it after all...

detail.line: You have to take good care of telescope lenses... Otherwise, they might get scratched up, and that's a huge problem.

expedition.line: Our friends from the commission team have returned. Look, they're over there––

feeling1.line: I'm sorry, but please leave me alone...

feeling2.line: Commander, you've tried looking through the telescope, right? ...So, what do you think is the difference between seeing something through the lens and seeing something up-close?

feeling3.line: A telescope makes it possible to see things clearly even from a distance... From a place far, far away, where I won't bother anyone...

feeling4.line: Imprinting a beautiful scenery into your memory after seeing it once is already good enough... But, sometimes, the more you see something, the more you want to touch it, feel it...

feeling5.line: Umm... Commander, do you have any free time next week? There's a place I really want to go to... Um, I want to take you sightseeing... Is that okay? I-it's always been really important to me...

headtouch.line: Is there something wrong with my ribbon?

home.line: ......Oh. Sorry, I was taking in the scenery outside and didn't notice you returning...

hp_warning.line: I mustn't drag the others down...

login.line: Hrmmmm... Yeah, you really do look nothing like what I saw through the telescope... N-nevermind. Welcome back, Commander.

lose.line: Excuse me, um... Commander, you don't need to feel too down about it.

mail.line: You've got new mail. It's from... somewhere I can't see... Hrmm, someplace far, far away?

main1.line: I like to gaze out into the distant scenery. What your eye can perceive... is so much greater than what your fingertips are able to touch.

main2.line: There should be a lot of great observation spots around the port, right? I'd like to jot them all down when I get the chance.

main3.line: Da Recco, if you're going to go out, wouldn't it be safer to take a more... charted route?

mission.line: There are still missions that need doing. Commander, you seem to be having a rough time... Need to take a little break?

mission_complete.line: Here's the mission completion report... Need help looking over it? If a typo slipped its way into the final submission...

profile.line: I am the Navigatori-class destroyer, Emanuele Pessagno. Back then, I managed to serve Sardegna commendably, but if only I had been more careful during that final escort mission...

propose.line: Eh? Th-this is for me? Thank you... I'll make sure to treasure it, no matter what... Ehehe, I don't have to keep gazing from a distance anymore... After all, happiness is within my reach...

touch.line: You want to try looking through my telescope? ...Um, sure, but be careful...

touch2.line: P-please stop that...

unlock.line: I'm the Sardegnian destroyer, Emanuele Pessagno. Umm... Commander, you look way different in-person than through my telescope... Must be because I can get a closer view.

upgrade.line: Am I able to see farther now...?

win_mvp.line: Did we manage to win? That's a relief...

gift_prefer.line: I-I'll treasure this!

feeling5_ex.line: When I travel alone, I keep all my emotions buried deep inside me... But when I'm with somebody else, I feel like I can open up my heart... Ehehe, I'm so glad that I get to share this journey with the person I love...

headtouch_ex.line: Um, C-Commander...?

home_ex.line: Ehehe, I saw you coming back from a long way away. But, it still feels more comforting to welcome you in person like this...

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! ...Oh, um, there's something stuck on your face... Hold on just a moment. I'll get it for you...

main4_ex.line: My telescope can bring the most distant of sceneries right before me, but I won't be able to touch them. It's a rather lonely feeling... The same goes for people I like...

main5_ex.line: The same scenery can look completely different when sharing it with someone else, as opposed to viewing it alone... Ehehe, maybe I'm not so envious of the others anymore.

main6_ex.line: Da Recco drafted a route map for me, but something doesn't seem quite right with it... Commander, would you mind checking it out with me...?

touch_ex.line: I wish there was a telescope that two people could use at once...

touch2_ex.line: You know I'm not good with these kinds of things, right...? (*blushes*)

win_mvp_ex.line: It's our victory. I'm really glad that I was able to be of help to you and the others.

detail.line: Commander, um, can you ask Alfredo to put me in some inconspicuous corner when she's writing her review? ...I, I don't want to stand out too much...

feeling5.line: Commander, umm, can we go somewhere together? I want to see some familiar scenery before the performance begins, to relieve some of my nerves... And, whenever I'm with you, I feel even more at ease.

headtouch.line: Th-the microphone isn't clipped on crooked, right...?

home.line: Commander, can you grab a comb for me? There should be one in the next drawer over...

login.line: Th-thank you... for coming all this way to see me... Phew... I've finally managed to calm down a little, and I don't think I'm as nervous as before...

main1.line: I have to stand up there in front of everyone as a part of the set... Just thinking about it is making my heart pound like crazy...

main2.line: If you're talking about my telescope, I let my friends hold on to it. Y-you want to use it to look at me since you're sitting pretty far back...? P-please stop teasing me...

main3.line: Now that I think about it, this outfit is pretty risqué... I wonder why Laffey doesn't seem to mind at all...

touch.line: I, I can put these shoes on myself. There's no need to bother the Commander...

touch2.line: Y-you shouldn't do something like that...

unlock.line: Eek! Wh-why are you guys tugging at my stockings... P-please stop that... C-Commander, please... Hurry and come help me! Waah...

battle.line: Watch this! I'll drive off all those baddies!

couple_encourage1.line: You go, Captain Pompey! You're the coolest knight in the castle!

couple_encourage2.line: Whoooa, you've got bunny ears! Can I touch them?

detail.line: Commander, you gotta protect all of our friends in the castle, too! You're so cool and strong, I know you can do it!

expedition.line: The older girls brought lots of stuff back! Were they out adventuring?

feeling1.line: C-Commander, are you actually a minion of the Onion Monster?!

feeling2.line: Mr. Birdy, come down here! I'll give you some tasty dried fish! ...Hmm. Why do they always fly away as soon as they're done eating?

feeling3.line: Commander, look! Here's the White Bunny, here's the Black Bunny, and here's Duke Monochrome Bunny! Captain Kitty and the Manjuu Guard are here, too! Everyone, let's have fun with the Commander!

feeling4.line: The Black Bunny and White Bunny play every day, so they're the bestest friends! You and I play every day, too, which also makes us the bestest friends!

feeling5.line: All the good people should be happy, all the bad people should get punished and learn to be better, and everyone who loves each other should end up together... That's what I want. What about me? Hehehe, as long as I'm with you, I already have what I want!

headtouch.line: Ehehe... Squishy...

home.line: Commander, you're back! Hey, did you meet the Dolphin Knights and Captain Shark? I wanna know all the fun stuff you've been up to outside of our castle!

hp_warning.line: Whoa, whoa! I'm gonna lose to the baddies...!

login.line: Commander, I lined up your paperwork like paper soldiers for you! Now you just gotta knock 'em out!

lose.line: F-forget that just happened! Next time, you and I are gonna teach them a lesson!

mail.line: Commander, you got a letter! I'm like a bunny delivering mail!

main1.line: I hope the Onion Monster and Evil Pepper don't show up in my lunch tomorrow... B-but I know you'll save me, Commander!

main2.line: Commander, I'll rub your shoulders for you! Let me and the cute bunnies soothe you together.

main3.line: I love your castle, Commander! I can play with the bunnies and kitties whenever I want, I don't have to go anywhere far, and I don't have to be in the sun!

mission.line: What's a mish-shun? Does that mean I'll get a reward if I help with work?

mission_complete.line: Commander, our rewards came! Let's go take 'em into our castle!

profile.line: My name is Attilio Regolo, and I'm a Capitani Romani-class destroyer from the Sardegna Empire! Don't you think a shipgirl and her Commander are like a fairy tale princess and her knight? Though some seem to think we're the knights, while you're the princess...

propose.line: Hehe, I love you, Commander! Hey, can you squat down for a sec? There you go... Now I can give you a big kiss on the cheek! Mmm-mwah! We're gonna live together forever, just like the princes and princesses of fairy tales~

touch.line: Come play with me and the bunnies!

touch2.line: Hahahahaha~ Th-that tickles~

unlock.line: Vowed to protect me forever, and bound by the red string... You are my fated knight, Commander! Finally, I found you! Hehe, go on—welcome me to your castle!

upgrade.line: I'm getting stronger!

win_mvp.line: We won! My friends and I really trounced those baddies!

gift_prefer.line: Whoa! You mean this is for me? It's so cute!

login_ex.line: Commander, I missed you so much! Hehehe, huggies, huggies!

main4_ex.line: Commander, let my bunnies soothe you! Hup... Commander secured! Do you mind if I keep hugging you?

main5_ex.line: With the Commander by my side, I'm a real princess! Hehehe, I love you, Commander!

mission_ex.line: We have lots of mish-shuns to do! Let's do our best and get lots and LOTS of rewards!

mission_complete_ex.line: Commander, we've got rewards! Yay, hooray!

touch_ex.line: Hehe, you're my favorite person to play with!

touch2_ex.line: This feels weird... I dunno how to feel about it...

detail.line: You write the words, and I'll draw the pictures! We'll make a really happy story together!

home.line: Commander! Y-you're good at computers, right? It's not working... D-did I make it mad, or something?

login.line: You're just in time, Commander! Sit right there, okay? I wanna draw you all chibified and cute! It won't take long.

main1.line: If you turned into a kitty, I'd be able to snuggle and pet you all I wanted... Heehee!

main2.line: Vice Captain Pen, it's up to you! Aww, I wish you could just draw in my place...

main3.line: Kitties and bunnies, get along, okay? Whoa! Don't scratch the bunny's ears! And no jumping around my desk, either!

touch.line: Hey, what is a princess carry like? I wanna be princess carried!

touch2.line: Hahahaha, haha... Haha... C'mon, that tickles!

unlock.line: Welcome to my humble abode! Bunnies, kitty-cats, and the Commander... The gang's all here! Today's tale is gonna be a wild one!

detail.line: Hmm... Y'know, I think it would be cooler if we could swap how we appear. Seeing you descend from on high... Heheh, just imagining it is exciting!

feeling5.line: For me, being with you is the greatest joy of all! My heart feels even fluffier than a cloud... Hehe... This is the kind of love you see in fairy tales, isn't it?

home.line: Commander, welcome back! Heheh, what do you think? I bet you never get tired of seeing me float down from above!

login.line: Commandeeer! Heheh, it's time to jump into fairy tales. Hurry up and take my hand!

mail.line: Commander, you've got letters! Don't I look like a mail delivery girl now? Heheh!

main1.line: I've been practicing a lot so you can see my cutest side! ...You think I look like a real angel? Hehehe~

main2.line: Whoa, my parasol's making a weird noise... Am I gonna fall if it breaks?

main3.line: With Duke Monochrome Rabbit~ We part the clouds and light up the day~ To my fated one, I'm on my way~

touch.line: Floaty, airy... Commander, do you like this? Wanna try it?

touch2.line: Ahahaha... Come on, that tickles! I'm gonna lose balaaance!

unlock.line: I wanted to try making a fairy-tale entrance. Did I look good, Commander? When you saw me come down from the sky, did you sense destined romance?!

battle.line: Preparations are complete. Let us depart.

couple_encourage1.line: Alfredo, you should put your articles through another revision phase... or three.

couple_encourage2.line: Hai Tien, I brought a collection of poems for you in return.

couple_encourage3.line: It's an honor, Brest. I adore your poetry!

detail.line: ...Hm? Commander, how long have you been here? Sorry, I was a little too engrossed in my book. This is a Royal Navy poetry collection – want to join me? Lovely! Let's read it together.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission fleet is back. I checked the material manifest, and nothing seems to be out of line, but some of the terminology seems inaccurate...

feeling1.line: If I were to write your words just now into a poem, I would have to express it as akin to verbal vomit...

feeling2.line: You found my notebook?! Thank you... It's full of many of my favorite phrases. If you hadn't found it, I'd... Well, thank you.

feeling3.line: Welcome to my personal collection. As you can see, I've divided literary works into sections by faction... What do I do with books in languages I can't read? Well, learning the language and trying to translate it is a perfectly enjoyable challenge.

feeling4.line: I use this page to analyze your linguistic habits. Why do I analyze even simple small talk? Even the simplest of phrases can undergo all kinds of subtle modifications!

feeling5.line: "From you have I been absent in the spring... Yet seem'd it winter still, and, you away, as with your shadow I with these did play." Commander, I made a bookmark for you. I wanted to present it along with one of my favorite poems.

headtouch.line: This is a laurel wreath – the utmost honor to a poet.

home.line: Dropping anchor, mooring... No, we can do better... Hm? Commander, you're just in time. I'm trying to write a poem about returning to port. You must know more about this than me. May I borrow your knowledge for a bit?

hp_warning.line: I'm fine. I can still fight!

login.line: Commander, this document seems to be in need of revisions. For example, here and... Ahem. Sorry for rushing you. Please, sit down.

lose.line: We must retreat. It's not too late to sort out our findings and try again.

mail.line: There's mail addressed to you, Commander. Wait, not that one... That's a poem I was in the middle of writing. Ahem... You may see it once it's done.

main1.line: This document... Hmm. There's a typo on the word "commission" here. It's a small problem, but we should fix it.

main2.line: Curious about my notebook? I've collected and analyzed everyone's linguistic habits in it... Oh, this page is yours. I'm still collecting yours.

main3.line: Watching da Vinci's experiments reminds me of purgatory as written in poetry... Well, frankly, purgatory seems more promising than her works.

mission.line: You're worthy of a poem even when you're acting slovenly, but is now really the time? Brace up and handle your work, Commander.

mission_complete.line: It looks like your missions are done. Good job, Commander. Take a break while you can... Oh, me? I just happened to get a flash of inspiration, so I'm jotting it down before I forget.

profile.line: Giosuè Carducci. Third Poeti-class destroyer. Affiliation: Sardegna. This introduction ought to be more convenient for a written report, no? ...Hm? This isn't meant to be written?

propose.line: You felt the same way all along? Thank you... I promise to love you with every breath, every smile, and every tear for all my life – and even after I've been sunk, if it may be...

skill.line: The shudderings of Etna and whirlwinds of the Alps upon you!

touch.line: Phew... Finally, the archive is perfectly organized. ...Hm? Did you call me, Commander?

touch2.line: That one's going into my Collection of Boorish Acts.

unlock.line: I'm Giosuè Carducci, a Sardegnian poet. Pleased to meet you. Should I get to work right now? If I have time before I start, I'd love an opportunity to visit the port library first.

upgrade.line: Inspiration is surging within like never before!

win_mvp.line: To you I offer a hymn of honor and glory.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you. I really like... No, I think it would be more accurate to say that I love it.

detail_ex.line: Commander, would you like to read a poetry collection together? Come sit. They're love poems, so I'm sure there's much fun to be had.

feeling5_ex.line: "The forests feel thee, and with a cool shiver awake; up soars the falcon, flashing in eager joy." This is a poem I wrote for you, Commander.

headtouch_ex.line: Your approval is the greatest compliment I could ever want.

home_ex.line: Here you drop your sail and lie by me... Hm? Commander, welcome back... Yes, I'm working on that poem I mentioned before. Now that we're together, the things I want to express have changed a little.

login_ex.line: Commander, I brought suggestions on optimizing the language in your documents. I have three ideas... Oh, right. I made coffee, so have a drink while you read.

main4_ex.line: Do you need a grammar check? No? It's a poem... for me? Let's see... Oh, very nice. I like it! ...Though your diction COULD be improved a little.

main5_ex.line: My notes here aren't just for analyzing your linguistic habits. I also just... want to remember your words, too...

main6_ex.line: They say morning is the most beautiful time of day. Next time you're free, let's watch the sunrise together – just the two of us.

touch2_ex.line: Oh...! I-I understand your desire. It's described as beauty in many poems... I'm still a little embarrassed, but...

detail.line: "The grace of one's advance, such is the true beauty of dance..." Sorry, that may have been too pretentious. I'll work on it.

feeling5.line: The time I've spent dancing with you here in this palace... no, every moment we're together has been special. My dance may leave some to be desired, but I'd like to commemorate this with a poem. When it's done, I'll share it with you.

headtouch.line: Shall I remove my veil?

home.line: Would you like to dance with me? Oh, you'd like me to teach you... I'm happy to, but these are the only moves I know. I hope that's okay...

login.line: Traveler, enjoy this banquet. Delicious food and wine, supplemented by bewitching dance... A moment frozen in time.

main1.line: Dance and poetry are a lot alike. They both have a rhythm and tempo you need to adhere to... It's just a little harder when it comes to dancing.

main2.line: I may not be able to do the whole dance, but if you only looked right now, wouldn't you call me beautiful?

main3.line: It's just like writing poetry. Careful use of empty space can rouse the imagination... So I'll leave the rest of the dance to your imagination, Commander!

touch.line: You'd like to see other dance moves? Sorry... I may not be able to do that.

touch2.line: I'm losing balance!

unlock.line: Traveler from afar, allow me to pen a welcoming verse with this dance... Why'd I stop? Umm... S-silence is golden, as they say...

battle.line: I-I'll take care of everyone!

couple_encourage1.line: Here's a first-aid kit. Take it with you on your adventures.

detail.line: Huh? Oh, m-my health? Sorry for making you worry... I just bandaged up a few little scratches, that's all... I'm really okay!

expedition.line: The commission is done. I'll go ask if they need help unloading.

feeling1.line: If your body is unhealthy, it'll affect your mind, as well... May I heal you before it's too late, Commander?

feeling2.line: Ugh, why do I keep tripping... Has something gone "ill" in my shoes? Hmm? You want to hold hands and walk slowly? Thank you... That's very comforting.

feeling3.line: Commander, you'll need ample sleep and lots of vegetables to stay healthy! If I happen to see you sneaking work into your bed at night... I-I'll start watching you to make sure you sleep!

feeling4.line: The thought of you actually being sick makes me feel awful... Am I the one who's suffering from some strange illness now?

feeling5.line: If you're feeling unwell, tell me right away! I want to help you! Even if it's just a little... It would make me so, so happy. S-so rely on me more... please?

headtouch.line: You and I care for each other and look after each other... just like family!

home.line: Thanks for all your hard work, Commander. Let me take a look at you... Hmm. Your uniform and hat are in good "health"... You must take such good care of them!

hp_warning.line: I'll never abandon a patient!

login.line: Commander, let me diagnose you! Hmm... You're in perfect health!

lose.line: It's okay. We'll try harder together next time.

mail.line: You have mail... Yes, yes, very "healthy" mail. It's safe for you to open.

main1.line: When you're getting a shot, don't stare at the needle. If it hurts, focus your attention on me, and the pain will go right away!

main2.line: Your books might "catch a cold" if they're left out of the bookcase, just like you. Let's go outside and get you some sun, okay?

main3.line: Plasters, bandages, disinfectant... and the candy you gave me, of course! These are all essential supplies!

mission.line: You do have tasks that need doing, but you should really take care of your health, Commander.

mission_complete.line: Another mission done. I'll go check on the rewards. Oh, you can just rest here while I do.

profile.line: I'm the Sardegnian destroyer Ugolino Vivaldi. Umm, I hear you have "paperwork-itis." I'll get you fixed up right as rain in no time!

propose.line: Y-you'd really let me have something so valuable? I see... I'll care for it just as lovingly as I do for you.

skill.line: For the sake of everyone's safety!

touch.line: I love this uniform! It's both comfy and durable.

touch2.line: Hyah?! Th-thank you for your concern...

unlock.line: N-nice to... meet you. My name is Ugolino Vivaldi, and I'm from the Sardegna Empire. Everyone calls me Nurse Ugolino... Keep me by your side, and I'll keep you healthy and at ease!

upgrade.line: I'm the very picture of good health now! Thank goodness.

win_mvp.line: N-nobody is hurt, right?

gift_prefer.line: Oh, you're too generous... Thank you, Commander.

feeling5_ex.line: Whatever you want from me, I'd be happy to do... Huh? Could this be a symptom of... love?

headtouch_ex.line: C-Commander, umm... Could I ask you to check on my health with a little kiss to the forehead?

home_ex.line: Oh, no... The Commander still isn't home. What if there's danger, or... I knew I should've gone with you... Ah! Welcome back, Commander!

login_ex.line: Commander, I wanted to try a different methodology for today's diagnosis... Mwah. I measured your forehead temperature with my lips! You're in perfect health, by the way.

main4_ex.line: If I fall, you'll help patch me up... It feels wonderful to be cared for so much.

main5_ex.line: Sometimes, I accidentally go out wearing your clothes... W-we share bath soap and detergent, after all, so it can be hard to tell the difference sometimes...

main6_ex.line: Commander, come over to my place after work! I'll prepare a nice bubble bath for us to relax together.

touch_ex.line: Hehehe, Commander... Our shadows are touching.

touch2_ex.line: Hyah?! Yes, this does feel good, but... Urk...

feeling5.line: I-if you really want to take me home as your rare prize... I'm not one to deny your wishes. In that case... p-please take good care of me!

headtouch.line: Ah... Thank you, Commander. You know just how to make me feel better.

home.line: Did you find a way to get me out of here?! Huh? Why do you have a camera...? T-to document this and prevent it from happening again? Um, w-well, I suppose that makes sense...

login.line: Ah... I-I'm not a plushie. Commander, can you help me?

main1.line: C-congratulations... You caught a kitten... O-ooh, this is too embarrassing...

main2.line: The rare prize...? B-but I'm not a plushie! Goodness, Commander...

main3.line: These plushies are so soft and fluffy... If you hadn't caught me, I might've fallen right asleep on them.

touch.line: You wanna take a picture of me because you think I look cute...? I-if you really like this outfit... then I'll do my best to look good in it!

touch2.line: C-Commander, you'd take advantage of me right now...?

unlock.line: E-examination complete... This "sick" claw machine seems to have mistaken me for a plushie... O-or did it realize how much I wanted the Commander to take me home?

battle.line: To battle! My splendor shall be proven!

detail.line: I am the final development from a class of treaty cruiser. With the performance enhancements I received, victory is but guaranteed in any battle I partake in.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned to port. It is part of your job to acknowledge their efforts, is it not, Commander?

feeling1.line: You've proven yourself a spineless imbecile. Get out of my sight!

feeling2.line: My name is Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi. You find that too hard to memorize? Then you may shorten it to Duca degli Abruzzi, but no less than that. My dignity won't allow it.

feeling3.line: Don't fret over each and every obstacle you face, Commander. Your subordinates will do all in their power to help.

feeling4.line: I am not just a soldier at your disposal, Commander. I am someone with a desire to understand and support you to my utmost. This desire has nothing to do with rank or status.

feeling5.line: What do you want to discuss today, Commander? One cannot do much without the aid of loyal supporters, and I strive to be your biggest one. Hahah. It's the least I can do to return the recognition you've given me.

home.line: If you need rest, now is the time to get it, Commander. We will have much to do afterwards.

hp_warning.line: As long as I can still fight, I will!

login.line: Greetings, Commander. The Empire's splendor radiates as brightly as ever.

lose.line: Alas, we must shamefully turn our backs on our foes...

mail.line: You have a letter. Whoever wrote it is brutishly uncourteous... It's what? From Naval HQ? I see.

main1.line: How can you sit idly like this, Commander? We dignitaries must set an example for others to follow.

main2.line: It matters not how strong your adversary is as long as you are stronger. That is what war boils down to.

main3.line: Hmm. Climb Mount Niitaka? I see I'm not alone in the desire to mountaineer... What? That's not what the message means?

mission.line: Say the word, and I will complete these missions for you.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. It's time you looked over the rewards.

profile.line: I am the Condottieri-class light cruiser Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi, from the Sardegna Empire. I fought valiantly alongside my esteemed allies during the war. My ambition now is to achieve lustrous feats as the Empire's splendorous flagbearer!

propose.line: This ring could only mean one thing. You want my support till death do us apart, no? Then I will oblige. After all, there is no greater joy than knowing you want me by your side forever. Hahaha.

touch.line: What do you need, Commander? I can perform some of your duties in an official capacity.

touch2.line: What has gotten into you?!

unlock.line: I am light cruiser Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi, Sardegna's splendorous dignitary. I've waited for the day to fight under your banner, Commander.

upgrade.line: Now the question is, how to make the best use of my new abilities?

win_mvp.line: I am the Empire's splendor – Duca degli Abruzzi! Etch this name into your memories!

gift_prefer.line: I accept. You have my gratitude, Commander.

detail_ex.line: I truly do hope to see you at Le Triomphant's tea party. Feel free to ask if you want suggestions on what gifts you should bring.

login_ex.line: Care for some tea before work? I'll put the kettle on.

main1_ex.line: You're not procrastinating, but rather taking a break? I wish you would've said so sooner. Forgive me if I've been excessively strict. Let us both work on our undesirable quirks.

main4_ex.line: Your presence has lifted a great burden from my shoulders. The energy it has freed up I will use to better myself.

touch_ex.line: Yes, Commander? Whatever it is you need done, just say the word, and I'll see to it.

touch2_ex.line: I don't blame you for losing control, but you must consider the impact on your public image.

win_mvp_ex.line: You have been defeated by the one and only Luigi di Savoia Duca degli Abruzzi! Remember this fact!

detail.line: Fixated on my younger sister, hmm? You lend credibility to the adage that heroism breeds virility. Hahah!

home.line: Is the water temperature satisfactory? You must not come here much, so make the most of your visit. If you want something, just ask for it.

main1.line: What do you think of this neon-lit cityscape? It doesn't start to compare to the idyllic vistas of Sardegna, but it has its own merits.

main2.line: You truly are dependable to the utmost, obliging my younger sister with your company like this.

main3.line: Valiant? I'm not sure where she is. Which is concerning, as I don't believe she's a good swimmer...

touch.line: Enjoy your time here. Let others take care of any bothersome chores in the meantime.

unlock.line: Good evening, Commander. Here to unwind after a day's work, I take it? Even dignitaries desire a bit of luxury sometimes. Hahaha.

battle.line: Let's get this done in a flash.

couple_encourage1.line: I'll do as a dignitary and take the lead!

couple_encourage2.line: Sweet rigging. I want one like that.

detail.line: What are you standing there all stiff for? Make yourself comfortable. I'm not gonna punish you for it. You're not the type who fusses over a noble's manners, are you?

expedition.line: Hey, you completed a commission. You should remember that, even if I forgot.

feeling1.line: You call yourself the Commander, but you're really just a nobody. Hmph.

feeling2.line: I'll follow your orders no problem, but please don't demand more of me than that. It's just easier for us both that way. Besides, you don't like being a slave to formality like Abruzzi, do you?

feeling3.line: It's not like a dignitary's duty is too much for me or whatever. I'd look like a fool if it was. I'm just easygoing – don't you wanna be that too, Commander?

feeling4.line: Leading and protecting your friends is what's important, not petty etiquette or manners. I've known that since day one. Heck, I'm protecting you right now... Well, in my own way.

feeling5.line: Can't you take it easy at least for today? You have all these supportive girls by your side – rely on them for once. Think of it like this: I'll never be able to fulfill my duty as a dignitary of protecting you if you're always working around the clock.

home.line: Oh, you're back. Go ahead and take a seat. What for? The after-action review, obviously. Were you expecting something else?

hp_warning.line: Knock it off...!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Phew... Sardegna's splendor is shining as brightly as ever today~

lose.line: Hmph, so you got us good this time. I'll be back.

mail.line: A letter? Open and see what it says.

main1.line: My duties as a dignitary? Ehh, don't give a rat's ass about 'em. My sis and I are worlds apart in that regard.

main2.line: If what you're doing isn't hugely important, just wing it. If you mess up, someone will come and fix it.

main3.line: I usually go to tea parties with like-minded people. You interested, Commander?

mission.line: We've got new missions. Time to do what you signed up for.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Which is to say, you've performed your duty as a dignitary.

profile.line: I'm the final variant of a line of treaty cruisers... I think? Anyway, my time in the limelight was after the war rather than during it, for various reasons. You still wanna know more about me? Like what – my achievements, or the stats of my weaponry?

propose.line: I'm guessing you want me to look after you forever and ever? You got it. Simply always being there for you is a total breeze when you're Abruzzi's sister.

skill.line: Here's what I can REALLY do!

touch.line: Obbedisco! Just tell me what you need.

touch2.line: Well, I'll be damned.

unlock.line: Is everyone doing well? Now, let's put our hands together for the port's latest arrival – light cruiser Giuseppe Garibaldi of Sardegna! ...Oh, Commander? I was just updating my shipgirl profile... And that does it! Who am I? Didn't you just hear me say Giuseppe Garibaldi?

upgrade.line: Pretty good. Nothing to complain about and much to love. Like my new firepower.

win_mvp.line: I've won. My name is light cruiser Giuseppe Garibaldi. Easy to remember, right?

gift_prefer.line: I'll take it then~

battle_ex.line: You're all under my protection!

detail_ex.line: Not trying to throw any shade here, but can you really handle standing up for so long? Stop fretting over appearances and have a seat. Alternatively, go ahead and punish me for being too lax. Just kidding♪

expedition_ex.line: Commission complete. Do you actually remember when you sent them out?

home_ex.line: Have a seat. I'll go get you a quick meal, so take the chance to get comfy before it's time for the review.

login_ex.line: You know the drill – we must again strive to spread Sardegna's glory. Heehee.

main4_ex.line: How about a Sardegnian signature drink on your afternoon break? It'll reinvigorate you, I promise. Heehee.

main5_ex.line: Look, you can honestly just wing it if the task's not important. Didn't I tell you someone will fix any errors you make? Mainly me, your secretary.

main6_ex.line: Leander, put some extra sugar cubes in my tea if you don't mind. Commander, are you good with 8 for each of us?

touch_ex.line: Your bidding is my command and whatnot.

touch2_ex.line: No way, you actually just touched me...

home.line: Watching me dance ballet is fine and all, but I think it's time you do your after-action review. People are waiting, you know.

login.line: It took getting through a storm to finally clock in, eh?

main1.line: Both the white and black swan are meant to be played by the same person, right? Doesn't that make Roma and me rivals?

main2.line: Da Vinci's the kind of girl who really gets into her role, unlike me. Good for her if she enjoys it. Me, I just can't do it.

main3.line: Is Abruzzi watching me? Aw crap, then I'll have to do hardcore practice or she'll chew me out. She should play a role herself if it's so damn important...

mission.line: You've got new missions. Wonder if one of them is like, make a lovers' pact and you'll be rewarded, or something?

mission_complete.line: A dignitary never goes back on their promise. Mission complete.

touch.line: Will you swear your love to me? Heehee~

touch2.line: It's no big deal, but something feels off about this...

unlock.line: I am the evil swan Odile! Where oh where is my prince? ...Oh, it's you, Commander. My lines aside, pretty good performance, right?

battle.line: With my military pride on the line, I swear, I will bring the Commander victory!

detail.line: My colleagues say that I'm too uptight, but on the battlefield, a moment's inattention can beckon death. ...Though when I'm up late at night writing reports, I do enjoy the occasional break with milk tea and romance novels... Ahem! Milk tea is just a tactical drink for replenishing my energy! And the novels... Umm... Don't tell anyone about those, please.

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned to port. I've summarized their mission for you in this report here. Please have a look.

feeling1.line: You've disappointed me today, Commander. As a soldier, you should maintain basic discipline.

feeling2.line: I appreciate your cooperation, Commander, but we really should keep a professional distance given our working relationship...

feeling3.line: When I work with you, I feel oddly... giddy. Oh, I-I just mean I'm happy that my efficiency has improved, of course! Nothing else... N-no hidden meaning at all, nope!

feeling4.line: Maybe the strategy in my novel will work...! A-ahem, Commander, do you have a minute to join me for tea, or... N-no, I just wanted a meeting to discuss our strategy for the next battle...!

feeling5.line: When I'm with you, it seems like I don't need to be so uptight... Mmm... How long has it been since I felt so relaxed? Maybe... Love really does change a person, just like in my romance books... O-oh goodness, I didn't just say that!

headtouch.line: Huh?! C-Commander, this is hardly appropriate for two military folk... But I actually don't mind that much...

home.line: Your missions are going well, I see. Ah, I've already compiled the combat report. Detailed notes and addendums are – oh, this? I-I only use pretty fonts to make it more engaging for you...

hp_warning.line: I'm fine. An injury like this isn't even worth writing in the report!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. I've finished preparing the materials for today's strategy meeting... Oh? Am I being needlessly uptight? I-I'm simply presenting the professional front that any officer should!

lose.line: N-no way... Were my plans incomplete?

mail.line: Commander, you've got new mail. Shall I sort it out for you?

main1.line: Commander, I've finished today's plan... Oh, I'm sorry. Already talking about work again. You said it's okay to relax once in a while, right...?

main2.line: Hm? What am I reading? Th-this is a book about how commanders and their subordinates can improve their relationships! U-umm... It's just for the sake of teamwork...

main3.line: Do you think I'm well-dressed today? As a soldier, personal grooming is the most basic of basics... C-Commander?! Why are you coming so close?!

mission.line: Commander, you have missions that still need to be handled. As your staff officer, I suggest you get to work immediately... But of course, if you're too tired at this moment, I'm willing to do them for you.

mission_complete.line: Well done. I finished my report, so make sure you get your rewards... Huh? I doodled in the corner?! Pretend you didn't see that, please!

profile.line: I'm Bartolomeo Colleoni, staff officer and mission support of the Sardegnian fleet. I've put a lot of time into studying tactical analysis and combat deployment... Really, don't you think it's better for a soldier to be seen as uptight? Umm... You disagree? O-okay. I'll try to be better...

propose.line: Hmm? Is this a document you need me to work on... Wha? Whaaat?! A-a contract?! I've imagined this so many times, but I don't feel ready at all...! Oh, my hands are shaking so much... Wh-where do I sign? I can hardly hold the pen steady. Help me, Commander!

touch.line: Hm? Do you need something?

touch2.line: Th-this is inappropriate. Please stop at once!

unlock.line: I am Bartolomeo Colleoni, staff officer and mission support for the Sardegnian fleet. Don't worry – when it comes to tactical analysis and combat deployment, I... Oh, there I go again. Umm, I look forward to working with you, Commander.

upgrade.line: I'll use this power to the fullest for the Commander's sake.

win_mvp.line: Heh. When I serve as the front-line staff officer, victory is but a matter of course.

gift_prefer.line: Ah! C-Commander... You don't have to be so considerate of me, you know. We have a lot of work to do... b-but let me be clear, the gift does make me very happy. Thank you!

feeling5_ex.line: I've written about all of our time together in my diary. Sometimes, I draw my memories with you... It's frankly childish behavior for a soldier, but when I look upon them, I remember you. It makes me... so very happy.

headtouch_ex.line: Mm... It's far from appropriate, but I could get used to this...

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. You're unusually early today. If you'd like, umm... I-I happened to find this lovely café, and my book says that they're a great place for... d-discussing work!

login_ex.line: Let's do our best today, Commander. ...My notes here? They're not for work. They're, um... my research on how to get closer to you... D-don't laugh at me, please!

main4_ex.line: Umm... I made lunch for you today, Commander. Of course, it's normal for a soldier to eat in the cafeteria, but I just wanted you to eat more nutritionally balanced meals...

main5_ex.line: Hey, thanks for all of your hard work. I brewed black tea if you'd like to take a break. It'll help you be more efficient, right...?

main6_ex.line: In one of the romance novels I read recently, there was a girl like me who gazed vacantly at her beloved's profile... Oh, w-was I saying that out loud?! Forget that, please!

touch_ex.line: Yes, I'm here.

touch2_ex.line: C-Commander... There's a time and a place for this...

detail.line: Staff Officer Bartolomeo reporting! Whoops, right, I'm supposed to be playing the part of an empress... It's hard to give bedroom eyes the whole time, though.

expedition.line: I'll go take care of the commission team... "Commander, you may remain here where you belong – in my chamber."

feeling5.line: You know... I spent a lot of time secretly putting together this outfit and room. I might seem clumsy or indiscreet, but this was my plan to show you a different side of me and conquer you, in a word... Umm, basically... I did this because I hoped it would make you like me more...

headtouch.line: Heh... Heheheh... "H-how bold of you."

home.line: Welcome back. Umm, please wait a moment. I prepared fruits for your return... Ugh, where did I put them?!

login.line: Welcome, ahem... to my... chamber. Urk, th-this is just too embarrassing to stand!

mail.line: New mail? That's weird... I don't remember that being part of the plan.

main1.line: Do you like my outfit, Commander? Is it too different from the usual? Maybe I should change... Huh? You think it's cute? Th-then I'll keep it on! Behold a soldier's tenacity!

main2.line: According to my schedule... You and I should be in bed having... P-pretend I didn't say anything! Commander, do NOT look at this schedule!

main3.line: Some fruit, Commander? Ahem... "I-I bequeath this reward unto you. Partake, lest you disappoint me!"

mission.line: I know role-playing is fun, but don't forget your work. You have missions that need doing, Commander.

mission_complete.line: "Graciously accept the mission rewards I've bestowed upon you..." Ugh...

touch.line: Huh? N-no, I'm not spacing out! What was... I supposed to do next?

touch2.line: The book says I should be bolder, but this is just... Ooh, it's too much...

unlock.line: Hrmm... Romance novel analysis shows that this pose is the most likely to succeed... Ah. C-Commander, there you are... Ahem. "What business do you have in my private chambers?"

battle.line: Ooohohoho! Bring me the strongest enemy!

couple_encourage1.line: Forget the little details. Let our results speak for us!

detail.line: Do you think I'm really easy to read? When I win, I get excited. When I lose, I get angry. But I'd say that just makes me worthy of being favored by victory!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Do you think they've brought unexpected treasures?

feeling1.line: Should I just work without you for a while, dearest Commander? It would certainly be a new challenge.

feeling2.line: Did my glorious dance moves leave an impression? Ballet is an art that involves making mistakes and picking yourself up every time. Ooohohoho!

feeling3.line: Dearest Commander, might I suggest a little challenge? Relax and take my hand... in an unknown, wonderful, and exhilarating dance! Ooohohoho!

feeling4.line: How can I win your heart? This has become my sweetest challenge yet. Heehee, I just know that solving it will be beyond satisfying. Prepare yourself, dearest Commander, because I'm going to put my all into making you mine. Ooohohoho!

feeling5.line: Maybe I'm impossible to satisfy. That's why I keep dancing, dancing, and dancing more... But when I think of you, I feel oddly content. Your light is dazzling, a source of warmth that holds me instead of making me chase after it. Is this what they call love?

headtouch.line: Ah?! What is this nervous, ticklish feeling... M-my face is burning!

home.line: What inspiring triumph, dearest Commander! Next time, let's fight an even more formidable foe!

hp_warning.line: NOW things are getting interesting!

login.line: Dearest Commander, are you even more captivated by me today than you were yesterday? Huh? No...? Well, that just gives me something to strive for!

lose.line: Geez! We were so close! If we do it again, I just know I can win...

mail.line: You have new mail! Will there be acrostic poems? Riddles, perhaps? Leave any puzzles to me – oh... I-I don't get this one. Ohohoho...

main1.line: Ooohohoho! Dearest Commander, behold my dazzling dance steps! Or else... all my time spent practicing will be for naught!

main2.line: Dearest Commander, let's play a game. I bet I can complete our next mission with my eyes closed... What if I lose? Then you may do whatever you want with me, of course! As if that would ever happen.

main3.line: Oh dear, have you seen through me? Yes, I know some challenges can be especially difficult. But with your help, maybe Lady Luck will smile upon me!
