mission.line: Let's finish these trivial tasks before we challenge ourselves. In fact, why wait? Why not see who can complete this work more efficiently?

mission_complete.line: See how quickly you've finished your missions thanks to my help? Awaiting your compliments now! Ooohohoho!

profile.line: Greetings, dearest Commander. My name is Alberto di Giussano! Simple victory doesn't suit me – I prefer a triumph marked with difficulty, one that will earn me looks of admiration from my peers. Working with you should give me plenty of opportunities, I trust?

propose.line: Ooohohoho! I, Alberto di Giussano, have won the most precious wager of my life! Dearest Commander, are you ready for your next challenge? That would be... spending the rest of your life with me!

touch.line: Oh? Are you testing my sense of balance?

touch2.line: O-oohohoho...! Is this a test? Well, I'll show you that I can withstand anything!

unlock.line: Ooohohoho! Did my magnificent dancing captivate you, dearest Commander? Consider it an official greeting from yours truly, Alberto di Giussano! Why, I'd dare wager that you will fall for me in the very near future!

upgrade.line: Now that I'm stronger, I must aim for greater heights.

win_mvp.line: I won! Dearest Commander, I humbly await your ample praise.

gift_prefer.line: Goodness! How did you know my favorite? I'd be delighted to have it.

feeling5_ex.line: Here's the plan for our date. First, we go to an amusement park. Then, we watch a movie, and we end it with mountaintop stargazing! You think we don't have enough time? Don't worry! As long as we tackle it together, nothing is beyond us! Ooohohoho!

headtouch_ex.line: Is that all? You don't want to see if you can accomplish making me feel so good that I lose track of time?

home_ex.line: You finally came home to me. I just ran into a problem that I can't solve on my own. Help me deal with it!

login_ex.line: Dearest Commander! Hehe, I'd wager you thought about me at LEAST three times while I was not at your side! ...Oh, you say I'm correct? My intuition never fails. Ooohohoho!

main4_ex.line: Dearest Commander! Today is as normal as can be, so I decided not to prepare any special surprises for you... Hmm? You already know I have a surprise?!

main5_ex.line: *sigh*... Oh, Commander. I dreamed that I'd turned into a swan, took flight, got overly excited, and fell into the sea... Ahem. A pretty classic ending, no?

main6_ex.line: Heehee, I'm fine with pineapple on pizza. Do you have anything more challenging? Huh? P-pizza with strawberry cream pasta on it?! Just the description is fascinating!

touch_ex.line: Mmm... It looks like neither of us is any match for the power of love.

touch2_ex.line: Ooohohoho... Dearest Commander, I feel your love.

feeling5.line: Dearest Commander, which outfit would you like me to wear for "the decisive battle"? Give me an honest answer! Otherwise... I'm going to stay in your heart and never leave again!

headtouch.line: The matching accessories are cute, aren't they? Feel free to touch them more.

home.line: Tadaaa! I put on this special, limited-edition outfit to celebrate your triumphant return! Do you like it? Or do you LOVE it?

login.line: Behold, my many styles! Dearest Commander, are you ready to help me pick out the outfit that suits me best?

main1.line: This one is for when we go to the beach together again, this one's for a hot spring... Oh, this one? Umm... You'll find out tonight! Ooohohoho!

main2.line: When I was buying all of these, I was always hoping you'd get to see them. Heehee... I guess that wish came true early.

main3.line: Ooohohoho! Whether I'm dressed or not, it's only natural that your eyes are drawn to me. Th-though... It is preferable that I am dressed!

touch.line: Heehee... I just knew you'd love this outfit. Ooohohoho!

touch2.line: Mmnh... I have better attire for this, you know. But this will do just fine, too.

unlock.line: O-ooohohoho... Look what I've done, knocking down the clothing rack. I suppose this is the perfect time to show you my clothing collection!

battle.line: Come on, everyone! We are born winners!

detail.line: Umm... What was I doing just now? Do you have any ideas, Commander...?

expedition.line: The commission team is back, safe and sound. May I head out to receive them?

feeling1.line: Don't give up, Commander! If you just make amends for your mistakes, nobody's going to abandon you!

feeling2.line: I much prefer complimenting and congratulating people over scolding and blaming them~

feeling3.line: Please have some of this stamina-recovering coffee! ... Oh, does it taste bad? Let me try... Eww?! I might have mistook salt for sugar...

feeling4.line: Are you having troubles of any kind? Could you share them with me? Telling others what's on your mind can be a great help~

feeling5.line: As long as you need me, I accept you for who you are, Commander. No matter what happens, I'll always be here for you~ See? Everything's all right~

home.line: You're amazing, Commander! Bringing home another victory for the team~

hp_warning.line: This doesn't look very promising...

login.line: Right on time~ Way to go, Commander~!

lose.line: It's okay, it's okay! This isn't anybody's fault!

mail.line: Please don't forget to check your new mail!

main1.line: You've already finished all the paperwork? That's great~!

main2.line: Tea blends, let's see... Hmm, would any Royal girls take issue with this mix? Yeah, they might...

main3.line: Looks like I'll get to enjoy both the Dragon Empery's AND the Sakura Empire's cuisine at this port~ That's wonderful~

mission.line: If we push on just a little more, we can take on a new mission!

mission_complete.line: Yup, yup, mission complete! Keep it up, Commander~!

profile.line: I am the nameship of the Trento class, but if you count the days since our launches, Trieste has a longer service record. Speaking of which, I had a little incident on my launch day... but I still carried out my missions as a member of the Sardegnian fleet~

propose.line: I thought I was prepared for this, but now with the ring on my finger, I feel so unbelievably happy~ With all my heart, thank you, Commander. Ehehe, we'll always be with each other now, so if anything ever happens, please let me know!

touch.line: I've heard that hugs help people relax~ Shall we test that theory, Commander?

touch2.line: That's naughty, Commander! You'll be unpopular with the girls if you keep doing stuff like this.

unlock.line: I am Trento, first heavy cruiser of the Sardegna Empire, here to help out. I'll support everyone in my own special little way, so please do look forward to that, Commander♪

upgrade.line: Please take good care of the others as well, okay?

win_mvp.line: Very well done, everyone! I'm so glad we won~!

gift_prefer.line: You prepared this for me? Well, it's perfect~

battle_ex.line: We all believe in you, Commander!

detail_ex.line: I was just about to go buy the ingredients for tonight's dinner. I'm impressed you remembered, Commander! Heheh, I should work on remembering things better myself~

expedition_ex.line: The commission team has returned. Remember to check the rewards list!

feeling5_ex.line: You've shown how much you need me, so as promised, I wholly accept you for who you are~ Hehehe~ You have nothing to worry about, sweetie. You're doing really, really good~

home_ex.line: Awesome work bringing everyone back safe and sound~ Keep it up, sweetie!

login_ex.line: You've clocked in right on time again! Way to go, Commander~ I'll shower you in more love and support after you finish your job~

main4_ex.line: You've already finished all the paperwork? That's great~! Then I say we go have lunch with Trieste~

main5_ex.line: Ah, you're going for a stroll around the pier in a while? Do you want me to come with you?

main6_ex.line: How about taking a little break and doing something fun? We can doodle with crayons, play with toy blocks, or maybe even do a round of musical chairs... Hehehe~

mail_ex.line: You have new mail~ Just be careful not to fold the envelope, okay?

touch_ex.line: Here you go~ And don't forget: you're doing a great job, Commander~

touch2_ex.line: Okey-dokey, let's cuddle all you want! ...Wait, this isn't exactly what I had in mind...

win_mvp_ex.line: Great job, everyone! Including you of course, Commander! You're my superstar~

detail.line: I might get sunburnt? Ah, you're right, I should be more careful... Commander, would you mind helping me apply the sunscreen?

home.line: It must have been difficult fighting in this heat~ Mmhmm, good job out there~

login.line: Commander? Did you doze off to the sound of the waves just now? Ahah, don't worry~ There's plenty of time, so you should enjoy your nap~

main1.line: Commander, would you like to try this sundae? Here, say "ahh~" Very good, very good~

main2.line: Playing in the water seems like a lot of fun. Commander, shall we join them as well?

main3.line: The rhythm of the waves is quite hypnotic... Commander, if you want to take a nap, just come lie down over here and let me take good care of you~

touch.line: If there's anything you want me to do, just speak up~ Don't be shy~

touch2.line: Being at the beach always makes people more easygoing... I suppose I'll forgive you today~

unlock.line: The summer's scorching heat is alleviated by the ocean~ Commander, why don't you set aside your worries and... cut loose a bit~?

battle.line: I'm used to being flagship. All ships, get into formation! Tiro!

couple_encourage1.line: We're allies now, huh... I'm counting on your fire support then!

detail.line: Now, Pola and I are often praised for our beauty, but aren't you worried that all this ogling might cause some unsavory rumors?

expedition.line: Commander, you must profusely thank all these girls for ensuring the safe delivery of these supplies.

feeling1.line: Terrible... There's absolutely nothing about this commander anyone could ever find appealing...

feeling2.line: Is there something bothering you, Commander? Let's hear it then.

feeling3.line: Despite her appearances, Pola is a really sensitive girl, you know? And anyone who dares to hurt her... even you, Commander, would not be easily forgiven.

feeling4.line: Now that we're finally alone together, was there something you wanted to do, Commander? ... You want me to clean your ears? Well, all right... Come, put your head right here~ And please, try to relax, okay? I'm going to very gently, very slowly, clean your ears♪

feeling5.line: Commander, after all this time together, you should already know what I'm thinking before I even open my mouth. Hehe, so who am I thinking about right now? Of course it's you, Commander, that's too easy. Hehehe♪

home.line: An exhausting mission, was it? Why not relax with a glass of wine?

hp_warning.line: My armor... will hold!

login.line: Welcome back. I've gathered everyone up and we're awaiting your inspection.

lose.line: Ugh... Don't make me recall the humiliation I endured that night...!

mail.line: Commander? The mail is here. If you don't get to it soon, I could always read it out loud for you? I wonder if there are any love letters, hehehe...

main1.line: Tenacemente, that is, fighting to the bitter end, no matter the odds, is my personal motto.

main2.line: Looking up at the night sky, admiring the countless glimmering stars, it's really nice, actually. But it's better enjoyed from inside... don't you think?

main3.line: By the way, I've actually got kind of an eye for fashion. How about I help dress you next time, Commander?

mission.line: Is this mission giving you trouble? Here, let me take a look.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! My my, that's quite a big reward there, isn't it? Well done, Commander~

profile.line: I am the first ship of the Zara class of heavy cruisers, Zara. I was born to be a marine battery, with my magnificent guns and armor plating. I served as the flagship of my squadron, at least until that fateful night...

propose.line: You really think you can bind me to you with nothing but a cheap little ring? This isn't nearly enough~ ... Hehe, don't give me that face... Haha, I'm only joking~ Don't worry, Commander. I'll be with you forever.

skill.line: Don't think you can pierce my armor so easily!

touch.line: You like my sword, Commander? Or could it be... something else you're interested in?

touch2.line: Eeek?! ... Ahem! There is more to me than my armor plating, you know? Maybe you would like a taste of my guns as well?

unlock.line: Ciao. It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I'm the heavy cruiser, Zara, and I look forward to bringing victory and glory to your fleet.

upgrade.line: Grazie! Now my main guns are an even greater threat to the enemy.

win_mvp.line: I've brought you victory and glory, just as I promised.

gift_prefer.line: Did you prepare this just for me? Grazie! I'll keep it well cared for.

detail.line: Did you do your stretches? You don't want your legs cramping up in the water.

home.line: Legs straight, calves stretched– Ah, welcome back, Commander. I suppose you can tell I've been teaching the others to swim. Would you like me to teach you as well?

login.line: Commander, please be careful swimming in the deep end, okay?

main1.line: Hey, no horseplay in the pool!

main2.line: I really like swimming, but the submarines and destroyers are always faster... Why is that, Commander...?

main3.line: Speed is one thing, but I'm quite confident in my stamina. How about it, Commander? Want to try me?

touch.line: Your eyes are wandering. Hehe, what's on your mind? You can tell me.

touch2.line: Really now, Commander? I understand your eagerness, but there's a time and place, no?

unlock.line: Phew... It's a perfect day for swimming. Oh my, Commander, did you come to swim too? Or... perhaps you had something else in mind? Ehehe~♪

battle.line: The small fry never seem to learn their place.

couple_encourage1.line: Zara, your hands are so warm...

detail.line: My Zara is always so gentle and lovely, I just can't take my eyes off her.

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. All your girls are such hard workers.

feeling1.line: A commander that acts in this manner is in need of some "re-education."

feeling2.line: My gentle and compassionate Zara simply doesn't know how to say no to others. I wonder, what should I do...

feeling3.line: Commander, focus on what you need to do. I'll take care of any annoying little obstacles in your way.

feeling4.line: So, between Zara and me, who do you like better? Well... you wouldn't know the answer to that unless you tried, right~? Hehe~♡

feeling5.line: Because you're so kind, I worry about you too, just like with Zara. But... because of your kindness, we also know that we can entrust you with our futures.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Bring back any juicy gossip for me?

hp_warning.line: My turret won't move? Why... at a time like this...?

login.line: Hehe, you sure took your sweet time. The fleet exercises are about to start without you~

lose.line: My mantle's all dirty now. What a shame...

mail.line: Commander, there's mail for you from the Naval HQ. You might miss some important information if you drag your feet~

main1.line: All these "conventions" and "treaties"... Things that do not consider the feelings of actual people should disappear from this world.

main2.line: A true fighter does not fear any danger. I won't back down even in the face of a heavy storm.

main3.line: The feeling of being enveloped by a searchlight... makes me a bit uneasy.

mission.line: You've got to stay motivated and finish your work... Or, were you expecting me to give you some "motivation?"

mission_complete.line: All done with the missions, huh? That's what I want to see. ...I haven't forgotten about the reward. Mind waiting there for a bit? Hehe~

profile.line: I'm the fourth ship of the Zara-class heavy cruisers, Pola. My sisters and I have stronger armor rarely seen on heavy cruisers, which gives us an advantage in artillery battles. In terms of my abilities to serve as flagship... I might be a bit more suitable than Zara?

propose.line: Commander, once you've become my chosen partner, you must be prepared to be bound with me for a lifetime. Are you willing to sign this "contract" with me?

skill.line: Let's have a little bit of fun~

touch.line: My rapier is not simply for show, you know.

touch2.line: You surely didn't do the same kind of stuff to Zara, right?

unlock.line: I'm Pola, heavy cruiser from Sardegna. And you're the commander of this fleet? I see. Well, don't let me down, okay? Hehe~

upgrade.line: Oh? Some interesting developments.

win_mvp.line: MVP? Why, that's only natural. Enemies of this caliber aren't even worthy of staining my mantle.

gift_prefer.line: Grazie. You have good taste – I'd be happy to take this off your hands.

detail.line: Commander, you're not satisfied with this game being for your eyes only, right? Hehe~ In that case... You can be the referee as well. Any objections, Zara?

home.line: Commander, don't expect me to save your life even if you're drowning~ ...Oh, Zara already taught you to swim? Hmph... Lucky you.

login.line: I do say, if you want to watch the game from over there, don't come crying to me when you get hit by a stray ball. Got it?

lose.line: Damn it... I'll remember this!

main1.line: ...Isn't this swimsuit... a bit too tight...?

main2.line: This obstinate starfish... C-Commander, come give me a hand here... Eek?!

main3.line: Littorio, how about a 2v2? Heheh, though having Veneto on your team would be too much of a handicap, so how about I lend you the commander?

touch.line: What are you staring at? Hehe, spit it out already... Just what were you thinking about?

touch2.line: Jeez, Commander... I know you're the impatient type, but are you sure you want to suffer the same fate as this manjuu?

unlock.line: Zara, how dastardly of you to spike the ball at such a time– Eek?! Commander?! Why are you in a place like that?

win_mvp.line: Much easier than a match against Zara. Heheh~

battle.line: Everyone do your part, or else I'm giving you detention!

couple_encourage1.line: Show some restraint with the teasing.

detail.line: Why are you here and not in your office, working? Shoo with you. You're still on duty.

expedition.line: The commission team has come back. Phew... I'm glad they're okay.

feeling1.line: Are you happy now? Sigh... I'm going to fix you. You WILL learn some damn discipline.

feeling2.line: No time to rest, Commander. You've done your job, but not the assignment I gave you. Start on it now, or you'll fall behind.

feeling3.line: Done with your job? Okay. Have a nice dinner, then treat yourself to a bath. You'll feel as good as new after a hard day's work, trust me.

feeling4.line: That sortie sure took its toll on you. You should probably take some time to rest. Rework today's timetable as needed and I'll relay the changes to the others... Huh? You want me to rest with you?

feeling5.line: I don't need to rest, though. Why do you want me to stick around? I suppose I could monitor to ensure you are getting enough rest... Okay, hang on, I'll be there in a moment!

home.line: I'll check through the after-action report. In the meantime, reflect on your battle with the girls. Go on, get to it.

hp_warning.line: Well, this is a conundrum...

login.line: Right on time. It's good to know you're punctual. Try to be here the same time tomorrow.

lose.line: This is all on me for being too damn lenient!

mail.line: Best to read your mail now before you forget about it.

main1.line: I'll schedule the resupply shipment. Better I do it than trust an underachiever to produce good results.

main2.line: You made an error in this paragraph. Fix it yourself – it's tiring enough just pointing out mistakes. Don't make me dump more assignments on you.

main3.line: People put pineapple on pizza?! That's disgusting! That's a war crime against Sardegnian cuisine!

mission.line: Keep your nose to the grindstone. These missions won't finish themselves. Do a good job and I'll treat you to a home-cooked meal.

mission_complete.line: You've done well. Here you are, as promised. It's a good thing I wrote that down.

profile.line: I'm Trieste, second ship of the Trento class. I saw action in the Mediterranean and was to become a carrier, but... Never mind. Forget what I just said.

propose.line: I figured you were dying to tell me something... Huh? Did you arrange all this to propose to me? You're sure this isn't some mistake? S-s-so this ring is for ME?! Have you had these feelings for me all along? That... makes me so happy! I just...

skill.line: Keep an eye on your surroundings!

touch.line: Need a break, do you? Fair enough. I suggest doing some stretches.

unlock.line: I am Trieste, Trento-class heavy cruiser number two. My job is to help you with your work. Now, would you stop gawking and get back to it?

upgrade.line: A smart move on your part.

win_mvp.line: Now do you get why I'm so strict, Commander? It's because discipline begets victory.

gift_prefer.line: Your motives are impure... but fine, I accept.

detail_ex.line: I'm fine with giving you a lap pillow, but I won't pamper you like Trento does... Y-you meant I'D rest on YOUR lap? Well, I suppose I... No, never mind! Come on, here you go!

feeling5_ex.line: You've got food on your face. I thought you could at least eat properly, but I suppose you're a child, hmm? Remember to drink your water, too... Clean it with a kiss? I-I suppose I could...

home_ex.line: The girls are waiting for you. This isn't the time to chit-chat with me – go talk to them. Yes, of course, I'll spend some quality time with you later.

login_ex.line: Finished your morning preparations? I sure hope so. Please don't make the others shoulder your burdens.

main4_ex.line: How's our food supply looking... Wait, what? We're nearly out of food?! Commander, remedy this at once before we have a famine on our hands!

main5_ex.line: This paragraph is... error-free, it seems. Nicely done. It's things like this which prove that you're capable of running this place.

main6_ex.line: Since you'll be spectating tomorrow's exercise, is there something you'd like for a boxed lunch? Let me know before the end of today.

mission_ex.line: Pick a mission to do first, then set out to complete it. Do a good job and I'll... Hmm, well, I'll set aside a day for a date with you.

mission_complete_ex.line: Well, well... You did it. So, how about that date? I did say I would, didn't I?

touch_ex.line: Do I need a hand? Not at all, I'm plenty capable of handling this.

touch2_ex.line: Oh my. Go on...♡

win_mvp_ex.line: I want to claim some credit for this victory... but no, this one's all thanks to you, Commander. Well done.

detail.line: It's perfectly normal to wear uniforms at school... Can you handle it though, Commander? You look worked up for some reason.

expedition.line: I think the commission team is back. Down there – isn't that them?

home.line: This selection of dishes should work for half a year without feeling too samey. Tomorrow I think I'll... Oh, welcome back, Commander. I was just thinking out loud about our boxed lunches.

main1.line: I don't know how to approach you when I wear this uniform. Do I treat you as an upperclassman? Should I address you differently, or like normal?

main2.line: What's for lunch today? You'll have to see for yourself. I'll tell you this: it's a dish both you and Trento like.

main3.line: How do you hope to spend the prime of your life, Commander? Making great memories to look back on, and the like?

mission.line: Don't neglect your missions. You're keeping me and Trento waiting.

touch.line: You're THAT eager to have lunch with me? What am I to do with you...

touch2.line: Yup, I really don't know how to approach you...

unlock.line: Oh my, are you done with your errands already? Surely, you didn't skip work just to eat lunch with... Ah, sorry for doubting you. Alright, let's go. Trento is waiting for us.

detail.line: I know I'm strict with you... Mmh... I just want to say, thank you. Like Veneto always says, it's a good time to be frank with people when you're bathing with them.

expedition.line: Is the commission team bathing after us? Hmm... I can't quite remember...

feeling5.line: Ugh... I'm sorry for making you worry when this was supposed to be a relaxing vacation for you... Can I make it up to you somehow? We're alone out here, so you can fawn on me all you want... Y-yeah, well, Trento lets you do it all the time!

home.line: Don't let yourself get cold. Keep your shoulders below the water. There, that's great... D-did I sound like Trento just now?

login.line: *pant*... *pant*... This is much too hot for my liking. Can you handle it, Commander? Are you sure?

lose.line: Oh no... My head's going completely blank...

mail.line: You've received a letter. Better check it after this bath.

main1.line: Didn't I tell you to focus on relaxing today? Come into the water – your work can wait. Whew... That's more like it.

main2.line: Excited about dinner after this bath? So am I. I'll very eager to see what sort of food they serve here.

main3.line: Mmph... I'm feeling a bit dizzy... I might have caught a fever, because I feel hot all over... Mmh...

mission.line: In a bit... Okay. Missions first, then I'll go back in.

mission_complete.line: Can't you ask someone else to get the mission rewards? Or would you rather do it yourself first, and continue your bath later?

touch.line: Whew... This cool breeze is just what I needed.

touch2.line: Whew... Wh-what's gotten into you?

unlock.line: Whew... I'm getting dizzy... I'll rest in the breeze for a moment. You okay, Commander? Step out if it's too hot. See, someone will worry about you...

win_mvp.line: The sea breeze is so refreshing... Thank goodness.

detail.line: These clothes? Ah, yes, it's relaxing to put them on and practice calligraphy. If you like how they look, then that makes me even happier.

expedition.line: The commission team is back? I'm starting to get the hang of this, so could you check this first before you go and receive them?

feeling5.line: Once I've learned to write well, do you want me to compose a message for you? Not just as thanks for guiding me, but also as a wish for us to support one another into this year... That doesn't mean I'm going to coddle you, though! Understood?

headtouch.line: Huh? You're ruining my concentration.

home.line: Welcome back. I just wrapped up and I'm going to take a break... Huh? No, I'm not tired. I just want a change of pace.

login.line: Umm, mh... Good timing. Could you have a look at this, Commander? I don't feel like the strokes are as smooth as they should be.

mail.line: You have a new letter, so read that first. You can, umm, teach me about calligraphy after that.

main1.line: Something feels different about me? You're right – I'm facing this challenge with a new mindset. It's made me ease up, just like you said.

main2.line: What am I writing? Oh, it's a list of materials needed for the party. It'll be quite luxurious, so look forward to it.

main3.line: I'm usually the one supervising you, but today you're the one doing it... It feels a little strange. Oh, I don't mean that in a bad way.

mission.line: You haven't finished your missions yet, have you? Should I focus on helping you with those first?

mission_complete.line: You finished your missions? Great work. Ahem... Being strict with you has paid off. Now keep it up.

touch.line: Hm? What did I get wrong?

touch2.line: Is this... one way to wield the brush?

unlock.line: Commander? As you can see, I'm putting into practice the calligraphy knowledge you taught me before. The problem is, I can't seem to nail it... Could you watch for a bit and guide me?

battle.line: Allow me to prove myself in combat!

detail.line: Anything... I will perform any task if you think I'm suited for it. Ah, I'm just saying IF! Please don't go out of your way for me if it's more trouble than it's worth.

expedition.line: The commission team has arrived in port. Phew... I'm glad they're okay.

feeling1.line: Please stay away from us! You don't deserve any support from the girls with how you are acting now.

feeling2.line: I'll take my leave now if that will be all... Zara asked about me? Oh... Well, I'm perfectly fine. Forgive me for making her worry...

feeling3.line: You're still worried about me? I appreciate the concern... Zara may be right with what she said about me inadvertently distancing myself from people...

feeling4.line: You'd like to take me somewhere on your day off? If that's your order, then okay... Um, I'm afraid I don't have a favorite movie! I prefer things like books and theater over movies, you see...

feeling5.line: I'm sorry for ruining it by forgetting about you and bursting into tears from the performance... I've always been so easily moved by these kinds of stories... And that's despite how overjoyed I was that you invited me to see the play...

home.line: The Commander has returned. All ships, prepare to repair and restock, then gather combat data on the mission.

hp_warning.line: I don't want to be locked up in the dock again...!

login.line: I'm the secretary... Welcome back, Commander. Here is today's schedule.

lose.line: We... have failed. I knew I'm not cut out for this...

mail.line: There's a letter for you, Commander. Here you are.

main1.line: Gorizia, you're not like me – you can keep fighting... I'm doomed to stay like this forever...

main2.line: I've gathered the documents for your meeting. What would you like me to do next? Please don't hesitate to give me orders.

main3.line: I should start thinking about how to spend my next day off... Maybe doing something where you can still call me in at a moment's notice...

mission.line: We have been informed of new missions. Please stand by until all ships have received the sortie order.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Mhm, this is good.

profile.line: I'm Bolzano, Sardegnian heavy cruiser. I took part in naval reviews before the war, then fought in live battles during it. A streak of bad luck left me irrepairable, so I was stripped of my rigging and ultimately sunk in a harbor. *sigh*...

propose.line: Um... I'm hesitant to say this after you've been so kind to me, but... are you sure I'm the one for you? I just sincerely hope you're not giving me this out of pity or concern. If not, then... Then I'll g-gladly accept!

touch.line: Yes? I will do anything you deem me suited for.

touch2.line: Wh-what are you doing...?

unlock.line: Sardegnian heavy cruiser Bolzano, reporting in. I am hereby under your command. Um, if that's all then I'll be taking my leave now.

upgrade.line: I'm steadily becoming stronger. Thank you.

win_mvp.line: Victory is ours. Let's move – our friends are waiting for us.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much! Ah... Sorry. I didn't scare you, did I?

battle_ex.line: I feel ready for anything right now. To battle!

detail_ex.line: You'd like to have a word? Of course, you can tell me anything! You believe in me, so it's the least I can– Oh, it's nothing especially important?

expedition_ex.line: The commission team is back in port. Commander, please get ready to leave.

feeling5_ex.line: Heheh, heheheh... Oh, sorry! I couldn't help but laugh at the main actress' performance... It feels like I've been laughing a lot today? That's because I'm over the moon, just like that actress, and I've wanted to smile.

home_ex.line: Welcome back! Please get some rest for the time being. This port – YOUR port – is a safe haven.

login_ex.line: I'm with you as your secretary... Welcome back, Commander. Let's do our utmost as always, shall we?

lose_ex.line: I can't let this turn into a streak of defeats... Ugh...

main4_ex.line: Trento pampers you far too much on a regular basis... No, I really don't have the right to say that, considering I'm so dependent on you.

main5_ex.line: A tea party? Oh, I'd love to accompany you on one! Heehee... I can hardly wait.

main6_ex.line: Would you like to watch a play with me on your next day off? I-I'll try to pick one that won't make me weep like a baby!

mission_ex.line: I've confirmed we have new missions. You may issue the sortie order now, Commander.

touch2_ex.line: ...Commander...?

win_mvp_ex.line: Victory is ours! Commander, we should go reunite with the others.

battle.line: I'll try my best!

detail.line: So this is Swan Lake... I believe there's one production where everyone is left inconsolable in the end. I'd probably cry if I saw that one...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to watch the others rehearse after you've finished your combat analysis?

login.line: This is improper attire for a secretary... A-are you sure you don't mind?

main1.line: While my outfit bears some resemblance to Arizona's, the overall styles differ considerably. Oh, Zara didn't say that!

main2.line: You don't know whether it's right or not to look at me? Um, should I change clothes after all? Although then my rehearsals won't feel right...

touch.line: Am I doing something wrong?

touch2.line: Oh gosh...

unlock.line: I've never had a knack for dancing or exercise unlike Zara and her sisters... but if asked, I will dance as best as I can! Please keep your eyes on me, Commander!

win_mvp.line: I just hope this was thanks to my cheering... Wait, I'm the MVP?

detail.line: I believe that Tempesta girl has her sights on the port's treasure. Then again, the treasure you know of isn't exactly buried or hidden, is it? Heehee.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. If anyone is lugging real treasure around, it has to be them.

home.line: Outstanding work. Would you like to rest for a while with me?

login.line: "Escape from Pirate Isle." I see. Do let me know if you need any assistance, Commander.

main1.line: How will we bring this treasure back to the port, I wonder... Oh, they're simply props, so I don't have to worry about it?

main2.line: (Given the situation, I have to be conscious of not distancing myself from the Commander... Unless being in a swimsuit has something to do with this...?)

main3.line: You may take my shawl if you feel cold, Commander. We wouldn't want you catching a cold, right? Me, I'll be fine, don't worry.

mission.line: New mission orders have come in. Commander, I'm ready to sortie at your command.

touch2.line: O-only because we're alone out here, okay...?

unlock.line: So... The premise is that you and I were shipwrecked and ended up on a desert island... Is that right, Commander? I see... But if we weren't actually shipwrecked... what is this treasure, then?

detail.line: "The moon speaks words of love to the flowers, and the flowers blossom with affection"... What a beautiful sentence. Commander, I hope you understand my feelings on a night such as this...

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. That's a relief. Now we can all enjoy this festive night sky together.

feeling5.line: "Blessed be the month, and the time, and the moment"... On this wonderful night, ever since the moment our eyes met... I have been spellbound by you.

headtouch.line: Mgh... Commander, please – you might undo my braids.

home.line: Commander, I've prepared some snacks for recovering your strength... Hm? You want some of what I have, too? Well, in that case, please help yourself... *blushes*

login.line: Could you please come here, Commander? I, um... I just think you'll get a better view of the night sky from here.

main1.line: You are the moon in the night sky, and your gentle words are like its silver light, burning away my hesitation...

main2.line: Doesn't it feel like a wish is more likely to come true if you make it the moment fireworks go off? Heehee. Although... my wish has already come true.

main3.line: Are you interested in these lights taking to the sky, Commander? Well... I made a small lantern myself. Do you want to see it?

touch.line: Huh? Is that your way of saying you... want me to come a little closer?

touch2.line: Ahh... Are we doing it? Under the moonlight?

unlock.line: I prepared so much for this festival only to run off and hide again on instinct... Oh, Commander?! Um... Are you here to see the fireworks? Or are you here to see... me?

win_mvp.line: This will make the festival even more lively.

battle.line: Me, of all people, being sent into battle?!

couple_encourage1.line: I can't simply sit back while you take the spotlight!

detail.line: *stares princessly*... (Should I break the silence? No, wait, the Commander should be the first to speak... Alright! I'll wait as long as it takes!) *continues staring*...

expedition.line: A commission's been completed. Aren't you going to thank the team in person? ...Y-you're going alone?

feeling1.line: So this is it... This is who my true love is... *sniffle*...

feeling2.line: *stares princessly*... (The Commander isn't coming any closer... Why not? Is this not the perfect time to invite a lady to dinner?)

feeling3.line: Do you take me for an easy flirt? You're very mistaken! I won't be courted with merely an intent gaze... What I'm saying is, I'm not going to open up until you start getting on my good side!

feeling4.line: The Commander still hasn't floated the idea of a date... My feelings should be clear as day, and yet... Maybe I need to give up on playing hard to get...?

feeling5.line: Umm, my dear Commander, if you're free then why don't we go somewhere? Anywhere is fine, even within the port! I know a place with a good view, and also tons of great date spots Pola told me about!

headtouch.line: (I hope the Commander will keep patting my head if I pretend not to notice...♪)

home.line: Oh. Welcome back. Thank goodness you're still in one piece... Um, can't you react to me coming here just for you with a little more emotion?

hp_warning.line: How have I been hit this much?!

login.line: Oh, you poor thing, you look exhausted... Please share your pain with me and ease the burden on your– E-excuse me? You want me to, umm, sort paperwork?

lose.line: An unfortunate setback... but, I'll get back on my feet!

mail.line: (Where's the love letter I sneakily left on the Commander's desk... Wait, what? Did it get lost under the new mail?)

main1.line: I don't get hurt easily because of my nature, but it sometimes makes people avoid me... They say I'm too different.

main2.line: Isn't it the norm to chat about stuff to break the ice during downtime like this? Why isn't the Commander paying attention to me?

main3.line: (I said I'd watch a play with Bolzano on our next day off... That being the case, I've got to figure out some way to catch the Commander's notice!)

mission.line: New missions have come in. Oh, my dear Commander, will you let me decide which one to complete first?

mission_complete.line: (The Commander's attention is solely on the rewards, not the fact I helped retrieve them...) Huh? Oh, please, it was nothing. You don't need to shower me with praise.

profile.line: I'm Gorizia, Zara-class heavy cruiser. I fought hard in the war, but didn't achieve anything you could call career-defining. People say I'm very lucky, having survived an attack unscathed even though I didn't move an inch. I'm not sure how to feel about that...

propose.line: You finally came forth and did it! I'm so happy... So happy I could cry! Now we can be lovey-dovey all day when– Oh, forgive me, I haven't answered yet! Yes! I will, gladly!

skill.line: Now I'M going to hit them!

touch.line: What is it? Oh... Do you have something to tell me?

touch2.line: Whuh?! Wh-what's gotten into you?!

unlock.line: Ahh, we finally meet, my dear Commander. Yes, I am Sardegna's heavy cruiser Gorizia, your one true– Uh, excuse me? Aren't you supposed to say, "Gorizia, I've been waiting so long for you" right about now?!

upgrade.line: Thank you for making me stronger, but I wish you'd be a little more... gentle, I guess...

win_mvp.line: I daresay I did pretty well. *stares princessly*

gift_prefer.line: Oh, thank you, Commander! *sniffle*... I'll cherish this!

battle_ex.line: Please tell me you're watching, my dear Commander...

detail_ex.line: *stares coquettishly*... Hm? What is it? ...You want to go somewhere with me since the weather is nice today? Oh, um... Yes, I'd love to!

expedition_ex.line: The commission goods, my dear Commander.

headtouch_ex.line: M-my dear Commander... could you keep doing that? Just for a little longer...

home_ex.line: Welcome back, my dear Commander! I'm glad you're safe! I've been here, praying for you the whole– Err, of course I've made you something to eat!

login_ex.line: *fidget, fidget*... Where's my good-morning kiss? ...You need time to gather your courage? Come ooon!

main4_ex.line: If you ever end up in danger, I'll protect you. Don't worry, I could stand completely still and not get hit.

main5_ex.line: I-if you don't know what to talk about, do you mind if I pick a topic, my dear Commander?

mission_complete_ex.line: Hey, mission complete. Y-you could praise me a little, you know...

touch_ex.line: I'll be counting on you to escort me today, my dear Commander.

touch2_ex.line: It's not me you want, but this, right? ...You're so predictable... *blushes*

win_mvp_ex.line: Tell me how magnificent I am! Heheh!

detail.line: I can help if you have too much work on your plate, my dear Commander. Just say the word. Even if we can't finish everything, I'll stay right here with you!

home.line: Did your operation go well? Oh, and don't worry, I completed all my office work while you were away♪

login.line: (Working late into the night while my beloved boss just... Gosh, enough of that! I need to finish my tasks quickly so I can chat with the Commander!)

mail.line: That sound again... Must be a new message.

main1.line: (I think I've put on weight again... Why did I bluff about it and let Zara pick a size that's too small for me...)

main2.line: Once I wrap this task up, I'm going to muster my courage and ask out the Comma– Huh? You're working overtime today?

main3.line: It's just me and the Commander now... If it wasn't for these damn stockings I could try to make a move... *sigh*...

touch.line: Y-you'll show me how it's done? ...Hm? On the contrary; you need my help?

touch2.line: Y-you like this kind of stuff? I... I'm so done with you, perv!

unlock.line: These stockings are so annoying to wear... Mmrgh... *sigh*. You can't give up already, Gorizia. If you want the Commander's attention... this is what you have to do!

detail.line: *stares princessly*... You're gathering intel on me, and I'm doing the same on you, my dear Commander.

feeling5.line: Th-this won't do! A professional spy shouldn't let her heart race as soon as her target walks into the room!

headtouch.line: I'm only not fighting back because I'm tied up. Th-this totally doesn't feel nice or anything... Are you really not going to touch me anymore?

home.line: D-did you come back so soon because you worried about me? Oh, right! I definitely wasn't scouring the room in secret, and I certainly didn't put any confidential data on this USB stick.

login.line: ...This is the part where you look down at me with that penetrating gaze and say, "Gorizia, all your efforts were in vain," and... Huh? My dear Commander, why are you laughing?

main1.line: This isn't exactly what I planned, but it's not so bad since I get to chat with you face-to-face... If nothing else, your eyes are glued to me now.

main2.line: *stares princessly*... (What are you doing, Commander? Have you noticed me? I'm here! Look at me!)

main3.line: Huh? My USB stick! It's going to slip out! *huff*... *puff*... Ugh! This is getting out of hand!

touch.line: You're going to untie me? ...Wait, why did you pull your hands back?

touch2.line: I-if you push me any further, I'll... Eek!

unlock.line: Oh nooo, how aaawful, I've been captured, and my suit is toootally in pieces... W-wait, why can't I break free? This ruins my plan of intentionally getting caught to perform an investigation...

win_mvp.line: I still won even while tied up like this. It's no big deal. *stares princessly*...

battle.line: Eternal Flagship Vittorio Veneto, sallying forth!

couple_encourage1.line: It is reassuring to have the backing of such capable allies.

couple_encourage2.line: Bow to the Empire's splendor!

couple_encourage3.line: May your battle go fortuitously.

detail.line: This may be unbecoming for me to say, but nevertheless... It would delight me if you used one of our baths. It would let you fully appreciate the splendor of our Empire.

expedition.line: Were my tortellini to your tastes? I must make more to give to the returning commission team, you see.

feeling1.line: It seems I must reassess the Empire's future...

feeling2.line: I never would've thought one day I'd sit down for teatime with Illustrious of all people. Fate is truly a strange thing, I suppose.

feeling3.line: Strenuous efforts on everyone's part will be necessary to spread the Empire's splendor across the world. That includes you, of course, Commander. Heehee~

feeling4.line: I see not only my Sardegnian friends, but all members of the fleet, beaming with joy. How you managed this feat, I don't know, but it fascinates me to no end.

feeling5.line: I have gained many things in our time together – power, allies, and peace of mind. Please, Commander, I'm dying to know – what is it you desire from me in return? I can offer anything you seek...

home.line: I have lunch planned later with ladies from the Royal Navy. Are you interested in joining us, Commander?

hp_warning.line: You hope to defeat me? With attacks this lackluster?

login.line: May I offer you some succulent tea and a biscuit before you start your work for the day?

lose.line: The enemy overpowering you by sheer force is the most easily acceptable reason for a defeat...

mail.line: May I offer a bit of advice? Choose your friends carefully.

main1.line: The power of a cannon cannot be gauged by its caliber alone. Any who underestimate my 15-inch battery will pay dearly for their misjudgment.

main2.line: I joined this fleet for two reasons – to achieve world peace, of course, and to further the Empire's influence. The latter of which I would like your assistance with, Commander.

main3.line: Allow me to be curt, Commander. If you had the power to crush your opposition, would you still choose the path of passive deterrence? Would you choose a fleet in being?

mission.line: Allow me to give you a reminder, Commander. You are in your right to delegate missions to me, your secretary.

mission_complete.line: Heehee. I think I know what you're thinking, Commander. "These missions are a cakewalk."

profile.line: Expectations of me were high already at my birth, when I inherited the flag following a horrific night. Ultimately, I failed to lead my loyal friends to victory... My past isn't all that bright, is it? But that is why I have high hopes in you, Commander.

propose.line: Do you comprehend the significance of this vow? Our futures are henceforth interconnected. I would normally not have accepted your proposal so easily, but your sheer passion won me over. Heehee.

touch.line: Even I – the flagship of the Empire's fleet – enjoy leisure breaks from time to time. There will always come some downtime, no matter how tirelessly one works.

touch2.line: Let it be known that this sort of behavior is abjectly inappropriate, no matter your motive for it.

unlock.line: It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I am Vittorio Veneto, Eternal Flagship of the Sardegna Empire. Forgive me if I sound discourteous, but are you confident in your ability to command me?

upgrade.line: A most wise decision, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Sardegna's hope, faith, and love shall be felt all across the world's seas, with our fleet as its emissaries.

gift_prefer.line: Oh, my. Have you been looking into my favorite things behind my back?

battle_ex.line: Now, let us proceed according to the commander's plans.

expedition_ex.line: Could you give this a taste? ...Oh dear, I might have used too much salt. I thought the commission team might prefer stronger seasoning.

home_ex.line: I have dinner planned for later this evening. I hope you'll join me at the table, Commander.

login_ex.line: Oh, I suppose it's time for work. Allow me just a moment to tidy things up.

main4_ex.line: Self-care is important. When you're out on a sortie, don't you wish you could come back to a warm bath every day? ...Not exactly?

main5_ex.line: You and Littorio are similar in a certain way. Namely, your tendency to rely on me for help~

main6_ex.line: I'm able to use my abilities to their fullest thanks to all my reliable friends around me. Please, send me out on more missions, Commander.

mail_ex.line: Is this letter from your friend? Ah. Heehee. I'm sure your friends are all lovely people.

touch_ex.line: You really should take occasional breaks and empty your mind instead of working tirelessly all the time, Commander. You'll lead a fuller life if you do. Heehee~

touch2_ex.line: I do not condone this, but since you're so insistent... Ohoho.

win_mvp_ex.line: Now they know the Empire's splendor, and the firmness of our resolves. And you made it possible, Commander.

detail.line: A shipgirl gazing out at the sea from atop a ship... It sounds almost like the setup for a joke! I'll have to tell Littorio about it later. Hehehe~

home.line: Would you care to sunbathe with me? It's delightfully pleasant, I assure you.

login.line: Basking in the sunlight, feeling the sea breeze, and listening to the sound of the waves... Ahh, it's wonderful to have a relaxing day off.

main1.line: Only when you take the time to recline can you truly take in the beauty of the vast, blue sea. One day, we will have finally reclaimed it in its entirety. Won't we, Commander?

main2.line: Are you going fishing, Commander? I see, then if you don't mind, I will take my leave for a while. I'd like to finish building my sand Colosseum.

main3.line: Please do come and spectate our beach volleyball game later in the evening, Commander. If luck is on our side, you may get to see us go up against the Royal Navy's team.

touch.line: Littorio said I am terrible at photography and now she prohibits me from using the camera. Why, I've never heard something so rude before... Commander, would you ask her to let me take a picture?

touch2.line: Commander? I'm still awake, for your information.

unlock.line: Nngh, haah... It's awfully sunny today... How long was I asleep, Commander? Oh, it's already lunchtime? In that case, I'll get started on some food. Would you like something as well?

battle.line: Did the enemy wander here by mistake? That's too bad for them.

detail.line: That Veneto, she's not half bad for a fleet flagship... However, if she wants to move forward, she must learn from me. Hahahaha!

expedition.line: You need not worry, Commander. For as long as I am here, your commission rewards will be superb.

feeling1.line: I apologize, Commander. I only wanted to push you in the right direction, but it seems that all I did was impede your progress...

feeling2.line: You want my autograph? I will give you it for free, as a special favor... Just kidding. Hahaha!

feeling3.line: Be more confident in yourself, Commander. To serve as the commander of Littorio means that have earned the trust of the most glorious ship in all the world. Aren't you proud?

feeling4.line: Commander, I must admit that you have the qualities to become as glorious as me. That is a wonderful thing, for though I have always wanted a partner to journey with, none were capable of it until now.

feeling5.line: When you give to the world, the world gives back to you. So put your mind at ease. Pursue the object of your desire and grab hold of it. Because I, Littorio, deem you worthy.

home.line: Rejoice, Commander, for I am here to bid your return welcome.

hp_warning.line: Don't give in yet, Pugliese system!

login.line: Waiting is tedious, but waiting for you is anything but, Commander.

lose.line: Defeated? No, we are simply not victorious yet.

mail.line: It appears there are more letters addressed to me than to you.

main1.line: There are two kinds of people in the world: those who are Littorio, and those who are not.

main2.line: Isn't it lamentable, Commander? There are so many places in the world that yearn for light, but there is but one Littorio.

main3.line: There is no denying that, though battleships once ruled the seas, aircraft have ushered in the beginning of a new era. This is a fact that not even I can refute.

mission.line: Commander, there is value to be found in all missions, so they should be carried out in earnest. Am I wrong?

mission_complete.line: Contact your superiors for me. Tell them these paltry rewards do not satisfy me.

profile.line: I am Littorio, Vittorio Veneto-class battleship number two; the Mediterranean's mightiest battleship. During the war, I strutted about the ocean as if it was my garden, and that shall not change even now. Now, let us strike fear into the hearts of our enemies, Commander!

propose.line: I simply cannot understand. I was convinced that nobody would be worthy of placing this ring upon me, yet here you are before my eyes, having captured my very heart... Tell me, Commander, how did you successfully win me over?

touch.line: Chasing after others is a novel and interesting experience, is it not?

touch2.line: Commander, it's understandable that you would fall for me... but... this is not the time nor place for debauchery.

unlock.line: Rejoice, Commander! For you have gained an indomitable ally in Littorio, but more importantly... let's put a smile on that cute face of yours.

upgrade.line: Your ability to see my true potential proves that your perception is superb.

win_mvp.line: Trying to oppose me was your greatest mistake.

gift_prefer.line: Promise me you'll be this nice to the other girls, okay?

detail.line: Veneto? Don't expect much from her... No, I don't mean her swimsuit. She's the type that would spend the entire day building a sand Colosseum.

home.line: Heheh, I say you deserve some "eye candy." Interested, Commander?

login.line: I see you've returned, Commander. Hmph, today my glory shines brighter than even the sun.

main1.line: There are two kinds of people in the world: those who are bewitched by Littorio's swimsuit, and those who are not. Which one are you, Commander?

main2.line: The Mediterranean Sea is thing of beauty in summer, but this sea surpasses it in sheer bustle. I prefer this one; it lets my glamor reach the hearts and minds of many more.

main3.line: What? That damned Veneto is going to play beach volleyball?! ... I must help her, to ensure the Sardegna Empire's glory remains unsullied...

touch.line: Donning swimwear to display one's glamor for all to see – isn't it fantastic, Commander?

unlock.line: A visit to the beach with me? Then you must try your hardest to stand out. Otherwise the eyes of the world will be on me alone.

detail.line: As proud as we are of our wonderful Sardegnian thermae, and as befittingly charming it is when Veneto conducts foreign relations from them, the fact remains that diplomacy should be left to the pros. Wouldn't you agree?

feeling5.line: Commander... you are an unlabeled bottle of fine riserva with more charm than meets the eye – your taste enchanting, maddening, and making one possessive over you. And I – Littorio – am no exception, tesoro mio.

home.line: Let us have a grand toast to the triumphant return of our hero. Alla salute!

login.line: None but you are permitted to keep me waiting, Commander.

main1.line: Now, who will be the lucky recipient of Littorio's rose this time? Oh, but of course, Commander. If you want it, maybe you'll get it?

main2.line: There are two kinds of parties in the world: those with Littorio in attendance, and those without.

main3.line: I personally picked out all the various furnishings in here. It is no exaggeration to call this suite "La Littorio" itself. How do you like the sound of that, Commander?

touch.line: To be frank, I've been to so many parties that I've grown a bit tired of them. Let's do something interesting for a change, shall we, Commander?

unlock.line: Welcome to Littorio's personal suite. Are you here to issue me a challenge of who can romance the most girls? Hahahah, I'm joking of course! There'd be no fun in a game I would win every single time.

detail.line: As a leader, part of my duty to my people is to make the decisions that lead to tranquil days where everyone may rest easy.

home.line: Look who's back. Hang up your coat and make yourself at home. Then I can get comfortable too.

login.line: You certainly took your sweet time... It's not every day I let a person see the casual side of me, you know.

main1.line: Come on now, stop and smell the roses. Care for a cup of cappuccino? Actually, no, it would keep you awake through naptime.

main2.line: Hmm? Tired, are we, Commander? A bath in the thermae would rejuvenate you splendidly. I could go for one myself, in fact.

main3.line: Veneto is a tad too formal, wouldn't you agree? She really ought to do like me and take time to unwind more often.

touch.line: My cardigan is made of woven silk. You can appreciate its quality just from touching it, no?

touch2.line: When put before a stunning treasure, few could be satisfied with only watching from afar.

unlock.line: Hello there. You'll have to forgive the loungewear; I have scarcely any reason to wear extravagant clothes in my private space away from the public eye.

detail.line: Should've brought an umbrella, you say? ...Let's forget how that wouldn't help in a massive downpour and focus on enjoying this providential quiet time we have, shall we? Hahaha!

home.line: Once the rain's stopped, I'm going to take a nice, long bath. What about you, Commander? You could join me in the thermae if you'd like.

login.line: Going somewhere, even though it's still raining? You could simply stay with me instead. Hahaha!

main1.line: What is it? ...I'm soaked through and through? Well, look who's talking. We're both dripping down to our ankles.

main2.line: Knowing Impero, she'd run outside barefoot without a care in the world about getting wet if she was caught in the rain. She wouldn't let anyone stop her, either.

main3.line: You could go to work in the rain, or kick back and relax while you wait for it to stop. When the weather gives you a free pass, why not seize the day, after all?

touch.line: Oh? Feasting your eyes on the rare sight that is me in rain-soaked clothes, are you?

touch2.line: To be frank with you, I WOULD say this isn't the time for this, buuut...

unlock.line: Talk about bad luck, we're caught in a rainstorm right now. Unfortunately, it seems we'll have to wait it out here, Commander.

battle.line: Be crushed by Roma's exalted light!

couple_encourage1.line: Show me a battle worthy of Captain Pompeo's name!

couple_encourage2.line: Yes, Impero is great.

detail.line: Veneto's idea of a thermae party is one that I adore. When people strip naked, they unconsciously lower their guards and let their secrets slip. Furthermore, bathing itself is quite enjoyable.

expedition.line: Commission rewards have arrived. Splendid. We need these for our next plan.

feeling1.line: Beacon of Incompetence, the Loathsome One, or the Savage Brute – which title do you feel suits you best, Commander?

feeling2.line: Are you apprehensive of me? Good. I do not get along with frivolous people who act unnecessarily friendly around others.

feeling3.line: Commander, which do you find more gratifying – conquering land, or conquering hearts and minds? ...Both, about as much? I see you're an insatiable soul.

feeling4.line: Why did you intervene when I took wares from the store earlier? ...It's against the store's rules? Hmph, is the purpose of great power not to rewrite the rules?

feeling5.line: How tragic it would be to conquer a world and have no one to share it with. Commander, should I meet an unfortunate fate, it shall be you who inherits Roma's splendor.

headtouch.line: Do you wish to obtain my blessings, Commander?

home.line: Now is a good time to assess which place to conquer next.

hp_warning.line: Where is my legion?!

login.line: The clock is ticking, Commander.

lose.line: Commander, I'm afraid I need more legionaries.

mail.line: A new letter? Perhaps it is a declaration of surrender from afar.

main1.line: Have you ever gazed out from the port's highest vantage point? If not, I suggest you try it sometime.

main2.line: Negotiate with the enemy? I'd rather not waste my time. However, I can gladly draft a declaration of war if you so wish.

main3.line: I do not fear danger, because I am more fearsome than danger itself. Hah!

mission.line: Mission instructions, you say? I do not appreciate having orders imposed upon me.

mission_complete.line: You've completed a mission? It may be time to grant you the title of "Fulfiller of Duties."

profile.line: I am battleship Roma. Sadly, I did not get to enlighten the world with my splendor during the war. You've given me a second chance, and for that, I'm in your debt. A favor to me is a favor to Roma, and Roma always repays her allies.

propose.line: You and I are now as one, bound together unto eternity. In other words, defiance against you is defiance against me... Be a little more considerate of others, you say? Very well. If that's what you wish... then I shall try.

skill.line: I shall liberate you from the toils of war.

touch.line: What do you seek from Roma? Come, offer your tribute.

touch2.line: You needn't be shy to admit whether or not Roma has conquered your heart, Commander. I already know the answer.

unlock.line: I am Roma, the inheritor of Romulus' will. Commander, Protector of the Seas, Guider of the Port, Leader of Our People – how would you like me to address you?

upgrade.line: The key to defeating a strong enemy is to be even stronger.

win_mvp.line: But of course. The foundation of my glory is built upon those who stood in my way.

gift_prefer.line: This is an interesting gift. I like it.

detail_ex.line: I'm quite weary myself, so I propose we hold our conversation in the thermae. Hm? Is something the matter? Yes, I am asking you to join me.

expedition_ex.line: The commission team has returned. Oh, I shall accompany you? I assume you want me to discipline the slackers among– Ah, nothing of the sort. I see.

home_ex.line: Congratulations on your triumph, Commander. I've determined our next destination. Let us march onward.

login_ex.line: Now that you're here, let us begin today's tasks.

main4_ex.line: You need some fresh air? Allow me to assist. I can punch a hole through this window with my– Oh, I suppose I'll open it like normal.

main5_ex.line: When my ambition is one day realized, I shall engrave your name upon my laurel crown. Come that day, I want you present to see this moment with your own eyes.

touch_ex.line: Kindly make your request to Roma. You need not offer tribute on this occasion.

touch2_ex.line: How very bold of you... You're becoming more and more like Romulus.

detail.line: A bath is a great way to wash off the fatigue of dancing. I say that not just for myself, but for both of us.

expedition.line: New commission rewards have just arrived.

home.line: I told you to stay here, didn't I? To make up for leaving, you shall spend twice as long rehearsing a pas de deux with me.

login.line: Our march fades into the blackness on nights with dim moonlight. That is likely the reason I why couldn't detect your presence here.

lose.line: Hmph... The flames of war have sullied my gorgeous tutu.

mail.line: You have a new letter. I believe it's a ballet invitation. Shall we attend, or are you too busy? I shall dispose of it if so.

main1.line: You wish to see me perform on the stage? I'd be happy to if it would spread Romulus' splendor... However, I ask that you be patient until I've perfected my dance.

main2.line: While the cursed princess-turned-swan can only reassume her human form at midnight, I can dance whenever I please.

main3.line: Garibaldi, despite the nonchalance she ordinarily displays, plays the black swan quite well. I sincerely acknowledge her skill.

mission.line: New missions? I'm afraid now is not the right time for those.

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed. Strange, as I could've sworn you've been here from the start... Are you able to clone yourself? Heehee.

touch.line: This is what a pas de deux is like? How novel.

unlock.line: You seem to have known that I would be here. Then stay and spend the night with me. Just the two of us.

win_mvp.line: Nobody is allowed to disturb the peace tonight.

battle.line: It is time to clad yourselves in courage and wisdom!

couple_encourage1.line: A Royal Knight, huh? I never expected to fight alongside someone like you.

couple_encourage2.line: Cesare, follow me!

couple_encourage3.line: The glory of Sardegna... yes, it used to shine brighter.

detail.line: Leonardo da Vinci... had that tragedy not occurred, she surely would've fought to the last breath for the glory of the Sardegna Empire, just like Cesare.

expedition.line: The commission squad has returned to port. Were you sending this bunch to a parade or something?

feeling1.line: You will eventually pay the price for your arrogance.

feeling2.line: As one of Sardegna's veterans, I have ample experience ranging from communication to fleet management. If you need any advice, feel free to ask me.

feeling3.line: Commander, what do you think about when you gaze up into the night sky? I always think back to that night... when the skies were ablaze with what looked like countless meteors.

feeling4.line: Long live the glory of the Sardegna Empire... Forget it, it's all in the past now. I'm getting used to being in this fleet, so let's look ahead.

feeling5.line: I said "let's look ahead," right? In that case, I'll cover your back. That way, no matter what happens, you can always keep your eyes ahead of you and leave the rest to me.

home.line: A hard fought battle. Next, there are many missions that you must attend to... Oh my, it would appear that I've accidentally finished everything. Do have some tea and rest for a while.

hp_warning.line: Everyone, stay vigilant!

login.line: Save your breath. Let's begin today's work.

lose.line: Ngh... Must I also bow my head to the passage of time...?

mail.line: New mail has arrived... I'm not your butler, and you're perfectly capable of getting it yourself. Look, it's by your right hand.

main1.line: A gown? I have no interest in things like that. Nor will I ever.

main2.line: Commander, if I ever get invited to one of those Royal tea parties, please tell them that I am too busy with secretary work.

main3.line: Some people used to hold me to lofty expectations, but it feels natural to see the next generation surpass me.

mission.line: Hmm... The number of missions you've completed seems to be lower than the number of missions you were given. Commander, may I ask why?

mission_complete.line: One more name off my list... Oh, I was talking about the list of unfinished missions.

profile.line: I witnessed the ascendancy of the Imperial Fleet as well as its decay into powerlessness. Commander, I pray that you, as the leader of the fleet, will never repeat the tragedies of the past.

propose.line: You're giving such an important thing to me...? I... this is... ahh! I'm sorry, I can't keep my composure, but I'll try my best to say it... "I do!" How's that? P-please let this embarrassing ritual be over already...

skill.line: This volley... shall not be my last!

touch.line: Allow me to say this: judging people by their appearance will be your downfall.

touch2.line: Just how little do you think of me?

unlock.line: I am the dreadnought, Conte di Cavour. There is much that I can do for you, Commander, but that depends on whether or not you are trustworthy.

upgrade.line: Thanks for your consideration.

win_mvp.line: One will never tire of victory.

gift_prefer.line: You put more thought into this than I'd expect.

detail.line: It's always the normally quiet types that end up making the boldest statements at the beach...

home.line: My "ammo" is about to run out... Commander, fetch me more water!

login.line: Curses... I can't believe people are seeing me in this soggy, ugly mess... What, I'm cute? Wh-what kind of sick joke is that? Come help me already!

main1.line: Huh?! Where'd that sneak attack come from? I've gotta answer back...!

main2.line: Cesare, this is the only time we'll be fighting on the same front. Let's do this!

main3.line: Not as much as a damn molehill on this beach... Where's a soldier supposed to hide herself...?

touch.line: You've helped me a lot. Thank you.

touch2.line: Y-you traitor...!

unlock.line: Commander, take this. Good, for the time being, you are a now a disciple under my command. It is time for us to mete out punishment to the unruly.

battle.line: As per the Commander's orders, we depart for the front!

couple_encourage1.line: Our battle isn't over yet!

couple_encourage2.line: Cavour, worry about yourself instead!

detail.line: At last I can have a rematch with Warspite on equal terms. I've been waiting for this!

expedition.line: Isn't that the commission team? Why not go say hello to them, Commander?

feeling1.line: Seems you lack the mindset to be a worthy commander.

feeling2.line: Cavour always stresses the importance of courtesy and diplomatic discourse, but I believe in simply speaking one's mind. Doesn't it sound dreadful to obsess over some idea of formality?

feeling3.line: A little bit of harsh discipline is the right medicine for slouches who can't obey orders. "It's not that simple"? Well, I thought I was making a good suggestion...

feeling4.line: A little bird told me you're free, and I've got two tickets to the opera, so what do you say? I'd say you're due for something you haven't experienced before.

feeling5.line: You can rest easy, Commander. For as long as I have your back, you can keep your eyes on the path ahead and continue moving forward. I'll take care of everything else for you!

home.line: Triumphant once again, yes? It's written all over your face.

hp_warning.line: You won't break my spirit so easily!

login.line: You're right on time... Naturally. I'll admit your timeliness is the one thing I could learn from.

lose.line: Am I out of my depth...?!

mail.line: There's a letter for you. Assuming it's no private matter, you don't mind if I open it, do you?

main1.line: Office work? Cavour is better at it than me... but I'll still do it. As any secretary should.

main2.line: Commander, be decisive. Hesitation wastes time, and wasted time is gone forever.

main3.line: A good leader doesn't micromanage or mediate, they issue clear orders and make firm decisions. Isn't that right, Commander?

main4.line: Cavour, don't be so overly formal around the Commander! No one wants to be treated like an old-timer!

mission.line: You can honestly skip missions you'd rather not take on.

mission_complete.line: On the topic of completing missions, does it even affect the war situation?

profile.line: Memories that haunt me? None but that dreaded battle. I had to retreat from the Battle of Punto Stilo after taking a single hit... Things would've gone differently, had I only gotten to strike first...!

propose.line: *Sigh*... The romantic vacation I booked was all for nothing... "With who"? With you, shouldn't that be obvious?! ... "Just ask me next time"? But I booked it just for you in the first place... F-fine, I will...

skill.line: All shall bow before my might!

touch.line: Mh... Mm? Sorry, I zoned out for a bit... Were you worried about me, Commander?

touch2.line: If you plan on toying around with me, don't blame me when you get burned.

unlock.line: I'm Giulio Cesare, battleship of the Sardegna Empire. Prove to me your talent in commanding a fleet!

upgrade.line: I've yet to hit my own limits!

win_mvp.line: Veni, vidi, vici.

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me? Th-thanks...

detail.line: Want me to make a training plan for you? ... "Cesare's training methods send nutrients to your muscles and away from the brain"? Did Cavour really say that?!

home.line: Here, take this! Don't forget to rehydrate.

login.line: The treadmill is free right now. Do use it if you plan to work out.

main1.line: "Inaction saps the vigor of the mind"... Who said that, again?

main2.line: Jogging courses, fat-burning courses, rolling hills courses... Is it really this complicated? I'll just start with whichever seems the toughest.

main3.line: If you feel stressed out, just let it all out on that sandbag over there. I can attest that it does wonders for the mood.

touch.line: Are you out of breath already? You've still got a long way to go, Commander.

touch2.line: What was that for?! Don't ignore me, answer!

unlock.line: Both exercise and war are at their core about willpower! Now, get ready, Commander! We're not finished until you're dripping with sweat!

home.line: Want some ice with your Sardegnian liqueur? It's best downed in one gulp when it's this cold.

login.line: Hey, Commander. I hope you're not tired already, or else you'll be branded as unreliable.

main1.line: Warspite's taking part in the beach volleyball tournament? You should've told me so sooner!

main2.line: Trento and Pola are out for you, so you came here to lie low, didn't you? ...No?

main3.line: This is not a playground, Cavour! Take your watergun fight elsewhere! ...I'll be right back, Commander. I'm going to have a word with that wannabe commando!

touch.line: I do like this bikini, though it doesn't quite match up to Veneto's.

touch2.line: Surely you know what consequences await you for doing that.

unlock.line: Tired already? For goodness' sake, I thought you'd be more reliable than this. Don't go burning all your energy at once, we still have a whole day of recreation ahead of us.

win_mvp.line: Are you charmed by my prowess in battle, or just me? Haha~

battle.line: I won't embarrass myself in front of the people who look up to me.

detail.line: *sigh*... Commander, do I seem dependable to you? I don't want those who look up to me to see me as incompetent... Yeah, exactly. I have to be a role model to people.

expedition.line: Commission complete. Let's go give our thanks to those hardworking girls.

feeling1.line: What happened to you, Commander? If it's help you need, I'm here for you.

feeling2.line: There are all kinds of shipgirls at this port, some of whom are naughty and cause you headaches, I'm sure. But when you're at your wits' end, you can rely on me.

feeling3.line: Something on your mind, Commander? It's not healthy to bottle up your emotions... How did I know? Heehee. Because you're like me – when you feel bad, it shows in your expression.

feeling4.line: *sigh*... Am I doing the "cool role model" thing right? I feel like people don't think I'm someone they can rely on... You think I'll find out by instead relying on them for a while? Okay, in that case... Can I rely on you, Commander?

feeling5.line: It's exhausting always trying to be there for everyone... But, as long as I have you, I'll always get back up whenever I'm near my breaking point. It's like you, uhh, refill my energy and confidence... I suppose? Heehee~ You're my bosom buddy, Commander♪

home.line: A few girls stopped by while you were gone. Oh, and I wrote a note of what they wanted to tell you. You can read it, if you'd like.

hp_warning.line: H-hold steady just a while longer!

login.line: Getting to work this soon, Commander? Why not have a hot cup of milk before you begin?

lose.line: It's okay. We might have lost this time, but next time, the Commander will lead us to victory!

mail.line: There's a new letter. Maybe the milk I ordered has arrived already?

main1.line: Do you want more hot milk? I'll heat up some more right now. Enjoy it while it's warm.

main2.line: Sometimes I just want to relax, but I can't let my guard down in case someone comes by... *sigh*... Do you ever have that problem, Commander?

main3.line: Commander, am I doing a good job keeping up appearances? I'm not too nice to people, am I? I'm bad at self-evaluating...

mission.line: You have a new mission. Why not leave it to someone else as a bit of practice?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! I'm glad to see everyone doing so well.

profile.line: I'm Andrea Doria, the lead ship of my class. While I don't have any accomplishments to brag about, I really try to look after those close to me! S-so, come to me if you need help.

propose.line: For you to acknowledge me in this way is the highest honor in my opinion... Will things stay the same, moving forward? Of course! I'll do whatever you ask, whenever you ask! Maybe I'll even ask you for something from time to time... Heehee♪

touch.line: Mmh... Do you find this relaxing, Commander?

touch2.line: N-now you're being naughty...

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander. I am Andrea Doria, Sardegna Empire battleship. I'm honored to be working with you. Oh, and if anyone in your fleet needs a helping hand, I'll support them as best as I can.

upgrade.line: That's right, a role model can't afford to fall behind!

win_mvp.line: I hope my results will inspire others.

gift_prefer.line: For me? Oh, it's not that I don't like it... Quite the opposite, I love it! H-hehe...

battle_ex.line: I'm fine, because I have the Commander with me!

detail_ex.line: I'm glad to have someone to rely on, but I feel bad doing it when the Commander already has so much work to do... Ugghh... I won't work this out myself. Guess I should ask Trento and the girls for advice...

expedition_ex.line: Commission completed. I'll tally up the rewards for you.

home_ex.line: You've been out on nonstop sorties lately, haven't you? So here, I sorted your paperwork to make it easier to read. That should extend your break by a solid ten minutes. Heehee.

login_ex.line: Here's your daily cup of hot milk. Enjoy it, and then let's get to work♪

main4_ex.line: I should probably make some time for just you and me so I can carry on my always-there role model attitude. But... then it's like I'm keeping you all to myself...

main5_ex.line: Some girls love doting on you, and some love being doted on by you... I'm not sure how to put it, I just feel a little nagged about that...

mission_ex.line: You have a mission. How about we complete it together for a change of pace?

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission done and dusted. You're awesome, Commander! Come here for a hug... The rest of you will get one later♪

touch_ex.line: Yes? Do you want me to pamper you? Heehee.

touch2_ex.line: Indulge yourself as much as you want♪

win_mvp_ex.line: Now this is how a role model rolls! Heehee~

detail.line: "Thank you for flying with us today"... Uhh, do you think my delivery is okay? I'm new to this and I don't wanna screw up...

expedition.line: The commission team has come back? Let's bring them some drinks as a show of thanks!

home.line: What the...? Is this compartment broken? The door won't close... Commander, could you help me out there?

login.line: Commander, we're landing soon, so fasten your seatbelt. Should I take your bags and stow them away for you?

main1.line: "I'll now demonstrate how to use a life jacket"... Erm, Commander, how do I do this again?

main2.line: What drink would you like – juice, coffee, or soda? I have hot milk as well, of course.

main3.line: You there, please keep quiet on the aircraft! I'll get the Commander if you don't simmer down.

touch.line: Give me a call if you ever need anything.
