touch2.line: I told you to stop being naughty, Commander...

unlock.line: "I'm your stewardess, Andrea Doria, here to ensure you have a pleasant flight"... Did I sound natural, Commander? ...Still a bit on the stiff side, huh? *sigh*, this job really isn't easy for first-timers...

battle.line: Let's go! I'm gonna make a masterpiece as destructive as a meteorite strike!

couple_encourage1.line: Have you cooked up some new scheme? Can I hear about it?

couple_encourage2.line: Mmhh, this atmosphere... It's Roma!

couple_encourage3.line: We're gonna make works of art that transcend time!

detail.line: A-ha, you wanna know more about me, don'tcha? Well, be my guest – ask all the questions you want! Later, I mean – 'cause I've been staying up and drawing for a whole week straight and my head isn't on straight right now. Let me just make a staw-and-cup telephone and we'll do some direct brain-to-brain communication instead!

expedition.line: Commission complete! I'll go say hi with you! Promised the girls I'd draw the moment you meet up with them, y'see!

feeling1.line: You were a blank sheet with so much potential, and you turned into an old painting you can't change... Man, what a disappointment.

feeling2.line: Still doesn't feel like we're that close, you and I... Be calm, though! My methods guarantee we'll get closer! Oh, also, it feels like our pace is faster than usual today... Dynamic beauty like that still makes for a good painting, though!

feeling3.line: I'm sorting through my refs, and it's going well! You know, every single thing you do really DOES inspire me! I'mma draw every last one of these then hang 'em all over your office while you're out.

feeling4.line: Seems you've gotten used to me observing you – from your first cuppa joe in the morning, to how you grimace while reading paperwork at night... It still ain't nearly enough for me, though! Lemme put a microcamera on your collar – I need my fix! What? Is that a step too far?

feeling5.line: I'm happy to report that after extensive, detailed, and intimate observations, the conclusion I've come to iiis... you really are my endless source of inspo! O flawless God of Inspiration of mine, let me depict every little part of you♪

headtouch.line: Oohh! The inspo is kicking in! Ogh, ohh!

home.line: Ah, back you are! Hold on a sec... There! Your side profile looks suh-frickin'-preme from this angle!

hp_warning.line: Hmm. Getting kinda fed up here...

login.line: Heyo! There you are, my wellspring of inspiration and favorite research subject. I can't wait to see what fun encounters you and I will have today☆

lose.line: Fiddlesticks. I won't hold back next time!

mail.line: New letterino! Hey, why don't we fold it up into a paper boat and send 'er down the river?

main1.line: The natural lighting in your office is just perfect! Can I make this my temporary studio? I already brought my sleeping bag! ...Huh? You're worried I'll get carried away and not go outside for a whole week again? I mean, I go outside when I've got no inspo. When I do, though, I draw 'til the well's completely dry!

main2.line: You've been getting reports of some weirdo hanging out on rooftops 'round the port? I was just... drawing in different places, that's all. Is that not allowed? Even if I do it for free?

main3.line: A casual observer might say you've made the same serious look while reading papers today, but I counted at least seven different types of gazes! When you're reading something especially unreasonable, you unconsciously look up and to the right...You knew I've been observing you this whole time? Well, you're welcome!

main4.line: Imagine if we covered all your office walls with mirrors – then I could observe you from dozens of different angles! Hm? That'd make it harder for others to navigate? That's kinda what I was going for, you kn– Err, I mean! It's all for the sake of art!

mission.line: Hey, you've still got missions to do. Mind if I sit beside you and draw while I wait? I'll pour you some coffee while I'm at it!

mission_complete.line: Lessgo! Mission complete! Let's balance these pens on our chins and run 'round the office for a change of pace! ...No? I'll do it just by myself, then!

profile.line: Grazie, my beloved Commander! I'm Raffaello, a Sardegnian girl who cares little about hierarchies and stuff and more about defining herself as an artist committed to capturing beauty. My plan is to draw every single moment we spend together in painstaking detail – and especially to draw the little things even you yourself don't notice!

propose.line: Finally... Finally this precious moment has come. The gentle touch of your fingers will forever be imprinted upon my heart... Heehee. Allow me the honor to depict every moment of our lives together from now on, using the most pious brushstrokes!

skill.line: Get a load of the power of ART!

touch.line: Oh, Commander, next time you wanna get my attention, can you form a cross with your index and middle fingers? From my point of view, that composition will look so peak!

touch2.line: Ohhh... Oh, frick yeah... You got my heart pumping now!

unlock.line: You're that famous Commander, huh? Lemme get a reeeal close, intimate look at you... Oh, excuse me! Yet to introduce myself, haven't I? I'm Raffaello of the Sardegna Empire, and I am NOT a freak! Hope you don't mind if I make every beautiful moment in your life into a painting! I'm gonna paint all the less flattering ones too, just so you know.

upgrade.line: Props for building me! I'll be sure to draw many, many more masterpieces of you♪

win_mvp.line: A perfect victory, and a perfect source of inspo!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh... I-I've never been given such a perfect gift. Have you been watching me, Commander? YES? Hahaha☆

feeling5_ex.line: First I gazed at you, observed you, then came closer and drew you... and now, you've become an irreplaceable part of my life. My pen and my heart – they both belong to you, my beloved Commander♪

headtouch_ex.line: Ooh! I need to take your hand... and sculpt a copy of it!

home_ex.line: Welcome back, my beloved Commander! Gotta say, once again... you make my heart flutter from every angle today!

login_ex.line: My precious companion, my personal gemstone of art... It makes me so happy that I get to see your gentle eyes before anyone else! I'm gonna draw every little part of you in incredible detail today!

main5_ex.line: My room's getting full of reference materials. Hm? It's high time I sorted it all out? But each and every one is a source of inspo! Besides, my collection is a lot more modest than it used to be!

main6_ex.line: I've been studying sketching from different angles lately! Like by hanging upside-down from the ceiling like this... Aww, you won't let me, huh? Oh well! I did figure out that your smile looks 3.7 degrees gentler from this angle.

main7_ex.line: Even though this pencil is almost completely used up, sharpening it down to this length feels the most comfortable to draw with... Hm? Did I get the desk dusty again? I'll clean it up right now.

main8_ex.line: Hmm... From an architectural point of view, your office would be perfect for installing a secret door somewhere. It'll be convenient to have – for all sorts of purposes!

touch_ex.line: Ahh, no matter how you touch me, it makes my heart skip a beat!

touch2_ex.line: Ooh... I-I've gotta draw what you just did!

detail.line: Don'tcha agree that the role of Protector of Love and Beauty fits me like a glove? Presiding over a holy domain, watching an eternal collection... Ooh, just putting it into words is giving me tons of inspo!

expedition.line: Ah, a commission from the mortal world? I shall permit you to briefly leave this place, then!

feeling5.line: Despite you being a hapless invader in a god's domain, I knew from first glance that you were the perfect collection piece I've been searching for... As the Protector of Love and Beauty, I shall bind you to this place forever! Yes, because you're worth drawing for all of eternity!

headtouch.line: Hmm? I'll forgive that transgression just because you're so beautiful!

home.line: No matter where you run, you'll always return to me in the end. That's your bound fate, my dear collection piece♪

login.line: What's this? Trying to escape today? Sorry, that's not gonna happen until you finish this Eternal Beverage. Be good and stay put so I can observe you♪

main1.line: You wanna leave, huh? Heh. You've entered my domain, my eternal tra– You know the drill! You're the best ref I could ask for, and I'm gonna draw out each and every one of your expressions!

main2.line: Whoa there, intruder! You're in my holy domain, so you must remain under my watchful gaze! Heehee. This is a great chance to draw some art, so hold real still!

main3.line: A common invader means nothing to the Protector of Love and Beauty – but I didn't expect a mortal to show me such beauty... Heehee. You're staying by my side from now on!

main4.line: I'll let you go if you manage to drink all the liquid in this pot. Hm? You keep drinking but it never runs out? Heehee! The gifts of God are endless!

mission.line: How dare a lowly intruder leave an unfinished mission in the domain of a god? Unacceptable!

mission_complete.line: Something just arrived... Oh, since I laid eyes on these mission rewards, they're mine now!

touch.line: Hmm? Want a refill?

touch2.line: Ohh... This behavior is so blasphemous... but so good!

unlock.line: Heheh! You were not invited to this place, and as its guardian, I must punish you by... Oh, wait, wait, stop! This angle... This outline... It's simply perfect! Turning you into stone would be a waste, so just stay here and let me observe you every day!

detail.line: Being a work of art is really hard! I can't move, so if I ever get an itch... I'm gonna need you to touch me right here, real gentle. Aaah♡ A bit higher~ Yes, just like that♪

feeling5.line: I thought this artwork lacked soul, so I decided to liven it up into a trick painting and made it truly complete by incorporating myself as part of the art... Just kidding☆ What it was really missing was you! My inspiration, my muse, my beauty incarnate, the miracle in my magic♡

headtouch.line: Please don't touch the art without permission...! But keep giving me inspiration please♪

home.line: Welcome your very own art magic~ Come and immerse yourself in this world I weaved from my warmth and color☆

login.line: Oooh! Seeing my perfect Commander step into my painting melts my heart away♡ Come, join my magic, and join my art☆

main1.line: Nhaaa! The paint splotches you left behind just gave me a flash of inspiration...!

main2.line: Are your eyes fixed on me, Commander...? Come, get a little closer♪

main3.line: Isn't the painting's background lovely, Commander? Reach your hands out to me... Ahaha☆ Did you touch it?~

main4.line: Would you like to add a stroke on me with your own hands? Let beauty guide you and leave your own unique, creative mark on your favorite spot♪

profile.line: Being a work of art is really hard! I can't move, so if I ever get an itch... I'm gonna need you to touch me right here, real gentle. Aaah♡ A bit higher~ Yes, just like that♪

touch.line: Are you curious about how the colors you apply blend together? If you wanna know, you should try it once and see for yourself♪

touch2.line: Can't restrain your creative urges anymore?♪

unlock.line: Welcome to the Circus Art Roadshow! What do you think, Commander? Did my present make your heart race? I used everything I have to complete this art... And I mean EVERYTHING♪

battle.line: I shall judge your sins.

couple_encourage1.line: To think that poetry could be as sharp as a blade...

couple_encourage2.line: The sacred light that you depict... It's so radiant.

detail.line: You so easily pierce through my defenses... Is this a blessing, or a different form of judgment?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned with spoils... and turmoil from the outside.

feeling1.line: Why do you linger here? Nothing remains... within this shadow.

feeling2.line: My true strength, you ask? It rests within this bound body of mine. Even I have never seen it in its entirety before.

feeling3.line: Your existence renders unnecessary my restraints... Is this really how it ought to be?

feeling4.line: I've walked through darkness with no stars to guide me. I hear it now... The sound of your voice, in the wind's whispers from afar.

feeling5.line: I used to hold that life was a series of winters, until I met you... That's when I knew true warmth for the first time.

headtouch.line: Well... If this helps you relax, then so be it.

home.line: I suppose... this is what it means to wait.

hp_warning.line: Ugh... So irritating! Your voice, Commander! I need to hear your voice!

login.line: When you're here, the turmoil within my mind quiets down.

lose.line: Fate eventually strips us of everything...

mail.line: A new letter has arrived. Could it be news of a victory, or judgment for me?

main1.line: Your fingers bring me greater reassurance... than the cold of the chains.

main2.line: Say something, won't you? Even an offhand comment can subdue the power that itches within me...

main3.line: Tsk... So irritating... Commander, let me hear your voice... I want you!

mission.line: Commander, you have new missions. Do not let business unfinished become a waking nightmare.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Let us return to the embrace of silence.

profile.line: I am Sardegnian battleship Francesco Caracciolo, the bound magistrate awaiting the dawn that shall never come in the eternal night.

propose.line: This vow is greater than the eternal night, and more beautiful than the faint light of dawn... This whole body of mine I surrender to you. Please forevermore show me the way.

skill.line: Heehee... Now... Let all fall into the abyss!

touch.line: So you seek to get to know me better... Curiosity killed the cat.

touch2.line: Give me peace... Give me love.

unlock.line: I am Francesco Caracciolo, the magistrate of the Sardegna Empire. If you do not fear my power, then please allow me to pursue a moment of peace by your side.

upgrade.line: Commander, I implore you to "discipline" me in your own way. Keep me bound to your side.

win_mvp.line: Let the filth be returned to dust.

gift_prefer.line: An item imbued with your sentiments, is it? I will treasure it.

battle_ex.line: My body is a blade that purges sin.

detail_ex.line: My heart trembles, and my thoughts are confused... Only when your warmth reaches me does my composure return.

feeling5_ex.line: I surrender these chains to you, and allow you to judge my sins and future and guide me... You are my sole and final salvation.

headtouch_ex.line: Could this be... a ritual of blessing?

home_ex.line: The turmoil of my mind is letting up... I knew you'd come back.

login_ex.line: Even should the turmoil continue, my heart is clearer than it ever has been before. Your light guides my way, Commander.

lose_ex.line: Ah... How irritating...

main4_ex.line: Were I to approach, would you fly away like a frightened bird, or gently linger for me like a star?

main5_ex.line: I pray for you, for you are my one and only weakness.

main6_ex.line: Commander, this power I cannot control... It now lies in your grasp.

touch_ex.line: Hahh... Commander, does this bring you joy?

touch2_ex.line: Ahh... So warm... Let me take in your all with these lips.

upgrade_ex.line: My strength grows. To think that a lovely hope would emerge amid endless suffering...

win_mvp_ex.line: Another sin has come to an end.

detail.line: My attire? I merely changed from a heavy restraint to a gentle bind. Do you think it suits me?

feeling5.line: Once all pictures have been developed, you will find the answer that lies hidden in each and every one – that I have long since given you my true self.

headtouch.line: Mgh... My hair is in the way... Could you straighten it for me again?

home.line: Hm? A good angle, you say? Then let's continue.

login.line: ...Do you wish to see more of my "truth," Commander?

main1.line: You say that this will capture my true self... What am I to do, Commander? Will you assist me?

main2.line: The tether that coils around my body is a gentler one... Or is it, truly?

main3.line: Adjust the hem? One moment... How's this?

touch.line: What did the camera capture – my pious confession, or proof of my sins?

touch2.line: Mgh... In darkness that even the light avoids, what do you ascertain?

unlock.line: Now it is laid bare before you... The shadow that even the sun's light cannot pierce. This is my complete, unfiltered confession to you.

battle.line: Mm, hmm! Yes, this is how it's supposed to be... Fly, my aircraft, fly!

couple_encourage1.line: I do hope we can get along, Miss Graf Zeppelin.

couple_encourage2.line: Well met, fair ladies of the Royal Navy~

couple_encourage3.line: Wow, as dashing as ever today~

couple_encourage4.line: Have a nice trip~ Uh... Did I get something mixed up?

detail.line: So this is how you're supposed to launch carrier-based planes... I think I've got the hang of it... Hyah! ...Oh no, I guess it really is nothing like launching seaplanes...

expedition.line: A commission has been successfully completed! Good work, everyone! My Commander, make sure to offer them words of praise as well!

feeling1.line: My Commander, are you still alive? ...Well, if I keep doing this, I'm sure you will come back to your senses...! *thwack*!

feeling2.line: My Commander, have you already completed today's missions? And did you finish checking off the documents? This is just a friendly reminder from Aquila~ Mhm, no need to thank me~

feeling3.line: Miss Graf Zeppelin? In terms of our history, I'm quite similar to her, right? In that case, "I shall hope that we may forge the bonds of camaraderie"... Eheh~

feeling4.line: My Commander, look out! ...Phew, thank goodness. By the way, why did you come visit me in the middle of my aircraft training? Did you... perhaps want to see me at my most vulnerable?!

feeling5.line: There's been something on my mind recently... "Just how should I make myself more appealing to you, My Commander?" ...What do you think? Please, teach me all sorts of things~♪

home.line: My Commander, should I assist you in turning down any troublesome requests?

hp_warning.line: I'm not some frail young miss who'll go down in a single blow...!

login.line: We're going to have a busy day. Thanks in advance, my Commander.

lose.line: Ugh... Did I make a mistake somewhere...?

mail.line: There's new mail, my Commander. Please choose your words carefully when replying.

main1.line: Sleeping on the job is not something that an excellent commander would do. My Commander... *poke* *poke*... Care to wake up?

main2.line: My Commander, you should try using gentle words to get an emphatic point across. You'll find the results quite remarkable.

main3.line: My Commander, will you allow me to organize the warehouse with the help of my planes? ...The previous accident? Well, that was just a one-off thing~ Ahaha...

mission.line: We've got a mission direct from the Naval HQ... It might be pretty tough...

mission_complete.line: My Commander, I just knew you'd complete your missions without a hitch! Thank goodness~

profile.line: My "history"...? Hmm... I do feel a longing for something like that. If only I had been finished a little sooner during that war... My Commander, don't you think I would've had an enviable service history?

propose.line: I've prepared many, many words for today's occasion, but first, I'd like to hear your words of love, my Commander~♪ After all, you're the one who proposed to me. Hehe, what do you think I should do?

skill.line: I do believe it is time to say goodbye~

touch.line: My Commander, did you need me for something?

touch2.line: My Commander, I do apologize, but... may I refuse this kind of behavior...?

unlock.line: Good day to you, my Commander. I'm Aquila, aircraft carrier from the Sardegna Empire. Our meeting today is no mere coincidence. No, it must be a gift from Fortuna herself, I'm sure of it.

upgrade.line: I feel more experienced now... As long as I do as I practiced in battle, I'm sure everything will be fine!

win_mvp.line: Oh my, I won! Hehe, was this victory to your satisfaction, my Commander?

gift_prefer.line: I graciously accept this.

battle_ex.line: Friends, heed my call – Begin our advance!

detail_ex.line: Let's give this another try... Are you sure it's supposed to work like this? ...Hyah! ...Ohmygosh! It worked! My Commander, Miss Illustrious!

home_ex.line: My Commander, if you receive any troublesome requests, will you delegate them to me?

login_ex.line: Please look after me today as well, my Commander~

main1_ex.line: Zzzzz... Ahhn, you mustn't~ Hwuh? My Commander? Hehe~ I wonder why you didn't directly wake me up?

main4_ex.line: This is your favorite food, isn't it~ ...Oh, it's not? But that's what Miss Junyou told me. She's your childhood friend, isn't she...?

mission_ex.line: Let me handle this task... Oh, are you worried that I won't be able to handle it, my Commander...?

mission_complete_ex.line: Thank you very much, my Commander! I did a good job, didn't I?

touch2_ex.line: Oh my... Just what am I going to do with you, my Commander...

detail.line: Oh my, Commander~ If you stare so much at a young signorina's swimsuit, you're going to give others a bad impression~

home.line: I've already tidied up your schedule. Hehe, though it's your day off, I can still handle these small details~

login.line: My Commander, would you like a floaty ring or a life jacket? ...You don't need either? I'll be taking them then~

main1.line: A swimsuit contest? My my, that sounds like one of Littorio's concoctions~ Don't worry, I'm not interested in entering.

main2.line: Graf Zeppelin, huh... I don't think we have much in common after all...

main3.line: I'd like to fly my planes around, but... No, I've got to practice some self-restraint...!

touch.line: My Commander, would you like some fruit?

touch2.line: My Commander, after we get back, I'll need to lecture you on how to treat a signorina.

unlock.line: Good day, my Commander. We have the day off to enjoy the sea breeze and the ocean waves~ Hehe, would you like to help yourself to some fruit?

battle.line: Take flight, with great elegance!

detail.line: Did you enjoy my black tea? I've worked very, very hard so that I may meet your every demand~♪

home.line: Commander, would you like some Amaretti? I thought some sugar would be nice to help you replenish after leading a battle~♪

login.line: Mm, yes, that's just perfect... Oh my, Commander, how are you doing today? –Hmm, I added too much sugar...?

main1.line: Yummy treat~ Become sweet and replete~♪ Commander, I've prepared a little magic spell to make your tea that much tastier~♪

main2.line: Shall we invite Carabiniere as well next time? I'm sure she'll be quite surprised~♪

touch2.line: Nngh–– Commander, I think this might be a little too naughty?

unlock.line: Oh, my Commander? I didn't expect to meet you here! Fortune smiles upon me today. Hehe~ If you have a minute to spare, would you care to join me for a cup of tea?

battle.line: Gaze upon Sardegna's splendor – MY splendor!

couple_encourage1.line: You awake, sleepyhead?

couple_encourage2.line: I've got the skies covered, Veneto.

detail.line: Need something? Come back in 3 hours after I've had my bath. But, if it's urgent, join me in the bathtub and we'll discuss it.

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Go give them my regards.

feeling1.line: Get out of my sight. I've no need for a snake like you.

feeling2.line: There needn't be a reason why I'm brilliant. Brilliance is inherent, self-apparent, and unmistakable for anything else. Veneto said that, so yeah.

feeling3.line: Have you finally decided to pledge your loyalty to me? ...Hm? I suppose you are a brilliant Commander, but I am also brilliant. How about we swear an oath of mutual loyalty, then?

feeling4.line: I could do nothing – not even lift a finger – and I'd still contribute to Sardegna. To serve you, however, I have to put in real work.

feeling5.line: I did a task for you. It was sloppy, but I'm not used to doing work, so cut me some slack. Nobody's born knowing how to work, are they? My point is... Exactly. I appreciate the compliment.

headtouch.line: ...You really like playing with my hair, huh?

home.line: You've returned. Now where's my thank-you for getting up to bid you welcome back?

hp_warning.line: If I must exercise my brilliance, so be it...!

login.line: Evening. *yawn*... I'm going to sleep. Wake me when it's sortie o'clock.

lose.line: They caught wind of my spaghetti planes? I see... Sorry. This is my fault.

mail.line: Seems the wind brought this letter straight to your desk. Oh, you saw me bring it in? Welp.

main1.line: Is Veneto still up? She has this splendrous aura when she's awake. It's dazzling, genuinely.

main2.line: The only things I need in life are bread and my smartphone. Wait, Oxy-cola too. Oh, and warm baths...

main3.line: You could build a slide outside the office window that leads to my dorm room for quick access. Great idea, right?

mission.line: Missions, hmm? Completing them is key to furthering Sardegna's splendor.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete, at the cost of nearly all my precious energy... Take it from here.

profile.line: I'm Impero, fourth ship of the Vittorio Veneto class. Kneel and pledge your loyalty to me, now. Why? Because I'm brilliant, so I deserve special treatment.

propose.line: Hm? Is this a ring? You want to marry me? I should probably tell Veneto about this first... Oh, I can do that later? All right, good. I love being free of responsibility because I'm so brilliant. I'll leave the formalities to you, Commander.

touch.line: Ready to kneel before me yet?

touch2.line: ...Sleazebag.

unlock.line: I'm Impero of the Vittorio Veneto class. Introduction over – now back to sleep... By the way, I'm brilliant. So you don't need to boss me around... Just give me my space and we'll be good. Night.

upgrade.line: *yawn*...

win_mvp.line: Daring to pick a fight with the brilliant Impero isn't heroic. It's just foolish.

gift_prefer.line: Hmm. Not bad at all.

detail_ex.line: Whew, nothing beats a good bath... Huh? What do you mean "what's with the towel"? I just got out of the bath, that's what?

expedition_ex.line: The commission team's back. I'll go bid them a splendrous ret– Eh, forget it. You're up, Commander.

feeling5_ex.line: We don't have to do anything today. You heard me – you can be like me and just not do anything productive. And if you do something wild, I'll let it slide.

headtouch_ex.line: Mhh... That's nice. Do it again.

home_ex.line: You've returned. I got you something to snack on. How nice of me, right? You may thank me with a headpat.

login_ex.line: Evening... You're not tired right before work? Darn, I was hoping we could nap together.

lose_ex.line: I can't let the Commander see me like this... I'm supposed to be brilliant...

main4_ex.line: Littorio! Is dinner ready yet? Don't forget I'm brilliant. I'll starve to death if you take too long.

main5_ex.line: Need some help with that? ...You can do it on your own? Geesh, soon there'll be nothing left for me to do.

main6_ex.line: It's nice being a carrier. I don't need to get my hands dirty, all I have to do is pilot my planes. I'm so brilliant for being able to fight on my own.

mail_ex.line: A carrier pigeon... I wish I could fly like a bird. A rigging upgrade might make that possible.

mission_ex.line: Missions, hmm? Completing them is key to promoting your brilliance and Sardegna's splendor.

mission_complete_ex.line: Brought you the mission rewards...! Oof! They're a lot heavier than I expected.

touch_ex.line: Is dinner ready?! ...Not yet, huh...

touch2_ex.line: ...I love when you do this♡

win_mvp_ex.line: I'm brilliant, aren't I? Yeah, I am... Hehehe.

detail.line: Do you like reading too, Commander? ...Yeah, I do, 'cause I dream of the comfy stories I read. Do you?

home.line: Ah, you're back. You hungry? I'm kind of famished, so let's hit the cafeteria in a few.

login.line: Evening. Here's what I'm doing to further Sardegna's splendor today... Zzz...

main1.line: Bookmarks are a genius invention. They save me the effort of remembering how far into a book I am.

main2.line: Zzz... Oops, I nodded off. If you wanna borrow a book, go ahead. Anyway... *yawn*... Hang on, what page was I on again?

main3.line: It's practically impossible to stay awake in class. But you manage, Commander. Keep on being a brilliant student.

mission_complete.line: These mission rewards let me read a few minutes more. Brilliant.

touch.line: You here to return a book, or...?

touch2.line: ...Mgh. Hm? Huh?

unlock.line: Seems school uniforms are all the hype. Veneto picked this one out for me. What are you dressed as, Commander? A teacher? A classmate?

win_mvp.line: Now I can read another three pages. Awesome.

detail.line: Listen, Commander, I was so brilliant today... I worked a bunch, I went to observe the thermae, then I went to observe the public bath... I'm running on fumes...

feeling5.line: Whew... I'm just so glad to forget about work. I feel like I'm floating on a cloud... Commander, I want every day to be like this – carefree, no need to work... Pretty please... From now on, you're in charge of my happiness... Zzz...

headtouch.line: That's good... Keep going... Stroke me more...

home.line: The skewers at this bar are pretty delish. Have a li'l bite, Commander! ...Huh? Why do you have two heads?

login.line: My job is so exhausting... I don't wanna work ever again... You do the heavy lifting, Commander – I'll be sleeping...

main1.line: I'm hungry, but I don't wanna move... Feed me, Commander. Nom...

main2.line: I'm thirsty, but I don't wanna move... Pour a drink into my mouth, Commander. Mmh...

main3.line: My uniform's too tight... Who the hell came up with this cumbersome design? I'm requesting permission to come to work in a dressing gown... Zzz...

touch.line: Drink up, Commander. The day only really starts after you've clocked out...

touch2.line: Mmh... Oh yeah... I want more...

unlock.line: Ugh... I don't wanna work... I don't wanna work... I don't wanna work... Commander? Finished your overtime shift? Great timing... Come and drink with me!

battle.line: Do whatever, it doesn't matter, I just wanna get this over with quick...

couple_encourage1.line: Your personality is my k-kryptonite...

couple_encourage2.line: I'm not sure we're on the same wavelength...

detail.line: Wh-why are you looking at me...?

expedition.line: The commission team's back? I couldn't care less... You're gonna go see them? I-I'll tag along then...

feeling1.line: You're even edgier than I am... Hehehe...

feeling2.line: Like I said, don't worry about me... I'm right here, out of sight, out of mind... Hehehehe...

feeling3.line: Yuubari said thanks? I just gave her an idea for a c-cannon modification, that's all... Now she wants my help with it, too? Uhh, I'm gonna pass...

feeling4.line: Commander, can I come a step c-closer? Hehe, hehehehe... Your hand feels so nice and warm... Hehe...

feeling5.line: I'm glad I have somone as d-diligent and charitable like you to count on... Hehehe... Y-you want me to give you a hand sometimes? I-I'll try...

headtouch.line: Ooohh... Ahh, hehehe... M-more...

home.line: I know this scent... When I smell it, it means you've come b-back... Hehe, hehehehe...

hp_warning.line: I wanna get out of the water...

login.line: Ehh?! C-could you not pop in out of the blue like that... It scares me...

lose.line: I-I'm resurfacing and going back...

mail.line: There's mail for you. I've made sure nobody's read it but me... Hehe, hehehe...

main1.line: You're awful busy today, Commander... You want my help? Umm... I-I'll think about it...

main2.line: It's safe and quiet under the surface... I'd love to have you down there with me... Hehe, hehehehe...

main3.line: Could you... c-close the curtains, please? The sunlight... it burns...

mission.line: Missions? Ugh, I hate missions... Could we just pretend they don't exist...

mission_complete.line: Leave the mission rewards alone for too long and shrooms might start growing on them... Hehe, hehehehe...

profile.line: I'm Brin-class submarine Torricelli... Just remember my name, and I'll be happy... My battle with the Royal Navy? It taught me a lesson about what happens when you underestimate your enemies... Hehehehe...

propose.line: Hehe, hehehe... Now you're obliged to provide for me forever... That was j-just a joke... So, what comes next...?

touch.line: Mine don't hold a candle to the massive mounds of some other girls... Hehe, hehehe... Sorry if that disappoints you, Commander...

touch2.line: I guess this means I've c-caught your interest...

unlock.line: You've gotta be the commander... My name is T-Torricelli, here to claim this room for myself... Don't worry about me, I'll just be sitting in some quiet corner... Hehe, hehehehe...

upgrade.line: My guns could use an upgrade too...

win_mvp.line: Can I come up now? Okay, I-I'm heading back now... Hehe, hehehehe...

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me? Heh, hehehe... I-I accept.

feeling5_ex.line: Thanks for everything you do, Commander... Hehehehe... Tell you what, I-I'll make you dinner today... Mushroom marinade, mushroom risotto, and my own mushroom special... Hehehehe....

main1_ex.line: I sorted all your paperwork, Commander... Hehehe... C-could I get a "thank you," please...?

main3_ex.line: I love the dark... Hehehe... It hides you from people who'd judge you...

main4_ex.line: Could I c-come with you on mission briefings? I am your secretary, after all... Hehehe...♡

main5_ex.line: Helping out with prototype equipment is such a chore... Ugh...

mission_ex.line: Another mission? O-okay...

touch2_ex.line: Oh, Commander... Hehe, hehehe...♡

win_mvp_ex.line: Hehe, hehehehe... S-say something good about me...

detail.line: I'll trade you this shell for a coconut, Commander... Hehe, hehehehe... You have only to g-gain from this deal, don't you see? Hehehe...

home.line: Back already? Hehe... I'm not alone in being a bad swimmer... Hehehehe...

login.line: Eep! H-how do you keep appearing out of nowhere...

main1.line: Don't be scared, little turtle... I won't hurt you, I just wanna watch... Hehe, hehehehe...

main2.line: I need this straw hat to protect me, or else the sunlight would melt me...

main3.line: A letter in a bottle? The ocean currents must've brought it here... Hehe, it's the plight of a poor girl who'll never be real... Hehe, hehehehe...

touch.line: You're not p-planning something, are you...? Hehehe...

touch2.line: Good thing it's j-just us two here... Hehe, hehehehe...

unlock.line: Hehe, hehehehe... We have this little c-corner of the beach all to ourselves... Now, what should we do first... Hehehehe...

battle.line: I've already worked out an angle of attack!

detail.line: Behold, Commander! My latest invention – the mechanical spaghetti winder! It saves two minutes per serving, so assuming two servings a day, you save 1,460 minutes over a year! Hah-hah! Am I a genius or what?

expedition.line: Commission rewards have arrived! With fresh materials come brand spanking new ideas~ Heheheh♪

feeling1.line: I should probably build some sort of gadget that sounds an alarm when you're nearby...

feeling2.line: Now, Torricelli, behold my latest invention! ...Huh? Where'd she go? Don't tell me she went hiding in some dark corner again!

feeling3.line: Whenever I get a new idea, I sketch it down and store it in my satchel. I love keeping a physical record of all the inspiration I get!

feeling4.line: Are you free, Commander? Then have a look at this blueprint as well as this, this, and this and tell me whatcha think. Two heads are better than one, and I want your feedback!

feeling5.line: Commander! You free again? Like they say... Look below you for ideas, look around you for inspiration! Time: from dawn 'til dusk – place: every nook and cranny of the port! Heheh! I'm bound to come up with something new this way!

headtouch.line: Ah... I just came up with a new idea! Commander, keep it up!

home.line: Awesome work out there! ...You're running on fumes, huh? Unfortunate. I'd give you half my energy if I could~

hp_warning.line: Think, da Vinci! How will you get out of this pickle?!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! Me? I've been here all morning. Heheh, stunned by my sheer vitality, aren't ya?

lose.line: Crap, I goofed that one up...

mail.line: Got a letter for you! I brought it here at max speed♪

main1.line: I've got an idea for an automatic seal stamper! You just put it on a ready document and it stamps it for you, saving both time and energy♪

main2.line: Take a break? But I don't need one! I'm just fine. Besides, my brain fires on all pistons when I'm searching for inspiration♪

main3.line: Whoa, my mind just birthed a fresh idea... Commander, let me borrow your pen! And your ruler and compass! Okay, it's something like this... *scribbles*

main4.line: This little guy's my Autonomous Dive-Bombing Sneak-Attacker Minisub! Huh, you think that's too long? Then, uhh, let's go with Canguro! Make sure the two of you get along!

mission.line: New missions, you say? Let me at 'em! I can do it all, from drafting to completion! ...What? It's a task only you can get done?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Surf the waves of accomplishment to the next challenge♪

profile.line: I'm Leonardo da Vinci, the Marconi-class submarine who completed many patrol missions! My hobby is inventing fun things! Like this little lion – just push the button here and a flower pops out of it!

propose.line: What you're saying with this is that you love me, correct? It goes without saying that I love you too♪ On another note, looking at this shiny ring is giving me an idea... Namely, a ring that literally glows! Let's make one, Commander!

skill.line: Let's see how you like THIS!

touch.line: I see there's a blueprint here! Time to see whether it can be built or not, Commander!

touch2.line: Whuh?! Wh-where do you think you're touching?

unlock.line: Heya, Commander. I'm the Sardegnian submarine Leonardo da Vinci, but you can just call me da Vinci. Now that I'm finally here at the port, I hope every new day is a wellspring of inspiration!

upgrade.line: Mhm! I'm getting all sorts of new ideas here♪

win_mvp.line: Talk about a cakewalk! Well then, my search for inspiration continues♪

gift_prefer.line: Ooh, yeah. I'll keep this one safe!

battle_ex.line: I've got a brilliant plan B, so do your worst!

detail_ex.line: I wanna thank you for always giving me input and listening to my rambling by inventing something that'll be of use to you~ Just tell me whatcha want♡

expedition_ex.line: Commission rewards are here. Let's check out what we got and see what new things we can come up with!

feeling5_ex.line: That pillow cover drying in the sun is of course the one with your darling da Vinci in a raunchy pose♡ ...You thought I was serious? So you're saying you WOULD own that... Guess I'll just have to make one♪

headtouch_ex.line: Heheh! Charging complete!♪ Now I'm at full throttle again!♪

home_ex.line: Good going on that sortie! Feeling beat, don'tcha? Let's fix those stiff shoulders with my massage-o-tron! Have a seat in my lap and just relax♪

login_ex.line: You're looking alive today, Commander! Heheh, must be thanks to my li'l works-like-charm alarm clock♪

main5_ex.line: Not all ideas are feasible to materialize, but that's no reason not to try! As they say, the proof is in the pudding♪

main6_ex.line: Commander! I've got another brilliant new invention to... Darn, you're busy. I'll give it a show to Torricelli instead.

main7_ex.line: I may be a short sleeper, but you need your beauty sleep. I also know what it's like to be in the flow, which is all the more reason why you need to call it a day! Come on, it's time to go to bed, Commander!

mission_ex.line: It's time to test out my machine that replicates your signature! ...No? Come on, there's no harm in automating that bit!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete♪ You know what you get for shutting down my brilliant idea? A thorough tickling!

touch_ex.line: You got an idea outta the blue? Quick, here's a pen and paper – write it down before you forget it!

touch2_ex.line: Heheh, I knew you were being too modest up to now♪

win_mvp_ex.line: We won, Commander♡ Heck yeah, that look of surprise is just what I wanted to see~

detail.line: If ballet and invention have anything in common, it's that they both take inspiration from animals. So, dancing among animals is a great way to get new ideas♪

home.line: Hey, I rehearsed a bit while you were out! Though I'm still nowhere near Roma's level.

login.line: Dancing among the beautiful flora and fauna makes me feel like I'm becoming one with nature.

main1.line: If only there was a device that could accurately translate the cries of these deer... Guess I have to invent one myself, eh?

main2.line: Do you reckon I could fly with these wings if I scaled them up? Imagine the midair dances I could do. They'd be stunning!

main3.line: Watch closely, Commander! Here comes my grand fouetté en tournant♪ Wheee... Oh god, that made me dizzy... Th-that was kinda overkill...

touch.line: Ballet's actually not hard. Come on, just take it slow and repeat after me~

touch2.line: D-d-d-don't sneak up on me like that!

unlock.line: Here to watch me rehearse just like these deer, Commander? Isn't it wonderful being surrounded by the beauty of nature? For a performance based on a fable such as this one, ambiance is key. Ehehe~♪

feeling5.line: So long as you're watching me, I know I could pull off any magic trick, even in the middle of a high swing. This sense of safety... that matters more than any inspiration♪

headtouch.line: Heheh, don't forget to fix my ears back the way they were♪

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Would you like to watch my swinging tricks? Or maybe just relax together?♪

login.line: Commander? Did you see me perform just now? I was just testing a little theory. I wanted to see if being suspended in midair makes one's inspiration a bit "lighter"♪

main1.line: Maybe we should make a portable swing? That way I'll be able to whoosh around wherever I go!

main2.line: This sense of weightlessness, of speed, it's completely different from when I'm lost in inventing... Ah, I just came up with a new idea!

main3.line: Si cominica! Commander, next up... Waaah?! All the cards in my hat... they all turned into design sketches?!

touch.line: Are you just going to watch? Come on, gimme your hand! Let's fly high enough to touch the stars♪

touch2.line: Eek?! Commander, you're such a tease. Are you looking for inspiration in the middle of a performance?♪

unlock.line: Ah, Commander! I got a flash of inspiration when I swung to the top just now! Let the magic show begin now!

win_mvp.line: What an easy win~ And I get lots of applause and inspiration as my reward♪

battle.line: I'm the flagship? But I might suddenly appear or disappear!

couple_encourage1.line: You'll have to try harder if you want the Commander's punishment... That's not what you're after?

detail.line: Commander, you wanna come with me and see if the port has any restricted areas or buildings you can only reach by scaling a wall? Don't worry about you getting hurt, because I'll be there!

expedition.line: A commission's been completed. What do you say we go and receive the girls?

feeling1.line: Even after all my blunders, you still won't get mad at me... How disappointing.

feeling2.line: Oh, doesn't look like you really react to my pranks. I suppose I'll have to take them a step further, then!

feeling3.line: You've been pretty interesting as of late. You finally understand me, don't you? Heehee.

feeling4.line: Lately, it's been making my heart race whether you scold me or smile at me... I've never felt it beat this fast before...♥

feeling5.line: Even just spending time with you gets my heart pumping now... but I still wanna tease and prank you. Heehee. I can't help it, it's just so cute when you lecture me♥

headtouch.line: Huh? What a letdown... I mean, thanks for the headpat! I guess...

home.line: Hey, Commander, I didn't follow your orders the other day, did I? You know what that– It worked out in the end, so no punishment for me? Dang...

hp_warning.line: Is this the time I finally sink? Yeah, right!

login.line: Oh, you're here early, Commander. Heehee. I tried to "sort" your paperwork while you were gone, but, well... Now that you know who did it, it's time to punish me♥

lose.line: Well, safe to assume the Commander will punish me for this...

mail.line: I have a letter for you, Commander. Heehee, I didn't do anything to it. Nope, nothing at all!

main1.line: Hm-hmm-hm♪ Hm? Where I went? Well, there's a crevice here that leads to the attic. It gives a great view of your office. Wanna go have a look? ...What? You don't? Alright, then I'll keep the best seat.

main2.line: These missions today are so plain. How about something more exciting? Like if I were to intentionally miss my torpedoes during today's exercise... I'm not participating in any exercise? I guess not...

main3.line: Commander, I organized your work files. The ordering might be a little different from what you're used to... That's reason enough for you to punish me, right?

mission.line: Seems you have new missions. Wanna try completing them under a time limit?

mission_complete.line: You completed a mission. About those rewards... Will you punish me if I hide them somewhere?

profile.line: I'm Maggiore Baracca. I may have a penchant for stimulating experiences, but I stop just short of getting into actual danger, so don't worry about me. And yes, I've been pranking you lately to get you mad at me. It's more exciting than playing with danger. Of course, I know my limits – I just want to see you scowl at me!

propose.line: Oh, you're serious this time? Oh, dear... You really caught me. You're awful, scolding me while presenting that thing to me. What if I said no? Will you be harder on me? This is a tough choice... but my answer is yes!

touch.line: Commander... You're gonna have to be more forceful than that.

touch2.line: Mgh... You're an audacious one, Commander... Oh, is this your way of punishing me? Okay, continue...♥

unlock.line: Ciao, Commander. I'm Maggiore Baracca, but just call me Baracca. Heehee, you look like you're lots of fun. Let's be friends♪

upgrade.line: Heehee. Someone's in for a world of pain... Oh, I was talking about the enemy, that's all!

win_mvp.line: Heheh. Told you that an improvisational fighting style is more efficient!

gift_prefer.line: Hey, Commander... There's something I want even more than this, you know...

feeling5_ex.line: It used to be that I'd prank you just to see your reaction, but now, my heart races just from being around you... Hm? I never said anything about not pranking you anymore. You scolding me is the best reward I could ask for, you know♥

headtouch_ex.line: Ugh... Even being gently headpatted makes my heart race...

home_ex.line: Welcome back. I did my work exactly as instructed. Heehee... I love how you look when you're surprised♪

login_ex.line: Commander, I've "redecorated" your office and paperwork. By that I mean I attached some pictures so you'll think of me.

main4_ex.line: Say, Commander, could I slip in under your desk? ...There's not enough room? So you believe, but I like to think I'm quite flexible.

main5_ex.line: Heehee. Let's get some serious work done today. Hm? I mean it. I want to make you happy!

main6_ex.line: How about we go outside and take a break? I'm not saying we should go anywhere dangerous, just nearby where we can run around.

touch_ex.line: Oh? Do you have a sortie story to share?

touch2_ex.line: Commander... I'm going to hug you from behind without warning as payback.

expedition.line: Oh, the commission team is back? Hmm... Alright, I'll come with you – partly to make sure you don't escape.

feeling5.line: Heehee. I'm not surprised YOU were able to beat a God like me... You think I lost on purpose? That I did. What can I say? I want to be punished so badly♥

headtouch.line: Hm? Such blasphemy, headpatting a God... Oh well, it's you, so I'll let you off the hook!

home.line: Ah, welcome back. Want a taste of these offerings to God? You are eligible to take a bite.

login.line: You came at just the right time. I just found out about a fun game... Yes, the loser has to take a punishment. Wanna play with me?

mail.line: You've received new messages? Heehee. Don't even think about asking for help. It's just you and me in here.

main1.line: Heheh... This is pretty comfortable. Do you wanna lie next to me? Sure – if you can beat me at a game. Win, and I'll let you do whatever you want!

main2.line: Oops... I "accidentally" squirted fruit juice at you. How will you punish a God such as me, I wonder?

main3.line: Weighing your soul and passing judgment accordingly is so trite. To spice things up, I came up with a few exciting games. Heehee. Since you're here, why not play with me? You're certainly not getting away if you don't!

mission.line: You have unfinished missions. Why don't we incorporate them into a game of sorts? Then it'll be easier to beat me.

mission_complete.line: Maybe I hid the mission rewards here... You'll have to come closer to find out!

touch.line: Hmm? Do you want me to judge you that badly?

touch2.line: Oh dear... I am a God, and yet you're so violent with me... Heehee. It's exciting... and novel.

unlock.line: Oh, I wasn't expecting that you'd come here, Commander. As the God of Death, I will have to pass "judgment" on you♪

battle.line: I dunno what to say. Let's go with... Ураааа!

couple_encourage1.line: Are you a bunny? That's cute.

detail.line: Lifting my lovely кролик really does make comrade Commander behave. Just as Chapayev said.

expedition.line: Comrade Commander, I will go to the pier ahead of you. I'm eager to meet everyone who's returned.

feeling1.line: You're strange, comrade Commander. Everyone tells me not to talk to strange people, but wouldn't you be lonely then...?

feeling2.line: Everyone tells me that is getting food from strange people is one thing, but making strangers *into* food is not okay.

feeling3.line: Always I get told to stay away from strange people, but you're not strange, comrade Commander. Meaning it should be fine to accept food from you.

feeling4.line: It's not decent to ask you to share your food all the time, comrade Commander. That's why I'm going to start sharing mine with you. Here, want a drink?

feeling5.line: *burp*... We've drunk all there is, comrade Commander. It feels like my drinks taste better when we enjoy them together. Let's have some more another time... *yawn*... But now, I need some sleep...

home.line: Comrade Commander, want some borscht and hot cocoa?

hp_warning.line: I haven't had enough to drink...

login.line: *burp*... Hello, comrade Commander. You followed my scent? Then how about a drink?

lose.line: Blahh... I've had a few drinks too many...

mail.line: There's nothing odd about me delivering your mail, comrade Commander. We all take turns doing it, after all.

main1.line: *burp*... Say, comrade Commander, do you know anyone else who drinks this? One with bunny ears? Interesting...

main2.line: Those "Four Unbreakables" are a cool bunch. I wish I could join them, but that's not possible 'cause that would ruin the naming convention. Very unfortunate.

main3.line: I don't like foxes or invaders, 'cause they both try to take my home from me. Once they show up, you must drive them away.

mission.line: "She who does not work, neither shall she eat," seems to be the rule here. With that in mind, we should finish these missions now so we may drink tomorrow.

mission_complete.line: Well done, comrade Commander. Now we have all the ingredients for tonight's soup.

profile.line: I am Gnevny-class destroyer Grozny. I was part of convoys, laid mines, and provided shore firing support at one point. Call for me if you have orders, comrade Commander. And if you'll let me indulge in some drinks, I'll be delighted.

propose.line: I think I like me a drink more than a ring. Here, drink this, and we'll become family, comrade Commander. Hm? You might be right; aren't we already like family...?

touch.line: Comrade Commander, is this snack my reward for my hard labor...?

touch2.line: кролик bites when it gets angry. Well, not so much bite as slice... I guess.

unlock.line: здра́вствуйте, comrade Commander. I am Gnevny-class destroyer Grozny, reporting for duty... What is the matter, comrade Commander? The item in my right hand? This is my lovely кролик. It's a cute убийца.

upgrade.line: I much prefer the Northern Parliament's drinks! *burp*!

win_mvp.line: хорошо. Now I'm getting warmed up... Huh? It's over already?

gift_prefer.line: It smells good... May I open it, comrade Commander?

detail.line: Hold on a second. Humph... Alright, I welcome you to my abode... The Manjuu looks nervous? Why's that?

expedition.line: It's warm here compared to my motherland's waters. I can drink while wearing little clothing and still be fine. *glug glug*

login.line: No need to drop off my rations today, comrade Commander. I'm not sleepy yet.

main1.line: *burp*... Drinking from a can doesn't feel the same...

main2.line: Comrade Commander, this exercise is surprisingly fun since I don't need to do any thinking. You should try it too.

main3.line: The ball and chain? It doesn't weigh much. See? Oh, sorry for startling you...

touch2.line: I don't have my кролик, so I'll have to use this ball and chain.

unlock.line: Comrade Commander, are you here to see my room? Hm? That Шутки isn't funny? Then how about... did my room come to see you, comrade Commander?

detail.line: Królik is taking the day off. It'll be stronger the next time you see it. Trust me.

home.line: Comrade Commander, there's hot cocoa and coffee. Want some?

login.line: Let's add a little sugar... Nom. Yummy. Comrade Commander, care to try a blini?

main1.line: *burp*... Warm drinks are nice.

main2.line: I want to make Królik look cuter. Any good ideas how to do that, Comrade Commander?

main3.line: Laffey, give me your rabbit ears for a second. Let's see how this looks... Hmm... It sort of fits, but not really...

mission_complete.line: Nice work, Comrade Commander. Now we're good on snacks for a long time ahead.

touch.line: Eat as many blini as you want.

touch2.line: Do you want to give Królik a swing?

unlock.line: Hmm... If I tweak Królik around a bit like this... But, it'll probably be a problem if I don't finish this in one go... Guess I'll think about it while I eat. Mhm.

battle.line: Time for action! Uraaaa!

detail.line: Akashi made these Manjuu combat robots? Mwahahah. I guess even the bourgeois cat has her useful moments... I appreciate the sponsorship.

expedition.line: Avrora? Never mind – it's the commission team. They're back.

home.line: Mwahahah... The port is mine now, Comrade Commander. Not really, just joking.

login.line: Time to get to work, Pirožkí. Roar!

mail.line: Here's your mail, Comrade Commander. Mwahahah...

main1.line: Nobody's getting through us, not even you, Comrade Commander... Hot chocolate? For me? Thanks. The entrance is over there.

main2.line: Kent's scones are so good... I'll take those as today's payment, please.

main3.line: Show me what you can do, Porta-Królik.

touch.line: Here, Pirožkí. Food.

touch2.line: Don't tempt fate, or you'll see Królik's bad side. Mwahahah...

unlock.line: Our shift starts now. Królik, Pirožkí, Manjuus – form up! Let us realize our Manjuu comrades' dreams!

win_mvp.line: *burp*... I can keep this up a while longer.

detail.line: Chang Chun styled my hair to complement this dress. Do you think it looks good, Comrade Commander?

home.line: You don't feel hot, Comrade Commander? All this tea is starting to make me sweat... I think I'm going to fan myself for a bit...

login.line: Drink your tea while it's still hot, Comrade Commander.

main1.line: Strong green tea is almost as good as hot chocolate. It sucks I can't chug it since this cup is so tiny.

main2.line: Gremyashchy and I left our weapons at Gromky's place for safekeeping. She said it's dangerous to walk around with them out.

main3.line: This fake plant looks nice... Hm? It's not fake, it's real?

touch.line: Whew. Could you give me a refill, Comrade Commander? Thanks.

touch2.line: Comrade Commander, stop doing that before I go fetch Królik.

unlock.line: *burp*... Now I think I get the appeal of tea. Why is the cup so small, though? Do you have a bigger one on hand, Comrade Commander?

detail.line: *gulp gulp*... Pfahh! That cold water hit the spot. Why'd you come here, Comrade Commander? To check on me?

expedition.line: I hope Gromky's team comes back soon... I'm going to melt soon...

home.line: You wanna join me, Comrade Commander? I'll shuffle over. There. I'll go get some borscht and chocolate mix.

login.line: *gulp gulp*... Pfahh! Ahh, I'm coming back to life... Oh, need to give myself a little splash... Urgh, now I spilled my borscht...

lose.line: My whole world... is spinning...

main1.line: *gulp gulp*... Pfahh! The more I drink, the hotter it gets... Must be because I'm drinking HOT chocolate. Makes sense...

main2.line: There's many ways to enjoy a sauna? Really, huh... How do you usually do it, Comrade Commander?

main3.line: Us Northern Parliament girls can handle the cold, but heat, not so much. It's not what we're used to... Between hot and cold, which do you handle best, Comrade Commander?

mission.line: We'll take a cold bath after the mission? Okay. Be quick.

touch.line: I'm getting dizzy again...

touch2.line: That's odd... I haven't even cracked open the vodka...

unlock.line: Uughh... Ooohh... Królik is melting... *gasp*! I'm getting lightheaded... Comrade Commander, fetch me some ice...

win_mvp.line: Khorosho. But now my drink has gone warm... I can't drink this!

battle.line: Can you keep up with me? Ура!

couple_encourage1.line: Woah, Avrora, you're totally inspir... I mean, shining today!

detail.line: Heheh~ Comrade Commander, have you come to participate in my new inspired experiment?

expedition.line: Commission complete! Hehe, first, we have to welcome everyone back!

feeling1.line: Comrade Commander, you're really quite an insipid person. You won't score any admirers that way.

feeling2.line: Comrade Commander, if you want people to like you, you've gotta be an interesting person yourself! In other words, what you need is a dose of inspiration!

feeling3.line: Ahaha... Comrade Commander, we're already friends, right? So, uh, when they come to collect debts, could you... Hey, wait, why are you running!

feeling4.line: Comrade Commander, I thought you were a real hardass, but turns out, you're actually quite interesting! You have quite a lot of ideas of your own... and most importantly, you don't chew me out when I mess up! Hahaha!

feeling5.line: All right, I finally understand now! I've finally reached a conclusion as to why I'm always thinking about you! So here's my hypothesis: I'm in love with you! Hehe, does that sound right?

home.line: I can't control my overflowing inspiration! Even though you just came back, I can't...

hp_warning.line: Looks like it's time for me to get serious!

login.line: Comrade Commander, you came at just the right time! I just had a flash of inspiration and came up with a new strategy! Come test it out with me!

lose.line: Woah, woah, time out! I'm not ready to retreat yet! Waaah!

mail.line: Ah, um... Just give me a minute to come up with an explanation as to what I'm doing in this room full of mail...

main1.line: Gangut...? Err, I mean, Comrade Gangut? Hmm, she kind of scares me...

main2.line: My fighting spirit, just like my inspiration, is unbreakable! That's right, I'll stand back up again!

main3.line: When I mess up, I make sure to apologize profusely! That way, everyone will forgive me... hopefully.

mission.line: Comrade Commander, wait until you hear about the latest idea I got! Hey, wait, don't run away!

mission_complete.line: Long live the rewards! Err, so, where's my share?

profile.line: I'm the Project 38 destroyer, Minsk. I fought in the Great War alongside my sisters! Comrade Commander, expect great things from my inspiration... and my hard work!

propose.line: This means we've signed off a lifelong contract! Comrade Commander, we'll always be together from here on out! Don't worry, don't worry, I'll be gentle!

touch.line: Hm? Did you stumble into your own inspiration, Comrade Commander?

touch2.line: Eh...?! Is this revenge for something I did?!

unlock.line: Ура! How's that, what'd ya think? Huh? Where I'm from, they said you're supposed to surprise the people you're greeting! What, I'm the one being welcomed?! Sorry, I mixed something up!

upgrade.line: Woahh! I'm getting inspired again!

win_mvp.line: How's that? My power is surging! That's right, don't get jealous!

gift_prefer.line: Спасибо! You get me, Comrade Commander!

detail.line: Fools, dance for your overlord~♪

feeling5.line: Congratulations, Comrade Commander, you've completed your sentence~ Well, even without your sentence, I'll still be supervising you for the rest of your life. After all, your next sentence is "staying with Minsk forever!"

home.line: Prisoner, exercise time is over! Hurry up and get back into the office!

login.line: Entrust your faith with god, and entrust your body with me! That's right, you're in my jail now!

main1.line: If you try to escape again, I'll slap more time onto your sentence? Huh? You weren't given a sentence in the first place? Eh, don't sweat the details~

main2.line: Hehe, you think you can stage a jailbreak? I'd like to see you try, Comrade Commander!

main3.line: When I'm not patrolling, I'm writing reports... this jailor business is super boring! Hey, one of you prisoners, write the reports for me!

touch.line: Heheh~ Do you want to get tased that badly~?

touch2.line: Congratulations, you've earned yourself a one-way ticket to a Siberian potato-digging trip! Sign right here, and enjoy~!

unlock.line: You've violated the Minsk Protocol, comrade! Therefore, the sentence appropriate for you is imprisonment! Until when? Obviously, until your jailor is satisfied~♪

battle.line: Let's beat them to a pulp! Ура!

couple_encourage1.line: Unlike you, I don't have anyone to enjoy Sardegnian cooking with...

couple_encourage2.line: When we get serious, nothing can keep us down!

detail.line: Did you come to watch me practice? ...So, are you staying or what?

expedition.line: Dear comrade, did you forget about the commissions? Are you dumb? Even I remembered.

feeling1.line: Stay away from me, moron.

feeling2.line: Do you need me for anything, dear comrade? I'm busy, so make it quick... Oh, is that so...? You just wanted to play? Well, I suppose I have some time to burn, so...

feeling3.line: With a nickname like "the Blue Cruiser," you'd expect me to be someone who's cute and well-behaved right? People are always disillusioned as all hell after meeting me... and, well, I can't blame them. What do you think, dear comrade?

feeling4.line: I'm just a normal girl. I don't want special treatment or anything. The same goes for you, dear comrade, I'm sure of it...

feeling5.line: I don't really know anyone here, but everyone seems to genuinely like me. That's even after knowing what kind of person I am, so I want to be better. Of course I feel the same way about you, dear comrade. After all, I like you!

home.line: Welcome back. ...Tea? Nah, I have vodka though.

hp_warning.line: I won't concede defeat!

login.line: Is it that fun staring at Tashkent? ...Is that so? Well, do as you please.

lose.line: Curses! Tashkent can still fight!

mail.line: I brought the mail. You don't have to thank me for it or anything.

main1.line: I was born in Sardegna, so I'm quite familiar with their cuisine. Well, it's not like it matters if the people here like that kind of food.

main2.line: Why is so g'damn hot here? Dear comrade, go turn the air conditioning on for me?♡

main3.line: How strange... It's not like I make any effort to be friendly or sociable, so why do people end up liking me more? Hey, do you know why that might be, dear comrade?

mission.line: Missions? Is there anything that looks interesting?

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards, huh... Lemme take a look. So...? Is there any food?

profile.line: I'm Tashkent, flotilla leader destroyer from the Northern Parliament. There are three other... actually, nevermind. I'm called the "Blue Cruiser" because of my Sardegna-style construction. Of course, I'm a destroyer, and I have nothing against that. I'll put up results just like I did during the Battle of Sevastopol, so look forward to it.

propose.line: So, this was the important thing you were telling me about? ...Sure, I'll take it. ...What, didn't I already tell you before that I like you? So, nothing wrong with us getting married, right?

skill.line: I'll have you witness my true power!

touch.line: What is it? Oh, you have work for me? Is that so... Fine, I'll take care of it.

touch2.line: Eh...? What are you trying to do? Are the puffy balls on my outfit that interesting?

unlock.line: I'm Tashkent. Some call me the Blue Cruiser. Another comrade who wants to woo me? It's just about recruitment...? I see. What a hopeless fellow you are.

upgrade.line: It's my turn to fight? ...Is that so? Fine, I'll do it.

win_mvp.line: Ура! Did you witness my true power!

gift_prefer.line: While it doesn't compare to the honor of receiving my guard's commission, I am happy to accept this.

detail.line: Dear comrade, how long are you going to keep me like this? ...Is that so... Ehh? Forever?!

expedition.line: You can't lift the mission rewards? ...Is that so? What a wimp. Here, I'll do it for you. I can leave it over here, right?

home.line: Welcome back. We're all throwing a big party tonight. ...I'm not lying! I'm going to invite everyone from the Northern Parliament over!

login.line: Dear comrade, do you really think you can keep me bound like this? ...Is that so? Naive fool. Hehe~

main1.line: I knew there was something... wrong about that chocolate... I never thought this would happen to me... my head's still spinning...

main2.line: When I was talking to Zara, she said I look more appealing in this outfit. So... what do you think, dear comrade?

main3.line: I'm not like Avrora. I can't drink at all... Ah, wait, I'm not talking about vodka!

touch2.line: Wait, I'm not okay with this role reversal! I should be the one touching you, dear comrade!

unlock.line: ...*Sigh*, I never thought I'd get captured by these little guys... Dear comrade, does Tashkent really have to play along with this?

win_mvp.line: Heheh, not a bad display of power, right?

detail.line: I look really "dangerous" right now? What's so dangerous about me...? I think... you're the dangerous one, dear comrade.

home.line: Zara's crew brought me some snacks from Sardegna. Would you like some, dear comrade?

login.line: I'm still a bit sleepy, but if you insist on playing with me, dear comrade... perhaps I can spare some time for you.

lose.line: Zzz... So tired...

main1.line: Dear comrade, do you like stuffed animals too? ...Um, here. You can have this bear.

main2.line: Why do so many people want to play with me? I just want to stay indoors and slack...

touch.line: Button up...? ...Tell you what, dear comrade. How about you come here and help me?

touch2.line: You're messing my clothes up even more...

unlock.line: Urrk... Who dares disturb Tashkent's slumber? ...Oh, it's you, dear comrade? Um, in that case... I can always get more rest later. Is something the matter?

detail.line: How do you see me right now, dear comrade? I'm curious. Very curious... Mhm.

feeling5.line: Mmph. Where should we continue, dear comrade? Continue what? Our time alone together, obviously. I love you, dear comrade, so... isn't it normal for me to try and be alone with you?

home.line: Good work, dear comrade. Here... A relaxing hug.

login.line: Mmph. Welcome back, dear comrade. Come sit next to me~ What do you think of me today, I wonder? ...Oh, really?♪

lose.line: This getup just doesn't work with me...

main1.line: Dear comrade, you've been staring. You must really like this look. ...It's refreshing because of how unlike me it is? Well, well. Should I be more unlike my usual self...?

main2.line: My face is hot... Dear comrade, you're a little too close... No, too close is just fine...

main3.line: Dear comrade, want to lie your head in my lap? I could even clean your ears for you as a bonus. Heheh, I've kept up with my studies. Don't think I'll take no for an answer, dear comrade.

mission.line: Dear comrade... Even if you get a little lightheaded like me... Mmph. You gotta do those missions~

mission_complete.line: Your mission rewards are here? Mmh, I wonder if they gave you anything that can clear my head...

touch.line: Hm? You wanna lie down? Next to me?

touch2.line: Oh, yeah. You do love doing this, dear comrade...

unlock.line: Mmph. There you are, dear comrade. I've been waiting... Oh, yeah. I'm not done yet, so... do you wanna relax with me for a bit before you go?

battle.line: Ура! Let's get this show on the road!

couple_encourage1.line: That girl... is it even possible to dance like that?!

detail.line: I've always been good at dancing, and I trust that my vocal skills won't disappoint either... Still worried about me, dear comrade? ...So, you're too much of a worrywart. I can handle this.

expedition.line: The commission has been completed. Even if I'm an idol, I can't neglect my normal line of duty.

feeling1.line: I can do this by myself... I don't need your help.

feeling2.line: Are you looking forward to my idol debut? Is that so... Well, considering this is an armament test and whatnot, I guess I can put in a little effort.

feeling3.line: Dear comrade, are you concerned about our teamwork? Heh, there's no need for concern. This kind of cooperation is second nature to us girls from the Northern Parliament.

feeling4.line: It really is hard to express our individuality while performing as a group... Even though my dear comrade was concerned, I still... Oh, what is it? Did you come to help me...?

feeling5.line: Dear comrade, what do you think of me now? ...Is that so. Look, I've taken lessons with the others and performed on stage. You don't need to worry about me anymore, for real this time. Hehe~♪

headtouch.line: Are you seriously giving me the kiddie treatment? Hmph!

home.line: Cola and tea, chocolate milk, juice, and vodka... Everyone's back all right... Dear comrade, what would you like?

hp_warning.line: My dear comrade is watching me...!

login.line: Dear comrade, please go over our daily itinerary with us.

lose.line: Were we out of step? But why...?

mail.line: Looks like work from the agency. Dear comrade, let's look it over before showing it to Baltimore's group?

main1.line: The other experimental ships all have instruments? Is that so? I don't plan on losing to anyone, no matter who they might be.

main2.line: That Albacore really is something... She's got ideas for everything from costumes to choreography.

main3.line: It's hard to keep your dance steps in sync... If you're just singing, you can pretty much hear how things are going. But if you're focused on dancing, you can't always be looking at the others.

mission.line: Dear comrade, there's work to do. Come on, let's get to it.

mission_complete.line: That should wrap things up! You did pretty well!

profile.line: I'm Tashkent, destroyer from the Northern Parliament, and now an idol participating in the experimental Muse System. I'll show you the tenacity of the Northern Parliament.

propose.line: Heheh~ You're still too naive, dear comrade. There's no way I'd be satisfied with just being one star in a constellation. I'll shine the brightest of them all! That's why you shouldn't take your eyes off me even for a second~♪

skill.line: Don't even think about looking away!

touch.line: Chocolate for me? Is that so... Thanks for the support, dear comrade.

touch2.line: D-dear comrade?!

unlock.line: How do you like my outfit, dear comrade? ...Is that so? After all of Tashkent's work to become an idol, that's how you react? Hmph. Just you wait. My next concert will rock your socks off.

upgrade.line: Guess it's time to get serious. Hehe.

win_mvp.line: This victory is a testament to my abilities, not just that of the Muse System!

gift_prefer.line: Big thankies, comrade! *cough* *cough*... F-forget what you just heard!

battle.line: Stremitelny, setting sail!

couple_encourage1.line: C'mon, just give me a little taste!

detail.line: Everyone in the Northern Parliament likes calling each other "comrade." Comrade Commander! I'm Comrade Stremitelny! ...Buuuut, that's a heck of a mouthful, so I'm just gonna call you Commander!

expedition.line: I'll go greet the friends coming back from their commission! ...I'm not going to throw snowballs at them!

feeling1.line: I hate you! Stay away! One step closer and I'm gonna pummel you with snowballs!

feeling2.line: My snowballs are gentle! There are no rocks or bits of ice inside, only softness!

feeling3.line: Secret technique! Snow down the back of your neck! That oughta freshen you back up, or so Minsk said! ...Um, Commander... You're not upset, are you?

feeling4.line: Are you cold, Commander? C'mere! Come stick your hands here where it's nice and fluffy! ...Hehe, aren't I super nice?

feeling5.line: Come build snowmen with me, Commander! You'll make one, I'll make one, and then we can have them hold hands, just like we're doing now! Ehehe~

headtouch.line: Geh, you meanie! You're gonna make my hat come off!

home.line: My sisters said that I'm not allowed to drink vodka because that stuff melts snowballs or something... Uhh, somehow that doesn't sound quite right...

hp_warning.line: I hate airplanes! Shoo, go away!

login.line: Hurry up and come play in the snow with me!

lose.line: Ehhhhh?! How could I lose?!

mail.line: Your mail's here! Catch~! ...Eh, I'm not allowed to throw it...?

main1.line: Chang Chun and I were looking into a way to retrofit our naval guns into snowball launchers. Eh, that's not allowed..?

main2.line: Why am I called Snezhok? Well, it means "Little Snowball," and I'm a little cutie who likes snowballs.

main3.line: During the winter, you can have snowball fights, build snowmen, and wear fuzzy clothing! Winter's the best!

mission.line: Commander, are you letting your missions pile up like snow on the branches?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Wooooohoo~!

profile.line: So, I'm Stremitelny of the Gnevny class. My friends and I did some escort missions as well as coastal support operations! Commander, if there's anything I can help with, just say the word!

propose.line: Hauuu... My face is burning hot, like I'm gonna melt for real! But... if I can melt right into your heart like this... that wouldn't be half bad. Ehehe~

touch.line: Do you like playing with snowballs too?

touch2.line: Now I'm angry! Take this! And this! And this!

unlock.line: Way! Too! Slow! Why'd it take you so long to find me?! That's right! I'm Stremitelny of the Gnevny class, but you can also call me by my nickname, Snezhok! Anyway, here's a snowball to commemorate our meeting, catch~!

upgrade.line: Snowball fight or gunfight, I feel like I can't lose!

win_mvp.line: Hehe, victory! Commander, I want a prize!

gift_prefer.line: I want it!

detail.line: Pamiat Merkuria is way above my skill level... Oh, I know! Commander, practice with me so I can get better!

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Uh-huh... Okay, okay! I'll do it next time, I promise, just go and greet them this time for me! Please!

home.line: *yaaawn*... Hm? What time is it? Eh, guess I'll boot up the console and play something... Wait, no! I've gotta get eady for work!

login.line: Whoa! When'd you come in here, Commander? Never mind, let's just play video games!

main1.line: Whew, I'm tired! I'm gonna put on my sleep mask and catch some z's! ...Dang, not happening?

main2.line: Rekordny! An Shan! I know you've got games in your room! You can try to hide your power level, but you're also a gamer, aren't you?

main3.line: I learned a ton of gaming trivia from Pamiat Merkuria!

touch.line: O-one more round! If you win this one, then I'll get up and do work!

unlock.line: It sucks not being able to play in the snow... Oh well! I'll play some games instead! Commander, let's play something fun together!

detail.line: Wait a minute~ I'm double-checking your condition to ensure there won't be any negative drug interactions! You gotta be careful with medicine!

feeling5.line: Take your medicine and get well soon! When you feel better, let's build a snowman! Heheh, I've already thought of what kind, too! We'll build two snowmen hugging each other! As for how to make them hug, uhh... Let's figure that out when you're better!

headtouch.line: I'm a qualified nurse, I'll have you know! I studied everything I need to know!

home.line: Does your head still hurt? Hmm... I hear massages are good for headaches. Lie down, Commander! I'll massage you! ...Huh?! You wanna lie in my lap?!

login.line: Sit down already! I'll get you painkillers! Uhh, let's see... Here! I got water, too, so take them.

main1.line: Take your medicine exactly when it says to, or else I'll throw a snowball at you... Just kidding! You're sick, so it's my job to take good care of you!

main2.line: Is it boring working night shifts? Nope. This is my job, so don't you worry about me. Take your meds and rest~

main3.line: If your head still hurts, how about trying this new painkiller? I hear it works great! ...No? Heheh, are you scared of syringes, Commander? I'm not! Heheheh!

mission.line: You've still got so many missions even though you're sick... Being a Commander is rough! But I'll help!

touch.line: You're going back to your room? I'll walk you there!

touch2.line: You still have the energy for this stuff?! Say, are you faking being sick...?

unlock.line: Huh?! Commander, why did you walk here?! If you're feeling bad, just press the call button... Ugh, you can't walk around at night when you're sick! Grrr!

battle.line: I'm good on fuel. Only thing left to do is dispatch the enemy!

couple_encourage1.line: I'll protect you.

couple_encourage2.line: Don't be reckless, huh... You too.

couple_encourage3.line: Friends...

couple_encourage4.line: C-can I have some of that?

detail.line: What are you ogling me for? Are you some sort of creep?

expedition.line: Commission team's come back. I kind of expected that you knew that already.

feeling1.line: ...Why exactly are you still here?

feeling2.line: I've always got my eyes on you. Mm, that's all.

feeling3.line: You might fool Gromky, but you can't fool me. If I catch you doing anything questionable, I won't hesitate to whack you with this thing. Mm, that'll be all.

feeling4.line: You're awfully good at putting on faces. Unless... you're actually an honest, decent person after all? I guess I'll give you the benefit of the doubt for now. Mm, that'll be all.

feeling5.line: All right, you're a decent person, I'll give you that. Huh? You want me to... be with you, forever? Ummmm... I-I need to think about, that's all...

headtouch.line: Cut it out. My hat's gonna fall off.

home.line: Here, some cookies Gromky made. As your reward for a job well done.
