hp_warning.line: I've been hurt. Mm, that's all...

login.line: You've got lots of work to do. Like, that huge stack of papers on your desk.

lose.line: Ugh... That was a pretty garbage battle...

mail.line: Check your mail, yadda yadda. If you don't, I'll just throw it away. Mm, that's all.

main1.line: One whack with this thing dispatches any and all bugs and creeps. Mm, that's all.

main2.line: Bad things happen to people who anger Gromky. Watch yourself, Commander.

main3.line: Slacking on the job, huh... Maybe I'll tell Gromky about this.

mission.line: That's a whole lot of unfinished missions...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. You know the drill, claim the rewards. Mm, that's all.

profile.line: I'm Gremyashchy, Grozny-class destroyer. I didn't just do escort missions, I squared off with enemy destroyers and rescued allies too. I've done almost everything, save for dealing with aircraft carriers, so I'm fit for pretty much any mission. Mm, that's all.

propose.line: I've sailed through bad weather and finished countless tough escort missions. If I can do that, then I can promise to follow you anywhere you go, Commander. Mm, that'll be all.

touch.line: ...You need something?

touch2.line: Th-that confirms it, you're a creep...

unlock.line: Gremyashchy, Northern Parliament destroyer. I'll do what I need to do, so don't bother me for the other stuff. Mm, that's all.

upgrade.line: Thanks for making me stronger. Yeah, that's all.

win_mvp.line: That takes care of the enemies. I guess that's all.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you. I'll take it.

detail_ex.line: What are you ogling me for? I don't see what you get out of this...

home_ex.line: You've earned three cookies for today's sorties. Mm, that'll be all. Now say "aah."

login_ex.line: You've got all this work to do before the end of the day? ...I guess we just have to make a miracle happen...

lose_ex.line: Next time, do your job and command properly.

main3_ex.line: Hmh. Just so you know, Gromky, the Commander isn't slacking on the job. Mhm, that's all.

main4_ex.line: You always drink tea with me, so why do you leave all the cookies to me? ...You'd rather I eat all I want? Huh, I see...

mission_ex.line: Are you ignoring all these missions, hoping they'll go away? Yikes...

touch2_ex.line: Uhh, woaaaahhhhh...

detail.line: Gromky's looking for me? Ugh... I don't wanna go outside. But I'd feel bad about telling her to buzz off, and pretending to be sick would worry her... Hrmmm...

feeling5.line: Wanna read this book with me, Commander? This one. It's called "The Happy Lovebirds." If we read it together, I might just be able to figure out what it's about. Mm, that's all.

home.line: So many books lying around... Oh, Commander, I could use your help returning these books to the shelf when you come back.

login.line: I got up to this part just the other day. Time to read the rest. Mm, that's all.

mail.line: There's a letter for you. Can I keep the stamp? Mm, thanks.

main1.line: If you wanna lounge around, do it over there. Mm, that's all.

main2.line: Mmmh... *yaaaaawn*... Huh?! Oh no, don't tell me I dozed off... You didn't see anything, got it? I mean, of course you didn't!

main3.line: Retivy... I mean, Tai Yuan, and I shared our recommended book lists. It turns out we've got pretty similar tastes. Heheh.

mission.line: You could fill a whole book with all these unfinished mission drafts...

touch.line: Want me to read aloud for you, or...?

touch2.line: I-I knew it! You are a creep...!

unlock.line: Wh-who gave you the right to just barge in? ...I did? Huh. Well, seeing as you're here, I guess we could read a book together. Mm, that's all.

battle.line: All our powers, combined into one!

couple_encourage1.line: Hey, Snezhok! Let's get this snowball fight started!

couple_encourage2.line: How nostalgic!

couple_encourage3.line: Calm down! ...That goes for me, too!

couple_encourage4.line: Is that borscht on the inside?

detail.line: Eh? What's wrong, Comrade? Why are you staring at me like that... Did I do something weird?

expedition.line: They're coming back with some precious supplies over there!

feeling1.line: Comrade Commander... Are you a bad person...?

feeling2.line: Comrade Commander, how were you able to build such a cohesive fleet? Please teach me your ways!

feeling3.line: Have you been getting along with Gremyashchy? She's a bit rough to get along with at first, but if you're patient enough with her, I'm sure you'll be able to get along with her just fine in the future! I believe in you, Comrade Commander!

feeling4.line: Comrade Commander! Do you prefer food when it has a deeper taste, or do you prefer it if it's lighter? Mmn, alright. I'll try to make sure the borscht I make next time is just to your tastes, Comrade Commander!

feeling5.line: Comrade Commander, great work today! Here's a piping hot drink... along with some bliny... and... hehe, a warm hug from me!

headtouch.line: Hehe, Comrade, did you also want to play with my little buddy?

home.line: Nothing's better than some blini to fill up your weary and hungry belly! Which would you like, honey or jam?

hp_warning.line: T-There's a crack in the rigging?!

login.line: Woah! Comrade, you sure are early today! You know, you can get a bit more rest if you'd like...

lose.line: Owww... I didn't think the enemy would be this organized...

mail.line: Here are some letters! Is there anything you were looking forward to?

main1.line: Comrade Commander, you musn't slack off! I swear, I'll get mad at you!

main2.line: For troublesome issues, let us all gather to face it together! That's the way we do it at the Northern Parliament, after all!

main3.line: Comrade Commander, if your hands are cold, feel free to use my sleeves! They're nice and warm, aren't they~

mission.line: Let's start with the easier missions! Here, I'll help out too!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Unity is strength!

profile.line: Just so you know, I've done missions with ships from both the Northern Parliament and the Royal Navy! I've also escorted icebreaker ships, and rescued ships along with Gremyashchy! Yep, may we always have fair winds and following seas!

propose.line: I can feel the warmth of happiness radiating from the ring...! Ehehe~ Comrade Commander, thank you very much! I'll continue to be by your side from here on out!

touch.line: There there, what a good commander you are~ Hmm? Isn't this what you wanted?

touch2.line: I swear, I'll get mad at you, Comrade Commander!

unlock.line: Goooood morning, Comrade! I'm the Northern Parliament destroyer, Gromky! It's an honor to serve alongside everyone in this fleet!

upgrade.line: As long as I can be of more use to everyone...!

win_mvp.line: It's all thanks to everyone's hard work!

gift_prefer.line: Thanks, Comrade Commander!

detail_ex.line: Why are you staring at me like that? ...Ah! Did you want me to pat your head! ...Huh? That's not it?

home_ex.line: Comrade Commander, your reward for today's battle is... you can have as many blini as you'd like! Ehehe~

login_ex.line: Heyy! You can't get up yet! Didn't I tell you to get more rest?

main1_ex.line: Comrade Commander, you mustn't slack off! ...Huh? You want me to come relax with you? I, I guess I can't get mad at that... Wait, hey! Get back to work!

win_mvp_ex.line: You've worked real hard, haven't you? Good job, good job~!

detail.line: Comrade Commander, what did you do to make the paper airplane go so fast? That's so cool!

headtouch.line: I don't hate it when you stroke my hair so... Hold on, you're doing it too roughly!

home.line: Comrade Commander! You musn't fall back asleep! Don't. Fall. Back. Asleep. You. Stupid. Commander!!!

login.line: Good morning, Comrade Commander! Hehe, my little friend here is greeting you too!

mail.line: Here are some letters! Comrade Commander, hurry up and take a look at them!

main1.line: Hey, Snezhok! Don't just sit there in the room and play games all day! Come on, get a move on it, will you?

main2.line: This paper crane is supposed to be Reshitelny... Chang Chun was the one who taught me how to make these! Hehe~

main3.line: When I'm standing here, I can reach your head, Commander! Good job, Comrade Commander! Ehehe~

mission.line: Comrade Commander, let's do our best to take care of these missions! Yay!

touch.line: You want to know if I'm cold right now? I'm totally fine! Look, the weather's so nice right now!

touch2.line: Comrade Commander~ Take a seat! Don't you dare try to run away! Stay still, right over there, until I finish talking to you!

unlock.line: Comrade! The morning is already here! Look how high the sun is in the sky!! C'mon, a wonderful day is calling to us~!!

battle.line: Now we shall all find out whose equipment is superior!

couple_encourage1.line: What do you say we build something together?

couple_encourage2.line: Whoa! A spark of ingenuity!

detail.line: Dust is a mechanic's mortal enemy! But, I have managed to prevent its spread by cleaning every nook and cranny of my workshop daily! My foresight is impeccable! Mwah-ha-ha-haah!

expedition.line: Commission supplies! Let's see what we have... Hmm, this steel container looks strong... I could find some use for it! Hah-ha-haah!

feeling1.line: Others can fix your machines when they break, but only you can make up for the mistakes you've made, Comrade!

feeling2.line: In contrast to the beauty of Mother Nature, the beauty of machinery lies in its unique status as the culmination of millennia of humanity's technological development! That is why I'm so in love with it all!

feeling3.line: Hmgh! Hurmph! ...What am I up to? Working on my rigging, obviously. Don't worry about the parts rough around the edges – I'll just sandpaper those down later! Ahh-ha-ha-haah!

feeling4.line: Would you be interested in building a small device, Comrade? I don't mean rigging repair tools, I mean something practical you yourself could use! Of course, you'll have a genius to teach you every step of the process!

feeling5.line: It's true I talk about machinery all day, and yes, I build and tinker day in and day out, but that doesn't mean I'm a mechaphile or that I want to date a robot... Y-you see what I'm getting at, right?!

headtouch.line: Being a genius mechanic, I of course made these safety goggles myself! They provide flawless eye protection while I'm building!

home.line: Exemplary work, everyone! Is anyone in need of rigging repairs, by any chance? I'll fix and improve it so it works as good as new – guaranteed!

hp_warning.line: Th-th-this is mechanically impossible!

login.line: Splendid – you're back, Comrade! ...What's that noise you're hearing? Oh, it's nothing! I'm just giving your office machinery some ingenious upgrades!

lose.line: How come I've stopped moving?! Come on, rigging! Why aren't you working?!

mail.line: New mail has arrived! ...WHAAAT?! The parts I ordered are STILL in transit?!

main1.line: Strain your ears and listen closely! The rotations of the bearings, the tension in the levers, the rigging's rhythmic ticking! The beat of an enchanting machine!

main2.line: Plastic? Absolutely NOT! Who in their right mind would make components out of a material with zero reliability compared to metal?!

main3.line: Clean though your office may seem at a glance, I can tell there is dust hidden all over! It's time to do some cleaning, Comrade!

mission.line: We've received new missions! Listen, Comrade - they may look hard, but that's no excuse to put them off!

mission_complete.line: Whew! That's that mission completed! All thanks to my peerless genius! Hah-ha-haah!

profile.line: I am Storozhevoy-class destroyer Soobrazitelny, present mechanical mastermind and former member of the Black Sea Fleet! I've survived battles against numerous relentless adversaries, all through my sheer ingenuity and just a hint of luck!

propose.line: My prediction was spot-on – I knew you'd make the first move! Heheheh! I love you too, Comrade! One might say... My love for you is as strong as the hardest steel! ...Maybe that analogy doesn't make sense, but you know what I'm trying to say! Hahahah!

touch.line: Don't be shy! Pet it to your heart's content! ...What? You weren't talking about my rigging?

touch2.line: Th-this is no way to treat a girl...!

unlock.line: Ahh-ha-ha-haah! Comrade! I am Soobrazitelny, the Northern Parliament's genius mechanic! Look no further than me for all matters related to machinery!

upgrade.line: Rigging upgrade: complete! My genius knows no bounds! Hah-hah-haah!

win_mvp.line: Ahh-ha-ha-haah! Dispatching you cretins was as easy as tightening a screw!

gift_prefer.line: This is incredible! I'll repay you, Comrade, mark my words!

battle_ex.line: Brutes like you deserve brutish answers – punches!

detail_ex.line: WHAT?! Dust is upon us! Comrade, open the window at once! Or else your screens will be ruined!

feeling5_ex.line: You needn't worry, Comrade! I may be obsessed with machinery, but I could never forget about you, my dear lover! On that note, why don't we go on a date to that toy store which opened just today? It supposedly has tons of mechanical toys on offer!

home_ex.line: Allow me to fix up your escort ship, Comrade! While I'm at it, do you want any new additions? Like a massage chair, for instance.

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Comrade! Oh, mind your step around the components on the floor! Without really thinking, I turned your office into a second workshop. Hah-ha-ha-haah!

main4_ex.line: The grinding of gears, the whizzing of a propeller, the ringing that tickles my heart... Whuh?! Hey! What are you touching me for, Comrade?!

main5_ex.line: Another one of plastic's shortcomings is the difficulty in fixing it. How so? Well, if I were to WHACK it, it would simply break – unlike metal.

main6_ex.line: Comrade! What are your thoughts on the Soobrazitelny-brand Automatic Door Closer? Now you'll never need to close the door manually again! I'll fix the frame damage caused during installation later!

mission_ex.line: We have new missions! Comrade! With me by your side, you have nothing to fear!

mission_complete_ex.line: With your commanding and my ingenuity, we could finish these missions with our eyes closed!

touch_ex.line: Whereas metal is tough and sleek, your touch is soft and calming.

touch2_ex.line: Fweh?!

win_mvp_ex.line: Success! Hoh-ha-ha-hah! Victory for the galaxy-brained mechanic!

battle.line: Go forth, my Mechajuu minions!

detail.line: Nuoooo! I spilled your cup of coffee, Comrade! This is bad! Terrible, even!

home.line: Welcome back, hun~♡ Could you give me a hand with this experiment? ......That cold stare of yours is hurting my feelings.

login.line: What is it, Mechajuu? ...Ah, Commander! I've been waiting for your arrival!

main1.line: Quite the useful fish tank we have here... Or, is it technically an aquarium? I confuse the two sometimes...

main2.line: This outfit makes me look both intelligent and sexy at the same time. What an ingenious combination! Mwah-ha-ha-haah!

main3.line: The screen went black again! So be it... Hurmph! Owwww! I forgot I'm not wearing my regular gloves!

touch.line: Has anything got you stumped? I can give you a lesson – assuming it's within my sphere!

touch2.line: Mhaahh♡ I-I told you, I won't do anything crazy!

unlock.line: Yes, these data and results are quite interesting... Though they mean nothing to me! I am a genius mechanic, not an analyst! Ahh-ha-ha-haah!

win_mvp.line: Time to gather data! ...Um, what exactly am I meant to do?

battle.line: There's no ice I cannot break through!

couple_encourage1.line: We fight together, for the Commander.

detail.line: Are you free, Commander? Do you wanna... hang out?

expedition.line: Our commission comrades are back. Seeing all their smiling faces makes me envious...

feeling1.line: Am I the cause of your sadness? Would you cheer up if I simply... disappeared?

feeling2.line: Do you think I'm cold? Or unapproachable? That's something I want to change about myself, but I don't know how...

feeling3.line: More people are willing to talk to me than before... I think that's thanks to you, Commander. Thank you.

feeling4.line: I've made many new friends with your help... But you're my first, and still closest friend. I want to get even closer to you. Are you fine with that?

feeling5.line: Whenever we're apart, or whenever you're about to leave, my heart aches like it's being torn in two... I want to always, always be with you. Will you stay with me?

headtouch.line: I love it when you pet me. I need more... Please?

home.line: Commander! Oh, uhh... I know you're safe and sound, I just wanted to see you again as soon as possible... That's fine, right?

hp_warning.line: I'll stop at nothing for the Commander...!

login.line: Commander, umm... Is it fine if I wait for you outside the office next time, too?

lose.line: Abandoning my comrades to save myself... I refuse to do that!

mail.line: There's mail for you. I think it's important. Are you fine with me fetching it?

main1.line: Huff, puff... There... Ah, I just thought I'd write something on the window.

main2.line: I'll show no mercy to anyone that tries to harm you. Assisting you and protecting you are one and the same to me.

main3.line: Growing flowers are way beyond me. The only plants I can be trusted with are cacti... They can survive even if you neglect them.

mission.line: This mission sounds tough... Can you handle it, Commander?

mission_complete.line: Someone should claim these mission rewards... Is it fine if I do it?

profile.line: My name is Kiev. I was to be a Project 48-class destroyer, but I was never born for a number of reasons... I'm glad to have you as my first-ever Commander.

propose.line: To think I'm taking an oath with the one I love... I'm overjoyed, blissful, warm inside, thawing like snow under the sun into a puddle... Commander, is it fine if I... melt in your arms?

skill.line: We're fighting on MY terms now!

touch.line: I wanna come closer... Is that fine?

touch2.line: My chest feels... so warm...

unlock.line: I'm Kiev, Project 48-class destroyer of the Northern Parliament. From now on, I'll be assisting you with all manner of things, Commander... W-was that, umm, a good enough introduction?

upgrade.line: We can't forego routine maintenance and upgrades. Right?

win_mvp.line: All foes are down. Commander, did I, um... do alright?

gift_prefer.line: I've always wanted this... Can I really have it?

battle_ex.line: Just have to fight... Everything will go fine!

detail_ex.line: Are you free, Commander? I could... kill some time. Are you fine with hanging out?

expedition_ex.line: Our commission comrades are back. They told me about some interesting things they saw... Do you wanna know, Commander?

feeling5_ex.line: I want to be the only one for you. Of all the girls close to you, I want to be your most faithful one. When you look at all of us, I want to be the only one you really see... That's fine, right?

home_ex.line: You're back by my side again... Phew. Now I feel fine.

login_ex.line: I will always be right here, waiting for you, Commander. You're fine with that, I hope?

lose_ex.line: Please never leave me behind. I promise I will keep you safe.

main4_ex.line: Huff, puff... There... I wrote your name and mine in the fog on the window. This looks fine, right?

main5_ex.line: I never wanna become a cactus. If I could grow in spite of neglect, then I worry people would actually abandon me...

mission_ex.line: New missions... They're not so tough when I have you.

mission_complete_ex.line: Are you... gonna go claim the mission rewards? Would it be fine if I went with you?

touch2_ex.line: Umm... (*blushes*)

battle.line: ...They've caught on to us? Then I'll fight head-on!

detail.line: My black clothes let me blend in, but my silver hair does the opposite... The net result is that I stand out.

home.line: Commander! Where've you been? We should stick together, since it's easy to get lost in here. Is that fine with you?

login.line: Everything is in order. Ready to set off, Commander?

main1.line: There's no one suspicious in sight... But we must keep our eyes peeled.

main2.line: I feel safe when I'm with you, and I don't wanna leave your side... It's fine if we stick together, right?

main3.line: Wonder how it's going for the others. Kronshtadt said to maintain radio silence, which... I'm fine with, since you're here.

touch.line: Hold hands? Okay. Is this fine?

touch2.line: Commander... Not in public, please...

unlock.line: Seeing you here puts me at ease. I know this stakeout will go smoothly as long as you're here. Mhm, all is fine.

win_mvp.line: All foes are down. Nobody spotted me. Job well done, right?

battle.line: Everything I do is for you, Commander, now and always!

detail.line: It's supposed to be cold today, but when you're here by my side, everything seems so much warmer. ..."This is the Commander's power? Ah, is that so..." Um, how was that? Did I sound like Tashkent at all?

expedition.line: Our friends in the commission fleet have returned. Commander, once you're done greeting them... Yes, I'll be waiting right here for you.

home.line: You want to go ice skating with me? ...You should get some rest first, since you're tired... Mm, you're fine with that, right?

login.line: While you were practicing, I organized your documents for you. Only if you have no work left to do, it's fine if I take a moment of your time for myself... right?

main1.line: Commander, the way you're skating looks really dangerous, and I'm getting worried just watching you... How about we practice while holding hands? Is that fine?

main2.line: Even if you get better, make sure to invite me again next time, okay? I want to always be able to do this with you... Is that fine?

main3.line: The air outside is so nice and crisp, it feels so great... Commander, are you cold? Are you going to be fine if we stay outside?

touch.line: Are you still scared? Here, hold on to my hand.

touch2.line: Oh no! ...Phew, Commander, please be more careful, okay?

unlock.line: Since you're a beginner at this, Commander, let me show you the ropes. Somehow... it feels like I skate better than usual when you're around. I'm pretty good at ice skating, aren't I? This... should be fine, right?

win_mvp.line: All the enemies have been defeated. I fought just the way you told me too... Mhm, just the way it should be.

battle.line: Firepower at full throttle! Let it rip!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's show them the power of cuteness!

detail.line: I don't like wrecks! They're not cute, and the smoke they emit makes me cough! But, if I have to leave wrecks in my wake to protect my friends, then I won't hesitate to pepper my foes!

expedition.line: The big girls are back from their commission! I've got a bunch of cute decorations ready to give out, so let's go talk to them!

feeling1.line: Hmph! You're not ever getting a hug from me again!

feeling2.line: Comrade Commander, have a look at my new weapon! Heehee! What do you think? Isn't my rigging the cutest ever? All these ornaments are brand new!

feeling3.line: There aren't many decorations around your office. Do you really prefer it that way, Commander? Because after today's work is done, we could buy some stuff and I'll spruce the place up for you!

feeling4.line: Excuse me! I know you're really busy, it's just... could I come with you the next time you decide to go out? I won't be a nuisance, I promise! ...I'm asking because I really, reeeally didn't like being all alone in your office!

feeling5.line: If my hugs make you feel not alone, then I'll hug you tightly wherever and whenever you want! I'll always, always be right by your side, Comrade Commander!

headtouch.line: ...I'm gonna ruffle YOUR hair too after this! Hmph!

home.line: Oh! You're back, Comrade Commander! Will you take me with you next time, please? It's so, sooooo painful to just sit here and wait!

hp_warning.line: Oh no! My power is dropping!

login.line: *yaaawn*... I'm still sleepy... Do you always arrive this early, Comrade Commander?

lose.line: Comrade Commander, we should retreat quickly for everyone's safety!

mail.line: New letter♪ New letter♪ Are these all for you, Comrade Commander? There aren't any for me? Aww...

main1.line: Comrade Commander, if you're feeling down, let me give you a hug to cheer you up!

main2.line: These ribbons are for my quarters, these butterflies go on my rigging, and these plushies are presents for... Oh! I'll cute up your office while I'm at it!

main3.line: Why I like hugging people? Umm... It makes me feel all warm inside! It warms both me and the person I'm hugging, so it's really like that "two birds with one stone" thing!

mission.line: Comrade Commander, we got word of a new mission! We should give it a look!

mission_complete.line: Hmm... Looking at this goods list... It's probably fine! Comrade Commander, please review it!

profile.line: I'm Ognevoy, Project 30K-class or Ognevoy-class destroyer! I didn't get to fight in the war for a myriad of reasons! Also, I don't like violence! But don't be alarmed, Comrade Commander! I'll still do what my job demands!

propose.line: Whoa! So cute! Is this for me? Heehee, thank you! ...Huh? Wait, what was that about "getting married"? You? And me? We're getting married? Oh gosh... I'm feeling lightheaded... B-but if this will make me never feel lonely again, then please put it on! I'm ready!

touch.line: What is it? Do you need a big hug?

touch2.line: ...You want me to shoot you, is that it?

unlock.line: Hi, Comrade Commander! I'm Ognevoy, Project 30K destroyer of the Northern Parliament! Check out my rigging! Isn't it the cutest you've ever seen?

upgrade.line: Am I stronger now? Then can I put more cute stuff on my rigging?

win_mvp.line: That's why you don't mess with cuteness!

gift_prefer.line: Aww, cute! Thank you for the present, Comrade Commander!

feeling5_ex.line: Isn't it nice to just huddle together quietly and do nothing sometimes? ...You don't want to bore me? It's not boring! I'm never bored when I'm with you!

headtouch_ex.line: Hmph... You'll have to style my hair into something cute later!

home_ex.line: Way to go, Commander! You can have a hug as a reward! ...Did that make your fatigue go away? That's great, heehee!

login_ex.line: Commander! I missed you... It was lonely without you, but I stayed positive and waited for you.

lose_ex.line: I will protect you, Commander! Retreat, now!

main4_ex.line: Hold still for a minute, Commander! I'm going to put a ribbon on you! ...It's over-the-top cute, so it doesn't fit you? Don't say that! Everything cute looks best on you!

main5_ex.line: I've finished all the paperwork now! Is there anything else I can help you with? ...I'm free to do whatever I want? Okay, then I'll wait for you right here! I want to spend more time with you, heehee!

main6_ex.line: Commander, Commander! Can I put up more decorations around the office? ...You're sure? Hooray! But I'm not allowed to decorate you? Aww! But you'd look so good covered in cute stuff!

mission_ex.line: Commander! We've been informed of a new mission! I can help you finish it before you know it!

mission_complete_ex.line: The mission rewards list checks out! Please put a cute checkmark here!

touch_ex.line: Hm? Are you giving me this ornament? Wooow! It's sooo cute!

touch2_ex.line: Here and now? You're awfully bold today, Commander!

feeling5.line: If I weren't a police officer and you weren't a fugitive, maybe things could've ended differently... Aww, why does the story have to end like this? The me and you outside the story should've been together forever and ever, right?

headtouch.line: Pl-please be more gentle! It takes so, so long to tie these braids!

home.line: Great job, Commander! I would hug you, but we're about to start filming, so I can't...

login.line: Welcome back, fugitive! ...Huh? My tone toward you should be stricter?

lose.line: I will protect you, Commander! Retreat, now!

mail.line: There's a letter for you, fugitive! Could you please let me have the cute little stamp attached to the envelope?

main1.line: Don't get cheeky with me just because I'm a rookie! I'll arrest you right– Oh nooo! I somehow handcuffed MYSELF! Commander, Abercrombie, Svirepy, help me out! The set is gonna blow!

main2.line: Hmm. These handcuffs are so normal... Oh, I know! I'll spruce them up with some cute ribbons and stickers! ...I can't, or it'll make laughingstock of the force? Awwww!

main3.line: Why is Svirepy– Er, the graffiti artist helping the fugitive?! Please stay where you are! You're both under arrest!

mission.line: We have a new mission! I will arrest you in the name of the law!

touch.line: I-if you think you can bribe an honest police officer with cute accessories, think again!

touch2.line: Huh? But I'm a police officer, and you're a fugitive... Oh no! This is forbidden!

unlock.line: I'm Ognevoy, the newest policewoman on the block! I've come to arrest you, fugitive! Give yourself up now! I'm going to– Ah! Oh gosh! ...Can I please get a cuter role instead?

battle.line: Fight me, assholes!

couple_encourage1.line: MY graffiti is the cutest!

detail.line: Ah... Achoo! ...Why're you lookin' at me like that? Damn nose got itchy, is all! It's not a cold, alright?! ...Stop dressing me up! You dumb or what?! *blushes*

expedition.line: Hey, you, get out there and greet the commission team. They're back now! Tch... Don't make me remind you about every little thing!

feeling1.line: God's sake... Did I mess up and pick the wrong person or what?

feeling2.line: I always thought I slept late, but you go to bed even later than me. Man. Is your job THAT big a drag? ...What do I do to stay up so late? Hey, that's something else entirely!

feeling3.line: Only by pushin' myself and never stopping can I live up to my name – "Fierce"! ...Huh? I shouldn't go crazy with it 'cuz I'm already doing great? A-are you serious? ...Hey, I know you're just recognizing my hard work. Thanks.

feeling4.line: Zzz... Wait and see... I'm gonna prove how capable I am... Whoa! Wh-why was I sleeping?! ...Whuh? Why're you pattin' my head totally unprompted? Wait... Don't tell me I said somethin' weird in my sleep!

feeling5.line: I'm self-centered, I'm rude, and I get sick often 'cuz I'm not used to these waters... However you cut it, people just don't like bein' around me. But you, you always treat me warmly, you acknowledge me, you compliment me... L-look, if you like bein' with me... then I'm cool with hanging out with you.

headtouch.line: Eeeeeek! The hell are you doing?! Hands off!

home.line: You're back. Props for not gettin' hurt out there.

hp_warning.line: You're fine, Svirepy! Just a little more!

login.line: Finally back? Better get your act together quick, 'cuz a new challenge is coming!

lose.line: Didn't try hard enough... Next time, though! Next time is gonna be it!

mail.line: I left the letter on your desk. Just... remember to actually read it, got it? Don't go missin' out on important stuff.

main1.line: Cute? The graffiti on my rigging? Damn right it is! That's 'cuz this Northern Parliament symbol was drawn by a world-class graffiti master – me!

main2.line: I've had three plates of torpedo tempura, two plates of naval curry, and five glasses of honey beer, sooo... some snacks and oxy-colas should stave off the hunger during my late-night studies.

main3.line: I get sick all the time 'cuz the water here isn't what I'm used to! I frickin' hate it! When am I ever gonna get to show off how nasty I am?!

mission.line: What're you lookin' at? Supplies ain't gonna pop outta thin air. If ya want goods, do some damn missions!

mission_complete.line: Checked the rewards. Ya better have another look at... "Thanks for the help"? Ahem... I just... It was nothing.

profile.line: I'm Svirepy, Storozhevoy-class destroyer. I'm an evolution of the Gnevny class and pack not just nutty firepower, but also... "Sensitive to low temps and prone to catching colds"? Only 'cuz I'm not used to these environs and I ain't got enough rest! Get off my case!

propose.line: Hm. Guess this doesn't look half-bad on my finger... What? An oath ring? Whoa, whoa, hang on! That can't be... What? It's for me? You serious?! Thank go– Ahem! Okay, thanks! I'll always, aaalways be with you!

touch.line: Yeah? You checkin' out my gun-axe here?

touch2.line: Seriously? You trying to get cut or what?

unlock.line: Storozhevoy-class destroyer. Name's Svirepy. Heh, I don't respect you just 'cuz I've heard of you before. If you wanna be tough like me, you've got some catchin' up to do!

upgrade.line: Hmph! ...Heh, this ain't bad. These fangs got a nastier bite now, know what I mean?

win_mvp.line: Ahahahah! You losers should be honored that I whooped your asses!

gift_prefer.line: You know exactly what a girl likes! Guess I'll have to repay you somehow...

expedition_ex.line: Hm? The commission team's back. Aren'tcha gonna go meet 'em?

feeling5_ex.line: When we're apart, I feel like I have to push myself endlessly to prove my strength, to prove my value... "Like pulling back a bow's string too hard"? Yeah, something like that... I really don't know how I'd manage if you weren't here.

headtouch_ex.line: If ya like touching me... then fine, I-I'll let you!

home_ex.line: Look who's back. You did a killer job out there! And not even a scratch! Heehee!

login_ex.line: Welcome back. Nice, you're lookin' full of life today!

main4_ex.line: The time has come to unveil the graffiti master's latest work! Whaddya think? Ain't it the cutest thing you've ever seen? Heehee, I knew you'd like it♪

main5_ex.line: You're glad I've been pullin' fewer all-nighters lately? Yeah, 'cuz... You keep complimenting me for my hard work, so I feel I can relax and have fun for a bit too...

main6_ex.line: Ah... Achoo! Would you PLEASE turn up the temp on the AC, Commander?!

mission_ex.line: You've got a new mission! Let's do it together!

touch2_ex.line: Whoa, whoa! We're in public! Wh-wh-what the hell are you thinkin'?!

expedition.line: Hey, hurry up and go greet the commission team already. They're back now! For cryin' out loud... I don't wanna have to go over this again.

feeling5.line: Hmm... Gotta say... Your drip is pretty boring. Heehee, that's why the graffiti master is gonna cute and color your fit-up! ...You don't need that? Too bad, I'm doing it anyway♪

headtouch.line: Yeah? These cat ears feel all hard? Uhh, maybe that's 'cuz they're not real.

home.line: Back, huh? Heh, my latest piece is almost done... No, obviously it's not HERE. "Then where"? That's a surprise for when it's done.

login.line: Too late! This place is my turf now! But I'll let you have a li'l slice of it as a show of appreciation!

mail.line: I left your letter right here. Don't forget to pay the fine... Ugh. N-no, it's got nothing to do with the fact I left your name when making graffiti...

main1.line: "Playing myself"? You sayin' I'm perfectly in-character? ...Oh, yeah! As thanks for the compliment... I'll improv something the next time you forget your line.

main2.line: Ahahaha! You pigs think you can arrest me? Keep dreaming! The whole city's gonna be covered in my art by the time I'm done! And you, you'll help, won't you?

main3.line: I've got a brilliant idea! If I sign my graffiti with your name, the pigs will go after you instead of me! Heehee!

main4.line: Nooooo! Don't take my spray paint! I'm sorry for what I did, okay?!

mission_complete.line: If I were to spray paint the rewards that just arrived... Hey, I was just kidding! Don't take it seriously!

touch.line: I know we're filming and all, but I'm freezing my ass off in these clothes... Ah... Achoo!

touch2.line: Can we not wait with this until AFTER we're back?!

unlock.line: Let's hear it for the graffiti master that's taken the world by storm – Svirepyyy! You people are in real luck, gettin' to witness the birth of my new piece! And if you ain't got any taste, watch yourself!

win_mvp.line: Aw yeah! Hit it out of the park!

battle.line: I'll deal with the toughest one!

couple_encourage1.line: Take this seriously!

detail.line: Life is made up of countless little things, so you can't go being lazy about anything! If even a kid can understand that, then I'm sure you can, too. Hmph – looks like there's a mountain of things I'll have to teach you.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Hurry up and check the goods before I do it all myself!

feeling1.line: Still not a passing grade. Apply yourself.

feeling2.line: D-don't get ahead of yourself! You praising me a bit isn't gonna make me all giddy! Idiot!

feeling3.line: Hey, what's wrong with you?! You worked all night in your office AGAIN, didn't you? Do it again and I WON'T cover you with a blanket! I mean it! That was the last time!

feeling4.line: Just so you know, I'm not really praising you when I say this... You've been, well, kind of showing that you can be reliable, and... No, it's not! I'll say it again! I'm not really praising you!

feeling5.line: Sometimes I feel, "Maybe it's fine to embrace you and be a little needy for a while"... Not because I've gotten soft or anything! As you no doubt know, even the most mature among us need the support of someone they like... Stop looking so smug!

headtouch.line: Huh?! What are you doing?! I've told you I'm not a little kid!

home.line: I took notes of all your commands in the last battle. Hmm... Decent, I guess. Anyway, come and see me tonight and I'll give you some special training! Don't forget, or you'll get a whooping!

hp_warning.line: Don't you worry about me... I can do this myself!

login.line: It's time to get to work! I don't have to tell that to YOU of all people, do I?

lose.line: Dammit! What did I do wrong?!

mail.line: Here, I brought your mail. Do I seriously have to help with something so basic?

main1.line: Hmph. Don't expect me to be as polite with you as other people are. I don't even consider you my superior officer yet... Commander.

main2.line: ...You left the office in a mess after searching for some data last night? Hmph! I cleaned it up just earlier! If you do it again, I'll just have to teach you how to efficiently organize your materials!

main3.line: More coffee? Good grief... Just leave early today and I'll give you a little help. Stop flaunting your work ethic or I'll give you a whooping!

mission.line: You still have missions to do! I guarantee you'd have forgotten without my reminder!

mission_complete.line: Not half bad... Just barely acceptable! Now claim your rewards!

profile.line: Listen up! I'm Ozornoy, the Project 30-K Ognevoy-class destroyer. Don't let my appearance fool you, 'cause I'm a full-fledged adult! ...What's with that look? Are you doubting me? I'll whoop you down!

propose.line: A-are you dumb or something?! Y-you can't just make such a big declaration out of nowhere! You're supposed to pick a time and place and submit a request first... B-but anyway, I accept! Because I... I love you! Heheh...

touch.line: Need my help with something? Heheh! Glad you finally see how reliable I am!

touch2.line: Y-you moron! What are you doing?! I-I-I'm gonna whoop you!

unlock.line: Hmm... So you're the Commander? I'm Ozornoy, and I'll apparently be working for you from now on. Just a heads-up: I'm gonna hold this place to the highest standards of discipline!

upgrade.line: This is... nowhere near enough! I've gotta get a lot, lot stronger!

win_mvp.line: First place. Hah. What did you expect?

gift_prefer.line: You're giving this to me? Well, don't expect me to go easy on you just because of this!

feeling5_ex.line: You've been really proving yourself reliable lately... but don't get cocky! You should rely on me a bit more instead of trying to do everything yourself! I won't take "no" for an answer!

home_ex.line: Check it out! I cleaned the office while you were gone! ...Don't you have anything to say?

login_ex.line: I made some honey water for you. Drink it while it's warm. What? Why are you just staring at me?

main4_ex.line: Take a nap? Only little kids take naps. I mean, if you wanna take a break... I-I guess I could rest with you for a little bit...

main5_ex.line: I've studied all of it. Your favorite foods, favorite sleeping posture, the places you often go to on breaks... Oh! I-I'm not saying I've been stalking you! I just... I just wanted to learn about you to the fullest extent!

main6_ex.line: Been treating you nicer, you say? Y-you're just imagining it! Even if I had been, it'd be solely because of you... Wait, don't tell me you LIKE it when I scold you!

touch_ex.line: Ran into trouble again? Alright, I'm on it!

touch2_ex.line: You... are such a stupid idiot...

detail.line: This outfit's pretty good, I'd say! Heh – it caught my eye the moment I saw it at the Dragon Empery's clothing store! It's grand, majestic, and makes me look like an invincible hero from a legend!

headtouch.line: Hey, hold on! It took a ton of work to style my hair! If you mess it up, you're in for a world of pain!

home.line: Oh! You picked a good time to come back! Tonight's play is about to begin! This spot has the best view, so come up here!

login.line: You're late, Commander! I already checked out all the cool spots in the area while you were away! You just be quiet and follow me!

main1.line: You there! Don't shove when you're standing in a queue! What are you, a little kid? I can see it all from this rooftop!

main2.line: You shouldn't be afraid to talk to me just because I look really awesome!

main3.line: Really, now... Do you think this staff is just a toy, huh?! Hey! That's 100% what you're thinking, isn't it?! Well then... You can have a firsthand taste of its might!

touch.line: Where do you wanna go and have fun? Just say it!

touch2.line: O-out here?! You idiot... You're getting a whooping!

unlock.line: Don't I look so awesome in this outfit, Commander? ...Hey, wait! I-I absolutely wasn't fishing for compliments!

win_mvp.line: It's already over? This staff's pretty easy to handle!

battle.line: Victory lies ahead!

couple_encourage1.line: Gangut, don't bully the commander too much, okay?

couple_encourage2.line: Kuku? I'm not sure I want to call you that... Ahaha...

couple_encourage3.line: Forward, comrades of the Northern Parliament!

detail.line: For combat to be the sole purpose of my existence is a strange and novel feeling.

expedition.line: Commander, a commission has been completed. Let's bring some vodka to the girls to warm them up.

feeling1.line: Even I am unable to shed a light into the darkness of your heart, Commander?

feeling2.line: Commander, care for a drink? Whether you can get me to do strange things afterwards... depends entirely on your ability~

feeling3.line: My hometown? It's very beautiful. Although if you want to go there, you would need to be prepared for the cold. Me? I'll be fine, even without clothes. Hehe... want proof?

feeling4.line: Commander, everyone from my hometown is straightforward, and I'm no exception... If you can finish this drink, you can do anything you'd like with me...

feeling5.line: Я люблю тебя, Commander. If you want to know what it means, you'll have to learn my mother tongue... and come to my hometown.

headtouch.line: Do you like my ushanka, Commander? Heehee. You can try it on if you'd like~

home.line: Good work, Commander. Would you like a bottle of vodka to warm you up?

login.line: Ah, Commander, you're back! Would you like some borscht?

lose.line: The Revolution shall not cease its march.

mail.line: This mail has traveled a long way to get here. Please read it.

main1.line: I have a big heart? Thanks for the compliment.

main2.line: As the herald of dawn, I shall bring light to everyone.

main3.line: Bears? They're pretty cute. I used to raise one.

mission.line: A new mission! I'm more excited than I should be.

mission_complete.line: Here are your well-deserved rewards.

profile.line: I am Avrora, a light cruiser. I started a famous revolution, but I cannot understand what happened to the world after that...|I'm no more than just another soldier in your fleet. Please utilize my abilities to their fullest, and I'll make sure to ring victory to the fleet.

propose.line: Commander, are you all geared up? The journey is going to be cold. Don't worry! I've brought plenty of vodka to keep us warm...

skill.line: Within the light of dawn are spilled blood and raging flames...

touch.line: I'm not cold though~

touch2.line: You should express your feelings in a more passionate manner.

unlock.line: Здравствуйте! Avrora, reporting in. Along with the light of dawn, I shall bring you victory.

upgrade.line: I feel like I could lift an entire bear! Hehe...

win_mvp.line: We must remember the sacrifices that made this victory possible...

gift_prefer.line: You really remembered! Спасибо~

feeling5_ex.line: Wherever you are is my home. I'll always be by your side, just like the inevitable break of dawn every day.

headtouch_ex.line: That feels nice... just like sitting by the fireplace.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. If I can help with anything, please don't hesitate to ask.

login_ex.line: I made fruit pelmeni today. Which would you like first, strawberry or cherry? Heehee, why the strange face? No being picky, Commander~

main4_ex.line: Commander, can you hold my hand? Mmm... You're very warm.

main5_ex.line: Has the sun already set? Don't worry. Darkness may always exist, but the dawn always follows.

main6_ex.line: Sometimes, when we're together, I find myself thinking... The days used to feel so long, but now they pass in the blink of an eye. Why is that, I wonder?

touch_ex.line: Ready to go drinking?

touch2_ex.line: You're as passionate as ever. I hope you're ready for me to repay that passion.

detail.line: Roleplaying as a damsel in distress is rather new and exciting. Hehe~

home.line: Commander, my apologies. I'll go compile the reports, so please let me out of these for a bit.

login.line: Ah, Commander, welcome back. Did you come to save me? Here, I'm all yours~

lose.line: The coming of dawn... is yet deferred...

main1.line: This building's ambience and lighting are just right. Heehee~

main2.line: "I won't surrender myself to fate. I pray that the light of dawn will reach even this dark place."

main3.line: Even if my knight in shining armor was to come, they probably wouldn't be able to get past the bears... Just kidding~♪

touch.line: I'm not particularly cold, you know? I'm actually pretty used to it. Commander, make sure you stay warm though.

touch2.line: "The captured princess was toyed with by her tormentors..." Something like that won't happen to me, right?

unlock.line: "I am Avrora, the princess bound within this tower by a cruel fate... My beloved, please come for me soon..."

win_mvp.line: May freedom soon dawn upon this land...

battle.line: "Muahaha... Get 'em, girls!"

detail.line: You think I... make a pretty good mafia boss? Mikasa and Gangut were laughing their heads off saying I wasn't cut out for the role...

expedition.line: "Muahaha... Today, I'll have you and Pamiat' do my legwork!" ...All right, Commander, be careful on your way there~

login.line: Who's on the hit list today...? Umm, give me a moment... I have to go over the script again...

lose.line: Looks like we got busted...

mail.line: News from our top-secret contact? Let's hurry up and check.

main1.line: I'll bring revolution to these streets with a single shot! ...Umm, wait, right now I'm supposed to be... Right, I'm a bad girl now.

detail.line: Alright, all appears in order. Comrade Commander, give me the order – then watch as I push the boundary of what is humanly possible!

home.line: I can hardly believe my new record made it next to your victory in the port newspaper... Actually, that is something of an affront to you...

login.line: Are you ready to challenge yourself, Comrade Commander? Then watch my maneuvers closely!

main1.line: Never overestimate your physical ability. That is a skill – one that has been built on the learnings of countless people over centuries.

main2.line: Why not try this yourself, Allen? Same for you there – yes, the Sakura Empire girl. I'll reposition the bar for you so don't be scared.

main3.line: This feat is the product of routine practice. You can do it too if you set your mind to it, Comrade Commander... You think it's impossible? Don't give up before you even try!

touch.line: Hah! Be awed at the sight of my athletic skill!

touch2.line: Look out! ...Phew. Be careful – a collision from this height seriously hurts.

unlock.line: ...Hmph! Just short of a new personal best, huh? But make no mistake, Comrade Commander. Keep watching me and your patience WILL be rewarded with a breathtaking record!

battle.line: Fear me! Then, follow my lead!

couple_encourage1.line: Chapayev, I'll take the lead!

detail.line: I'm not afraid of being hurt. If it means protecting you and the others, I'll take that bargain every time. Heehee.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I'll escort them back to port.

feeling1.line: Perhaps I must discipline you as Chapayev would.

feeling2.line: The port is chilly at night. You must have some reason for being here at this hour. Would you be willing to share why?

feeling3.line: Fancy meeting you here again. Aren't you cold? I don't just mean your body; I want your heart and mind to be warm and healthy evermore... Heehee.

feeling4.line: There, there. You can go back to being the Commander everyone leans on tomorrow. Until then... You may stay here with me.

feeling5.line: Isn't the moon beautiful tonight? You know... I only feel this heartwarming sensation when I'm with you. You've shared your worries and vulnerabilities with me... I don't want to take my eyes off of you. Heehee, but don't turn to me; keep your eyes fixed on the moon for just a while longer.

headtouch.line: I'm fine. Your concern is much appreciated.

home.line: Welcome back. You got a little wet during that last battle, didn't you? Best change your clothes before you catch cold. Here, give me your hand.

hp_warning.line: Ugh! I must... withstand this!

login.line: Ahh... Good morning, Commander. If you find yourself cold, come to me. I can warm you with my rigging.

lose.line: It doesn't matter if I fall, as long as my comrades make it out!

mail.line: Your mail has arrived. Why don't you reply to it while the feelings behind them still burn?

main1.line: Nnh... I'm fine. Today's document review is another behemoth. Thank you for all you do.

main2.line: *blows*... That should do it. Here's your coffee, Commander. Warm yourself while it's still hot.

main3.line: Believe in yourself. Your accomplishments in bringing peace to these blue seas are more than worthy.

mission.line: Unfinished missions await. If there's anything I can do to help, don't hesitate.

mission_complete.line: Back from another mission? Why don't you rest with a warm bowl of borscht?

profile.line: Project 68-K, Chapayev-class cruiser Kuybyshev, at your service. My construction was halted before the war, robbing me of my opportunity to contribute. I have to admit that I have my regrets, but I plan to do all I can now to make up for it. You have my full support, Commander.

propose.line: Take this to heart, Commander. If humanity ever betrays you, do not be saddened or angered. I will stay by your side and keep you warm until the snow stops and the sky is clear.

touch.line: Worry not. I am here for you.

touch2.line: Tell me, are you familiar with the phrase "summary offense?"

unlock.line: It is an honor and a joy to meet you, Commander. I am Kuybyshev, light cruiser of the Northern Parliament. Let us steel our hearts to weather the war ahead.

upgrade.line: We must be ready for our next battle.

win_mvp.line: What a wonderful, heart-warming victory.

gift_prefer.line: You didn't have to put yourself out for me... Thank you.

battle_ex.line: The Commander is watching! All shipgirls, with me!

detail_ex.line: Ouch! Sorry for making you wrap these bandages for me... Don't worry about me. It's better if we go all-out during these exercises. I'm used to this, anyway.

feeling5_ex.line: Solving your problems and warming your bed are both my responsibilities... Haha! I'm kidding. I do it all because I want to, after all. Oh? That's not what you expected the punchline to be? Well...

headtouch_ex.line: I'm fine... Oh, that's not why you're touching me? H-heheh... My mistake.

home_ex.line: Commander, over here! You're finally back. Come enjoy some piping-hot borscht.

login_ex.line: Phew... Commander? Did you turn the AC on? Th-thank you...

lose_ex.line: ...We mustn't retreat! Ours is the final line of defense!

main4_ex.line: Is something on your mind? I could... Oh. You say you're just daydreaming? I see... *sigh*

main5_ex.line: Back straight! Fix that posture! Head up! Heehee, there! Now this feels more like an outing.

main6_ex.line: *blows*... Ack! I forgot to move the tea out of the thermos... O-oh, ignore me! I don't burn that easily, I swear, haha...

mission_complete_ex.line: This is a rather paltry reward... Perhaps I should look into this?

touch_ex.line: Is this a distress signal from our poor, dependable Commander? Heehee~!

touch2_ex.line: Your hands are so warm, Commander...

win_mvp_ex.line: Such a passionate celebration. It's beyond warm—why, I'd call it downright fiery! Heehee.

battle.line: Tighten up! This is a battlefield!

detail.line: Oh, you're curious about my bandages? I hit my head while I was decorating... Sorry to worry you.

feeling5.line: Can't sleep, hm? Have some warm milk and put on classical music, and I'm sure you'll drift right off. Today is a day to be with family, so why don't I stay here with you until you're sound asleep? Heehee♪

home.line: Why not kick back and enjoy the music? There's no need to overwork yourself today.

login.line: Though they say spring has come, the wintry wind has not yet left. Be careful you don't catch a cold, okay?

main1.line: The subtle serenity of life as winter, the radiant merriment of fellowship as spring... The Dragon Empery's music is so delightfully expressive.

main2.line: Are you lost, Miyuki? Don't worry; we'll see you home to your dorm, isn't that right, dear Commander?

main3.line: Today, we forget the fighting and savor song and music instead. Commander, you should try and relax, too.

touch.line: Speak up if you have any requests, okay? Heehee!

touch2.line: No touching allowed, Commander.

unlock.line: ...Thus marks the end of this tune. The Dragon Empery has graciously allowed me to perform in their Spring Festival celebration. Are you here to listen, Commander? In that case... How did you like the song? Heehee.

win_mvp.line: I'm glad this victory was worthy of celebration.

feeling5.line: While it's true this outfit may just be a part of the set dressing, my desire to be embraced by you is completely genuine. Heehee. Do you want to prove it, Commander?

headtouch.line: Are you comforting me? I should be the one doing that to you...

home.line: Heheh. You're back safely. These wounds of mine are unimportant. Your and everyone else's well-being matters more.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Let your humble Kuybyshev wash away the day's fatigue for you.

main1.line: This outfit really catches the eye, doesn't it? If it's managed to surprise or relax you, then I'm happy.

main2.line: What do you want to start with? Snacks? Music? Or perhaps you'd like to inspect my "injuries" first?

main3.line: You look a little tired, Commander. Make yourself at home and I'll read a story for you. Or I could simply quietly keep you company for a while – that's fine by me.

mission.line: Commander, it looks like you have some unfinished missions.

mission_complete.line: Nice work on completing that mission. Now you can focus entirely on receiving my care. Heehee.

touch.line: Commander, if you're wondering... this bandage is just decorative. Not sure why you're so curious about it...

touch2.line: Mmh... This part of me is unscathed. Or... are you looking for some other kind of "injury"?

unlock.line: Commander... You smell like rain. Let me warm you. The bandage? It's a part of the service. Take a guess as to how it's used... Heehee.

upgrade.line: I suppose... this will let me shoulder more of your burdens.

battle.line: I'll open fire on the enemy~

detail.line: How do you like my tails? They're super fluffy and feel nice in your hands~ By the way, I made them myself♪

expedition.line: The team has come back~ Should we offer them a few warming shots of vodka?

feeling1.line: Is there something wrong? I'm worried about you...

feeling2.line: I might not have many special skills to boast about, but I'll do my best to live up to your hopes~

feeling3.line: Oops, sorry, I lost track of time while chatting with a friend, and I forgot I was meeting with you today... Did I make you feel sad? I'm really sorry.

feeling4.line: Hmmhm~♪ Once I start chatting with you, it's really hard to stop~ Is that a problem for you, in regards to work? Aww, that's a shame...

feeling5.line: Today is my watch-only day, but tomorrow we can chat to our heart's content. This should fix our little time-schedule problem~ ...It doesn't make much difference in the end? Oh, I see...

home.line: Good to see you back~ I've left a refreshing drink and a juicy tangerine on your desk~

hp_warning.line: Aww, these tails took a lot of work to make...

login.line: Good morning. Sorry that I'm late, I ran into a friend along the way and stopped to have a chat.

lose.line: We lost the battle... I'm sorry for messing up...

mail.line: You have new mail~

main1.line: Are we going on a rescue mission today? I really love helping people~

main2.line: Pirouette and a spin~ To my right is a fox, and a bunny to the left~♪

main3.line: Whew... Hmm~♪ Staaare... Aha!

mission.line: You've still got missions~ Would you like me to pester you about them the next time you forget?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete~ Now let's tackle another job while we're in high spirits~

profile.line: I'm the light cruiser Murmansk. In terms of my history, I used to be an Omaha-class cruiser, doing rescue and escort missions. Then after becoming part of the Northern Parliament, I took part in some training missions~

propose.line: Taking this oath means we will share an eternal bond, right~? Wonderful! Then from this day forward, I promise I will see you every day, without it causing you any trouble~

touch.line: Hmmhm~♪ Oh, do you want to chat? Why, sure thing!

touch2.line: Ummm, I've got just a teensy qualm about you touching me this way...

unlock.line: Zdravstuvuyte, Comrade~ I'm the Omaha-class light cruiser, Milwaukee, reporting for duty~ Oh, did I slip up? ...Ahaha, sure did. I'm Murmansk, from the Northern Parliament. It's a pleasure to meet you~

upgrade.line: I've gotten stronger~

win_mvp.line: We won~! Fighting comes naturally to me~

gift_prefer.line: I'm so happy~

login_ex.line: Good morning! I managed to make it on time today. Teehee~♪

main4_ex.line: A friend told me a while ago that being around me feels warming sometimes, and chilling other times... Umm, that's not really a good thing, is it?

main5_ex.line: Staaare... Hey~♡ You're really good-looking, Commander~♪

touch2_ex.line: Gosh, your hand feels so warm~

detail.line: I'm spending the whole day lazing around indoors, so I don't really need to get dressed~ You can change into loungewear too if you want, Commander~

home.line: Welcome back~! A warm beverage would be perfect right now~ Like vodka, perhaps?

hp_warning.line: Oh gosh! Silly me, I need to focus...!

login.line: Mrmm... *yaaawn*... Good morning... Sho shleepy...

main1.line: Have you seen my favorite pillow? It's "just down pillow"...?

main2.line: Apparently, Pamiat Merkuria likes lazing around too~ I find that surprising, but also kind of unsurprising at the same time...

main3.line: Whew... I can't help but admire how well everyone's holding up in this snowy weather~

touch2.line: You won't find any tails down there today~

unlock.line: ...Achoo! Uhh, good morning... Snow? Yeah, it is snowing today... Woah, it's really coming down hard... Ahaha~

win_mvp.line: Easy as porridge in the morning~

detail.line: I wonder. Should I drape my tails over my shoulders, or should I keep them fixed at my back? What do you think?

feeling5.line: *yaaawn*... The incense smells so good that... I'm getting sleepy. Come to think of it, one of the Empery girls said it had a soporific effect... Heehee, wanna sleep together~?

headtouch.line: My hair accessories and outfit match perfectly, don't you think?

home.line: Welcome baaack~ This incense has calming aromatherapeutic effects, so come and rest your weary bones.

login.line: I can't exactly run around in this outfit, but as you can see, I made it on time. Heehee♪

mail.line: Even the mail smells good... *sniff*... Very nice~

main1.line: You've been staaaaring for a while now♪ I take that to mean you love the dress?

main2.line: "One, two, three, four, five, foxes love potatoes~" That's an old Dragon Empery nursery rhyme, you know! Hmm? Isn't it? Maybe I'm remembering wrong~

main3.line: Staaare... Oh, nothing~ Just observing you, that's all. Heehee.

touch.line: Huh? My tails are on the floor? It's okay~ I can just wash them later~

touch2.line: I don't think this room is designed for that...

unlock.line: Hello there, Comrade Commander~ Come take a deeeep breath of this. Sniiiff... Can you smell this room's fragrance? Hm? You can't tell? Oh. Uh, my incense may have stopped burning.

battle.line: I've undergone countless practice drills. I won't fail!

couple_encourage1.line: With Kirov here, I know this will work out!

detail.line: From here to there, and then... Oh, Comrade Commander. I was just devising an emergency escape route from your office. Would you like to look over it? It may come in handy someday.

expedition.line: Huh? It's already that time? ...Th-thank you for letting me know. I almost forgot that the commission team was coming back...

feeling1.line: You and I just aren't on the same wavelength, Comrade Commander. I'm sorry.

feeling2.line: If you don't have any business with me, don't waste time looking for me. We should just do our own jobs and keep an appropriate distance. Wouldn't that be best?

feeling3.line: I often read books on tactics to gain inspiration for my plans. If you have any interest, Comrade Commander, I could lend you a few. For example, this volume: "Using Neglect Play to Make Your––" ...Ermm, sorry. Wrong one...

feeling4.line: Comrade Commander, how is your mission progress? ...You've finished all of them? What of the commissions? You've arranged them, too? I see. You're doing quite well. (whispering) My plan to get us closer ends in failure again...

feeling5.line: Comrade Commander, what's the matter? I'm the same as ever, so I don't think there's any reason for you to be extra worried... (whispering) It's okay. I'll keep on waiting until you look my way. My "Conquer the Commander" master plan must succeed...

headtouch.line: Why would you do that?

home.line: Sort the delivered documents, deal with any and all minor issues, and I'll be all ready when Comrade Commander— Oh. When did you get back?

hp_warning.line: Hang in there... Just a little more...!

login.line: Welcome back, Comrade Commander. I didn't know when you'd return, so I've been standing by here... Is that not part of the secretary's job?

lose.line: I'm sorry, Comrade Commander. Allow me to rectify my mistakes by my hands...

mail.line: Comrade Commander, you should check your mail. The sender may not be so patient with us.

main1.line: There is a saying about Kirov and me: "As hot as an inferno, yet as cold as ice." O-or... something like that.

main2.line: Comrade Commander, what time is it? ...Phew, thank you. So I haven't missed it.

main3.line: Ways to kill time? I like to put ice down and watch it melt... How about you, Comrade Commander?

mission.line: The piled-up snow may melt, but your missions won't do the same. Comrade Commander, perhaps we'd best get them done?

mission_complete.line: Comrade Commander, the mission is complete. According to our plans, the next task is...

profile.line: Kirov-class cruiser of the Northern Parliament, Voroshilov, at your service. Do you already know Kirov? I make the plans, and she carries them out... Oh? You say we give off completely different impressions? Fair; our comrades often say the same.

propose.line: (whispering) Was my "Conquer the Commander" strategy a success? ...O-oh, ignore that! I'm happy you and I seem to feel the same way. Huh? Y-you always knew?! I see... I should've been more straightforward to begin with...

touch.line: You're going out? Do you wish I wait here, Comrade Commander?

touch2.line: D-don't act like you get to touch me whenever you want...

unlock.line: We finally meet, Comrade Commander. I am Voroshilov, light cruiser of the Northern Parliament. Hm? I don't think I was waiting that long... I mean, it was only a few hours. That's not so bad, is it?

upgrade.line: Absolute power is an effective insurance policy for our subsequent missions.

win_mvp.line: As long as your information is ample and your strategy is thorough, there's no chance of failure.

gift_prefer.line: Ah, I've had my eye on this for a while... Never mind. Thank you.

feeling5_ex.line: Dates must be planned as thoroughly as a battle. These three should do... "Port Dates and You," "Top 100 Dating Techniques," and "How to Steal the Commander's Heart on a Date." ...Oh? You say I should leave the planning to you? I-if you say so...

headtouch_ex.line: I don't... quite understand... *blushes*

home_ex.line: Ah, Comrade Commander. I was so focused on work that I didn't notice your return. I would've liked to give you a more special welcome, but I lost track of time... Sorry.

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Comrade Commander. You think I shouldn't wait for you all the time? ...It's okay. I was looking forward to seeing you.

main4_ex.line: Do you still think I'm as cold as ice? Haha, well, that ice melted long ago thanks to you.

main5_ex.line: Kirov told me that if I want something, I should be bold. I understand that logically, but shouldn't I be more careful when it comes to emotions? I mean, this is my first time, so...

main6_ex.line: I'd always thought that absence is what makes the heart grow fonder. But staying so close to you and chatting... Heehee, it's pretty nice.

touch_ex.line: Your hands are cold... Would you like me to warm them up?

touch2_ex.line: We should both be more straightforward... *blushes*

battle.line: Don't worry. I've gone through my fair share of emergency battle drills!

detail.line: Gangut and Sevastopol went inside with vodka. I hope they don't seriously plan to have a drinking contest in the hot spring... Comrade Commander, we'd best stop them before it's too late.

feeling5.line: Somebody once told me that people are more honest when they're in a hot spring. Heehee, that means this is my chance... Comrade Commander, I've always had feelings for you. I thought that keeping a distance from you would make you more interested in me, but... I suppose when people say "awkward," they're referring to people like me...

headtouch.line: Hm? Is there snow on my head or something?

home.line: The Sakura Empire girls brought over some dango. You came just in time, Comrade Commander. How about we give them a try?

login.line: It's cold enough to snow, but the hot spring will warm us up in no time. Let's not dally, Comrade Commander. The hot spring awaits.

mail.line: New mail? Mm, who could possibly be planning to cause Comrade Commander trouble at a time like this?

main1.line: The cold wind blowing through, the steamy water... They could be likened to fire and ice, couldn't they? Heehee.

main2.line: You say I'll get dizzy if I soak for too long? Maybe I'm an exception... After all, I'm used to waiting. But Comrade Commander, don't hesitate to say something if you're not feeling well.

main3.line: What would I do right now if there was an emergency? Oh, I shouldn't waste this date thinking about such things...

mission.line: A new mission, hm? I'll add it to our to-do list for later.

touch.line: I hear you're supposed to hold hands on dates. Comrade Commander, should we...hold hands?

touch2.line: Should I get a little closer? Well, okay...

unlock.line: Comrade Commander, is the bath to your liking? I'm glad. Heehee, it's a good thing I trusted that "Top 10 Dates for Snowy Days" article and chose this secluded hot spring.

detail.line: I've already studied many texts and learned a lot from my friends. All that's left is to treat you and receive your evaluation... Heehee, go easy on me, okay? I'll do the same for you.

feeling5.line: I'd gladly take advantage of the opportunity to make you mine if you DID fall ill, but I'm not the kind of girl who'd want that to happen. My plan will have to go undeployed for now, forever a fantasy... Ah! *blush* You'll make it reality... for me?

home.line: Congratulations on a successful mission. Are you hurt? Sick at all? And your mood? Umm... I mean whether you're in the mood for your "physical."

login.line: I plan to use medical equipment, of course, but no physical is complete without direct questioning and physical contact. Your body may have been tampered with, so I must be thorough.

main1.line: It feels like you're on fire, and then you're freezing? Hmm... Such severe symptoms demand a much more thorough examination...

main2.line: Comrade Commander, can you come closer? I can't measure your heart rate from this far. Or if you can't come to me, may I come to you?

main3.line: My plans? Hmm... I'll stay with you until your fluid transfusion is done. Don't worry, counting the drips is enough to entertain me for hours... But we could chat, if you'd like.

mission.line: Leave your mission correspondence to me, Comrade Commander. You just hold tight.

mission_complete.line: You finished your missions? Good. Now we can focus on your physical.

touch.line: It's just going to feel like a little pinch. Relax, okay?

touch2.line: Comrade Commander... I'm ready for you...

unlock.line: Don't move, please. You're playing the patient, and I'm playing the nurse, so it's only natural that the distance between us is different from usual... Hm? What does that have to do with this pose? Ahem. Now that you mention it, umm...

battle.line: C-combat?! But I've been so busy all week that I haven't had a wink of sleep!

couple_encourage1.line: Whoa... Whoooa! Such a disposition full of love for inventing!

couple_encourage2.line: Do you need a hand optimizing your program?

couple_encourage3.line: Care to try my latest neck massager?

detail.line: Fusing wires with my hands and adjusting gears with my feet whilst enjoying a chat with you – that is the kind of efficiency a genius possesses. Controlling the flow of water with my feet to make tea? I certainly haven't tried that yet, but perhaps if I put the teapot on a rotating platform...

expedition.line: Yahoo, the commission team is back! Which is to say, my adorable components have come home, yes?! Let me go see! I promise I only need a tiny handful of components!

feeling1.line: You don't seem very interested in my invention. A failure though it may be, I still put a ton of work into it... Oh well. It's okay. I still have a bunch of other ideas to develop on!

feeling2.line: Oh, hang on a moment, I need to make a note of an idea I just got... Huh? Octopus? No, this is no octopus! It's a mechanical arm that sorts paperwork automatically! Do you want me to explain what all these symbols mean?

feeling3.line: The knob on your office door is so normal and dull. Its security aspects leave much to be desired as well... Would you like me to give it an identification and automatic counterattack system? If some ne'er-do-well touches it, it'll administer an electric shock, and then...

feeling4.line: *sob*... Commander, my invention just won't work! I'm at my limit here – please charge my batteries up with a hug... Heehee, your embrace is so warm... I think I got my motivation back!

feeling5.line: I've learned how to classify components thanks to you, and my inventions have become considerably more practical. Ah, yes, as thanks, allow me to sing you my invention song! Spin-spin goes the drill♪ Being an inventor's such a thrill♪ My love's by my side and I'm fulfilled♪

headtouch.line: Fascinating... The temperature, grip, and headpatting tempo of your hand are all quite pleasant... Hold it! I must make a mechanical hand that replicates this sensation!

home.line: Whoa, Commander! You're back! Pray tell, what new and shiny components have you brought back to me? Believe me when I say I have a BOATLOAD of ideas I wanna give form to!

hp_warning.line: Egads! My flame of inspiration is gonna go out!

login.line: Woohoo! You've arrived, Commander! I was just sorting out the equipment I'll bring with me today. Let's see... Extendable claw, portable collector, screwdriver kit – all good! Want me to examine your stuff, too, Commander?

lose.line: Guhhh... My inspiration has eluded me...

mail.line: Ooh, my letter-bringer birdie has brought your mail! ...Hm? The letter's caught in its beak? Roger-dodger, I'll go fetch a wrench right away!

main1.line: Wahaa, Commander! I repurposed those junk components I found in the depot into a mechanical canary that can sing! ...What? What's it used for? Tsk, tsk, your eyes do not see. Inventions are not bound by the need to be useful!

main2.line: Mmh... While I may LOOK unoccupied, the truth is, I am busy as can be. If you need a hand with something, I might just have to use my feet instead.

main3.line: "Junk"? How rude! All of these components are treasures with limitless potential inside of them! They each have their own destiny and will shine if just given the chance!

mission.line: Hey, Commander! The mission reminder birdie I made has been buzzing for ages! What that means is you've got super-important missions left to do!

mission_complete.line: Looks like SOMEONE hasn't claimed their mission rewards! Do you not need them?! If so, I'll gladly take them!

profile.line: I am Oleg! The port's one and only genius scientist specializing in bringing components back to life! Give me some parts and I can make miracles happen! Things may sometimes blow up along the way, but explosions are the mother of invention, so it's fine!

propose.line: Whoooa! I've never seen something so shiny before! You're giving it to me? Heehee, I'll gladly accept! I'm of course aware of the implications of this. I'm going to add a heartbeat and body temp sensor to this and it will keep our minds connected forever and ever!

skill.line: This is my creation, brimming with chaos!

touch.line: Hmm? Hrrmm... I'm jogging my noggin at present, you see...

touch2.line: Nooo! Y-you touching me without warning made me drop the circuit board that I JUST welded! *sob*... My precious...

unlock.line: Oh. Ohhh... If it isn't my test product evaluator... No, I mean my Commander! Heheh. I am Oleg, an ingenious scientist capable of turning components into fabulous inventions! Pleased to be working with you.

upgrade.line: Whoooa! Feels like my inspiration circuit has opened! Ah, wait, no – my toolbox has merely gotten lighter...

win_mvp.line: Heheh... These components are all mine now!

gift_prefer.line: *sob*... It's so sparkly... Is it really all for me?!

detail_ex.line: You know, I try to make coffee every morning using my latest invention. Granted, I do burn my hands pretty often... Hm? Why don't I just use a coffeemaker? Because that's so boring!

feeling5_ex.line: I used to care only about making things, but I've learned so much ever since we met. Sorting and categorizing things, considering usefulness, taking safety measures for others and myself... and of course, that your warmth and smile cannot be substituted by any invention.Heehee♪

headtouch_ex.line: Hmm... The mechanical arm I made doesn't even hold a candle compared to your hand...

login_ex.line: Commander! Your impeccable timing is much obliged! I just finished organizing all the components in the depot into two categories: "Will probably explode" and "will absolutely explode"! ...Hey, I'm kidding! I organized them in just the way you taught me!

main4_ex.line: Behold my mechanical lobster repairer! This thing can do my repairs for me, giving me more time to spend with you! ...Why is it shaped like a lobster? Because those are the parts I happened to have on hand! Don't think too hard about it!

main5_ex.line: *sigh*... I wanna lie down and read a book while fine-tuning my blueprints... Hm? How do I do all that at the same time? Commander, don't tell me you forgot I'm adept at using my hands AND feet for work!

main6_ex.line: I used to only think about inventing for the sake of it – "What fun things can I make with these components?" and such. Nowadays, I'm more interested in seeing you smile when using my inventions. I've really grown as a person! Heehee.

touch_ex.line: Yeah? I'm trying to focus here... That said, if you need me for something, I'll make that a priority.

touch2_ex.line: Eek! C-Commander... I'm not saying you can't... just tell me first next time, okay?

detail.line: These pajamas look light on the surface, but they're fitted with temperature regulation systems on the inside! I also installed an emotion sensor on the tail so I can express my feelings for you without even saying a word♪

expedition.line: Hmm? Oh, that commission is finished... Right now, though, I just wanna be with you... and watch a movie on the couch...

feeling5.line: Hm? It's bedtime already? But the movie isn't over yet... It's all your fault. It was so late by the time I got out of the bath... Look, we're finally on vacation, and I don't wanna waste it! ...What? We can go on vacation together another time as well? Alright, I'll hold you to that... Heehee.

headtouch.line: Mgh... Mmhh... I'll fall asleep again if you won't... stop doing that...

home.line: Buhhh... Whuh? Did I... doze off? Oh, are you still on the clock, Commander? Your laptop screen is still on, so...

login.line: Come here and have a seat, Commander. Heehee, how do you like this cabin outfitted with my personal choice of automated systems? I just fine-tuned the temperature control and safety program on the fireplace, so now it's perfectly safe and pleasant!

mail.line: Have you considered answering your mails with an automated reply system? ...Huh? That won't fly?

main1.line: Whew... The fireplace is so nice and cozy... And so are you... I think I might... *yaaawn*... Mmmgh, no! I can't doze off now!

main2.line: It's pretty nice and fulfilling, just being with you on vacation and not thinking about inventions at all. I've never done this before!

main3.line: Everyone tells me that giving you a lap pillow will make your affinity for me skyrocket... Personally, I think giving you a tummy pillow should raise it by twice as much! I mean, tummies are squishier than thighs after all!

mission.line: My mission reminder birdie is chirping again... Dang it, maybe I shouldn't have brought it along!

mission_complete.line: Can't you just... claim your mission rewards later? I can make a machine that'll claim them for you tomorrow.

touch.line: Mgh... Mmff... No, I'm not sleeping... I wouldn't doze off on our vacation... Sleeping it away would be such a shame...

touch2.line: C-Commander, I'll have to bathe again if you get me sweaty... Unless this is how a vacation... should be?
