unlock.line: *yaaawn*... Nothing beats relaxing after a nice bath! Now that I've changed into my warm pajamas, what should we do next? Hm? Go to sleep? No, no, it's too early. I only yawned because I was getting comfortable!

battle.line: Enemy... found!

detail.line: Ah, there's no need to worry... I'm wearing a blindfold, but I can see everything through more... primal means. Including you, Commander...

expedition.line: The commission team is back. I'll go organize the supplies they brought.

feeling1.line: C-Commander, I have mental training to get to. Could you leave, please...?

feeling2.line: Your warmth, your heartbeat, your emotions... All of them are so special to me. Even when you're in a crowd, I can sense you clearly, like... like a bonfire atop an icy field.

feeling3.line: What do I fear most? Hmm... Being pranked, maybe? I scream really loud when I get scared... Yours are fine, though. In fact... I'd let you scare me more, if you wanted!

feeling4.line: Y-you've never seen me in the midst of mental training? W-well, I prefer to do it alone... with nobody else around. B-but I guess it wouldn't be so bad to let you watch... Hehe...

feeling5.line: *sigh*... I don't know why, but when you're around, all these strange thoughts pop into my head. I start to feel all hot... T-take responsibility and cool me down...

headtouch.line: Ah... You want to see the color of my eyes? Now isn't a good time to remove my blindfold, but if you insist... I'll show you next time there's an opportunity!

home.line: Ah... Even from far away, I feel your gaze. It's like a sweet caress... *pant*... A-ahem! W-welcome back, Commander!

hp_warning.line: Ouch... Oh, Commander...

login.line: The tempo of your footsteps, how you move when you open doors, the amount of force you use... Ah, I can feel every bit of it... Eep?! C-Commander? N-never mind...

lose.line: I'll focus more next time...

mail.line: Commander, I sorted out your new mail. Don't forget to check it.

main1.line: Do you know about mental training? Close your eyes and focus, and it'll amplify even the tiniest sensations that you'd usually miss. Ah, it's so much fun...

main2.line: Mmmph! (I-I can't talk... Commander, don't look at me like that!)

main3.line: Ugh... I shouldn't have agreed to go to the debate tournament with Pamiat'. I spent the whole time stammering... So embarrassing.

mission.line: Commander, would you please entrust your remaining work to me? Ahem. Once in a while... I'd like to experience the feeling of being crushed by a mountain of work...

mission_complete.line: The work's aaall done. It was a lot... but my training has been working out great!

profile.line: I am the cruiser Krasny Kavkaz, serving the Northern Parliament. I was supposed to be as towering and impregnable as the mightiest mountain, but you conquered me in no time, Commander... *peeks*... Wh-what am I saying? Let me start over, please!

propose.line: I have so many feelings I want to share with you, but my words can't keep up with my emotions. You take up all of my thoughts, and you've seized my heart. I want to be with you... forever...

touch.line: Eep?! Commander... When you touch me out of nowhere, I... Ah! I'm not saying I don't like it! I-in fact, it makes me so happy...!

touch2.line: Eep?! C-Commander... This mental training routine of yours is even more... stimulating than I dared hope. Aah...

unlock.line: I am the cruiser Krasny Kavkaz, serving the Northern Parliament. Thank you for welcoming me. *peeks*... Hm... You look VERY reliable.

upgrade.line: The world is clearer than ever before now!

win_mvp.line: I didn't even have to break a sweat.

gift_prefer.line: Oooh... You know everything I like, don't you?

detail_ex.line: Ahh... The room is bursting with your musk. I want to do mental training here forever...

feeling5_ex.line: Staying focused and withstanding external distractions is the hardest part of mental training. Pull my collar for me... Harder, please... *pant*... Now I can start!

headtouch_ex.line: Hehe... Hehehe... My hair is touching my ears... Commander, it tickles... Hehehe.

home_ex.line: You finally came back to me... I told you I can tell just from your sound, didn't I? Maybe it's time... we covered my ears, too?

login_ex.line: Hyah?! Commander, you came at me out of nowhere... I feel my knees getting weak... Huh? N-no, I'm not saying you should get away!

main4_ex.line: Cover my ears, Commander... Yeah, just like that... I can't hear, and I can't see. All I feel is the touch of your fingers... Ah, I could get used to this...

main5_ex.line: *pant*... I can't... live without you anymore, Commander... Help me finish my training, would you? Ah...

main6_ex.line: Hmm... I'm still no good at debate. Help me practice, Commander. For example... some verbal humiliation could help train my tolerance... Hehe, that's a good idea...

touch_ex.line: Ah, ahh... D-don't take your hands off of me. Anywhere you want, any amount of pressure you want... Do exactly as you please.

touch2_ex.line: Ooh! J-just like that... You found my weakness, Commander... Very, very nice...

detail.line: I've memorized all the tiles... Oh? You have, too? Then are you ready for a game? The loser gets punished with... hmm... having to take off an article of clothing, say?

feeling5.line: I finally got to play a game with you, and I lost right away... Goodness, it's just too hard. Well, Commander... Are you ready to give me my ultimate punishment? Hehe... Heehee...

headtouch.line: Mm... Is this my reward? Heehee...

home.line: Commander, you've kept me waiting. Remember how we agreed that the loser gets punished? I've been so excited... Ahem! I mean worried sick, waiting for you...

login.line: This outfit is chilly, but when I think of practicing together with you, I can't help but get all hot...

main1.line: Heehee... Rubbing the bumpy tiles against my body, trying desperately to endure the chilly stimulation to tell them apart... is such wonderful training...

main2.line: Oh? Wrong again... This is all I have left on, though... Hm? But my tights...? Ooh?! My legs are gradually being exposed! Oooh...

main3.line: Pfft... Hahaha... N-not right there! It's too much... If you tickle me, I won't be able to tell which is which... Hahaha!

touch.line: I specifically picked out this outfit, you know... It's really form-fitting, and it's perfect for tactile training...

touch2.line: Ah... Aaah... There are too many pieces. I need to touch them all carefully, or I won't be able to tell which is which... Oooh...

unlock.line: It's time to begin our blind mahjong practice. This is another part of mental training, after all... Heehee.

battle.line: Initiating collection of robot companion combat data.

couple_encourage1.line: Your inventions... show good taste.

detail.line: This is a charging station designed for my robots. It's safe, portable, provides stable power output, and supports multiple charging interfaces. Would you like a demonstration?

expedition.line: When did the commission team leave, again...?

feeling1.line: Commander, do you need help from a housework robot? You seem to be struggling.

feeling2.line: Wrench, please... Pliers, too. And the blowtorch... You don't know where they are? I'll send you the map of my lab now.

feeling3.line: Analysis complete. After ingesting black tea, I've seen a significant improvement in my mobility. Commander, may I have more?

feeling4.line: *stare*... *staaare*... Hm? When I'm observing you as such, my system efficiency doubles, making my processors heat up... An error has occurred. System overheating.

feeling5.line: Thinking about you generates so much uninterpretable data... System overload imminent. Commander, catch me...

headtouch.line: Core temperature rising. Overload imminent...

home.line: Reading new robotic runtime structure... Commander? Did you just get back? But when did you leave...?

hp_warning.line: Switching to power-saving mode.

login.line: Adjusting robot movement functions. Current progress 79%... New access request detected. Oh... Commander?

lose.line: Robot companion damage rates exceeding expectations. Preliminary analysis suggests discrepancy between design environment and combat environment.

mail.line: My assistance robot brought your new mail in.

main1.line: The solution to this problem is complicated... A data processing overload triggered a forced circuit breaker flip. Restarting... Ah. Sorry, Commander, I just lost consciousness. I'm glad you were there.

main2.line: I leave housework to my housework robots. Oh, you wish you had one, too? I'd be happy to give you one.

main3.line: On the way here, I ran a performance optimization on my interactions with you. I did bump into a door one time and trip and fall once, but... Ah. I'm okay. That won't affect my performance whatsoever.

mission.line: Tasks requiring completion have been detected. Dispatching work assistance robot.

mission_complete.line: Huh? You finished your missions? When in the world...

profile.line: Welcome to my laboratory. I am Bogatyr, the robotics engineer. My robots primarily assist in research and combat, but they are also outfitted with features such as cooking, cleaning, and shopping. They're very convenient.

propose.line: Let me think for a moment before the ceremony. When I think about our future – the mornings, afternoons, and nights we will spend in each other's arms... I feel hope and joy. Yes... My thoughts have converged on one answer: I love you, Commander.

skill.line: This will make for good combat data.

touch.line: Hm...? I just finished synchronizing data. What's the matter, Commander?

touch2.line: What kind of feedback would make the Commander happy? I need... more data...

unlock.line: I'm the robotics engineer for the Northern Parliament, Bogatyr. Good morning, Commander. I'm in the middle of uploading interactive data to optimize this robot's behavioral logic. Reading data... Please wait.

upgrade.line: Energy exceeding threshold... Requesting activation of root cause analysis program.

win_mvp.line: Assessing robot companion combat effectiveness... Results: highly effective.

gift_prefer.line: A present from the Commander... I love it.

feeling5_ex.line: I can't help that my eyes are drawn to you... because I want to record and preserve all of our time spent together.

headtouch_ex.line: Abnormal data detected. Reason unknown. Risk of overload... Mm, mmm...

login_ex.line: I've been waiting, Commander. My robot development is going well, so I don't need help... I just wanted to see you.

main4_ex.line: My time perception module seems to be malfunctioning. I was just trying to glance at you, but before I knew it, so much time had passed...

main5_ex.line: I've confirmed a lack of energy on your part. Where is your charging port, exactly...?

main6_ex.line: My current experiment is to see how long I can stay near you without overloading and restarting... Hm? My current experiment is to see how long I can stay near you without...

touch_ex.line: I'll record and archive all of your actions in real time.

touch2_ex.line: Today's experimental data... Mmm... *pant*...

detail.line: When you come close, the abnormal data increases exponentially... Commander, am I going to break?

feeling5.line: Abnormal data analysis complete. It isn't a hardware malfunction or a system error. It all points to a new prime directive: I want to be with you, Commander.

headtouch.line: As my energy levels decrease, my scan efficiency is... increasing?

home.line: Scan 56% complete... Welcome back, Commander. I'll be ready soon...

login.line: Restart complete... Commander, I'll find the source of the abnormal data right away. Just stay a little longer...

main1.line: Self-checking diagnostic failed... Commander, I require a more in-depth scan. Please connect to me...

main2.line: Ah... Mm... An electric current is stimulating my depth sensors... Commander, help me stand up straight...

main3.line: Mobility functions offline. Commander, hold my hand... I need help.

touch.line: Please do not touch my cable. I may run out of energy...

touch2.line: Ah, ahh... So much abnormal data is flooding in...

unlock.line: System error detected. Abnormal data is being generated at a rapid pace, and energy consumption exceeds normal values. Initiating emergency diagnostic protocol. Commander... stay with me until the root cause is found, please...

battle.line: Imbeciles! Stop the pointless struggling and surrender!

couple_encourage1.line: Kirov, I'm counting on you!

couple_encourage2.line: Hehe, things are looking pretty good~

couple_encourage3.line: I've always thought your name was a little funny.

detail.line: No matter how many of my cannons are disabled, even should I get turned into a floating turret, as long as I am still able to fight, I shall fight until my last breath. That is my duty and my obligation.

expedition.line: Your job now is to go and show your gratitude to the returning commission team. Do it well and in a timely fashion.

feeling1.line: Use your head before ordering me around. If you can't even do that much, then I won't lift a finger for you.

feeling2.line: If you want me to follow your orders, then prove yourself a capable commander first. I can handle myself if you can't.

feeling3.line: Don't like my scoldings? Then do better! You're not about to tell me you actually ENJOY being scolded, I hope.

feeling4.line: I'm surprised you've actually taken my scoldings to heart. Hehe, hahaha... Since you like it when I tell you what to do, I'll be more exact from now on.

feeling5.line: Are you sure you're fit to be a commander, considering how you take orders from your secretary? Don't worry, I'll keep telling you what to do so you can keep your job. I've started enjoying it, actually. Hehehe~

headtouch.line: Wha...?! Keep your hands off my head!

home.line: Good work out there. Keep it up.

hp_warning.line: Urgh... What kind of monsters are they?!

login.line: You're astonishingly late. Did you want me to discipline you that badly?

lose.line: ...Tsk, all because of some small mistakes...

mail.line: A letter has come in. I wonder who sent it...

main1.line: Focus on your work. ...What, you need a break? If you've got the energy to complain, you've got the energy to work.

main2.line: How do Tashkent and Murmansk manage to fit in with the others so well... What? Nothing important. Focus on your work.

main3.line: I think I'll have a beer after work. Vodka? No thanks. I'll pass.

mission.line: It is imperative that missions be completed. This was true during my time in the Iron Blood, and is still true now.

mission_complete.line: Hello? Confirm the mission rewards. Don't keep us waiting forever.

profile.line: I'm Tallinn, Northern Parliament heavy cruiser, formerly known as Lützow under the Iron Blood. I fought in the war under the name of Petropavlovsk as well. In the end, I never did get to unleash my full potential, but I trust your commanding to make good use of me.

propose.line: All you need to do is sign this document, and I'll take care of everything else. Now to put on the ring and make it official with a kiss... So, how did my lips feel? Hehe~♪

skill.line: Fire all cannons! Don't stop shooting!

touch.line: What do you need? Don't even think about making me do grunt work just because I'm your secretary.

touch2.line: Ngh...?! Now you've done it...

unlock.line: The name's Tallinn, heavy cruiser from the Northern Parliament. Don't expect me to blindly take orders from you just because you're the commander. Use that head of yours to think things through first, then we'll talk.

upgrade.line: Just as it should be.

win_mvp.line: Look at that, we won. Victory comes naturally if you just follow what you trained for.

gift_prefer.line: Sure, I'll take it off your hands. You're pretty thoughtful.

home_ex.line: Do you really think this is all it takes to satisfy everyone? Exactly. Let that annoyance motivate you to do better.

login_ex.line: Hats off to you for clocking in on time. See? You can do it if you just try. Hehehe.

main1_ex.line: Have you checked out that report yet? ...If you've got time to make excuses, you've got time to do your job.

main4_ex.line: Maybe I should put a collar on you, like Chapayev suggested... What? Nothing important. Focus on your work.

main5_ex.line: Do your job well, and you'll be rewarded. Use your head and think up something good, then I'll see what I can do. Hehehe~

touch_ex.line: You're in need of some guidance, aren't you?

touch2_ex.line: Hehehe. You know what? I'll let you have your fun for once.

detail.line: Commanding the fleet isn't your only job. You've also got to live up to everyone's expectations, and keep going no matter how tough things get. I'll be there to make sure you do.

home.line: Good work out there. Get some rest, you've earned it.

login.line: Make yourself at home. I don't like being uptight all the time.

main1.line: Hipper and I surprisingly have much in common. I like talking about food and guitars with her.

main2.line: Kirov has a thing for barging into my room and ask me to go drinking with her... Still, I'll take that over the antics of Gangut and the rest.

main3.line: Care for a hot beer? If you want a little spice added to it, let me know.

touch.line: I suppose now's a good time for a nap... *yawn*...

touch2.line: Hnngh?! You're pushing your luck...!

unlock.line: What, you've never seen the inside of a shipgirl's room? It's not like you're here on official business, so stop standing around already. Find a place to sit and relax.

battle.line: Hmph. I'll just have to teach you how pointless it is to struggle.

detail.line: Always work at flank speed – the momentum you build up will keep you going. If you ever forget that, I'll remind you as many times as it takes.

expedition.line: It's your duty as the Commander to show your gratitude to a returning commission team. Go on, don't keep them waiting.

home.line: Wow, you solved that one quick. Keep it up.

login.line: You're cutting it very close here. Five minutes early to everything – that's something you should practice.

lose.line: ...Tsk. You little rats!

main1.line: This case is going to be a pain... It may be time to ask Chapayev for assistance.

main2.line: Look, little Manjuu, I can't understand you through your sobbing. Take a deep breath, calm yourself, and then speak.

main3.line: Well done, Commander. Care to go for a drink? I know a place that specializes in mulled beer.

mission.line: Missions and inquiries alike deserve our undivided attention. Wherever you are, this still rings true.

mission_complete.line: You've completed a mission, now go claim your rewards. Chop-chop, we're on the clock here.

touch.line: What is it? I already told you – you're not ready to be a phone operator.

touch2.line: Huh...?! Now you're really asking for it...

unlock.line: You've reached the Bureau of Investigation... Oh boy, another case. Commander, finish up your paperwork ASAP. We've got witnesses to interview.

win_mvp.line: We won. Given enough training, victory is par for the course.

feeling5.line: What was going through the mind of that fairy who journeyed to the moon on her own? I suppose I just wouldn't get it. I'm firmly tied to you, after all. Heehee.

headtouch.line: What, do you like my rabbit ears that much? I can give you them, but what will I get in return? A kiss, maybe?

home.line: Looks like the moon welcomes you. Just for tonight, take it easy. Oh, and don't think about anyone but me tonight♪

login.line: Ready to go to the moon, Commander? Hold on tightly to me so you don't fall... What, you thought I was serious? Heheh. You're a funny one.

main1.line: Ah, I got so caught up in looking for the best moongazing spot that I completely forgot how chilly this place is... Commander, could you come a little closer? Relax, I'm not going to take off your clothes. Not yet, at least.

main2.line: As if putting on this bunny ear hairband wasn't enough, now you want me to hop around... You've got some nerve to ask for that!

main3.line: Crap, I forgot to bring the beer... Luckily, we still have plenty of the osmanthus wine I got for you. Say, how about we exchange drinks? I'll take the osmanthus wine, and you'll drink the beer I forgot. I think that'll go perfectly with this outfit of mine. Heehee.

touch.line: Ah! Whew... Yes, it obviously makes me jump when you touch me in this outfit! Ugh, fine, just pick up my shoes! Do that, and I'll overlook your little bold move.

touch2.line: Now you're pushing it... I can still teach you a lesson even in these clothes!

unlock.line: I'm not letting my guard down, even when dressed like this. Take your eyes off me for just a moment and I'll escape to the moon. With you, of course, heheh. Someone has to keep pushing you forward, after all.

battle.line: The hunt is on!

couple_encourage1.line: You smell of danger... Interesting.

couple_encourage2.line: There won't be enough prey to go around with this many hunters.

detail.line: I'm used to working solo. Even if it doesn't snow here, I can still cover up my tracks... if I want to.

expedition.line: Commission completed. Enjoy the job-well-done party yourself – I'll pass.

feeling1.line: Stay away from me.

feeling2.line: Swords become dull if not sharpened. It's why I still go back to the tundra and hunt like I used to – skills, like swords, need to be maintained.

feeling3.line: I'm not so much a lone wolf, I just choose not to get involved with people. I operate on efficiency and ruthlessness, so I steer clear of cowards and weaklings for their sake, not mine.

feeling4.line: People say I'm cold, but I just don't feel the need to pay attention to every little shift in other people's moods. Getting caught up in emotions is a waste of everyone's time.

feeling5.line: Even though I've adapted to solitude, I somehow don't feel repulsed when I'm around you. Maybe... Maybe you've rubbed off on me.

headtouch.line: Why are you acting like we're that close? I don't get you people...

home.line: Oh, you're back... Did you win?

hp_warning.line: The thrill of walking the line between life and death... Give me more, more!

login.line: Morning, boss. I was going to leave you a note before I left, but decided to just tell you in person after all.

lose.line: Urgh... My hunt can't end in a place like this...!

mail.line: Left a letter for you on the desk. I don't care what it's about, so check it yourself.

main1.line: Hunters are loners by nature – only helpless prey form groups. I walk a solitary road for that reason.

main2.line: Tactics? Those are a chore. I follow my gut instincts. Nothing can tamper with that.

main3.line: Snow, huh... I love when it snows. Makes it easy to cover up my tracks. It's as though it was made for ambushing.

mission.line: You need my help with this new mission? Fine, you rest in the meanwhile. I'm not a team player.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have come in. Go check 'em. Everything that's there, you've earned.

profile.line: I'm Kursk, a hunter from the snowy tundras of the North... That's too brief? Ugh, what a waste of time... I hate socializing. If you want to get along with me, then keep your distance.

propose.line: ...You serious? You want ME, the lone wolf of the tundras? Heheh. Let's see if you have what it takes to tame me.

touch.line: Something urgent? I'll do it, if you want.

touch2.line: What are you trying to do?

unlock.line: You're the boss around here? Good. Don't bother trying to tell me what I can and can't do; I'll prove my worth to you my own way. That's all I wanted to say.

upgrade.line: The thrill of gaining power... makes me crave more.

win_mvp.line: Ahh... The smell of gunpowder and victory. Just what I like.

gift_prefer.line: It's almost unsettling how well you know my preferences... I'm saying it's a good gift. Thank you.

detail_ex.line: Here to see me? 'kay. No need to cover my tracks... Truth is, I wanted to see you too.

headtouch_ex.line: If you really must...

home_ex.line: *sniff*... I smell gunpowder on you, but not blood. Good to know you're unharmed.

login_ex.line: Welcome back. What are we doing today? Work, first of all? Fine. I'll wait here in the meanwhile.

main4_ex.line: I do things my way... but if need be, I'll follow your commands. I trust your better judgment.

main5_ex.line: The Northern Parliament's having a party? I don't mind liquor, it's just... Ah, forget it. I'll go, if only to make you look good. When it's time for chitchat, back me up.

main6_ex.line: Those white tundras and snowy valleys still hold a special place in my heart. I'd happily take you with me to see them sometime.

mission_ex.line: You've got new missions. I'll help you... in the way I know best.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. Hah, we're starting to look like a team.

touch_ex.line: I'm right here. I'm bad at reading emotions, so if you need something, just say it.

touch2_ex.line: It's time I taught you who's the hunter and who's the prey.

battle.line: There's no reason I cannot go into battle like this. The hunt is on!

detail.line: ...Am I cold? Not really. If I can handle an ice bath, a hot spring is nothing. You, on the other hand, should be careful of the night breeze.

home.line: Where have you been? ...You didn't want to pass out from dizziness? Don't worry about that. Worst case scenario, I'll just carry you back home.

login.line: Hmh... The water's nice. What are you waiting for, Commander? Get in.

lose.line: Seems I'm still wet behind the ears...

mail.line: I left your letter in a less humid spot. Don't want your important papers getting wet, do we?

main1.line: Seems the Sakura Empire has the most hot spring enthusiasts. Not that I don't want to bathe with them, but as you know... I'd rather be alone.

main2.line: The hot steam causes the cold air to fog up, impeding visibility and making this an ideal place to set up an ambush... Heh. Don't worry. I'm right here.

main3.line: How's the temperature? If you want, I can turn up the heat using my rigging.

mission.line: A new mission just got handed down. Go ahead and take a look – we'll have plenty of time to relax later.

touch.line: While I hate rubbing shoulders... I can tolerate you being around.

touch2.line: You want to get up close and personal, huh? Heheh.

unlock.line: This steamy hot spring... is a rather novel experience. I left a spot for you, so come sit down already – Wait, why haven't you taken your clothes off yet?

feeling5.line: I'll admit, this new approach is interesting, but I've never done it with you before. Who will top who? We'll find the answer shortly. Heehee.

headtouch.line: ...If you're going to pat my head, say it to my face.

home.line: Alright, you don't sound hurt. Seeing you safe and sound makes me happier than hearing you win or lose.

login.line: Welcome back. You don't need to count me in at the party. If you start missing me, just give me a call.

main1.line: Boisterous parties are not my thing. Still, I changed into an Empery dress to fit in with the festive mood. Yeah, it's a high slit, up to the waist. Can you guess what I'm doing now as we speak?

main2.line: I've put my legs up to get more comfortable. Yeah, it's exactly what you think... "Not a very Kursk pose"? It's called changing strategies to catch valuable prey.

main3.line: ...Nice fireworks. If I can hear the booms from over here, we mustn't be very far apart. Keep searching, Commander, and you might just get a look at me.

main4.line: Hm? You're coming back already? The prey yearns to be caught, it seems.

touch.line: I like honesty in both words and actions. If you want something, just tell it to me straight.

touch2.line: Well, well. You want me to change my pose? Can do.

unlock.line: I prefer talking face-to-face, but if you really insist... Heavy cruiser Kursk sits in an office chair, donning a Dragon Empery dress. What's next, Commander?

battle.line: For freedom! For our ideals! Uraaa!

couple_encourage1.line: I didn't see you there. Now, our defense is unshakeable!

detail.line: You wish to get to know me better? Sure. I can tell you anything, be it my tactical thinking, my rigging structure, or even personal things about me.

expedition.line: Our comrades are back from their commission, bringing substantial spoils. They've done well.

feeling1.line: The port's temperature is too comfortable. Sometimes, a cold breeze is needed to keep you sharp.

feeling2.line: You want to call me "friend"? This is the first time anyone has called me that.

feeling3.line: You ask if I ever feel lonely. The port is where you are, Comrade Commander, so the answer is naturally "no."

feeling4.line: As I understand it, a friend is someone you share time and space with. Ergo, it makes sense for me to stay by your side.

feeling5.line: You said you'd be my friend forever, did you not? In that case, there should be no problem with us standing this close, holding hands, heads pressed together – right?

headtouch.line: Comrade Commander, our relationship has taken another great step toward the highest level of friendship, hasn't it?

home.line: I bid you welcome back, Comrade Commander. To protect the peace and seize victory – these are the things we set sail for.

hp_warning.line: Don't lose focus! Victory is almost within reach!

login.line: Ready to get to work, Comrade Commander? Excellent. You are our role model.

lose.line: Comrade Commander, evaluate the casualties and prepare for the next battle.

mail.line: Is that the latest battle report? Read it quickly – our comrades on the front lines are waiting for our answer.

main1.line: Everyone gathers at your side and chats like it were the most natural thing in the world. How do you create such an approachable atmosphere? Have I been too strict with others?

main2.line: I can always offer consultation if you have any concerns over strategy. It's also my professional duty.

main3.line: I'm especially fond of winter swimming on snowy days. One can better temper their spirit in cold climes, you see. Have you considered trying it, Comrade Commander?

main4.line: Excuse me, Comrade Commander... How does one initiate topics unrelated to work?

mission.line: Comrade Commander, you still have missions to accomplish. Do you want me to help rank them by priority?

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. Your hard work has paid off.

profile.line: I am Moskva, Northern Parliament heavy cruiser. My hobbies are winter swimming and skiing. A little eccentric, you say? That's true. Still, this spirit of pushing through the snow and wind is what allows us to aspire for our ideal world.

propose.line: Is this ring a proof of friendship? Very well. Then from now on, you are my one and only best friend. We'll always be together now, won't we?

touch.line: Is this something that friends do? My understanding isn't wrong, is it?

touch2.line: ...Does "friendship" include doing such intimate things?

unlock.line: Northern Parliament Project 66 heavy cruiser Moskva. Greetings, Comrade Commander. In your eyes I see the glimmer that can make our dreams come true. Allow me, as your strongest sentinel, to temper your will.

upgrade.line: No blizzards will impede me on our next expedition.

win_mvp.line: Victory is ours! This is the fruit of our collective labor.

gift_prefer.line: Did you get this just for me? Thank you.

detail_ex.line: Before you stands your best friend, your very own Moskva. My strength, my rigging, my everything is yours to use as you please. You can come closer if you so want. It's your exclusive privilege to do so.

feeling5_ex.line: What do I think of you? I like you. A lot. That's how we became best friends, isn't it? I will fight for everything you desire and wish to protect. Of course, I do look forward to other things that you want as well...

headtouch_ex.line: Yeah. This is probably right. It feels pretty intimate...

home_ex.line: Comrade Commander, can I have some of your break time later? Since we're best friends, don't you think it's perfectly natural for us to go on a date?

login_ex.line: I've been waiting for you. So, shall we start the day with some work? Or would you rather do something only close friends can do?

main5_ex.line: Comrade Commander, if you ever feel hot, come close to me. My body temperature should make you a bit more comfortable.

main6_ex.line: I read in a book today that close friends memorize each other's little habits. For instance, how you look at me when you think of me. You do, don't you?

main7_ex.line: A traveler who hesitates in the Northern Parliament's snowy plains will freeze. That's why I'm always at the front, charging forward to clear the path for those behind me. Now, I will rid your path of all the obstacles in its way.

main8_ex.line: Comrade Commander, here's a report awaiting review. Oh, if you'd like to rest, I'll sit here with you for a bit.

mission_ex.line: New missions have come in. Let's get them done together. It's more efficient that way.

touch_ex.line: Need something to calm you down? Alright, I have you covered.

touch2_ex.line: I want to learn more from you...

win_mvp_ex.line: Relax. As long as you're behind me, my defense will never falter.

detail.line: Want to see how I placed my stones? You can even come a little closer. My plan from the start was to enjoy this game with you anyway.

feeling5.line: Fighting spirit, positioning, resourcefulness... Only you can match me to the end in these aspects. It's wonderful to have a worthy opponent, and I'm convinced that this game has further heightened the feelings we share.

headtouch.line: You messing with my hair isn't going to impede my judgment.

home.line: Welcome back, Comrade Commander. I just figured out how to exploit the state you left the board in. Look forward to seeing it.

login.line: Ah... You're here. I'm reviewing the last game we played. That move of yours was utterly sublime...

main1.line: Your opening move may have seemed mindless, but it was packed with meaning. Before long, I noticed you had me going all out...

main2.line: Your turn. If you're unsure of what move to make, then I know a way to clear your mind quickly.

main3.line: Seems it's my turn. Since one can't undo a move, I'd better consider the board state and act cautiously... Give me a moment to think of how to respond to your move...

main4.line: Ah, what a move... You caught me, let's say, pretty off guard.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have come in. Shall we have a look at them after we finish this game?

touch.line: Mgh... That's where you wanted to put your stone?

touch2.line: Mmh... Not where you meant to put it? No, since it's come to that, I will respond in full force.

unlock.line: The extent of one's true wit is revealed within the 19 lines on the board. Ever since I began learning to play Go, I've desired a match with you. Observe now, as this next move will determine the outcome of the game.

battle.line: Show me your mettle!!

couple_encourage1.line: Ahahaha! Finally, I have the privilege of fighting by your side, Mikasa!

couple_encourage2.line: For the light of revolution!

detail.line: Know this, comrade. Even if I am battered and bruised, muddied by defeat, I will rise each time to reclaim the glory of mankind! Yes, that is the революция I desire, the only heaven that exists for me!

expedition.line: Hopefully our comrades will return bearing good news, unlike that bitter Ice Cruise. Come on, let's go welcome them back.

feeling1.line: There is no future for those who mistake recklessness with courage, comrade.

feeling2.line: I am Battleship Gangut, also known as Oktyabrskaya Revolyutsiya. However, my name is less important the what I've achieved. Don't dwell too much on it and just call me what you want.

feeling3.line: I hope you don't take this the wrong way, comrade, but this fight is not just for all of us. It's also yours. Never settle with the status quo, and always seek to keep improving.

feeling4.line: Ahahahaha! Well done, comrade! No matter how strong the enemies we may face, we now join each other courageously, prepared to give everything in pursuit of greater challenges! What could be more revolutionary than that?

feeling5.line: Let's get to the point! Comrade, I was struck by your brilliance, and thus I fell for you! And now, I face the challenge of how to express my feelings for you! Here, comrade, accept my embrace!

home.line: O comrade, do you return bearing news of glorious victory? Ah, but it matters not, for the thing that matters most is that you fought with all your strength!

hp_warning.line: Ahahahaha! At last, this is a battlefield that I am meant for!

login.line: Comrade, what sort of strong enemy will we face today? I, Gangut, shall stand with you!

lose.line: Comrade, consider this not a defeat, but rather a warning. A sign that we are losing sight of our revolutionary spirit.

mail.line: You have a letter, comrade. It would be best to open it soon.

main1.line: Comrade, how about a few drinks? ...What? Don't tell me you can't even handle a swig of vodka!

main2.line: O comrade, aren't those stories about the exploits of sailors absolutely riveting? You see, that is the very spirit of revolution, humanity in all its glory!

main3.line: An easy victory? What a stupid thing to say, comrade! How are you supposed to draw out your full power if you have nothing worthwhile to fight? Send me to a more dangerous battle next time!

mission.line: Missions exist for the sake of preserving the order. We should complete them as soon as possible.

mission_complete.line: Excellently done! This reward will help pave the next step of our revolution!

profile.line: I am Gangut, a dreadnought from the Northern Parliament. My equipment may be outdated, but don't underestimate me. Both humans and ships are alike in their quest for greater power, to protect what they otherwise would not be able to. That is революция, the revolution I strive for! From the Bering Sea to Leningrad, only by rising up in the face of humiliation was I able to become a beacon for the light of glory!

propose.line: A pledge, huh? While this act is symbolic in nature, it is also undeniable proof of the bonds we've formed. A toast, comrade. Please continue to guide me in the future.

touch.line: What about my rigging? Isn't fully utilizing everything at your disposal a wonderful and pragmatic ideal? Why would I consign myself to weakness for the sake of showmanship?

touch2.line: What are you doing, comrade? Are you not aware of how we handle lawbreakers in the Northern Parliament?

unlock.line: Hahaha! Not bad, comrade! Come, let us fight for the safety of these azure lanes! Fight until your last breath!

upgrade.line: Comrades! You are also strong! Let our souls shine out brilliantly!

win_mvp.line: Rejoice, for we have earned this privilege! May this celebration become the bread that sustains us until our next victory!

gift_prefer.line: Hahahaha! Are you testing me? Very well! Then I will just have to give YOU a gift of equal value! Just you wait, Comrade!

main1_ex.line: Comrade~ have a bit more to drink~ That Marat can't keep up with me~ C'mon, keep me company until dawn.

main3_ex.line: No strong enemies around? I feel your frustration, comrade... Well then, come at me. Let's make life worth living!

touch_ex.line: I see, I see, so you want to fully grasp the extent of my rigging. Very well! I have no objections, for your courage is commendable as well!

touch2_ex.line: You are forgiven, comrade! Such courage deserves to be rewarded! Come, put your hands all over me until you've had your fill!

detail.line: Comrade, it is too soon to confess to your sins! Struggle for your freedom, and resist until you are about to break! That is the true path to growth!

login.line: Commander, did you come to inspect the exercise? Hahaha! Feel free to ask away!

main1.line: This outfit resembles something that you'd wear in the Eagle Union or Iron Blood, right? If I chose something more imposing, I'd scare off the kids!

main2.line: "This is Gangut... Everything's fine over here, so stay on patrol."

main3.line: Care for a drink, comrade? Come on, it's good stuff. I just happen to have a little bit of free time.

mission.line: Having trouble with your missions? If you need to conduct an investigation, I'll help you out.

touch.line: Are you curious about this medal? You can make as many replicas as you'd like!

unlock.line: You have my thanks for this exercise, comrade! I shall gladly carry out the important duty of judge, jury, and rehabilitator!

detail.line: Have you read the article in this magazine, comrade? It's a great piece on how the working class is the reason for our ever-improving quality of life.

home.line: My room is a total mess, you say? I suppose it is, yes. If I am to clean it, the question becomes, where do I start? The bottles? The magazines?

login.line: I take it you've come to share a drink with me, comrade? Ahahaha! What a coincidence, I just received this bottle of vodka from Avrora. Two shots, coming right up!

main1.line: Comrade, you must always be ready to fight, even in times of peace. If you get complacent with the status quo, then who else will stand up in the event of a crisis?

main2.line: The Sakura Empire is home to a few drinkers too, I've learned. Ise and Hyuuga, I think their names were? I'll invite them over the next time I'm enjoying some liquor!

main3.line: Ugh! I've had enough of this! Get up, comrade! We'll round up some more comrades and go for some target practice!

touch.line: Drink, comrade! Have another shot! You'll have to do much better than that to get me plastered!

touch2.line: You're drunk out of your mind, aren't you, comrade? No worries, you may use the couch! Go on, lie down!

unlock.line: ...Bwahaah! I've had all kinds of liquor, but nothing beats the stuff back home! Comrade, let's have a toast to the coming off-duty days!

battle.line: Onward. No turning back.

couple_encourage1.line: Onwards we march, together.

detail.line: Why I'm fond of Arctic hares, you ask? Don't you think they look adorable when they stand up, Comrade Commander? ...You really don't see it? Their bodies are so round, yet their little arms and legs get so long when they stretch! Isn't the contrast just so shockingly cute?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. You should go speak to them, Comrade Commander. I... Seeing me may stress them out, so I'll stay here.

feeling1.line: It seems I have no choice but to show you my strictest side, Comrade Commander.

feeling2.line: ...A solemn ruler, or a curt decision-maker? What I want to be is a listener, a person whom others confide in. Changing people's views of me in that direction is quite difficult, however.

feeling3.line: I won't become closer with people merely by listening to them. I know that, but I'm terrible when it comes to talking about personal matters. Comrade Commander, please, give me a hand. You have the tools to help develop my interpersonal skills.

feeling4.line: The relationship with you I seek is something deeper than an acquaintanceship or alliance... but I feel like it's selfish of me to want it. Why is that? Because becoming friends with me carries much, much more weight than you think.

feeling5.line: We've reached the point where I can call you a close friend, Comrade Commander. I'd like to take our relationship even further, though... Don't be so surprised. Knowing you, I'm sure you understand what I mean.

headtouch.line: Well... This is unexpected, coming from you. Still, I'll allow it. This contact is a morale booster for your troops, after all.

home.line: You're back, Comrade Commander. I put new wood in the fireplace. It should dispel the chills you're feeling from the weather out there.

hp_warning.line: Where did my plan go awry?

login.line: I take it you're ready, Comrade Commander. It's time to get started on today's tasks.

lose.line: How unfortunate. Our plans will need to be revised.

mail.line: This letter is for you, Comrade Commander. Here, use this letter opener.

main1.line: Planning and efficiency. The two things you need to make it in the world... No, I believe they are important, but I wouldn't go as far as saying that they are everything. Rest assured, there is more to life.

main2.line: You feel I'm more like a reliable colleague than a serious manager? No one else has described me like that before. Most of my comrades view me as one of the latter.

main3.line: Not much to talk about outside of work and combat, you say? Yes, there aren't very many situations where I can offer input. All the more reason why I should focus on listening to what others say rather than speak myself.

main4.line: Rossiya, Belorussiya... Or should I say, my sisters. They're doing so well. One day, they will surely surpass me.

mission.line: Here is the mission list... Let's focus on efficiency. I'll handle the logistics while you concentrate on the missions themselves.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. They have been reviewed already.

profile.line: I am the first ship of Project 23, Sovetsky Soyuz. Like my sisters, I was a centerpiece of the Northern Parliament's naval strategy. Now my strength is all yours to wield, Comrade Commander. Your decisions have my support, as always, because I have full confidence in your ability.

propose.line: At last, this time has come. I know I specifically asked to deepen our relationship, but... to be frank, I always feared I wasn't returning your feelings properly. I've felt this the whole time, but now, there is no longer any doubt in my heart, heehee. Yes, this is the future I wished and hoped for. From this day onward, we walk together.

touch.line: Yes? Do you have a new production adjustment proposal?

touch2.line: Comrade Commander, if you want to deepen our relationship... it will take a toll on your spirit, and especially your body.

unlock.line: I am Sovetsky Soyuz, flagbearer of the Northern Parliament's will. I hope extending a simple greeting doesn't make you too anxious, Comrade Commander. Let us henceforth work together and fight side by side.

upgrade.line: Thank you, Comrade Commander. This concludes my maintenance.

win_mvp.line: Great. This is going just as expected.

gift_prefer.line: This is very thoughtful. How could I say no?

expedition_ex.line: The commission team has returned. Let's go bid them welcome back, shall we? I'll... try, for their sake.

feeling5_ex.line: Oh, dear... Looking back at it, "deepen our relationship" was an outrageous thing to say. Then you said all those things and even threw a wedding... Thinking about it now... it makes my cheeks warm.

home_ex.line: Good, you're back, Comrade Commander. Now let's have a break. A healthy body leads to improved productivity.

login_ex.line: Mh... Looks like you're in good shape as well, Comrade Commander.

main5_ex.line: Our path is one towards a bright future. It doesn't matter how rugged or long the journey is, because the many sights we'll see along the way will become wonderful memories.

main6_ex.line: ...You think I should smile when speaking to someone to not make them anxious? Not a bad idea... Like this, then?

main7_ex.line: I'd like to thank you once more, Comrade Commander. I've never felt better than I do when I'm by your side... Hm? You liked my smile just now? I... see...

main8_ex.line: I make endearing faces when I look at Arctic hares? You really think so? Oh, dear...

touch2_ex.line: You like doing it here, do you? Mmh... I don't mind it at all. Heehee.

win_mvp_ex.line: Follow the plan and seize victory!

feeling5.line: Ah, yes, agents creating a family does sound like an interesting theme. Would you like to... give it a try, Comrade Commander?

home.line: Excellent work. How's the stage-setting going? ...Oh, the camera was rolling. Please send that take to the cutting room floor.

login.line: Perfect timing, Comrade Commander. Everything is prepped and ready. Give the order to sortie.

main1.line: Did you think you could escape justice by hiding in a fortified skyscraper? You banked on a naive hope – which I'm now going to crush.

main2.line: That was a pretty visually stunning take, wasn't it? ...Hm? You're worried your performance as my rival won't be that good? I understand. Once we're done filming, let's go find a place for you to rehearse.

main3.line: Changing careers and trying a different life... It's more fun than I expected. I'd love to do this again if I ever get the chance.

touch.line: My way in is... Rappel down from the roof, then break directly into the room with the objective. A plan full of highlights, it seems.

touch2.line: So you like roleplay, do you, Comrade Commander?

unlock.line: This is Agent Sovetsky Soyuz, codename Polyarnaya Zayats, commencing infiltration. I'd hate to spend long on breaking through the security, so please just surrender now. It's not too late.

gift_prefer.line: This is very thoughtful. How could I say no?

detail.line: A little chat to start with? Yes, let's. Although I'm fine, I imagine it's hard for you to stay calm in this situation. Let's talk about how cute Arctic hares are when– Oh, save that topic for another time, you say?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned on time. Find a suitable time to meet them to ensure the plan doesn't fall through.

feeling5.line: Despite being in a pinch, I strangely feel as though I can be open with you, Comrade Commander. Come to think of it, I've never been in a situation where I'm entirely at someone else's mercy, unable to do anything... You're free to do with me as you please. I trust in your strength and our bond.

home.line: Mgh... Are you going to disable the trap already, Comrade Commander? You don't need to, as I can maintain this pose without trouble.

login.line: Comrade Commander?! Ahem! How shameful of me to be caught... No, actually, this may very well be a blessing in disguise.

mail.line: There's a letter for you, Comrade Commander. You should be able to easily open it if you make adept use of these strings.

main1.line: There's no need to worry about me. My only issue... mmh... is that it's hard to see you in this position.

main2.line: Any further delays will negatively impact the plan. Using force to extract information is an option at your disposal, Comrade Commander.

main3.line: My outfit being as flexible as it is has backfired. I'm tied up in such a way that... I can't free myself with my own strength...

main4.line: When viewed another way, this is a chance for us to share secrets and deepen our relationship... Ah, no, I didn't say anything.

mission.line: To ensure you can begin your mission as soon as possible, I'll– Mmh!

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. One of our comrades will surely claim them for us.

touch.line: Comrade Commander, that's my– Ah! No, I'm fine...

touch2.line: Ahh... Apologies, my body has gone numb, impairing my tactile sensitivity...

unlock.line: Curses... To think I'd fall for such an elementary trap... I take it you're going to "interrogate" me now, Comrade Comander? Oh, no, it's just... if you don't know the proper technique, I could assist you.

detail.line: While improvising is easy, playing the role of your assailant is hard. Oh, no, I don't mean that attacking you is hard, but rather that it's hard for someone like me to seize the initiative and... well...

expedition.line: The commission team is back on time. I should... Actually, no, you're better suited to receive them than I am currently.

feeling5.line: I can do whatever I like to you if I get you to surrender... Heehee. I'm sure you can imagine what a tempting proposition that is. Even so, you're still willing to cooperate – is that because you trust me? Or is it, perhaps, because deep in your heart, you want me to be dominant with you?

home.line: Excellent work, Comrade Commander. The night is still young, and I will be making good use of your body until morning.

login.line: There is nowhere left to run, Comrade Commander. Now, as planned... I mean, as fate dictates, allow me to attack you one time.

mail.line: There's a letter for you, Comrade Commander. This is an excellent chance to test the precision of my cuts.

main1.line: Cease your futile resistance and give me the rest of your time – how does that sound? A good deal, wouldn't you think?

main2.line: No matter how well one person prepares, the collective wisdom and efforts of the many will easily trump the few. You lose, Comrade Commander.

main3.line: Hmm – you're approaching me? Instead of running away, you're coming right to me? Are you, too, perhaps actually well-versed in swordsmanship?

main4.line: Even should you make a choice with many irrational aspects, I will still gladly accept it since it's your choice, Comrade Commander. Heehee – the same goes for this outfit.

mission.line: You need only surrender and I'll take on your missions for the day... Is that not enough?

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. We should examine them in just a bit.

touch.line: Come at me whenever you're ready, Comrade Commander.

touch2.line: What you just did... was it due to my outfit?

unlock.line: So here you are, Comrade Commander. You're usually so well-guarded, yet now you're all by yourself – something I can only describe as careless. I, Sovetsky Soyuz, shall take you on.

battle.line: Crush the enemy! Break their spirits, then their bones!

couple_encourage1.line: Dropped some screws? I'll gather them up for you!

detail.line: If excellency is what you seek from the Sovetsky Soyuz class, I am your best and only true option!

expedition.line: Interested in a bet, Comrade? Do you think the commission team has returned with bountiful rewards, or few at all?

feeling1.line: I don't care. You are absolutely nothing to me. Just stay out of my way.

feeling2.line: How about a bet, Comrade? Do you think your job will only be accomplished thanks to my help, or regardless of it?

feeling3.line: Oh, so you don't mind losing a bet if it means you get my help? I see. Well, regardless, it doesn't matter who wins a bet made on the spur of the moment. Now, what do you need assistance with, Comrade?

feeling4.line: If you ever tire of managing the fleet and planning battles, I will take over for you. You can rest easy, knowing I will bring you good reports on the daily. Although, knowing your devotion to your job, I doubt you'd ever delegate it to get some rest.

feeling5.line: You don't mince your words, do you? I will say I do prefer a forthright confession of love over beating around the bush. Standing at the top of the world, gazing at the horizon, with you by my side – I like the sound of that. Ahahaha!

headtouch.line: Your little hand gestures have no effect on me.

home.line: Do not be so lenient with the enemy next time, Comrade.

hp_warning.line: The battle is still under our control!

login.line: Aha! I knew you'd be back right at this hour, Comrade! Rossiya doubted my intuition.

lose.line: Everyone makes mistakes, I suppose...

mail.line: A letter? I welcome correspondence, assuming it is an enthralling read.

main1.line: It's much more entertaining to lure your foes into a trap one at a time than to crush them all at once. Am I right?

main2.line: Seems it's all quiet on the western front... Don't you have any palpitating news?

main3.line: There is no greater pleasure than decimating your enemy with minimal losses. Wouldn't you agree?

mission.line: Comrade, sure we should not allow the glorious advance of our fleet to be delayed by such trifling missions.

mission_complete.line: Fantastic. With HQ's missions complete, we can finally continue with our own plan.

profile.line: My sisters and I were devised as part of Project 23, but we never saw the light of day, much less fought in the war... But on the other hand, it would've been ludicrous to sail into battle equipped with second-rate armaments. Now though, I would be content with just getting to perform at full capacity under your command, Comrade.

propose.line: You hope this ring will forever connect me with you, do you? Then I believe it will, because I believe in you. Only you are capable of standing at the top of the world together with me. Do not let me down, Comrade.

touch.line: Let me guess, you are simply poking me for your own amusement, and not because you need something done. Am I wrong?

touch2.line: You chose the most depraved of ways to prove you have guts, Comrade.

unlock.line: Comrade, are you sure you're ready to have me under your command? Very well! Let us join hands and lay waste to our enemies — using my methods, of course!

upgrade.line: We will curb the enemy with our superior firepower! Hahaha!

win_mvp.line: This comes as no surprise. All I did was nudge those fools toward the annihilation they so desired.

gift_prefer.line: You've figured out my taste with perfect precision, Comrade Commander!

expedition_ex.line: What, you wanna bet on whether or not our commission fleet is bringing back a big haul? Nah, no need for that. We pretty much know the outcome already.

home_ex.line: There is no harm in prolonging the suffering of our foes, but do not forget the reason why we are here, Comrade.

login_ex.line: You've come, Comrade. As punctual as always.

main4_ex.line: That's checkmate. Hey hey, throwing in the towel already? What, you're making it seem like I'm bullying you or something~

main5_ex.line: The port sure is peaceful... just as it should be. Violence should have no place outside the battlefield.

mail_ex.line: Letters, huh? Let's take a look... Wouldn't want to miss out on anything juicy.

mission_complete_ex.line: All right. After we finish these missions, you should go back to pursuing your own ambitions.

touch2_ex.line: Hey, hey... I didn't call you here to make you all hot and bothered.

battle.line: There's no point in betting on a sure outcome! Onwards!

detail.line: What's your favorite book, Comrade? I'm asking out of curiosity, and to have something to recommend to Soyuz and Rossiya.

home.line: I see you've all returned in one piece. Your reputation has further improved as a result.

login.line: Take it easy. There are many ways to kill time. Just pick one which feels sound.

main1.line: Anyone's life can be enriched by having many diverse interests. Even I enjoy the odd girly hobby or two.

main2.line: Oh please, don't toot your own horn, Comrade. I know several destroyers who read advanced literature too.

main3.line: I need to get up and move around a bit. My joints start aching if I sit down for too long.

touch2.line: What, did my revealing outfit cause you a lapse of judgment?

unlock.line: To pass the time by proactively reading, or by passively enjoying the company of others... Ah, good morning, Comrade, I've been expecting you. Hahaha!

detail.line: The fact that my prominence is unrivaled remains true even in leisurely settings. Now, let this beach serve as a new stage for you and me.

expedition.line: The commission team has come back? I have a feeling that the spoils will far exceed your expectations. Hahaha!

feeling5.line: It wasn't the sea breeze that loosened me up – my feelings for you did. I promise you, Comrade, that you will not forget this profession of love for the rest of your life.

headtouch.line: Are you asking to be tied up in my veil?

home.line: Welcome back. Wish to spend your break time with me, do you? Hahaha! Then you should cherish this moment we have to ourselves.

login.line: Your time of arrival is nearly precisely what I estimated, Comrade. The winds are fair, so let us feel the breeze.

mail.line: Hm? A letter? I hope it's nothing that will ruin the moment...

main1.line: This breeze really is lovely. Ah, I know – care to make a wager? If you're able to grab hold of this veil, I'll treat you to a reward, Comrade.

main2.line: It's nice, just staring at the sea with you. It makes even me want to stay here forever.

main3.line: Wouldn't you agree I look pretty sexy, Comrade? ...Haha! You can't fool me with those halfhearted words. I picked out this swimsuit carefully. Stare as much as you like.

mission.line: Finish your missions so we can stroll along the beach and enjoy the weather. I'm raring to feel the breeze.

mission_complete.line: See? Do as I told you, and even missions will become no more than a way to kill time. Now help yourself to the rewards.

touch.line: Oh? You thought I'd lowered my guard? You were in over your head if you believed that.

touch2.line: I'll need to bind you with this veil and punish you for this, Comrade.

unlock.line: Haha! Did you not expect this to be our rendezvous spot? Oh please, even I wish to unwind in the sand sometimes. Since you're here, accepting my invitation, won't you keep me company to kill some time, Comrade?

battle.line: Commence bombardment! We will bury them!

couple_encourage1.line: This is no time to ponder the meaning of life. Just show us your strength!

couple_encourage2.line: Kirov, aid me!

detail.line: Is that you, Comrade Commander...? I'm afraid the office is a bit messy. But we must make sacrifices to achieve our goals.

expedition.line: Military commissions? They are part of the logistical aspect of proper fleet management.

feeling1.line: This negative attitude is unacceptable. You must be forcibly reeducated.

feeling2.line: Your fleet must be an iron curtain... Hm, it's a metaphorical expression... My meaning is that I hope to see this fleet stand united, just like our Northern Parliament.

feeling3.line: Comrade Commander, what is this? You wish to deepen your relationship with me as an individual, not a representative of the Northern Parliament? Well, such subjective decisions are acceptable.

feeling4.line: Mm, this food is well made... Comrade Commander, thank you for serving me this meal, but I have to wonder, is this more than simple social etiquette? C- could you have some ulterior motive for this charm offensive?

feeling5.line: Gah, well done...! I have no choice but to place the pride of the Northern Parliament on the line and face defeat at the hands of Comrade Commander's charm offensive! Now then, Comrade Commander, you face the full power of my love offensive!

home.line: Rest. And tell me now of what glorious victory you have won, or how you turn defeat to our advantage.

hp_warning.line: It's not fatal damage...!

login.line: Comrade Commander, you are late. You must not forget your proletarian values.

lose.line: Gah, how humiliating... to think a material defect would surface at a time like this...!

mail.line: Mail. Comrade Commander, you must read it quickly before the next one comes bringing another letter.

main1.line: A report I submitted went missing? Pardon my negligence. I'll make it up, so... please don't tell the others about this matter.

main2.line: I hope that you can command from a global perspective. After all, the responsibility on your shoulders is much greater than just that of an individual.

main3.line: When I was inspecting my rigging, I noticed a few more screws than last time... Hm, an unexpected "increase in resource allocation?" That's a good thing, right?

main4.line: Your tactics are too conservative! As long as it has not been sunk, it can repaired, learned from, strengthened, and optimized... Continuing this cycle is the best way of fighting.

mission.line: We have a mission. I will handle the clerical work. You must be clear to focus on your duties as a commander.

mission_complete.line: Hm? Something missing from the reward manifest...? It should be generally correct...

profile.line: I am Sovetskaya Rossiya, of Project 23. I was part of a strategic plan during the war, but for several reasons never came to be. I see though that I can prove my value here in this fleet with a series of decisive victories.

propose.line: So long as I draw breath, I labor to carry out my mission. Not only as a member of this fleet, but also in service of the bonds you have forged... This is not a product of rational thinking alone, but also a decision born of my subjective opinion.

touch.line: You want to deepen our camaraderie? Very good, let us start by making a firm handshake part of our regular routine.

touch2.line: This is not polite behavior.

unlock.line: I am called "Sovetskaya Rossiya," and as the mightiest of all the Northern Parliament's battleships, I am her ultimate weapon. I will press onward to eliminate all obstacles that stand between you and the Revolution.

upgrade.line: An excellent strengthening. The next one should be so good.

win_mvp.line: Kill confirmed. You cannot stop the Northern Parliament... You cannot stop our righteous liberation!

gift_prefer.line: Oho. Should I take this as a simple token of your goodwill?

detail_ex.line: This port has such abundance. That leaves me one core duty. I must bring emotional enrichment to your life.

home_ex.line: Comrade Commander, please eat this. Think nothing of it. Call it a personal supplement.

main1_ex.line: I need only focus my attentions on battle? That is a reasonable decision... But does it mean my clerical skills did not pass muster?

touch_ex.line: Comrade Commander, today's handshake. Mmm. Let us properly follow proper protocols today.

touch2_ex.line: Is this what the Iris would call a "breach of etiquette?"

battle.line: Freeze! Comply!

detail.line: What is the most efficient way to dispose of... Ooh? I mean the refuse. Spare me that look of concern.

login.line: Facility inspection, watch patrol, and observations conducted in accordance with regulations. Everything running smoothly.

main1.line: You find me more reliable than Gangut...? I am glad you see my value, but I find that a very low bar to clear.

main2.line: This is all in service of a greater cause. The girls have fully committed their labor. You need not trouble yourself.

main3.line: Document classification protocols...? I was trying to find the required materials, but seem to have created a bit of a mess in the process...

touch.line: Now, your hand... For today's handshake. I am not going to clap you in irons. Relax.

touch2.line: Hmph. Do you want to be handcuffed?

unlock.line: "Situation normal in all sectors of the facility..." Oh, it is you. I was just giving Minsk the daily report. Do you have something?

battle.line: The battlefield knows only one sovereign - me!

couple_encourage1.line: If you want to surpass Warspite, you must first beat me!

couple_encourage2.line: Teamwork, everyone! Teamwork!

detail.line: You can lead the fleet as a whole, but in the field, I'll take command. By covering for each other, victory will be certain. Having said that... I wouldn't mind being the one to make decisions around the port every now and then~

expedition.line: Attention: the commission team has returned! Now, to pour something that warms the body – not tea, but vodka.

feeling1.line: You're a disgrace to your position! Apply yourself!

feeling2.line: While I appreciate your courtesy, do remember that I'm not some noble lady, I'm a soldier. Likewise, you're my Commander, so try to act like it!

feeling3.line: Ugh... I'm dog-tired... Ah, Commander. Haven't you been working yourself into the ground too? Just don't go completely overboard, okay?

feeling4.line: (Hehehe, what impeccable concentration. I knew you had potential. If you weren't so reliable, I wouldn't be ready to entrust my future to...) Oh, you heard that?

feeling5.line: Well, the cat is out of the bag! Commander, I'm going to leave my future in your capable hands. To that end, you must learn how to issue me orders without my input! Understood?

home.line: So you've returned. Now you must reflect on your battle, review your results, and inspect your ships for damage... But first, have some tea while it's still warm.

hp_warning.line: My maintenance is lacking? Impossible...!

login.line: To your desk! Chop-chop! Let's get through today's tasks quickly!

lose.line: All ships, withdraw! ...You haven't seen the last of us!

mail.line: Attention: a letter has arrived! It's for you. Do give it a read.

main1.line: It's delightful to see you're still excelling, Lady Warspite. You live up to your name as a royal knight.

main2.line: While I'm far from the only Northern Parliament battleship at this port, I strive to be the best. Those aren't empty words – I mean it!

main3.line: Have you finished your work? Ready to start on the next task? ...That's the spirit. Once that's done, we're onto the next, and then the next after that!

mission.line: Attention: we've received new missions! Give them a look, Commander!

mission_complete.line: Attention: the mission has been completed! Spasíbo! I'm pleased you did them before I had to.

profile.line: I'm Arkhangelsk, Northern Parliament battleship. I began life in the Royal Navy, taking part in convoy escorts and engagements with the Sardegna Empire. I did also have a period of, let's say, diminished strategic usefulness. But that is in the past – I stand here now to deliver you the victories befitting a capital ship!

propose.line: Hoho. This is what I wanted to see. An occasion this special calls for more ladylike behavior... Or rather, that I return your affection. Of course I gladly accept! I trust you with my future – take good care of it!

touch.line: Being excessively polite is no different from simply being rude. Speak to me as you would any other.

touch2.line: Wh-what are you doing–?!

unlock.line: I am battleship Arkhangelsk. Hehe, being plainspoken with me is exactly what I like. I see quite a bit of potential within you.

upgrade.line: How about a complete modernization and retrofit next time, hmm?

win_mvp.line: Victory is mine. Heh, not that I ever had any doubts about the outcome.

gift_prefer.line: Very nice! So this is how a real gentleman chooses gifts, eh?

detail_ex.line: With you commanding even in the field, and me offering advice on the fleet's course – yes, the port has a bright future ahead of it. Hehehe~

feeling5_ex.line: Would you please tell me ahead of time when you want me to switch from soldier to lady mode? It's hard to dote on you at the drop of a hat – I'm not used to that. As an aside, would you like to go on a date? ...Hehehe. Expect me to make the first move for as long as I'm not used to doting on you.

home_ex.line: Results look good, same with the after-action report... And you, Commander? Good to hear! ...Mmm, this tea came out excellent, even by my high standards.

login_ex.line: Attention: the Commander is back! Now then, what's our first task of the day?

main4_ex.line: That's hardly a drink suited for a tea party, Belorussiya... And Rossiya! That's not the right way to use that! Sorry, Commander, my hands are a bit tied for the moment!

main5_ex.line: How my abilities are put to use is for you to determine. I have no doubt you'll make the right call.

mission_ex.line: Attention: new missions have come in. I suggest taking a gander at them.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete! That's created some time for us to go on a date.

touch_ex.line: Need advice? I can offer mine only if you'll rely on me!

touch2_ex.line: I'm not sure what to say about this...

detail.line: I'll be taking this treasure, if you don't mind! Heheh! Royal Navy grace with Northern Parliament dexterity is not a combination to be trifled with.

expedition.line: Attention: the commission team has returned! You'd best go out and greet them, Commander!

home.line: I'd kill for some tea after work. Say, would you have the time for a tea party, Commander?

login.line: We're taking off in just a moment, Commander! Get over here, quick!

main1.line: The right way to spend a vacation is to maximize your moment-to-moment fun. That's the reason I've brought you along, Commander.

main2.line: Our next objective is to... Ah, we have to bring this over to Kiev to finish our mission. Nice and easy.

main3.line: Despite my appearance, the fact is that I am a soldier with knowledge of everything from avoiding security to moving stealthily. Shipgirls usually aren't proficient in those? I mean... Doesn't it vary from person to person?

touch.line: You're coming in loud and clear! What do you need?

touch2.line: Eek!

unlock.line: Your choice treasure now belongs to master thief Arkhangelsk! Think you can arrest me? Then stop gawking and come get me!

detail.line: The fun of studying magic lies in taking the knowledge of previous generations and using it in new, innovative ways. You've done this well. Soon, perhaps you'll mature into someone who can pursue the very roots of magic with me.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned! ..."A spell that can warp you to the harbor"? No such thing exists.

feeling5.line: Join your party to kill the Demon King? And that's not a request, it's an order? What a bold way to ask your teacher for help. Heehee, that's why you're my disciple. I will join, just don't expect to always be the party leader.

home.line: Welcome back. You control your mana better than I expected. I'll have to revise my estimates... Don't be anxious. Settle down and have a cup of tea.

login.line: Alright, time to start today's training! The pursuit of magic does not allow even a moment of idleness!

lose.line: Are you really sure Revenge wouldn't play the sorceress better than me? It doesn't take much stamina, you know.

mail.line: I picked up this letter addressed to the hero. You should really read it.

main1.line: You must learn the foundation of magic before you can pursue its greater mysteries. Start off by studying every last book in my library!

main2.line: The thing floating above me? Heehee, it's just a decorative spell I stumbled upon. It has no practical use... but then again, vanities are inevitable on the road to new things.

main3.line: Today, we are going to test the limits of your mana! You're going to create water, freeze it, and fire off ice shards a thousand times in a row... What's that? Out of motivation before we've even started?

main4.line: Go to the tavern after the studying is done? Sure thing. But no vodka! I'm not like Poltava or her sisters!

mission.line: You've received a new mission from the Mages' Guild. This is the perfect time to prove the fruits of your training.

mission_complete.line: I see you've collected your mission rewards. Good. You're on the right path.

touch.line: Oh, do you want to study a new spell?

touch2.line: W-wait... Are you serious about this?! I'm playing your TEACHER right now!

unlock.line: I am Arkhangelsk, the royal sorceress who resides in the tower to the north. So, you wish to study magic to defeat the Demon King? Very admirable... You're deserving of the title of "Hero." I will be equally sincere and impart my teachings to you sternly.

battle.line: If you don't want to die, stand aside!

couple_encourage1.line: Ooh, I smell vodka...

couple_encourage2.line: Politeness? Pssh, who cares about that?!

couple_encourage3.line: Don't get too full of yourself now~♪

detail.line: Well met, comrade. Would you like to learn more about my revolyutsiya? Heheh, you hardly have to ask. I know you like the back of my hand, comrade.

expedition.line: Transport of goods, especially to battlefields, is a difficult thing. You should be thankful for the efforts of your commission team.

feeling1.line: You certainly have the qualifications to be a proletariat, but you don't quite understand the revolutionary spirit...

feeling2.line: I could trounce you with ease, but as people with similar goals, I will treat you as an equal. Heh, you should be thankful that you've become an ally of the Northern Parliament instead of sinking beneath our iron billows.

feeling3.line: I don't know what those battle-addled idiots think of you, but if nothing else, you might make for a fine drinking partner. Heh, don't get too carried away; keep on applying yourself.

feeling4.line: *hic*... C'mon, you haven't even finished half your glass yet. Pfft, heheheh... Waiting for me to drink myself under the table, are you? Well, too bad... No matter how much I drink... *hic*... I'm not goin' down...

feeling5.line: *hic*... Comrade Commander, I like you. Hell, I love you. If I win this, I'll be your eternal partner and join you in the final battle. Now, I'm not dead-drunk yet. How about you just... accept defeat?

headtouch.line: Huh?! H-hands off!

home.line: In celebration of our comrades' victory... A toast of vodka! Ack! *chokes*... I-I'm fine!

hp_warning.line: Urgh...! I'm not even drunk!

login.line: Good morning, Comrade Commander. Come and show us who we will do battle with today!

lose.line: As long as I have not sunk, I will continue to stand time and time again! That is the meaning of revolution!

mail.line: Comrade Commander, there's mail for you. If you plan to reply, do it promptly. We don't want to make them wait.

main1.line: Comrade Commander, join me for a drink! Waaait, you're not telling me you don't know Northern Parliament tradition, are you? ...You don't like vodka? Crappy excuse, sorry. See? We've got wine, too!

main2.line: Carrier-based aircraft? Let me just say, bring 'em on. We'll see if they can beat Sevastopol!

main3.line: Social standing matters not when it comes to revolution. Heh, as long as we share the same willpower, we're comrades through and through!

mission.line: You have a new mission. Do your best, and keep your eyes on the prize: a celebration full of vodka!

mission_complete.line: Ahahahaha! Another step closer to revolution! M-maybe I'd better tone down the drinking for today...

profile.line: Dreadnought of the Northern Parliament and flagship of the Black Sea Fleet, Sevastopol, has arrived. Hahah, I am the very ironclad willpower of the revolutionary vanguard, always under attack but never falling! Got it?

propose.line: ...Mm? Where am I? Oof, I might've drank too much. Comrade Commander, what's with this ring? You mean I... snatched it from you and put it on my self? I-I really did that?!

touch.line: We are two comrades. I will gladly exchange a handshake with you!

touch2.line: Comrade Commander... What exactly do you think you're doing?

unlock.line: Ahahahaha! So you're the Comrade Commander. I'm the Northern Parliament battleship, Sevastopol. Revolution doesn't happen on tea parties alone, comrade. Think of me as any ordinary young lady, and you'll regret it!

upgrade.line: What revolutionary growth. Hahahahaha!

win_mvp.line: Ahahaha! All who seek to obstruct the revolution are fated to fall!

gift_prefer.line: I like it! I-it is for me, isn't it?

detail_ex.line: My, Comrade Commander? Did you come to see me because you wanted an invitation to our drinking party, or officially, "tea" party? I've already slipped one into your office drawer~♪

home_ex.line: I brought some beer! Heh, unlike Gangut, you'd get bored of only drinking vodka pretty fast, right?

login_ex.line: Good day, Comrade Commander. Revolution isn't all fun and games. Can I trust you to guide us all to battle once more?

main4_ex.line: I'd look miserable if I got drunk at work. Listen! You'd better stop me before I get drunk! ...Cheers!

main5_ex.line: Aww, someone looks like they're ready to learn. Okay! Sevastopol, dreadnought and training ship, would be happy to teach you!

main6_ex.line: There is no end to revolution. Rest easy; you will forever be my Comrade Commander.

touch_ex.line: Ask me for anything. As a comrade, I intend to do everything in my power to help you.

touch2_ex.line: C-Comrade Commander... What was the point of that, exactly?

detail.line: Come to think of it, when did I even put this on... I-I mean, gotta dress right for a hot spring bath, right?! See? Look, I even tied the sash right!
