expedition.line: The commission team is back. Think it's their turn to come in after us?

home.line: (This hot spring is so comfy... I didn't even realize I was drunk until the Commander arrived.)

login.line: Aww, you just got here? Hell, I guess I wouldn't mind going back in with you, Comrade Commander...

main1.line: (I-I'd better not tell the Commander... that I wandered over to this hot spring alone after Gangut got me drunk! Urk...!)

main2.line: Voroshilov? Don't worry about her. I don't know if she gets by through grit alone, but she's the kind to never get dizzy in a hot bath.

main3.line: The joy of getting out of a hot bath? Umm... How about you go first, comrade? Erm, I'm just feeling a little, y'know...

mission.line: A new mission... Once it's over, how about we celebrate with wine instead of vodka?

touch.line: (The wind feels nice... O-oh, right! I need to put on a cool front so the Commander doesn't notice I'm drunk!) ...Achoo?!

touch2.line: I'm soaked? ...Haha, well, yeah? I was bathing in the hot spring, so duh...?

unlock.line: Phew... This is... Comrade Commander? Fancy meeting you at this time of night. Me? Heh, heheheheh... You wouldn't believe me if I said I got too drunk and went in first, would you?

battle.line: Follow orders and neutralize them in order!

couple_encourage1.line: After this is over, wanna go for a drink?

detail.line: Making problems disappear is what I do best. From requests that came out of the blue, to brutes who have no manners... Think of it as a part of learning, heehee.

expedition.line: Those girls who went out on a commission are back. It's your job to welcome them back, so start getting your things in order.

feeling1.line: Heehee... It seems I must take firmer measures to discipline you.

feeling2.line: A single nail was misplaced, and thus a war was lost. What I'm telling you is not merely a fun story, Comrade Commander.

feeling3.line: ...Yes? There is no more than meets the eye to these chains. And don't worry, I don't have a kink for wrapping things up in them.

feeling4.line: I tie my bagage down tightly because I don't want it collapsing. Same with my furniture and ornaments so they don't fall. I want them to be stable... You don't get it? That's fine, heehee. You'll know what I mean when trouble befalls you.

feeling5.line: Heehee, you've figured it out, my smart comrade. Love is a kind of chain. A chain that wraps around us both. A chain that links and keeps us together when the world wants to separate us.

headtouch.line: My, how assertive. I like it♪

home.line: You've returned, Comrade Commander. Come, sit down next to me... I'm not asking you, I'm telling you to.

hp_warning.line: Things are getting dire... I need to be quick!

login.line: Someone still looks sleepy. You need to shape up... or I'll be displeased. Heehee♪

lose.line: Even in defeat, you should have order in mind as you retreat. Because if you don't... Heehee♪

mail.line: Time is valuable. I'll sort your letters and you just stay focused on your work.

main1.line: Manners aren't things you do to appear cultured, they're a mindset of paying attention even to the littlest things. Yes, it's about whether you have an eye for details or not. Remember that.

main2.line: Sometimes you need to be strict to get a person to take something in earnest. What are your thoughts on that, Comrade Commander?

main3.line: How time flies... Why don't we have dinner together? Heehee. Oh, and do try not to drink too much.

mission.line: These incomplete missions are piling up... I won't stand for this. I suggest you stop slacking before I have to discipline you.

mission_complete.line: You've completed every last mission? How excellent. Your pluck and focus bring a throbbing to my heart♪

profile.line: I'm Poltava, Gangut-class battleship of the Northern Parliament. While Gangut herself may be more famous, my abilities will not disappoint you. Got a work issue, a personal issue, or any issue at all? Just come to me!

propose.line: Oh my... This is a statement, saying you want to be together forever. And if you're giving it to me, you must be ready to forever be connected. Heehee. Whatever comes next, we'll get through it together... sweetheart♡

touch.line: Curious about my rigging, are you? Heehee, it may look rough on the outside, but it's sophisticated and industrial on the inside.

touch2.line: Heehee... Should I interpret this as a formal invitation?

unlock.line: Mmh. You're Comrade Commander, aren't you? I'm Poltava, Northern Parliament battleship, and I'll be aiding in your work starting today. Since you're the face of this port, I will hold you to a high standard of conduct and etiquette. Hope you're ready♪

upgrade.line: My chains are even stronger now. How lovely♪

win_mvp.line: Every second matters. On to the next fight.

gift_prefer.line: How sweet of you. I accept.

detail_ex.line: Oh, do you want to play with Pirozhki, too? Heehee, sorry, but no. You have your work to deal with – namely, figuring out the cost of the Ganguts' drinking party♪

expedition_ex.line: Ah, the girls who went on a commission are back already. You're linked not just with me, but with them as well. Heehee.

home_ex.line: Way to go, sweetheart. Go on, sit down and let me take care of you. Who's my little soldier? Heehee, yes, you are.

login_ex.line: Well, hello, sweetheart. I love to relax as much as you, but you're supposed to be working right now. Please be mindful, lest you get on other girls' nerves♪

main4_ex.line: No need to be on your best behavior, sweetheart. There's nobody around♡

main5_ex.line: Go drinking? Sweetheart, please, do you think I'm the same as Sevastopol? ...Heehee, too late to pull out now. You're going to learn just how much we Parliamentarians can guzzle.

touch_ex.line: This isn't the chain that binds you... THIS is♡

touch2_ex.line: Heehee... I know you're trying to provoke me into something, sweetheart♡

win_mvp_ex.line: Aren't you amazed by how quickly I neutralized them, sweetheart?

battle.line: Oh my, the oranges are in the frame with you.

home.line: Thanks for setting up all the props, Comrade Commander. Now... how about a nice full-body massage from Queen Poltava?

login.line: Heehee. Great timing, Comrade Commander. I got my hands on the script for the next scene. Want to go through it with me?

main1.line: "You don't treat me as a friend and you refuse to call me 'Queen'"... What an impactful line.

main2.line: If you want to strike a deal, come up with a reason I can't refuse. Heehee, my character is quite the arrogant one.

main3.line: So, who is playing my rival? ...Sovetsky Soyuz? Heehee. Her, against a mafia queen... They gave her quite the important role.

touch.line: Heehee. A drink, Comrade Commander? The glass may be a prop, but the liquor is the real deal.

touch2.line: Heehee... I might have to add an improv scene♥

unlock.line: Heehee... Oh, are you ready for your audience with me? Remember the important thing – minding your manners. Queen Poltava's time is very, very precious indeed.

win_mvp.line: Heehee. Another huge and historic victory for Queen Poltava.

battle.line: Let's begin. I won't any danger come even close to the Commander.

couple_encourage1.line: You can't go on being such a klutz.

couple_encourage2.line: Do NOT do anything that might endanger the Commander.

detail.line: Sometimes, I worry that I'm a bit too involved with your day-to-day life. From managing your meals, to your sleep schedule, and even your room's temperature... it's all because you mean a lot to me. I just don't want to overstep my boundaries or come across like a... guardian.

expedition.line: Commander, let us go and receive the commission team. Hrmh... No, I'm not peevish, I just want to look after you more.

feeling1.line: I'm disappointed in you, Commander. Not because you did anything wrong, but because you don't understand that you need my warmth... This needs to change.

feeling2.line: Doesn't look like you've accepted my tender care yet... Don't worry, everything I do is for your sake. In cold lands such as these, warmth is the one thing everyone needs the most.

feeling3.line: Could you tell me who made the tea on your desk? The teacup has a gorgeous design, sure, but I want you to drink MY tea. I know better than anyone else the kind of warmth you like... Oh, forgive me – did I cross a line there?

feeling4.line: Once in a while, I wonder if I should let you be more independent... then every time I see how tired you look, I can't help but feel like I need to be there to protect you. Do you know what that's like?

feeling5.line: Over time, my desire to protect you changed and gave birth to a new kind of emotion... Be that as it may, I still want to protect you and keep you warm. That, to me, is the peak of happiness.

headtouch.line: Ahh... It's my job to look after you, and yet you're so kind to me... It fills me with joy.

home.line: Ah, welcome back. Get some rest... is what I would say, but first I need to check your forehead temp. Heehee, don't be embarrassed, it's just some family bonding.

hp_warning.line: This is nothing... I can take it for the Commander's sake!

login.line: Ah, Commander. How was the weather outside? If you're chilly, I can make tea and hot chocolate for– Hm? You'd prefer vodka? Well, if that's what you want, alright.

lose.line: Retreat right away... I have your back.

mail.line: Commander, a letter came in. Will you read it after a quick rest? I'll leave it here for now, then.

main1.line: Commander, you should use my blanket if it gets cold at night. It's incredibly soft, and if you wrap yourself up in it, it'll feel like I'm giving you a big hug. Heehee.

main2.line: You slept soundly last night, didn't you, Commander? Oh, how did I know, you ask? Because I went to check on you. You looked so at ease – you must've been having a wonderful dream.

main3.line: I made some hot milk for you to warm yourself up with. Whew... Let me check the temp before you drink it... Hm? You're not a kid? Heheh, well, in my eyes, you'll always be a sweet little child... Here you are – enjoy!

mission.line: Hmm... While I don't want to burden you too much, you do need to finish your missions. Heehee... Would you like me to help reformulate your plans?

mission_complete.line: Commander, you have yet to claim your mission rewards. They're all the recompense of your hard work. Heehee.

profile.line: I'm Kazan, shipgirl of the Northern Parliament. I have cozy blankets and warm tea or hot milk all ready for you. Stay by my side forever, and I'll protect you from threats and the cold alike. For you see, that is my duty and my desire.

propose.line: I see... You love me just as I love you, and you want to protect me. I understand. From this day on, I'll do more than just protect you – I will support and warm you as your partner, and you'll do the same for me. What do you say we build a loving, warm family together?

skill.line: Don't you dare take one step further.

touch.line: I'll warm your hands for you.

touch2.line: Hm? Are you feeling cold? ...Okay, then come into my arms.

unlock.line: I'm Kazan of the Northern Parliament, here to serve you. My job from now on is to make you snug and cozy – indeed, that's the sole thing I live for.

upgrade.line: Nicely done, Commander. I'll get you a hot treat as a reward.

win_mvp.line: Heehee. This is naturally how powerful my feelings for you are, Commander.

gift_prefer.line: Ah... You remembered what I like. Hehe, I just want to hug both you and your gift really tight~

detail_ex.line: I used to focus only on protecting you, and now I've become helplessly reliant on you. Heheh, maybe me changing so radically is proof that I've grown a bit? And it's all thanks to you, Commander.

feeling5_ex.line: Every now and then, I wonder if destiny brought you and me together... My feelings for you have stayed the same between me initially wanting to "protect" you and now when we've become a pair. What I am now is your protector, your partner, and someone who couldn't be happier that you love me just as I love you. You can imagine how I feel, can't you?

headtouch_ex.line: This used to simply make me happy, but now it makes me wanna be spoiled... Keep going...

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've made fresh bread and meat soup that'll warm your heart. I just checked and it's the perfect temperature for eating.

login_ex.line: Welcome back, my beloved. Let's give it our all today while we support one another. I still can't help but want to fawn over you sometimes, so I hope you'll keep sharing your warmth with me.

main4_ex.line: I made your favorite tea. Best to drink it before it goes... Oh, lip marks? Heheh, oops, I must've left those while checking the temperature a second ago. Heehee.

main5_ex.line: You've seemed pretty exhausted as of late, so how about tonight, we go to my place and I'll read you a story? Then you can fall asleep in my lap, then... Hm? My place is a little cramped? Yes... I suppose it's high time I put away all my stuffed teddy bears.

main6_ex.line: I know I agreed to falling asleep with you, but I just can't rest easy without seeing you asleep with my own eyes... At least I don't need to come see you every single night, since we're always sleeping together.

touch_ex.line: Do you want a hug? Nowadays, I want some of your warmth too.

touch2_ex.line: Yes, I understand... Come into my embrace♡

detail.line: Heehee. In truth, I've always wanted to be by your side with a more homely look. For instance, like this... in the kitchen in the morning, welcoming a new day together as family...

feeling5.line: Making breakfast for you every morning, feeling the temperature in the kitchen, watching you eat with a smile on your face... This casual happiness is my irreplaceable treasure, the one I've been after for so long.

headtouch.line: Heheh... It's a little embarrassing, but it does make me really happy.

home.line: Excellent work, Commander. Does the nice smell of breakfast help you relax? Maybe you want something to drink?

login.line: Here just in time for breakfast... Oh, hang on a second. Let me check your forehead temp... Heheh, no, there's no real reason for it. I just wanted an excuse to come close to you.

main1.line: I thought you might be getting tired of just drinking hot milk lately, so I made some coffee this time... What's that? You're suddenly craving milk now?

main2.line: Let me know if there's anything you want to eat. I'll cook it up for... Hm? That's spoiling you a little too much? Heheh, making food is for granted, I'd say.

main3.line: Need a hand? Sure, just sit there and wait a minute. I absolutely love taking care of you, so don't sweat it and let me handle it for you.

touch.line: Oh my... Are you asking me to spoil you by any chance? Heehee.

touch2.line: First thing in the morning? Seems you've gotten a bit clingy with me. Heehee.

unlock.line: Ah, you're up, Commander. Heehee. Good morning. It's so sunny today that even the kitchen is a bit hot. That's okay, though – I've made a refreshing breakfast for you. Go wash your face, then it's time to dig in.

battle.line: I'll do my best to offer air support!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's do our best, everyone~

couple_encourage2.line: Wow, so you're also real carriers...?

detail.line: In case of an emergency... Um, I mean, you can always rely on me, emergency or not!

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned! I'll go take lunchboxes out to them~

feeling1.line: A nice person doesn't cause trouble for their friends, got it?

feeling2.line: You can't have an unhealthy lifestyle, okay? I know you're busy, but nothing is more important than your health.

feeling3.line: Commander~ Want some vodka? Oh, you can't drink during work hours, huh... Well, just let me know when you're done here~♪

feeling4.line: Hey, why don't you treat yourself to something nice today? Hmm, if I had to pick out a reward for my hardworking Commander... What do you think it'd be? Hehe~

feeling5.line: So you want me to reward you with a headpat? Sure, I can do that~ Yes, yes, who's a good Commander? Now, come lie down over here~ You can fall right asleep if you want~♪

headtouch.line: W-wait, I'm supposed to be the big sister here, right? I, I'm sure of it!

home.line: Commander, thanks for your hard work~ Operation debriefing? Let's leave that for later and have some food with the others first?

hp_warning.line: The final victory... will be ours!

login.line: I'll do my best today as well~ Hehe, Commander, that goes for you and the other girls too. Let's all work hard together~♪

lose.line: So this is defeat... But, the final victory will eventually be ours!

mail.line: You've got a letter~ Wouldn't it be nice if your friends are inviting you to do something fun?

main1.line: Arkhangelsk, can I bring vodka to the next tea party? Ehh, I can't? Aww...

main2.line: Hum hum~♪ It's fun thinking about what I want for dinner while cleaning your office~ Oh right, Commander, do you have any recipes you'd like to share with me?

main3.line: Heh heh~ I might not look it, but I sure pack a punch on the battlefield! ...Huh? The "might not look it" part is unnecessary?

mission.line: We've got new missions, huh? Try to pace yourself and not overdo it, Commander.

mission_complete.line: Owwie... I tripped while bringing the mission rewards over... Commander, would you mind lending me a hand? Ehehe, thank you very much~

profile.line: I'm here, I'm here! My introduction, right? I'm Volga, Northern Parliament aircraft carrier. Named after our homeland's life-giving river, I'll do everything I can to support our friends, from sea or sky! Just make sure to be extra nice to me, Commander~♪

propose.line: I'm here, Commander! What's wrong? ...Huh? Umm, this ring... It's for me? Really? W-won't the other girls be jealous though? ...Ehehe, this makes me so happy, it really does... *sniffles*

skill.line: Now's the time to give it our all!

touch.line: I'm coming~ Did you need something from me?

touch2.line: If that's how you feel about me, then... Huh? It was an accident??

unlock.line: You don't look so good... Have you been eating properly lately? And how about your sleep? Hmm... Maybe it has something to do with emotional stress, or relationship problems? ...Oh. My name's Volga, Volga of the Northern Parliament. Oh my, did I really forget to introduce myself until now?

upgrade.line: I'm a REAL aircraft carrier, after all~

win_mvp.line: Our march forward is unstoppable! We shall endure, no matter what, until the final victory is ours!

gift_prefer.line: A gift for me? Really? Hehe, you're gonna make me blush~

detail_ex.line: My greatest contribution to this fleet isn't on the battlefield - but rather, through courage, companionship, and love! Heh heh, sounds pretty cool, doesn't it?

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, what would you like for din– Huh, it's already done? No way, I spent all day coming up with a special recipe... *nom*... Woah, delicious! Um, Commander, c-could I please have some more?

home_ex.line: Back from the operation already? *nom*... Mmhmm, sho, who'sh the MVP this time?

login_ex.line: *Yawn*... Commander, did you sleep well? I was having a nice nap just now as well... Zzz...

main4_ex.line: Kiev said the lunch I made for her was funny-tasting... But how could that be? Ugh... Commander, what did you think?

main5_ex.line: Having a proper outlet for stress is a trick that'll go a long way, whether in work, leisure, or life itself... Well, assuming you want a long life, that is~

main6_ex.line: If you're heading out for battle, you can call on me! Heh heh, after all, I have a great reputation for being reliable, right?

mission_complete_ex.line: Good, good, you sure did a great job out there~ I'll bring the rewards over to the depot... Huh? It's dangerous, so it's better to stick together...?

touch_ex.line: I'm here, Commander! What do you need~?

touch2_ex.line: Ehehe, if you're really that into me, then what can I say~

detail.line: All right, I've got myself some conclusive evidence this time. Please loop around that way. After that... Oh, before I forget, take this in case you get hungry~

headtouch.line: Shh, I'm in the middle of a mission!

home.line: (*grumble*) You heard something just now? Uh... I'm sure it was just your imagination! Yeah, nothing at all!

login.line: Do I turn left or right at this next juncture... Oh, hey there, Commander! If you haven't eaten yet, take this– ...Uhh, oh! Right, I've got to focus!

main1.line: Belorussiya told me that the bar there serves really good drinks... Oh, yeah, focus, focus!

main2.line: The time it takes to get from here to the next stakeout point is... Commander, hold on tight!

main3.line: Kirov should be lying in ambush on the other side... All right, this is where I show you what I'm made of!

touch.line: Now we wait... Ugh, my cover's been blown... There goes the mission...

touch2.line: Ahhhn?! W-wait, now's not a very good time...

unlock.line: Volga here. I'm currently tracking an important witness. *gurgle* ...Is my stomach rumbling because this AR game requires so much stamina? Ugh, lost track of the witness just now...

battle.line: Comrades! We march towards victory, heads held high!

couple_encourage1.line: Your firepower still does not trump mine!

couple_encourage2.line: Covert missions are my forte!

detail.line: My comrades should be contacting me soon. Let me open my– Huh? Don't move! ...Comrade?! Don't you know to knock before you enter? ...You already knocked? Oh. I see...

expedition.line: So, the commission team has returned. Exactly when the report said they would.

feeling1.line: If you hope to gain my trust, you're putting in quite a lackluster effort, Comrade.

feeling2.line: So, I did some research into your past before coming here, Comrade... Oh, please. You can infer what I found based on the fact I'm conversing with you right now and addressing you with the word "Comrade."

feeling3.line: One person can only do so much alone. I have my comrades to thank for having made it this far. Likewise, Comrade, if you need my assistance, I'm absolutely willing to give it.

feeling4.line: I have no issue giving something greater than intel to those I consider as trustworthy as you, Comrade. But, by accepting it, you may be inviting danger into your life. Are you prepared for that, hmm?

feeling5.line: Our relationship goes beyond mere "trust," as I'm sure you know, Comrade. So, ahem... Allow me to give you something purer, more intense, and unquestionably greater than my trust – my love! ...Wh-why are you laughing?!

headtouch.line: Comrade, what are you... "Returning my efforts with intimacy?" I, I see... You've quite the straightforward methodology. I'll be doing the same the next time.

home.line: Huh?! ...Oh, it's just you. You put yourself in great danger by suddenly approaching me from behind. At least call out to me first... Don't be ridiculous! You didn't startle me!

hp_warning.line: Do not panic! Focus! Focus!

login.line: Morning, Comrade. I always warmly welcome one who practices punctuality. Hmm? The workday hasn't begun yet?

lose.line: It's all my fault this happened! Dammit... I apologize for my poor judgment!

mail.line: You have a new message. Read it, and I'll dispose of the letter aftewards, if it's of a confidential nature. I'll ensure there's no trace left of it.

main1.line: I left a note on your desk with a summary of all of today's tasks, Comrade. What? You can't read my handwriting? Fine, then I'll read it out for you. Let's see... This says...

main2.line: Who am I making such frequent calls to, you ask? Be patient – you'll learn in due time.

main3.line: I never repeat something I've explained before. The more information is repeated, the greater the risk of leaks... Hmm? You didn't catch that? Okay, as I was saying...

main4.line: Strange... My transceiver isn't working. How am I supposed to contact my comrades now? Screw it, brute force it is... Gah! It burst into smoke!

main5.line: What's essential during stealth missions is that you leave no trace. What this means is: before you go in, cannons booming, you should first create an even bigger boom to distract from– Huh? That's not how you do it?

mission.line: I've compiled a list of all available missions. Strike them through one by one as you complete them, Comrade.

mission_complete.line: Your efficiency in completing missions is quite admirable, Comrade... Goodness, you completed another just as I said that!

profile.line: I'm Kronshtadt of the Project 69 cruiser designation. Bravery alone does not win battles – gathering intel while denying your enemy it does. And, just as your fleet's power is not to be underestimated, neither is mine. Understood?

propose.line: Oaths and ceremonies? I've no need for such grand wastes of time. We have but one thing to do once you've slid on this ring. Close your eyes, Comrade, and forever memorize what I am about to do!

touch.line: If you need my assistance, just come forth and ask for it, Comrade.

touch2.line: I will not tolerate you – or anyone else – mistreating me... Stop that, right now!

unlock.line: I'm Kronshtadt, Northern Parliament cruiser. Firepower isn't my only merit – I have many more than that. I'm sure you'll discover them for yourself as we clash with our enemies, Comrade.

upgrade.line: Who could pass on more firepower, am I right?

win_mvp.line: Hahah! Victory is determined not by random chance, but by a cascade of certainties.

gift_prefer.line: Wait, how'd you know what I... I've never told anybody that I wanted this, so if YOU knew, then... Gah! An information leak?!

detail_ex.line: I just received a call from my comrades. It was all good news. I'll send you the important details later, Comrade.

feeling5_ex.line: Take this transceiver. It connects to a highly secure channel no one but you and me knows about. Use it whenever I'm not around and you need help, have something on your mind, want to go on a date, or just have a chat. I'll be there for you anytime, anywhere!

home_ex.line: Ah, Comrade? There's no reason to fear for your safety just over saying hello. By now I've grown used to you approaching me from behind. Ahahah!

login_ex.line: Good to see you, Comrade. I've been waiting for you. Th-the reason I waited here was, uh... so nobody would spy on me. That's it.

lose_ex.line: Dammit, I must've gone overboard...

main6_ex.line: You struggle to read my handwriting? Well, if even you can't parse it, that means it's a well-encrypted message. Ahahahah!

main7_ex.line: Thanks, Rossiya. I'll put this screw back where it... Wait, where did you find this?

main8_ex.line: My peers? Hmh, it pains me to admit, but this port is home to a number of people one cut above me when it comes to espionage.

mission_ex.line: I've compiled all the pertinent mission info. Get out there and knock them out of the park!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. It delights me to see you giving it your all.

touch2_ex.line: Y-your boldness is a league above even mine...

win_mvp_ex.line: Our victory wasn't a stroke of luck – it was a certainty, thanks to Comrade Commander.

detail.line: They've taken Manjuu hostages? God dammit, then we've no other choice... Squad, prepare to storm the building!

login.line: The perimeter has been secured, Comrade. Should I brief you on the situation, or do you want to see for yourself?

main1.line: What's wrong with using indiscreet methods as means to an end? I quite like how much simpler this job is than information warfare.

main2.line: It was a smart move to set up a barricade. This way, Kirov's squad can catch any suspects that try to flee the scene.

main3.line: Copy that... Arkhangelsk is on the move. It won't be long before this is over.

touch.line: You turn the megaphone on with this button. Want to try it, Comrade?

touch2.line: Well, well. Time to test how sturdy these handcuffs are... by trying them on you. Heehee...

unlock.line: Listen up, assholes! We have you surrounded! I'm Kronshtadt, squad leader of the Northern Parliament Special Forces! You have only one option: come out with your hands in the air and surrender!

win_mvp.line: Arrest the suspects! Move!

detail.line: Ah, seems it's almost time for my regular check-in with my comrades. Today's message and topic are... Huh. "Preparing for the Upcoming Event" and... "Costume Verification"?

feeling5.line: While I do trust you, I just can't keep a cool head in this situation. If I could at least distract myself with... I've got it! Since I can't help but be conscious about this outfit, I might as well lean into it... Comrade Commander, could you assist me?

home.line: Eek! G-greeting from behind would've been dangerous, you say? Well, this and that are completely different situations!

login.line: I-I've been waiting for you, Comrade Commander. Uh, no, this outfit is not meant to tempt you or any such... Look, in short, it's not about that!

main1.line: Wh-what? Intelligence work is inherently risky, so if I must dress like this for the job, then that's... Ugh! No, this is way too much!

main2.line: Of all things, it had to be this animal... Say, Comrade Commander, do you also like to have milk in the morning? ...N-never mind.

main3.line: "Why not recommend this outfit to others"? A good point. If we all wear it, I'll blend in with the crowd compared to... Wait, what?!

touch.line: Comrade Commander, wh-what are you doing?

touch2.line: I feel a little numb... or a little anxious... *blushes*

unlock.line: When you said "special animal costume," I was expecting some sort of mascot costume... not whatever this is! B-but don't worry, Comrade Commander! This is no big deal for an agent of the Northern Parliament!

battle.line: In the name of Iris Libre, let us break their lines!

couple_encourage1.line: Let us bring victory to the Commander!

couple_encourage2.line: I'm glad we can fight together, my sister!

detail.line: If you have any questions, feel free to ask away. I will respond to each one.

expedition.line: Why don't you let me handle the next one? I'll get it done the fastest.

feeling1.line: So... I guess this is the kind of person that you are, Commander...

feeling2.line: Don't you think Noblesse Oblige is an elegant idea?

feeling3.line: In order to realize their ideals and ambitions, even family members may part ways and eventually meet each other on the battlefield... It's so tragic...

feeling4.line: Familiarity with hardship and suffering cultivates an appreciation of life and death. At least that's what I think...

feeling5.line: Commander, as long as we're together, I feel like I can easily overcome any adversity... that's what I truly believe.

home.line: That was a hard-fought battle, Commander. Would you like to have a cup of tea before you resume work?

hp_warning.line: The outcome... still isn't set in stone!

login.line: My, I see you've returned? What shall your orders be today? I am ready to accept any assignment - commission or sortie!

lose.line: Sometimes... things like this can happen as well...

mail.line: It feels nice to be celebrated by someone you don't know, doesn't it?

main1.line: My sword and shield? Oh, they stop feeling heavy after a while. Well, I also am quite strong.

main2.line: If I was with my sisters at that time... would things have happened differently...?

main3.line: Whether someone is friend or foe... is not something set in stone.

mission.line: New missions have been issued.

mission_complete.line: Commander, here are the fruits of your labor.

profile.line: I am Le Triomphant, a Le Fantasque-class Destroyer from Iris Libre. It is an honor to meet you. My sisters and I were in the 8th Light Division before the fateful Battle of Jutland. After that, our paths diverged...

propose.line: Finally... this day has come at last... Commander, you truly are my fated partner. I, Le Triomphant, willingly offer you my sword, my shield, and my body.

touch.line: Commander, you'll be missing out if you treat me and my sisters as regular destroyers.

touch2.line: Eek! To think that you're even faster than the Le Fantasque class... you're not one to be taken lightly, Commander.

unlock.line: Oh my, Commander, what a pleasure it is to meet you. I am Le Triomphant, an elegant large destroyer from Iris Libre, yours to command. The power of the Le Fantasque-class shall exceed your wildest fantasies.

upgrade.line: I feel strength rippling from my sword and shield... Commander, thank you.

win_mvp.line: You'll find that the speed of the Le Fantasque-class is not easily matched!

gift_prefer.line: How did you know my favorite? Thank you.

battle.line: All right! I'll surely be able to win in this condition!

couple_encourage1.line: Le Mars, stay in formation!

detail.line: Hooh! Haah! Oh, great timing, Commander! Let's practice some swordplay!

expedition.line: Commission complete! Next time, let me go as well. I swear I'll do better!

feeling1.line: If the knights found out that I had sworn fealty to a person like you... I don't know if they'd blame me or pity me...

feeling2.line: There are all kinds of amazing people gathered here. There's just so much to learn... Ahh, I've gotta work even harder!

feeling3.line: Why do I spend so much time training with the sword? Well, it's true that I don't plan on using it during sorties, but being able to keep myself sharp and in shape is surely an asset on the battlefield!

feeling4.line: Commander, did you know that I've always had two dreams? The first was to become a worthy knight like my seniors. The second was to find someone worthy of swearing fealty to... I never expected that my second dream would come true first~

feeling5.line: Commander, please believe in me. The only time someone will be able to hurt you is when the last shell has been spent and I am no longer able to lift my sword.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Don't worry, nothing happened when you were gone.

hp_warning.line: This fight's not decided yet!

login.line: Hooo! Haah! Oh, Commander, let's do our warm-up exercises together!

lose.line: I swear... to take this defeat to heart!

mail.line: A letter...? Wonder if someone's challenging you to a duel...

main1.line: Iron Blood or Royal Navy, I don't care who it is, I just want to learn more about them!

main2.line: When will I become as strong and cool as the knights?

main3.line: I don't want my life to end without having accomplished anything... so this time, I'll give it my all!

mission.line: Commander, I believe that it is your duty to complete these missions.

mission_complete.line: Don't let these mission rewards go to waste, Commander.

profile.line: I'm Forbin, a L'Adroit-class destroyer from Iris Libre. For various reasons, I was stuck in port for two years, but after returning to service, I was able to get a lot done and make up for some of that lost time on the battlefield.

propose.line: This I do swear - my sword shall be your shield, Commander. In return, please promise to guide me down the correct path... I don't ever want to experience that ever again...!

touch.line: Commander, did you know that there are many different kinds of swords? For example, there are rapiers, sabres, flamberges, and so on...

touch2.line: I didn't mean to draw my sword upon someone unarmed... I am very sorry.

unlock.line: I am Forbin, a squire from Iris Libre. I may not match up to the stature of my seniors, but please offer me your guidance!

upgrade.line: My odds of victory have improved!

win_mvp.line: I'm one step closer to becoming a knight!

gift_prefer.line: This is... Wow, thank you so much!

battle.line: I hope... I don't get these clothes dirty...

detail.line: Would you like some fresh fruit, Commander?

feeling5.line: If only this peace could last forever... Nay, as long as we work together, this won't merely be a dream. Right, Commander? Hehe~

main1.line: We don't usually get such fresh apples and tomatoes, so how about a mixed juice? It's good for your health!

main2.line: No more fighting, no more wars... That's the peace that we're fighting to reclaim.

main3.line: Commander, I heard that aromatherapy can help you recover from fatigue. Why don't you try growing some flowers?

touch.line: I know the other knights went out of their way to pick this dress for me... but I'm not used to all the frills and whatnot...

touch2.line: Eep! N-next time, I won't hold back!

unlock.line: It's good to be able to stop and smell the roses every now and then. Um, Commander, would you be able to accompany me a bit longer?

detail.line: I joined the Kendo Club. I'm thinking it'll be good to hone my swordsmanship skills against my peers and build up my streng— Huh? What do you mean it's a different kind of sword!?

home.line: Commander, what do you say we have lunch together, if you have time?

main1.line: Commander, have you seen Le Mars? If she's slacking off again, I don't know how she thinks she's going to pass the exam...

main2.line: Study is much like swordsmanship, you have to take it seriously if you want to improve.

main3.line: Commander, your collar's all twisted. Hold still, I'll get it— There, that's better!

mission.line: In study as in war, we must always remember the mission. Isn't that right, Commander?

touch.line: Aie! The wind! ...Erm!? Commander!? You, you didn't see anything, did you?

touch2.line: S- such filthy, immoral behavior... You can't do this, Commander!

unlock.line: Even though I'm an Iris Libre squire, I'm currently working hard to have a rich student life. Um... maybe this is a bit too laid back?

detail.line: Where's Le Mars? Good grief, she ran out without finishing her homework again. I'm going to have to go give her an earful... Come on, Commander, come with me as well... H-huh?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I'll go greet them now... Huh, I'm not allowed to go right now?

home.line: Woahhh... H-huh? Commander, when did you... Oh, I looked like I was about to fall over? I see...

login.line: Would you like some too, Commander? It's really good, you know? Ehe, ehehe...

mail.line: A letter... Um, what kind of letter was it...

main1.line: Oh, some water to help me clear my head? Thank you very much! I'm so sorry for making you see that!

main2.line: Miss Algérie looks like she knows how to hold her liquor... But everyone in the Vichya Dominion seems like that... except Le Mars, I guess...

main3.line: Commander, are you enjoying the party? I won't permit you to order me to have fun while you continue to bury your head in work, all right...?

touch.line: Commander, how about another cup?

touch2.line: Ugh... How could this happen to a knight...

unlock.line: Good evening, Commander. I am currently enjoying the party in the company of my friends, as my duties as a squire entail. Um... I've had a bit too much to drink? R-really...?

win_mvp.line: You'll have to try harder than that to stop an Iris knight!

battle.line: With this newly-formed bond, I shall continue to forge ahead!

detail.line: Just looking at all the flowers around the ceremony hall is filling my heart with bliss... Ehehe~

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. Of course, I shall accompany you to welcome them back.

feeling5.line: It still feels so surreal, like I'm off in dreamland... But, I'm sure these feelings will solidify and become strong as we continue to support each other. Here and now, I renew my oath to you once more – Commander, my sword belongs to you, and I shall never leave your side.

home.line: (*pouts*)... Welcome back. Jeez, the next time something like this happens, you'd better promise to take me with you, alright?

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Um... This is still a bit embarrassing, but I'll start out by assisting you with your work!

main1.line: I have a confession. Yesterday, I was so nervous I started practicing my swordsmanship without realizing it... Luckily, my seniors stopped me right away...

main2.line: This bouquet symbolizes a knight's pride. Yes, I've chosen to swear an oath of love and loyalty... (*blushes*)

main3.line: You'd like me to change the way I address you? W-well, um... It, it's too embarrassing after all!

touch2.line: Le Mars? ...Woah, it's you, Commander?!

unlock.line: At long last, this wonderful day is here. It feels like I'm dreaming... I'm so happy, I just... Forgive me, I promised myself I wouldn't cry... I, Forbin the squire, shall remain by your side for the rest of my life!

battle.line: In order to protect everything that we cherish!

main1.line: Looks like there are plenty of folks in the Sakura Empire who understand the way of the sword. I'd love to meet with them sometime.

main2.line: I still fall short compared to the other knights, but I'm in no rush. Slowly but surely, I know I'll be able to catch up to them.

main3.line: Hnn! Haah! Oh... I started swinging my sword again without even realizing it...

touch.line: Commander, are you trying to see what's different about me?

touch2.line: Hey, there's nothing different about that place... Are you doing this on purpose?!

unlock.line: My hard work has finally paid off! Commander, thank you for your guidance all this time! I'll return the favor by bringing you even more honors in battle!

win_mvp.line: I'll say it again. I won't let Commander's efforts go to waste!

battle.line: Anyways, let's keep charging forward!

couple_encourage1.line: Miss Dunkerque, I'd like a macaron!

detail.line: Everyone here is so nice... but, there are some who seem hard to strike up a conversation with...

expedition.line: Commander, I'm going to go welcome back the girls who are coming back from their commissions!

feeling1.line: Commander, you're not going to have any friends left!

feeling2.line: I'm gonna take a stroll around the port today~♪ Maybe I can make some new friends!

feeling3.line: I have a play date with my friends today! Commander, want to join us?

feeling4.line: Commander, even though I've made a lot of friends, you're... something special. That's because I'm happiest when I'm with you!

feeling5.line: A relationship more important than friendship... lovers? But, I don't know what it means to be lovers... Huh? Just do what we always do?

home.line: Welcome back! I put the documents back on the shelves for you! ...Huh? You still wanted to check those?

hp_warning.line: H-huh? Where am I?!

login.line: Vas-y! Come on, the day's work is only beginning!

lose.line: Ehh? I lost...?

mail.line: Mail's here! I already opened it for you!

main1.line: I made friends from several different camps yesterday! Ehehe~♪

main2.line: Ah, those are the girls I played with yesterday! Commander, I'm going to get up for a bit!

main3.line: If everyone all got along, then we wouldn't have any wars!

mission.line: We still have missions left! Let's knock them out in one go!

mission_complete.line: Yay, the mission rewards are here! Huh...? We still have to check them?

profile.line: I am the Le Hardi-class destroyer, Le Téméraire! I was never completed during that war, but I'm really happy that I can be with all of you now!

propose.line: I'm not sure what this "marriage" thing is all about, but surely it means that we'll always be together from now on! Mmhm! I'll always be at your side, Commander!

touch.line: Ahahaha! That tickles!

touch2.line: W-wait, I'm not emotionally prepared yet!

unlock.line: I've finally found you! Commander, it's a pleasure to meet you! Um, my name...? Ah! I'm Le Téméraire, a Le Hardi-class destroyer from Iris Libre!

upgrade.line: I've gotten stronger!

win_mvp.line: Heheh~ Did you see me just now?

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! I love this!

detail.line: Commander, what do you think about my choice of swimsuit...? Ah, by the way, I also picked out Opiniâtre's swimsuit!

feeling5.line: I had a great time today! Ehehe~♪ But you know, it'd be nice to have some alone time with you, Commander... Hey, umm, can I... lean against your shoulder...?

home.line: Commander, aren't you hot...? Mm! Here, have an ice pop!

login.line: Heyyy! Commander! I'm over here~!

main1.line: Today's the day of the big beach volleyball meet! My friends and I are aiming for the top spot!

main2.line: Opiniâtre, are you busy practicing your "magic" again? Since we came all the way out here, you might as well have some fun...

main3.line: Huh, a crab? ...Ehh?? It was just right there... Where'd it run off to?

mission.line: Huh? We're getting work on our day off?

touch.line: The sea is refreshing and feels great! Commander, you should come on in as well!

touch2.line: Awawawa! Th-the strings are coming loose...!

unlock.line: Commander, I've finished changing into my swimsuit! Heheh~ let's head down to the beach and enjoy ourselves as much as we can!

detail.line: I got this lollipop from Mutsuki earlier! Oh, and keep it a secret from Dunkerque, okay? I'm hoping she'll make one for me later~

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Watch out, Manjuu plushie coming at you! Hehehe~ Smells nice, doesn't it?

login.line: Nighty night, Commander! ...It's not time to sleep yet, though! Feeling cheated? Hehehe~

main1.line: I can't sleep now, there's still tons of stuff I wanna do before bed. No staying up late allowed? Aww... Fine, then I'll lie down right now!

main2.line: Today was so much fun! I bet tomorrow will be even more fun, Commander!

main3.line: Hang on, where's my Manjuu plushie gone? Oh! It was hiding in the pillow!

touch.line: This Manjuu plushie is so squishy! It feels super comfy to cuddle with!

touch2.line: Th-th-th-that's not something you should be squishing...!

unlock.line: How do I look? These pajamas are super cute, aren't they? Ehehe, I really like this one! It even matches with Opiniâtre's!

detail.line: This is the best part and you're watching, so I've gotta really put some energy into it! Shipgirls, shipgirls, out at sea! Lead us all to victory!

expedition.line: Commission complete! You girls must be real tired, so go ahead and take a breather!

feeling5.line: I should be the one rooting for you, yet YOU'VE given ME so much support! ...Huh? But you haven't done anything? Well... Heehee, just you being here fills me with courage! You keep being here for me, and I'll keep doing my best!

home.line: Welcome, welcome, back to base! How was that, Commander? Did you like my surprise welcome dance? Heehee♪

login.line: Commandeeer! It's a new daaay! Your cheerleader's here to root for you!

mail.line: Letter, letter, coming thro– Oops! I almost threw your letter!

main1.line: My cheerleading dance looks great! As it should, 'cause I worked hard on it! ...It's good that I've got so much energy? Heehee, well, yeah!

main2.line: Ooone, twooo... Whuah, look out, Commander! I didn't hit you, did I? If you're hurting, tell me where so I can kiss the boo-boo! That'll make the pain go away!

main3.line: Mmmh! I can do this all day! Until I've become a praiseworthy cheerleader, I'll keep at it liiike... this!

mission.line: Commander, mission! I'll be cheering you on from here, so go get 'er done!

mission_complete.line: Mission, mission, cooom-plete! Heehee! Hope you liked that!

touch.line: Come on, move your body with me! It's bad for your health to sit around all day!

touch2.line: Nooooo! You're gonna make me fall! ...Wait, would you prefer it that way?!

unlock.line: Let's go, let's go! Allons-y! Whew... Heehee, you here to watch me rehearse, Commander? Okay, and how was my performance just now? Did that manage to motivate you?

battle.line: Keep it together, me! I can pull through with just my own powers...!

couple_encourage1.line: You're overextending yourself, Tem!

detail.line: This book lists hundreds upon hundreds of powerful spells... In my imagination, that is. It's just a regular old book of fairy-tales. No, really, that's all.

expedition.line: Our commission teams sure make magic happen.

feeling1.line: I wonder if there's a chant that'll turn you invisible...

feeling2.line: Do you believe in magic, Commander?

feeling3.line: Watch this coin closely, Commander. Left... right... left... right... Yes, you're feeling veeery sleepy... Oh. I suppose my hypnosis didn't quite work on you...

feeling4.line: Please give me your hand, Commander. Okay, now put it over mine, like this... Wait, why isn't this working? The book said I'd be able to see into your mind if I do this...

feeling5.line: You know, I always get so worked-up and feel my heart race just by being near you, Commander... Have you cast a sort of spell on me?

home.line: Well done, Commander. Would you like a soft drink, rather than a spell, to reinvigorate with?

hp_warning.line: I refuse to admit defeat so soon! B-but how am I going to win?!

login.line: I knew you'd be back right about now, Commander. Hm? Oh, well... I made that prediction based on your day-to-day activity.

lose.line: If only I had a spell that could protect us all...!

mail.line: I present to you this mail brought by hand; no levitation spell used. Here you go.

main1.line: Let me tell you... Miss Dunkerque's sweets are truly magical.

main2.line: Poke. Hm? Oh, don't mind me. I just got a sudden urge to poke you with my wand. Pokey-poke.

main3.line: If someone told you they'd grant you one wish, what would you ask for, Commander?

mission.line: Do I have a spell that automatically completes missions...? Sadly, I don't. Please do your best, Commander~

mission_complete.line: I wonder if there's a way to increase our mission rewards...

profile.line: I saw many things during the war, though my construction never finished. But now I get to lead a new life as a part of this fleet... This is a gift from the magic realm... or rather, a gift from destiny.

propose.line: I had never even dreamed of partaking in a ceremony as sacred as this... Commander, I promise to treasure this feeling and remain beside you, forever and ever.

touch.line: Feeling tired, Commander? Then would you like me to cast an awakening "spell" over your head with my wand?

touch2.line: Please stay where you are. I must go look for a spell that'll turn you into a rabbit.

unlock.line: I'm the destroyer L'Opiniâtre, a so-called "magician" from Iris Libre. It's a pleasure meeting you. Umm, actually, please forget the "magician" part.

upgrade.line: It would be nice to have a spell that does my training on my behalf.

win_mvp.line: Hm? We won? I'm happy to know that my efforts led to this victory.

gift_prefer.line: Wow. Are you a mind-reader, Commander?

feeling5_ex.line: Now that I think about it, whenever I'm around you, Commander, my heart always feels fluttery and I can't calm down... Wait, could this be... the Magic of Love?!

detail.line: It is undignified to stare so much at a maiden's swimsuit. B-besides, it's really embarrassing...

home.line: Everyone was saying how they wanted to head to the beach because of how hot it is, but it doesn't seem any cooler out here... Ugh...

login.line: Jeez, how'd my glasses end up in the sand... Um, where's my handkerchief... ah, there it is! Oh, Commander, when did you get here?

main1.line: If only there was a spell to make it cool down... maybe something to blot out the sun? Hehe, just kidding. A cold drink will suffice. Commander, what would you like?

main2.line: The sheer number of people gathered here... is this the mystical allure of the summertime beach?

main3.line: Commander, have you seen Temeraire? ...She's playing beach volleyball with the others? Hehe, I see she's as full of energy as ever.

touch.line: Commander... you didn't get heatstroke, did you?

touch2.line: Do you want to be turned into a starfish?

unlock.line: It is said that the summertime sea holds an extraordinary enchantment over people... but the only supernatural thing I'm feeling is this accursed heat... Am I missing something?

battle.line: Eek, oh nooo, I'm so scared.

couple_encourage1.line: If you need help, just say the word.

couple_encourage2.line: Bleh... I'll never reach that level...

detail.line: I suppose I'm so weak that you simply can't leave me be. Fine – I'll permit you to attend to me for a short while.

expedition.line: The commission team is back? Okay, let's go, then. I'm willing to try my best when it comes to making new friends.

feeling1.line: Commander, did you know? If someone grows too weak, they might vanish one day without a trace.

feeling2.line: Why are you looking at me like that? It's scaring me and making me feel faint... "Just looking a normal amount"? There's no way it's "normal." I look irresistibly cute when I'm weak.

feeling3.line: Why do you always conduct yourself so casually around me? You should bow before me. Yes, that's it. Lower. There we go. Remember: Always look up at me in reverence like this!

feeling4.line: When things get dangerous, you're the only one I can rely on... Well, I say that, but if it ever gets TRULY dangerous, I will step up to the plate and protect you.

feeling5.line: Gosh, I... Ahem! I'm NOT swooning, and my heart is NOT racing! If you wanna get me to admit such things... you'll need to work much harder!

headtouch.line: Mmh... I'll permit you to touch me a little longer. That's how I reward subservience.

home.line: You're back already? You really are the best in the world! Please keep me under your protection.

hp_warning.line: Now watch as Peureux retaliates!

login.line: It's such a pain for me to walk. Commander, can you carry me? ...I mean, I'll give you a loving hug in return, obviously? And don't say you "don't need it."

lose.line: They beat us... Ugh. I had a feeling this was coming.

mail.line: A letter's arrived. I sent Peureux out to get it. Why didn't I go, you ask? Well, you know, because I'm just a frail little girl...

main1.line: ...Everyone loves cute girls. I'm a good example of that – everyone likes me, and we all have fun.

main2.line: You're so huge that it's annoying, Peureux... People shouldn't be able to see a weapon from a mile away. It affects how they view me... Hey! St-stop eavesdropping!

main3.line: Um, Commander... I was feeling hungry, so I ate your lunch. You're not gonna punish me, are you? ...You won't? Oh, that's great! Next time you're hungry, I might just whip up something for you.

mission.line: New missions? Just let Peureux sort them out. You're not gonna leave frail little Hardi all by herself, are you?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Whew, I feel like I'm gonna pass out from exhaustion... I hope you'll reward me well for this, Commander...

profile.line: I'm Le Hardi, lead ship of the Iris Orthodoxy's Le Hardi class of destroyers. As you see, I'm just a regular, frail little girl... Oh, and this is Peureux, my weapon. I know it looks imposing, but I'm not lying when I say I'm weak.

propose.line: Whoooa... You're actually using glitzy jewelry to please me! Heehee. Okay, as a special privilege, I will allow you to remain by my side and serve me for many long years to come♪

skill.line: This is what you get for underestimating me!

touch.line: Eek. You're so mean, Commander. You could have made weak little Hardi trip with just a small touch.

touch2.line: Eek! I'm so weak that I don't know how I could possibly impede you... Huh? Why'd you stop? Did I not make it clear that you can do as you please?

unlock.line: I'm Le Hardi, the lead ship of the Le Hardi-class destroyers. I'm nowhere near as big or strong as anyone else, so I'm probably going be reliant on you for all sorts of things... Huh? I just said I'm reliant on you... Aren't you gonna look after me?

upgrade.line: Becoming stronger just increases the burden on your shoulders...

win_mvp.line: Mmh, ahh... We won? Didn't even have time to go easy on them.

gift_prefer.line: You've made me happy. Keep on doing that, okay...?

detail_ex.line: You know, your biggest strength is that you know your place. Yeah, you're MY Commander, and you're going to listen to whatever I say!

feeling5_ex.line: I, um... l-l-luh... love... you... No, it's YOU who loves ME, isn't it? So I have to say that for the sake of... Hey, stop with that smug expression!

headtouch_ex.line: Just once? You're free to pat me twice. Come on, do it more... If you wanna stop, you need to show sincerity. Heehee... I'm just kidding.

home_ex.line: How rude of you to make me wait THIS long. Next time you get home late, I'm gonna hide ALL your paperwork! That's what you get.

login_ex.line: Target sighted! I'm going in! Here we go... Owch! I hit my head... Pat it to make it better...

main4_ex.line: Whoooa! This feels awesome! Let me ride on your shoulders again! Take me higher! Yeah, higher! Now let me stand up! ...Hey, wait... Don't! Don't look up!

main5_ex.line: The place on your shoulders is reserved for me! If you break the promise between us... you're gonna be subjected to a BOLD prank!

main6_ex.line: Ahaha! Did me popping out from under your desk spook you? ...No? It didn't? Hmm... Clearly, you're just as magnanimous and lenient as I am.

touch_ex.line: Do you wanna armwrestle? Sure, I'm weak and powerless... but that doesn't mean you should underestimate me.

touch2_ex.line: Eek! Nooo! How'd that sound? Heehee – nobody will hear us no matter how loud we scream. Heheh♪

detail.line: Bweeeh... I used the sauna for so long that I can't stand up... Sorry, but I can't do anything unless you hold me♪

feeling5.line: When... did you stand up? You haven't been peeking at my chest, have– You haven't? O-okay, then come closer... That's it. Heehee. This is my favorite kind of... scenario♪

headtouch.line: My hair's so wet and heavy... Mind holding it for me, Commander? I need to dry it after I'm done with this milk. Heehee, yes, like that. This way, I can go slow and savor the taste♪

home.line: Commaaandeeer! Are you back to protect me and my precious milk?

login.line: Ahhh... Feels like my head's about to start fuming... Commander. Hey, Commander! Could you bring me some cold milk? Yeah, I want all of it!

main1.line: Wheeew, I'm so sweaty... Hey, don't I look even weaker than usual when I'm drenched in sweat?

main2.line: Heheh! Surpriiise! Did I spook you? ...Hm? That's odd... We both left at the same time, so how come you're so dry? Rub, rub♪

main3.line: I'm so sticky... Is it because of all the sweat? Ugh, it's even dripping off of me... Why don't we take a shower together afterwards?

touch.line: Want some of my milk? ...Oh, you were just trying to wipe off some that I spilled? Oh nooo! Look away, look away! Don't look!

touch2.line: If you go any further, I really will start screaming, "Help! Heeelp!"

unlock.line: Gulp, gulp... Ahh! That hits the spot! Cold and refreshing... There's nothing in the world like a glass of cold milk after steaming in the sauna.

battle.line: Let's go carve us some meat!

couple_encourage1.line: Here we go! Chaaarge!

couple_encourage2.line: Barbecue? Barbecue, barbecue!

detail.line: Hmm? You wanna know about my barbecue magic? Or... are you waiting for the food to be ready? Aww, you don't have to be shy~ Come and eat before it gets cold!

expedition.line: Everyone just got back! I've got meat on the barbecue, so bring them over for a big meal!

feeling1.line: Sorry... There isn't any meat left for you.

feeling2.line: Eating meat together is the first step to becoming fast friends. Get over here and eat with me, Commander!

feeling3.line: Watch closely, Commander~ Hmmm... Haah! Pretty good swordplay, huh? If you wanna eat well and fast, you need swordsmanship and passion!

feeling4.line: *blooow*... Perfect! Open up, Commander. I've been watching this meat closely, so it should be cooked just right! Did it taste good? Hehe, glad to hear it.

feeling5.line: You smell really good lately, Commander... Am I just imagining it? *sniff sniff*... Mmm... Huh? No, I'm not gonna eat you!

headtouch.line: Ooh... The moment you gave me headpats, my tummy started rumbling. Is that magic?

home.line: Welcome hooome! I grilled meat for you, so hurry up and eat... Oooh, that smells good. Can I have some? Just a bite...

hp_warning.line: I'm too hungryyy!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander! I tried roasting meat with a new blend of spices. Come and give it a taste. Can't work on an empty tummy!

lose.line: *sigh*... I'm sooo hungry. Can we cook the baddies, you think?

mail.line: Mail caaall! Let's see if it's good news, Commander!

main1.line: Alright, the pineapple barbecue is almost ready~ Hm? You think eating barbecue every day is bad for my nutritional balance? Don't worry – I eat different side dishes every time!

main2.line: Commander, have you seen my ribbon? I thought I brought it... Oh! It's already on my head! Hahaha!

main3.line: Phew... I ate a ton... Commander? Why are you looking at... Oh! Did I accidentally eat yours?! Sorry! I'll make it up with double... no, TRIPLE for you!

mission.line: Ah! Commander, you have new missions to do. If we do them together, we'll be done before dinnertime!

mission_complete.line: Everything finished on time! You're amazing, Commander!

profile.line: Report! Iris Libre destroyer L'Intrépide is here and full of energy! Whether it's cooking, eating, OR fighting, you can leave it all to me!

propose.line: Wait... This is a ring! Huh? Wha? Whaaaat?! For ME?! Yes, of course! I'd be happy to! I'll cherish you for the rest of my life, Commander!

touch.line: Whoa! Commander! You scared me...

touch2.line: Whoa! You're so forward, Commander... Not that I mind!

unlock.line: Meat's done! *blow*... *munch*... Hmm? Oh, Commander, hello! My name is L'Intrépide, and I'm with the Iris Libre... Huh? You want more details? Mm... Can it wait until I finish this?

upgrade.line: Phew... I cooked and ate a lot~ Now I'm satisfied.

win_mvp.line: We won! Let's celebrate with a feast – I'll do the grilling!

gift_prefer.line: I LOVE it! Thank you so much, Commander!

feeling5_ex.line: I wanna give you a hug... May I? Here I come... Huggies! You and I will be together forever, like meat and potatoes!

headtouch_ex.line: Hehe, that feels nice. Smells good, too...

home_ex.line: Good work, Commander! Relax and let me knead and tenderize those shoulders. Does it feel good? Hmm... How else can I make you taste even better?

login_ex.line: Heheh... I smell something even better than barbecue meat. *sniff*... You smell delicious... Umm, I mean, welcome home! I just made barbecue. Come eat up!

main4_ex.line: Commander, are you tired? Wanna lie down on me and take a nap? I'll be the perfect, immobile cushion for you!

main5_ex.line: Urgh, my tummy's rumbling... Meat... Where's the meat? Do you have it? Thank goodness!

main6_ex.line: Just one more piece left... No, this is for the Commander... Huh? Can I really have half of it?!

touch_ex.line: Mmm... I wanna jump into your arms and take a big whiff of your scent!

touch2_ex.line: Heheh, I'm used to this, so it won't surprise me anymore. Come with me now♪

detail.line: Did you like my fiery dance just now? If you still want more... I'll use my barbecue magic to set the whole stage on fire for you!

feeling5.line: Give me a hug, Commander! Why now? Because I want you to feel my burning passion, of course. Are you ready? Here I cooome!

home.line: Commander, you're back just in time for the opening act! There will be owls performing today. You'd better find a seat so you don't miss the action!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. You're looking great today! Wanna try out this super-fun fiery trail with me? Don't worry – if you keep up with me, you won't get hurt at all... I think! Hehehe!

main1.line: Commander, come closer~ Just a little more... Hah, got you! Can you feel my sizzling passion and energy?

main2.line: That was the BEST! I had so much fun... Let's do it again! Join me, Commander!

main3.line: Success! We've got medium grilled meat! See how the inside is still a vibrant red? Do you wanna eat it as-is, or would you like to try my special black pepper spice blend?

touch.line: Heheh, don't get burned by the heat of my passion!

touch2.line: Whoa! You really like this spot, don't you?

unlock.line: Heheh, here comes the grand finale! Watch in amazement as I snatch the meat from that ring of fire and put the finishing touch to tonight's feast! Don't blink, Commander!

battle.line: What is it that you are fighting for?

couple_encourage1.line: If you keep slacking off... I'll have to inform Le Triomphant~ Heh heh.

couple_encourage2.line: Let us do battle together, my beloved sister!

couple_encourage3.line: Your orders, Cardinal?

detail.line: I have no interest in fighting pointless battles, but there seem to be some individuals here who place excessive pride in their speed... Of course, I was more than glad to put them in their place. More importantly, I made quite a few friends in the process. Not too bad, right?

expedition.line: Coins, oil, and supplies... I wonder if the rewards for this commission will also be abundant.

feeling1.line: If you wish to make a confession, better to turn to the Cardinal rather than to me.

feeling2.line: You're here neither for prayers nor confessions? I see. In that case, I'll also have to find something else to do to pass the time... Hmm, hmm...

feeling3.line: You'd like to have a chat? Let's see then... Between life, freedom, and love, which is most important to you, Commander? Hehe, don't be alarmed that I suddenly sprang that question on you. I simply wanted to see how you'd react~

feeling4.line: Now then, moving on to the next question. Commander, do you prefer to be bound by someone else, or would you rather be the one doing the binding? Hehe, assume there are no other options~

feeling5.line: If I was to cross the threshold of death's door one day, would you pull me back–– Hmm, I suppose that question's a bit too easy. I'm not trying to toy around with you, I simply wanted to hear how you feel. Heheh~

headtouch.line: Please refrain from touching my hat.

home.line: Here are the materials you've requested, as well as the tea and light meal. Please note that the tea may be a bit hot. Hmm? It's cooled down?

hp_warning.line: The Holy Iris will protect us!

login.line: My, you seem to be in high spirits today, Commander. Do you have any orders for me?

lose.line: The warriors of Iris Libre must not falter.

mail.line: Commander, if you're unable to locate your mail... it's because I've already brought it over here. Heh heh~♪

main1.line: That little incident I had with Le Malin? Yes, I've already apologized to her, but her mind seemed to be on something else...

main2.line: My, Commander, look at you over there with that derpy face–– Ahem, what I meant was, it's not good to slack off. You should try to learn a thing or two from Le Triomphant.

main3.line: Those who seek to spread the wings of hope are too often shackled by trivial matters. Commander, do you have the ambition to break your chains?

mission.line: Commander, have you come across a mission so difficult that it's even making you furrow your brow? ...My my, I see~♪ Ahem, I mean, I would be more than glad to lend my assistance, should you desire it––

mission_complete.line: Are you sure you're able to sort out all these rewards yourself, Commander? Heh heh... Perhaps you could look for another person to work with you~?

profile.line: As a part of the 10th Scout Division of the Brest Fleet, I carried out escort missions as well as participated in the withdrawal from Strasbourg. As one who served the Iris Orthodoxy, I was finally shown the light of victory. Ah, how blessed I must be.

propose.line: Sorry to make you buy a ring for me, but I can't deny these feelings any longer–– Heh, heheh... Ahahaha~♪ Yes, with this sacred ritual, no longer will I be teasing you. Indeed, from now on, I pledge myself to you, fully and forever.

touch.line: You may pray to the Holy Iris, or offer me a confession in person. Speak your piece.

touch2.line: I do say, Commander, how generous of you to reveal your weaknesses to me one after another~

unlock.line: I am Le Terrible, the elegant large destroyer who protects the teachings of Iris Libre. I have come in pursuit of your ideals. Commander, please show me the reason for which you fight.

upgrade.line: To claim to be the strongest... is not something that should be stated haphazardly. Don't you agree, Commander?

win_mvp.line: Do not deny yourself the pride that you righteously deserve. The path to victory has been paved by God, but it is you who shall lead us down that path, Commander.

gift_prefer.line: Commander... I'm not worthy of such a gift!

battle_ex.line: Accept your divine punishment!

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, have some spare time to have a chat? No no, I didn't have anything special in mind. You know, I get anxious if I don't get to see your face for even a day. Whether you're having a good day or a not-so-good day, I just want to see more of you~

login_ex.line: You look to be in high spirits today. So, what do you need me to do next?

main4_ex.line: A tea party with my sisters? ...I don't know about that... H-hey, it's not that I don't want to go... But what if the tea is too hot...

main5_ex.line: If you have a mission that requires speed, just leave it to me. That's one of my fortes, after all.

main6_ex.line: Want to head to somewhere high up after you're done with work? I'd like to understand... what it feels like to be a bird, soaring freely through the skies.

mission_complete_ex.line: The mission rewards are right here. Heh heh~ I love the way you look when you're pushing yourself to the limit~♪

touch_ex.line: If you could talk to me about your concerns, Commander, I'd be really happy~♪

touch2_ex.line: This... is also one of my weaknesses.

upgrade_ex.line: Ahaha! Thanks to you, Commander, I feel even stronger.

win_mvp_ex.line: How's that? Look what I, in all my grace and elegance, have done in your name.

battle.line: Well then... I guess I'll fight...

detail.line: Le Malin, Le Triomphant... We'll be together forever...... Zzzzz...

expedition.line: Our commission went wonderfully... I saw that in my dream...

feeling1.line: Zzzzz

feeling2.line: Zzzzz

feeling3.line: Zzzzz

feeling4.line: Zzzzz

feeling5.line: Commander's derpy face... Ehehe... I've always wanted to see this... Just let me rest a while... at your side... Zzzzz...

home.line: Zzzz... Black tea... should be left until it's a bit cooler than room temperature...

login.line: Le Malin... It's time to get to work... Make sure you don't drag the Commander down... Zzzzz...

lose.line: I knew it, I'm just not good enough... Unlike some of those Eagle Union destroyers...

mail.line: Please remember... to check your mail...

main1.line: Le Triomphant... You're not the most photogenic sleeper...

main2.line: Commander... Give me another couple hours... And then...

main3.line: Nooo, I'm going to get pranked... Ehehe... I won't hold it against you though, so please...

mission.line: The missions... We haven't finished them all yet...

mission_complete.line: We have mission rewards... waiting for us...

touch.line: But if you could stop at scribbling on my face... that'd be nice...

touch2.line: Nngh... Mmh...

unlock.line: Zzz... Commander...? Sorry... for showing you this unsightly side of mine... I'm just, not a morning person... Zzzzz...

upgrade.line: It'd be nice... if I could get stronger after waking up...

win_mvp.line: *Yawn*... I'm still a bit sleepy... I can't even properly savor the aftertaste of victory like this... Zzzzz...

detail.line: For someone not accustomed to strenuous exercise such as myself, I prefer to let the ocean's waves rock me back and forth.

expedition.line: Oh, it appears the commission fleet has returned.

home.line: Splendidly done. Would you like to hold a tea party by the beachside, Commander? Indeed, something with ice would be nice~♪

login.line: Is the sun a bit too oppressive for your liking, Commander? If so, you would do well to find some shade, as my clever sister has done.

mail.line: Commander, if you're talking about the mail, I think Le Malin has it... Hehe~♪

main1.line: Miss Ark Royal? Hmm, you're asking if she comes across as helpful or troublesome? Perhaps a bit of both, I must say...

main2.line: The Cardinal plans to go surfing? Commander, I think you should keep an eye on her.

main3.line: If a big wave comes... Hmm... Uhh... That's probably not going to bode well for me...

touch.line: If you find it too hot, why not take off another layer~? Hehe~♪

touch2.line: My, oh my~♪

unlock.line: How goes your day, Commander? Hehe, are you looking for my clever sister, Le Malin? If so, you would do well to search somewhere less... popular~♪

battle.line: Onwards, girls! Holy is the war that we wage!

couple_encourage1.line: On me, Vauquelin!

couple_encourage2.line: Why, it's you, Algérie!

couple_encourage3.line: I-it's an unimaginable honor fighting alongside you, Cardinal!

couple_encourage4.line: Wouldst thou try and take this seriously, Foch?!

detail.line: Do you understand, Lord Commander? The Cardinal herself is with us in this war. Therefore, it's a holy war! You should feel honored to be part of it!

expedition.line: The commission team hath returned! Heheh. The rewards would've been greater if you'd entrusted the job to a Templar Knight like me...

feeling1.line: We both have goals to work towards! I'll strive to be a full Templar Knight, and thou should strive to be a half-decent commander!

feeling2.line: I may still be a way's off from full knighthood, but I would still give my life for our holy crusade! Give me orders, and I will execute them, Lord Commander!

feeling3.line: Lord Commander, if you ever feel anxious before a battle, simply put your hands together and pray, like... "Iris, watch over our souls," and you'll be fine!

feeling4.line: It's not enough to protect just my Iris comrades. I must fight for all my friends here at port too... Oh, the burden on my shoulders doth grow ever bigger... Cardinal, Lord Commander, how will I carry this weight...?

feeling5.line: If we share the burden of protecting everyone, then we can manage this feat together! The Cardinal told me that! On my sword, I vow to work harder than ever!

headtouch.line: Stunning hair ornament, am I right?

home.line: Exemplary work, Lord Commander! Although I guess it would have been a cakewalk for the Cardinal!

hp_warning.line: I cannot and will not succumb...!

login.line: Sound the trumpets, for I am here! ...Ah, morning salutations, Lord Commander!

lose.line: Th-thou may crush my body, but my spirit will live on...! Wait, that doesn't sound right...

mail.line: New mail... The information inside is sure to be of paramount significance!

main1.line: Our next battle is important, and I will not neglect my training in preparation for it!

main2.line: Vauquelin! Thou must eat thy veggies! ...G-green peppers, however... Yes, it's a bad vegetable! Thou may pass on that one!

main3.line: The Cardinal herself will be spectating our next exercise?! Oh goodness, oh dear... I must practice more!

mission.line: What about these unfinished missions? You'd better do them before the Cardinal scoldeth you.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! It's time to reap the rewards, Lord Commander!

profile.line: I am Maillé Brézé, Vauquelin-class destroyer! I am renowned for my ability to escort, patrol, transport, and to fight off submarines! ...Ultimately, though, it didn't save me from sinking... Aww...

propose.line: To whom do I deliver this ring, Lord Commander? ...I-it's for me?! You're serious?! I-I accept. I just worried for a bit whether you truly wanted me...

touch.line: It won't be long before I'm dubbed a full-fledged Templar Knight!

touch2.line: Are you that enamored by my sheer magnificence?

unlock.line: Destroyer Maillé Brézé, Templar Knight of the Iris Libre, has arrived! Thou there, plebeian, thou may now sleep soundly knowing I'll defend thy lanes! ...What? Y-you're the Lord Commander?! F-f-forgive my grave disrespect just now!

upgrade.line: Another step on my journey to full knighthood!

win_mvp.line: There you have it! That was a display of a Templar Knight's might!

gift_prefer.line: Oooh! Thank you, Commandeeer!

detail_ex.line: You went shopping with Algérie?! N-no, I'm not envious in the slightest, not at all! ...Though I wish you'd have taken me along...

feeling5_ex.line: Lord Commander! When is the next sortie? I must know so I can prepare for our holy battle, and also to relax and repose! Most of all, I'd love to spend a day off together with you~

home_ex.line: Outstanding performance, Lord Commander! If you brought gifts for the Cardinal, I may deliver them for you!

login_ex.line: Good morning, Lord Commander! Early as always, I see! Hehehe~

main4_ex.line: I will protect you with my life, as your sworn knight, Lord Commander! Hehehe~

main5_ex.line: Mayhaps I should ask Émile for dancing lessons... N-nothing! Just thinking out loud!

main6_ex.line: Anything you require, I can do no problem! Simply give the order, Lord Commander!

touch2_ex.line: Is this... what falling in love feels like?!

win_mvp_ex.line: We did it! We are victorious, Lord Commander! Hehehe! The Cardinal will surely honor me for this!

detail.line: Those things in the dark were just... Manjuus? N-n-no, impossible! Those little creatures could never frighten me so!

headtouch.line: I can't t-take this anymore!

home.line: You're back! You're finally back! I was sooooo scared, Lord Commandeeeer...!

login.line: Wh-what is it, Lord Commander? As you see, I'm simply guarding my room...

mail.line: G-g-go check your mail, right now!

main1.line: Why am I afraid of monsters under the bed...? I-I-I'm not!

main2.line: Eek! I heard a weird noise coming from outside! I'm sure of it! Help meeee, Lord Commander!

main3.line: It's times like these when I envy Tartu so much...!

touch.line: I-I was merely pretending to be spooked!

touch2.line: Could you stay here until I fall asleep...?

unlock.line: H-h-halt, intruder! Thou art intruding in the domain of an Iris Libre Templar Knight, a crime punishable by... Eek! I'm begging you, spare my life! ...It's you, Lord Commander?!

win_mvp.line: S-see?! No monster can scare me as long as I have the Iris' protection!

detail.line: It's blissful to have such many desserts just within arm's reach! More blissful yet is that they art a gift from the Cardinal herself! Heheh♪

home.line: Outstanding! You are permitted to treat yourself to my desserts!

login.line: Won't you join me for teatime, Lord Commander? This is too much to eat alone. I... I am not asking for your help at all! Partake only if you wish! Be grateful for my magnanimity!

main1.line: This pastry is for thee, Vauquelin! Savor it thoroughly as it's a gift from the Cardinal! Thou must eat it with dignity!

main2.line: C-Cardinal?! Thank you dearly for these gifts – such lavish treats are much more than I deserve!

main3.line: I do not have any donuts, Tartu. However, I do have macarons, the next best thing.

touch.line: You would touch my unarmored body?! A cowardly attack, I say!

touch2.line: You will have NO desserts if you're going to be like that!

unlock.line: Enjoying sweet pastries in a lovely dress – heehee, such bliss! ...I care not how unbecoming this is of a knight! I saved these desserts for my holiday! Let me enjoy myself, would you!

win_mvp.line: There is nothing as sweet as a celebratory dessert!

battle.line: The concert's starting!

couple_encourage1.line: I've got your back!

couple_encourage2.line: Let's up the tempo a bit!

detail.line: I've been working on a new dance the whole day... Tired, you ask? Heehee, I can take it if it means putting on a great concert for you!

expedition.line: We could welcome back the commission team with a song and dance! What do you say, Commander?
