feeling1.line: Commander... Has the stress been getting to you?

feeling2.line: Commander, my concert is just around the corner! It's gonna be amazing and elegant and you don't wanna miss it!

feeling3.line: Commander! Whew... How's that? Have I gotten more elegant? Heehee! I've been rehearsing SO hard to get to this point!

feeling4.line: Commander, are you free today? I don't need a favor from you or anything, I've just been working extra hard on some moves that I wanna surprise you with a demonstration of... Oh no! I gave the surprise away!

feeling5.line: You think I look like a real star up on stage? Heehee, you say that, but if you ask me, the real star here is you! ...When I put it like that, maybe you're actually better suited to be an idol than me!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Now have a break. Heehee, you need regular breaks if you wanna deliver your best performance!

hp_warning.line: Oh no! I went off-key!

login.line: I'm gonna try to be the best idol I can every day!

lose.line: Dang it... Back to rehearsals for me...

mail.line: There's a letter for you! Buuut you can always read it later! Heehee!

main1.line: Commandeeer! Heehee! I've got a surprise present for you – a biiig and warm hug! Feeling charged up on energy now?

main2.line: Ow-ow-ow... Got a leg cramp. This choreography is so tricky... Whoa! Commander, how long have you been here? ...You'll give me a leg massage? Oh yeah... Heehee, I think that's helping a bit!

main3.line: What's beyond the door? Ahaha! A room where these huge mushrooms grow. Pretty cool, right? Even if it's just stage dressing!

mission.line: Commander, you have a new mission! Let me help you with it!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete, Commander! The rewards have been claimed, so let's go have fun!

profile.line: I'm Le Téméraire of the Le Hardi class! Just you wait – I'm gonna give you the best, most elegant performance you'll ever see from Cyanidin!

propose.line: Heehee. Honestly, I've wished for this ever since the day I became an idol. In my dreams, you've already put the ring on my finger a thousand times... but now that it's happening for realsies, I'm feeling tense. Could we just... hold hands for ever and ever?

touch.line: You want to be part of my performance? Yippee!

touch2.line: Eep! Commander, I've got a concert soon! This isn't the time to mess around!

unlock.line: I am the Le Hardi-class destro– Wait, no! Right now, I'm Tem, AKA Le Téméraire, an idol with the unit Cyanidin! Keep your eyes peeled for my debut performance, Commander!

upgrade.line: My rehearsing has paid off!

win_mvp.line: Now you know what makes me so great!

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me...? Yay♪

battle.line: Allow me to have this dance~

detail.line: I love dancing because it brings joy to people♪

expedition.line: Commander, look towards the harbor! The commission team has returned.

feeling1.line: I can't feel any passion coming from you, Commander...

feeling2.line: I often hear people say that we of Iris Libre are romantics, but the way I see it, we simply focus on life's little details.

feeling3.line: Because we focus on the details, we can see the beauty of everyday things. I believe a true romanticist values even the smallest of life's beautiful things.

feeling4.line: Dancing when one wants to – that is what's known as the courage to express one's love of life. Commander, I believe a romanticist must sometimes show courage and express their feelings in some way. Like this– *Kiss*... What do you believe, Commander?

feeling5.line: The gorgeous radiance of yesterday, the heart-throbbing excitement of today, the overflowing hopes of tomorrow! Every day is so wonderful! Each passing day, my love for you grows even stronger!

home.line: Commander, if you feel tired then some rest would do you good. Taking breaks is important.

hp_warning.line: It seems I'm not in pace with the battlefield...

login.line: Bonjour~ Commander, before we get to work, I say we do some stretches~

lose.line: Oh, dear... Perhaps I left my guard too low.

mail.line: Commander, here's your mail♪

main1.line: The Land of Gold – the Sakura Empire! Fantastique! I do hope to see it one day!

main2.line: Compared to those 2 years at Fort-de-France... it's wonderful to be able to dance freely beneath the blue sky~

main3.line: Commander, is there anything I can help you with? Whatever it is, I'd love to.

mission.line: We've been relayed new missions? Then let's get them all done at once♪

mission_complete.line: Oh, was that the commission complete notification? You should give it a look, Commander.

profile.line: I'm Émile Bertin of Iris Libre~ In days of old, I worked hard laying mines... and leading destroyers. I also transported gold, took part in Operation Dragoon, and participated in a few other missions, so you could say I got through the war unscathed... I suppose?

propose.line: I want to express my feelings in this joyous moment through a dance and a kiss... Commander, could you indulge me?

touch.line: Are you worn out, Commander? Shall I perform my energizing dance for you?

touch2.line: Commander, if you're asking me for a dance, you need to do it more courteously~!

unlock.line: Bonjour~ I'm Émile Bertin of Iris Libre. You can just call me Émile~ I want to make friends with everyone here~

upgrade.line: Ohoh, my steps feel lighter now~

win_mvp.line: Merci pour tout~ Thank you for your time♪

gift_prefer.line: Merci~ I love it!

detail.line: Commander, how about a game of beach volleyball? I actually happen to be quite good at it♪

home.line: My, you're so excited, Commander♪ I knew you were looking forward to the beach~

login.line: Commander, don't forget to stretch before going into the ocean, okay?

main1.line: Commander, could I ask you to apply sunscreen to my skin next time we go to the beach?

main2.line: Long hair is quite inconvenient when you're swimming... Which way of tying up my hair is your favorite, Commander?

main3.line: Oh, Commander~ Since we're going to the beach, why not change into your swim gear ahead of time? Oh, no, I definitely don't want to see how it looks on you, not at all~

touch.line: Go on ahead without you? Why, a secretary can't just casually part from her Commander, can she? I'll be right here waiting for you♪

touch2.line: It seems as summer comes forth, so too does your passion~

unlock.line: Commander, does my swimsuit pique your fancy? I'm actually quite proud of my fashion sense. *Giggle* Now, let's enjoy midsummer together~

detail.line: Be they simple dresses or extravagant costumes, any outfit can be romantic once you actually put it on!

home.line: You know what comes next? Mhm! Tell me what's on your mind and your worries will all go away, Commander♪

login.line: "Welcome back, Master~" – Just like how all the Royal Maids do it~

main1.line: Wouldn't it be lovely if these stuffed toys could join me for a dance~?

main2.line: I've heard people describe their dreams as astonishing or romantic. I wonder, have you had any fascinating dreams like that, Commander?

main3.line: I'm more fond of imparting my passion to others through actions than through words while sitting down~

touch.line: Hehe~ I will perform a little number called "The Maid's Dance" for you~

touch2.line: This sort of lust is not what romance is about!

unlock.line: I heard of this romantic concept of maid outfits, and thought I'd try one on to see how it feels~ What are your thoughts, Commander?

detail.line: Gorgeous flowers alone don't create a vibrant party. Leaves and greenery have a place, too.

home.line: Oh, this fragrance just dissolves all my fatigue~ Come, take a deep breath, and relax, Commander~

login.line: You're the guest of honor at today's party, remember? We can't have you looking like that!

main1.line: These flowers would suit you perfectly, Jeanne! Take one and wear it for the party, I say. Heheh~

main2.line: The bees are so drawn to this place. My, they're like passionate little fairies!

main3.line: A party is a fantastic occasion when the air fills with passion! Enjoy your time here to the fullest, Commander~

touch.line: Do you wish to rehearse our dance? I'm ready whenever you are!

touch2.line: Commander, try to mind your manners, whatever the time or occasion!

unlock.line: Modest though it may be, isn't this a lovely little garden? Come, Commander! Let us dance surrounded by Mother Nature~

detail.line: As I am now, I'll surely be able to dance for you even more wonderfully!

expedition.line: I'll head down to the docks to dance a little for the girls who are coming back~

home.line: Allow me to restore your energy with my dance, Commander!

login.line: It's a wonderful day today as well, Commander!

main1.line: Commander, did you know that the most important thing in dance is not the technique, but rather the confidence? Yes, the confidence that "I am at my very best on stage!"

main2.line: The dances of the Sakura Empire, in contrast to my passionate and free-flowing form, focus more on tradition. C'est magnifique!

main3.line: Recently, more and more people have become interested in dance. Commander, you should join as well!

touch.line: The essence of dancing is to follow your own feelings. Come on, Commander! Allons danser!

touch2.line: Commander, you need to focus more when you're dancing!

unlock.line: Émile Bertin, retrofit complete! I feel like a completely new person! To show my gratitude, Commander, I'll perform a brand new dance for you!

battle.line: Brave soldiers, follow my lead!

couple_encourage1.line: My comrade, may you also receive our Lord's blessings!

detail.line: Jeanne d'Arc... While this name imparts a heavy responsibility, I refuse to run away from it. After all, bearing that burden is my duty.

expedition.line: Everyone's returned safely. Praise be to the Lord!

feeling1.line: ...If you are a demon, I will not hesitate to cut you down with my sword... If if is just that you have strayed from the righteous path, then repent, now!

feeling2.line: If thorns block my path, I will clear a way. If flames obstruct my path, I will overcome them. I will not let any obstacle keep me from walking the path of God!

feeling3.line: This blade does not exist to be wielded for my sake. I wield this blade for you, my homeland of Iris Libre, and for all in the fleet...

feeling4.line: My dream is to lead everyone to victory while bearing a banner. However, victory is something that cannot be achieved alone. For that purpose, I need the help of my allies, and you, Commander.

feeling5.line: Commander... The more burdens I bear, the more I cannot allow myself to rest. That's why, for a little bit... just for a little bit... would you lend me your shoulder?

home.line: The flames of war have yet to be extinguished. It's time to redouble our efforts.

hp_warning.line: The situation is dire... Everyone, stay in formation!

login.line: May the port be ever blessed with our Lord's grace.

lose.line: No, I can't stop here...

mail.line: Commander, you've received some mail. Please look through it.

main1.line: Saint Michael, I beseech you – please tell me what I should do next...

main2.line: My name, my weapons, and my rigging. All are testament to my conviction.

main3.line: If you're tired, you should rest. Battles should not compose your entire existence.

mission.line: Commander, there must still be some unfinished business you need to attend to.

mission_complete.line: There is more value to mission than just the rewards.

profile.line: Even though I had previously been a training cruiser in charge of raising excellent warriors, I am now standing at the front lines for my country with sword in hand. I pledge my all for my beloved homeland!

propose.line: This is... how you feel...? I'm so happy. I also treasure you the most, Commander. Um, you see... I'm not really sure what we're supposed to do together, but... first, would you like to try being pampered by me, Commander?

skill.line: The Lord's blessings upon the Iris Libre!

touch.line: Is there something bothering you?

touch2.line: I-is this what you're into, Commander?

unlock.line: If you are familiar with the name I have been entrusted with, then you should also understand my noble calling. Jeanne d'Arc of Iris Libre is now under your command.

upgrade.line: My burning spirit, become my strength!

win_mvp.line: This still isn't enough to fulfill our duty... No. Everyone, you've all done great!

gift_prefer.line: I'd almost forgotten something that I once loved so dearly... Thank you, Commander.

detail_ex.line: In comparison to someone like me, Cardinal Richelieu... is a true saintess. N-no, I'm not jealous at all.

home_ex.line: One who is bestowed the Iris' power must always be humble. We must take care to not let ourselves be swayed by the outcome of a single battle, Commander.

login_ex.line: Commander, may God's blessings be upon you.

main1_ex.line: As you always have done, please, continue to protect everyone in the Iris Libre, the port, and the Commander...!

main2_ex.line: ...E-eh? Commander's documents... Oh no... How could I make such a mistake!

main3_ex.line: If you're tired, you should get some rest. If you don't rest, then I can't rest peacefully, either... After all, it'd be inconceivable for the secretary ship to rest before the Commander! A-anyway, please get some rest first.

touch_ex.line: I-it sparkles, so please don't touch it too much.

touch2_ex.line: D-don't touch me there!

detail.line: To think that there was such a wonderful movie set at the port... What a surprise.

login.line: Commander, shall we get started? I'm all ready.

main1.line: I know you told me to rest when we take breaks, but... my, how should I put it... I'm really enjoying this work!

main2.line: There's a dream I have from time to time... I dream of what it would be like to cruise freely about the sea, using only my divine powers to do so, though I as a ship do not deserve such freedom.

main3.line: Com...mander. Commander. Is something the matter? You've been zoning out while looking at me. By the way, I require your assistance. Would you please come over here?

touch.line: When we wrap up this job, do I want to go to the beach? Yes! I'd love to go to the beach with you!

unlock.line: "O chosen hero, I bestow this sword upon you so that you may clear any obstacles in your path..." Commander, how did that sound?

detail.line: You want to know what I wrote on my lantern? Heehee, they say that wishes don't come true if you tell others what they are. For now, it stays a secret.

feeling5.line: I put up all of these lanterns, each bearing a different wish of mine. Yes, I know that I must be on my guard against all kinds of greed, but... What is a wish, if not something I want to be granted?

headtouch.line: I know I don't normally dress like this... Is it too different?

home.line: Commander, you return. Did your mission go smoothly? Good... Glory to the Holy Spirit for answering my prayers.

login.line: Pray that our wishes and blessings become eternal and protect everything we hold dear...

main1.line: May the fireworks and lanterns above carry my wishes to protect everyone... and to protect you.

main2.line: Goodness, it's that late? I didn't notice. It's practically as bright as daytime, after all.

main3.line: I can put down my sword for today...? "As long as you don't forget your duty, occasional rest is perfectly fine," you say? Hmm... I understand. Thank you, Commander.

mission.line: You mustn't forget your duty, even on days of celebration. I'll help you.

mission_complete.line: Your missions are all complete. Now we can relax a little.

touch.line: The petals are falling on you. U-umm, would you like to come under my umbrella?

touch2.line: H-here, of all places?!

unlock.line: Oh, Commander, would you like to release a lantern? I hear they're a way to send wishes into the heavens above... May our Lord bless our companions and bring peace and joy to all.

battle.line: Oh, fine, if I must~ But only a little.

couple_encourage1.line: Why don't you show me what you've got?♪

couple_encourage2.line: It's about time I pulled out all the stops, too♪

detail.line: Sufficiently advanced technology may look like magic, but there are times when human miracles are treated as sacraments. Don't you find it wonderful that humans can perform such divine works?

expedition.line: I wonder if the girls on commission duty will bring any herbs back for me...

feeling1.line: Now, now. I'm sure you can recover from this blunder in no time, Commander.

feeling2.line: Calling myself a witch of the Iris Orthodoxy... may be a little misleading. I'm just a shipgirl, and one of your subordinates at that. Heehee~♪

feeling3.line: People are saying I have a weird cauldron in my room? Well, yes, I have one for boiling down herbs... Why would people spread rumors about that? Is it something about the cauldron, or is it something about me... Heehee. Curious, isn't it?

feeling4.line: Welcome to the witch's abode. More normal than you expected? But of course. You treated me as a friend rather than a witch, after all. Or were you hoping to see something more... magical?

feeling5.line: As you know, we witches are better at deceiving human hearts than making miracles. In much the same way, I'm going to show you one essence of the magic that is love. Your heart is as good as mine, Commander♪

home.line: Excellent work. Let's not worry about the battle reports for now; more importantly, find anything interesting?

hp_warning.line: Well, this is a bit of a problem...

login.line: You're a steadfast worker. I wish I could put that much work into my magic research! Ahaha!

lose.line: I'll blow my cover if I go all-out, so this is all you get for now~

mail.line: Your unread mail is stacking up. Are you trying to act like a big-shot? Why, exactly?

main1.line: Not everyone from the Iris Orthodoxy is necessarily religious. What do they call that again? Stereotyping, right?

main2.line: I'm a lot better at magic than office work. Casting spells, making dubious potions, riding brooms... Wait, you actually believe me?

main3.line: Prayer and spells aren't a waste of time if they touch your heart. If anything, aren't miracles only possible because they can be conceived of by human hearts?

mission.line: You have unfinished missions. Some of them might disappear if you ignore them for too long, so are you sure you don't want to give them a second look?

mission_complete.line: There are rewards here with your name on them. Leave them alone, and they might get away!

profile.line: I'm Guichen, a De Grasse-class anti-aircraft cruiser. As you can see, I'm just your average witch without any history to speak of. But now that I've been given this lovely new home, I'll do my very best to be worthy of it.

propose.line: Hm? You can't move? I wonder why that might be? Heheheh, I won't keep you long, so just do as I say for now. Here... Put on this ring. I got matching ones for us!

touch.line: You need help with something? I don't mind, though I'm not sure I have much to offer...

touch2.line: You know, there are legends about witches attacking hapless, ordinary people... Want to find out more firsthand?

unlock.line: I am anti-aircraft cruiser, Guichen. May heaven's blessings be upon you– Though, that doesn't mean much coming from me. Heehee, I am but a humble witch of the Iris Orthodoxy. It's a pleasure to work with you, Commander.

upgrade.line: Works better than a magic spell. Heehee.

win_mvp.line: Oh, I'm in first place? Don't show too much favoritism toward me, or the others might get jealous♪

gift_prefer.line: This is just delightful. Thank you.

detail_ex.line: Do you know about the magic of love? It's like... a miracle that makes it so you can do anything for the person you love. Haha, of course, even you can use this brand of magic... as long as you love me, that is?

expedition_ex.line: It's about time for the commission team to come back. They're just in time to replenish our materials.

feeling5_ex.line: A poor Commander, robbed of bodily control by a devious witch's magic and doomed to be her plaything... It's a tale as old as time. Heehee, why don't I try a few more things while you're still immobile?

home_ex.line: You know, Commander, I'm always so excited for you to come back. After all, you bring back both victory and delightful stories!

login_ex.line: Do I seem like I'm in a better mood than usual? Strange... I wonder why? Heehee♪

main4_ex.line: The Iris has a lot of surprisingly flexible girls, like Béarn. Did you know that? Ahaha... Well, you are the Commander, after all. I guess that's natural.

main5_ex.line: Faith is important, but you shouldn't go too far. Even I can't make potions that heal the wounded.

touch_ex.line: If you need help with love, I'm happy to oblige! Heehee.

touch2_ex.line: Want me to attack you? Either way, I don't mind♪

win_mvp_ex.line: Oh, I'm only MVP because of the Commander's favoritism. It wasn't just my magic at all, haha!

home.line: You'd like another dance? I'm more than happy to join you, if that is what you want. No matter how wonderful a performance may be, it's nothing without an audience.

login.line: The gliding Sorcière on Ice... Witness the most artistic of sacraments. Heehee!

main1.line: Right now, you should be calling me the Sorcière on Ice. ...Too far?♪

main2.line: I'm going to rehearse with girls from Sardegna later. Any advice? ...No using my magic? Heehee, what could you possibly mean by that?

main3.line: What's the secret to learning ice skating? Haha, all you have to do is freeze a lake so you can practice in all seasons! ...I'm kidding♪

touch.line: Commander... Come, dance with me.

touch2.line: Heehee, you caught me, Commander~♪

unlock.line: Advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic—and that goes for this icy stage, too. Commander, please enjoy this demonstration of our heaven-bestowed sacrament until the very end~♪

detail.line: I'm here to give you the relaxing afternoon you've been waiting for... Heehee, when you wake up, I want you to think to yourself, "Oh, I'm being loved and cared for."

feeling5.line: Well, it looks like I only have one service left for you. Ring this bell, and your personal magical maid will come with pudding, hot milk, and a blanket in hand to give you lots of love!

home.line: You rang my bell. Is there anything you need from your magical maid? Anything goes!

login.line: You were sleeping so comfortably, Commander. Did you have sweet dreams? Good... Now, make your day sweeter with breakfast in bed!

main1.line: Milk, or kisses? Which warmth do you crave right now... Commander?

main2.line: Which service would you like next? Pudding? Hot milk? A sweet little bedtime story? Or maybe you'd just like me to stay by your side... In that case, I'd feel like I was the pampered one!

main3.line: Drink slowly so you don't choke, okay? It's okay... As long as I'm around, time will slow down for you, Commander.

touch.line: Your magical maid is ever by your side.

touch2.line: Is it so hard to resist what your magical maid has to offer...?

unlock.line: It's almost time to wake up, dear guest... Don't open those eyes just yet. Let me use my magic to spirit away that last bit of sleepiness.

win_mvp.line: I managed to seize victory even under these circumstances... One must assume it was all thanks to you, Commander.

asmr_001.line: Are you awake yet, dear guest? My hypnotic magic had quite an effect. Now... Why not try some special milk? It's perfect for a sleepy afternoon.

asmr_002.line: Commander, Commandeeer, wake up. It's time for an intimate afternoon with your magical maid! Which one do you want first? Milk, or pudding?

asmr_003.line: Awake yet? Or do you want to nap next to me for a little while longer?

asmr_004.line: Come a little closer~ Doesn't the pudding smell so sweet and sublime? ...Hmm? The milk? I drank it all♪

asmr_005.line: I have a few other magical services, you know. For example... I could cast a spell to put you right back to sleep!

asmr_006.line: Our public menu only has ordinary services available, but don't worry. Your magical maid has plenty of secret methods to help you relax~

asmr_007.line: My next service will be even more pleasurable for you~ Oh, but my skin is getting a little dry... Say, dear guest... If you don't mind... Could you help me out a little here?

asmr_008.line: Heehee, are you satisfied with my spellbinding services?

asmr_009.line: Ah... Dear guest, you know that touching me won't come cheap♪

asmr_010.line: Dear guest, lie down next to me... Good. Next, you'll enjoy this delicious pudding~ Open up... Mwah! Perfect♪ Heehee, this is just the start of my private services.

battle.line: Destroy the devil's army at once! Then, plunder them dry!

couple_encourage1.line: Heehee, I'll be taking your impure wares.

couple_encourage2.line: Er, you want me to take your cloak? I'll pass, thank you!

detail.line: Remember to bring valuables when you come to confess. I'll examine them closely, and if any are impure, I'll gladly relieve you of them.

expedition.line: Our friends are back with many spoils. I wonder what treasures they've brought... Heehee. Don't disappoint me, now!

feeling1.line: Boooring. You don't have ANYTHING good?

feeling2.line: Aah... I just can't resist temptation. This must be the devil's influence! Commander, I must have the warehouse key – it demands purification by tomorrow!

feeling3.line: Hmm? Why do I take things instead of just purifying them? Well, impure items must be kept safe to minimize their negative effects. You do understand what I mean, yes?

feeling4.line: Commander, I've finished purifying this batch. See if any of it is yours... Oh, all of it was? What a funny coincidence! Look at me, being all helpful and kind. Go on – take it. Don't forget to reward me for my efforts, though!

feeling5.line: Commander? You haven't listened to my prayers for a long time... Why, I think it's been a whole day at least! I'm so very lonely... Hmm? You'll let me hold you while I pray? Th-then I'll do just that... Okay? U-umm... Right, how does the prayer go, again...

headtouch.line: Curious about my treasures, Commander? Heehee, that's right – it's all hidden in my wimple.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Stand there a moment... There. I've used my gaze to purify you. Now that my job is done, I'll gladly take my share of the rewards.

hp_warning.line: Trying to steal from me? You're in for it now!

login.line: Long time no see, Commander. I've already helped countless others in need today... Oh, you saw me sneaking into the warehouse? Lies. The devil deceives you... Come to me and repent, before it's too late.

lose.line: Aaargh! That wasn't just a loss – it was a downright disgrace! God ****ing dammit, everything's ****ed!

mail.line: There's mail for you. Please read it yourself – I'll see if there's anything I can swipe... er, I mean, purify.

main1.line: Commander, can you start prepaying for your purifications? Hmm? Yes, I purify your things, and you reward me in return – do you have a problem with this arrangement?

main2.line: The ominous auras that occasionally fill others are warnings from the Holy Iris. You don't need to worry, though – by confessing and handing over your impure goods, you can avoid evil.

main3.line: Heehee, children are too easy to deceive. Simple wordplay was enough to get me so much treasure... Hmm? Ark Royal is looking for me, you say?

mission.line: This mission is sure to yield precious goodies! Let's do it! Now!

mission_complete.line: I just knew you'd come back with valuable loot, Commander. I'll help you identify it right away.

profile.line: I am Duguay-Trouin. The Holy Iris guided me to this land in order to take possession of all impure items, and I do mean ALL. Relax, Commander. Hold out your hands and let me purify them now.

propose.line: To think that I would be the one giving up my valuables... Heehee... My heart may be yours now, but I'm not satisfied yet. I'll take your heart and body alike... Prepare yourself, Commander♥

skill.line: If I just kill you, the treasure will be all mine!

touch.line: Don't worry about who's around. Be bold with me!

touch2.line: Oh, Commander, you're so bold today... You'd better come close and give me a good confessional...

unlock.line: By the guidance of the Holy Iris, Duguay-Trouin has come to serve. Do you seek sacred protection? I already know the answer to that. The devil's essence resides in your epaulet – shall I begin by purifying it?

upgrade.line: OOOH, HOT DAMN! This power feels too ****ing good!

win_mvp.line: Haha♪ What a beautiful harvest!

gift_prefer.line: Heehee. You know exactly what I'm into, Commander!

detail_ex.line: Heehee, I knew you'd come, so I turned down all of the other purification requests I got... What would you like to confess to today?

expedition_ex.line: It's time to receive our loot, Commander. You get to choose first this time.

feeling5_ex.line: Commandeeer, turn toward me. When our foreheads touch... Do you hear my heart's prayers? Oh, you can't? Then here... Mwah♥

headtouch_ex.line: I already moved my treasures. Instead of rustling my hair, about you just give me a big hug?

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Let's skip the purification and get straight to the "giving me things" part. Specifically, I want full control over you for a day... Heehee, though I’d happily settle for a half-day.

login_ex.line: I've been waiting for you. Come on – give me all of your valuables! Yes, yes, good! Next... I'll be taking YOU, too.

lose_ex.line: YOU MOTHER****ING ******BAG! Get over here so I can **** you up!

main4_ex.line: Cups, pens, badges... Is there anything else you can give me? I'm ready to purify!

main5_ex.line: Robber, swindler, bandit – all old nicknames of mine. Heehee, that's all in the past now. What do you want to call me now, Commander?

main6_ex.line: You think my outfit is mere performance? What are you getting at, Commander? I'm not ALWAYS acting out a part. Besides, my true self is what you should really fear...

mail_ex.line: Why not let me handle your mail correspondence from now on? After all... Control over that will help me win your heart.

mission_ex.line: You'll let me have all of your time that isn't devoted to missions, won't you?

mission_complete_ex.line: Heehee. Did you finish your missions so fast just because you wanted to see me again?

touch_ex.line: The devil's power lurks in your left hand... Heehee, let me purify that. Don't let go, now!

touch2_ex.line: My body... Hnnh! It's being controlled by the devil! Commander, you must forgive me! I can't control myself – I'm going to do something shameful to you!

upgrade_ex.line: The stronger I become, the easier it'll be to steal my Commander away.

win_mvp_ex.line: While I do love the spoils of war, you're still the one that excites me the most.

detail.line: You'd confess before a naked nun, now of all times? Incredible... You know, Commander, this is a rare opportunity. Don't you think we should be doing something more... special?

feeling5.line: *sigh*... I'm heating up awfully fast. Is it just the hot water, or is it my restraint melting away...? Commander, do you know what predators do when they're at their hungriest? Keep playing dumb, and you might get eaten up...

headtouch.line: What is it about my hair that attracts you so? Go on, my covetous Commander... Indulge all you want.

home.line: We've come this far – there's no need to keep up appearances. Why not... take off that towel?

login.line: Ah, Commander, I can't see anything through this steam! Heehee... If you tried anything right now, I'd have no way to stop you. Getting excited yet?

main1.line: Worried that my wimple will get wet? Then you can take it off for me. This is an important ceremony, so I trust you'll treat it with the gravity it deserves.

main2.line: Oh, should we warm up before we get in? I thought you only do that before swimming. Or... Are you expecting a bit of roughhousing in the hot spring? Heehee, my, my!

main3.line: The wind is bitingly cold! Don't you think we should "warm up" together in the water?

touch.line: Oh, are you finally going in with me? Would you like to take me by the hand, or will you carry me instead?

touch2.line: Aaah... You want to do this on the shore? We could hide in the water, but you'll do it out in the open instead? Heehee, of course I don't mind...

unlock.line: Commander, this is where we'll be praying today. Nobody can disturb us here... You already know what to do, I'm sure?

battle.line: Get ready to cross swords with a Templar Knight!

couple_encourage1.line: Foch, be careful when you throw that thing!

detail.line: While I'm usually super nice, I've earned the nickname "Admiral Satan" from how terrifying I am when I'm ticked off! Like this – grrr! Isn't that scary?

expedition.line: The commission team's back with rewards. Go on and accept 'em, Commander.

feeling1.line: I don't want to lash out at you, Commander. Get your act together.

feeling2.line: Feels kinda weird that you're looking after me. I mean, I don't hate it or anything... It's just, y'know, I'm usually the one looking after others, since I'm a big sister figure and all.

feeling3.line: Assisting with your work, protecting you when a battle breaks out... Yeah, the stuff I can do for you is pretty much the same as anyone else... What can I do to stand out?

feeling4.line: Gimme just a minute, Commander. Your fair and reliable Suffren is gonna cook you a delicious– Oh nooo! I burned the ingredients! And I forgot to turn off my vacuum cleaner! Commander, help!

feeling5.line: I'm an elegant Templar Knight and a reliable big sister – it takes more than one little failure to break my spirit! So, Commander, tell me what you need! I want to show you how far I've come!

headtouch.line: Whuh?! Stop whatever you're doing!

home.line: Great work on that sortie! Sit down and have a think about the battle! Your documents are right– Uhh, I... I don't know where they are... Ahaha...

hp_warning.line: A Templar Knight does not tremble!

login.line: *yaaawn*... Whuh? Commander? W-wow, so you're an early bird! I'm proud of you!

lose.line: Commander, it's time for a tactical retreat! We'll get 'em another time!

mail.line: You've got a letter. By the Holy Iris, let this be good news... Okay. You can open it now.

main1.line: *yaaawn*... Mgh... The port on the whole is pretty great, but I wish I could sleep in a hammock rather than a bed... Hmph. I like hammocks more than beds, that's all.

main2.line: What's nice about being a Templar Knight is how few rules dictate what and when you can eat. You can't fight on an empty stomach, after all.

main3.line: Commander, know that I'm right here if you need to get something off your chest. You and Iris Libre will always have a friend in me♪

mission.line: Ah, missions... Get 'em done quick, Commander! I don't want you working late into the night; it's bad for you.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. Hope dinner tonight is gonna be something special♪

profile.line: I'm Suffren, the lead ship of my class. There are a few minor differences between me and my sisters, but that doesn't really matter since we're all Suffren-class at the end of the day! Always a pleasure to chat with you, Commander!

propose.line: You wanna exchange vows? Perfectly fine by me♪ Heehee~ I get to look after you for the rest of our days, and you can enjoy being spoiled rotten – it's a total win-win! ...Sounds completely focused on you? Well, I love you, so I can't help it!

skill.line: Now's your chance if you want to surrender!

touch.line: Commander? You got something you wanna tell me?

touch2.line: That's weird... Could've sworn I was about the same size as Foch...

unlock.line: I'm Suffren, Iris Libre Templar Knight! You can finally rest easy, Commander! There'll be no more problems ever again now that your lady knight in shining armor has arrived!

upgrade.line: Thanks, Commander! I'll do my best to live up to your hopes♪

win_mvp.line: See? The Suffren class means business! Ahahah! I'm always happy to assist♪

gift_prefer.line: Wow! How'd you know I liked this so much? A-am I that easy to read...?

detail_ex.line: Hmph. Feels like you've been looking after ME all the time lately... I just want the chance to shine on my own once in a while.

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, are you ready to get coddled and looked after? 'Cause today, you're gonna see a different side of me♪ Heehee♡

home_ex.line: Well fought out there! Your documents are on your desk – read 'em before you review your battle! Oh, and I didn't forget to make you tea and snacks♪

login_ex.line: Huh? Commander? You ruined everything! I was gonna get up early for once and surprise you!

main4_ex.line: The bed at your place is way cozier than any hammock I've been in... Am I just not used to sleeping in beds?

main5_ex.line: Me, Foch, and some other friends are going shopping on our next day off. You wanna come with us, Commander? Heehee~ We'll stop by loads of good restaurants along the way.

main6_ex.line: Commander, I'm always here if you want someone to talk to... *tummy rumble*... Perfect timing! Let's have a chat while we munch on some sweets!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission rewards have arrived. Now the question is – what're you making tonight, Commander?

touch_ex.line: You wanna shoot the breeze? Sure♪ Let's talk about whatever!

touch2_ex.line: Hey, uh, Commander, groping 'em that hard won't make 'em bigger!

win_mvp_ex.line: I'm Templar Knight Suffren, the beautiful, awesome, and reliable big sister – who else?

detail.line: Thoughts, Commander? You don't get to see me in this outfit any day. Heheh. Truth be told, I'm just as fashion-savvy as Foch or Algérie!

expedition.line: The commission team is back? Let me get changed real– Uhh, my zipper's stuck...

home.line: I know you're not peeping, but this still feels weird... Hey, wait, there's no point in leaving NOW!

login.line: Hang on, Commander! You can't go out now, or you'll look so suspicious! For now, uhh, you should just lock the door and wait it out in here!

main1.line: Commander, are you good or bad at sports? Not any one in particular; I mean on the whole. I'm just curious.

main2.line: Oh, I know. Since you're already here, you should get changed and exercise with me! Then nobody will suspect anything! ...You doubt it?

main3.line: Dunkerque is an evil woman... She's always making tons of delicious pastries, I tell you! She has no idea how hard I have to fight the urge to eat them! It suuucks!

touch.line: I'd be lying if I said I don't mind this at least a little... but it's just you, so it's fine! I think so, anyway...

touch2.line: C-cut it out, Commander! I can't undress while you're doing that!

unlock.line: Hm? The door's open! ...Commander? Oh, ahaha... Silly me, I should've put up a card with "occupied" on it... Then again, I... I guess I don't mind if you're the one who sees me~

win_mvp.line: They served us this elegant victory on a platter! Heheh!

detail.line: If you need to rest, you can come and do it here. Your charming– I mean, your dependable Templar Knight will shield you! ...That's not what you need?

expedition.line: Commission rewards have arrived? Then let's go speak to theEEEEM! Geesh, I nearly tripped!

feeling5.line: You're so cool and reliable, and I need to act all pretty and adorable to match that! Come on, picture it – me, taking you by the hand and leading you to... Wait, what? How come even I can't imagine it anymore?!

headtouch.line: H-hey! I JUST got it to look good!

home.line: Oh, Commander! You must be tired after that sortie! You should fetch that wine and steak for me so I... I-I mean so YOU can eat it! I'm not saying I want to, not at all! Probably not...

login.line: C-Commander! Give me a minute! Your knight needs to make herself look pretty for... Dammiiit! Forget it – help me ooout!

main1.line: If I'd known you'd see me in an embarrassing spot like this, I would've asked Foch or someone else for help... I really fumbled this one...

main2.line: You think I look like something out of a painting? In that case... Heehee♥ How does this look, then? Is that pushing any of your buttons?

main3.line: Having a few is fine and all, but don't drink TOO much, okay? ...Yeah, partly for the obvious health reasons, but mainly because I don't wanna have to carry you home in this outfit!

mission_complete.line: As reward for all your hard work... how about a night together with your charming knight?

touch.line: Hey, you, Commander! I'm ready to hear what you think about my dress!

touch2.line: C-Commander?! Y-you know, it's pretty cramped if we both sit here...

unlock.line: Oh, Commander. Were you waiting for little old me? You've gotta take your time sorting out your dress if you wanna look snazzy! Heheh, feast your eyes on this cute little kni– Uhh, how are you supposed to tie this thing?

win_mvp.line: I feel a bit different today, don't I? Heh!

battle.line: Now, behold my pure wrath.

couple_encourage1.line: Fighting side-by-side with former enemies... How interesting.

detail.line: ...To be reborn in the material world, one must first remove their fetters. The stage for decisive battle will soon appear. Swordbearer of prophecy, hold your sword tight.

expedition.line: The commission is complete. Let us witness our allies' triumphant return together.

feeling1.line: It seems you'll need to apply yourself before you're ready to bear any sword...

feeling2.line: Do you know the trial of Sisyphus? The final battle I look to is the same, pushing a rock up a hill only to see it roll back again. Anxiety-inducing, indeed...

feeling3.line: Do I seem a little too tense? Well, the final battle approaches... Of course I understand what you want to say, Swordbearer. "Life goes on, and you need to enjoy the present," right?

feeling4.line: I do feel a sense of fulfillment pushing that rock up that hill, but... You're right. As long as I fight on, the resistance is never truly over.

feeling5.line: I see. As you claimed, the human world is full of fighting spirit, too. Then I accept your invitation – "amusement parks" must be bursting with fun, no?

headtouch.line: ...Hmm. Is this the stress reduction method you mentioned?

home.line: Welcome back. The quivering strings have settled – well done.

hp_warning.line: Is this... a trial?!

login.line: How do you do, Swordbearer? What string do you wish to pluck today?

lose.line: Urgh... I won't give up...

mail.line: Swordbearer, there's mail... Hm? There's a pink envelope in here...

main1.line: The sounds of strings may be intangible, but for me, they are tangible things that can be woven together. Even something as fine and delicate as thread can be used to hurt others.

main2.line: I can't always be flawless... You do have a point, Swordbearer. Maybe there are times when I should rest, too...

main3.line: Through the strings' vibrations, nothing becomes something before once again returning to nothing. The world walks atop one vibrating string, ever waiting for the sound of bells...

mission.line: There are missions that require your attention, Swordbearer. Our deeds today serve as the foundation for tomorrow – do not forget that.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Ensure that your reward list contains no errors.

profile.line: I am Brennus, a C5 cruiser designed to protect against a new threat. Swordbearer of prophecy, I will fight on to the end for your sake.

propose.line: This is... Of course I know what that is you're holding! Then you're asking me for... Hm? You think I'm attractive when I'm lost in thought? I-I... O-of course, I'd be happy to –Nnh?! A-aaah... You didn't even let me finish my sentence!

touch.line: Hm? You're interested in how I hold my sword? ...Then allow me to play you a verse now.

touch2.line: ...Nh?! P-people like you are just... *blush*

unlock.line: My name is Brennus. I am the sword born of oceans of fantasy in order to usher forth change in this world. Now, Swordbearer of prophecy, answer this question of mine – are you prepared for change?

upgrade.line: The strings have become even more taut.

win_mvp.line: And so it ends, in unceremonious silence.

gift_prefer.line: Hmm. I didn't know such fascinating things existed.

feeling5_ex.line: Kh... Wh-why are these "crane games" so much more devious than even Sisyphus's trial?! S-stop laughing and help me, damn you!

headtouch_ex.line: (whispering) How in the world did I come to enjoy this...?

home_ex.line: Welcome back. You look like you're in a good mood. Another victory, I'm guessing?

login_ex.line: Greetings, Swordbearer. What are your plans for today?

main4_ex.line: I'm lucky to be able to travel with you... Once this is all over, I'd like to see this world again.

main5_ex.line: When I let go for a moment and relax, I feel the world has changed... You say the way I talk to you has changed, too? I-I would ask that you not mention that!

main6_ex.line: Heehee, the strings I pull are just the laws of science... This is just a bit of sophistry on my part.

touch2_ex.line: ...I'm happy to do whatever you want...

detail.line: Indeed, I call this outfit "Wielder of Twin Swords – Underwater Performance." ...You think I should just call it a swimsuit? I refuse.

feeling5.line: My goal is still far away, so I need a breather now and then... Swordbearer, permit me to hug you and enjoy a dreamy night together with you...

headtouch.line: ...Mm. If you want to touch me, wait until after I finish tying, please.

home.line: Welcome back... What song would you most like to hear now?

login.line: Good evening, Swordbearer. The night is beautiful. Come sit with me, and let's watch the fireworks.

main1.line: The fireworks are being set off so close by, but strangely, it calms the heart. Yes, I feel a state of perfect peace... But of course. You're here, after all.

main2.line: Wearing the "Wielder of Twin Swords – Underwater Performance" makes tuning a more formidable challenge. Making music that moves the heart will prove a difficult task...

main3.line: Now is the perfect time to confirm the effects of this outfit. Shall I play you a song? The mood is just right...

touch.line: Hmm? You want to help me because I look like I'm struggling?

touch2.line: ...C-come, then. I'm ready...

unlock.line: Swordbearer, you've come at the perfect time. I need your help. Hm? What's with that look on your face? You didn't expect it would be a difficult feat to arrange the clothes you requested I wear, did you...?

detail.line: If you wish to restore the material world, then your resolve must be firm. The stage is set. Swordbearer who leads the army of salvation, are you prepared to overcome the countless difficulties awaiting you?

feeling5.line: The boundary between reality and fantasy can shift based on one's will. Even with the awareness that this is a fleeting dream, we must savor it until we wake. Swordbearer, my one true love... do you feel the same way?

home.line: Clamorous strings, now as still as water... Welcome back.

login.line: You've done well to come here, Swordbearer. Let us enjoy the moonlight, accompanied by my melody.

main1.line: A distant realm, illuminated by moonlight... Though it is very literally a mere stage, there's no limit to what stories may play out with you.

main2.line: I am accustomed to redefining my existence depending on the role I must play. Umm... In short, I'm an experienced actor.

main3.line: Existence can only manifest in limited forms in a closed time-space continuum. Swordbearer, you exist as my lover for now, so please act like it.

touch.line: Is this moon real, or a mere reflection upon the water?

touch2.line: Mm... Y-you didn't tell me there would be ad-libbing...

unlock.line: An encounter under the moonlight – the work of fate, or the very laws of their world? Ah, Swordbearer... Those weren't rehearsed lines, but a simple greeting to you.

battle.line: We stand at the front lines.

couple_encourage1.line: An adventure? My apologies, but I prefer my food cooked.

detail.line: I am packing my luggage for my next journey. Clothing, food, coinage... Yes, one person's worth. Journeying alone allows one to choose destinations on the spot. It's much more flexible than traveling with a caravan.

expedition.line: It seems the commission team has returned to us. What heroic tales bring they back with them this time, I wonder?

feeling1.line: This place is no more than another stop on my journey. I beg your pardon, for I must go.

feeling2.line: Flattered am I at times that you put this much trust in me... No, it's nothing. Wherever you go, I shall always be in tow.

feeling3.line: It is to me a blessing of the highest order to stand shoulder to shoulder with a commander as accomplished as you. I ask for your continuing permission to undertake missions great. I swear that I will not disappoint you.

feeling4.line: The understanding of what a person needs in the moment is the greatest dish, and one's heartfelt feelings are the greatest seasonings. What flavor do you crave in this moment? I may very well know.

feeling5.line: Once, my journeys were made alone. I walked beneath the dome blue and circular of a church in a town of pure white; I crossed a field of lavenders dancing purplishly in the wind; I left imprints upon the dusty floor of an old lighthouse symbolizing hope... Now, what I look forward to most is my next journey with you in accompaniment.

headtouch.line: This is certainly one way to convey one's feelings...

home.line: Salutations, Commander. Yes, I'm having fine tea from the port of Casablanca. Its flavor invigorating, it quenches thirst and clears the mind. Help yourself.

hp_warning.line: Prepare for retreat. I shall guard the rear. Worry not, for this duty is ours to bear.

login.line: Ah, you've come early. I've laid out the paperwork that requires your attention. Oh, you flatter me. I did only what's expected of an adjutant.

lose.line: A sword broken still carries more dignity than a cannon rusted.

mail.line: It appears a new letter has come in. Is it perchance the postcard I sent to you in my journey prior?

main1.line: You've come. I'm presently recreating a dish I savored long ago in a foreign land. Ground beef is added to clarified butter with spices and gently cooked, its flavor most rich when it reaches medium rarity. Would you care for a taste?

main2.line: Are you familiar with Demera? When I visited the port of Addis Ababa, I witnessed the people setting alight a giant bonfire after nightfall. That moment, when the flames rose and the entire plaza burst in excitement, is ever etched onto my eyelids.

main3.line: The extent to which I've grown astounds me... Whew... This gauntlet of challenges is precisely the journey I've longed for.

mission.line: A new mission, you say? I shall aid you. The diligent execution of plans is my strong suit.

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed. Aye. It pleases me to be of service.

profile.line: I am Duquesne, Templar Knight. My time spent on the field of battle is likely longer than you suspect. My hobby is to roam in search of sceneries new and specialties local. That should suffice for an introduction. If you thus desire, I shall be your glaive that cuts through the raging waves.

propose.line: I once witnessed during my travels a particular matrimony. Amidst sands unbounded, in a region of cactused forests and the sunset's alluring glow – there, sacred vows were exchanged... This moment that we've arrived at together is the most blessed in all of my life. I have now but one possible place to be – by your side.

touch.line: I offer you these photographs. They're of a city I visited whilst touring the Mediterranean. Beautiful, are they not?

touch2.line: Commander... Will the scenery unfolding around me... leave an imprint upon your memory? *blushes*...

unlock.line: A view so fair and a townscape so welcoming... Ah, apologies. I am Duquesne, Templar Knight. Think of me as a pilgrim who fancies scrumptious food. If you'd ever like to hear about the Mediterranean's culture and geography, come and see me.

upgrade.line: This power will give peace of mind to my comrades in arms.

win_mvp.line: With your command, nary a soul can impede us.

gift_prefer.line: I can feel the love you put into this, Commander. Allow me to express my sincere gratitude.

detail_ex.line: So it caught your notice. Yes, I've changed to a larger suitcase. It's, well... Fitting the luggage of two people requires a rather large one.

feeling5_ex.line: If we... Hypothetically, if we were to go on a honeymoon, have you a place you wish to visit? In my case, a picturesque city with flavors fine and plentiful would be ideal. May I get to decide? Ahahaha...

headtouch_ex.line: Commander, how about you experience the sensation I feel? Pat, pat... Pat, pat...

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Now... allow me to give you a hug to soothe your mind weary. Heehee.

login_ex.line: I have prepared breakfast for you, Commander. Bon appétit. Ah, a little too hearty, is it? Let us partake of it together, then.

main4_ex.line: In the birthplace of dishes such as this, it's customary to pick up the food with one's hands. Care to try it, Commander? Or perchance you'd like me to feed you? Alright, then open your mouth... Say "ahh"... Heehee – so delicious you had to savor it with eyes closed, I see.

main5_ex.line: There are feasts and carnivals to be found wherever one goes. People wish to forget their lonesomeness with festivals... I, on the other hand, found in your eyes a celebration most lasting.

main6_ex.line: Which color of bath towel do you like, Commander? I'm packing for the next journey, you see... What? We can just share the same one? Um, I suppose that's... fine... *blushes*...

touch_ex.line: Commander, I've brought the camera. I wish to preserve, as one might a treasure, the time we share together.

touch2_ex.line: The sight that is my being has also been etched into your heart... *blushes*...

detail.line: A wine bath is not made merely by pouring red wine into hot water – rather, residue from the winemaking process is suitably added so that one will not get drunk so easily. Supposedly.

feeling5.line: Grapes are picked, crushed, and fermented, thus sublimating the sweetness into a rich wine aroma. After a lengthy period spent growing closer, the fruit most precious may be harvested. It's just like our relationship...

headtouch.line: Hmm. I feel as though I slightly better understand your thinking now.

home.line: You're back, Commander. This place, I believe, is a worthy reward for your labor.

login.line: This pool of crimson mist – beautiful, is it not? I will wholeheartedly etch into my mind this time we spend together.

lose.line: Wine that has turned sour deserves not to be drunk...

main1.line: Mmgh... Basking in your gaze invokes strangely a warmth in me... W-would you turn around if just for a moment? Whew... I all but forgot how to breathe there...

main2.line: This Cabernet Sauvignon wine seems to be one of the treasures of this place. What a fragrance, so mellow and enticing. Would you care for a taste, Commander?

main3.line: One, two, three... Why are there three of you, Commander?! P-perhaps... I am already inebrious.

touch.line: Is the wine getting to you as well, Commander? Ah... Weakness is supplanting strength within my body...

touch2.line: If you're thirsty, Commander, then I offer myself. Drink of me until you're quenched.

unlock.line: This wine bath mustn't be wasted. One must strip off their clothes and submerge themselves deeply in this rich bath of life. Be not so reserved, Commander, just... Huh?! N-no, I would never peek whilst you got changed!

battle.line: Let the battle begin! Victory's all but guaranteed.

couple_encourage1.line: Smells good... Can I have a bite? Just one!

detail.line: Eat yummy food and fight battles you can win. Food that's yucky to you is still somebody else's favorite food. When you end up in a losing battle, there'll be reinforcements coming to help. Hmm... That's me in a nutshell, I guess? If you think this covers me well enough, I can accept that.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission team is back. Their haul of goodies looks really appealing... Yeah, I have a feeling there's some delicious food in there.

feeling1.line: Ugh. You don't smell like tasty food anymore...

feeling2.line: I'll help you fix the things that trouble you. As long as you give me snacks or hang out with me, at least.

feeling3.line: Commander, this one, this, and this – they're all delicious. See? I collected their packaging to show you. Hm? They're already in your drawer? Open it up and let me see... Just a look-see, that's all.

feeling4.line: I've been looking for your missing badge ever since you told me about it. I ate all the snacks I bought with my spare change, and I still couldn't fit it... I don't understand why... Can you hug me, Commander? Because I feel like I've just tasted something gross...

feeling5.line: What you want most is to keep winning forever? Then you have to keep hugging me forever. Your biggest wish should come true that way. Hm? You already have what you want most? ...You mean me? Okay... Hey, can I take a small bite out of you? Nom... I love you, Commander...

headtouch.line: Uhh... Does doing this grant you a blessing? It does feel pretty nice, so it's not like I have a problem with it.

home.line: It's you... *growl*... I smell something yummy. Is all that food for me? Wonderful – everything should go perfectly for you today. As long as you stick around me, that is.

hp_warning.line: Ugh... My strength's running out... I need some snacks...

login.line: You're here. I was just getting bored. Are we doing holy tasks again? Why don't we do something fun before that? I think we'll have an easier time after.

lose.line: Huh? We lost? There's no way.

mail.line: You should give me a hug before you read your letter. It'll turn all the contents into good news.

main1.line: I found loads of coins while at the beach today, so I used them all on snacks and... Oh, right, I also found a button. It's the one you said you lost the other day, right?

main2.line: Hm? Okay... I see... Whew... I listened to the whole thing. To your battle plan. Can I have the snacks in your pocket now?

main3.line: Shoot. I won't make it in time for the apple pie... Hm? Are you eating apple pie right now? Nom. I made it in time. Heehee.

mission.line: You've got missions. If you're not gonna do them, hang out with me.

mission_complete.line: You completed a mission. That took you a while. Can we enjoy ourselves now?

profile.line: I'm Masséna, Iris Orthodoxy battlecruiser... I guess. People say I've been blessed way too much and need to taste what failure's like. It probably tastes bad, so I'm not too keen to experience it. If you hate the taste of failure, too, then I know a way to avoid it – just bring me wherever you go.

propose.line: I will give myself to you and protect your future. Your wishes are my wishes, and your commitments are mine as well. When you need me, I'll come running... even if there's a pile of snacks in front of me!

touch.line: What? ...My "power" can help you? Then use it as you like!

touch2.line: Ahh... Hahh... Will this... bring you good fortune?

unlock.line: You're the Commander... Uhh, do I have to follow your orders? Okay. I mean, I'll try... By the way, could I have some of those snacks you got in your pocket? They look really yummy.

upgrade.line: Hmm... You should keep following my gut feelings. Victory comes more easily when you do.

win_mvp.line: Oh. It's over. Did I even do anything?

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander... Can I take a bite now?

detail_ex.line: Today I encountered an enemy that retreated without a fight and a really, really delicious Commander... Nom. Oops – I felt so happy I couldn't help but take a bite.

feeling5_ex.line: All the things I've done for you somehow ended in failure. *sigh*... This might be the first time I've tasted this "failure" thing. Hm? "Don't do them for me, do them for yourself, because seeing you happy makes me happy, too"? I'm so glad to hear you say that! Um... Could you have... just a small taste of me? Just... give me a little chomp?

headtouch_ex.line: Mhm. You can keep patting me as long as you want to.

home_ex.line: What's that lovely smell? ...Oh, you're back, Commander. Is that, umm, the smell of food or the smell of you? Do you mind if I check real quick?

login_ex.line: I was just thinking about you, Commander. Let's hang out a little bit before work. I'll even give you a hug so your work will go perfectly.

main4_ex.line: Oh. There's something on your lips. Let me just... *lick*... Heehee. Sweet and tasty, just like you always taste♪

main5_ex.line: *poke poke*... Are you sleeping? Then you need a blanket to– Oops! Sorry, I tripped over the blanket... On the bright side, your embrace feels... so calming.

main6_ex.line: Commander, I want to help you with all sorts of things, but nothing I've tried has worked. Maybe... if you take me out today, we'll cross paths with all kinds of delicious food. I mean, right?

touch_ex.line: There's nothing under my skirt. Nope, I'm not hiding snacks under there.

touch2_ex.line: There's no room for snacks here... Do you still want a blessing? Well, um...

detail.line: Come into the water, Commander. It'll sweeten you up and make you delicious, I think.

feeling5.line: Commander, my face feels so warm, and my heart's racing... but I think we're the same temperature. Heehee. Your heart's racing, too, and your face... looks so yummy. It must taste sweeter than a cherry. Heh. Nom♪

headtouch.line: This one tuft of hair just won't flatten out, even in the bath.

home.line: Come here, Commander... I see you brought snacks for me. I'll just dig right in! Nom♪

login.line: Ooh... This spring feels so nice. It's a bit too hot, though... Commander, could you fetch me a cold towel?

main1.line: My towel doesn't do much if I use it like this, you say? Well, could you adjust it for me?

main2.line: Just gonna lie on my stomach... Ahh, that's good... I wonder – if my body turns as soft as a marshmallow, will I taste good?

main3.line: These cherries are sooo sweet. Ahh... Wow, they're so sweet it feels like I'm on a cloud... Hm? And now I've fallen into your arms? Heehee – the water must have made me dizzy.

mission.line: Splash, splash... Blub-blub-blub... You got a new mission in the middle of a bath?

touch.line: Your hand feels colder than the water. You should warm it up.

touch2.line: D-don't take away my lucky blessing, or I won't be able to stand up...

unlock.line: Commander, this spring has a sweet taste to it. You should try it.

battle.line: All ships, prepare for combat! For liberty and glory! Aux armes, marchons!

couple_encourage1.line: As long as we have Heaven's divine protection, we have nothing to fear!

couple_encourage2.line: It seems that we fight together once again.

couple_encourage3.line: Please fight to your heart's content. I have your back.

couple_encourage4.line: Brethren! Assemble under the banner of righteousness!

couple_encourage5.line: Bring down judgment upon the nonbelievers.

detail.line: Place your faith in me. Follow my lead. Offer up your prayers. Seek the Lord. Only then will the path of God be opened...

expedition.line: I'd like to report that the commissions have been safely completed, and that fleet operations are running smoothly. You've done a good job, Commander.

feeling1.line: Those who refuse to stop marching shall face the path of ruin... Make sure you keep that in mind.

feeling2.line: The one you are talking to was once despisingly called many things: the calamity that brought on war, the fearsome Cardinal, and the maniac possessed by religious fervor. I ask of you: when you look at me, what do you see in me?

feeling3.line: Commander, please have a seat. What would you like to drink? ...There's no need to be on guard. Even someone like me lives an ordinary life when not on duty or performing religious rites. A person cannot live on faith alone. Sometimes, you just need a drink or two. Hehe.

feeling4.line: You've come by again. Haven't you been getting too friendly with me? ...Just kidding. I'm truly grateful to have another person that I can chat casually with. I hope that you feel the same way, too.

feeling5.line: The feeling of distance between people is an interesting thing indeed. A superior officer and their subordinate. The leader of a fleet and the highest post of the organization. A warship and... Hehe. For the time being, let's let the others continue misunderstanding our relationship, okay?

headtouch.line: May Heaven confer upon you its blessings.

home.line: Mission complete. The fleet has safely returned to the port. Good work, Commander.

hp_warning.line: There is... still hope...!

login.line: Bonjour, Commander. Please relax and drink this tea while I carry out my morning prayers.

lose.line: Is this... also a trial from Heaven...?

mail.line: Letters are blessings from other people.

main1.line: I believe that any obstacle can be overcome with fervent faith and untiring efforts.

main2.line: Those round little creatures... If I recall correctly, Algérie told me they're called "Meowfficers."

main3.line: Have I met the Royal Navy yet? Yes. I hope to deepen our bond, so I'm bringing some wine to the next tea party.

main4.line: Please make use of my precious allies, the Iris Templar Knights, at your discretion. After all, one of their missions is to fight for peace.

main5.line: The relationship between those from the Eagle Union and those from the Iris Libre is a bit... Well, I get the feeling that Jean Bart would get along with them just fine, though.

mission.line: Missions may be called a kind of trial. If you take them on with the proper attitude, there is no need to worry.

mission_complete.line: The reward for those who work hard is Heaven's grace. Let us accept it gratefully.

profile.line: I am Richelieu, the lead ship of the Richelieu class. During my history as a ship, I lived through good times and bad times, and I also witnessed the rise and fall of my homeland... This time, I hope to protect all that is dear to me up until the end. Together with this fleet, I strive for liberty and peace...

propose.line: As the one who guides Iris Libre, I cannot make an oath solely to you. However, I vow to protect and support you for as long as I live. This, I vow, on the holy name of Iris...

touch.line: Please listen to our prayers closely, Commander.

touch2.line: If nothing else, your audacity is commendable.

unlock.line: I am Richelieu, Cardinal of Iris Libre. If you too will fight for freedom and faith, then I shall bring you victory, Commander.

upgrade.line: At times, might is needed to guide others on the right path. I give you my thanks.

win_mvp.line: May the wandering souls drifting about the battlefield find eternal peace and salvation... Amen...

gift_prefer.line: This is for ME? Merci beaucoup, hehe.

detail_ex.line: I meet with Jean Bart every once in a while. We don't talk much, and simply focus on whatever we're doing at the moment. Even so, I feel like we understand each other very well. It's something to be happy about.

feeling5_ex.line: Whether you or I care more for the other is inconsequential. I feel more than happy enough just feeling our close bond together like this. Thank you for always being by my side.

home_ex.line: Welcome back. Thanks to you, everyone's safe and sound. I'm truly grateful.

login_ex.line: Bonjour, Commander. Please relax and enjoy this tea while I finish my morning prayers.

main1_ex.line: The practice of faith is not an easy path to walk. Discipline is required for enlightenment, and the path is sometimes accompanied by suffering and even self-sacrifice.

main2_ex.line: Commander, I have a question. Is there a way to get these "Meowfficers" to like me as much as they like being cuddled by you?

main4_ex.line: Please, do not forget. The warriors from Vichya are also Iris Libre's brethren.

touch_ex.line: It's time for worship. Please wait here patiently.

touch2_ex.line: If you would like to touch me, I would prefer it if you took a different approach.

detail.line: Iris' teachings do not go as far as to forbid its followers from spreading their wings. Let us enjoy today with everyone to our heart's content. Consider this as yet another of Heaven's many blessings.

expedition.line: We have a really good view from up here. I can even see a commission group starting to return out there.

feeling5.line: Walking together on the beach like this while basking our ears in the sounds of the sea... Agréable. Hehehe, this is quite a rare experience. Commander ... Thanks for being with me. I'll cherish this moment.

home.line: I don't wish for my absence to become a burden on you, Commander. If there's anything I can help with, please let me know.

login.line: Scenery that calms the heart... Commander, you've got good taste.

main1.line: Commander, I'll be heading to the beach for a bit. ... Hehe. Indeed, this is a bit different from how I am usually. Would you like to come along with me?

main2.line: Frozen treats are most effective against hot and humid weather like this... Shall we ask Dunkerque to prepare some more next time?

main3.line: Jean Bart... Perhaps it's better to spend some more time with her... Sigh...

touch.line: My... Where are you taking me, Commander?

touch2.line: If you know what's good for you, I wouldn't assume that a girl is defenseless just because she's in a swimsuit.

unlock.line: This swimsuit... Yes, the one Émile picked out for me, seems a bit skimpy... I didn't think she'd be the type to trick me into wearing something like this, but... Commander, where are you looking?

detail.line: Believe, atone, and pray. Seek a new day... that you may grasp hold of your happiness, and the road to the light.

expedition.line: It seems the commissions team made it back safely. This counts as good fortune, doesn't it?

feeling5.line: Settle down. Let us pray together. If I listen to your prayers and you listen to mine, you will come to understand that we are heading toward the same goal. Let us walk toward the light. You and I, together...

home.line: Please calm down and ponder what we should do. I'll be waiting right over here.

login.line: It looks like you went out to take a glimpse of the morning sun. I look forward to being in your company today, Commander.

mail.line: So this is what the Sakura Empire's New Year's greeting cards look like... How interesting. Hehehe.

main3.line: What these fortunes tell may be your fate. Even so, is it not mankind's strength to overcome fate?

main4.line: Shh. Lower your voice. I'm trying to get this one to warm up to Jean Bart.

main5.line: Béarn, is it already time? ...Yes, I made a promise earlier to visit the shrine with everyone else. How would you like to come with us?

touch.line: You'd like to sit by my side? Up we go... Good kitty... Alright, here you go, Commander.

touch2.line: Is this a greeting... for the New Year?

unlock.line: Commander, I wish you a Happy New Year. May you avail yourself of the period of repose that follows the culmination of the year's duties. I pray that you and everyone else may receive the blessing of the Heavens.

battle.line: Let the Festival of Lights commence!

detail.line: There may be little demand, but if anybody from the port wishes to repent... Rather, if anyone needs guidance, please let me know. Hm? You already have others doing the same thing? I'm happy to hear that.

expedition.line: Our fellows who left on a commission have returned. Commander, you confirm the rewards, and I shall thank them for their work.

feeling1.line: Do not deviate from the righteous path. If the time comes when I must destroy you, I will show no mercy.

feeling2.line: Sincere and righteous deeds will be repaid, both in prayer and in everyday relationships. Even without complex rituals, others will feel your love for them.

feeling3.line: Rituals and ceremonies often become complex as a direct result of the feelings in them. We know in our hearts that such things are unnecessary, but we can't stop ourselves from trying to show off. Maybe that's just what it means to be human.

feeling4.line: I admire you as much as anyone else, so I understand the desire to work hard and earn your attention. Hahaha, don't think too much of it. No matter how it ends up happening, I'm certain that your love will come across just fine.

feeling5.line: Commander, did you get a glimpse of my feelings for you? Heehee, I won't let you lie about that. If you value appearances so much... then I'm happy to stick to you like glue all day and night.

home.line: Our victory is all thanks to divine guidance. Before we look back upon our victory, let us offer a prayer of gratitude.

hp_warning.line: Please, give me the strength to overcome this peril!

login.line: Good day. Would you like to hear the teachings of the Holy Iris?

lose.line: Remain calm and withdraw. Our sacred duty has only just begun.

mail.line: You have mail. I pray that it's good news.

main1.line: By performing good deeds, showing gratitude to others, and being compassionate to the weak... You, too, can be saved even without faith, Commander.

main2.line: You look like you're struggling with some difficult dilemmas... Should we perform the rite of wisdom? It might be able to help you.

main3.line: Holy knight Saint Louis... She may be skilled at arbitration, but I think I have her just barely beat in that regard. Heehee!

mission.line: Uncompleted missions await you. I think you'd best clean them up quickly.

mission_complete.line: You have rewards waiting. Ensure that you do not forget to offer gratitude upon receiving them.

profile.line: The Iris has guided me, Battleship Lyon, to shepherd the lost and banish the wicked. Let us fight together—and prevent the scourge of the great war that once plagued us from ever occurring again.

propose.line: Now, we must exchange eternal vows in this blessed place and tie our sacred bond with a kiss. Don't be so nervous, now. I'm excited, too, because I get to perform this ceremony for myself for once... Heehee.

skill.line: All I do is for the sake of destroying the enemies of the Iris.

touch.line: Yes? I'm happy to offer you guidance.

touch2.line: What are the motives behind this action? I'd love to know.

unlock.line: May the Iris's absolving light be upon our fleet, and may its solemn judgment find our sinful foes– I, battleship Lyon, hereby rush to your aid, Commander. I pray that the Iris's blessings reach you, wielder of powers unsanctified.

upgrade.line: I'm stronger now. You have my gratitude, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Please forgive me, merciful Iris, for I need this strength to topple our foes.

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! Ah... I'm sorry. I seem to have lost my composure upon seeing this.

detail_ex.line: Whether you're struggling or not, please know that you can tell me anything. ...Yes, sometimes, I just want to chat with you. Heehee, is that so wrong?

home_ex.line: I would like to thank my allies for carrying out this sacred duty, and my beloved Commander who led us. ...Heehee, is something wrong? I didn't say anything strange, did I?

login_ex.line: Good day. Would you like to hear the teachings of... Hahaha, lovely. Then I'll put you on my schedule after work.

main4_ex.line: Are you listening to Richelieu? May I join you...? I happen to be capable of jealousy, too, you know.

main5_ex.line: My favorite animal? Lions, I say. They're brave and dignified, much like my beloved Commander. Hahaha!

main6_ex.line: If you're tired, then let me take over. I want to do more for you than just pray.

touch_ex.line: If you don't mind, I'd love to share my troubles, too.

touch2_ex.line: I understand that you want to be pampered. If you think I'm up to the job, then I'm willing to help any time.

win_mvp_ex.line: Geez, Commander. I'm glad we won, too, but we shouldn't get too excited over it.

detail.line: Did you know that this exercise is also called Contrology? It's all about using ideal posture and exercise to control your body and mind... I can see why it's such a profound field.

expedition.line: The girls out on commission should return soon. If you'd like, we could go and greet them together once we're done here...?

home.line: (The Commander is out of breath, too... I may be tired from battle, but I'm still happy to be able to sweat with you. Um... I just hope you don't mind the smell...)

login.line: Do you have it in you to keep going, Commander? If it gets too strenuous, just say the word...

main1.line: (The neck is fine, but it's a little tight around my chest... Am I doing something wrong...?)

main2.line: (Now that I really think about it, this pose is really embarrassing. But the Commander is watching, so I can't just stop... Should I stay like this...?)

main3.line: (The Commander took time out to exercise with me, so it'll all go to waste if I yield first... Okay. I'll just wait for the Commander to suggest we take a break.)

mission.line: Missions...? Of course. Once we're done here, let's check them out right away.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards? Aren't these a touch too luxurious as a reward for simple effort? Heehee.

touch.line: (Hmm... How long is it going to take before I can do this stretch correctly...?)

touch2.line: Ah?! ...Commander, no more of that, please...

unlock.line: Mmh... Pilates may be easy to learn, but it seems difficult to master... Are you still okay, Commander? Me? I-I can keep going...

battle.line: Behold the Sacrament's manifestation!

couple_encourage1.line: One shall bring you victory, Richelieu of the Holy See!

couple_encourage2.line: Allied frame detected. Providing holy assistance.

couple_encourage3.line: Forge a path to the Orthodoxy's future!

detail.line: Commander, why do you gaze upon this one for so long? Is it the mask? Well... You shouldn't, because... This one's emotion module– Er, I mean, my heart isn't ready for this!

expedition.line: Thus one declares – the commission team has returned. One believes they bring a good haul.

feeling1.line: Commander... I don't know how to talk to you anymore after all you've done.

feeling2.line: Maintenance complete. Emotion module functioning as norm– This isn't normal at all! Ugh, god... Commander, you keep doing this! My emotion module has nearly blown up so many times because of you!

feeling3.line: One has had no hardware upgrades, yet this one's operating efficiency is steadily increasing... Is this because of your daily staring? Have you... Have you been secretly exposing this one to your brainwaves?!

feeling4.line: *stares robotically*... Yes? What is this one doing, you ask? Reply: I'm trying to beam my brainwaves into you!

feeling5.line: Da-dim... Da-dum... Da-dim... Attempting indirect connection with Commander's emotion module... Connection attempt failed. Attempting direct physical connection. Commander, please help! This, umm, connection task is really important!

headtouch.line: Hm? Commander, what are you doing?

home.line: (To carry out a holy task so swiftly... You are everything they say and more, Commander.)

hp_warning.line: Activate reserve tanks!

login.line: One is ready following a full system reboot. When does our holy task begin?

lose.line: Gah... I couldn't... This isn't my fault...

mail.line: Thus one reports – a new letter has arrived. Speaking of which, this one should send you a letter sometime.
