main1.line: Commander, it seems evil has gone into hiding out of fear of you. Today, we may lower our guard for just a while.

main2.line: The purpose of this mask is to deepen one's calm and raise one's efficiency... a-and to scare enemies, too, of course.

main3.line: Battleship Alsace – the noble blade of the Orthodoxy and your protector – hath arrived! How's that? D-do you think that sounded cool?

main4.line: One observes. One protects. One awaits your orders.

mission.line: A mission? Delegate it upon this one and... Hm? You'll handle it yourself? B-b-but... But then what am I supposed to do?

mission_complete.line: Thus one announces – a holy task has been accomplished. Commander, forget not to claim the spoils.

profile.line: This one is Battleship Alsace – Sacrament of the Unified Orthodoxy, an unreachable dream, and guardian of– This one already said that? No matter. One's introduction is memorable and thus bears repeating. Take the mask off, you say? Um... I-I can't... Or else my emotion module will overheat and explode...

propose.line: Seems I didn't need to connect to your emotion module to see what's inside your heart... Are you zapping me with your brainwaves again? Y-you can't, not after making me put this ring on! I feel like my emotion module will explode just from looking at you! Fine, if that's how it's gonna be... L-let's f– Let's get freaky!

touch.line: Would you mind giving one a physical inspection, Commander?

touch2.line: Status report... I feel... h-hot and bothered... I-I'm gonna burst!

unlock.line: This one is battleship Alsace – Sacrament of the Unified Orthodoxy, an unreachable dream, and guardian of the Holy See. Commander, let us work together to cleanse the world of evil.

upgrade.line: One grows stronger. Perhaps this newfound strength will bring us a little closer together.

win_mvp.line: Holy task has been carried out. One will return to designated area.

gift_prefer.line: I-I love this almost as much as I love you!

detail_ex.line: (The Commander just keeps ogling my unmasked face... I-I can't do this... One must get back to battle, to the holy tasks, before... before I start having the wildest fantasies...)

expedition_ex.line: Come again? The commission team is back? Forgive me... I was wholly absorbed in beaming my brainwaves into you.

feeling5_ex.line: Da-dim... Da-dum... Da-dim ––Now, to hack right into Commander's emotion module... Wh-why'd I take my mask off? Um... Well, it's to make you lower your guard... Ahaha! Ahh~♡ Ahhhn~♡... Haah... Commencing physical synchronization~♡!

headtouch_ex.line: Hahh... C-Commander... H-how long are you going to keep patting me?

home_ex.line: (No-no-no-no... You're going to lose control of your emotion module before the Commander even comes ba– Ohhh! Why?! Why does just imagining the Commander looking triumphant turn me on like this?!)

login_ex.line: Good, you're back. One is ready to commit one's body to the holy task... of... Commit one's body to... I didn't mean to phrase it like that!

main5_ex.line: I'm starting to feel... warm. H-h-how am I supposed to deal with the heat? Oh, I know! Transfer it to something with a colder surface temperature! C-Commander, I need your embrace!

main6_ex.line: "The noble blade of the Orthodoxy and the Commander's protector." One could add that to one's preamble... Ahem. This one is a Sacrament of the unified Orthodoxy, an unreachable dream, the guardian of the Holy See, and the noble blade that protects the Commander!

main7_ex.line: Are there really no holy tasks for this one to perform? You know, I'd really like some holy tasks. A buuunch more... ♡

main8_ex.line: The secretary manual describes а procedure called "the wake-up call"... D-don't you think it's vulgar? ...What part of it? A-all of it, the whole thing!

mail_ex.line: A new letter? One wonders who it's from. Perhaps it's the very letter that this one wrote earlier... Don't open it! I need to read it first!

mission_ex.line: There are holy tasks to be done. The punishment for neglecting them is... Oh god... Stop thinking primal thoughts, brain! ...C-Commander?! Sorry for that... I got distracted.

mission_complete_ex.line: If one claims these rewards now, one shall receive a reward later... R-reward... Noooo! My emotion module and logic pathways are going to explode!

touch_ex.line: Ahh... C-Commander... Touch the darkness inside me... ♡

touch2_ex.line: Status... report... O-one has already overheated... Pl-please help repair my frame... ♡

upgrade_ex.line: One's emotion module has been upgraded... Even if it can only last one second longer, that still counts as an upgrade!

win_mvp_ex.line: A holy task has been seen through. Now one shall– Whuah?! Y-you can't just appear in my line of sight without warning!

battle.line: I need to do this quickly, or I'll be late to see the Commander!

detail.line: Wheeew... Aahhh... Huh? H-how did you know I was sending brainwaves into you? I'm still wearing the brainwave interceptor...

expedition.line: The commission team is back? I can't leave the pool now, so... You do the reception thing, please.

feeling5.line: One is in a bikini and underwater, thus one's cooling capabilities are at their all-time highest. You can come closer if you want– Ahh! Identification error has occurred in vision module, and logic pathways have shortcircuited... Why is my Commander resistance value still at zero?!

headtouch.line: A headpat? One doesn't particularly need it... W-wait, one must turn on the Commander brainwave interceptor... Aahh! Hahh... N-nooo... Don't beam me so hard! You're making me hot even in the water!

home.line: Wheeew... Okay, one needs to stay in the water to keep one's emotion module regulated. Just don't think of the Commander... Commander... Ahh... Hahh... ♡

login.line: Goodness, you're panting and drenched in sweat... Did my bikini do this – making you hot and craving action in broad daylight? ...N-no, Alsace, you mustn't harbor these thoughts!

mail.line: Your letters would just get wet if I brought them... Pl-plus, I'd make you... you know.

main1.line: Me, fuming even more than usual? Well, yes, because this cruise with you is just that fun... You've rendered my barely-serviceable emotion module completely nonfunctional.

main2.line: You think this bikini looks cute on me? N-now you're going out of your way to make me overheat! And it's working so well it's making me all dizzy! Ahh... Give it to me already... ♡

main3.line: W-wait! My brainwave interceptor fell off... Thank you... Aahh... Am I imagining it, or is the pool heating up all of a sudden?

main4.line: S-so, we're the only ones here... Try not to lose control of yourself like I do, okay? Ahh, hahh... Oh god... Just thinking about having you all to myself is making me have all kinds of wild thoughts... ♡

mission.line: Commander, there are still holy tasks awaiting you... This one's talking "like that" again? Yes. The temperature has decreased slightly in one's emotion module.

mission_complete.line: A holy task has been accomplished. One needs to get back in the pool immediately... *pant*... Before the temp gets too high...

touch.line: It doeshn't make senshe... I'm underwater, and I'm shtill sho hot...

touch2.line: Ahh... Commander... I won't stop you if you wanna do it here... ♡

unlock.line: Thish one ish battleship Alsace – a-artifact of the unifuh... guardian of the Holy See, donning summer clothes... One's frame is overheating and the only fix is submersion in water... Aahhh...

upgrade.line: You think this one looks even hotter than usual in the summer sun? Ahh... Don't say another word or I WILL overheat and stop working!

win_mvp.line: One shall bring a bikini-clad victory!

detail.line: (I'm powerless to resist anything the Commander does to me in this pose... I thought I'd get to flaunt my cool side, but I just can't stay composed around the Commander... Oh, god... My emotion module... Drinking this sake has made its temperature go up... Ugh...)

expedition.line: Message received: The commission team has returned. One shall get down and– Mgh?!

feeling5.line: Detecting error in sensor functioning... But you're not even touching this one, so how– Eek! M-my sensor's sensitivity is acting up, so you shouldn't touch me there... Hahh, ahh... You'll make me turn into a real oni and attack you!

headtouch.line: Hahh... Eek! C-Commander! My mask!

home.line: Commander, let us drink every drop of this sake... Ahh. Your heroic performance has been duly logged in– Gah! Th-the cup!

login.line: Welcome, Commander. The holy task awai– Mrgh! N-no, it's... It's nothing...

main1.line: You needn't fuss over form when atoning for a sin. Doing good deeds and accomplishing holy tasks are one and the same.

main2.line: This one adorned this mask to suppress one's emotions and act in adherence to one's role... a-and also because it looks cool... *blushes*

main3.line: About the alcohol you recommended – it wasn't sake, but rather Armagnac... which is causing problems for one's emotion module...

main4.line: Maintaining this pose is a simple task thanks to one's balance function... M-my clothes, on the other hand... Oh, god...

mission.line: You carry out your holy tasks... So, too, shall this one fulfill one's role.

mission_complete.line: Do not forget to claim the rewards of your holy task. And to give this one a reward.

touch.line: Are you checking this one's ventilation function?

touch2.line: Eek! This one's sensors are... overheating! Detecting sudden temperature increase!

unlock.line: This one is Battleship Alsace – the Sacramental Blade, the Swordbearing Oni Protector of the Backwoods. One has awaited your arrival. *burp*... Um, pretend that didn't happen, Commander...

battle.line: I'm not done yet. We will win.

detail.line: Tch, more and more sacred duties... Hm? You're going to work overtime? That isn't necessary – leave it all to me, and you can go home and rest.

expedition.line: Break time is over. Let's go greet the commission team.

feeling1.line: I'm limiting our communications solely to work situations. Is that a problem for you?

feeling2.line: Among my sacred duties, the most important is caring for you – that is, maintaining your health. But don't mistake that for meaning that you can neglect regular medical examinations.

feeling3.line: I've done all of the trivial work available, so that should lighten the load on you for... Zzz... Ah! No, I didn't do an all-nighter. I just stayed a little extra...

feeling4.line: Looking good. I feel my efforts are working... Hmm? You're actually following my health advice? That's great. Ideally, you'll put the same effort into your sacred duties. I'll be there to help you, of course.

feeling5.line: Wait, I'll finish my work right away so we can talk... Argh, I messed up! Stupid... I know I can't balance sacred duties and physical affection at the same time, but I still try... Hm? You'll be with me to help? Haha... I didn't think you'd be the one taking care of me this time...

headtouch.line: Nnh... I'm not sleeping. Wh-what do you want?

home.line: Thank you for your efforts. We still have many sacred duties... Nnh... Okay, that's everything! Hm...? Oh, we just started? Sorry... I must've dreamed of finishing it all.

hp_warning.line: There are still people in need of help... Back to work!

login.line: ...Ah! Right, let's begin today's work.

lose.line: ...We lost? This is going to double my work... Tch, whatever. What matters now is a timely retreat.

mail.line: Mail's here. I'll get it... Say, don't you think you rely on me too much now? Is that really what you want?

main1.line: Your work environment meets health standards. Continue your sacred duties without worry. I'll be here to help in case you have any problems.

main2.line: Hm hm♪... Soft music is good for relaxation. Try it out, Commander. Sleep well, and have good dreams... I'll take care of the remaining work.

main3.line: Staying late again? Okay. I'll work with you and try not to suddenly fall... Zzz... Hnh?! It's okay. I'm definitely... not... falling asleep...

mission.line: New missions have arrived and require urgent attention. I'll help you, so don't worry.

mission_complete.line: I'm glad we've finished our sacred duties on time. Now I can finally sleep...

profile.line: I'm Bois Belleau, a light aircraft carrier under the Holy Iris banner. But I'm more interested in you... Strip for me so I can examine you, please. Why? As I recall, I already told you that ensuring your health is my most sacred of duties...

propose.line: What is it that makes me want to be so close to you? We were only together for work, but we've become so intimate. It's as if you're caring for me... How did you turn the tables like that? *sigh*... I'll keep performing my sacred duties for you and take better care of you than ever from now on.

skill.line: One after another, endlessly... Time to finish this all at once!

touch.line: What's the matter? Do you need health counseling, or... is there work you need me to do?! (Why am I so flustered? It was just a light touch. Calm yourself...)

touch2.line: Wh-wh-what are you doing?! How unholy, how... You can't DO that in the midst of our sacred duties! It's obscene!

unlock.line: Bois Belleau. I handle logistics and care for the Iris Orthodoxy. I also keep an eye out for everyone's health – particularly yours, Commander. Keeping you healthy and sane is the most sacred of my duties.

upgrade.line: With greater power comes more plentiful responsibilities... Tch, whatever. I guess that's what I'm here for.

win_mvp.line: Outstanding victory, everyone. Nnh... Sorry, I fell asleep. Let's make arrangements for our next battle.

gift_prefer.line: You went through the effort of finding out what I like? Thank you for the thought.

detail_ex.line: Hmhmhm♪~ Does this melody calm you? O-oh, is that the first time I've hummed for you? Well... Did you like it?

feeling5_ex.line: Your advice helped me out a lot. I stopped working late every night, and now we mutually care for each other. Umm... You know, persistence over the long term is important when it comes to caring for others! Will you stay with me for as long as it takes?

headtouch_ex.line: Zzzz... Mmm, Commander... That feels nice...

home_ex.line: Good work today, Commander. Would you like a head massage? Y-you can lie down in my lap... As long as it helps you relax...

login_ex.line: Commander? I dealt with all of the urgent work already. Say, for the sake of our health... Would you nap with me? You'll just have to wake me up on time...

main4_ex.line: ...Smile? If you want me to, I'll try... H-how's this? Cute...? Wh-what are you going on about?

main5_ex.line: Zzzz... Hm? Just let me work... So much left to do... Hwuh? That was last night? Was I just dreaming about work, then?

main6_ex.line: I'm getting sleepy, but I haven't finished my advance work yet... Huh? I can stop for today? Okay... I guess I don't have to push myself in front of you.

touch_ex.line: Ahem... Are you feeling unwell? Lie down, and I'll examine you.

touch2_ex.line: W-we're doing sacred work right now! We can't... O-oh, fine, then...

detail.line: Can you feel it? The water's warm, soft embrace... Your mind sinking into a sea of clouds, drifting away quietly... This hot spring therapy is incredible. It's so comfortable, I can't help but feel like I'm healing alongside you.

feeling5.line: You think... just being with me is enough to relax you? It sounds as if you're denying medical science... but if what you say is true, then would this be a kind of "couple's" hot spring therapy? While the hot spring soothes you, I myself am soothed BY you...

headtouch.line: Mmm... Ah, now you've gone and healed ME, Commander...

home.line: Zzz... Ah?! I-I could've slept until morning... Long baths really do make me sleepy.

login.line: After your hot spring treatment, you should be able to focus more on your work than before. Now, let's get to it. Want me to play some calming music?

main1.line: Your deliverables still aren't done? Well, if you work while you bathe, you probably won't get tired... I know that's impossible for you, though.

main2.line: Ugh... My legs are numb from sitting like this for so long. Commander, we should get out for a while. Umm... Can you carry me?

main3.line: It's easy to slip in here. Can you pull me up – Hyah?! Ah...

touch.line: I'm not giving you a massage in the hot spring. Try all you like, but I'm not indulging you this time...

touch2.line: Your heartbeat is quickening... Is your blood pressure spiking? Is it because of the hot spring... You're certain it's not? O-oh...

unlock.line: Finished your sacred work? I looked into hot spring therapy a little to help you relax a little. It's the warmest and most pleasant healing method I've ever seen. Would you... come in with me?

battle.line: Time for Marteau to shine!

detail.line: Commander! Wanna see my warm-up spins with Marteau? ...Hmm? You think that's too much effort for a warm-up? The word "tired" doesn't exist in my dictionary! All I know is "again"!

expedition.line: Things are getting lively over there... Our commission team must be back~

feeling1.line: Sorry, I'm busy!

feeling2.line: Com-man-der! Let's do gymnastics together! I'll show you the ropes, so... Hey, don't be so nervous. As long as I'm around, you won't get hurt! Relax, relax~

feeling3.line: I might not look like it, but I know how to be elegant! For example, I can... curtsy? Umm, is that what it was called?

feeling4.line: Commander! I dunno why, but I really want to hear your opinion now! Give me feedback on my performance today, okay? If you like it... I'll be walking on sunshine all day!

feeling5.line: I knew it... You're the perfect audience! You take my performance seriously, and you give me sincere feedback... Hehe, I love you, Commander!

headtouch.line: Oh, wooow! Your encouragement is making me feel more energetic than ever, Commander!

home.line: Ooh, welcome back, Commander! Did you like my triple backflip? Pretty cool how I landed square in front of you too, right?

hp_warning.line: Nkh... This is starting to hurt.

login.line: Woohoo! It's another high-energy day, Commander! Let's do some gymnastics together to warm up!

lose.line: I've got so much energy, but nothing to do with it...

mail.line: Ooh! This mail... must be an invitation to a dance party! Hurry and open it.

main1.line: Hehe, I won a prize in another competition today! What kind? Hmm... I don't remember... Hahaha! I joined partway through!

main2.line: Look, Commander! Five turns in midair, followed by a 720-degree spin, and finally, a steady landing with Marteau... Whoa! I made a crater in the ground!

main3.line: Commander, I stopped a fight today! All I did was stand there with Marteau, and suddenly, they calmed down...

mission.line: Mission alert, mission alert! Let's get it done, Commander!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Let's wrap it up with a high-energy acrobatic performance!

profile.line: Arromanches, the Colossus-class aircraft carrier, takes the stage! Wherever excitement goes, I follow! Apart from combat, I'm great at acrobatics – a real pro, you know! Hey, don't call me wild!

propose.line: I love you more than anything! I love you so much that I could do ten somersaults right now! But if I did that, I'd make a mess of the room... so I'll go for something simpler and more direct! Huuuug!

touch.line: Commander, you wanna high-five? Awesome! Let me just charge up, and... HYAAAH!

touch2.line: Hyah?! You sneaky little... Take this! And this!

unlock.line: Hello, hello! Nice to meet you, Commander! I'm the acrobatic dancer of the Iris Libre, Arromanches! Rumors of a lively port brought me here! Come on – time to show me around my new home!

upgrade.line: Power up!

win_mvp.line: Huh? I just finished warming up, and it's already over?!

gift_prefer.line: Oooh, a present from the Commander?! Yay!

detail_ex.line: Commander, I just discovered this cool pose! Basically, I wrap my legs around your waist like this... and now, I can use you to do stretches!

feeling5_ex.line: With my super-invincible Arromanches Hug, I'm gonna give you all of my joy, passion, and devoted love all at once! Hnnngh... Do you feel it, Commander?!

headtouch_ex.line: Heheh... Keep going, Commander! I'll tell you when you've petted me enough♪

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! Great work on that last mission! May I give you a massage? ...Huh? Don't worry, I won't be too rough! It'll be okay!

login_ex.line: Com-man-der! Heheh... Seeing you again makes me super happy!

main4_ex.line: I was playing hopscotch just now, but I accidentally held the chalk too hard and broke it to bits... It was really pretty to see it fall down like a rainbow of powder!

main5_ex.line: Commander~ It's break time! Get over here so I can show you the after-exercise massage I just learned!

main6_ex.line: Whoa! Commander, why are you watching my practice videos? ...Let me watch with you! I'll sit in your lap – it's my personal VIP seat!

touch_ex.line: Hm? You wanna touch Marteau? Be my guest!

touch2_ex.line: Heheh... Don't underestimate how flexible I am!

feeling5.line: Aww yeah, my aim is perfect! Hmm? You say I didn't fire any arrows? Heheh, well... I wasn't shooting at the target – I shot your heart! Did you feel how I pierced it right in the center? Hehehe!

headtouch.line: Huh?! Is this supposed to help me calm down? There's no way that'll... Huh. I do feel calmer now...

home.line: Urk... Keeping this position is starting to make my feet cold... I know! Commander, hold my feet and use them to draw the bow! It'll help me practice AND warm up my feet – that's two birds with one stone!

login.line: Drawing a bow while reciting my lines... i-is actually really hard! Only I can pull this off!

lose.line: I-I'm gonna fall!

main1.line: There's a lot of stuff I had to learn: how to keep my balance, how to draw a bow while doing a handstand, and how to aim with my feet!

main2.line: Are you trying to see if I can keep my balance while you're distracting me? That's not ne... Ack! D-don't touch my hair! If you do that, I... Nkh! Hahaha?! Don't tickle my feet, either! I'm gonna drop the arrow!

main3.line: Commander, can you aim the bow and arrow for me? Then, all I'll have to do is draw it and... Whoa?! I pulled too hard and broke the bow!

touch.line: Hmm? You wanna see if my posture is stable? Heheh, I promise you... Whoa?! Hey, that didn't count! I'm not ready yet!

touch2.line: Hyah?! S-stop that, or I might collapse...

unlock.line: Focus your core, keep your center of balance... Draw the bow, and... Huh? Great timing, Commander! I was just looking for an assistant for my new performance!

win_mvp.line: Hahaha! Perfect precision!

battle.line: Now, as outlined in our briefing, prepare for combat!

couple_encourage1.line: I'd love to transport fascinating items with you.

couple_encourage2.line: I am profoundly honored to fight by your side.

couple_encourage3.line: Allow me to show you an Iris sacrament.

detail.line: An improvement in operational code and tactical variables... This sequence should be useful. I shall write this down in my notebook.

expedition.line: Transport commissions and cargo escorts are vital, of course, but let's not forget the important safety of our docks.

feeling1.line: "You are the most outstanding, exceptional commander I have ever met." – You can only hope to hear me say these words in your most outlandish dreams.

feeling2.line: Are you curious about this book? It is just a notepad, more or less. Rest assured, there is nothing remarkable about it. And it is certainly not something you need look at.

feeling3.line: A "grimoire"? Hmm... And you say L'Opiniâtre told you this? It's certainly an amusing allegory. Now, I'm afraid I must take my leave for a while, as I have business to attend to.

feeling4.line: This "grimoire" topic again? I do not appreciate your insistence on it. "A sacrament from the Iris Libre can perform all sorts of miracles"... Assuming that were even true, how would you utilize such great power, Commander?

feeling5.line: Commander, all of today's clerical tasks have been completed right on schedule. This is a good opportunity to... Indeed, as you've requested, I will teach you about the so-called "sacrament of love."

home.line: You would like something sugary in preparation for your mental labor? It so happens I have a list of our stock of confectionaries. Please have a look.

hp_warning.line: I have sustained damage, but it is under control...

login.line: Here is today's schedule, Commander. Read it at your leisure.

lose.line: I sincerely apologize, Commander. I take full responsibility for this defeat.

mail.line: Reporting in. I have a newly arrived letter for you, Commander.

main1.line: If I may be so blunt, Commander, it would be very unwise of you to read my book. I am not exaggerating or joking about this.

main2.line: Are you daydreaming, Commander? You may continue to fantasize if you so wish; we have enough free time in today's schedule to accommodate for it.

main3.line: I shall attend to our official business and schedule management. You need only focus on the work on your desk, Commander.

mission.line: Commander, I have received word of new mission directives from headquarters. I shall go and make some arrangements.

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed. That's one burden off our minds.

profile.line: My name is Béarn, I am the Iris Libre's first aircraft carrier, converted from the unfinished 5th Normandie-class dreadnought. I lived to see the end of the strife between Iris and Vichya... A tragedy I pray will never happen again.

propose.line: If there are sacraments that can emotionally move and unite people, then this so-called "marriage" must be the most powerful of its kind. Ah, this bliss, this feeling of butterflies in my stomach... Now I understand how it feels to take an oath. It's quite enjoyable, actually. Hehehe~

touch.line: I am right here, Commander. Do not hesitate to give me your orders.

touch2.line: Do you lack the knowledge of what being a decent person entails, or are you simply unable to control yourself, Commander?

unlock.line: Béarn, Iris Libre's very first aircraft carrier, reporting for duty. It is an honor to fight by your side. I eagerly await your orders, Commander.

upgrade.line: Your kindness will not go unrewarded, Commander.

win_mvp.line: How would you say I did? Was my performance satisfactory?

gift_prefer.line: Commander, do you ever feel as if you're putting too much thought into me? It's okay to be more relaxed around me.

detail.line: Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves at the beach. What do you say about playing beach volleyball, or building a sandcastle, Commander? Me, I would rather remain here and observe.

home.line: You were out at sea? Here, have a towel.

login.line: Would you like a swim ring, Commander? It could be useful if you plan on playing with the girls by the beach.

main1.line: One can seek cover from the sun, but cannot escape the heat. As I'm on lifeguard duty, perhaps I should've brought an electric fan with me.

main2.line: This ice cream is going to melt if nobody eats it. Say, Commander, would you like a taste?

main3.line: Both Vichya and Iris girls enjoying the summer on the same beach... A lovely sight, in my opinion.

touch.line: Your praise honors me, but I can easily imagine that you praise everyone here for their swimsuits.

touch2.line: I suspected you would engage in obscene behavior as soon as you distanced yourself from onlookers, Commander...

unlock.line: Are you perhaps feeling unwell, Commander? Oh, I see, you're just looking for a shaded place to rest? Acknowledged. In that case, you may sit here if you'd like.

battle.line: Today is a lucky day, I'm certain... Everything will be okay!

couple_encourage1.line: Our trial... has begun!

couple_encourage2.line: T-to the Templar Knights' triumphant return!

detail.line: Only by truly wishing for it can we continue to reach greater heights. Commander, as someone who travels with the blessing of the Holy Iris at your back, do not forget this.

expedition.line: Our commission team is back. I sent them off with today's lucky item, so I'm sure they bring great results!

feeling1.line: Ever since I met you, I've noticed so many more ill omens. Why could that be...?

feeling2.line: Ah... Umm... Yes, I understand your wish. As for me, I'd prefer to maintain an appropriate distance...

feeling3.line: Please accept this blessed lucky item. ...Yes, I'm certain that it'll bring you good fortune!

feeling4.line: You always know exactly what I'm thinking, Commander. Hahaha, you know... I don't mind the feeling of having someone see through me without so much as a word.

feeling5.line: Whenever I pray, images of you well up in my mind. I always end up looking forward to it... Wh-what am I saying right now?!

home.line: I've been praying here ever since you left, Commander. ...Oh, and I prepared drinks and snacks, too. Would you like to partake together?

hp_warning.line: Answer my prayers...!

login.line: Oh, Commander... I'm not done praying yet. If you don't mind... could you please wait a bit?

lose.line: Why...? Were my prayers not enough? Did I miss some sort of ill omen?

mail.line: New mail... *sigh*... I hope it's good news.

main1.line: Commander, making wishes isn't all-powerful. Don't make too many wishes, or you may invite divine retribution...

main2.line: Commander? The thing is, I... No, never mind. Forget I said anything...

main3.line: Astrology, tarot cards, tasseography, bagua... Which one should I choose today?

mission.line: Missions... I wonder if there's a lucky process to them. Oh, what I mean is, maybe there's a specific order you can do them in to make good things happen, or... something.

mission_complete.line: Our missions are all done. Did my lucky process work for you? Maybe you got more rewards than usual, or...?

profile.line: I am aircraft carrier Painlevé, and I stand here only because of wishes. Making our wishes come true isn't easy – it comes with sacrifices and regrets. But despite all that, we can never stop wishing.

propose.line: I have more wishes than I can count, but right now... Heehee, there's only one on my mind, and it's about to come true. Commander, thank you for making my dream a reality. I'm so glad... I came to love you.

skill.line: This, too, is the Holy Iris's wish–

touch.line: Commander... Is there something you want me to do?

touch2.line: S-sorry! I don't really want that right now...

unlock.line: I am the second Joffre-class aircraft carrier of the Iris Libre, Painlevé. It is a pleasure to meet you... May you and your companions receive the Iris's protection.

upgrade.line: Umm... if this is your wish...

win_mvp.line: Our prayers... have been answered.

gift_prefer.line: I've never said that I wanted this, so how did you... Th-thank you very much!

detail_ex.line: What do you wish for, Commander? ...N-no, you don't have to tell me! Heehee, it's just that I heard that if you and your loved one wish for the same thing, it helps you grow even closer...

expedition_ex.line: Commander, shall we greet the commission team together? ...Oh, can't leave without my lucky item... There! That should be today's.

feeling5_ex.line: You and I wish for each other's happiness, and our two wishes intertwine to make one. That's what gives us this dreamlike, blissful time together. I'm glad I fell for you, Commander...

home_ex.line: Thank you for helping the one I love triumph... O-oh, you heard that? I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be embarrassing...

login_ex.line: Oh, wow... I just happened to think of you while I was praying, and there you are... Heehee.

main4_ex.line: The luckiest time to set sail is... any time, of course!♪ Haha, I'm kidding. Any time you set sail is a lucky time, Commander—I'm constantly wishing for your good fortune.

main5_ex.line: My wish... Umm, my wish is... for you to... N-no! I shouldn't be greedy...

main6_ex.line: U-umm... It's not a good idea to meet the Commander today? That can't be... There must be a mistake here.

touch_ex.line: Okay, but just a little...

touch2_ex.line: I'm wearing a lucky color today... if you get what I mean...

detail.line: This pose is a little embarrassing, isn't it... Oh, i-it's okay! I wasn't telling you to look away...

home.line: Relax your body now, and... Hnnngh!

login.line: Oh, good morning. You're just in time for today's calisthenics session, Commander.

main1.line: Commander, can you push down on my back please? Yes, just a little more...

main2.line: It's okay, just relax a little more... Heehee, this is important for stretching.

main3.line: C-Commander? What was that crack I just heard? Are you... okay...?

touch.line: I-I don't think I have that much extra fat there...

touch2.line: S-sorry... I'm all soaked with sweat...

unlock.line: Phew... Commander...? Would you like to... hnnngh... stretch with me? Don't worry, it won't hurt. We have plenty of time, so we can take it slow...

detail.line: You have a little request? And the request is that you want to feed me? I-I see... Come to think of it, I happened to have a similar little request...

expedition.line: Has the commission team returned? Umm... Here's today's lucky item. When you go greet them, please bring one of these back.

feeling5.line: Commander, I have something important to share. In the time we spent together, I've gained a new wish. A sweet, happy wish... A wish about the two of us.

home.line: W-welcome back, Commander. ...You're wondering why I haven't eaten any? I just thought it'd be better if I waited for you to get back so we could eat together... *blush*

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. My prayers have made this parfait even more delicious, so please, eat up. ...Okay, open up, and I'll feed you.

main1.line: Commander, umm... N-no, I shouldn't be greedy... b-but I want to be with you forever... *blush*

main2.line: You want to talk about wishes again? Heehee, tell me one of yours. I'll do my best to help you achieve it.

main3.line: The shape of the melted parfait can divine today's fortune... Umm, today, let's see... Oh! It's a very lucky day for a date!

mission.line: It's almost that lucky time of day... Commander, I think you'll see great success if you do your missions now.

mission_complete.line: Did you see great success in your missions?! So the lucky time really did help! Thank goodness.

touch.line: Does this mean... you like my new outfit?

touch2.line: U-umm... I'm going to spill my ice cream!

unlock.line: Mm... Aah, that hits the spot! I just hope my prayers are answered and it suits the Commander's tastes... Heehee, maybe if I personally feed–eep?! C-Commander? D-did you just hear that...?

battle.line: They're just slightly bigger targets! On y va!

detail.line: Commander, why don't we design a flag for the fleet? Let's make it look like the Iris Libre flag~

expedition.line: Commander, a commission's been completed~ I'll go check if they found anything neato♪

feeling1.line: Oh, Commander, could you get back to work? I have more fun when you're not around.

feeling2.line: So apparently, I'm named after a big-shot pirate! Some say that's pretty cool, but I'm not a fan of those guys, so I don't really care.

feeling3.line: Salut~! Wanna go have some fun, Commander? Let's take a walk around town, go shopping, then fall asleep in a grass field~

feeling4.line: Commander, I've found a fantastic napping place, and I'll tell you where it is. Oh, and don't tell anyone else, okay? Let's keep it a secret between just the two of us♪

feeling5.line: *Giggle* Aren't we practically made for each other? It's not every day you find people as closely in synch as we are~ Say, isn't it time we become a couple now?

home.line: Commander, did you bring anything for me?

hp_warning.line: I promised the Commander I'd fight and give it all I've got!

login.line: Salut~ Good morning, Commander~

lose.line: Oops, we lost... Commander, think we should flee?

mail.line: Commander, you've got new mail! ... Huh? No, I didn't bring it with me. I'm just saying you should go get it~

main1.line: You appointed me as your secretary because you were so enamored with my gorgeous body, weren't you? Spot on, aren't I~? Don't be so shy, I won't get upset with you~♪

main2.line: You sure are hard at work, Commander... I'll join you and help out! Although what am I supposed to help with...

main3.line: Commander, have you seen my darling Passepartout? Ah, that's what I call my floatplane. He's my BFF~

mission.line: Okay, let's see what rewards we got today!

mission_complete.line: Ooh! I found something nice amongst the rewards♪

profile.line: Submarine Surcouf of Iris Libre, that's who I am. "Cruiser submarine"? Ah, are you talking about my gorgeous body which matches that of a cruiser~? Well, my firepower matches that of a cruiser, too! I bump into people quite a lot, but don't worry about that. Hahaha♪

propose.line: So, you wanna chain Surcouf to your side with this ring? Jeez, aren't you greedy~ But, since it's you... I might be fine with it♪

touch.line: Eat a lot, sleep a lot, fight a lot! And everything else is your responsibility♪ I think I can dig this way of life~

touch2.line: Commander, if you wanna fondle 'em, just say so first~

unlock.line: Salut~! I am Surcouf! "What's a ship with the physique of a cruiser doing with submarine equipment"? Hey! You've got it all wrong! My looks may be deceiving, but I'm a fully qualified submarine! Anyhoo, it's nice meeting you~

upgrade.line: Bien joué, Commander!

win_mvp.line: *Yawn*... Winning makes me sleepy, somehow... Mmh...

gift_prefer.line: Ooh. Nice one, Commander!

detail.line: This scooter really is fantastic! A good buy for a good price~ Lucky me♪

feeling5.line: Here, Commander. You drive and I'll hold onto you from behind like this~ Mmm, now it feels like we're a real couple~ I've always wanted to try it out myself♪

login.line: Commander, are you ready? Then we're off to the next stop~

main1.line: Commander, you can give me puppy-dog eyes all you want, but I won't share my ice cream... F-fine, just one lick, got it?

main2.line: My twin-gun turrets are also on vacation today! Gotta work hard and play hard!

main3.line: Uhh, I don't think I'll bring the puppy with me next time... He's way too jumpy and almost even fell off the scooter once...

touch.line: Oh, you finally noticed, Commander! That's right, I put my hair up just for today's ride! This is your only chance to see it like this.

touch2.line: I can't believe you. You almost made me drop my ice cream!

unlock.line: Hmm? Commander, are you shopping as well? If so, why don't you come along and take a look around? ... Huh? Of course you can't climb on. That'd be illegal.

detail.line: Sure, I go in the water all the time since I'm a submarine, but it's nice to just relax by the beach every now and then! *yaaaawn*... A girl needs her vacation time, you know~

home.line: Welcome back, Comma– Whuah! Geesh, that last wave was huge! You could've warned me that it was coming! Hmph!

login.line: Hey, Commander, done anything fun lately? I wanna know!

main1.line: Hey, Commander! Just lie on your back and I'll cover you with sand~

main2.line: Go get the camera, Commander! I wanna take a photo of this.

main3.line: Passepartout, could you get me some sunscreen? Oh, and Commander, would you mind rubbing it on for me?

touch.line: You're head over heels for my gorgeous body, aren't you? Heheh, stare all you want, because I don't mind♡

unlock.line: Mmmh~ Bonjour, Commander~ Nothing feels better than the waves lapping at your skin~ Oh, Commander, why don't you come lie down and experience it for yourself?

battle.line: Let's cause some chaos in their ranks!

couple_encourage1.line: I know the secret to becoming elegant. Just do as I say, and you'll get there in no time.

detail.line: One choice, one path, with countless possibilities swirling at your fingertips... Fact and fiction are irrelevant. All are simple hallucinations that disappear in the blink of an eye. What drives our choices, then? Fun, of course.

expedition.line: The commission team has brought back a veritable mountain of supplies! Heehee... It's actually an illusion. Aww, now I can't bring myself to dispel it, seeing how happy they are.

feeling1.line: Boring.

feeling2.line: Why are there a dozen coffee cups on your desk? Pssh, as if I would know... Try taking a drink, and you might find out. But if you pick wrong... Your coffee might just pounce on you like a cat!

feeling3.line: I heard there's a new scratcher at the convenience store. If you get the super-rare heart pattern, you can turn it in for a mystery prize... Isn't that thrilling? Anyway, I bought a thousand. Let's get scratching!

feeling4.line: Hmmm? Why am I following you? Don't worry about it. I'm just... discovering a new hobby of mine, hehehe.

feeling5.line: Every decision you make opens up new possibilities for me... It fills me with more excitement than anything else. I'm totally addicted to you now, Commander.

headtouch.line: You're petting me? Well, this is novel...

home.line: That was a hard-fought battle. Relax those tense nerves, alright? I know a lot of fun places to go, and I'd be happy to show you around, hehehe~

hp_warning.line: What chaos... Now I'm getting excited! Heheheh!

login.line: *yaaawn*... Your daily schedule is so rigid that it puts me to sleep. I put some thrilling surprises in your daily schedule... You'd better look forward to those. Hehehe.

lose.line: Oh my, don't be sad~ Sometimes, the roulette wheel of fate just lands on red.

mail.line: You have new mail~ What could it be? I'm dying to know.

main1.line: Oh, you're finally awake. We're on a snowy mountaintop! ...Oh, you think the snow is an illusion? What if the blanket's warmth is the illusion instead?

main2.line: The boredom of these monotonous times drives me crazy... Commander, entertain me. I'll take ANYTHING♡

main3.line: It's almost time for the girls' "Grand Adventure" to begin. Would you like to watch? These are the best seats in the house!

mission.line: I've put together a list of your unfinished missions. Take a look... Oh? You think I added that last one myself? Goodness, how easily you pierced my illusion...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Are you SURE you're not interested in the special mission I planned for you?

profile.line: I'm Cherbourg, a naval treaty specification 23,333-long-ton protected cruiser under the Iris banner. As for who I am? A believer in chance, a connoisseur of chaos, and an illusionist... In this ever-changing world, I think it's a little silly to hold on to a fixed identity.

propose.line: Marriage? Why, I'd be happy to~ Just imagining the unpredictable future that we share makes me shiver with excitement... Never ever bore me, you got that?

skill.line: Don't blink, or you might miss it! Heheheh!

touch.line: Oh? What will you do next? I can't wait to find out.

touch2.line: What a sudden attack... You know just how to entertain me, don't you? Heehee.

unlock.line: Are you the Commander? Greetings from Cherbourg, Illusionist of the Iris... Oh? Things are getting lively out there. Mind if I go take a look? I hope you and I can get to know each other better later on... Hehehe.

upgrade.line: The line between reality and illusions blurs even further~

win_mvp.line: Victory becomes boring the moment it's guaranteed... Let's get to our next battlefield.

gift_prefer.line: Unwrapping a gift is always such an exciting experience~

feeling5_ex.line: I used to think that fun things were like sand on a beach – you can't have them all, and they'll slip through your fingers eventually. But then... I met you, Commander. You're my one-of-a-kind, inexhaustible treasure.

headtouch_ex.line: Hmm? The spot you should be touching is right here, isn't it...? I'm sure it'll be more fun and thrilling... Heheheh.

home_ex.line: Let's go to the cafeteria together for a romantic, full-course Iris-style meal. Imagine the looks on everybody else's faces while they're having quick meals! Heheheheh!

login_ex.line: I'm bored of everyday small talk. Let's skip the boring etiquette and have some fun, heheheh!

main4_ex.line: Why does your office door lead to my room now? Hehe, it's just a little trick of mine~ The look on your face made it all worth it.

main5_ex.line: Let's flip a coin. If it's heads, we'll go do paperwork. If it's tails... let's do something more fun... Oh. It's standing on its edge? Isn't that funny!

main6_ex.line: Tadaaa! Work's over, which means it's time for our date! Let's get going... You want me to wait? No way! I'm at the end of my patience♪

touch_ex.line: Heheheh. Are you getting bored of the dull days, too?

touch2_ex.line: Aaah. Try not to bore me too soon, now... Heheheh♥

detail.line: How did you like my teddy bear magic show? Wasn't it amazing? Or... Are you only focused on what you see spilling out of the costume?

headtouch.line: Don't worry. My outfit is soft, so it's a good cushion... To be quite honest, I'm having fun right now... Hehehe.

home.line: Hey, can you come over and hold me already? I'm a little chilly. Heheheh... Ah, I can feel your warmth...

login.line: I didn't think I'd run into you quite like this... First I tripped and fell, and then, I almost crushed my one and only audience member... What a coincidence! Hehehe.

main1.line: As an actor, I've managed to draw you, my viewer, into the spectacle... What should I do now, you think? Heehee!

main2.line: Hm... This position is really embarrassing... Oh? Are you enjoying the sight, Commander? Surely not~

main3.line: Was this all part of my plan? Nooo, it was just bad luck~ All I did was think about you. Isn't fate just an incredible thing?

touch.line: Aw, you're helping me up? Thank you... Oh nooo, I'm falling again~

touch2.line: Taking advantage of a poor girl in distress? You're a real bully, Commander... Heheheh~

unlock.line: *pant*... It's really hot inside the teddy bear suit... I bet that dynamic entrance took you by surprise, didn't it? Heheh!

battle.line: Warm-up exercises are all done! I'm setting out~!

couple_encourage1.line: Forbin, shall I take the lead?

detail.line: To be honest, I'm a little jealous of Forbin. Back then, we both weren't able to move, but she made more of the situation than me...

expedition.line: Everyone's back! I'm gonna run down to greet them! Be right back!

feeling1.line: Woah, Commander... I, I think I'll be training solo today!

feeling2.line: To be an outstanding knight, it's not enough to just have the strength to protect others. You must also become wise through learning! But... I always start dozing off when I'm studying... *yawn*

feeling3.line: Commander, you'll help me study? Yay! Thank you so much! I'll be sure to... Huuhh? Wait, I have to memorize all this?! S-sorry, I have a stomachache!

feeling4.line: I think I'm starting to get it, but maybe not... But, I'm so glad that you're patient enough to teach a dummy like me. Thank you, Commander!

feeling5.line: Even though I still don't quite understand this stuff, there is one thing that's certain - when it comes to learning things about you, Commander, I function twice as well!

home.line: Commander, you've gotta sweat to burn off fat!

hp_warning.line: It's just a flesh wound! I'll tough it out!

login.line: Commander, you finally made it! What's on the training regimen today?

lose.line: Merdé! Time to retreat!

mail.line: Mail's here~! I already brought it all with me, ehehe~

main1.line: Commander, I'll teach you some stretches for those long days!

main2.line: Being a commander sure is tough, isn't it? Having to micromanage this and that... My head would start spinning...

main3.line: Studying just isn't my strong suit... I obviously can read all these words, but they just don't make any sense to me when put together...

mission.line: We're not done with the missions quite yet. Let me handle the errands!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Huh...? I still have to tally the rewards?

profile.line: Back then, I wasn't able to fulfill my duties, but... Commander, this time, I'll show you what I'm capable of!

propose.line: Um... I haven't learned what I'm supposed to do at a place like this yet... Ah, um! In any case, p-please continue to take good care of me in the future!

touch.line: My shoulders were starting to get stiff too... Thanks a ton, Commander!

touch2.line: Th-this place also needs a massage? Um... it feels a little strange...

unlock.line: Eh? Who are you... Ah! Right, you're the Commander! I'm the L'Adroit-class destroyer, Le Mars! A pleasure meetin' you!

upgrade.line: I grow stronger yet again! Thanks, Commander!

win_mvp.line: I'm in first place...? Très bien! Ehehe~!

gift_prefer.line: Ah! I've always wanted one of these!

detail.line: This is no simple inner tube, Commander. It also doubles as "ammunition storage" for my water gun! How 'bout it? Wanna taste my waterpower~?

home.line: Ehehe, Commander, are you done with work for the day? Let's get going then! ...Huh? Where to? The beach, of course!

login.line: Commander, summer is finally here, so why such a long face~? Let's enjoy some fun in the sun on the beach~♪

main1.line: Commander, wanna share a watermelon?

main2.line: Just because it's hot doesn't mean you should stay cooped up underneath the air conditioner all day. Let's play outside~!

main3.line: Commander, you should also get a tan! That way, we'll match~♪ Ehehe~!

touch.line: Sunscreen? I don't need that~!

touch2.line: C-Commander... that place doesn't need any sunscreen...

unlock.line: It's summer~! Summer is here, Commander! Let's head down to the beach to play! I'll show you why I'm feared in water gun fights!

win_mvp.line: If you underestimate me just because I'm lightly equipped, I'll gladly teach you a lesson~!

detail.line: School life is all about running track under the warm sun, am I right!?

home.line: Uh oh... I can't get anything in this book to stick in my head...

login.line: I'll be bringing the heat at school today!

main1.line: Commander, you should get us some more phys ed classes! I mean... exercise is really important!

main2.line: Listening to music is a real good way to calm your mind when you wanna relax! Let's listen together, Commander.

main3.line: Huh? Forbin's heading this way with a pile of notebooks? Um, is there a good hiding place around here—

touch.line: The wind doesn't scare me!

touch2.line: I don't need a massage right now...

unlock.line: Hey! Over here! Hehe. I didn't expect to run into you at school, Commander. What are you doing here?

detail.line: They do these crazy flips and spins in the movies, right? ...So what'd you think, Commander? I sure wish mine could look that good...

home.line: You seem pretty worn-out, Commander. Let's do some cool-down stretches! Maybe some mild exercise will make you feel better!

login.line: Good morning, Commander! What kind of work will we start with today?

main1.line: I can't do this... Reading books about etiquette puts me right to sleep... Huh? You're willing to be my practice partner? That'd be a huge help!

main2.line: By the way, Commander, have you seen Forbin? ...Even though she's a total lightweight, she keeps trying to push herself... Ugh, I'm getting a bad feeling about this...

main3.line: Phew... I finally managed to finish making my rounds... I was so nervous my body was stiff as a rock, but you looked like you were totally in your element... That's amazing, I tell you!

touch.line: Um, this is how you're supposed to hold the champagne, right?

touch2.line: Um, is this also a part of my training...?

unlock.line: Commander, thanks for coming to pick me up! I don't often get the chance to wear formal clothes, though it is a little hard to move around... Oh, but I can deal with it!

win_mvp.line: It's probably because I got a good warm-up in. Hehe~

detail.line: Commander, are you that desperate to see my gallant form as I unload all my cannons and torpedo tubes? Ehehe, what am I going to do with you~

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Shall we plan our next sortie?

login.line: My torpedoes and cannons are locked and loaded! Commander, I'm ready to sortie at any time!

main1.line: Hehe! Commander, is this victory pose cool? I saw it in an anime!

main2.line: Commission or sortie, I'm ready to do anything! With how strong I am now, I won't let you down, Commander!

main3.line: Is there something that needs doing? I'll be happy to shoulder even a little bit of your burdens.

touch.line: Hehe, how about I be the one to give you a shoulder massage this time?

unlock.line: Retro~ fit~ com~ plete! The new and improved Le Mars is at your service~!

win_mvp.line: Now, for a victory pose! ...Hey! Wait for meeee!

battle.line: Focus, focus...!

couple_encourage1.line: Vauquelin, don't push yourself too hard.

couple_encourage2.line: Miss Dunkerque is with us... I-I'll have to do my best!

detail.line: The motherly Dunkerque, the elegant Algérie, and Lady Richelieu... They all represent the pinnacles of womanhood. I must strive to be more like them.

expedition.line: The commission has been completed. Sorry, Commander, I forgot to tell you...

feeling1.line: Commander, please be quiet. I can't even hear my own thoughts over your ruckus...

feeling2.line: Ow...! Ugh, where did that tree branch come from... Oh, Commander, good morning. I'm... Mm, I'm fine. I just got lost in my thoughts while I was walking. Don't worry, this kind of stuff happens all the time.

feeling3.line: Listen up, me, if I keep overthinking everything, I won't notice what's going on around me... and then won't be able to become a mature and compassionate woman...

feeling4.line: Commander, you're always trying to follow my pace during conversations... Thank you. However, if I end talking to myself, feel free to snap me out of it. I won't get angry or embarrassed if it's you...

feeling5.line: Nowadays, when I think about you, I end up even deeper in thought than ever... Ah! I'm so sorry... Just now, I...

home.line: Hmm... What would be the optimal way to welcome back the Commander...

hp_warning.line: ...Eep! I've got to stay focused...

login.line: Commander, good day...... Oh, I was deep in thought about why you hadn't shown up yet...

lose.line: Hmm... I knew I should have aimed a bit more to the left on that last shot... Oh, I'm sorry... I should be retreating right now...!

mail.line: Ah, um... Right, Commander, I came to bring you the mail.

main1.line: Commander, do you think I can grow up to become a mature, caring woman like Dunkerque?

main2.line: Vauquelin, about the donuts last time... Oh, you already heard about that? ...Sorry, I must have gotten lost in my thoughts again...

main3.line: Vauquelin is really athletic. Getting tired from exercising, resting, and getting hungry... Oh, sorry, I started thinking about Dunkerque's sweets...

mission.line: How should we spend the rewards from last time... Oh, we have new missions?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Should I arrange the report based upon priority, completion time, payout, or... Mmm...

profile.line: I am Tartu of the Vichya Dominion. During the war, I was assigned to the Mediterranean and joined the fight against the Royal Navy. At Toulon, the others and I were... No, I can't get caught up about the past. The important thing is what's now in front of us! That's what Vauquelin would say, hehe.

propose.line: Commander, do you like me as I am now? I also... like you a lot, but it feels like you're always looking after me... I'll do my best to grow up into someone who can look after you, Commander...!

skill.line: The right thing to do in this situation is... this!

touch.line: Commander, regarding what you asked me earlier... Eh? You've already taken care of it? I, I see...

touch2.line: According to the book Vauquelin recommended me, what I should do in this situation is... gather the evidence, and... detain the offender?

unlock.line: Good day, Commander. I'm Tartu of the Vauquelin-class. ...Huh? Oh, I'm so sorry, I got caught up in thinking about how large the port is...

upgrade.line: I feel like... I've become stronger.

win_mvp.line: ......Oh, sorry, who got MVP again? Oh, it was me?

gift_prefer.line: How did you know... Did I end up talking out loud while thinking about this at some point?

feeling5_ex.line: It's fine to always be thinking about you? In that case....... Huh? Didn't you just say it was fine...? I sometimes feel like I could just daydream about you forever...

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Would you like me to give you a massage?

login_ex.line: Hello, Commander. Ah, um... I was just thinking about what to make for you to eat...

main1_ex.line: Commander, about that donut from earlier... Oh, I already asked you about it? ...Sorry, I was caught up thinking about other things and forgot...

main2_ex.line: Commander, would you like to read as well? I have lots of recommendations for you.

touch2_ex.line: ...Eek! Ah, I'm sorry, I got too absorbed into thinking about you...

win_mvp_ex.line: Who's the MVP? Um... Why's everyone looking at me...?

battle.line: I won't get washed away...!

detail.line: The book I last read took place on the beach, if I remember properly... It was a murder mystery on the beach, right?

login.line: Oh, Commander, good day. Would you like some ice cream?

mail.line: Oh, speaking of letters... I'm so sorry, Commander, I got engrossed in our conversation and totally forgot...

main1.line: McCall from the Eagle Union and Suffolk from the Royal Navy seem to get along really well. The two of them are pretty funny, hehe.

main2.line: Vauquelin, I'm not going into the water. I'll just spend a nice, peaceful day on the beach like this.

main3.line: Commander, aren't you going to change into a swimsuit? ...Um, I'm slightly curious, just a little...

touch2.line: Commander, what's wrong? The ice cream? ...Hyaa?!

unlock.line: Commander, you're not going to get into the water? ...Ah, I'm fine right here. To tell you the truth, I once got washed away by the waves, and then got laughed at by Vauquelin... so I'm perfectly fine right here.

win_mvp.line: I could really go for one of Dunkerque's donuts right about now...

battle.line: Witness the true might of a LARGE destroyer!

couple_encourage1.line: So Tartu, did you finish that book I lent you the other day?

detail.line: Oh gosh! D-don't just appear outta nowhere, Commander... You'll scare people.

expedition.line: A commission's complete! Just F-Y-I! So yeah, let's go receive the returning team.

feeling1.line: You know, I've learned something, Commander. People who can't introspect probably won't make many friends...

feeling2.line: I got one of Miss Dunkerque's cakes! Oh boy, which one is it today? Think you could guess, Commander?

feeling3.line: Something that's bothered me lately? Well, Tartu asked me for advice on becoming more ladylike, so I thoughtlessly recommended this detective novel I've been reading, and she apparently got hooked on reading it... It feels like that was a mistake, you know?

feeling4.line: Whether I'm actually dumb or not doesn't matter, but sometimes I like pretending to be stupid. Then when I do something smart, people are gonna be like, "Whoa, you're a genius, Vauquelin!" That's how it goes! I mean... it does, right?

feeling5.line: Plus, when you're playing dumb, you don't need to use your brain! It's refreshing to just not think about anything! Thus, when you enjoy yourself, others will, too! You should give it a try sometime, Commander!

headtouch.line: Ahehehehehehe~

home.line: For all your hard work, you deserve a headpat... Whuah! Spare me that expression of yours!

hp_warning.line: Stay calm and wait for the right time...!

login.line: So, Commander, didn't you promise you'd return with snacks for me? Uhh, what? We never made any promise like that?

lose.line: Huh? You're asking for my opinion on what went wrong? Dunno, that's your job to find out, Commander!

mail.line: Mail? Oh, I'll go get it then!

main1.line: You look bored and in need of some relief, Commander. Perchance you would fancy a showcase of my lancing skill– Oh gosh, careful! You'll get hurt!

main2.line: Can I ask you a favor, Commander? Well, I was hoping you could, uhh... leave out the bell peppers from my dinner tonight...

main3.line: Aah, so it's like that, huh. I understand everything now. Let me take it on... NOT!

mission.line: A mission, you say? Hehehe! Finally, it's my time to shine!

mission_complete.line: Holy cow! Look, Commander! We got a huge bounty for that mission! O-oh, it's nothing out of the ordinary?

profile.line: (I wanna give a cool self-introduction, but I don't have many exploits to my name... I did escort Dunkerque and Algérie, though that's not much...) Long story short: I'm Vauquelin from the Vichya Dominion! I've got more potential than you can imagine! C-cool, am I right?

propose.line: Holy smokes... You really meant that thing the other day about getting married?! Well, not to say I took it as a joke, or didn't believe you, or anything... Uhh, I mean... Y-you get what I'm trying to say, right...?

touch.line: What's up? Need me to do you a favor?

touch2.line: You're making me a bit uncomfortable, Commander...

unlock.line: Tadaah! Nameship of the Vauquelin-class large destroyers, Vauquelin, has arrived in style! Hey, what's so funny? I may not look strong, but I am! Um, probably!

upgrade.line: You're not gonna... dump additional work on me now, are you?

win_mvp.line: MVP! This calls for a celebratory cool pose... Uhh, why's everyone giving me funny looks?

gift_prefer.line: Ooh. Did you strike it rich, Commander?

expedition_ex.line: Commission... commmmplete! Yaayyy!! Commander, you don't have to follow along!

feeling5_ex.line: Allll righty, what carefree adventures are we going to have today? ...Woahh?! Commander, why are you hugging me so suddenly? I, I don't mind if you want to fool around, but what if someone sees us... Ahhn?!

home_ex.line: Commander, as a reward, I'll give you a headpat! ...Ahaha, you don't need to act all bashful!

login_ex.line: Hmm... So this is the commanderly feeling of sitting atop the commander's throne... Woahh?! When'd you get here?!

main1_ex.line: Let me show you the spear dance that puts even the knights to shame! ...Commander, do you really have to hide under the desk? I won't hurt you... Ah! Look out!

main2_ex.line: Let's throw out all those yucky vegetables! Yeah, all of them! Including yours too!

mission_complete_ex.line: Commander, we've got a boatload of rewards... No, an entire mountainload! Way more than usual!

touch2_ex.line: Th-this is a bit embarrassing...

win_mvp_ex.line: Number one! Clap, clap, everyone! Heheh, I'm super strong, after all!

detail.line: Tartu's not gonna get washed away by a stray wave, I hope... Yeah, figured as much...

main1.line: Everyone's looking so cute~! Woo~! Hm? I'M looking cute too...? W-woo~!

main2.line: Isn't it great to just forget about work and have a good time~? But, uh, what's up with that Royal Knight over there? She's casually playing around too, even though she's still on duty...

main3.line: Beach barbeque! Heck yeah! I'd love to grill some vegetables, but I'd rather someone else does the bell peppers!

touch.line: Teehee~ Well? How do you like my swimsuit~? Yeah, I know, I'm flat in a few places...

touch2.line: I know I don't hold a candle to Tartu, but... Wait, what do you think you're doing?!

unlock.line: Commandeeer! What are you doing? It's our day off! Turn the work part of your brain off and just have fun! C'mon, let's enjoy ourselves on the beach!

battle.line: Let us play a requiem! ...Hang on, that sounds familiar...

detail.line: Wow, rude much, Commander and Tartu? Way to fall asleep during my performance! ...I mean, technically I wasn't personally performing... But still!

login.line: Check it out! Your favorite Vauquelin, now in a fancy dress! Also, good luck at work, Commander!

lose.line: So yeah, I'm thinking it's time for me to scoot! Phew... Good thing I picked a non-cumbersome dress...

main1.line: Gotta swing in rhythm to the music, like... Oh, Commander! Guess what? I've been getting tons of compliments on my conducting skills! Hehehe~!

main2.line: Right-o! Now'd be a good time for a relaxing song! ...Wake up, Commander! You're sleeping on the job!

touch.line: Got any requests? Like a song, or food, or even a thrilling chat with yours truly? Hehehe~

touch2.line: Bet you were imagining these were Tartu's knockers. Hmph.

unlock.line: Yes, the strings... I can hear the celebratory melody... Now, follow my lead and we'll take this song to greater– Oh, Commander? What's all this, you ask? Uhh... You know... Ahahaha...

win_mvp.line: First place! Let's hear a victory song for me! Wait a sec... Where'd my orchestra go?

detail.line: As I've found out, everyone in this crazy world thinks it's okay to waltz into someone's home, go through their drawers, and break their pots. That's video game logic for you. Ahahah.

home.line: Welcome back! What drops did you get? Hero's gonna mock you if you didn't find anything.

login.line: Oh, you barged in, just like me? Sounds like you've learned the rules of this world!

lose.line: Crap! Time for the escape QTE!

main1.line: I've moved up the thief skill tree! Now I'll probably get more item drops! Heheh♪

main2.line: That enemy had a stealable item you can't get anywhere else?! You should've said so! There's no way to load saves here!

main3.line: My new Silent Steps skill makes me undetectable. I can steal anything if I want to now... Heheh.

touch.line: You're naive if you think you can grab me!

touch2.line: Whoa! That's not part of a thief's skillset!

unlock.line: *crash*! Found another coin! Check it out, Commander! I got all these from smashing pots! ...Breaking the law? Heheh! The one law among thieves is that there are no laws♪

win_mvp.line: Bet they dropped some loot! Better grab everything we can!

battle.line: May the Holy Iris guide us!

couple_encourage1.line: I didn't grow like this because I wanted to...

couple_encourage2.line: How to be more mature? I don't know why you're asking me...

couple_encourage3.line: I hate the limited mobility more than standing out...

couple_encourage4.line: Implacable, how can you be so confident...?

detail.line: How many times do I pray per day? Well, once at dawn, once at sunrise, every few hours, in the evening before I go to bed... Eight, maybe?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned to us.

feeling1.line: It's all my fault that you've become so unruly... Urk, all because my prayer wasn't enough...

feeling2.line: Compared to the others, I don't know if I have much help to offer you... If I could just pray enough to send you blessings, then maybe...

feeling3.line: Sometimes, Tartu asks me how she can be a more gentle, charming woman. Do you have any advice, Commander? It's honestly beyond me...

feeling4.line: You think I'm plenty charming already...? I appreciate that, but if that means distracting you from your work, I... Y-you say it's fine?

feeling5.line: There may be times when my charms can help you, right, Commander? Okay, th-then please feel free to call on me whenever you please. I'll do anything for you, be it prayers, help, or anything else!

home.line: Thanks and prayers to the Holy Iris for returning our Commander safely to port. Commander, would you like to... j-join me?

hp_warning.line: If I keep on praying...!

login.line: I devote this prayer to the pure, divine Iris. Please let this day be a peaceful one, and please give the Commander your sacred blessing...

lose.line: M-maybe my proportions aren't built for battle...

mail.line: You've received some letters. Commander, may I ask you to read them...?

main1.line: Hmm, can I put the documents... over here? Hup... I hope this makes your work easier, Commander.

main2.line: If I'm a distraction, um, don't hesitate to say so... With regards to, erm, certain parts of me...

main3.line: I get so antsy when you stare at me... Sorry, it's my fault for not being used to this.

mission.line: Your mission list is here—S-sorry. I didn't touch your hand on purpose, I promise...

mission_complete.line: Congratulations on your successful holy mission. What should I do with the rewards, Commander?

profile.line: I am Kersaint, Vauquelin-class large destroyer of the Vichya Dominion. In Toulon during the war, I was forced alongside Tartu and others to... Oh, maybe my prayers weren't fervent enough...

propose.line: I offer a prayer to the glorious Iris. Please, give me and my Commander eternal happiness... Beloved Commander, please continue to look after me forevermore.

skill.line: O holy light, come to me!

touch.line: I-if you'd have me, Commander, I'm happy to listen to your worries... While I can't guarantee that I'll solve anything, I can at least pray...

touch2.line: A-are my proportions distracting you, Commander...?

unlock.line: I'm Kersaint, a Vauquelin-class large destroyer. May the Iris bless you, Commander... And may you patiently lead me despite my shortcomings...

upgrade.line: My thanks to you, Commander. May the Holy Iris's blessing be upon you.

win_mvp.line: The Holy Iris has led us to victory. I'd like to express my sincere gratitude.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. If you wouldn't mind, an offering for the Iris would be...

detail_ex.line: I appreciate your praying with me, b-but don't feel too obligated, okay? It would defeat the point if it caused trouble for you, so... Umm, please forgive me...

home_ex.line: You'd like to pray with me? O-of course you may! Umm... Thank you for protecting us from storms during our voyages, for leading us safely home to port, and for granting my wish to give the Commander faith... U-umm... Forget you heard that last one...

login_ex.line: Let us pray to the shining Iris. Please give us another peaceful, blissful day, and give your sacred blessings to the Commander...

main4_ex.line: (Let this prayer imbue the Commander with focus and inspiration. Please...)

main5_ex.line: Commander, I noticed you stopped working... Are you distracted by my—Goodness, how can I say such impure things?!

main6_ex.line: Why do I feel so fidgety? I should be used to being a secretary ship by now...

touch_ex.line: Confession? Of course. Go ahead and tell me all of your sins, Commander.

touch2_ex.line: C-Commander, get a hold of yourself...

win_mvp_ex.line: The Commander also helped lead us to victory, so I should thank the Commander, too... Ah, um...

detail.line: After a run, my daily prayers... Commander—Oh, you're going back to your office? I-I see... Your mornings are busy, after all, so we can't... A-actually, may I come with you?

home.line: Commander, would you like... to keep going? Oh, I mean running, not praying! Sorry. I know you only just got back...

login.line: *gasp*... *gasp*... A prayer to the Holy Iris. Please... let this day be a peaceful one... and give the Commander... boundless energy...

main1.line: I'm running, um, for the sake of losing weight... Yes, I feel a little too heavy in some places... What about you, Commander?

main2.line: Does listening to music make running easier? Hmm... Marseillaise did recommend a hymn to me. Would you like to listen?

main3.line: Dunkerque's sweets... They do tempt me. As soon as I eat one, I'm hopeless to stop, and I end up falling into sugary hell... Eep...

touch.line: Is there anywhere you'd like to stop on the way...?

touch2.line: They feel even heavier from all this sweat... Urgh...

unlock.line: Phew... Commander? So the Iris brings us together once again... I-I'm sorry for being so sudden, but... Would you like to join me on my run?

detail.line: Commander, do you have any tips and tricks on how to tame animals? ...Loving them is important, but so is having the determination to master them? I-I see...

expedition.line: I'd better keep this creature in check until the commission team returns... Whoa whoa?!

feeling5.line: It may be hard work, but caring for animals is another holy duty. Besides, if it means helping you... I-I'm always happy to put my heart and soul into any task!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Th-things seem to be fine right now, but if it gets out of hand later... I hope you'll be willing to help again... Oh, me...

login.line: Commander, watch out – Hyah?! Why did it calm down as soon as it saw you...? Either way, thank you...

lose.line: *pant*... It finally calmed down... Ugh, I can't believe this happened...

main1.line: I hear this is an Eagle Union matador's costume... But it's so unlike Europa's. Have we verified that claim...?

main2.line: You seem even more worried about me since I changed into this outfit. What a sin I've committed...

main3.line: I should have discussed this with Lady Clemenceau first. If only I knew caring for animals was such a difficult task... No. This must be a trial given to me by the Iris... Right? Right?!

mission.line: Changing the hay, cleaning the stable, the daily milking... There! A complete list of today's holy duties!

mission_complete.line: Phew... That holy duty was a tough one. Thank you for your efforts, Commander.

touch.line: Do you have a confession? O-okay! If you don't mind that I'm dressed like this!

touch2.line: I-I can't move another inch...

unlock.line: C-Commander, p-please hurry and stop this creature! Otherwise! You might! Get hurt! ...WoooooOOOOAH! Phew... That was a close one... Haah... Praised be the Holy Iris... Urgh...

win_mvp.line: Oooh... We managed to win, but I'm so dizzy... I think I'm about to faint...

battle.line: Heheh, you small fries are in for a bad time!

couple_encourage1.line: Keep it together for at least a minute!

detail.line: I always look forward to doing magic with you. You have such funny reactions to every trick I show you! Ahahah!

expedition.line: A commission's been completed. Head out and talk to the girls!

feeling1.line: Hrmh. You're hopeless the way you are now. Then again, hopeless people still have their charm. Heehee.

feeling2.line: Loooser, loooser! You're a loser! ...There, happy now? You really make weird requests sometimes.

feeling3.line: I'm "surprisingly well-behaved"? What's that supposed to mean?! I've always been more principled than mischievous! I take my job as a Templar Knight seriously!

feeling4.line: I can do more than just write cards. Tadah! Have a rose! Heheh, surely you of all people know the meaning a single flower can hold.

feeling5.line: You've gotten to the point where you can't imagine life without me, haven't you? You've got to make a move on me already, or there will be consequences!

headtouch.line: Heehee, aren't I cute? Feel free to keep patting!

home.line: Welcome back! I took a leaf out of someone else's book and made you tea. Don't worry, I didn't add anything to it – enjoy your perfectly normal tea!

hp_warning.line: Oww... That really hurts!

login.line: Ah, here comes the Commander of our Dominion! Heehee, do you wanna play a game? How about... card guessing? You pick a card, and I'll sus out which one it is.

lose.line: Hrmh... Clearly, I wasn't fast enough.

mail.line: Commander, there's a letter for– What? You're worried it's boobytrapped? Come on, who do you take me for?!

main1.line: You've been giving me suspicious looks as of late, Commander. VERY suspicious looks by Orthodoxy morals. Heh, do you have a crush on me? Yeah, right... Huh? I was right? I think I've actually developed telepathy!

main2.line: Where'd I leave the documents that were on your desk? I disposed of 'em all. Hah, just kidding! I processed them and put them right here.

main3.line: How about instead of performing magic, we play "greater than less than" with cards next time? And whoever loses has to be the winner's mount!

mission.line: Still got holy tasks you need to do, huh? C'est la vie. Let me help you out!

mission_complete.line: Heheh! Mission complete! See? I knew you needed my help!

profile.line: I'm Fleuret, Le Hardi-class destroyer and the Vichya Dominion's flower. Don't dismiss me just 'cause I've got a cute name, 'kay? I can handle anything you throw at me, from being a Templar Knight to serving as your bodyguard!

propose.line: Ahahaha... I-I didn't think you'd actually do it. Come on, don't stare daggers through me as a way to get an answer... That's playing dirty! L-look, my answer is: yes, happily!

touch.line: Heh! You wanna see a new kind of magic, do you?

touch2.line: Eeek! Stooop! Touching a lady like this is criminal! ...Ahahaha! You should've seen the look on your face!

unlock.line: I'm Fleuret, Le Hardi-class destroyer and Templar Knight of the Vichya Dominion. And you must be the Commander, heehee. We're gonna get along juuust fine, you and I!

upgrade.line: This'll let me pull great tricks!

win_mvp.line: Nice and simple! This is easier than practicing my telepathy trick!

gift_prefer.line: Wow. I've never told you what I like. This is really impressive, Commander!

feeling5_ex.line: You think I've gotten more mischievous? Heheh, is that a problem? You know, we swore an oath together, which means I should be annoying you more, if anything... Yeah, right. Fine, I'm sorry! I apologize!

home_ex.line: Welcome back. I made you tea! Whoa! You drank it all in one go. Heehee, not very scared that I spiked it with something, are you?

login_ex.line: Commander! I'm feeling reeeally needy today. Heehee... Does hearing that excite you? You really are a simple person.

main4_ex.line: When you'll get to see a new trick? Soon, I can tell you that much! I've been researching ways to make a part of your body "disappear" into something else. Look forward to it!

main5_ex.line: I've heard that resting your head on your partner's chest helps you relax! I wanna see if it's true or not! Oh, you could do it to me, too, if you want.

touch_ex.line: Hm? You saying you wanna chat with me?

touch2_ex.line: You've really figured out how to use those hands!

detail.line: Really, Commander? I explained all the rules of the game and you're still spacing out. Is it my outfit? Is it distracting you? Heh, just kidding. You're a sweet little bean, Commander.

expedition.line: Whoa, the commission team is back. There's no rule saying you can leave in the middle of our game, but I'll allow it this time!

feeling5.line: Ahaha! This is great! I thought about using card magic, but I didn't need even it to easily beat you! Heehee, now, as the winner, what should I ask from you?

headtouch.line: Heheh, you trying to butter me up to make this easier for you?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Once you're ready, take a card! Relax, we're not playing a game – this is magic!

login.line: You took an awfully long time shuffling the deck, Commander. Huh? You suspect my cards are marked? Why, I'd never do anything like that!

mail.line: You got a message? Fine, you can check your phone. Normally, that would be cheating, but I'll tolerate it in this case.

main1.line: Commandeeer, you ready yet? Staring at the cards won't transform them into new ones. Well, probably not. Maybe they will!

main2.line: Look at you, eyes darting around! I don't blame you, though. You did lose your every last chip to me. How will you pull yourself outta this one?

main3.line: If you're feeling tired, come here and lie down. You won't get my cushions, but you're free to rest your head on my thighs.

touch.line: Commander, you're only meant to touch the cards in my hand.
