touch2.line: Eeek! I'll have you know there are hidden cameras in here! Not really, but I bet you bought it!

unlock.line: Welcome, welcome! I'm Fleuret, your game master. Are you ready to make a wager? Heehee!

battle.line: I-I'll try not to make it hurt!

couple_encourage1.line: Fleur, b-be careful...

detail.line: I have a holy duty to protect you and make you happy... Right! I might cause a little bit of trouble for you now, but I'll do my very, VEEERY best...!

expedition.line: *staaare*... C-Commander, may I come with you to greet the commission team...?

feeling1.line: C-Commander... It's totally my fault you turned out this way, huh? Ugh...

lose.line: There's no time for regrets...!

mail.line: It's work-related. Look it over please.

main1.line: An "idol" is something that people worship and exalt. As the word suggests, we mustn't do anything that would shorten that distance.

main2.line: Jean Bart told me to just enjoy myself, but... the expectant gazes of Le Triomphant and Richelieu... it burns!

main3.line: That little girl from the Royal Navy.. . Not only does she act all innocent, she also sings about "prayer." Hehe, as if I'd let her steal my thunder~

mission.line: We got a job offer... Hopefully we can take care of it quickly and efficiently...

mission_complete.line: F-finally, that's taken care of... Now all that remains is the collect the reward, elegantly...

profile.line: I am the Le Fantasque-class destroyer, Le Malin, reporting for duty. Heheh... Just watch, I'll do an amazing job on this idol mission. J-just to be clear, it's not like I was looking forward to this!

propose.line: The fact that I'm standing upon this shining stage right now is due to all the support from you and my friends. Now, place that ring upon my finger, and may our vow preserve this radiance forevermore!

touch.line: Thanks for always cheering me on~

touch2.line: Hwuh?! Wh-what are you doing?!

unlock.line: I am the Iris's shining sword, Le Malin. As the shimmering idol who chases the waves, may your souls be healed by my songs of prayer.

upgrade.line: The Iris's miracle manifests here!

win_mvp.line: Long live the glory of the Iris! Rejoice! Weep!

gift_prefer.line: I-is that...

detail_ex.line: At times like these, you gotta throw your hands in the air like you don't care, and turn around... Zzzzzz... Wh-wh-wh-what is it?! Eh? I fell asleep?

expedition_ex.line: The commission fleet has returned. Uh, yeah, that's what Béarn told me.

home_ex.line: Tired... Why are performances so draining... I just wanna go to sleep today...

login_ex.line: Good morning. Um, today... there are no lessons planned, right...?

main1_ex.line: Idols shouldn't get too close to their fans, right? So that means I don't have to do these autograph events either. Sweet~♪

main2_ex.line: If I just stay awake through this lesson, I'll get to enjoy Dunkerque's sweets afterwards... Focus, focus!

main3_ex.line: Graf Spee wants to rehearse with me? Uh... O-of course I have no issues with that?

mail_ex.line: ... (Am I imagining things, or is the work piling up the more I do it...?)

mission_ex.line: Uh, so today's offers are... Ah, wait, nobody said you had to go and accept ALL of them!

mission_complete_ex.line: Too tired... can't do this anymore... Lemme go to sleep after you look over the rewards!

touch_ex.line: Ahh~ Yeah, yeah, that's the spot. Keep massaging right there~

touch2_ex.line: Too tired... I'm gonna die... Ahhh... Waaah...

win_mvp_ex.line: Long live the glory of the Iris! Rejoice! Weep! ...Wait, I don't need an encore!

battle.line: I'll teach you what painful things happen to those who cross the line!

couple_encourage1.line: Le Malin, join me in battle!

couple_encourage2.line: Noblesse oblige indeed!

couple_encourage3.line: I'm not keen to have you along...

couple_encourage4.line: Heheh! I am the chivalrous one between us!

detail.line: My black lance? Hmph! As if a pleb like you would understand the majesty and power of this rigging that befits me!

expedition.line: I've finished inspecting the commission goods. Grateful for my help, hmm? Hah! It's par for the course!

feeling1.line: Hmph. A donkey like you would flee like a coward once we encounter real danger anyway.

feeling2.line: Prove your honor and sense of duty to me, then I will treat you fairly! A proud Templar Knight is true to her word!

feeling3.line: You follow the example set by my sisters Le Triomphant and Le Malin... What of Le Terrible? She is wise, yes! But do not be like her and go around asking people impossible questions!

feeling4.line: I, I must admit, you have quite some elegance for a pleb... Hm? You appreciate my efforts in observing you? It's hardly worthy of praise. In fact, I'm enjoying mys– No, I mean...! Flattery won't get you anywhere with me!

feeling5.line: Hmph. You've earned my recognition, pleb! I will be your knight. You have my loyalty, and my heart! ...What about it? What I just said is completely ordinary coming from a Templar Knight!

headtouch.line: Hmph! You think your pleb tricks will work on– Hehehehe... Oohh...

home.line: Magnificent commanding, pleb! Keep it up if you hope to earn my recognition!

hp_warning.line: You underestimate this proud Templar Knight!

login.line: You're late! One in command of the whole fleet must always be first to arrive at the office!

lose.line: Grrr... My knightly pride has been tarnished...

mail.line: A letter for you. Well, well, this is an exquisite wax seal.

main1.line: I strive to always conduct myself with confidence and elegance, like my role model, Le Malin! ...What are you grinning for, pleb?

main2.line: A reward for a job well done, you say? I'll have some macaro– Ahem! No, a proud Templar Knight needs no rewards!

main3.line: The Le Fantasque class is renowned for its speed. And any who think it comes at the cost of firepower is in for a world of pain!

mission.line: I am a Templar Knight with honor! I do not let missions gather dust unlike you, pleb!

mission_complete.line: Mission completed. Let's see the rewards... This is all...? N-no, I said nothing!

profile.line: I am Templar Knight L'Indomptable, Le Fantasque-class large destroyer. As my name states, this proud knight shall neither cede a single step, nor back down before any foe!

propose.line: Is a ritual like this required for me to become yours? And I even have to wear this ring too? ...Very well. Then let us move on to exchanging vows! ...Hold hands? Then go on a date? Wh-wh-what are you talking about? Y-y-you've tricked me, haven't you?!

skill.line: You will be judged in the Vichya's name!

touch.line: Hahah! Revere my lance 'til you've had your fill! It is my weapon and my badge of honor!

touch2.line: Y-y-you vile barbarian!

unlock.line: L'Indomptable – Le Fantasque-class large destroyer and Templar Knight of the Vichya Dominion – has arrived! Have you the honor befitting someone of your status? ...Hmph, save your breath! I shall judge you through your conduct, not your words.

upgrade.line: The greatest equipment belongs only in the hands of the greatest wielder!

win_mvp.line: MVP? Woohoo! ...Ahem! My wish is to see hard work be duly rewarded.

gift_prefer.line: I-I guess I could accept a gift from you... once in a while.

battle_ex.line: We shall efface all that stands in the Commander's path!

detail_ex.line: Rest assured! If you're approached by any miscreants intent on disrespect, I will scare them off with my lance! Hahaha!

feeling5_ex.line: My creed says I "must be ready to sacrifice everything for love, even my life." I would never betray you, but I don't know how to martyr myself for love... I needn't do anything so extreme, you say? Hmph, then I implore you to tell me what I SHOULD do! ...A-a date, for starters?!

headtouch_ex.line: Well, um... Do as you please. Ooohhh... H-h-hey! I didn't tell you to stop!

home_ex.line: With one as elegant and excellent as you at the helm, I assume your battle went well! I expect no less from the one who guides my sword!

login_ex.line: Get your act together and learn to clock in early like me! I w-worry about you when you're not around, you know!

main4_ex.line: Resting to regain one's strength is crucial, you say... Ah! Now I see the profound reason for why Le Malin is always doing that!

main5_ex.line: Whew... Huff... Puff... Your proud Templar Knight has put in a lot of work today! T-tell me you appreciate me already!

main6_ex.line: Your sword is always at your side! Give me your orders, and I shall carry them out!

mission_ex.line: Hahah! In times when missions have you overwhelmed, what you should do is call upon your sword – that is to say, me!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete! Don't forget to hand down a few rewards in accordance with who worked hardest!

touch2_ex.line: St-st-stop it with this caprice!

win_mvp_ex.line: Hmph! See? I am your most commendable champion!

battle.line: It's your funeral if you think my helplessness is any more than an act!

detail.line: Am I really meant to lie here and do nothing, Le Malin? ...It's part of getting into the role? I see. Then lie I will!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Don't keep them waiting over at the pier.

feeling5.line: If I were to ever lose my strength and become a helpless little girl... would you stay with me, even if I'd be a hindrance to you? ...If it comes to that, you'll become MY sword?! Th-th-th-that doesn't exactly delight me, not at all...!

headtouch.line: C-careful with my hair!

home.line: "Are you my Grandmamma?" – Hah, Little Red Riding Hood is a fool! If I were her, I'd say "I saw through your disguise with one glance, Big Bad Wolf! Prepare to meet your maker!"

login.line: So soft and cushy... Mmh, this is the dream... *yawn*... *gasp*! Rats! I got dangerously close to dozing off...!

lose.line: Urgh. Playing a feeble character must've turned me genuinely feeble...

main1.line: I'm infinitely more suited to play a gallant knight than a defenseless little girl... But, I'm sure Le Malin has her reasons for promoting this role to me.

main2.line: How should I act to appear helpless? ...Hm? When I encounter evildoers, my first instinct is always to send them packing with my lance.

main3.line: Sleeping Beauty is apparently the role Le Malin most wants to play. Fitting, seeing as she's skilled at feigning sleep!

mission.line: New missions have come in. I'd rather be doing those than playing this role that ill suits me.

mission_complete.line: You finished the mission? H-here I thought I could assist you after my rehearsal...

touch.line: Do you want this sweet, juicy apple? ...No, it's not poisoned, it's merely a tasty apple!

touch2.line: Y-y-you're making me mad!

unlock.line: What a farce, making a proud Templar Knight portray a helpless little girl... Why am I lying here, you ask? Hmph. Because Le Malin asserted this is the best way to get in touch with my "vulnerable side"...

upgrade.line: I feel ever so slightly stronger...

win_mvp.line: You reaped what you sowed by scoffing at a Templar Knight!

detail.line: Ah... Achoo! ...Why do I wear such light clothing when it's snowing? Le Terrible recommended it, and, well... I-I have no reason whatsoever to doubt her wisdom!

home.line: It's faster to take that route? Thank you! Your guidance serves me well both in the port and on the battlefield!

login.line: Haa... Haa... Ahem! You made it to the office ahead of schedule! Eat up while it's still warm!

mail.line: A note of correspondence... Oh. It's addressed to you.

main1.line: The elegant Le Fantasque class performs stunningly in all manners of missions! Yes, even including food delivery!

main2.line: You're willing to assist? I-I'll be fine! I'm still perfectly capable of handling a delivery! ...I will call for your help when I truly need it!

main3.line: This is the third time Le Malin has ordered food just today... Granted, it is an Empery holiday. Elegance is a luxury ill-afforded in hectic times...

mission.line: A mission, much like Dragon Empery cuisine, is best to take in hand posthaste.

mission_complete.line: I have brought your mission rewards. Inspect them before they turn cold.

touch.line: A positive review, you say? I gladly accept a commendation that speaks to my honor as a Templar Knight, if... You're simply referring to your delivery experience?!

touch2.line: Stop that lest you make me drop the food, pleb!

unlock.line: Hmm... Traveling by foot from here would be quickest. Ah... It's snowing. Hmph! A little snow and wind can scarcely faze a noble Templar Knight! I'll be back shortly!

win_mvp.line: Behold! L'Indomptable, the black lancer of Vichya, shall cater the victory banquet!

detail.line: There is cream stuck to my lips? Hmph – I was told by Le Malin that this would greatly better my disguise. Although it may itch a tad, she is a professional, and her advice cannot be wrong!

headtouch.line: Whuah?! You're undoing my disguise!

login.line: Oh, Commander. Have you also come to enjoy a sip of– No, wait! I am not L'Indomptable! I have no recollection of your identity!

lose.line: Curses! The target is getting away!

main1.line: How delectable and sweet it smells... *gasp*! Curses! I licked up the cream! Damn it... My disguise will surely fail now!

main2.line: Comma– Ahem! Youthful stranger, how are you today? ...That greeting gives nothing away, does it?

main3.line: Seeing as you've seen through me, we'll just need to keep going like this! We are but an ordinary couple on a date at this café – understood? Good! Nothing can go wrong now!

mission.line: Attention! Your missions remain undone!

touch.line: H-how did you see through my disguise, Commander?! I could swear that it was flawless...

touch2.line: W-wait! What you're doing now... ruins my ability to complete my mission!

unlock.line: A masquerading-and-eavesdropping mission is a walk in the park for a Knight of the Dominion! Finding evidence of my target's crimes will take no time at all!

win_mvp.line: Heheh! My mission has been completed flawlessly! This is nothing for an exemplary Templar Knight!

battle.line: Tremble before the might of the Holy Iris!

detail.line: Humility, honesty, mercy, courage, justice, self-sacrifice, spirituality, and honor – these are the eight virtues of the Chevaliers that I uphold. Upon my name as a mighty Templar Knight, I shall protect all our comrades!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned, Commander. They returned with these rewards. A flawless victory, I'd say.

feeling1.line: You've turned your back on the Holy Iris and fallen far, but I will never give up on you!

feeling2.line: Nearly everyone at the port has nothing but glowing things to say about you. This could only mean you're an exceptional and strong individual! Perhaps you're even suited to be a Chevalier!

feeling3.line: The closer I get to you, the more I realize my own shortcomings. However, the more I find, the more I feel like I'm growing! For you, Commander, are my idol, and so every step closer I get to you is proof of my own growth!

feeling4.line: To be worthy of a place by your side, I must become stronger and better! Or else I will end up a Chevalier abandoned by the master she pledged herself to... I will not let that happen!

feeling5.line: If I may be abrupt, I've been having these feelings lately... I don't merely want to pledge myself entirely to you, I also want to be with you forever... Huh? Th-this is what they call "love"?

headtouch.line: I will say... this does feel pleasant...

home.line: Excellent work, Commander. Your commanding was truly a sight to behold! You never cease to amaze!

hp_warning.line: I can take it!

login.line: You've arrived, Commander. Now, what is our schedule for today, pray tell? Rest assured, your loyal Templar Knight shall be with you throughout any and all matters!

lose.line: I will hold off the enemy's pursuit. Everyone else, fall back!

mail.line: You've received a new letter! Here – I fetched a letter opener for you!

main1.line: I seem to have my act together, you say? Why, yes! Ahem... A level head and a sound heart are foundational for a Chevalier.

main2.line: It feels as though I've been treated like a child again today... A Chevalier won't be so easily fooled.

main3.line: One with strength but no wits is no more than a hothead. With wisdom comes true courage. Through deliberate thinking do you seize true victory. These, Commander, are the learnings of the Chevaliers!

mission.line: You have new missions, Commander. Shall I prepare anything in advance for you?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... and I was on guard duty yet again... It's okay! Endurance is one of the Chevaliers' virtues... I think!

profile.line: I am L'Audacieux. I strive to be a bold and courageous Chevalier worthy of this name. Will you bear witness to my growth?

propose.line: Does this signify that... we've made vows to one another? I would still protect you, with or without having received this ring... What? This ring means that we've officially become wife and... Wait, whaaat?! That's what it signifies?!

touch.line: Commander, do you need any help?

touch2.line: C-Commander? Is this a part of a Chevalier's duties?

unlock.line: I am L'Audacieux, Chevalier of the Holy Iris. Commander, are you this blade's new master?

upgrade.line: Yes, I feel a surge of new strength. It is for you, Commander, that I continue to swing this blade!

win_mvp.line: You fought risking life and limb to the very end... This, I respect!

gift_prefer.line: A-a gift? For me? W-wow!

feeling5_ex.line: When I think about the time I confessed to you without even knowing it, my face gets all hot... but as long as I can convey this feeling of love, it doesn't matter how hot it gets...

home_ex.line: Whoa... Simply incredible, Commander! I must follow your example and become a sharper blade!

login_ex.line: Commander, y-you've come! Is there anything I can d-do for you? A massage, for instance... I'll give it my all!

main4_ex.line: You may say I can loosen up around you, but I fear then I'd turn into a lazy blob... Maybe not being a Chevalier for just a moment is fine. Yeah!

main5_ex.line: B-being short or tall neither has any bearing on your strength, nor does it determine if you can become a Chevalier! ...Am I really that short?

main6_ex.line: You'd like to swing my sword? Certainly. You hold it like this... then do this... Whoa! Be careful!

touch_ex.line: Are you feeling lonesome?

touch2_ex.line: S-so I hold you tight just like this? ...Am I doing it right?

detail.line: Speeding cars, rising smoke, fiery hot enthusiasm in the air... I never knew races were such adrenaline-charged things, in every right rivaling jousting matches.

feeling5.line: Whenever I see your satisfied smile, I feel warm inside and get butterflies in my stomach... I'd like to, um, revere your smile some more! Perhaps I could do something to... I know! How about I shade you with my parasol?

headtouch.line: I look sweet in this sun visor? Y-you really think so?

home.line: Victory is a foregone conclusion with you on our side. That was incredible, Commander!

login.line: Whew... There you are, Commander. You're welcome to stand beneath my parasol and cool off before the race starts!

main1.line: Strasbourg and the girls are much more natural at this than I am, plus they have those proportions... No, what am I saying? I can't lose heart now! Get it together, me!

main2.line: Is this how one should pose with a car? What about my... Move my parasol a bit further back? Okay, this should do it. Please start snapping pictures, Commander.

main3.line: I'm actually quite interested in motorsports. It's just that I'm more preoccupied with my holy tasks. Say, once this race is over, do you think you could teach me the fundamentals of driving?

mission.line: There next race is starting soon. Are you going to be spectating, Commander?

mission_complete.line: You completed the race! Um, you could use something to wipe your sweat... Where did I leave those wet tissues?

touch.line: Would you like me to strike my coolest pose for you?

touch2.line: C-Commander?! What's gotten into you?!

unlock.line: Urgh... As a Chevalier, I simply cannot get used to wearing an outfit like this. But, if I tell myself it's for the Commander's sake... Alright! I shall complete today's sacred duties to the utmost of my abilities!

battle.line: I'm lookin' for a fun time... Gimme one!

couple_encourage1.line: Could you make me another mousse cake when we get back?

couple_encourage2.line: Cardinal, I march into battle beneath your banner.

detail.line: You lookin' to have some fun? You mean with me, or my weapon?

expedition.line: Commission team's back, eh? Cool, then I'll go say hi since I've got nothing better to do.

feeling1.line: If you wanna quit being a commander, I could refer you to a decent new job.

feeling2.line: Lookin' to be a boring day like any other...

feeling3.line: I've got some of Dunkerque's handmade mousse cake! Here, have a slice. Nah, nah, don't thank me, thank the girl who made it!

feeling4.line: Sure, we ships fire our guns and torpedoes all day, but it's fun to just have a chat about weapons now and then. Hit me up for that sometime, Commander! You seem like a cool person!

feeling5.line: My opinion on you? Hmm, to tell you the truth, I kinda like you. You wanna hang out and do something fun sometime? I mean, we already have fun every day, but still!

home.line: Sorry, nobody's permitted to enter the office while the Commander is out... Oh, hey, Commander! Obviously you can come on in!

hp_warning.line: Hell yeah! More of that! This is getting fun!

login.line: Finally! You're back! I thought I was gonna rust up from boredom while you were gone. Gimme a task, any task, and I'll do it.

lose.line: Oops, I've been beaten... Just let me fight another time!

mail.line: Here, letter for you. Better read it now, 'cause it's not my problem if you lose it.

main1.line: Just sitting in the office, boooored out of my mind while the Commander goes ham on a ton of paperwork. *siiigh*...

main2.line: If the goal's to beat the enemy, then what's wrong with me bashing them with my rigging? I swear, you fuss over the strangest stuff, Commander.

main3.line: Can't say I'm keen on planning stuff... It's like, you make a plan, but it always changes, y'know?

mission.line: These missions are a pain? Well, sorry to hear that? I can't exactly do 'em for you, y'know.

mission_complete.line: You finished a mission? Cool, that's quicker than I expected. Maybe I underestimated you, Commander.

profile.line: I was assigned to Vichya's "High Seas Force" back during the war, I think? Don't think I ever set sail though, due to fuel shortages... Y'know what? You're probably gonna get a quicker rundown if you just ask Dunkerque.

propose.line: You're just the kind of person I love, Commander! Hahahah! From now on, if anyone tries to mess with you, I'm gonna deal with 'em!

touch.line: Touch me all you want! As long as you don't mind getting hurt.

touch2.line: Listen, unlike a certain someone from the Templar Knights, "dirty work" is my specialty... Wanna know more?

unlock.line: Vichya, Sardegna, Iron Blood... and now this place? Ah well, doesn't matter to me 'long as I get to have a good time. Anyway, I'm La Galissonnière from the Vichya Dominion. Nice meetin' you!

upgrade.line: Makes me look back on my days in Brest...

win_mvp.line: Ahaha! Now that was a lot of fun!

gift_prefer.line: Oh, wow! How did you know I loved this?

detail_ex.line: You wanna know about "that" work? How do I say this... Let's just call it the "Inquisition?" What it means is... Hmm, I really can't tell you after all~♪

home_ex.line: There's not too much of "that" kind of work to do at this port, huh... Well, as long as the Iris girls are safe and sound here, then I can have fun without worrying about anything! Hehehe!

login_ex.line: What are we doing today? Why don't you gimme something to do before I turn to rust?

main2_ex.line: ♪～Hey Commander, can you help me check if I sharpened this enough? I'm always afraid that I missed a spot or something...

main3_ex.line: Gotta say, I still prefer working under Jean Bart rather than Algérie. Y'know, it's that whole "don't worry about anything other than slaughtering your enemies" kind of feeling...

touch2_ex.line: Hm? Hmmmmm? ...Mmm... Well, whatever~♪

detail.line: I'll throw the swim ring at you if you get close to drowning. Relax, knowin' you, I'm sure you'll catch it!

home.line: Could you throw me that ball, Commander? Merci~

login.line: I'm not gonna swim all day, so I'll just skip the warm-ups. Should be no biggie!

main1.line: We don't really NEED to swim just 'cause we've got a pool, do we? Nothing wrong with just dipping our toes, you know.

main2.line: Over here, Commander! Ka-splash! Ahahahah! Feelin' refreshed now?

main3.line: Hmm... Feels a little weird, not having my hands full with something...

touch.line: Whoa there, trying to startle me? Sadly for you, I saw that coming from miles away~

touch2.line: Ahahah. So you wanna practice holding your breath, is that it, Commander?

unlock.line: Summertime means pool time! Oh, hey, Commander. What are you waiting for? Come over and let's have fun!

detail.line: I dig the design of this Dragon Empery outfit. Uh, that's NOT an invitation for you to ogle me all you want, okay?

home.line: You can feel the festival spirit everywhere you look! Isn't that nice?

login.line: You're leaving me out in the dust here, Commander! I'll die from sheer boredom if you won't hang out with me!

main1.line: Got any red envelopes for me, Commander? Talk about lame, there's just money inside... I expected something that's like, more novel, and now I'm disappointed!

main2.line: Get together with the extended family over New Year's, hang up fai chun decorations, aaand... what's left? Courtesy calls? Take me along, Commander! I won't embarrass you, pinky promise!

main3.line: I know! Let's meet up and do festive stuff with Dunkerque!

touch.line: What's up? You thinkin' about finally introducing me to your family?

touch2.line: Watch it, or you'll make it come off!

unlock.line: Happy New Year, again! So, you wanna try sharing this "cross-cupped wine?" What, it's not a drinking game? Welp, I guess I've still got a whole ton to learn about the Dragon Empery's customs~

detail.line: Sure are a lot of cat lovers around here. Algérie, Richelieu... Are you one too, Commander?

home.line: Trick or treat! ...Only kids go trick-or-treating? Who cares! Shut up and gimme candy!

login.line: You're back? Thought up a good spooky trick yet?

main1.line: Uhh, Commander? If you're just gonna sit around, then I'll find someone else to hang out with.

main2.line: Let's see what candy we're giving out! Hmm... You mind settin' this, this, and some of this aside just for me?

main3.line: Putting on a costume and scaring people sounds pretty fun... So that's what Halloween's all about, huh? Makes my costume choice seem kinda out-of-place though...

touch.line: Am I supposed to go "meeoow?"

touch2.line: This lingerie won't stop me from gettin' my hands dirty if I need to, y'know.

unlock.line: If you ignore me, I'll use my black cat magic to turn you into a pumpkin! Is that Halloweeny enough? Ahahaha! I'm just messing! C'mon, let's go do somethin' fun tonight, Commander!

battle.line: All those who would oppose the Orthodoxy... must be eradicated.

couple_encourage1.line: Please, La Galissonnière, show some more dignity!

couple_encourage2.line: It is an honor to stand alongside the Cardinal.

couple_encourage3.line: I'll leave the other half of enemies to you, let's wrap up this battle swiftly!

couple_encourage4.line: La Pucelle, let us both fight for the Iris Orthodoxy!

couple_encourage5.line: So, you stand with the Iris Orthodoxy this time...

couple_encourage6.line: Just as you believed, hope has arrived!

detail.line: An awe-inspiring melody can inspire soldiers to carry out their sacred duties. Commander, I would like to bring this song to the battlefield– Oh, um... Actually, do you find the fact that my rigging can play music strange, by any chance?

expedition.line: Commission complete. A hard-fought victory... Hmm? Did you not risk life and limb to seize these from the enemy?

feeling1.line: Commander, you are the last person I wish to consider an enemy... Please repent, and be born anew.

feeling2.line: I hope that I may become a source of inspiration for my compatriots, just as the name bestowed upon me implies. Raising the banner, standing on the front lines, cleaving a path forward– Heeding the will of the divine, I shall lead us to victory.

feeling3.line: Both Iris Libre and the Vichya Dominion were once parts of the same Iris Orthodoxy... Here, at this port, my friends are able to come together once more. Thank you so much, Commander.

feeling4.line: I hardly know anything that does not pertain to fighting... I'd appreciate it if you could instruct me, but... where would I even start? Umm, I don't even have much experience in being taught...

feeling5.line: S-sincerest apologies. I've caused you nothing but trouble since my arrival... But despite that, I've never had so much fun before. If at all possible... I'd like these times to continue forever.

home.line: So this is how you raise the morale of your troops... I would expect nothing less of my Commander.

hp_warning.line: I shall uphold my sacred duties, until the very end!

login.line: I, the fighting angel Marseillaise, await my Commander's arrival.

lose.line: Bitter... defeat... I am sorry to have let you down.

mail.line: You have mail, Commander. Shall I open it up using my blade?

main1.line: Sincerest apologies. Though I may be your secretary ship, I am unable to assist in your sacred charge... If only I possessed skills outside of combat...

main2.line: La Galissonnière? Sure, she can be a bit of a pain at times... but it doesn't matter. That Tribunal girl is no match for the fighting angel.

main3.line: Is the R&D department busy right now? I suppose it'll have to wait until next time then... Oh, it's nothing. I simply wanted to ask for some advice.

mission.line: A new mission? There has to be something I can do to help, right...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. I shall escort you as you go to retrieve the rewards.

profile.line: I am La Galissonnière-class light cruiser Marseillaise, the Iris's fighting angel. I feel no fatigue, fear no pain, and swing my blade only to uphold peace and justice. I am resolute in my belief that one day, all unrighteousness in the world shall be vanquished.

propose.line: I, the fighting angel Marseillaise, swear upon this blade: as long as I still draw breath, I will protect my beloved Commander from all enemies, and punish all those who seek to harm us in the name of the Holy Iris.

touch.line: For justice, peace, and the Holy Iris, I shall carry out your will.

touch2.line: Hmm? Commander? I'm not sure I understand the meaning of this...

unlock.line: I am Marseillaise, fighting angel of Iris Orthodoxy. Speak to me your orders, Commander.

upgrade.line: Peace and justice are sacred duties that cannot be accomplished through ideals alone.

win_mvp.line: The Iris's sacred blade annihilates all who would oppose the Orthodoxy.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you. I'll keep it safe.

feeling5_ex.line: For someone like me who knows nothing outside of battle, being able to experience so many different things... makes me truly happy whenever we do things together, Commander. Might this be... true love?

home_ex.line: Commander, how are you able to inspire our friends to such an extent? Every time we go on a sortie, I find myself thinking about it.

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've already prepared the tea... Huh? Wasn't I supposed to pour the leaves into the cup? I thought it would be best to fill it up as much as possible...

main4_ex.line: Affixing your stamp here signifies your approval, right? In that case... Umm, does multiple stamps signify strong approval?

main5_ex.line: If we were to further retrofit this rigging and amplify the volume... Alright, let's give it a try right now!

mail_ex.line: So, it's possible to open the letter without using my blade after all... I understand now.

touch_ex.line: You want me to fold you within my wings...?

touch2_ex.line: I don't quite understand, but... if it pleases you, that makes me glad...

detail.line: I cannot strictly rely on my rigging to fight; I must also train my body to respond to various situations, just as you said.

home.line: Umm, maybe like this... Eek?! ...Oh, Commander, thank you very much. You've completed another one of your sacred trials of combat, yes?

login.line: Are we going to train together again today? I do hope I'm not inconveniencing you, Commander...

main1.line: If only I could spread these wings, those mistakes could've been avoidable– Hmm? That doesn't count as training? I understand...

main2.line: Hmm... Commander, how does this look? Umm, if you could give me some tips on how to improve my posture...

main3.line: Many of my friends listen to music while working out. Haha, I really want to ask around and see what they're listening to.

touch.line: Phew... Sorry, I'll go wipe off my sweat now...

touch2.line: Even though you're helping me... Nngh... This is still difficult...

unlock.line: Alright, aim at this part of the ball, and drop my hips... Nngh?! I, I'm alright! The fighting angel, Marseillaise, will not be defeated by this... Hyeep?!

win_mvp.line: Phew. May the Holy Iris bless you–

battle.line: Victory can only be attained with the will to conquer! Foch, heading out!

couple_encourage1.line: We'll be fine, just follow the plan.

couple_encourage2.line: Ease up, we're on the same side now.

couple_encourage3.line: You look a bit like me... but not quite?

detail.line: Commander, mind playing along with one of my whims? Stay still while I put this apple on top of your head... Wait, I'm just messing with you~ You don't have to run away♪

expedition.line: We've gotten a new shipment of supplies. Are you going to check on them yourself?

feeling1.line: If you're truly planning on leading everyone to victory, you'll need to put more heart into it, instead of being this tepid.

feeling2.line: The knife-thrower who never misses, Foch! ...at least, I wish I were that skilled.

feeling3.line: Don't tense up like that, Commander, relax! ...And quietly accept your fate... Letting yourself be taken care of is for your own benefit, you know~♪

feeling4.line: Commander... did you stay up all night again? It doesn't look like you've been eating properly, either... This is unacceptable... I guess it's time for me to look after you!

feeling5.line: Commander, you did remember our dinner date tonight, right? You know, back when I told you I would look after you? I mean, I won't force you, but... you're not cruel enough to refuse me, right? Ahaha...

headtouch.line: My hair's ruined now! ...Just kidding, I'm not angry at all~♪

home.line: Oh Commander, welcome back! Now now, don't focus so hard on your work that you forget to eat! I can even whip something up for you if you'd like!

hp_warning.line: There's nothing to fear! I'm still here!

login.line: Commander, I've placed your work for the day on your desk. ...Don't look at me like that, I'm here for you too!

lose.line: Even with these enhancements, I'm still not strong enough...

mail.line: You've got some mail... Would you like me to cut the seal off for you, Commander?

main1.line: It's important to keep your guard up while doing work. To put it as a strategist would, "This is not peace. It is an armistice for a long while."

main2.line: Maintaining a regular schedule is the key to efficiency, so no pulling all-nighters, okay?

main3.line: How to get along with Algérie...? Well, for starters, she'll open up to you naturally if you have a cat with you.

mission.line: An indicator of a commander's capability is being able to take care of things in a timely manner. You should try a bit harder in that regard.

mission_complete.line: Commander, I've collected the mission rewards for you. I guess you owe me one now~

profile.line: I'm the third ship of the Suffren class, Foch. My design was different enough from those of my sister ships that I've even been called a member of the Foch class. As for what I'm good at... Nothing in particular, because I'm good at just about everything!

propose.line: Well, of course I'm nervous, but... when I look at your face, all of my worries just melt away~ Ahaha, well, I guess I'll reveal my true feelings to you... "Sure, I'd love to♪"

skill.line: You're not getting away! Main guns, fire!

touch.line: Is there something you're concerned about? Aha, well, if you don't mind opening up to me, an extra head can't hurt.

touch2.line: Eek?! ...Jeez, I didn't know you were into this kind of thing.

unlock.line: Hey there~ So you're the Commander? I'm Foch, from the Suffren class. I consider myself quite an experienced strategist, so I hope you'll find me useful~ Ahaha, anyway, it's a pleasure to meet you~

upgrade.line: Feel free to make me even stronger~♪

win_mvp.line: How was that! The true power of the Foch class! Ahaha, feel free to depend on me as much as you'd like~♪

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me? Hahaha, glad to know you're so considerate, Commander!

expedition_ex.line: Our supplies have arrived. Don't worry, I've already checked up on them myself!

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, did you have any plans for the evening? Ahaha, it's nothing special. I was just thinking that I'd like to eat dinner with you tonight. The reason is... Well, isn't wanting to spend more time with you reason enough? Haha~♪

home_ex.line: Do you need some help with the reports? Leave them to me, and go take a break. I'll find you if I need anything from you.

login_ex.line: Commander, the documents for you to take care of today are on your desk. ...No need to look so down, Commander~ I'll help you with anything!

lose_ex.line: What a miscalculation... I'm sorry, Commander...

main4_ex.line: Algérie invited you to a cat café? Haha, then let's go there after we're done with work.

main5_ex.line: I'll help you out so you don't need to work extra hours.

main6_ex.line: If someone wants to disturb the peace that we've built... Well, it's our job to stop them, isn't it?

mission_complete_ex.line: I've gone and collected the mission rewards for you. This favor's on the house~♪

touch_ex.line: If you want me to pamper you, just say the word~♪

touch2_ex.line: Commander? What might you be thinking about?

win_mvp_ex.line: Yep~ Feel free to keep relying on me~♪

detail.line: Of course I like to dress up in pretty clothes. Did you never see me as a lady? Hmph. ...Ahaha, don't be down on yourself, I was just toying with you♪

home.line: You've kept me waiting for a while, Commander! Just kidding~ good work on your mission♪ Do you want to take a short break somewhere before we head out?

login.line: You're letting me plan out our date? ...What a mistake on my part... I was hoping you would escort me to your heart's content...

main1.line: In exchange for having made you wait, I promise that today will be a super fun day, Commander~♪

main2.line: I had Algérie tell me what stores to go to, so I'll lead the way! I guarantee that you'll have a good time as well!

main3.line: I've got one for self-defense. Hehe, sorry about that! Guess you won't have a chance to look cool in front of me.

touch.line: Hmm... What do you think about the scenery over here?

touch2.line: Aren't... you in too much of a rush...?

unlock.line: Yo, Commander, did I keep you waiting? Sorry 'bout that. You know how it goes, sometimes it's really hard for a girl to pick out the right thing to wear. Anyway, let's get going~♪

win_mvp.line: What are you planning on presenting me with as a reward?

detail.line: May I interest you in attending today's tea party today with the young ladies? Don't be shy – just go there if you want to, Commander.

home.line: Your orders, Commander? ...Oops, I mean... Master, please tell me whatever it is you need.

login.line: I'm ready to give my all for you, as always. Dunno why, but this outfit always makes me feel motivated!

main1.line: I should ask Dunkerque to make a couple of pastries...

main2.line: Lady Algérie, could I interest you in some tea? ...How's that? Pretty on-point, right?

main3.line: Now I want to try on a maid uniform too... I should float the idea to the Royal Navy.

touch2.line: Ahaha... I thought I didn't stand out more than usual...

unlock.line: How are you today, Master? Your humble butler Foch patiently awaits your orders... Hahah! I sure look the part, don't I?

win_mvp.line: You will be a glorious stepping stone for the Iris and my Commander. Heehee.

battle.line: It'd be nice if the battle goes the way we want it to.

couple_encourage1.line: There's nothing to fear. The Vichya Dominion rises up to face any crisis.

couple_encourage2.line: We've finally got a chance to compete, Zara. Wanna see who's better?

couple_encourage3.line: Hehe, what a nice smell. Will you let me tag along for a bit?

detail.line: When it comes to history, relying on second-hand accounts is not enough to sift fact from fiction. You must conduct your own research.

expedition.line: The girls from the commission team have come back. I wonder if I can guess which girl's carrying the most important goods?

feeling1.line: Oh, Commander. I've been looking into the documents that need to be prepared for your formal retirement. Are you ready to start the process?

feeling2.line: Are you a bit scared of me? Hehe, don't worry, Commander. I wouldn't harm an ally.

feeling3.line: Commander, won't you drink a little with me? Are you perhaps bad at holding your alcohol? That's alright. Just take a little sip, like this... and try slowly tasting it with your throat... That's it... Don't you taste it?... The cool, rich flavor of maturity.

feeling4.line: You know, I actually really, really like cute things. Those trinkets, those squishy furballs, making sweets... Hehe, don't you think it's nice for an adult to enjoy cute things?

feeling5.line: Commander... would you like to rely on me? ...If it's you, I'd be happy to let you rely on me, and I'd always be supporting you from your side. Hehe, in exchange... I hope you'll show me just how much you can achieve, with me by your side.

headtouch.line: Are you trying to see if I have a fever...?

home.line: Good work planning out the operation, Commander. How would you like some freshly brewed coffee?

hp_warning.line: I'm telling you, the constraints of the treaty are still too suffocatingly restrictive...

login.line: We're on great terms after all. I would've been fine waiting a bit longer.

lose.line: It seems that I lost... But don't worry, Commander. Let's prepare carefully and try again.

mail.line: Reading a letter allows you to peek into the hidden heart of the person who sent it... Hehehe, how exciting! Here, Commander, some new mail's come in for you.

main1.line: Even if I don’t have any honors or decorations, my strength can speak for itself.

main2.line: Oh, Commander. How about enjoying some wine with me later? Hehe, only after you finish up the rest of your work though, alright?

main3.line: Gold...? Oh, were you interested in that story? Hehehe. At that time, the Iris were...

main4.line: My hobby is touring cat cafés, but this port doesn't... Oh, that's right. Even at this port, there are plenty of adorable creatures... Yes, how lovely!

main5.line: The Royal Navy are now allies who fight together with us. Furthermore... even yesterday's enemies are today's allies. What an interesting life this has been... Hehehe.

mission.line: We've just received a new directive from the higher-ups. Oh? It seems that you're just as busy as always... As much as I'd like to do some of this work in your stead, I suppose I wouldn't be able to?

mission_complete.line: Have you finished the mission? Good work. Please leave the report to me and go get some rest.

profile.line: I'm the flagship of the Vichya's First Cruiser Fleet, Algérie of the Templar Knights. In my history as a ship... I was called the best-designed treaty cruiser. Accordingly, I've been through plenty of interesting escapades... Hehehe. How do you feel about me, Commander?

propose.line: Thank you. Henceforth, I vow to dedicate my whole heart and body to you. Together, let us enjoy - slowly and surely - just how sweet our future will be. My partner, my beloved...

touch.line: Oh my, did you want to slack off for a bit? Hehe, I won't tell anyone else, so take some time off, okay?

touch2.line: Commander~? No matter how nice the other person may be, you shouldn't get too carried away. Hehe.

unlock.line: Bonjour. From today, this heavy cruiser of the Vichya Dominion shall now be serving at this port. It's a pleasure to meet you, hehe. If it's not too much to ask, I hope that we can get along well.

upgrade.line: Shattering the confines of the treaty... is rather pleasurable. Hehehe~

win_mvp.line: If only you realized the situation you were in a little sooner, you might've been able to avoid this outcome... but what can you do at this point?

gift_prefer.line: Thank you for this gift. I love it, hehehe.

detail_ex.line: Oh, Commander. ...Next time I'm off duty, I'm planning on checking out a sushi train with Dunkerque. Of course, you're welcome to join me. Hehehe.

feeling5_ex.line: Love, how are the plans for our next date looking? Oh, I know that the destination's basically decided upon. More than that, I was thinking things like... where we'll eat dinner, or where we'll stay. We have to plan out everything carefully so we can enjoy the date that much more!

headtouch_ex.line: My my, do you want to be pampered like a child today?

home_ex.line: You look really tired... Darling, you shouldn't push yourself too hard. Please, leave this to me and go lie down for a bit.

login_ex.line: Welcome back, dear. What will you start working on first?

lose_ex.line: Oh no, I lost... I'm sorry for letting you down...

main2_ex.line: Commander, is there anything you'd like for dinner today? Something other than dinner...? Oh my, how bold~ ...That's something you can look forward to later♪

main3_ex.line: Whether it's during work or in your daily life, it's no good to be too strict on yourself. Make sure you rest properly when you have the time, alright?

main4_ex.line: Hmm~ How is this one thiiiis cute... That's right. I'll have to show this to Miss Richelieu next time. Hehehe~.

mail_ex.line: Dear, you've got some new mail. I wonder if I should try my hand at writing some love letters myself. Hehehe.

mission_ex.line: We've just received a new directive from the higher-ups. Oh? It seems that you're just as busy as always... As much as I'd like to do some of this work in your stead, I suppose I wouldn't be able to?

touch2_ex.line: There's no reason to be so impatient, right? Hehehe♡

detail.line: Hehehe. Commander, it seemed like you enjoyed being surrounded by so many cute girls. Who caught your attention the most?

feeling5.line: Commander, if I buried you in the sand neck-down, you wouldn't be able to move, and I'd be able to do whatever I want to you~ Hehehe, I'm joking. Or, would you like to do that to me? Hehehehe.

home.line: Wine... would be a little bit out of place here. Hehe. Commander, will some tropical juice suffice?

login.line: Even if you've already applied some sunscreen, you still need to take care to not get sunburns.

main1.line: Here, a sun cap. If you want to play out on the beach, please make the proper preparations against the sun's rays first.

main2.line: A beach volleyball match between the Vichya and Royal Navy... Sounds fun. How about watching it together?

main4.line: Writing words on the beach and waiting for the waves to wash them away... Hehe, seems like it'd be fun~ What shall we write?

main5.line: Sigh... It's seriously quite hot... Commander, don't push yourself, you hear? Please let me know if you start to feel worse.

touch.line: You want some coconut juice...? Alright, wait there for now. I'll bring some over.

touch2.line: Huh?! I wonder, do these clothes make the Commander more impertinent...?

unlock.line: Oh my, hehe... Are you enjoying the warmth of the sunlight here? I'm glad that you're finding some time to relax here, but wouldn't you rather come play with everyone else?

detail.line: The Cheshire Cat? A bit foul-mouthed, but still a good kitten nevertheless. Oh, considering my current role, maybe I should be more annoyed?

home.line: Feeling tired? If you'd like a drink, I'll have one of the "little attendants" bring it over.

login.line: You're finally here, Commander. Have you decided how you'll continue the plot?

main1.line: It's quite troubling playing the role of a villain. Should I act in a way that people will like me, or in a way that people will hate me...?

main2.line: The rabbit who's supposed to lead the way in the story ended up getting lost in the set... Commander, shouldn't you go help that little'un?

main3.line: Good triumphs over evil... In fairy-tale stories like this, there's no better ending than that. Like a storytale for pure, innocent children.

touch.line: If you'd like to try your hand at being the "Evil Ruler," I'm perfectly willing to hand over the throne to you, hehehe.

touch2.line: Shall I call the soldiers? ...Just kidding, hehe.

unlock.line: Oh my, it seems that the one who ended up coming wasn't little Alice, but you instead... Do you plan to defy me as well, Commander? If so, I'll have to put you on trial for your sins... How was my acting just now? Hehe~

battle.line: Disappear without a trace, please, so that you don't add even more to my sacred duties!

couple_encourage1.line: Suffren, wanna go out next time we're off, or...

couple_encourage2.line: I'll back you up, Foch.

detail.line: Not finishing today's sacred duties can ruin your time-efficiency and poses a risk of a snowball effect the next day, so I won't rest until the day's work is done. You know how you feel when your work never ends, and you hate yourself because you really need to take a break from it? That's the worst, isn't it?

expedition.line: The commission is complete, Commander. Here's the list of materials they received. Look over it for me.

feeling1.line: I found the cause of all my extra work... It's you. You're at fault, aren't you, Commander?!

feeling2.line: You impress me, Commander. Even faced with so many holy duties, you don't look worried at all. I should be a little stronger, too. After all, I'm... I'm like your big sister now!

feeling3.line: When I'm with you, I can't help but relax and end up depending on you... Ugh, I can't be like this! I need to be the kind of woman you can depend on!

feeling4.line: Commander, wanna make a bet? If I can finish my holy duties ahead of schedule, I get aaall of your break time... You mean it?! Okay! I'm definitely gonna win this!

feeling5.line: So our contest starts in earnest tonight... My plans are as perfect as can be... W-wait, why am I getting more holy duties at a time like this?!

headtouch.line: Work-life balance, huh... Are you saying you want me to take a break? Thanks, Commander.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. I did some of your work for you to match what I did of my own. Let's use this extra time to rest. It's already break time, so...

hp_warning.line: I'm really not cut out for this stuff!

login.line: We're getting today's work done, TODAY. I hope you're ready, Commander.

lose.line: Reviewing the loss, accounting for lost materials... H-hahaha... So much for my sleep and our date plans...

mail.line: Mail for you. Commander, you should check it soon. Don't forget, you got that?

main1.line: Holy duties, holy duties, holy duties holy duties holy... Gah, there's another. How am I supposed to handle all of this... Eep?! Ahem, Commander? How long have you been there?

main2.line: Not there, either... I can't find the stuff I just bought... C-Commander, help. What do I do?!

main3.line: If I had Lady Clemenceau's aptitude for planning, I could secure break time for you... Sorry.

mission.line: New missions... Don't you think you have too much work to do? Share some of the burden with me.

mission_complete.line: Mission compleeete! Strike one holy duty off the list... In no small part thanks to you, Commander.

profile.line: I'm Dupleix, a Suffren-class heavy cruiser and a concierge for the Vichya Dominion. Commander, let's get our holy duties done together.

propose.line: Commander, what's gotten into you? Coming to me as soon as you finished your holy duties... You want me to close my eyes? Okay, but why... Huh? I-is this... for me?! I-I feel like I'm about to cry... Oh, finally... Finally, I get one of these...

touch.line: Oh, my... Is this how you relieve stress? Very unique...

touch2.line: C-Commander, where do you think you're putting your hands?!

unlock.line: I am Dupleix, concierge for the Vichya Dominion. Doesn't look like time's on our side today, Commander... Now then, here's today's timetable. Shall we get started on our sacred duties?

upgrade.line: My hands and feet feel so warm... It's nice.

win_mvp.line: We'd better get back while the battle is fresh in our minds. I can write up a good report on this...

gift_prefer.line: Heehee, aren't you sweet, Commander.

detail_ex.line: (Huh? What is this about a "forced no-overtime day"?! Commander, you bully... Tch... But if that's what it takes for us to get our date... then I'll just have to deal with it!)

feeling5_ex.line: This time, it's definitely perfect... I'm alone with the Commander, and my winning gear is ready... Yeah. I'm basically invincible!

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. You're on a break right now, but get this – so am I. I-in other words, umm... You get what I want to say, right?

login_ex.line: I organized your files in order of priority before you came here. A-and if you're free after work, we could go somewhere... M-maybe?

main4_ex.line: You'd be surprised how many fields I work in. Heheh, the eve of battle... The sunken Alma... If you'd like to see my movie, Commander, why don't we make it a date?

main5_ex.line: Holy duties... Wait, we're all done with them?! Hooray! Now... Huh? It's already dawn! Th-then how about we take a walk and watch the sunrise...?

main6_ex.line: Achoo! Chilly... Huh? You'll warm me up? Heehee, you really are warm, Commander♡

touch_ex.line: With you around, I hardly need pillows. Ah, paradise...

touch2_ex.line: Commander... You don't think my proportions are weird, do you?

detail.line: As a vehicle inspector, it's my duty to inspect as thoroughly as I can before the race. Everything has to meet safety standards, and that includes your equipment, Commander.

feeling5.line: Work has been busy, but the memory of seeing you on the racetrack gives me the energy to accomplish anything. That doesn't mean I wouldn't like a reward, though... You'll take care of me, won't you, Commander?

headtouch.line: Seat belts, check... Fire extinguisher, check. All should be well, Commander.

home.line: Thanks for all your hard work, Commander. I just reached a pause in my duties... Shall we take a breather?

login.line: When did this checklist get so... C-Commander?! Wait a second, I'm just finishing up!

main1.line: Even after the race, we'll have never-ending work... Just thinking about it tires me out.

main2.line: (After this inspection, I'm gonna find the best spot to watch the race. No shot I'm missing the Commander's race!)

main3.line: It's hot... Hm? For me? Th-thanks... That was really nice of you, bringing a drink just for me.

touch.line: After the race, things are going back to usual, huh? Say... Commander, what would you say to a date before we're inundated with work again?

touch2.line: Hyah?! Commander, at least wait until I'm done here...

unlock.line: Good timing, Commander. There are some parameters I need you to check... Come on, this is safety we're talking about. As an inspector, I can't just ignore them. Anyway, come sit next to me so we can get started.

battle.line: Apologies. I have no mercy to spare for my enemies.

detail.line: What should I make... Macarons, or Mont-Blanc? Oh my, Commander, you came at just the right time. Why don't you help me decide what confection to make?

expedition.line: Oh my, it looks like the commission fleet has returned. Perfect timing - I'll invite them to try my new confections.

feeling1.line: Ça faisait longtemps, Commander. There's no need to worry about me; I've been doing fine.

feeling2.line: Glad you could make it, Commander. One moment please - the dessert is ready, I just have to make tea. Today, let's unwind and chat a little.

feeling3.line: Back then, none of us had a choice... so I don't blame the Royal Navy for what happened. Quite the contrary - if it wasn't for them, we might not be fighting together now.

feeling4.line: Commander, you're quite the conversationist. Do you find me interesting to talk to? Hehe, I make sure to remember all your preferences. Sit tight for a moment, and I'll bring some cake out for you.

feeling5.line: True strength is not measured by our capacity to suffer in silence, but by our courage to open up to others. Commander, that's why... if you ever feel like crying, my bosom is always available for you.

home.line: Commander, would you like to try my freshly baked gâteau?

hp_warning.line: I'm only getting warmed up...

login.line: Commander, did you get enough rest?

lose.line: T'en fais pas... a defeat here is not the end.

mail.line: Commander, I've finished sorting your mail, so don't forget to take a look.

main1.line: There are things in this world that you might never be able to accomplish, but that is no reason to give up hope.

main2.line: It's not nice to sit around idly in port, but... Strasbourg, who took my place in leading the fleet, must feel even worse about what happened... if only the Army was able to hold out a little longer... *sigh*

main3.line: Ahh~ Sweets can really take a girl to heaven... C-Commander?! How long have you been here?!

mission.line: There's no shortage of new missions for us to get through... Hard work is important and all, but let's not overwork ourselves.

mission_complete.line: Hm? I see, the mission rewards are here. Commander, I'll go get them.

profile.line: I am Dunkerque, 1st Division of the Line of the Vichya Dominion. As you already know, there is no glory in my service history - there is no hiding this fact. However, if you are still willing to use me, I will not let you down.

propose.line: If I only was able to meet you in the present because of my suffering in the past, I won't say things like "I wish I had met you sooner." However, I do hope that in the future, I will always be able to find solace in your embrace. Commander, can I stay by your side forever?

skill.line: Let's do it just like we practiced...!

touch.line: Commander, shall we make some confections together? My home country is world-famous for our sweets, you know?

touch2.line: What am I going to do with you...

unlock.line: The day when we can all stand together has come at last... It's an honor to be here, Commander. I am Dunkerque - please allow me to become a part of this magnificent fleet.

upgrade.line: Every little bit matters.

win_mvp.line: Let's keep up this pace.

gift_prefer.line: Merci beaucoup~

battle.line: Enemies...? Way to spoil the scenery...

detail.line: Everyone looks like they're having so much fun... I couldn't ask for anything more.

home.line: Commander, would you like some ice cream? I brought several different flavors of syrup.

login.line: Commander, are you done changing into your swimwear~?

main1.line: Ice-cream based desserts are delicious, but they melt too easily... I might have to bring a cooler with me next time...

main2.line: It's been a long time since I last was able to enjoy scenery like this without any worries...

main3.line: Commander, are you done changing? The others are calling for us, let's go play with them!

touch.line: Want to try gazing into the ocean horizon together? It always puts my mind at ease.

unlock.line: I've been waiting so long for summer... and it's so worth it - the sun, the sand, the waves, and everyone's laughter. Commander, why don't we take this opportunity to enjoy some crullers together?

win_mvp.line: Who wants to have some crullers? I made more than enough for everyone~

detail.line: What's your favorite dessert? I can make it for you, Commander.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission is complete... Hehe, no matter the time or place, I suppose I'm still your secretary ship.

feeling5.line: The warm sunlight, the peaceful atmosphere, the soothing music, all embracing me as I relax and chat with one so dear to me. If this is a dream, I hope to never wake up...

home.line: No need to rush, Commander, I don't mind waiting for you.

login.line: Here you are, Commander. Oh? Don't worry, I've only just arrived myself.

mail.line: We have new intelligence? Well, don't worry about me. Please, check it at once.

main1.line: ......der, Commander! Look at you, staring at me and spacing out again, am I really so captivating? Did the ice in your drink melt?

main2.line: Commander, shall we go for a stroll? How often do we get to go out on a date? Let's not waste this one sitting around chatting.

main3.line: When I sit here like this, I sometimes forget I'm a warship... But, to fight for these little moments, that's not such a bad motivation, is it, Commander?

mission.line: Is it a very important mission? Well then, I'll go with you.

mission_complete.line: Commander, some mission rewards are available. Shall we head back to the office?

touch.line: Just relax, Commander, we still have plenty of time.

unlock.line: Don't you simply adore the atmosphere in this place? It's one of my favorites. The desserts here are to die for. Would you like a taste?

battle.line: Open your ears for this requiem is for you.

couple_encourage1.line: Will you... make more desserts for me?

couple_encourage2.line: The Tribunal shall support you.

couple_encourage3.line: Here we shall play. Lead the charge.

detail.line: The domain of music is free of lies and treachery. There, I and my instruments can become logical and perfect beings. How fantastic it is to swim in the sea of melody and harmony – wouldn't you say so?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned to us. The inventory list I made is right here. Do read it, Commander. G-good job, you say? W-well, I won't refuse a compliment...

feeling1.line: I don't see you as a listener, and you don't see me as a player. Thus, we are at an impasse.

feeling2.line: The song I played had a mellow sound to it? Why, thank you for your kind words. Playing the music that suits the listener's tastes is, after all, an instrumentalist's job – quite similar to how we interact with people, don't you think?

feeling3.line: (Whew... Okay, I got that out of my system. Hm? Who's that at the door?) ...C-Commander?! Why are you here? ...You heard terribly violent music playing? Wh-why, yes, that was me.

feeling4.line: I found out that nobody has been using this room, so I converted it into my private music room. W-wipe that look off your face! We all have our secrets... and this is mine, the secret no one else knows. From now on, you must bear my secrets and my stress together with me.

feeling5.line: *sigh*... Commander, when I look at you, do I really see the person who I adore so much? I've grown so attached I can't deny it anymore. I'm in love with you. Do your eyes see the love in me? Gaze upon me, and don't look away... Please...

headtouch.line: You're hopeless, Commander... *blushes*

home.line: You've returned. Shall I play a melody to mellow out your tense nerves? ...No, that was not an expression of affection for you. I-I said it's not, so it isn't!

hp_warning.line: Agh... Has something gone awry?

login.line: Greetings, Commander. Oh, I'm surprised you've already started your holy task.

lose.line: This can't be! I... never lose...

mail.line: There's a new letter for you. I've left it over here. You'll do the wise thing and read it at once, no?

main1.line: Though I'm not a judge, I've learned much from my Tribunal colleagues who perform the "dirty work"... Though, one thing I'd like to know is, how on earth your espionage skills have come to rival that of our intelligence officers.

main2.line: Dunkerque made this dessert for me. And this one is for you, heehee. Now you owe me.

main3.line: So, what did you think of my improv piece today? ...You REALLY liked it? You don't need to be THAT direct with your words... Still, thank you... *blushes*

mission.line: You have new missions. Seems you have your work cut out for you, no?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Wonderful – like a song played to perfection.

profile.line: I'm Strasbourg, member of the Tribunal. I am both a listener and a player. As my coworker, try not to bore me.

propose.line: For... For me? Really? Why? You have no shortage of other admirers... Wait, let me just confirm this one last time! It's me – I'm the one you want, yes? Because if so, I will really stop holding back, embrace you tightly, and make sure nobody can ever take you from me.

touch.line: What, pray tell, is your goal with this intimacy?

touch2.line: Well, well... Want to know what it feels like to have both your arms tied up in strings?

unlock.line: I am Strasbourg, Knight-Virtuosa of the Tribunal. And you must be the one who I've heard so much about. I see. Heehee, I look forward to seeing what you're capable of, Com~man~der~♥

upgrade.line: Good. I'm not opposed to power.

win_mvp.line: The performance has ended.

gift_prefer.line: Th-this is for me? What do you want in return? You can ask for anything!

expedition_ex.line: Commission complete. Yesss! ...Well, Commander? Is there any praise coming?

feeling5_ex.line: I was always a woman who was anxious and acting tough – until you came along and changed me completely. I'm going to hold on to you tightly, hog all your attention, and make you never choose anyone else over me. This is my crime, and it is your punishment... because I'm now the happiest woman in the world.

home_ex.line: You've kept me waiting for far longer than is reasonable, Commander. You better be ready to make up for how much I missed you. Come, we're going to the music room.

login_ex.line: Hello, Commander. I've already gotten started on the work. Don't worry, I can do this all by myself today – that's how used to it I've gotten now♪

main4_ex.line: Commander. Hey, Commaaander. What are you thinking about? It better not be anything except work and me. Or else...♥

main5_ex.line: Dunkerque's desserts... Mmm... I can't stop eating them. Makes me want to do nothing but eat them together with you all day.

main6_ex.line: Why don't we visit the music room after work is over? I'll "play you a song" nobody else nobody else gets to hear♥

mission_ex.line: You have new missions. The more of them pile up, the more you'll need my help, right?

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. Wonderful – like the freshness and comfort of a newly baked dessert.

touch_ex.line: I do like this, so don't be afraid to go even bolder, Com~man~der♥

touch2_ex.line: You look VERY content. Good. Now stay focused on me♡

win_mvp_ex.line: I'd looove some dessert as a treat. Heehee. Make it extra delicious this time, please.

feeling5.line: Cheering on the racers together, getting ready for a race together, playing the piano together... The track is brimming with my memories with you. Now there's only one thing left to do. Why don't you take the wheel of the vehicle known as... me? ♡

headtouch.line: Hey! C-Commander! Leave my headphones alone.

home.line: The race is over, Commander. Want a cold drink? Or maybe a bucketful of cold water over your head? Or maybe you want...♡

login.line: Commaaander – what are you looking at? I said, "what are you looking at"? Heehee... Have you fallen under my spell within moments of arrival, hmm?

main1.line: Race cars are like instruments – they have a clear logic to them, their physical framework is evident, and they warrant studying... Buuut, as soon as you arrived, all my attention went straight to you.

main2.line: Everything's ready. Should be good to go... You know, we're starting to get REALLY synchronized, you and I. Let's keep this up.

main3.line: I'm so tired... Stay still, will you? Don't move so much or I might trip and get stuck. Heehee, you've made me like this – will you take responsibility for it? Come closer so our bodies may touch♡

touch.line: Oh? Need my help?

touch2.line: Are you THAT eager to do it? Alright, but let's continue this INSIDE the car♡

unlock.line: Commander? I can't believe you found me... As you can see, I'm finishing up this car's pre-race checks. If you have time to spare, would you mind lending me a hand? Oh, and of course, keep this a secret between the two of us. I can count on you for that, yes?

battle.line: Don't bother with courtesy! Just bunch up and come at me!

couple_encourage1.line: That's enough praying. Prepare to fight!

couple_encourage2.line: You're not gettin' ahead of me a second time!

detail.line: If some dumbass sticks their nose where it doesn't belong, they got only themselves to blame when they're hanging from my cannons.

expedition.line: Guess your rackety team's come back.

feeling1.line: Seems you've mistaken a wolf for a dog... Hmph, don't start crying if you get bit cause of it.

feeling2.line: Your smile makes me think of her... She's someone I wanna hate, but can't bring myself to.

feeling3.line: Stop looking so intimidated. Long as you won't betray me, I won't betray you.

feeling4.line: I can't stand hearing those babies cry when you get hurt... So use me as a shield. I don't mind.

feeling5.line: It's like the mood eases up when you're with me... I'mma get some rest right here... And don't you leave me...

home.line: You finished plundering? Coulda gotten it done in no time if you'd brought me.

hp_warning.line: That all ya got?

login.line: Go figure... you're busier than I expected. If ya need a hand with something, just gimme a shout.

lose.line: My payback comes with interest... Before long, you'll know how much!

mail.line: Got some mail for ya. Picked it up on the way here.

main1.line: The era of battleships is over? Hah, the hell you mean? MY era is just getting started!

main2.line: Insincere preaching about faith and beliefs is no different from idle sleeptalk.

main3.line: Idiots just don't ever wisen up, do they... What drives 'em to pray to a made-up being that won't even respond?

mission.line: A job's a job. Whining won't make it go away.

mission_complete.line: ... Pish, them's some shabby rewards.

profile.line: I'm Jean Bart, the battleship. I was named after a certain "renowned" privateer... You what? Never heard of privateers? They're pirates with legal permission to pillage, fighting for a just cause.

propose.line: The path I walk is an unforgiving, dirt-ridden path where you can't even see the future lying ahead of you. But ya still wanna go with me? ... Hmph, your stupidity amazes me. And for your foolishness, I offer you the rest of my days.

touch.line: Stop trying to hit on me.

touch2.line: ... You better not regret this later.

unlock.line: I'm Jean Bart, the Vichya Dominion's last cutting-edge battleship. Guessing you'll be plotting my course from now on... Hmph, I'll see for myself how good a job you'll do.

upgrade.line: Feeling great. Wanna give it a shot?

win_mvp.line: Your endeavors were touching... but when you pick the wrong fight, that's all they'll ever be.

gift_prefer.line: Hmm? Give something to a pirate like myself, and you'll never get it back. Are you sure you want to give this to me?

battle_ex.line: All hail the Vichya Dominion!

detail_ex.line: I'm not the kinda girl who goes shopping with Dunkerque and Algérie. But you knew that already, being the person who knows me best, right? On the other hand, I wouldn't mind doing that with you.

expedition_ex.line: Guess that merrymaking team's come back.

feeling5_ex.line: ...Oh, crap, guess I dozed off. How 'bout you take a quick nap too? You could use my lap for a headrest. Take it easy. You and I, we're always by each other's side.

home_ex.line: I mighta once had a big role to play, but with you in command, I just never get to truly act.

login_ex.line: Gimme that, I'm gonna help ya out... Of course I'm gonna assist, I'm your secretary.

main1_ex.line: I ain't letting any new talent outshine me. I am Jean Bart, the Vichya Dominion's most powerful ship and bearer of the sacred Iris' name. This title is my pride, and I will never surrender it.

main2_ex.line: If you wanna go talk to Richelieu then I could come with ya. We believe in different things, but we're still sisters.

main3_ex.line: Praying isn't my thing, but wishing is fine by me. 'Cause wishing for the wellbeing of the one you love is what it means to be human.

mission_ex.line: This loot ain't nearly good enough. Not for me, nor for you.

touch_ex.line: Look, just don't get too flirty with me...

touch2_ex.line: You're really that keen on my body?

detail.line: I'm more willing to listen to Dunkerque than a lot of others. She's a lot more in touch with the masses.

expedition.line: A commission fleet has returned? Let's head down to greet them together then. I needed some fresh air anyway.

feeling5.line: I loathe red tape, nor do I have any desire to stand here like a flower vase for people to stare at... But I'm doing all of this for you, because you make me feel like it's all worth it. You've committed quite the serious offense, mon amour...

home.line: Did you just come back from battle? Here, cheers.

login.line: You... look awfully bored, Commander. Hmph, what a coincidence. That makes two of us.

lose.line: Hmph. Still better than going to that banquet...

main1.line: Letting go of everything and losing yourself to the merriment of song and dance... that is what a banquet should be about. Not this pompous farce that makes even wine taste bad.

main2.line: The one thing that this banquet has going for it is the fact that everyone's smiles are genuine and heartfelt... Look, I'm praising you, can't you tell?

main3.line: Commander, I'm not going to exchange pleasantries with you. C'mon, it's not like we just met for the first time, right?

mission.line: You still have missions to do even now? ... Need my help?

mission_complete.line: C'mon, put all that stuff aside and have a drink with me.

touch.line: Cheers... Hmph. I never asked for the "blessing" of being someone's sister, but I've already gotten used to what that entails.

unlock.line: The guest of honor shouldn't be wandering around looking for girls drinking alone... Hmph, might as well have a drink while you're here anyway.

win_mvp.line: Mmm... the wind on the battlefield... now that's what I'm used to.

detail.line: You wanna go lookin' for treasure? There's no damn treasure 'round here. But one day... Hmph, one day, when we've achieved a boring peace, I'll give you a taste of what a real treasure hunt is like.

feeling5.line: Man... The sun's crazy bright out today... What, you're still here? How long are ya gonna hang around? Hmph, you're real good, both at making me happy AND making me mad, you know that?

home.line: Would you stop comin' here right after returning to port? Don't want people catching wind of this place and turning it into a playground.

login.line: Don't you go touchin' my stuff without permission! I'll knock ya out cold.

main1.line: Sorry, but this hammock's only big enough for one of us. Ya wanna relax, get your own. I ain't your personal servant.

main2.line: Just how much damn work do you have if you're even bringin' it up here...? You just like being with me...? Tsk...

main3.line: Wha–? Is... Is that Surcouf? The hell... How'd she end up dozing off in here? That girl's a real piece of work.

touch.line: Ack! Don't put your damn ice-cold soda on me! You're on thin ice, buddy...

touch2.line: You're not the only one who can do whatever ya want just 'cause nobody else will come here. I can, too. Understand?

unlock.line: You damn scalawag... You don't just sneak into someone's hideaway without consequences, ya know. Though, I found this place by pure chance too. Don't go tellin' anyone else about it!

battle.line: Forward! Quarter them!

detail.line: Aid with getting dressed? This is nothing compared to a ceremonial Iris dress. Not to mention it suits me better. Don't ya agree?

feeling5.line: Not to say I've grown soft, but I have gotten too used to you bein' around. I don't mind it – hell, I like it. I'm all but dependent on you, that's just how important you are to me.

headtouch.line: Hmh...

home.line: You're back? Seems you've got girls queuein' up to meet you. Me, not so much...

login.line: Work, same as always, huh? Tell me if there's anything I oughta know.

main1.line: Sakura Empire-style badminton? Sounds fun. I'll knock that shuttlecock beyond the horizon!

main2.line: I hate it when people approach me to either give or get a hug. Never asked for their damn compassion.

main3.line: Wagashi, for me? Thanks. Dunkerque sure is considerate as always.

touch.line: What, you wanna see me brandish one of these?

touch2.line: Umph! What now?!

unlock.line: Bonne année... Or rather, I should say "Happy New Year" here, yes? A year of peace and prosperity passes, and we are here to welcome another... and I must thank you for making that possible.

win_mvp.line: I'm not the type to underestimate anyone.

detail.line: While I do like this holiday spirit, don't expect me to dress up every single year... You'll help take photos next time around? Hah. You sure know how to get someone's hopes up.

expedition.line: That rowdy bunch is back. Heheh. They're right at home with this holiday spirit.

feeling5.line: It's a new year... As long as you'll be here, I'll have something to look forward to. Is this what those Empery girls're talking about when they wish for "peace in the years to come"? Although, I'd hate it if I started becomin' reliant on you for... Nah, forget it. What matters is – I'm counting on you for another year, Commander.

headtouch.line: I swear, people like you... Ugh. It's a holiday. I'll pretend you didn't do that.

home.line: Look who's back. So, what should I do? It's not that I DON'T want your approval, I just want to do my best.

login.line: You're here. Well? Does this attire meet your standard? ...No, just asking out of curiosity.

mail.line: Got a letter for you here... No, I didn't go looking for it. I just happened to find it.

main1.line: Sure, this is more fun than I thought, but I can't go 'round cheering like a little kid... You wouldn't mind it if I let my inner kid out? Well, I'll be the one to decide what I do.

main2.line: A red envelope? Oh, is that how you give blessings to someone? Heheh. Alright, then how 'bout showing me how sincere you are?

main3.line: A new year and a new beginning... So they say, but every day's new to me. What makes it different from the past ones is the fact that I have you now.

mission.line: Remember, you've got work waitin' for ya. It being a holiday ain't an excuse to slack off.

mission_complete.line: Looks like your rewards're ready. You're not gonna tell me to go and fetch 'em, are ya?

touch.line: Don't get too ahead of yourself, now...

touch2.line: You sure you ain't getting carried away? It being the New Year isn't an excuse to... Actually, do whatever you want.
