unlock.line: What're you starin' daggers through me for? Are ya that excited about this new outfit? Alright, then feast your eyes on my fashion sense. Yeah, I didn't put it together just for your sake this time – more like to demonstrate my tastes.

battle.line: The curtains rise on a splendid play.

couple_encourage1.line: I appreciate the prayer. Now, let us focus on the enemies in front of us.

couple_encourage2.line: Jean Bart, how long are you going to keep wearing your grumpy face?

couple_encourage3.line: Marco Polo, let's try not to get too ahead of ourselves~

couple_encourage4.line: Fighting angel Marseillaise, pass judgment upon the Holy Iris's enemies!

couple_encourage5.line: Seize victory, the Tribunal's way.

detail.line: Whenever I want to play with the cute little Meowfficers, they naturally gather around. And as soon as I need to do something else, they will also leave on their own. Heehee... I suppose this is one aspect of me that makes Richelieu and Jean Bart green with envy~

expedition.line: Take these gifts over to the girls in the commission fleet, won't you? ...Hm? When did I prepare them? Why, is that something you absolutely have to know? Heehee~♪

feeling1.line: I see now. So, the upstanding Commander is just a made-up facade? Hmm... Au contraire, I actually find that quite dull.

feeling2.line: A person who is worthy of praise and adulation, yet is not revered as an idol... Is it because you walk alongside your troops? Hmm... how thought-provoking.

feeling3.line: I see you're on your guard, just as always. Perhaps Jean Bart told you a little thing or two? ...Heehee, just as I thought. Speaking of which, Commander, how did the two of you get on such good terms? I expected her to be quite difficult to get along with, no?

feeling4.line: If you don't mind, Commander, could you tell me about some of your likes and hobbies? That way, I would be able to cater to you in all sorts of ways~ Heehee. Even if you don't feel like telling me, I could always ask some of our friends.

feeling5.line: This port is truly a battlefield in its own right, seeing as how many of your companions are vying for you. By the looks of things, I won't be able to win over your attention without some ingenuity... Heehee. Commander, I do wonder, what do you think the odds of me winning are?

home.line: Shall we review our previous operational strategy? If time permits, why not try to ascertain an alternate possibility?

hp_warning.line: Oh my, I seem to have let my guard down.

login.line: Welcome back, our ever-so-sought-after Commander. Heehee, is there anything I might be able to help you with?

lose.line: Oh my, it seems that I've been bested... But just so you know, I'm the type to hold on to grudges... Heehee~

mail.line: A new letter has arrived. It's not urgent, so you can take a look after you've finished what you're working on right now.

main1.line: Commander, you are both the director on the stage, as well as the staff working behind the scenes. Which role do you enjoy playing more? Or... does our Commander actually wish to be just another spectator? Heehee~

main2.line: Enjoying one of the Royal Navy's elegant tea parties or downing vodka with the Northern Parliament are both effective methods of bridging the distance between parties. Though, vodka... can be a bit of a struggle...

main3.line: Those who do not scheme enjoy the levity that comes with having nothing to worry about, whereas those who do enjoy the fruit borne by their plans. Having that said, it is not my place to judge. Regardless of who we are, we all have our ways of getting along with one another... Wouldn't you agree?

mission.line: There's still work left to finish. I'd assume it has already made its way onto your itinerary, yes?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Yet another item on the itinerary dispatched efficiently... So this is the Commander in work mode.

profile.line: I am the third of the Richelieu class, the never-completed Clemenceau. Unlike Richelieu and Jean Bart, who made a name for themselves, I was abandoned during that great war. However, my lack of history or honors is also my greatest asset – that's right, nobody ever notices the shadow lurking behind the curtains. Heehee~

propose.line: I'm an evil woman. Which is why I can do things like this without a second thought... For example, orchestrating a date, creating a time and place just for the two of us, or getting jealous over who you've been with– Heehee, can you handle someone like me?

touch.line: Oh my, Commander. You look like you want to ask something~

touch2.line: Hmm? Commander, do you really want me to exploit your weakness so badly?

unlock.line: If it isn't the Commander! I, Vichya Dominion battleship Clemenceau, am honored to fight by your side. I'm essentially a nobody compared to you and your world-renowned deeds. Now... Before we get to business, do you have any questions for me?

upgrade.line: Commander, don't forget to keep improving yourself as well, alright?

win_mvp.line: With this one additional weight... the scales of victory tip ever in our favor.

gift_prefer.line: How charming. Where did you learn to do this? Heehee.

feeling5_ex.line: Shhh–– Just take my hand, and come with me. Where to? Naturally, a place free from the prying eyes of others, where we can be our true selves. Look– even though you have your doubts about me, you're still coming along. In other words, that's proof that you trust me, right?

home_ex.line: Let's try exploring other possibilities from the last operation a bit more thoroughly. Will you play the role of the enemy, or shall I do it?

login_ex.line: Oh, right on time. To be honest, I wanted to see what you're like when you're late and scrambling to get here... Just for curiosity's sake, of course. Heehee~

lose_ex.line: An enemy capable of outwitting both Clemenceau and the Commander at the same time? How interesting... Surely you're not going to let this one slide, are you?

main4_ex.line: "Clemenceau, that wicked woman. She somehow managed to snatch the Commander away from right under our noses..." Oh my, I didn't realize there were such outrageous rumors going around already. Heehee, it would appear that I'm not able to fly under the radar anymore.

main5_ex.line: Heehee, I wonder why you're spacing out all of a sudden~? Are you thinking about your other allies... or about some other girl~?

main6_ex.line: Richelieu, I thoroughly enjoyed the cat café you recommended to me the other day. Why yes, of course the Commander was with me. You know what they say about good company, don't you? Heehee~

mail_ex.line: Rumor has it that when some of the girls are coming by to deliver your mail, they're also sneaking in some personal effects– Haha, forget I said anything~

touch_ex.line: The relationship between the two of us doesn't need to be so stiff and formal, you know? Unless... you're afraid that I'm going to do something to you? Heehee~

touch2_ex.line: Don't forget this– the more "sins" you commit, the more you will have to "repent"~♪

battle.line: Looks like our precious leisure time will be cut short.

detail.line: If you're getting tired of swinging the golf club, why don't we take the cart around and enjoy the scenery? Heehee, and of course, you'll be the one driving.

expedition.line: You've received the commission rewards? Excellent, let's see if there's anything we can put to use.

feeling5.line: Commander, when I'm with you, I feel a sense of safety that makes all the thoughts in my head go poof. ...Oh, you too? What if I told you, I was just telling you what you wanted to hear? Heehee. Hey, Commander... Don't let yourself get fooled by the sweet flattery of other bad girls~

login.line: Let's start from here. Why don't you show me what kind of condition you're in today?

main1.line: Hmm? I'm measuring the wind speed. Or, would you rather me say... that I'm enjoying the warm, gentle breeze?

main2.line: Don't worry too much, and play however you see fit. This isn't a competition, so relax a bit.

main3.line: Richelieu holds back too much, worrying about where the ball might fly off to. Jean Bart swings too hard, without worrying about anything at all. Looks like fun, doesn't it?

touch2.line: Oh my, Commander. Your hands don't seem to be able to calm down.

unlock.line: The skies are blue and the wind is calm, a perfect day for golfing... Commander? I didn't bring you here just to watch the scenery, you know? Brace yourself, because you're in for a long day with me.

win_mvp.line: Phew, problem solved. I won't let any uninvolved parties get in the way of our leisure time.

battle.line: Activating idol version protocol.

detail.line: Information request: what is Master's favorite song?

expedition.line: Gascogne proposes greeting commission team with a singing performance.

feeling1.line: Master evaluated as unbeneficial to the improvement of Gascogne's idol talents. Activating autonomous learning module. Please step away from Gascogne.

feeling2.line: Gascogne has finished compiling idol data sets and has developed a new definition of an idol's capabilities. Assessment: an idol stops wars by singing. This holds strategic significance.

feeling3.line: Emotional activity was detected during musical performance on stage. Requesting investigation into origin of this phenomenon.

feeling4.line: Idol career evaluated as holding strategic significance. Requesting permission to proceed with idol work after today's operations have been completed.

feeling5.line: Gascogne understands the meaning of being an idol and requests system alteration to uninhibit emotions. "I am counting on you, Master."

home.line: Report: Gascogne has completed a lesson. Requesting reviewal of results.

hp_warning.line: Combat protocol engaged.

login.line: To do: vocals, dancing, band aesthetics. Requesting establishment of Gascogne's schedule for today, Master.

lose.line: Gascogne requesting immediate termination of current protocol and enabling of default combat mode.

mail.line: Requesting Master's response to received invitation of competition.

main1.line: Concept in database detailed as "saving the world by singing" was analyzed and logically equated to Gascogne's ultimate goal.

main2.line: "Emotion-packed singing can truly touch people's hearts"... Unable to infer meaning of said statement. Requesting assessment of Gascogne's singing ability.

main3.line: Detecting factual conflict between promotional materials' claim of Gascogne being "inexpressive" and existence of installed emotion module.

mission.line: Requesting approval for Gascogne's undertaking of photoshoot, performance, or radio show.

mission_complete.line: Report: working as an idol has improved Gascogne's capabilities.

profile.line: Gascogne has received an alternate functionality mode and undergone minor rigging upgrades to allow for singing in combat. Numerous incorrect parametric values caused by current mode have been detected. Referring to Gascogne's default form for basic information is advised.

propose.line: Being an idol means to have hope for tomorrow, an unfading smile, vigor, and passion. Now I see how much fun can be had beyond the battlefield... Thank you so much, Master.

touch.line: Gascogne is currently practicing.

touch2.line: Warning: unsolicited physical contact with idols is unnecessary. Likelihood of others interpreting said contact as sexual harassment is high.

unlock.line: Gascogne module change process complete. New directive: sing for the world. Master's order is my will.

upgrade.line: Action has no observable beneficial effect on idol abilities.

win_mvp.line: Assessing version protocol as effective. Gascogne will continue engaging in singing.

gift_prefer.line: Analysis: this item will increase my motivation to new levels.

detail_ex.line: Information request: Master, how do you like my singing?

expedition_ex.line: Would you mind if I headed to the harbor and sang a song for the commission team?

feeling5_ex.line: I completely understand what it means to be an idol now. It's about using my abilities to their fullest to sing brilliant, emotionally touching songs to the world. "Thank you," Master.

home_ex.line: Master, I just finished a lesson, and... was wondering if we could enjoy a little chat?

login_ex.line: To do: vocals, dancing, and band aesthetics. Master, what I should I focus on today...?

main1_ex.line: Concept in memory detailed as "saving the world by singing" detected. Is such a thing possible, even for me, Master?

main2_ex.line: Emotion-packed singing was assessed to be effective at touching Master's heart... Master, won't you... listen to my song?

main3_ex.line: Promotional materials' claim of me being "inexpressive" are... likely not accurate. I am like everyone else; I want to sing with a bright smile.

mail_ex.line: Master, I'd like your opinion on my participation in this contest...

mission_ex.line: Between a photoshoot, performance, or radio show, which should I focus on today, Master?

mission_complete_ex.line: Report: working as an idol has improved my capabilities. Nice!

touch_ex.line: I'm practicing at the moment... Do you need something, Master?

touch2_ex.line: Comet told me that people shouldn't readily get to touch idols... Master, does this qualify as sexual harassment?

battle.line: In the name of the Vichya, I shall bring down punishment upon thee.

couple_encourage1.line: Let us show them the power of our sacraments.

couple_encourage2.line: Please ascertain if I have the right to be your rival.

detail.line: Bringing down punishment upon sinners—that is the sole reason for my existence. As for whether you will need to be judged or not, it is still too early to tell.

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. Such is the Holy Iris's will.

feeling1.line: Please don't force me to carry out my "duties" upon you. That would only make everyone sad.

feeling2.line: My duty here is to "battle," not to judge, right? Do not worry. I shan't do anything that causes you worry.

feeling3.line: My duty here isn't solely to battle, but also to get along with the others at the port? Understood. If those are your orders as the leader of this port, then I shall see them done.

feeling4.line: Don't just try to get along with the others, but also try to have fun...? But for me, having fun means doing my "other" job... Heh, just kidding. I had fun watching your reaction just now. Ehehe.

feeling5.line: I don't like to mince words, so I will tell you this. On your next day off, how about going on a date with me? If you turn me down, I guess I'll have to—Hehehe, I see. I'll be looking forward to it then, Commander.

home.line: I shall judge the results of your battles on behalf of the Holy Iris. ...Well done. That was a magnificent victory.

hp_warning.line: So long as my wings don't break...!

login.line: Done with your morning prayers already? ...My apologies. Asking that of you is rather inappropriate on my part.

lose.line: This is merely a trial under the guise of defeat...

mail.line: It seems there's some new mail for you. Let's go check on it.

main1.line: Because I am one who judges sinners, in a sense, I hate everyone. All humans are born sinners, after all.

main2.line: Why did you stop working? If I'm not mistaken, you still have missions to take care of...?

main3.line: I am not here to judge whether your actions are good or evil. Rather, I am here to judge your existence itself.

mission.line: Your missions have arrived. Whether or not I pass judgment upon you depends on your progress.

mission_complete.line: The rewards for your missions are here. Take them without succumbing to greed.

profile.line: I am the aircraft carrier, Joffre. I was constructed to face off against Iron Blood carriers during the great war, but due to various misfortunes, I was fated to a life of continually being laid down and halted again, never getting to see the light of day. I have no doubt that was yet another of my many trials.

propose.line: I swear upon the name of the Holy Iris that our vows shall hold us together evermore. ...And with that, I am no longer fit to pass judgment upon you, but that's just fine with me. I'll just have to make good use of my newly-acquired qualification to love you instead. Hehehe.

touch.line: Is something the matter?

touch2.line: ...Accept my judgment.

unlock.line: By the power vested in me by the Holy Iris, I am aircraft carrier Joffre. I see that you are the Commander of this port. Hehehe, may you also receive the Iris's blessings.

upgrade.line: As the Holy Iris wills.

win_mvp.line: It is time for you to repent. Your life shall continue no longer. Soon, your remains shall become the foundations for our victory.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. I'd be happy to have this.

battle_ex.line: Accept this divine punishment.

detail_ex.line: Are you curious about the Sacrament of Love? Of course, I don't mind sharing with you—In order to make it easier for you to understand, why don't we go on a date?

home_ex.line: There is no need to fret. I am very well aware that all your battles are magnificent. What need is there for me to pass judgment?

login_ex.line: Commander, let us pray together. I got up two hours late just to match you.

main4_ex.line: The Independence-class... I don't think those girls understand the Holy Iris's will, but they sure fight well.

main5_ex.line: While I may no longer hold the qualification to pass judgment upon you, I am still qualified to continue observing your actions. That's the duty of a secretary ship, after all. Hehehe.

mission_ex.line: Whether or not I pass judgment upon you depends on your progress... Just kidding, of course. Let's work at a reasonable pace.

touch_ex.line: What is it? Did you need something from me?

touch2_ex.line: Hehehe...

detail.line: If I end up being hunted down, I'll fight back with all I've got. That's the best way of ensuring my survival.

home.line: My little mirror told me that you'd be arriving shortly. ...Hehe, that's a joke of course.

login.line: Welcome back. What role will you be playing today? A dwarf? Or are you... my prince in shining armor?

main1.line: I won't drop dead from eating a poisoned apple or two. Unlike you, I'm built pretty tough.

main2.line: "Seven dwarves"...Hmm. Why don't we ask the Manjuus to play that part?

main3.line: You know, I never expected Algérie to play a part like that. Though, I didn't expect to be playing the role of a princess either.

mission.line: We've received a new mission. How should we proceed?

touch.line: You want to be my prince? That's fine with me.

touch2.line: You're acting just like a famished wolf right now, hehehe.

unlock.line: Were you planning on freeing me from this spell? Then I suppose you're prepared to lock lips with me. Even though I'm already awake, um... that's just part of the ritual.

detail.line: Am I having fun? Yes, I'm quite enjoying this relaxation and the thought of crushing our enemies. What about you? Are you enjoying yourself?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Shall we take hot springs souvenirs to them as thanks?

home.line: Loath though I am, I shall bare my skin, too. Just as with the Holy See's edicts, the rules of the bathhouse must also be upheld.

login.line: Welcome back. Why don't you cleanse yourself before going to your office?

mail.line: La Galissonnière was kind enough to deliver your new mail. Would you like me to hold on to it for now?

main1.line: Don't fret over my wings. The sacred symbols made manifest by the Sacraments are cleansed not with water, but with one's faithful heart.

main2.line: As long as I am here, you won't commit the great sin of peeping. Though I wish it was thanks to your own restraint instead of my surveillance...

main3.line: I hear that a hot spring amidst the extreme cold elicits more gratitude than one amidst heat. Perhaps pleasure that takes advantage of one's weaknesses is the most terrifying of all.

touch.line: Phew... Praise unto the Iris for leading me to this wonderful bath.

touch2.line: Heehee. Is a steamy bath not enough to satisfy you?

unlock.line: Do you feel refreshed? Even without a holy ritual, the Iris would be happy to know that I've managed to soothe you with this bath. Was it not enough? Then... Shall we go back in?

win_mvp.line: Things seem to have warmed up a bit. Good.

battle.line: May these seas be cleansed of injustice.

detail.line: Know that if you violate the rules, you'll receive my judgment from the windshield just like this... Heehee. Did that startle you?

expedition.line: I hear the commission team is back. I'll tell them to give you a few minutes.

feeling1.line: You look as if you want to say, "I can't drive with you in the way, fighting angel." Heehee.

feeling5.line: Does my "support" make it harder for you to focus on the race? Don't worry. As a fighting angel, I will take responsibility and free you of the sin that ruins your concentration. Come to me, Commander...

home.line: I suggest making a pitstop for quick maintenance. Continuous overuse can lead to misfortune – for people, and for machines.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to check on your vehicle before the next race? I'm happy to assist.

main1.line: Looks like you set a new record. Congratulations. I'm certain it was the blessing of the Iris that guided you.

main2.line: *blow*... Okay, that's enough fogging up your windshield. Yes... May this give you the blessing of love.

main3.line: I find it commendable how you liven up the competitive mood, but please remember to be safe... I should, too? Heehee, thanks for your concern.

mission.line: Your missions... Yes, they can be put off for now. That's the judgment I've given, after all.

touch.line: Forgetting that there's glass between us, I see?

touch2.line: ..Hmm. I don't think you need to clean me, really...

unlock.line: Commander, have you prepared yourself adequately for this race? I hope your machine is able to perform to its full potential... and of course, the same goes for you too.

win_mvp.line: May this victory serve as the foundation for your next, Commander.

touch.line: 请问找我有什么事吗？|有什么问题的话，请当面提出吧|不知道妹妹们有没有懈怠呢……？
指挥官，来一杯？黑啤不会苦的，试试吧？|走，打一盘，我会让着你的！|指挥官，请下达指令！我的舰炮已经饥渴难耐了……
指挥官！~你呀，本来可以做得更好的，但为什么总是正经不起来呢……|镇守府一直这样毫无改变，指挥官你至少努力点啊！|指挥官？到底有没有认真听我说话呀？我要用粉笔头砸你了~~最讨厌别人问话不回了~哼！

battle.line: The enemies look quite strong...

detail.line: Before and after the modernization of the data is much worse!

expedition.line: This cloud looks like cotton candy...hmm? Ahh, Commander, Commission team is back~

feeling1.line: ...the sky is so blue.

feeling2.line: Mmhmm, the weather is nice, it's weather suitable for going out for recon at sea~ Commander you want to come together?

feeling3.line: Reconnaissance is a very important task! Eh, losing focus? Wh-what are you saying, I'm just ob-observing the weather.

feeling4.line: My elder sisters are very strong, I would be happy if only I could assist them~Eh, I'm worked hard? Ehehe, I got praised~

feeling5.line: Although I'm happy when praised by other people, now whenever I can assist Commander, I feel even happier, why is that...

home.line: Good work commander, want a cup of tea?

login.line: Commander, you're back! Me? I'm looking at the clouds.

lose.line: Wuu...if only I paid more attention.

mail.line: Commander...ehh, what did I want to say...ahh, yes, new mail!

main1.line: I'm always like this! I've got to explore before I find a place I like.

main2.line: Commander, want to watch the clouds with me? I bet we'll see wonderful things!

main3.line: Don't look at me like that. I've been to plenty of places before!

mission.line: The weather sure is nice... Oh? Commander! You've got some new missions.

mission_complete.line: Commander! How could you forget to collect your mission rewards?

profile.line:
I'm the fifth ship of the Kent-class, Suffolk.
Don't judge me by my looks! I'll be your go to ship whenever a critical moment comes. You know I basically saved the day at the Denmark Strait!

propose.line: Hng hng, commander finally noticed the shining spot hidden underneath my woozy appearance! From now on I can be as lazy as I want...ehh, I can't?...

touch.line: ...............Mmmh, Commander?

touch2.line: ...Aah, Commander! Say something if you're here.

unlock.line: Where is this place... Ah, hello! You're the Commander? I'm Suffolk. I've finally found you!

upgrade.line: If you get lost again, you can protect yourself.

win_mvp.line: Wow that cloud looks like...ehh, we won?

battle.line: Norfolk...will do her best...

detail.line: So embarrassing...

expedition.line: Seems like commissions are done!

feeling1.line: Wuu...

feeling2.line: Commander...why did you call for Norfolk——anything I want to do...? I...want to hear Commander tell a story...is that ok?

feeling3.line: Commander...can you tell more stories to Norfolk...this time I brought a fairy tale book I want to listen to...

feeling4.line: Commander...Norfolk is afraid of the dark, I can't sleep...can I sleep with the Commander...?

feeling5.line: Commander's body is so warm...can Norfolk stay here forever?

home.line: Commander...if you don't mind, let Norfolk massage...wuu, forget about it...

login.line: Commander, welcome back...

lose.line: Wuwuwu...I'm not suitable for combat afterall...

mail.line: ...new mail, I'm a bit jealous of Commander...

main1.line: I... don't like winter...

main2.line: My name carries... quite the weight... with it...

main3.line: It's best... to try and... get along with everyone...

mission.line: Some new missions are available... Want to take a look, Commander?

mission_complete.line: Commander, your mission rewards are ready. Want me to pick them up for you?

profile.line: Norfolk is ... That one...... The third batch of county heavy cruisers ... Whoa, commander, don't stare at me ... However, when the Danish strait was the antenna was frozen ... No, not because of cowardice!

propose.line: Mmm...Norfolk wants to stay forever and ever by Commander's side as well...

touch.line: Did Norfolk do something wrong...?

touch2.line: Ahh, Commander...baddie...

unlock.line: He- hello, Commander, I'm Norfolk...umm...uhh...hmm...please take care of me...

upgrade.line: Commander gives Norfolk so much courage...

win_mvp.line: Is it alright to give me such a rating?...

battle.line: Glory is ours.

couple_encourage1.line: prestige, do not wander again

couple_encourage2.line: keep the Etiquette, counterattack

couple_encourage3.line: at your service, Your Majesty

couple_encourage4.line: Go ahead, we are Royal Glory

detail.line: The pride of the Royal Navy, admire as you wish.

expedition.line: Completing commissions is also a show of honor, will you not treat those children?

feeling1.line: Sigh, seems like you have to learn it the hard way.

feeling2.line: Commander, it's such a great afternoon, shall we have a chat? ...Hm, alright, I'll talk about the times when I was with Renown.

feeling3.line: I talk about being refined at all times, but Commander need not to force yourself to comply. Your normal self is most charming.

feeling4.line: Hm? Too close? While a lady must be elegant, they take the initiative towards their love, you know?

feeling5.line: Shall I compare thee to a summer day? Thou art more lovely and more temperate... So long as I can breathe, or eyes can see, so long lives this poem, and this gives life to thee... A beautiful verse, could Commander read this for me?

home.line: Commander, is the tea ready? Let's taste it while we review.

hp_warning.line: Even I am slightly angered.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Care for a cup of tea?

lose.line: Victory and defeat are commonplace among those who fight, and we have all the time in the world.

mail.line: It's unopened... Commander, it's not gentlemanly to ignore messages from others, you know?

main1.line: An outstanding commander must have an in-depth knowledge of tea.

main2.line: This word is... ah, so I read it wrong. Sorry, my vision isn't very sharp.

main3.line: Listen more, speak less. You should listen to others' opinions, but retain your own judgments.

mission.line: Commander, you've got a new mission. Take a look, would you?

mission_complete.line: Glory comes with reward, do not forget the latter.

profile.line:
Indeed, the pride of the Royal Navy stands before you.
To be refined at all times is the upbringing of a royalty. The Denmark Strait? Victory and defeat are commonplace among those who fight. That was but a single failure.

propose.line: Haha, you cannot express your feelings to a lady this nervously. But your feelings have reached my heart... it is Hood's pleasure.

skill.line: Elegant, but not breakable like a vase!

touch.line: Appropriate contact is indeed essential, shall we dance?

touch2.line: Commander should know very well the consequences of disrespecting a lady... are you prepared?

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander. As the pride of the Royal Navy, Hood comes with victory.

upgrade.line: Your efforts will be rewarded.

win_mvp.line: The warm sun, the cool breeze, a brilliant victory.

battle.line: Acts of bravery beget success... All ships, open fire!

detail.line: Fate can be easily derailed, Commander.

expedition.line: Commissions complete! Please welcome the fleet home.

feeling1.line: Keep your distance. You are not qualified to command me...

feeling2.line: I heard that my current name was chosen because my original one could bring misfortune, but... judging by how things turned out... it seems I'm unable to escape my fate...

feeling3.line: You never know how many plans, hopes, and efforts would sink into the sea with you, Commander. Don't die too easily.

feeling4.line: Fighting with honor is my motto. I wish it could be the same when it comes to love. So... can you stay with me a bit longer? I have something important to tell you, Commander...

feeling5.line: I had a dream, a dream of that time which makes me feel hopeless even now... But when I open my eyes and see you by my side, it feels like life... like life isn't so bad after all...

home.line: Sometimes victories come down to nothing but luck. Don't get too full of yourself, Commander.

hp_warning.line: Get up! We're looking for a fight!

login.line: Welcome back. Shall we have tea before getting back to work?

lose.line: A horse may stumble even though he has four legs. Let's try again next time.

mail.line: You have a new message, Commander.

main1.line: Expensive isn't always better, but it's your job to maximize our combat capability, Commander.

main2.line: I don't want to suffer the pain of losing comrades...

main3.line: Would you like to have some tea? I have a sandwich as well. I'm a big fan of pickles, you know!

mission.line: It's time to test your resolve, Commander.

mission_complete.line: Rewards delivered! You performed beautifully.

profile.line: I'm the second ship of the King George V-class battleships, the Prince of Wales. I once escorted the Prime Minister to sign the Atlantic Charter. I turned a new page in the history books of weaponry? Hmph, how dare you mention that in front of me.

propose.line: To me, the ritual isn't as important as the fact that you've already recognized our love... However, receiving such a wonderful gift still makes me happy. Thank you, Commander... I'll keep this with me forever!

touch.line: Let's have chat, Commander.

touch2.line: You know what this touch means, don't you?

unlock.line: You're the Commander? Very well. I, Prince of Wales, shall let you witness my true strength.

upgrade.line: Let's not repeat failure again...

win_mvp.line: Success is gratifying every single time.

battle.line: Want to go... to Solomon?

detail.line: I've inspected the communication equipment. It won't cause any more problems...

expedition.line: Commander, a commission has finished.

feeling1.line: I don't really want to get any closer.

feeling2.line: Ayanami's impressions of Commander? I don't really know.

feeling3.line: Commander, you're always saying that my ears are cute... But why won't you touch them?

feeling4.line: If there's one thing that worries me... it would be when you are not at my side.

feeling5.line: I don't particularly... like or dislike combat. I just do what must be done. But if it's for you, Commander... maybe I can get a bit stronger.

headtouch.line: I don't really get it but... I'm a bit happy...

home.line: Commander, you're a little like me on the battlefield... That's... pretty cool.

hp_warning.line: I don't want... to be alone...

login.line: Commander, have you eaten yet? Here's some snacks.

lose.line: It's okay... I'll recover quickly.

mail.line: There's... new mail...

main1.line: {namecode:6}'s ears... are they cute? I don't understand... As long as you're happy, Commander!

main2.line: I've been having nightmares of all the girls getting lost... I'm certain that it's my fault, too...

main3.line: Commander? No, nothing. I just wanted to see if you were here or not.

mission.line: Commander, we've been notified of new missions.

mission_complete.line: The rewards for the previous mission are here.

profile.line: I am Ayanami, an improved Fubuki-class destroyer. I am not afraid of combat. Though just a destroyer, I can fight any enemy...

propose.line: Rest assured... This time, no matter what happens, I'll survive and return to you... because I'll always want to see you again...

skill.line: Bear witness to the true power of the "Demon"

touch.line: Uuu... it tickles...a bit.

touch2.line: Commander... please... don't touch there so much... It's making me feel weird...

unlock.line: I'm... Ayanami. I am often called the "Demon." Pleasure to meet you.

upgrade.line: My power is overflowing...

win_mvp.line: MVP? I don't really get it, but... thanks.

battle.line: Please leave combat to me. I shall not shame my title of being "The Strongest!"

detail.line: Small strokes fell great oaks, constant drops pierce through rock. Those who train through the most humdrum of days shall seize victory in the most critical of moments. That is my belief.

expedition.line: Your fleet has returned from commission. Want to welcome them back?

feeling1.line: A sword has no eyes. It would be wise to avoid approaching me casually.

feeling2.line: Do you need anything? If not, I'm going back to work.

feeling3.line: It might be pretty nice to just set aside my duties and have a relaxing conversation with you every once in a while, Commander.

feeling4.line: Recently, I haven't been able to keep my composure during training.. Just from thinking about you, my form becomes sloppy. If I am like this, would you still want to keep me by your side?

feeling5.line: No matter how badly I'm injured, I will make sure to always return to your side. So... Commander, could you always stay with me as well?

home.line: I'm glad that you came back safe and sound.

hp_warning.line: Be still as water...!

login.line: {namecode:66} standing by. What are your orders?

lose.line: I was careless... I definitely will not fail next time!

mail.line: Commander, there's new mail. Shall I bring it for you?

main1.line: Even back in port, we must not lower our guard. Danger lurks around every corner.

main2.line: Commander, not even you could withstand my blade.

main3.line: Daily refinement means to continually strive towards your goals. Commander, may your focus never falter.

mission.line: New tasks have been assigned - would you like to confirm them?

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished! Are we going to collect the rewards?

profile.line: I am {namecode:66}, first ship of the {namecode:66}-class heavy cruisers. I may not look like it, but I have already crossed through countless battlefields. Please place your faith in my firepower and armor, and be at ease.

propose.line: For you to acknowledge me like this, Commander, is the greatest honor. From now on, this blade shall serve only you. Please continue to treat me kindly.

touch.line: E-enemies?! Oh... It was you, Commander? Apologies - my eyesight isn't the best.

touch2.line: Kyaa! You scared me... how shameless!

unlock.line: Are you the Commander? Please allow this lowly {namecode:66} to offer you what little strength she has.

upgrade.line: Power... flows through my blade!

win_mvp.line: Hm... Once again, I've cut a worthless object.

battle.line: Naughty children need to be punished~

detail.line: You shouldn't ask about a maiden's weight so casually~ *giggles*

expedition.line: The commission fleet is back! Let's go give them a warm welcome.

feeling1.line: You've been naughty, Commander. Do you want to be punished so badly? *giggles*

feeling2.line: If you don't express your thoughts clearly, Commander, nobody will ever understand you.

feeling3.line: Commander, would you like me to clean your ears? Come on, don't be shy. Just leave it to me~

feeling4.line: It's all your fault, Commander... If you make such a cute face, I won't be able to keep my hands off of you...

feeling5.line: It's no good... I can't control myself anymore! Commander, won't you become mine? You don't have to worry about anything... All you have to do is listen to me, and I'll satisfy all your needs...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Are you tired? Come bury yourself in big sister's bosom~!

hp_warning.line: Looks like big sis needs to get a little serious.

login.line: Welcome back! What should we do today?

lose.line: Oh my... this is a bit troublesome...

mail.line: Ara~ new mail? I wonder who it's from.

main1.line: It seems like... my shoulders are always sore...

main2.line: Commander~ I can see you ogling me in a daze, you know?

main3.line: Hup! A little bug got into the room. You didn't see it? I'm confident in my good eyesight.

mission.line: Missions have been updated. Don't forget to take a look!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! I wonder what rewards we will get~?

profile.line: I'm {namecode:67}, the second ship of the {namecode:66}-class heavy cruisers and flagship of the Second Fleet. Many of my sisters have followed my banner into battle. No matter the mission, just leave everything to big sister here~!

propose.line: Oh my, you've caught me, Commander. Or should I say, I've finally caught you? Hehe~ I'll never let you go now!

skill.line: Oh my, how should I torment you today?

touch.line: Oh my~ Are you going to give me a massage?

touch2.line: You can touch me even more if you'd like... but there's no saying what might happen next... *giggles*

unlock.line: Oh my, what a cute commander! Please allow your big sister {namecode:67} to take good care of you from now on!

upgrade.line: My whole body feels... hot... Commander, can you stay with me for a bit?

win_mvp.line: Combat operations... complete! It's all thanks to your leadership, Commander!

battle.line: The perfected aircraft carrier, {namecode:95}, setting sail!

couple_encourage1.line: Zuikaku, give it your all! I'll cover you!

couple_encourage2.line: Do you see my true power, Akagi?

couple_encourage3.line: This time... I'll prove to you how powerful I really am!

couple_encourage4.line: I won't be able to protect you if you stray too far!

couple_encourage5.line: Where is the Queen of the Docks heading to?

detail.line: The melody of my flute is a requiem for the dead. Shall I play it for you?

expedition.line: This is all required to carry out the Circle Five Plan.

feeling1.line: I think I just saw a future in which you were cut down by {namecode:91}, Commander.

feeling2.line: My sister {namecode:96} and I held on for two years during the darkest of times. If only our senpai could have worked a little bit harder.

feeling3.line: Do I hold a grudge against the First and Second Carrier Divisions? Of course~ For them to leave us behind like that, wouldn’t anyone complain in that situation?

feeling4.line: Those senpai are so sly! Just when I was about to overtake them, they went somewhere I could never reach! How unfair!

feeling5.line: Commander, could you lend me your shoulder? Sometimes, even I want to simply clear my mind and rest. When I get like that, can I depend on you to be by my side?

home.line: The girls have returned safely to port, just like the Fifth Carrier Division always does.

hp_warning.line: Pump water to the other side! Hurry!

login.line: Intelligence is said to be a woman’s virtue, but that often puts me at odds with those senpai of mine. How troublesome~

lose.line: Hiryuu-senpai may be willing to fight until the bitter end, but... that’s not my style. What a shame~

mail.line: We’ve got mail from HQ, they told us to carry out the Decisive Battle Doctrine. Heh, just kidding~!

main1.line: To always be dealing with those senpai from the First Carrier Division... Commander, you must have a really strong liver.

main2.line: Though our relationship was once one of victim and perpetrator, I look forward to working with you, Lexington.

main3.line: {namecode:96}, if you keep causing trouble for our Eagle Union colleagues, you’ll only get tempura for dinner tonight~

mission.line: Let me take a look the mission... It’s not the Coral Sea? That’s too bad~

mission_complete.line: We’re not going to carry out our plans of attrition warfare? Tch~

profile.line: I am {namecode:95}, the flagship of the Fifth Carrier Division. Because my super smart senpai went and got themselves all killed, I had to carry the flag of the Sakura Empire’s carrier divisions. Though I was more accomplished than them, for whatever reason, I was always considered weaker. Maybe it was due to my "lack of grace and speed" during my final moments... With that said, allow me to reintroduce myself. I am Shoukaku, the punching bag of the Sakura Empire. Please take care of me from now on~

propose.line: The melody of my flute is like a flowing river, requiring an inspiration that usually can only be found atop a mountain. Just being by your side, however, inspires me even more.

skill.line: This is the privilege of being the elder sister!

touch.line: Commander, would you like to hear me play my flute?

touch2.line: Commander, come and indulge yourself in {namecode:95}'s tenderness.

unlock.line: As the flagship of the Fifth Carrier Division, I, Shoukaku, shall do my best to become as good as those esteemed senpai in the First Carrier Division, or something... *giggles* That was on purpose~

upgrade.line: Now, I can protect {namecode:96} better!

win_mvp.line: The Glory of the 5th Carrier Divison is here! *giggles*

battle.line: A never-ending swarm of enemies? I’m already used to it.

couple_encourage1.line: I'm fearless, as long as my sister is with me!

couple_encourage2.line: I don't know why, but I just find you terribly annoying...

couple_encourage3.line: That ties up the score. Next round decides the winner!

couple_encourage4.line: Uwah! When did you get here?!

couple_encourage5.line: I never thought I'd fight alongside the Grey Ghost herself!

detail.line: That Grey Ghost... I’d like to duel her just once.

expedition.line: If only I had more planes...!

feeling1.line: Commander, would you like a taste of the anguish I experienced during the Battle of the Marianas?

feeling2.line: Seniors and juniors... they’re all such a pain.

feeling3.line: My fate always seems to be entertwined with Lexington’s... Ah~ Commander, please don’t tell Sara I said that. I can’t handle that girl.

feeling4.line: Whenever I feel irritated or lost, training always makes me feel at ease. Yes, I’ll definitely get stronger and catch up to that Grey Ghost one day.

feeling5.line: Commander, you make me feel just as if I am with Shoukaku. H-huh? That’s not it! I’m not treating you as my sister!

home.line: I’ll need you to perform some maintenance on me. Ah, don’t forget about the planes either!

hp_warning.line: Shoukaku... Is Shoukaku all right?

login.line: Where are we going today? Pearl Harbor? Or perhaps the Coral Sea?

lose.line: Am I going to be sunk... again...?

mail.line: So? Is it good news or bad news?

main1.line: {namecode:95} is so cute when she’s embarrassed!

main2.line: Keep fighting until the last arrow is broken! That is what it means to be an elite!

main3.line: Wait, Grey Ghost, don’t run away just because you won! Let’s have a rematch!

mission.line: Is it time for a break? Commander, you should come try some of {namecode:95}’s cooking!

mission_complete.line: Hmm... Seems like the situation has taken a turn for the better!

profile.line: I’m {namecode:96} from the Fifth Carrier Divison, though I was assigned to the First Carrier Division at one point. Together with my sister Shoukaku, we became the last two elite carriers of the Sakura Empire. We triumphed in bitter battles against Lexington, Hornet, and even Enterprise. That’s right, I was even able to severely damage the Grey Ghost herself, although she proved to be luckier than me. My service came to an end when Lexington, risen from the dead, sunk me. In the end, I still completed my final mission and sank with no regrets.

propose.line: E-eh?! Th-this is... I’m not misunderstanding you, right? Then... um, from now on, I’ll be in your care, dar... darling? Waaah! Shoukaku is calling me!

skill.line: As long as Shoukaku is with me~!

touch.line: My least favorite food? Turkey, of course.

touch2.line: Commander, {namecode:95}’s are larger and softer...

unlock.line: I am {namecode:96}, the last elite of the Sakura Empire’s Carrier Divisions. I can only be at my best when I am with my sister {namecode:95}.

upgrade.line: As a perfected aircraft carrier, I shall not lose to anyone, not even to my seniors or to the Grey Ghost herself.

win_mvp.line: I am the auspicious crane, after all!

battle.line: The fate of our country rests upon this battle!

couple_encourage1.line: We fight together for humanity itself!

couple_encourage2.line: Steel yourself! And press the attack!

couple_encourage3.line: Never fear, the Sakura Empire is your ever steadfast ally.

couple_encourage4.line: Be careful. Misuse that power and we're worm food.

detail.line: A flagship must lead from the vanguard. This is a self-evident truth.

expedition.line: Without robust logistics, even the mightiest fleets will turn into a disorderly mob.

feeling1.line: You Showa-born brat!

feeling2.line: Thinking about how I won't see old friends from back in my day ever again, it's... Well, never mind. I have people who look up to me now, and I can't let them down!

feeling3.line: If you don't have a plan to end a war, then you'd better not start one to begin with!

feeling4.line: Yes, I can tell you've been working hard. B- but! That doesn't mean you get to start goldbricking now!

feeling5.line: You can't fire on all four boilers all the time. Listen, I'm going to look the other way while you take five... You've been wanting to nap on my lap? I-I guess that'd be okay...

home.line: Excellent! The scales of war are tipping in our favor!

hp_warning.line: Keep calm! This battle is far from over!

login.line: Until we've reclaimed our former glory, we must never stop pressing forward!

lose.line: So this what it must have felt like to suffer through the Battle of Dan-no-ura...

mail.line: No matter how many medals and honors I receive... Ehehe~♪

main1.line: The victory at Tsushima did not occur by chance.

main2.line: Royal cuisine? I'll pass... I've had enough of that.

main3.line: Those things flying through the sky... Err, they're called "ear-playings," right?

mission.line: Hmm, I'm in charge of today's fleet operations? Very well... the fate of our country rests... mmf! ... Why aren't you letting me speak?

mission_complete.line: Very well. I shall plunder... I mean, receive the spoils of victory!

profile.line: I am Mikasa, a Shikishima-type battleship, and last of the Six-Six Fleet shipbuilding program. I served as the flagship of the Combined Fleet, and won a glorious victory that honored the name of our country across the world.

propose.line: You still got a long way to go to earn my respect! ... Hehehe, so that's why I better stick by you♪ 'Til you're too good even for me.

skill.line: Let every ship do her utmost!

touch.line: Even the most hardworking people sometimes have lapses of judgment. It is my duty to admonish you in times like these.

touch2.line: You'd like me to be your dance partner at the next banquet? ... I-I suppose I have no choice...

unlock.line: I am the one who braved a hail of bullets and shells to return to my homeland with glory and victory. I am Mikasa, pre-dreadnought battleship of the Sakura Empire and flagship of the 1st Fleet, awaiting your command!

upgrade.line: Only the battlefield can separate the wheat from the chaff.

win_mvp.line: Through righteousness comes prosperity. Such is the will of the heavens.

battle.line: Hehe, shall we go enjoy the festivities?

couple_encourage1.line: Are you still waiting for your sister?

detail.line: Hehe~ Which do you prefer: matcha, or black tea?

expedition.line: Welcome back, everyone. Hopefully, none of you encountered any suspicious people?

feeling1.line: What a pity...

feeling2.line: Ehehe~ Commander, is there something on your mind?

feeling3.line: That Kirishima... She's actually quite the popular one...

feeling4.line: Being able to see everyone's smiles at the banquet makes all the hard work and preparation worth it.

feeling5.line: Commander, after tonight's banquet... will you be free? Hehe, please look forward to it~

home.line: Welcome back. The tea has just been brewed to the right temperature.

hp_warning.line: Commander... It's too early to give up just yet!

login.line: There is nothing more relaxing than a banquet following a battle... By the way, Commander, I'm free after this...

lose.line: Was I bested...?

mail.line: Are all of these new letters? Thank you for your hard work.

main1.line: *Sigh*... Whenever Kirishima comes to a banquet, all those kids that tag along with her usually end up making a mess of things...

main2.line: When it comes to warfare, wisdom and courage are equally important. We can't count on another miracle if we discard proper planning and rely on blind courage.

main3.line: Commander, I'll be able to protect you, no matter the situation. Hehe, I am called an "Imperial Ship" because I have that capacity after all~♪

mission.line: Let's finish while we still have the momentum!

mission_complete.line: Hehe, shall we celebrate by holding a banquet tonight?

profile.line: I am Hiei, the first Kongou-class battleship born in the Land of the Rising Sun. As an Imperial Ship, I witnessed the growth of our mighty fleet, and led our forces into the Battle of the Solomon Sea. Commander, have you finished your preparations? The banquet is about to begin.

propose.line: So this means... "We'll always be forever?" Thank you very much. I'll gladly accept it - however... If anything was to happen to us, I hope that you would consider yourself first...

skill.line: Be swept away by the raging waves!

touch.line: I can take you anywhere the ocean reaches.

touch2.line: Hehe. Commander, have you not gotten enough sleep yet?

unlock.line: I am the Imperial Ship Hiei, second of the Kongou-class, reporting for duty. Commander, where shall we go next?

upgrade.line: Today's breeze feels more pleasant than usual.

win_mvp.line: It was no big deal~

battle.line: The enemy can't hide from me.

couple_encourage1.line: Penny, cover me!

couple_encourage2.line: SG, full area scan! I will never let that tragedy repeat itself!

couple_encourage3.line: Chicky Unit... sounds kind of cute!

detail.line: I can't rely on this thing alone...

expedition.line: Hey, Commander, could I lend my SG radar to my sisters this time?

feeling1.line: SG, protect me...

feeling2.line: If only my recon could help the others...

feeling3.line: My expression? Ah... it's because I left while we were on the losing end of the war... I might just not be so used to peace and happiness. But don't worry, I'll be fine!

feeling4.line: I think I've been more at ease lately... No, I was just too tense up until now. It's all thanks to the courage you've given me by being beside me.

feeling5.line: I believe that you will bring us hope, Commander. This time, I'll fight to the end... Just the thought of saying goodbye to the person I love makes me feel like my heart will tear in half...

home.line: Did everyone make it back safe and sound? Good. But there's spare parts lying around in the docks now... I wonder why...

hp_warning.line: SG, lock on the enemy position!

login.line: ... Ah, welcome back, Commander. Sorry, I was just brooding over something.

lose.line: ... Please, save me... Ignore the enemy, just let them go...

mail.line: You've got new mail. It's important to stay in touch with your loved ones.

main1.line: Are you trying to hide, Commander? No matter where you hide, I know where you are.

main2.line: Commander, what should we do after the war?

main3.line: If only my guns could be as strong as my radar...

mission.line: Bit by bit we'll build the foundation for victory. We'll start by doing missions.

mission_complete.line: Resources are no good if they just pile up. We should make use of them.

profile.line: I was designed to be on par with heavy cruisers, but just my power alone isn't enough to save everyone... Commander, can you help me?

propose.line: A promise... from you, Commander? I see... I'm so happy...

touch.line: Hm? I'm fine. I'm just... a little distracted.

touch2.line: If this makes you feel good, then... I'm fine with it.

unlock.line: Nice to meet you, Commander. I'm Helena. My strong suit is enemy reconnaissance. Please... guide us towards victory.

upgrade.line: I'll use this power to protect everyone!

win_mvp.line: ... We actually won?

battle.line: Don’t be overconfident, and try not to be so nervous while focusing on winning~

detail.line: Being stared like that makes a bit shy...

expedition.line: The commission is over, they should be back soon~

feeling1.line: Commander, I'm gonna get angry.

feeling2.line: Commander remembers me~ Not that I’m boasting or anything, but I still have confidence in my low sense of existence. (smiles wryly)

feeling3.line: If you’re only going by appearances, every child in this fleet looks cute. But in terms of personality, they all have their unique quirks. To be honest, I am a bit envious of them. (strokes chin).

feeling4.line: I always believe there is nothing wrong with being ordinary. But after meeting you Commander, I want to change myself a little... after all, my sisters are all so charismatic~ Well.. Commander, are you fond of bunny girls?~

feeling5.line: Do you want to eat something later Commander? And then you can accompany me to go shopping, if you want to get something then let’s go together. Then... hehe... let’s take a walk in the park? Commander, everywhere I go as long as I’m with you will be just fine~

home.line: Ah, hold on, your collar is all messed up. Stand still while I fix it... there you go~ (waves).

hp_warning.line: Sisters, hold on!

login.line: Welcome back~

lose.line: Not so successful... let's try again next time.

mail.line: You’ve got new mail~

main1.line: What do I wear inside? It's not something that’s so significant

main2.line: If I think about it, I certainly have been to many places... seen many landscapes, and also parted ways with many people.

main3.line: Sometimes I get so envious of my younger sister Washington and how she’s so energetic all the time.

mission.line: It’s not good to leave tasks unfinished.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards were sent out, are you not going to pick it up?

profile.line: I am North Carolina class ship no.1. I can be considered the big sister battleship of the Eagle Union~ I don’t particularly like or dislike anything, so to speak. Even though I have fought in all kinds of engagements, I have not gained any fame... I am a little bit troubled by this.

propose.line: Well, your trust deserves to be rewarded... umm... Commander, do you like bunny girls?~

touch.line: Do you need help with something?

touch2.line: Not good...

unlock.line: North Carolina here, awaiting your dispatch. Although I may seem to have a bland personality compared to my sisters. But as the saying goes, no personality is still a personality, hehe. Anyways, awaiting your orders, sir.

upgrade.line: I'll try to work a bit harder~

win_mvp.line: If the Commander gives me a few praises, then I will be very happy~

battle.line: Ok, let’s work out. (Snickers)

detail.line: Hmm, you want to know how well I fight?

expedition.line: Your memory can’t be worse than mine, right? The commission fleet has returned, won’t you go greet them?

feeling1.line: You are too weak, it’s no fun playing with you, go practice some more.

feeling2.line: What must I do to possess a good smile... think about the things I like? If so, I feel very happy even at the thought of winning against South Dakota... muahahaha...

feeling3.line: No, no, that’s not right. If we do it this way, won’t it end much the same like in the past? … Don’t try so hard? You sometimes say stuff like that… Hmm? That was a good smile from me just now?

feeling4.line: Lately, my smile has become more natural? Emm, huh (scratches head), I was recently trying to find a new hobby. While I was searching, I realized that being with you is not so bad… (whispers)

feeling5.line: I couldn’t help but smile when I saw you, this is the first time that I’m feeling this way... although, I also have other feelings rushing towards me. I suddenly want to see your expression when you are bullied by me—— Commander, stay with me for a while. (Laughs)

home.line: I’m glad that you didn’t get hurt—— What?! I don’t have feelings for you!

hp_warning.line: I won't let go of victories to my enemies!

login.line: Welcome back... how does my smile look? (Forcibly smiles)

lose.line: Oh, I will not forget you!

mail.line: Hey, your mail.

main1.line: My smile looks beautiful? You jerk... oops, keep smiling, keep smiling. Thank you for your compliments.

main2.line: Hey, that rigid South Dakota is still the same. Commander, you see, I am cuter than her.

main3.line: A true measurement of friendship is their actions and not their words, I don’t like people who are rhetorical in nature.

mission.line: A new mission? Haha, now my blood is boiling.

mission_complete.line: Go grab the reward yourself, I’m not interested.

profile.line: North Carolina class ship no. 2. I am Washington! The thing I like to do the most is to destroy my enemies. Recently, I am practicing on my smile. —— Battle record? I don’t really show off with such things, all in all, how’s my smile?

propose.line: Wait wait! We’re doing “that”, right? Is this your new way of teasing me!... Damn, you bastard, I’m not sure if I should cry or laugh about this...

skill.line: Out of my way. I'm ready to fight!

touch.line: Don’t touch me as if you’re trying to be intimate with me.

touch2.line: ...You wish to die? (Smiles)

unlock.line: Hello, Commander, I am Washington... my sister told me that I cannot be so rough once I join the fleet, so I am practicing my smile. Darn, why must I listen to her...

upgrade.line: It feels so good to become stronger.

win_mvp.line: Sure enough, I am happiest when all the foes are annihilated~

battle.line: I would never let the commander's enemies escape!

couple_encourage1.line: Do you want to race this old lady?

couple_encourage2.line: Unmatched by any? *Sigh*...

couple_encourage3.line: Elegance does not belong on the battlefield.

couple_encourage4.line: Your Majesty, please look forward to my performance in battle.

couple_encourage5.line: Youngsters, follow me.

detail.line: Don't be blinded by statistics. Victory depends on far more!

expedition.line: Commissions? I suppose I do miss running around on errands... Let's go. We need to welcome back those hard workers!

feeling1.line: Would you please not act like we're close...

feeling2.line: Commander, want to hear about the history of the Royal Navy? Maybe I should tell you something about the generals who used to accompany me.

feeling3.line: I'm not very elegant? I'm sorry that I'm not like Hood or the others... No... I'm not talking about my body...

feeling4.line: How do I put this... I'm considered to be one of the older girls, yet my body is like this... It might be unbecoming of one my age to compete with the younger girls, but I wanted to at least be attractive to you… What is a lady meant to do…

feeling5.line: Well, enough of that. I'm Warspite, the one who spites war. Hmph! However, whosoever tries to take the Commander away from me will first have to face my cannons!

home.line: Whew, not a bad fight. Let's rest for a while.

hp_warning.line: So this is how harsh the battlefield can be.

login.line: As long as I'm here, we can deal with any enemy, no matter how far they are.

lose.line: My damage control isn't functioning?! I've lost control of my steering wheel as well! Why now, at such a critical moment?!

mail.line: You've got mail, Commander!

main1.line: Your orders are absolute, Commander. They shall be my highest priority.

main2.line: This grand old lady can run faster without a skirt. Want to race with me?

main3.line: If you make fun of me one more time, you'll be eating my 15 inch shells!

mission.line: Accept your new mission and then get ready to head out, Commander!

mission_complete.line: Missions give out rewards once you complete them. Don't forget that!

profile.line: Elizabeth-class fast battleship, Warspite, reporting in. I hold the record for the longest ranged hit on a moving target. I've come close to being defeated quite a few times, but I managed to cheat death every time. This must be my fate.

propose.line: Finally the day has come! It looks like my efforts were not in vain... Let's go, Commander, I'm prepared for this. Officers, draw swords!

touch.line: Body contact...? I don't hate it...

touch2.line: Just so you understand, I'm definitely not that sort of, erm...

unlock.line: Greetings, I'm Warspite. I hold the record for the longest ranged hit on a moving target. Surprised? I'm smaller than you thought? Looks like we need to have a long talk...

upgrade.line: Battlefield, I'm coming for you.

win_mvp.line: Don't be confined by the so-called "limits". It is indeed possible to be unsinkable!

feeling3.line: 诶，指挥官也在这里呀。秘密基地？诶嘿嘿，我不太清楚呢~说回来，指挥官看到我的点心了吗？不，那东西可不能吃

battle.line: You can't run anymore!

lose.line: Never again... will I repeat the failures of the past!

win_mvp.line: Heheh~ The goddess of victory now stands on our side!

win_mvp.line: Heheh~ The goddess of victory now stands on our side!

lose.line: Never again... will I repeat the failures of the past!

win_mvp.line: Heheh~ The goddess of victory now stands on our side!

battle.line: Venture forth!

couple_encourage1.line: Teaming up with old rivals doesn't feel so bad.

couple_encourage2.line: Time to show you the true meaning of invincibility!

couple_encourage3.line: Such a playful old partner!

couple_encourage4.line: Brave Eagles, we fight until the end!

couple_encourage5.line: Heh, want to square off against me?

couple_encourage6.line: We all know each other. Come on, let's go!

detail.line: Want to look at my medal collection?

expedition.line: I've been on the battlefield for a long time, so I know about the importance of logistics. Commander, let's greet the girls who work hard behind the scenes.

feeling1.line: ...Commander, you don't seem to have enough courage

feeling2.line: It is my wish to live honestly and sincerely. That's why I'll speak my mind if I have something to say. You too should do the same without holding back.

feeling3.line: All the lights in the sky are stars, just as all the lights on the seas are enemies... Commander, will there be a day where there's no more fighting?

feeling4.line: There's no meaning in being peerless. As long as you are here, Commander, I can draw upon all of my strength. Let us end this war.

feeling5.line: What do you want to do after the war? --Me? I'll probably stick with you. I feel the safest out of battle when I'm with you. Will you... take me along with you?

home.line: It's one battle after another, huh...

hp_warning.line: Interesting...!

login.line: You've come. If it's fighting, I'm ready for it any time.

lose.line: I've lost after giving my all. I'm not regretting this...

mail.line: Commander, it's a new mail.

main1.line: Is it you, Commander? ...Recently, I'm thinking about whether or not I can engage in anti-submarine actions...

main2.line: Luck is also a part of strength? Then if possible, I'd like to impart some of it to my older sister.

main3.line: So long as we live, there are things that will never go our way. When we die, it must happen in a way that carries no regrets.

mission.line: Commander, your missions are not yet completed.  Hurry up and set off!

mission_complete.line: Commander, the rewards are here.

profile.line: I am the Yorktown class aircraft carrier, Enterprise. "Grey Ghost" is one of the many nicknames I have. My smoke-covered and bloodstained battle record is a reminder of my mission. I will continue to be victorious until the war ends.

propose.line: I carry with me the hopes and wills of the countless battlefields and goodbyes that I have experienced. Commander, are you prepared to shoulder them all? …I see. Then let us walk together until the end of our lives.

couple_encourage1.line: Zuikaku, give it your all! I'll cover you!

couple_encourage2.line: Do you see my true power, Akagi?

couple_encourage3.line: This time... I'll prove to you how powerful I really am!

couple_encourage4.line: Heehee~ I won't be able to protect you if you stray too far.

couple_encourage5.line: Where is the Queen of the Docks heading to, hmm? Heehee~

detail.line: The melody of my flute is a requiem for the dead. Shall I play it for you?

expedition.line: This is all required to carry out the Circle Five Plan.

feeling1.line: I think I just saw a future in which you were cut down by {namecode:91}, Commander.

feeling2.line: My sister {namecode:96} and I held on for two years during the darkest of times. If only our senpai could have worked a little bit harder.

feeling3.line: Do I hold a grudge against the First and Second Carrier Divisions? Of course~ For them to leave us behind like that, wouldn’t anyone complain in that situation?

feeling4.line: Those senpai are so sly! Just when I was about to overtake them, they went somewhere I could never reach! How unfair!

feeling5.line: Commander, could you lend me your shoulder? Sometimes, even I want to simply clear my mind and rest. When I get like that, can I depend on you to be by my side?

home.line: The girls have returned safely to port, just like the Fifth Carrier Division always does.

hp_warning.line: Pump water to the other side! Hurry!

login.line: Intelligence is said to be a woman’s virtue, but that often puts me at odds with those senpai of mine. How troublesome~

lose.line: Hiryuu-senpai may be willing to fight until the bitter end, but... that’s not my style. What a shame~

mail.line: We’ve got mail from HQ, they told us to carry out the Decisive Battle Doctrine. Heh, just kidding~!

mission.line: Let me take a look the mission... It’s not the Coral Sea? That’s too bad~

mission_complete.line: We’re not going to carry out our plans of attrition warfare? Tch~

propose.line: The melody of my flute is like a flowing river, requiring an inspiration that usually can only be found atop a mountain. Just being by your side, however, inspires me even more.

skill.line: This is the privilege of being the elder sister!

touch.line: Commander, would you like to hear me play my flute?

touch2.line: Commander, come and indulge yourself in {namecode:95}'s tenderness.

unlock.line: As the flagship of the Fifth Carrier Division, I, Shoukaku, shall do my best to become as good as those esteemed senpai in the First Carrier Division, or something... *giggles* That was on purpose~

upgrade.line: Now, I can protect {namecode:96} better!

win_mvp.line: The Glory of the 5th Carrier Divison is here! *giggles*

battle.line: A never-ending swarm of enemies? I’m already used to it.

couple_encourage1.line: Nothing scares me as long as you're here, sis!

couple_encourage2.line: I don't know why, I just don't like you...

couple_encourage3.line: We're still even! Next time, I'll settle it for good!

couple_encourage4.line: Whoa! When'd Saratoga get here?!

couple_encourage5.line: I can't believe I'm here, fighting alongside the Grey Ghost!

detail.line: That Grey Ghost... I’d like to duel her just once.

expedition.line: If only I had more planes...!

feeling1.line: Commander, would you like a taste of the anguish I experienced during the Battle of the Marianas?

feeling2.line: Seniors and juniors... they’re all such a pain.

feeling3.line: My fate always seems to be entertwined with Lexington’s... Ah~ Commander, please don’t tell Sara I said that. I can’t handle that girl.

feeling4.line: Whenever I feel irritated or lost, training always makes me feel at ease. Yes, I’ll definitely get stronger and catch up to that Grey Ghost one day.

feeling5.line: Commander, you make me feel just as if I am with Shoukaku. H-huh? That’s not it! I’m not treating you as my sister!

home.line: I’ll need you to perform some maintenance on me. Ah, don’t forget about the planes either!

hp_warning.line: Shoukaku... Is Shoukaku all right?

login.line: Where are we going today? Pearl Harbor? Or perhaps the Coral Sea?

lose.line: Am I going to be sunk... again...?

mail.line: So? Is it good news or bad news?

main1.line: {namecode:95} is so cute when she’s embarrassed!

main2.line: Keep fighting until the last arrow is broken! That is what it means to be an elite!

main3.line: Wait, Grey Ghost, don’t run away just because you won! Let’s have a rematch!

mission.line: Is it time for a break? Commander, you should come try some of {namecode:95}’s cooking!

mission_complete.line: Hmm... Seems like the situation has taken a turn for the better!

propose.line: E-eh?! Th-this is... I’m not misunderstanding you, right? Then... um, from now on, I’ll be in your care, dar... darling? Waaah! Shoukaku is calling me!

skill.line: As long as Shoukaku is with me~!

touch.line: My least favorite food? Turkey, of course.

touch2.line: Commander, {namecode:95}’s are larger and softer...

unlock.line: I am {namecode:96}, the last elite of the Sakura Empire’s Carrier Divisions. I can only be at my best when I am with my sister {namecode:95}.

upgrade.line: As a perfected aircraft carrier, I shall not lose to anyone, not even to my seniors or to the Grey Ghost herself.

win_mvp.line: I am the auspicious crane, after all!

battle.line: Everyone, go~! Waaah?! My guns fired on accident!

detail.line: Milord, you smell really nice~

expedition.line: Milord, the girls have returned from commissions!

feeling1.line: You're so boring, Milord. I don't want to play with you anymore.

feeling2.line: Milord, come play with me! Ah... I forgot to bring stuff to play with... what should we do?

feeling3.line: I love my sister, but she's a bit too quiet sometimes. Milord, I like spending time with you more because you'll play with me!

feeling4.line: Your Majesty, do you know this mask? It's a fox mask used in Kagura. Hehe, I'm actually about to practice my Kagura dance now. Do you want to watch?

feeling5.line: I know how hard my big sister works, so for her sake, I know that I should allow myself to be happy. That way, I can share my happiness with her. Now that you are here, Milord, I think I'll finally be able to do that. I feel so happy every time I see you!

home.line: Welcome back, Milord, I made you some tea... Woah! Watch out!

login.line: Milord, milord! What shall we do today?

lose.line: Uu... Sister... where are you? *sobs*

mail.line: Milord! Milord! Your mail is here!

mission.line: Milord! New missions!

mission_complete.line: Milord, milord! I've brought the rewards... Oops!

propose.line: Milord? You're going to give this to me? ...Even though I am slow-footed and far from perfect? Milord, you are far too kind. I love you too.

touch.line: Milord... that tickles!

touch2.line: Woah! Watch out, Milord! I'm about to fire my main gun!

unlock.line: Woah! It's Milord! Milord in person! Um... I'm Yamahi-, {namecode:79}! I am pleased to make your acquaintance.

upgrade.line: I've gotten stronger... I think!

win_mvp.line: Milord, did you see that? Did you?

battle.line: Don’t be overconfident, and try not to be so nervous while focusing on winning~

detail.line: Being stared like that makes a bit shy...

expedition.line: The commission is over, they should be back soon~

feeling1.line: Commander, I'm gonna get angry.

feeling2.line: Commander remembers me~ Not that I’m boasting or anything, but I still have confidence in my low sense of existence. (smiles wryly)

feeling3.line: If you’re only going by appearances, every child in this fleet looks cute. But in terms of personality, they all have their unique quirks. To be honest, I am a bit envious of them. (strokes chin).

feeling4.line: I always believe there is nothing wrong with being ordinary. But after meeting you Commander, I want to change myself a little... after all, my sisters are all so charismatic~ Well.. Commander, are you fond of bunny girls?~

home.line: Ah, hold on, your collar is all messed up. Stand still while I fix it... there you go~ (waves).

hp_warning.line: Sisters, hold on!

login.line: Welcome back~

lose.line: Not so successful... let's try again next time.

mail.line: You’ve got new mail~

mission.line: It’s not good to leave tasks unfinished.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards were sent out, are you not going to pick it up?

propose.line: Well, your trust deserves to be rewarded... umm... Commander, do you like bunny girls?~

touch.line: Do you need help with something?

touch2.line: Not good...

unlock.line: North Carolina here, awaiting your dispatch. Although I may seem to have a bland personality compared to my sisters. But as the saying goes, no personality is still a personality, hehe. Anyways, awaiting your orders, sir.

upgrade.line: I'll try to work a bit harder~

win_mvp.line: If the Commander gives me a few praises, then I will be very happy~

battle.line: Ok, let’s work out. (Snickers)

detail.line: Hmm, you want to know how well I fight?

expedition.line: Your memory can’t be worse than mine, right? The commission fleet has returned, won’t you go greet them?

feeling1.line: You are too weak, it’s no fun playing with you, go practice some more.

feeling2.line: What must I do to possess a good smile... think about the things I like? If so, I feel very happy even at the thought of winning against South Dakota... muahahaha...

feeling3.line: No, no, that’s not right. If we do it this way, won’t it end much the same like in the past? … Don’t try so hard? You sometimes say stuff like that… Hmm? That was a good smile from me just now?

feeling4.line: Lately, my smile has become more natural? Emm, huh (scratches head), I was recently trying to find a new hobby. While I was searching, I realized that being with you is not so bad… (whispers)

home.line: I’m glad that you didn’t get hurt—— What?! I don’t have feelings for you!

hp_warning.line: I won't let go of victories to my enemies!

login.line: Welcome back... how does my smile look? (Forcibly smiles)

lose.line: Oh, I will not forget you!

mail.line: Hey, your mail.

mission.line: A new mission? Haha, now my blood is boiling.

mission_complete.line: Go grab the reward yourself, I’m not interested.

profile.line: North Carolina class ship no. 2. I am Washington! The thing I like to do the most is to destroy my enemies. Recently, I am practicing on my smile. —— Battle record? I don’t really show off with such things, all in all, how’s my smile?

propose.line: Wait wait! We’re doing “that”, right? Is this your new way of teasing me!... Damn, you bastard, I’m not sure if I should cry or laugh about this...

skill.line: Out of my way. I'm ready to fight!

touch.line: Don’t touch me as if you’re trying to be intimate with me.

touch2.line: ...You wish to die? (Smiles)

unlock.line: Hello, Commander, I am Washington... my sister told me that I cannot be so rough once I join the fleet, so I am practicing my smile. Darn, why must I listen to her...

upgrade.line: It feels so good to become stronger.

win_mvp.line: Sure enough, I am happiest when all the foes are annihilated~

battle.line: Venture forth!

couple_encourage1.line: Teaming up with old rivals doesn't feel so bad.

couple_encourage2.line: You're about to witness true peerlessness!

couple_encourage3.line: You can't help but mess around, huh?

couple_encourage4.line: Warriors of the Eagle Union, we fight 'til the end!

couple_encourage5.line: Heh, think you can take me on?

couple_encourage6.line: We all know each other. Come on, let's go!

couple_encourage7.line: Alright, let me see what you're made of!

couple_encourage8.line: I'm counting on you. Don't fall behind!

couple_encourage9.line: So this is the power of friendship...

couple_encourage10.line: I feel like... if you'd been there, Akagi might have...

detail.line: Want to look at my medal collection?

expedition.line: I've been on the battlefield for a long time, so I know about the importance of logistics. Commander, let's greet the girls who work hard behind the scenes.

feeling1.line: ...Commander, you don't seem to have enough courage

feeling2.line: It is my wish to live honestly and sincerely. That's why I'll speak my mind if I have something to say. You too should do the same without holding back.

feeling3.line: All the lights in the sky are stars, just as all the lights on the seas are enemies... Commander, will there be a day where there's no more fighting?

feeling4.line: There's no meaning in being peerless. As long as you are here, Commander, I can draw upon all of my strength. Let us end this war.

feeling5.line: What do you want to do after the war? --Me? I'll probably stick with you. I feel the safest out of battle when I'm with you. Will you... take me along with you?

home.line: It's one battle after another, huh...

hp_warning.line: Interesting...!

login.line: You've come. If it's fighting, I'm ready for it any time.

lose.line: I've lost after giving my all. I'm not regretting this...

mail.line: Commander, it's a new mail.

mission.line: Commander, your missions are not yet completed.  Hurry up and set off!

mission_complete.line: Commander, the rewards are here.

profile.line: I am the Yorktown class aircraft carrier, Enterprise. "Grey Ghost" is one of the many nicknames I have. My smoke-covered and bloodstained battle record is a reminder of my mission. I will continue to be victorious until the war ends.

propose.line: I carry with me the hopes and wills of the countless battlefields and goodbyes that I have experienced. Commander, are you prepared to shoulder them all? …I see. Then let us walk together until the end of our lives.

touch.line: What is it? Sortie time?

touch2.line: What the...?!

unlock.line: Second ship of the Yorktown class, Enterprise, reporting for duty. I will neither sympathize nor hold back with my enemies, and instead, I go all out. Such is my way.

upgrade.line: I will show you... what lies at the end of power

win_mvp.line: Commander, tell me. How many more do I have to sink?

battle.line: Sinful roses of blood, bloom around me! Bloom!

couple_encourage1.line: Karma shall find thee one day.

couple_encourage2.line: Stop struggling in futility, my~ little~ kitten~

detail.line: Dost thy heart cry restlessly in my absence?
