expedition.line: O mesmerising Narcissus, do remember my warning when greeting those who return. Be misled not by the illusions swirling in the water.

feeling1.line: It would appear... that I must get a little more violent...

feeling2.line: What a nice gaze. Through thy pupils, I can see another world.

feeling3.line: How thy visage tempts me so with each passing moment... I must ask of thee, just how sweet is thy blood?

feeling4.line: How unfathomable... looking at thy sleeping visage hast made me replete with calmness... Now, pray that thou dost not wake, for I know not what I would do to thee...

feeling5.line: O ignorant snake, hast thou only realised now, how long I have hopelessly been in love with thee? Therefore... would thou give thy everything to me?

home.line: Oh, triumphant nightingale that has overcome death itself, what plagues thee enough to silence thy song?

hp_warning.line: Perhaps I have indulged myself too much...

login.line: O unclean snake, who is it thee lusts after today?

lose.line: Ahh... why dost thou obstinately refuse to obey me...

mail.line: Thy visage when reading and concentrating, unbudging and focused, resembles one of Michelangelo's sculptures. I do not dislike such determination.

mission.line: Such fair weather is rare indeed. 'twould be a pity to return to port so soon.

mission_complete.line: Only the moon and sweet liquor fail to disappoint. We shall share the most unforgettable of nights.

profile.line: I am King George V-class' Duke of York. Scharnhorst? An interesting one indeed, but now, thou art the one who captures my interest the most... My... if thou displays such an expression to me, I won't be able to contain myself...

propose.line: Even the most ingenious poet cannot describe the beauty of this moment. Hehe, close thy eyes, feel my warmth, and listen to the beating of my heart. This is the one who shall be thy lifelong partner...

skill.line: All ye, weep at your own demise!

touch.line: The night is both lengthy and brief. Come, blow out the light burning within thee, and accompany me into the dark.

touch2.line: Ahh, how beautiful... thy eyes, normally placid, burning with the fires of lust...

unlock.line: I see. So the scent that has been driving me crazy... emanates from thy soul. O sinful Commander who tempts me so, engrave my name upon thine heart - Duke of York, of the Royal Navy.

upgrade.line: Did thou hear? A sound that makes my blood boil, like wind passing through the forest in the dead of night.

win_mvp.line: There exists no living being that can resist the embrace of death.

battle.line: Sigh, all that cannons and gunpowder can do is make is war even uglier...

couple_encourage1.line: Pleasure to meet again, little Ms. Flat-As-A-Pancake.

couple_encourage2.line: Illustrious, y-your bust is just too busty!

detail.line: In both love and war, one should be brave~ So, be brave, and if you need support, I shall be there!

expedition.line: Stop loafing around! I promised the commission team that I'd use my planes to photograph the moment they entered the port!

feeling1.line: I'm fed up~! I'll knock you out stone cold!

feeling2.line: You know about me from the Battle of Trafalgar? Umm, aren't you thinking of somebody else? Please, Commander~ Who you're thinking of is totally unrelated to me.

feeling3.line: My part in the pursuit of Bismarck and Operation Tungsten? I was just in the mood to help, I wasn't at all trying to earn any honours.

feeling4.line: I'm not in such a great mood... Are you free, Commander? Great! Then let me dress you in something fabulous! Seeing beautiful things makes me feel better, you see!

feeling5.line: I wonder what the future you will be like, Commander~ Of course, I already quite like the way you are right now. ...Goodness, you're blushing ear to ear. How utterly adorable you are~

home.line: To celebrate your victory, why not wear this olive wreath? I'm certain it'll suit you.

hp_warning.line: Oh dear, I've let my guard down.

login.line: The quiet sea, the cool sea breeze... Even in this moment, the birth of new, beautiful things blesses us.

lose.line: Remaining dignified even in defeat: this is how one should lose a battle!

mail.line: Handwritten letters are so much better than typed ones. Don't you think it's interesting how you can deduce the author's emotions based on their handwriting, Commander?

main1.line: War is ugly. And this olive wreath is the symbol of peace and beauty.

main2.line: Tirpitz, if you won't come out and have fun with me then I'll bomb your room again!

main3.line: I don't like violence, but using it is often the quickest solution to many problems...

mission.line: Only I have the privilege of being selfish. Don't even think about pushing missions onto me.

mission_complete.line: Fine, but just this one time! I won't help you with your missions a second time!

profile.line: I'm Victorious, Illustrious-class aircraft carrier number two! From the Atlantic Ocean to the Indian Ocean, and even the Pacific... where the ocean breeze goes, I follow!

propose.line: Don't think too hard about it. Just follow my lead at your own pace. ...Come on, this is a day to celebrate, don't be so nervous~ From this day on, you'd better work hard to always please me!

skill.line: O beautiful world, sing to me a song!

touch.line: When you feel down, I also do. Come on, you have someone as beautiful as me beside you, so why not be happy?

touch2.line: Y-you just did "that," didn't you?! B-by "that," I mean...

unlock.line: I am the one called Victorious, Aircraft Carrier of the Royal Navy. Yes, sing my name as you herald the coming of the symbol of victory. As long as I am here, our endeavours shall be smooth!

upgrade.line: Words are not needed to praise me! It's not people's words that touch the heart, it's their actions!

win_mvp.line: When my foes have been this thoroughly defeated... not even I, the symbol of victory, can truly be glad.

battle.line: The fate of our country rests upon this battle!

couple_encourage1.line: We fight together for humanity itself!

couple_encourage2.line: Steel yourself! And press the attack!

couple_encourage3.line: Never fear, the Sakura Empire is your ever steadfast ally.

couple_encourage4.line: Be careful. Misuse that power and we're worm food.

detail.line: A flagship must lead from the vanguard. This is a self-evident truth.

expedition.line: Without robust logistics, even the mightiest fleets will turn into a disorderly mob.

feeling1.line: You Showa-born brat!

feeling2.line: Thinking about how I won't see old friends from back in my day ever again, it's... Well, never mind. I have people who look up to me now, and I can't let them down!

feeling3.line: If you don't have a plan to end a war, then you'd better not start one to begin with!

feeling4.line: Yes, I can tell you've been working hard. B- but! That doesn't mean you get to start goldbricking now!

feeling5.line: You can't fire on all four boilers all the time. Listen, I'm going to look the other way while you take five... You've been wanting to nap on my lap? I-I guess that'd be okay...

home.line: Excellent! The scales of war are tipping in our favor!

hp_warning.line: Keep calm! This battle is far from over!

login.line: Until we've reclaimed our former glory, we must never stop pressing forward!

lose.line: So this what it must have felt like to suffer through the Battle of Dan-no-ura...

mail.line: No matter how many medals and honors I receive... Ehehe~?

main1.line: The victory at Tsushima did not occur by chance.

main2.line: Royal cuisine? I'll pass... I've had enough of that.

main3.line: Those things flying through the sky... Err, they're called "ear-playings," right?

mission.line: Hmm, I'm in charge of today's fleet operations? Very well... the fate of our country rests... mmf! ... Why aren't you letting me speak?

mission_complete.line: Very well. I shall plunder... I mean, receive the spoils of victory!

profile.line: I am Mikasa, a Shikishima-type battleship, and last of the Six-Six Fleet shipbuilding program. I served as the flagship of the Combined Fleet, and won a glorious victory that honored the name of our country across the world.

propose.line: You still got a long way to go to earn my respect! ... Hehehe, so that's why I better stick by you? 'Til you're too good even for me.

skill.line: Let every ship do her utmost!

touch.line: Even the most hardworking people sometimes have lapses of judgment. It is my duty to admonish you in times like these.

touch2.line: You'd like me to be your dance partner at the next banquet? ... I-I suppose I have no choice...

unlock.line: I am the one who braved a hail of bullets and shells to return to my homeland with glory and victory. I am Mikasa, pre-dreadnought battleship of the Sakura Empire and flagship of the 1st Fleet, awaiting your command!

upgrade.line: Only the battlefield can separate the wheat from the chaff.

win_mvp.line: Through righteousness comes prosperity. Such is the will of the heavens.

battle.line: Pretty tough, aren't you? You won't cry if I hit you, will you?

couple_encourage1.line: The way you are now... I like it. This is good.

couple_encourage2.line: I envy your defense, sis...

detail.line: Tell me when you're done inspecting.

expedition.line: ... Oh, look. They've brought so much back. I'll go help them out.

feeling1.line: Your body is weak, Commander. Are you eating properly?

feeling2.line: How to get stronger? Uhh, do some push-ups? ... Not working for you?

feeling3.line: Seeing you challenging yourself with things you can't do is... interesting. It makes me want to explore my own limits, too.

feeling4.line: I like how cool you look when you're pushing yourself hard... but overdoing it isn't good. I'll force you to rest if I have to.

feeling5.line: I don't have any dreams. But I have the power to grant them. Commander, do you have a dream for me to grant one day?

home.line: You're back... Did you get hurt? If anyone pokes fun at you, we can talk about it.

hp_warning.line: ... So you want me to get serious?

login.line: For lunch, I'll make... Oh, Commander, are you going for a stroll?

lose.line: Sorry, I got distracted...

mail.line: I'll leave your letter here. Check it later.

mission.line: So many missions waiting on us...

mission_complete.line: Ah, the rewards have arrived... Seems we can afford beef for dinner tonight.

propose.line: Umm, yeah... I already know what you want to do and want to say... Because I love you too, Commander.

touch.line: You want someone to pamper you? ... You want ME to?

touch2.line: ... If you'd move your body more, you'd have fewer weird thoughts.

unlock.line: Hm? Ah... my turn to speak. I'm Massachusetts. I'm just a regular old South Dakota-class you can find anywhere... So, yeah, I hope we can... get along.

upgrade.line: I feel a bit different...

win_mvp.line: It's over already? But I was just warming up... Aren't there any other enemies left?

battle.line: May glory be with us today.

couple_encourage1.line: Miss Renown, please mind where you're going.

couple_encourage2.line: Miss Repulse, mind your manners.

couple_encourage3.line: I shall do anything you ask of me, Your Majesty.

couple_encourage4.line: The glory of the royal family, advancing.

detail.line: Feel free to admire the glory of the Royal Navy to your heart's content.

expedition.line: Having completed numerous commissions is a sign of glory. May I suggest rewarding those girls?

feeling1.line: *Sigh* Seems like you must learn it the hard way.

feeling2.line: Commander, it's such a great afternoon. Shall we have a chat? ... Hm, alright... I'll talk about the times when I was with Renown.

feeling3.line: Though I speak of being refined at all times, you need not force yourself, Commander. Your normal self is the most charming, after all.

feeling4.line: Hm? I'm too close? A lady must be elegant, but they must also seize the initiative towards the targets of their own affection.

feeling5.line: "Shall I compare thee to a summer's day? Thou art more lovely and more temperate... So long as men can breathe, or eyes can see, so long lives this, and this gives life to thee." ... A beautiful verse. Commander, could you read it out loud to me?

home.line: Commander, may I offer you some warm tea? We can drink it as we review your battle.

hp_warning.line: Even I am slightly angered.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Care for a cup of tea?

lose.line: Victory and defeat are commonplace among those who fight, and it is we that have all the time in the world!

mail.line: It's unopened... Commander... It would be ungentlemanly to ignore the messages of others.

main1.line: An outstanding commander must have an in-depth knowledge of tea.

main2.line: This word is... ah, so I read it wrong. Sorry, my eyes fail me.

main3.line: Listen more, speak less. You should listen to the opinions of others, but also retain your own judgment.

mission.line: Commander, we have been entrusted with new missions. Please look through them.

mission_complete.line: With glory comes rewards. Please do not forget about the latter.

profile.line: Indeed, the glory of the Royal Navy now stands before you. Being able to maintain an air of elegance at all times is the hallmark of royalty. The Denmark straits? Soldiers know of victory and defeat alike. It was no more than a temporary setback.

propose.line: Aha, look how nervous you are. You can't convey your feelings to a lady when you're this nervous. However, your feelings have definitely reached my heart... I would happily oblige.

skill.line: Elegance is not just for show.

touch.line: Appropriate contact is indeed essential. Shall we dance?

touch2.line: Commander, you should understand the consequences of disrespecting a lady... Are you prepared?

unlock.line: Are you the commander? Greetings and well met. I am the glory of the Royal Navy: Hood. Wherever I go, victory follows.

upgrade.line: Your efforts will definitely be rewarded.

win_mvp.line: The warm sun and the cool breeze: a brilliant victory.

battle.line: Is that it? Hah! Swordfish squadron, prepare for battle!

couple_encourage1.line: I feel so strong now!

couple_encourage2.line: I've got to set an example for the others!

detail.line: Ark Royal, ready for inspection!

expedition.line: Commissions have been completed, Commander. If there are any cute destroyers in the fleet, allow me to welcome them back myself.

feeling1.line: You can't compare with the destroyers, Commander...

feeling2.line: I... I'm going to say this in advance, but... those destroyer girls... u-um... I mean... I kind of hold them dear... I know how to mind my manners... It's not... it's not a crime!

feeling3.line: I thought you were finally going to have me Court Martialed, Commander! I'm grateful to finally be recognized by you. It's nothing to be ashamed of? Commander, I, Ark Royal, will follow you forever!

feeling4.line: G-good grief... If you were the same size as those destroyers, Commander, I wouldn't be so embarrassed... I was fine with doing this with the little ones... but with you...

feeling5.line: If I were closer to you, Commander, I could get closer with the destroyers too... Of... of course, that can only happen with your approval. I'm more than happy to help you with destroyer inspections! Is that all right, commander?

home.line: Is it time for a break? I'm going to see my destroyer sisters then!

hp_warning.line: If only a destroyer would give me a hug!

login.line: Ready for orders, Commander. I am confident in any kind of battle!

lose.line: Damn, trapped!

mail.line: Do you need to me read out your mail, Commander?

mission.line: Commander, it's a soldier's duty to complete missions!

mission_complete.line: Commander, to leave your rewards unclaimed is disrespect to the mission.

propose.line: I'll take care of all the destroyers from now on! No one can touch Commander or my destroyers. No one!

skill.line: It's time for you to leave!

touch.line: Your warm hands keep me energized to keep fighting, Commander!

touch2.line: Eh... Commander... please don't... Why are you doing this?!

unlock.line: Ark Royal, reporting in for duty! I am confident in all manners of battle. Why, it was I who managed to destroy Bismarck's rudder!

upgrade.line: Oh! oh! oh! Allow me to protect you, my destroyer friends!

win_mvp.line: An enemy who loses their ability to steer will be doomed!

battle.line: Are you girls also trying to get close to Commander? Ahahaha!

couple_encourage1.line: Am I beautiful, Commander?

couple_encourage2.line: Look out for friendly fire~!

couple_encourage3.line: I'm very tolerant, you know...

couple_encourage4.line: Commander, are you testing Akagi's love~?

detail.line: Commander, are you keeping {namecode:91} in your most secret of thoughts? Mmm, how delightful~.

expedition.line: I was hoping that they wouldn’t have come back at all... Commander, I’ve already confirmed the completion of the commission. No more than a glance should be needed from you.

feeling1.line: If Commander was cut up into little pieces, he would never be able to leave Akagi’s side or break her heart ever again... Ahahaha!

feeling2.line: We were destined to meet. I knew at first sight that you were the one I’ve been looking for my whole life.

feeling3.line: You belong to me, and me only, Commander! That's something you should never forget, even if you are in charge of an entire fleet... Or else...

feeling4.line: Commander, why were you talking to that girl? Weren’t you coming to see {namecode:91}? She was tempting you? Then... {namecode:91} is going to make her disappear.

feeling5.line: Commander... With this, nothing will get between us ever again... Your embrace, your smile, your scent... all belong to me.

home.line: Five Minutes of Fate? You mean every five minutes that we spend together?

hp_warning.line: Ahahaha! I’m getting excited!

login.line: Ah, welcome back... Commander, if you had taken any more of your sweet time, I would have turned this place into a sea of fire~

lose.line: This wound is nothing compared to the thought of you abandoning me, Commander!

mail.line: Commander, who sent you this letter? A girl? Who is she?

main1.line: Commander, you’re so cute when you are hard at work. Just watching you makes me feel like I’ll overheat~

main2.line: Don’t make fun of me for being slow-footed. See? I’ve~ caught~ you~

main3.line: You smell like... that girl! Commander, Akagi needs to step out for a bit~

mission.line: A new mission... is another opportunity to deepen our bonds. *giggles*

mission_complete.line: Rewards? Being together with you, Commander, is all the reward I need.

profile.line: I am the glorious Akagi, the pride of the peerless First Carrier Division. With my famed air wing, I shall overcome any battle as long as you are with me. Yes, Commander, as long as we are together...

propose.line: I have waited an eternity for this day to come. No one shall be able to separate us ever again! My mind, body, and soul belong to you, as yours all belong to me. Haha... ahahahaha!

skill.line: My love is invincible! Ahaha... ahahaha!

touch.line: {namecode:91} loves you so, Commander~

touch2.line: If you so desire, I would not mind if you partake of me in front of all the others.

unlock.line: We finally meet, Commander. However, there appear be too many eyesores here. Please allow me to "clean up" a bit before we deepen our relationship. Hehehe~

upgrade.line: Commander, your love is filling up {namecode:91}'s chest...

win_mvp.line: I will do anything for Commander’s sake, even if I must slay a god.

battle.line: Entertain me with your final struggles. Hehehe...

couple_encourage1.line: Sister, please take this seriously.

couple_encourage2.line: The 1st Carrier Division is not to be looked down upon!

couple_encourage3.line: I did not expect to be fighting alongside you all...

couple_encourage4.line: I owe you for that one time, Nagara.

couple_encourage5.line: Fate dealt you an unfortunate hand.

detail.line: Commander, if you keep looking at me like that, you’ll be eaten up.

expedition.line: The girls on commission have returned. Go on ahead, I will prepare some refreshments for them.

feeling1.line: It seems like you're not the hero I was looking for...

feeling2.line: The weak will be eliminated. If you cannot accept that, then simply become stronger.

feeling3.line: Should you be defeated one day, it simply means that you were too weak. That much is a fact of nature. Though... because you are mine, I would at least avenge you.

feeling4.line: I cannot comprehend these emotions... is this some sort of primal instinct?

feeling5.line: I have so much I want to say, but I forget them all the moment I see your face...

home.line: A fitting reward for the ears of our enemies. Let us enjoy the spoils of war leisurely.

hp_warning.line: It’s time for a death match! Heheh- hehehe!

login.line: Justice and righteousness are for the strong only. The weak can only weep in vain.

lose.line: This pain... I shall return it tenfold!

mail.line: Your mail is here. Try not to forget it next time.

main1.line: I shall conquer all, no matter who stands against me.

main2.line: Our enemies may be strong, but that is what makes them worth crushing. Heheh...

main3.line: The girls of the Fifth Carrier Division? They might amount to something if they work hard enough.

mission.line: Commander, stop slacking around. There are still missions to complete.

mission_complete.line: Here are the rewards, the fruits of your labor.

profile.line: I am {namecode:92}, from the First Carrier Division. I was originally designed to be a battleship, but fate had different plans or me. Enemies? I simply slaughter them, but only because it is my duty, not for fun.

propose.line: ... Is this for me? Hm... perhaps it is fate for the strong to be drawn to each other. If that is the case, I shall follow my instincts then. Hehehe~

skill.line: Only the strong may survive on the battlefield!

touch.line: Is there a problem?

touch2.line: ... Fine. If you say it helps you relax...

unlock.line: Will I be able to find a worthy foe here? Very well. I’m yours. Perhaps this, too, is destiny.

upgrade.line: Not bad. I’ve come up with some new combat techniques.

win_mvp.line: Such is the fate of the weak. Death, nothing more.

battle.line: Enemy fleet in sight! All ships, fire at will!

couple_encourage1.line: It's an honor fighting with you!

couple_encourage2.line: Speed: 29 knots! Renown: attacking!

couple_encourage3.line: Renown: firing on enemies upon sight!

detail.line: All systems functioning properly. Do not worry, Commander.

expedition.line: The girls who went out on a commission have arrived. Please, let me go in their stead next time, Commander. I... don't like being on the receiving end of things.

feeling1.line: Commander, you cannot continue like this.

feeling2.line: Love letter? How does one love something like a letter? People love all sorts of things, but that one I cannot understand.

feeling3.line: Commander, you always ask me to accompany you for walks. Is something bothering you?

feeling4.line: ... Why would you arrange candles in a heart on the beach? And then... why did you cry when I said "aren't you afraid of the fire being extinguished by the wind"?

feeling5.line: Don't worry, I'm not that dense. Next time I will bring a cap and cover up the candles for you. Then you can tell me what is truly on your mind.

home.line: I will review this operation's performance and report back to you as soon as I can.

hp_warning.line: Speed is the best defense!

login.line: Commander, please give me your orders.

lose.line: ...I am sorry, Commander... I failed to live up to your expectations.

mail.line: If you have time, please look over the mail.

mission.line: Commander, we still have missions to complete!

mission_complete.line: Please, claim the mission rewards!

propose.line: Wait, Commander... Let... let me find some candles...and make a heart... and some covers to prevent them from being blown out.... t-t-then I'll... Please... don't look at me! I must be making a very strange face right now!

touch.line: ... It's a bit strange... Only you have ever done this to me, Commander...

touch2.line: ...!! Commander! I do not intend to resist... but still...

unlock.line: Renown, Battlecruiser of the Royal Fleet of the Royal Navy, at your service. My guns shall aim where your sword points, Commander.

upgrade.line: Your will is the source of my power.

win_mvp.line: Enemy fleet eliminated. Mission complete.

battle.line: Let us go forth and plant our banners!

couple_encourage1.line: Wales, you'd better not suddenly leave me again!

couple_encourage2.line: York, let us shatter our enemies together.

detail.line: My standing within the Royal Family? Hmm... If I had to draw a comparison, I'd say "Knight Commander" would be the most fitting... Hahaha...

expedition.line: There's some commotion by the port...? Oh, it seems to just be the commission team returning.

feeling1.line: I favor those of character, and those who can cook. Commander, you are neither.

feeling2.line: By the way, Commander, are you a good cook? Hmm? Despite my appearances, I've spent many hours honing my skills to sate my own appetite.

feeling3.line: How's that, commander? Are you impressed by my cooking abilities? Here, have as much you desire. Seeing you enjoy my food pleases me.

feeling4.line: Commander, so you're learning how to cook? Hmm, colour me impressed. I look forward to trying the dish that you're making for me.

feeling5.line: My greatest hobbies in life are food and fighting. While I am more than capable of fighting alone, dining by myself is quite difficult and lonesome. To be able to find someone who can share both of these things with me is truly a joyous thing.

home.line: Commander, did you thoroughly enjoy the battle?

hp_warning.line: Hmph, how interesting!

login.line: Commander, did you already partake of supper?

lose.line: Do not be demoralized. Neither victory nor defeat are decided by a single battle.

mail.line: A letter, huh? Now then, is this a challenge, or a love letter?

mission.line: New missions, eh? It would be ideal if we got something a bit more challenging.

mission_complete.line: Supper tastes best after the day's missions are all complete. Wouldn't you agree, Commander?

propose.line: They say that "the quickest way to one's heart is through their stomach," but you've managed to win over both at once. Commander, shall we share all our meals together from now on?

skill.line: The glory of the sun that never sets shall not fade!

touch.line: Why do I have a mountain of snacks before me? Isn't it obvious? One cannot move on an empty stomach.

touch2.line: Ohh? I wasn't aware that you possessed such audacity, Commander.

unlock.line: So this is my new battlefield. Ahh, how I've long awaited this... By the way, are you my commander? You are in the presence of King George V – do use me well.

upgrade.line: Hmm... I suddenly feel like having a lavish feast.

win_mvp.line: Make no mistakes. I shall ensure both victory and the safety of all my comrades.

battle.line: I would never let the commander's enemies escape!

couple_encourage1.line: Do you want to race this old lady?

couple_encourage2.line: Unmatched by any? *Sigh*...

couple_encourage3.line: Elegance does not belong on the battlefield.

couple_encourage4.line: Your Majesty, please look forward to my performance in battle.

couple_encourage5.line: Youngsters, follow me.

detail.line: Don't be blinded by statistics. Victory depends on far more!

expedition.line: Commissions? I suppose I do miss running around on errands... Let's go. We need to welcome back those hard workers!

feeling1.line: Would you please not act like we're close...

feeling2.line: Commander, want to hear about the history of the Royal Navy? Maybe I should tell you something about the generals who used to accompany me.

feeling3.line: I'm not very elegant? I'm sorry that I'm not like Hood or the others... No... I'm not talking about my body...

feeling4.line: How do I put this... I'm considered to be one of the older girls, yet my body is like this... It might be unbecoming of one my age to compete with the younger girls, but I wanted to at least be attractive to you… What is a lady meant to do…

feeling5.line: Well, enough of that. I'm Warspite, the one who spites war. Hmph! However, whosoever tries to take the Commander away from me will first have to face my cannons!

home.line: Whew, not a bad fight. Let's rest for a while.

hp_warning.line: So this is how harsh the battlefield can be.

login.line: As long as I'm here, we can deal with any enemy, no matter how far they are.

lose.line: My damage control isn't functioning?! I've lost control of my steering wheel as well! Why now, at such a critical moment?!

mail.line: You've got mail, Commander!

main1.line: Your orders are absolute, Commander. They shall be my highest priority.

main2.line: This grand old lady can run faster without a skirt. Want to race with me?

main3.line: If you make fun of me one more time, you'll be eating my 15 inch shells!

mission.line: Accept your new mission and then get ready to head out, Commander!

mission_complete.line: Missions give out rewards once you complete them. Don't forget that!

profile.line: Elizabeth-class fast battleship, Warspite, reporting in. I hold the record for the longest ranged hit on a moving target. I've come close to being defeated quite a few times, but I managed to cheat death every time. This must be my fate.

propose.line: Finally the day has come! It looks like my efforts were not in vain... Let's go, Commander, I'm prepared for this. Officers, draw swords!

touch.line: Body contact...? I don't hate it...

touch2.line: Just so you understand, I'm definitely not that sort of, erm...

unlock.line: Greetings, I'm Warspite. I hold the record for the longest ranged hit on a moving target. Surprised? I'm smaller than you thought? Looks like we need to have a long talk...

upgrade.line: Battlefield, I'm coming for you.

win_mvp.line: Don't be confined by the so-called "limits". It is indeed possible to be unsinkable!

battle.line: Why cause unnecessary conflict?

couple_encourage1.line: You haven't changed one bit, Miss Saratoga.

couple_encourage2.line: May the light illuminate Kaede's Legion!

detail.line: Could you help me pick up that handkerchief...? I'd lose my balance if I try to pick it up myself...

expedition.line: The light shall disperses the fog of darkness. Oh? The girls are back!

feeling1.line: Not even my light can reach the darkness within your heart?

feeling2.line: Commander, what do you find most important in a girl? Seriously, could you look me in the eyes when we're speaking?

feeling3.line: Commander, while I'm like this, I take a special liking towards suprise night attacks. Seriously, I didn't mean it like that, but is the Commander into things like that?

feeling4.line: Commander... do you want to try... a soft landing?

feeling5.line: No matter what you ask of me, Commander, I'll accept it... So, Commander, please tell me how you feel about me.

home.line: Feeling tired? Relax for a while. How about a massage?

hp_warning.line: Don't panic, Commander. I'm here!

login.line: Greetings, Commander. I've tidied up a bit here. What do you think?

lose.line: Let's retreat, lest I lose my life...

mail.line: Here's your mail, Commander! Should I open it for you?

main1.line: Have you seen where did I put my planes? Oh? Right in front of me? Sorry, something blocked my line of sight.

main2.line: Commander... can you feel my heartbeat through the palm of your hand?

main3.line: Commander, why are you always staring at me? Am I that pretty?

mission.line: Commander, it's no good to leave missions unfinished.

mission_complete.line: Don't forget to collect your rewards, Commander!

profile.line: Greetings, Commander. I am the armored aircraft carrier Illustrious. I may seem gentle, but I have quite the temper. I single-handedly bullied the Italian fleet during the raid at Taranto.

propose.line: Even though light should be shared equally among us all, it's fine for you to have a bit more. After all, I've received something important from the Commander as well.

touch.line: It's as though... I've received your recognition, Commander. I feel so relieved.

touch2.line: Seriously, Commander, you're like a little kid.

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander! Aircraft carrier Illustrious reporting in! I pray that you will bring love and peace to this world. May the light be with you.

upgrade.line: This way we can radiate our brilliance even further.

win_mvp.line: The light shines upon our land of triumph.

battle.line: Ladies of the Royal Navy have many virtues, but mercy to enemies is not one of them!

couple_encourage1.line: Illustrious, my dear sister, what would you say to a spot of tea after this?

couple_encourage2.line: Victorious, my dear sister, have I comported myself well today?

detail.line: ?! ... Ah, I was just doing a bit of tidying up. Please, come right in.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission is complete. Shall we go to the harbour and greet the team?

feeling1.line: I'm afraid I've contracted a disease that gives me a dreadful headache when you're nearby. Would you mind going someplace else?

feeling2.line: Commander, is there something required of me? If you have a moment, why not join me for a cup of tea?

feeling3.line: My big sisters Illustrious and Victorious, like so many other ships you've gathered here, vouch for what a great commander you are. Now come, let this cake be a symbol of our new friendship. Take a bite, won't you?

feeling4.line: Truthfully, even though I'm a Lady of the Royal Navy, I sometimes want to have a bit of fun too. A side of me that I can't normally show except to people close to me like Illustrious... Doesn't that make you want to get closer with me?

home.line: Hmm~? Hmm~? C-Commander! I am p-pleased that you have returned!

hp_warning.line: You are all to redouble your efforts!

login.line: Commander, you're uncharacteristically punctual today.

lose.line: Why you miserab- Ahem! You are truly worthy adversaries, but next time victory will be mine!

mail.line: Commander, I'm leaving the mail right here. Please don't forget to review it.

mission.line: Commander, please don't forget to review the mission list I prepared for you.

mission_complete.line: Commander, please don't forget to review the list of mission rewards.

touch.line: I must admit, Tirpitz is quite the hard nut to crack.

touch2.line: Commander, is this the appropriate way for one to behave?

unlock.line: Good day, Commander. I am Formidable, third ship of the Illustrious class. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

upgrade.line: Formidable shall not disappoint.

win_mvp.line: What a magnificent victory! Let us press the advantage.

battle.line: Commence bombardment! We will bury them!

couple_encourage1.line: This is no time to ponder the meaning of life. Just show us your strength!

couple_encourage2.line: Kirov, aid me!

detail.line: Is that you, Comrade Commander...? I'm afraid the office is a bit messy. But we must make sacrifices to achieve our goals.

expedition.line: Military commissions? They are part of the logistical aspect of proper fleet management.

feeling1.line: This negative attitude is unacceptable. You must be forcibly reeducated.

feeling2.line: Your fleet must be an iron curtain... Hm, it's a metaphorical expression... My meaning is that I hope to see this fleet stand united, just like our Northern Parliament.

feeling3.line: Comrade Commander, what is this? You wish to deepen your relationship with me as an individual, not a representative of the Northern Parliament? Well, such subjective decisions are acceptable.

feeling4.line: Mm, this food is well made... Comrade Commander, thank you for serving me this meal, but I have to wonder, is this more than simple social etiquette? C- could you have some ulterior motive for this charm offensive?

feeling5.line: Gah, well done...! I have no choice but to place the pride of the Northern Parliament on the line and face defeat at the hands of Comrade Commander's charm offensive! Now then, Comrade Commander, you face the full power of my love offensive!

home.line: Rest. And tell me now of what glorious victory you have won, or how you turn defeat to our advantage.

hp_warning.line: It's not fatal damage...!

login.line: Comrade Commander, you are late. You must not forget your proletarian values.

lose.line: Gah, how humiliating... to think a material defect would surface at a time like this...!

mail.line: Mail. Comrade Commander, you must read it quickly before the next one comes bringing another letter.

mission.line: We have a mission. I will handle the clerical work. You must be clear to focus on your duties as a commander.

mission_complete.line: Hm? Something missing from the reward manifest...? It should be generally correct...

profile.line: I am Sovetskaya Rossiya, of Project 23. I was part of a strategic plan during the war, but for several reasons never came to be. I see though that I can prove my value here in this fleet with a series of decisive victories.

propose.line: So long as I draw breath, I labor to carry out my mission. Not only as a member of this fleet, but also in service of the bonds you have forged... This is not a product of rational thinking alone, but also a decision born of my subjective opinion.

touch.line: You want to deepen our camaraderie? Very good, let us start by making a firm handshake part of our regular routine.

touch2.line: This is not polite behavior.

unlock.line: I am called "Sovetskaya Rossiya," and as the mightiest of all the Northern Parliament's battleships, I am her ultimate weapon. I will press onward to eliminate all obstacles that stand between you and the Revolution.

upgrade.line: An excellent strengthening. The next one should be so good.

win_mvp.line: Kill confirmed. You cannot stop the Northern Parliament... You cannot stop our righteous liberation!

battle.line: Show me your mettle!!

couple_encourage1.line: Ahahaha! Finally, I have the privilege of fighting by your side, Mikasa!

couple_encourage2.line: For the light of revolution!

detail.line: Know this, comrade. Even if I am battered and bruised, muddied by defeat, I will rise each time to reclaim the glory of mankind! Yes, that is the революция I desire, the only heaven that exists for me!

expedition.line: Hopefully our comrades will return bearing good news, unlike that bitter Ice Cruise. Come on, let's go welcome them back.

feeling1.line: There is no future for those who mistake recklessness with courage, comrade.

feeling2.line: I am Battleship Gangut, also known as Oktyabrskaya Revolyutsiya. However, my name is less important the what I've achieved. Don't dwell too much on it and just call me what you want.

feeling3.line: I hope you don't take this the wrong way, comrade, but this fight is not just for all of us. It's also yours. Never settle with the status quo, and always seek to keep improving.

feeling4.line: Ahahahaha! Well done, comrade! No matter how strong the enemies we may face, we now join each other courageously, prepared to give everything in pursuit of greater challenges! What could be more revolutionary than that?

feeling5.line: Let's get to the point! Comrade, I was struck by your brilliance, and thus I fell for you! And now, I face the challenge of how to express my feelings for you! Here, comrade, accept my embrace!

home.line: O comrade, do you return bearing news of glorious victory? Ah, but it matters not, for the thing that matters most is that you fought with all your strength!

hp_warning.line: Ahahahaha! At last, this is a battlefield that I am meant for!

login.line: Comrade, what sort of strong enemy will we face today? I, Gangut, shall stand with you!

lose.line: Comrade, consider this not a defeat, but rather a warning. A sign that we are losing sight of our revolutionary spirit.

mail.line: You have a letter, comrade. It would be best to open it soon.

mission.line: Missions exist for the sake of preserving the order. We should complete them as soon as possible.

mission_complete.line: Excellently done! This reward will help pave the next step of our revolution!

propose.line: A pledge, huh? While this act is symbolic in nature, it is also undeniable proof of the bonds we've formed. A toast, comrade. Please continue to guide me in the future.

touch.line: What about my rigging? Isn't fully utilizing everything at your disposal a wonderful and pragmatic ideal? Why would I consign myself to weakness for the sake of showmanship?

touch2.line: What are you doing, comrade? Are you not aware of how we handle lawbreakers in the Northern Parliament?

unlock.line: Hahaha! Not bad, comrade! Come, let us fight for the safety of these azure lanes! Fight until your last breath!

upgrade.line: Comrades! You are also strong! Let our souls shine out brilliantly!

win_mvp.line: Rejoice, for we have earned this privilege! May this celebration become the bread that sustains us until our next victory!

battle.line: Two days ago it was {namecode:90}, yesterday it was {namecode:103}, and today it's you all. Let's go!

couple_encourage1.line: The forbidden Double Lexington!

couple_encourage2.line: I'm the lovable Saratoga, not some Old Brother!

couple_encourage3.line: How come YOU'VE all grown so much?!

couple_encourage4.line: Let's go! Time to make some headlines!

couple_encourage5.line: Heheheh~ Can you tell who's the real deal?

couple_encourage6.line: Let's do our best as Virtual Idols, Sandy!

detail.line: If you keep on peeping where you shouldn't, even kids will not be talking to you~

expedition.line: Commander, my patrol planes told me the girls out for commission have returned~

feeling1.line: Pranks? I already stopped pulling them on you~ You're no fun for those

feeling2.line: Who should I prank today~?

feeling3.line: Commander, what's the greatest difference between me and my big sister? The answer, is my 'color' today!

feeling4.line: Commander, I have something I want to tell you. I'm gonna write it on the back of your hand~ and done... Did you think I'm gonna write 'I like you'? Silly Commander~

feeling5.line: Commander, you dropped something~~ *kiss* ...Hehe, it was my heart?. Here, you can keep it!

home.line: We~ are back~

hp_warning.line: Wah! I'm in a pinch!

login.line: Oh my~ Sorry Commander. I didn't mean to launch planes at you on purpose~

lose.line: Oh dang~ I'll go back for repairs, and then have a good rest while I'm at it~

mail.line: You didn't see the mail? --Then should I read it?

main1.line: Boo! Hehe, did I susprise you?  Commander, you're slow, aren't you?!

main2.line: Commander, don't confuse me with my big sister!

main3.line: Eh? Call you 'big bro'? There's no way that's happening~

mission.line: Commander, can't you complete even a mission?

mission_complete.line: This is bad, Commander! The mission rewards are missing! --Darn, you caught me.

profile.line:
I am aircraft carrier Lexington's little sister, Saratoga! Hmm... I like to play pranks! But you already knew that, Commander~ 
Pioneer of aviation tactics? If my sister hadn't passed away so soon, that title would've definitely been hers.

propose.line: Ah, Commander. Please wait for a bit~ The Eagle Union carriers are all gathering~ Eh? This is a once in a lifetime occassion! Despite my appearance I am a veteran. I'm well respected!

skill.line: Where are you looking? I'm right over here~

touch.line: My stature may be small, but I've yet to grow past that fact!

touch2.line: ...wha!

unlock.line: Hey there, and good day, Commander! I am Lexington...'s little sister, Saratoga~ If there's nothing important, I'm leaving now

upgrade.line: Saratoga-chan loves you a lot~!

win_mvp.line: Ooh la la~ Big sis is busy, so it's fine that I get to come by once a while~

battle.line: All carrier-based aircraft in position, anti-air defense preparations complete. All forces, full speed ahead!

couple_encourage1.line: Just you watch, Enterprise! I won't lose to you so easily!

couple_encourage2.line: The era of carriers is upon us!

detail.line: What would you like to know, Commander? I'll answer to the best of my abilities.

expedition.line: The birth of the Essex-class would not have been possible without the hard work of the logistics teams. I have to show my gratitude to everyone.

feeling1.line: I wonder how Enterprise puts up with someone like you...

feeling2.line: I witnessed the end of the era of battleships with my own eyes. Will carriers share the same fate some day...?

feeling3.line: Jealousy? No, that's not the case. Enterprise is a true hero worthy of all the respect she gets. However, compared to her dazzling aura, I'm just...

feeling4.line: I won't lose to anyone, not even to Enterprise. But how do I get everyone to acknowledge this? Commander, if you were in my shoes, what would you do?

feeling5.line: I might never be able to become a hero like Enterprise... But when I'm with you, I feel like I can do so much more than just that...

home.line: The fleet has safely returned. Commander, I've prepared the battle report for you. Time is of the essence, so please review it right away.

login.line: There you are. I've already finished preparing everything. Commander, give us your orders!

lose.line: I won't let it end like this... I swear it!

mail.line: There's new mail for you. Here you go.

mission.line: There are still unfinished missions? Mind letting me handle things this time...?

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have arrived. Are you sure you don't need me to go get it?

profile.line: I am the nameship of the Essex-class carriers. Although I was built with great expectations, I was always overshadowed by Enterprise's success. If only I could have been deployed sooner...

touch.line: Time to sortie?! Just leave it to me! Oh... you just wanted to chat...?

touch2.line: Wh-what is this?! I, I...

unlock.line: So this is where Enterprise is... A-ahem! I am Essex, one of the Union's state-of-the-art aircraft carriers. Commander, you can expect great things from me! I swear that I won't disappoint you!

upgrade.line: When will I be able to get jets...

win_mvp.line: Enterprise, did you see my feat?

battle.line: Flight preparations complete! Attack squadrons, roll out!

couple_encourage1.line: Task Force 38, let's rock and roll!

detail.line: One should always go all out, no matter the enemy... Having that said, there are various practical reasons why that isn't always possible...

expedition.line: Commission completed, resources received~! Hehe, way to go, Commander. You know exactly how important logistics are to our fleet operations!

feeling1.line: Commander, the way you're acting now makes you no different from a coward!

feeling2.line: The great symbol of fearlessness is none other than I – Intrepid! Don't you forget that!

feeling3.line: Oh, Commander! This– yeowwwch! Who decided it was a good idea to leave a trolley here?! Jeez, why does this always happen to me...Ah, um, nevermind, I'm fine! More importantly, when do I get to sortie?

feeling4.line: During my free time, I like to read, watch movies, or stargaze. Oh, by the way, I got a movie ticket from Casablanca. Why don't we go watch it?

feeling5.line: The stars in the night sky are distant. So distant that even with all the courage in the world, the effort it would take to reach them is unfathomable... However, all it takes to catch the commander in front of me is.... this! Hehe, isn't that right?

headtouch.line: Wooahh?! You're messing up my hair?!

home.line: Phew, I'm back! Oh, you need a battle report, repair and resupply overviews, and a mission debriefing? Sure, five minutes should be enough, right? After that, send me back out there!

hp_warning.line: Crap, I didn't think there'd be so many of them...

login.line: Am I slated to sortie today? If not, hurry up and fix that!

lose.line: I have to go to the docks again...? Damnit, why is it always me... Y-you didn't hear anything!

mail.line: There's new mail... do we have new orders?

mission.line: Having trouble with your missions? If you're stumped, why don't you let me try my hand?

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished! See, there's nothing you can't do if you put your mind to it!

profile.line: I'm the third ship of the Essex class, Intrepid! Although my poor luck during the war earned me quite a few unflattering nicknames... Heheh, that's all behind me now! Commander, under your command, I'll show you just how powerful I am!

propose.line: I didn't expect you to be the one to take the initiative... but I suppose that's fine too. Commander, guess I'll continue to be in your care then! As long as I am with you, I want you to push forward and face the future fearlessly!

touch.line: Want something to drink? Then, how about a martini – shaken, not stirred? Just kidding!

touch2.line: You... *sigh*...I'm way more inclined to beat you to a pulp than to praise you for your bravery.

unlock.line: "The Fighting I" of the Essex-class, Intrepid, is here! Commander, leave the combat missions to me! I'll bring home victory and glory!

upgrade.line: I feel like I can always keep improving! For example, how 'bout giving me a dozen jets?

win_mvp.line: The crown of victory goes to me, the one who knows no fear!

battle.line: Why did they choose to become our enemy...?!

couple_encourage1.line: You are nothing before the Essex class.

couple_encourage2.line: Project Rainbow? ...It has a nice ring to it...

detail.line: Commander, why are you staring at me...?

expedition.line: Pardon, but I'll go greet the girls who are coming back from their commission. Just wait here until I report back.

feeling1.line: I'd rather not talk to you right now.

feeling2.line: There is no beauty in warfare. There is only ugliness in the suffering and loss of life we inflict upon each other.

feeling3.line: Don't think I'm upset just because I have little to say. If anything, I'm probably thinking about something, or about how to express myself.

feeling4.line: Something strange has been going on with my thoughts recently. Whenever I start thinking about things, your face pops up in my head and makes it hard for me to stay calm...

feeling5.line: We were born as weapons of warfare, and I thought that is all we would ever be. But having spent time with you, I'm beginning to think... that there's more to our lives than war.

home.line: You've returned? ...Very well. Why don't we prepare for the next sortie?

hp_warning.line: Why now of all times...?!

login.line: We're in a state of emergency. Be prepared to run the Holiday Express, even if it's a holiday.

lose.line: Their power... surpasses even the "Dragon's Jaws"...?

mail.line: The mail's here... Wonder if there's any new intel?

main1.line: Right now, another place out there is being engulfed by the flames of war...

main2.line: Eldridge's ability? I'm not exactly sure, but... I feel like I've seen it somewhere...

main3.line: All resistance is meaningless before the Essex-class's attack formation.

mission.line: Missions... should best be completed in a timely manner.

mission_complete.line: There are a ton of rewards? Of course.

profile.line: Essex-class, Bunker Hill. My name comes from a battlefield in the Revolutionary War. I've seen my fair share of battles... and know that war brings nothing but sorrow and pain. Let's not talk about it any more.

propose.line: Sorry... My mind has gone completely blank... I'm lost for words... Oh, that's right! "I pledge loyalty and love to you until the end of time." ...How does that sound?

touch.line: ...Don't think I'm upset just because I have little to say. Just let me know if you need anything.

touch2.line: By the looks of things, you won't learn your lesson without some harder-hitting "experience."

unlock.line: Bunker Hill, one of the Essex-class carriers, is joining the fleet under your command. Don't worry, you'll see the extent of my abilities soon enough.

upgrade.line: I grow stronger... yet again...

win_mvp.line: So this is the end that you all chose...

battle.line: All ships, prepare for combat! For liberty and glory! Aux armes, marchons!

couple_encourage1.line: As long as we have Heaven's divine protection, we have nothing to fear!

couple_encourage2.line: It seems that we fight together once again.

couple_encourage3.line: Please fight to your heart's content. I have your back.

couple_encourage4.line: Brethren! Assemble under the banner of righteousness!

detail.line: Place your faith in me. Follow my lead. Offer up your prayers. Seek the Lord. Only then will the path of God be opened...

expedition.line: I'd like to report that the commissions have been safely completed, and that fleet operations are running smoothly. You've done a good job, Commander.

feeling1.line: Those who refuse to stop marching shall face the path of ruin... Make sure you keep that in mind.

feeling2.line: The one you are talking to was once despisingly called many things: the calamity that brought on war, the fearsome Cardinal, and the maniac possessed by religious fervor. I ask of you: when you look at me, what do you see in me?

feeling4.line: You've come by again. Haven't you been getting too friendly with me? ...Just kidding. I'm truly grateful to have another person that I can chat casually with. I hope that you feel the same way, too.

headtouch.line: May Heaven confer upon you its blessings.

home.line: Mission complete. The fleet has safely returned to the port. Good work, Commander.

hp_warning.line: There is... still hope...!

login.line: Bonjour, Commander. Please relax and drink this tea while I carry out my morning prayers.

lose.line: Is this... also a trial from Heaven...?

mail.line: Letters are blessings from other people.

mission.line: Missions may be called a kind of trial. If you take them on with the proper attitude, there is no need to worry.

mission_complete.line: The reward for those who work hard is Heaven's grace. Let us accept it gratefully.

propose.line: As the one who guides Iris Libre, I cannot make an oath solely to you. However, I vow to protect and support you for as long as I live. This, I vow, on the holy name of Iris...

touch.line: Please listen to our prayers closely, Commander.

touch2.line: If nothing else, your audacity is commendable.

unlock.line: I am Richelieu, Cardinal of Iris Libre. If you too will fight for freedom and faith, then I shall bring you victory, Commander.

upgrade.line: At times, might is needed to guide others on the right path. I give you my thanks.

win_mvp.line: May the wandering souls drifting about the battlefield find eternal peace and salvation... Amen...

battle.line: Now, as outlined in our briefing, prepare for combat!

couple_encourage1.line: I'd love to transport fascinating items with you.

couple_encourage2.line: I am profoundly honored to fight by your side.

couple_encourage3.line: Allow me to show you an Iris sacrament.

detail.line: An improvement in operational code and tactical variables... This sequence should be useful. I shall write this down in my notebook.

expedition.line: Transport commissions and cargo escorts are vital, of course, but let's not forget the important safety of our docks.

feeling1.line: "You are the most outstanding, exceptional commander I have ever met." – You can only hope to hear me say these words in your most outlandish dreams.

feeling2.line: Are you curious about this book? It is just a notepad, more or less. Rest assured, there is nothing remarkable about it. And it is certainly not something you need look at.

feeling3.line: A "grimoire"? Hmm... And you say L'Opini?tre told you this? It's certainly an amusing allegory. Now, I'm afraid I must take my leave for a while, as I have business to attend to.

feeling4.line: This "grimoire" topic again? I do not appreciate your insistence on it. "A sacrament from the Iris Libre can perform all sorts of miracles"... Assuming that were even true, how would you utilize such great power, Commander?

feeling5.line: Commander, all of today's clerical tasks have been completed right on schedule. This is a good opportunity to... Indeed, as you've requested, I will teach you about the so-called "sacrament of love."

home.line: You would like something sugary in preparation for your mental labor? It so happens I have a list of our stock of confectionaries. Please have a look.

hp_warning.line: I have sustained damage, but it is under control...

login.line: Here is today's schedule, Commander. Read it at your leisure.

lose.line: I sincerely apologize, Commander. I take full responsibility for this defeat.

mail.line: Reporting in. I have a newly arrived letter for you, Commander.

mission.line: Commander, I have received word of new mission directives from headquarters. I shall go and make some arrangements.

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed. That's one burden off our minds.

profile.line: My name is Béarn, I am the Iris Libre's first aircraft carrier, converted from the unfinished 5th Normandie-class dreadnought. I lived to see the end of the strife between Iris and Vichya... A tragedy I pray will never happen again.

touch.line: I am right here, Commander. Do not hesitate to give me your orders.

touch2.line: Do you lack the knowledge of what being a decent person entails, or are you simply unable to control yourself, Commander?

unlock.line: Béarn, Iris Libre's very first aircraft carrier, reporting for duty. It is an honor to fight by your side. I eagerly await your orders, Commander.

upgrade.line: Your kindness will not go unrewarded, Commander.

win_mvp.line: How would you say I did? Was my performance satisfactory?

battle.line: Heheh, there'll be no mercy for you!

couple_encourage1.line: Allow me to witness your true might.

couple_encourage2.line: Let us show the world what we're made of.

couple_encourage3.line: Cookies are great, don't you know? Do you really not want one?

detail.line: To your friends, show no cowardice; to your foes, show no mercy – that is my creed. Hehehe~

expedition.line: Do you need someone to escort the commission team home? I'm quite the experienced escort, I'll have you know.

feeling1.line: A kind deed to others is a kind deed to yourself – or so I was naive enough to believe...

feeling2.line: "Shape the world into God's vision" – if there is a God, what is his ideal world? It can't be one of perpetual war, that's for sure.

feeling3.line: Are you tired, Commander? Under the weather, perhaps? Heh, well, a nice cookie can fix that. Just eat one of these and you'll be right back to normal.

feeling4.line: Come visit the dorm next time we're having cookies, Commander. We'd all love to have you, and I especially want to spend some quality time with you.

feeling5.line: Bah, being indirect is just not like me. I adore you, Commander. Both as the leader of the fleet, and as my beloved special someone. I wish to know... do you adore me as well?

home.line: Nicely done out there. If you've got the energy to spare, perhaps you could write an after-battle report?

hp_warning.line: I can't... falter now!

login.line: How nice to see you. Now, let's get to work on today's tasks.

lose.line: Next time... victory will be ours.

mail.line: We've received what looks to be mail addressed to you.

mission.line: Oh, missions? Are there any I can help with?

mission_complete.line: A mission's done. I can take care of claiming the rewards, no problem.

profile.line: Prior to my being sent to the Pacific, I always worked side by side with George. But aside from the one time we escorted our Sardegnian friends, I suppose I don't have too many notable feats to my name.

propose.line: Thank you for your sincerity, Commander. I will gladly be yours. I won't ask of you to share all your joys and sorrows with me, as I'm more than happy with just being by your side. Ah, that didn't sound like what I would say, did it? Well, hehehe~

touch.line: Do save the massage for later. I'm not tired yet.

touch2.line: Umm... What are you doing?

unlock.line: It's a pleasure meeting you, Commander. I'm Howe of the King George V-class. I hope we can build a healthy relationship.

upgrade.line: Phew... I'll return your gesture with valour on the battlefield, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Heheh, I'm in top shape today!

battle.line: Heed my command! Forward!

couple_encourage1.line: Feast your eyes upon the might of the noble Queen Elizabeth-class!

couple_encourage2.line: M-make sure you observe my every move!

detail.line: Look, isn't Elizabeth acting a bit too spoiled? And Warspite and the others are totally enabling that. I knew I should have been the one in charge... Huhh? I'm more or less the same...? Wh-what did you say?!

expedition.line: Heheh, it seems that the commission team has been doing well. Do send them my best regards in my stead.

feeling1.line: I had great expectations for you...

feeling2.line: Good, you came. If you have no other work to do, play me in a game of chess.

feeling3.line: Y-you're better than I expected... F-fine, I won't go easy on you next time...!

feeling4.line: H-hold up! Chess is like a real-world exercise, so you have to consider all the various external factors! Th-that's right! That last match was a fake! A fluke! Doesn't count! Cancelled! Got it?!

headtouch.line: Wh-what are you doing?!

home.line: My attendant, how fares the combat situation? Do tell me in detail.

hp_warning.line: H-hey, hurry up and do something about this...!

login.line: It's about time! Now, show me today's itinerary!

lose.line: Ugh... H-how is this possible...

mail.line: Tsk... Why is all the mail for you...

mission.line: I'll leave this these trifling quests to you.

mission_complete.line: Even the most trivial quests at least deserve some rewards.

profile.line: Queen Elizabeth-class battleship, Valiant. Hehe, this fleet is known from Jutland to the Far East for its heroic majesty, and I am the reason for that! Now, Commander, you shall become my assistant so that you may prove your worth as a subordinate.

propose.line: Well done! You've gained my recognition as my trustiest spear in the arsenal! To reward you for your continued loyalty, I shall allow you to stay at my side and bask in my charisma! May this ring be a symbol of our bond~?

skill.line: Everything dances within the palm of my hand!

touch.line: Speak your mind, my attendant. You have my ear.

touch2.line: What's the meaning of this?! Grrr... As a charismatic, generous, and VERY patient person, I will forgive you just this once!

unlock.line: To be Valiant is to be me. Remember this face, for it is the face of a fleet leader! ...Speaking of faces, who are you? The Commander? Very well! I shall treat you as my personal servant!

upgrade.line: Not bad, my attendant~ Do you want a reward?

win_mvp.line: A heroic battle commanded elegantly by the Commander— now this is the kind of flawless victory that befits me.

battle.line: Careful, now. The battlefield is no place to worry about fuel economy.

couple_encourage1.line: Time for a new experiment?

detail.line: The big mirror in my room? What about it? If I told you, "I just like mirrors," would that satisfy your curiosity?

expedition.line: Look, Commander... No, I'm not angry, I was just going to tell you a commission is done.

feeling1.line: You really are like a can of rancid surstr?mming.

feeling2.line: I can hear just fine, Commander, so don't go yelling in my ear, thanks...

feeling3.line: If you ask me, people should be able to say whatever they want... Oh, hello there, Commander. Just talking to myself.

feeling4.line: I'm a total moron... Why am I so rude to the Commander when I just want to be friends... I'm so, so stupid...

feeling5.line: How would I describe you? I dunno, I guess like a storm in the middle of a peaceful voyage... No, no, I didn't mean it like that... Sorry, what I meant to say is, um...

headtouch.line: ...Yeah?

home.line: One quick battle, and you're knackered already, Commander? You have the stamina of a beached whale.

hp_warning.line: ...I can't afford to mess around, huh.

login.line: There's some saying that goes, "the early bird catches the worm." ...If that's true, I guess you'd starve, Commander.

lose.line: Damn, we lost... Sorry.

mail.line: You've got mail. Nope, didn't bring it with me. Next time, ask, and I'll consider it.

mission.line: What kind of lazy cat are you, just lounging around all day instead of doing missions?

mission_complete.line: Those mission rewards will expire if you don't claim them. Maybe.

propose.line: Obviously I don't hate you, Commander. How could I, when I adore talking to you and being patted on the head? L-look, I'm trying to say... I love you. I mean it...

touch.line: Maybe try finishing your work before you "chat me up" or "interview me" or however you wanna sugarcoat it?

touch2.line: You must really want a seat at the naval jailhouse dinner table, huh?

unlock.line: I'm Perseus, from the Royal Navy. You can pronounce it "Per-see-us" if you want though... Well, whatever. Are we done here? Great. Nice meeting you.

upgrade.line: Thanks a bunch... Well, yeah, didn't you want a thank-you?

win_mvp.line: Looks like the enemy will have to, uh, try harder next time.

battle.line: The battlefield... Heh, I'm getting all fired up!

couple_encourage1.line: Let us fight side by side!

couple_encourage2.line: Hrmh! Try as you wish, you won't beat me!

detail.line: There are many Royal Navy ships named "Eagle," and I will go great lengths to maintain its honourable reputation.

expedition.line: Commission complete. Let's go and offer the returning team some biscuits. Don't worry about me, I can do without.

feeling1.line: You're betraying everyone's trust in you by acting like this. Pull yourself together, for god's sake!

feeling2.line: People say I'm not great at socializing, a fact that I begrudge. But my social skills aside, I do know my manners.

feeling4.line: Despite my low-calorie diet and daily rigorous exercise, my weight stays the same... *sigh*, I guess my past status as a battleship defines me more than I think... But why?! How does everyone else manage to lose weight just fine?!

feeling5.line: You are irreplaceable to me. Whatever becomes of me... Scratch that. I'll stay the way I am now, just for you. Because I think this is what made me equally irreplaceable to you. Am I right?

home.line: My body weight's still the same as it w– Oh! Commander! Didn't think you'd be back so soon. A-anyway, you'd better give our next mission plan a look!

hp_warning.line: A warrior of the Royal Navy won't back down so easily!

login.line: Great to see you! Based upon your punctuality, I can already tell that you're a responsible commander.

lose.line: Tsk, I've taken damage after fighting for so long... I'll need repairs when we return.

mail.line: There's mail for you. Don't forget to give it a look.

mission.line: There's still unfinished missions, Commander. We should get them done sooner rather than later.

mission_complete.line: Now that's the face of an accomplished commander. Good job.

propose.line: I once met my final obstacle in the Suez Canal... But if you ever need saving, I will overcome any obstacle to get to you, Commander. This is my promise not just as a warrior, but as your lover.

touch.line: What is it? An invitation to get lunch? Hmm... Sorry, but could you go in my place?

touch2.line: You see, this is the reason why we have to teach people proper etiquette.

unlock.line: The name is Eagle. I intend to serve your fleet to the utmost of my abilities as a proud warrior of the Royal Navy.

upgrade.line: Enhancements, huh... I just wish they wouldn't affect my weight...

win_mvp.line: To show compassion to your foe is to put the safety of your allies at risk.

battle.line: Yet another... tragic battle.

couple_encourage1.line: Combined Fleet, crush our enemies!

couple_encourage2.line: 1st Battleship Division, open fire!

couple_encourage3.line: Mutsu, leave your questions for after the battle!

couple_encourage4.line: Observe closely this battle of mine, Mikasa!

couple_encourage5.line: Akagi, I need your strength as my own!

couple_encourage6.line: Hmph...! I have no reason to envy you for those... things!

couple_encourage8.line: Kawakaze, I trust you to lead the way!

detail.line: Everyone's faces are full of laughter here... I think I am rather fond of this place!

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned... H-Hey, I managed to remember the time. Have you no words of praise for me?

feeling1.line: Your wish... is to repeat the errors of the past once more? Very well... I see...

feeling2.line: What do you require of me? Hmm? I am not doing anything in particular. After I handed the work to Yamato, there is little to do except fight.

feeling3.line: I should spend more time with the others? Even if I tried to do that, I would not know how to behave, and they would be afraid of me all the same... Hey, what are you doing... why are you taking off my riggings?!

feeling4.line: I see! I am less intimidating with my riggings taken off. I certainly do feel lighter... but why does it feel like I've lost something... like when I appointed Yamato to take over as flagship?

feeling5.line: It is enough to be treasured by one person? Since you were the one who brought me out... I shall have you take responsibility... that is, umm, in other words, I command you to... treasure me... if that is acceptable?

home.line: I have never had to welcome anyone before. Perhaps I shall do so by firing my cannons?

hp_warning.line: The decisive battle is upon us!

login.line: Welcome ba... oww, I bit my tongue...

lose.line: Ugh... I have failed once again...

mail.line: What is this piece of paper? "Mail?" I see, it's mail. Shall I read it?

mission.line: Is it acceptable to arrange the itinerary in this manner? I do not quite understand how to do it yet...

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards... Ngh...! Phew... is it acceptable to leave them here?

profile.line: I am the manifestation of the soul of the Sakura Empire, the pride and glory of her warrior spirit. As a Big Seven, I am also the symbol of an era. Open your eyes and bask in my radiance... You may stop basking now, I'm getting a bit sleepy...

propose.line: When I cross the river after the war ends, what awaits me is not a searing white light that engulfs everything, but rather, your warm embrace... There is nothing more that I could ask for...

skill.line: I am called Nagato... Nagato of the Sakura Empire!

touch.line: ...! N-No one has ever dared to lay hands on me in such a manner...

touch2.line: ... H-How uncouth!

unlock.line: I am called Nagato, flagship of the Sakura Empire's Combined Fleet. Are you the one known as the Commander? I shall bear witness to whether or not you have the ability to unite this world.

upgrade.line: I hope... to be able to welcome the day when we can all beat our swords into plowshares...

win_mvp.line: Impudent fools... why did they have to provoke me?

battle.line: Everyone, the one with the lowest results will get extra lessons~~

detail.line:
D-don't look at me inappropriatly! And do your work properly! 
--Y-Y-You were just looking at my bridge?! ...Ahaha...

expedition.line: Mr. Commander~ You forgot to check the results. You might see the girls become angry at you.

feeling1.line: Maybe I should quit teaching...

feeling2.line: Why are kids today thinking about weird things all the time...!

feeling3.line: Commander, you are a capable child if you are put into action. I feel a little happy.

feeling4.line: T-T-Teacher-student relationships?!! I've never thought about such things; I've never even read those kinds of books before. I totally, totally never look forward to that!

feeling5.line: Commander, you're really helpless without me. S-so... I-I'm... I'm holding you back for another year!

home.line: Have you finished your homework? Alright. Then as promised, I'll give you a reward~

login.line: Can I conduct combat operations since the weather is so nice today, Commander?

lose.line: I can't let you see me like this, Commander.....

mail.line: You've got mail. Do you want me to hold your hand through teaching you how to reply? AAH! Not literally!

main1.line: What I teach besides fighting is human se... I-I mean... physical education!

main2.line: The Sakura Empire? ...Uh, Uhhh... I- I don't know enough to teach you about that!

main3.line: If you don't listen to what I say, I'll punish you!

mission.line: Finish your missions properly. Otherwise, there will be catch up lessons!

mission_complete.line: The compensation... is nothing major, but it's not good to neglect it either.

propose.line: *cries*... Receiving such a precious thing from a student, and getting so happy to the point of shedding tears... I, Ranger, am a failure as an educator...

touch.line: Hwaa!? Commander... S...Stop... is what you want me to say?!

touch2.line: D-don't tell anyone about this! You'll embarrass me!

upgrade.line: I, Ms. Ranger, am going to teach you some more things

win_mvp.line: Commander, you must not become worn out quickly like the enemy-- Oh no... not like that!

battle.line: Entertain me with your final struggles. Hehehe...

couple_encourage1.line: Amagi, please don't go off to a distant place by yourself again.

detail.line: Commander, if you keep looking at me like that, you’ll be eaten up.

expedition.line: The girls on commission have returned. Go on ahead, I will prepare some refreshments for them.

feeling1.line: It seems like you're not the hero I was looking for...

feeling2.line: The weak will be eliminated. If you cannot accept that, then simply become stronger.

feeling3.line: Should you be defeated one day, it simply means that you were too weak. That much is a fact of nature. Though... because you are mine, I would at least avenge you.

feeling4.line: I cannot comprehend these emotions... is this some sort of primal instinct?

feeling5.line: I have so much I want to say, but I forget them all the moment I see your face...

home.line: A fitting reward for the ears of our enemies. Let us enjoy the spoils of war leisurely.

hp_warning.line: It’s time for a death match! Heheh- hehehe!

login.line: Justice and righteousness are for the strong only. The weak can only weep in vain.

lose.line: This pain... I shall return it tenfold!

mail.line: Your mail is here. Try not to forget it next time.

main1.line: I shall conquer all, no matter who stands against me.

main2.line: Our enemies may be strong, but that is what makes them worth crushing. Heheh...

main3.line: The girls of the Fifth Carrier Division? They might amount to something if they work hard enough.

mission.line: Commander, stop slacking around. There are still missions to complete.

mission_complete.line: Here are the rewards, the fruits of your labor.

profile.line: I am {namecode:92}, from the First Carrier Division. I was originally designed to be a battleship, but fate had different plans or me. Enemies? I simply slaughter them, but only because it is my duty, not for fun.

propose.line: ... Is this for me? Hm... perhaps it is fate for the strong to be drawn to each other. If that is the case, I shall follow my instincts then. Hehehe~

skill.line: Only the strong may survive on the battlefield!

touch.line: Is there a problem?

touch2.line: ... Fine. If you say it helps you relax...

unlock.line: Will I be able to find a worthy foe here? Very well. I’m yours. Perhaps this, too, is destiny.

upgrade.line: Not bad. I’ve come up with some new combat techniques.

win_mvp.line: Such is the fate of the weak. Death, nothing more.

battle.line: I'm not very skilled in real combat... but I shall not betray your expectations!

detail.line: You're like a kid sometimes, Commander... Come over here~

expedition.line: Commander, your girls have returned from commission. I'll welcome them back now, but you should hurry over as well.

feeling1.line: Is something the matter, Commander?

feeling2.line: Want to take a nap, Commander?

feeling3.line: I look a bit like a courtesan? Hehe~ Well then, mister, it seems like tonight shall be our one and only night together. Let us feel the warmth of our embrace, then let the memories fade to nothing. How does that sound?

feeling4.line: A prominent person once praised my beauty, but to be honest, I am not so sure about myself. But if Commander was to acknowledge me, perhaps I could find my confidence. So... Commander, am I beautiful?

feeling5.line: Commander, the moon is beautiful tonight, isn't it? I've prepared some drinks... would you like to stargaze together? I wouldn't do this for anyone else - this is a special service just for you, my dear.

home.line: Good work, Commander! Would you like dinner? A bath? Or perhaps... a drink first? Hehe~!

hp_warning.line: Looks like I can't afford to take it easy just yet.

login.line: Commander, have you eaten yet? No? Let me make something for you. You can't head to work without first preparing your body and mind!

lose.line: I'm so sorry, Commander...

mail.line: Commander, there's mail for you!

mission.line: You've got new missions, Commander. Care for a challenge this time?

mission_complete.line: Commander is sure forgetful, always needing my reminder just to claim the rewards.

profile.line: I guess you could say that I was the first aircraft carrier ever in the world. You could call me the eldest sister, or mother, of them all! Feel free to consult with me whenever you'd like, Commander. I'm always here for you.

propose.line: My dream is to one day settle down with the person I love and open a small bar somewhere... Now, it doesn't seem like my dream is so distant anymore. Right, my dear?

touch.line: Are you looking for me, Commander?

touch2.line: Ahh! ... Commander, that's naughty. You can't touch me there.

unlock.line: Ah, it's the Commander... My name is Houshou, and I'll be in your care from now on. Please leave the children of the fleet in my care. I won't let you down!

upgrade.line: Now I can help you even more, Commander!

win_mvp.line: Commander, will this be enough?

battle.line: Mmm... I'm looking forward to everyone finishing their work too~!

couple_encourage1.line: Hood, you must not waver.

couple_encourage2.line: You shouldn't underestimate your opponents, dear sister.

couple_encourage3.line: Kaede's Legion? Let's do our best together!

detail.line: Need me to explain the details?

expedition.line: Hehe, Commander. The girls are back from commission!

feeling1.line: Even I'm a bit disappointed...

feeling2.line: The weather is pretty nice. Want to take a walk, Commander? Let's relax and chat for a while. What do you think?

feeling3.line: Commander sure is gentle, always slowing down to match my pace when we're taking walks... I'm moved by details like this.

feeling4.line: Not respecting the chain of command can mean big trouble, it has happened before……Of course it's ok for us since we're so close~

feeling5.line: Commander, want to have dinner together tonight? I'll make your favorite dish... Hmm? it's not a holiday or something like that... I just thought of it just now... If you want, Commander, we can do it every night~.

home.line: Let me make a cup of tea~

hp_warning.line: Can I increase my firepower?

login.line: Ah, Commander, you're back! I was just tidying up the documents, please have a look.

lose.line: I can still fight... but we should probably retreat, for now...

mail.line: I've brought your new mail, Commander.
