main1.line: I'm here to help you with anything you need.

main2.line: If the Commander doesn't mind, please allow me to keep you company!

main3.line: Commander, if you keep slacking off, even I will get angry.

mission.line: Commander, shall we complete our new mission?

mission_complete.line: Here are your mission rewards. Let's take a look!

profile.line:
I'm Nelson's little sister, Rodney! Um... us sisters are pretty famous right?
 Erm, you've heard that my fighting style is unbefitting of my appearance? Well well, Commander, such rumors are, of course, false~

propose.line: Everyday I spend with the Commander is a special day, I hope days like these will last forever.

skill.line: There's no need to be polite when dealing with enemies.

touch.line: What is it?

touch2.line: Please don't do this in the command room...

unlock.line: Hello, I'm Rodney. I shall be in your care from this day forward.

upgrade.line: I hope you're looking forward to my performance from here on out!

win_mvp.line: Hmm, I think I accidentally wasted a lot of ammunition...

battle.line: Everyone, go~! Waaah?! My guns fired on accident!

detail.line: Milord, you smell really nice~

expedition.line: Milord, the girls have returned from commissions!

feeling1.line: You're so boring, Milord. I don't want to play with you anymore.

feeling2.line: Milord, come play with me! Ah... I forgot to bring stuff to play with... what should we do?

feeling3.line: I love my sister, but she's a bit too quiet sometimes. Milord, I like spending time with you more because you'll play with me!

feeling4.line: Your Majesty, do you know this mask? It's a fox mask used in Kagura. Hehe, I'm actually about to practice my Kagura dance now. Do you want to watch?

feeling5.line: I know how hard my big sister works, so for her sake, I know that I should allow myself to be happy. That way, I can share my happiness with her. Now that you are here, Milord, I think I'll finally be able to do that. I feel so happy every time I see you!

home.line: Welcome back, Milord, I made you some tea... Woah! Watch out!

login.line: Milord, milord! What shall we do today?

lose.line: Uu... Sister... where are you? *sobs*

mail.line: Milord! Milord! Your mail is here!

main1.line: Milord, Milord! Waah~! ...Thank you, milord. I have always tipped over easily, but I am used to it now.

main2.line: Milord, do you want to jog with me? I want to become a little faster.

main3.line: The vase in the hallway broke... It wasn't me, I swear! It just jumped off right as I walked past it...

mission.line: Milord! New missions!

mission_complete.line: Milord, milord! I've brought the rewards... Oops!

profile.line: Um... I'm big sister {namecode:78}'s little sister, {namecode:79}! Neither of us have really had good fortune since we were born, but I've grown up well thanks to big sis! Please don't judge me by my looks... I was once the flagship of the Combined Fleet! Planes...? What are those? Can I eat them?

propose.line: Milord? You're going to give this to me? ...Even though I am slow-footed and far from perfect? Milord, you are far too kind. I love you too.

touch.line: Milord... that tickles!

touch2.line: Woah! Watch out, Milord! I'm about to fire my main gun!

unlock.line: Woah! It's Milord! Milord in person! Um... I'm Yamahi-, {namecode:79}! I am pleased to make your acquaintance.

upgrade.line: I've gotten stronger... I think!

win_mvp.line: Milord, did you see that? Did you?

battle.line: Witness the power of my new rigging, bulin!

detail.line: That green cat said something about this new equipment being "experimental," bulin. Not sure what that means, but since it looks like my sis, it must be super strong!

home.line: Are you not letting me sortie because I'm too OP, bulin?

hp_warning.line: Bulin?! I'm in trouble, bulin!

login.line: I want to try out some experimental equipment here in your office, bulin!

lose.line: Ehh? I thought I was supposed to be stronger, bulin?

main1.line: This bulibulin has become even strongerer, bulin!

main2.line: Even though I look a bit like my sis now, she's still the only one in charge of super rares, bulin~

main3.line: I never get tired! But, Commander, you seem to get tired all the time... does that mean you're weak, bulin?

skill.line: Within my equipment is the power to end all creation!

touch.line: Bulin? Commander, did you wanna learn how to bulin?

touch2.line: Bulin! I'm about to activate my skill all over you!

unlock.line: Bulin? Did I just get an upgrade? Now, I can fight too, bulin!

upgrade.line: (I can't believe it... Even with my newfound powers, there's no way to undergo enhancement...)

win_mvp.line: Bulin! I've successfully buli buli'd the enemies!

battle.line: Purin~! Don't stop until they kneel and cry!

detail.line: Staring at me all day won't turn you into an expert!

expedition.line: Yaaaay~! Commander! The girls who went out on a commission have come back! Let's drill something to celebrate!

feeling1.line: You're pretty amazing to have gotten on my bad side! But I won't get angry just to appease you! Haha! Enjoy your emptiness!

feeling2.line: My sister is so dumb. When people talk about our colors, it's not about our hair, it's about ra... rari... ah, now I remember! Reality TV!

feeling3.line: I'll let you in on a little secret. My little sister keeps telling people that she's smarter than me. But truth is, she's dumber! I try to be nice and let her feel good about herself, like a big sister should. Ha!

feeling4.line: Whee~! I'm flying! So~ high! Hey, don't move! You'll have to catch me if I fall!

feeling5.line: You're not an average commander if you managed to conquer my heart. But I won't be shy or blush! Instead I'll give you a growl! Graaaah!

home.line: Let's run around and relax! Purin~!

login.line: Righty tighty, Lefty loosey, Stay calm and Purin on!

lose.line: So why am I on the battlefield anyway, purin?!

mail.line: Purin! Secret skill: Drill Translation!

main1.line: Purin~! It's so big in here! There's so much room to run around!

main2.line: Oh right, it's not my job to just run around, is it? Purin~!

main3.line: Purin~? I'm too loud? Hmph, who cares what you think!

mission.line: Purin~! The next mission has been chosen for you!

mission_complete.line: I'm just heading out to fetch your rewards, purin! I promise I won't break them!

profile.line: Hahaha! It's your lucky day now that you've met me! We can purin together from this day forward! What for? To make everyone stronger, obviously! How do you purin? Like this! Purin~! Purin~!

propose.line: As a simple Bulin, I'm meant to just help strengthen your other ships... But you gave me this ring... You're a strange one! I like you! Come, let's raise our hands together and say purin~ purin~!

skill.line: My drill is the drill that will pierce the heavens!

touch.line: Purin~ You can't catch me!

touch2.line: Purin~ purin~! (Prototype Bulin MKII continues to spin faster)

unlock.line: Purin~! The herald of good fortune has arrived! Are you ready? Raise your hands and follow me... Purin~ purin~!

battle.line: All ships, charge forward!

detail.line: For the next operation, we need to allocate resources, and... Yes? Ah, help yourself, Commander.

expedition.line: Stop daydreaming! Commissions have returned!

feeling1.line: You might as well just leave the fleet management to me.

feeling2.line: I was a flagship before, but now I'm just a common warrior. Please treat me the same as you would the others.

feeling3.line: Commander, it's okay to respect my opinions, but please have confidence in your own judgment. I wouldn't be standing by your side if I didn't believe in you.

feeling4.line: Commander, why do you think those famous generals of the past were willing to bow to their superiors? Was it the limit of their abilities, or was it devotion to their leaders? In my case, perhaps a bit of both.

feeling5.line: Real leaders will always stick to their guns, no matter who opposes them. You can tell if their methods are correct by seeing who is willing to follow them. For example... me...

home.line: Books cannot teach you everything. Some things can only be picked up through live combat. What do you think, Commander?

login.line: Commander, how you spend your time off-duty is no business of mine. Once you arrive, however, please do your work properly.

lose.line: All ships, retreat! Do not make meaningless sacrifices.

mail.line: Commander! It's important to respond to messages promptly!

main1.line: If being cautious is considered cowardice, then shouldn't being brave also be considered recklessness?

main2.line: There is no single solution for everything. Only through comparison, practice, and even failure, can one find their own correct answer.

main3.line: Even if others don't understand my actions, I'll always do what I think is right... Even if you don't understand, Commander.

mission.line: Your new missions have been sorted. Please take a look.

mission_complete.line: Rewards are here... Hmm? Don't worry. I'm just thinking about how to make our fleet more efficient.

profile.line: I'm Sendaii-class ship No. 2, Flagship of the Second Torpedo Squadron, Jintsuu. People have criticized me for being a coward, but I proved myself in the Battle of Kolombangara. Let me show you the glory of the Second Torpedo Squadron once more.

propose.line: Deciding on the best course of action before acting cautiously has always been my creed. I can now say with confidence that choosing you, Commander, was the correct decision.

skill.line: I've been waiting for this moment!

touch.line: What's the matter? I'm just thinking about how to manage the fleet.

touch2.line: You've got more guts than I expected, Commander. Do you have the heart to face the consequences, though?

unlock.line: The battlefield can change at any second. Think rationally and act cautiously so that you may never be defeated in battle. Commander, have you been able to achieve this? Flagship of the Second Torpedo Squadron, Jintsuu, reporting for duty.

upgrade.line: Should we consider advancing deeper into enemy territory?

win_mvp.line: Is that it?

battle.line: Everyone, Level 1 combat readiness! Set sail!

couple_encourage1.line: A larger-caliber Iowa? No, not quite...

couple_encourage2.line: As if I'd lose to some carriers!

couple_encourage3.line: Freedom and firepower: an unstoppable force!

couple_encourage4.line: Oh? Finally, a worthy opponent? How interesting~

couple_encourage5.line: We owe a lot to you, Miss Heroine.

detail.line: Thanks for finishing the equipment inspection. All systems nominal! ...Oh my, you seem to be unable to take your eyes off me~ Not that it bothers me though? Besides, don'tcha like this sort of stuff?

expedition.line: Your commission fleet's back. Are your words of praise not the best reward you can give them? Hehe~♪

feeling1.line: Ah, so you're the kind of person who makes girls cry. Yeah, you'd better feel bad about it.

feeling2.line: We'll only get in each other's way if we keep an ambivalent relationship. Say, don'tcha think getting touchy-feely might help break the ice? ...Just kidding~ See, you're already not as nervous~ Hehehe~♪

feeling3.line: Look at that, you're already starting to chat me up. So, what's on your mind today? Something a bit more technical? Small talk about daily life? ...Oh, you want me to choose?

feeling4.line: My my, look who's all run down today... I knew it, you've been overworking yourself. C'mere, lie down here and let me take care of you. Yeah, my thighs make for a pretty good pillow substitute huh? Don'tcha just love this kind of stuff~?

feeling5.line: Commander, would you prefer I take the lead, or would you rather do it? Hold up~ I'll see for myself when the time is right, so there's no need for you to answer in words. After all, don'tcha just love being toyed with~?

headtouch.line: Done having your fun yet? Hehe, now it's my turn~♪ Take a seat!

home.line: Wanna check the battle results~♪ Yeah? Who do you wanna start with? Oh, you'll do it yourself? I'll listen in while enjoying some ice cream over here.

hp_warning.line: I know just the thing to turn this situation around!

login.line: Glad you made it. Do you already have a plan for what you wanna do? And how do I factor into those plans?

lose.line: Unbelievable... I'm actually getting cornered?! ...I'm not gonna be able to sleep 'til I figure out how to set things straight!

mail.line: You've got new mail. Heh, dont'cha just love the anticipation~?

main1.line: Iowa versus Yamato, huh? A real classic. Don'tcha just love that kind of stuff?

main2.line: I go for the fruity stuff~ green apple, orange, and soda water. As for coffee... Not my favorite, I guess?

main3.line: How much stuff should I be doing as your secretary? ...Lemme think, how does 40% sound? If I did everything, wouldn't that make me the commander? Heh.

main4.line: About that matter... I must admit that you have a point, Commander. How about taking my suggestion next time though?

main5.line: It's now the age of carriers? ...Dunno about that. If carriers are able to evolve, what's to say that battleships can't also evolve?

main6.line: They call me Big J or the Black Dragon of the Eagle Union! ...What, got a problem with talking myself up a bit?

mission.line: Did you already accept this mission? Sounds good, let's take care of it together.

mission_complete.line: Since we already got the hard stuff out of the way, why not take a little break? It's gonna be pretty easy to prioritize whatever is left~

profile.line: I am battleship New Jersey, the indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union. When I say "indomitable," I'm not just tooting my own horn, hehe~♪ If you knew more about me, you'd know exactly what I'm talking about.

propose.line: Commander, I can already hear everything you're thinking. As long as you're fine with it, I don't have any objections~ After all, I still owe you a proper confession, don't I? Hehe, don'tcha think that's what mutual love is supposed to look like?

skill.line: Fire control, I'm counting on you!

touch.line: I'll take any work-related requests, but anything outside of that... won't come cheap. Just kidding~♪

touch2.line: Commander, don'tcha just love being put on the defensive? In more ways than one~♪

upgrade.line: Some say that the age of battleships is over. They haven't met the Iowa class.

feeling1.line: Ah, so you're the kind of person who makes girls cry. Yeah, you'd better feel bad about it.

feeling2.line: We'll only get in each other's way if we keep an ambivalent relationship. Say, don'tcha think getting touchy-feely might help break the ice? ...Just kidding~ See, you're already not as nervous~ Hehehe~♪

feeling3.line: Look at that, you're already starting to chat me up. So, what's on your mind today? Something a bit more technical? Small talk about daily life? ...Oh, you want me to choose?

feeling4.line: My my, look who's all run down today... I knew it, you've been overworking yourself. C'mere, lie down here and let me take care of you. Yeah, my thighs make for a pretty good pillow substitute huh? Don'tcha just love this kind of stuff~?

feeling5.line: Commander, would you prefer I take the lead, or would you rather do it? Hold up~ I'll see for myself when the time is right, so there's no need for you to answer in words. After all, don'tcha just love being toyed with~?

headtouch.line: Done having your fun yet? Hehe, now it's my turn~♪ Take a seat!

home.line: Wanna check the battle results~♪ Yeah? Who do you wanna start with? Oh, you'll do it yourself? I'll listen in while enjoying some ice cream over here.

hp_warning.line: I know just the thing to turn this situation around!

login.line: Glad you made it. Do you already have a plan for what you wanna do? And how do I factor into those plans?

lose.line: Unbelievable... I'm actually getting cornered?! ...I'm not gonna be able to sleep 'til I figure out how to set things straight!

mail.line: You've got new mail. Heh, dont'cha just love the anticipation~?

main1.line: Iowa versus Yamato, huh? A real classic. Don'tcha just love that kind of stuff?

main2.line: I go for the fruity stuff~ green apple, orange, and soda water. As for coffee... Not my favorite, I guess?

main3.line: How much stuff should I be doing as your secretary? ...Lemme think, how does 40% sound? If I did everything, wouldn't that make me the commander? Heh.

main4.line: About that matter... I must admit that you have a point, Commander. How about taking my suggestion next time though?

main5.line: It's now the age of carriers? ...Dunno about that. If carriers are able to evolve, what's to say that battleships can't also evolve?

main6.line: They call me Big J or the Black Dragon of the Eagle Union! ...What, got a problem with talking myself up a bit?

mission.line: Did you already accept this mission? Sounds good, let's take care of it together.

mission_complete.line: Since we already got the hard stuff out of the way, why not take a little break? It's gonna be pretty easy to prioritize whatever is left~

profile.line: I am battleship New Jersey, the indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union. When I say "indomitable," I'm not just tooting my own horn, hehe~♪ If you knew more about me, you'd know exactly what I'm talking about.

propose.line: Commander, I can already hear everything you're thinking. As long as you're fine with it, I don't have any objections~ After all, I still owe you a proper confession, don't I? Hehe, don'tcha think that's what mutual love is supposed to look like?

skill.line: Fire control, I'm counting on you!

touch.line: I'll take any work-related requests, but anything outside of that... won't come cheap. Just kidding~♪

touch2.line: Commander, don'tcha just love being put on the defensive? In more ways than one~♪

unlock.line: The indomitable Black Dragon of the Eagle Union is none other than me, New Jersey! You're about to witness true power! Haha, just messing~♪ Don'tcha just love flashy introductions?

upgrade.line: Some say that the age of battleships is over. They haven't met the Iowa class.

win_mvp.line: Course: steady! Objective: completed! Enemies who can stop us: none! Heheh, don'tcha love it when things go smoothly?

battle.line: Everyone, Level 1 combat readiness! Set sail!

couple_encourage1.line: A large-caliber Iowa, you say? I'm not sure that's accurate...

couple_encourage2.line: I'll leave the skies to you.

couple_encourage3.line: None may stand before our will!

couple_encourage4.line: Hm? An unexpected competitor. How interesting~

couple_encourage5.line: We salute you for fighting the good fight, hero of the Eagle Union!

win_mvp.line: Course: steady! Objective: completed! Enemies who can stop us: none! Heheh, don'tcha love it when things go smoothly?

battle.line: When you're ready, let's get going.

couple_encourage1.line: The parrot tulips aren't growing very well... Can you take a look at them?

detail.line: Quiet, please. I'm observing this club silverline butterfly laying eggs.

expedition.line: The commission group is back. This destination... seems ripe for research. Commander, let me go there next time.

feeling1.line: Quiet, Commander. I'm busy observing this moss.

feeling2.line: This is a miniature tropical rainforest ecosystem. If you're interested, come and observe data with me.

feeling3.line: This moss is growing much faster than expected. See how the sporangia develop 37% faster than the control group... Hm? Why are you looking at me like that? Did I use too many big words? ...You like seeing me smile?

feeling4.line: Commander, don't touch the plants in this room. They contain trace toxins as part of an experiment... Ah, there it is. I made this balloon flower bookmark for you... It explains the language of that flower on the back.

feeling5.line: May I sit next to you and work on my latest observational data? Okay, thank you... Huh? Does it bother you how close I am? But this is the only place I can sunbathe while I work... If you don't mind being just "bothered" a little, then it's fine if I stay, yes?

headtouch.line: Is this a kind of healing magic?

home.line: You're going right back to work even though you just got back? I'll use magic to cure your fatigue. Sit still, please.

hp_warning.line: I'm okay. I can treat these wounds myself.

login.line: Work efficiency trends upward in environments with a lot of greenery, so I've brought a few pots of air plants and cacti. They're easy to care for... Stop staring and focus on your work, please.

lose.line: Is anyone hurt? I'll help treat you.

mail.line: You have mail. Don't forget to check it.

main1.line: Commander, focus on your job rather than my plants, please. ...Hm? I did just call them all plants for simplicity's sake, but if you're really curious, I can introduce you to each. AFTER you finish your work, of course.

main2.line: Does the mini pine tree look healthier than before? Well, I did use magic on it. I also wrote care instructions on a sticky note and put it on the pot.

main3.line: Want to look at this through a microscope? This thallus has a darker color than usual, indicating a higher chlorophyll content... One of nature's many mysteries.

mission.line: Don't forget your missions, Commander. Shall I spruce you up with a little magic first?

mission_complete.line: Your missions are all complete. Well done, Commander.

profile.line: I am Evertsen, an Admiralen-class destroyer of the Kingdom of Tulipa. I'm currently observing and researching the ecosystem of this port. If you're interested in my findings, then come along – quietly, please.

propose.line: Commander, I brought a bunch of baby's-breath for you. I'll preserve it in its most beautiful state with magic so that it never withers... Yes, like my love for you, it will remain eternal.

touch.line: Perfect timing. My growth experiment needs an assistant. Can you come and help me?

touch2.line: Aah?! Please stop... This is embarrassing.

unlock.line: Hmm. Are you the Commander? I'm Evertsen. ...Wait. We can talk after I finish recording this data.

upgrade.line: My magic grows stronger...

win_mvp.line: We won. Very good.

gift_prefer.line: I love it. Thank you for the thoughtful gift.

detail_ex.line: Shush... Actually, come over here. Quietly if you can. This bee-eating philanthus is hunting prey, so don't startle it.

feeling5_ex.line: Just as plants need sunlight and water, I need you, Commander. It's so very simple and easy to understand... A natural truth, you might call it.

headtouch_ex.line: Mm... I really feel healed now...

home_ex.line: Do I look tired? Well... Yes. I've been organizing data on symbiosis between fungi and termites over the past few days... Phew. Honestly, seeing you has made me feel so much better. Maybe you have your own sort of "healing magic."

login_ex.line: Commander, you're here. Come and look at this! The plant I brought here is blooming.

main4_ex.line: Commander, focus on your work... Your staring at me is distracting...

main5_ex.line: The lady of the night has truly fascinating characteristics. I'd love to tell you about it... Wait, you're really interested? It's going to be a long one... Okay. Let's find a sunny place to relax, okay?

main6_ex.line: Do you want my magic to help you keep working? I'll have to refuse. If you want to energize yourself, then we should go out together. Interacting with nature is the best way to eliminate fatigue for me.

touch_ex.line: Do you want a hug? Umm... I just handled a sample, so I'll do it right after I wash my hands!

touch2_ex.line: My rising temperature, my hastening heartbeat – both are normal bodily reactions... because I love you...

detail.line: There's no need to be quiet today, so... shall we chat? I want to know more about you...

feeling5.line: This is my first time doing something like this... just relaxing and basking with someone I love. It's comforting. Don't look so confused, Commander – the person I love is YOU, of course.

headtouch.line: Hm? You want to be next to me?

home.line: This data has a few abnormalities. Let's do another control... Ah, Commander. I'll get you water – oh, my experiment? It's no hurry. We can do it after.

login.line: Let's sit by the window together. Ah... Watch your step. I have notebooks, um, lying about.

main1.line: What are you looking at? Are you interested in the regular deviations of monarch butterfly migration paths? I'll gladly tell you all about it.

main2.line: This is just an ornamental plant. It isn't poisonous, and it won't bite, so look closely if you'd like... Here. I made room for you to view it.

main3.line: Are you still not used to seeing me on days off? Even I need breaks, you know... and so do you. Relax a little, why don't you?

touch.line: Why not join me and change into pajamas? You'll be comfier.

touch2.line: By the window is a little, umm, embarrassing...

unlock.line: Commander, relax wherever you like. ...Why so far? You won't get any sun there.

detail.line: There's only so much that healing magic can do. Yet, these mangroves not only provide a habitat for marine organisms and migratory birds, but also protect the ecosystem. They're even more impressive than magic.

feeling5.line: Mangrove roots are special. They intertwine, supporting one another without ever letting go. I want us to be like that, too... supporting each other, and becoming one.

headtouch.line: Come here and take a rest next to me. It's nice and cool...

home.line: I'm taking water samples. Come over here if you're interested. I'll teach you how to do it.

login.line: Let's do some deep breathing together. Mmmh... Haaah... The crisp air around the mangroves does much to uplift one's mood.

main1.line: I resemble the guardian fae of the mangroves, you say? Then, would you perhaps like to join me in protecting them, Commander?

main2.line: The mangroves' roots have spread farther since the last time I was here. Would you like to see them up close? I'll give you a detailed explanation.

main3.line: Are you too hot? Then come over here and we'll dip our feet in the water together. Let's give ourselves over to the pleasant breeze while we're at it... Well? It feels lovely, doesn't it?

touch.line: What's the matter? If you're worried about the stability of this perch, then please hold my hand.

touch2.line: The animals are watching...

unlock.line: Do you see where the little egrets descended, Commander? That is where the mangroves we planted together are. And now, they are a home for the birds.

battle.line: Let's press on. We can win this!

couple_encourage1.line: Can I offer you any plants for your newest experiments? Or any help whatsoever?

detail.line: Hum hum... Ah, Commander. I was just watering Klein Groentje here... Hm? Did you like the song I was humming? Heehee, then I'll keep going for you~

expedition.line: Commander, the girls who went out on commission are back. Go see them, okay? I'm sure they all miss you.

feeling1.line: Commander... You should really be more considerate of everyone.

feeling2.line: I could clean so much better if I could handle a robot vacuum, but I just can't figure it out... Push here, maybe? Or... *cough* *cough*! Wh-why is there so much dust...

feeling3.line: I'll give the white one, Klein Witje, to Evertsen. She likes little flowers... Do you, Commander? Okay, then I'll grow one for you as well~

feeling4.line: Commander, I prepared the garden. Are you free later? I made flower herbal tea, so let's have a little tea party there to celebrate.

feeling5.line: Commander, I grew these roses for you... Heehee, aren't they pretty? I raised them with sooo much love! That is... love for you♡

headtouch.line: Are you tired? Let's go to the park and take a relaxing stroll. It's okay, you don't have to worry about me~

home.line: Welcome back. Umm... Can you take a look at the coffee machine for me? I followed the manual, but when I pressed start, smoke started coming out...

hp_warning.line: Ngh. Is everyone okay...?

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Klein Groentje welcomes you, too... Who am I talking about? Heehee, my little plant here. For you~

lose.line: It's okay. Let's regroup and try again.

mail.line: Commander, there's new mail... You want me to read it to you? Umm, this is how you open the menu, right... H-huh? Where'd the mail go?

main1.line: Commander, can I turn the space behind your office into a little garden? If I just plant some flowers and the like, they'll be right there to help you relax.

main2.line: Why isn't the printer working... Huh? It's just out of paper? I see...

main3.line: Why did I give Klein Groentje such a difficult name? Well, I don't think it's difficult. It just means Little Green, actually.

mission.line: Commander, there are new missions for you to handle... It's not too many, so just keep at it for a little while. Give it your best~♪

mission_complete.line: Good work, Commander. Leave the rest of the work to me while you unwind.

profile.line: De Zeven Provinciën, Kingdom of Tulipa's own light cruiser, speaking. Would you like to know about my home? It has colorful flower fields, spinning windmills... I think you'd love it. Oh, you want to know about ME? That's fine... Heehee, how about we walk and talk?

propose.line: Commander, come closer for me... I want to see your smile and feel your warmth, so that I can remember the most important day of my life forever...

touch.line: Are you feeling down? You can tell me about it. Oh, but not if you don't want to. I'll just stay here by your side, okay?

touch2.line: Do you like? Heehee, if it excites you... then touch more. I don't mind~

unlock.line: Hello there. I'm De Zeven Provinciën, a light cruiser from the Kingdom of Tulipa. It's a pleasure to meet you... Heehee, the plants of the port are so properly maintained. I can tell you take good care of them!

upgrade.line: This power didn't come easy... I'll use it to the fullest!

win_mvp.line: Thank goodness we won... It's all thanks to you, everyone!

gift_prefer.line: Aww, how kind of you. I'll treasure this~

detail_ex.line: You can't water this one too much, and this one needs frequent exposure to the sun... Hm? How do you take care of ME? Heehee, I just need your warm hugs and sweet kisses every single day♪

feeling5_ex.line: Now, we just pack the soil tight... There. I can't wait to see the rosebud peek out of the soil♪ It's a new life planted by you and me... Say, should we give it a name while we're at it?

headtouch_ex.line: Are my bangs getting a little too long...?

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I'll make tulip tea... Oh, you want coffee? Umm... So, you know how you fixed the coffee machine the other day? Well... I broke it again. I'm sorry.

login_ex.line: Commander, you're back~ I'm glad you didn't miss these babies' peak bloom... Heehee, they bloom so beautifully that I just knew I had to see them with you.

main4_ex.line: Commander, how about a walk in the garden? You've been hard at work for a long time, so take a little break... Or just consider it spending time with me.

main5_ex.line: Oh, no... Where did that file go? Commander, I think I... Huh? You found a backup? Phew... Thank goodness! I was trying to help you, and I didn't expect...

main6_ex.line: Commander, what name would suit this yellow tulip? ...Hm? How'd you know I would name it Klein Geeltje?

touch_ex.line: Indulge all you want~

touch2_ex.line: There are lots of ways to relieve stress~ Heehee... Wanna try one with me?♡

detail.line: How happy I would be if I could wake up next to you every day... Commander, if you like this place, then why not stay a few more days?

feeling5.line: You've been too busy lately. You finally have time off, so come and have sweet dreams with me... Heehee, close your eyes... Mwah.

headtouch.line: Do you want me to stay, too? I'd be happy to sleep with you for a while longer♪

home.line: Stay in bed for a while~ I'll go make breakfast. Will milk and toast do? Oh... Right, I broke the toaster yesterday...

login.line: Are you awake? ...Why didn't I wake you? Hmm... Because you looked too cute in your sleep. How could I take my eyes away?♪

main1.line: I'll get you a glass of water. ...Is something wrong? Oh, you don't want me to leave? Hmm... Okay, the water can wait~

main2.line: Do you like my sleepwear? Heehee, how about you pick for me next time?

main3.line: You wanna close the curtain? Is the sun too bright? ...You're worried people will see? It's okay; we're surrounded by greenery. Nobody knows a thing♪

mission.line: Commander, you have new missions. We can't lie around for much longer... Oh! Can you work from bed?

touch.line: You want to get closer? Be my guest~ I'll share half my pillows!

touch2.line: Hm? You want to go another round? Geez, did you really recover so fast?♡

unlock.line: Good morning, Commander. Did you sleep well? Oh, there are petals in your hair. I'll get them for you~

battle.line: Alright, Commander – it's time to show you what I'm made of.

couple_encourage1.line: Have you made any new discoveries? Tell me about them.

couple_encourage2.line: Singing to your plants – that's so lovely!

detail.line: Heehee. Just as the warm winds of spring are a part of nature, so, too, are the cold streams of winter. Mother Nature deserves respect in all her forms... Oh? You say my control over nature's powers deserves respect as well? My, my... I think your efforts are better spent on vigilance than flattery.

expedition.line: What's this? The commission team has come back. Come with me and we'll go see them, Commander.

feeling1.line: Goodness gracious. If something's upset you, why don't you speak to nature? It may just ease your mind.

feeling2.line: Heheh, the nights have been oddly quiet lately, you say? That's because I've been lulling the troublemakers to sleep with my vines.

feeling3.line: Commander, if you ever need a break, I can take on some of your work for you. Mother Nature's powers can fix anything, so don't hesitate.

feeling4.line: Look, Commander – I conjured an illusion of you! Sadly, it doesn't have the warmth of your hands, and its heart doesn't thump like yours... I much, much prefer the real version of you!

feeling5.line: Goodness, I was hoping you'd be wholly reliant on me, and yet I'm the one who can't get enough of you... Well, it is how it is. We are both in nature's embrace, completely inseparable from one another. Isn't that right? Heehee.

headtouch.line: Heheh. Yes, this is quite pleasant. Like the gentle warmth of the sun on a spring day.

home.line: Oh, our champion returns. How about a quick break? Give yourself to the sun's brilliance, the birds' chirping, and the fragrance of the flowers. It may very well have a surprising benefit.

hp_warning.line: Don't be alarmed. Nature will inflict this pain back on our enemy!

login.line: Ah, Commander. Welcome. Letting my vines stretch too freely, you say? My apologies. I was concentrating on my breathing and didn't notice... Heheh, it's a wonderful feeling, so why don't you try it with me? Huff... Puff...

lose.line: This is nothing but a minor setback. It's fine. Just relax and we'll give it another try.

mail.line: Did you receive a new letter? Tell me what it's about later.

main1.line: Why don't we take a walk? There are so many trees growing here. I can escort you through the quiet and vivid woods♪

main2.line: Aww, Commander, are you pulling another all-nighter? That's really not in tune with nature at all. Come on, you've worked enough. Let this firefly guide you home.

main3.line: Those children are ruining nature's beautiful sounds... Commander, if you keep ignoring them, my vines will take things into their own hands and punish them.

main4.line: What are you listening to, Commander? A "sounds of nature" playlist? So merely listening is good enough for you? You can't even smell the flowers and plants... If it's the sound of nature you wish to hear, why not do so in my embrace?

mission.line: Commander, it's time to do some missions. If you're too tired, come here and I'll look after you.

mission_complete.line: My, you're incredible! Come here for a hug. Heehee – is this the kind of reward you prefer?

profile.line: I am Gouden Leeuw of the Kingdom of Tulipa. Vines come from nature, and magic comes from light. Look here – I can use light magic to conjure illusions of animals. Interesting, no? I do this as a reward for children who behave.

propose.line: It seems we've walked into the hidden realm of love whilst blessed by nature... My time spent with you is like a vine in the nourishing sunlight, and our love grows and grows more with time... Take my hand, Commander, and let us listen to the song of nature as we walk into tomorrow.

skill.line: Listen... to this lullaby of life.

touch.line: Be gentle. I'm a bit ticklish, you see. Heehee.

touch2.line: Aahh... You may want to reconsider... before my vines tie you up.

unlock.line: Heehee. It was you who brought the sound of nature here, yes? I hope this gift may warm your heart and soothe your body. Now, close your eyes... Become one with the sound of harmony and embrace a world of peace.

upgrade.line: Would you like an up-close demonstration of my improved strength, Commander?

win_mvp.line: Trying to resist nature? This simply won't do.

gift_prefer.line: You have such a way of always giving me what I want~ How can I possibly return the favor?

battle_ex.line: Let us seize the fruits of victory. I'm sure they're delicious!

detail_ex.line: Never take your eyes off me, Commander. My vines are always wrapped around you!

expedition_ex.line: It takes blood, sweat, and tears to grow beautiful flowers, Commander. This is much the same.

feeling5_ex.line: Commander? Are you already asleep? Heehee... It's so nice – listening to each other's heartbeat while in nature's embrace... We can forget about our burdens and responsibilities and enjoy this stillness just for us. Commander, I will always be there for you, be it on the blazing battlefield, or the moonlit way home.

headtouch_ex.line: Feel free to run your hand through my hair. It'll feel good for the both of us.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Oh dear, did my vines wrap around you? Goodness, I need to be more careful... Heehee – it seems they're as fond of you as I.

login_ex.line: Commander, did you hear the wind blow through the trees on your way here? Heehee – the port is under nature's protection. Even her critters are keeping watch over you. Of course, I'm protecting you as well.

lose_ex.line: Defeat is a fleeting thing. You're still under nature's protection.

main5_ex.line: Come, take a rest on my shoulder and I'll tell you a story about the forest. The stars that shine on the treetops, the dew that moistens the leaves – all things in nature have a long, long journey.

main6_ex.line: Commander, you can be completely relaxed when I'm here. Let us enjoy this silence just for us.

main7_ex.line: My, my, Commander... Which little animal brought you here this time? Was it the baby deer... or was it the lion cub?

main8_ex.line: Heehee. Your heart's beating fast... Is it because of me? Come, listen... Find out if my heartbeat tells the same secrets as yours does.

mail_ex.line: Ah, there's a new letter. Let's see what interesting things are written in it.

mission_ex.line: It's time for work, Commander. Best of luck to you. I'll be waiting right here.

mission_complete_ex.line: Oh, mission rewards? You can have anything you want, heheh. My vines will block the door and the windows, so I assure you nobody will see or hear anything.

touch_ex.line: Ah, a warm closeness that's like being held by the forest...

touch2_ex.line: Ahh... Are you asking for more intimacy, hm?

upgrade_ex.line: This new strength will help me protect you better.

win_mvp_ex.line: What a splendid victory! Time to stretch our muscles, Commander.

detail.line: Since you'll be cleaning me, get on top of me. Please, I insist. Be thorough and meticulous, and don't miss a spot anywhere from my toes to my chest... or my hair and my skin. Heehee.

feeling5.line: Is the cleaning done already? Heehee – you, however, don't seem to have had enough. Allow me to repay your efforts now, then. Aahhh... It's true – other than nature, you are the only thing that helps me relax.

headtouch.line: Well, if you wish to do it this way... Ahh... Yes, that feels lovely.

home.line: Welcome back. It's time we got you cleaned up. This time, I'll be the one doing it to you.

login.line: I do wonder what part of me you'll clean first. Yes, start with whatever you like. You're mine to spoil right now, after all.

main1.line: What sorts of aroma do you like? The fragrance of ripe fruit? The smell of a quiet forest? ...The scent of my body soap? Well, then why don't you come closer?

main2.line: Oh dear, I'm all covered in bubbles... You didn't have to go THAT far, Commander.

main3.line: This spot next. We should be nearly done. Don't worry, I'll hold still. Heehee – you're so well-mannered, Commander.

main4.line: ...If there were any vines here, I'm sure they'd constrict you right up.

touch.line: Commander, could you clean this spot for me?

touch2.line: Ahh... Ohh... Naughty-naughty, Commander. What should I do with you?

unlock.line: After all that messing around in the bathroom, it's time to clean myself. Commander, would you please assist me? I'll be still for you, of course. For instance... How about this position, hmm?

battle.line: Go, go! Fortune favours the fleet-footed!

detail.line: Alright, lassies, it's time to go night-night. The pirate bedtime stories will have to be another time. Hm? You wanna hear them too, Commander? Then maybe an adult story would be more to your tastes, huh? Hahahaha♡

expedition.line: The commission team is back with a boatload of booty! They're waiting for you to divvy it up, so get going!

feeling1.line: Ugghh. If this were the olden days, I would've fed you to the sharks or dumped you off on a deserted island.

feeling2.line: Living in the moment means doing what you enjoy and forgetting all your troubles and concerns! ...That still doesn't mean I have the right to plunder? Laaame!

feeling3.line: Even to this day, lots of people go wild for pirate treasure! I suppose very few can resist the alluring shimmer of gold and silver, eh... Hm? Where do ya find said treasure? Sorry, no hints! If you want treasure, you gotta find it yourself~

feeling4.line: You don't sail the seas with me just to find treasure, do ya, Commander? I don't think you're in it just for the novelty either... It can't be ME you're after, right? I mean, there's no way... Woah, you're not gonna deny it?

feeling5.line: Since you don't have a destination in mind, why don't I plot your course for you? For instance... to that deserted island said to have buried pirate treasure I've heard about. Heheh, don't you worry – worst case scenario, we only end up stranded and have to live there, right? C'mon, let's go!

headtouch.line: Hey! I don't like it when people touch my hat without permission!

home.line: You made it back! Brought back any exciting tales of your adventures? You know, like being caught in a storm, chased by sharks, and swept away by the waves before finally escaping with your life?

hp_warning.line: Let's find out who fortune favours!

login.line: Ahahaha! There you are, Commander! Hurry up and finish your work so we can set off on another grand adventure!

lose.line: Grah! I hate swallows! Shoo with the lot of you!

mail.line: A letter? Ahah! Is it a wanted list? Say, if you had a bounty on your head, how much do you reckon it'd be worth?

main1.line: Movies! Video games! Ah, modern entertainment is bloody amazing! It's easier than ever to stave off boredom even while not out at sea!

main2.line: Gambling simply boils down to a test of who's luckier. It's not about winners or losers – it's about scamming poor sods who aren't as lucky as they thought.

main3.line: Even we pirates have our own code of conduct. How are you supposed to keep people in line without rules? Speaking of which, what kind of rules do you have?

mission.line: New missions, eh? Let's have a gander... This one's high risk, but high reward too... Alright, let's do it!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Speaking of which, what's the secretary's cut of the rewards?

profile.line: My history? Well, I was a rough and tough pirate just like in the stories, bullying those I didn't like and ne'er living two days the same way~ Then I got into a fight with a real tough bastard and that was game over for me. Bad luck, that's what it was.

propose.line: Sooo... you're sure about this? Living with me's not gonna be easy. You can't just change your mind later, ya hear? ...Well, alright, then take my hand and put the ring on. Once we're done, get on my ship and hoist sails!

skill.line: I'll blow you all to bits!

touch.line: Hahaha, tired of boring ol' paperwork and ready for an adventure? I'm always ready to sail with ya♪

touch2.line: Between drinking lethal poison, a sword through the neck, or being thrown overboard... which one would you prefer? ♪

unlock.line: You're looking at the mysterious, heartstopping Royal Fortune! ...Hm? Scared you, did I? C'mon, don't be so uptight! Now, where are we headed? The fabled Treasure Coast? The cursed Black Reef, littered with shipwrecks? I don't care where we're going; let's just hoist the sails!

upgrade.line: Now that I'm stronger, shall we set out for a more thrilling, heart-throbbing adventure?

win_mvp.line: Heheh~ Time to feed these scalawags to the sharks!

gift_prefer.line: Whoa, bloody amazing! I'll take that!

battle_ex.line: Those who do the most work get the biggest cut!

login_ex.line: Look who's back! Let's team up and get this paperwork done lightning-quick!

main4_ex.line: Port law article four! Be good and switch off the light before going to bed! Which means no worky-work either! Nighttime means leisure time!

main5_ex.line: While I do hate gambling, I'm not opposed to making bets. On that note, I bet I can win your heart with just one single date! Wanna find out?

main6_ex.line: Booze? God no! Just taking a whiff of that stuff makes my head spin, and drinking it leaves me out cold until morning... In other words, keep it away from me.

main7_ex.line: I'd like one small favour from you, Commander... That you don't pull an all-nighter! Back in the day when curfews were in place, people got on just fine, didn't they? So, absolutely no staying up late tonight! Got it?

mail_ex.line: Here's a letter for you! And no, it's not a wanted list. But if you did become an outlaw, you can always flee to some barren corner of the earth.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete! When it comes to my cut... I don't need material stuff, just some break time to smell the roses!

touch_ex.line: If you're on board with it, we can make up some quick excuse and get out of here right now... Come on, you still don't have the courage?

touch2_ex.line: L-look, even I shy away from some stuff...

win_mvp_ex.line: Commander, I trust you to divvy up our booty!

detail.line: Hey, hold it! Get back here! Commander, don't just stand there! Catch these thieving birdies and get me back my desserts!

home.line: Who did this?! Who put liquor fondue on my desserts?! Urgh... It's hitting me hard... I'm gonna go lie down a bit...

login.line: Happy Halloween! On this frightening night, I am Royal Fortune the naughty succubus! Ahahah! I'm on the hunt for a tasty treat!

main1.line: Mmm! Sho good! Desserts are a rare luxury out at sea, you know! This sweetness will linger in my head for a looong time!

main2.line: Would be cool if we lived in a world where monsters are real! I get pumped just imagining what it'd be like!

main3.line: That Janus girl sure has got a spicy costume for how shy she seems... Aha, does that happen to be one of your weaknesses, Commander?

touch.line: You're in too deep to pull out now~

touch2.line: Wh-wh-whaddya think you're doing?!

unlock.line: Tonight's dessert is not a cake or a pastry... What are you looking around for? YOU'RE my dessert! Heheh, scared you, didn't I?

detail.line: You're my golden treasure today, so don't you go anywhere♪ That's right, stay where you are if you don't wanna get grabbed by my tentacles! Ahahah!

expedition.line: Commission team just got back! Let me handle 'em.

home.line: Oi, what happened to spending the WHOLE day with me? Other girls can have their turn later! Heehee, caught you♪

login.line: Back, eh? Let's continue, then♪ "Continue what"? Our daylong date, duh!

lose.line: Urgh... That drink was NOT non-alcoholic...

main1.line: Hm-hmm-hmm♪ There's a million ways to have fun at the beach! And the pirate's way is pretty widespread, eh? Brilliant!

main2.line: A cocktail? Whoa, it looks so vibrant and tasty! ...The hell?! It's got alcohol in it! Are you trying to get me hammered, Commander?!

main3.line: Port law article eleven! On holidays, everyone should let loose during the day, then feast, sing, and party during the night! And participation is mandatory, Commander.

touch.line: So, what're we doing next?

touch2.line: You've just earned yourself a kicking! Take this! And that!

unlock.line: Hell of a proposition, this. Keeping an eye on your booty for the whole day so nobody steals it. But I said I'd do it, and a real Tempesta always keeps her word. You're all mine for today♪

battle.line: Let us play a melody of destruction for our foes!

couple_encourage1.line: I would never have imagined I'd sail with Golden Hind.

couple_encourage2.line: All fortunes must return to their rightful place.

detail.line: I am the inheritor of the Invincible Armada's glory. You surely know the burden I carry, Commander, you being the head of a fleet just as I.

expedition.line: The campaign fleet has come back, returning the treasure to its rightful place.

feeling1.line: I thought you had promise as a fellow head of a fleet... It seems I overestimated you.

feeling2.line: Commander, I ask you to stay close to me during our expeditions. The golden light will protect us all.

feeling3.line: I offer prayers for victory and peace whenever I embark on a campaign. Commander, I will pray for you too, and grant you the golden light's blessings.

feeling4.line: A storm is coming. Commander, take shelter under my wings and... Hm? Rubbing shoulders, you say? Well, that is to be expected...

feeling5.line: Commander, I've located a calm anchorage where we can be alone and... "Return treasure to its rightful place"? No, a-all I want is some private time with you...

home.line: Now that you've returned, let me examine you... Arms and legs are fine. You're in perfect health.

hp_warning.line: I can still... hold steady!

login.line: Commander, what grand undertaking shall we begin with today? ...This paperwork, you say?

lose.line: Let us await the opportunity for redemption.

mail.line: A new letter? Hmm... Actually, it's best if you read it yourself, Commander.

main1.line: These wings are a sacred gift from the golden light. Do you wish to touch them?

main2.line: You wish to hear the Invincible Tempesta's many poems? Then you need only wait. Come the battle with our despicable enemy, my sails shall tell you my tales.

main3.line: Pay close attention to fleet logistics, and in particular, the rations supply line. I say this based on my own experience.

main4.line: I will under no circumstances sail when a storm is raging. Hm? No, not because I'm afraid, but rather... because rain makes my wings heavy.

main5.line: You must hold your tongue even in the face of pain. Showing strength is important, because neither storms nor foes are merciful on the weak.

mission.line: A new mission? Very well. Remember to perform a hull inspection and repairs before you embark.

mission_complete.line: I do hope these mission rewards were worth the effort of our expedition.

profile.line: Turn your gold into the most magnificent palaces – turn your battles into the most valorous poems. Bathed in the glorious golden light, the Invincible Armada continues its campaign to this day.

propose.line: I swear to you this oath upon the golden light. My lance shall pierce your foes, and my wings shall keep you from harm, even at the cost of breaking them if there is no other choice.

skill.line: O Invincible Armada, heed my order!

touch.line: Is this a physical examination?

touch2.line: Why do I feel warm...?

unlock.line: São Martinho – the Invincible Tempesta, flagship of the Armada, and retainer of the golden light – greets you. Whereto is our next grand campaign, Commander?

upgrade.line: Gracias.

win_mvp.line: The golden light shall shine upon the path of victory.

gift_prefer.line: It's clear that you have good taste. I'll give this pride of place, don't worry.

home_ex.line: Welcome back. It's time for your routine examination... Good, you look fine.

login_ex.line: There you are. Bask in the glory of the golden light... Um, all I wanted to say is, "welcome back."

lose_ex.line: No need to put on appearances in front of you, I suppose...

main6_ex.line: I've been receiving fruits and vegetables from my friends around the port, surely as offerings to the Invincible Armada... They're just "worried I'll go hungry otherwise"? That can't be true!

main7_ex.line: When the going gets too tough, don't push yourself – come to me for help. That is what you preached to me, and now I am preaching it to you.

main8_ex.line: Fan you with my wings to cool you down? That is not what they're meant for! But, if you want me to give it a try... There, how's that?

mail_ex.line: Let us both read your latest letter.

touch_ex.line: I could use a hand with grooming my wings.

touch2_ex.line: This stirring in my chest... tell me, what is it?

detail.line: I am the shadow cast by light, I am the dark inversion, and I am São Martinho, retainer of the golden light. This fact will never change.

feeling5.line: You wonder how differently the light and dark versions of me feel about you? Regardless of appearance, the retainer of the golden light loves you, Commander. From start to end, I am me, and my feelings for you remain the same.

home.line: Welcome back to the port. I will keep a keen eye open to see who out there is able to hurt you.

login.line: Not to say you're late, but I did wait some time. My heart ached for you.

main1.line: The golden light casts a shadow. This shadow is indispensable to our glory's continued existence.

main2.line: I've dyed you in my own color... Heehee, no, this darkness is only meant to protect you.

main3.line: This hunger, it yearns to be quelled... with lots of food. Hm? I mean a loooot of food, Commander.

main4.line: You wish to see me fight in my dark form? Hmmmm. It almost sounds like you prefer the way I look now.

main5.line: The "old" São Martinho? Silly you. I am still me; I'm not a fallen angel or corrupted by the dark. There is no "old" or "new."

touch.line: I feel you've become more reliant on me. Good.

touch2.line: What a delicious feeling...

unlock.line: Here you see the opposite side of the retainer of the golden light. Be not afraid. I am still me, and my feelings and my beliefs have not changed. Still, if it unnerves you, perhaps you should get to know me again?

win_mvp.line: The shadow follows the golden light's course.

battle.line: I will add you lot to my collection♡

detail.line: You really do have a stunning body, my darling~ Heehee♡

expedition.line: A commission's been completed. Would the team mind bringing me the enemy's remains?

feeling1.line: Your body is the only good thing about you... What a shame.

feeling2.line: I brought these lychees with me on a recent cruise~ Heehee, they're juicy, sweet, and delectable~ Want to try one? Let me just peel the skin and take out the annoying core, then I'll bring it to your mouth using my tongue♡

feeling3.line: I can come closer, you say? Heehee, I feel the passion emanating from you~ *squish squish* Heehee. Is this better, my darling Commander? Can you feel MY passion? ♡

feeling4.line: Too close? Heehee, my urge to top you has only grown stronger since I laid eyes on you, my darling... There's no escaping your fate now♡

feeling5.line: Oohh, so this is how you answer... You get dominant when you want to affirm your feelings, I see♡ If I'd known this when we first met, I would've done something more... Heehee, never you mind~ I can't wait to experience our future together♡

headtouch.line: You're quite gentle with those hands, my darling...♡

home.line: You're finally back, my darling~ How rude of you to leave me behind, when I prefer taking the lead rather than lying down... Oh? What's this mango? A treat for me? Heehee~ Why, how kind of you~♡

hp_warning.line: I can't regenerate quickly enough to keep pace...

login.line: There you are, my darling. Heehee, I have fresh meat and vegetables, hand-squeezed juice and liquor, everything you can think of, if you want a taste~♪ *squish*

lose.line: It's alright, my darling Commander. My severed parts will grow back in no time~

mail.line: Here's your letter, darling~ *squish* ...It's sticky? Heehee, think of it as my liquid passion for you~♡

main1.line: My apologies~ It seems some of my ooze got stuck on you.

main2.line: Are you interested in my remains collection? Don't you worry, I'll tell you aaall about it and the stories behind it in thorough detail♡ *squish squish*

main3.line: Movies, games, books... There are so many pastimes at this place~ I wonder, though... would you be interested in an onboard concert?

mission.line: Heehee, my darling~ You must read the fine print carefully before you sign the pact♡

mission_complete.line: As a reward for completing your mission, I invite you to my bosom♡

profile.line: Caught you~ Heehee. What do you wish to know about? My name? My eternal beings, or should I say, my adorable tentacles? Well, my tentacles have been to the end of the world once~ There is no end of the world? Whatever you say♡

propose.line: Is this...? Heehee, I see now~ It's a promise about a home, isn't it, my darling? Heehee... I've roamed freely up to this point, going wherever my whims dictated, but now I have a place that accepts me. Well, Commander, what are you waiting for? It's time we indulged in each other, forever and ever♡

skill.line: Join the others in my collection!

touch.line: What is it? Do you want to feel my tentacles? Heehee... Go ahead~

touch2.line: You've finally caught on, Commander... *squish squish* Now, come to me. I will take everything you have to give♡

unlock.line: Greetings, my darling Commander. I am Golden Hind. I've heard much about you and am pleased to meet you at last... Heehee, my, what a rousing body you have~♡ *squish squish*

upgrade.line: This will help me procure more remains♪

win_mvp.line: Now the victors have the right to do whatever they please~

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander. This will be the pride and joy of my collection♡

battle_ex.line: It's too late once I've caught you~♡

detail_ex.line: *squish squish* My darling Commander, do you like my tentacle massage combined with... Heehee, goodness, I don't know what this is called♡ Will you tell me? Surely you would know~?

feeling5_ex.line: I'm puzzled. I've done it with you so, so many times, yet I still need so much more... Even now, I'm having dirty thoughts while just standing next to you... Heehee♪ My little ones might snap and cover you in ooze, so if that happens, please don't get mad♡

home_ex.line: How do you like this~? Heehee, how careless of you to be caught by my tentacles as soon as you come back~ Just relax and I'll make you feel better♡

login_ex.line: Ohh♡ You bumped into me while trying to avoid my tentacles, hmm? Heehee, there's no escaping me~ Your body belongs to me, my darling Commander♡

main4_ex.line: Quiet, quiet... Heehee, oh, my darling~ My little ones can't help but get fidgety whenever you're around♡

main5_ex.line: My most prized possession? Oh, my darling, you are too good at feigning ignorance... It's your body, your soul, your stories – I always look forward to them♡

main6_ex.line: I have a one-of-a-kind advantage when it comes to concerts – I can play the whole orchestra using my tentacles~ Now, I dedicate this next performance to my darling Commander♪

touch_ex.line: My little ones are easier to follow than me, you say? Heehee, I suggest that you don't test my patience~ Tease me too much, and I might just suck you dry, my darling Commander~♡

touch2_ex.line: Do you want to feel my little ones' embrace? Or maybe... Heehee~ Come here~ I'll satisfy your every desire~♡

win_mvp_ex.line: You're going to rot, rust, and corrode anyway, so why not become a part of my collection? Heehee♡

battle.line: Heeere's Hindey~♡

headtouch.line: My veil hardly covers anything because of this antler... Oh, you think it suits me perfectly? Thank you, my darling♪

home.line: Welcome back, my darling Commander~ ...What am I doing with the axe? Why, I'm looking for a way into your office without the key~♡

login.line: I've been waiting for you this whole time, Commander♡ ...Did I run into anyone while you were gone? Heehee, you're so sweet when you're agitated♡

main1.line: ...Why not give all my tentacles an axe? Heehee, you sure get funny ideas, my darling~ That would turn this into a Halloween comedy, not a horror flick.

main2.line: Hm? Hmm? Seems my tentacles got ooze on my clothes... Wouldn't you say that's an upgrade, though, my darling Commander?

main3.line: "You cheated on me! Die!" ...Hahahah! Was that a bit too intense? Now I'm curious what kind of Halloween bride you do like♡

touch.line: Could you re-tie the knot on my skirt, please? Heehee, of course, you'll need to untie it first... ♡

touch2.line: A lonely newlywed in a deserted castle... This is how our loving starts, my darling♡

unlock.line: How do you feel about this look, my darling? ...Not scary enough? How odd... I thought Mary Celeste had the right idea. Wait, I know~ What if I hold this axe, hmm? ♡

win_mvp.line: The tentacles are for rewards, the axe is for punishment~

battle.line: There's no fleeing from a ghost!

couple_encourage1.line: You're a real fighter, li'l Vampire! Why don't you join my band of pirates?

couple_encourage2.line: Borrow "my Force", you say? I don't know what that means, but sure.

couple_encourage3.line: Hahahah! We're a bona fide ghost fleet!

detail.line: When you have woes, spill them to me. Though I cannot give you warmth, I can give you company.

expedition.line: Commander, we ought to set up a fright for the girls who just returned from their commission!

feeling1.line: Hey, Commander... Are you lonely? It's alright. I'll be here with you.

feeling2.line: From the shadows, I emerge... Eek! St-stop putting firewood into the stove at once! ...Ahem! C-Commander, just so we're clear, you did NOT hear that... Got it?

feeling3.line: You want me to stop hiding like a ghost and reveal myself out in the open? Hmm, that's honestly a lot to ask... What? You're telling me to do it right now, in the office?!

feeling4.line: It's weird, but I've developed this need to be around you in order to feel peace of mind... Huh? You noticed I've started caring about my appearance? Uh, thanks...

feeling5.line: I'll let you in on a secret, Commander. Us ghost ships have our own place to call home. Where, you ask? *hug*... Th-there, is that a good enough answer?

headtouch.line: My horns've caught your eye, eh?

home.line: You're back! Admirably done, Commander! Let's start you off with a chilling hug! ...It looked like I was waiting for you? Heh, yes, because I'm always watching you.

hp_warning.line: Wh-where's the fire?!

login.line: Ah! You've returned, Commander! What would you like? A cup of hot tea, or coffee? Or perhaps you yearn for my ghostly embrace?

lose.line: We'll be fine. The enemy cannot pursue us.

mail.line: Let's say your new letter floated into the office by itself – how do you feel about that? ...It would scare the younger shipgirls? Now that you mention it, I suppose so...

main1.line: I suggest wearing warm clothes if you want to hang around a ghost ship like me, Commander.

main2.line: Eeek! A-a fire?! ...They're just cooking barbecue? Ugh... I'm going to vanish for a while, Commander!

main3.line: People say I'm friendly? I don't know about that... I'm so used to living alone that I've just become a good listener, I think.

mission.line: Hmm... It's been untold years since someone relied on me. Makes me feel cherished – something I miss.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Now come here and I'll pat you on the head! Good, good~ ...Hahah! My touch is nice and cold, isn't it?

profile.line: I am Mary Celeste, a seaborne ghost birthed by a storm. Hmph, the legend surrounding me... It's merely one of the truths you can't see with the human eye.

propose.line: You're giving this to me? It's like saying you want to spend your life with me... Hahah! I'll gladly do that. From this day onward, you walk the same path as me. Your heart will be my home, from which I will always receive warmth.

touch.line: Hmm? I'd be wary of frostbite if I were you, Commander.

touch2.line: Hahah! Your hands are so warm.

unlock.line: Hmm, so you're the Commander? I'm Mary Celeste – the fabled ghost ship. And this one's name is... Argo, for short. Hahah! Don't be scared of her. She's just fond of this busy world, just as I.

upgrade.line: Heh. From the dark is where I protect best.

win_mvp.line: Mwahahaha! Another victory with no surviving witnesses!

gift_prefer.line: For me? Well, thank you. I'll repay you.

battle_ex.line: May the storm take you!

detail_ex.line: Teach you how to turn invisible like me? It's... not something you can learn. Putting aside whether you can or can't, how am I supposed to be by your side if I can't see you? Heh.

expedition_ex.line: You'll draw their attention, and I'll appear from behind and spook 'em. Alright! We've got a plan!

feeling5_ex.line: Shh. I know it's just you and me here, but you don't want anyone to hear us, do you? While I can always vanish from sight if someone shows up, you can't. That's why you have to be quiet. Same goes for me.

headtouch_ex.line: You... like the curvature of my horns? Didn't think you'd care about them... Now I'm a li'l self-conscious... *blushes*

home_ex.line: Feel like you're on fire after that last battle? Hahahah! That's where I come in. C'mere and cool your face in my chest! *hug*

login_ex.line: You're back. First, drink this to warm up, then I'll help myself to your body... You're so warm I feel like I'm burning up. Ahahah!

main4_ex.line: You feel like the temperature around me has gone up? Hahahah! I don't think you're just imagining it. I feel shy around you, which heats me up...

main5_ex.line: You wanna have a good time? Sure. We could sing, or go to the beach, or even... C-cook barbecue? Okay, that's enough teasing me... *blushes*

main6_ex.line: Heheh. Thanks for looking after me, Commander. It's refreshing. This feeling of codependence makes me think I won't be lonely again.

mission_ex.line: Okay, I'll support you on this mission! When do we start?

touch_ex.line: Getting to feel your warmth in this way... It's pretty nice.

touch2_ex.line: If it helps you cool down, then I suppose... Wait, huh? Umm... *blushes*

win_mvp_ex.line: Never forget – Mary is always by your side.

battle.line: I bring death to all turncoats.

headtouch.line: The red thing on my head? It's a spider lily petal... Probably.

home.line: Nicely fought! Yours truly has been waiting for you! ...Sorry for being late? It's fine. Loneliness never had a chance to take hold, because I knew you'd be back.

hp_warning.line: The spider lilies bloom... for me?!

login.line: Hahahah! Welcome to the rim leading to the afterlife! I will protect you on this moonless night! ...Hm? N-no, I wasn't feeling lonely, I swear.

mail.line: I had the bats bring your letter. They don't get lost even in pure blackness.

main1.line: It really is more heartening to walk the earth with you than to wander through the dark night alone.

main2.line: Wow, these bats remind me of Argo in that they're very docile. So, Commander, be nice when you give them orders.

main3.line: Bats hate fire, and vampires hate fire as well, so it makes perfect sense that I hate fire. Aye.

touch.line: Do you like my wings? ...They make me look even cooler than before? Oh... Th-thank you... *blushes*

touch2.line: Mhh... Hahh... Hey, should I really be wearing an outfit like this?

unlock.line: I am Mary Celeste, the silent reaper of the moonless night... Aye, this attire befits a ghost ship such as I.

battle.line: ...Another fight? Can you swap the little guys in for me instead?

couple_encourage1.line: You get it! Storms are totally scary, aren't they?

couple_encourage2.line: An adventure? ...Nah, I think I'm good.

detail.line: *Yaaaaaawnnnn*... Commander, you also interested in the legendary pirates' treasure? Hmm... Since you brought me crisps and cola, I suppose I could hand it over to you. But it's been such a long time... and picking it all up's gonna be a huge hassle...

expedition.line: Looks like the commission team's back. Go greet them for me, yeah? *sigh*... I seriously don't wanna get up... Commander, how about you just take some crisps to them for me...?

feeling1.line: *sigh*... Guess I'll just go play games in my room...

feeling2.line: I normally send the little guys to run errands for me, so I can just lie down and have crisps delivered straight to me... But, I guess I am still a Tempesta pirate at the end of the day, and doing some stuff on my own... is probably a good thing?

feeling3.line: Warm sunlight over a peaceful port... Yeah, that's the good stuff. So good it makes me want to take a nap... Commander, wanna join in? Nothing beats basking in the sunlight right next to the window.

feeling4.line: Some girls are real junkies for treasure hunting, but it's way too dangerous out there with the storms and hurricanes and whatnot. If you want treasure, Commander, you can get it straight from me... as long as you trade me lots of crisps of all kinds of different flavours.

feeling5.line: Before I knew it, we ended up in a dating relationship, and you're asking me where I want to go...?! How about just staying in my room... No good? How about the nearest fast food restaurant then? But then I'd have to go outside and interact with all those people... Wait, but what if I bought the store and moved in next door? Th-that way, I'd be able to go on dates with the Commander AND drink cola every day!

headtouch.line: You're gonna stunt my growth... *sigh*... Well, saying no is too much of a hassle... so I guess just do whatever you want?

home.line: *Yaaa↗aaa↘aaa↗aaaa↘wn*... Welcome back... Did you run into a storm? Sure must suck going outside... Huh? It'll be fine if we go together? Wh-what are you even... *sigh*... What a pain...

hp_warning.line: I never should've left home...

login.line: Welcome back, Commaaaaaander... Fwuh? You brought me a new flavour of crisps? You sure know how to get on a girl's good side, huh...

lose.line: A storm? ...What a pain... I never shoulda left my room...

mail.line: New mail's here... What a pain... Sorry, Commander, but can you check it yourself?

main1.line: I may be a pirate, but I'm also a pacifist. *siiiigh*... That's because fighting's a huge hassle...

main2.line: Bweh... Back to work again? How about I hand all my treasure over to you and go back to lying down?

main3.line: Commander, mind hooking me up with a lifetime supply of crisps? No good, huh. What if I buy it with my own money? What do you mean that's also a no-go? ...I'm not growing any taller because my diet's too imbalanced? ...Why you...!

main4.line: You want to make an exhibition out of the stuff I collected? ...I guess that's fine, as long as you don't make me show up. Huh? You'll buy me a new gaming console? Hrmm... Fine, I guess that's not the worst deal in the world...

mission.line: Commander, it might be a good idea to knock those missions out quickly. When too much troublesome stuff piles up, you'll eventually give up altogether.

mission_complete.line: Woah... Didn't think you'd get this motivated to finish all your work... But, don't forget the most important thing: the rewards! Otherwise, you won't be able to buy crisps for me, right?

profile.line: I've got no interest in swashbuckling and plundering like other pirates. Storms are scary, so I'm fine just chilling back at port. Plus... the pillow is real cushy...

propose.line: How strange. Whenever I'm with you, I don't feel scared anymore... If I put this on, does that mean it's okay for me to rely on you even more from here on out? ...Okay then. In return, I'll share my crisps and my treasure with you. Mhm, we'll be together forever from now on, right?

skill.line: So I can go back home sooner and get my beauty sleep... Sink!

touch.line: *YaaaaAAAAawn*... Commander, you're really good at back rubs... It feels so nice I'm drifting off to sleep...

touch2.line: Th-that place is off limits...! Even if you try bribing me with cola!

unlock.line: *Yaaaaaawn*... Surrender all your valuables to meeeee... Oh, I was just saying random stuff. No need to take it so seriously... *sigh*... What a pain...

upgrade.line: Am I stronger now...? What a pain...

win_mvp.line: We won? *Yaaaaaawn*... Finally, time to go home.

gift_prefer.line: This is even more tempting than potato chips! I'll trade you some treasure for it! Huh? It's free? Thank you...

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, are you sure it's fine for me to sit in your lap this whole time? Doesn't it get tiring...? But, being in your embrace really calms me down... There's no wind here, or rain, and it's really warm... I want it to last forever...

headtouch_ex.line: Patting my head again? I'll have to pay you back for that. Crisps or cola? Take your pick.

login_ex.line: Welcome back. I had the little guys clean the office... so you'll reward me with those crisps and cola as promised, right?

lose_ex.line: Commander, if you spend more time with me... I might not be such a scaredy-cat then.

main5_ex.line: I heard there's this place called "Potato Chip Rock." Think it's stuffed full of crisps? Commander, let's move it over to the port. ...Huh? There are no crisps there, nor is there any way of moving it?

main6_ex.line: Holding a conversation is such a pain... Wish I could make my coat big enough so I could hide myself entirely. Oh, but you'd be welcome to join me inside, heehee.

main7_ex.line: It's important to take breaks. Put all that work aside and go see if there's any cola in the fridge. Your fatigue's gonna melt away the moment you take a sip.

mail_ex.line: Yeah, yeah, I'll go get the mail. What a pain... But since it's for your sake, I suppose I'll have to.

touch_ex.line: ...Hm? You're all done with work, Commander? ...What a sneaky way of reminding me.

touch2_ex.line: C-Commander, are you going on another treasure hunt...? Fine, fine. You should've just asked me first...

detail.line: Hmm... You want to see some spooky Halloween pirate treasure? But, you're empty-handed right now, so in theory, that's a no-go... But saying no to you is always such a hassle... Well, whatever. I guess I'll take a look around...

feeling5.line: Shoo, shoo. Go on now, go outside and play... Oh, coming! Commander... Um, are you free today? I just got my hands on a new two-player co-op game. Wanna give it a try with me? ...Oh, and if you get tired, we can always lie down together...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander~ That's right, what you see before you is Whydah of Tempesta, completely drained after changing into a Halloween costume and now unable to go outside... Well, since you're already here, why not play some games with me?

login.line: Oh? Ohhh? ...Noo, just a tiny bit short! ...Commander? Hurry up and sit down already. Put the work aside for now – it's gaming time~

mail.line: New mail... I wonder if a new game just released?

main1.line: Fluffy... pillows... and the Commander is even lying down next to me... *yaaaaaaawn*... Zzzzzz...

main2.line: Want some crisps, Commander? I've got every flavour you can imagine. Go ahead and take your pick.

main3.line: Candy, crisps, and cola... Perfect. Now, I'll never have to leave my room ever again.

touch.line: Woah! That was a close one... My hairband almost fell off... Jeez, Commander. I told you not to mess with my halo.

touch2.line: Commander... I can't concentrate on my game at all if you do that...

unlock.line: You've summoned the angel of tricks and treats... Huh? Why am I dressed like this? Meh, it's too much of a pain to answer that... In any case, gimme candy or else! Commander, time is of the essence here. The sooner I can go home, the sooner I can continue my gaming session...

battle.line: I will plunder all you have with these iron claws!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's race to see who can seize all the treasure the quickest!

couple_encourage2.line: Stay away from me...

detail.line: These chains? They follow me like the memory of when I was deceived and betrayed, whispering to me – "you can't trust people"...

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Be sure to review the booty thoroughly.

feeling1.line: My trust is worth more than gold, and you betrayed it...

feeling2.line: My treasure still rests where I left it. Alas, it cannot stay there forever – someday, I need to relocate it to a safe place... Who knows, maybe that will be this port?

feeling3.line: I feel relieved when I return to port and drop my anchor at the pier, like I've come home. Maybe... it's because I know you're waiting for me, Commander.

feeling4.line: Until very recently, I always thought the only one I could TRULY trust was myself. You've changed me, Commander. It's really nice, having someone you can put your faith in...

feeling5.line: I'm considering moving my treasure to this port and building a secret treasury for us. "Am I sure"? Why shouldn't I be, when it'll always be under your watchful gaze?

headtouch.line: Wh-what are you...? Ehh...

home.line: Look who's finally home. Nobody turned on you mid-journey, I hope?

hp_warning.line: You will NOT put the noose on me!

login.line: You're back. Here's your schedule for today. Try not to let others know about it – nothing good will come of it.

lose.line: Where did I go wrong? No, don't tell me... I've been betrayed again?

mail.line: Check your new letter while you're ahead. Also, don't tell anyone else what it says.

main1.line: Oh, pardon me for staring. It's just, I've made a habit of keeping tabs on people around me... I'm not singling out you in particular.

main2.line: You promise nothing I'm worried about is going to happen here? You sound certain. Perhaps this place will be good.

main3.line: While I have worked with pirates, there is no trust between us, only the desire for profit. It's nothing like this fleet you lead, Commander.

mission.line: You have a new mission. Let's get it done with people we can trust.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Surely booty is considered legal income, right?

profile.line: Someone in your position must know at least SOME of my history. Yes, I've sailed with pirates, but don't lump me together with them. I've never seen myself as one, you know...

propose.line: Of all the treasure I've gathered, this is by far the most precious. In exchange, I offer my body, my soul... and my unconditional trust. Take them all, and please, store them in a safe place!

skill.line: May the sea bury your ambitions and doubloons!

touch.line: What do you want from me?

touch2.line: Huh. More interested in me than my fortune, are you?
