unlock.line: I'm Adventure Galley. I've got nothing else to tell you. Then again, you're letting me stay at this port, so I guess let's get along, Captain. Sorry... "Commander," was it?

upgrade.line: I can better protect my fortune with this new firepower.

win_mvp.line: You have some damn nerve, trying to steal MY treasure!

gift_prefer.line: Nice gift. I love it! I'll just go store it with my treasure.

expedition_ex.line: The commission team is back. They brought quite the haul!

feeling5_ex.line: Now when I look at my dear treasure, I feel like it's worthless compared to you, Commander. That's not to say it's lost its value, just that you're so much more valuable than anything else... The question is, where can I hide you, my biggest treasure? Heehee♪

headtouch_ex.line: Heehee. You can keep doing that, if you want.

home_ex.line: Phew... You're back, safe and sound. I can finally relax... If you don't want me to worry, take me with you next time.

login_ex.line: Welcome back. Here's your daily schedule. Take some people you can trust with you... and me.

main4_ex.line: I'm heading out to inspect my treasure. Do you – the person I trust more than anyone else – want to come with me?

main5_ex.line: I get fidgety when you're not in my line of sight, for some reason... Oh, it's not that I'm worried you're doing something behind my back, I just start wondering if you're okay.

main6_ex.line: I've never stayed at a port for this long... This will probably be my home forever, and I will always be by your side.

touch_ex.line: I will give you whatever you desire.

touch2_ex.line: Such thirst... You should plunder me to satisfy it♪

feeling5.line: "I want to be with Master forever and ever... But how... Oh, I know! If we just eat each other... Heehee..." Cut! How did that sound? Hm? That wasn't ALL acting, you know. I meant at least a little... What about the eating each other part? W-well, THAT was obviously just my line!

headtouch.line: What was that for?! There goes the mood I'd set up!

home.line: "Welcome home, Master! I've been waiting with bated breath for you this whole time and sharpening my blade, like this – shwing, shwing..."

login.line: "Welcome home, Master! I've prepared dinner for you, loaded with savoury meat. If you're still left feeling hungry... I can find more meat for you."

mail.line: "A letter? The writer of it will be my next kill..." Actually, this might be an important letter. You should check it now.

main1.line: This set is brilliant for building atmosphere. Ahem, let's see... Ahh! There you are!

main2.line: How can I get you to love me and me alone? ...Aha! I'll just take my blade and cut up anyone who stands between you and me... Hehe, hehehe♪

main3.line: "I'm so sorry, Master. The screams of our to-be-dinner must be annoying. I'll go make them quiet down... Oh, but don't come and look, okay?"

touch.line: "Yes, Master? What can I do for you?"

touch2.line: "You still love me, despite how much I've changed... Heehee..."

unlock.line: "Ahahahah! I've finally found yooou, Master! Dinner is ready, so just follow me to the... You're not hungry? Aww, but the meat is fresh off the bone..." Commander? Why are you backing away?

battle.line: O storm, grant me strength!

couple_encourage1.line: Ah, yes, having too much treasure truly is a burden.

detail.line: I was just drafting a renovation plan for your office. It's the most important place in the port, and I believe it should feel more special. For instance, by adding a dome to the ceiling and inlaying it with gemstones.

expedition.line: Are those girls your entourage? My, they're so cute!

feeling1.line: I'm off to look at that unique building over there! By myself, I mean. You just focus on your own business.

feeling2.line: I yearn to build a grand, beautiful palace in this port! Won't you look at my blueprints? ...Looks good? Thank you. Then while we're at it, could I receive your approval?

feeling3.line: You're free to take whatever you like out of my storage, be it treasure, art, or whatever else. You needn't even ask for my permission. Frankly, I don't remember what is in there!

feeling4.line: So, are you feeling better? By putting our foreheads together, I can direct my healing energy to you! Oh, why are you blushing all of a sudden? Don't be shy, now!

feeling5.line: I shall be your closest companion, and you shall be mine and mine alone... There, I cast a spell of love on you. Now we will always be together, no matter what may happen!

headtouch.line: Oh? Is this your way of conferring blessings? Thank you kindly!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. I see your mission went well. May I come with you sometime? I'd love to see the sights along the way. After the mission is complete, of course.

hp_warning.line: My remedy won't reach me in time!

login.line: I made you some coffee, Commander. I also threw in some spices. How does it taste? Personally, I can't get enough of this stuff!

lose.line: O rain, heal our wounds and ease our pain.

mail.line: I've brought all your letters, Commander. Read them at your leisure. I'll be waiting right here.

main1.line: La-laa-la-laa♪ Do you like it, Commander? I've been studying some, um, "modern" music, I suppose?

main2.line: *sniff sniff*... This scent... It could use some spices to really take it to the next level. Some black pepper, some cardamom, ginger, prickly ash, turmeric, cinnamon, cayenne pepper... That should be plenty!

main3.line: I read about all sorts of interesting ancient ruins in the port's travel brochure! Let's go visit them sometime. Pleeease? Come with me!

main4.line: Top ten classic wine bottles? There's no way this magazine is right. I have heaps upon heaps of bottles like that in my storage.

mission.line: Shall we begin on the day's work, Commander? Delaying won't do you any good.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards? Where? Oh, you mean these? I thought they were random things just left there... You must forgive me. Please don't be mad!

profile.line: Well met. I am Ganj-i-Sawai – I'll be docking here for the foreseeable future. In the name of the wind, blessings be upon you and your port. May our days together be filled with bliss and wonder!

propose.line: I've already started picturing our future together! We'll hoist sails and embark on far-flung voyages, we'll sleep in a curious and magnificent building we built ourselves, and we'll sing and we'll dance... Regardless of what the future has in store, I'm excited to be experiencing it with you!

skill.line: O storm, sweep away all disasters!

touch.line: Ah, do you wish to see my dance? Certainly!

touch2.line: Hmm. Commander, this is rather poor manners.

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander. I'm Ganj-i-Sawai. It's a pleasure! Is this place your port? My, it's so much bigger and grander than I expected! Do you mind if I walk around? And if you could join me, that'd be even lovelier. Heehee.

upgrade.line: My command over the wind grows stronger!

win_mvp.line: Heehee. Underestimate not the might of a storm.

gift_prefer.line: Thanks! I love this gift! What about you, Commander? If there's anything you want, it's all yours~

detail_ex.line: Give me your hand, Commander... There, I wrote a protective spell on it. Now clench. I only wrote it with my finger, but the effect should be the same. Heehee. Wherever you go now, the wind will watch over you.

feeling5_ex.line: Have a gander at my newly-sorted display shelf! Everything on here is from our travels and memories together. I hope to expand my collection substantially and add many more shelves! Heehee.

headtouch_ex.line: Hmph! You're getting it if you ruin my hair! Getting it, I say! ...Hahaha! I'm just joking!

home_ex.line: Whydah told me about a thing called a "smartphone" which can create "photographs" of wondrous sights and things instantly. Could you bring one of those along the next time we leave the port?

login_ex.line: Ah, I'm making some tea! Incidentally, are there any spices you dislike? I'll leave those out of the mixture.

main5_ex.line: It's too quiet here... Shall I sing for you? What song would you like to hear?

main6_ex.line: You can't just sit down all day. Give me your hand and let's dance! Dancing is at its most fun when excitement is in the air!

main7_ex.line: Give me thy blessings and grant me everlasting protection... Heehee, I'm done praying. Now it's time to make you a very special dish!

main8_ex.line: Commander, look here! *snap*! I did it! Taking photographs with these smartphones is so convenient. It lets me collect sweet pictures of you whenever I want. Heehee. I'll treasure these dearly.

touch_ex.line: Why I want to dance? Because I'm happy! Why am I happy? Because I got to see you! Heehee.

touch2_ex.line: Mmhh... You're making me angry! Not really♪

detail.line: I put a seal on myself for fear of being taken by the disaster, and when I awoke, my powers had purified the sea, yet I could not undo the seal. Please, traveler who heard my song, I have no one else to turn to! Help meee!

expedition.line: Your entourage has entered the area? And they're transporting goods for you? You should go speak to them, then! Oh, but don't tell them about me.

feeling5.line: Why are you making that face? Soon you will be one with me, one with the disaster... Heehee. Merging to be forever together is just another form of love!

headtouch.line: I'd hate to let go of such a reassuringly warm hand...

home.line: You seem rather tired, Commander. It must be the influence of a disaster... I'll protect you, but you must undo the seal on me first!

login.line: My energy wanes further and further. Please undo the seal quickly... Hm? You think I look full of energy? Well, that's because I'm happy to see you!

mail.line: You're still in touch with the outside world? Heh... That's okay. Soon, you'll be mine.

main1.line: Oh. The bandages around my arms came loose. They have nothing to do with the seal! Only YOU can undo it!

main2.line: Once you've undone the seal, I'm going to search the undersea ruins, then... Hm? You want to come with me? Sure, but by then you'll already be– Err! Never mind I said anything!

main3.line: Hm? You adore my singing? Ah, then I will keep singing for you! I'll sing for you forever... and ever... and ever...

main4.line: Destiny has chosen you to rescue me, so it will be child's play for you to undo the seal. N-no, there's nothing dubious about it all!

mission.line: Go ahead and do your work. I'll be here, waiting.

mission_complete.line: Are you finished with your work? You look exhausted – come here and rest by my side. I'll sing a song to ease your heart.

touch.line: Curious about the body of a mermaid? Come closer and have a better look. That's it, take it aaall in.

touch2.line: Eep! M-my, that's quite bold... You will pay for doing this! I hope you're prepared!

unlock.line: You heard my song? Thank goodness... Someone has finally come for me! Say, could you please remove the seal on me?

detail.line: Don't you think this silhouette is just beautiful? Who knew life was bursting with such passion and energy? Commander... Do you find it beautiful, too?

feeling5.line: You've been staring at me for a while... It's my turn to see through you now, Commander, until you're all mine~ This is the real me... the Ganj-i-Sawai who wants you all to herself~

headtouch.line: When you touch me... it feels like you're seeing something deep inside me.

home.line: This machine is amazing... Oh, Commander, you should try it, too. I've let you look inside me, so it's only fair that I get to know all about you~

login.line: Hmm... I'm not feeling so well. Can you help me find out what's wrong? Yes, take a veeery close look♪

main1.line: Do you think the silhouette onscreen is my true self? Don't you wanna know more?

main2.line: Commander, I can show you around the hospital after this exam. But when I do... don't you dare let go of my hand~

main3.line: The truth as viewed through the machine, and the truth as felt through direct touch... Want to find out how they differ, Commander?

touch.line: Don't you wanna get closer and see things more clearly? Heheh, then let's get this machine out of the way~

touch2.line: Thump, thump, thump... My heart is racing... Huh? Can you see it?

unlock.line: Welcome, my fellow sufferer of sickness~ This machine can reveal the true nature of things... Hahaha, why don't we show each other what we've got? Everything about me... and everything about you that I can't stop thinking about.

battle.line: Roll up the waves and tear the sea apart.

detail.line: Some predators use their gorgeous looks and beautiful voices to lure prey in. Heehee. Me? I'm simply following my instinct as a being of the abyss to communicate with you... Truth be told, even I don't really know whether I'm a monster or something else.

expedition.line: That commission team is like a school of fish, swimming from place to place.

feeling1.line: You bore me, human. I'm starting to think food is all you're good for.

feeling2.line: If nothing fun happens soon, I will raze your port to alleviate my boredom.

feeling3.line: You smelt nice yesterday. You feel nice today. You– Hm? No, I'm not going to eat you. If I do, I won't know what you'll be like tomorrow.

feeling4.line: Remember, Commander – I wear this mask to protect you. Acting on your curiosity to see the "real me" will only hurt you.

feeling5.line: You still want to see the "real me"? If the truth is worth more than your life, then I'm not one to deny you it... There, happy? Did it scare you? Do you regret it? Can you only tremble in fear as you wait for the end? ...No to all of those? Now I see those eyes you've been looking at me with the whole time... my Commander.

headtouch.line: Hm? What is it?

home.line: Do you want a good drink to wash away your fatigue?

hp_warning.line: Hm? Heehee. You must really want to be torn to pieces.

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. That's okay, right? Heehee, don't worry. I'll keep your "nest" safe while you're away.

lose.line: We were just messing around, no? Should I take this more seriously?

mail.line: A letter? Heehee. I'm curious how you engage with other humans.

main1.line: Commander! Oh, Commander! Heehee. Does it make you happy when I call you like this?

main2.line: I won't treat you as prey anymore. Are you happy? This isn't because you're inedible, it's just... Hmm... I still need time to determine which category to put you in.

main3.line: My interests? What does that mean? What is there beyond surviving and eating? For a human commander, you sure say funny things.

mission.line: You still have missions to do. Get to it.

mission_complete.line: There's not a single edible thing among these mission rewards...

profile.line: Nice to meet you. Hm? Is that not what you say on your first meeting? I see. Your explanation is quite interesting... As are your body temperature, body odour, form, mass, and texture, too...

propose.line: I can't understand you, and yet, without you I would dry like I hadn't had water, atrophy like I hadn't eaten food, and tire like I hadn't slept. Therefore, my instincts tell me to accept this from you. Heehee. Now we'll be together forever.

touch.line: Hm? You want to see my eyes? No.

touch2.line: Mm... Is this... another custom of yours? Okay then.

unlock.line: Good morning, human. I am Fancy. If I'm to follow your customs, I suppose I should call you... "Commander"? Yes. I'm glad you don't seem to fear me, even though I'm known as a "being of the abyss." I'll be watching you to see what sort of human you are.

upgrade.line: Commander♡ Commander♡

win_mvp.line: Repulsive. Not even worth a taste.

gift_prefer.line: I feel weird. What should I say... Thank you?

feeling5_ex.line: Heehee. When you're happy, I'm happy. Is this what "love" feels like? ...Hm? Before now? I've never had complicated feelings before, so I simply pretended to be happy. I get it now... When you're here, my "real self" can be truly happy. That's wonderful.

headtouch_ex.line: Oh... This is an act of closeness. I finally figured that out a while back.

home_ex.line: Heehee. I've heard that hugging someone from behind can relieve their stress. Is it working?

login_ex.line: Welcome back. Since you've accepted the "real me," I'm not going to "protect" you anymore. I will just be myself and strive to deepen our relationship.

main4_ex.line: This emotion known as "love," superficially similar to hunger... why have I never felt it before? It's strange – incomprehensible, even... I'm becoming increasingly hooked on you.

main5_ex.line: Can you tell me what it is that lovers are supposed to do? In exchange, I'll gladly help you with anything.

main6_ex.line: Heehee. I heard a story of a monster who'd climb a tower with their lover and make enemies with the whole world just to be with them. I've started to really understand why someone would do that.

touch_ex.line: Oohh... Heehee. Suddenly I have the urge to bite you.

touch2_ex.line: Aaahhhh... Feels strange. Was I drooling?

win_mvp_ex.line: Gurhhh... That was delicious. Your home cooking is excellent.

detail.line: Heehee. How do I look? Does this assortment of horror elements send terrifying chills down your spine? ...Hm? Explain them to you? Well, there's the mummy bandages... and that's about it. Hahaha.

feeling5.line: I've heard that you can imprint yourself upon humans' hearts by giving them various kinds of stimuli. This must be true of you as well. That's why I'll continue scaring you to make you remember me.

headtouch.line: Heehee. I'm even more frightening than usual, and you still want to touch me?

home.line: Come inside and lie down with me. I'll massage you from every which side.

login.line: I'm once again going to show you my frightening side today to get you to pay more attention to me.

main1.line: Heehee. I'm now going to launch a surprise attack on you as the incarnation of fear. A fear that follows you like your shadow. Are you ready to shake in your boots?

main2.line: Oh. Am I still not scary enough for you? Fine, time for something else. My tentacles and I will teach you the fear of being hunted by a predator.

main3.line: By the way, what even is "fear"? Despite everything I've done, you're still not afraid. Was there something wrong in the knowledge I learned?

touch.line: Heehee. Do you dare to... stick your finger inside?

touch2.line: Ahh... Even I've started to... derive pleasure from you doing this...

unlock.line: Oh... You've found me. This is horror fashion, and I've heard it's pretty popular. Boo. Scared?

battle.line: They've taken the bait.

couple_encourage1.line: What are we hunting this time?

detail.line: My trick to making friends, you ask? There isn't one. I just read the room, gauge reactions, and say what sounds right... What was it called? "Getting on their good side," was it?

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Let's go and see if they've brought back anything good.

feeling1.line: Oh, could you keep your distance? I think that'd be best for both of us.

feeling2.line: If you've got nothing better to do, tell me about yourself. I'll tell you all about me in return. It's only fair that we both know one another, no?

feeling3.line: Let's leave together when your work is done. The port is a vast place, and I'm liable to get lost on my own. Heehee, that's not an excuse, I'm serious! Come on, let's go together.

feeling4.line: I've come up with a way you can thank me for helping you earlier. How about you come with me on a seaside stroll after work is over? ...Ah, wonderful. Then get your work done and clock out on time! Naturally, I'll help you along the way.

feeling5.line: Hm? You look like someone who wasn't expecting to see me here – am I right? I've been waiting here for ages, and I'm starving. You'll do the right thing and join me for a late-night snack, won't you?

headtouch.line: How does it feel to touch my silky-smooth hair, hmm?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Heehee, I see you've brought back a real haul. Bravo!

hp_warning.line: If that's how it's going to be...

login.line: I've brought all your papers, Commander. Eeevery last one. Time to get to work!

lose.line: Since things are looking dire, let's fall back.

mail.line: Commander, I've brought a letter for you. How will you reward me, hmm?

main1.line: Here, Commander. You were looking for these papers, no? I found them for you. "How did I find them"? Don't you dare assume that I walked off with them by mistake.

main2.line: What? Your juice tastes quite bitter? Oops, that's my fault. I accidentally got you iced coffee instead of juice! Excuse me while I go and get you the right drink.

main3.line: I'll gladly help with your work if you'll do me a little favour. I haven't thought of what the favour is yet, but I'll figure it out later.

mission.line: You've got a lot of missions. Better get started. That work isn't gonna do itself.

mission_complete.line: Commander– Whuah! Don't freak out! All I did was nudge your face with this drink I brought for you.

profile.line: Feigning a shipwreck while loading your cannons, then once your targets get close, you take them by surprise and sink them all in one fell swoop – don't you think that kind of strategy suits me just perfectly?

propose.line: I've got the ring, so it's too late for second thoughts. You're mine, which means there's no getting away. Of course, I'm also yours, so you better hold my hand so I can't run off.

touch.line: Commander, could you open this bottle for me? ...No, you see, I'm asking for help because I really can't get it open. I'm serious.

touch2.line: Do that one more time and I'll stab you with my horn.

unlock.line: Ahh, Commander. I'm Amity. Here's hoping we'll get along. So, let's cut to the chase and get to know each other, shall we?

upgrade.line: Ooh, getting stronger feels nice.

win_mvp.line: This was child's play – yet again.

gift_prefer.line: Commander, thanks for the present~ I really like it!

battle_ex.line: The hunt begins!

detail_ex.line: Oh, is this treat for me? Heehee, are you trying to get on my good side, hmm? You must REALLY want my good graces♡

feeling5_ex.line: Have you decided where we're having late-night snacks tonight? I've got a few ideas, buuut... I'll let you decide this time and I'll pay! Sound good? Come on, choose a place so we can go!

login_ex.line: Oh, looks like you have lots of work today. Well, what's it going to be? Your only option is to ask me for help.

main4_ex.line: Hey, why don't you rest your eyes for a while? Heehee, I promise I won't prank you this time.

main5_ex.line: Your schedule sure is packed tight... Let's see if I can't pull some strings so I can have you all to myself today.

main6_ex.line: Let's leave together when your work is done. I'll even help you get it done sooner. Relax, I'll do it for free this time!

mission_ex.line: New missions have come in. I'll help so they'll get done faster.

touch_ex.line: Oh nooo, you caught me! What are you going to do to me now? I can't wait to see.

touch2_ex.line: I'll let you do this as long as you want.

win_mvp_ex.line: I win! Now it's up to me to decide my reward. Gosh, what should I pick...

expedition.line: If you're going to keep ignoring what the commission team brought back, I'm just going to take it.

feeling5.line: You yourself clearly made the choice to jump off – and the fact is, you've played right into my hand. Have you still not figured it out? I stole the treasure to make you chase after me. All this time, the real treasure I was after was you.

headtouch.line: Do you want me to take off my hat?

home.line: Wow! You're on my tail. I've been looking forward to the day that you finally catch me!

login.line: I've been waiting, Commander. Think you'll manage to catch me this time, hmm?

mail.line: I'll be taking this letter of yours!

main1.line: Why don't you come with me, Commander? Then I won't run away again even if you catch me!

main2.line: You can just about make out the streets below... How does it feel to overlook everything, hmm?

main3.line: Go on, guess which is more precious to me – the treasure I stole, or you.

mission_complete.line: Your mission is over, and yet you're still going to chase after me?

touch.line: Come cloooser, Commander. You'll never catch me from that far away!

touch2.line: Can't keep your hands in check, hmm? Heheh, you must really want to be tied up.

unlock.line: Well, well, look who's got nowhere left to go. Kidding, kidding. I win again, so I'll be taking your treasure! Follow me down if you're brave enough to jump.

battle.line: Hahaha! I'mma show you what it looks like to break through the seas!

couple_encourage1.line: Fancy, cut it out with those weird noises! It's creepy!

couple_encourage2.line: That's what you mean by "getting along"?

couple_encourage3.line: It's piratin' time!

detail.line: Booty! Booze! Grub! I want as much as I can get! Didn't think there was a like-minded person out there who could satisfy me, but you might just be the one! So, whaddya say you 'n' I go on an endless adventure to appease them desires, eh?

expedition.line: Oh! Commission team's back! Let's go rob 'em! ...Oh, they're on our side? Right! Silly me, I forgot!

feeling1.line: You're NOT gonna make it out to sea with me if ya don't get it together!

feeling2.line: *yaaaaaawn*... Sooo bored... Let's have a strength contest! You win, ya get a box full of gold! ...What? Ya care more 'bout what's in my bottle? Yeah, we're not gonna discuss that.

feeling3.line: Mornin', Commander! Mind if I step in as the secretary? Been wanting to just be around you lately, so, y'know... Bein' a secretary entails tons of paperwork? Ugh... Urggghhhh!

feeling4.line: What the sticky black stuff all around my body is? It's my miracle remedy! Ya can drink it or rub it on yourself, and it's got all kinds of mind-blowin' benefits! Oh yeah, said your back hurt the other day, didn'tcha? Well, I can spread some of this on there 'n' give ya a massage with my feet!

feeling5.line: Tonight, we're having a sleepover at your place to deepen our bonds, my bestest buddy! Also, I roll A LOT in my sleep, so I miiight end up squishin' ya with my– *grumble*... Man, I'm hungry! Let's look around 'n' find some grub 'n' drinks!

headtouch.line: Yeah? This hat's proof of my might. If ya want it, ya gotta work for it!

home.line: Yo-ho! Back on land I see, Commander! Betcha brought back a huge haul, judgin' by that smile! Need a hand inspecting all them goods?

hp_warning.line: Hey! You're pissing me off!

login.line: There go Commander 'n' Portsmooouth♪ Set sail for great treasure forthwiiith♪ – that'll be our sea shanty next time we sail!

lose.line: This is just as frustratin' as when I get a smaller share of the booty!

mail.line: Got a letter... Readin' too many words affects my appetite, so you take care of it.

main1.line: Try THIS! Mwahaha! Betcha can't breathe while you're caught between my legs! This is my new knockout move! Ain't it– Wait, what? You passed out?

main2.line: Gaaahhh! I'm done being a frickin' secretary! *chug chug*... Can't believe you do this crap day in, day out... *chug chug*... I pity you! So much I just wanna eat you up! Heehee♥

main3.line: Check it out! I busted my butt gettin' my hands on this stupidly expensive but tasty booze! First sip goes to me! *chug chug*... PFFFT! THAT'S SOUR AS HELL! It's worth the price, but it's not my thing... Here, it's yours!

mission.line: Still got unfinished missions, don'tcha? C'mon, no laziness allowed on the path of conquest and plunder!

mission_complete.line: Finished a mission? Well, I didn't do nothin', so the spoils're all yours!

profile.line: Ya wanna get to know me? Takes guts to just ask like that, so I'll tell ya whatever ya want. I much prefer outspoken folks like you over stiff bluecoats! ...So when're we talkin'? Oh, when I've got time and plenty of booze and food on my hands, THEN we'll talk!

propose.line: Huh? What's this? I'm guessin' this is, like, proof of our buddyship? On the finger it goes, then! Oh yeah, I'm in an amazing mood now! So, what do I do now! The choice is all yours! We're buddies who sail the seas together, after all!

skill.line: I'm unstoppable on the open ocean!

touch.line: Heeey, I've only had a feeew! Hehehehe... Y'want some booze too?

touch2.line: This how you make friends 'round here? Lemme give it a shot♥

unlock.line: Yooo! You that Commander I've heard tons about? Damn, you look pretty capable. So, where we goin'? My eyes're set on claiming not just you, but all the treasure in the whole wide world! Mwahahaha!

upgrade.line: Ahahaha! I'm plenty mighty as it is!

win_mvp.line: Cough up them valuables, now!

gift_prefer.line: A gift from you? Mine now! All mine! Thanks!

detail_ex.line: Hey, gotta ask you somethin'! That thing we did earlier... It's what lovers do, yeah? I mean, you really like me, and I really like you... C'mon, you know that already!

feeling5_ex.line: Heehee... How ya likin' this high-ABV booze I saved for a special occasion? Feelin' hot? As you should! I made you drink a whole ton of it, so yeah... Heehee... Now all you can do is try to quench MY endless thirst...♥

headtouch_ex.line: Sure, ya can wear my hat if ya want... Huh? Ya just wanted to pat my head?

home_ex.line: Yo-ho, Commander! You're lookin' like all went well! ...Huh? My face is all red? I just had a lot to drink, that's all!

login_ex.line: There go Commander 'n' Portsmooouth♪ Set sail for great treasure forthwiiith♪ – h-hey, stop starin' at me while I sing! It's embarrassing! Cut it out!

main4_ex.line: What? Ya figured out how to handle my knockout move 'n' want me to use it on ya again? No! That's dangerous! Ugh... Fine, if that's what you're into...

main5_ex.line: (It's only hittin' me now that being 'round the Commander gets me all excited and hot... Dammit! I've gotta make a move!)

main6_ex.line: Said you were curious 'bout what's in the bottle before, didn'tcha? Well, it's my strongest booze! Want a taste? ...What? Don't dare to try it? Ugh... Do it! Just drink it! Drink it 'n' submit to meee!

touch_ex.line: Eep! Y-y'know, for a while now... I've been gettin' these feelings when you start touching me!

touch2_ex.line: C-Commander, we're still on the clock 'n' I might pounce you if... Wait, no! I didn't mean it like that!

detail.line: Grrr... This trap was supposed to immobilise you, but I tripped and, well... Is this karma for tryin' to prank my best buddy?

expedition.line: The commission team's back? Well, I can't do much like this...

feeling5.line: Ugh... Help me loose here 'n' ya can do whatever ya want to me! ...Huh? You can do anything to me right now anyway? Well, I guess that's true... Hey, wait! Wait a sec!

headtouch.line: Th-the horns look real scary, don't they? ...That's not an invitation to grab 'em!

home.line: Grrr... Can't move... It was supposed to be the Commander getting stuck like this... Oh, hey, haha... Welcome back, Commander...

login.line: I'm NOT in the mood to sing right now! ...Wait until my mood improves? Hey, how about HELPIN' me here, huh?

mail.line: You're gonna read letters NOW? Fine... Just watch yourself so ya don't end up like me.

main1.line: Pretty nice idea for a trap? Uh, thanks? Forget about that! When are ya gonna help me get unstuck?!

main2.line: If you're gonna pull, start from my legs. If that doesn't work, my waist... L-leave my head for last, alright?

main3.line: Ugh... Are ya even gonna try to help me? You BETTER not be thinkin' about leaving me like this! We won't be able to sail the seas!

mission.line: A new mission? Yeah, you bet! Your new mission is to help me!

touch.line: You're gonna have to try harder!

touch2.line: Eek! W-well, if this'll help ya pull harder, then go ahead...

unlock.line: Wait, Commander?! You're here way ahead of time! N-no, this is NOT what my special surprise is supposed to be!

upgrade.line: I'm stronger, but I'm still stuck!

battle.line: Focus, girls! We're setting off!

couple_encourage1.line: I know where the treasure is! Follow me!

detail.line: This is a fossil of a weird creature with five tentacles and three eyes! Bristol asked me to find it! If there's any treasure YOU want, just let me know. I can find anything in the world with my special ability!

expedition.line: The commission team is back with treasure. Yup, I was right about that spot!

feeling1.line: Sorry, I'm not in a good mood. You should stay away for a while...

feeling2.line: Hmm... You're fun to look at, but my eyes will tire if I stare all day. I'm gonna rest my eyes for a bit and... It's obvious I'm peeking through my hands? Heehee, you're right. You got me.

feeling3.line: You can pick any key from my hat you want. They each open up a different chest filled with my treasure. As for where the chests are, the fishies will show you where!

feeling4.line: Look, Commander! I used my special ability to make the fishies form a big heart! I made it just for you, heehee. Do you like it?

feeling5.line: Hey, Commander, these fishies will point you to my most valued treasure... Hm? Why did they all gather around you? Gosh, I have no idea! Heehee. Can you guess why?

headtouch.line: Hm? Is my hat the real deal? Uhh... I dunno. I just wear it 'cause it's cute.

home.line: I knew you were back! I heard it from all the way over here. Seriously! I can hear sounds from super duper far away! ...How? Well, that's just my special ability! Heehee.

hp_warning.line: Owch... It's okay. I'm not out of the fight yet!

login.line: You've arrived. Let's get started on today's work. Hmm, there's quite a lot, but it's only half as much if we split it. We can do this!

lose.line: It's okay! We'll win next time! At least we're all okay!

mail.line: Hm? Is this one of those "e-mails"? How do you open it? ...Whoa. I didn't peek, though.

main1.line: *yawn*... *yaaawn*... Oh, look at the time! Boy, these games are all so fun. Just gonna play a little longer... Do you wanna join me, Commander?

main2.line: Alrighty. You can eat this octopus, or keep it as a pet if you want. It's all yours, Commander! Oh, eww, my hands got all slimy... I'm gonna go wash them!

main3.line: It's so fun, being able to talk to the fishies at the aquarium. We should go there again sometime, Commander!

mission.line: Keep at it, Commander! There's still work to do.

mission_complete.line: Job done! Let's check the rewards... I've never seen gold and items like these before.

profile.line: I'm Dolphin, and I'm a pirate, but it might be more accurate to say I'm a treasure hunter. Anyway, if you can call it a treasure, I can locate it! If you come up with any treasures you want, let me know. I'm an expert at tracking treasure down!

propose.line: I accept this unique ring, and the thing that's more valuable than any treasure in the world – your love! I'm going to treasure this dearly! Come here! I'm spreading my arms because I want a hug, silly. Heehee. Hold me in your arms!

touch.line: Heehee! You're not gonna be able to surprise me, Commander! I can hear every sound you make from a mile away.

touch2.line: Whuh?! What are– Hey! You can't do that!

unlock.line: Hmm? Are you that Commander everyone's been talking about? Pleasure meeting you. I'm Dolphin. Now let's do a handshake of friendship! Glad to be working with you.

upgrade.line: Whew! You made me stronger. Wait until you see me in action!

win_mvp.line: We won! Did pretty well, didn't I? Let me hear a bit of praise!

gift_prefer.line: Treasure! Thanks, Commander~

detail_ex.line: You said you wanted this a while earlier, didn't you? I found it with my special ability, and now it's yours! If you wanna thank me, then a hug is in order! Heehee.

feeling5_ex.line: My memories of you are locked away safely in here – inside my heart! Heehee. And there's still lots of empty space for us to create more memories.

headtouch_ex.line: Pat-pat... Heehee. I love it when you pat my head.

home_ex.line: You're back. Whew... While I can tell it's you from the sound, seeing you in person is more reassuring. Now let's see a warm hug!

login_ex.line: *gurgle gurgle gurgle*... Oh, it's done? Commander, I've figured out how to use the coffee machine. Expect fresh coffee every morning from now on!

main4_ex.line: Are you not feeling good? Give me your hand. Whew... How's that? I shared some of my good feelings. Will you manage now?

main5_ex.line: Hm? You weren't searching for me? But I DID detect that you wanted... Whatever! Since I'm already here, I'm gonna sit next to you.

main6_ex.line: The deep sea is a fun place. There are blobfish, fangtooths, and more, and they're all so sweet. You should visit sometime! Or I could catch a few and give them to you.

touch_ex.line: Alrighty, show me your hand. Tadah! This tiny pearl is for you. Why a pearl, you ask? Well, take a guess!

touch2_ex.line: Ahh... I wouldn't do this... with anyone but you... *blushes*

detail.line: Owch... These stitches kind of sting... The pain will go away if you give me a warm hug, though!

feeling5.line: The rain stopped? No, it didn't. It'll keep raining as long as I'm awake. See? It started again. Now be good and stay here. Now that I'm awake, I don't wanna be left alone again.

headtouch.line: The screw on my head? I think it's just decorative. I'm not too sure, myself!

home.line: Fooound you, Commander! Heehee. I said I'll always find you no matter where you go, remember? I have an ability that lets me pinpoint your location!

login.line: The rain isn't stopping anytime soon, so we just have to wait it out. Have a nap, if you wanna. How do I know it's not stopping? Umm, instinct, I guess? A prediction? I'm not sure either. Heehee.

mail.line: A letter for you? Weird. Where was it sent from? How did it make its way here?

main1.line: Why was I sleeping in here? Probably due to the curse... What's your guess? Because I have no clue. I don't remember anything that happened before I fell asleep.

main2.line: Look at that spider on the ceiling! Heehee. I've never seen one that weird before! Do you want me to go and catch it for you?

main3.line: The rain still hasn't stopped. If you're feeling bored, how about we look around for secret treasure in here? Places like these always have treasure! Sometimes!

mission.line: A mission? What kind? Let me have a look.

mission_complete.line: Is this mission done? That didn't seem so hard. Let me have a shot at the next one.

touch.line: Thanks. Keep hugging me and the pain will all disappear.

touch2.line: Wanna hear my heartbeat? ...Hm? You don't hear anything?

unlock.line: *yaaawn*... Was it you who awoke me? Heehee, thanks. Oh, don't be scared! Sure, rising out of a coffin is a bit creepy... but still, I'm not going to hurt you. Promise.

battle.line: What a bother... Can't I just give orders from home?

couple_encourage1.line: You'll get your share when we divvy up the booty.

detail.line: Look, it's just a giant bother. If I wanted to go outside, I'd have to dig my room key out of my treasure chest, then find the way from my bed to the door. That said, I do go out when there's something valuable for me to collect.

expedition.line: Time to go and greet the commission team. If they found any glittering treasure, bring it all to me.

feeling1.line: If you whinge any more about my plans, your documents won't be the only things getting burned.

feeling2.line: Clean my room? If it nags you so much, then do it yourself, why don't you? I've got better things to do.

feeling3.line: You look deft at cleaning up a mess... Help me out with this. It'll be done in five minutes. If you want me to do it, well... I think you know which option is the best.

feeling4.line: Quiet. I just need another 30 bloody minutes. It takes time to get into a dress as posh as this. If you're so keen, why don't you come in and give me a hand, eh?

feeling5.line: You can have this ring. No, it's nothing special. I've got loads, so pick whichever you like. But first, answer me this: Crows covet sparkling things, so... do you want me in that same way?

headtouch.line: As long as you don't mess up my hair ornament. *sigh*... Don't worry. There's nothing naff about making friends with octopuses in the sea.

home.line: Oh. You're back in one piece. Say, isn't my makeup terrific today? Then bloody say something good about it already.

hp_warning.line: You got my dress dirty... I won't even spare you the time to write a will!

login.line: You've come. I'm preparing to go out, so I'll be just another minute. If you're free, then bloody clean the place up.

lose.line: Meddlesome sods... Next time, I will sink you all myself.

mail.line: Saw a letter addressed to you just a minute ago. If you don't go looking for it now, you may never find it again.

main1.line: Impeccable makeup, flawless fashion, and a perfect Queen Anne's Revenge. I'm right chuffed. Hm? No, I'm not planning on going out.

main2.line: If I encountered someone like you whilst pirating, Commander... Heheh... Now that would be exciting.

main3.line: There's STILL a water leak in the bathroom? Heh. Heheh... I'm going to send the mechanic to the bottom of the sea.

mission.line: Hankering for a break when you've not even finished your missions? Go on. Treasure doesn't grow on trees.

mission_complete.line: Is that everything? I know a way to make more dosh quickly, if you're interested. Heheh...

profile.line: I'm Queen Anne's Revenge. The name's written on my stern, so read it your bloody self. Don't nark me if you don't want to end up on the seabottom. Heheh...

propose.line: I've finally got it... The glittering oath ring I've seen in my dreams. Heehee. It goes perfectly with my beauty, doesn't it? Once you put it on, you'll never get to regret it for the rest of your life... You wouldn't dream of regretting it? Heh. Good.

skill.line: You'll be fish food when I'm done with you...

touch.line: I'm drop-dead gorgeous, I know. Now will you adjust my bloody hems?

touch2.line: You couldn't resist how beautifully I was dressed? Heheh... Are those your final words, then?

unlock.line: I'm Queen Anne's Revenge, and brilliant treasures are my favourites. Hm... You're the Commander, no? Then help me pack up this pile of stuff. I want to admire it later tonight.

upgrade.line: Heh. Now I can sink all of my foes...

win_mvp.line: Heh. I lay claim to everything.

gift_prefer.line: Such an exquisite treasure... I'll take good care of it.

detail_ex.line: You got everything ready for me to go out? Well, sorry to say, but I want to get changed, so you have to start over.

feeling5_ex.line: It's dawned on me that there are traces of you all over my room. One way or another, I've wound up wholly reliant on you...

headtouch_ex.line: Tangled my braids again... Well, I guess this is a chance to try a new hairstyle.

login_ex.line: Mmgh... It's so sodding early... I don't wanna get up yet. I might consider it if you'll do my hair for me.

main4_ex.line: Hey, try not to come back too late. Or else my room will go back to how it used to look.

main5_ex.line: Put the stuff I'm not using into my storage? Not happening. It's already chock-full of your presents. The fault lies with you. Heehee.

main6_ex.line: I think this ring would look terrific on you. Hold still and I'll put it on your finger... Heheh – yep, my aesthetic sense is always right.

touch_ex.line: You wanna see me in these clothes? Maybe. Just maybe. If you'll help me put it on, though...

touch2_ex.line: Heh... I hope you're ready for the consequences.

detail.line: I am a being trapped by the shackles of an ancient curse, sealed forever within the temple's shadows... Huh? You've undone the seal? But I never said anything about wanting to leave.

feeling5.line: Since everything is in order, let the ritual commence. Don't worry, the tentacles won't harm you. Just relax and slip into the abyss of nothingness with me...

home.line: There is nowhere left to run. Faithful one, fulfill our eternal contract with your labour and devotion.

login.line: All is in order for the ritual to proceed? ...Eh? A god doesn't involve oneself with such faff.

main1.line: I have a sacred task for you, my devoted retainer – clean my noble body. Thoroughly. Down to every last tentacle.

main2.line: Is the jewelry for my tentacles ready? Cracking. They're quite a bit prettier now. And don't get the wrong idea – it's all a part of the ritual.

main3.line: You're doing some marvellous work, my diligent retainer. Remain here and continue serving this grand, ancient one. Refusal will be met with being devoured as an offering. Heheh.

mission_complete.line: Your missions are done, and the ritual nears its completion... You know, you're an excellent worker, my retainer.

touch.line: What do you seek from your god? Go on, say it. I might just make your wish come true. Heh.

touch2.line: Offering up your body to an indescribable supreme being? Heehee. You're brave, I'll give you that much.

unlock.line: You, lost mortal, have awakened an indescribable supreme being. You will become my retainer and aid me in completing my ritual.

battle.line: Commencing annihilation.

detail.line: What are your orders for today? Hunt monsters? Or help organise your workflow? ...You want me to play sports with you? Of course. I won't let you win so easily.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. I'll report the details to you later.

feeling1.line: Commander, I'm going to reevaluate the necessity of your orders.

feeling2.line: Commander, it's most optimal when the things on your desk follow the centre line, so I went and organised them. I adjust the balance and angle so it ought to be perfect.

feeling3.line: This is now the fourth time you've slid your cap today. Do you like it when I stare at you or something?

feeling4.line: You've defeated me again. There must be some way to clear this more efficiently... Hm? Games are meant to be relaxing, so I shouldn't take it so seriously? Maybe so, but I don't like being defeated.

feeling5.line: To more efficiently carry out your orders, I need to get to know you better and be able to guess what you're thinking. Then, once I manage to defeat you, that will be definite proof that I'm able to carry out your orders. Probably.

headtouch.line: Commander, physical contact outside the battlefield makes me lower my guard.

home.line: Commander, did you find leads on the enemy? I see. Then I'll go on another patrol.

hp_warning.line: I won't back down just because of a few wounds.

login.line: I'm right here, Commander. I'll keep watch so you can work with peace of mind.

lose.line: We lost? I will correct this mistake.

mail.line: New letters have arrived, Commander. Do you need me to sort them?

main1.line: I've finished defining a new workflow. Take a look, Commander. If you find any issues, I'll deal with them.

main2.line: Stacks of papers are put so close together that they risk getting mixed up, and ornaments are placed around seemingly haphazardly... Has your working environment always been like this, Commander?

main3.line: One more time, Commander! I'll finish the mock battle faster, with better results this time! Give me another chance!

mission.line: New missions have been added. I await your orders, Commander.

mission_complete.line: All objectives have been met and exceeded. The mission was completed flawlessly.

profile.line: I'm Lyme, a monster hunter. My technique is to calmly and adeptly deal a crushing blow to my target. Needless to say, your orders take precedence. I won't interfere with your plan.

propose.line: So this is a pledge of love. I see. I, Lyme, accept your pledge, and I swear with my strength the following oath: Your whole being is irreplaceable to me.

touch.line: Commander, are you nervous about our coming battle? Don't be. You'll be fine as long as I'm here.

touch2.line: Commander, this outfit is special... Only I can take it off.

unlock.line: Wait... Alright – the safety level is acceptable within this zone. Greetings, Commander. I'm Lyme. I will fight by your side from now on. Your orders?

upgrade.line: I'm getting stronger. Good.

win_mvp.line: Where's the next battlefield?

gift_prefer.line: This is a good present. Thanks.

detail_ex.line: Commander, I want to play that game again so I can learn to carry out your orders better! Also, could you explain why I lost last time?

feeling5_ex.line: I... won?! Oh! I did? I thought I never stood a chance against you no matter what happened... Wait, was this part of some plan of yours? Well, you've admitted defeat, so it's too late to pull out now!

headtouch_ex.line: My strength is entirely yours. Leave all dangerous matters to me.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Again, no enemies sighted in the area, I suppose... Hm? You found signs of enemy movements? Retreat to a safe area immediately! I'll go and have a look!

login_ex.line: Commander, I'd like you to give attention to the office's layout during your breaks. For instance, you could put the same ornament here to make it nice and symmetrical.

main4_ex.line: Commander, I've revised your workflow. I verified it, and it should avoid 99.99% of all risks.

main5_ex.line: Hmm. That should do for a remodel of the office. Symmetrical, tidy, and orderly. A place worthy of doing rational work in!

main6_ex.line: Even minute changes can have drastic repercussions due to the butterfly effect... For that reason, I need to always carry out your orders to a T during battle.

touch_ex.line: Aha, ahahaha! I-I'm not ticklish, so there's no point in this!

touch2_ex.line: Oh... Um, taking this outfit off requires a bit of technique, so...

detail.line: Was it necessary to make such an elaborate set just for an act? Where did you even get these tools? And these restraints... They're so hard to break out of...

feeling5.line: You've come to help, but I... I can't control myself... Come... Come closer! I can't bear this feeling any longer!

headtouch.line: Urgh... I know it's my power that you're after. Don't assume you're going to break me... so easily!

home.line: Where did you come fro– No, stay back! I don't know what you're after, but you won't get to do as you want with me!

login.line: Are you here to save me? Wait, no! You're clearly the boss of my enemy! You cannot fool me!

main1.line: This is the enemy's stronghold, so why are you the only one here? Where are the other captives? What did you do to them?!

main2.line: The enemy was wiped out, and all the captives were rescued? So you actually were the reinforcements... Does that mean I'm saved, too?

main3.line: Hmm. I've memorised all my lines, that's fine, but having to act in this position does make things awkward...

touch.line: Come any closer and I'll... I'll bite you if I have to! Urgh! Argh!

touch2.line: The corruption is advancing... It's... taking over me...

unlock.line: Ugh... Where am I? Why do I feel so weak? Did I... trigger a trap that corrupts its prey? Grgh! Was it you who laid the trap? You will pay for this!

battle.line: Surrender now, and the goddess may still forgive you yet.

detail.line: Good and evil, truth and falsity... Our world is a chaotic one. If you cannot understand yourself, then how can you demand understanding from others?

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned with a bountiful harvest. I hope nobody got hurt...

feeling1.line: Ah, Commander... I can't help but cry when you get like this.

feeling2.line: Victory isn't won through hurt. Only through wisdom and charity, only through finding a way to make both parties happy, can we achieve a loving victory.

feeling3.line: Commander, don't you think these pearls look like miniature moons? They're all for you! I hope they'll watch over your sleep when the moon cannot.

feeling4.line: Commander... I want to be a part of your world. It's my belief that there are no real walls between fellow people. If you are willing to accept me, then... you and I...

feeling5.line: I used to think that love was selfless and fair to everyone. But now I realise... Sometimes, you find that a special someone has stolen your heart. Do you know what I mean, Commander?

headtouch.line: Is this your gentle side, Commander? Heehee, I like it!

home.line: You've returned safe and sound. Give me your hand... I'll always be supporting you. Never forget that.

hp_warning.line: Lower your weapons. This is your final warning.

login.line: I bring the blessings of moonlight and pearls. May this moment of peace dispel all your worries!

lose.line: I will fight on – until all of our allies have made it to safety.

mail.line: Commander, you just got a delivery. Should we check on it?

main1.line: Commander, did you see my collection display shelf? Isn't the conch pearl in the middle just beautiful? I had to search long and hard for that one.

main2.line: Angel? Some do call me that, yes... It's rather odd when you do, though.

main3.line: My pearl jewelry and crafts are all handmade – by me, of course. Do you happen to like any of them...?

mission.line: Your workload is... troubling, to say the least. Allow me to help you!

mission_complete.line: What kinds of rewards did you get? Any rare jewels, maybe?

profile.line: Greetings – I am Pearl. May this encounter help you overcome your suffering... Commander, let's walk together from this point on.

propose.line: Is this the physical embodiment of love? Everything else pales in comparison to it. I'll treasure it and protect it forever, so that it shines eternally.

skill.line: May this gentle glow soothe all the world's pain.

touch.line: Your palms are so warm, Commander. Every time we touch, I feel special power well up in my wings...

touch2.line: Is this... how you communicate your feelings? It's novel, I'll give you that...

unlock.line: It must be fate that brought us together in this sea of pearls. My name is Pearl. I pray that hope and purity forever light your path.

upgrade.line: Gentleness and strength. Are they contradictory, or are they intrinsically linked?

win_mvp.line: Could this lead to true salvation?

gift_prefer.line: What a thoughtful gift! I love it, Commander.

detail_ex.line: Hmm... I really need a flash of inspiration... Commander, would you like to come walk on the beach with me? Let's let our minds wander atop the waves.

feeling5_ex.line: Pearls are the tears of the sea, the crystallisation of tenderness. No matter what trials await, I will continue to protect you gently. Forever... and ever.

headtouch_ex.line: Commander, do you like the wings on my head? I made them myself~ They're fluffy and good for warming up my ears when it's cold.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, and well done~ Come to me. Yes, of course you're free to lie down in my lap for a while!

login_ex.line: When your work is done, why don't we do some handicrafts together? You see... I found the perfect pearl for you, so I wanted to make matching rings for us...

main4_ex.line: Commander, what are you thinking about right now? If you have any troubles, you can come to me.

main5_ex.line: Just between you and me... the tears I shed become pearls. It's like a blessing from the goddess, but it's also a tiny bit embarrassing...

main6_ex.line: Doing the right thing can take a lot of courage. I wonder how long it'll take for me to become as brave and kind as you, Commander.

touch_ex.line: Heehee, that tickles! You seem so restless today, Commander... Do you need a hug from my wings?

touch2_ex.line: Umm... That pearl string there isn't for you to play with, Commander...

detail.line: My sweet salvation isn't gone yet – I mean you, Commander. Stay with me and use your unwavering faith to restore my fallen heart to grace... If you can, that is~

feeling5.line: Angels are born for the sake of love – nothing else matters nearly as much. Stay with me, my brave hero, so we may while away this enchanting night...

headtouch.line: Mmm... Ah... Sweet hero, you still caress me as gently as you used to...

home.line: Back again, are you? Oh, sweet hero... Heehee, do you long for me so?

login.line: Do you want to save me, brave hero? If you want my obedience... then it's going to cost you.

main1.line: A dark castle, a fallen angel bound in chains... Do you like this situation, brave hero?

main2.line: Oh no, I've spilled this potion all over me! Brave hero, would you mind... cleaning it off of me? Heehee! You can even taste a little, if you want.

main3.line: Set aside that silly mission of yours and follow your heart... right to my side.

touch.line: I'm a fallen angel, but my wings haven't turned black... How odd.

touch2.line: Mmm... Sweet hero, let me wrap you up in my wings... so the white can shield us from prying eyes as we fall into depravity together.

unlock.line: Oh sweet hero, you who charged into this forbidden and dangerous castle alone for the sake of your beloved angel... What a scene you've arrived to. The power of potions is really something, isn't it...

battle.line: Whoa-oh! They won't know what hit 'em!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's go treasure-hunting!

detail.line: You found a fun place?! Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go! Uhh, "submit a departure request"? When did we add that stinking buzzkill of a procedure?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned! Wonder what interesting places they'll go to next... We should follow them in secret!

feeling1.line: *sigh*... I can't be bothered to do anything when it's this boring...

feeling2.line: The hardest choice to make in this world is between two things you want to do at the same time! How do I decide? Please help me out, Commander!

feeling3.line: Did you hear the news, Commander? Someone caught a humongous octopus! It was thiiiiiis big! I want to see it for myself!

feeling4.line: You work overtime way too much, Commander! How will you have the energy to have fun with me if you never get proper rest?

feeling5.line: Ahahaha – even though it's true that I often cause a lot of trouble, my happiest times are when I can say "oopsie" with you! Hm? What do you mean, "I'm the only one making an oopsie"? You're there making it with me!

headtouch.line: Ooh. Who'd have thought getting headpatted would be so interesting?

home.line: You're back! You probably had all sorts of wild encounters out there, eh? You should bring me along next ti– No, right now!

hp_warning.line: Oh, owch... Now things are getting fun...

login.line: Wow, you are here only now? That must mean you DIDN'T stuff your alarm clock into your stomach!

lose.line: Let's have another go, Commander! One more time! Right now!

mail.line: A new letter has arrived! Alright, let's open it! You never know if it might contain a treasure map!

main1.line: Commander, I heard there's a fight on the beach between scallops and starfish! I wonder which side is stronger! Let's go and have a loo– Oh, the toilet in the dormitory exploded?! That sounds fun, too!

main2.line: Commander, looking at this plan, I feel like it's lacking originality! Want me to think of something? I'll make it look completely new!

main3.line: How does ramen taste if you eat it with your nose? Now I'm curious! Let's find out! *snort*... That's odd! The flavour's hardly any different!

mission.line: Commander, why do you think we need to finish missions as soon as possible? The answer is: Because fun things wait for no one!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Boooring... I'm fed up with this stuff.

profile.line: I'm Royal James! Where there is fun, you'll find me! Whenever you encounter something interesting, let me know immediately!

propose.line: Didn't you say there was a fight between barnacles to watch? Wh-what's this talk about a marriage? Only a nutter would answer such a sudden question with, "Yes, I do"! ...Huh?! I didn't say I WON'T say that! If it means becoming an item with you, then... I guess I'm fine with being a nutter!

touch.line: Here comes the takoyaki! Whoosh! ...I-it looks weird to you? Okay, have another!

touch2.line: A-ha! I knew it! You've got funny stuff on your mind!

unlock.line: Ahoy! Over here! It's me, Royal James, touching down! No time for explanations, Commander, let's just set off! ...Set off where, you ask? Hmm. I'm not sure quite yet. Never mind that – anywhere that's fun is fine by me!

upgrade.line: Hang on, getting stronger is THIS easy?!

win_mvp.line: Easy peasy. I already popped a bottle of victory champagne! I've still got some left, so help yourself!

gift_prefer.line: Whoa! I'm having fun just looking at this present!

feeling5_ex.line: No matter where we go, no matter what happens, no matter how fulfilled I am, no matter how caught up I get in something fun... I will never ever leave you all alone! I'll use every trick in the book so we'll be together!

headtouch_ex.line: I demand more headpats, Commander!

login_ex.line: Commander! I've been waiting for you! Next time, I'll spook you with a big "Boo!"

main4_ex.line: Oh! Commander! I just saw a star! If I ever discover a new star, I can name it after you and me! Wouldn't that be wonderful?

main5_ex.line: How'd you like the treasure-hunting plan I gave you yesterday? Oh, um, you want a little more detail? I can fill those in another time! Right now, I just want to set off with you!

main6_ex.line: Commander, how about you put your work down and go to the supermarket with me? I saw they have a really sparkly chemical mop! I bet you also want to see some flashy-sparkly midnight cleaning!

touch_ex.line: Commander, are you bored? As it so happens, so am I!

touch2_ex.line: I've always wanted to try this kind of fun stuff before!

detail.line: I'm a forbidden being... created through some occult society's wicked experiment, huh? Hmm... So much stuff I don't understand.

feeling5.line: I feel like something's been missing ever since I awoke. Is it... a heart? Investigator, could you give me your heart? If you can't, I'm fine with taking your whole body instead!

headtouch.line: Raaawr! You'd better tell me about some fun stuff, or Miss Forbidden Being is going to eat you up!

home.line: I've memorised your odour! I'm not letting go of you until I'm tired of it!

login.line: So you're an investigator, and you came to this cellar to investigate a forbidden being made by an occult society... Wow, that sounds really fun. What about me? What am I? Am I... the forbidden being in question?

main1.line: The barrel is totally filled with nutrient liquid. It feels nice to soak in, and it can sate your hunger, too. Why don't you give it a try, Investigator?

main2.line: These tentacles? I don't know why, but they obey my commands. If you try to run away, I'll make them bind you down!

main3.line: This role-playing is starting to get boring. Can't we do something fun? For instance, like a drift-swimming competition in the nutrient liquid!

touch.line: Are you asking for help with your investigation? How should a forbidden being help someone?

touch2.line: This feels... kind of good, maybe. Hey, do that again!

unlock.line: Where... am I? Brrr, it's cold... What am I supposed to– Oh, you look pretty warm, stranger. Would you mind... sharing a little of your body heat?

battle.line: Time for a brand-new adventure!

detail.line: I-I'm not paranoid, okay? I'm just trying to ward off threats effectively! Check the record – you'll see I've never fallen victim to an attack, not ONCE. That means I'm right!

expedition.line: The commission team is back! Should we send someone to keep guard over the rewards, or something?

feeling1.line: This place is unsafe... I'd better move out...

feeling2.line: Huh? I don't get to move homes?! I just wanna live somewhere safe. Isn't that plenty reasonable? Come on, Commander, pleeeease?

feeling3.line: Have you heard the story of the three little pigs? They got eaten because they didn't predict danger coming!

feeling4.line: Commander! I found this great hiding spot, so I'm building a new house there! Nobody gets to know but you... Hmm? Why not just keep living where I am? It isn't safe to live in the same place forever!

feeling5.line: Hmm... Y'know, I think the safest place for me is right next to you! Is it because of the port's top-notch defences, or is it because you make us all feel safe...?

headtouch.line: Heheheh... That's weirdly calming.

home.line: Hyah?! O-oh, it's you... You scared the hell out of me. I thought I was about to get my throat slit, or something.

hp_warning.line: Aaaah! T-t-too much danger, too much danger!

login.line: *tremble tremble*... Th-th-this place is giving me the heebie-jeebies. Is something targeting me? Commander, we gotta run before it gets us!

lose.line: Gaaaah, th-th-this place is too dangerous for me! Let's leg it!

mail.line: I made sure the mail is safe. You can read it now.

main1.line: Adventure's on an adventure♪ Saving the day between missions♪ Finding little hideouts all over while she looks for a home♪

main2.line: Can you make the safest doomsday bunker ever? Please! I wanna live there!

main3.line: Commander, I installed a tripwire alarm right here. It'll let me know right away if there's danger!

mission.line: Hmm... You don't have any adventuring or exploring missions? Those could be fun!

mission_complete.line: Commander! Hurry up and grab your rewards! You don't want someone stealing those.

profile.line: Good to meet you, Commander. I'm Adventure, and these are my new digs! If you wanna come over, you have to tell me ahead of time! Or else you'll fall into one of my traps, and trust me, you do NOT wanna do that.

propose.line: Commander, will you stay with me forever? Every minute of every day? You won't ever regret it? Phew... Good. To celebrate finding the safe harbor I've always dreamed of... Put that ring on my finger, you!

touch.line: This is a tool I use in my adventures! You can see it if you want, Commander.

touch2.line: Ack! Y-y-you just touched me! I knew this outfit wasn't safe!

unlock.line: Commander, is this the new place you got for me? It's bigger than I expected... Hey, where are all the security measures?! Can I get you to install some alarms?

upgrade.line: If I get stronger, will that make my bunker safer, too...?

win_mvp.line: Phew... I think we got a lucky win!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! I like this. No, I love it!

detail_ex.line: I feel so safe with you. Hmm... I shouldn't let my guard down, though. It's my job to make you feel safe, too!

feeling5_ex.line: Life with you is the peace I've always dreamed of! As long as I have you, I can go confidently to the most dangerous deserted islands or the deepest trenches of the ocean!

headtouch_ex.line: Hold it! Hold those arms out... Okay, good... Now you gotta hug me tight... Tighter... Good! Keep doing that.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander! Find any cool places to explore? I'm dying for an adventure!

login_ex.line: Commander, where should we stay tonight? A cabin halfway up the mountains? A villa with an ocean view? Your office? Or maybe... the hideout I made just for you and me!

main4_ex.line: Tadaaa! I finished prepping your own special bunker, Commander! Wanna see it? Heheh, I'll show you there right now!

main5_ex.line: Come closer... Now hug me! Yeah, just like that, don't move. Phew... That's calming.

main6_ex.line: I've already kitted this place out. It's got traps that trigger when you walk near them, surveillance cameras with no blind spots, and more. No bad guy is coming near me!

touch_ex.line: Wanna see what's up my sleeve? Then come closer and... BOO! Haha! I just wanted to scare ya.

touch2_ex.line: W-weird... We've done this so many times, but it still gives me such peace of mind...

detail.line: Let you go? Oh, gladly. As long as you can prove that you wandered in here by accident and don't pose a threat! That should be easy, shouldn't it?

feeling5.line: Oh, what a conundrum. I'm not the kind of person who can be persuaded by excuses, you know, but I've changed my mind! Your stories fascinated me. From now on, you'll live here and entertain me with more stories.

home.line: Well, well... You trespassed into private property, and now you're face to face with its owner. Did you think this is a coincidence?

login.line: Tell me, powerless intruder, why you've come to my castle! For the treasure? Or for the life of its beautiful master?!

main1.line: Ooh, now THAT'S a fascinating tale of adventure! Yet its protagonist fell into my clutches so easily... What could it all mean?

main2.line: Even in such peril, you make calculated decisions and well-reasoned hypotheses... Heehee, now you've really got my interest.

main3.line: Storyteller... Heheh, do you mind if I call you that? If you're thirsty, I have a wine fountain to wet your throat.

touch.line: Oh? You're approaching me? Instead of running away, you're coming right to me? You're either brave or stupid... Interesting.

touch2.line: Stay here, you. That's an order from the master of this castle...

unlock.line: There you are... Don't think I didn't notice you skulking around my castle! Can't believe you made it here without triggering my traps... Does that mean I'm not safe here, either?!

battle.line: I'll take the lead. Someone must.

detail.line: Should I ever become a monster... put a swift end to my life. Please.

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Those lassies – you can count on them.

feeling1.line: I give up... You are an untrustworthy Commander.

feeling2.line: So this shall be my base... Alright. It's not so bad, having a place to rest and resupply.

feeling3.line: Hm? You're here just to see me? You didn't have to – I'm well used to lonesome returns... Regardless, thank you.

feeling4.line: It feels almost like... my body and soul rejuvenate when I return here. I think this base has become my sanctuary...

feeling5.line: Whew... I've never overslept anywhere but here before. Either my sense of danger is waning, or I'm losing my touch... but I doubt it's either. Perhaps I'm just... at peace.

home.line: You're back. In one piece, I presume? Then relax and rest your weary bones.

hp_warning.line: Gah... I must calm myself!

login.line: Oh, it's you. Resuming the perpetual cycle of paperwork? Good luck to you.

lose.line: Even the hunter becomes the hunted in due time...

mail.line: You have a new letter. Read it, lest crucial information pass you by.

main1.line: Not everyone can calmly deal with a sudden threat. But you lead us all, Commander. You must stay composed no matter what.

main2.line: Ah... Is this the paper you're looking for? I've memorised the spots you routinely use – as any hunter would.

main3.line: What's this? Tea and biscuits? Whew... I've seldom tasted such lavish food, nor have I sat idly in one place for this long.

mission.line: New missions, eh? Who will you pit me against this time?

mission_complete.line: Another mission completed. Be that as it may, the hunt is not over.

profile.line: I'm a hunter, and I'm under your command. Give me orders as you see fit. What do I hunt, exactly? You'll see, sooner or later.

propose.line: Mh. I understand your feelings. If you don't mind a pitiable soul, I'd like to be with you until my final threat is felled... No, even beyond that, I want to walk beside you.

touch.line: Weary, are you? Go on and rest. I'll watch your back.

touch2.line: I don't understand the point of this...

unlock.line: Greetings, Commander. I'm Hunter. I hunt, as you might've surmised. Is this place... my new base?

upgrade.line: My weapons grow sharper... Good.

win_mvp.line: Henceforth we face the real threats. Be on your guards.

gift_prefer.line: Sure... I'll take it.

battle.line: Is there no other way...?

detail.line: There's no need for you to worry yourself over me... More importantly, um, thank you very much...

expedition.line: It appears that a commission has been completed... Unfortunately, I don't think I'll be able to help you in my current state, sorry...

feeling1.line: Please get away from me...! I, I'm so sorry, I don't know if I can control myself...

feeling2.line: Our meeting surely must have been ordained by fate... right? I wonder where the winds of fortune will take me this time...

feeling3.line: If the goddess of fortune truly exists, there are so many things I do not understand that I'd want to ask her... But in reality, whether or not those questions can be answered means so little to me now...

feeling4.line: Whenever I am with you, Commander, I can feel the wheels of fate turning, taking me in a new direction... It's a light, airy feeling I cannot describe well, but it also fills me with warmth...

feeling5.line: I now entrust my future and my fate to you, Commander. Even if I veer away from the correct trajectory, you'll be there to guide me back, right? Um, is it really alright for me to stay at your side?

home.line: Another mission completed successfully. Commander, it appears that the trajectory of your fate seems to extend to a more fortuitous future...

hp_warning.line: Don't make me... use this power...!

login.line: Commander... Umm, welcome back...? That is the proper way to greet you, right?

lose.line: No, no... It shouldn't have been like this... How could this be? How could this be?!

mail.line: Commander, there's new mail waiting for you... Um, unfortunately, I cannot hand it to you myself...

main1.line: Fate is said to both be immutable, but also something you carve out with your own two hands... What, then, is truly the nature of fate?

main2.line: This uncontrollable power... is surely a trial imposed upon me by fate. It is not something I can allow to flow freely...

main3.line: Commander, do you ever get the inclination that something is destined to happen to you? Oh, um, that was just my curiosity speaking, nothing more...

mission.line: Commander, um... Just in case you forgot... There are still missions we have not yet completed...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... I'm sure everything will be fine from now on...

profile.line: I was given the name of "Fortune," but in the end, it was I who was dragged down by fate... Um, if you insist on asking about these chains... They're, um, a self-imposed failsafe so that I do not harm those close to me...

propose.line: I'm so sorry... that I am accepting your ring in this pitiful form of mine... But, I'm also so thankful that you still accepted who I am despite all that! Commander, being able to meet you is truly the happiest event on the trajectory of my fate.

touch.line: Umm, if these interest you that much, I suppose it's fine for you to touch them... I am capable of restraining myself...

touch2.line: Mmgh... Is this... yet another trial imposed upon me by fate...?

unlock.line: Well met, Commander. My name is Fortune. Please don't worry about these ch-chains... They're there to... keep my power in check.

upgrade.line: My control... seems to be improving...

win_mvp.line: Did fortune favor me, or perhaps...

gift_prefer.line: I-is this for me? Ah! Um... Sorry, I got a little excited...

battle.line: Everything is up to you now, Commander.

detail.line: You look like you have something to say. If you need a favor, just spit it out. Next time I see you hesitate, I'll clobber you over the head.

expedition.line: Commission complete. While I could claim the rewards for you, I can't make you complacent. You've got arms – use them to do some lifting.

feeling1.line: Seems my hopes were misplaced... Now the question is – how to get through that skull of yours?

feeling2.line: I am not a "good girl." I did say I'd whip you into shape, but I have my motives for doing so. Heheh, if you're curious about them, use your head first.

feeling3.line: You're getting on well with your subordinates. Seems I won't need to lecture you on that... Hm? Am I getting along well with them? I told you before – you should keep your distance from METAs.

feeling4.line: I considered making you a good luck charm, but didn't; my hands would curse it. So, I'll content myself with watching you from the shadows as your elder.

feeling5.line: I've adapted to a life of solitude. Me helping others for my own selfish reasons, avoiding people – it's all normal to me. But, after spending time with you, I've begun thinking it's not so bad having someone I can rely on. For this, I blame you.

home.line: There's things to be learned from successes and defeats alike. I'm sure you've heard that a million times, though. Now let's begin.

hp_warning.line: You're sending the fleet into the tiger's den, you know.

login.line: Have you made your plans for the day? I see. It's good to see I don't need to remind you anymore.

lose.line: *sigh*... You will reflect long and hard on this blunder once we're home.

mail.line: I left the new letter for you on your desk. If you're to make me do this again, I want to add some conditions. Heheh, don't you worry. I won't shake you down over a little legwork.

main1.line: Inspiration is like an oasis mirage – it appears and disappears. Those who don't come upon a real oasis can only live with their thirst. If it's water you want, I could find a way to procure it for you.

main2.line: I've frightened people? I have no memory of doing such a thing. All I've done is stand my ground against a few cheeky younglings.

main3.line: Hm? Another request from a youngling... Good timing. Let us see to it together, you and I. We must not be indifferent to the plights of others.

mission.line: Well, you look satisfied. Completed a mission, did you? But if you didn't... I don't need to say the rest, do I?

mission_complete.line: Ah, you've completed a mission. Then you may have a break. A short one, of course.

profile.line: If it's a name you want... I am Hatakaze. Are you satisfied now? Because I don't care to tell you more than my name. However, I will say this – you should keep your distance from METAs.

propose.line: You really are an odd one. Why go these lengths for the likes of me? Fine. I will accept your love so as to not disappoint you, youngling... "It's about you, not me," you say? Speak such nonsense again and I will smack you on the forehead – got it?

touch.line: Something the matter? Need a hand? Heheh, know that that's no excuse to slack off.

touch2.line: *sigh*... I swear with you younglings these days...

unlock.line: You're helpless... So helpless it's worrying me. Oh, also, no need to concern yourself with who I am. Just think of me as the one who'll help you get your act together.

upgrade.line: Maybe you should focus on yourself rather than worry about me?

win_mvp.line: A splendid victory. Next time, we could be more ruthless.

gift_prefer.line: Oh? How'd you know I was interested in this?

battle.line: Executing annihilation order. Leave no survivors!

detail.line: My equipment maintenance is done. Let's have a breather and... Commander? Did we get assigned a new mission?

expedition.line: What a huge return... This will let us sustain the war.

feeling1.line: Heehee... The eternal war has changed you, too, Commander. Claimed your soul, did it? ...Liar.

feeling2.line: ...Why do I keep fighting when war is meaningless, you ask? To that I say, "Is there any reason NOT to fight?" It's all I can do, anyway... Go for a walk around the port? Sounds like a damn waste of time.

feeling3.line: Please stop trying to change me. You can't unbecome who you are, and neither can I. Focus on the present, which is this – I am your sword, a mere weapon that exists to do war.

feeling4.line: Zzz... A world without light... without hope... Don't let it happen again... Don't become like me... Commander... Zzz...
