feeling5.line: ...My answer still hasn't changed. To me, war holds no meaning... "Then cut it out and stop fighting"? But I... Um... I was taught war will one day give way to peace. I've believed that for as long as I can remember...

headtouch.line: ...My hair is stained by blood and smoke. I'm surprised you like it this much.

home.line: One battle may end, but then another begins. Are you ready to leap into the fray once more?

hp_warning.line: Hmph. The smell of death...

login.line: Commander, here is a list of areas we'll be sweeping today. Please have a look.

lose.line: I'll let you enjoy what little is left of your life...

mail.line: A letter for you. It may be a report that warrants a quick response. You should read it soon.

main1.line: What meaning does war have to me, you ask? Why are you trying to find meaning in war to begin with?

main2.line: War breeds more war, and death begets more death... That's how it is. What about it?

main3.line: Dreams and ambitions? As someone who struggles just to survive, those are some very lofty words.

main4.line: What I'll do after the war is over? ...You actually believe this war will end?

mission.line: Commander, we've received a mission to complete at once!

mission_complete.line: Mission objective achieved. The frontlines can rest easy for a while.

profile.line: I don't want to brood on the point behind this war that has gone on so, so long. Don't ask about it, Commander. You'll give orders, and I'll execute them as best as I can. No more than that, please.

propose.line: A gift for me? Isn't this an oath ring? ...It's obvious what it is when you formally summon me and present a small jewelry box. Hah! You set yourself up for disappointment. But enough teasing now... I hear you and I accept. I love you.

skill.line: I'll tear you all to shreds!

touch.line: War is a fact and nothing more. As long as it continues, I will keep fighting. That's all there is to it.

touch2.line: ...Do you really like girls who smell like blood and smoke that much?

unlock.line: I am Kimberly of the Fletcher class, ready to serve. That should do it for introductions. What's important is that I am your sword – all you need to do is tell me what to cut.

upgrade.line: A blessing received from the war without end...

win_mvp.line: This was the expected outcome... The spoils were horrifically damaged? Then I leave the battlefield cleanup to you.

gift_prefer.line: This doesn't seem useful for combat. You can have it back.

battle.line: Ohohoho! Bold of you to appear before Vampire!

detail.line: What is this... Dost thou think I'm still so young that I'd blush and get nervous from a mere love letter? Heheheh... Thou art right! That's exactly who I am! Yaaay, love letter!

expedition.line: The commission team you sent out has returned. Go welcome them~

feeling1.line: You really are a dummy... Do you think this can continue?

feeling2.line: Stop asking! It's BLACK, okay? ...What's black? I-I mean... Don't look at me so expectantly!

feeling3.line: Bookshelf... Under the pillow... Under the bed... Hm? N-nothing...? Have you gone crazy from loneliness?

feeling4.line: This is wine that I've let age for a looong time. The moon is so pretty tonight, why, it's the perfect time to open it... Yeah, yeah. Stop being so stuffy and just sit down!

feeling5.line: While I drank with thee on that beautiful night, I found myself... Ahem! There I go, almost telling you how I feel! I'm drunk, so take me back to my dorm!

headtouch.line: Mm, sometimes, being a kid isn't so bad after all~ Ahaha, whoops! Did I say that out loud?

home.line: Heheh, that triumphant look on thy face... What historic victory didst thou seize today?

hp_warning.line: Kh, this is rough...

login.line: Morning! Hm? Thou thinkest I wake too early? Heheh, only because I miss thine presence♪

lose.line: As long as everyone is safe... Pride is a small price to pay, anyway.

mail.line: Mail for thee, not for me! Speaking of, one of my love letters is in there. Guess which one it is!

main1.line: Dost thou ever think thou tryest too hard? Most things in the world are out of our control. Of course, I'm happy to help a little out of deference for your struggles.

main2.line: Ah, calm seas! You can really see some unexpected sights here. So, how do you plan to make up for keeping this place to yourself for so long?

main3.line: I've always wondered why you're so interested in my "colour" of the day? ...Because I'm wearing it now? Geez~ Even I get embarrassed, you know!

mission.line: Missions? Heh, I know that. Get to it, chop-chop!

mission_complete.line: Finished thy missions? What wilt thou do next? I shall join thee.

profile.line: So, what dost thou wish to know? My past? Future plans? Heehee, I can answer all, but prepare thyself first!

propose.line: Nnnh... *yawn*... This is how you promise me you want to be together forever? How crude... But on my name Vampire, I give thee my eternal blessing. Heehee!

touch.line: Heheh, thou must want to go further. Your mind is like an open book to me.

touch2.line: Eek! Pervert! Lecher! Lolicon! Heheh, is that what you wanted to hear?

unlock.line: The adorable Vampire, messenger of the dark night, graces thee with her presence. Hehe, thou smellest sweet♪ Thou art certainly the one I've dreamed of♡

upgrade.line: ...I don't look like I've grown much? That's just because I have big POTENTIAL, dummy!

win_mvp.line: Thou'rt a thousand years too inexperienced to challenge me!

gift_prefer.line: Very tasteful. I accept~

battle.line: Shall we cross... to the other side?

detail.line: Kasumi... of the Asashio class. Commander, I can be alone now, so... where would you have me go?

expedition.line: I've seen that the commission fleet has returned, and they're all waiting for you. Commander, don't keep them standing out there for long.

feeling1.line: I'm used to being alone, so... just leave me alone.

feeling2.line: Commander, you still remember Foo? Sorry... That's not something I'm ready to talk about right now...

feeling3.line: Foo has gone off to a place far, far away, but will sometimes come back to see me. Every time Foo returns, I become much, much stronger...

feeling4.line: Now that I've become stronger... do you feel like you don't know me anymore? Don't worry. I'm still the same me. Commander... You're not afraid of me, are you?

feeling5.line: My "power" is usually sealed off, which is why Foo cannot come back unless the seal is lifted. But because you're here, I don't feel alone at all... Even before Foo disappeared, I always felt like you were someone irreplaceable to me...

headtouch.line: Kasumi's hair... is ice-cold now. Commander, do you like it?

home.line: I have prepared... warm and cozy tea. Please enjoy, Commander.

hp_warning.line: Kasumi... will not sink here!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander...

lose.line: I must... release my powers. Foo, please keep the others safe!

mail.line: I've brought you the mail, Commander.

main1.line: Blue flames? ...Commander, you can see them too?

main2.line: Loneliness... is something I've gotten used to. It's not scary anymore. Kasumi will be afraid no longer, Commander.

main3.line: Do you like the tea I made for you? If so, I'll have it ready for you every time you come back.

mission.line: New missions have arrived. Commander... slacking off is a no-no, okay?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Commander, do you want a reward?

profile.line: I can see things that nobody else can. Not only see, but also feel. So, I am no longer alone. I am no longer afraid of being by myself.

propose.line: Commander... You've chosen me? Really? You've always been the person nearest and dearest to my heart... so of course, I'd like to be with you. That way, I'll never have to be alone again.

touch.line: Commander... Did you want to talk to me?

touch2.line: Commander, uweh... I can't believe you...

unlock.line: You... have summoned Kasumi. Commander, what do you need of me?

upgrade.line: I can... see more clearly now.

win_mvp.line: Kasumi... is victorious.

gift_prefer.line: Kasumi... loves this. Thank you, Commander.

battle.line: I'll escort you to the best of my abilities. I WILL keep protecting everyone this time!

detail.line: Commander? Oh, yeah, I was just sifting through some memories. Although I've been through a lot, there's also much I'd hate to forget... Like afternoon tea with my friends or the days we spent together.

expedition.line: Commander, the commission team is back. If you're free, how about we go greet them?

feeling1.line: I'm not asking for your understanding or concern. I just want you to not prevent me from protecting people.

feeling2.line: Commander, need a hand with anything? I can help you plan an operation, analyse information, and so on.

feeling3.line: My memory is... Well, it gets hazy in places, yet I also remember some things so vividly it's like they're right in front of me. Quietly talking to you like this gives me a peace of mind I haven't felt in ages. Thank you...

feeling4.line: C-Commander! I made new snacks again, and I actually measured the ingredients this time... W-wanna have some with me?

feeling5.line: I thought I had lost everything, but then I met you... and your existence has supported me for countless nights. It's thanks to you that I can move forward.

headtouch.line: ...Hey, could you stop that? I'm not as vivacious as I used to be. Well... that's not to say I hate it or anything.

home.line: End of combat... All that matters is that you're safe. I'm gonna go check on the team – the report can wait.

hp_warning.line: I will never abandon my duty of protecting the fleet as long as I still have strength!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've compiled a list of your missions for today. I've also made tea for you. I added a little something for... extra flavour.

lose.line: I've got to evacuate everyone!

mail.line: New letters came in, and I sorted them by order of importance. Thought it might save you some time.

main1.line: Lady... That word used to mean a lot to me. But now, all I care about is fulfilling the duty given to me – protecting you and the people here.

main2.line: Oh, umm... Commander, wanna try some scones I made? Just so you know, they might have a "unique" taste. The ingredients where I come from were pretty limited... I still hope you'll like it, though. It's the flavour of... me, here and now.

main3.line: My past self never understood the importance of being the flotilla leader... But now, I vow to bring everyone back home in one piece after every sortie.

mission.line: Commander, you have work left to do. If your hands are tied, I can take on the simple stuff.

mission_complete.line: Commander, claim your mission rewards. These resources are really crucial for us. I know better than anyone the dread that comes with destitution... Seriously, don't forget those rewards.

profile.line: I'm Grenville... Grenville META. I used to be a regular destroyer who dreamed of becoming a refined lady, but destiny had other things in mind and I lost so much... Let me use my strength to protect your people, Commander.

propose.line: This ring symbolises both an oath and the long path we've walked. I may not be the precocious young Grenville who dreamed of becoming a fine Royal lady, but I still want to find a future for you and me.

skill.line: I'm going all out in the name of everyone I care about!

touch.line: Hm? Do you need something?

touch2.line: C-Commander?! If it's a reaction you wanted... Uh, please, let go of me.

unlock.line: I'm Royal Navy destroyer Grenville, returning to the battlefield in META form. Long ago, I... No, that's all in the past now. Just give me a chance, Commander. I swear to keep the fleet safe this time.

upgrade.line: A little bit stronger... Cheers.

win_mvp.line: Victory... I only carried out my duty.

gift_prefer.line: Wait, this is for me? It's been so long since... Ah, never mind. Thank you, Commander. I'll cherish it... I really will. Thanks again.

battle.line: I by myself will suffice.

couple_encourage1.line: How interesting... How did you learn to control it?

detail.line: Do you need something, Commander? You're always welcome to just say hello. Have a seat and I'll put on some matcha tea– Ugh, shut up!

expedition.line: Commander, a commission has been completed. You needn't have worried – a commission is not easy to fail.

feeling1.line: Your judgment is correct, Commander. I am merely a blade. You needn't care about my feelings. That being said... when a blade is masterless, who can say upon whom it will descend?

feeling2.line: These blood-red shadows? Yes, they're ferocious and dangerous... Apologies. They seem intent on following me wherever I go. I can neither control them nor shake them off... Quiet, you!

feeling3.line: Commander, while I must thank you for being so kind, I am still bound by a duty and I will one day leave this place behind. By this I mean: Do not get too attached to me. Take that as a... warning.

feeling4.line: Commander, I understand how you feel, but please stop trying to console me. I needn't face the past to move into the future... Yes, I am moving into the future, you cursed snakes! In spite of you sticking to me like leeches! Even if I... Shut up, shut up, shut up!

feeling5.line: I'm surprised you've come near me again. Did the bloody shadows' outburst not daunt you? You have guts, that's for sure. Maybe I ought to follow your example and display the same degree of courage. By facing the past – by confronting the moment the bloody shadows came into being... I can't, Commander... I'm scared... Please stay here... with me...

headtouch.line: If this brings solace to your heart, then do as you please.

home.line: You must be weary after your series of battles, Commander. You're home now, so clear your mind of war for the moment and... Ah, it's nothing. I'll make tea for you.

hp_warning.line: Bloody shadows, join me in slaying our foe!

login.line: The same sight sparks different emotions depending on its viewer's heart... I've been waiting for you, Commander.

lose.line: I still have a mission to accomplish... I must live on... Retreat!

mail.line: Commander, a letter addressed to you has arrived... It may in fact be addressed to me? Quit pulling my leg.

main1.line: I am a masterless blade, now at your side for the time being. When you need my power, I shall lend you it.

main2.line: There is no end to conflict, Commander. Whatever you do, don't fall into that spiral.

main3.line: I guess it wouldn't be so bad to... spend the rest of my life in peace... Move it, snake! Out of my way!

mission.line: Why are there so many missions? Commander, if the need arises, I will cut them off at their source.

mission_complete.line: What surprisingly lavish mission rewards... Commander, I withdraw what I said earlier. It's best if the client remains alive if they provide remuneration as generous as this.

profile.line: I'm Kawakaze. My allegiance, my model number – all that vanished with the dregs of the past. Now I'm no more than a wanderer who accompanies you. What happened to me is something I... don't want to discuss. You are bright – I'm sure you can make a good guess.

propose.line: The river is strikingly clean, the sky is refreshingly clear. The wanderer purges the mist of her mind, having found a cause to fight for and a master to serve – such a beautiful tale. Commander, even should our journey be an endless one, I will walk it with you as your blade.

touch.line: I appreciate the gesture, Commander, but I don't wish to see your Lady Nagato. I am bound by my own unfinished business. She... She has her own loyal Kawakaze, I'm sure.

touch2.line: ...Care to experience the essence of dual-wielded blades, Commander?

unlock.line: So you're the Commander. I am Kawakaze, a roamer of the lands. We will be walking the same path for some time. Let's be cordial.

upgrade.line: I'm now one step closer... to fulfilling my long-held desire.

win_mvp.line: The outcome of a battle matters less than the safety of our allies... Yes, a victory is a victory. Rejoice, you courageous warriors.

gift_prefer.line: It's beautiful... Thank you. I love this gift.

battle.line: Heheh! This is gonna be a fun hunt!

detail.line: Hmm... Zzz... Grrmh... Zzz... Hm? Commander! Is it dinnertime?!

expedition.line: Woof?! Commission got done, I'm guessing? Boy, I can't wait to see what food they brought back this time!

feeling1.line: So... hungry... Sausage... Ham... Meat pie... Steak... Where's the food...

feeling2.line: I'm gonna go look for some food – wanna come with? ...What about the truckload of meat I got yesterday? Well, yeah, that was YESTERDAY'S food.

feeling3.line: I ate so much and now I wanna sleep... Mmh... but I wanna go out and fight, too... Or maybe I could go to the park and catch some butterflies? Ugh, I can't decide! Commander, pick for me!

feeling4.line: It's so weird... I was gonna eat this yummy meat all by myself, but now I wanna leave some for you.

feeling5.line: You're nice to me, and I like you for that! A little! Once I've stuffed my belly later today, I'll give you the privilege of patting my head!

headtouch.line: Don't touch me! That tickles, dammit!

home.line: Commander! Weeelcome back! *sniff sniff*... Hm? You got any snacks on you?

hp_warning.line: Now you've done it... assholes!

login.line: You're giving me all this meat and these snacks? Awright, just spit it out and tell me who you want dead!

lose.line: ...Retreat? Do I look like a coward?! Lemme go! I've still got fight left in me!

mail.line: Got a letter here, Commander! *sniff sniff*... Bleh! Smells not yummy!

main1.line: What am I fighting for? Nothing, really. If I had to say, then because it's fun? And 'cause it's tasty?

main2.line: A welcoming party? Count me out. Sounds lame and tiring. Wait, they've got yummy food there? Then I'll be there!

main3.line: Saw something interesting outside the office... Hm?! What's that you got? Is it... chocolate?!

main4.line: This work is sooo boring... *sniff sniff*... Smells like it's nearing lunchtime, Commander, so I'm outta here!

mission.line: A new mission? Ugh, what a pain in my ass... Two helpings of meat for my efforts?! I'm on it!

mission_complete.line: Nom, nom... Mmh... Commander, these mission rewards are so tasty!

profile.line: Call me Yuudachi or Yuudachi META or whatever the hell you want as long as you lemme eat all I can! I'll even beat the shit out of someone for you! Ugh, all this talking's making me hungry... Got anything to eat? Where's the grub at?

propose.line: A promise ring? Commander, I'm not a little kid – I know what this ceremony's about. Basically, you'll give me tasty food for the rest of time and I just gotta fight for you, right? Then you can bet your ass I'll accept!

touch.line: After breakfast comes lunch, after lunch it's snacktime, and after that it's time for dinner, and after that, I get a late-night stack. This port place you got here is goddamn amazing!

touch2.line: That's it, Commander! You're getting bit! Woof!

unlock.line: So you're the Commander? Name's Yuudachi! Think of me as a Shiratsuyu class. By the way, you guys got any food here? You do? Then we're all good!

upgrade.line: Commander, I'm absolutely dying to eat something or go out and mess somebody up right now!

win_mvp.line: Hah! That's all? Hope the next bunch will be more fun!

gift_prefer.line: Woof! Who do you want me to beat up?

battle.line: Please issue your orders, Commander!

detail.line: I'm presently gathering and sorting weather data on this sector of the ocean. You can't make a swift decision without accurate information! It'd spell disaster if we ran into a storm in the middle of an operation, for instance.

expedition.line: I've verified that the commission team has returned on schedule. It's time to go greet them.

feeling1.line: I'm your advisor, so I'd like it if you'd actually listen to my advice.

feeling2.line: Resources in all locations have now been more or less organized. Commander, have you decided on where we're going? I'm fine with anywhere!

feeling3.line: Commander, please have a look at my new plushie! Isn't it adorable? It's so soft, and... Huh? You'd like a hug? Of course, if you want... Huh?! You meant you want to hug ME?!

feeling4.line: Commander, it's time for a break! For dinner tonight, um... I made a boxed lunch, if I can interest you in that. I hope it'll be to your tastes.

feeling5.line: Commander, you can come to me for advice on anything. I want to help... and support you in new and different ways. And when I do, it should ease your burden by quite a lot!

headtouch.line: Y-you mustn't mess with my hat while I'm on duty!

home.line: So fluffy, so cute... C-Commander?! Welcome back! Um, I mean, when did you get back? Err, a-as for this plushie... I didn't expressly bring it to work, I just thought I could play with it during my break, you see...

hp_warning.line: Huff... Calm down, Dewey!

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've organized the files that need your attention. Please let me know when you have orders for me.

lose.line: We should retreat immediately. After that, we'll revise our strategy!

mail.line: Commander, you've received a new letter. Please read it when you have the time.

main1.line: That's most of the important missions done and dusted. Um, Commander, could we chat for a bit? It should help relieve some of the stress from work.

main2.line: The weather pattern suggests... a storm is coming? Is it yellow? Or red?

main3.line: The accessories in that display window are so adorab– Ahem, I mean, they're moderately cute. Should make a note of this place and come back after work...

mission.line: There are new missions. Hmm... I'll make some adjustments to your schedule.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. Allow me to organize the resources. Hm... Wonder if there'll be any cute things in there.

profile.line: I'm Dewey. Being a professional advisor, my job is to provide tactical support in the form of gathering and sharing intelligence, among other things. I hope that my assistance helps you make more accurate decisions.

propose.line: I may be a little anxious sometimes when I face an uncertain tomorrow... but that's okay, because from now on, be it in battle or at home, you'll always be there to show me the way – right?

skill.line: We have the upper hand. Time to strike!

touch.line: Is something bothering you, Commander? Hopefully, my proposition might be able to help you.

touch2.line: C-Commander! We're still on the clock... I can't focus like this...

unlock.line: I'm destroyer Dewey – Dewey META – and I'm pleased to be serving as your tactical advisor. I'll provide professional strategic assistance from the sidelines which I hope will be of use to you.

upgrade.line: I'm now able to assist with even more professional intelligence!

win_mvp.line: Our tactics were better than theirs. That's another victory to our name!

gift_prefer.line: You're giving this to me? Wow, thank you!

battle.line: Protect the Commander whilst eliminating the threats!

detail.line: Have you seen anything unusual, Commander? ...You're just on a regular patrol? Well, it's always good to remain vigilant.

expedition.line: The commission team has safely returned. Excellent. Nothing's better than everyone making it back.

feeling1.line: ...I am still evaluating whether you're deserving of my loyalty. I will professionally perform my guard duties until I reach a conclusion.

feeling2.line: You think my security plan is flawless? Oh, heheh... I am honored beyond words to receive your words of praise!

feeling3.line: The work of a guard requires a vigilance that does not cease, even for a moment. However... If you would like to have a chat, I'm always happy to listen.

feeling4.line: Commander, if you need a break, may I suggest stopping to have a chat with me? I could tell you countless things about guns and horses.

feeling5.line: When I'm at the port, I feel a profound sense of ease. Everything here – you in particular – gives my role as a guard another kind of meaning.

headtouch.line: Commander, please, this is no time to get careless.

home.line: Welcome back. Everything went smoothly during your absence. I've logged the details in this report for you.

hp_warning.line: I'll need to revise my security plan...

login.line: Commander, I've reviewed your security plan for today. You may begin your work at any time.

lose.line: Prioritize the Commander's evacuation!

mail.line: Commander, your new letter has passed the safety inspection. You may read it whenever you like.

main1.line: Security staff check complete. Now for the equipment list... Oh! Isn't that the gun I've always wanted to try?! Its firepower and precision are legendary, and... Talk about while we go on a patrol? Yes, let's!

main2.line: Weapon maintenance is part of a guard's daily routine. Their structure, performance, and the timing of maintenance are... Ahem, pardon me. I got lost in specialist talk again.

main3.line: I'm amazed that the port has such a well-made racetrack for horses! There is no substitute for a good warhorse's mobility in complicated terrai– Err, I mean, let's go for a ride after work!

mission.line: Commander, there are some important matters left that demand your attention. Would you like my assistance?

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have been reviewed. Ah, well, to me, there is no greater reward than professionally carrying out my guard duty.

profile.line: The name "Carabiniere" represents swiftness and protection – from now on, it's also my pledge to keep you safe. All of my past strength and resolve will be put into this duty of mine.

propose.line: An oath of... Very well. I shall use this gun and all of my professional abilities in service of you. This I say not out of compliance with any orders, but as a personal pledge made to you. In your guidance I hereby place my trust, Commander.

touch.line: Commander, I'm performing maintenance on my gun, so... Oh, you're interested? Then please come closer! I'd be glad to show you its intricate internal structure – it's no less than a work of art!

touch2.line: C-Commander... I'm not fond of pranks like this!

unlock.line: I am Carabiniere, your full-time guard, reporting for duty! I've assessed the risks of your upcoming schedule and have adopted a strategy accordingly, so you may set out with peace of mind!

upgrade.line: My power to protect you has grown again.

win_mvp.line: Although the threats have been eliminated, my guard shift continues. Please remember to stay alert.

gift_prefer.line: Is this... for me? Thank you kindly. I will put it to good use!

battle.line: Rest assured, I will light your path and dispel the darkness.

detail.line: Like a moth drawn to a lamp's light... If you're ever lost in the dark, I'll use this lamp to find you, Commander.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. They brought back no more or less than expected. It went swimmingly!

feeling1.line: It seems our paths were not fated to cross. I will continue my investigations on my own. Take care.

feeling2.line: Light will shine on your path, whether you want it to or not. I will continue my investigations regardless of whether you choose to join me.

feeling3.line: My goals and yours seem to overlap often. Working together, we could achieve them more efficiently... What do you say, Commander?

feeling4.line: The deep sea we call reality may be riddled with countless reefs and undercurrents... But worry not, I will always manage to navigate them. You'd do well not to stray far from the light of my lamp, Commander.

feeling5.line: Don't worry, even if I'm in the heart of fog, I will never lose my way. After all, I can always sense your light in the deepest reaches of my heart. And so long as I follow that light, I'll always find my way home.

headtouch.line: Being praised by your partner feels good, doesn't it? Feel free to give me more headpats, Commander~

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Don't worry, I'm keeping a close watch on your shadow, and it's behaving itself. Nothing uncanny is haunting you.

hp_warning.line: My life is fading away...

login.line: Ah, Commander. Hmm... It seems you've gotten yourself caught up in yet another tricky story. But don't worry, I'm good at sorting out trouble... and I love listening to stories, too.

lose.line: We should retreat... before the shadows catch up to us...

mail.line: There's a letter addressed to you, Commander. Don't worry, it's just a normal letter.

main1.line: My lamp shines bright today, enough to reveal even the moths hiding in the dark... It's a fine day for an investigation!

main2.line: My lamp is in sound condition, and my oil is plentiful... Better to be prepared than caught off guard. Right, Commander?

main3.line: Even in this form, Data 857 is a reliable little fellow... Mm, is it just me, or is it even more reliable than before...?

mission.line: Keep in mind, we still have tasks left to complete. Maybe some of them require your extra attention?

mission_complete.line: Mm, another case cracked. So, Commander... Could you reward me with a sweet?♪

profile.line: My past experiences teach me that all things hide a truth one cannot see just by looking at the surface. Eggs that might seem but a delicacy are in fact currency in other places and settings... Commander, won't you join me in deciphering the mysteries of this world?

propose.line: There are still many mysteries to unravel in this world, and sometimes they lead me down detours. But from now on and forever more, my lamp will light your way, Commander. No matter where you may be, I'll always find you. After all, I still have so many enigmas to crack with you♪ My partner♪

skill.line: Close your eyes if you must, but it won't help you any!

touch.line: Find any leads worth looking into, Commander?

touch2.line: Is that where you want to investigate, Commander...?

unlock.line: I am Bristol, pursuer of truth. Like reefs in the ocean, many mysteries exist even if they are out of sight... I pray you are equipped with the curiosity those mysteries demand, Commander.

upgrade.line: One step closer to the truth!

win_mvp.line: Target silenced! Brilliant, Commander! Now we can continue exploring in peace.

gift_prefer.line: Wow! This is gonna be a huge help in my explorations! Thanks a bunch, Commander!

battle.line: SG, tell me where my enemies are hiding this time.

couple_encourage1.line: There are some things... I will never let go of...!

detail.line: My SG tells me exactly where you are, but I wish it also told me what you're thinking...

expedition.line: SG has informed me that your friends will be returning soon. Let us prepare to greet them, Commander.

feeling1.line: If you intend to close your heart to me, then what happens to you is no longer of any concern to me.

feeling2.line: Of course I like to smile. As long as you can maintain a smile on your face, your heart will always remain opaque to others.

feeling3.line: Even if I can see everything, too often I cannot grasp any of it... I never wish to experience that sorrow again. Commander, I'm sure you'll be able to succeed where I failed.

feeling4.line: Even though I have all the information I could ever want at my disposal, why does my heart waver so... I see now... What I know the most, is also what I least understand... and that is you.

feeling5.line: Only your gentle voice can wash away my anxiety and distrust... How would I be able to live without you... Never go anywhere, Commander, stay by my side.

home.line: Where did you go, Commander? I'll know whether or not you're lying~

hp_warning.line: Don't resist. I know exactly where you are!

login.line: I knew exactly when you'd come back, Commander.

lose.line: How could I have overlooked something? I don't understand... Very well, so be it.

mail.line: You have new mail. Let me help you open it.

main1.line: Commander, call out for me, bare your heart to me, quell my turmoil, erase everything that I cannot comprehend...

main2.line: Commander, looking for someone? I know much more than just what happens around the office. I see everything that happens at this port.

main3.line: Knowing too much can also be a curse, if you only know but are powerless to act.

mission.line: Commander, your missions will not disappear just by simply leaving them alone. Do finish them diligently.

mission_complete.line: These are the mission rewards? ...Seems rather lackluster.

profile.line: Brooklyn-class light cruiser, Helena. As for what I'm good at, let's just say it's knowing a little more about you than the other girls.

propose.line: This symbol represents that we will never be separated, or betray each other... Mm, this I know. I have finally found peace of mind... So always, forever, eternally... remain by my side.

touch.line: If you wish to use my powers, you must first tell me why.

touch2.line: I knew... you'd think twice about doing that.

unlock.line: Were you looking for me? I am willing to lend you my power – provided that you promise not to hide anything from me.

upgrade.line: Greater power... but at what price?

win_mvp.line: The red dots on the radar... have all been eliminated.

gift_prefer.line: This is unexpected... Yeah. I like this, too.

battle.line: You're in the Commander's way. Disappear.

detail.line: Yeah, Commander? ...I'm perfectly fine. Right as rain even. There's no need to worry about me.

expedition.line: Seeing as the commission team's back, we'd better get going... You know the drill, Commander.

feeling1.line: No matter what form you may take, I will always support you. That's my sworn duty.

feeling2.line: What shall I start with today? Draft the next operation? A commission? A sortie? Whatever the case, I'll do a good job. Just give me the order, like always.

feeling3.line: I found this yesterday while I was out shopping. Thought it'd make for a nice gift, so here you go. Well? Do you feel happy? As happy as I was when I got a special gift from you?

feeling4.line: Do you feel like the satisfaction of completing a mission diminishes with each one, Commander? ...Sorry, that was an odd question. Let's get back to work.

feeling5.line: I'll do everything in my ability to assist you, Commander. Exactly the same as yesterday. The same place, the same work, the same you and I... I hope tomorrow will be no different.

home.line: Nice work. Want a soda? Don't say it – I already know which ones you like... Heehee, I know you inside and out, remember?

hp_warning.line: I've taken damage... but it's still within acceptable limits!

login.line: Here's your schedule for today. Let's get some good work done, like we always have.

lose.line: We can still trial and error our way to success, Commander. Everything's just fine – chin up and cheer up.

mail.line: There's a letter for you... Huh, you look happy. So it's good news, I assume?

main1.line: My way of handling documents is awfully similar to yours? Huh... I'd simply chalk that up to coincidence.

main2.line: The port is running smoothly, our resources are well-distributed, and our personnel is deployed in strategic positions... Everything's going swimmingly.

main3.line: Our synergy is so perfect it's like we can read each other's minds. I'd say we were born to work together, don't you think?

mission.line: HQ sent us a new mission. I added it to your schedule.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. All in a day's work.

profile.line: I'm Memphis, Omaha-class light cruiser. I doubt this brief introduction will make you well-acquainted with me, but I promise you this – I will always stand with you, come hell or high water.

propose.line: I haven't felt an emotion this strongly in who knows how long... Thank you, Commander. Supposing I one day forget what this passion feels like, you'll remind me, won't you?

skill.line: Unknown variables... are to be purged immediately!

touch.line: Yeah? Uh, is something the matter?

touch2.line: Aww, feeling lonely, Commander? ...It's a small comfort knowing you have moments like that too...

unlock.line: I'm Memphis. You may not know me, but I know you and I know you well. Don't you worry, I'm not a threat – you can trust me. Today I assume the role of your right hand and bodyguard.

upgrade.line: I feel the power... Thanks.

win_mvp.line: Look at that, we won. Hm? I am happy about this, even if I don't look like it.

gift_prefer.line: I'm really happy... I'll take good care of it.

battle.line: Now, let us begin our "cleaning."

detail.line: Even if we may never exterminate all pests, someone still has to do the job. Keeping your room tidy is the same. I'm sure you don't think that cleaning your room is unnecessary simply because it will get dirty again, right?

expedition.line: Commission complete. What, are you planning to leave your hardworking companions out to dry at the piers?

feeling1.line: I will never aim my gun at my friends... until they cease to be such. Please keep that in mind.

feeling2.line: If you fail to clean out pests, they will find a way of inflicting harm on you at unexpected times. Master, your compassion is a compromise that will lead only to your misery.

feeling3.line: Master, have you gotten used to working with me yet? If not, you'd better keep working at it.

feeling4.line: Are you concerned about me? Of course I'm glad to hear that– in your wildest dreams. Stop getting hot and bothered over a simple maid if you don't want others looking at you strangely.

feeling5.line: There is nothing more foolish than becoming enraptured with a maid who often disappears without a word, goes on dangerous missions, and has a terrible personality to boot. But, that foolishness is precisely what I love about you.

home.line: Was the operation successful? ...I see. Seems like you are capable of a thing or two.

hp_warning.line: Am I being pinned down? ...What a pain in the arse.

login.line: I've finished cleaning up your office, so please get started with work. ...What's the matter? Do you find it strange that I am holding a broom and mop?

lose.line: Don't go dying in front of me. Hurry!

mail.line: Who sent you this letter, I wonder? You'd better take a look.

main1.line: No abnormalities here... Hmm? Don't mind me. I'm just performing a routine security inspection of your office.

main2.line: A maid must always take proper care of her weapon, be it gun or broom. Master, you will regret it if you let your "weapon" go rusty. Please do not forget to do your due diligence.

main3.line: What's the matter, Master? You heard the sound of gunfire? That was just a blank. I do apologise for disrupting your sleep.

mission.line: Crack on. We've been notified of our next mission.

mission_complete.line: Do you really need me to remind you to collect your mission rewards?

profile.line: I am Town-class light cruiser, Sheffield. My specialities are cleaning, marksmanship, and infiltration. What's wrong? These are basics every Royal Maid must know. Why are you acting so surprised?

propose.line: Those who threaten the ones I love shall be greeted by the peal of my gunfire. So... Master, what kind of ending do you want for this ceremony? If your goal was to throw me off-kilter and see my vulnerable side... you've accomplished just that.

touch.line: The safety lock is in place, so you can take a look if you want.

touch2.line: Fix your ways, or you'll end up a pest yourself one day.

unlock.line: So you're the Commander... in other words, my Master. Alright, got it. The name's Sheffield, and the game's pointing my gun at vermin – Ah, please disregard that little gesture I made just now.

upgrade.line: My next shot will find its mark even more flawlessly.

win_mvp.line: The ring of my gun's muzzle tells us everything you need to know, Master.

gift_prefer.line: ...I'll take it. Thanks.

battle.line: Who wants a peek of hell itself?

detail.line: Here I thought there'd be something fun to do in this world, but apparently there isn't. Oh well, guess I'll treat this as a vacation♪

expedition.line: The commission team's brought back goodies. You mind if I smash up their cargo crates? Ahahah! I was just kidding♪

feeling1.line: Looks like your head might belong on the chopping block soon.

feeling2.line: Butchering the foes in front of me and passing judgment on criminals – my job is as simple as that. How to put my skills to use, that's for you to figure out.

feeling3.line: You seriously called me over just to chat, and you don't have any work for me? Okay, you pick a topic then. I'd better not, 'cause it'll just be a gruesome story.

feeling4.line: Heard there are some girls in this port who like harassing you... Heheh. I know what you're thinking, but no, I'm not plannin' on taking action. I'm just wondering what exactly they did to get on your nerves of steel♪

feeling5.line: We were practically made for each other, so why don't we stay together forever? Working with someone you can trust sure beats roaming the universe alone without a goal, too♪ Promise you won't ditch me one day, Commander?

home.line: Making an executioner take care of a guard's job? Ugh, kill me already...

hp_warning.line: C'mon! Struggle more for me!

login.line: Commander, mind finding something for me to do, just like usual?

lose.line: Like hell I'm gonna accept this humiliating defeat... Your days are numbered! Make no mistakes – I'll be back!

mail.line: You've got a new letter. I'm curious who sent it...

main1.line: The most efficient way to solve a problem is to get rid of what's causing it. Isn't that literally what weapons are for?

main2.line: I leave the planning to the people who are good at it and simply follow their orders. Speaking of, Commander, made your plans for today yet?

main3.line: You can make mousse cake, AND it tastes pretty okay? ...Guess I don't know you as well as I thought...

mission.line: A new mission? Lemme see... Maaan, it's just sorting paperwork. That's so lame...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Fighters get enemies to butcher, while office workers get papers to sort. Right people in the right place, like they say.

profile.line: I'm La Galissonnière, the shipgirl from hell! Don't ask questions about hell, or my job as an executioner. The only thing you need to know is that I'm damn handy to have around.

propose.line: You really sure? 'Cause if you're ready and willing to go to hell with me, I'll gladly be with you. Burning down anything that stands in our way – I'll do that for you any day of the week.

touch.line: Word of advice? Keep your hands off. My weapon, if that wasn't obvious.

touch2.line: You're one of those who's too fun to execute, Commander. Yeah, I'll let you off with a verbal warning this time♪

unlock.line: I'm La Galissonnière, the shipgirl from hell! I've come for your soul! ...Wow, didn't even flinch. Guess it's true that you don't fear death. Heheh, let's see if I can get a more interesting response out of you next time~♪

upgrade.line: Now that I'm stronger, how 'bout letting me see some action?

win_mvp.line: I put 'em out of their misery. All of 'em.

gift_prefer.line: Interesting. I'll take it.

battle.line: Simply act according to plan... Now, forward!

detail.line: A well-devised stratagem does more than extend a lead; it can even turn the tables on a disadvantage. Having that said... even the best strategists can do naught but lament their powerlessness in the face of an overwhelming discrepancy in raw power.

expedition.line: Oh, have our supplies already arrived? That's a lot... I can't help but be a little envious.

feeling1.line: A port without a wise Commander will lose coordination, leading to steep decline... Open your eyes, Commander. We can still act before it's too late.

feeling2.line: Don't worry, Commander. With our fleet's forces, everyone's fighting spirit, and my strategies, victory is all but secured.

feeling3.line: I wrote up some materials on yesterday's battle in hopes of gleaning helpful information. I've also summarized our recent commissions... Urgh, sudden dizzy spell... Don't worry about me. Just... a moment of weakness there...

feeling4.line: *cough* *cough*... I'm sorry for embarrassing myself in front of you before. I'm doing better now, but... Yes, you were right: it'd be all for naught if I push myself to the point of injury. I've learned my lesson, and I plan to take better care of myself from now on.

feeling5.line: I've always thought that following you was just one of many wise choices I've made, so I never expected to be repaid so greatly... Of course. I'll keep doing my utmost to support you. Even if it means overcoming destiny... Don't worry. I'll keep myself safe.

home.line: Welcome... back... Ugh, my apologies... I felt a bit light-headed for a moment there, but I'm fine now.

hp_warning.line: Now then, it all comes down to this gambit!

login.line: Commander, if you've already finished the preparations, let us tackle today's tasks.

lose.line: Try as I might to overturn fate, it remains naught but a fickle dream in the end...

mail.line: Commander, please check your mail right away. And do take your time reading it – we wouldn't want to miss valuable information.

main1.line: Commander, have you ever felt... that sometimes, victory or defeat has already been decided from the very beginning, regardless of strategy or ability?

main2.line: The more a person has experienced regret, the more they cherish the things in front of them, perhaps even to the point of paranoia... After all, nobody wishes to see tragedy play out again.

main3.line: Urgh... Sorry, my body suddenly gave out on me. I'll be right back on my feet in a moment, so please, let me stay like this for a bit...

mission.line: New missions? We'd best get to work right away.

mission_complete.line: Have you finished your missions? Good. You may now make time for yourself.

profile.line: Urgh... Sorry, I don't want to have to remember the past too much. All it does is cause me headaches... I am simply Jintsuu, a humble strategist – that is all you need to know about me.

propose.line: This must be the result of your long, careful thought. I should respond in kind... Commander, I'd like to know: what do you wish for me to do from now on? I'm ready to give up all I have in order to see it through.

skill.line: I hope this strategy goes according to plan...

touch.line: Commander, you are the backbone of the fleet. Be a little more mindful of how you manage the port, please.

touch2.line: Now isn't the time for this, Commander.

unlock.line: I am the light cruiser named Jintsuu. I take it you summoned me because you need help? ...Very well. Then I shall humbly devise plans that will serve your fleet.

upgrade.line: My own power is hardly sufficient.

win_mvp.line: I have delivered victory into your hands. It is up to you to decide how to use it.

gift_prefer.line: A gift like this should be treated with care.

battle.line: Raise our banner high into the air!

detail.line: I will give you my all to realize your ideals. Don't hold back – give me your orders! ...You haven't told me your ideals yet? So what? No matter your goal, it leads to a brighter future!

expedition.line: What do you know – the commission team is back. That explains the excitement... Really brings me back.

feeling1.line: Stand firm in your beliefs, Comrade Commander! Don't let sloth take hold of you!

feeling2.line: I've advanced alone for so long I've almost forgotten how to fight with comrades by my side. No, Comrade Commander, it's not yet too late.

feeling3.line: What's your verdict on the tactic I proposed? ...Denied? Really? Even if I lead the squad myself? ...THAT'S the most troubling part?

feeling4.line: Though I'd gathered a group of like-minded individuals, the path to my ideals was so long that already halfway in, I was the only one left... Yes. I can no longer accept any comrade other than you, Commander. Please, never leave my side.

feeling5.line: The bonfire of hope will be kindled anew, and this time, countless comrades will stoke its flames. I will be one of them. Comrade Commander, let me fight not just for your ideals, but also for you, the love of my life!

headtouch.line: My hat... It was reduced to ash in some battle. I can't remember when.

home.line: Great to see you again, Comrade Commander. Your guidance is carving a brighter future for us all!

hp_warning.line: The rest is up to you, Comrade Commander!

login.line: You've returned at last, Comrade Commander. Let us keep working towards our great goal!

lose.line: Our path has always been thorny. Having the will to overcome hardships is what's important!

mail.line: Maintaining correspondence is vital to ensuring everyone is on the same page. Miss your chance, and it will never come again.

main1.line: There is no messiah who'll come and save us. We must take our ideals into our own hands.

main2.line: Skvoz' grozy siyalo nam solntse svobody. I will bend reality to your ideals, even if I must wear my bones to dust!

main3.line: My left eye? It's nothing worth mentioning. Just a scar left by saving a comrade. I don't regret it, because I did save them...

mission.line: Hmm... This is a tricky one... Comrade Commander, let me help you on this mission!

mission_complete.line: Impressive as always, Comrade Commander. You are a real workhorse.

profile.line: In my ignorance of how rugged the path of pursuing ideals was, I committed many a mistake. It was when I was the only one left that I first understood how lonesome this journey is... Regardless, I will see it to its conclusion, Comrade Commander.

propose.line: "Dawn" is the name of my group. I thought I'd never speak this name again, and yet... Yes, you've helped me see the light of hope once more. Comrade Commander, push onward with me into the hopeful future you desire!

touch.line: The names of these two bears? Forgive me, but that touches upon a memory I'd rather not recall. I will say this – I was left behind, as you know, and so were they.

touch2.line: I let go of my individualistic desires long ago for the sake of my great goal... Is that what you think? Then you're sorely mistaken. Better brace yourself, Comrade Commander!

unlock.line: Tovarishch Ofitser, our meeting here will send trembles across the world! All my strength is yours to realize your ideals with. Let us fight, together!

upgrade.line: Let me handle your missions, Comrade Commander!

win_mvp.line: One step closer to making our ideals a reality!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Comrade Commander. I'll cherish it.

battle.line: Bow down before the Imperiya's majesty, suckers!

couple_encourage1.line: I can't be like you... I envy you a bit.

couple_encourage2.line: Avrora... It's been so long.

couple_encourage3.line: You carry the same colors as I do.

detail.line: You're wondering about my past? You wanna know why I turned out like this? Wrong question! You should be asking – why didn't I turn out like THAT?

expedition.line: A commission's been completed. I don't wanna walk all the way there and check it, though, so I'm just gonna ignore it.

feeling1.line: ...Looks like I was wrong about you.

feeling2.line: This room... It's not suited to me at all! It doesn't have to be draped in gold, but it should at least be furnished with antiques... Rustic? Wh-wh-what are you saying?!

feeling3.line: Hmph! This won't do! Nor this! At least put a reclining chair over here! A noble like myself needs a place where she can relax and rest!

feeling4.line: *yaaawn*... It's so cozy in the sunlight... Eep! Commander! Wh-why are you here?! ...Talking to myself? Y-you heard something? I didn't say a word! Forget whatever you heard!

feeling5.line: ...So you heard it all. Fine, I'll open up and tell you everything. The place I'm from, the glory I want to regain, those are exactly what you think they are... "Fixated on things that don't exist anymore"? Hmph! They still exist as long as I do!

headtouch.line: Hohoh! I like your attitude! In the olden days, your disrespect would get you sent to the gallows!

home.line: You're back? Great, then drink this soup! Ahahah, pretty good, right? I followed an old recipe that was meant for royalty♪

hp_warning.line: I can't fall, not now of all times! I still have things I must do!

login.line: You're here already, Commander? Your desk is packed to the brim with paperwork! Now, go on, nose to the grindstone!

lose.line: Retreat! Everyone, retreat! We can't win, so stop this pointless fighting already! Stupid idiots!

mail.line: A letter? From your friends far away? Fine, I'll fetch it for you this one time. Better read it before you forget and regret it!

main1.line: Wooow, you've got tons of games at your place... Hey, what's with that look? Even nobles play video games.

main2.line: Ugh! Paperwork suuucks! Aren't you high up on the pecking order, Commander? Just get your subordinates to do this for you!

main3.line: We've regained SOME lost glory today! ...What glory, you ask? Heh, entertain me and I shall tell you♪

mission.line: I demand 50% of the rewards for helping with your tasks. Whaddya say? Do we have a deal?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Now give me my cut! I only accept coins as payment!

profile.line: Heheh! The noble Lady Pamiat' Merkuria accepts your audience! Well? Are you amazed? You're speaking to the most powerful, most beautiful woman in the world!

propose.line: I'm sorry, Commander. It's not obsession that drives me, it's the hopes of the people I've lost. I'm not going to stop just because... Oh, but I do know you love me! From now on, you'll always save me whenever trouble befalls me, won't you – my beloved?

skill.line: The glory of the past... Shines again!

touch.line: Heheh, you cannot keep secrets from the great Lady Pamiat' Merkuria! Stop beating around the bush already and tell it to me straight!

touch2.line: Heehee... You can do aaanything you want as long as you accept my terms.

unlock.line: Yoohoo! Nice to meet you, Commander... When can I start? Heehee. You clearly don't understand the situation here. If you want the privilege of working with the noble Lady Pamiat' Merkuria, you'll have to earn it!

upgrade.line: Another small goal completed towards regaining lost glory!

win_mvp.line: One small step toward regaining lost glory, and one small step for me!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh! What an artistic little gift!

battle.line: Huff... Puff... Let's do this.

detail.line: This mask is important. You must never touch it... It's connected to a special device, and as long as that device is working properly, I can protect you in the most dire of circumstances.

expedition.line: The commission is done. Should we go say hi to our hard-working friends?

feeling1.line: Commander, how are you going to protect everyone like this...?

feeling2.line: Diving? Well, I can dive pretty deep, yes... It isn't easy, though. Do you have a mission that requires me to do underwater recon, Commander?

feeling3.line: Huff... Puff... Hmm? I was just taking deep breaths. It helps me calm down fast... Wanna try it, Commander?

feeling4.line: You know, now that I'm really thinking about it, you and I have already been through so many fierce battles... It almost feels strange being able to relax together.

feeling5.line: Do you have any special orders for me? Or do you just want to stay by my side? I'm okay with anything.

headtouch.line: D-don't touch the mask, please.

home.line: Welcome back. You look like you're doing fine, but if you get hurt, you HAVE to tell me.

hp_warning.line: Everyone's... in danger...

login.line: I'm happy I can help you with your work today, Commander...

lose.line: I still have my mask... Commander, withdraw everyone. I'll cover you!

mail.line: You have new mail. Want me to read it out for you?

main1.line: I don't feel uncomfortable at all wearing the mask. I'm used to it... Y-you wanna touch it? Umm... Well... No, you can't!

main2.line: I'm always watching and protecting you, Commander. Believe me... I just try not to be too open about it.

main3.line: Commander, if anybody's causing you trouble, you come to me. I'll do my best... to ask them to be nicer!

mission.line: Commander, it's time for your next mission...

mission_complete.line: Can we call that a job well done? Good... I think I'm getting the hang of this.

profile.line: I'm the Brooklyn-class light cruiser, Boise META... and I'm here to protect you. The mask is part of my power, so try not to be bothered by it. We'll be voyaging together from now on.

propose.line: As long as I'm here... As long as I can protect everyone... I won't let anything dangerous happen. This is my answer to your vow... and a promise.

skill.line: Fight on, everyone, and rest assured that you're under my protection!

touch.line: Commander? I'm listening... Go ahead.

touch2.line: Huff... Puff... Nothing happened just now, right?

unlock.line: Commander, I'm the META Boise... It's my job to give you and your fleet the protection you all need.

upgrade.line: My mask got stronger, too...

win_mvp.line: Threats removed. Is everyone okay? Good... Phew.

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me? Thank you... I love it!

battle.line: Enemy located! Charge!

detail.line: The Knight of the Seas' first rule is: Always stand up for those who need help! ...What other rules are there? Uhh... What were they, again?

expedition.line: Some valuable supplies just arrived! We oughta go give our thanks to the commission team!

feeling1.line: These seas are the graveyard of many naive soldiers... I'm praying you don't end up like them.

feeling2.line: Commander, can you stick around and talk for a bit? It's the quickest way to figure out each other's fighting styles!

feeling3.line: Riggings need regular maintenance. See this equipment? Developed it all myself. Pretty sick, huh? A soldier's weapons are like friends – you gotta interact with 'em wholeheartedly.

feeling4.line: Hey, those girls who just came to see you... Ah, so they were my sisters. Heheh. I'm just glad they're all getting on well with you. Be there for them when they need you!

feeling5.line: I'm not just a war machine, y'know! Whenever you want someone to cheer you up, or suddenly wish you had a shoulder to lean on, I'll always be there for you!

headtouch.line: Hm? You can't just do that to a Knight of the Sea. Buuut, as a once-in-a-while thing... I don't mind.

home.line: Welcome back! Great work, champ! ...I don't look surprised? That's 'cause my tracker picked up your course ages ago. Even told me exactly when you'd get back.

hp_warning.line: Muster your courage! Victory will be ours!

login.line: Standing by and ready for your orders! The wind today's perfect for a sortie.

lose.line: I've dealt with even worse situations before. We gotta take it in our stride and keep fighting!

mail.line: You've got new mail. Want me to text their contents to your device for easier reading?

main1.line: It's good to not let your guard down, but at the same time, you don't gotta worry too much. I'm right here by your side.

main2.line: ...Hm? My sisters? Man, that brings me back. We'd mess around so much way back when. You know, it feels ages since I last saw Montpelier smiling without a care in the world.

main3.line: They say technology changes the world, but aren't we the ones who can't live without it? Even I'd mess things up if I didn't have all these advanced systems... Only once in a blue moon, but still!

mission.line: New missions just came in! Heard they give pretty juicy rewards, too! Let's take a shot at 'em, Commander!

mission_complete.line: They give you THIS much stuff?! We gotta start the next mission right away! Money waits for nobody!

profile.line: Wassup? Wanna hear some tales of the Knights of the Sea? The tales of the light cruisers who always fought on the front and wielded their high-tech gear with full confidence, earning them several medals? Well, it sounds like a nice story, but the truth is, we made many sacrifices...

propose.line: There's no need for fancy words. This ring is the most precious vow of them all. I've already been yours since long ago, but even so, I want you to accept this Knight's pledge of loyalty again!

touch.line: You also starting to get bored, Commander? Let's hit the outdoors, then!

touch2.line: Seriously? This is what you do for fun?

unlock.line: Part of Flare? No. The Council? Not that either. Maybe the Ashes, then? Ah, forget it. Who or what you serve doesn't matter! I'm Cleveland, a Knight of the Sea! Let's be buds!

upgrade.line: Unleash full firepower!

win_mvp.line: Victory! This battlefield's changed, but it's still a battlefield at the end of the day.

gift_prefer.line: Ha, thanks! Much appreciated!

battle.line: Commencing strategic plan!

detail.line: What part of my notes are you interested in? My insights on management as a lord? Or perhaps... the unfinished scribbles in the corner?

expedition.line: The commission team has brought back supplies. Shall we go and have a look?

feeling1.line: How regrettable. Until you relearn how to observe basic manners, I will limit our interactions to the lowest formal extent.

feeling2.line: I will properly fulfill my duties as adjutant based on the spirit of our contract. As for anything else... My apologies, but I have no plans of any deeper partnership at the moment.

feeling3.line: Working with you puts me at ease, Commander. Hm? What scribble? Oh... That's simply an unfinished idea. Please excuse me for this embarrassing sight.

feeling4.line: I never noticed it happening, but ensuring your safety has become the top priority in my schedule. This doesn't count as... professional negligence, does it?

feeling5.line: I used to think that our emotions were the most inefficient thing about us. Now... I think it's fine that we have them. Heehee.

headtouch.line: Ahem. I don't believe our schedule includes physical closeness with no clear purpose.

home.line: Excellent work. Your combat data is already being analyzed. I will present a report to you later.

hp_warning.line: Injuries are above estimates... but still within acceptable limits!

login.line: Commander, here's today's agenda and strategy plan. I've already sorted through them. Have a look.

lose.line: Our calculations were wrong... but that's okay. We've recorded relevant data which we can use to course-correct for next time.

mail.line: There is a letter for you. Please read it in good time.

main1.line: Hmm... Writing a poem really is much harder than writing a report. It requires the right meter and emotion, and you can't derive those through logic.

main2.line: Fishing, you ask? While I have done it before, the time it takes to catch a fish could be spent writing three papers. Seen that way, it's work that really tests one's patience.

main3.line: This plan is pretty exquisite, wouldn't you say? Indeed – efficiency is beauty.

mission.line: Commander, we've received new missions. We should complete them sooner rather than later.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. Will you review them now?

profile.line: I'm Köln, Elector of the Holy Unitas Empire. Whether it's managing a fleet, governing a territory, or constructing a plan for the future, all things require a reliable and efficient leader. That is what I strive to be.

propose.line: This ring is more significant than any blueprint or plan in the world. It is our shared future, which I will put everything on the line to protect. Thank you for choosing me.

touch.line: Commander, do you have new orders for me?

touch2.line: ...Please redirect this curiosity of yours to the right things.

unlock.line: I'm Köln, an elector of the Holy Unitas Empire. My specialty is in the fields of military and governmental affairs. I hope that our partnership will function like a well-oiled machine.

upgrade.line: The performance increase is as predicted. Thank you for your contribution, Commander.

win_mvp.line: The threat has been eliminated. This result matches the ideal outcome of our simulations.

gift_prefer.line: What a thoughtful present. I'll look after it.

battle.line: I'll finish them off!

detail.line: What, you're interested in my collection? Regina is my most prized masterpiece – other common beasts fail to compare.

expedition.line: The commission team is here. Go take stock of their spoils – you may find something rare.

feeling1.line: You bore me... just like all the others. Get out of my sight.

feeling2.line: Keep your distance, Commander. Until you've proven yourself worthy, our relationship is merely a utilitarian one.

feeling3.line: I must confess, your strategies do make my hunts more enjoyable. I'm starting to understand why some beasts choose to obey powerful people.

feeling4.line: Time spent hunting with you has become more fun than time spent chasing prey on my own... Hmph. I'm only acknowledging you as a worthy companion – don't get cocky.

feeling5.line: To think that I, who have tamed countless beasts and pursued infinite legends, would be bound by one human... Worse, that I would LIKE it! Commander, you are the most dangerous, yet perhaps the most precious, prey I have ever encountered.

headtouch.line: Heh, I'll forgive this transgression. Sometimes, taming a wild beast takes indulgence.

home.line: You're finally back. Regina still seems unsatisfied... Very well. Rest is necessary to make the next hunt an even more thrilling one.

hp_warning.line: Interesting... Now this is worthy prey!

login.line: You're finally here. I have no interest in boring paperwork, so give me better orders – say, going hunting.

lose.line: Tch... I won't forget this humiliation!

mail.line: There's mail for you. Hopefully it's not something so dull as an invitation to a dance party.

main1.line: Regina is unusually docile today. Maybe she's conserving her energy for the next hunt, just as I am.

main2.line: Power and fame are tedious things. The only dream that captivates me is one where I discover and domesticate the rare and extraordinary.

main3.line: Rather than flip through endless documents, I'm far more excited for the clues hidden in the next mission report.

mission.line: You have unfinished work. Get it done at once so our hunt is not delayed.

mission_complete.line: You've won rewards. They're nothing like the spoils of the hunt, but loot is loot, I suppose.

profile.line: I am Regensburg, an elector of the Holy Unitas Empire. Rather than waste my time on pleasantries, I prefer taming beasts and chasing legends. Commander, I hope you'll entertain me just as much as the hunt does.

propose.line: I, Regensburg, hereby declare that you have become my one and only, my most prized possession in life. Don't be mistaken, however. It was I who chose and domesticated you... Isn't that right?

touch.line: Hmm? Do you mean to tell me that worthwhile prey has appeared?

touch2.line: Hmm? I think you need to be reminded which one of us is meant to be tamed.

unlock.line: I am Regensburg, an elector of the Holy Unitas Empire. Hmph, I hope you're not as tedious as those caged beasts, Commander. Taming someone like you is a far better use of my time.

upgrade.line: Wonderful. Now I can pursue even more powerful beasts.

win_mvp.line: I readily accept the spoils of this hunt.

gift_prefer.line: What a gift this is... I see you understand how to please a hunter such as myself.

battle.line: Live combat, huh? Time to put this new equipment to the test.

detail.line: Hm? Interested in my little inventions? ...Perhaps, they'll be able to further your growth~

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Actually, I happened to be missing some parts for my newest creation, so hopefully they'll bring me some good news.

feeling1.line: It seems you don't even have the fundamentals down... We'll need to start over completely from the very basics, Commander.

feeling2.line: You'd like to get closer to me? Very well. But first, you'll have to prove that you are worthy of my training~

feeling3.line: You've got more pluck than I thought, Commander... Heheh, that makes the time spent designing equipment and exercises for you more worthwhile. Do keep it up.

feeling4.line: Tinkering with equipment feels a lot more satisfying with you than when I'm by myself... Heh, are we what they'd call a perfect match?

feeling5.line: I've designed countless training devices and regimens, but my greatest source of inspiration... is you. That is how deep the extent of my love for you is, Commander. Now then, shall we get ready for the next round?

headtouch.line: How nice of you... I'll have to return the favor appropriately during our next private session~♪

home.line: You did pretty good out there. I've prepared tea and a few... gadgets to help you relax. Would you like to come and rest for a bit?

hp_warning.line: So much pressure... Heheh... But, this only gets me more riled up!

login.line: Commander, how are you faring today? Whatever the case, my equipment and I will ensure that you are in top condition.

lose.line: Tch... My machines' feedback procedure still falls short of perfection. I'll have to retune them after I get back.

mail.line: There's mail addressed to you. Hopefully it's nothing as insipid as some invitation to a ball...

main1.line: Compared to the tedium of official duties, there are much more interesting things I'd like to spend my time on... such as optimizing your training regimen.

main2.line: Hrmm... This sensor still requires more fine-tuning. It needs to capture the subtle changes in your expressions more accurately.

main3.line: I've just finished proof-of-concept testing for a new training machine... Commander, would you like to be the first to try it? I can assure you, it'll be an unforgettable experience~

mission.line: The sooner we finish our work, the more time we have for private training sessions. Isn't that right?

mission_complete.line: The rewards have arrived. No match for gear I've personally adjusted, but they do make for good materials.

profile.line: Greetings and salutations from Königsberg of the Holy Unitas Empire, Commander. Politics? Military affairs? Let the others handle all that. My true interest has always been in developing equipment to temper one's mind and body... And in mentoring promising individuals like yourself, Commander.

propose.line: I shall devote all my passion, knowledge, and love to training you to perfection, Commander. Heheh, this is hardly strange. After all, this is training for me as much as it is for you. Isn't that right, my dear Commander?

skill.line: Heheh, let's give this new feature a spin.

touch.line: What's the matter? If I had to guess... Did you want to leave some feedback about my machines?

touch2.line: Heheh, you're quite the mischievous one, Commander. But, fumbling around without proper guidance can be dangerous~ Shall I show you the ropes, step by step?

unlock.line: Well met, Commander. I am Königsberg of the Holy Unitas Empire. Unlike my sister, I care little for the vapid titles of nobility. What interests me more is sculpting you – yes, refining you into your highest, most perfect self.

upgrade.line: With this... I can come up with an even more ingenious training regimen.

win_mvp.line: An effortless victory. Proof that logic-based training is key.

gift_prefer.line: My, that's rather tasteful. Thank you very much.

battle.line: Mgh... I can't afford to get distracted, not now...!

detail.line: Being with you puts my mind at ease. It scares off all the awful visions that haunt me... You have a strangely potent aura, Commander...

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Shall we go thank the brave team that did it?

feeling1.line: This place, too, gives me anxiety...

feeling2.line: You think I look ill? Ahah, I'm fine. I just had a somewhat unpleasant dream...

feeling3.line: Have you ever experienced reoccurring nightmares, Commander? How did you get rid of... Ah, no, you don't have to tell me if you don't want to...

feeling4.line: Is there anything in your life you want to change? You can tell me anything... Oh, you're more concerned with me? Heehee, please don't be. I feel much better than I used to, and it's all because you're doing so well, Commander.

feeling5.line: I had a wonderful dream. It was a peaceful day, and everyone including you had gathered to enjoy my cooking... Heehee, thinking about it now, you've pretty much already made that dream a reality. Say "ahh," Commander. I'm going to feed you~

home.line: Nngh! Ugh... Another awful vision... Oh, don't worry about me~ I just lost my bearings for a moment, that's all. Anyway, would you like a meal to replenish your strength?

hp_warning.line: It's n-not over just yet...!

login.line: I'm relieved that you're right on time. Do you want to review today's schedule before we start working?

lose.line: It's time to fall back. We cannot be eliminated so easily.

mail.line: You have a new letter. Make sure you save it if it's something important.

main1.line: Our minds tend to wander when we're bored, don't they? Confusingly, it can be easier to focus when you have something to do.

main2.line: Hesitation can mean death for those who make decisions. Still, the fact remains that we're all tied down by our own emotions.

main3.line: Are you tired? Ah, then please hold on just a minute. I'll make you something quick to eat.

mission.line: We have new missions. Keep at it, Commander. I'll assist you.

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed. Way... Way to go, Commander~

profile.line: I'm heavy cruiser Trento. Please task me with whatever you may need, be it on the frontlines or backlines. Why am I here, you ask? Because I'm a shipgirl whose job it is to assist you, of course.

propose.line: I thought it was all an extravagant pipe dream, yet it became reality... This is --- Commander, whenever you have a bad dream, come to me and I will sing a soft lullaby for you~

touch.line: You want a hug? Um... There? Ah, sorry, I squeezed too tight...

touch2.line: Heehee. I'll indulge you just a teensy bit.

unlock.line: I am heavy cruiser Trento, and I will be your assistant. The best thing I could ask for is that my support helps you achieve your goals.

upgrade.line: May this new power serve you and all our friends...

win_mvp.line: Victory... belongs to us!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. It's nice to feel this warmth once in a while.

battle.line: Fighting, by itself, is enjoyable.

detail.line: The opposite of fun is not pain, but boredom. Knowing that, won't you fill this gaping void with something... enjoyable?

expedition.line: Commission completed. Shall we have a look at the rewards? You might be pleasantly surprised.

feeling1.line: *sigh*, old-fashioned people just don't understand what true joy is. What a shame...

feeling2.line: I enjoy fighting not just because slaying my foes is satisfying, but because fighting itself is fun. To really make them suffer, or make it quick and painless... I always let my whims decide what to do.

feeling3.line: "Possessed by the Devil"... That's merely an excuse for one's self-centered behavior. Say, have you ever used a trite phrase like that to lie to yourself, Commander?

feeling4.line: From what I've noticed, you do know what pleasure is, but meaningless little things inhibit your drive to pursue it. Now, come to me... I will teach you the essence of human nature. Heehee♪

feeling5.line: Ah, yes, you're a great and virtuous hero – you cannot be with a wicked devil. You need only ask, though, and I'll spoil you whenever you please. Nobody has the right to shame you for seeking just a moment of pleasure.

home.line: Judging by your look, you didn't enjoy your last battle. Were your foes too feeble? Maybe the mission went too smoothly for your liking?

hp_warning.line: Yes! Yes! Now you're doing it!

login.line: What brings you here this late? Surely you've not wasted time elsehere?

lose.line: Chagrin, anger... I see, so this is the taste of defeat? How delicious. Heehee♪

mail.line: You've received a new letter. Isn't it fun to look forward to the unknown?

main1.line: Caring only about your own pleasure gets you labeled as "selfish." To that, I say, name-calling is low-grade enjoyment.

main2.line: You seem to be struggling. Need a hand? ...Heehee. I mean, wouldn't you offer to help if you saw a kitten in need?

main3.line: Pain is a kind of pleasure. It doesn't matter whether you inflict it or receive it... Do you get what I mean? Heehee.

mission.line: A mission? Why spend time on that when it could be spent on your own pleasure?

mission_complete.line: Completing a mission is more satisfying than the rewards that follow.

profile.line: I am heavy cruiser Algérie, and I live to enjoy. Enjoy what, you wonder? Heehee. If I had to say... to enjoy anything and everything.

propose.line: To tell you the truth, this is far from enjoyable; it brings me great pain. It's not the exchanging vows part that hurts, it's not knowing how long I have to wait for you. Heehee♪

skill.line: I never gave you permission to flee~

touch.line: That look of yours when you're holding yourself back from acting on an urge – it's quite exciting.

touch2.line: If pleasure cannot be rejected, why don't you just embrace it? Heehee♪

unlock.line: You must be the Commander. I am the heavy cruiser Algérie. So, what pleasures can I experience here? I do hope you won't disappoint me. Heehee~

upgrade.line: Whew. I needed to stretch my muscles a bit.

win_mvp.line: There's no fun to be had in an effortless victory~

gift_prefer.line: For me? Heheh, you're sweet.

battle.line: Ahahaha! I've got an express ticket to hell for you!

detail.line: I've been thinking – as my Commander, what should I call you? The Supreme Ruler of Hell? The Overlord of Hell? Ahaha, don't look so tense! I'm not gonna call you that EVERY time we speak.

expedition.line: Commission complete. Aren't you gonna go check on that?

feeling1.line: Mgh. Hmm... To stick you in a volcano, or throw you into a trench...

feeling2.line: Commander, you haven't seen true hell until... No, I take that back. Your day-to-day schedule isn't much different from hell.

feeling3.line: When I was out of hope, standing by that cliff's edge, someone came and pulled me back. Who? You already know, Commander.

feeling4.line: They said I'd only sink deeper into hell if I didn't fight back. Threats like that don't work on me anymore, because I have you. Even if I will sink, I'll be sinking with you.

feeling5.line: Commander, let's go on a pleasant trip today, you and I. Where? Ahaha! To hell, I'd say! And don't say no. So strong is our bond that cutting it would only make it regrow stronger. Right?

headtouch.line: Hm? Is this some kind of greeting? My hair's gonna be ruffled if you keep doing that. Not that there's anything wrong with that!

home.line: You're finally back, Commander! Your food hasn't gone cold just yet. Take a seat and find out what a skilled chef I am!

hp_warning.line: No! This can't be the end!

login.line: Commander, you've got to process each and every one of these documents. Sheesh, you look like you've seen the devil... Don't fret – I'll help you out!

lose.line: Oops... I think history is repeating itself...

mail.line: There's a new letter for you. This one's a normal letter, so just treat it as such!

main1.line: It looks like your port is experiencing an everlasting interwar period... That's what people usually call "peace"? Hmm... Makes sense!

main2.line: That pile of paperwork is a thousand times scarier than hell. It's no wonder you're always working late. I need to find a way to get your life back in balance...
