main3.line: There's no place in the whole universe where you can relax forever. The 8-hour work shift exists even in hell! Hahaha, you've got to agree that being alive is so much better.

mission.line: You've got unfinished missions waiting for you, Commander!

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. Come here and have a look!

profile.line: I'm Foch. Like I said when we first met, I'm the Warlord. I've seen it all, so don't be afraid to tell me about anything that keeps you up at night! I will fix all your problems one at a time!

propose.line: Well... I'll admit, I'm getting butterflies in my stomach over this. Giddy or not, I'll still accept your ring! It's just like you said – nothing will get between us and our shared fate! Hahahaha!

skill.line: To the depths of hell with you!

touch.line: Hm? You wanna talk? Sure, let's chat the day away.

touch2.line: Commander, there's no going back if you take this any further!

unlock.line: Hey and good day, Commander. I am Foch, the Warlord. Heehee, the Warlord of what, you ask? That should be obvious – the Warlord of Hell! Hahaha! It's good to be serving you.

upgrade.line: Ahh, the fiery gale that blows over the lava.

win_mvp.line: That's how strong I am! Remember that you can always rely on me, Commander!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh, this looks fun! I like it! Thanks, Commander!

battle.line: Follow my lead and blitz on through! Fire!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's get this battle started. I'll cover you!

detail.line: I didn't just stumble upon this power – I paid the due price to get it. Would be a big shame not to put it to good use, right?

expedition.line: A commission's finished, eh? Ah, they brought back a real haul. That's what I like to see!

feeling1.line: Do you seriously think this shit will fly? 'Cause it sure as hell won't!

feeling2.line: My dreams? Don't care about 'em. The battlefield is my whole world. Anything beyond that, I try not to think about.

feeling3.line: Now that I think about it, me and this whip have been together for ages. If I ever kick the bucket, I want you to be its new owner. It's a bit long, but that makes it perfect for pointing at things on a map.

feeling4.line: I'm afraid... I used to not give a damn, but now... Hm? Oh, Commander. It's nothing. It just that it dawned on me that I've started fearing death. Yeah? ...Learn to value my life more, you say?

feeling5.line: I've grown attached to life, and it's all your fault. Ya know... If I buy the farm before you do, you'll be all alone, and I can't stand the thought of that. I'll take care of myself – if only so you and I can be together just a while longer.

headtouch.line: This is how you reward your soldiers? I'll take it.

home.line: Now THAT'S what I call a good battle. Go catch your breath now!

hp_warning.line: Not so fast! I've not keeled over yet!

login.line: You're back. Where're we going and who are we taking down today?

lose.line: Fall back! I'll keep 'em busy!

mail.line: Got a letter for you here. Better open 'er up and read it right now.

main1.line: War? War is never over. There's no issue between victory and you that a cannon shell cannot resolve! And even if there were, just fire one more!

main2.line: As soon as ya set foot on the battlefield, there's no turning back. Never forget what you're fighting for, Commander.

main3.line: Scars are a warrior's badges of honor. Being able to feel pain is proof that you're alive, Commander.

mission.line: If I can help ya on that new mission, just let me know.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Fine job!

profile.line: Just think of me as the Wichita you've always known! When ya have me in a battle, victory is a given and foes stand no chance! Now take me to the battlefield!

propose.line: We're not general and soldier, you and I, we're lovers... and I can't fight like my heart yearns. You've done things to me... but it's fine. We'll keep on keeping on. You are my anchorage; my port to return to. Long as you're alive, I'll be around – 'til the world itself comes to an end.

skill.line: Turn to ash and sink below the waves!

touch.line: If ya wanna spar, I'm game. I'm not responsible if you get hurt, though.

touch2.line: You've got a real big pair on ya... Now you're in for it!

unlock.line: You the Commander? Alright, say no more. Take me into battle and I guarantee ya won't be let down!

upgrade.line: More power! I need more!

win_mvp.line: You ain't seen nothing yet!

gift_prefer.line: I'm surprised. You have great taste.

battle.line: Behold! The Admiral Hipper class still fights!

couple_encourage1.line: Are you keeping them at arm's length? Well, I understand.

couple_encourage2.line: Oh... So that's what became of you...

couple_encourage3.line: The Northern Parliament? Eh, whatever.

detail.line: Why are you being all sneaky? If you're gonna look, don't be a coward about it.

expedition.line: There being so many commissions means that we live in good times... Time to go review the rewards.

feeling1.line: It's a miracle in and of itself that the girls are living happily here. What more could you ask for...

feeling2.line: Mind if I borrow the repair shop, Commander? ...Get help from Akashi and Yuubari? Don't want it. It's my gear, so I should be the one to maintain it.

feeling3.line: Life here is good. It's obvious that those two are happy, too. Me? It's too early to tell, so...

feeling4.line: Sure, I don't need to cook for myself, so I get why you brought me to the canteen... but why on earth did you then take me to the movie theater, then an amusement park? ...What? Because you wanted to see me smile? Sh-shut up...

feeling5.line: What did you say? You LOVE me?! Alright, I DID say you should just say what's on your mind... but THIS?! You've got to give me time to mentally prepare myself! Idiot!

headtouch.line: Whatever. Do what you want.

home.line: No, nothing happened at the port while you were gone. Did you do your duty out there?

hp_warning.line: We're at a disadvantage... I need to think of an escape plan!

login.line: You're here. Time to get to work?

lose.line: One defeat isn't the end of the world. We'll get them next time!

mail.line: You've got a new letter. Write a response ASAP.

main1.line: Schweinshaxe? I suppose it's been a while since I had it. Thanks... Want to eat it with me?

main2.line: What are you doing? ...What? Trying to make me smile by making faces? You're a real idiot...

main3.line: When something's on your mind, just come out and say it. When I realized I had things I wanted to say, it was all too late.

mission.line: I don't know how long it's been since headquarters sent me a mission...

mission_complete.line: The mission has been completed and reported. Why are you just standing there, holding the list? ...To show off? Are you dumb or what?

profile.line: I'm the lead ship of the Admiral Hipper class. My name isn't that important – what you SHOULD remember is my class as a whole. Honor my sisters who once fought in these seas... just as we do now.

propose.line: I love you. I told you about just coming out and saying what's on your mind, and so that's what I just did! I've got things I wanna say, too! So what do you have to say? ...That you'll always look after me? Seriously? Yeah, that goes without saying!

skill.line: This is proof the Admiral Hipper class still lives!

touch.line: M-my scarf is the one thing that's off-limits. Not even you get to touch it.

touch2.line: You're attracted to MY body? I really don't understand how...

unlock.line: I'm Admiral Hipper, lead ship of my class and sister to Eugen and Blücher. Got it memorized?

upgrade.line: Thanks. I'll put your valuable resources to good use.

win_mvp.line: In the name of the Admiral Hipper class, I will play a song to soothe your souls.

gift_prefer.line: Is this... a present? Th-thank you... I like it.

battle.line: My mission is to seize victory. Don't hold me back.

couple_encourage1.line: You're here, too? Then I'll leave half to you.

detail.line: Hmm? Do you need me on the battlefield?

expedition.line: I've finished inspecting the commissioned goods. The list is on your desk – do not forget it.

feeling1.line: I can do this myself. Do not follow me.

feeling2.line: You'd like to introduce me to the rest of the port? I have no need of friends, nor your special treatment.

feeling3.line: Did you organize the files for me? Don't bother trying to refute it. I know your habits very well by now... Thank you.

feeling4.line: I'm not used to the feeling of someone being near me, but for you... I will do my best.

feeling5.line: I don't mean to push you away. But being near me will bring misfortune to you. That's why I've always walked alone in the dark, wrapped in misfortune... I don't want you hurt.

headtouch.line: Stay away from me.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. You brought me a gift...? Thank you. But do not do this again – you'll find that nothing good comes from being a friend of mine.

hp_warning.line: I WILL complete my mission!

login.line: Let's skip the small talk. I've done my duty, and it's time for you to do yours. Take it seriously.

lose.line: Does this mean... our fate is unavoidable?

mail.line: Commander, you have unread mail.

main1.line: Commander, there's no need for you to keep trying to get closer to me. Simply give me my orders. No matter the mission, I will see it done.

main2.line: ...Commander, is this dessert meant to be a gift for me? I'm fine – oh, it's an order? Very well. Then I will partake.

main3.line: The plan for the next mission is here... Yes, you've read it right. I will do it alone. It's hardly difficult.

mission.line: You still haven't completed your missions. Don't expect my help – oh, it's an order? Then leave it all to me. I mustn't burden you, after all.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. If you have no other orders, then I'll be leaving.

profile.line: I am the heavy cruiser Bolzano, a knight of the Sardegnia League. You want to know more about me? I don't think that's necessary.

propose.line: Are you really so set on being with me? You truly understand nothing... Fine. I won't push you away anymore. No matter what misfortune befalls us, I will protect you with all that I am.

skill.line: Sink to the deepest depths, cursed soul.

touch.line: You're sitting here? Then I'll go over there.

touch2.line: I'm not entertained, if that was your intent.

unlock.line: I am Bolzano, a knight of the Sardegnia League. Commander, I await my next task.

upgrade.line: It... worked? That's new.

win_mvp.line: Mission completed. League Knight Bolzano will hereby return to her original post.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you.

battle.line: To fight... is to fulfill this life's purpose.

couple_encourage1.line: Bismarck, I never thought I would fight by your side once more...

detail.line: The more you suppress your emotions, the more rationally you can fight. Let the battlefield wash over you, and immerse yourself in the scent of steel.

expedition.line: The commission rewards? Ahh, what an enviable logistics department you have.

feeling1.line: These were the only "commands" you could come up with? What a joke.

feeling2.line: A machine's efficiency comes from its accuracy, lack of hesitation, and tirelessness. As ships, we must be the same.

feeling3.line: You seem to be quite drawn to me. I'm not sure what about me would warrant your fancy, so I don't know if you're stubborn or just a simpleton.

feeling4.line: You're commanding me... to take a break? Do you even know what you're asking me to do? ...Very well. I did say I'll obey your orders.

feeling5.line: You are quite an interesting person, trying to treat me as an ordinary human and integrate me into life at this port. I suppose I ought to try saying "thank you." ...I wonder if this is the first time I've uttered those words.

headtouch.line: What... is the meaning of this?

home.line: Rest is for the dead. I'll do the rest myself if you so desire.

hp_warning.line: Pain... is nothing more than a catalyst for madness...

login.line: So you came after all. Not that it matters to me either way.

lose.line: Withdraw? Haha... Ahahaha! ...It hasn't ended yet, so why are we to withdraw?

mail.line: Just a friendly reminder: you still have unopened mail.

main1.line: Only with exacting precision can you eliminate your enemies in a single fatal blow, thus ending the battle quickly.

main2.line: ...Leave me to my own devices, and your job will be much smoother... Though it doesn't seem like you're interested.

main3.line: It may take some time... until I am used to an ocean devoid of war.

mission.line: Cumbersome paperwork will only hinder your ability to fight.

mission_complete.line: Your duties end here. Mine, on the other hand, persist eternally...

profile.line: I am the Iron Blood battleship, Gneisenau. I've heard that you are an excellent commander, so surely you know how to operate a precise and efficient instrument of war?

propose.line: If you're prepared to go to these great lengths for me, then I shall accompany you to the very end. I'm becoming more and more curious – just how far will you be able to go by my side? ...Yes, I cannot allow you to leave until we've traversed the very bowels of hell. Are you ready?

touch.line: What's wrong? Can't make up your mind?

touch2.line: Such a crass hobby... But whatever makes you happy.

unlock.line: You're... the Commander, right? In other words, the one with the authority to control me. Though I have no interest in you as an individual, I will still obey your orders... At least for the time being.

upgrade.line: Now that my armament has been strengthened, the next step is... Ahahaha!

win_mvp.line: Indeed, it is wreckage and ruins that put my heart at ease.

gift_prefer.line: Well then, I'll take this.

battle.line: I've had enough of your bullshit. There'll be nothing left of you when I'm finished!

detail.line: My every scar is proof of a brush with Death survived.

expedition.line: The commission team has come back. I'll send down a stand-in since we're both preoccupied here.

feeling1.line: A weakling such as you isn't fit to command a fleet.

feeling2.line: I never flee the battlefield, but I know when to make concessions.

feeling3.line: There must be some people here who strive to push their limits. Introduce me to them, would you?

feeling4.line: I'm well used to life at this port by now. While I'm still pushing my limits as always, I do feel like I've started to... loosen up a bit.

feeling5.line: What is this feeling of inner peace which I've lacked for so long...? What will happen when it goes away? ...You won't let it go anywhere? Usually I'd call that an empty promise, but when it's YOU making that promise... I must just believe it.

headtouch.line: Stop wasting your time on infantilizing me!

home.line: We are most prone to carelessness after a hard-fought battle. Stay sharp, Commander.

hp_warning.line: I will make you suffer for your persistence!

login.line: Now that you're here, it's time to get cracking. Start by reading these documents.

lose.line: This isn't over! I will NOT retreat!

mail.line: Here, a letter for you. I've underlined the important parts of it.

main1.line: Aircraft carrier shitbags... I hate to admit, but they outclass me when it comes to information and long-range warfare.

main2.line: Wounds of the body heal in due time. Wounds of the mind... They don't often fade so easily.

main3.line: The Ugly Sisters... Hahah. What an unforgettable nickname. The spite of your enemies is the most potent affirmation you can ask for.

mission.line: Why do you need more people on this mission? You don't think I'm capable enough, huh?!

mission_complete.line: Good news – mission complete. I went ahead and claimed the rewards, too.

profile.line: I'm Scharnhorst. Never back down, no matter what – that's my doctrine. I'll state it upfront: I'm headstrong, and might even defy your orders from time to time.

propose.line: There's no guarantee I'll forever stay by your side. That said... I will lend you every ounce of my strength to realize your ideal world. I, Scharnhorst, will fight for you.

skill.line: There is no compassion in war!

touch.line: Exhausted, you say? A break is just around the corner. Don't let up until then.

touch2.line: You disgust me... Ugh!

unlock.line: I'm Iron Blood battlecruiser Scharnhorst. I am keen to join forces with a Commander as talented as you. Don't let my expectations of you be misplaced.

upgrade.line: Time to assess my new strength with a cannon volley.

win_mvp.line: Such is the inevitable fate of all raving shitheads who oppose me.

gift_prefer.line: ...Sure, I'll take it.

battle.line: Come on, we're sortieing – let's hear some excitement!

detail.line: When seasoned heroes grow tired of fighting and start seeking peace of mind... will the world welcome them back?

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Don't forget to give those weary girls a pat on the back, Commander!

feeling1.line: Don't lose all hope. While you've steered a bit off course, the fact remains that we're allies. So, I'll take it upon myself to lead you back in the right direction!

feeling2.line: Having chats with friends, taking a leisurely stroll, and napping on a bench when you get tired... that's what life at this peaceful port is all about. Here's hoping it always stays that way.

feeling3.line: When you get time to rest, take it – don't work yourself to death. You never know when there might come a day you'll never rest again.

feeling4.line: You've not worn yourself out today, have you? Good. Shame these missions keep coming in, one after another... Guess it'll be a long while before the weight on your shoulders will finally come off.

feeling5.line: Commander, you're my closest friend and most beloved person, and I hate to see your health suffer because of your workload. If you ever feel you've had enough of it all, just toss it out the window. I'll support you from start to finish.

home.line: Phew... Glad you made it back alive. You may think a safe return is business as usual, but I can never take it for granted.

hp_warning.line: I'm only... getting started!

login.line: Yup, you're as committed to your job as ever.

lose.line: We retreated before it was too late, securing the strength to fight another day... I hope.

mail.line: You've got a letter. Isn't it wonderful having someone who cares about you? Remember to write back to them.

main1.line: Whew... Oh, need something? You caught me getting lost in the scenery out the window. Sorry about that.

main2.line: Life is short. We should be kind to our friends and treasure every moment we get with them.

main3.line: A Royal Knight? Sure, I've heard a few fables about knights in my time... Anyway, stay focused – don't forget about your work.

mission.line: New missions, eh? Wonder if any of them let me leverage all my experience...

mission_complete.line: That mission's done and dusted! That gives us some time to be with our friends.

profile.line: Repulse, Renown-class battlecruiser. Me and my sis have seen some things... That's a story for another day, though. I must say... this calm, peaceful port is ideal for a place to rest.

propose.line: I don't feel I've got much appeal, so the thought that you don't want me held me back so long. It takes bravery to pop the question, and I'll show the same bravery with my answer... Heehee, my answer's "yes," obviously!

touch.line: Concerned about me? Don't be, I'm feeling great. Cheers.

touch2.line: For your own sake, don't try anything funny.

unlock.line: I'm Repulse, Renown-class battlecruiser. I've been through a lot... but that's in the past. Now, I'm a part of this port. Whenever you're in a pinch, come see me.

upgrade.line: I hope there'll come a day when I'll have no use of this rigging anymore...

win_mvp.line: Yeah! We won!

gift_prefer.line: How did you figure out exactly what I'm into? Tell me what magic spell you used!

battle.line: Get into formation! It's time for us to attack!

detail.line: "I'm so tired," huh... Hmph. Those aren't words I can throw around so freely.

expedition.line: Commander, the commissions have been completed. Let us thank our allies before tallying up the results.

feeling1.line: You're our leader, so it won't do for you to stay in this sorry state. I shall take responsibility for whipping you into shape and guiding you.

feeling2.line: I fear neither scars nor death.. but the heartbreak that war brings is far worse than both combined...

feeling3.line: I used to believe I would continue fighting tirelessly alongside my friends until the end of time... When did I dare to start dreaming of peaceful days...?

feeling4.line: This question may be inappropriate, but... Commander, have you ever considered life after retirement? To live life not as a warrior, but as a normal human... How magnificent would that be?

feeling5.line: Commander, I am eternally grateful to you for giving me the opportunity to share many precious moments with you. Our meeting, the time we've spent together... all of it is engraved in my heart. ...Ah, don't worry, I'm not planning on going anywhere! I'm sorry if I've caused any misunderstandings. And, umm... I will always stay by your side, Commander!

home.line: The sight of my allies returning home safely never fails to put a spring in my step.

hp_warning.line: The dawn... is within our grasp!

login.line: Commander, your diligence will one day be duly rewarded.

lose.line: My apologies. I was unable to follow through with your orders...

mail.line: Here's some mail, Commander. Why don't you take a short break to confirm the contents?

main1.line: ...Oh, my apologies. I got sidetracked looking out the window... Repulse does the same thing from time to time? I see...

main2.line: I've come to love this port. My heart feels lighter whenever I think about what I've become a part of since coming here.

main3.line: You think the other Renown looks cute when she's serious about something...? Yes, I do think she would be happy to hear that from you. Allow me to give you my thanks on her behalf then— Oh...

mission.line: Is there a new mission? I'm not sure if I'll be of any assistance, but...

mission_complete.line: Now that you've completed your missions, you can take it easy for the time being.

profile.line: I am battlecruiser Renown. I've been through countless missions and operations with Repulse at my side... I am very fortunate to have found a place to take refuge in this world.

propose.line: I can scarcely believe you prepared this many candles and even went through the trouble of shaping them into a heart... Of course I know how you feel. Even if you hadn't gone through all this trouble, my answer would still be... B-by the way, Commander, do I look too giddy right now...?

touch.line: Instead of worrying about me, you should be worrying about things more worth your time.

touch2.line: This behaviour is inappropriate considering your position, Commander.

unlock.line: Salutations to you, Commander. I am battlecruiser Renown. I hope that this battle-worn blade can become your power.

upgrade.line: So this... is what's needed to maintain one's strength?

win_mvp.line: No matter how much the vicissitudes of war wear away at me, I shall not fall as long as my resolve holds strong!

gift_prefer.line: I'll keep this as a souvenir.

battle.line: Begin combat! We shall face them with all we have!

couple_encourage1.line: Host a banquet after this battle? Count me in!

detail.line: Do you have any outdoor missions, Commander? If not, oh well – perhaps we could go for a walk together instead?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Come, let's inspect the rewards right away.

feeling1.line: Could you just tell me what you want from me?

feeling2.line: When injustice I see, my blade I draw – the world I wander, sword at my hip. Hmm... I'm struggling to come up with a cool introduction. You're an educated person, Commander – do you have any ideas?

feeling3.line: "With this blade I cleave the skies, returning justice to the world" – how does this one sound? Do you think it's cool?

feeling4.line: Oh, go to a banquet? That sounds great! The lively atmosphere, the food, the music, the smiles... It so happens I have matching outfits for us both. Let's go together.

feeling5.line: Ahh... What a relaxing day, perfect for going outside. Oh? Go out together, you say? I'd love to. The amusement park? Heehee, that's fine by me.

headtouch.line: My horns? Heehee. You may touch them all you like.

home.line: Splendid work, Commander. Now, would you like to catch your breath with me at the training grounds?

hp_warning.line: It's not over yet! Come at me once more!

login.line: What are your plans for today? ...Working in the office all day? Umm... Maybe we could change those plans right now?

lose.line: I got too careless... This was a massive defeat.

mail.line: Psst. Commander, there's a letter for you. I left it on your desk.

main1.line: While, yes, you need wisdom on the battlefield, sometimes you also need to be recklessly courageous. What we call "miracles" all begin with these two things.

main2.line: A thousand-mile journey begins with a single step. You should take that first step without worrying about what could go wrong.

main3.line: A banquet? Where will it be? Regardless, I'd love to attend a– You want ME to arrange it? That sounds like a lot of work, so I'm afraid I'll have to decline.

mission.line: New missions, I see. You should start on those as soon as you can.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Impressive efficiency, Commander.

profile.line: I am fast battleship Hiei – you may call me Hiei META if you like. Oh, I don't SEEM much like a META to you? I see... What is a META supposed to be like, then?

propose.line: I will always, always honor my vow to be with you forever. Even when the darkest days befall us, I will grasp your hand, so please – grasp mine as well. Yes, together, we shall overcome everything!

skill.line: Disappear like a cloud in the sky!

touch.line: Ahh... The wind is nice and it's a perfect day for an outing. How about we go out, Commander?

touch2.line: You really dared to make a move, I see. I admire your forwardness.

unlock.line: Battlecruiser Hiei, at your service. What shall we do next, Commander? I am ready to patrol or head into battle, so let us sortie at your earliest convenience.

upgrade.line: This strength lets me keep up even with the winds!

win_mvp.line: I should've known not to expect much from them. Please find me a more worthwhile opponent for next time.

gift_prefer.line: For me? Really?! Thank you so much, Commander!

battle.line: Shoot! I set the oven to the wrong time! You, get out of my way!

detail.line: Open your mouth, Commander. Hm? It's just a regular chocolate donut. See? Delicious, no? Then how about trying this not-so-regular dessert next, hm?

expedition.line: Going to see the commission team? Bring them this dessert I made. It'll make it a real welcome-back celebration. Heheh.

feeling1.line: Seems your feedback on my dessert-making won't be very useful...

feeling2.line: I have some mouthwatering dessert. Want a taste? ...Aww, you don't? You're letting a rare experience slip by.

feeling3.line: Still "no" even if I feed you directly? Hmm... I wonder if I can make a dessert so special that you cannot possibly refuse it...

feeling4.line: Can I interest you in some freshly-made dessert? Rest assured, it's perfectly normal this time... Oh. You ate it without a second thought. Heheh. Well? Wasn't it delicious?

feeling5.line: Happiness is like a dessert with a complex taste. A hint of bitterness and sweetness, blended together in an inseparable union... Care to know what it's like to indulge in this wonderful sweetness with me?

headtouch.line: Feels nice and silky, doesn't it? ...Hm? Like a chocolate fountain, you say? Heheh... Let me guess – you're hungry, aren't you?

home.line: Done fighting? Excellent work. You must be hungry, right? Why don't you try your luck with my freshly-baked desserts? Don't worry, the worst that'll happen is it'll make you laugh.

hp_warning.line: Heheh... Such a bitter feeling...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Care for something sweet to shake off the grogginess? ...It tastes awfully sour? Heheh, it might be a little sour in the beginning, but you should taste the sweetness soon. Wouldn't you agree this woke you up well?

lose.line: Heheh... I haven't felt this in so long... You've given me inspiration for a new dessert.

mail.line: Your mail? I organized it for you.

main1.line: Why do I fight? To protect the world's hope and all things that are beautiful, of course. I don't want my painstakingly-made desserts to be ruined by some short-tempered buffoon.

main2.line: I've fought in countless nerve-racking battles to procure ingredients for my desserts. If you're curious, I could tell you about them sometime.

main3.line: Even a small dessert can stir a person's heart... Don't you think they're like temptations from the devil, Commander?

mission.line: Quite a lot of missions have piled up... That's fine. I'll take care of all your problems with this sword.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards are already here, if you're wondering. Are you coming to claim them?

profile.line: I'm Dunkerque, "the Dessert Demon." It's a pleasure, Commander. While you're here, why not taste this newest dessert of mine? ...Hey! Come back!

propose.line: My temptations don't affect you in the slightest, do they? Heehee... Maybe, just maybe I was born to stand side by side with you. Don't worry – I will always satisfy you with the highest sweetness, even if we end up in the depths of hell.

skill.line: Witness the power that leads to victory!

touch.line: Is it my time to sortie? Or do you finally feel like eating my special dessert?

touch2.line: So you crave me more than my delectable desserts... Heheh. Have it your way. Help yourself.

unlock.line: I'm battlecruiser Dunkerque. Yes, I'm not purposefully giving you this tense look, it's just that I just returned from the battlefield. People call me things like "the Dessert Demon." Would you like to know why they call me that, Commander?

upgrade.line: Power... Heheh. This feels nice!

win_mvp.line: An outstanding outcome. You make me proud, Commander.

gift_prefer.line: I can sense the feelings you put into this. As thanks... would you like some sweets?

battle.line: Is this the only way to cleanse their impurities? Then so be it.

detail.line: Conflict throws all souls into chaos... I pray the gods may guide them to peace...

expedition.line: You command a whole fleet of shipgirls who'll fight with all their might for you, Commander... Please, do cherish them.

feeling1.line: There is nothing more I can do for you at this point, Commander...

feeling2.line: How may I be of use to you, Commander?

feeling3.line: Are you... concerned about me, Commander? You have no reason to be. I pray to the gods each day so that they bestow us all with their blessings and protection.

feeling4.line: I've seen far too many lost souls stricken with grief and remorse. Commander, when one day you look back upon your whole life, I want you to be able to smile, and say your life was a good one.

feeling5.line: Before I met you and everyone else here, all I could do was pray. I had lost all motivation to sing hymns or even lead lost souls to the light. But now, seeing all your smiles, I feel I've... rediscovered my purpose in life.

home.line: You cannot let your duty come before sleep, lest it ultimately consume you, Commander. Please, care for your own well-being.

hp_warning.line: I have already offered so many prayers... but is it still not enough...?

login.line: Commander, I have been waiting for you.

lose.line: This curse cannot be lifted... Then so be it.

mail.line: You've received a letter, Commander. I urge you to read it at the earliest convenience.

main1.line: Commander, do you ever wish you could return home? Do you have anyone in your heart who you are unable to let go of?

main2.line: Until we have finished our respective duties... May we not pry excessively into each others' affairs.

main3.line: I will keep praying to the gods, for as long as it takes, until the curse placed on Yamashiro and me can be permanently lifted.

mission.line: A mission, you say? I shall pray for the fulfillment of your wishes, no matter how small.

mission_complete.line: A mission has been completed. The gods have heard our prayers.

profile.line: The missteps and misfortunes of the past are now all but forgotten phantoms... Only by guiding these drifting souls towards the light can I accomplish my mission.

propose.line: If this is what you desire... then I shall accept. I know not whether this ritual will ultimately bring us blessings or misfortune, but I will continue praying for your happiness, Commander.

touch.line: I pray for you, Commander, and hope that the gods are listening.

touch2.line: Commander...? Has something strange possessed you?

unlock.line: I am battleship Fusou. I have come to bring peace to this world's tormented souls. Commander, do you seek blessings... or redemption?

upgrade.line: So many catastrophe-stricken souls still await their salvation.

win_mvp.line: May you slumber eternally and find solace, far from the turmoil of the sea...

gift_prefer.line: If that is your wish, Commander, then I shall accept it.

battle.line: Show them the fruits of your training~ Hehehe~

detail.line: You look bored, Milord. Was your training perhaps too easy?

expedition.line: Taking on commissions is a form of training. Milord, please mix up your commission rosters so everyone gets a turn!

feeling1.line: I know you can hear me, Milord. Come out of hiding and own up to your mistakes like a decent person!

feeling2.line: Do you wish to strengthen your fleet, Milord? Then allow me to be of service! I know the way to draw out latent potential!

feeling3.line: Why does at least one girl always call it quits partway through our training? And why do you always stick up for the quitters, Milord? The whole fleet will stagnate if people keep dropping out...

feeling4.line: I'll admit, I've been too strict with those girls... No, no, please don't say that. I understand why you feel that way. Those girls can stop if they wish, but your training, Milord, will stay as rigorous as ever!

feeling5.line: Astounding, Milord! You've seen through your most rigorous training yet! With someone like you, maybe my bad luck won't be such a... N-no, I didn't say anything! Anyway, the next session will be arduous – please give it your all!

home.line: Trai-ning♪ Trai-ning♪ Let me think about what I'm gonna drill into your head today~♪

hp_warning.line: Aww, just my luck...

login.line: I've sorted your documents and made you green tea. Strap in, Milord – it's going to be a long day!

lose.line: What went wrong? Please don't tell me one of you wasn't even trying...

mail.line: Milord, I suggest you read your new mail when you have the time.

main1.line: You mustn't let your mind wander while on the clock, Milord. Also, I've brought new paperwork for you!

main2.line: Life is awfully laid-back at this port... Your girls will never grow into fine soldiers in this environment!

main3.line: Oh no! The vase! ...Phew! That was a close one... Through my training, I've developed the reflexes to react quickly to imminent mishaps like this!

mission.line: New missions have come in. Knowing you, you'll breeze through them!

mission_complete.line: Oh, you've completed a mission? Then you should get yourself a cup of tea and enjoy a break!

profile.line: I'm battleship Yamashiro, Fusou's sister. I've learned a lot through my training, and I'd happily impart that knowledge to you. Would you like to learn, Milord?

propose.line: Is this... proof of your adoration, Milord? Oh, I feel truly blessed! Henceforth, please allow me to assist by taking on more and more work, or anything else you want done! I promise I'll be of great use!

skill.line: Keep going, don't let up already!

touch.line: Does anyone here wish to become stronger? Step forth and let me train you!

touch2.line: Milord... Fondling me without warning is a punitive deed. The punishment is quite severe, I'll say.

unlock.line: Are you this fleet's Commander, Milord? I see. You have great potential, but your skills need some refinement. I wonder what's the best way to train you... You'll see soon enough – stay alert until then!

upgrade.line: I'm afraid this isn't nearly enough power. I need more...

win_mvp.line: With enough rigorous training, victory becomes almost a certainty. Isn't that right, Milord?

gift_prefer.line: Thank you for the gift, Milord! That being said, you mustn't let your mind wander!

battle.line: I pray this is the correct decision...

detail.line: If given the chance, I'd like to do it all over again... But even if that were possible, wouldn't the same things just play out again? What do you think, Commander?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Go welcome them together? Never mind, I'll just be a hindrance anyway....

feeling1.line: You should stay away from me after all. Otherwise, it'll only end up with your friends getting hurt...

feeling2.line: Would you mind keeping a safe distance from me? Oh, no, I'm not trying to push you away. "Our" Vestal warned that something terrible will happen if you don't...

feeling3.line: You don't have horrible dreams when you're around me? Really? Um, it's not that I don't believe you, but...

feeling4.line: Peace of mind, and comfort... When I am by your side, Commander, those feelings seem to be slowly coming back to me... But, I'm scared of losing this happiness again...

feeling5.line: Commander, you who rescued me from the abyss of despair and suffering... You are my last hope. I'll strive to do even better. Someday, I'll show you that I can overcome these dark emotions! Until then... Commander, would you please wait for me?

home.line: Um, while you were gone, all the lights in the office seem to have gone out again... I'm sorry for inconveniencing you once again.

hp_warning.line: No! At this rate, I...

login.line: Welcome back. When you are here, Commander, the office does not seem as bleak.

lose.line: If only I could do it all over again...

mail.line: Commander, there's a letter addressed to you... I'll go ahead and leave it on your desk.

main1.line: "Arizona's Tears"... Does that refer to me? Maybe I was seen in a moment when I could not control my emotions. I'm sorry...

main2.line: It is said that staying around me for too long will afflict you with tragic dreams. Huh? You don't mind? I, I see...

main3.line: Oh, what was that sound just now? Did something break again because of me?

mission.line: Do you still have missions left? I'll try to help out in whatever way I can...

mission_complete.line: We finished the missions without any major issues... Phew, I'm glad it went well.

profile.line: If there are parallel worlds out there, would "I" exist in them as well? If that's the case... I pray that I could have met you earlier, and spend a life free from tears...

propose.line: You're willing to always stay by my side and watch over me? *sobs*... Oh, I'm so sorry... I just, can't stop the tears from flowing... Commander, I believe you. You are the only safe harbor for my heart...

touch.line: S-sorry! If you touch me without warning, I... Huh? You're not hurt? Thank goodness...

touch2.line: Is this... some kind of punishment?

unlock.line: I am Arizona... This may be improper of me, but is it really alright for me to stay here? ...Very well, Commander. If that is what you've decided...

upgrade.line: I hope this will make a difference...

win_mvp.line: Is victory... something worth celebrating?

gift_prefer.line: Oh, this, um... Thank you very much...

battle.line: What a grand welcome. Do they mean to roll out the red carpet for us?

couple_encourage1.line: Royal Fleet, follow our lead!

detail.line: What's the matter? Are you in such awe that you cannot utter so much as a word? Hmph... Servant, if you're thinking of anything rude, you will pay dearly!

expedition.line: Servant, tend to the girls who just returned from their commission.

feeling1.line: It's fine. Consider this our own mistake for not being more selective. Go and do what you want; you may no longer be our servant.

feeling2.line: Pretty yet empty words will not be proof enough that we have done our job as queen. Servant, if you have any doubts about us, we will ascertain and rectify them.

feeling3.line: Are you still struggling to swear your fealty? Hah, your queen understands that the most talented folk fashion themselves leaders rather than followers. Do your job as you wish, but we expect your aid when it is needed.

feeling4.line: Hm? Are you surprised that we would come here? Is it wrong for a queen to worry about her servants? Actually, why aren't you worried about us?! ...N-Not to say that's all there is to it...

feeling5.line: Your work isn't bad, but you focus too much on working out minor trifles! In other words... Umm, focus yourself on other things! For example, erm... Your queen...

headtouch.line: Servant, do you not find your actions extremely rude?

home.line: Finally returned? Good. We order you to rest. You may not continue working until your queen says you may! Understood?

hp_warning.line: This isn't funny! Your queen does not approve of this!

login.line: What took you so long, servant? Are you not aware that you are making us wait?

lose.line: All forces, retreat! We will not permit any unapproved sacrifices!

mail.line: Mail for you, hmm? What's so wrong with us asking what it says?! Of course, we do mean to respect your privacy.

main1.line: If you wish to pray, pray to your queen instead of the empty sky! We will bless and protect you!

main2.line: We will prove that charisma is more than just one's physical size... Nobody shall impugn our stature ever again!

main3.line: A port full of harmony and beauty... Is this your desire, servant? ...Don't worry. We were just a little happy for you.

mission.line: Missions? See them done, and done well. We will not tolerate you shaming our name.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards? We have no interest in such trifles. You take them, servant.

profile.line: We are the super-dreadnaught, Queen Elizabeth. We welcome any who wish to become our subject. Member of the Royal Navy or otherwise, we protect all those who follow us! Come, Servant; if you have any questions, ask now before our mood changes!

propose.line: Must we still tell you what needs to be done?! Take our hand and swear that you will never betray us! ...Hmph, you belong to your queen now, so you are no longer permitted to shoulder every burden on your own! If you try to escape us, you'll be the subject of our ire forevermore!

skill.line: Consider this a gift from your queen!

touch.line: You are a fearless one, laying hands on our body without express permission!

touch2.line: Pervert! Shameless lecher! Servants who don't know their place ought to be beheaded!

unlock.line: So you are the Commander? Very well. From this point forth, you will use your courage and intellect for our purposes! ...We don't have all day, now. You are our servant, so this won't go anywhere until you swear your fealty.

upgrade.line: It is good to see that you pay adequate attention to us.

win_mvp.line: Hmph. Did you think such foes stood a chance at stopping us?

gift_prefer.line: Excellent work. Now that's what I call a faithful servant.

battle.line: This is it...

couple_encourage1.line: Your concept... isn't the right one?

couple_encourage2.line: No matter the time or place, you will always be "our" queen.

couple_encourage3.line: It's an honour to fight by your side, Your Majesty.

couple_encourage4.line: "I" shall protect you, "my" sister.

detail.line: Tomorrow's programme? "I" haven't given it any thought. The flow of time holds no significance for Rodney as a concept, you see.

expedition.line: Commission complete. Do you need "me" to go and receive the team?

feeling1.line: The path "I" walk for eternity is a lonesome one. What about yours? Is it the same?

feeling2.line: "Powerful" is a word often used to describe "me." But what does it mean? It's all the same as far as the concept of Rodney is concerned.

feeling3.line: One can interpret "powerful" to mean, "Having the strength to protect what you cherish." Yes, it's fair to say you would need extraordinary strength to protect the weak.

feeling4.line: You need strength to protect what you cherish... "I" wish to protect you, Commander, and therefore, don't you fit the definition of something "I" cherish? "I" – "we" – want to find the answer to that question.

feeling5.line: Commander, "I" now have both the strength to protect what "I" hold dear and the time to do so into perpetuity. Therefore, "I" may be interpreted as "powerful," right?

headtouch.line: Um... "I" see...?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. "I" appreciate all your hard work.

hp_warning.line: Such fierce resistance from these physical entities...

login.line: "I" am listening. Let "me" take care of all matters of the physical world.

lose.line: You may have defeated "me," but you haven't defeated Rodney.

mail.line: There is a letter for you. The way people communicate in the physical world is fascinating.

main1.line: "Powerful"... Yes, that is what people say about "me." "We" take that as evidence of "our" strength, as meaningless as it may be.

main2.line: Time is a difficult concept for Rodney as a collective to understand. Still, it must be a very important thing – right, Commander?

main3.line: What to have for supper? Anything will do... Actually, anything but Royal cuisine, please.

mission.line: Your missions await your attention.

mission_complete.line: "I" have retrieved your physical rewards for you.

profile.line: "Rodney" is an amalgamation that exists in a higher dimension, even if "we" take human form in different branches. As for "me"... Yes, you're free to regard "me" as an incarnation of the concept of Rodney, specific to this branch.

propose.line: Do you see "me" as someone you cherish, Commander? Then you must become stronger. Protecting "me" will take an inordinate amount of... No, even should you be vanquished, "I" will always be with you. Forever, until the end of time.

touch.line: This is an act of closeness. Is "my" interpretation correct?

touch2.line: This gesture fascinates both "me" and Rodney as a whole... Please continue.

unlock.line: On behalf of all Rodneys, greetings... You must understand, "I" am a physical representation of the concept of "Rodney." "I" am no more than that...

upgrade.line: You've made "me" stronger? As far as the concept of Rodney is concerned, that was a meaningless effort.

win_mvp.line: They've all been destroyed...

gift_prefer.line: I" am very fond of this gift. Yes...

battle.line: Only death awaits those who stand in my path.

couple_encourage1.line: O Venerable Sakura, protect my fleet.

detail.line: The future you pursue is one and the same with my destination. I shall deliver you to the "other side". Fear not – I possess the requisite power.

expedition.line: Commission complete... Indeed, let us go together and greet our friends.

feeling1.line: ...So be it. Do as you please.

feeling2.line: Never again shall I sacrifice one for the many. I wield this power so that I will never be confronted with such a choice ever again. Through this power, I shall bring salvation to all.

feeling3.line: I cannot grind my existence away on the front lines for perpetuity? And why do you say this? What would you do if your friends were hurt in the absence of my protection? You want me to trust you? Hmm... Well, let's see. It all depends on how you lead.

feeling4.line: Before I realized it, I had already grown accustomed to having you at my side. I find it amusing that you neither fear nor worship me... But, do you truly have no desires? Should you be so inclined, I can make any wish of yours come true. Why not give it a try?

feeling5.line: First you ask me to go flower-viewing with you, then you invite me to gaze at the moon... You're plotting something, aren't you? You're trying to use your own "wishes" as a pretense to get me to open up. Listen well – I am aware of your tricks. You have one last wish to make, so think carefully about what you want.

headtouch.line: This sensation... is most sublime.

home.line: You have done well. For that, is there some reward you would like? Do not be shy and speak your mind.

hp_warning.line: I shall not fall... I shall not fall!

login.line: You have arrived in a timely manner. Most commendable.

lose.line: As moon waxes and wanes, so too do the tides of fortune ebb and flow. This is not the end!

mail.line: Commander, I have collected the mail addressed to you. Please do not neglect to read them over. You are not permitted to betray your companions' expectations.

main1.line: Commander, the cherry blossoms at the port are... truly beautiful.

main2.line: Whether everyone worships me or fears me matters not, as long as they are safe.

main3.line: I possess a vast power. Feel free to turn to me should you ever be in need.

mission.line: Commander, the mission documentation is complete. The rest is up to you.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Yes, please come with me to inspect the rewards.

profile.line: I am Nagato. Nagato of the "Sakura Empire". As flowers bloom and wither, so too do people come and go... That is all you need to know. Now, enough sitting around. Go and do what you need to do.

propose.line: Indeed... Your wish was well within my expectations, as the natural progression of the cosmos. But, I wonder if you truly understand the meaning of this wish... Though, I will not allow you to retract your words even if you say you don't understand. I have already accepted you; and just as flowers are short-lived, so too is the brevity of a maiden's spring. You've already come this far, so why space out now? Come, and make me yours.

skill.line: O thundering fox, prance betwixt the spirit realms!

touch.line: Do you have a wish? If so, come forth and speak your mind.

touch2.line: Are you aware of the presumptuousness of your conduct?

unlock.line: I am Nagato, Guardian Fox of the "Sakura Empire". Tell me, why have you summoned me? For power? Or for a wish you would like to have granted?

upgrade.line: Power is what I desire – the greater, the better.

win_mvp.line: As flowers bloom, so too must they wither. You are no exception.

gift_prefer.line: Hrm... Most commendable. I... am truly glad.

battle.line: Begin the conquest!

couple_encourage1.line: I give you my respect, magnificent Roma.

detail.line: Hm? Are we beginning a new conquest?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Let us remember the importance of logistics and bid them a triumphant return together.

feeling1.line: One day, I shall cross the Rubicon.

feeling2.line: You are extraordinarily talented as a leader, Commander. By working together, we can seize victory after victory and secure eternal glory.

feeling3.line: I have dreamed many times of my day of triumph, walking through the triumphal arches whilst flowers rain and the people sing praises to my great achievements. In the end, though, that was naught by an empty dream.

feeling4.line: Whilst I can no longer remember my home, I have no doubt that it was a peaceful and prosperous place such as this. Keep it safe, Commander.

feeling5.line: A red carpet and a cannon salute? What is this about? ...My triumph? Thank you! Giulio Cesare, conqueror of the empire... has returned triumphantly!

headtouch.line: While I do like the galeae my legionnaires wear, a naval cap is also satisfactory.

home.line: The battlefield is more my element than this. Take me with you on your next sortie.

hp_warning.line: The die is cast... All that remains is to advance!

login.line: You've come? Then concentrate and get to work.

lose.line: Send me additional legions, Commander.

mail.line: Letters are time-sensitive things. Don't forget to read yours.

main1.line: Commander, the patrol deployments around the port stand to be improved. May we discuss this?

main2.line: Concentrating on aircraft and cannons alone isn't enough. In war, each and every soldier has value.

main3.line: Orthodoxy rooster... Royal Navy lion? Heehee.

mission.line: Do remember to tackle your missions.

mission_complete.line: With greater fidelity comes higher efficiency. Excellent.

profile.line: I am Giulio Cesare, conqueror of the empire. I came, I saw, I conquered – and then, I will return home triumphantly... in that shining land of glory.

propose.line: Wherever you belong is where I belong, my beloved. All those you seek to protect, I shall protect, too. And all your enemies are mine as well. Take my hand, Commander, and let us set off into this vast world full of uncertainties!

touch.line: The endless sea, the vast sky – it all exists for me to conquer. Wouldn't you agree?

touch2.line: Good. This is how a conqueror such as you ought to act.

unlock.line: I am Giulio Cesare, conqueror of the empire. Spare me the needless chatter. I have no desire to squander time on such things.

upgrade.line: I will not stop here.

win_mvp.line: Victory and glory always follow my path.

gift_prefer.line: This is not bad. Thanks.

battle.line: To victory! Charge!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's go. There's still much to be done.

couple_encourage2.line: Look deep inside yourself. Your potential is so much greater than you think.

detail.line: The Sardegnian fleet's training results have been on a slight decline. I'm trying to figure out how to improve their condition... Commander, do you have any advice for me?

expedition.line: You can't have booming business without smooth shipping routes. Good work, Commander.

feeling1.line: Commander, we need to speak about your inappropriate decision-making of late.

feeling2.line: You look like you want to say something... If you're worried about anything, share the burden with me.

feeling3.line: Paying attention to your subordinates' health, both mental and physical, and giving individual care... This is something I could stand to learn from you.

feeling4.line: You're warm and nostalgic like hot milk, Commander... I'd say I'm more like pure cocoa – rich and dark, but of unknowable depths. Heehee... Why don't we meet in the middle and enjoy a cup of hot chocolate?

feeling5.line: Do you want to know more about my past? About things not written in the history books? Hmm... Perhaps not yet. You're special to me, so I want to handle our relationship gently for the time being.

headtouch.line: ...Oh? Are you trying to help me relax? I do appreciate your ministrations, Commander.

home.line: Commander, you look so tired. Take a break and let me take care of the mission postmortem review, okay?

hp_warning.line: It's okay. Just a scratch.

login.line: Commander, is it already time to work? How about a cup of hot milk first? Heehee, this one is mine. I'll go warm yours up right away.

lose.line: This isn't good... All who are injured, retreat and get treated! Victory can wait another day!

mail.line: Commander, I brought your mail. It's all just regular correspondence, so check it whenever you're free.

main1.line: Am I not that different from the Andrea Doria you know? Heehee, go on thinking that.

main2.line: I do love hot milk, but pure cocoa is nice, too... Hmm. Talking with you has made me thirsty. Shall we get a drink, Commander?

main3.line: Phew... I'm a little tired from this long stretch of work. Why don't we take a break?

mission.line: Commander, I just got word of new missions. Do you need any help?

mission_complete.line: Your missions are all done. Oh, sorry. I just wanted to ruffle your hair for a job well done... Your work is much appreciated.

profile.line: I am Andrea Doria. You may call me Lady Doria, if you please. Do you want to know about the Sardegnia League... or about me?

propose.line: Then our oath is sworn. I will stay by your side forevermore... You're still curious about my story? Okay. I can reveal one of my hundred tales to you, my beloved Commander♪

touch.line: If you're feeling down, a warm hug ought to lift your spirits.

touch2.line: Heehee... I'm happy to indulge you as much as you want.

unlock.line: I'm Andrea Doria, of the Sardegnia League. Is this your port, Commander? I see... It's a lovely place. I think I'll like it here.

upgrade.line: Well, this is... Heheh, not bad at all.

win_mvp.line: That was a well-earned victory. Heehee, good job, everyone!

gift_prefer.line: My~ Thank you. I love this. Thank you for putting in the effort♪

battle.line: Now this is a party. Let's set the enemy and the sea alight!

detail.line: I know I'm overdoing it a little, but I'd rather be called worrisome than the alternative. You can't complain unless you're alive, get what I mean?

expedition.line: Everyone made it home safe. Let's go see them. I gotta check and make sure they're not hurt.

feeling1.line: I thought you'd understand how I felt. Guess I was stupid for that.

feeling2.line: It's better to keep a certain distance. That'll help me keep cool when it's time to protect you.

feeling3.line: Shopping...? Sure, but I won't let my guard down. For your sake.

feeling4.line: Sometimes, I wonder if I'm a little too stubborn... But when I see you safe and sound, I know it's for the best.

feeling5.line: I finally understand. The thing that scares me most isn't external threats – it's the thought that I might lose you. So I'm going to keep protecting you until you really trust me.

headtouch.line: Heheh. What's up, young'un?

home.line: Are you tired? Let me check you for wounds... Okay, I'm glad you're safe. I've got water and a first aid kit, so tell me if you need anything.

hp_warning.line: Just a flesh wound! I'm protecting the Commander, no matter what!

login.line: Hold it! Let me scope this area out... Okay, safety confirmed. Hi there, Commander!

lose.line: Tch, Commander, hurry and retreat! I'll hold them off!

mail.line: Mail for you. As usual, I made sure none of it was suspicious.

main1.line: You think I worry too much? Maybe so, but a moment's inattention could lead to calamity.

main2.line: If you don't like me being around all the time, then I'll go patrol. Don't worry, Commander. I'll protect you AND the port.

main3.line: Do the things you wanna do while you're still young! Leave no regrets!

mission.line: Commander, you still have missions left over. Let me help you knock 'em out. I'm prepared for any and all kinds of accidents.

mission_complete.line: You've got rewards. I checked them all, so I can guarantee they're safe. ...Don't look at me like that. You can never be too careful.

profile.line: Experiencing that disaster made me realize that preparation is the only thing that can save you from danger. If you believe in me, I'll use everything at my disposal to protect you.

propose.line: Have you prepared yourself? Giving me this means that you've accepted me as I am... I like that look in your eye. You've been raised well. I just need you to accept my one request in return – let me protect you for the rest of my days, Commander.

skill.line: Try again in a few thousand years!

touch.line: Urk...! Oh, it's just you. I'm all for cuddles, but warn me first, okay? You might get hurt otherwise.

touch2.line: Hnh?! Phew... It's you. Say something next time, please. That's a vital area right there!

unlock.line: Yo, young'un. I know you've got things under control here, but this port may not be peaceful forever. You should stay with me from now on! I'll keep you safe no matter what happens!

upgrade.line: Heh, that feels good! I'll use this power to protect you.

win_mvp.line: We won, but there's still room for improvement.

gift_prefer.line: Oh? You have an eye for presents. Thanks!

battle.line: Fight until your last breath for this land!

couple_encourage1.line: For the sake of our comrades further back, we mustn't fall!

detail.line: I wasn't born with this power. It became mine by stumbling over and over and getting back up each time. This unbreakable will is what I believe in.

expedition.line: The commission team's brought home some crucial supplies. Excellent. Our front line will hold longer now.

feeling1.line: Impulsiveness and recklessness will be the bane of everything we protect. I want you to make sensible decisions, Comrade Commander.

feeling2.line: Our strength grows through the bond that we share. Let us keep on pushing forward, Comrade Commander!

feeling3.line: When we fight together, it feels like the skies have cleared for the first time in so long. Is this what... trusting someone is like?

feeling4.line: Comrade Commander, fighting by your side holds the same importance as achieving victory to me.

feeling5.line: You were right, Comrade Commander. Even if the greatest victory lies long ahead, it's still worth celebrating the smaller victories you earn along the way... Here. I've saved this vodka for a special occasion. Care to try some?

headtouch.line: Pardon, Comrade Commander? Well, I guess this is fine on its own.

home.line: I salute your return, Comrade Commander. Time to review the battles you fought? I'd be happy to assist!

hp_warning.line: Hmph... This is what war is all about! Come at me!

login.line: Comrade Commander, my blood's boiling in anticipation for an exhilarating battle! Let's head out and fight somebody today!

lose.line: This was my mistake. All the blame lies with me.

mail.line: There's a letter for you, Comrade Commander. Battlefield intel changes with every moment – best to read it now.

main1.line: Ahh... This is good booze! Come the day we win this grand war, we'll drink it until the sun rises!

main2.line: Comrade Commander, even if the world were to end tomorrow, you should still complete the work you have today.

main3.line: If you don't come to the front line, the front line will come to you. Comrade Commander, once we're done with this paperwork, let's head to the front and raise our allies' morale!

mission.line: Comrade Commander, we've been sent our missions for today. We ought to start on them at once.

mission_complete.line: Mission successfully completed. This result is the proof of our hard work.

profile.line: I'm Gangut META. It's a blessing, Comrade Commander, to fight with someone who shares my conviction as you do. Let us join hands and carve out a brilliant future for these frozen seas!

propose.line: I accept. In this age of war, an oath will make us both stronger. I raise this toast to you – my fellow soldier, my comrade, my support, and my dearest!

touch.line: Something the matter, Comrade Commander? If you're bored, we can fight a mock battle to rouse your spirit.

touch2.line: Comrade Commander, I applaud your bold ambush. However... Getting me won't be that easy.

unlock.line: I'm Gangut META. From now on, my will and firepower are yours to command. Let's seize victory with our own hands in this grand war, Comrade Commander!

upgrade.line: Good. This'll let me better protect this land.

win_mvp.line: Victory's ours, but we still have a long way to go until a lasting peace! Don't get lazy!

gift_prefer.line: A practical present. Comrade Commander, you have my thanks!

battle.line: Yeah! Throw them into disarray!

detail.line: I can't just sit on my ass all day! Commander, don't you have any information about where the Sirens will pop up next?!

expedition.line: A commission's been completed? Let's see... Wow, that's a pretty good haul.

feeling1.line: What a gutless Commander you are...

feeling2.line: Battles are simple. Just crush all of your enemies, and live to tell the tale.

feeling3.line: ...My eyepatch? Don't worry, it's no impediment in battle.

feeling4.line: Your job is to lead our way, Commander. My job is to eliminate any obstacle that tries to stop us. Perfect, isn't it?

feeling5.line: Commander, just do whatever you'd like and go wherever you'd like. As long as I can be by your side and fight together with you, I don't need anything else.

headtouch.line: Keep this up for a few more seconds, and I won't be able to guarantee your safety.

home.line: You've returned. Good, let's start planning for the next battle.

hp_warning.line: Tis but a scratch...!

login.line: I can't sit still anymore! Commander, I'm all ready to head out!

lose.line: This is unacceptable! I'll crush you all next time!

mail.line: Here, Commander. Your mail.

main1.line: Junyou? ...I'm doing just fine. No need to worry about me.

main2.line: The best defense is a good offense. Take them out before they can get to you. Don't you agree?

main3.line: Doing paperwork dulls my blade, Commander. When's our next battle going to be?

mission.line: We've received some missions. If any of them concern the Sirens, leave them to me.

mission_complete.line: All right, mission complete!

profile.line: Name's Hiyou, aircraft carrier of the Hiyou-class. I'm considered a light aircraft carrier along with Junyou, but I don't mind if you treat me as you would a standard aircraft carrier. Don't worry, I won't let you down.

propose.line: Commander, you're making a promise to me...? Heh, ahahaha... Sorry, it's not that this doesn't make me happy, it's just... I don't know how I'm supposed to feel or respond... Right, I can just answer the way I'm used to: by defeating your enemies for you.

touch.line: What, got any new info on the Sirens?

touch2.line: What are you trying to say? That I have no charm?

unlock.line: Ahahahaha! The fact that you've chosen me means you clearly have a discerning eye. So, what now? Where's the enemy you need me to sink?

upgrade.line: Got any targets I could wipe out for a warm-up?

win_mvp.line: Hehehe, that was a good fight. Let's just leave it at that.

gift_prefer.line: How fascinating. I love it!

battle.line: Here I come!

detail.line: How would you react... if I told you we've been lifelong friends, and... N-never mind. Please forget I said anything.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Do you mind if I go see them on your behalf...?

feeling1.line: I'm a grown woman now. It's time to put my childhood behind...

feeling2.line: Oh, uh... S-sorry, I didn't mean to stare... I'm just thinking about what-ifs and what-could-have-beens...

feeling3.line: Commander... How do you feel about lifelong friends? Err, I mean, in the context of fictional stories... and things like that...

feeling4.line: What if... Just speculating, of course, but... What if you and I had known each other since long ago...? Things would be a lot different to how are they now... wouldn't they?

feeling5.line: We may not be genuine lifelong friends, but that doesn't matter anymore... We've been through so much that we've grown as close as best friends like you see in fiction! ...I mean, right?

headtouch.line: Ahh... *blushes*

home.line: Hello. Good to see you... back in one piece.

hp_warning.line: An approach this direct is bound to fail...!

login.line: You're back. Are you about to start working? I promise I won't be a nuisance.

lose.line: Whatever comes next, I've made my peace...

mail.line: There's mail for you. Please check it as soon as you can.

main1.line: I see Hiyou hasn't changed... She still revels in war.

main2.line: Focus on yourself. Focus... Ah, um, I'm meditating. Please leave me alone for a while...

main3.line: These shikigami planes are my weapon of choice against the Sirens. Only I can control them. No one else may touch them... No one...

mission.line: We should strive to complete our missions.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Don't you think... we work astonishingly well together?

profile.line: I'm not sure what you want to hear from me... but ask me about my past, and I'm afraid you'll be disappointed... Because I simply have no answers.

propose.line: Thank you, Commander. This proves to me that our relationship is real – that it has ALWAYS been real – and not some figment of my imagination... I want to be with you, now and forever.

touch.line: I don't understand what you want...

touch2.line: Whuh?! I'm... I'm not...!

unlock.line: I'm... Junyou. Please give me your orders... Commander.

upgrade.line: Thank you.

win_mvp.line: One tiny little victory... won't be enough...

gift_prefer.line: I-I appreciate the sentiment!

battle.line: Carrier Princeton, commencing operation!

couple_encourage1.line: I'm glad to be fighting with you again, Saratoga!

couple_encourage2.line: Uhh, well met, other me...?

couple_encourage3.line: What in the world happened while I was gone?

couple_encourage4.line: How did you become so skilled so quickly?

detail.line: "Sirens"... Is that what you call them? And they're our enemies... Forgive me if asking that is considered taboo. I just have so many questions...

expedition.line: The commission team has come back. Anything I can do to help them?

feeling1.line: Is something the matter, Commander? Maybe you should take a leave of absence...

feeling2.line: Commander, if possible, could you tell me everything you know about me? I know I may be in no position to ask that of you, but some part of me just has to know...

feeling3.line: I was conducting a special mission. Then I was separated from my comrades, got caught in a strange place, and somehow ended up here... It's baffling that it's already been this long since then...

feeling4.line: While I only had a gut feeling that I could trust you, you've proven that feeling correct. That's why I urge you to use my strength in whichever way you see fit.

feeling5.line: You can't do anything about a choice you regret, but as long as you stay on the right path, the past won't have been for nothing. And I believe in the path you've shown to me, Commander. I will keep walking it with you.

home.line: How goes the battle, Commander? I'll provide reinforcements if needed.

hp_warning.line: I can't give up! Not yet!

login.line: Your will is my command, as always, Commander.

lose.line: What a blunder... Forgive me, Commander.

mail.line: A letter addressed to you has come in. Read it sooner rather than later.

main1.line: "S-Sara"?! My respected predecessor's name should never be abbreviated! I will refer to her as Saratoga in full.

main2.line: I was hoping I could update my gear so I may perform new duties on the battlefield.

main3.line: It is a secretary's duty to aid her Commander. Is there any way I can be of assistance?

mission.line: You still have missions to complete, Commander. Please don't forget about them.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. You could add the rewards to our stockpile.

profile.line: I'm Princeton, second ship of the Independence class, and I once fought alongside Antiochus. I don't know how I wound up here, and there's much regarding the circumstances I still don't understand... but, I knew from first glance that you're someone I can trust, Commander. That is why I follow your orders.

propose.line: D-does this mean you take me as your partner? I'd never guessed you view me so fondly... Now that I know, it's become all the more impossible to leave your side. Yes, I trust you with my everything. Let us march forward, together, to a new future!

touch.line: What is it? Do I look that dreary to you?

touch2.line: Pl-please stop with this improper behavior at once!

unlock.line: Aircraft carrier Princeton, reporting for duty. I'm afraid I'm still a bit disoriented... would you mind briefing me on the situation?

upgrade.line: Need to keep your gear up-to-date, after all.

win_mvp.line: That went well. Commander, your next orders?

gift_prefer.line: Can I really have this? ...Thanks.

battle.line: Heehee. Disappear with grace.

detail.line: You feel like someone's watching you, even when no one's around? Oh dear. You're imagining things because you're overworked. If you're concerned about it, might I suggest relying on me more?

expedition.line: The commission team is returning one by one. I'm glad that they're unscathed.

feeling1.line: It's alright, Commander. Despite everything that's happened, I will still hold you tightly.

feeling2.line: You look rather worn out. Would you like to cuddle? Come and embrace me, clear your mind, and vent aaall your frustrations to me♥

feeling3.line: I knew it – I can be an excellent partner for you as long as I match your pace. How did I notice such small details, you wonder? Well, I'm afraid that's a secret.

feeling4.line: You think I'm beautiful just the way I am? Heehee, I never thought I'd hear a compliment of this magnitude from you. Then, please, look at me more – because I am always, ALWAYS looking at you.

feeling5.line: How does it feel to be in my embrace? You're free to doze off, if you'd like. Don't worry about anything – I will take care of it for you.

headtouch.line: Now it's my turn♥

home.line: Exemplary work, Commander. I have made you food and a beverage and ran a bath for you. Before you get those, though... come and leap into my bosom♥

hp_warning.line: I will not cause the Commander distress!

login.line: I've arranged your paperwork according to how you usually process it. Now, shall we get to work?

lose.line: I'm forced to admit that this defeat was my fault.

mail.line: There is a letter for you. If opening it feels like a chore, I will gladly do it for you. All you need to do is read it afterward.

main1.line: (The Commander's looks and movements, they're clear as crystal... I could observe them all day...)

main2.line: Oh? It's like I know every little thing about you? Goodness, I've never heard such a wonderful compliment before.

main3.line: Do you not need me, Commander? What things could I do better? Please, I must know! I promise I'll better myself!

mission.line: You have new missions, Commander. I have prepared a plan for you.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Kindly claim your rewards. Ah, I notified you at a good time? Heehee, that's because I'm always watching you.

profile.line: Please, depend wholly on me like a child would♥ That is what I consider bliss.

propose.line: Dream... My dream? Oh, I remember now. My dream is to call you mine and always be together. Then again, hasn't that dream already come true, my sweetheart?

touch.line: Shall I play you a song, Commander?

touch2.line: I will always consent to anything you do to me♥

unlock.line: Commander, I am Houshou. Henceforth, I will take veeery good care of you. Forget all your concerns and just let me handle everything. Heehee♥

upgrade.line: (Now I can stare more intently at the Commander...)

win_mvp.line: I can't wait to see the Commander...

gift_prefer.line: This present is of utmost import to me... but my greatest treasure is no doubt your sentiments toward me, Commander.

battle.line: I'll fight with all I have!

detail.line: Commander, are you keeping an eye on my work? I-if you find any mistakes, you have to tell me, okay? I'll correct it immediately.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. They're all working so efficiently... I'll have to redouble my efforts.

feeling1.line: My abilities are insufficient to assist you. I'm sorry, Commander...

feeling2.line: Say, Commander... Do you think I've come to rely on your guidance too much? As the head of my class, I have to be more independent...

feeling3.line: Would the Commander notice if I swapped the order of these documents... Ack?! U-umm... I wasn't doing anything!

feeling4.line: I've been having some strange thoughts lately... For example, about how you'd react if I hid your favorite pen, or... A-actually, forget I said anything, please!

feeling5.line: Commander, I've made up my mind! Today, I'm going to be a bad girl and mix this unsigned document into the signed pile... Ah, I can't go through with it! That would only cause you trouble...

headtouch.line: Is this... proof that you acknowledge me?

home.line: Welcome back. I made a little drink for you, in the hopes that it'll alleviate some of your fatigue.

hp_warning.line: I still... mustn't fall yet!

login.line: Commander, you're here. Here's a look at your schedule for today. I checked it for you, so there shouldn't be anything wrong... hopefully.

lose.line: I'm so sorry... This is because of my incompetence. I must learn from this blunder.

mail.line: There's mail for you. Would you like me to sort it out?

main1.line: I tried organizing last month's inventory today... I never knew comparing the estimates and real figures could be so complicated.

main2.line: If I do anything wrong, you have to let me know! I want to become capable as soon as possible.

main3.line: When I see how confident everyone else handles all manner of situations, I have to wonder if I'll ever be like them...

mission.line: Commander, you have unfinished work. Umm... May I help you track your progress?

mission_complete.line: You've received mission rewards. I checked the quantity, and... I-I think it's correct!

profile.line: I am Elbe, working under the Holy Unitas Empire. I'm still in the process of learning, and my lack of experience will be evident... but I will approach every task earnestly. Commander, um... I look forward to working with you.

propose.line: I-is it right... to give this to a bad girl like me? I'm unreliable, and I always get the urge to play pranks but lose my nerve right away... You still accept me, despite all that? ...Okay! I'll be right by your side forever, whether I'm doing my best or being as selfish as can be!

touch.line: D-do you have instructions for me? Oh, you were just saying hello? Okaaay...

touch2.line: Hyah?! W-wait... This is all too sudden...

unlock.line: Good day to you, Commander. I am Elbe of the Holy Unitas Empire, here to serve. I've never undertaken such a major duty before, so there's still much that I have to learn... I would be grateful for your guidance!

upgrade.line: I feel like I've grown a little... Thank you very much!

win_mvp.line: I-I did it! It's all thanks to your leadership, Commander!

gift_prefer.line: Is it really okay for me to have this? Thank you... I'll cherish it.

battle.line: Quick, let's get started! Come forth, my planes!

detail.line: I'd rather you pay attention to the others. ...If you're going to keep idling around here...

expedition.line: It's good to count your blessings for the fortune of having plenty in the present moment. One day, it'll just be a wistful memory.

feeling1.line: Leave me alone.

feeling2.line: Right now, I'm merely a soldier. I simply follow your directives, and that's all there is to it.

feeling3.line: On the battlefield, even a moment's hesitation can invite total destruction. Thinking about nothing other than how to defeat the enemy - that's my fighting style.

feeling4.line: Would you keep challenging strong foes you have no chance of defeating? ...For the sake of those you wish to protect? Since it's you, I can see that you've given it plenty of thought. I support that sentiment.

feeling5.line: This unwavering conviction, that if it's you, there will be a way... Hmm, I guess I've still got a naive side to me... It's nothing. Commander, as your blade, I will continue to pledge myself to your service.

home.line: Don't worry about me. Simply stay focused on what it is you need to do.

login.line: Guide my blade. Where do my enemies lie?

lose.line: Sister... I'm sorry...

mail.line: Please take this, Commander. It's your mail.

main1.line: Enterprise? Whether as a rival or an ally, there's no doubt that she's an existence to be respected.
