main2.line: Hanafuda...? Now's not the time to be indulging in entertainment.

main3.line: My usual training regimen isn't designed to show off my skills, but rather to protect my allies and defeat my enemies. Am I mistaken?

mission.line: These are all just trifling matters...

mission_complete.line: Though they're all just trifling matters, they're still missions proper. I'll report back to you when I finish receiving the rewards.

profile.line: I'm the aircraft carrier, Hiryuu. ...Right now, I am naught but a single soldier. That's all you need to know about me.

propose.line: This is... the proof of your oath... I understand. If you will continue to value me as your blade, I will not turn my back to you. ...Though, my comparatively uncomely and unpleasant self will give you a hard time. Hehehe.

touch.line: If you have something to say, just spit it out. If you fuss over it too much, you're just going to end up not saying anything.

touch2.line: Hah?! ...Hmph! ...Next time, I'll assault you back with my blade.

unlock.line: I'm getting all fired up! The name's Hiryuu, Hiryuu from the 2nd CarDiv. As a member of this fleet, I'll obey your orders. I do hope that you are qualified to lead us.

upgrade.line: ...What a shame.

win_mvp.line: Such a small victory is not worth celebrating...

gift_prefer.line: Since you went through the trouble of picking out this gift... I will accept it. You have my thanks.

battle.line: Show them no mercy!

couple_encourage1.line: Have no fear. I guarantee your safety.

couple_encourage2.line: Together we stand! For the glory of the Royal Navy!

couple_encourage3.line: Once more... the fire rises!

detail.line: Peace is something worth protecting at any cost.

expedition.line: Our companions risked much to bring back those resources. They deserve acknowledgement. Let us go see them, Commander.

feeling1.line: Let me offer a word of advice, if you'll even listen: turn around and leave while you still can, Commander.

feeling2.line: You need someone to escort the little destroyers, do you? I can certainly do it, but I could just as well do any other mission. I'm ready to sortie at all times.

feeling3.line: A ship who's lost her way is fated to go under. The same is true for people. Do you have the strength to keep yourself on the right course, Commander?

feeling4.line: Your outstanding expertise and determination are truly awe-inspiring. I have no doubt you can lead this fleet to places nobody would've expected.

feeling5.line: Put your mind to rest, Commander. Wherever your destination may be, I will follow you to it. Be they towering waves or colossal icebergs, whatever obstacles we encounter, I will tear them down!

home.line: Have no fear. I am always ready for orders!

hp_warning.line: I will not be defeated!

login.line: Ready to face another day? Splendid!

lose.line: Don't bet on all future battles ending in your safe escape.

mail.line: You've received a new letter? Best to read it now, then. Do not live in ignorance of the latest happenings.

main1.line: One should protect their loved ones, that is abundantly clear. In the case of the little destroyers, even more so.

main2.line: My strengths lie in outranging the opponent. But, of course, I am no slouch in close-range combat either.

main3.line: Developing new tactics for the fleet, are you? Do you need my expertise?

mission.line: One of your most important duties is to accomplish the missions assigned to you. Don't forget that, Commander.

mission_complete.line: A mission's been completed. Excellent.

profile.line: We are both soldiers, you and I. We fight to protect our loved ones. Whatever desolate wastes the streams of fate carry you to, never forget your duty.

propose.line: Is this for me? Ah... I understand. Then on this day, I vow to follow wherever you go. I'm eager to see what awaits us at the end. Hahaha!

touch.line: I see no resolve in your eyes! Shape up! ...There, that's better. Hahaha.

touch2.line: This is not the time nor place for this kind of behaviour...

unlock.line: Aircraft carrier Ark Royal, at your service. I hereby vow to lend you my strength for as long as you harbour honourable ambitions!

upgrade.line: I need to become stronger to protect what I must!

win_mvp.line: Flee to the ends of the world if you so want, I will still hunt you down!

gift_prefer.line: This...?! How thoughtful of you...! You have my thanks!

battle.line: Let's finish this quickly.

couple_encourage1.line: 2nd CarDiv, sally forth!

detail.line: Can you take pride in the duties you've fulfilled as commander? If you cannot say "yes," then you must reflect upon yourself.

expedition.line: The commission supplies have arrived at port. Examine them thoroughly and take stock of all costs, gains, and losses.

feeling1.line: When danger approaches, don't wait until you regret it. It'll be too late by then.

feeling2.line: In the future, your carelessness will become a fatal flaw in the face of a fearsome foe. If you cannot be strict and resolute with yourself, then I shall do it for you.

feeling3.line: Hanafuda? That's a word I haven't heard in a while... If you're interested, I don't mind playing a round with you after work.

feeling4.line: You're using hanafuda as an excuse to get closer to me, right? Hehe... sure, let's go for another round. In the meantime, I'll explain to you where you fall short.

feeling5.line: You are now able to calmly and rationally devise a solution even in the face of the most desperate and critical situations. However, I'll continue to keep an eye on you, so don't let your guard down, alright?

home.line: Why don't we reflect upon the battle? It may be troublesome, but well worth the effort.

hp_warning.line: Calm down and look for an opening to break through–

login.line: Commander, now that you're here, let's cut to the chase. Here are the documents that need your attention.

lose.line: We don't have much time left...

mail.line: There's new mail, I left it on your desk. If it's from Hiryuu, I would've shown it to you directly.

main1.line: Hiryuu... She's off training alone again, and she's still as strict on herself as ever. Commander, don't you think you should learn from her example and cultivate a bit more self-discipline?

main2.line: The past cannot be changed. All that matters is that we live in the present.

main3.line: Spacing out again? Haven't I already told you? Not a single one of your actions escapes my gaze.

mission.line: It is your duty as commander to complete your missions. Go forth.

mission_complete.line: Here are your mission rewards– You can go take a break and leave the rest to me.

profile.line: I am Souryuu of the 2nd CarDiv. I shall look after you so that you may become an exemplary commander.

propose.line: How unlike you to get so flustered. –Wait, this is... I see, I get it now. Hehe, why are you worried then? My answer... has been set in stone long ago, yes?

skill.line: I have no time to waste!

touch.line: I'd like to believe that you have a good reason to call for me...

touch2.line: *sigh*... There's no cure for you, is there...

unlock.line: I am Souryuu of the Sakura Empire's 2nd CarDiv. Let's skip the formalities and get to work right away.

upgrade.line: My strength has increased? I appreciate your effort.

win_mvp.line: A quick and decisive victory. Exactly what we needed.

gift_prefer.line: This is a great present. Thank you... Just know that I don't take bribes, okay?

battle.line: They shall now be judged.

detail.line: Hmm. It's become clear now that I've observed you up close. You, too, are far from what's considered normal.

expedition.line: Commissioned goods have arrived. If I were you, I wouldn't want to leave them sitting there at the dock.

feeling1.line: "A moth"?! How dare you show such disrespect toward my grimoire!

feeling2.line: Hmm? I take it you're curious about my companion. It is an ordinary dark grimoire, as you can surely see. Nothing to be suspicious of whatsoever.

feeling3.line: The Dark Tome is no mere grimoire... I remember L'Opiniâtre was the one who named... Ah, forgive me. I remembered something I shouldn't have. Excuse me for a moment.

feeling4.line: Does the word "dark" not set off alarm bells to you, Commander? ...Only nitpickers get hung up on words, you say? Ahem. That's good, then.

feeling5.line: Today is a fine day, Commander. Would you like to try the most miraculous Sacrament recorded in the Dark Tome? It's one that requires love to be performed.

headtouch.line: While I am but a fool who ended up as a witch... No, never mind.

home.line: An impeccable showing. Hmm. It would appear that the fundamental points of Sacraments are the same in your branch.

hp_warning.line: It seems they are purer than I...

login.line: Good morning, Commander. I have a supreme Sacrament ready to be used. Would you like to make a wish?

lose.line: It seems I must tap into deeper reservoirs of power...

mail.line: Commander, there's a letter for... Hm? I sense a Sacrament. That can't be right...

main1.line: Though they are fascinating things, the Sirens are a scourge upon civilization. Hah. This kind of scourge is best dealt with through swift cannon fire.

main2.line: There are no bans on knowledge and no limits to power. The only obstacle on the way to the ultimate Sacrament is the weakness of the spirit.

main3.line: I disagree with the notion that there is a dark side to power. People simply fear strength greater than theirs on an instinctual level. Personally, I would not be afraid to seize greater power for myself.

mission.line: Commander, kindly remember to do your missions. You could find a lead on a Sacrament.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Let's see if you found any new leads.

profile.line: I am Béarn, pursuer of knowledge and power and one who wanders the borders between realms. If you wonder how I became a witch... the fastest way to gain knowledge is by stealing it through brute force. This is such a self-evident truth that even you can grasp it.

propose.line: The Sacrament of love is a contract that will last throughout your whole life, and yet you're still willing to sign it with a witch as I... Hah, I am truly touched. Please, allow me to finish the final ritual before an unstoppable wave of happiness knocks me out.

touch.line: Commander, do you wish to grasp the forbidden fruit of knowledge?

touch2.line: One could call this knowledge shunned by other people. Please commit to the act now that you've started, Commander.

unlock.line: I am Béarn, a high mage and a humble seeker of knowledge and power. If I may ask, can I expect to find any supreme Sacraments in this place?

upgrade.line: Hah. My new strength is responding to me.

win_mvp.line: Hah. This is what ultimate power looks like.

gift_prefer.line: This seems very interesting. I like it.

battle.line: I will NOT let you impede me!

detail.line: Oh, my Commander, I'll always yearn for you – so much so that I will give you my all, forever. Heehee... Nobody can ever take you away from me...

expedition.line: The commission team has returned? What a terrible annoyance... If you must bid them welcome back, please put on a blindfold first. You don't need to look at anyone but me!

feeling1.line: Why do you do this to me, my Commander? You know that I'm broken without you by my side!

feeling2.line: Is there any way in which I'm still unsatisfactory to you, my Commander? I'll do better... I'll strive to be perfect, so you'll pay attention to me and me alone!

feeling3.line: You are so, so kind to me, my Commander... And yet, that's just not enough... I need more... I need much, much more from you!

feeling4.line: Should you and I be the only ones left living, we could spend an eternity together, just the two of us... Ohh, how wonderful that would be♥

feeling5.line: My Commander... I want you so badly today that I might just "lock you up" for a little while... You'll allow me to fulfill this desire of mine, won't you? Heehee♥

headtouch.line: I need more, more, more... I need much, much more...

home.line: I've laid out a futon for you. Come and join me in bed, my Commander.

hp_warning.line: I'm not done... I still have the strength to keep fighting for my Commander!

login.line: My Commander! How do you like waking up with me by your side? Do you feel just as blissful as I do? Heehee.

lose.line: Die! Die! DIE! DIE!

mail.line: A letter for you has arrived, my Commander. Heehee, I already checked it for you, and I was right – I'm the only thing you think of♥

main1.line: Commander... Oh, my Commander... Ahh, finally, you've come! The waiting was killing me! Now you're mine and you're not going anywhere♥

main2.line: My Commander... You're never ever going to leave me, right? Because if you do, the sheer loneliness will literally drive me insane!

main3.line: My Commander... Ohh, my Commander... I think about you every second of every minute, and I couldn't stop thinking about you even if the thoughts filled my head... Ahahahaha♥

mission.line: Who cares if you forget about doing your missions? All that matters is that you remember me!

mission_complete.line: I shall claim the mission rewards for you. In return, please reward me again... Heehee♥

profile.line: I am never leaving you again, my Commander... My future, my whole being, I shall give it all to you, so please, quench this thirst of mine and fill this hole inside me...

propose.line: Even though you needn't say anything for me to know how you feel and what you do, you still graciously came out and said the words for me... I am so, so happy! Ohh... Now let me hold your hand and never, ever let go♥

skill.line: This power exists to serve my Commander!

touch.line: You can do anything you like to me. After all, you're never leaving my sight again...

touch2.line: Forget about everything else and just be with me forever♥

unlock.line: Finally... Finally, I've met you, my Commander! My thirst has been quenched and the hole in me has been filled! Heehee... Now if you don't mind, I'm going to melt you little by little with my immense love♥

upgrade.line: Heehee... My power grows. Does your love for me grow, too?

win_mvp.line: Heehee... It makes me sooo happy when you look at me♥

gift_prefer.line: Ahh... A present from my Commander, just for me... Just as you will always keep me by your side and take good care of me, I shall forever cherish this present and never let it leave my side~

battle.line: Let's go when you're ready!

couple_encourage1.line: I finally found you! That's another story mission of mine to scratch off the list!

couple_encourage2.line: Yorktown! Enty! I'm so glad we could meet!

couple_encourage3.line: Behold the terrifying power of the mighty Hornet!

detail.line: Staring into space? Hey, no I wasn't! ...Alright, fine, I was. But I was just thinking about what's happened the past few years... and about my sisters.

expedition.line: Zzz... Seems a commission got completed... That's nice... Wait, crap! We gotta go and welcome them back!

feeling1.line: Having broken through the Veil, what awaits us is an even bleaker reality...

feeling2.line: Weekend plans? None for the moment. Uhh... Go and watch a movie with my sisters? Man, I'd be stoked to, but... won't it feel kinda weird between us?

feeling3.line: Commander, this port of yours – it's a very heartwarming place. Hey, tell me more about my sisters! With both of them here, there must be cool stuff happening all the time, right? I wanna know about 'em!

feeling4.line: Commander... Is it possible all my experiences here are just another layer to the Veil? I guess as long as it makes me this happy, there's nothing wrong with it...

feeling5.line: Pfft... I just said it in the spur of the moment last time, and you seriously had the R&D team research it? Want my help? I'm an expert at using META powers to create explosions! ...Hm? I'll get myself suspended if I do that? It was just a joke... Ahahaha!

headtouch.line: What's up? If it's my hat you like, wanna hold it?

home.line: Commander, let me come along on the next sortie! I'll perform as great as my sisters... probably!

hp_warning.line: Crap... I'm in hot water now!

login.line: Commander, I was thinking about going for a run since the weather's nice. Wanna come with me?

lose.line: The situation's disadvantageous... Retreat! Fall back!

mail.line: Final move: Council Mail Saturation!

main1.line: Commander, you want some iced coffee? No need to bother with adding ice cubes, I'll just use my META powers!

main2.line: Commander, I baked this pineapple pizza using my META powers. Want a slice?

main3.line: Man... A port where you can just eat and sleep without a care... This place really is paradise.

mission.line: Get it together, Commander! You've got lots of stuff to do today!

mission_complete.line: Missiooon complete! Let's kick back with some cold sodas!

profile.line: I'm Hornet, with the Council's 7th Special Dispatch Fleet and third ship of the Yorktown class. This is my original identity and the story that was decided for me since birth. Even though I'm the youngest among the Yorktown class, I've never actually met any of my "sisters"... Isn't that weird?

propose.line: You know... I don't care all that much about the Veil or my role now that you're aware of them. At the very least, my heart is always telling me that the present is real, and that's enough for me. I'm going to take today as an opportunity to start a new life – a life with you! Wherever you go, I'll always be right behind you, Commander!

touch.line: Don't worry, I've got a control device so the META corrosion doesn't seep out. You can even touch my jacket if you wanna check. Or my shorts, or my boots!

touch2.line: Huh?! Wait, wait, I, uhh, need time to mentally prepare! ...O-okay, I'm ready!

unlock.line: You're the Commander of the fleet? Nice meetin' you! I'm Hornet, the youngest among the Yorktown class. I may not be as amazing as my big sisters, but I'm still pretty capable... probably!

upgrade.line: Awesome! One step closer to my sisters!

win_mvp.line: Heheh! How's THAT for a magnificent victory?

gift_prefer.line: Whoa, for me? Thanks!

battle.line: Glorious, of the Royal Navy, spares no foes!

couple_encourage1.line: Don't push yourself too much. You're already worthy.

detail.line: ...Would you also like a cup of tea? I'll brew it right away. Please wait a moment.

expedition.line: How long has it been since I saw a fleet so replete with supplies? ...Commander, the commission is done. Leave the rest to me.

feeling1.line: ...What's the matter? You called for me, didn't you?

feeling2.line: Commander, where are the port's nicest views? I'm in the mood to go out for a while... Don't worry. I just need some fresh air.

feeling3.line: I passed by the Royal Navy dorms today and saw Ark Royal and the destroyers in the distance... They never change, do they?

feeling4.line: I've started learning to make herbal tea along with my usual black tea. Would you like to try a cup, Commander?

feeling5.line: You came all this way looking for me...? Here, take my hand and watch your step... I love being in high places. Seeing everything and feeling the breeze can be so relaxing... This moment of rest is even more precious now that you're here, though.

headtouch.line: ...My apologies. Was I spacing out again?

home.line: Oh, you're back already? Sorry. I was lost in thought... Let's get to work.

hp_warning.line: I'm used to this pain by now.

login.line: The weather is lovely. Let's do our best to make today a productive one.

lose.line: I have failed... yet again.

mail.line: Commander, how do you use this mailbox... I'm sorry. I haven't handled mail in a long time, so it's hard to learn.

main1.line: Your black tea is... hmm, about 30% as strong as Implacable's? Heehee, allow me to brew some for you.

main2.line: If only I could get a rematch against Illustrious, I'm confident I would win this time.

main3.line: Was this dessert made by the Royal Maid Corps? It tastes just like how I remember... Thank you.

mission.line: Having superiors who would give rewards for completed missions doesn't sound bad... Commander, let's get this job done.

mission_complete.line: Well done. You've earned a good rest.

profile.line: Hm? Let's put that matter to rest. What matters is the glorious future, not my trifling past. Commander, if there's anything I can help with, do not hesitate to ask.

propose.line: You've made your feelings clear, so I should be honest about myself... I am Glorious of the Royal Navy, and I was the final glory of my test site. As long as there's life in me, I must keep that glory alive... Will you still walk alongside me, Commander?

touch.line: Hmm? If you need company, then I can talk for a while.

touch2.line: Even the most beautiful rose has its thorns, Commander.

unlock.line: Good day to you, Commander. I'm the Royal Navy aircraft carrier Glorious. It's an honour to be here, and I thank you for having me.

upgrade.line: Let's continue to seize victory together.

win_mvp.line: To this glorious triumph.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much, Commander. I am very fond of it.

battle.line: ...You're impeding my observation.

detail.line: ...Why am I always observing? Because if I don't, I'll lose something very dear to me. I could explain it in greater detail, but sometimes, the journey matters more than the destination.

expedition.line: ...Little Eagle has told me that the commission team has returned. Yes, she's observing them on my behalf.

feeling1.line: ...Please stop it, Commander. It's really important to me that you... see me...

feeling2.line: ...Little Eagle seems to really like you. I really do think you'd make a better owner of her than me.

feeling3.line: ...There are many things in this world more worthwhile to stare at than me, and yet, your gaze is always on me... I know why you feel that way.

feeling4.line: ...Commander, smile more for me. Even if a smile doesn't matter for my observations, it still makes me feel... satisfied.

feeling5.line: ...Commander, I promise you this: There will be no more mournful farewells. I will always be by your side. No matter what form it may be in...

headtouch.line: ...Are you checking what state I'm in? Don't be alarmed. As long as I observe, so, too, do I exist.

home.line: ...You've returned at the preordained time. Everything is moving exactly on the path I observed.

hp_warning.line: ...I will continue observing... until the final moment...

login.line: ...Good morning, Commander. I've been watching you... Everything is fine.

lose.line: ...This means defeat.

mail.line: ...Your mail contains quite important information. Be sure to read it.

main1.line: ...Little Eagle has been rubbing her wings against me for a while now. Do you think she's hungry? ...Oh, she's just being affectionate? So that's what it is...

main2.line: ...Watch, observe, exist. All things must find their value through observation.

main3.line: ...Yes, I remember everything. Every unspoken smile we shared, the feelings that meant more than our very lives... I've not once forgotten them.

mission.line: ...New missions have come in. I take it these must be very important to you.

mission_complete.line: ...I've delivered all your mission rewards. Is there anything else I can help you with?

profile.line: ...I am Yorktown META. I am an observer and an observee, and I am one who maintains the balance between existence and extinction. I hold no preconceived views, and I am not bound by worldly rules. I am simply... me.

propose.line: ...Our destinies are already interlinked whether we do this or not. Still, since you've proposed, I will answer accordingly. No matter what may come, and even if I cease to be myself, my answer will be the same... now and forever.

touch.line: ...Commander, stay in range so I can observe you.

touch2.line: ...Ahh... I know... I understand...

unlock.line: ...It's a pleasure to meet you. Or should I say... we meet again. Just keep staring like that, Commander. I want to bask in this calm moment for a while longer...

upgrade.line: ...Keep observing me.

win_mvp.line: ...This means victory.

gift_prefer.line: ...You still remember, Commander.

battle.line: No hard feelings, but we're enemies after all~

detail.line: Promises... You've made a lot of 'em, haven't you? Were you able to keep them all? There must be some you were forced to give up on...

expedition.line: The commission team is back. You promised you'd welcome them, remember? C'mon, get going!

feeling1.line: I think we should go our separate ways. You do your thing, and I'll do my thing. We're both square, and that's that.

feeling2.line: Here comes the Parzival of the Seas♪ Teehee~ Does anyone need my help today? And Commander, do I have permission to give out favors in your name?

feeling3.line: If you just vanished one day, you'd betray the trust of everyone at this port. You wouldn't walk away on your near and dear, would you, Commander?

feeling4.line: Do you think an on-your-life promise is a childish fantasy, or just plain silly? Teehee~ I knew you'd say no♪ You're a good person, after all~

feeling5.line: I used to want to be Parzival the Careless, playing in the sea all day with no goal or concern in the world. But I'm okay with who I am now. At least this way I got to meet you, whom I can share my heart with... Right?

headtouch.line: Hm? Hmm? What'cha doing?

home.line: You're back? While you were gone, I may have issued a few orders in your name. Teehee♪

hp_warning.line: Stop getting in my way!

login.line: Welcome back~ Got promises to fulfill? 'Cause if someone has dibs on you, I'll take my leave♪

lose.line: That's enough. We don't need to push ourselves any longer. I've shed tears over fallen friends too many times already.

mail.line: You've got a letter! I picked it up on the way here.

main1.line: What does it mean to be an adult? Not having the time to play all day anymore? Heehee. No, it can't be THAT simple♪

main2.line: What to do for a fun break... I know! I'll ask around the port if anyone needs help with something♪

main3.line: Hey. Teehee. Whatever promises you've made to these girls, just don't forget about them.

mission.line: You've got new missions. It's none of my business, but won't you be worse off if you don't take care of them?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. I'll fetch the rewards, just 'cause I feel like it♪

profile.line: Of course I remember my promise to Lord Bismarck. I just don't repeat it constantly, or I'd annoy her. Besides, she specifically asked me to continue on by myself... Anyway! I'm not forgetting about my promise anytime soon.

propose.line: You do know how much promises mean to me, right? This is your last chance to back out. Commander... Do you swear on your life that you won't betray me, that this won't end in tragedy? Promise?

touch.line: I don't have time for games, alright?!

touch2.line: Let me guess... You do this all the time, right? Teehee~

unlock.line: U-556, the Parzival of the Seas, has arrived! Let's see if there's really anything I can help with here. Seeing as I'll be staying here – nice meeting you♪

upgrade.line: There's a limit to what you can achieve by getting stronger...

win_mvp.line: A win is a win~

gift_prefer.line: I suppose I will remember you whenever I lay my eyes upon this from now on, Commander...

battle.line: Please, safety first.

detail.line: A flower, once withered, will not bloom again; a life, once lost, will not return. The weight of a life cannot be simply measured with a scale.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned with goods. I can stock up on medical supplies.

feeling1.line: You are ill, Commander. Gravely ill. However, you may yet be cured if you cooperate with my treatment.

feeling2.line: While, yes, medicine is not your domain, you always lend an ear and a shoulder to the girls here who need it. In that way, I could see why someone would regard you as a doctor.

feeling3.line: Commander, can you make some time for a physical exam? People, like ships, need regular upkeep. And just because you don't feel ill doesn't mean everything is fine.

feeling4.line: You can bottle up your troubles, but they will come bursting out one day. Commander, when someone confides in you, listen to them. I will do the same for you, if you ever need it.

feeling5.line: Care for you forever? You certainly are an oddball. I've never heard of anyone wanting to be nursed around the clock... But, since I enjoy looking after you, I suppose I will.

home.line: Are there any wounded from your last battles? I'll examine all the girls, just to make sure.

hp_warning.line: It's alright. A little bit of first-aid, and I'll be fine.

login.line: Welcome back. I've sterilized your office, so it may smell a little odd... I hope it's not too distracting.

lose.line: We'll be in a tight spot if we suffer any more casualties...

mail.line: A letter from afar... I suggest reading it at once, Commander.

main1.line: The most annoying thing for a doctor is when a patient lies about their health. An illness will turn grave if you let it fester.

main2.line: Huh? You should set your eyes on more important things than worrying about me.

main3.line: It is a doctor's job to save lives. Even when I get hurt in the line of duty, I have no regrets. Of course, I know I mustn't throw my life away. I take whatever precautions are necessary.

mission.line: You still have many missions to accomplish, but please, don't bite off more than you can chew.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. You should give yourself some time to breathe now, Commander.

profile.line: I am the repair ship Vestal. You may think of me as a doctor for shipgirls. I will, of course, also try to help if sickness should befall you, Commander.

propose.line: I will answer "yes" if you can promise me one thing – to take better care of your body from now on. Remember, the fleet isn't alone in needing you – I do, too.

skill.line: You must take your doctor's advice.

touch.line: Do you want me to examine you?

touch2.line: Overdependence on the kindness of others is a sickness of its own, Commander.

unlock.line: I... assume you're the Commander? Don't worry, I can see that you're in good health. I'm Vestal. Bring your sick to me, and I should be able to assist with treatment and repairs...

upgrade.line: May this strength let me help more people.

win_mvp.line: Any casualties? No? Good.

gift_prefer.line: You care for us so much, Commander. I am sure everyone here is very happy.

battle.line: Innumerous stars shine in the darkness.

couple_encourage1.line: It's an honour to see you, my esteemed Queen Elizabeth.

couple_encourage2.line: You're a cleaner... Much like myself.

couple_encourage3.line: I will support you. Just like old times.

detail.line: "Cleaner"? Yes, my friends would call me such. I'd always be the last to set foot on the battlefield... Oh, I'm not suggesting anything gruesome, mind you, Commander.

expedition.line: The commission team has safely returned... That's a load off my mind.

feeling1.line: You must've gone mad from sheer business...

feeling2.line: I feel like you and I are very much alike. Yes, in the sense that we fixate on looking after others. I don't see it as a bother, myself. If anything, it's just what life is.

feeling3.line: You must not let your job come before your personal life, Commander. There is no substitute for time spent with your loved ones...

feeling4.line: I'm taking your coffee away. You just want to feel awake and clear your head, hmm? Then I suggest skipping coffee and visiting a haunted house instead.

feeling5.line: I'm stunned you actually came here, to the domain of my darkness, to this haunted house. The perfect place to shake off the tedium of work. Follow me, Commander. Exploring a nightmare with a clear mind is important to a romance.

headtouch.line: ...Mhm. Feels nice.

home.line: Welcome back to the world of tranquillity. Savour this splendid moment.

hp_warning.line: The dead are clamoring...

login.line: ...Welcome back, Commander. You have a charming sleeping face. Though, it would be even better if you didn't sleep at your desk.

lose.line: The dark will return one day.

mail.line: Letters are embodyings of lovely feelings and earnest pleas. Please treat them with care.

main1.line: I command an air of seniority? That may be because, long ago, before I became like this, I fought side-by-side with Queen Elizabeth...

main2.line: The port is a lovely place. You can forget about everything and spend the whole day sunbathing in the grass... "Home," you say? That word sure brings me back...

main3.line: Romance, hmm? I assume you mean a nightmarishly heart-thumping scenario in which you ask out your crush... Too teenage-girly, you think?

mission.line: You have a new mission. Relax, it's not a task from the underworld.

mission_complete.line: Don't forget your rewards. There is no harm in claiming them.

profile.line: I was gravely wounded in a battle long ago, but Queen Elizabeth didn't give up, thus letting me continue fighting in this form. She inspired me to do everything I can for my friends, just like she did.

propose.line: This is where we exchange vows... Mhm, I see how you feel. Now then, Commander, with the darkness as our witness, let us swear an oath. As long as you stay where the light is, a shadow will be right by your side.

touch.line: Don't be so tense. I'll be here, always.

touch2.line: ...Want to try experiencing your soul leaving your body?

unlock.line: I have arrived, heeding your summon. Worry not, this isn't a nightmare, but rather a fateful mercy. Now, make a pact with me and become an acolyte of darkness.

upgrade.line: With greater strength comes purer darkness...

win_mvp.line: By the terms of our pact, I now reap these souls.

gift_prefer.line: Yeah, I will wear it on my scythe.

battle.line: Witness the might of a protagonist!

couple_encourage1.line: Hey, Noire! Let's see who can beat the most enemies!

couple_encourage2.line: All right! Let's go, everyone!

detail.line: It's so embarrassing when people stare at me like that.

expedition.line: Hey! Everyone's back! Shouldn't we head out and welcome them?

feeling1.line: Huh? What was that? I can't hear you, I've got bananas stuck in my ears.

feeling2.line: Going out for some exercise every now and then isn't so bad! Hey, Commander! What do you say we go for a walk together next time?

feeling3.line: I've got an idea! Commander, you should visit Planeptune sometime! I'm sure everyone would love to meet you!

feeling4.line: Commander obtained! Now we're gonna play some games together! Listen: you're not getting any sleep tonight.

feeling5.line: What should we play today? How about "who's-their-crush"? Hmm, your crush... that's gotta be me! Heheh, spot on, aren't I?

home.line: Oh, the pudding is calling out to me...! We gotta get back home!

hp_warning.line: Nep?! It's not time to panic just yet!

login.line: Welcome back! Let's give it all we've got, nep!

lose.line: We regret to inform you that Neppy has been defeated.

mail.line: You have new mail! Now's not the time for pudding!

main1.line: Heheh! How's my rigging look? It's all so Azur Laney! Looks good on me, don'tcha think?

main2.line: Nep nep♪ Nep nep♪ Nep nep neppynep♪

main3.line: I'm hungry... Go get me some pudding, Commander!

mission.line: Me, do some missions? I'll help if you give me 5 servings of pudding, how's that? ...I'm just kidding! Let's get out there and finish it!

mission_complete.line: Mission completed! Rewards obtained!

profile.line: I'm the protiest of protagonists, Neptune! I'm the CPU of a country called Planeptune. What's a CPU? It's a long story, so I'll tell you another time.

propose.line: Tell you the truth, I was nervous when I first came to this world, but now after meeting you and becoming your special someone... I'm happy from the bottom of my heart that I came here. So, here's hoping for a bright future together!

touch.line: Ahahah! That tickles! Stop it, will you!

touch2.line: Hey! You can't do that, Commander!

unlock.line: Heya! My name's Neptune! Nice to meet you!

upgrade.line: Chala-la-la-laaaa!

win_mvp.line: Justice will always win! Just kidding...

gift_prefer.line: Ohh! This is exactly what I've always wanted! Thanks!

battle.line: Watch and see what happens when I get serious!

couple_encourage1.line: Come on, Neptune! Pay attention so I don't have to butt in all the time!

couple_encourage2.line: I assume everyone's ready for this?

detail.line: H-hey! What're you looking at?!

expedition.line: It seems a commission has finished... Thank goodness, looks like nobody's been hurt.

feeling1.line: Could you please just get out of my sight already?

feeling2.line: Ah, you came just in time. I was just about to make lunch. Wanna join me?

feeling3.line: A friend of mine would like to have lunch with you next time. You don't mind, right? I'll be there too, of course. I mean, someone has to be there to make sure you don't get ahead of yourself and do anything weird.

feeling4.line: You need advice? Can't you just ask someone else? Like that girl from the other day you seemed to be having such fun talking to? Was that all you wanted to say? Well then, good luck...... Sigh, I'm such an idiot...

feeling5.line: Hey... When I'm together with you, my heart feels like it's gonna burst. How do you feel about me? ...Actually, don't tell me. I already know the answer...

home.line: Well done. I consider relaxation to be a legitimate training method.

hp_warning.line: I'm fine, there's nothing to worry about.

login.line: You're fashionably late, I see. We have much to do today, so get ready.

lose.line: I will never forget this defeat. And that is why I will grow stronger.

mail.line: It seems mail has arrived.

main1.line: You're not neglecting my maintenance are you? Of course equipment is important, but our motivation also affects our performance, so pay attention to it.

main2.line: The dresses these girls wear are quite cute. A-and I'm not just saying that because I want to try them out or anything.

main3.line: Hmhhmhmmn♪ Hmmhm♪... Huh? Since when did you get here...?

mission.line: You should check for missions at regular intervals.

mission_complete.line: If we get any rewards we can't use then I'll inform the higher-ups for you.

profile.line: I'm Noire, the CPU of Lastation. I wonder if I'll be able to make many friends in this new world... B-but more importantly! Give me a report on the current state of the war.

propose.line: What?! This isn't just a prank, is it...? This can't be, I thought you hated me for sure... Why are you looking at me like that? That means my answer is: OK! You should be able to tell that on your own, idiot!

touch.line: Noir...! Keep your hands off me!

touch2.line: L-listen here... If you don't stop it right now then I will get angry.

unlock.line: Are you the commander? Hmm. Very well. I'm Noire. The CPU of Lastation. You can put your mind at ease now that I'm here.

upgrade.line: I'm going to set my sights higher.

win_mvp.line: Hah, what child's play. It'll take more than this to satisfy me.

gift_prefer.line: This is a fairly decent choice for you, Commander. I'm seeing you in a new light.

battle.line: As long as you stay calm nothing can go wrong.

couple_encourage1.line: Ughh... I'll use those disgusting over-inflated balloons of yours as a cushion!

couple_encourage2.line: Let me finish them off!

detail.line: Would you like to read a book too?

expedition.line: A commission's done.

feeling1.line: ...Who are you?

feeling2.line: I'm writing a novel right now, would you like to give it a read?

feeling3.line: Oh, what a coincidence. I was just thinking I should come see you. Anyway, today I've got this novel for you to read...

feeling4.line: Did you enjoy that book I gave you? You did? I'm glad to hear that... Hm...? No, it's just that nobody's ever said they enjoyed my books before, so I don't know how I should react...

feeling5.line: You're the only one who seems to enjoy reading my novels... Nothing makes me happier than that. I hope you'll continue reading them, too.

home.line: Great, now I can get back to reading my book.

hp_warning.line: I'm getting a little ticked off...

login.line: Welcome back. Not much happened while you were gone.

lose.line: I'm astonished they've cornered us like this...

mail.line: You've got mail.

main1.line: I could recommend you a book I like. Hm? There's no need for that? I see... That's a shame.

main2.line: It's really windy today... Let's hurry up then, before it dies down...

main3.line: Perhaps I should write about this world and make a book about it when I return to Lowee.

mission.line: Have you checked out today's missions?

mission_complete.line: How about we go retrieve those mission rewards?

profile.line: I'm Blanc, the CPU of Lowee. I guess my hobbies are to read and write novels. I'm currently working on a new one.

propose.line: ...! I never thought I'd hear you say those words. Maybe it was fate all along for me to come to this world and meet you. Of course I hope we'll always be together from now on.

touch.line: Hahah... I'm pretty ticklish there...

touch2.line: What were you hoping for?

unlock.line: I'm Blanc. Nice to meet you. Maybe you could introduce some intriguing books from your world to me...

upgrade.line: A level is just a number... Let me demonstrate how strong I really am.

win_mvp.line: That was great for a warm-up.

gift_prefer.line: This makes me very happy. Thank you.

battle.line: Commander, are you prepared for this?

couple_encourage1.line: I think books and tea go hand in hand. May I offer you a cup?

couple_encourage2.line: You will regret the day the you decided to make us your enemy!

couple_encourage3.line: Once we come back home I will give you all a big hug!

detail.line: Ohoho, do you have business with me?

expedition.line: It seems everyone was able to make it back. Let us give them a warm welcome.

feeling1.line: Could I just return home to Leanbox?

feeling2.line: Would you like to play an MMO together with me? Yes, of course I will assist you with everything you need to know!

feeling3.line: I would like to hold a meetup for fellow MMO enthusiasts today! Surely you will be part of it, Commander? I will move forward under the premise that you and I will be in attendance.

feeling4.line: May I ask you for some advice, Commander? There's a person who I've recently grown quite fond of, but I don't know how I should approach him... On second thought, never mind I said anything!

feeling5.line: Being with you warms my heart, like a hot cup of tea. And just as I love tea, I love you. I want this moment in time to last forever, but perhaps that makes me sound selfish...?

home.line: Thank you for your hard work. Now it is time for some tea.

hp_warning.line: It is just as I thought; the enemy is no match for me.

login.line: Good day. I was just about to brew some tea. Would you like to have some together with me, Commander?

lose.line: So this is how defeat feels... I see. That battle was so enjoyable that it made my heart race.

mail.line: It would appear mail has arrived. I suggest that you check for it regularly.

main1.line: Ohoho, I will watch over you, Commander. You may rest assured and know that I can guarantee your safety.

main2.line: Ohhh?! Tell me, what is that girl's name?! Please, I beg you, let me make her my little sister!

main3.line: I feel completely overjoyed that there are so many cute little girls here.

mission.line: Even just 5 minutes is plenty of time for you to finish a mission, no?

mission_complete.line: Mission completed! Let us go collect our rewards!

profile.line: My name is Vert, I am the CPU of Leanbox. My favorite things are tea, video games, and my adorable little sisters! ...Hm? I have no little sisters, you say? If I view someone as my little sister then they ARE my little sister!

propose.line: So you wish to drink my tea till death do us apart, I see...? That makes me so happy. I will gladly make tea to just your liking, my commander... no, my sweetheart.

skill.line: Witness the glorious power of Leanbox's CPU!

propose.line: Heheh~ I've received something special from you~ I feel the same as you, Commander. Heheh, all of our memories together are precious treasures to me!

skill.line: I'll show you my real power!

touch.line: Commander, did you need something?

touch2.line: Where do you think you're touching me?!

unlock.line: Hello! Oh... What am I supposed to call you? "Commander"? Got it! My name is Marie Rose. Just call me Marie, okay? I'm counting on your support, Commander!

upgrade.line: Commander, do you feel like I've matured a bit?

win_mvp.line: Commander, did you see how useful I was?

gift_prefer.line: Wow~ I love this♥ Thank you, Commander!

detail.line: A photoshoot? That's fine with me! I'd like to take a lot of wonderful pictures! ...But, I'm not going to strike any weird poses, got it?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Oh, I'm cooling down a bit right now~ It's quite hot out, after all~

login.line: Ehh... This is no fun... Oh, Commander! Heheh~ Won't you come play with me?

main1.line: Commander, you're always heading out to sea, aren't you? I'm a bit jealous... Eh? I'm right, but it's probably different from what I think?

main2.line: Heheh, I'll always win when it comes to beach volleyball!

main3.line: The feeling of the waves on my skin is so nice... Commander, you should come and have a dip too!

touch.line: Your hands feel so nice and cool~

touch2.line: Ah! Not there!

unlock.line: Hmm, this swimsuit is pretty cute, but isn't it a bit childish? ...In any case, if you like it, then it's all good!

detail.line: We've got ramune and manjuu buns here... If only we had princess cake, it'd be perfect...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! It was cold out on the seas, right? I've kept the water nice and hot for you, so warm up before you head out again!

login.line: Hum, humdeedum duuum♪ Heheh, come and relax in the onsen with me, Commander!

main1.line: Haha, everyone looks so comfy~♪ Thank you for bringing us to such a nice place♡

main2.line: I hear this hot water is great for your skin! Maybe it'll make me even more mature♪

main3.line: Heheh, Commander? I know I'm adorable, but staring is bad manners, y'know.

main4.line: This one smells lovely, and this one makes your skin all smooth... The Royal Maids are really smart when it comes to this stuff.

main5.line: Thanks for the tasty manjuu buns. Oh? You ordered these for me, Commander? Well, I'd better thank you, too~♪

touch.line: Heheh, I'm getting all hot and lightheaded~♪

touch2.line: Geez! Quit messing around, Commander!

unlock.line: Phew... So warm and comfy~♪ Wanna join me, Commander? Oh... It's a little embarrassing, though, so... Don't look my way too much, okay?

battle.line: All riiight! Let's get pumped!

couple_encourage1.line: Marie! Let's do our best!

couple_encourage2.line: Evil spirits, begone! Hehehe, is that how you do it~?

detail.line: Dinner, a bath, or... me? What will you have? Hehe~ Okay, then let's go play!

expedition.line: Commission complete~! Leave the rest to me~ I've helped Grammy out lots, so I'll be fine~

feeling1.line: Ughh... I just want to go back to my Grammy's place...

feeling2.line: Mmh! The weather's so nice, I feel great~ Let's take a stroll around the port!

feeling3.line: Commander, won't you come shopping with me later? I want to buy some souvenirs for Grammy!

feeling4.line: Commander! I sent a letter to Grammy! I wrote that this is a fun place, with the Commander and many girls~ Hehehe~ Oh, next time, I'll show you around Grammy's place!

feeling5.line: Commander, you and everyone else here have taken such good care of me! When I'm with you, I feel relaxed, as if I'm back at home with Grammy! In return, please let me know if there's anything I can do for you!

headtouch.line: Hehehe, this makes me feel happy...

home.line: Commander, welcome back! Did anything interesting happen?

hp_warning.line: Oh no, oh no... I'm in big trouble here!

login.line: Good work, Commander! Wait, you're starting work now?

lose.line: Ohh~... I'm all out of energy~

mail.line: There's some mail for you, Commander! I should write some mail to Grammy as well~

main1.line: I learned a lot of things from Marie today!

main2.line: Yaaawn... Everything's so fuzzy... I-I'm not asleep!

main3.line: Commander! Um... Is there anything I can help out with?

mission.line: Missions? Do you do these everyday?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Wow, and they give you this many rewards for it?! Commander, you're amazing!

profile.line: An introduction? My name is Honoka. I love my Grammy! Also... I really like pro wrestling! I watch it on TV a lot and act out the scenes. I'm super good at imitations! The other day I broke my TV... Oh, um... promise me... you won't tell anyone.

propose.line: Wh-what... Is it okay to give me something so valuable? I-I'll have to tell Grammy...! Um... I'll treasure this for all my life! Hehehe~

touch.line: Eh? Would you... like me to help?

touch2.line: Eep! Wh-whoa... There's a limit to what you can get away with, Commander!

unlock.line: Um... Are you the Commander? Oh, perfect! It's nice to meet you. My name is Honoka! I don't know how much I'll be able to help, but... let's be friends!

upgrade.line: Honoka, powering up!

win_mvp.line: Hehehe, I'm all fired up~

gift_prefer.line: Huh?! Can I really have this?

detail.line: This swimsuit might be a bit too revealing... It took some courage to put it on... Um, how... is it?

home.line: Commander, are you taking pictures? Oh, I was asking because I wanted to send some to Grammy... Oh... um, I'm talking about the scenery, not me!

login.line: The sun's shining brightly today! Let's go play in the ocean~!

main1.line: Hmm... I wonder if there's a crab under this rock?

main2.line: Marie! Let's play beach volleyball together!

main3.line: Don't forget to do your stretches! Come on, Commander, you should join me~ One, two, one two...

touch.line: Whew... Oh, Commander, are you tired? Why don't you take a break?

touch2.line: There's a limit to what I'll let you get away with, Commander!

unlock.line: Whoa, the sea is so pretty~! It's as beautiful as the Venus Islands! I'm so blown away, I don't even feel the heat anymore!

battle.line: Teehee~ It's my time to shine. Let's get it done, everyone!

couple_encourage1.line: Witness my Mugen Tenshin!

detail.line: You call it the "Sakura Empire"? Somehow, it feels really familiar to me. Teehee~

expedition.line: Everyone working together to complete a commission... Yep, what a concept.

feeling1.line: Commander... I'm more than angry with you at this point. Reflect on your poor behavior.

feeling2.line: These shipgirls also have sisters, I see... Both younger and older ones... Oh, sorry, I just had a random thought. Nothing to worry about.

feeling3.line: I see the Sakura Empire has its own disciples of ninjutsu... Hm? You wish to see mine? Err, I'm afraid... I can't do that. You aren't meant to openly show them to people.

feeling4.line: My favorite food? Hmm... I suppose strawberry mille-feuilles. You don't think that's... childish, do you? I always worry that people will think that about me...

feeling5.line: Um, Commander... Do you have a moment? I read my fortune today, and there's a so-called "destiny spot" in port. Could we... visit it, together? Oh, thank you so much! I'm sure fate has a surprise in store for us. Teehee~

headtouch.line: Can I, um, help you?

home.line: I'm still learning how to use this so-called "rigging," but I try my best to do my part! Please put me on the next sortie, so I can prove myself.

hp_warning.line: I'm not down for the count... just yet!

login.line: Is it time to get to work, Commander? I will be right here, so tell me if you need anything.

lose.line: Mgh... How could this happen...

mail.line: Oh, there's new mail. Do you think it could be from your family, Commander?

main1.line: Excuse me, but... what's a secretary supposed to do? My knowledge is bit spotty when it comes to these things...

main2.line: You can see the sea from mostly anywhere here at the port. The scenery is truly gorgeous!

main3.line: According to my fortune, today's destiny spot should be somewhere over...

mission.line: A new mission has come in. I could... give you a hand with it, if you'd so like?

mission_complete.line: Mission completed. That leaves us one less thing to worry about. Right, Commander?

profile.line: I wonder how everyone's doing back at the Venus Islands... Oh, shoot! I'm supposed to be assisting you, and here I am letting my thoughts drift. My apologies, Commander.

propose.line: I can't believe you're offering something this precious to me... Teehee, I truly was destined to be at this port. Listen, um... I assume you don't mind, but I want stay here for a while longer. Teehee~

touch.line: How can I help, Commander?

touch2.line: Would you PLEASE show some self-restraint?!

unlock.line: Are you the Owner of the port? The "Commander"? Hello. My name is Kasumi, I'll be staying here for the foreseeable future. I hope we can both get along on friendly terms.

upgrade.line: I feel more powerful... Thank you for that, Commander. Teehee~

win_mvp.line: Let's keep this up! Teehee~

gift_prefer.line: Aha, I'm so happy! Thank you!

detail.line: Um, Commander... Could you please not stare at me... because... it's a bit embarrassing...

home.line: You would think shipgirls are excellent swimmers, since they do so much battle at sea... But perhaps that isn't necessarily the case?

login.line: Are you here for some relaxation as well, Commander? Have yourself a nice, prolonged break from all that paperwork you're used to.

main1.line: What's your favorite drink, Commander? I'm partial to the... iced café au lait, I suppose.

main2.line: Commander, are you good at swimming? I'm just curious to see how fast your breaststroke is!

main3.line: There's nothing... off about my swimsuit, is there?

touch.line: We're taking photos? Well, I'm a bit camera shy, but... okay. How's this pose? Should I stay like this?

touch2.line: Please... No funny business, okay?

unlock.line: I was amazed to see the port had such a scenic place as this... Truly, you can't go without taking this view in. Right, Commander?

battle.line: Aaaaall right! When you do something, you gotta do it right!

couple_encourage1.line: Sis? Oh, never mind...

couple_encourage2.line: I can take care of myself, so focus on yourself, sis!

detail.line: I get these weird vibes from this port and the shipgirls that live here... But most of all, I get them from you, Commander. Oh, I'm just messing with you! Ahaha!

expedition.line: The commission team's returned! I wonder if they brought back some sweets~

feeling1.line: This port might be an interesting place, but you? You're not very dependable... I guess the responsibility for whipping you into shape falls on me, the part-timer~

feeling2.line: So, I can drash across the ocean if I put this rigging on? The wonders of technology, huh!

feeling3.line: Everyone looks extraordinary when fighting, but I guess they're really just normal girls when they're not. I've even found some friends who like comic books, heheh.

feeling4.line: Apparently, there's a two-for-one deal at the store for bubble milk tea right now! Two might be a bit too much for me, though... Commander, if you're free, do you want to go with me?

feeling5.line: Commander, let's go to the dessert store~ Afterward, we can take a stroll together! I want to learn more about this place! And then, after that... um... Well, let's just get going!

headtouch.line: Hey, um... This feels odd to me...

home.line: Oh, Commander, nice work on that last battle! Now, how about a short break?

hp_warning.line: This is just the beginning!

login.line: Commander, hurry up~ Let's get to work, shall we?

lose.line: We lost... I can't believe it...

mail.line: Commander, you've got mail. Come take a look!

main1.line: If you've got nothing else for me to do, I'm gonna head off to my part-time job... wait, I guess this is one, too...?

main2.line: Mm~ I could go for some sweets right about now. Maybe a crêpe or something...

main3.line: My sister might be scary at times, but she's a nice person at heart! ...Though, she might be a bit on the overprotective side...

mission.line: Commander, you've got new missions! Don't we get rewards for completing them?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Commander, don't forget to give me my share of the rewards! Oh, I'm just pulling your leg! Ahaha!

profile.line: You want me to introduce myself? I'm Misaki, and my hobbies include scuba diving, stargazing, and... reading comics, I guess. Also, I really like mango vanilla crêpes and bubble milk tea! Oh, right, and... be nice to my sister, Nagisa!

propose.line: Ever since I've arrived at this place, you've taken such good care for me. I can't believe that I'm about to receive something this precious from you... Thank you, Commander! I'll work even harder for you!

touch.line: Yeees? Did you call for me, Commander?

touch2.line: Wah?! Geez, I'll be really angry if you do that again!

unlock.line: It's nice to meet you! From what I've heard, you're the "Commander," right? I'm Misaki. I have experience with various part-time jobs, so... I'm confident that I can be of help to you all. Let's do our best!

upgrade.line: What do you think? Can you feel my growth?

win_mvp.line: We won! Woohoo, a V for victory!

gift_prefer.line: Wow, amazing! Can I really have this?

detail.line: Commander, did you ask my sister to participate in some photoshoots too? Hehe~ She might act all mean on the outside, but she'll do whatever you need as long as you don't ask for something risqué~

home.line: Yaaawn~ ...Oh, did I fall asleep? Sorry, the sofa was just too comfy...

login.line: We're doing another shoot today? I don't mind, but...

main1.line: After the shoot, wanna go grab some bubble milk tea? All right, no backsies!

main2.line: Commander, are you taking some photos of the other girls as well? Let me have a look~

main3.line: Commander, if you could go on a trip, where would you go?

touch.line: G-geez, you're making me blush...

touch2.line: N-no, you can't! It's too embarrassing...

unlock.line: A photoshoot? That'd be similar to what I did before coming here, but... um, this swimsuit is a bit much... Commander, is this what you're into? Geez... It's so embarrassing...

detail.line: Sitting here watching the fireworks with you, I feel something beyond just... admiration at their beauty. It's hard to put into words... Is this the magic of fireworks, too?

home.line: Are you sure you're not more tired than me? Let's go rest so you can catch your breath.

login.line: I'm okay, I swear... Ah! Ouch, ouch... Maybe I'm not so okay yet.

main1.line: I hear this is the best place around port to see the fireworks! Let's watch them until the end, okay? Especially since we're alone for once... y'know?

main2.line: Don't stare at me. Watch the fireworks, silly! They're pretty, so you gotta see them!

main3.line: My ankle? Y-yeah, it's fine... Wait, are you asking because you realized? N-never mind! Thanks for worrying about me.

touch.line: Oh, is my swimsuit coming off? Gosh, that's embarrassing...

touch2.line: H-hey, you don't have to rub it so much. I'm fine...

unlock.line: H-hey, so... I think I twisted my ankle a little. Can we rest here for a little bit? There's a place we can sit over there... Is that okay with you?

battle.line: If I have to do it, I'll do it properly. I just have to drive them away, right?

couple_encourage1.line: Misaki! Be careful! Make sure you don't get hurt!

couple_encourage2.line: Honoka, looks like you're wearing a shrine maiden's swimsuit as well!

detail.line: I can't believe there are so many girls at this port... You must have tricked them into coming here, didn't you?!

expedition.line: Hey, you have girls back from a commission waiting for you out there. You silly dog.

feeling1.line: I'm taking Misaki back. Farewell.

feeling2.line: Not just Misaki, but all of these other girls too... You dirty dog, what kind of devious schemes are you up to?!

feeling3.line: If Misaki's having fun, it's fine, but... the moment you do anything weird, you'll regret it!

feeling4.line: Eh, you're saying you saw me talking to the sea? Oh, I'm a theater actor, so I was practicing... wait, you were spying on me?! You... You dirty dog!

feeling5.line: Thanks for taking care of Misaki... I may have been wrong about you. You know, thinking that you were evil, and all. So... I'll watch you for a bit longer. That's fine, isn't it? You silly dog.

home.line: Nice job in battle, you silly dog. But there's still a lot left for you to do, isn't there?

hp_warning.line: Oh no... At this rate...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. ...You're quite the hard worker. Like a sled dog.

lose.line: It's all your fault, you silly dog...

mail.line: Here's some mail. Are you going senile? I can't believe you neglected it until I told you.

main1.line: Hey, you silly dog. This is a gift from someone. Apparently, there are some soufflé pancakes inside, too... I-I didn't say anything! Don't forget about it later!

main2.line: You're quite a hard worker, which I'd say is good... Even for a lowly dog...

main3.line: Hey, is there anything I can help you with? ...Don't take this the wrong way, I'm just doing this for leverage against you.

mission.line: Looks like there are still missions you haven't completed. Are you planning on doing them now, you silly dog?

mission_complete.line: You did this many missions on your own? My opinion of you has slightly improved... you silly dog.

profile.line: Like I said the first time we met, I'm Misaki's sister, Nagisa. What I like most are soufflé pancakes, and what I hate most are green peppers. Do anything weird to Misaki, and I'll never forgive you for it, you dirty dog.

propose.line: I-I understand your feelings! Geez, I'm not stupid like you are... My answer? D-don't you know without me telling you?! Like I always say, you're so slow, you silly dog! ...Hehe, I'll treasure this, you dog~

touch.line: Wh-what do you think you're doing, you dirty dog?!

touch2.line: I guess... you really are an incorrigible dirty dog...

unlock.line: Are you the person who led Misaki to this port? You go by the name... "Commander"? Hmm... I don't know how you sweet-talked her into it, but you're not fooling me. The moment you do anything strange... you better be on guard! My name? It's Nagisa. You... silly dog!

upgrade.line: Thank you... What? What's the problem with me saying "thanks" once in a while?!

win_mvp.line: Whew, I'm a bit tired... I wonder if I overexerted myself.

gift_prefer.line: I-I'll take it. ...Thanks, silly dog.

detail.line: A photoshoot? Outdoors, like this? Fine... But no indecent photos, you hear? ...Excuse me?! Those aren't allowed, indoors or outdoors, you pervert!

home.line: You worked hard that battle. Of course I'll praise you every once in a while... I-I didn't say anything, you silly dog!

login.line: You finally came? ...It's nothing. I was just wondering if you had forgotten our promise to go to the beach together.

main1.line: I can't believe how many girls there are, playing around in their swimsuits... Hold on a sec, is this the reason you came to the beach on your day off? You dirty dog!

main2.line: How long are you going to stare, you dirty dog... I'm c-cute? I don't need your cheap pickup lines!

main3.line: Let me take a look at the pictures you have of Misaki. If I spot any weird ones... then you're really in for it!

touch.line: Eek! What are you touching me for?!

touch2.line: Are you in heat? ...You dirty dog!

unlock.line: Whew! The wind feels great! ...What are you staring at me like that for, you silly dog? You're the one who said you wanted to go to the beach, remember? To start with, how about... we take a stroll?

battle.line: Disrupting my vacation like this... I hope you're ready for what's coming. Hehehe.

couple_encourage1.line: Haha, I shall show you the power of these "carrier-based aircraft" of mine

couple_encourage2.line: Oh, what a curious fate it is that ties us together.

detail.line: Well, well. What shall I do for amusement now... Have you any good ideas?

expedition.line: Your subordinates are calling for you. You shouldn't keep a woman waiting for long.

feeling1.line: You... You are a boring human...

feeling2.line: One year for a human is no time at all to a Tengu. ...However, that does not mean I have no interest in the world of you humans.

feeling3.line: This port abounds with curious "take-knowledge-ease." Commander, might I ask for a tour? Hehehe, you know quite a bit, don't you?

feeling4.line: No matter where I go, humans seem to love festivals and feasts just the same. Ah-ha-ha... That's right, I love them too♥

feeling5.line: Oh, we're on a "date"? It seems I was taking you far too lightly, hehehe. Well, what kinds of events should I look forward to?

headtouch.line: I-it tickles a bit...

home.line: After battle comes official duties, it seems. You must be suffering, so I shall lend you a hand.

hp_warning.line: The battle is just starting, is it not?

login.line: Just arriving, Commander? Heheh, you will show me around the port, won't you?

lose.line: To corner me like so... One must always be on their guard...

mail.line: "May-ull"? I am most curious as to where it came from.

main1.line: In order to fly, humans created airplanes... I wonder how the view from within one is?

main2.line: I'd like to drink some tea while snacking on some manjuu... Not those little ones you have here, mind you. Ah-haha.

main3.line: There is a strange presence within the ranks of the Sakura Empire. Hehehe, interesting, how very interesting...

mission.line: There are still duties left for you to do. What a forgetful one, hehehe.

mission_complete.line: You seem to have completed your tasks. Hehehe, are you tired? Go ahead and rest awhile.

profile.line: I am undoubtedly a tengu. Oh? If you have any doubts, why not confirm it with those eyes and hands? Ah-haha...♥

propose.line: To think you'd try to detain me in the world of man, what inconceivable rubbish... Ah-ha-ha, that was merely a joke. My vacation is still in its youth. I shall stay by your side for the moment's passing♥

skill.line: Haha, what a trifle you are!

touch.line: Are you planning on checking my body yourself? Hehe, how daring.

touch2.line: Hehe, you shouldn't...♥

unlock.line: Oh? You don't seem to fear me... Who might you be? ...I see, so it is you who rules over this place. Then I shall call you "Commander." I am Nyotengu. You would do best to keep me entertained, hehe.

upgrade.line: Haha, that's not enough. Give me more...♥

win_mvp.line: It's over already? How unsatisfying.

gift_prefer.line: That's my Commander♥

detail.line: Your port is quite fine. With hot springs and beaches, there are plenty a wonderful place to choose... This looks to be quite the auspicious vacation, indeed, ah-haha.

home.line: You, leaving me alone like this... Come take the place of this monkey, hurry in to the bath.

login.line: What are you doing, standing there like a fool? Don't hold back, come closer... to my side.

main1.line: More than me, you seem to be the one direly in need of a vacation.

main2.line: Hehehe, Commander, won't you join me for a drink under these beautiful, crimson leaves?

main3.line: What are you looking at? If there's something that interests you... shouldn't you take a closer look? Ah-haha.

touch.line: Hehe, I wouldn't mind it if you... came closer.

touch2.line: Hehehe, what an incorrigible fool...❤

unlock.line: Oho! To think there was a place with this much class... Not bad! I shall hereby be enjoying my hot springs vacation right here, hehehe.

battle.line: Heheh, I'm the wild card in this battle!

couple_encourage1.line: Heheh! Would you like to bet on this battle?

detail.line: High-stakes gamble are once-a-day only! You'll have to wait until tomorrow to give the wheel another spin, Commander.

expedition.line: A commission team has returned! It was a gamble, but those lucky girls won!

feeling1.line: You can't give up after losing just one single bet, Commander. Life, as we all know, is one big series of wins and losses!

feeling2.line: This one time, I saw someone do a "straight up" bet with all their chips. You just have to admire the moxie it takes to bet against Lady Luck like that!

feeling3.line: Heheh, let me show you this dealing method I learned a while back, Commander!

feeling4.line: Are you the type that's easily influenced by pretty girls, Commander? That's not good! You need be focused at all times, or you won't win.

feeling5.line: I really do like gambling with you, Commander. Win or lose, it's lots of fun! That's your biggest charm point, in fact. Heheh!

headtouch.line: Heheh. Is there something the matter?

home.line: Way to go, Commander. Here, a glass of water. Heheh, a dealer needs to keep an eye on the player, don't you know?

hp_warning.line: Calm down, Monica! Focus!

login.line: Greetings, Commander. What do you say to... a small bet before starting work?

lose.line: Dammiiiiit! Next time, I swear it... Next time!

mail.line: Don't forget your mail now, Commander!

main1.line: Which do you prefer, Commander? Skill-based card games, or luck-based roulette?

main2.line: You can wager more than just chips. Like an afternoon teatime, for instance. The loser provides the tea and biscuits!

main3.line: Something... on your mind? I could offer you some insight, if you'd like. Assuming you win this next bet, that is!

mission.line: Hey, Commander, you've got unfinished business! Let's wrap things up so we can gamble!

mission_complete.line: Mission done on time and with flying colors. You might have it in you to be a casino manager, Commander!

profile.line: Why do I want to be a dealer? Because it's cool! Why else? Dealer distribute cards with so much style, and they've got such solid poker faces!

propose.line: Huh? You're giving THIS to ME? Can I really have it? Talk about the bet of a lifetime... Heheh, I'll call your wager! Or would you rather I raise it?

touch.line: This next gamble wiiiill... have to wait until our work is finished!

touch2.line: Th-there's no sleight of hand going on here!

unlock.line: Are you the one in charge here? The "Commander"? I'm Monica, the dealer! Well, dealer-in-training. I know it's sudden, but would you care to gamble with me? The stakes will, of course, be high!

upgrade.line: The house advantage grows ever so slightly!

win_mvp.line: Heheh! There are no backsies in gambling!

gift_prefer.line: Wow, is it really okay that I have this? Thank you!

detail.line: "You want my fortune, do ya? Beat me in cards, and it's all yours, kid!" ...That's how they do those huge gambles in movies, right? Heheh!

home.line: Are you having a good time, Commander? At the Fantabulous Casino, chips come free of charge! If you ever run out, do come see me!

login.line: Welcome, Commander! Enjoy your stay at the Fantabulous Casino! Here are your chips for the day.

main1.line: Would you like a nice, cold beverage? It'll clear your head, I can promise you that!

main2.line: Be it at work or at the tables, you always need a clear head and a poker face! Those so happen to be my special skills!

main3.line: Don't you think it's interesting how, even though the odds are the same for everyone, if there are winners, there must be losers too?

main4.line: I see you blushing there, Commander. Heheh, eyes on the prize!

touch.line: You've run out of chips? Now, that just won't do! Here you are. Spend them wisely, okay?
