main3.line: My skin's getting a little flushed... It's a good thing the steam hides it for me.

touch.line: Shouldn't a swimsuit be the main attraction here? ...Goodness, you want BOTH? How greedy you are... Heehee!

touch2.line: Should I soak a little deeper, Commander? Hehe, you seem to like your girls wet, so...

unlock.line: Welcome... Aww, did I startle you? Hehe, but why? I thought you of all people would appreciate this seductive vibe, Commander. Hmm... I'll pose for you, if you'd like. Just say the word!

battle.line: Oookay... Here goes!

couple_encourage1.line: L-let's see how cool you are, Yukino!

couple_encourage2.line: Shandy, you're so pretty no matter what you're doing...

couple_encourage3.line: Raffaello, you should give me some pointers on drawing cute girls when we get back!

detail.line: Incredible things keep happening here at the port. I could draw manga for the rest of my life off of this... Heh heh heh.

expedition.line: I got a message saying that the errand is done! Commander, let's go greet everyone!

feeling1.line: Umm, so... I'm kind of busy right now! Bye!

feeling2.line: Oh, Commander! Greetings... Isn't that an elegant greeting? Maybe I should use it in my next manga.

feeling3.line: What kind of girl do you like, Commander? Um, just asking as a reference for a character design...

feeling4.line: I was planning to draw all day, but do you have any plans, Commander? If you're free, maybe you and I could... Uh, n-never mind!

feeling5.line: I've been racking my brain over the heroine of this manga for a while now... Now that I've spent so much time with you, I think I've gotten a rough idea. I think I've captured that sense of... endearingness? Haha, what am I even saying...

headtouch.line: Huh?! Oh no, is my hair a mess?! Aww, this is so embarrassing...

home.line: Good work today, Commander. Wanna take a little break for now?

hp_warning.line: *sob*... C-can we go home already?

login.line: Ah, Commander... G-good morning?

lose.line: W-we lost... Next time! I'll try harder!

mail.line: Handling mail... I feel like a secretary just in my manga!

main1.line: This outfit might be kind of lame, but I'm not brave enough to be in my swimsuit ALL the time...

main2.line: There are goddesses all over the place at this port! Heh heh heh... I think I've found heaven, after all!

main3.line: Someone invited me out to lunch just a minute ago... I can't go in there! It's so dazzling, I doubt I could get a word out!

mission.line: Commander, you left this undone... Are you sure you shouldn't check it out?

mission_complete.line: Huh? Can I really have this? But Commander, it's your reward...

profile.line: My name is Tsukushi. Umm... I guess I'm just a student? I-I like drawing manga and stuff, too... You don't have to worry about it, though. I've seen a whole lot of cute girls around here. For someone with anxiety like me, it's basically heaven to be surrounded by all these goddesses...

propose.line: This world is full of good manga and pretty girls. If only someone as... insignificant as me could be among those shining stars. Umm... This is embarrassing to say, but I'd be really happy if you would always watch over me... Hehe.

touch.line: You want me to take off my tracksuit? You mean... show off skin? I-I don't have the confidence for that!

touch2.line: Hyah! Y-you scared me...

unlock.line: Blue skies... White clouds... A sparkly, endless sea... Hehe! What a beautiful view... Huh? Wh-where am I... Whoa?! Wh-who goes there? Huh? A Commander? You wanna know where I came from...? Umm, sorry. My name is Tsukushi. Do you know where we are, exactly?

upgrade.line: I-I got praised for growing stronger! Hehe...

win_mvp.line: Wh-what? We won?

gift_prefer.line: Huh? Are you sure I can have this? Th-thanks... Hehe!

battle_ex.line: I-I'll do my best. Cheer me on, okay?

detail_ex.line: The port is full of people who shine brightly, like protagonists in their own stories... I've got to do better as well! Whether it comes to manga, or other things... Ehehe♪

feeling5_ex.line: Ever since I met you, I've started to understand what it means to have feelings for someone else. This should help me make even better manga... I'll keep trying hard, so I hope you'll support me, too.

login_ex.line: G-good morning. Should we take care the day's plans... together?

main4_ex.line: Delicate beauties, cosplay cuties, swimsuit chicks... You've got all kinds! Huh? You think I'm cute, too? Umm... Th-thank you very much.

main5_ex.line: Y-you scared me! Don't call out to me out of nowhere... If it weren't you, I would've screamed so loud...

main6_ex.line: I bet I could find all kinds of models here... Huh? You'll ask for me? Okay... Can I get YOU to model for me, then?

mission_ex.line: C-Commander, you still have work to do... I-is there anything I can do to help at all?

mission_complete_ex.line: Commander, can I mark this mission completed?

touch2_ex.line: Commander! Th-that's out of the question!

win_mvp_ex.line: I won, Commander! Ehehe...

detail.line: Massages are really important to make sure you don't still feel fatigued the next day. If I could just get one whenever I wanted... Oh, but I need an emergency stop button in case it tickles!

home.line: Commander, you look beat... One of those massage machines sure would come in handy right about now...

login.line: Commander, do your muscles ever ache? I'm feeling a little sore myself...

main1.line: Imagine using AI to analyze my data and provide the perfect massage... That'd be way better than doing it myself.

main2.line: A full-body massage from head to toe... Oh, but if it kneaded too hard... Ugh, I don't even wanna imagine. M-maybe we shouldn't, Commander!

main3.line: A-an introvert like me could never ask someone for a massage! This is exactly why I need a machine.

touch.line: Ah! Right there... Just a little harder, Commander... Ack! Why did I just say that...

touch2.line: Mmmnh! C-Commander! I'm really sensitive right there, and right here... Hey, stop! I can't take anymore!

unlock.line: H-hey, Commander... Do you think the people here could build one of those machines where you lie down in bed, and the machine's arms give you a full-body massage?

battle.line: C'mon! Let's move to the beat~♪

couple_encourage1.line: Let's do our best, Elise!

couple_encourage2.line: That tail accessory is too cute!

couple_encourage3.line: Guam, let's make this broadcast a good one!

detail.line: The radio went quiet out of nowhere. I got sad because I thought it was broken, but maybe it's just set to the wrong frequency?

expedition.line: The girls who went out just got back! Let's go welcome them, Commander!

feeling1.line: Hmm, I don't like that smell... I know! I'll go for a walk to clear my head.

feeling2.line: Hello hello! Are you doing good, Commander? Yeah, it's good that you're feeling good! Hahaha!

feeling3.line: Hello hello! Hey, what do you think of this outfit... Does it look good on me? ...Hehehe!

feeling4.line: You say I should stay away because you smell sweaty...? But I like your scent, Commander. You don't have to worry about it one bit, I promise.

feeling5.line: I love listening to cheerful songs! It puts me in a great mood. I also love talking to you just as much now. Maybe you're the source of all my energy...♪

headtouch.line: So, am I cute, or what? ...Hehe! Thanks for the compliment!

home.line: *sniff*... Oh, you smell tired, Commander. Come here, and let's relax together!

hp_warning.line: Ugh, you're all just bullies! But I won't lose yet!

login.line: Hello hello! Mhm, I'm all ready to go!

lose.line: Aww, I messed up... But I can still fight!

mail.line: Commander, you've got mail! I can't wait to see what it says!

main1.line: It gets lonely here because I can't hear my radio, but sometimes, I hear people singing or playing instruments. It really gets me hyped...

main2.line: When I go on walks, I see so many sights I've never seen before! It's even more fun because people come along sometimes!

main3.line: Shopping? Let's go! Yaaay, I hope I find something I like!

mission.line: Umm, let's see... Does this mark mean it's not finished?

mission_complete.line: You got a lot of stuff... Should I not touch that?

profile.line: Hello hello. I'm Patty! Everyone just calls me Patty, so you should too, Commander. This radio is my treasure, and I love every little song that comes out of it... Haha!

propose.line: Hmm... The smell of my heart racing is even stronger than your scent now... I don't even know what to do anymore. But I do know that I'm bursting with excitement, so let's have lots of fun together, Commander. Hehe!

touch.line: Ooh, hello hello... Did something exciting happen? I wanna join in!

touch2.line: Hyah! Geez... You smell naughty!

unlock.line: Mmm... The wind, sea, and sun all smell wonderful! *sniff*... What's that smell? Wait, who are you? A... Commander? Hello hello! Hm? Me? I'm Patty, of course. By the way, what is this place? ...Ooh, okay. I'll trust you, then! I'm not worried, since you smell like such a good person...

upgrade.line: Hehe... What do you think? Have I changed?

win_mvp.line: Woohoo! Patty wins!

gift_prefer.line: Huh? You got this for me? Wow, you're the best!

battle_ex.line: Okay, let's do this... Here we gooo!

detail_ex.line: Heh heh heh... Thanks to you, my radio's playing music again! It's all songs I don't know, sure, but I'm happy that they're all so fun!

feeling5_ex.line: Your scent feels really kind, and it makes me feel happy... Is this what romance is? Can you teach me, Commander?

login_ex.line: Hello hello, Commander! What do you wanna do today? Can we do it together?

main4_ex.line: This place is full of smells. Tasty ones, pleasant ones... and I know your smell too, of course!

main5_ex.line: Everyone smells happy when they're talking to you... It's incredible. I'm having fun, so I wonder if I smell happy, too.

main6_ex.line: The trees, flowers, birds, and fish are all full of life. Every one of them smells kind... I think it's all because you're here, Commander.

mission_ex.line: You've got more of those... missions? It looks like a lot of trouble... Can I help?

mission_complete_ex.line: This is proof that you worked hard! I already know.

touch2_ex.line: Gosh, Commander, that tickles!

win_mvp_ex.line: Ooh, I'm feeling the rhythm today!

detail.line: Bunnies are popular everywhere, huh? They're fluffy and cute... I hope everyone thinks I'm super cute, too.

home.line: Commandeeer, you've been working so hard! I hope the sight of Patty the Bunny lifts your spirits.

login.line: Hello hello, Commander! What's it gonna be? You ready for a quick match with this bunny?

main1.line: Commander, you smell really troubled right now. Hahaha! It's okay. You can look at me all you want, any time you want.

main2.line: What kind of bunnies do you like? Little ones? Ones with floppy ears? Or maybe... ones that hop around like this?

main3.line: Do you think I could take a picture with a real bunny? You can be in it, too!

touch.line: Hehehe! Does my bunny outfit suit your tastes, Commander?

touch2.line: Hehe! I can smell the excitement on you, Commander!

unlock.line: Oh, Commander! Hello hello! *sniff*... Huh? You smell like you're plotting something... Is it my bunny-like softness you're after? Well... If you can catch me, you can fluff me all you want! Hahaha!

battle.line: Alright, let's get hype!

couple_encourage1.line: I'm so glad I get to be with a cutie like you, Elise!

couple_encourage2.line: T-Tamaki... You're making me nervous!

couple_encourage3.line: I like your style, Owari!

detail.line: How do you like this pose? Pretty awesome, right? I think it's great... Just looking at me gets you going, huh?

expedition.line: Finished those errands? Great job, girls. You're the best!

feeling1.line: Gosh... Not cool, Commander. I'm not into that.

feeling2.line: You wanna hang later? Okay! Where are we going?

feeling3.line: Ugh, there's just so much stuff I wanna do with you, Commander!

feeling4.line: Hey, tell me more about your loves, Commander. Trying out some new things could be fun!

feeling5.line: My fit today is a little different from the usual... You say it suits your tastes? Heheh, I really love how direct you are, Commander. I knew it was a good idea to pick something you'd like... Hehehe!

headtouch.line: Hm? Commander, what's up? Need something?

home.line: Oh, there you are. Good work, boss! How are you feeling? Doin' okay? Great to hear it!

hp_warning.line: Ugh, this blows...

login.line: Oh, heya, Commander! You about to get to work? Good luck!

lose.line: I got a little too hasty... Next time, though! I'll totally get it right next time!

mail.line: Mail, huh... All this business stuff is too stuffy for me.

main1.line: The beach really is the best in the morning! It feels like I've got the whole thing to myself. Do you ever feel that way, Commander?

main2.line: I can even go shopping here? Heck yeah... You're coming too, aren't you?

main3.line: I've got a ton of respect for Tamaki. A former model AND a designer? How perfect can you be? It's just a little overwhelming to be around her all the time...

mission.line: Oof! Your workload is insane!

mission_complete.line: Done with your work already? Wow! You're crazy good at this.

profile.line: I'm Yukino. Give me a nickname, if you want. I've got lots of loves... Fashion, for example! On that note, I gotta give huge props to Tamaki!

propose.line: It's so fun here, because I get to find new things to love every day! It's all because you're here, so... Keep taking care of me, alright, Commander? Hehehe!

skill.line: I'm about to do something crazy strong!

touch.line: Hm? Interested in my fit, Commander? Or are you just into this style?

touch2.line: You scared me... H-hey, that joke went too far!

unlock.line: Oh, man... Where am I? This sucks... Hey you, can you point me in the right... Huh? Me? I'm Yukino. Nice to meetcha! Oh, so, I rushed here 'cause I heard Tamaki was here... Guess I'm lost now. Mind taking little ol' me in for a while? Hehehe!

upgrade.line: Hehehe! Thanks, Commander. That one was all you!

win_mvp.line: Do we kick butt, or what?!

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me? Wow, that's awesome... Thanks!

battle_ex.line: Heh heh heh... Let's party hard!

detail_ex.line: My three sizes are 89, 55, and... Hey, you can't go around asking people that. But if you wanna know, I could tell you... Hehehe!

feeling5_ex.line: You know how you always support my loves, Commander? I think that's pretty cool of you. I wanna keep sharing more of my loves with you, so you'd better be ready!

login_ex.line: Commander, are you free right now? Let's grab a drink together.

main4_ex.line: Ice cream by the beach is the best! I'm happy any time I'm eating something sweet. Commander, get over here and join me, would you?

main5_ex.line: My skin hasn't been in great shape lately. I'd love to soak in a hot spring right now... You got any recommendations?

main6_ex.line: I'm plenty happy with all the good food here, but... I'd better watch my waistline, huh?

mission_ex.line: Do you still have work to do, Commander? Don't let that stuff pile up. Let's go knock it out right now.

mission_complete_ex.line: Did you rush through your work just for me? Aww, thanks, Commander!

touch2_ex.line: Hehehe! That kinda tickles.

win_mvp_ex.line: Hehehe! I won, and I looked good doing it!

detail.line: What do you think? I think this wild look is kinda hot in a new way! Make sure you take some really good pics of me, okay?

home.line: Hehe, even the king of beasts needs sleep. *yaaawn*... It's cool and comfy here...

login.line: Commander, this way! Over here! You're in my territory now!

main1.line: My wildness level is through the roof! How about I pose up in this tree? I'm pretty agile, y'know!

main2.line: The whole jungle photo shoot didn't work out, but I love this place's vibe. Don't you?

main3.line: I'm already strutting all around the beach in this swimsuit... Why don't you change into something flashier, too? Hehehe!

touch.line: You don't have to stand all the way over there. Come and get a closer look, if you dare.

touch2.line: When you stare at me like that, I get a little... embarrassed, you know? Geez! Keep that up, and I'm gonna eat you!

unlock.line: Ooh, is this carnivorous vibe what you're into, Commander? No prob! I'll make all your dreams come true... Roooar! Haha, did that scare you? Get your heart pounding? Hehehe!

battle.line: All righty, time to get fired up!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's put on a top-notch show for the fans, Chihaya!

couple_encourage2.line: Thanks for that tip you gave me, Ritsuko!

couple_encourage3.line: Don't be silly, Ami, I'm not gonna trip on– Whuaahh!

detail.line: You want to get to know me? Uhh, sure... To start with, what do you want to talk about?

expedition.line: Well done on that errand, everyone! Glad to see you made it back in one piece!

feeling1.line: Oops, sorry, I was busy reading the script. What were you saying?

feeling2.line: I've loved singing since I was a kid. I especially love singing together with a group of friends!

feeling3.line: Ow, oww... Oh, hi, Commander. It's nothing serious, I just tripped in the corridor... A bandaid? Aww, thank you so much!

feeling4.line: That's enough rehearsing for one day, I think... Are you taking a break too, Commander? Then we could sit and relax together! What do you say?

feeling5.line: Commander! I made some cookies today! They came out pretty good, I'd say. Listen, I was hoping you could... have a taste and tell me what you think?

headtouch.line: You like how my ribbon looks? Hehehe~ Thank you! It's my signature accessory!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! I made snacks while you were out. Do you want some while you take a break?

hp_warning.line: The show is far from over!

login.line: Good morning, Commander! Let's roll up our sleeves and get to work!

lose.line: Urgh... Sorry for tripping up... I'll work on it so we win next time!

mail.line: I think there's mail for you, Commander! Maybe it's a new job offer?

main1.line: What were those little kitty creatures called again? "Meowfficers"? I bet our resident animal lover, Hibiki, would love to meet one!

main2.line: I'm glad to see fellow idols at the port! They're all so cute, and so pretty to boot... I hope one day we can all go up on stage together.

main3.line: I've played a villain character before, and I actually really got into the role! Didn't think it would be so fun!

mission.line: There's still a few tasks we need to do. If you need my help with any of them, just say the word!

mission_complete.line: Job completed! Way to go, Commander!

profile.line: I'm Haruka Amami! I've loved singing ever since I was little, and always dreamed of becoming an idol. It's a tough job, but I know I can overcome any challenge as long as I have my friends! Hehehe~

propose.line: It's thanks to you and all the wonderful people here that I've managed to get this far and work with a smile. I want to bring a smile to your faces, just as you have for me!

skill.line: Here's a smile for all my fans!

touch.line: Do you need something, Commander? Oh! I'm guessing you need a hand with something.

touch2.line: Eeeek! Wh-what are you doing?!

unlock.line: Hello, Commander! I'm the idol, Haruka Amami! I'll do my best to share my dreams with everyone in port! Let's all have a great time together!

upgrade.line: I'll try to be the best, brightest-shining idol I can!

win_mvp.line: We woooon! Girls, you're awesome!

gift_prefer.line: Wow! Is this for me? I'm really happy!

battle_ex.line: All right! Let's get 'em!

detail_ex.line: Welcome back, Commande– Oh shoot, look ooooout! Ow, oww... Whoopsie, I did it again...

feeling5_ex.line: I forgot to ask, but how'd you like that cake I made the other day? ...You loved it? Hehehe~ I get all giddy when people give me their feedback. If you want to, I could make another one for you~

login_ex.line: Hey, Commander! What job are we starting the day with? Whatever it is, I'll give it my all!

main4_ex.line: Owww... I tripped again just earlier. But don't worry, I'm not hurt or anything. I trip all the time, so I'm used to it.

main5_ex.line: Commander, I was wondering if I could... Oh, you're sleeping? Hehehe~ Then I'll get you a blanket and let you get some rest.

main6_ex.line: I've learned about so many new pastries and snacks since I came here! There's this one cake recipe someone told me of a while ago that I'm dying to make for myself!

mission_ex.line: We're almost done! I'll help you with these tasks as best as I can!

mission_complete_ex.line: And that's a wrap! Let's keep up this pace for the rest of today!

touch2_ex.line: Eeeeek! Please, don't do that to me all of a sudden, Commander!

win_mvp_ex.line: Victory! It's all thanks to you, Commander!

detail.line: I've tried to replicate the takoyaki and yakisoba they sell here, but I just can't get the flavor right for some reason. Isn't that weird?

home.line: Wow, you've really been out and about! Should we take a break and sit on that bench over there?

login.line: Oh, hi! I'm glad you came to the festival too, Commander! Do you want to take a look around?

main1.line: What's wrong? Why are you hanging over there, Commander? Are you tired from wading through the crowds?

main2.line: It's kind of annoying to walk around in a yukata. I've got to pay extra attention so I don't trip ov– Oh, shoot!

main3.line: You came at just the perfect time, Commander! I just bought ramune and they gave me an extra bottle. Here, let's enjoy them!

touch.line: Hehehe~ Don't you love festivals? Anyway, where should we go next?

touch2.line: C-Commander! Please stop, or you'll open my yukata's bottom!

unlock.line: Good evening, Commander! Are you also taking a break? If so, let's go get some candied apples and have a little chat~♪

battle.line: I'm all done warming up and ready to sing!

couple_encourage1.line: Haruka! Let us sing together!

couple_encourage2.line: Azusa, let us do our best.

detail.line: Is there something you need me for? I was just about to start practicing singing though...

expedition.line: Commander, it seems like people are back from commissions. Shouldn't we go and greet them?

feeling1.line: Did you need something?

feeling2.line: Lalala~♪ Oh, Commander. I was just warming up my voice.

feeling3.line: An idol's work isn't limited to only singing. However, improving your singing skills will aid in any job... That's what I think.

feeling4.line: There are a lot of children here at the port. You know, I've been teaching some of them how to sing at their request. Hehe, everyone has such pretty singing voices.

feeling5.line: Um, Commander, would you mind accompanying me for a little bit? I've been practicing a new song, but I've been stuck on a part. I was hoping to get your opinion.

headtouch.line: Is something wrong?

home.line: Good work, Commander. Will... you be taking a short break? Understood.

hp_warning.line: It's... not over yet!

login.line: Good morning to you, Commander. I'd like to go over today's schedule with you, if you don't mind.

lose.line: ...Ugh! If only I had practiced singing a bit more...

mail.line: Commander, we've received some mail. I think it's a good idea to go check it soon.

main1.line: If there's nothing you need me to do, can I read some sheet music to pass the time? I'd like to practice the songs I'm singing at my next performance.

main2.line: The people at this port all operate such huge machinery... It's very impressive. I'm not very good with machines, you see.

main3.line: Lalala~♪ No, I need to put a bit more emotion into this part... Oh, Commander. I'm sorry, I'm having a hard time understanding this song...

mission.line: It looks like there's still work left to be done.

mission_complete.line: It looks like you've finished up the rest of your work. Well, I'll be getting back to practicing singing.

profile.line: My name is Chihaya Kisaragi. I aim to become a singer that's on a higher level than anyone else. You... want me to sing for you? Well... just one song then.

propose.line: Having come here and been able to sing for many people... I consider this a very valuable experience. To express my feelings for the Commander who gave me this opportunity... I'd like to sing you a song!

skill.line: Let this song... reach the hearts of everyone!

touch.line: I'm sorry... I'd like to do some vocal exercises to warm up my voice...

touch2.line: P-please stop. Where do you think you're touching me!

unlock.line: Pleased to meet you. My name is Chihaya Kisaragi. Are you the one in charge of this port? I look forward to working with you.

upgrade.line: Thank you very much. This has been an invaluable experience for me.

win_mvp.line: It's a victory. But I'm still a long way from reaching the top...

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much! I promise I'll treasure it...!

battle_ex.line: I... can soar even higher!

detail_ex.line: Commander, if you're free, could you accompany me for singing practice?

feeling5_ex.line: When I first arrived in port, there were so many things I didn't understand, but thanks to the help you and the others have given me, I've come to really enjoy my time here. I'm truly grateful for all you've done for me.

login_ex.line: Good morning, Commander. I'm in tip-top condition today! I feel like I can sing without a worry...!

main4_ex.line: Commander, I'm sorry for calling you over when you're so busy, but I don't really understand how to operate this equipment. I'm supposed to press this and do that? Um, it's not moving at all now...

main5_ex.line: Excuse me Commander, could I go and take some pictures of the port? I wanted to have something to remember my time at this place by.

main6_ex.line: Are you feeling tired? How about playing some classical music over at the office? I've heard that it helps you feel more relaxed...

mission_ex.line: Looks like you've still got some work left to finish.

mission_complete_ex.line: Good job wrapping everything up, Commander. Please allow me to help next time as well.

touch2_ex.line: Eek...!!! Please, stop it...!!! What are you doing all of a sudden...?!

win_mvp_ex.line: Looks like we've won. This experience is sure to be a catalyst for my further growth.

detail.line: How does this yukata look? ...It looks pretty on me? I'd be happy if that were the case...

home.line: In the summer, it's so hot, even in the evening... I'm going to go buy something cool to drink.

login.line: Good afternoon, Commander. Huh...? How long have I been waiting? There's nothing to worry about, I just got here myself.

main1.line: There's a flower pattern on the inside of this umbrella. I love to look up whenever I use it because it looks as if flowers are blooming above my head, and that's so pretty.

main2.line: The fireworks exploding above our heads and the fireworks reflected on the surface of the water... they're both very pretty.

main3.line: Watching fireworks next to the other people really feels exciting and festive, but I also like the relaxed atmosphere of watching fireworks from afar like this.

touch.line: This stone is so slippery, it's hard to stand on... Eek! T-thank you, Commander... That was a close one.

touch2.line: Eeek! ...Don't do something like that all of a sudden! I almost tripped!

unlock.line: Oh, the fireworks display is starting. I'm planning to meet up with the others after this, but... Why don't we spend some time enjoying the view here first?

battle.line: Are these guys even worthy of being my opponent?

couple_encourage1.line: Ami, stop playing around! Let's go!

couple_encourage2.line: This much is nothing! Heehee♪

couple_encourage3.line: Azusa, let's go!

feeling2.line: Ugh, I bought the wrong flavor of soda... Oh hey, Commander. Were you thirsty by any chance?

feeling3.line: Hum hum~♪ Oh, good morning, Commander. Hehe, yeah, I'm in a pretty good mood...

feeling5.line: At first, I was confused about the whole fighting-in-another-world thing, but I think I've gotten the hang of it. I owe it to everyone here, as well as to you...

headtouch.line: Um... Did you need me?

home.line: Good job out there. Want me to whip up a latte to help you relax?

hp_warning.line: I might've slipped up... but I can still do this!

login.line: Oh, good morning. You're unusually early today.

lose.line: No way, I messed up?! Hurry up and retreat, everyone!

main1.line: Huh. There's even a school over here... I'm sure you learn different stuff, but it's pretty neat how similar our worlds are.

main2.line: Huh? Where'd Namiko and Hass wander off to? Jeez... I came all the way from the other side of port to look for them...

main3.line: Oh, Commander, have you seen Akane? I thought we were going to hang out and all...

mission_complete.line: Good job. Looks like our rewards are in too, so make sure you don't lose track of it.

propose.line: When I first landed in this world, confused and lost, everyone here extended their hospitality to me. Especially you, Commander. I hope you'll continue to do everything you can to keep this place special.

skill.line: There's... something even I can do...!

touch.line: Huh, you need help with work? I was going to head to the shop, but... Well, fine, I guess. What'd you need?

unlock.line: Um, my name is Rikka Takarada. I'm still a bit confused about what's going on, but... I guess for the time being, I'm in good hands.

upgrade.line: Huh, so I'm capable of doing stuff like this too... Thanks, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Phew... I somehow managed to pull through.

gift_prefer.line: No way... I love this stuff... Thank you so much, Commander!

battle_ex.line: This time, it's my turn to fight.

detail_ex.line: Your coffee, Commander. Thanks for waiting so patiently. How does it taste?

feeling5_ex.line: Back then, I wasn't able to fight the enemy head-on. But this time, I have the power to help others. Now, I swear to fight for you and everyone else.

login_ex.line: Y'know, It sure feels weird not having to go to school in the morning...

main4_ex.line: Excuse me... Oh, huh. You're asleep already? Work must've been tough. I'll be waiting here until you wake up.

main5_ex.line: The shops here really have everything. I wish we had something like this back where I'm from.

main6_ex.line: This PC's not turning on? Hm, let's check if it's plugged in... (*thump*) What's wrong? Why do you look like you saw a ghost?

mission_ex.line: Please continue working. I'll brew something for you to drink, so stay focused until the very end.

mission_complete_ex.line: Well done. Since you worked so hard, why not take a little break?

touch2_ex.line: Whaaa?! What's the meaning of this?!

win_mvp_ex.line: Thank goodness... Everyone's safe and sound.

detail.line: A brand new look, a long train ride... All that's missing is a partner to keep me company. Yeah, as if...

home.line: Here, Commander. Do you prefer juice or tea?

login.line: Mm-hmm~ What lovely weather. Wonder where I should go today~

main1.line: I've got nothing else to do 'til the train arrives... Oh, that's right. The other day, I went to play with some of the girls back at the port...

main2.line: Huh, look at all the pigeons gathering around. Well, I guess that's one way to beat the heat...

main3.line: I wonder where I'll end up if I take this train to the end of the line. Well, being in a different world and all that makes me curious...

touch.line: Hum hum~♪ Oh, it looks like the train is finally about to arrive.

touch2.line: Wh-what do you think you're trying to do in public?! There's no way you'd normally be able to get away with this!

unlock.line: The train still isn't here yet? ...Oh, what a coincidence to see you here, Commander. Where were you headed?

detail.line: I'm always dressed like this at home... but nobody but my family sees me when I am. Consider yourself special, Commander.

home.line: You seem tired, Commander... Want to rest here with me? I can keep a secret.

login.line: Mm~ How about we take it easy today?

main1.line: I like this outfit. It's all soft and comfy.

main2.line: You really gotta prioritize comfort when you pick bedroom clothes~

main3.line: Don't complain about just a little mess! Gosh, you sound like my mom.

touch.line: Can't take your eyes off of me when I dress casually, right? That's it, isn't it?

touch2.line: Wh-whoa, okay, that's a little too much touching!

unlock.line: Ack, Commander?! Geez, look, I at least want to be able to relax in my own room. Let it go just this once, okay?

battle.line: I wonder what kind of enemy we'll get to fight today~?

couple_encourage1.line: Really glad you could make it, Rikka.

couple_encourage2.line: Are you a fellow kaiju enjoyer, Mujina?

couple_encourage3.line: Dang, Chise! Your rigging looks sweet~

detail.line: Kaijus are freakin' awesome. I love their moves and personalities... and I love sculpting them. Are you a fellow kaiju enjoyer, Commander?

expedition.line: The girls are back in port, huh? Go say hi to them, would you?

feeling1.line: Ahaha... Wow, you really are worthless.

feeling2.line: Oops! Sorry, I didn't mean to– Oh, hi Commander. Hey, don't sweat it, we only bumped into each other. Still, I'm glad you're all polite and stuff.

feeling3.line: There you are, Commander. Want to tag along with me to the store? I need to restock my sculpting materials and all that~

feeling4.line: An apple a day keeps the Sirens at bay, Commander. C'mon, you need some breakfast in your system. Let's get you to the cafeteria.

feeling5.line: Y'know, I'm glad I got the chance to experience this universe and make a bunch of new friends. Especially you, my more-than-just-friends friend... Or are we~? Hehehe~

headtouch.line: Hmm... Did you need something, Commander?

home.line: Look who's back. Maybe I oughta reward you for your efforts out there... Yeah, nah.

hp_warning.line: It'll take more than that to get rid of me~

login.line: Oh, hey. About time you showed up, Commander.

lose.line: The hell? How are these guys so strong? Doesn't make any damn sense...

mail.line: Your mail's still sitting there. If you're not going to read 'em, then I will~

main1.line: I'm totally loving how sweet these shipgirl riggings look. I wonder how they'd look in action.

main2.line: The store sells like, a hundred different kinds of tomato juice. They all look so good, so I went and bought them all~

main3.line: Come to think of it, this rigging reminds me of an old friend. What kind of person were they? Mm... I dunno if "person" is the right word~

mission.line: You know we're not done yet, right, Commander? Get back in the game.

mission_complete.line: Hey, not too shabby, Commander~

profile.line: The name's Akane Shinjo. Apparently I'm a battleship in this universe? I'm not much of a fighter, so don't be surprised if I get done in... Juuust kidding~

propose.line: It's so nice having people I can count on. People who readily wanted to get to know me. It's changed my perspective on life, honestly. Thank you, Commander.

touch.line: The store's got books for sale, right? Let's go check it out.

touch2.line: Jeez, you shouldn't do that~

unlock.line: Hey there, the name's Akane Shinjo. This rigging looks super cool, like it's right out of a mecha. Now if only there were some kaiju around, that'd be the best...

upgrade.line: Ooh, feelin' pretty good. Thanks, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Ahahah! Piece of cake!

gift_prefer.line: Ohhh, this is it, this is it! You know me well, Commander!

battle_ex.line: Hanging out with you all is kinda fun.

detail_ex.line: Check it out! I made a new figure! I put extra effort into the details on this one. Feel like praising me, Commander?

feeling5_ex.line: You hold a pretty special place in my heart, Commander... Huh? Is that a blush I see~?

login_ex.line: Oh, if it isn't the Commander~ Good timing too. I was starting to get bored.

main4_ex.line: Zzz... Heheh... Caught you reachin', Commander. If you admit it, I might let you keep going~ Or maybe not, hehe.

main5_ex.line: Commander, are you working hard, or hardly working? ...The former? Really? All you've been doing is staring off into space though.

main6_ex.line: Good on you for keeping your office nice and tidy... How's my room in comparison? Sorry, that's top-secret.

mission_ex.line: Look at that. Unfinished missions. I'll be here for moral support if you need it.

mission_complete_ex.line: Whoa, you finished a mission. Real nice work.

touch2_ex.line: Ah, you're what they call a hands-on person, eh?

win_mvp_ex.line: Aw yeah! We got 'em!

main2.line: This cushion is super comfy. Go on, give it a feel, Commander.

touch.line: Oh man, I'm starving. We should get some home delivery.

touch2.line: Ahaha... Only 'cause we're alone, all right?

home.line: Aww, what? You came home and you just had to come to me first? If seeing me soothes your fatigue, then knock yourself out!

login.line: Mmm~ This isn't really a place you should be visiting so often... I'm kidding. You're always welcome here, Commander.

main1.line: Hmmm~, what are you looking at? You should be more careful~

main2.line: It's a little bit of a mess, but don't worry about it. Or what? Do you want to clean up for me?

main3.line: Hmmm... There might not be enough space for two to sleep, y'know? Or do you want to try that badly?

touch.line: Look, I wouldn't mind a massage...

touch2.line: Hmm~ Why do I feel a sense of danger?

unlock.line: Hey, Commander, what's up~? You're not intoxicated by my good looks, are you? Pssh, lighten up, I'm kidding~

couple_encourage1.line: There's nothing to worry about with you around, Akane!

couple_encourage2.line: Rikka is so precious~

couple_encourage3.line: Namiko, let's get this over with~

expedition.line: Good work, everyone. Find anything interesting while you were out?

feeling1.line: Sigh... Looks like you were just another of those guys in the end...

feeling2.line: Commander, are there any cafés around here? I was looking to snack on some sweets. Wait, you'll go with me? What a gent.

feeling3.line: Hold up, why have you been staring at my face for so long... Eh, you want to know why I wear this mask? Well, there are a few reasons...

feeling4.line: Commander~? What might you have been doing with that girl last night~? ...Huh? I'm mistaken? There's no way! C'mon, just tell me already~

feeling5.line: Looks like I'm finally used to this place. Y'know, at first I was wondering what the heck I was supposed to do here. But these days, I've been having a pretty good time.

home.line: Oh, welcome back. Perfect timing, c'mere and take a look at this video.

hp_warning.line: This is where I say... the battle starts now!

main1.line: Wow, this is such a nice spot~ I can't stop taking pictures.

main2.line: Namiko and Rikka sure are late. We're supposed to be meeting here at the central garden... Well, I guess they don't know their way around yet, so it can't be helped.

propose.line: I've somehow managed to make it this far in this world thanks to you and your guidance. Well, I'll keep doing my best to live up to your expectations... Let's get'em, Commander.

touch.line: Oh, nice timing, Commander. I was just starting to feel a bit listless. Why don't you take me around to some hidden gems around the port?

touch2.line: Hey, officer, over here.

upgrade.line: Hmm, this is what leveling up feels like? It's true that I do feel a bit stronger.

win_mvp.line: See, that's what you get for messing with me.

gift_prefer.line: Huh? Is this for me? You're magical, Commander! Thanks!

battle_ex.line: Follow my lead, guys.

login_ex.line: Yo, morning. I'm amazed you even manage to get up in the morning~

mission_ex.line: You're at the final stretch with your work, aren't ya? I'll put some music on, so let's focus and wrap things up~

mission_complete_ex.line: Good work. Well then, let's go and feast on some sweets~

touch2_ex.line: Hey Commander, your pranks are going a bit overboard.

win_mvp_ex.line: I'm invincible with my friends around~

detail.line: Sigh... I'm so tired of editing. Commander, wanna head out for some tea?

home.line: Where do we head first... to this super popular café, or to that restaurant that's about to be the next big thing... Mmn, help me think this through, Commander~

main1.line: The next shop should be the last one... After we're done, let's go on a date, just you and me... Just kidding, of course. What are you getting all flustered for?

main2.line: Oh, you're lending me your jacket? You're good, aren't ya.

main3.line: You think I look taller than usual? Nah, I'm telling you, you're just imagining things... Oh no, wait, don't look down at my feet!

touch.line: Jeez, hey. Your eyes have been glued down there for some time now. You surely wouldn't mind telling me what you've been looking at, right, Commander?

touch2.line: Wait, I'll get banned from streaming...

unlock.line: Hass here. Tonight, we're going to take a walk around the port at night. Aaaand, we even have a special guest– the Commander! ...Psst, hey, look at the camera real quick!

battle.line: Don't underestimate a high-school girl!

couple_encourage1.line: Hass, let's head to the café after we're all done here!

couple_encourage2.line: Yume, we cool?

couple_encourage3.line: Rikka, I'm counting on you!

detail.line: Yo, Commander! Got some juicy gossip for me? Like, any news on who's into who~?

expedition.line: Great job out there, everyone! Wow, that's an equally impressive haul of rewards!

feeling1.line: H-hey, need something from me?

feeling3.line: Commander, you on Juustagram as well? If so, gimme your ID so I can follow you~!

home.line: Welcome back! Let's hurry on over to the café~

hp_warning.line: As if I'd let you stop me here!

login.line: sup, Commander, good morning! Just barely beat the bell, huh?

lose.line: Stop! Time out! I give up, so stop firing at meeee!

main2.line: Woah! That's a crazy amount of paperwork you've got on your desk, Commander. Your job's pretty rough, isn't it?

main3.line: Huh, so this academy offers different classes for different ship types? That's pretty neat, but I'm not exactly the studious–– Ehh? Commander, where are you taking me?!

mission.line: You still have work you haven't finished, right? Shouldn't you go take care of it first?

mission_complete.line: Great job, Commander! You're all done with work!

skill.line: Let's take 'em out in one shot!

touch.line: Ooh, you even have your own social media-looking thing over here. Woah, this shop's sweets look freakin' amazing. Commander, wanna come with?

touch2.line: Nope! No touching! Hands off!

unlock.line: Heyyo, it's Namiko! Uhh, wait, is this that whole getting-reincarnated-in-another-world thing that's been super popular? ...It's not, huh. Well, in any case, nice to meet you!

upgrade.line: All right, now I'm all fired up! Thanks a bunch!

win_mvp.line: Booyah! Pretty badass, aren't I?

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me?! I love this stuff, you know! You're seriously a genius, Commander!

battle_ex.line: Let's go all out~!

detail_ex.line: So, Commander, you definitely have someone you're crushin' on, right? ...Seriously, you don't? C'mon, don't be like that. Just between the two of us, I swear I won't tell anyone?

feeling5_ex.line: Oh, Commander! You'd better not forget to come to the next tea party! Heh heh, I swear I'll show you why I'm awesome!

login_ex.line: Huh, you're pretty early today. Did something good happen?

main4_ex.line: Oy, Commander, wake up! Do you really have time to laze around when you still have so much work left?

main5_ex.line: Hm? Need me to help with your work? Sure, but you owe me juice afterwards~

main6_ex.line: The girls here are all such pearls, you know that? I promised to go on vacation with them the next time we have time off. I'm really looking forward to it~

mission_ex.line: Huh? You're still not done with work? I'll lend a hand, so let's tackle this one step at a time.

mission_complete_ex.line: We're finally done! Now, go get me that can of juice you promised!

touch2_ex.line: W-w-w-wait a minute! Do you have any idea what you're doing?!

win_mvp_ex.line: That attack... was TOTALLY BADASS!

main2.line: Commander, I'm feeling a bit peckish... Huh? You're gonna treat me? Thanks a bunch!

couple_encourage1.line: Chise! Over here!

couple_encourage2.line: We're in this together, Mujina!

couple_encourage3.line: Namiko? Umm... Let's give it our best shot.

couple_encourage4.line: Cover me!

expedition.line: Oh, looks like the commission team's come back.

feeling1.line: Look, I... I'm sorry.

feeling3.line: What is it this time? Hey, wait... That's one of my plushes. Thanks for bringing it to me, Commander.

feeling4.line: Every place has its own rules and restrictions. Sometimes, though, you need to break the rules to do what's right... You know what I mean?

feeling5.line: While I'm still getting used to living here, I wanna do anything I can to help... I'll keep fighting the good fight, even if I slip up along the way.

home.line: Good to see you again, Commander. You should take a quick break before the battle.

hp_warning.line: I'm doing fine...!

login.line: Hello and good morning. What are we practicing today?

lose.line: Okay, this is so not good... We've gotta get out of here, guys!

touch2.line: Seriously...?

upgrade.line: I won't fall behind.

win_mvp.line: Phew... I managed.

gift_prefer.line: Huh? I can have this? ...I'm so happy.

battle_ex.line: Enemy fleet incoming... Ready up, everyone!

login_ex.line: Surely the Commander isn't going to be late to work, right...

main6_ex.line: I'm usually uncomfortable in places with lots of people, but with how friendly all the shipgirls here are, I think I'll slowly fit in...

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission completed. Great job, Commander.

win_mvp_ex.line: We were able to come together as one, right?

main2.line: We're actually kind of stranded, yet everyone seems cool with it... I know it's crazy to think, but do you have the power to make everyone calm?

main3.line: Hm? What is it? Come on, you've obviously got SOMETHING on your mind... You're weird.

touch.line: I'm fine. I don't feel cold at all... Although, I do appreciate the thought.

touch2.line: Please, I don't need help getting dressed. I assumed that was kind of obvious.

unlock.line: You're wondering why I'm so carefree? Uhh... Because I'm comfortable with you... Let's leave it at that.

battle.line: I can fight too, you know!

couple_encourage1.line: Leave it to me, Yume!

couple_encourage2.line: Yesterday's enemy is today's ally, as they say!

couple_encourage3.line: You're super cool, Akane!

detail.line: Oh, if it isn't the Commander~! I'm in the middle of playing a game, did you need something?

expedition.line: Oh, it looks like they're back! I wonder if they brought back any souvenirs~?

feeling1.line: Commander, you're the exact type of person that I don't want to become when I grow up.

feeling2.line: You want to know what's under this arm sleeve? Of course, it's a secret~! Oh, and if you try to take a peek when I'm asleep, I'll get really mad at you!

feeling3.line: When I look at this rigging, I can't help but think of you. I wonder what you're up to, my friend, the coolest one in the world...

feeling4.line: Looks like you're busy as usual, Commander... Oh, right. Would you mind if I tried helping you with your work? I think I could help you out with some stuff, at least.

feeling5.line: Commander, you were my first friend in this world! Thanks for bringing me along to all of the cool places here!

headtouch.line: I-I don't know why, but it's a bit embarrassing...

home.line: Good work on your mission, Commander! Take me with you next time! I don't mind even if it's just as an extra!

hp_warning.line: The real battle starts now!

login.line: Commander, you seem like you didn't get enough sleep? It's time to start working though, so please waaake up!

lose.line: Ehhhh, no way, no way! I've actually been useless this whole time?!

mail.line: Commander, there's a letter for you~! I wonder if it's from your lover~?

main1.line: Hmm, so there's a school here as well. Huh, you're asking me if I want to attend? No way, I'd rather not if I don't have to!

main2.line: Sit! Lay down! Paw! Oh, Commander, these Meowfficers are so dang smart! I'm taking a walk with them for a bit!

main3.line: Hey, Commander! Huh, you look a bit tired... Here, I bought some candy earlier, so you can have one.

mission.line: You want me to handle the remaining missions for you?! ......Heh, as if I'd ever get to say that...

mission_complete.line: Mission complete~! By the way, how much am I getting paid per hour?

profile.line: I'm Chise Asukagawa, and I'm currently an aircraft carrier at this port! It's a completely new experience fighting at sea, but it's pretty fun! I'm so glad that my arm sleeve from my former world is waterproof~

propose.line: Coming to this world, fighting together with everyone else, I've had tons of fun! This is all thanks to you, Commander... I'm really, truly grateful for all you've done for me!

skill.line: This is my time to shine!|Burn to ashes! Goldburn!

touch.line: Y'know~ It's pretty amazing how hard you work every day. Is this what it's like to be a professional?

touch2.line: Uegh. Is that what you're into...

unlock.line: Woahhh, I somehow ended up in a totally unknown place... Oh, um, my name's Chise Asukagawa! Since I might be here for a while, thanks for looking after me!

upgrade.line: Chise, powering up! Thankies, Commander!

win_mvp.line: Ohmygawd, ohmygawd! Did you see that! I won!

gift_prefer.line: Whoa, that's so generous of you, Commander! Thankies!

battle_ex.line: Everyone, let's go get'em~!

detail_ex.line: Commander! Take me somewhere fun~! I'm so sick and tired of watching TV in this room.

feeling5_ex.line: Huh? Commander? What's with your expression? ...Is there something you're worrying about? If you'd like, I'd be willing to lend an ear. We're friends, after all.

login_ex.line: Hey, looks like you're all chipper this morning. Good ol' Commander, you~!

main4_ex.line: Even the Commander dozes off from time to time, huh. Well, I guess I can slack off for a bit. I wonder if there's anything interesting here...

main5_ex.line: This office is so clean, even though there are so many things here. Who's in charge of cleaning it?

main6_ex.line: This place is surrounded by the sea, right? Does that mean that I could swim every day when it's hot out if I wanted to?!

mission_ex.line: Chop chop, hurry and wrap up those missions, so we can go somewhere together~

mission_complete_ex.line: Commander~! A bunch of stuff arrived because you finished those missions~!

touch2_ex.line: Wha, Commander! I'll call the police on you!

win_mvp_ex.line: Commander~! Were you watching~!

detail.line: It's still raining a bit... Huh, don't you have an umbrella, Commander? Well, would you like to share this one then?

home.line: Welcome back... Wait, Commander, you're soaked from the rain! Let me bring a towel for you!

login.line: Today's weather forecast said the sky would clear up after some rain... It's been raining since earlier, so it should be sunny for the rest of the day!

main1.line: Ahaha, look at me, I'm flying! Oh, isn't that where we were deployed last time?

main2.line: Mmn... I don't see a rainbow... Commander, you should help me look for one too!

main3.line: Commander, come on, jump a bit higher! ...Yay, you're on! Well then, let's head out!

touch.line: Commander, do you want some candy as well? I think I still have one last one in my pocket...

touch2.line: Eek! I-I could fall, you know!

unlock.line: Woaah, the sun's coming out! It feels so great outside after the rain... Oh, Commander! Let's take a stroll through the sky together!

detail.line: I don't have many clothes to begin with, so if I don't wash 'em right away... What's that? You'll buy me clothes, Commander?

home.line: Good work today. Whoa, you're kinda sweaty and gross... But in your case, the dirt doesn't tarnish your honor!

login.line: Oh, hey! You playing hooky, too, Commander?

main1.line: Oooh, you look like you just can't get your mind off me~

main2.line: Must be nice, being able to just relax with an empty mind all the time...

main3.line: Commander, has anyone ever told you that you lack delicacy?! Meh, not that I care...

touch.line: I'm fine. It's not like I'm gonna catch a cold, or anything. But... Thank you for worrying about me, okay?

touch2.line: Hey! I won't have anything to wear if you get this dirty!

unlock.line: Aww man, I hate to be seen in such a lazy-looking outfit. It's embarrassing, y'know~?

battle.line: Can I leave once we're done here?

couple_encourage1.line: So you're the Dyna Wing girl, huh...

couple_encourage2.line: Up and at 'em, Chise.

couple_encourage3.line: You can... create kaijus, Akane?

detail.line: Didn't I tell you I'm a kaiju user when I first arrived here? What else do you need to know?

expedition.line: Seems the commission team is back. Mind if I sit this one out?

feeling1.line: I don't know what I was expecting from a world without kaijus...

feeling2.line: Good god, I'm hungry. I'd kill for a hot stew or something... Know any good restaurants, Commander?

feeling3.line: What is my goal in this new place...? Right now, I honestly don't know. I'll figure it out one day.

feeling4.line: You're glad to have someone helpful like me around? I see... I don't think I've done much, but all right.

feeling5.line: What's my purpose in this world? The answer to that should become clearer as I fight alongside the shipgirls.

headtouch.line: What?! A kaiju?! ...Oh. Never mind then.

home.line: Ah, you're back. That means my work here is done. Can I return to my room now?

hp_warning.line: Not yet! I'm not done yet!

login.line: Ah, you've come. What's on the schedule today?

lose.line: We lost... But we should be able to do better next time.

mail.line: Your mail's here. You should probably go take a look.

main1.line: You sure have a lot of leisure facilities here. Do you also have a pool or hot spring, by any chance? It's been ages since I went to one...

main2.line: Riggings... Machines... Robots... Oh, nothing, just thinking aloud. Be back soon, I'm going for a walk.

main3.line: Sleeping on the job when you've got so much left to do? My advice: get up and put your nose to the grindstone.

mission.line: Oh, Commander, I saw you still had some unfinished missions on your desk. Are you sure you don't have somewhere else to be?

mission_complete.line: Well done. The fruits of your labor are waiting for you. Don't forget to claim them.

profile.line: I'm Mujina, kaiju user. In my home world, I was a Kaiju Eugenicist. Now, I fight alongside those I considered my enemies... What a bizarre twist of fate.

propose.line: In my home world, I couldn't imagine what I'd do if kaijus disappeared... But after spending some time with you, I think I know what I'd do now. Thank you, Commander.

touch.line: Instance Domination! ...Doesn't work on Sirens, I suppose.

touch2.line: Um... What are you doing?

unlock.line: Kaiju Eugenicist, Mujina. I suppose I'm a battleship now. Just asking to be sure... There are no kaiju in your world, correct?

upgrade.line: Whew... That's really invigorating.

win_mvp.line: All done over here. Now it's time to... What? We aren't finished yet?

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander. I've wanted this for a long time.

battle_ex.line: I will crush you... No matter what!

detail_ex.line: How old am I? Well... 5,000 years... Yeah...

feeling5_ex.line: Oh, time to sortie soon? Take me with you. You'll want a battleship like me... Yeah, that'll be great.

login_ex.line: Good morning. Still feeling tired? You should go wash your face.

main4_ex.line: You poor overworked soul... Do you need a hand? I've got nothing better to do right now.

main5_ex.line: I like how lax this coat is. Although, it's not so great in winter.

main6_ex.line: Say, Commander, do you wanna watch a movie I borrowed from a friend? ...What's it about? Fairly sure it involves crabs one way or another.

mission_ex.line: These missions still aren't done? Let's get to it then. I'll assist you.

mission_complete_ex.line: Outstanding job on that mission. Get cozy and I'll make you something to eat.

win_mvp_ex.line: Interesting. I'm a little wiser than I was a minute ago.

detail.line: It's nice to wear something a bit different from usual, though it's making me feel slightly nerv– Ah! What a strong breeze...

home.line: These gingko leaves are so gorgeous. Autumn is in the air, quite literally.

login.line: Ah, Commander. Why are you out so early in the morning?

main1.line: Could we sit for a minute? Ahh, it's so relaxing being next to you. Makes me... sleepy... Zzz...

main2.line: Got time to spare, Commander? Then we could go somewhere before we head home.

main3.line: I got these freshly-baked baguettes at a store just earlier. They smell so good... I can't wait to get home and eat them.

touch.line: Hm? We should take some time to rest? Sure. Let's check out that café over there.

touch2.line: D-do you do this to everyone, or...?!

unlock.line: You've come as well, Commander? In that case, let's accompany each other back while watching the gingko leaves fall.

battle.line: Come, everyone! Let's do our best!

couple_encourage1.line: That altitude isn't enough for you, is it?

couple_encourage2.line: Chise, I expect you to do your best here, too.

couple_encourage3.line: You're here with everyone, too? Hmm, isn't that nice?

detail.line: Not quite Kaiju, but similar to Kaiju... Maybe there is a reason we were brought to this world, after all.

expedition.line: The errand girls are back. Let's go greet them.

feeling1.line: *sigh*... I suppose it's all part of the job.

feeling2.line: Do you have shops around here? Mmm... Maybe I'll go and waste some money.

feeling3.line: Thank you for your work, Commander. You must be busy, but take breaks when possible, okay?

feeling4.line: Oh? Commander, have I caught you during rare downtime? Then how about we go on a date? My treat!

feeling5.line: Heehee, it's all so fun. Both our worlds are full of human activity and those who protect them... I think it's wonderful.

headtouch.line: Huh?! Um, what's the matter?

home.line: Oh, welcome back. I'm glad you've returned in one piece.

hp_warning.line: I could really use a Fixer Beam right now... Can't do it? Figures...

login.line: Oh? So we meet again.

lose.line: Ouch, ouch... Maybe this is asking a little too much of me...

mail.line: Commander, you have messages awaiting your attention. Make sure you take a look.

main1.line: I was certain that a Kaiju would be involved in such a large-scale disaster...

main2.line: The weapons here are all smaller than Dynazenon, but they pack a real punch. How do they work?

main3.line: Would this world be better off, too, without Sirens...?

mission.line: Commander? Aren't you supposed to be in the middle of a job right now?

mission_complete.line: Yes, the mission is complete. Don't forget to grab the rewards.

profile.line: You may call me The 2nd. I work with the Gridknight Alliance to protect the world from all Kaiju threats... though I suppose things may be different here...

propose.line: Commander, I can't begin to explain how thankful I am for all of your help. But I... No, it's nothing. I want to repay you, so please think of a way for me to do that.

touch.line: What's that? Something seems different? Heheh, well, you see...

touch2.line: Commander, you're practically begging to get swallowed whole.

unlock.line: Oh, where am I now... Ah. Good to meet you. Call me The 2nd. I'm with the Gridknight Alliance... Not that it matters in this world, I'd assume.

upgrade.line: Maybe it's not so bad to pursue pure strength once in a while.

win_mvp.line: Phew. It feels different from the usual... but I think I've shown that I can handle it.

gift_prefer.line: Oh, thank you very much, Commander. I don't know how to begin to express my gratitude.

battle_ex.line: Now, Commander, I await your orders!

detail_ex.line: You should know that I'm keeping a terrible secret... Would you like me to share, Commander?

feeling5_ex.line: Because of our duties, our meeting is a once-in-a-lifetime blessing. I've accepted that by now, but... right now, the thought of it makes me so sad.

login_ex.line: Good morning. Let's give today our all!

main4_ex.line: You've done so much for me, Commander... I'll have to return the favor, don't you think?

main5_ex.line: I just hope that I can be of some help to your work...

main6_ex.line: There must be a reason I was brought to this world... I'm sure of it.

mission_ex.line: You haven't finished your work yet, have you? Let me help.

mission_complete_ex.line: Congratulations on a completed mission. Once you've finished checking your rewards, come for some tea.

touch2_ex.line: Mmheheheh...

win_mvp_ex.line: Was I able to help you at all...?

detail.line: I always dress like this at home. Not that it's quite my favorite, but... I tend to pick whatever is comfy and easy to wear.

home.line: Sorry, I couldn't get dressed in time... You like it? O-oh... Well, in that case, I...

login.line: I don't have much in the way of hospitality, but feel free to relax.

main1.line: My place doesn't look lived-in? Well, I'm a busy woman... How about you pick some nice things for me, Commander?

main2.line: You don't know where is safe to look? Aren't you the one in the wrong for being here?!

main3.line: This outfit is cheap, well-made, and comfortable. A real triple threat.

touch.line: Excuse you! I'll have you know I'm well-bathed! ...Though a lot of the time, I just shower instead...

touch2.line: I wouldn't recommend touching me too much.

unlock.line: Would you mind waiting a moment? I just have this one report. Oh, and can I interest you in coffee, Commander? Ah... Sorry, this is my only mug. We could... share it?

battle.line: Listen, everyone! Take pride in wiping out the enemy! Begin the assault!

couple_encourage1.line: That power... Chise, you have the power to tame a dragon?

couple_encourage2.line: Akane... What's with you?

couple_encourage3.line: I'm delighted that you're joining us in battle, The 2nd.

detail.line: I don't know what brought me here... Has fate cursed me yet again? It has put yet more distance between me and him...

expedition.line: Your errand girls have returned. It's the gentlefolks' obligation to greet the commoners, so let us move!

feeling1.line: Word of advice – you should learn how to read peoples' feelings.

feeling2.line: Food and drinks the likes of which I've never seen. A story that warms the heart... What a lovely place this is.

feeling3.line: The people here all approach me naturally, paying no mind to my status... Although, that makes me think of HIM...

feeling4.line: What's up, Commander? You're always looking in my direction... Oh, that's it! You've fallen for my gorgeous looks!

feeling5.line: Sooo, listen, because of my position as a princess, I've never really been in this situation, and I don't know how I'm supposed to respond... I'd PREFER it if you'd get a clue!

headtouch.line: Uhh, not too much casual intimacy, or my Royal Guard will be livid.

home.line: Welcome back! You must be worn out. Go on, dust off and kick back.

hp_warning.line: I wonder in times like this... what if I were them...

login.line: Heya, Commander. Did you sleep well? Nice, nice. It's important to always get your beauty sleep.

lose.line: Owch... Time to pull out! Everyone, turn around! Double-time, go!

mail.line: Commander, there's a missive addressed to you. Give it a read.

main1.line: Hey, Commander, if you have a minute, how about some tea? Have to say, it's awesome tasting all these drinks I've never seen before.

main2.line: Shipgirls blow my mind. They could go toe to toe with a kaiju, unaided... Might they be stronger than a dragon?

main3.line: *sigh*, I'm getting sloppy without others to attend to me... Oh! Forget you saw that, Commander!

mission.line: Commander, it's not appropriate to leave work undone and roam about.

mission_complete.line: Task complete. Well done. Now don't forget to claim your rewards.

profile.line: I am a whisperer of dragons, and... No, screw this! I hate coming off as overly formal, so can we leave it at "I'm an enigmatic princess"? It's more mysterious that way, which I like.

propose.line: I never tire of hearing the things you tell me, and time spent with you is always a treat... I thank you will all my heart for your treatment.

skill.line: It is time to unleash the power inside of me!

touch.line: Oh dear, casual contact... That ain't gonna fly. Don't forget that I'm basically nobility!

touch2.line: Do you know what my Royal Guard will do to you for touching me?

unlock.line: What? Where am I? Oh, umm, what may you need of me, young one? ...You don't need anything? Ahahah... Well met, person from this strange land. My name is... You know what, just call me "Princess Hime."

upgrade.line: So this is what it feels like to gain new strength...

win_mvp.line: Yeah! We won! This worked out nicely, even though fighting isn't really my style.

gift_prefer.line: Huh? For me? Thanks! Wow!!! I'm so happy!

battle_ex.line: Raise a war cry! Show them your might! Attaaack!

detail_ex.line: No matter the era, those who wield superhuman power are labeled gods, worshipped, and feared... Although, being a god sounds terrible to me.

feeling5_ex.line: I think we've formed a true bond. However, in the truest sense, we come from different worlds. Even if we can't change this fact, we have to look to the future and not linger on the past forever...

login_ex.line: Heyo, Commander! So glad to see you again... No, I mean it!

main4_ex.line: There's so much tasty food in this world. Especially seafood! Crab has got to be one of my favorites.

main5_ex.line: What power runs this world? It can't be dragon power, surely. Hmm... The mystery deepens further.

main6_ex.line: So hey, I'm basically of noble birth. But don't let that change your attitude towards me, okay?

mission_ex.line: You still have work to do! Stop being lazy and finish what you started.

mission_complete_ex.line: Way to go! I'll make some tea – c'mere and rest for a bit, why don'tcha?

win_mvp_ex.line: Well done. I hope I was able to be of at least some use to you.

detail.line: I don't ALWAYS dress up like a princess, you know. Even I deserve some private time!

home.line: Worn out, Commander? Then why don't you sit down and have a drink with me?

login.line: Seafood paired with a lovely cup of sake. Oh, what a delight♪

main1.line: Oh, the bliss of having so much fresh seafood. Straight out of the sea and ready to eat! It can't be legal to be this happy~

main2.line: Hey, wouldn't you agree that sake tasting so good with food is proof that the world is full of light?

main3.line: There are three things in the world you as a human being must respect. Love, promises, aaand...

touch.line: Why, yes, this is made of fairly fancy fabric. That's to be expected for someone of my standing, no?

touch2.line: Heheh. Nope, that's off limits. I get why you'd want to try, though.

unlock.line: Oh! Guess you found me... Look, it doesn't matter what I wear when I'm drinking at home... What's that? Does me being a bit flushed from the drinks really get you that fired up?

battle.line: Alrighty, let's make a splash!

couple_encourage1.line: I'm glad we get to go on another adventure together, Klaudia!

couple_encourage2.line: I'm counting on you, Lila!

couple_encourage3.line: Patty, how've you been?

detail.line: Hey, Commander, do you know if I can get some sort of big pot from Akashi? It'd be nice to have an alchemy cauldron I can use here...

expedition.line: The girls are back from their errand! I wonder what materials they managed to bring back.

feeling1.line: A quest? I'm not sure if I... Huh, there'll be rewards? Then, count me in!

feeling2.line: Mm, what a wonderful day! Let's go explore for something new and exciting!

feeling3.line: I bet there's all sorts of interesting materials in the mountains behind the port, right? Huh? You'll take me there yourself? Sweet, thanks a bunch!

feeling4.line: Hey Commander, want to come fishing with me? ...Hm, you don't have any gear for it? Not a problem. I've got a special fishing rod here that I made myself! Give it a while, and you'll be able to reel in a ton of fish!

feeling5.line: What a peaceful day... I'm sure the reason everyone is able to enjoy ordinary lives here at port is because of your hard work. Thank you for everything you do, Commander!

headtouch.line: Oh! It's a barrel!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! How'd your adventure go? I wanna hear all about it over some tea!

hp_warning.line: I'm only getting started!

login.line: Oh, it's you, Commander! What new adventures will we go on today?

lose.line: Aww, I was so sure we had 'em... Anyway, let's retreat for now!

mail.line: A letter's come in! I wonder what's in it~

main1.line: While this place isn't as big as the royal capital, it's still bustling with activity. I've gotta keep an eye out so I don't get lost.

main2.line: Yikes! Monsters! ...Oh, these little guys are called "Meowfficers?" Aww, they're actually pretty cute!

main3.line: You've got a school here? I actually used to teach on the island I come from. Though, all my students were little kids since I wasn't a formal classroom teacher or anything.

main4.line: So these are Augment Modules...? The nitty-gritty details are lost on me, but combining ingredients to make and upgrade something sounds pretty similar to alchemy. Mind if I watch you work on them?

main5.line: Drake! I heard you're putting together a crew to go on an adventure. Mind if I come along?! ...Hooray! Alright then, let's decide where to go!

mission.line: Commandeeer! You've still got work to take care of. Are you sure you can just leave it lying around?

mission_complete.line: Woah, look at all these materials! Oh, Commander, are these your mission rewards?

profile.line: I'm the alchemist, Reisalin Stout, but all my friends just call me Ryza. Alchemy is a pretty profound thing, you know. With enough creativity, you can turn even the simplest things into all kinds of neat stuff!

propose.line: Eh, you're giving this to me?! I don't know what to say... This has to be the most excited I've been since I came to this world... Thank you so much, Commander. I'll have to work extra hard to reciprocate your feelings!

touch.line: You want to know what can be made with alchemy? Hmm... I'm not sure how to sum it up neatly, but you can make pretty much anything as long as you have the right materials.

touch2.line: ...I was just thinking about testing out this new bomb I synthesized.

unlock.line: Hey there! I'm Reisalin Stout, but you can just call me Ryza. I'm not really sure what this whole "shipgirl" thing is, but I'm sure I'll figure it out eventually... In any case, it's a pleasure to meet you!

upgrade.line: Mhm, I can feel my skills improving! Thanks, Commander!

win_mvp.line: A flawless victory! I knew I could do it!

gift_prefer.line: Whoa, I think I can make something really amazing with these materials! Thanks, I'll put them to good use!

ryza_item1.line: Woohoo! I caught a big one!

ryza_item2.line: I might be able to make a bomb with this.

ryza_item3.line: I think I saw a yellow bird take off holding one of these...

ryza_item4.line: Gotta be careful so this doesn't overload my rigging.

ryza_item5.line: This thing is brimming with power!

battle_ex.line: Ready to do this, everyone?

detail_ex.line: Hehe. Commander, welcome to my atelier! Okay, I'm just kidding. Anyway, grab a seat and I'll bring you a cup of tea!

feeling5_ex.line: If there's ever anything on your mind, you can come straight to me! I want to do everything I can to support the person who lets us all live ordinary lives in this world!

login_ex.line: I can't wait to see what adventures we're in for today. Aren't you excited, Commander?

main6_ex.line: Good moooorning– Wait, oh. The Commander's sleeping like a log. Things have been pretty hectic around here lately, so maybe I should help by synthesizing some fatigue-relieving potions.

main7_ex.line: I saw they're serving creamy pasta with Uni in the canteen today. That's Uni as in the things that grow into trees, right? Hm? They're seafood, not fruits? Huh, guess they're different from the kind of Uni I know.

main8_ex.line: These species of flowers and plants don't even exist back in my world. I wonder what you'd get if you used them for alchemy!

main9_ex.line: Teaching a whole class is seriously exhausting, isn't it, Z23? I felt at my wit's end all the time when I was a teacher. Especially with the little rebels who acted like my younger self would...

main10_ex.line: Whatcha doing there, Bristol? ...Oh, investigating mysteries surrounding the port? Sounds fun! Can I go mystery-solving with you?

mission_ex.line: Looks like you've still got work to do, Commander. I'll brew an energy potion for you. Be sure to drink it so you can knock out every last task!

mission_complete_ex.line: Great work, Commander! Come on, I think it's time for you to take a break!

touch2_ex.line: Woah, woah, easy there! I know we've gotten closer, but we're not THAT close!

win_mvp_ex.line: Aw yeah, we won! And it's all thanks to you, Commander!

detail.line: I love how soft and fluffy this pillow is. I'm sure I'll be getting a great night's rest. Want to give it a feel, Commander?

home.line: Great work today, Commander! Would you like me to give you a shoulder massage? ...Okay, come lie down over here!

login.line: Zzzzz... *gasp*! G-g-good evening, Commander!

main1.line: I went exploring in the hills this morning, and then I went to a café with Klaudia and Patty. What a great day it's been... What have you been up to, Commander?

main2.line: *yaaawn*... Maybe I am starting to get sleepy after all... Oh, Commander, you're already fast asleep? Guess I'll hit the hay too then.

main3.line: Good night, Commander. Let's go on adventure tomorrow!

main4.line: There you are, Klaudia! We've got tons to chat about tonight! ...Oh, you think my PJs are cute? Ehehe, you're going to make me blush if you keep saying that!

main5.line: I spotted Serri not too long ago. She was headed towards the front door... Where do you think she's going this late at night?

main6.line: Come in, Ayanami! Hey, what's that box you've got? A game console? You can plug it into a TV and play games? Ooh, sounds fun! Show me how to use it!

main7.line: I could use something to eat... Oh, right, I still have the snacks Dunkerque gave me! ...Mmm! So yummy! It amazes me how she can bake pastries that taste THIS good.

touch.line: Hungry? I thought you might be, so... Tadaaah! I got us some snacks! There's cookies, chocolate, and more... What would you like, Commander?

touch2.line: Eep!

unlock.line: Hey there, Commander! Hehe, it's been a long while since I had a sleepover with someone. You know, I've really been looking forward to today. So, what would you like to do first?

detail.line: Akashi taught me how to use this thing, but it's just so complicated. We alchemists know that sometimes, you just gotta give it a try and see what happens!

home.line: I get too worried if I'm not watching it closely... Wait, Commander?! How long have you been there?

login.line: Hey, umm... You mind waiting a little longer?

main1.line: I think I'm getting the hang of this. It's definitely not my imagination. This is going to taste good... Show 'em what you've got, Ryza!

main2.line: This machine is awesome. You can't control the heat of a campfire easily, but this does it instantly. I'll have to ask Akashi if she thinks alchemy can do this.

main3.line: What kinds of things can I mix in this world? I should see if I can replicate tools from our world using similar materials!

touch.line: W-wait! Don't mess with it! I already don't know what's going on, and you're making it worse!

touch2.line: Geez! Do you want to distract me that badly?

unlock.line: Oh, do I have it on too high? It's burning in there... Or maybe that's just soot? Hmm... This machine is convenient and all, but I can't get the hang of it. What do I do now, Commander?

battle.line: I can keep going - I'm just as capable of fighting!

couple_encourage1.line: I'm so happy to see you again, Ryza!

couple_encourage2.line: Miss Lila, I'll support you!

couple_encourage3.line: I'll let you know if I find anything, Miss Serri.

detail.line: Huh? You'd like to know more about me? Then, how about we head inside and have a little chat? I'll go prepare the tea and snacks.

expedition.line: It looks like the commission team has returned. Commander, let's go welcome them back!

feeling1.line: Fine. I suppose it's just business...

feeling2.line: Looks like there's a lot of work to get through today... But, if the two of us work together, I'm sure we'll be done in no time. Let's both do our best.

feeling3.line: Commander, it's amazing how thorough your work is considering your busy schedule. I have a lot to learn from you still...

feeling4.line: We've barely just started, and you're already blazing through your work. What's your secret, Commander?

feeling5.line: Here you go, Commander. This tea is supposed to help you relax. I saw it at the store yesterday and thought of you, so I decided to buy some.

headtouch.line: Do you need any help with your accounting? My father entrusted me with that kind of work back in my world, so I'm pretty confident in my abilities.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. We still have work to do... but how about taking a little break first?

hp_warning.line: I'm not done yet!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Let's work hard today!

lose.line: I-is everyone alright?! Hurry, we need to tend to the injured!

mail.line: Commander, there's mail for you. I left it on your desk, so please have a look as soon as possible.

main1.line: I can't believe I'm going on yet another adventure with Ryza and the others... It's truly a miracle.

main2.line: When I visited the store earlier, I couldn't help but notice Miss Akashi's business acumen. As a fellow merchant, it was quite an eye-opening experience.

main3.line: The Commander's looked pretty out of it for a while... We're at a pretty good stopping point with the work, so maybe I should suggest taking a break...

main4.line: Miss Shiranui is quite a proficient saleswoman. There are plenty of talented people at my company, but Shiranui would make a great addition to the team.

main5.line: Miss Shoukaku's flute is a transverse one like mine, but has a completely different sound... What a distinctive and beautiful tone!

mission.line: Commander, I believe you still have some missions left to take care of. I've already ordered them for you, so why don't you get them out of the way first?

mission_complete.line: Um, let me check on your rewards... Yup, they've arrived without any issues!

profile.line: My name is Klaudia Valentz. Back in my world, I used to work for my father, a traveling merchant. When I arrived here, I was so worried I'd never be able to see Ryza and the others ever again, but I'm so glad we were able to be reunited!

propose.line: I'm really glad I was able to come to this world. I was able to reunite with Ryza and the others, and I also got to meet a wonderful person - you, Commander. Let's treasure our time together and keep working hard!

touch.line: I've never been good at making friends... But thanks to the kindness everyone here at port has shown me, I've been having a great time and feel right at home.
