touch2.line: If you keep this up, it's going to be awkward being around you in the future.

unlock.line: It's a pleasure to meet you. My name is Klaudia Valentz, and due to various circumstances, it seems that I'll be staying here for the time being. Please let me know if there's anything I can help with!

upgrade.line: I never thought I could become this strong... Thank you, Commander.

win_mvp.line: We won! Let's keep up the good work.

gift_prefer.line: Huh?! Commander, how did you know what I like...? Thank you! I am so happy!

ryza_item1.line: Seems like this can be used as emergency food.

ryza_item2.line: They're so pretty, but Ryza probably doesn't see them as anything more than alchemy ingredients...

ryza_item3.line: Looks like we found some rare plants.

ryza_item4.line: Did these arrive in this world along with us?

ryza_item5.line: What's this? It's completely different from what we've found in the other ruins...

ryza_shop1.line: Welcome to the Item Shop. Feel free to pick out what you'd like!

ryza_shop2.line: What will you be getting today?

ryza_shop4.line: Is this what you want? You've got a good eye.

ryza_shop5.line: Seems like you've cleared out my entire stock. Excellent work, Commander!

battle_ex.line: We can do it if we work together...!

detail_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I just finished baking some cookies. It's been a while since I last made them, but I think they turned out pretty well... Would you like to have a taste?

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, you seem pretty busy today too. I hope you're not pushing yourself too hard though. After all, you are a precious friend to me.

login_ex.line: Commander, you still look pretty sleepy. Why don't you go wash up a bit? I'll get your work ready in the meantime.

main6_ex.line: I'll be going out for lunch with Ryza and the others later. Would you like to join us, Commander?

main7_ex.line: I've finished looking over those documents, but are we still not done on this end? ...Oh, did I wake you up? I'm still sorting out your paperwork, so you can rest a bit longer if you'd like.

main8_ex.line: The flute has such an exquisite voice in this piece... Actually, I can play a thing or two myself. Eh, you want me to play something for you? If it's for you, I suppose I can...

main9_ex.line: So, Miss Akashi, why don't you let me in to some of your business secrets? Huh? Where'd she go?

main10_ex.line: Miss Kazagumo? Oh, you were practicing the recorder? Haha, don't worry. You'll get better as long as you keep practicing. Once you've worked up your confidence, make sure to play for someone important to you!

mission_ex.line: Commander, you're at the final stretch! I'll help out too, so let's finish strong!

mission_complete_ex.line: Phew, it's finally over... Commander, you did a great job too. Want to unwind with a nice cup of tea?

touch2_ex.line: (What should I do? I don't want to ruin our working relationship...)

win_mvp_ex.line: Thank goodness we won... Great job, everyone!

detail.line: Feel free to pour yourself any of the drinks over there. By the way, I'd recommend the herbal tea. The fragrance is very relaxing, and it doesn't have any caffeine so it won't impact your sleep.

home.line: Good work today, Commander. I'm sure you must be tired, so please take it easy.

login.line: Good evening! I've been waiting all day to hear more of your stories.

main1.line: Whenever I reread my past diary entries, I think back at everything I've done since coming here. I've been through all sorts of things, but they've all become my precious memories.

main2.line: Would you like some cookies to go with your tea? I've been baking them whenever I have the time... Oh, they're better than the ones from before? Thank you!

main3.line: Thank you for telling me about all those stories. Sleep well, Commander!

main4.line: What are those drinks I have in my fridge? They're special smoothies I made with the herbs Miss Serri suggested. I was wondering if my skin will become as smooth as hers after drinking them... Heehee.

main5.line: After I finish my diary entry, I'll be heading to a slumber party with Ryza and the others! I haven't had many experiences staying up late with friends before, so I'm pretty excited. I wonder what it'll be like?

main6.line: Today, I joined in on a study session Miss Swiftsure was hosting. I learned a lot about fighting tactics and shipgirls.

main7.line: I found out Miss Tirpitz also plays the flute. We ended up talking a lot, and we're going to be performing together in the near future. It's super nerve-wracking thinking about putting on a show with someone else, but I'm really looking forward to it!

touch.line: ...Alright, that's a good place to leave off for today! Commander, thank you so much for helping out. So, what should we do now? Will you go to sleep? Or... would you like to chat for a bit?

touch2.line: Eeek?! Jeez... You almost made me spill my tea!

unlock.line: Hehe, today was such a fun day... Oh, good evening, Commander. I was just writing my diary entry for the day. Since you're here, why don't you help me out?

battle.line: Don't let your guard down, no matter what kind of enemy you're up against!

couple_encourage1.line: New place, same old Miss Ryza.

couple_encourage2.line: So this is how Oren warriors fight...

couple_encourage3.line: You know, Miss Serri's age... Eep! Nevermind!

detail.line: This room is rather small compared to what I have back in my world, but it somehow puts my mind at ease...

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I wonder what they've brought this time...

feeling1.line: If you have no need of me, I shall take my leave.

feeling2.line: Commander, do you need something? Oh? You'd like to show me around the port? Thank you very much. To be honest, I'm still having much trouble finding my way around as a new arrival.

feeling3.line: I wonder if this stone can be used for alchemy... Ah, my apologies. When adventuring with Ryza and the others, we usually gathered materials as we walked.

feeling4.line: It's important to speak your mind freely, Commander, if anything's bothering you, you can share the burden with me. If nothing else, I can at least listen.

feeling5.line: To be honest, when I first arrived here, I kept asking myself, "What sort of messed-up world is this?!" But, it didn't take long for this place to become my second home. And it's all thanks to your support, Commander.

headtouch.line: Wha-?! What's gotten into you?!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander... You're going right back to work? Good work ethic is a virtue, but you should still take some time to relax. I'll go and brew you some tea.

hp_warning.line: A powerful enemy, indeed...

login.line: Good morning. How should we start our work today?

lose.line: How could this happen... Everyone, please fall back immediately!

mail.line: Hmm, something just arrived in the mail... Oh, I wonder if it's a letter for the Commander.

main1.line: The people here at the port are so lively. I spent a lot of time with my friends back home, but most of them were more reserved in comparison. This has been quite a novel experience.

main2.line: What great timing, Commander. Would you mind showing me the way to this café? I was supposed to join Ryza and the others for tea, but I happened to get lost...

main3.line: This port is a veritable bounty of cuisines. Much of it differs from what I know, but all of it is delicious. Every day, I look forward to enjoying new foods.

main4.line: So that's the Knight of the Sea... I was expecting her to be rather unapproachable, but she's actually surprisingly easy to get along with. Hm? Would I like to... plant trees? I, I'm not sure why, but I don't mind coming along.

main5.line: Knowledgeable about tea AND ballroom dancing? Miss Hood is a model gentlewoman. I have much to learn from her...

mission.line: Your missions are really piling up. Would you like me to give you a hand?

mission_complete.line: Well done on your mission. I will leave your rewards right over here.

profile.line: My name is Patricia Abelheim. In my world, I was the daughter of a low-ranking noble family. As my father, a knight, provided me tutelage in swordsmanship, I am fairly confident in my skills. What's that? You'd like to see my techniques? Well, I suppose if the opportunity arises...

propose.line: I've come to see this place as home because you've always been watching over me, Commander. I'd like to do even more for you as a way of expressing my gratitude. Once again, thank you for looking after me.

skill.line: I'll show you what I'm made of!

touch.line: Eek, a bug! ...Th-thank you for brushing it off of me, Commander. I'm no good with bugs...

touch2.line: ...Do you want to be cut down?

unlock.line: Are you the Commander I've heard so much about? My name is Patricia Abelheim, but you can call me Patty. It's a pleasure to meet you. I suppose I will be counting on you for the time being.

upgrade.line: I won't let my experiences in this world go to waste.

win_mvp.line: Victory achieved, just as expected.

gift_prefer.line: This is really precious, right? Can I really have it? ...Thank you. I will treasure it.

ryza_item1.line: A banquet on the beach... Oh? You call it a barbecue here? The ladies of the Royal Navy are surprisingly easygoing...

ryza_item2.line: Crystals? Perhaps a source of capital for the port? Or... perhaps not.

ryza_item3.line: Hm? You don't mean to tell me this is rare in your world?

ryza_item4.line: Why would the Sirens be interested in meteors...?

ryza_item5.line: We must learn to wield the enemy's strength well if we are to protect our friends. Let's gather what we can.

battle_ex.line: An enemy attack! Everyone, be on alert!

detail_ex.line: Commander, one of your buttons is about to come off. Stop by my room, and I'll fix it up for you.

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, please take me with you on your next vacation. As I'm more familiar with this world now, I wanted to try taking a trip, but I don't feel safe alone. I'd be much more confident with you by my side.

login_ex.line: You never cease to impress, Commander. I haven't seen you show up late a single time.

main6_ex.line: I went to a tea party hosted by the Royal Navy the other day. They all conducted themselves flawlessly... As the daughter of a noble family, I have much to learn from them.

main7_ex.line: So this is your office... It reminds me of my father's quarters.

main8_ex.line: Commander, excuse m—Oh, you're sound asleep? You might catch a cold like this though... Let me see if there's a blanket lying around.

main9_ex.line: Oh? I'm invited to attend today's tea party as well? Thank you very much. In return, I'll bring more of those sweets you said you enjoyed the last time.

main10_ex.line: I've seen many maids and butlers in my own world, but none as perfect as Miss Belfast. So devoted, yet also stern at times... She's certainly someone I want by my side.

mission_ex.line: Let's finish our remaining missions quickly. I'll do everything I can to help you.

mission_complete_ex.line: Well done. Once you've sorted out your rewards, would you like to have a tea break? I've even prepared sweets.

touch2_ex.line: I assume you're ready to face the consequences?

win_mvp_ex.line: That went well. Good work, everybody.

detail.line: When I change into pajamas, I feel myself loosening up... Hm? I'm free to relax even more? Then just this once... I suppose I could indulge myself.

home.line: Yaaaawn... No! Don't you fall asleep yet, Patty. The Commander's coming soon... Ah! Commander, good work today.

login.line: How peaceful... I don't mind evenings like this every once in a while.

main1.line: Zzz, zzz... Mm... Huh? Commander, why are you here...?

main2.line: What's the matter? You seem restless. I don't believe I've put anything odd in here?

main3.line: Good night, Commander. I'll see you in the morning.

main4.line: I ran into Miss Lila in the hallway. She seems entirely different in her pajamas. Is that what it means to be mature...?

main5.line: Miss Klaudia took to work at the port astoundingly fast. I have to respect her quick wits.

main6.line: Hm? What was that hooting? ...Ooh, it's Miss Perseus's bird. Those wings look so soft. I wonder if she'd let me touch them...

main7.line: What in the world was with Miss Belfast at today's tea party? Um... "Little Bel?" I see... With other worlds come otherworldly occurrences.

touch.line: These pajamas are wonderfully comfortable. I always sleep soundly in them.

touch2.line: Letting you into my room was a mistake.

unlock.line: Phew, that's everything taken care of for the day... Huh?! Commander, how long have you been there?! I-I apologize for letting you see my slovenly side... Please, just come over here for now.

battle.line: It's the enemy! I'll lead the charge!

couple_encourage1.line: I'll handle this, Ryza!

couple_encourage2.line: You're in good form, Patricia.

couple_encourage3.line: Let us both fulfill our duties, Serri.

detail.line: I appreciate the furniture, but the room needs a bit of tidying up first. It's just... too much of a hassle to do it myself.

expedition.line: The commission team you sent out has returned. Now, let's see what they've brought back...

feeling1.line: Enough is enough. I have to find a way back home...

feeling2.line: What is it, Commander? If you have business with me, keep it brief.

feeling3.line: There is something I must accomplish. Until it is done, I have not a single moment to squander.

feeling4.line: I journey to fulfill my oath, whereas you fight to protect the peace... We each have our own duty, and in that way, we might be similar.

feeling5.line: I finally understand your resolve, Commander. I will acknowledge it by vowing to lend you my strength for as long as I stay in your world.

headtouch.line: You need a hand? Not with a battle, but... with office work? And why should I? Do it yourself.

home.line: You're back? Taking battles one after another is fine and all, but getting enough rest is just as important.

hp_warning.line: Nothing but a scratch. It won't slow me down.

login.line: Hmm, you're still half-asleep? As the Commander, you of all people should be alert and ready to go.

lose.line: Everyone, fall back at once! I'll cover your retreat!

mail.line: Commander, a missive of some sort has arrived. The sender is unknown... but the contents don't seem to be suspicious.

main1.line: I see the enemy your world faces are called "Sirens." They're very different from the Philuscha...

main2.line: Great timing, Commander. Want to join in on my training? It's too peaceful here, and I don't want to get rusty.

main3.line: There are so many kinds of people here. I find the Sakura Empire girls particularly interesting... For some reason, talking to them brings back warm memories.

main4.line: Enterprise? She and I may be different in many ways, but she is also a great warrior who lives for the battle. The power that has earned her so many medals... I would like to witness that firsthand someday.

main5.line: Oh, you want a duel, Hiryuu? Sounds good. Come at me–– Woah, taking the first swing already? Quite the impatient one, aren't we...

mission.line: Commander, do what needs to be done first.

mission_complete.line: Go harvest the fruits of your labor. You've earned it.

profile.line: I am Lila Decyrus, an Oren warrior of the Whitefang clan. I have been traveling the world to fulfill an oath I made with my clan. Even if this may be a journey with no end... I will still continue to press onward.

propose.line: You've not only understood my purpose, but also accepted me as an ally. To repay you for your kindness... I can perhaps stay here a bit longer. Allow me to lend you my power once more, Commander.

skill.line: This ends now! You're no match for me!

touch.line: You want to become stronger? Well, I don't mind teaching you the warrior's code. In exchange... show me around the port, alright?

touch2.line: I see. So you've made your peace.

unlock.line: I am Lila Decyrus, an Oren warrior... I may have become a "heavy cruiser" now, but that won't hamper my ability in battle. So long as I stay here, I will carry out my duties as a warrior in your service.

upgrade.line: Until my purpose has been served, I will continue to press onward.

win_mvp.line: I can't afford to stand around and do nothing.

gift_prefer.line: Ho, this is a fairly decent choice. I will take it.

ryza_item1.line: That's a big catch. Don't push yourself - let me handle it.

ryza_item2.line: Using cannons to collect ingredients. What a concept.

ryza_item3.line: The Sirens made this, so it goes without saying that it's no ordinary plant.

ryza_item4.line: Seems shipgirl technology can't produce everything... We'll have to turn to alchemy.

ryza_item5.line: I think I'm starting to get what makes them so sturdy.

battle_ex.line: The enemy's here. Stay sharp, everyone.

detail_ex.line: How old am I? Does that really matter, Commander?

feeling5_ex.line: What's wrong? Something on your mind? If there's something you want to get off your chest, just let it all out. It's not something I'd normally offer, but I'll make an exception today.

login_ex.line: You're doing well, and that's what matters... Hm? Don't tell me you're half-asleep again. You really never change, do you?

main6_ex.line: Go with you on a shopping trip? Ah, you must need a bodyguard. Rest assured, I've done it countless times before– Hm? Not quite?

main7_ex.line: Commander, stop sleeping on your desk and use your bed instead. You'll feel better rested that way.

main8_ex.line: Ever since you started training with me, you seem to be quicker on your feet. How about I test your abilities next time?

main9_ex.line: Ah, Bismarck... I was observing the Iron Blood exercise the other day, and her prowess impressed me. Commanding so many warriors while personally doing her utmost to lead her allies to victory... I doubt you'll find another warrior like her anywhere else.

main10_ex.line: The unsinkable Grand Old Lady who never misses a shot... While I don't know your full story, I can clearly tell you're a seasoned warrior. Now, why do you look so disgruntled? ...Hm? My build? What about it?

mission_ex.line: Seems you still have work to do. I'm here if you need a hand.

mission_complete_ex.line: All finished? Nicely done. I knew you could do it.

touch2_ex.line: ...Sit down over there. I'm going to teach you some manners.

win_mvp_ex.line: Your leadership is what let me fight so well. Thank you.

detail.line: You think I sound more subdued than usual tonight? My garment is probably the reason why. Don't worry, I can still fight in this nightgown if the enemy appears.

home.line: Have some hot milk, Commander. Someone from around here told me that it helps you fall asleep. Drink it and try to settle down.

login.line: What a nice night.

main1.line: I can hear crickets chirping... I guess even this port, busy by daytime, falls silent come nighttime.

main2.line: Sitting around, doing nothing in particular but spending time with someone else... Nights like these are pretty enjoyable every now and then.

main3.line: Starting to get tired, huh? Then you should head back to your room. Get ample rest to prepare for tomorrow.

main4.line: I see you're up as well, Patricia. Hm? What? I got this nightgown just a few days ago. What's so unusual about it?

main5.line: Ryza invited me to some sort of party. I agreed to come just on a whim, but I have no idea what sort of gathering it'll be. Also, why is a nightdress mandatory wear?

main6.line: I joined Kashino in an open-air bath just earlier. Relaxing in the water while gazing at the night sky is actually very satisfying.

main7.line: Is that Kasumi? It sounds like she's having a nice chat with someone, but who? ...Wait, are there beings in this world that I cannot see with the naked eye? If so, I must devise a countermeasure lest they become our enemies...

touch.line: Care to go on a walk, Commander? I want to see the unfiltered moonlight.

touch2.line: You must think anything could happen in a place as dark as this and I wouldn't notice immediately.

unlock.line: You shouldn't be up this late. What, you can't sleep? You want to stay up with me? ...Fine, I'll keep you company. I haven't been able to get a wink of sleep anyway.

battle.line: It's the enemy. Let's take them on.

couple_encourage1.line: I won't give up either, Lila.

couple_encourage2.line: Patricia, I expect you to keep my secret.

couple_encourage3.line: Klaudia, have you seen any unusual plants?

detail.line: I've always been traveling, so it feels a bit unusual to have my own place.

expedition.line: Our friends seem to have returned. It might be a good time to go greet them.

feeling1.line: I know I won't be here forever, but still...

feeling2.line: ...Commander, I'm looking for some seeds. The ones I'm trying to find might not be here, but just in case... Oh right, do you think you can help me?

feeling3.line: I hope that one day, that world will once again return to its original, verdurous beauty...

feeling4.line: I've already searched most of the places around the port. Do you know if there are any other places around here with plants... Oh, you do? Then, would you take me there next time?

feeling5.line: You've done so much for me since I came to this world. You've also helped me search for seeds. I feel the sincerity behind each and every one of your actions. Thank you very much, Commander.

headtouch.line: What do you want?

home.line: You're back? Good work.

hp_warning.line: I won't give up.

login.line: You're here. What plans do you have for the day?

lose.line: I can't let things end here...

mail.line: A letter has arrived. I wonder who it's from.

main1.line: Those small creatures are called Meowfficers? A long time ago, I used to keep a pet of my own. That's why I find those things cute.

main2.line: Meat garnished with vegetables... No, I don't mind. My clan just tends not to eat vegetables. However, I do drink a special smoothie made of some secret herbs from time to time.

main3.line: The hills behind the port are lush and green. I wonder if there are seeds over there...

main4.line: So this plant is called mugwort. It's not what I'm looking for, but it appears to have medicinal properties... Huh, there's a song about mugwort? I see, I'd love to hear it.

main5.line: Yuudachi, what's this... "Meat Lovers' Recommended Restaurants List"...? Astounding. I'll put this to good use.

mission.line: It appears that you still have some missions to complete. I'd recommend getting them out of the way first.

mission_complete.line: The rewards are here. If there are any plants, let me take a look as well.

profile.line: I am Serri Glaus, an Oren of the Green Plume clan. I ended up here while on a journey to find something... What was I searching for? The seed of a certain plant.

propose.line: I'm still in the middle of my journey to find what I'm looking for. But with all the help you've given me here, I'd like to stay in this world a bit longer. Thank you once again for all the support.

touch.line: Why is my skin so smooth? Nothing in particular comes to mind, but If I had to guess... it might have something to do with my clan's secret herbal smoothie that I drink every day.

touch2.line: ...What are you doing?

unlock.line: I am Serri of the Oren. I seem to be an aircraft carrier of some sort now. By the way, have you seen any seeds...?

upgrade.line: So, even I still have room for growth. Thank you.

win_mvp.line: Looks like things ended without any issues.

gift_prefer.line: This is exactly what I have wanted. Thank you. I am so happy.

ryza_item1.line: The ocean's capacity to nurture... seems to remain a constant, regardless of the world.

ryza_item2.line: How exactly did this island come to be?

ryza_item3.line: I should bring one with me for Hanazuki's flower house.

ryza_item4.line: The thing I'm looking for is not here... But for the sake of my companions, I will continue my search.

ryza_item5.line: This power... is completely unlike anything I've known before...

battle_ex.line: They're coming. Everyone, stay alert.

detail_ex.line: What is it, Commander? ...Never in my dreams would I have imagined inviting someone into my room. Anyway, please come on inside.

feeling5_ex.line: That seed isn't what I'm looking for either. But since it's something you went through the trouble of looking for... I'll take good care of it.

login_ex.line: Good morning... Where shall we go today?

main6_ex.line: How old am I? Commander, you should know better than to ask a woman her age. But, I will say... we Orens have much longer lifespans than humans.

main7_ex.line: Looks like you're buried in work again, Commander. Is there anything I can help with? It's the least I can do.

main8_ex.line: In the midst of a journey chasing an impossible dream, spending some time like this might not be so bad after all...

main9_ex.line: I see that rabbit girl a lot whenever I'm out looking for seeds. She's almost always taking a nap though, just like right now... I wonder if I should wake her up.

main10_ex.line: I've heard you know a lot about the flowers of this world, Hanazuki. Do you know anything about a flower with great power? ...I see, thank you. By the way, that display over there is called... Ikebana? It's very beautiful.

mission_ex.line: Seems like you still have some missions to get through... Let's make quick work of them, shall we?

mission_complete_ex.line: Your rewards have arrived. I'd like you to check to see if there are any plants inside...

touch2_ex.line: What an incorrigible human...

win_mvp_ex.line: This was also made possible because of you...

detail.line: A wondrous place of sylvan beauty. How calming...

home.line: If you're worn out, you should take some time to rest. Don't worry, I'll wake you up if you fall asleep.

login.line: The wind is quite refreshing tonight.

main1.line: My hair ornament looks good on me? Thank you... I've always been fond of floral ornaments.

main2.line: Being surrounded with plants like this fills me with nostalgia.

main3.line: Are you heading back? I see... I'll be staying here for a bit longer. Good night, Commander. Sweet dreams.

main4.line: One day, I will bring peace and verdure back to our old world. Let's start by doing whatever we can now, Lila.

main5.line: I saw Patricia having a tea party with some of the girls from around here. By the looks of things, she's getting used to her life here.

main6.line: Right before I arrived, I ran into a shadow of some sorts in the dorms that claimed to be a ghost. Do you think it was a real ghost...? Huh, it's just some girl called Long Island, not an actual ghost? I see...

main7.line: Shinano, you should head back to the dorms if you were planning to go to sleep. Hm, she doesn't seem to want to wake up... I wonder what kind of dreams she's having right now, with that look on her face...

touch.line: Aren't the stars beautiful, Commander?

touch2.line: ...Perhaps I should be getting back now.

unlock.line: An elegant verdure, a pellucid azure. I never knew there was such a lovely place at this port... Oh Commander, are you also out on a nighttime stroll?

battle.line: Heehee. Who wants to face me next, hmm?

couple_encourage1.line: A most curious alchemist you are, Ryza.

couple_encourage2.line: Impressive, Whitefang comrade. How reliable!

couple_encourage3.line: I pray that your dream becomes reality, Serri.

detail.line: What's that? You're curious about the curios in my room? Heheh, they are all extremely valuable artifacts collected over the years. I'm quite attached to all of them.

expedition.line: Your errand girls have returned. How I yearn to hear their stories.

feeling1.line: You bore me...

feeling2.line: Hrm. Suppose I ought to explore the port today. Commander, do you wish to join me?

feeling3.line: The time is nigh to break our fast. Commander, why don't you take me somewhere I can sate my appetite?

feeling4.line: Traveling to another world seems to shatter one's "common sense." But oddly...that isn't so bad an experience.

feeling5.line: Heehee, this place is full of such interesting folk. I never tire of watching them... Oh, but of course, you are the most interesting of all. Heehee! Is it a relief to hear that?

headtouch.line: So you wish to treat me like a child, too? Say... I suppose I could use some exercise. Have at you!

home.line: Well, then... Perhaps I ought to organize the things I found during our travels.

hp_warning.line: Oh ho. Perhaps it's finally time for me to get serious again!

login.line: Those who set upon their work so diligently are a rare breed indeed. What an interesting one you are.

lose.line: ...These otherworldly fiends put up a surprising fight. Retreat seems to be the best course of action.

mail.line: Oho. Commander, you've got mail. A love letter, perhaps... What? It's not?

main1.line: Aha. So these little creatures are called Meowfficers? I've seen nothing of the sort in my own world... but they are such adorable things.

main2.line: All the world's cultures gather in this port. The stories shared by all are truly fascinating.

main3.line: Say, are there any dealers of rare curios in this port? Goodness! Then I must pay them a visit. Mind showing me the way, Commander?

main4.line: Hah! How adorable it is to see someone who can't be true to her feelings. Take this advice from your elder: be sincere if you want your thoughts known.

main5.line: A superior who looks after many... Heheh, I think you and I will be good friends. Come, why don't we chat over tea?

mission.line: It seems you have some unfinished missions. What will you do about them, I wonder?

mission_complete.line: That mission must have been quite successful if these rewards are anything to go by.

profile.line: I am Kala Ideas, chief of the Oren Songwave clan. The circumstances of my arrival may have been out of my hands, but a world with culture and history beyond my knowledge is fascinating indeed. I have been enjoying my time here.

propose.line: Wh-what an exquisite item...! So this is a symbol of your sincerity? Very well. If it means so much to you, then I'm not one to refuse. As you wish, I will remain here and watch how this world changes for some time.

touch.line: This port is brimming with young ladies. Say, Commander, which is your... Oh? Is that topic taboo? Your life isn't an easy one, I see.

touch2.line: I've lived long enough now that it'll take far from this to disturb me...but I think a tongue-lashing is in order.

unlock.line: Oho. What sort of interesting person would summon me? My name is Kala Ideas, and I am the chief of the Wave Tuner clan. Perhaps I shall sojourn in this world for a spell, just as you desired.

upgrade.line: Few can put me to such good use. You have my thanks, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Quaint little foes, wouldn't you say so?

gift_prefer.line: Ohh! You know me well, don't you? Thanks so much, Commander! You have my praise!

battle_ex.line: Folks, be careful not to get yourselves hurt!

detail_ex.line: Hmm... I've found so many rare and fascinating curios in this world that my stash has become unmanageable. Commander, could you lend me a hand?

feeling5_ex.line: The fruit you gave me the other day was marvelous! It's been a long time since my heart throbbed like that. You know me well, Commander! How could I expect any less?

login_ex.line: Have you awoken, Commander? Why don't you take some time off and show me around the port? I'm sure that even you need time away from work.

main6_ex.line: What's the matter? Would you like to chat with me? Heheh... No need to be shy. Come and sit next to me.

main7_ex.line: The genres of music in this world are prolific indeed. I happen to like this so-called "Classical" type. Listening to it is like rocking my heart to sleep...

main8_ex.line: Hehe, the ways of this world may be infecting me.

main9_ex.line: Friedrich der Große... Her lullaby is similar but different to the tones of our own world. But how beautiful and vigorous it is...

main10_ex.line: Yes, Ryuujou? Oh, is that a "dragon?" It's not exactly like the dragons I know... But I suppose one could say the same of this whole world, no?

mission_ex.line: I find myself with no shortage of free time... You know what that means. Why don't I help out with some of your missions?

mission_complete_ex.line: Finished your mission, have you? Then allow me to pamper you as reward.

touch2_ex.line: *sigh*... Commander, will you ever learn to keep your hands to yourself? You are a tiresome one... Sit down and think about what you've done, you rascal.

win_mvp_ex.line: Most spectacular leadership, Commander.

detail.line: I never did much baking back in my old world as it was outside my duties. It may not be easy to see, but I'll have you know that I'm enjoying myself.

home.line: Hmm... So far, so good. Yet it's so time-consuming... We'll have to wait.

login.line: You came at just the right time! Get over here and assist me, now!

main1.line: Hmm. Meowfficers, will you be assisting me? Just don't stare too much – as long as you value your lives, that is.

main2.line: This outfit? I'm told it's formal wear here. Hmm... You're not plotting something, are you? Why are you averting your eyes?

main3.line: Wait here. You may try my homemade treats... What, you can't wait a sparse few minutes? As impatient as a child...

touch.line: Oh... How in the world did cream get there? Should I be thanking you, or...?

touch2.line: Hmph. Do you think I can do nothing right? Or do you just want me to shove some of this cream in your mouth to shut you up?

unlock.line: I expected this sort of work to be effortless for me... but I see how wrong I was. It's not as simple as they say... Well? Are you just going to stand there and watch, or are you going to help?

battle.line: May the best fighter win!

couple_encourage1.line: Ikaruga! I'll take the lead here!

couple_encourage2.line: Homura, I'll prove I'm better than you in this world too!

couple_encourage3.line: Yumi, cover me!

detail.line: Gosh, I'm starving. I miss grandpa's futomaki rolls. They're the best ever, I tell you!

expedition.line: Looks like the girls are back from their errand! Hats off to them all.

feeling1.line: *sigh*, I can't believe you...

feeling2.line: We're short on a lot of supplies... Huh? Go shopping together? That would be great!

feeling3.line: Oh, Commander! If I may ask... could you teach me how to fight in your world? Ninjutsu is pretty hard to make use of on the open ocean, you see!

feeling4.line: It feels like you've always got your hands full, Commander. Do you ever take breaks? I'm a little concerned over you!

feeling5.line: I've started thinking there may have been a reason why I was sent to this world. It was to train here, to fight using a rigging... and yes, meeting you is a big part of it as well.

headtouch.line: It's calming when someone pats your head, isn't it?

home.line: There ya are! ...Wait, sorry! Welcome back, Commander!

hp_warning.line: I-I think I should still be fine!

login.line: Good morning, Commander! Let's give it our all today, like always!

lose.line: It's so over...

mail.line: There's a message for you, Commander. Shouldn't you read it?

main1.line: I wish I could treat everyone here to my grandpa's sushi. I guarantee you they'd love it!

main2.line: While I love shinobi outfits, these "riggings" you have in this world are just amazingly cool!

main3.line: The food in this world tastes amazing every time I eat it. Even your snacks are delish! Better watch my intake, or I'll put on weight.

main4.line: Practice ninjutsu together with you, Akatsuki? Yes, please!

main5.line: Kinu, you look like you're skilled with a blade... Are you a swordmaster, by any chance?

mission.line: What's this? You've still got unfinished missions!

mission_complete.line: Oh! Mission complete, Commander!

profile.line: I'm Asuka, second-year student at the Hanzō National Academy! I train daily to become the best shinobi I can be! Oh, and my favorite food is the futomakis my grandpa makes!

propose.line: After fighting the Sirens alongside the shipgirls under your command, I've realized I'm just not up to scratch. I'm going to get much, much stronger, so please support me on the way there, Commander!

touch.line: Huh?! Kat?! ...Oh, it's just you, Commander. What is it? Do you need something?

touch2.line: You know, your naughty touch reminds me of Kat.

unlock.line: Hello! I'm Asuka, second-year student at the Hanzō Academy! Wait... this isn't the new shinobi base at all! This place is your port, you say? Okay then... Well, no matter where I end up, I'll always train as best as I can!

upgrade.line: I've gotten even stronger! I think my training's paying off.

win_mvp.line: Phew, I'm feeling kinda sweaty! Rigging doesn't rust from sweat, do they?

gift_prefer.line: Wow! Awesome!! Commander, thank you so much! I'll treasure this♪

battle_ex.line: Come, let us fight!

detail_ex.line: I'm gonna treat you to my home cooking soon. You'll be able to taste the effort I put in!

feeling5_ex.line: Meeting you was, I think, necessary for my growth as a shinobi. It without a doubt had a great impact that allowed me to take the next step as a person!

login_ex.line: Oh! Commander! I waited for you! Come on, let's get going!

main6_ex.line: What are your favorite things, Commander? Not just in terms of food, but also sports, music, and so on. I'm a little curious.

main7_ex.line: You say my training has paid off, but I won't feel satisfied until it pays off to an astonishing degree.

main8_ex.line: My grandpa, grandma, and classmates must all be worried about me... Even so, there are things in this world I have to do.

main9_ex.line: Shoukaku, hearing you play your flute reminds me of my home world – it strikes a chord with me!

main10_ex.line: What shinobi school are you from, Akatsuki? ...It's a secret? Thought as much. Secrecy is part of being a shinobi!

mission_ex.line: You've got tasks left to do. Don't worry! I'll help you with them!

mission_complete_ex.line: Wow, you finished your tasks! You never fail to impress!

touch2_ex.line: I-I'm not a fan of when you touch me out of the blue...

win_mvp_ex.line: I'd say my training has paid off, Commander.

detail.line: Gosh, I feel so spoiled by this visit. So much fun to have, so many treats to eat... I'd be hard-pressed to call this "training" in any way.

home.line: Nice fighting, Commander. How about a break in the shade? I've got cold drinks, if you'd like some!

login.line: Oh, hey, Commander. Slacking? Am not! I'm just having a quick break!

main1.line: Think I wanna give diving a shot. Should I ask the submarines for some tips?

main2.line: Okay, break time! My grandpa's very strict about taking regular breaks, even when you're honing your skills.

main3.line: Since we're here, nobody will get upset with me for having just a LITTLE beach fun, right?

main4.line: New Jersey, do you recommend that new ice cream? I'd kill to try it myself!

main5.line: Oh, it's just you, U-110~ I thought you were a real shark. I was this close to using the depth charges I borrowed from Akatsuki...

touch.line: Doesn't my swimsuit look wonderful? Yeah, I love it, too!

touch2.line: Whoa! My bikini string will loosen if you touch me like that!

unlock.line: Blue skies, white sands, and oceans that stretch as far as the eye can see... I've seen this on TV before – this place is heaven on earth! Thanks so much for inviting me here, Commander! Now, it's time to have fun!

battle.line: I'll show you how we shinobi dance!

couple_encourage1.line: Asuka, you're being way too pushy! Calm down a little, please!

couple_encourage2.line: Homura! Please consider being a bit more cooperative!

couple_encourage3.line: I can't believe I'm fighting side-by-side with you, Fubuki...

detail.line: As a class representative, one of my important duties is cracking down on disorderly conduct. Do I make myself clear, Commander?

expedition.line: Those who were out running errands for you have returned. Let us go welcome them back.

feeling1.line: What's your deal? ...Please stay away from me.

feeling2.line: Are you interested in learning about ninjutsu, Commander? Very well! Be it offense, defense, espionage, or tactics, I'd be more than glad to instruct you!

feeling3.line: Commander, if you're going to go on break, would you mind waiting a little bit? Yes, if you don't mind, I'd like to join you... Umm, only if you're fine with it though...

feeling4.line: Has my hair caught your eye? Now that I think about it, Yomi also commented about how beautiful my glossy black hair is... Umm, I guess I don't mind if you touch it a little...

feeling5.line: Though we each bear different burdens on our backs, our duty is nevertheless to come together as inseparable allies and defeat mighty foes.

headtouch.line: Umm... Please be gentle with me.

home.line: Well done on your sortie. How about some tea for a change of pace?

hp_warning.line: It's not too late... to turn this kind of mistake around!

login.line: I've been waiting. Shall we continue our training? Will you be providing me with a special training session today on rigging operation?

lose.line: This... calls for a retreat. But, I will not give up!

mail.line: It looks like some documents here are addressed to you, Commander. Want to take a look?

main1.line: This rigging, as well as this very land upon which your port sits, is completely novel to us all. Indeed, we must study it thoroughly...

main2.line: I'm not sure if it's because your instruction has been spot-on, Commander, but I feel like I've been in great form as of late. Perhaps this is a result of my training, as well as the bonds I've forged with the others...

main3.line: Reading is my hobby. It's quite enjoyable to immerse yourself in books and broaden your horizons.

main4.line: Iroha's clothes... look just like an ordinary swimsuit, but I wonder if they have any special functionalities...

main5.line: I feel something mysterious coming from Nagato... something akin to an aura of dignity.

mission.line: You still have work you've yet to complete. I believe it would be wise to make haste.

mission_complete.line: Looks like you've already finished your work. Don't delay, and make sure everything has been turned in.

profile.line: I am Ikaruga, third-year student at Hanzō National Academy and the shinobi class representative. But perhaps because of that, everyone says that I'm overly serious...

propose.line: When I found myself lost and confused, stranded in a strange new place, everyone at this port including you, Commander, gave me encouragement... and that allowed me to stand back up and move forward. That's right, let's continue that momentum, and keep trying our best.

skill.line: Be consumed by the soaring swallow's flames!

touch.line: *gasp*! ...Now that I think about it, Katsuragi isn't here. When I say stuff like that, it's like I'm blaming her for everything, which really isn't a good thing...

touch2.line: Y-you're getting way too touchy-feely with me! This is your warning!

unlock.line: I am Ikaruga, a third-year student at the Hanzō National Academy, serving as the shinobi class representative. How should I conduct myself in this foreign place? I would be most grateful if you would provide me with your assistance.

upgrade.line: I have become stronger. So too grows my mastery of this rigging.

win_mvp.line: My training seems to have paid off. I could not be any happier.

gift_prefer.line: Hm? Is this for me? Th-thanks! I'm so happy!

battle_ex.line: Behold my bladework!

detail_ex.line: Commander, if you're tired, you should take some time to rest. Your efficiency will go up that way.

feeling5_ex.line: When I was about to give up on everything, when I felt like I couldn't continue on any further, you were the one who took my hand, illuminated the way forward, and encouraged me to press on... Because I have someone like you, I am able to keep going... So please, continue watching over me just a bit longer.

login_ex.line: Where have you been, Commander? We've all missed you.

main6_ex.line: Now that I've finished up my shinobi training, I'd like to relax by working up a nice, easy sweat... Do you think you can provide me with your guidance?

main7_ex.line: I see quite a few people here practicing their sword techniques, but how do they maintain their blades? Are there any swordsmiths or sharpeners here?

main8_ex.line: Shopping around for some nice clothes can be quite refreshing... Commander, if you don't mind, do you think you could pick something out for us?

main9_ex.line: Miss Taihou's long black hair is always so lovely... How does she manage to take care of it?

main10_ex.line: Miss Akatsuki, are you also a shinobi just like us? Wow, to be both a ninja and a shipgirl... You must have had some superb training.

mission_ex.line: It's almost time for work. I don't mind helping out, so please keep it up.

mission_complete_ex.line: Looks like everything's taken care of. Thank you for your hard work. Would you like a shoulder massage?

touch2_ex.line: W-wait, please! Don't stare at me like that...

win_mvp_ex.line: Thank goodness... Everyone made it through safely.

detail.line: A place like this would normally have no connection with my shinobi duties, but for whatever reason, I feel at ease... Is this what it means to be on vacation?

home.line: Commander, thank you for your hard work. Would you like to take a little break? ...Um, do you think this hammock can support two people?

login.line: Commander, do we have work to do? Is it okay if I stay here and watch the fish for a bit longer?

main1.line: Swish, swish... How soothing it is to sway to the sound of the waves and the rustling of the wind... I'm getting sleepier and sleepier...

main2.line: The only time I've ever seen oceans this crystal-clear was through photos and TV screens... I had no idea a place like this really exists...

main3.line: If we built a nice resort like this where I could lie down and watch the fish all day long, I'd visit every week...

main4.line: Akashi, do you have a fish encyclopedia? Hmm? You charge extra for full color? Ugh, that's a rather steep price...

main5.line: Is this what the world looks like through the eyes of a submarine? That makes me somewhat jealous...

touch.line: Commander, please stop that! If you shake the hammock around too much, we'll fall into the water!

touch2.line: C-cut that out! If we fall into the water, the fish will be scared away!

unlock.line: Wow! The fish are so cute! The water's so clear that you can see everything under the waves! I've never seen an ocean like this before, and being able to relax while rocking back and forth on the water... is just like one of those "vacation paradises" I've read about in various books!

battle.line: I'm gonna show you my crimson power!

couple_encourage1.line: Hey, melon mounds! Don't charge in blindly by yourself!

couple_encourage2.line: I'm not letting you run circles around me, Miss Class Rep.

couple_encourage3.line: Yumi, do NOT try to pick a fight with me here just because I'm an evil shinobi.

detail.line: Hm? You wanna know more about me? Alright, I'll tell you. Wanna know how I train, or see my skill with the blade? I can do that right here, if you want.

expedition.line: The mission team is back. At least go give 'em your regards, Commander.

feeling1.line: ...You're a real cocky bastard. Whatever happens next is up to your fate.

feeling2.line: Hahah, you're a piece of work. I didn't take you for such a fearless one, you know that? Hey, it's a compliment.

feeling3.line: What're you looking at?! No, I'm not mad. You staring is fine in my book.

feeling4.line: I've still got much more training to do... What, is it THAT odd for me to grumble? (whisper) Because you're special... Nah, I didn't say anything.

feeling5.line: I am a renegade shinobi, which means others see me as an oddity. However, that doesn't matter here. This is a place where fighting alongside you holds meaning, which is why I feel at home.

headtouch.line: Wh-what the hell are you doing? I'd have cut you down if people were around!

home.line: Nice work. How'd it go? No embarrassing screwups, I assume.

hp_warning.line: Tsk! Shit! The real battle starts now!

login.line: Ah, Commander! You're finally back. Let's get this started, then. Think you can keep up with me?

lose.line: Dammit... What a letdown...

mail.line: Commander, you've got mail. Heh, I'd better read mine before it piles up.

main1.line: I like a uniform that's on the simple side, but my rigging is a lot bigger than I'd like it to, maybe 'cause it's so powerful... Can't do much about that.

main2.line: What, you keeping a secret from me? Heheh, don't assume you can keep it for long. It's better to come clean, before I force it out of you.

main3.line: I'm craving some meat today. I need the extra calories on days when I train especially hard.

main4.line: Shimakaze, while your outfit is no doubt easy to move in, it's a bit indecent... *gasp*! Maybe that's the point... Is it meant to seduce?!

main5.line: "Rigging Burst Release"? Ayanami, that technique sounds... It sounds cool as hell!

mission.line: You've got unfinished tasks. Don't be lazy – get to it.

mission_complete.line: Whoa, you completed your task. Good, 'cause unfinished business is bad.

profile.line: I'm Homura. I used to be with Hebijo, but broke off from 'em, so I'm what's called a "renegade shinobi." While I made a clean exit, and I've still got some reservations about Miyabi... I don't regret my choice. Besides, I'm now the leader of my Crimson Squad, and I have companions I can trust.

propose.line: You've been my guide in this world, and it's thanks to you I've been able to concentrate on fighting. Commander, have I lived up to your hopes? ...Okay, I'm glad to hear it. I will fight by your side from this day on. I will give you my all to aid you.

skill.line: I, Homura, sacrifice myself to our dance!

touch.line: What's up, Commander? Got something on your mind?

touch2.line: Back off! You looking to get stabbed, or what?

unlock.line: My name's Homura. I'm the leader of Homura's Crimson Squad. I was once affiliated with a school, like many others, but... stuff happened. Anyway, don't let that bother you.

upgrade.line: My training's paid off. I'm becoming one with my rigging, too. Little by little, I'm improving!

win_mvp.line: Marvel at my refined strength and skill!

gift_prefer.line: Huh? This is for me? I-I see... W-well, I'll gratefully accept it.

battle_ex.line: You're about to find out how I fight like!

detail_ex.line: It's really struck me how hard it is to follow somebody's orders. That's not to say I hate it, though.

feeling5_ex.line: Fighting used to be all I had... Or, it should've been. Now I'm at a bit of a loss, 'cause casually hanging out with you is more fun than I thought. Let me enjoy this period of uncertainty a little longer.

login_ex.line: Hey, welcome back, Commander. You good? 'Cause I feel bad when you don't... Ah, never mind that! Let's get to work.

main6_ex.line: Making bold moves is sweet. Taking the first step forward, then thinking afterwards... that's your specialty, isn't it?

main7_ex.line: While there's no such thing as training too much, I do take regular breaks so I don't make you worry.

main8_ex.line: Why do you touch me so much? Not saying I don't like it, just that it feels embarrassing past a point!

main9_ex.line: Yuudachi, I'll give you this meat if you help me with... Wait, what? Where'd the meat go? Hey! Did you just eat it whole?!

main10_ex.line: Akashi, I know you're busy, but could you have a look at my weapons? Huh? Payment? I'm not trying to sell them... What? Repair cost? Ugh, money-grubbing little...

mission_ex.line: You've still got work to do. I'll help you out so we'll get it done quickly.

mission_complete_ex.line: Finished a few tasks, huh? Man, you sure work hard. Then again, I like that about you.

touch2_ex.line: Cut the boring crap. If you must, come at me head-on.

win_mvp_ex.line: Heh! That's all they had? Too easy!

detail.line: Fishing is great. It sharpens your fingers' tactile sense, improves your concentration, and at the end of it all, it fills your stomach. It rocks.

home.line: Now let's put you in with the other pretty fishies... Damn, this icebox keeps them looking like they're fresh outta the water!

login.line: Hey, Commander. You finally showed up. Been waiting for you. You didn't forget we were going fishing today, did you?

main1.line: I keep catching the same damn fish! Okay – sucks about the catch, but it's time to find a new riverbank...

main2.line: Heheh! Check it out! Mine's 10 centimeters bigger! This has gotta be our biggest catch of the day!

main3.line: Commander, come on, stop ogling me and start fishing! If you don't – no dinner for you.

main4.line: Oh, hey, Kawakaze and Abukuma. Yeah, let's just kick back and enjoy some quiet time.

main5.line: Since you told me to bring the catch to your place, I've gotta ask – you a good cook, Vestal?

touch.line: Hm? Hey, wait! Don't touch me! My skin's sensitive since I got a sunburn... Eek!

touch2.line: Apply sunscreen? You're not offering just out of kindness, are you? It's written all over your face!

unlock.line: Fish! Heheh, that's a biggun! We'll be eating good tonight... Wait, I guess I don't need to worry about food now. Old habits die hard, it seems... Commander! Hey! I know you're over there! I'm gonna let you have a taste, so stop staring all enviously like that!

battle.line: All in the name of justice.

couple_encourage1.line: Asuka, bear witness to my power in this new world!

couple_encourage2.line: Homura, have you things you must do here, too?

couple_encourage3.line: To be fighting alongside you, Fubuki... If only my grandfather could see this.

detail.line: You wish to know me better? Very well. I can do so in the form of combat. Actions speak more than words, after all.

expedition.line: I've received word that your expedition party has returned. Be so kind as to speak to them, please.

feeling1.line: Commander, don't you believe that you should reflect upon your actions once more?

feeling2.line: You've enlightened me on so many matters, Commander... I only wish I could pay you back in some way.

feeling3.line: I am indebted for your appraisals of me. I shall return them with even greater dedication.

feeling4.line: Commander? Oh, I was merely cooling myself off. Speaking of which, you may find my presence more cooling than others'. I, um, invite you to get comfortable by my side, if you so like...

feeling5.line: Oh, Commander... You've caught me in a moment of sloth. My apolo– You say it's no big deal, but it's not that simple. Although... perhaps a little sloth is forgivable, just with you.

headtouch.line: Quite the indecorous look on you... Heehee. I jest.

home.line: I bid you welcome back, Commander. I'm certain you're weary after your mission. May I suggest taking a short break?

hp_warning.line: You believe this will make me step down?

login.line: Welcome back – I've been awaiting you. It is good to see you return in good health.

lose.line: A true shame though it be, we must retreat. This embarrassment will not happen again.

mail.line: There are quite a few messages for you, Commander. Do read them before you forget, please.

main1.line: Let us rest not too little, nor too much. It is important to rise again and continue on your path.

main2.line: My rigging, despite its immense size, is actually quite easy to move around with.

main3.line: While I believe functionality is the most important thing on the battlefield, I cannot say so easily with full confidence.

main4.line: Ah, so you're able to control animals, Avrora! ...You aren't? But I've heard you use a bear to attack your enemies...

main5.line: Chapayev, I find your rigging... very interesting, for reasons I'm not sure of. Particularly those ice crystals.

mission.line: It seems we have a long journey to reach the end of the day.

mission_complete.line: It would appear you have completed a mission. Be sure to turn it in.

profile.line: I am Yumi, third-year student at the Gessen Girls' Academy. I will spend every day training to achieve justice in this world, too. I kindly ask for your guidance and support to help me understand what it means to be an aircraft carrier.

propose.line: I am not adept when it comes to expressing my feelings, and I may be hard to read as a result... However, there is no denying the faith I have in you. So, once again, it is my pleasure to be with you, Commander.

touch.line: I'm afraid it startles me when others touch me so...

touch2.line: Wh-where do you think you're touching me?!

unlock.line: I am Yumi, third-year student at the Gessen Girls' Academy. Though I know not why I was brought here, I am committed to justice, no matter where I go.

upgrade.line: Let us continue growing. Steadily, one step at a time.

win_mvp.line: This is the power of pure justice.

gift_prefer.line: Is this... mine? Thank you very much. I'll treasure it for the rest of my life.

battle_ex.line: Here I come!

detail_ex.line: You wish to know everything about me? Surely you jest... All you need to know is that I exist to achieve justice.

feeling5_ex.line: I can never repay you for the lengths you've gone for a hopeless woman with no knowledge of this world. Allow me to thank you once more, as I will again many more times to come.

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Heehee. I'm pleased to be by your side, as always.

main6_ex.line: Commander, will you help me choose an outfit in the days to come? Certainly, you may pick one according to your tastes. In fact, I'd prefer that.

main7_ex.line: This port is in no shortage of curiosities. My gaze constantly switches from one thing to the next.

main8_ex.line: I wonder how everyone back at Gessen is faring... That said, Minori is there to watch over them, so I may be worrying over nothing.

main9_ex.line: I feel that my skills have synergy with the ladies of the Northern Parliament. Especially with Gremyashchy – she's diligent, so I think my way of doing things would work well with her.

main10_ex.line: St. Louis, I've heard you teach people to dance. I'd like to learn the Western style of dancing – do you think you could instruct me, please?

mission_ex.line: It appears you have unfinished business. Could I offer you some assistance, incapable though I may be?

mission_complete_ex.line: You've finished your assignment? Most marvelous.

touch2_ex.line: I am... not experienced with matters of impropriety.

win_mvp_ex.line: It is an honor to fight alongside you all.

detail.line: Apparently, shaved ice comes in many different shapes across the world. I wonder how many it's possible to try in one lifetime?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Asuka told me that nothing beats shaved ice on a hot day, so I made you some. Please, have a seat.

login.line: I've been waiting for you, Commander. May I have a moment of your time before you begin working?

main1.line: Personally feeding another person isn't something I do often, but that's not to say it doesn't come naturally to me!

main2.line: It flusters me when you stare at me like that, without even stopping to blink... You're really leaving me at a loss...

main3.line: What luxury, getting to eat shaved ice on a warm midsummer day like this. What's more, getting to spend this moment together with you...

main4.line: Oh? You recommend condensed milk, Kashino? That sounds appetizing, to be sure.

main5.line: Kaga! While I'm sure there are people who would like the added plum liqueur, it's still only noon – I ask you to show abstinence, please.

touch.line: While, personally, I don't think revealing swimsuits are my style, perhaps they're to your liking, Commander?

touch2.line: So it's true that you have an insatiable appetite for women in swimsuits...

unlock.line: Here, Commander – shaved ice. Say "aah"... Heehee. I've not fed someone like this many times before, so please don't get mad in the event that I spill some.

battle.line: Let us do battle.

couple_encourage1.line: I fear I may make this tough for you, Yumi...

couple_encourage2.line: Seems the new locale hasn't changed you one bit, Asuka.

couple_encourage3.line: I wonder what you think about the Sirens, Yūyaki...

detail.line: With apologies to everyone else, I'm trembling with excitement right now. If Bashou from Hebijo were here, she'd surely recite a poem about this.

expedition.line: The ladies have returned from their expedition. What will you do now?

feeling1.line: Alright then... What is it now?

feeling2.line: I'm sorry that I don't have much to talk about... I've tried not to discuss private matters in my day-to-day life, you see.

feeling3.line: Whenever we speak, there's never enough time to discuss all I want. Whether that's a good or bad thing, well...

feeling4.line: What's important is sharing your positive feelings with your partner... You and a certain someone I know seem to have a lot in common.

feeling5.line: I've noticed that I'm enjoying my life in this world more than I used to... Though, that doesn't mean I never want to return home, it only means that, for the time being, a part of me is content with fighting by your side.

headtouch.line: Why are you so drawn to my hair?

home.line: Heehee... Welcome back, Commander. I commend you on your mission.

hp_warning.line: I'm only... getting started.

login.line: Welcome back. You've... returned to us. The ladies are raring to see you. Give them a warm smile, would you?

lose.line: Let us retreat for now – and plan our revenge...

mail.line: A number of letters addressed to you have arrived. Won't you read them now?

main1.line: I adore observing the people around the port. They are powerful, even if they aren't shinobi.

main2.line: Gekkō taught me this fortune-telling method... Are there any conclusions we can draw from it?

main3.line: There is so little I know of this world... and so much I'd like you to tell me about it.

main4.line: I've heard you like white rice as well, Haruna. Rice really is meant to be savored on its own, without any extra seasoning on top.

main5.line: Gascogne's speaking cadence is... strangely pleasing to me. It feels almost like being embraced by the most serene music.

mission.line: It seems that you have tasks left to do. I suggest completing them posthaste.

mission_complete.line: You have yet to turn in a completed mission. Please remember to do that.

profile.line: I am named Fubuki. I once had reason to hide myself, and for some reason, I was transported to this world. You'd be wise to keep engagement with me to a minimum. Why? I'll let you surmise from the meaning of my other name, meaning, "Never Returning."

propose.line: There is a story behind my "Never Returning" second name. I attract yōma – the enemy. I feared that this ability of mine would put you – put others – in danger. Stunningly, you had the power to repel those enemies. Knowing that brings me joy.

touch.line: Yes? What do you need? I'll assist in any way I can.

touch2.line: I will not overlook this as a mere jest.

unlock.line: I am named Fubuki. I try to keep out of the public eye, so how have I wound up in this strange place? Also, you may want to leave me to my own devices. If you wonder why, well...

upgrade.line: I feel my strength growing.

win_mvp.line: We win this time. May we meet again.

gift_prefer.line: You have a present for me...? ...No, it's a bad habit to overthink things. I will accept it gratefully.

battle_ex.line: I shall imprint the Never Returning's might upon your memory.

detail_ex.line: You must care deeply about everyone who lives at this port. To tell the truth, it makes me slightly envious.

feeling5_ex.line: You never fall prey to pessimism, and you lead us all with a positive attitude... How is one meant to stop idolizing a person such as you? Heehee... You shouldn't blush, or that blush will spread to me as well.

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I've been waiting wearily for you... Heehee. That's not entirely false, you know.

main6_ex.line: I'm sure Gekkō and Senkō would be very surprised if they saw how mellow I am now.

main7_ex.line: If Sirens are monsters that comprehend human language, they may have more in common with yōma than we think.

main8_ex.line: My second name, "Never Returning," would ward people off. Yet, the people of this world seem not to mind it very much.

main9_ex.line: Your apparel is quite similar to what we shinobi wear, Kuroshio. It appears to have all the same functions, too... Who made it, I wonder?

mission_ex.line: You have a few tasks left to do. I shall help with them.

mission_complete_ex.line: Oh? You've accomplished one of your tasks. Shall I turn it in for you?

touch2_ex.line: Do you do this to other ladies as well?

win_mvp_ex.line: It soothes my heart to see you're all okay.

detail.line: Twilight – the time when the boundary between worlds blurs. Be aware of Sirens trying to kidnap you, Commander. I'll keep my eyes open, too.

home.line: Well fought, Commander. Since the sun is setting, we could go for dinner together.

login.line: Ah, you're back. You came running because you knew I'm here? Heehee, why, thank you.

main1.line: When was the last time I played in the water leisurely like this... I really can't remember... Heehee, it's surprisingly fun.

main2.line: Commander, don't you have important business to... Huh? Building rapport is crucial? If you say so...

main3.line: Seeing the water gradually turn an orangish color from the sun... Doesn't it make you feel wonderful?

main4.line: This sunscreen you told me about works wonders, Bremerton. If you know any other great products, please do fill me in.

main5.line: Reno said she's going to aim for a spectacular splash and got out of the water... Is she going to be okay?

touch.line: Do I look good in this swimsuit? I think it's rather revealing, though I'm happy as long as you like it.

touch2.line: Heehee. Your hand is nice and cool to the touch.

unlock.line: Ohh, it's so wonderful, being in the calm water with you, Commander... Eek! What's this?! A fish hook's caught on to me... Please stop reeling it in, or my swimsuit will untie itself!

battle.line: I so don't want to do this...

couple_encourage1.line: Always smiling, even on the battlefield, huh?

couple_encourage2.line: You and Asuka look strangely simila– Eek! S-sorry!

couple_encourage3.line: Umm, Fubuki... N-no! Never mind I said anything.

detail.line: This is a strange place. If I hadn't changed from my shut-in days... I'd probably be so scared I'd break down crying now.

expedition.line: Your errand girls are back. I'm glad they're all okay...

feeling1.line: No... I'm scared... Leave me to myself for a while...

feeling2.line: You don't smell anything, do you? Good. I have a pretty sharp nose, so...

feeling3.line: I talk to Bebeby whenever something's bothering me... From now on, though, I'll talk to you too, Commander.

feeling4.line: You've taught me so much, and I really wish I could return the favor... So, if you ever need someone to talk to, come straight to me.

feeling5.line: Truth be told... I don't want to fight. All I want is to go home as soon as I can. But, when I see everybody fighting for their dear lives... I feel like I can't abandon them.

headtouch.line: S-sorry... Huh? This isn't any kind of punishment? Okay, good...

home.line: W-welcome back. Are we done for today? Okay... Then can we relax for the rest of the day?

hp_warning.line: Ugghh... I'm afraid of pain...

login.line: Oh. You're back.

lose.line: I'm scared... I'm scared... I wanna go home...

mail.line: Commander... I think there's an unread letter for you.

main1.line: I worked extra hard, so can't I rest for a little longer? Miyabi isn't around, so...

main2.line: Despite all the scary stuff... I'll be fine as long as I have Bebeby.

main3.line: Your eyes scare me, Commander... Oh! Err, just a little, not a lot...

main4.line: Hatsuharu? Umm, hey, would you... N-never mind I said anything!

main5.line: I smell aromatic tea... Did you brew it, Belfast? Oh. Uhh... G-g-goodbye...

mission.line: You've got unfinished missions, so... maybe look at the list again?

mission_complete.line: Looks like you finished a mission... Good work.

profile.line: I'm Murasaki... from Hebijo Clandestine Girls' Academy. I don't really like going outside, so... can I go back to my room? Resting in my futon helps me destress...

propose.line: Well, Commander? Am I... good enough? Thank goodness. I'm glad to hear that from you. I guess this means I'm not a burden to you, right? Maybe my sister will praise me if I can pull my weight until I come home...

skill.line: I dance for the honor of evil.

touch.line: Breaktime is over? Can't we rest for five more minutes, please?

touch2.line: St-stop it...

unlock.line: I'm Murasaki... from Hebijo Clandestine Girls' Academy. Umm... what is this place? I'd like to go home now... The outdoors are scary...

upgrade.line: Maybe my special training with Bebeby has paid off.

win_mvp.line: Now I can finally go home.

gift_prefer.line: This is... Huh? For me... Yeah, I'm so happy... Thanks...

battle_ex.line: Okay. Let's do this.

detail_ex.line: When I first saw people wearing riggings, walking around the port, I felt like I was surrounded by superheroes... Secretly, though, I was really scared.

feeling5_ex.line: I think I can push myself just a little as long as I'm with you. So please, be kind to me until we've found a way to return to our home...

login_ex.line: Welcome back. I'm glad to see you again... If you weren't here, I'd shut myself in my room.

main6_ex.line: It's fun to hang out with people. And, as long as you're here, I don't feel scared...

main7_ex.line: Something smells friendly... *sniff sniff*... I think it's you, Commander.

main8_ex.line: I used to dislike going outside, but now I leave my room quite often... It's weird how things can change.

main9_ex.line: I-58, do you like quiet nights? Me too... I like it when it's quiet...

main10_ex.line: *sniff sniff*... You smell nice, Exeter... Like roses.

mission_ex.line: You still have unfinished missions. Maybe I could... help out, if you want?

mission_complete_ex.line: You've finished a mission. With that done... could we have a short break?

touch2_ex.line: You're right up next to me... But I don't mind...

win_mvp_ex.line: Oh, we won... Can we go back now?

detail.line: As much as I appreciate everyone inviting me to go swimming... I prefer staying right here.

home.line: Well fought. You must be exhausted, so nobody should mind if you go straight home.

login.line: Welcome home. Well, this isn't YOUR place, but can't you still call it "home"?

main1.line: I'll faint if I go outside when it's too sunny. I wish Mr. Sun would take it down a notch...

main2.line: I promise I won't spill my drinks... You don't mind if I keep a few around, right?

main3.line: Just need to get to the next save point... I'll go for a short swim once I'm done, so please wait for me at the beach.

main4.line: This swim ring you gave me is adorable... Thanks, Vestal.

main5.line: Le Malin pointed me to a napping spot... But, as great as it is, I think it's a little too sunny for me...

touch.line: There's arguably everything you need here to experience being on the beach.

touch2.line: There's no way I've gotten a tan, but... what do you think?

unlock.line: When you're in a swimsuit, listening to the waves, eating ice cream, and playing a beach game... can't you say it counts as being on the beach, even if you're indoors?

battle.line: Heheheh... Just leave everything to me!

couple_encourage1.line: Fubuki! I'll show you the results of my training!

couple_encourage2.line: Asuka, Homura... You two... are breathing perfectly in sync...

couple_encourage3.line: Murasaki! Don't just clam up and disappear on us!

detail.line: There are so many things about this port that I don't yet understand. It would be terrible if I accidentally ended up wrecking it... Though, I'm sure that's nothing Miss Nachi can't resolve with some money...

expedition.line: Wow, that's amazing... So this is what everyone uses to help guide them back home? ...Oh, and if this part here is glowing, that means...

feeling1.line: I might've placed too much faith in you. That is something I'll have to reflect upon...

feeling2.line: O-okay... But, that's still not enough... Eek! I, I'm so sorry! I wasn't watching where I was going... since I might've been lost in thought a little... I'll make sure to be more careful from now on.

feeling3.line: I think my shinobi skills have improved here. That may be partly due to your help, Commander... I hope Lady Jasmine can witness this after I return home...

feeling4.line: Don't you think you've been... coming on a bit strong recently? No, um, I'm not saying you shouldn't... If anything, I kind of like it... Um, forget I said anything...

feeling5.line: Commander, thanks to your mindfulness, I feel like... we've been able to move forward in a positive direction. Our ultimate goal is still to return home, and we're not going to give up on that, but... beyond that, we're glad to help you in other ways.

headtouch.line: Commander, do you... enjoy touching my hair?

home.line: Well fought, Commander. What did you think of our last battle? Hopefully, we were able to be of some use...

hp_warning.line: Ugh... I've got no choice... but to do this! This is where the real fight begins!

login.line: It's good to see you again. Let's... both give it our all today. Yes, me included...

lose.line: S-sorry... I think... I messed that one up a little...

mail.line: I've received several messages addressed to you, Commander... Would you like to review them right now?

main1.line: Holding a weapon is scary... and it's not something I'm good at... But I'm not going to be able to fight otherwise, right?

main2.line: I like animals a lot... but they don't seem to miss me a whole lot. Why do you think that is?

main3.line: The warmer it is, the more nature flourishes... just as is the case with me.

main4.line: There are lots of people here with silver or white hair, huh? I don't stand out much in comparison... Miss Belfast, you're also... very beautiful.

main5.line: Miss Hiei, is that the fermented food you have here? Do you mind if I have a taste? ...Huh? That takes bravery? If you put it that way, I'm sure I'd have even more regrets if I don't at least try it...

mission.line: Do you still have work left to do? Your job is quite difficult, isn't it...

mission_complete.line: You've already finished your work? Impressive, just as expected...

profile.line: M-my name is Yūyaki... I'm the leader of the Tohno Tengu Shinobi Group. Um... I must say, this city is quite spectacular. It has so many big buildings and facilities... Huh? It's not a city, but rather a port? And it's your base of operations too? I see... Life can be full of unpredictable surprises...

propose.line: Everyone here... and above all, you, Commander, showed me acceptance... I've come to realize, that is truly the most valuable treasure. The things that've happened here have taught me how bonds between people are formed and strengthened.

skill.line: Ahaha! I'll cut you to ribbons!

touch.line: People in the village always used to comment on how white and beautiful my hair is... What do you think, Commander?

touch2.line: I'm not sure... that's proper conduct...

unlock.line: My name is Yūyaki... and I'm the leader of the Tohno Tengu Shinobi Group... To be honest, I'm not great around water... Bad things always happen when I'm around it... And this place is a whole ocean, right? What should I do...?

upgrade.line: W-woah... I feel power coursing through me!

win_mvp.line: Ahh... My blood boils with victory!

gift_prefer.line: Commander, is this for me? Huh? Really?! No way... Thank you so much...

battle_ex.line: Just leave it all to me! I'll deliver victory right into your hands!

detail_ex.line: This place... is completely different from our village. But, after staying here for a while, it's starting to feel a bit like home... I'm getting used to it here.

feeling5_ex.line: To be entirely honest, there's a problem that I haven't been able to discuss with you. But, it'll be okay. My friends and I will find a way to get by. I'm sure that it'll be alright... because of you, Commander.

login_ex.line: W-welcome back. Commander, I was getting a bit lonely without you...

main6_ex.line: As Tohno's leader, I have to do my best... but I still feel like I'm not strong enough...

main7_ex.line: I wonder how Tohno Village is doing these days... I'd really like to know, but the battle here is also very important right now.

main8_ex.line: This port has so much delicious food... I have to tell Ushi when I get back.

main9_ex.line: I always feel calm and at peace when Miss Illustrious is around.

main10_ex.line: Amagi-chan, you'll tell me all about the delicious food at this port, right?

mission_ex.line: It looks like you can't keep up with your work... Shall I give you a hand...?

mission_complete_ex.line: Since you're done with work... How about going for some tea once you've wrapped things up?

touch2_ex.line: Commander... is this what gets you going? It's... rather embarrassing...

win_mvp_ex.line: You had the guts to stand before ME... at least, your courage is worth acknowledging!

detail.line: Blue skies, white clouds, and an ocean that stretches into the horizon... It's completely different from what you see in the mountains... I never imagined I'd be able to see scenery like this...

home.line: Good work, Commander. You really worked up a sweat, huh... I think you should get yourself tidied up first... Maintaining your appearance is also very important...

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Did you have any plans for the day? I don't mind keeping you company if you'd like...

main1.line: I think... I'd prefer relaxing by the mountainside to playing by the water...

main2.line: If I get a tan while wearing this outfit, it's going to leave behind imprints of my swimsuit... "But that's what makes it good?" Oh, um... I see...

main3.line: I feel my body get hotter than usual... when someone stares at me so intently...

main4.line: Miss Akashi, it's very thoughtful of you to bring drinks out for me, but... aren't these prices a bit excessive?

main5.line: I am quite experienced with water-manipulating skills as part of my shinobi training, but not quite to the level of mastery as Reno and the others...

touch.line: I can't believe you prepared all these wonderful swimsuits for us... Huh? You chose this one specifically for me? Umm... does it look good on me?

touch2.line: My skin's cold? Umm... that's because I just got out of the shower...

unlock.line: Phew... Nothing beats a cold shower. I'm still not great with water, but this cool and soothing sensation really makes me feel refreshed. Commander, do you want to join in?

battle.line: Leave it to me!

couple_encourage1.line: Momo, Nana! Let's kick butt together!

couple_encourage2.line: Yami, you're too cool!

couple_encourage3.line: Haruna, be careful out there!

couple_encourage4.line: You look stronger than before, Yui!

detail.line: The outfit I'm wearing right now is actually a transformed Peke! I have a version that matches Sainan High's uniform, too! Remind me to show you some time~

expedition.line: Shipping materials, huh... You should use the D-Dial I invented! It could save you a lot of time!

feeling1.line: Aww... That's kinda disappointing.
