feeling2.line: Commander, can you introduce me to everyone at the port? I wanna be their friend!

feeling3.line: Hey, what if we all threw a party together? It's sure to be fun and lively!

feeling4.line: Commander, we should go out into space sometime. I even had a spaceship prepared!

feeling5.line: Thanks to you, I've made so many friends at port! Thank you! And I'm happy to be YOUR friend, too, of course!

headtouch.line: What's up? Are you interested in Peke? It's a costume robot I made!

home.line: Good work on your mission, Commander! Take a nice break now~

hp_warning.line: Waaah! That huuurts!

login.line: I souped up your chair with my Almighty Tool! Now your work will be faster than ever! Come on, give it a try!

lose.line: Oof... Well, guess we should retreat...

mail.line: Commander, you've got new mail~ Don't forget it!

main1.line: Where should I set up my lab~ Is there enough space in your office?

main2.line: Wow! Is this one of Soobrazitelny's inventions? Neat! That's the genius of the Northern Parliament for you!

main3.line: All of the food here is so good! You wanna know what Deviluke food is like? I'll cook some now~

main4.line: Hey, do you get Explosive Heat: Magical Girl Kyouko here? That show is awesome! I'll invent a device that lets you watch it here!

mission.line: You still have unfinished missions. Being a Commander sounds tough!

mission_complete.line: Mission completion rewards received!

headtouch.line: I'll be fine! I can get through this!

touch2.line: H-hey...

couple_encourage2.line: I'll show you what I'm made of.

couple_encourage3.line: Let's do our best!

feeling1.line: So that's the kind of person you are...

feeling2.line: You might not be very reliable, Commander. I'll have to keep an eye out myself.

feeling3.line: The port's tennis court is pretty nice. How about we go play a round together?

feeling4.line: Wh-what do you mean, you're "fine with flat"?! Nobody asked, so keep your weirdo remarks to yourself, pervert!

feeling5.line: Thanks for coming to the zoo with me, Commander... Seeing all these cute animals really calms me down. I had a lot of fun today. Thanks again!

headtouch.line: Hm? What's up?

home.line: Hi again. What sweet stuff did you bring back for me today?

hp_warning.line: I-I'm getting mad!

lose.line: H-hey, what the heck is going on here?

main1.line: The vibe here at port feels kinda lonely... I think it'd be more fun if you had more cute animals around! Man, I wanna meet some animals... Take me to the zoo, right now!

main2.line: Commander, I see you staring at Momo... Wait, you think bigger is better, don't you?!

main3.line: You're awfully quiet in front of me. It's suspicious... I'd better watch you closely. N-not that I'm enjoying watching you, or anything!

main4.line: There are so many good swimmers here... Especially that I-25 girl. Her floppy bunny ears are too cute!

mission.line: You've still got missions waiting. Is now the time to be slacking?

mission_complete.line: What's a mission reward? It's kind of like a game. Interesting...

profile.line: Hm? Oh, I'm Lala's little sister, just like Momo. We came from Planet Deviluke. I can talk to animals! Also, if you do anything lewd around me, I'll hate you forever!

propose.line: I accept that you're someone I can rely on, Commander. Let's stay together for a long time to come! Huh? No, I never said I LIKED you! Get over yourself!

touch.line: Hah! Dodged it. Don't underestimate me.

touch2.line: I said cut it out!

unlock.line: Uh-huh, so you're the Commander? I'm Nana, Lala's little sister. This port you've got here is pretty lively... Well, it was nice meeting you.

upgrade.line: Whoooa, awesome!

win_mvp.line: Heheh! That's right, be grateful that I was here.

gift_prefer.line: Huh? Can I really have this...? Thank you! I'm so happy!

detail_ex.line: Don't think you can do whatever you want at port just because we're closer now! You're still unreliable, so I need to keep a watchful eye on you.

feeling5_ex.line: What do you mean when you say I'm "blessed with natural mobility"? Are you talking about my boobs?! Well, it doesn't sound like a compliment to me! But... If it was really meant that way, then maybe choose your words a little better next time.

headtouch_ex.line: D-don't treat me like a kid...

home_ex.line: I know you're busy, so I bought you a snack. Let's eat together before you get back to work.

login_ex.line: Welcome back! Let's do our best together today~ Ugh, it's still so embarrassing to talk like that... Let's just go back to acting normal, okay, Commander?

main5_ex.line: Oh, Commander, you're back. Hmm? My pet's been following you? Th-that's just me making sure you don't pull anything weird. It's not a sign of me being interested in you!

main6_ex.line: Momo might seem like a good girl, but don't let her lure you into a false sense of security. I've had enough of getting dragged into her problems.

main7_ex.line: Aww, I wish I could eat sweets with the Commander... Huh?! You bought some for us? Hooraaay!

main8_ex.line: Commander! Belfast invited us to a tea party~ I hear Royal Navy tea parties are as fancy as can be... Heheh, I should invite Lala and Momo along, too!

mission_ex.line: You STILL haven't finished your missions? Oh, fine. I'll just have to help you!

touch_ex.line: Th-that tickles! Cut it out!

touch2_ex.line: Y-you... beast!

feeling5.line: Wow. You pick up on the rules fast, Commander. Do you play a lot of games? If so, let's play some more sometime.

headtouch.line: No peeking!

home.line: Already done with your work? Then let's get back to it. Lala and Momo are waiting.

login.line: Finally, you're here. We were just starting a new game... Come on, you know I'm not gonna let you get away.

main1.line: Luck's just another part of skill, you know. Winning games is too easy for me – ready to give up and accept defeat yet?

main2.line: Heheh, I win again! Now you have to buy me snacks! ...Huh? You never promised that? Okay, then let's play again!

main3.line: I could play with you all day, Commander! Oh, right, you have work... That's rough, buddy. Should I get Lala and Momo to help you?

main4.line: Hey, so, I hear Long Island and Ayanami are good at video games... Does that make them good at card games, too? I dunno.

mission.line: You can play AFTER you finish your missions.

mission_complete.line: While you're focused on missions, you might as well go and pick up your rewards.

touch2.line: Not another touch, I mean it!

couple_encourage1.line: Momo, Nana! Let's kick butt together!

couple_encourage2.line: Yami, you're too cool!

couple_encourage3.line: You look stronger than before, Yui!

detail.line: I can converse with plants, and it sounds like all the plants in your office are grateful for your care. It's plain to see that you're a very kind and caring person, Commander.

expedition.line: The shipgirls who went out for commission work are back. Would you like for me to go help them?

feeling1.line: So this is the Commander who leads the port... How disappointing.

feeling2.line: How do you normally spend time with the girls of the port? I'm curious.

feeling3.line: Everyone gets along so well here. That speaks to your impressive leadership, Commander.

feeling4.line: Actually, I happen to have a certain... plan of my own. I'm sure it'll help you, but for now, it's my little secret.

feeling5.line: During our time together, I've begun to understand why all the girls here love you so much. This is indispensable information for the sake of my plan.

headtouch.line: Is something wrong? Do you need my help?

hp_warning.line: This is getting irksome...

lose.line: I'm sorry, Commander.

main1.line: How can you stay so calm when you're surrounded by lovely women all the time?

main2.line: I love how fancy the port's café is. It even has plenty of video game consoles. If only it had a garden, it would be perfect.

main4.line: Kiev of the Northern Parliament seems to really like cacti. Just recently, she had me teach her how to grow them.

mission.line: You still have missions to do. Try your hardest for just a little longer, okay?

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards? Once you get them, let's relax with some tea.

profile.line: I am Momo Belia Deviluke of Planet Deviluke, and I'm one of Lala's little sisters. Oh, and I can hear the voices of plants. I hope we can get along well during my time here.

propose.line: In order to further our relationship... Yes, I need to execute my plan! Oh? You want to know what it is? Well, it's a genius plan... A plan to make everyone here love you even more!

touch.line: Are you curious about my tail? Well, I suppose you can touch it...

touch2.line: My, my... That won't do, Commander.

upgrade.line: Oh, my... Have I changed?

win_mvp.line: Yeah... I need to keep doing my best.

gift_prefer.line: Is this a present? Thank you very much.

headtouch_ex.line: Heehee... You're too sweet, Commander.

touch2_ex.line: Mm... You're getting awfully bold, Commander...

headtouch.line: Thank you very much.

login.line: Oh, no... Are you okay? You look like you need water. I'll get some right away.

main4.line: You always make the people of the port your first priority. I think that's why everybody loves you so much.

touch.line: Do you need my help?

touch2.line: C-Commander... Feeling better already?

feeling1.line: ...Don't come any closer.

feeling5.line: You noticed that I'd finished your books and bought more for me... Thank you. You're kinder than I'd thought.

headtouch.line: What?

home.line: Well done, Commander.

hp_warning.line: It's over.

main4.line: This is my combat gear. I wear it so I'm ready for a fight at any time.

mission.line: New missions, hm...

touch.line: Do you need something?

touch2.line: I hate perverts!

unlock.line: I'm Golden Darkness. Pleasured to make your acquaintance.

upgrade.line: Is this... new power?

win_mvp.line: It's done.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much... I really like it.

feeling5_ex.line: Maybe it's best to simply enjoy my time with you and my friends while we still can.

headtouch_ex.line: Is there a new mission?

login_ex.line: May I help, Commander?

touch_ex.line: *staaare*...

touch2_ex.line: I'll kill you!

detail.line: A pajama party...? That sounds fun.

expedition.line: I hear the commission team finished their work. You should go greet them soon, Commander.

headtouch.line: Are you having some perverted thoughts?

login.line: Don't get ahead of yourself, Commander.

main2.line: What do people DO at pajama parties?

main3.line: Commander... Why are you staring?

couple_encourage2.line: Impressive as ever, Kotegawa! I should to my best, too!

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Wanna go see them together, Commander?

feeling1.line: Maybe this isn't a place I can rest easy in, after all...

feeling2.line: I was worried that I wouldn't be able to get along with the people here, but with your help, I think I'll be just fine!

feeling3.line: You're really sweet, Commander. You pay attention to me, help me when I need it... Thank you.

feeling4.line: I had a lot of worries at first, but thanks to you and everyone else here, I feel a lot better.

headtouch.line: Hm? Something wrong?

login.line: Good morning, Commander. You've been busy lately, so I organized your work for today. Hopefully that helps.

lose.line: I'm sorry, Commander... It's just so scary...

mail.line: Remember to check your mail regularly.

main2.line: Is Mary Celeste really a ghost? So ghosts really do exist...

main3.line: Is it weird to walk around port in my school uniform? What do you think?

main4.line: Lala's really taken to this place. I should do my best, too, so that I don't trouble the people of this world.

mission.line: Make sure you don't forget your unfinished missions, okay?

mission_complete.line: Your missions are all done! Good job. Get some rest.

propose.line: Is this proof that you've acknowledged me? Thank you! If there's anything else I can help you with, just tell me! I don't know how good at it I'll be, but I'll do my very best!

skill.line: I can do this! Yeah, I know it!

touch.line: What's the matter, Commander? Oh, if you have time, let's chat for a while.

touch2.line: Eep?! We can't...

unlock.line: Nice to meet you, Commander. My name is Haruna Sairenji. I'm going to be in your care for a while, but if there's anything you need my help with, don't hesitate to ask!

upgrade.line: Do I feel stronger? I do. It's weird, though...

win_mvp.line: We won? Thank goodness! And thank you for your orders.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander! I will treasure this.

detail_ex.line: I still don't understand how rigging works, but I'm happy I can fight like Lala now. It makes me not want to part with it again~

feeling5_ex.line: I think I've accomplished a lot here. I wasn't able to hold my own in a fight before unlike Lala, and I had so little confidence in myself. But thanks to you, I could muster the courage to try. From now on, I'll keep doing my best so I can be the protector instead of the protected!

headtouch_ex.line: You're too nice, Commander.

home_ex.line: I've gotten used to my rigging AND combat, so I think I'll be able to help next time we sortie!

login_ex.line: Good to be working with you again, Commander. I'm your secretary ship today, so I summarized your schedule and such. Take a look, please.

main5_ex.line: I can do any and all chores, so call me if you need housework done. I'm happy to help.

main6_ex.line: Milk is good for you and helps you get taller, so I drink it all the time. There's NO other reason! ...Have some, Commander.

main7_ex.line: That Dolphin girl really is like a dolphin. She's kind, gentle... and she also gave me a blobfish.

main8_ex.line: Commander, is it true that there's an aquarium here? Let's go there together. I bet I'll see all kinds of sea creatures that weren't in my world.

mission_ex.line: I made a list of your missions. Does that help?

touch2_ex.line: Geez, Commander. I'll still get mad, even when it's you...

win_mvp_ex.line: Yes...! We managed to protect everyone, Commander!

detail.line: Hearing the ocean and feeling the warm sunlight is a great way to wake up. Thanks for letting me live here, Commander. I love it.

feeling5.line: Good night, Commander. Sweet dreams.

headtouch.line: My heart skipped a beat...

home.line: How about a hot drink? Maybe coffee or tea... Oh, hot milk to help you sleep might be a good idea.

login.line: You look sleepy, Commander. It's been a busy afternoon. I think you should clock out early today.

main1.line: I've been scared of these odd noises I hear from the hallway at night... Imagine my relief when I learned it was just Bristol investigating the dorms.

main2.line: Sometimes, I still leave the light on when I sleep. When it's dark, I can't stop thinking about scary stories.

main3.line: Lala invited me to a pillow fight party. Everyone else is coming – join us, Commander!

main4.line: I'm growing these succulents. Aren't they cute? If you like them, feel free to take one.

mission.line: You've been working this late? That's awful... Tell me if I can help at all, okay?

touch.line: I can't sleep, either... Here's an idea. Why don't you tell me more about yourself and the people here at port?

touch2.line: Hyah?! No more of that, please...

unlock.line: I made some black tea, Commander. We could drink it together, if you'd like...? These are my favorite tea leaves.

battle.line: I won't let even one breach of discipline pass!

couple_encourage1.line: Stop pulling out so many weird things during combat!

detail.line: Hmm... There are so many girls breaking the rules here that I can't deal with them all myself. Commander, can you help me patrol?

expedition.line: Commander, the commission work is complete. Don't forget to collect the supplies.

feeling1.line: You have no common sense. Just disappointing.

feeling2.line: So many strange things around here converge on you... A Disciplinary Committee member knows no rest, I guess.

feeling3.line: I saw a girl with cat ears the other day. I'd assumed they were just a headband, but they were real! Lala's tail surprised me, but that was an even bigger shock.

feeling4.line: The school at port is a lot like the one we go to. But the chemical equation on the blackboard is wrong. Who wrote that...?

feeling5.line: Before I knew it, I'd gotten so used to life here. I will continue to fight and carry out my disciplinary duties – for you, and for the people of the port!

headtouch.line: Wh-what? What's the problem?

home.line: Thanks for your efforts, Commander. Rest is important, so... I brought you a cold drink...

hp_warning.line: I can still keep fighting!

login.line: Back at home, we said that disheveled dress reflects a disheveled mind. What I'm saying is, you should dress better.

lose.line: I-impossible!

mail.line: Commander, there's new mail for you. Don't let your mailbox fill up with unread messages.

main1.line: You need to focus when you're working, Commander! No glancing around or fiddling with random things!

main2.line: The port's Meowfficers look a little different from normal cats... but they're round and cute in their own way, so it's fine.

main3.line: This stuff called "rigging" is awfully flashy... Why does mine have a plant stem in its mouth, though?

mission.line: You have new mission deadlines, Commander. Don't miss them!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Phew... Maybe now I can finally get a break.

profile.line: Yui Kotegawa, Sainan High Discipline Committee. I ended up here after an unfortunate accident, but it's obvious that discipline is a serious issue here. So I'm going to do my job – just leave it to me!

propose.line: If everyone still needs me here, then I don't mind staying here longer. But no perverted behavior while I'm here, got it?!

skill.line: No perverted activities on my watch!

touch.line: What's up? Do you want help with something?

touch2.line: H-how... utterly depraaaved!

unlock.line: Are you the Commander? I'm Yui Kotegawa, and I'm pleased to make your acquaintance. Some strange circumstances brought me here... But if I'm to intrude on your port, then I promise to uphold discipline in return!

upgrade.line: Wh-what is this?! Am I... getting stronger?!

win_mvp.line: Phew... It's finally over.

gift_prefer.line: This is so cute... Th-Thanks, Commander.

feeling5_ex.line: Thanks for agreeing to go to the port's cat café with me, Commander. Those soft, friendly kitties, especially the Meowfficers... They're too adorable!

headtouch_ex.line: H-hey, if you need something, you can say it.

home_ex.line: Commanding a whole port sounds difficult. You should make sure you're well-rested before you take on your next workload.

login_ex.line: Good morning, Commander. The port really is full of all kinds. I thought Lala was weird, but she doesn't hold a candle to some of the people here.

main4_ex.line: This kitty really likes you... I-I'm jealous. Can you teach me how to be liked by cats?

main5_ex.line: People listen when I warn them about breaches of discipline, but there's still too much to overlook. I have to keep it up!

main6_ex.line: As a disciplinarian, it's natural that I uphold order here. Help me out, Commander!

mission_ex.line: Another new mission? Darn... I'm happy to help, if you'd like.

mission_complete_ex.line: You finished all of those missions? I'm impressed.

touch2_ex.line: Commander! People like you make me so... Ugh! Kneel down and apologize!

detail.line: I might not look it, but I'm a busy person... But I do worry about you, so if you have something to say, go ahead.

feeling5.line: Next time you're free... We could go out to the cat café, or you could hang out here, even without a reason... Sometimes, though. Sometimes! I'm only offering because it'd be easier to get to know everyone and uphold discipline if you're with me, that's all!

headtouch.line: What are you thinking right now?

home.line: Don't you think it's time for a break? You shouldn't push yourself too much, okay...?

login.line: Commander, did you come looking for this kitty here? Thanks. Umm... If you have some spare time, you know... I mean... N-never mind!

main1.line: I think it'll be fine for now. Thanks for your help, Commander – but don't relax too much, because I might need it again soon.

main2.line: Algérie and I chatted about cats and took a lot of pictures together. You should take a look, Commander.

main3.line: I want to take this cat to the cat café. Can you come with me? It'd be awful if she got away.

mission_complete.line: This kitty has really taken a liking to you. Now I feel bad about the thought of taking her back to the cat café...

touch2.line: Commander?! Eeek! What are you looking at?! P-pervert!

unlock.line: Come on over, I'm not scary~... Wha, Commander?! H-hey... don't go barging into people's rooms! Look, you're scaring my new friend!

battle.line: Let's go... I'll carve us a path.

detail.line: What meaning is in the struggles of this world? I must fight on until I know.

expedition.line: Our allies have returned. I sense relief.

feeling1.line: Your many friends should be cherished, now and forever...

feeling2.line: Have you ever heard... that talking with others can help you maintain a balanced heart and mind?

feeling3.line: I was born for combat, but that doesn't mean that I can't connect with others. That includes you, of course.

feeling4.line: You protecting me... It's almost laughable how unrealistic it is. But I do feel a sense of gratitude...

feeling5.line: Love and hate are such powerful emotions. They can hurt others or save their lives. I could never refute these whims of the heart.

headtouch.line: What? Do you doubt my existence? Hmm... Yes, you may see my existence as hazy.

home.line: You're back safe and sound... Do not forget to rest.

hp_warning.line: I've only... just begun!

login.line: Good morning, Commander. Beware... I sense another battle ahead of us.

lose.line: I'm not done yet...

mail.line: There appears to be mail addressed to you. I recommend checking.

main1.line: Azur Lane and Sirens are concepts that I've never heard of, but I understand that here, they are firm reality.

main2.line: Friends can quickly become foes – a common occurrence. Even then, my promise to protect you still stands.

main3.line: There's nothing better than being able to find time to rest. You should keep that in mind, Commander.

main4.line: I want to compare the power of cannons with that of my ★Rock Cannon. Knowing one's strength is important.

mission.line: Something seems unnatural about your work. Am I just imagining it?

mission_complete.line: Your work is complete.

profile.line: When the world is shrouded in dark and all hope is lost, I continue to struggle and fight. I am BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER, and I will guide your way forward.

propose.line: I see fire in your eyes when you speak of the future. Is it the same fire that burns in my left eye? I don't know if I'll learn the answer today, tomorrow, or ever... but I hope to know someday.

skill.line: Limiters released! It's over for you!

touch.line: It's okay... I'm no illusion. I still exist in this world.

touch2.line: ...Should I perceive you as an enemy?

unlock.line: Are you... my enemy? No... I don't sense hostility, but instead, strong willpower. So this world is full of struggle, too. You are... the Commander? I am BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER, and I will protect you.

upgrade.line: I'm stronger... though I don't look any different.

win_mvp.line: Annihilation complete... Onward.

gift_prefer.line: Thanks... I'll treasure it.

battle_ex.line: Witness how BLACK★ROCK SHOOTER fights.

detail_ex.line: I fight alone... but in this world, you all work together. I don't consider that a bad thing.

feeling5_ex.line: Many of the stories in this world have so-called "happy endings." That is proof of the people's wishes, and I want to see that world made – by your side.

login_ex.line: Good morning, Commander. I noticed your presence and came to greet you.

main5_ex.line: The port is so close to the battlefield, but it has a peaceful atmosphere... How strange. How much of that is thanks to your power?

main6_ex.line: Everyone here is strong. Being here has made me stronger, too. Being able to use my power productively... makes me happy.

main7_ex.line: If you're worried about something, then come to me. I'm sure that my powers can help with any obstacle in your way.

main8_ex.line: You're interested in my ★Rock Cannon? If you can improve it, then that would be a great help.

mission_ex.line: Is there any way... I can help with your work?

mission_complete_ex.line: You finished your work without my notice. Well done.

touch2_ex.line: I feel your warmth. So this... is existence.

win_mvp_ex.line: May your eyes forever look back upon this victory.

detail.line: If you want to train, then you should learn to swim in your usual clothes instead of a swimsuit. That'll be more useful in combat.

home.line: I think I'll swim a little while I wash off the sweat of battle... You want to join me? Well, I don't mind...

login.line: I can sense your presence there, even when you just stare at me in silence.

main1.line: The sea stretching out into the horizon... I find this blue planet beautiful. The waves receding under my feet and the scent of the sea breeze are nice, too.

main2.line: Is this swimsuit for personal use? I see... I'm sorry you had to go out of your way to prepare it for me. I'll thank you on the battlefield.

main3.line: Even when it comes to water fights, I don't hold back, so give me your all. No, I'm not mad that you just soaked me a minute ago.

touch.line: Forgive me for being a little more alert when I'm so exposed.

touch2.line: Don't you find your actions overly reckless?

unlock.line: The babbling of brooks and the crashing of waves were once such minor things to me. As people who do battle on the sea, you all must see something greater in them, too. But I wonder... if this swimsuit isn't very well-suited for combat.

battle.line: Ready your weapons. Yes, it's time to fight.

detail.line: Her existence summons me. It's as universal as any other natural law.

expedition.line: Your friends are back, you know. Do you always leave them hanging?

feeling1.line: I want you to disappear without sound or trace. Oh, you think I'm joking?

feeling2.line: Speaking with you like this feels... strange.

feeling3.line: I'm hardly one to speak, but why do you spend time with such an incomprehensible being? You're an odd one.

feeling4.line: Thinking about everything so far... I realize that it's strange in itself that I can stand here and speak with you.

feeling5.line: Past, present, and future are all one and the same to me. I'm surprised that I've found someone other than her who can stand out among all that.

headtouch.line: You've never considered that mind and body might be separated? Heh, how naïve.

home.line: Welcome back. Done what you needed to do? Well, you look happy, so I'm happy.

hp_warning.line: That's enough warm-up.

login.line: It's been a while... Hm, but not that long, I suppose? I'm just doing what I feel like, so don't worry about me.

lose.line: Makes my skin crawl...

mail.line: This message is for you, apparently. I guess you're not in much of a hurry.

main1.line: You've explained this world to me, but I still don't understand it. That must mean it isn't worth my care.

main2.line: You call this the "port," but it's hard to wrap my head around what that means. I expect you to explain it clearly.

main3.line: There's really no need for you to care especially about my existence here, you know.

mission.line: Oh? Your work isn't done yet. Slacking off, are we?

mission_complete.line: So you finish your work, and then you pretend it doesn't exist? How carefree.

profile.line: I'm the nightmare chasing a certain girl upon her appearance in this world, both her greatest enemy and closest friend. Now, raise your sword. Let's fight.

propose.line: My war with her was the only thing that gave me shape, but a certain something, some momentary respite, has ripped me out of that cycle and won't let me go... This must be a fleeting fantasy.

skill.line: May this blow haunt you for eternity!

touch.line: Are you curious about the nature of my existence? Consider it... unstable.

touch2.line: You'd best think about the meaning of your actions.

unlock.line: Now where exactly am I? Hmm... Well, this is a mess, isn't it? I want you to tell me everything, but if I'm here, then she must be, too... Oh, don't worry about it. I'm DEAD MASTER, and I guess I'm sticking with you for a while. There's got to be a good reason I'm here, after all.

upgrade.line: Do I look different? If you say so, then it must be true.

win_mvp.line: Heehee, that was as refreshing as always.

gift_prefer.line: Do you know what it means to give a present? Oh. In that case, I'll take it.

battle_ex.line: Let's begin the battle, shall we?

detail_ex.line: Am I just a boat drifting along with the world's rhythm? If so... maybe your existence is one of its verses.

feeling5_ex.line: I thought I would experience the same conflict and same resolution for all time, but now I want a different future for myself... When did I become such a bad girl?

login_ex.line: You've returned. Oh, don't mind me. I came out to see you because I wanted to.

main4_ex.line: My connection with her will never be severed, but surely there's nothing wrong with resting my legs once in a while, right?

main5_ex.line: The battles here are ceaseless... I can tell. So be careful, ever so careful...

main6_ex.line: Just so you know, our fight is similar but different from yours. But for some reason, you and I are connected now... so I'm just helping you out a little.

mission_ex.line: This task isn't finished, and neither is this one! Goodness, what am I going to do with you?

mission_complete_ex.line: Hmm? You finished all your work just like that? Well, you're pretty good at this.

touch2_ex.line: So? Do you feel something? Yes... I'm warm, aren't I?

win_mvp_ex.line: I thought I would experience the same conflict and same resolution for all time, but now I want a different future for myself... When did I become such a bad girl?

detail.line: Of course I don't carry a swimsuit around all the time. I had the girls here prepare this one for me. How do you feel about it, Commander?

home.line: Welcome back. Are you tired at all? I'll make tea, so rest a moment.

login.line: Welcome, Commander. If you have time, come and keep me company.

main1.line: I'm amazed that things can be so peaceful when she and I are in the same world line... If I told my past self – or my future self – she definitely wouldn't believe me, that's for sure.

main2.line: Wow, really? No, fighting is not my only reason for being. I don't mind taking things slow once in a while.

main3.line: It's not that I can't swim... Really, I mean it. But whether you're in the sea or a pool, don't you think stretching out in a swimsuit is just as fun?

touch.line: Oh? Which entices you more... the feeling of the swimsuit, or my skin?

touch2.line: Yes, I assure you I'm real. Is it so unusual to see me like this?

unlock.line: Oh? Commander, stop staring and come over here. Let's have a cup of tea and relax... Huh? You're concerned about my outfit? Aren't swimsuits common sights here, or am I special somehow?

battle.line: I'm... ready now!

couple_encourage1.line: Please don't run too far ahead, Nina!

couple_encourage2.line: Lenja! We'll do this on my mark!

detail.line: In my homeworld, beyond just making things, I'd also exterminate monsters. But I suppose that skill isn't in particularly high demand here... right?

expedition.line: The research team has returned to base. I wonder what they found?

feeling1.line: Oh, hang on. Can this wait until I'm done preparing?

feeling2.line: Alright! Ready to get to work. Let's see if I can't put my alchemy to use!

feeling3.line: Oh, Commander! Do you have a minute? I'm going on an expedition into the woods, and it'd be great if you could come with!

feeling4.line: Hmm... So you don't want "the greatest discovery of the century" or "the shocking truth"? I just want to make you happy, you know.

feeling5.line: You believe in and accept me and my alchemy, despite its status as an unknown and vague craft from your point of view... Thank you so much for that, Commander.

headtouch.line: Oh, are you curious about my alchemy tools? Everyone I meet always is.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. How'd your sortie go? Actually, knowing you, I'll bet it was a great success.

hp_warning.line: I can... still fight!

login.line: Ah, Commander! As always, I'm counting on you.

lose.line: Urgh... Just one step short...

mail.line: A letter has arrived. Might be urgent business...

main1.line: I'm working on some items that can be used in battle with the enemy... I think I'll need to further research which abilities are effective, though.

main2.line: Hm? What are these yellow birds? And these cat-looking creatures? They're... kind of cute.

main3.line: That tracking device I once made could probably be useful here, too. I don't know how I'll get the materials, though... Alright, I'll ask around to see what materials you have here.

mission.line: Looks like we still have work to do... Should I report it?

mission_complete.line: What?! You're done already? Didn't you JUST start working?

profile.line: My name is Yumia Liessfeldt. I'm an alchemist. Everyone has a different take on the use of alchemy. Personally, I always remind myself that everyone has to think and judge for themselves how it's meant to be used.

propose.line: My, um... My heart is really racing. Ahahaha... This is a kind of throbbing that's quite different from what I feel when I discover a new alchemy recipe. Don't tell anyone about this, okay?

touch.line: Does this stuff strike you as odd? I don't think my gun, my boots – or any of my items, really – are anything special...

touch2.line: Hey! I'll blow a gasket if you break my tools!

unlock.line: Huh? Where am I? This isn't Eustella, and it certainly isn't Aladiss... Um, excuse me, stranger, could you tell me about this world we're in? Oh, I'm Yumia... Yumia Liessfeldt, an alchemist... Well, do you know what alchemy is?

upgrade.line: It feels like my knowledge has deepened a bit more!

win_mvp.line: Nice! It worked!

gift_prefer.line: Huh? Can I really have something this precious?! Th-thank you so much!

atelier_yumia_item_2.line: Some of it is dangerous, so you'd better be careful.

atelier_yumia_item_3.line: This pointy thing is... an Uni!

atelier_yumia_item_4.line: Owch! Should've known this would be a pain...

atelier_yumia_item_8.line: This should work as a material!

atelier_yumia_item_9.line: I'd better not harvest too much.

atelier_yumia_item_10.line: Wonder what this can be used for...

atelier_yumia_item_11.line: I wonder if this world's fish are tasty, too?

battle_ex.line: We'll get through this by working together!

detail_ex.line: An alchemist's studio is called an atelier, which makes the port my atelier... Would you mind if I started calling it that?

feeling5_ex.line: When I'm able to stand by your side and use my power – alchemy – to help... Those times make me feel really honored and proud. I hope I can continue to be of use to you.

login_ex.line: Good morning, Commander! Can we work together today?

main4_ex.line: I learned alchemy by myself. Yes, it was because I didn't want to be a bother to anyone. As long as it's able to help the people of this place, then my hard work wasn't for nothing.

main5_ex.line: Your stories fascinate and inspire me, Commander. They also give me new alchemical ideas! I hope you'll keep telling me things.

main6_ex.line: This is a place where you can do so many things... That's why I think I can do even more interesting things using alchemy. That's what my gut is telling me!

mission_ex.line: Commander, there's still work to do. I'll help you out, so let's get it done!

mission_complete_ex.line: Oh, you're finished. Then it's time for a break. For us both.

touch2_ex.line: You may be in charge here, but there are still things you can and cannot do!

win_mvp_ex.line: That's a wrap! Glad everyone's alright.

detail.line: Weighing the ingredients, mixing them at the right ratios, baking them at the right temperature... It might sound really complicated, but these are the essentials of cooking. It's a lot like alchemy!

home.line: Now, let's check on that dough I left to rise... Yeah, looks like it's coming along well. This will turn out delicious!

login.line: Perfect timing, Commander! Breakfast is ready.

main1.line: Hmm... Wish I had more varied ingredients... Need to combine everything at the correct time... Ahh, so the amount of water affects the dough's characteristics... Oh! Commander. Sorry, my mind was elsewhere just now.

main2.line: Having a clear vision of the finished product is important. That goes for both cooking and alchemy. Of course, putting love into what you're making is important, too.

main3.line: As much as I like making everyone happy, it feels quite special to make something for just one person... Huh?! Commander?! D-did you hear anything just now?

touch.line: Hey! No snacking!

touch2.line: There'll be no dessert for you today if you keep this up!

unlock.line: Ah, sure. Could you wait just a minute? These are nearly done baking. Mmh, that smells wonderful! I reckon these are my pièce de résistance. Speaking of baking, I think it has a surprising amount of things in common with alchemy.

battle.line: Here we go! Be careful, everyone!

couple_encourage1.line: I'll leave the vanguard to you, Yumia!

couple_encourage2.line: Nina, that attack was so cool!

couple_encourage3.line: Lenja, let's coordinate our next attack!

detail.line: I love clothes and accessorizing! It's fascinating how unique everyone's outfits are here!

expedition.line: Your research team is back. Let's go say hi to them!

feeling1.line: You should try being nicer to people. It'll help you out in the future.

feeling2.line: Haha, don't be so formal with me! Let's both relax a little, okay?

feeling3.line: Oh? Commander, if you're free, then let's go shopping. I bet it'll be fun!

feeling4.line: Tell me anything you need, alright? We're friends. Isn't it normal... to want to help you out?

feeling5.line: There must be a really important reason why I ended up in this world... and I think I'll figure it out as long as I stay with you.

headtouch.line: Hm? Need help, or anything? Don't worry. I'm here to help!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! How'd it go? Did you win? Oh wow, I see.

hp_warning.line: No problem... This is like nothing to me!

login.line: Alright! Here's to another great day, Commander!

lose.line: Ouch... Ugh! Hold back a little, would you?

mail.line: Oh, you've got mail from everyone, Commander!

main1.line: I've tried out all kinds of awesome technology here. You guys don't call it alchemy, though... The world really is full of mysteries!

main2.line: Back in our world, we could get pelts and stuff just by adventuring. It seems harder here... Huh? We can use sea monster skin? That does sound enticing...

main3.line: I wanna try sewing an outfit or two for you... Would you be interested? I can do handsome, cute, and everything in between, as long as you're willing to model for me.

mission.line: If you put off all of the work you hate, that'll just make it more of a slog later.

mission_complete.line: Our work here is done! Never leave a task undone, okay?

profile.line: I'm Isla von Duerer, a member of the Order of Eustella! I run around doing all kinds of odd jobs, like killing monsters, and... Oh, that doesn't matter right now, huh? Anyway, you still gotta be fashionable when you're in a fight. I want to be at the forefront of style!

propose.line: Geez, don't make fun of me! I really didn't know how to respond to that... I mean... It's hard to accept that our relationship is really real, you know?

touch.line: Hmm? Are my clothes torn somewhere? That's okay! You might not guess it, but I'm great at mending!

touch2.line: Huh?! Geez, what're you doing?!

unlock.line: I'm Isla von Duerer! Call me Isla! I'm with the Order of Eustella and the Aladiss Research Team... So hey, why am I here?! Do you know why?

upgrade.line: Check this out. I'm even stronger now!

win_mvp.line: Woohoo! We won!

gift_prefer.line: Huh? Is this for me? Amazing! Thanks~

atelier_yumia_shop_1.line: Welcome to my shop! Heh, just kidding♪

atelier_yumia_shop_2.line: What've you got to trade with me today?

atelier_yumia_shop_4.line: You'll trade for this? Ah, you have good taste!

atelier_yumia_shop_5.line: Whoa! I've completely sold out! Nice work, Commander!

battle_ex.line: All ready? Then let's get going!

detail_ex.line: I've experienced a lot of crazy things like alchemy, but all the stuff that happens here is crazy in whole new ways!

feeling5_ex.line: Someday, I might have to go back to my old world. But even if that happens, I won't lose the experiences I had here... No matter how it looks, the bond between our hearts will still be there.

login_ex.line: Morning! Fancy seeing you this early. It must be my lucky day!

main4_ex.line: I can make work clothes for you, if you're okay with that. I'll make them nice and flexible!

main5_ex.line: Commander, I wanna see some of the clothes here... Huh? You'll take me shopping? Hooray! Let's go right now.

main6_ex.line: Your job is to rest now, Commander! I'll get the weaponry ready and prepare everything for battle!

mission_ex.line: Come on, you still have work to do! Do your best~

mission_complete_ex.line: Oh! Finished your work? Good stuff!

touch2_ex.line: If you want a hug, just tell me that!

win_mvp_ex.line: Wow... That was incredible, Commander!

detail.line: It's crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and it just melts in your mouth! Give it a try!

home.line: Welcome, welcome! After a day of hard work, you need some nourishment, right? Which dish would you like to try first? You can have anything you like♪

login.line: Welcome, Commander! You're just in time to try the herbal tea!

main1.line: Have a taste! These are all my original recipes, and I'm proud of them all! Eat until you've had your fill! And when you're done, let me know what you think!

main2.line: A blue sky, white clouds, and loads of delicious dishes lining the table make for a beautiful scene in my opinion. What do you think?

main3.line: Commander, which do you like more – seafood or forage? Make an order now and I'll even personally feed you!

touch.line: Hey, no snacking! The food is almost done, so just wait a little longer♪

touch2.line: Heheh, is this what you like, Commander?

unlock.line: Hello and welcome to my wonderful cookout! I tried out all kinds of special BBQ recipes! Well, everything looks tasty, right? ...Huh? Me? I'm not on the menu!

battle.line: Let's finish this quick!

couple_encourage1.line: I swear, things never get boring when you're around.

couple_encourage2.line: I'm snuggling you for one hour after this. Get ready, okay?

detail.line: I'm actually a mercenary, so I took to this "rigging" pretty easily even though it was my first time seeing it. In real combat, what you have is what you have.

expedition.line: Those errand girls just got back. Yes, yes, I suppose we should go see them.

feeling1.line: I'll help you with your work. No more, no less.

feeling2.line: Let's do our best at work today, Commander!

feeling3.line: Strange... This doesn't seem right. Maybe if you were fluffier, I'd understand...

feeling4.line: For some reason, I can always tell when you're looking at me. Yes, I'm surprised, too – who knew I'd care?

feeling5.line: "I was just wandering around, and I ended up here!" Obviously, I'm kidding. This strange place, our new friends, and you... There must be a special meaning to it all.

headtouch.line: Hey, now. You shouldn't touch a lady's hair so casually.

home.line: You look tired. How about I make you a cup of herbal tea? Relax a while.

hp_warning.line: Not done yet... I'm just getting started!

login.line: Hi there, Commander. Doing well? Let's get some work done!

lose.line: Well... I've gone and embarrassed myself now.

mail.line: Commander. This mail's for you, isn't it? Check more carefully next time.

main1.line: Everyone here looks so nice. You've got everything from cute girls to sexy big sister types. If Isla were here right now, she'd go research them all one by one.

main2.line: These weapons are magnitudes stronger than the ones we're used to... Even an experienced merc such as myself might struggle to use them to the fullest.

main3.line: I've really gotten into herbal tea lately. This place has all kinds of tea leaves I've never seen before. Try some with me some time... I promise I won't put anything weird in it.

mission.line: Hmm? You have unfinished tasks here. Did you forget?

mission_complete.line: Wow, are we done here? Better check your rewards before you forget about them.

profile.line: Nina Friede. I spend my days hard at work with the Aladiss Research Team. Place of origin? Age? I keep that info secret. Heheh... It's better when a girl has a little mystery to her, don't you think?

propose.line: If I didn't run into you back then, I'm sure I wouldn't be here... I'd be someone else entirely. As for what that means? Leave it to the historians to find out.

touch.line: Hm? What's wrong? If something's troubling you, you can talk to me.

touch2.line: Heehee. That's enough of that.

unlock.line: Well, hello there. I'm Nina, a member of the Research Team... Not that it matters much to you. Anyway, I'm not sure what to do now... Oh? You want me to go to your house? My, my, are you sure that's appropriate?

upgrade.line: Oh my, my, my. Is it just me, or are you in need of help?

win_mvp.line: Aww. Is that all you've got?

gift_prefer.line: Uh, what? This is for me? Hehe. Thanks. I'll treasure it.

battle_ex.line: Here we go!

detail_ex.line: Some mercs like having long-term clients. What do you think? Interested?

feeling5_ex.line: I see... That explains everything. Okay, I accept defeat. Hmm? Don't worry about it. I'm not changing – I've just made up my mind about things, that's all.

login_ex.line: Ugh, how long are you going to make me wait... Haha, I'm just kidding. Thanks for all you do.

main4_ex.line: I used to be a mercenary. But maybe there's a world in which this place becomes my homeland... in which wherever YOU are becomes my home.

main5_ex.line: Say, Commander, you know you can pay a little more attention to me. For example, I'm hungry and would love to eat with you right now.

main6_ex.line: Rely on me as a mercenary if you want, but I'd like it even more if you leaned on me as a person who cares about you.

mission_ex.line: Hmm? Leaving work undone again? I just don't know what to do with you.

mission_complete_ex.line: Is that all the work we have left for now? Then I think it's the perfect time for some tea.

touch2_ex.line: Come on... Wait until the sun goes down first.

win_mvp_ex.line: There! It's all taken care of. We win again!

detail.line: There's something about nostalgic cafés that makes time here feel so special... Do you get it?

home.line: Hi there. Doing okay? I reserved you a seat, so get over here! Let's have our first glass together, okay?

login.line: Hello hello. Don't worry – you're early for our meeting.

main1.line: Say, you there! May I order now? Oh... If it isn't you, Commander. Are you working here? Ouch... Get some rest later, okay?

main2.line: I saw a girl wearing a cat ear accessory a minute ago. Where do you get those? They were adorable.

main3.line: What's good after a nice swim? Fried chicken? A bowl full of fries? Can I order something along those lines?

touch.line: Heehee, I'm still a little shy. Be gentle, okay?

touch2.line: My, my. Keep up that mischief, and who knows what might happen?

unlock.line: Heehee, what's got you staring, Commander? Is it this piping-hot burger that's stolen your attention? Or... Heehee, well, that can wait for later.

battle.line: O-on my way! I'll try my best!

couple_encourage1.line: I think I can fight better!

couple_encourage2.line: This really isn't the time or place to... touch my tail...

detail.line: I-in the tribe I'm from... we need to... s-set out on journeys to help people... *whimper*... I need to give this my all...

expedition.line: Umm... Their errand is done... Incredible!

feeling1.line: Oh, e-excuse me... I didn't catch that...

feeling2.line: Huh? Do, um... Do you need... help?

feeling3.line: Oh, yes! If there's anything I can help with, please just let me know!

feeling4.line: I'm... not smart enough for difficult topics, but... I want to help my friends if I can...

feeling5.line: Heehee... When I talk to you, I... I feel so at ease... Oh! Umm... Please forget I said that...

headtouch.line: Is, err... Is there something weird about me?

home.line: Oh, well fought, Commander. Just, um... Please don't push yourself too hard.

hp_warning.line: N-no... I can still keep going...

login.line: Eek! C-Commander?! G-good morning...

lose.line: Aww... I-I'm sorry... I'm no good after all...

mail.line: Commander, there's... Well, a letter for you. Oh, yes, that's right.

main1.line: The sun... It's so warm... *yawn*... Mmh... *gasp*! I-I didn't doze off! I didn't! I wasn't napping, no way!

main2.line: Commaaander! Are you taking a nap? Th-that's fair... since the weather's nice... Huh? Just resting your eyelids? S-s-s-sorry for making assumptions!

main3.line: S-sorry, I must be a burden... I'll go over there and... Huh? It's fine if I stay with you? Oh, I see... In that case, I will... Heehee.

mission.line: Huh? These missions haven't been... No, I just... Well... I'm a little curious.

mission_complete.line: C-Commander... This one's already done... N-no, never mind.

profile.line: Err, um... I'm Lenja. I, uh... I want to help people, but... I'm not sure if I'm capable enough... Oh, um! Forget that! Please forget I said that!

propose.line: I, um... Err... I-I'd like to help you and support you, Commander... So if you... could ask for my help... I'd be glad.

touch.line: Hey, um... Commander? Is there anything I can... help you with?

touch2.line: Eek! Whuah! Pl-please... wait a minute...

unlock.line: Uh, um... I-I'm... Lenja. A-although we've never met, I'd... um... I-I-I'm so sorry! I don't know anything right now, so c-could you... take me under your wing?

upgrade.line: H-have I gotten... stronger? At least a little?

win_mvp.line: H-hooray! We did it!

gift_prefer.line: Huh? Uh, um... This is for... me? ...Thank you... so much...!

skill_2.line: Time to... display the pride of the Welleks!

battle_ex.line: E-everyone! Let's give our b-best shot!

detail_ex.line: Both alchemy and the weapons you have here... they're not just powerful, they exist to protect your near and dear... I think.

feeling5_ex.line: Wherever I go, I just fail over and over, I make mistakes, and I fall behind... but the fact that I can be by your side and help in many ways... That makes me really happy.

login_ex.line: Ah, C-Commander! Good... morning.

main4_ex.line: Huh? Are you having a nap, Commander? Hello? Hmm... No response... I hope it won't scare you if I sleep next to you...

main5_ex.line: If I record everything that's happened here in my diary... will it become a part of our history?

main6_ex.line: Commander, I want to repay you somehow... Is there something you'd like from me? I'll do anything you want as long as it's not weird.

mission_ex.line: Hey, um... You still have... unfinished work to do... I'll help you out.

mission_complete_ex.line: This task is... done. Great work... Would you like to... squeeze my tail?

touch2_ex.line: Ah! Th-th-that tickles!

win_mvp_ex.line: Okay, I did it... I managed to do it.

detail.line: Even in this other world, fish tastes... delicious! I think that's... quite amazing.

home.line: You must be exhausted after all that... Come here, sit down, and take it easy... please. Here. Have a drink.

login.line: Ah, C-Commander... I'm... good to go!

main1.line: Umm... Plates are ready... Ingredients are ready... Fire is lit... Everything's ready, Commander! Let's get this... "barbecue" thing started!

main2.line: Uh, um... I'm glad to have someone to help. Really. But! There are things I can do, too... So... please let me help at least a little.

main3.line: You'd like to cook with me? Th-thank you...

touch.line: I-I've never worn anything like... this before... H-how do I look?

touch2.line: Heehee... You're getting my stomach wet! It tickles!

unlock.line: So, um... This is my first time trying this, so... I just... Ah, right! Since we're all here, let's make the most of it and have fun together!

battle.line: Come on, let's go!

couple_encourage1.line: Miss Elf, I'm going in.

detail.line: In my world, we gods had familias who'd conquer dungeons. I guess in this world... you'd conquer the sea, huh?

expedition.line: Your familia who went on an errand are back. Huh? They're not familia, they're your friends? I see – you insist on that.

feeling1.line: Need something? Uh, can it wait? I'm so sleepy right now.

feeling2.line: If my side hustle and our outing overlap on the same day... Hmm. That'll be annoying.

feeling3.line: I think it'd be nice if you'd set aside a little more time for me.

feeling4.line: Are you here to see me? Nice, that's the sign of a good familia member. Wait, maybe not a good familia member, but a good friend?

feeling5.line: I was really stressed when I got thrown into this world out of the blue. I'm really glad I met someone as helpful as you.

headtouch.line: Hrmh... Why are you staring at me like that, huh? Ah, don't call me a shortie or you're gonna get it!

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Thought something might've happened to you. I'm glad you're fine.

hp_warning.line: I'll try a little harder.

login.line: Hey there, Commander! I've been waiting a looong time for you!

lose.line: Darn it... They're gonna call me a fraud goddess again over this! No way, no way!! This doesn't count!

mail.line: Is this... a letter for you? Reckon it might be a love letter?

main1.line: You've got so much tasty food here. It's almost as good as Potato Poppers. I've gotta try all of it before I go back to my home world!

main2.line: Commander, I found something tasty – want a bite? Don't be shy, just give it a taste.

main3.line: Ow, ow, ow... Hey, Commander! Why are you lying down over here? You've gotta sleep in a bed if you wanna recover your strength.

mission.line: What, you still haven't finished this mission? I'll help.

mission_complete.line: Hey, you've got missions to turn in! Don't just leave them sitting there.

profile.line: I'm Hestia, the goddess of the hearth and fire! And since I'm a god, you just go ahead and worship me. Also, is there any part-time work that pays well in this world?

propose.line: The worlds you and I live in are so far apart... or more like totally different. It's pretty wild that we met and were able to spend time together like this.

touch.line: You just can't get enough of me, huh? ...What? I've got dust on me? Ohh. Brush it off, would you?

touch2.line: Commander. Ready to face the consequences?

unlock.line: I'm Hestia, the Patron Goddess of Hestia Familia, believe it or not! What? That doesn't surprise you at all? Hmm. You're nothing like the kiddos I've seen before.

upgrade.line: You're telling me I've powered up? What's going on with this world?

win_mvp.line: Victory's mine!

gift_prefer.line: Thanks! Now, let's get this party started!

battle_ex.line: I'll try my darnedest to help you!

detail_ex.line: Commander, you're setting yourself up for punishment by ignoring me too often, you know?

feeling5_ex.line: Do I make myself clear, Commander? Don't push your luck by leaving me all by myself. I don't like being alone in an unfamiliar place.

login_ex.line: Oh, Commander! You here to see me?

main4_ex.line: Huh? Feeling a little weary, Commander? Then as a special favor, I'll give you a lap pillow! And in exchange... I'll be watching your face closely while you sleep!

main5_ex.line: Heheheh... Look who's here. Let's have ourselves a tea party with desserts, Commander!

main6_ex.line: Ugghh... Sorry I made you worry. I'm not worthy of being a goddess... I dunno if this makes up for it, but how about I make you some food?

mission_ex.line: Still got missions to do, do you? I'll help you out – as a treat.

mission_complete_ex.line: Finished your mission, huh? That's my Commander. A bit of praise, just for you!

touch2_ex.line: Stop, stop! That's a no-go, Commander! I'm serious!

win_mvp_ex.line: I'm the goddess of victory!

detail.line: The beach is so much fun! The surface is deep blue and pretty and the water's nice and cool! Being here makes it feel like time is flying by.

home.line: Nice job, Commander. Go and get comfortable in the shade over there. I'll get you something cold to drink!

login.line: Heeey! Commandeeer! Come here! Get yourself in order quickly!

main1.line: So many tasty-looking fish and shellfish... Hey, Commander, I say we treat ourselves to a barbecue while we're here!

main2.line: Careful so you don't get sunburned. The sun's intense today... I'm gonna go put on some sunscreen, so can you wait just a minute?

main3.line: You wanna swim? How about we swim together, then? It feels nice to just float in the sea!

touch.line: Huh? I'll hold your hand, if that's what you want... Do you not know how to swim?

touch2.line: Hey! What do you think you're doing, huh?

unlock.line: Hey-hey, Commander! You're finally here. I've been waiting my butt off! I've already had the full beach experience... Ah, wait, I still have things I wanna do, so do me a solid and stick around!

battle.line: ...Let's go.

couple_encourage1.line: Let's go, Lady Hestia.

detail.line: Forgive me... I tend to go too far sometimes.

expedition.line: Everyone's returned safely. Commander, prepare to welcome them home.

feeling1.line: Surely you understand that your behavior is foolish.

feeling2.line: Having so much energy in the morning is commendable, yes, but you must direct it toward your work... No. I'm not angry.

feeling3.line: I appreciate your dedication to your goals. Yes, even I can give compliments.

feeling4.line: Don't push yourself too much, please. Hurting yourself will hurt everyone else in the process. Being honest... I worry about you, too. Please take care of yourself.

feeling5.line: You're very kind, Commander. I can tell that your kindness extends to everyone... and I respect that greatly.

headtouch.line: What do you think you're doing? I sense a malicious aura emanating from you.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Let's get you dusted off... Okay. I will make you tea soon, so rest until then.

hp_warning.line: I mustn't back down... Not now!

login.line: I've been waiting for you, Commander. Have you decided on our plans for today?

lose.line: Is it time to retreat? Now is the time for clarity of judgment.

mail.line: Mail has arrived. Is now a good time to take a look?

main1.line: As I understand, you form combat parties that combine members with varying roles... Fleets, you call them? Hmm. Noted.

main2.line: My apologies for the delay. Here is your tea. Cookies, understood... Hmm? What am I doing? The Royal Maids asked me to help as a waitress, a job that I'm quite accustomed to.

main3.line: What an outright abusive workload... Hmm? This isn't all for one person? It's meant to be shared among everyone? I-I'm sorry. I should know better than to make assumptions.

mission.line: Would you like my help?

mission_complete.line: Your rewards are piling up... Do you need me to sort them out for you?

profile.line: My name is Ryu Lion. I work at Hostess of Fertility in Orario. The bountiful experience and skills I've accumulated as an adventurer should come in handy here as well.

propose.line: Something is wrong... Why is my heart beating so fast? D-don't get so close! You've done nothing wrong... Oh, how do I explain this?

skill.line: In the name of justice, I will smite you!

touch.line: Enough! Any closer, and there's no telling what might happen.

touch2.line: Are you ready to prostrate yourself in apology?

unlock.line: Who are you? No – Where am I? This doesn't look like Orario. You must be the one who saved me, so thank you. My name is Ryu Lion, and I work as a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility pub in Orario.

upgrade.line: I suppose this is a... rank-up? How delightful.

win_mvp.line: Victory... is ours.

gift_prefer.line: Hm? Could this be... Ahem. Thank you very much.

battle_ex.line: Here I come!

detail_ex.line: How many events have led this place to be the battlefield it is today? My past, too, is... No, never mind. Forget I said a word.

feeling5_ex.line: What I've seen and heard here, the things I've felt in our time together, and my own thoughts... There are too many things to discuss. Could you spare some time for me, please?

login_ex.line: Commander! I've waited so... I-I mean, um... Good morning.

main4_ex.line: Is there something on my face? Huh? No, I'm not unhappy with you... I appreciate your attention – er, I mean, umm...

main5_ex.line: My lack of experience in combat at sea left me hesitant, but I think I'm beginning to understand. I even look forward to taking on this new challenge... Would you train with me for a while?

main6_ex.line: Waitressing? Well, yes, I'm very experienced... Huh? You want to see my uniform? A-absolutely not! It's too embarrassing...

mission_ex.line: You still haven't finished your work, have you? I guess I have no choice but to help.

mission_complete_ex.line: You've already finished your duties? Impressive.

touch2_ex.line: Ah, hngh! (It's impossible to keep a straight face under these conditions...)

win_mvp_ex.line: We won... all thanks to you.

detail.line: Wearing this is a little embarrassing, but I am happy that you like it.

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. We've already started your dinner order, so rest easy.

login.line: W-welcome... I'm ready to take your order...

main1.line: I hear you chose this uniform... Hmm? No, I'm not saying I dislike it... but I think this has told me a lot about your tastes.

main2.line: Thank you for your patience. I brought your food. A drink refill? Certainly... A-a smile?! That is a difficult request...

main3.line: I-I don't mind you looking, but no recording me! Also, I'd appreciate if you forgot what you've seen after you leave.

touch.line: What exactly were you going to do with that hand? I expect an answer.

touch2.line: Wha?! We do not provide those services!

unlock.line: W-welcome... Don't stare at me, please. This pub's uniforms are a little revealing, so I'm nervous. I-if you insist, though, I can make time to chat after closing time.

battle.line: Come with me! I will carve a path!

couple_encourage1.line: Leave it to me, Origami!

couple_encourage2.line: You're so reliable these days, Yoshino!

detail.line: Commander, what are the best foods in this world? I have much I want to ask, but that's the most important thing!

expedition.line: Ooh! Everyone's back. We must go see them! I made snacks for them, too!

feeling1.line: Mm... Do whatever you want. I'm going back to the others.

feeling2.line: Oh, really? Then join me now!

feeling3.line: Hehe. Food tastes a lot better when we eat together, doesn't it? I wonder why that is.

feeling4.line: Hmm, you're well-beloved by the people of this port. I understand it, though. You've saved them all, in a sense... I think that's remarkable.

feeling5.line: My goal now is to become strong enough to protect you and everything you hold dear! Will you help me? Good! Then let's get training!

headtouch.line: Hmm... What's the matter? You want to pat my head? Well, you may.

home.line: Ah, Commander, you've returned! How was the battle? Don't spare a single detail.

hp_warning.line: I mustn't fall now!

login.line: Good morning, Commander! Let's keep up our efforts today!

lose.line: It's... beyond... the reach of my power...

mail.line: Is this... a letter for you? It must be important, so you should read it now.

main1.line: Huh? You have kinako buns here, too?! Why didn't you tell me sooner? Show me where right away. I must buy them now!

main2.line: Hmm... The shipgirls? They all look powerful, but they're such good friends. What is their secret?

main3.line: If there's nobody hostile here, then that makes life all the easier. And the food is delicious to boot!

mission.line: What? You still have work to do? Then let me help.

mission_complete.line: Hmm, these are marked as completed. Don't you need to review them?

profile.line: I'm Tohka Yatogami, a Spirit. What is a spirit? Hmm, it's hard to explain, but you might think of me as someone with much greater power than a normal human. Hmm... Well, I suppose that makes me sound the same as everyone else here. In that case, it's only a minor distinction!

propose.line: Spending time here has given me so many more things to cherish. Good foods, friends... Hmm? You act nonchalant, but you count, too. Hmm... Having so many things to cherish is, in itself, something rare and worth cherishing.

touch.line: What? Do you need me? Tell me what you require, and I'll help with whatever it may be!

touch2.line: Hmm? What's the matter? Is there dirt on me, or something?

unlock.line: Identify yourself. Are you my enemy? ...Perhaps not. Hmm... Could this be a different world entirely? No wonder I've seen so many unfamiliar things. Regardless, my name is Tohka Yatogami. It's an important name, so you'd best remember it. I suppose I'll be in your world for the time being. On that note... I'm hungry. Do you have anything to eat?

upgrade.line: Ooh... I feel my power surging!

win_mvp.line: We won! Moving around makes me so hungry.

gift_prefer.line: What? You are giving this to me!? Wow... Thank you, I'll treasure it!

skill_dal_1.line: Split the sky and sunder the earth! —Sandalphon

battle_ex.line: Come! Let our date begin!

detail_ex.line: Hmm? I don't stay with you just for the delicious food, of course. I can't believe that you would think so. By the way... What's for dinner tonight?

feeling5_ex.line: This place is so comfortable. It must be because of you and the people you lead. Though it's only temporary, I'm honored to join you... and I want to protect our time together. May our relationship be a lasting one, Commander.

login_ex.line: Ooh, Commander! I've been waiting for you! Come, let's work hard together!

main4_ex.line: Everyone in this land is so happy, and I can only assume that you're the reason... You don't think so? Hmph. I know what that is—it's called humility.

main5_ex.line: When I went to the canteen, I asked for "the usual," and they knew what I meant... Is this proof that I've made friends? Or am I spending too much on food?

main6_ex.line: When I'm running through the port, everyone greets me. It's wonderful... Hmm? Why do I run? Because exercise makes food taste better, of course!

mission_ex.line: I'll help you clean up these missions! Don't worry—I owe you one, anyway!

mission_complete_ex.line: Okay, all done! Now you get some of my special and treasured treats!

touch2_ex.line: Hyah! I-it's okay... You just startled me.

win_mvp_ex.line: Victory! Thanks to everybody's efforts, of course.

detail.line: Nothing adds to a beach trip like popsicles! It's amazing how the taste of food can change so much depending on the place and season.

home.line: You're back! A job well done deserves a break. Rest is an important part of work.

login.line: Ooh, there you are! Come and have a popsicle!

main1.line: You have so many kinds of popsicles here. To think, you even have kinako flavor... I never imagined this.

main2.line: Does seeing me eating happily make you happy, too? As it should! Delicious food is always the key to happiness!

main3.line: You're about to go swimming, right? How about we all have a race? Whoever wins gets all the popsicles!

touch.line: Hmph! Keep your hands off! I took it first!

touch2.line: Mm, did it drip on me? Can you wipe it off?

unlock.line: Hmm? What's the matter? Oh, this? Someone gave it to me to have as a little treat! I won't keep it all to myself, though. I'll share some with you! What would you like? Vanilla? Chocolate? Or strawberry? No, the kinako-flavored one is MINE! But you really want it? Hmm... Maybe just a little...?

battle.line: Enemy target detected. Commencing combat operations.

couple_encourage1.line: Tohka, with me. We'll break through the front.

couple_encourage2.line: It brings me joy to see my disciples spread their wings

detail.line: The shipgirls here have very unique designs. I find it most illuminating. ...Might this be your preference, Commander?

expedition.line: The girls have returned from their errands. Do you need a lecture on how to greet them properly?

feeling1.line: Blind faith in some half-baked skills is a disaster waiting to happen. Let this be my advice to you.

feeling2.line: There are many things I still do not understand, but you have helped me again and again. I hope that our cordial relationship will continue in the future.

feeling3.line: There will surely be a limit as to what you can do by yourself. When that time comes, please turn to us for help. We are your friends, after all.

feeling4.line: If you ever have any problems concerning the shipgirls, feel free to consult me. Don't worry. Back in my world, I was known as the Love Master.

feeling5.line: If you wish, I can teach you the Origami-style approach to love. Several shipgirls have already attended my lessons. How to deal with advances? Simple, accept them all. That is what it means to be a commander.

headtouch.line: ...What is it?

home.line: Confirming Commander's return. Your safety holds higher priority over all else.

hp_warning.line: Combat capabilities decreased. ...But this isn't over yet.

login.line: Good morning. Have you decided on today's itinerary yet?

lose.line: A miscalculation... in a place like this, how...

mail.line: I would recommend responding to important messages promptly.

main1.line: I believe that this "rigging" equipment holds great potential. Its meticulous tuning to maximize the wearer's power fascinates me.

main2.line: I would like to purchase some necessary equipment. First, I need two CCD cameras and several ultra-compact microphones. For what purpose? I cannot disclose for now.

main3.line: This? This is a special Origami-brand aphrodisiac. A certain shipgirl requested that I make it. I do not know what it might be used for after the order is fulfilled, but I was specifically asked to keep it a secret from you. Oops, I went and said it. Silly Origami.

mission.line: I see that a mission you chose to take on has not yet been completed. You should address that, quickly.

mission_complete.line: Mission accomplished. Please claim your reward promptly.

profile.line: My name is Origami Tobiichi, former AST Master Sergeant. I am now a high school student—and also an entity known as a Spirit. Though I was once in a precarious state, I am now stable thanks to my friends. There is nothing to worry about.

propose.line: Dainty, cute, or charming? Which quality appeals to you the most? ...There's no deeper meaning behind it. I simply made an assessment that this information might come in handy in the future. There's no deeper meaning behind it, but what you make of that is up to you.

touch.line: Did you need something?

touch2.line: Openly expressing your desires often comes with a price.

unlock.line: Is this... a different world from the one I came from? ...Understood. Panic accomplishes nothing. I will do my utmost to resolve this situation. I am Origami Tobiichi, former AST Master Sergeant. May I ask you to state your affiliation and rank?

upgrade.line: Confirming all-around parameter growth. Resuming combat operations.

win_mvp.line: Combat over. Confirming annihilation of hostiles.

gift_prefer.line: Amazing... Where did you even get something like this?

battle_ex.line: Let us begin our date.

detail_ex.line: What is it you desire, Commander? Of course I know. I can piece that together from your conversations as well as the monologues from when you're in your room.

feeling5_ex.line: A girl's words can often carry multiple layers of meaning. If you are unable to discern these subtleties, you still have much to learn. For example, "thank you" is not only an expression of gratitude. If you want to be able to read the true emotions behind these words, you should come to me for lessons.

login_ex.line: Good morning. Today's a wonderful day.

main4_ex.line: I've received requests for love advice from several shipgirls, so I sent them on their way with some pick-up lines. I don't know who they'll use them on, but you should be prepared.

main5_ex.line: The intruder prevention trap I set at your request has been dismantled. The culprit must be very skilled.

main6_ex.line: I've concocted a new aphrodisiac using ingredients gifted to me by people around the port. I haven't tried it on anyone yet, but would you be interested?

mission_ex.line: Do you have any work left? If I lend you a hand, it should be done in no time.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. Good work.

touch2_ex.line: Please inform me beforehand. I need time to prepare myself mentally.

win_mvp_ex.line: No enemies in sight. This is a victory we seized together.

detail.line: It seems that swimsuits these days are often used for purposes outside of swimming. While this is a deviation from their original functionality, it is nevertheless a form of evolution.

home.line: Welcome back. Did your fatigue disappear as soon as you saw me? Fascinating. This is a phenomenon worth studying. I would very much like to know more about it.

login.line: Good morning. Did you have a good time last night? Mhm. Then, do enjoy yourself today.

main1.line: The size is mismatched? Not at all, it is a perfect fit. This is a masterpiece that carefully takes into consideration many factors such as skin exposure ratio.

main2.line: The sun is quite intense. Should I apply sunscreen, or deliberately work up some tan lines? Quite the dilemma.

main3.line: The goddess of allure... is born. Hmm? Is "goddess" a bit much? Indeed, I am no goddess, but rather a Spirit. However, I do not intend to change the "allure" part.

touch.line: Usually, these ties you see on swimwear are merely decorations. The swimsuit won't come undone just from untying them. Usually.

touch2.line: Are you curious about how the swimsuit feels?

unlock.line: What do you think about my swimsuit? As long as you like it, that's all that matters. It is a masterpiece that incorporates the opinions of many different shipgirls. During that time, I was advised that it would be better for it to include *** and ***, but I reluctantly excluded them due to my high levels of situational awareness.

battle.line: Let's get this done the right way. Follow my lead!

couple_encourage1.line: You're both soaking wet... Want me to help dry you off?

couple_encourage2.line: I just know you're up to something... Step out of line and you'll see me get real mad, Kurumi.

detail.line: Back in the world where I'm from, I was the captain of an airship. But, that ship and the ships here are completely different... Like, we're talking on a conceptual existence level different...

expedition.line: Looks like your friends are back. Go on, go greet them already. As a commander, you should know how important the aftercare is, no?

feeling1.line: Um, can we set that aside for later? I don't have the time right now.

feeling2.line: Alright, all done on my end. Next up is... Hey, why are you looking at me like you've got no skin in the game? Hurry up and help me!

feeling3.line: What are you even saying? I'm super, duper appreciative! So that's why you get... the love-lashing~♪

feeling4.line: Jeez, what am I even going to do with you? Fine, I'll do it for you, so make sure you pay close attention~♪ So, do you prefer me like that? Huh? You think both versions of me are cute? Well, um... if you like it so much, then maybe next time...

feeling5.line: I know my words might be a bit harsh, but that's because I'm seriously looking out for the other person! ...Jeez, what are you trying to make me say?!

headtouch.line: Wh-what are you doing all of a sudden! I-it's not like you startled me or anything!

home.line: Good work. Commander, how would you rate this last sortie? Hm? You'd like my personal assessment? A full 100, of course. It goes without saying.

hp_warning.line: Look closely! This is where the real battle begins!

login.line: Morning, Commander. Let's go all-out today as well!

lose.line: We must keep pressing forward... even if it's one step... at a time...

mail.line: You've got a message. Don't let these things pile up.

main1.line: I'm curious what it's like around here. Mind if I take a look around? Heehee, you could also escort me around while you're at it.

main2.line: Even for someone like me who's used to seeing Spirits, this is kind of its own fairy tale kingdom. I mean, look—you have both magic and cannonballs flying through the air... Hmm? Looking at it that way, maybe our worlds aren't so different.

main3.line: Spirits are a formidable threat, so our way of dealing with them is taking them out on dates and getting them to fall in love. I wonder if this also works for shipgirls...

mission.line: There's still work to be done! C'mon, get on it already!

mission_complete.line: Oh wow, looks like you've taken care of all the work over here. See, you can do it if you try.

profile.line: The name's Kotori Itsuka. I guess you'd call me a Spirit, but... about that, the situation's pretty complicated though. I'd appreciate it if you didn't worry too much about that whole deal. As someone who knows what it's like to be a captain or commander, I hope we can have a good relationship as peers.

propose.line: Don't you think it'd be awesome to have the kind of relationship where you can directly tell each other what you like or dislike? ...Huh? You ask what I am trying to say now? Jeez, could you pick a worse time to ask that?

touch.line: What do you want? ...No, I'm not mad or anything. I just wasn't expecting you to suddenly touch me.

touch2.line: Wh-what are you doing?! ...I-i-i-it's not like I'm mad or anything though...

unlock.line: Where the heck am I... I can't get a hold of Fraxinus... Don't tell me, we've crossed a dimensional wall?! In any case, I need to get a handle on the current situation—Oh, got a moment? My name's Kotori. Kotori Itsuka. I'm just a schoolgirl... You'll buy that, right? Sorry, but can I have a moment to speak with you?

upgrade.line: Heheh, very good. I'll show you what I'm like when I mean business.

win_mvp.line: Done already? How boring.

gift_prefer.line: Sorry, you must've gone through much trouble for me... But, thank you...

skill_dal_1.line: Turn them to ash, Flames of Purgatory! —Camael

battle_ex.line: Now, let our date begin.

detail_ex.line: Not to brag, but I'm also a commander in the world I came from. If there's anything you'd like to discuss, feel free to consult with me.

feeling5_ex.line: I don't want the kind of relationship where one person does all the venting and the other person has to just sit here and take it... I want one where you take the burden of hardship off each other and put your heads together to work through problems... A relationship where you both can move forward, taking everything in stride together. Doesn't that sound ideal?
