login_ex.line: You're late! Jeez... don't make me worry like that...

main4_ex.line: It's nice to sometimes space out and do nothing. ...Who said I was slacking off though? This is a tactical decision after someone told me, "even warriors need rest"!

main5_ex.line: Weather's real nice today, huh? Really makes me want to take a look around the port... If only there was someone kind enough to show me around~

main6_ex.line: ––"Option 1: I'd do anything for your sake!" "Option 2: Just tell me what you want already!" "Option 3: I will make even your wildest dreams come true!" ––So, which one's your pick? Huh? They pretty much all say the same thing? Heh. Stop thinking so much and just pick one already. I promise you won't regret it.

mission_ex.line: Still not done yet? What am I going to do with you... Guess I'll help out.

mission_complete_ex.line: Done already? Not half bad, you. Efficiency is sexy these days.

touch2_ex.line: ...Look, even I can get flustered, you know?

win_mvp_ex.line: Good work. You know...I wouldn't mind some words of praise myself.

detail.line: Jeez... What even goes through your mind all the time? Playing in the ocean at a time like this? ...Well, since you're this close anyway, I guess it makes sense.

home.line: Done with work already? Well, then you can hang out with me for a bit, right?

login.line: Sorry to keep you waiting—Wh-what? It's not like I got changed just for your sake!

main1.line: Aren't you normally supposed to say something in situations like these? Well, I suppose it helps to have some experience first... W-wait, it's not like I'm trying to rush you or anything!

main2.line: Ughh... I'm not embarrassed... I'm totally not embarrassed! This level of embarrassment doesn't even count as embarrassment!

main3.line: Hmph... Well, as long as you like it. At least I didn't get changed for nothing.

touch.line: Oh... am I getting sunburnt? Maybe I should see if they have sunscreen here...

touch2.line: Hmm? ...That's quite daring of you. So, how should I pay you back?

unlock.line: So, I got changed into my swimsuit and... What? If you have something to say, make sure I can hear it. ...Eh? It's cute and looks good on me and you want to see even more? ...D-don't say embarrassing stuff like that!

battle.line: "Yoshinon, movin' out!" -Moving out...!

couple_encourage1.line: Miss Tohka, I'll go. Just leave it to me!

couple_encourage2.line: Ah, um... I'll do my best! "Kurumi-chan, you'd better cover our backs! Which means, no backstabby stuff!"

detail.line: Sorry...I'm not very good at talking to people... But...I would be happy if we could become friends.

expedition.line: Everyone was able to come home safely... What a relief.

feeling1.line: "You know, Yoshinon isn't too sure about this thing after all..." Y-Yoshinon...

feeling2.line: Hello. The weather's quite nice today... Yoshinon, was that okay? "Yes, yes! Good job, keep it up!"

feeling3.line: "Yoshinon will let you in on a secret. Gentle headpats are always welcome." Ah, um... H-here you go, then...

feeling4.line: "Ding ding! A flag has been raised on the Yoshino route! Your next choice is going to be extra important, okay?" Y-Yoshinon...y-you're going to bother other people...

feeling5.line: I'm not good at talking to strangers...but around you, Commander...I feel like I can speak naturally. "Wowee, look at you. Reckon ya might've been a bunny in a past life?"

headtouch.line: Ehh? Umm... Y-your...hand...is really warm... "Yoshino, is, confused."

home.line: Welcome back... Is everything okay? "Good to see you back in one piece. As a reward, I'll give you a RABBIT PAWNCH!

hp_warning.line: "Woah, woah! Yoshino, you doing okay?" ...Mhm, I can...still manage!

login.line: G-Good...morning... "Heyyo! It's a WOOONDERFUL day!"

lose.line: I'm so sorry...everyone... "We— goofed— up— big— time—..."

mail.line: I think you might have mail... "Make sure to check your messages regularly!"

main1.line: It's nice outside... Really makes me want to go out for a stroll... "Yoshinon's got you covered! The nice ladies here gave us some sweet recommendations for places we can go!"

main2.line: Heheh.. Shopping's a lot of fun, Yoshinon... "Hey, check out all the cool stores over here! The stuff here's awesome!"

main3.line: Everyone at this port...is really good looking... "Yoshino's no slouch either! Just look at that Commander who's totally head-over-heels for you!" H-huh?!

mission.line: Ah, um... Excuse me... "Oh, what's this? You're STILL not done with your work?"

mission_complete.line: "Wowee! What a huge boatload of rewards!" Mission...complete.

profile.line: Um...I'm Yoshino, and this is my friend, Yoshinon. "Just remember us as Cute Yoshinon, and Super Cute Yoshino!" Yoshinon, th-that's embarrassing...

propose.line: Umm... Ah... um... "Oh, oh? What's this? Not feeling as chatty as you were before?" B-because...when I'm around Commander...I start feeling shy...

skill.line: "Ready to doooo this?" Mhm... Let's do this together!

touch.line: Eep! ...Oh, it's you, Commander... Ah, um... You just surprised me, that's all...

touch2.line: Uh, umm... "Beep beep! I'm your neighborhood bunny police, and you're not allowed to do that!"

unlock.line: Eh... ah... umm... "Wooow, what a spectacle. What the heck even happened to us? Where even IS this?" E-Excuse me...I, I'm Yoshino...and this is...Yoshinon. C-Can we...chat for a bit?

upgrade.line: "Power-up, success!!" I...I wonder if I've gotten any stronger...

win_mvp.line: Phew...I, I did my best... "You totally kicked ass!"

gift_prefer.line: Oh, th-thank you... I'm truly...so happy.

battle_ex.line: L-let our date... "BEGIIIIIN!"

detail_ex.line: As long as Commander...is with me...there's nothing to be scared of... "Yoshino, you and the Commander sure get along nicely." ...Y-yeah!

feeling5_ex.line: Um... Commander, what's on your mind? If something happened... please tell me. Even though I'm not the most dependable, I still want to help...

login_ex.line: C-Commander, ah...umm...I'll try my best today...

main4_ex.line: Huh? Did something...happen? ...Commander, you look...really worn out... "What's wrong? If you need to vent, Yoshinon's here to lend an ear."

main5_ex.line: Commander...you always look so busy. Please let us help you as well. "Yoshinon's got you covered!"

main6_ex.line: "Thanks a bunch, ship ladies!" They taught me so much when I didn't know what was going on... Everyone here is so nice...

mission_ex.line: It looks like there's still some work left to do... "No slacking off allowed!"

mission_complete_ex.line: I guess...this is the last of it. Thanks for your hard work, Commander.

touch2_ex.line: Ah, umm...it's...very warm...

win_mvp_ex.line: I hope I was...able to meet everyone's expectations...

detail.line: "Goggles, check! Snorkel, check! Yoshinon is fully geared out!" Going to the beach...is still a bit scary...

home.line: You're not hurt, are you? I've been waiting for you...praying this whole time...

login.line: Commander... you're here. Welcome...

main1.line: "Nyuhuhu... Yoshinon prepared this legendary swimsuit!" Miss Akashi was the one who provided it...but what do you mean by..."legendary"?

main2.line: "Woah! What a vast ocean! And so many fish! I've been looking forward to this!" I think I...might be a little excited too...? But maybe...also a bit scared?

main3.line: Before going to the beach...I built myself...a little place to stay. "This is the very definition of a secret base, isn't it?!"

touch.line: Um...does it...look good on me? "Of course! It suits you well, don't you see?"

touch2.line: Um...it's not like I'm cold or anything... "Ah-ah, hands off! Who said you could get touchy-feely?!"

unlock.line: Um...I still tend to be a bit shy...when it comes to unfamiliar places. So...is it okay if I stay here...a bit longer? "You've already done the prep. Now what you need is the courage! Say, Commander, mind giving us a hand over here?"

battle.line: Kihihihi! You think you have the might to go against me?

couple_encourage1.line: Come on now, Yoshino. Let's fight together.

couple_encourage2.line: Heehee. It's nice to see a familiar face, Kotori. For the time being, let's be allies.

detail.line: Commander, what sort of impression do you have of me? Heehee~ Perhaps... I might not be the kind of girl you think I am.

expedition.line: Welcome back. I'm glad you're all safe.

feeling1.line: Hmph... So that's how it is. Well, not like I was expecting much from the beginning.

feeling2.line: My, my... What am I going to do with you? I suppose I'm willing to make an exception, just this once.

feeling3.line: Heehee. You know, you're quite the interesting person. I do like how you're not intimidated by me in the slightest.

feeling4.line: Heehee, you're a LOT more interesting than I expected. You know, Commander—I'd love to devour you right up. Kihihi, just kidding~

feeling5.line: Good evening. Recently, you've been meeting my gaze more and more often. Are you that captivated by me? ...Hmm? If our eyes are meeting, that means I've been looking at you too...? My, oh my...

headtouch.line: My, my... Is something the matter?

home.line: It seems you were able to come back safe and sound. Yes, yes. I understand—but first, let us rejoice in your triumphant return.

hp_warning.line: You should know now... THIS is where the true battle begins, understand?

login.line: Good morning, Commander. May I ask what plans you have for the day?

lose.line: Have I... been... defeated?

mail.line: This letter... seems to be addressed to you.

main1.line: My, my... Are you THAT interested in me? I'm glad to hear it, heehee. Buuut, I wouldn't get too tangled up if I were you.

main2.line: The seaside certainly has a unique charm to it, wouldn't you say? Like, one that cleanses the soul—Oh my, is there something you wanted to say?

main3.line: My my, is there any particular reason why everyone is gathering here today? Is the fact that I am here so unusual to all of you? Though, if you ask me, there are some equally eccentric people here...

mission.line: Come on now, there's still work to be done. Let us proceed with quiet diligence.

mission_complete.line: It seems that you've finished your mission. Please go ahead and collect the rewards, then.

profile.line: My name is Kurumi Tokisaki, but you can just call me Kurumi. Some call me scary things like "the disaster that will destroy the world" and the "Worst Spirit", but please don't let that get to you. As you can see, I am nothing more than a weak and powerless little thing. Kihihihi~

propose.line: Heehee, what a truly wonderful place this is. The deep blue of the sea, the foamy white crests of the waves... It brings peace even to my troubled heart. ...Hmm? What is it that troubles me? My, my... Wouldn't it be terribly dull for me to just go and say it?

touch.line: My, my, are you doubting the nature of my existence? Heehee... Though it is true—perhaps under different circumstances, I might've been a very different kind of being.

touch2.line: My, my... That's not proper, you know?

unlock.line: My, my... Now, where exactly might this be? Hmm, I seem to have... crossed into another world without realizing it. Kihihihi... It looks like things are about to get a lot more interesting. Ah, but please disregard that for now. Please allow me to introduce myself first. I am Kurumi Tokisaki. What might your name be?

upgrade.line: Ahh, ahh! I can feel it! How exhilarating!

win_mvp.line: Surely you didn't think you had a chance against me, did you?

gift_prefer.line: My, my... You want me to have something this wonderful? Heehee, I'll take good care of it.

skill_dal_1.line: None may escape the prison of time. —Zafkiel

battle_ex.line: Now, shall we begin our date?

detail_ex.line: Are you curious about me? Heehee. Well, I won't stop you from prying into my affairs.

feeling5_ex.line: What do I think about this place, you ask? Heehee... Well, I can answer you by saying that even I, as someone who "belongs" nowhere, will be staying here, just for a while.

login_ex.line: How nice of you to finally show up... Good grief, how rude of you to keep me waiting this whole time.

main4_ex.line: You seem quite worn out. Since we've come to such a wonderful place, I'd recommend using this time to get some rest.

main5_ex.line: Ahh... the sea breeze feels so good... During moments like these, don't you just... feel like getting up and dancing? Heehee, just kidding.

main6_ex.line: What's wrong? Hmm... You could've sworn you saw me somewhere else a moment ago...? ...Is that so? Heehee. What a strange thing to say, don't you think?

mission_ex.line: My, my, you're still not finished? I'll give you a hand, so let's get this done quickly.

mission_complete_ex.line: A job well done. Now then, please take a moment to rest.

touch2_ex.line: My, my... I assume you're already prepared to face the consequences?

win_mvp_ex.line: Heehee. This battle... is over.

detail.line: Two Kurumi Tokisakis—and both are "me". So, Commander, which "me" do you prefer?

home.line: You're back? Well then, step closer and let me loosen up that weary body of yours.

login.line: Good day to you. My, you seem quite taken aback by this outfit of mine. Heehee, do you not think it looks good on me?

main1.line: I personally think this is a bit too risque, but what do you think? "Heehee... that beet-red face says it all."

main2.line: My, my... I can't believe how deep these tan lines already are—Heehee, Commander, can you see them as well?

main3.line: Why are there two of me? Heehee. Every girl has her secrets, right?

touch.line: Hmm, it's really hard applying lotion to your own back... My, oh my. Are you expecting something from me?

touch2.line: Kihihihi... How awfully daring of you~

unlock.line: My, my. It seems that we've been seen, the other "Me". "Indeed. Such a passionate gaze is naturally going to make me feel flushed." ...So, how long do you intend to stand there staring?

battle.line: The time is now! Follow me! "Deploying. I'm heading out."

couple_encourage1.line: "Report. Master Origami, please behold the fruits of our training." What training?!

couple_encourage2.line: Over there! Kotori! Isn't that a LITTLE too much firepower?! "Analysis. She's trying to make her grand entrance with an explosion."

detail.line: "Inquiry. What is our reason for being in this place?" Hmm... I don't think you should think too hard about it.

expedition.line: Oh, the girls are back from their errands! Come on, let's go see them!

feeling1.line: "Surprise. You're still here?" Come on, Yuzuru, let's bail.

feeling2.line: "Greeting. Good day." What, got nothing better to do? Hmm. You wanna hang out with us, then? "Concur. Casual mingling is fun."

feeling3.line: Retainer of mine, your proven dedication to me has made you deserving of a reward. What do you desire? ...What? M-my smile?! S-such an eccentric fellow you are...

feeling4.line: "Response. Yes, what is it, Commander? Hmm. I see..." "Warning. I believe you should choose your words more carefully, Commander. Otherwise, misunderstandings are bound to occur, and these may throw the port into chaos."

feeling5.line: "Gratitude. It is thanks to you that we've managed to survive in this place we know nothing about. You have our utmost thanks." Hey! Don't be a show-stealer! I wanna express how super grateful I am, too!

headtouch.line: Eek! Wh-wh-what're you doing?! "Supremacy. This is what is colloquially known as a 'headpat.'"

home.line: Welcome back. You alright? Didn't get hurt out there, did you? "Unharmed. That is a relief."

hp_warning.line: I am... immortal! "Unyielding. The true battle... begins now."

login.line: "Greeting. Good morning." Huh? Hey! I'm still in bed here! Don't gawk!

lose.line: Sorry, Yuzuru—I messed up... "Rescue. Kaguya, hang in there!"

mail.line: Commander, a message has arrived. Information is the key to any strategy. Read it posthaste.

main1.line: "Praise. Don't you think it's very cute how Kaguya conducts herself? Moreover, her powers are a perfect 10/10." What? What're you chatting about? "We were discussing how you should work on your temper." You what?!

main2.line: "Explanation. Kaguya and I were originally a single Spirit. At some point, we split into two." Huh? What kind of Spirit were we originally? Hmm... I'm not sure, but I DO know we were stronger than anyone else!

main3.line: Incredible. Look how many facilities here can be used for competitions... My blood rushes with excitement! "Concur. Let's have a match, Kaguya."

mission.line: Commander, I'm not impressed with how you neglect your work. "Proposal. You should get it done already."

mission_complete.line: "Received. Your rewards have arrived. Please have a look."

profile.line: Mwahaha... Kaguya Yamai is my name! And this Yuzuru, my other half! We are the Children of Typhoon who control the wind! Heed my word, my beloved subjects! The time has come! No foe can challenge my tyranny! Prostrate yourselves in awe and spread the noble name of Yamai across the world. "Praise. Clap clap. You're so awesome, Kaguya. Woohoo." Hey, are you being sarcastic?

propose.line: The world is a place where various causes and effects come together. When viewed that way, there must be a reason for us all meeting here. "Affirmative. At the very least, we are grateful for having met you."

touch.line: What's up? Need help with something? Fiiine, since you want it so badly. "Observation. You seem rather pleased, Kaguya."

touch2.line: Eek! Th-that's cold!

unlock.line: Mwahaha! We are the Children of Typhoon who raze everything! Kaguya Yamai, and... "Concur. Yuzuru Yamai." Wait, what? Where are we? "Confusion. It seems we've wound up in another world." S-seriously? Wh-wh-what do we do now, Yuzuru?! "Composure. Calm down. We should ask someone what is going on. You there, please explain as much as you can."

upgrade.line: Ugh! This power... Be still, my right arm... "Growth. Our abilities have improved."

win_mvp.line: Alright! That's done! "Report. Victory is ours."

gift_prefer.line: "Delightful. You have my heartfelt gratitude." Wow, really? Thank you so much!

skill_dal_1.line: Bear us forth on swift wings of steel! —Raphael

dal_shop1.line: We've been waiting for you, Commander! "Greetings. Welcome."

dal_shop2.line: Anything catch your eye today? "Suggestion. Yuzuru likes this one."

dal_shop3.line: A superb choice! "Excellent choice! "Props. Praise is in order."

dal_shop4.line: "Received. One would expect nothing less." Huh? Did something happen??

dal_shop5.line: "Sold out. Now then, let's close up shop." Huh? We're sold out already?!

battle_ex.line: Let "our" date "begin!"

detail_ex.line: Y'know, I get the feeling your criteria for judging people aren't based on coolness or strength, Commander. "Praise. This speaks to your noble character."

feeling5_ex.line: Hey, it's no bother at all! I just want to help you like you helped me, Commander! "Gratitude. You need not hold back in front of us. Please don't be afraid to tell us if you have a problem."

login_ex.line: Aye. Appreciate you coming, Commander! "Request. I hope we will have a productive day today."

main4_ex.line: "Proposal. Whoop, bang, and finally, gwop!" What?! You're telling me to do a running jump into a hug? No way! That's embarrassing! "Smirk. That is not what I meant, but I see that's how you interpreted it." Hey!

main5_ex.line: Hm-hm-hm-hmm♪ "Shh. Kaguya is in a good mood and humming. I suggest we observe her for a bit." Hey, I can hear you!

main6_ex.line: Hmm. You're still working, I see. You're a busy one. "Proposal. How about we assist with your work?" Oh, a fine idea! Allow me to demonstrate my ability! "Doubt. Perhaps you should pick a task you are better suited for."

mission_ex.line: "Report. You have yet to accomplish your assigned missions." Heheheh. So it's come to this. I shall lend you my strength.

mission_complete_ex.line: "Proposal. Take a break once you've finished your work."

touch2_ex.line: "Shock. Perhaps this is some kind of special skill..."

win_mvp_ex.line: "Anticipation. I can't wait for our reward." Indeed. Do your utmost to entertain me!

detail.line: "Shock. There are so many fish forming these schools..." Heh! Our sheer charm must've drawn them here! "Doubt. Maybe they think we're... coral?" Umm.... Maybe, I guess?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander! Surely now you've got time to play! "Attention. The Commander is tired. We shouldn't be too pushy." Tired-shmired! Come on!

login.line: I've been waiting for you! No time to waste—let's go swimming!

main1.line: Heheh! Well done on the escort! Henceforth, you shall follow me as my right hand! "Doubt. I feel more like we are the ones being escorted here."

main2.line: I've figured it out! Swimming underwater's not that different from flying! That being the case... My vassal! I shall reveal to you the realm of the fish beneath the great ocean!

main3.line: "Fear. I feel as though I'm being drawn to the sea bottom when doing this. Could you hold my hand for a little while?"

touch.line: Yuzuru and I are wearing matching swimsuits! How do we look? "Confidence. No answer other than 'incredible' would be acceptable."

touch2.line: Not THAT! My hand! Take my hand! "Shock. How bold of you... Kaguya." I'M the bold one?!

unlock.line: I now entrust this body of mine to the beautiful flow of the sea god! Come, Commander, and give me your hand! "Request. Let us hold hands so that we don't get lost in the sea." Come on, don't be shy!

battle.line: Rout them all!

detail.line: Machine lifeforms or Sirens, I'll destroy them all.

expedition.line: Looks like someone's back?

feeling1.line: ...This is pointless.

feeling2.line: Defeating the enemy... As long as our objectives are the same, that's all that matters.

feeling3.line: I'll cover you. That much, I know I can do.

feeling4.line: Looks like I won't have to worry about you getting in my way.

feeling5.line: ...As long as our goals and desires align in some way, I'll lend you my strength... That should be good enough, right?

headtouch.line: What...do you think you're doing?

home.line: All done? Just say the word if you need me.

hp_warning.line: I... can still do this!

login.line: About time you showed up.

lose.line: Damn it! How could this happen, in a place like this...!

mail.line: Looks like you've got a message.

main1.line: I'm fine on my own. It's just business as usual.

main2.line: So we'll be fighting on the sea the whole time, huh? Not used to that.

main3.line: The sea, huh... Doesn't bring back any fond memories.

mission.line: Looks like there's still work to be done?

mission_complete.line: Looks like a mission was completed.

profile.line: My goal is to destroy all machine lifeforms. As long as you don't get in my way, I might even help with your objectives. If I slack off now because there are no machine lifeforms around, I'll get rusty soon.

propose.line: I never thought I'd have a comrade to fight alongside ever again, but... for the time being, let's do this, together.

touch.line: ...Got nothing better to do?

touch2.line: I'll destroy you...

unlock.line: I'm... called A2. I'm used to fighting by myself, without support... but maybe it wouldn't be bad to find a place to rest my feet.

upgrade.line: Not half bad.

win_mvp.line: Just stay there and sink.

gift_prefer.line: I appreciate it, really.

battle_ex.line: They're no match for us.

detail_ex.line: This so-called ship rigging... seems somewhat similar to our flight units.

feeling5_ex.line: Being by myself is easier, less to worry about. But being here isn't so bad either.

headtouch_ex.line: Don't do that again, understand?

login_ex.line: About time. So, what are we doing today?

main4_ex.line: It's nice and quiet here. I can tell you've been fighting day and night to protect this place... I know what that's like.

main5_ex.line: Being with all of you reminds me of the time I spent with my old comrades.

main6_ex.line: I've never had the time or place to be able to rest before... I don't know what I should do with my time.

mission_ex.line: If you still have work that needs to be done, I wouldn't mind helping you with that.

mission_complete_ex.line: You went through all that effort to get those missions done, so make sure everything is in order.

touch2_ex.line: ...You really should cherish your life more.

win_mvp_ex.line: Piece of cake.

detail.line: No harmful substances detected in this fruit. Not that I was planning on eating it anyway.

home.line: You're back? ...No, it's not like I was waiting for you or anything...

login.line: You came all the way out here just to chat with me? Awfully thoughtful of you...

main1.line: If you have something to say, just say it already. Can't relax with silence like this.

main2.line: Are you really alright getting this comfortable?

main3.line: *sigh*... Fine, do as you like.

touch.line: Will it kill you to not get so handsy all the time?

touch2.line: Is it just me, or are you a bit warmer than usual?

unlock.line: Why are you looking at me like that...? Is it so unusual to see me without armaments? ...Honestly, I don't think I'm much fun to stare at, but suit yourself.

battle.line: Enemy aircraft detected. Entering combat-ready state.

detail.line: I have no preferences when it comes to the choice of operations. Feel free to assign me whichever missions you see fit.

expedition.line: The expedition team has reported their return. Would you like to review the results?

feeling1.line: Should I conduct a system scan?

feeling2.line: It's dangerous for you to be alone. Head back to your quarters first; I'll protect you.

feeling3.line: Good day... I assessed that establishing communicative rapport would make things efficient here.

feeling4.line: You wish to learn more about machine lifeforms and aliens? I don't think I have any relevant information for you. But if you don't mind, we can talk about it some other time.

feeling5.line: I believe it is justified for a commander to treat casualties as statistics. It is not something you need to concern yourself over.

headtouch.line: ...It's alright. There are no problems with basic functionalities.

home.line: We've returned to base safely. Awaiting orders for the next operation.

hp_warning.line: I will not back down.

login.line: Confirming the Commander's arrival. Awaiting instructions.

lose.line: Damage is heavier than expected. Judging it detrimental to the operation, I will now start retreating...

mail.line: A message has arrived. Please look it over, Commander.

main1.line: YoRHa androids are forbidden from having emotions.

main2.line: How am I meant to spend my time when there are no missions...?

main3.line: These are goggles, not a blindfold.

mission.line: It appears that some tasks are still incomplete. I am simply reporting this, just in case.

mission_complete.line: It appears that you've completed some tasks. I recommend proceeding with the follow-up procedure.

profile.line: I am 2B. YoRHa No.2 Type B. I excel in close-quarters combat and normally use my Pod support system to handle ranged combat. I take it that here, I will be using this rigging to conduct ranged combat?

propose.line: Everyone, we all stand here to fight against our enemies, but nobody can fulfill this duty alone. To make up for that missing piece... Commander, perhaps that is why your presence is needed.

touch.line: ...What is the purpose of such an action?

touch2.line: No abnormalities detected. Maintenance should proceed without issue...

unlock.line: I am YoRHa No.2 Type B, an all-purpose battle android belonging to the YoRHa squadron. You can just call me 2B. I do not know where this is, but I will respond to any requests for assistance. After all, it is our mission to fight for humanity.

upgrade.line: This body is successfully enhanced. Thank you.

win_mvp.line: Battle concluded. Now returning to base.

gift_prefer.line: ...Thank you.

battle_ex.line: Enemy aircraft detected. Leave this to me.

detail_ex.line: Just as we fight against machine lifeforms, you fight against the Sirens... Looks like we all have a duty to keep on fighting.

feeling5_ex.line: The war against machine lifeforms seems endless... but will your fight against the Sirens end? Until peace has been restored, I will be your blade.

login_ex.line: I'm looking forward to our time together today, Commander.

main4_ex.line: Your port is a lot livelier than our Bunker.

main5_ex.line: Battler models absolutely require operator support, so we are always grateful for it.

main6_ex.line: While rest is not essential for us androids, some downtime is needed once in a while.

mission_ex.line: It seems you still have some unfinished work. Is there anything I can help with?

mission_complete_ex.line: It seems you've completed a mission. I can take care of the settlement procedures.

touch2_ex.line: There should've been no issues with maintenance... But feel free to inspect as much as you'd like.

win_mvp_ex.line: Confirming complete elimination of enemy aircraft. We can return safely now.

detail.line: All mechanical devices require proper maintenance for stable operation, and androids are no exception. In other words, I am requesting maintenance.

home.line: Returning from combat operations. You deserve some rest as well, Commander.

login.line: Commander... I recommend you take today off as well.

main1.line: I wish to preserve this scenery in my memory module. I wonder if this is the process humans refer to as "remembering."

main2.line: Plants are said to have a relaxing effect. However, this is not the case for androids... supposedly.

main3.line: Commander, do I appear to be "relaxing" to you?

touch.line: I am able to measure your body temperature accurately, even without physical contact.

touch2.line: I have detected a subtle abnormality in your tactile system. Could you do that one more time, for confirmation?

unlock.line: Confirming the safety of the surrounding area. I shall now enter sleep mode for the time being. While resting is not essential to us androids, the tranquil environment here seems to be urging me to do so.

battle.line: So this is a battlefield? Ahaha... how interesting.

couple_encourage1.line: I-I wouldn't do something like that...

couple_encourage2.line: Let's seize a decisive victory, Miss Head Maid~♪

couple_encourage3.line: Let me see how the Maid Team fights~♪

detail.line: Want to know about this? It's called a trident. Don't you think it's cool?

expedition.line: Commander, I shall temporarily grant you permission to leave my side so that you may greet the girls who have returned from commissions.

feeling1.line: Commander, did you know how high my expectations were for you at first? What a shame, for you shall now never know.

feeling2.line: Commander, I have a question. If in the future you were given the option to sacrifice me for world peace, what would you choose?

feeling3.line: The correct answer is - to do everything in your power to prevent that situation from occurring in the first place. Heehee~ Commander, if you wish to woo me, you will have to use your brain more~

feeling4.line: Having that said, I believe that a truly intelligent person knows how to rely on others when appropriate. Ah, that's right~ Commander, would you feed me some cake?

feeling5.line: Commander, have you planned where we're going to go for our date? If you have picked out an outfit for me, why don't you help me put it on? Eh~? "Why don't I wear it myself?" Silly, that's what love is all about~ L.O.V.E~♡

home.line: You've done well to return home safe and sound.

hp_warning.line: I seem to have underestimated the battlefield...

login.line: That simply will not do, Commander, keeping me waiting all this time~

lose.line: I shall not repeat this mistake again.

mail.line: Commander, there's mail for you. Hmm? I didn't do anything in particular~

main1.line: Unlike the other girls, this is my "maiden voyage" onto the battlefield. I wish to confirm for myself what this oft-touted "difference in experience" looks like.

main2.line: Commander, if you get on your knees and beg, "Please, Mistress Neptune," perhaps there would be a chance for something nice to happen?

main3.line: Commander, if you wish to taste my freshly-baked cake, then please first brew your finest tea~

mission.line: Commander, I see you have allowed your unfinished missions to pile up. I am not very fond of lazy people, you know?

mission_complete.line: Commander, what do you hope to gain through not collecting the mission rewards? Perchance you are waiting for me to remind you?

profile.line: My background? Ehehe, I am the large light cruiser who only existed on paper, Neptune, so it is understandable that you have never heard of me before. Though I have yet to step onto the battlefield, my abilities are top notch... allow me to prove that to you in live combat~

propose.line: "You are my world?" Did you think you could fool me with such flattery? Ehehe... well, I suppose there's a chance that I would let you fool me~ But first, you would have to repeat it ten times, nay, a hundred times~

skill.line: I have no intention of getting friendly with the enemy~

touch.line: You would like to challenge me to a game? Very well. Do not expect me to hold back though, hehe~♪

touch2.line: That simply will not do, Commander. You cannot seek to gain my attention that way.

unlock.line: Who am I? I am the Royal Navy's large light cruiser, Neptune. I shall see to it that you will never forget my name~♪ Yes, pleased to be of service~♪

upgrade.line: As expected!

win_mvp.line: Ehehe~ As a special service, I shall allow you to praise me more~♪

gift_prefer.line: Bingo! Don't forget next time, either, okay?

battle.line: How uncouth, spoiling the mood like this...

detail.line: My daily routine is nothing but missions and sorties, so it’s nice to be able to get dressed up and have a good time. Hehe~

login.line: Commander, Merry Christmas~ ♪

mail.line: Commander, why don’t you take a guess which box I put your mail into~?

main1.line: Commander, if you kneel in front of me and beg, you might just get something very nice in return~ Hehe~

main2.line: Commander, did you already forget? If you want a present from me, you must first give me something that I’d be satisfied with~

main3.line: Since joining the fleet, I’ve made a lot of friends. Especially Shropshire — she’s both a good friend and a good rival.

touch.line: Commander, would you help me out with these presents that I prepared for Seattle’s party? They’re going to be for everyone~

unlock.line: Hehe~ I usually let the other girls have all the glory, but even I must sometimes give you something to remember me by. Merry Christmas, Commander~

win_mvp.line: That should wrap things up. Commander, let’s continue our party~

battle.line: You, going against the Commander? That simply won't do~♪

detail.line: Commander, I know you actually attend all sorts of parties with the Royal Maids. Buuut, heehee~ Don't you think I'm a cut above those girls when it comes to these kinds of situations?

home.line: Welcome back. Now then, please take my hand once more. Oh... Is the trident getting in the way?

login.line: That simply won't do, Commander. As you are the guest of honor, we cannot have you arriving late. You've kept me waiting, you know. Heehee♪

lose.line: Was I too preoccupied with putting on airs...?

main1.line: Allowing some other girl to attend you instead of choosing me? That simply won't do, Commander... Just kidding♪ I'll be waiting right here, so make sure you say hello to everyone~

main2.line: Commander, have you forgotten the magic words when you want me to take you somewhere? "Please, Mistress Neptune." Remember?

main3.line: Charybdis' demeanor seems rather out of place compared to the rest of the Royal Maids... Say, Commander, how would you like it if I tried to act extra high-and-mighty to get you to do all sorts of stuff for me?

touch.line: That's right, the party venue is right in front of you. Heehee~♪

touch2.line: That simply won't do, Commander. Everything has a proper time and place, you know?

unlock.line: Welcome to our celebration, Commander. At this breathtaking venue, I, Neptune, shall be the one to show you around, rather than the Royal Maids. Heehee~♪

win_mvp.line: You're welcome~♪ It was only possible because of you, Commander.

detail.line: There's more to this case than meets the eye. Who knows how deep the rabbit hole goes... Advisor, it's time you start searching for clues. With your help, we've got this in the bag.

feeling5.line: Practicing that last jump has me exhausted... Say, how about you massage my thighs for me? Yeah, just like that... Aw, you can go higher if you want, you know.

home.line: Commander, don't you think that jump I pulled off was just perfect? I put hours of practice into it! Phew... But now I'm tired... Pass me the water, would you?

login.line: You're just in time for our scene, Commander. Hurry up and get changed... Do you want my help? Hmm, only if you say please and thank you!

main1.line: These traces are suspicious. It almost feels as if they were left on purpose... Advisor, write down everything that looks... Hm? Oh, right, that wasn't in the script. Sorry – I couldn't help but rely on you!

main2.line: You're doing great work. Once this case is wrapped up, let me treat you to dinner. This is a personal invitation and not from the team, I'll have you know.

main3.line: Are you telling me... this wasn't the first crime scene?! Ahem. How was that one, Commander? Hmm, you think I should be more confident like I always am? Okay, I'll give it a try!

mission.line: This is a big case, and time is running out. Let's get to work, advisor.

mission_complete.line: Advisor, our fieldwork is about done for the day. Let's give it a rest... Hey, you free later?

touch.line: Oh? Is there a problem with how my outfit's fitting? You're free to help me adjust it.

touch2.line: We're on camera, Commander. Are you really so impatient?

unlock.line: Step aside, officer comin' through! Oh, here already, advisor? Did you find any good clues? ...No? Heheh, watch and see how the pros do it!

battle.line: Depend on me! I will make sure this fleet returns home without as much as a scratch!

couple_encourage1.line: I am George, Elizabeth, and Edward... but I will never be "Wales"!

couple_encourage2.line: In another world, perhaps I would've been your real big sister.

detail.line: You are the one and only being who matters to me... Until I met you, there was nary a single soul who believed in me.

expedition.line: I wonder what efforts it took to materialise me... Hmph, regardless, I will see to it they are repaid in double.

feeling1.line: Are you saying that I am inferior to them?!

feeling2.line: I only survived in that dark world by believing that I am excellence itself, and thus irreplaceable...

feeling3.line: Love needs no repayment. No matter how much the Royal Family neglects me, my loyalty to them is unwavering.

feeling4.line: So, they can still laugh together... Perhaps I wasn't discarded for nought, then... I have never felt this way before.

feeling5.line: Commander, to me, you are the most special, most dear person in existence. You always have, and always will be...

home.line: That was a marvellous welcome. Hmph, were I the only one returning, would anyone welcome me at all...?

hp_warning.line: If Wales were me, she would probably have sunk long ago.

login.line: Splendid; you're back. I, Monarch, am superior to the likes of Wales and York. Wouldn't you agree, Commander?

lose.line: Am I... being discarded yet again?

mail.line: You've received mail regarding the war. You would do best to check it.

main1.line: Wales and York... I despise them for bereaving me of my existence, but I cannot resent them for succeeding me.

main2.line: A younger sister? If I have one, her name would be... Prince of Wales... That has a rather nice ring to it.

main3.line: I will make the world understand how foolish it was not to choose me.

mission.line: Let me handle this mission. I shall prove my excellence!

mission_complete.line: For as long as I exist, it isn't over. I am excellence itself, therefore I must exist.

profile.line: I am the battleship named Monarch, one of the rejected King George V-class designs. Hmph, though I was once forgotten, now I live and breathe...

propose.line: Even if the world no longer needs me, you will always need me. That is more than enough for me... Hahah, perhaps I was materialised with the sole purpose of meeting you. Even if so... I am happy.

skill.line: Not even the Queen's orders can subdue me!

touch.line: Is my presence needed, Commander?

touch2.line: Do not fall victim to those degenerate habits of theirs.

unlock.line: We meet for the first time. I am the battleship Monarch. Hmph, once I was discarded, but now I am needed; how ironic... Is this how low the Royal Navy has sunk?

upgrade.line: Hmph, sure enough, I am the most excellent of the King George V class.

win_mvp.line: Heed my words: depend on me! I will always win!

gift_prefer.line: A wonderful gift this is!

battle_ex.line: Behold, Commander! This victory I'll dedicate to you!

feeling5_ex.line: Never would I have imagined this – that one day I, a loner with no one relying on her, would be mulling over my future together with you. Thank you, for accepting me and giving meaning to my life. You are my greatest love.

home_ex.line: You've returned. Unscathed, no less. I'm certain you'll welcome me back with those same words, even should I return alone. Truly, that is a comforting sensation.

login_ex.line: Splendid; you're back. Are you going to hunker down, or take a breather? Whichever the case, I will do the same.

main4_ex.line: You brought meaning to my existence. As a token of my gratitude, I will forever bring you victory.

main5_ex.line: It will take time to accustom myself to being wed, but as long as you're here, I will never doubt or feel lost.

main6_ex.line: It's as I feared. Being alone has become unbearable to me. I blame you for this. For... changing me for the better.

touch_ex.line: Commander, I am glad to serve you.

touch2_ex.line: Mgh... Give me a moment. I need time to... accustom myself.

win_mvp_ex.line: See that? I will never let you down.

battle.line: Allow me to demonstrate the elegance with which a lady of the Royal Navy comports herself.

detail.line: Stand up straight and puff out your chest, Commander. You're the only one I deign to— You're not sure where to look? Well, why not look me in the eyes then?

login.line: Don't just stand there gawking, Commander. There remains much to be done today.

main2.line: Shall I teach you the Royal Navy's courtly dances?

main3.line: Such splendid dress is normally reserved for special occasions. But for me, every day I exist is a day to be celebrated.

touch.line: You like this dress, do you? Hmph, I see you've learned the art of empty flattery from Wales. But nonetheless... thank you...

touch2.line: I admire your bravery. Now would you rather I stab or trample you? Or would you prefer to taste a volley from my guns?

unlock.line: Hmph. One's outfit is merely superficial. True nobility must come from within. Don't you agree, Commander?

detail.line: "Paint our jubilant memories of this festival into history"? Hmph, she's as grandiloquent as ever, isn't she?

login.line: This festival comes but once a year. I shan't let you waste it working yourself to death. Come, let me handle that. The fleet will survive you taking a break.

main1.line: Tsk, Wales, must you always pester me with this Dragon Empery chinoiserie? I'll learn about their customs myself, without you.

main2.line: A New Year's wish? Naturally, I wish to prove you were right to choose me. That isn't going to change.

main3.line: Though I am a proud lady of the Royal Navy, I find myself deeply moved to have this chance to experience a festival from an exotic culture.

touch.line: You desire my company? You should have said so.

touch2.line: Have you been afflicted with Wales's vile proclivities? Commander?

unlock.line: So, an Eastern outfit this time... Hmph. My nobility is evident regardless of what I wear. However, since you prepared this outfit especially for me, it would be unbecoming of me to not express my gratitude. Thank you.

battle.line: Drop your weapons! Stop resisting!

detail.line: You want to showcase our bond as partners and deliver a performance as realistic as possible, and so you'll keep your script hidden from me? ...Sounds like you're really enjoying this. Very well, I'll try to live up to your expectations.

feeling5.line: "Stay with me, my partner. There's no one else like you in the world... "That line wasn't in the script"? You're right, it's not. I added it just now.

headtouch.line: Is... this some new city etiquette I missed the memo on?

home.line: Didn't think you'd be back so soon. Hm? What's this? You've pieced together all the clues in all the case files thus far? Bloody good job. This is why I say you're my most trusted partner.

login.line: You've returned. I've organised your paperwork and written up the case in general and in detail. Heh... Now it is time to prove how much better we are than them.

lose.line: Bugger, I blew it... I'm going to hate writing this apology.

mail.line: Did PhantoM send you a new calling card? Read it at once.

main1.line: This city has changed so much I don't recognise it anymore... Hmph, it's no wonder why PhantoM is so drawn to it. It's a bloody mess.

main2.line: Buddy, it's time to go! To PhantoM's target! I've sent instructions to the task force already. That sodding thief isn't getting away this time!

main3.line: PhantoM always knows where the force sets up traps for her... Hmph. There has to be a conspirator in our midst. Partner, who do you think it is?

main4.line: I'll catch this PhantoM bastard even if it's the last thing I do. Then the whole force will see that I am the most excellent detective!

touch.line: Hm? Have you found a new clue? ...No? You were just staring at me? Then why do you hesitate, my friend?

touch2.line: You've picked up some bad habits while I was gone. But fine, I'll turn a blind eye this one time. Only because we're partners.

unlock.line: This common thief – calls herself "PhantoM" – is running circles around the Metropolitan Police. Now they've come to me for help... Bet they never thought this day would come when they demoted me to the sticks. On the bright side, we get to detect side by side again.

battle.line: I shall demonstrate how a monarch enjoys the beach!

detail.line: I look forward to the closing bonfire party George and the others are preparing. Will you be there, Commander? Ah, no, of course you will. They would not be making such grand preparations if you weren't coming.

expedition.line: We must congratulate the team's efforts, regardless of how the commission went... Yes, I understand.

feeling5.line: Though I may forget my duty momentarily, you have not changed in my eyes. You accepted me, guided me, and taught me how to enjoy everyday life... Hm? You've yet to teach me all the ways to have fun? Ugh – that is an unnecessary addition!

home.line: You've returned. Have you enjoyed the beach to its fullest? ...Me? I've done more than just sit here and wait for you. I think so, at least...

login.line: While clothes are just a flourish, we are told to dress appropriately back home... I'd love to hear a reason for why I must wear this.

main1.line: I know everyone enjoys the beach in their own way, but how do you typically do it? I can't imagine you always sit and stare at people like this...

main2.line: You say I take competitions all too seriously, even informal games between friends? I hate to admit it, but... you're right.

main3.line: The sunshine is getting stronger. Whew... Are you alright, Commander? Should I bring you a cold beverage?

mission.line: This is no time to fuss over being the most excellent. Complete your missions so we may enjoy the beach.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards have arrived. Now we can all better enjoy the beach, can we not?

touch.line: Suntan lotion? Oh, right. Appreciated...

touch2.line: Is it the beach you're enjoying, or is it me you're... No, forget it.

unlock.line: Whew... Surely now one can argue that I'm "enjoying the beach," yes? ...Still not enough? I am laying my exposed self bare before you – what more is there I need to do?

win_mvp.line: Relishing the beach and victory – that is how I celebrate my holiday with you. Hmph.

battle.line: The battlefield is callous... Ibuki, advancing!

couple_encourage1.line: Feeble though I may be... I shall give this my all!

detail.line: Milord, w-welcome... I wasn't able to prepare much for your arrival... but would you like some tea?

expedition.line: Milord, the comm... Um, whatever these are called. Yes, they're done now.

feeling1.line: Had I known I would have to serve a person like you, I never would have manifested during this era...

feeling2.line: I would also enjoy a life of sitting atop the mountains, watching the clouds pass through the sky. But my current life here isn't so bad either.

feeling3.line: I'm cool, you say...? If anything, I am somewhat jealous of how everyone can always have a smile on their faces... In contrast, I simply do not know how to express my emotions...

feeling4.line: After spending a lot of time with everyone else, I've experienced firsthand how difficult it can be to express my emotions clearly... such as joy... and love...

feeling5.line: The mugwort on Mount Ibuki is said to symbolize love that burns quietly... F-For example, right now, Milord... can you feel Ibuki's heart?

home.line: Milord, if you are ever injured, please allow Ibuki to treat you with this mugwort liniment. There's still a lot left.

hp_warning.line: A fight with our backs to the wall? ... Exactly what I wanted!

login.line: Milord, you must be tired.

lose.line: Ugh... I must increase my training multifold.

mail.line: Milord, your mail... Huh? You'd like me to read it? B-but that's embarrassing...

main1.line: Spending time alone with Milord... somehow... makes my heart pound...

main2.line: Milord, if you have no further orders for me, may I go over there to meditate?

main3.line: In order to hone my swordsmanship, I practice my strokes a thousand times every day... Don't worry, Milord, I already finished while you were gone.

mission.line: We seem to have new missions. Would you like Ibuki to accompany you?

mission_complete.line: Milord, there's a big pile of stuff over there... Um, are those the rewards then?

profile.line: Milord, are you interested in me...? Mm... this Ibuki, who was never born, and has no history or accomplishments to speak of... Um, my hobby is poetry, and I'm skilled in swordsmanship! Are you satisfied with that? Um, also, I'm not very good around people...

propose.line: I never knew that having my feelings be reciprocated could be so overwhelmingly joyful... Milord, p-please don't look at me... I'm so happy that... my face must look strange...

skill.line: The pinnacle of Ibuki... resides in this single strike!

touch.line: You'd like me to put on a show? S-Sorry... in front of other people... I can't...

touch2.line: Clear the mind, and purify the six roots... Eek! Mi, Milord...

unlock.line: Was it your voice that beckoned me from my timeless slumber? This lowly Ibuki, though still in training, shall be yours to use as you see fit.

upgrade.line: Is this... the sensation of getting stronger? Thank you!

win_mvp.line: My skills are but party tricks, unworthy of such praise.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Milord. I'll treasure this.

detail_ex.line: Milord, would you like to relax with a cup of tea? May I... spend the day by your side?

feeling5_ex.line: Milord, you light up my world, once comprised of only swordsmanship and poetry. Made it warmer and more vibrant than ever before. I will devote my body, my heart, my everything to you... Milord, please... Embrace me, tightly...

headtouch_ex.line: ...This is about you, Milord. I will be... fine.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Milord! Allow me to check that you are unharmed... Ah, my apologies! Ibuki was simply concerned for you...

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Milord. We were only away for half a day, but it felt so much longer...

main4_ex.line: Today, I bought some of the sweets that are most trendy... Would you like to have some with me, Milord?

main5_ex.line: Are you tired, Milord? You see, I have practiced new massage techniques... Inexperienced though I may be, allow your humble Ibuki to heal you.

main6_ex.line: With each day, I temper the blade with which I protect you, and the heart that yearns for you. Always, and forever...

touch_ex.line: Milord... Can you feel my heart racing? This isn't from nerves, but, hmm... It's because... I am with you...

touch2_ex.line: 'Tis not fair, Milord... You know I cannot say no to you...

upgrade_ex.line: This power... It shall become a blade with which to protect you, Milord.

detail.line: I'll have to thank Houshou for this lovely kimono...

feeling5.line: The winter in my timeless slumber was silent and cold. But here, at Milord's side, I feel only warmth... Milord, would you... take my hand?

home.line: The snow is coming down outside... Milord, let me get an extra sweater for you.

login.line: Milord, shall we go outside together?

main1.line: Achoo! ...I'm cute when I sneeze? D- don't make fun of me...

main2.line: This is... real snow... beautiful...

main3.line: Aren't there some big festivals in the wintertime? I guess you could say... I'm a little interested... only a little!

touch.line: Is there someplace you'd like to go, Milord? Of course I'll accompany you.

touch2.line: Um, Milord, your hands are cold...

unlock.line: Milord, it's starting to snow... If it suits you, please take shelter under Ibuki's umbrella.

detail.line: These foreign beverages and teas have quite a distinctive flavor...

home.line: Milord, please try this cake. It's fluffy, sweet, and delicious.

login.line: I am unsure how I should conduct myself at a "banquet..." Milord, may I just follow you?

main1.line: There are so many things at this banquet that I simply do not understand... Ah, please don't get the wrong idea... I merely realized that there is much for me to learn still.

main2.line: Actually, it was Miss Seattle who invited me here... She's quite a charismatic person.

main3.line: Though I prefer my outings to be a bit more... introspective, I don't mind the camaraderie and joyfulness here.

touch.line: Milord, it feels nice when the wind gently strokes my cheeks.

touch2.line: D-do these clothes not suit me after all?

unlock.line: This is my first time wearing Western clothes... Um, Milord! Does this outfit... suit Ibuki well...?

detail.line: Hmm, I'm a lot more outgoing than usual? Maybe the festive atmosphere is rubbing off on me. Milord, do you think... I'm acting strange...?

login.line: The warm glow of the lanterns and the vivid, red decorations... it's all so beautiful...

main1.line: Milord, Ibuki will be performing a sword dance at the Spring Festival banquet tonight... Um, it's my first time performing in front of everyone, so I'm a bit nervous...

main2.line: Milord, Miss Akashi seems to be selling firecrackers. I heard they are a bit like fireworks... Huh? They are firecrackers, right?

main3.line: Milord, those things hanging on the walls are "fai chun," right? I see, there's something written in them... I wonder what it means...

touch.line: Around this time, the cold begins to recede. Soon, spring shall arrive... I see, so this is why people hang "fai chun" on the walls...

unlock.line: The Dragon Empery's "Spring Festival" is... filled with fun, liveliness, and pure jubilation. I can feel my true feelings welling up... Maybe, an environment like this would suit me pretty well...

battle.line: Milord, I'll protect you!

detail.line: Milord, is the tea I prepared to your liking?

feeling5.line: Milord, I've prepared your tea. Phew... Even though we're spending all this time together doing nothing, I... still feel fulfilled. Mm, this overflowing emotion... Milord, is this what "love" is...?

headtouch.line: Milord...?

login.line: *Yaaawn*... Milord, please relax and make yourself at home.

mail.line: Milord, you have new mail. Um... Shall I read it aloud for you?

main2.line: Milord, I shall now continue my meditation... Oh, y-you'd like to talk to me?

main3.line: Milord, could you please arrange some work for me? I'm... feeling a little fidgety...

touch.line: Milord, what would you have me do...?

touch2.line: Milord?! H-have I done something to displease you...?

unlock.line: I'm glad you've returned, Milord. I've changed my attire in order to better carry out your order–for us to "relax together." Now then... could you please instruct me on how to proceed?

detail.line: Admittedly, it is quite easy to move around in this swimsuit... Eh? What did I draw in the sand...? Oh, why would you ask me when you already know... Aah...

feeling5.line: The waves may wash away what I drew in the sand, but it matters not. My feelings for you will last for as long as the sea breeze blows. Ibuki's place is forever by your side, Commander...

headtouch.line: Huh? The sea breeze is... messing up my hair?

home.line: Welcome back, Milord. Would you like some cold ramune to relax with?

login.line: Milord, you're here. The sun feels quite pleasant... Shall we take a walk along the shore... Watching the rolling waves?

main1.line: The briny smell of the breeze is a world of difference from the crisp winds of the mountains... But any scent is soothing with you by my side, Milord.

main2.line: Shall we take a walk by the beach, Milord? There is something... quite important Ibuki wishes to tell you...

main3.line: Milord, burying your feet in the warm sand feels quite good. Would you, hm... like to try it with me?

touch.line: Here, Milord, have some ramune. It is your favorite flavor.

touch2.line: Eek?! M-Milord, umm... there are no rocks to hide us here...

unlock.line: Thank you for accepting my invitation... The sea breeze blows pleasantly here, but if it's still too hot for you, allow Ibuki to present you with some cold ramune... Milord, if you would like some... Wh-what's drawn in the sand behind me? I-it's nothing...!

battle.line: All ships, form up! Target: enemies in front!

detail.line: If you've got time to stare at me then maybe do your work instead.

expedition.line: Commission complete. Why don't you go on one yourself, sometime?

feeling1.line: You lack what it takes to order me to swing this blade.

feeling2.line: This blade is my other half. Casually touch it, and you'll get hurt.

feeling3.line: *Sigh*... Why do you always make that miserable face, Commander? It's so miserable that... it makes me want to scold you...

feeling4.line: Hey, you've started getting just a bit into shape recently... Hmph, I suppose I'll acknowledge you've worked hard.

feeling5.line: The path of my blade is one of constant solitude... or so I thought. Hmph, maybe being with you... isn't so bad after all.

home.line: Look who's back. Time's precious, so start reflecting on your last sortie immediately.

hp_warning.line: P-put out the fire...!

login.line: Late, as always. Just how long will you keep me waiting?

lose.line: Damn... I can... still fight...!

mail.line: Here's a letter. It's rude to the sender to not read their letter thoroughly. Don't you agree?

main1.line: A blade requires careful maintenance. Isn't that obvious?

main2.line: Sisters... eh. The Izumo class consists of just me, so I guess I'm a bit jealous.

main3.line: Become stronger, Commander. Once you become strong enough to protect everyone... Once that happens, I...

mission.line: What are you planning to do about these unfinished missions?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Good lord, would you ever have realized it on your own?

profile.line: I'm battleship Izumo, of the Sakura Empire. I existed as a proposed Yamato-class design, although they didn't construct me... But if you look down me even slightly then prepare to taste one of my main cannon volleys.

propose.line: You're making that miserable face again. I just can't leave you be, huh... Listen, today is the day I will acknowledge your hard work... or, should I say, your talent! I, battleship Izumo, swear on my blade to walk with you, both in life and death.

skill.line: Feel the wrath of my blade!

touch.line: Commander, you don't have the free time to endlessly chat with me.

touch2.line: ... I-I'll slice your hand off!

unlock.line: Battleship Izumo, reporting in. Are you the Commander? Sure don't look very reliable... Listen here: do anything to slow me down, and you won't hear the end of it!

upgrade.line: My blade grows sharper.

win_mvp.line: Victory? Of course we won!

gift_prefer.line: You really did your homework. Thank you.

battle.line: I'll remind ya, in case ya forgot...! I'm the battleship Izumo!

detail.line: My name has connections to classical dancing...? I-I see...

main1.line: Dancing and my sword are much alike. Untold hours of learning and practice are for a single moment of brilliance...

main2.line: Commander, if I really captivate you so... will you be able to finish your work?

main3.line: Savory delicacies and mature festivities... I say why not enjoy the New Year and let loose for once? Hahahah!

touch.line: ... Drunk? Me? I've only had a few... *Hick*

touch2.line: Commander, are you insinuating you want a swift kick?

unlock.line: You'd like to see my classical dance? Your tastes are quite refined, Commander... In that case, I'll show you the finest performance in the land!

win_mvp.line: How stunning; how gorgeous – to my eyes, the sight of this battlefield is worth ten thousand ryo.

detail.line: This stuff is stronger than I thought... Huh? Commander?! N-no, I'm not drunk! You're just imagining things!

feeling5.line: The red liquid dripping from my tail isn't just for cocktails, you know. Who knows how you might change if you drank it directly? Heh... Interested? So am I. Go on, Commander... Give it a try.

headtouch.line: Mm... Oddly soothing...

home.line: Oh, you're back. Let's get back to our drinking contest, then. Get ready – I can hold my drink better than anyone.

login.line: I'm good at more than just bartending, you know. Why don't I join you for a round of drinks? ...Worried I'll get drunk? This isn't even enough wine to get me tipsy!

main1.line: How can I drink the Commander under the table... If I keep this up, I'm done for...

main2.line: Huh... Commander! How'd you get tied up in my tail?! Wait, why are you giving it free rein to do as it likes?!

main3.line: ...Did that one taste a little different? The secret is in the hole at the end of my tail. Open up, and I might just let you get a taste of the secret ingredient.

touch.line: *sigh*... That's good drinkin'... Nnh... Zzz...

touch2.line: I'm still not drunk yet... You'll rue this day... I-I mean, no! I'll get you back right now...!

unlock.line: Finally realized I'm the bartender here? This isn't any ordinary wine, you know. Give it a try, if you're interested. Heheheh...

battle.line: *Giggle*... You saw me, and now you're trying to flee...? Do you really think you can flee from ME?!

detail.line: Commander, do you have any interests outside of work? If you're okay with it, why don't we relax together?

expedition.line: Those commission girls must work really hard... Okay, everyone line up~ I'm going to give each of you a hug~

feeling1.line: Commander... YOU WILL PAY!

feeling2.line: How I'm faring at the base? Perfectly fine. Although... isn't it a little too peaceful here...?

feeling3.line: It is our destiny to kill one another on the battlefield... So, wouldn't you say it's normal to revel in the killing just a little bit?

feeling4.line: Ahhh... The feeling of tearing apart enemies with gunfire... and breaking them into a million little pieces... I can't get enough of it... You know how I feel, don't you, Commander?

feeling5.line: *Giggle*, I get more fulfillment from being with you than from killing enemies on the battlefield... Is this the power of love? But then...

home.line: I want to pummel some enemies, too~ *Giggle*... The more of them you sink, the more you prove your worth, after all~

hp_warning.line: You dare hurt me...? YOU WILL PAY!

login.line: This place is so peaceful. Everyone's so nice, too...

lose.line: Aww... Did we fall prey to an ambush...?

mail.line: It's not any bad news, is it?

main1.line: Every time I see something beautiful get squashed on the battlefield, I just... Aahhh...

main2.line: I want to do something to soothe your mind. But... what should I do...

main3.line: What my hobby is? Perhaps something like "granting sweet release"?

mission.line: What might this next mission be? I'm getting a little excited.

mission_complete.line: Let's give our all on the next mission, too.

profile.line: I am Roon, the Iron Blood cruiser. In a far-off world, I never existed beyond the drawing board... But that aside, I've seen it, Commander... Deep within your heart, there's something that resembles me...

propose.line: Thank you so much. But listen, I finally understand now. What filled the void in my heart wasn't slaughter on the battlefield or love, it was the hatred known as "envy"... Commander, I love you just as much as I deeply, deeply, DEEPLY hate those other girls... THEY WILL PAY!

touch.line: Please open your mouth, Commander... *Giggle*, do you like it? Have I gotten better at cooking?

touch2.line: Hm? Do you want a hug, too? Okay~

unlock.line: I never thought I'd end up here... Hello, I am Roon. I don't know this place very well, so could I ask you to give me a tour?

upgrade.line: Thank you for that, Commander.

win_mvp.line: Not only did you not sink yourselves upon seeing me, you even forced me to sink you myself... YOU WILL PAY!

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. I like it a lot.

battle.line: You're just in time, I needed to blow off a little steam!

detail.line: Did my dress catch your attention, Commander? ... But when I think about you looking at the other girls' dresses, I just...

login.line: Hah hah... it's not often we have a party. Let's enjoy ourselves, Commander.

main1.line: When you see something so perfect and beautiful, don't you just feel the urge to... crush it?

main2.line: Commander, I picked out this dress specifically for the occasion. Don't you feel like it... completes you?

main3.line: All this merriment is making me nauseous... Commander, can you let me sortie when we get back?

touch.line: Are you having a good time, Commander? ... Me? Oh I'm just happy to see you~

touch2.line: Commander... I think you can get closer than that...

unlock.line: Such a delightful party with our wonderful friends in this peaceful harbor... It's wonderful, really... But, it's all so boring...

win_mvp.line: Hehehe... That was another lovely "banquet."

battle.line: How DARE you ruin my special moment with the Commander!

detail.line: Mainz's favorite coffee is a nice party drink, though I think I still prefer Iron Blood beer. What do you prefer, Commander?

expedition.line: I can see the commission team all the way from up here. Well? Are you heading out to greet them?

feeling5.line: Ah, so this is what you meant by "a break." It certainly is a cure for boredom, and I am happy to have some alone time with you, buuut... (I know you're trying to keep me in check, and you're going to pay for that♥)

home.line: Welcome back! Let's give you a nice, waaarm hug♪

login.line: Good timing, actually – the party was starting to bore me. Thanks for pulling me out, Commander~

main1.line: While I like vistas as much as the next person, I'm awfully fed up with the port's scenery at this point. Battlefields differ in that regard... Ahh... I'll never tire of seeing them.

main2.line: Heehee~ Don't you worry, I'm not going anywhere. Why would I, when it's you who brought me here?

main3.line: Since we have access to a piano, could you help me work on my singing? I'm starting to feel restless from sitting around for too long... Heehee~

touch.line: Oh, you're back already? Then please, come here and let your heart be soothed♪

touch2.line: Go on – we're all alone here~♥

unlock.line: It's so nice getting away from the bustling party hall and being alone with you, Commander. I'm eager to see what we'll do now as your idea of a... "break"~

win_mvp.line: Heehee... Now that's what I'd call a good "break"~

detail.line: My swimsuit? Well, I thought you might like it if I tore it up a little, Commander. What do you think? Doesn't it suit me... just as much?

expedition.line: Looks like the commission team is back. Heehee, is there something you were hoping for from me, Commander?

feeling5.line: Phew... It's late, but I'm feeling kind of restless. While I think we should get to bed, I could go for one last round of stress relief♪ You will join me, won't you, Commander?

home.line: There, there... Excellent job on that sortie. Phew. If you're feeling a bit more rested now, how about a light snack? This is my homemade cooking. I used the freshest ingredients.

login.line: You must be exhausted from playing with everyone during the day, Commander. Heehee, just leave your evening relaxation to me.

lose.line: Commander... don't tell me you wanted to see me defeated?

main1.line: Ahhh, there's nothing like a sharp blade drawing a slit into flesh... Filleting fish is a nice change of pace, you know. Would you like to join me next time, Commander?

main2.line: You were worried about me? I'm completely fine. I can down a battleship with a single punch, so all I need to do is flail around a bit to make a shark yield.

main3.line: Letting the sea's nightly breeze caress you as you lie in a soft bed and drift into a peaceful slumber... It would be a bit too peaceful and boring to do every evening, but it's nice and refreshing once in a while. Hehe...

touch.line: You're going to hug ME, Commander? Go right ahead. Nice and tight~

touch2.line: Want to tear it up some more? Go ahead~

unlock.line: Good evening, Commander. Here, let me give you a late-night hug~ You want to know why my swimsuit's in tatters? Heehee, I ran into an unruly little shark when I went out to get food. To think it tried to resist ending up as my meal... It's going to pay!

win_mvp.line: Shall we pick up some ingredients for a late-night snack while we're here?

detail.line: Jealous? Well, you and I have already sworn an oath, so I don't see any need to care about anyone else. Say, Commander, why would you ask that? Why would you bring up other girls? You'll pay for that!

expedition.line: Seems the commission team is back. Let's go say hello to them... and get some fresh air while we're at it♪

feeling5.line: Impetus and nihility, love and hatred, a surge of desire from the heart – you'd never be the same if you accepted my all, Commander... That's fine by you, you say? I can't believe how kind you are... Heehee. You may think it's fine to wish for that, but to me... Yes, to me, that's beyond unforgivable.

home.line: Time for a welcome back hug, Commander! I can't believe you left me behind while you went out on a sortie... What do you have to say for yourself?

login.line: A quiet moment, you say? While it may be that way to you, my head and heart are beating so hard it's bringing my sanity to the brink.

main1.line: When you hold me tightly like this, it makes me feel... a tremendous surge of "love."

main2.line: While the port can sometimes be boring, what with how tranquil it is, I'll still never tire of any place where I can always be with you. Whether it's me making a total mess of you, or you making a total mess of me... Ahh...

main3.line: Has anything been troubling you lately? I'm always here to listen. If anyone – no matter who – hassles you, I will tear into them, rip them apart, and grind them into a paste with my own two hands♪

mission.line: Missions? I'll help you with them, just please be sure to have a reward ready for me at the end.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Ah! Heehee, my, I wasn't expecting this hug. Thank you for the reward.

touch.line: It's so exciting when you do this – touching me without being prompted to♪

touch2.line: The urge to ruin something for being beautiful... Heehee. You're just like me, Commander♥

unlock.line: Commander? You've not only filled the void in my heart, but also wholly embraced my fervid feelings... Ah, you really make me want to do things... Unforgivable things, like opening my heart for you.

win_mvp.line: Mmh! Now that was refreshing. Thank you, Commander♪

battle.line: Things are heating up, I see. I hope you've braced yourselves for the Nachthexe's wrath!

couple_encourage1.line: Have you ever seen a flying machine brimming with witchly powers before?

couple_encourage2.line: Do NOT touch my flying machine! I mean it! It'll curse you!

detail.line: Should the sun, to shine, refuse, the eternal blood moon will rise with you. The witch shall recite a dark incantation. The heavens shall crack from light, wings of destiny shall take flight, then comes the oracle of the dark night – this eve, who shall join me in the sky?

expedition.line: The girls that went on a commission are back. Perhaps they've brought magic components for my Midnight Wings with them?

feeling1.line: You really don't understand the greatness of flying. You'll just have to walk with the rest of the commoners.

feeling2.line: A witch defying gravity knows too well the world of loneliness. Heehee... Keep your eyes out during the night, and you'll see me flying across the face of the blood moon.

feeling3.line: It is my fate as the Nachthexe to soar across the midnight sky. Do you know what that means, Commander? ...Huh? You know just how I feel and what I want? Okay, I understand...

feeling4.line: You said you know how I feel and what I want, so you'll be the one to name my plan for tonight! Indeed, you and I will fly together for the entire night! A-and I really do mean the entire night, so...

feeling5.line: Commander, these are my Wings of the Dark Night. My witchly power is concentrated in them, and they're for you alone. Do you like them? Don't worry – I'll keep you safe. I won't leave your side.

headtouch.line: Can you feel my witchly power? I'm brimming with it!

home.line: Praise to you, Commander. Rest while you can, for we'll soon make haste to the soaring witches' night gathering! ...It'll be a long ride!

hp_warning.line: Urgh... Thank goodness my flying machine is intact...

login.line: Commander, behold this impeccable weather. Even nature's ambient waste dares not show itself... You want to freely soar the skies with me, eh? Hah! Fittingly, I just recharged my flying machine. Wanna go for a ride? I said: Wanna go for a ride?!

lose.line: We were THIS close! I'm SO gonna rain hellfire on them next time!

mail.line: Is this an invitation to the Night of Witches' Flight? Consider it accepted. Off we go!

main1.line: I've run a little short of magic components for the next-generation flying machine I'm working on... Will you come help me look for some tonight, Commander?

main2.line: Ahem. What I have in my hand is the Magical Tome of the Dark Night. It will allow me to seize incredible powers that– Hm? It's a night battle notebook? A-ha! All the more reason to read it.

main3.line: The flight plan for the new Dark Oracle – running on my pure witchly power, of course – is set for midnight! Its official designation shall be... Huh? "Operation: Skyfall"? No! Absolutely not! My powers would never fail and lead to a crash!

main4.line: Seeing as the port has no notable events planned for tonight, it seems the airborne gatherings that I host can continue! I could bring in a rock band for tonight's climax... Ahahaha! I must continue preparing for the flying show!

mission.line: You can't forever gaze at the skies – you need to touch the ground and carry out your missions. Go forth, Commander!

mission_complete.line: Do remember to claim your rewards, alright? Or else I'll take them for my own purposes.

profile.line: I am the Nachthexe, otherwise known as Iron Blood battleship Mecklenburg. Listen to the symphony of boiling blood and madness! To the poem of electric guitars and drums in tandem that pierces the sky! As my witchly power surges, to the lonesome, lofty sky realm shall I ascend!

propose.line: Commander, our souls are drawn to one another... Every night from this day on, I will bring you on a journey through the skies, and I will make the dark night dance for you until morning comes. This is the Nachthexe's everlasting spell.

skill.line: Heehee... See what the Nachthexe is truly capable of!

touch.line: Hm? Do you want to revel in the dark night together?

touch2.line: Heehee... So you've fallen for this witch's charm. Care to experience the joy of falling from the sky as well, hm?

unlock.line: Hmph, so even the famed Commander wishes to be free of the shackles of gravity... D-do you, really? If you acknowledge my abilities, I might very well... lend you this flying machine – blessed with witchly powers.

upgrade.line: My witchly power grows and grows! Tonight, I shall rise with the blood moon!

win_mvp.line: Gaze in awe! Know the Nachthexe's might!

gift_prefer.line: Hmm! I love this! It's perfect for a fun evening!

detail_ex.line: I feel it – all my witchly powers have combined into one! This time for certain, the Night Roamer will take me up to the sky and bring me to the abyss's deepest depths! Commander, will you come with me?

expedition_ex.line: Huh?! The commission team has come back... but how are they flying so high?!

feeling5_ex.line: Imperator – my Commander. I wish to surpass the bounds of current knowledge and keep exploring the endless abyss of the dark night side by side with you. What do you wish to do?

headtouch_ex.line: More and more of your power seeps into me, my Imperator...

home_ex.line: Splendid work, Commander. I'm prepared for tonight's gathering. My potent witchly power will allow us to reach new heights!

login_ex.line: Commander, this next flight will not take ordinary witchly power. It will take the ultimate spell, capable of breaking through the heavens with blazing flames and leading us to the edge of the galaxy... Hm? What's with that look? Do you not believe me?

lose_ex.line: When you use witchly powers, it's inevitable that something won't go the way you hoped...

main5_ex.line: Commander, a more splendiferous world must lie beyond the sky. With the courage given by my witchly power, I swear that I will surpass my limits and reach that world beyond!

main6_ex.line: Ahh, I see you have plans to take over the world, Imperator... Heh, of course I knew it was your work schedule. I merely wanted to have a look.

main7_ex.line: Oh, Commander, what's that on your back? ...A parachute? What for? My power, my flying machine... and I myself will never let you have a reason to use such a thing!

main8_ex.line: The blood moon is in the sky, and the wind howls... What a splendid night. Come, Commander, and join me in a grand carnival!

mail_ex.line: Commander, wanna try a spell that claims your mail for you? Making a device like that wouldn't be too difficult.

mission_ex.line: Imperator! Commander! Pretend these missions are necessary for the soaring witches' night gathering and get them done!

mission_complete_ex.line: You finished a mission, did you, Commander? Hah. Then come and help me infuse my flying machine with power.
