touch_ex.line: Hm? Did the surge of my power stir something within you?

touch2_ex.line: N-never do that while we're in the air! At least wait until we've landed!

upgrade_ex.line: Whoa... My witchly power shall attempt to tear through the skies!

win_mvp_ex.line: Doesn't this power strike fear even in the heart of you, my Imperator? ...I asked you a question! Say something, Commander!

detail.line: Ahem... You are my Imperator alone, and I am your Nachthexe alone. This night together shall deepen our bond.

feeling5.line: By the pact of this brand, you are to grant me the power to fly, Imperator... Not yet? Oh. Well, then let's take this time to "deepen" this bond between us. Soon, it will be time... Heehee♥

headtouch.line: Oh? Do you want my brand more deeply imprinted on you?

home.line: Splendid! You fought well! The power granted by my brand lets you conquer everything, doesn't it?

login.line: Welcome to my shop of refreshments, Imperator. I'm glad you answered my call. Now, let this searing pain leave a mark on your memory!

main1.line: Welcome to my domain! Now come and revel in this pain that gnaws at the soul; in this pleasure that sends you to the heavens!

main2.line: Hm? Why do you have a marker pe– I mean, a Branding Mark? Do you seriously mean to brand me? I'd love to see you try to– W-wait! Not my thigh! It tickles like mad!

main3.line: The whip? Oh, you mean this? Yes, I felt a tremendous power flow into me the moment I took it in hand. I feel an even greater power when I swing it! Go on, you give it a try as well!

mission.line: Go, my Imperator, and realize your duty! Complete your missions before I imprint my brand upon you!

mission_complete.line: You're finished? That was rather quick. Are you that excited to receive my brand?

touch.line: Even if you'd welcome receiving my brand, it's too late to– Huh? You wanted my brand since the very start?

touch2.line: Agh... Why does this pleasure feel like being launched skyward?!

unlock.line: Commander – I mean – Imperator! You've been seeing me far too little as of late, which has left me in a very sour mood. I will punish you by inscribing my seal on your body, so that you'll remember me! Um... How do I do this, again?

upgrade.line: I feel it... Power surges from within my body!

battle.line: You shall all be purged equally!

detail.line: Commander, have you come here to offer your prayers to God?

expedition.line: Commander, my sisters in arms have returned from their commission.

feeling1.line: My sisters in arms here may be righteous, but not you. Prepare to face divine punishment, sinner.

feeling2.line: So this is the land that I was promised... Tell me, will this place be Sodom, or Canaan?

feeling3.line: I see my sisters in arms smile every day as if without a worry in the world. Perhaps this is their Canaan...

feeling4.line: I feel like I have earned the acceptance of the fleet. However, is this truly the land that I was promised? ... No, I do not mean to cast doubt upon anyone. I merely feel that... I may yet have a deeper purpose.

feeling5.line: I finally understand now, Commander. What I experience now is the same as my sisters in arms – nay, perhaps even more fulfilling. Being a part of this fleet, by your side... is truly my Canaan.

headtouch.line: Commander, I do not think this can be considered appropriate conduct...

home.line: Suffering is the brand of a warrior. Everyone, I'm proud of you for making it through.

hp_warning.line: This too... is God's trial...!

login.line: Bonjour, Commander. Please instruct me, what should we do next?

lose.line: My Lord, why have you abandoned me...

mail.line: Commander, does it not matter if these letters remain unopened?

main1.line: Commander, your time should not be squandered here. Leave the chores to me.

main2.line: If there are any disputes within our ranks, allow me to handle the arbitration. That is my specialty.

main3.line: Just winning the battle alone is enough to satisfy me, but you, Commander, ought to look far beyond that.

mission.line: Commander, it may not be the will of God, but you do have new missions issued from headquarters.

mission_complete.line: While rewards may certainly be nice... I have no interest in them.

profile.line: Because ruination befell my homeland, I was returned to nothingness before I was born. As I am now, I am but an illusion, a manifestation of an ideal. But as long as you continue to lead my way, I shall in return clear all obstacles standing before yours.

propose.line: This I do swear. Your joy is my will, your victory is my glory, and the place that I can call home, is by your side... Blessed be the Lord who has brought me together with you – my commander, my love, and... my light.

touch.line: I fight so that there may be peace. That is the single role that I can play.

touch2.line: Commander, your self-respect...

unlock.line: It is an honor to meet you at last - my prophet, my leader. I am Saint Louis, brought to your side by God's will. As long as it is justice that guides your hand, then this humble spear shall be yours to wield.

upgrade.line: For the sake of the role that we all must play...

win_mvp.line: Ashes to ashes, dust to dust...

gift_prefer.line: Thank you.

detail_ex.line: How about a short break? This place is enveloped by a peacefulness that allows the mind to settle... It is perfect for us to spend some quiet time.

feeling5_ex.line: The days I spend with you bring me a satisfaction and a happiness that I have never known before. This... is likely the home that I have been searching for.

headtouch_ex.line: Your hand is enough to quell the turbulence of my heart. Can I ask you to stay like that a while longer?

home_ex.line: The safety of my sisters in arms delights me more than any victory... and your safety, Commander, even more so.

login_ex.line: My sense of duty strengthens whenever you turn to look at me. I hope you will allow me to join you for your plans today.

main4_ex.line: This quiet is unlike that before a battle. Instead, I am reminded of the weight of our vow. But it is far from a burden. It is a comforting weight.

main5_ex.line: What am I reading? Ah, it is a book on gardening... I was considering planting some irises on the veranda.

main6_ex.line: I thought the path I walked would lead me to countless battles, and yet here I am enjoying this peace with you... Oh, what a wonderful reward. It is far more sacred than any victory.

mission_complete_ex.line: I have checked all the rewards. They are useless as far as I am concerned, but I'm happy to see they bring such a contented smile to your face.

touch_ex.line: Your touch reassures me more than any prayer.

touch2_ex.line: Ahem. We cannot let the others witness this...

upgrade_ex.line: I shall use this power to defend our vow.

detail.line: I have no serious objections to sitting up here, but... there is one thing I cannot figure out. Are you perhaps deriving pleasure from seeing me up here like this?

feeling5.line: As a servant of God, there is no need for vanity— Having that said, as the recipient of your love, you are free to make any arrangements that please you. After all, great and permissive is God's love.

home.line: I would much rather wield my spear upon the seas of battle than sit up here like a statue, Commander.

login.line: Commander, making me sit up here waiting for you by myself is a tribulation in its own right.

main1.line: So I've managed to capture your gaze? Your eyes are... Nevermind, it doesn't bother me.

main2.line: My arbitration is needed? ...Very well, please excuse me for a moment. I will make sure to hear them out.

main3.line: As the one guiding this fleet forward... Commander, you are the one best suited to this throne.

touch.line: My weapon is always within reach. Should you will it, I am ready to sortie at any time.

unlock.line: With all due respect, Commander, this finery and this throne are not fit for one such as myself. Despite the hallowed name I have inherited, I am nothing more than a warrior. —However, if such an arrangement pleases you, then I shall hold my objections.

battle.line: Be cleansed in the Iris's light!

detail.line: Let us also give our utmost this coming year, as to not squander the preparations everyone has painstakingly made.

expedition.line: Commander, our comrades-in-arms have returned from their commission. Let us take over their responsibilities so that they may enjoy the Spring Festival.

home.line: God witnesses all your deeds. The trials you endure today will surely bear fruit in the future.

login.line: Bonjour, Commander. Please determine the duty you would like to fulfill first today.

main1.line: The Dragon Empery's Spring Festival... the celebration of a new year seems quintessential to all. Please rest well after completing your work.

main2.line: La Galissonnière... seems to be thoroughly enjoying this holiday. Rather, that girl seems to be able to find enjoyment in just about anything. Quite broad-minded of her.

main3.line: The greatest joy is to be able to have a life of peace. If everyone can act in accordance with God's will, then there would be no need for justicars.

mission.line: Here are today's assignments. Let's work together to finish them quickly.

touch2.line: A-ahem!

unlock.line: Commander, regarding your next appointment... Ah, hard work is one of the highest virtues of the Iris's holy knights. On weekdays or vacations, in knights' armor or the Dragon Empery's attire, there can be no pause to my prayer, my training, or my duties as the administrator of your will.

detail.line: My body may be disobedient at present, but I still wish to conduct myself properly before you... I-I wonder whether I may be forgiven for lying down in such a manner.

feeling5.line: Commander, that smile of yours... is a little different than what I usually see. Is it because you saw me in a less disciplined state? How curious that I do not find the current situation to be all that unpleasant...

headtouch.line: Aaah... Zzz... Mm? Oh, forgive me. It seems I unintentionally let my guard down in your presence.

home.line: Welcome back. I'm relieved to see you return unharmed. Thank you for allowing me this rest in your absence. I am now in perfect condition.

login.line: Is your glass empty, Commander? Worry not. It seems the alcohol is affecting me somewhat... but I won't forget my duty to pour you another drink.

main1.line: The solemn duties of combat and arbitration must not be carried out with vagueness or deceit. And yet, I find myself less disciplined in your presence, Commander... so much so that I can hear my own heart pound...

main2.line: I'm sorry, Commander. Forgive me for being unable to drink with you any longer. Freedom must not be an excuse to indulge. I must keep my wits about me in order to protect you.

main3.line: The lights of this banquet feel much warmer than the flames of the battlefield. You have nothing to fear, Commander. I shall always be able to distinguish your light from any other.

touch.line: Commander... it seems I have made a terrible error.

touch2.line: Am I to take it that you're fond of this flavor, Commander?

unlock.line: ...Commander? When did this happen...? Sorry, I must have misjudged my alcohol tolerance. Don't worry, I shall not let my guard down over something like this... Yesh... I have not let my guard down... at all...

battle.line: All right, let's gang up on 'em!

couple_encourage1.line: Hey, you girls wanna come to my party once we're done here?

couple_encourage2.line: I wanna know more about these Sakura Empire banquets you throw!

detail.line: I've got a party, tea time, girls meetup, and drinking get-together to attend... Okay! My schedule is PACKED! Guess that's not really a bad thing, though!

expedition.line: Yo, commission team's done, Commander. We oughta go give 'em a snack or something!

feeling1.line: Hm? My party? You're not invited, so be a good commander and get back to work.

feeling2.line: Mi amigo, you oughta let up on your jabberwocky mission talky and just live a little sometimes. Listen, I'm throwing a party later, so stop by and have some fun, alright?

feeling3.line: I love throwing parties, but I'm not gonna FORCE anyone to show up to 'em. But I guarantee anyone who does show up is gonna have a heckin' good time, even the super-introverts!

feeling4.line: Glad you finally understand the magic of parties, Commander! That magic being: you can make friends with anyone if you just hang out with them! As an example: me and you are best buds now!

feeling5.line: Hey, we're BFFs, so tell me who's your crush and I'll give you some hot tips~ Heheheh~ ... It's me? Wait, hold up, you serious? Y-y-you really mean it?!

home.line: Fighting's important and all, but you gotta take regular breaks, Commander!

hp_warning.line: C'mon, team, we can do better!

login.line: You eat yet, Commander? If not, would you like me to whip something up real quick?

lose.line: Man, if only we'd brought more firepower~

mail.line: Commander, you've got new mail! Hell, it might be an invite to a party!

main1.line: Hey, Commander... Isn't it kinda lonely with just one secretary? Whaddya say we liven it up and get some more peeps in here?

main2.line: You free once you're done with work today, Commander? Listen, I'm throwing a cool party later! You can drop by any time if you want!

main3.line: I've got zilch combat experience on paper, but with everyone teaching me stuff, I'll catch up in no time!

mission.line: New missions! We need more manpower up in here!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Aren't you gonna celebrate, Commander?

profile.line: Heyoooo! The name's Seattle– Err, I don't technically have a real name, but just call me Seattle! Seriously, don't sweat the small stuff! Anyhow, I was one of the prototypes for the Worcester class, and as an improvement on the Atlanta class, AA is my A-game! Just leave anything with wings to me!

propose.line: Okay, I'm 100% ready for this! Oh, and needless to say, I love you too, Commander! I wouldn't invite you to go drinking if I didn't~ So, back on topic... There's one more thing we gotta do today besides partying – it's go on a date! Dee-ay-tee-ee!

skill.line: Let's get some hype up in this place!

touch.line: Commander, you wanna do some dance practice? You'll rise on the girls' popularity lists if you can dance well!

touch2.line: Listen, if you did that on purpose, then consider my gears grinded!

unlock.line: Sup! You the one who woke me up? Alrighty then~ The name's Seattle! Nice meeting you!

upgrade.line: I feel like I could snipe a mosquito out of the air!

win_mvp.line: Victoryyyy! Let's throw a big party when we get back!

gift_prefer.line: Ooh~ Thank ya very much!

battle.line: Heheh! Let's totally rock this place!

detail.line: I dig how super-refined I look with this violin! It's not just for show though, I've got a little number for you! Check this out!

feeling5.line: As much as I love me a hype party, I totally get the appeal of the occasional formal banquet like this. This way I can have some alone time with my sweetheart, y'know? Oh man, I'm feeling pretty dang drunk right now... Mmhh, shleepy...

login.line: Hey! Welcome to my fabulous party, Commander! We're the life of the party tonight, you and I! Well, kinda.

main1.line: What kind of drink do ya want, Georgia? Ah, an Oxycola sour on the rocks? So the usual, then? You got it!

main2.line: So like, you know parties are a group activity, right? Let's get you away from your drinking-alone corner and out in front of some friends!

main3.line: I spy with my little eye a few peeps who don't party much... Just gimme a few minutes. I'm gonna go hit 'em up!

touch.line: What's your poison, Commander? There's always soft drinks if alcohol's outta your league.

touch2.line: Eek! Hey pal, I think you might be a little tipsy there.

unlock.line: Hey! Great to have you here, Commander! I've gotta ask, whaddya think of my dress? Looking real gorgeous, right? ...Phew, awesome! I was worried my dress didn't look nice and might be dragging down the party mood, that's all!

detail.line: I've gotta show everyone who walks through these doors how passionate the Eagle Union is about our Christmas celebrations!

home.line: All righty, that should about do it for the food preparations.

login.line: Yooo! Awesome! With your help, Commander, we're gonna speed through things twice as fast... no, three times!

main1.line: Georgia, the gingerbread you wanted is ready! There's a little surprise waiting for you!

main2.line: Hmm, let me think, what are we still missing...? Ah! A special Christmas tree that can immediately grab everyone's attention!

main3.line: The holidays give us all a reason to get together and have a good time. As for me, I'm in charge of providing the best venue for that to happen!

touch.line: Pass the salt shaker this way! Thanks!

touch2.line: Commander, now's not the time for that!

unlock.line: Meeeerry Christmas~! Even though the party is about to start, as you can see, I'm still getting ready~ Just gimme a moment, all righty~?

battle.line: Got no choice but to resurface, I guess!

detail.line: I've got a game tournament by noon and barbecue in the evening. Having so much on my schedule makes me a happy gal!

home.line: Recreation is important for your well-being, but someone's still gotta watch over everyone!

login.line: You wanna go for a dive too, Commander? Aight, then I'll be your buddy diver!

main1.line: Come on, Cheshire! Stop messing around and gimme a hand! You too, Georgia! Chop-chop!

main2.line: Bremerton's a real cool gal! You should totally hit her up if you need life advice or if you run into trouble at the party!

main3.line: Boy, I tell ya, I just love the beach! We gotta work extra hard so everyone can have a good time here!

mission.line: New missions are in! Maybe this is thanks to that "magic" thingy L'Opiniâtre talked about?

touch.line: Remember to keep a real tight hold on my hand, Commander!

unlock.line: Supportive sorceress Seattle, comin' in hot! So, something got you down, my good pal? I'm up to talk about whatever's on your mind, but in return, you've gotta come to my party tonight!

battle.line: Who am I up against this time? I hope they're up to the task!

detail.line: It's a good idea to look over your weapons and keep it all working. You want to help?

expedition.line: Commission team's back. Hey, how about we serve them up some Oxy-cola? An officer has to reward her subordinates for a job well done, you know.

feeling1.line: You are unworthy of my power...

feeling2.line: Peaches are great. Tasty and nutritious. Want one, Commander?

feeling3.line: Sorties and battles really get my blood pumping, but every once in a while it's nice to relax.

feeling4.line: Why don't we go on a trip together next time? I think we'd have a lot of fun together.

feeling5.line: So we head out from the Eagle Union... Drop in on the Royal Navy and Iris, then head over to the Dragon Empery... Oh! I was just planning our world tour. Don't tell me you can't go?

headtouch.line: GEORGIA BEEAAAAM! ... Just playing around! Hahaha!

home.line: Yo. Good work out there. Nothing like an ice cold Cola after work, huh?

hp_warning.line: Ack... you scratched my armor?! You'll pay for that!

login.line: Oh, perfect timing. I just finished warming up. Time to exercise? Or sortie?

lose.line: All we can do... is fall back?

mail.line: Commander, mail here for you. Would it be okay if I kept the stamp?

main1.line: I have a dream. A dream where the seas are free of the stink of gunpowder, and all the people of the world live in peace.

main2.line: Cola sure is the best drink, isn't it? Oh, but you can't drink Oxy-cola, Commander...

main3.line: If I had the chance, I'd love to travel all around the world. The Sakura Empire, the Dragon Empery, the Royal Navy... Hmm, some kind of world tour sounds nice, doesn't it?

mission.line: A mission...? If it's a combat mission, we're good to go. Hahaha!

mission_complete.line: A job's not done until a report's submitted. Commander, don't forget to double check everything.

profile.line: I am the Eagle Union Battleship Georgia. My main guns are bigger than those of my distant cousins. Yes indeedy, these guns of mine take all the bad guys in front of me... and blast 'em all to hell!

propose.line: Ahem... I never thought you'd attack me head on, Commander... Well, I guess I'm glad I get my world tour sooner than I expected. Hahaha!

skill.line: The sound of these massive guns is your funeral march!

touch.line: Oooh? You find my guns so appealing, Commander? Enjoy them to your heart's content~

touch2.line: Oooh? Hey Commander, did you want me to use you for target practice...?

unlock.line: I am Georgia from the Eagle Union. Fear not, for my cannons shall bring victory in your name.

upgrade.line: You'll see how strong I am next time I fight.

win_mvp.line: No matter how thick the armor... these guns can pierce it!

gift_prefer.line: Is this for me? Then I graciously accept. Haha, you've got great taste!

detail.line: My dress? Oh, Seattle helped me with it. We all know I couldn't get it looking like this myself...

feeling5.line: I love being with you under the moonlight, Commander... Err, not like that. Unless...? I mean, I could maybe mean it like that... Sorry, I'm making it weird... This is so awkward...

home.line: Commander, the air out here is delightful. Come take a breather.

login.line: It's so much easier to relax when we're alone... Don't you think, Commander?

main1.line: Whew, now this is a fine place to enjoy a cola. You want one, Commander? I brought extra.

main2.line: Don't you have to hurry back to the party, Commander? Lots of girls waiting for you, no?

main3.line: Don't worry about it, Commander. I love the fleet. I'll head back inside in a bit.

touch.line: Woah!! That was close... Thanks, Commander. Getting around in high heels isn't exactly my forte.

unlock.line: Oh? Commander, did you need to get some fresh air as well? Me? Ahaha... It's a bit too stiff inside that venue, so I came out for a change of pace. Why don't we take a little stroll together?

detail.line: Seattle picked out this lace coverup for me. She's good with this kind of thing...

home.line: Ooh, nice work on that sortie. Did you want an ice cream? I still have some here.

login.line: Ooh, you're just in time. Commander, mind helping me set up this parasol?

main1.line: What do you think of my sunglasses? I dig them, personally. Hahaha!

main2.line: Nothing beats an ice cold Oxy Cola on a summer day! Here, take one, Commander... Oh right, you can't drink these. This one's for you.

main3.line: We've still got some summer left, so why not try to plan a "Beach World Tour" for us?

touch.line: Commander, it's really funny watching you try to figure out where it's safe to look. Hahaha!

touch2.line: Ah haah? Commander, you've really gotten into the spirit of the beach now. Maybe I should give you a bit more "stimulation." Like a whooping with this parasol, for instance.

unlock.line: Heh heh, the warm sun and the sea breeze really hit the spot, don't they? Alright, let's get out there and enjoy ourselves! That's what you've been waiting for, right, Commander?

detail.line: The Sakura Empire's tea is good stuff! But I still feel like I want an Oxy-cola sometimes... Huh? It wouldn't look right? I can't help it if I want one.

login.line: And just where are you escorting me today? I'm dying to find out.

main1.line: So this "Momotarou" pops out of a peach! What an amazing little guy!

main2.line: Seattle, I got an invite to this party or something. Any idea for a talent show? It has to be something better than the "Georgia Beam"!

main3.line: Commander, I just finished my new drink - mixing cola with tea! Come on, try it!

touch.line: Ready to be a proper escort?

touch2.line: Hey now, you're going to mess up my outfit.

unlock.line: Happy New Year, Commander! I guess you dress up all flashy like this for the Sakura New Year. Would you escort me...? What are you gawking like that for...? Haha, am I so dazzling? Hahaha!

battle.line: Then today, I fight for the Commander! But let's get it over with quickly...

detail.line: My hair? *sigh*... If it's not messy, then don't worry about it. It's easier to just let it all hang... Hm? Of course... It makes it easier to sleep comfortably.

expedition.line: The commission's completed? Great. I'll wait here for you to come back, so you go welcome them home...

feeling1.line: Don't waste your energy, Commander... Never mind. Do what you want...

feeling2.line: Did you come to wake me up again? Mm... Okay. I'm ready to set sail at... Zzz...

feeling3.line: Commander? The weather is so nice. Just let me lie down a little... Hmm... Or you could join me?

feeling4.line: It's so quiet here in your office... Can I slack off – ahem, stay with you a little longer? If you need me, just wake me up... Hmm? I'm being too obvious? Who cares... Good night...

feeling5.line: How long have you been staring at me now... I can't sleep well if you keep doing that... What? Would I rather sleep alone or with you watching me? That's a hard choice... I do sleep better with you around, though.

headtouch.line: Commander, your hand... Actually, never mind. It's fine there.

home.line: Thanks for all your hard work... Where should we go rest now? My place, or yours?

hp_warning.line: *yaaawn*... I'm getting exhausted...

login.line: *yawn*... Another new day. I'm ready whenever, just say the word... Mind if I take a nap first, though?

lose.line: Oh, okay. So we lost. Gather the fleet and get ready for retreat...

mail.line: Wanna... check your mail? I'll leave it up to you...

main1.line: Mm... If there's no special work to be done, then let's go look at the scenery and find a place to doze... I'll let you pick the place...

main2.line: Commander, you mentioned going to a seminar... Whatever it is, there must be too many people there. I don't think I have the energy for it...

main3.line: I did all your work for you already... Hmm? That was too fast? That just shows how hard I worked... Yep, time for bed.

main4.line: I wasn't slacking off this whole time... I just used up all my energy when you weren't looking. I'm only resting right now... so I can be ready to fight for you...

mission.line: Hmm... Are we assigning tasks now?

mission_complete.line: Missions are done. How about a nap?

profile.line: Union battleship Kansas... Zzz... Oh, I'm not actually sleeping. It's just hard to be energetic... Don't worry. I'm still ready to fight for you.

propose.line: Commander, you wouldn't secretly make such a big decision while I was sleeping, would you? You might not realize it, but I'm always watching you... I promised I'd fight for you any time, so of course I'll stay by your side... Mm... Suddenly, I'm really sleepy. But now, I can sleep next to you all the time...

skill.line: I have awakened. Bring it on!

touch.line: Mm... Ready to fight, just say the word... *yawn*... Oh, you're just touching me? Have at it, then...

touch2.line: Commander, I'm awake right now...

unlock.line: Mmm... Commander? I was just resting my eyes. I didn't think you'd get here so fast... Ahem. I'm battleship Kansas with the Eagle Union, and I'm ready to fight for you any time. By the way... are there any missions I need to fight in today?

upgrade.line: Hmm. Now I can relax in style.

win_mvp.line: Welp, we won. How about we just head back now? There are too many people here... It's not great for my mental health.

gift_prefer.line: Hm? I love everything you pick out for me, of course.

battle_ex.line: With you by my side, we can win faster than ever...!

detail_ex.line: Socializing? No, thanks. You're the only person I feel like talking to, Commander...

expedition_ex.line: Good, the commission was a success... Hurry and go see them, Commander. I'll do my best to be awake when you get back.

feeling5_ex.line: Are you asleep already? Oh, no... Is it because I didn't help enough today? Will I have to lengthen my working hours and learn to take on more duties? Mm... Maybe tomorrow. For now, I'll just... sleep in your arms a little longer...

headtouch_ex.line: *yawn*... Keep petting me, and I really will fall asleep...

home_ex.line: Commander, I'm happy you're home safe. Now, lie in my lap... Isn't that comfy? Let's sleep together now...

login_ex.line: Are you here to wake me up again? Okay, okay, I'll get up... Actually, give me five more minutes...

lose_ex.line: We should retreat... Relax. Everything will be okay.

main5_ex.line: Shopping list? Hmm... Sounds hard. I'll do the next battle plan first... No wait, maybe the next... Oh. All of these have so many decisions to make. I feel my energy draining...

main6_ex.line: You've been staring, Commander... Are you spacing out, or do you want to rest with me? Or... Is this a sign that I should hurry up and fall asleep?

main7_ex.line: Finished with work? Good. We can do the sorting later. How about a nap for now? I'll help when my energy is replenished... It won't take long.

main8_ex.line: Do you want to go out for a walk today? Hm? I can muster the energy if you're around, and it means I get to be with you longer... We can also just sleep together, though, if you want...

mail_ex.line: New mail again? You're so sociable...

mission_ex.line: Missions... Even if you can't motivate yourself to do them now, they'll still be there when you wake up.

mission_complete_ex.line: Finally... You have time to sleep with me.

touch_ex.line: Ready for bed? Then come over here. I can barely keep my eyes open...

touch2_ex.line: Mm... I won't be able to sleep if you keep that up...

upgrade_ex.line: Did it work? Good. Back to bed I go...

win_mvp_ex.line: When I'm fighting for you, I can stay focused and alert for long periods of time.

feeling5.line: With you here, by my side... I'd love to just sleep the night away, but I don't want to take my eyes off of you... Do you feel the same way? Hehe, I guess romantic nights come with their own dilemmas...

headtouch.line: Can we stay together... a little longer?

home.line: *yawn*... Good work. I actually just built up enough energy to come see you. So... Want a drink?

login.line: Mm... When you got here, I woke right up. You're the only person who can make me feel this way...

main1.line: Commander, let me lean on you for a bit. I'm not out of energy, no, it's just... Umm, I like doing it...

main2.line: I can't waste my energy on trivial things. My full power must stay reserved for whenever you demand it.

main3.line: Tonight, I'm at your disposal... What I do and how I do it is all up to you. I won't fall asleep first, I swear...

main4.line: Hmm? You'd like to know our signature cocktails? Well... I'll make them all either way, so why not just order me, instead?

mission.line: Commander, missions just came in... The sooner you finish them, the sooner we can get back to relaxing.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete... Let's relax and enjoy the rest of our night together.

touch.line: Hm? Would you like to order? Or... Do you just want to touch me? Either way is fine.

touch2.line: Hmm... Maybe it's time I unleash my full power. I just hope the energy I have left is enough to satisfy you...

unlock.line: *yawn*... That's enough rest. It's just you and me tonight... Whatever it is that you want from me, I've stored up enough energy to go all the way.

upgrade.line: Phew... I think tonight is going to be a long night.

battle.line: The enemy’s movements... are clear as day! Everyone, follow me!

detail.line: Those who lead upon the battlefield must also carry their own blade... Worry not, this one is not heavy at all.

expedition.line: The commission fleet must have returned with a lot of goodies. Commander, you should take a look.

feeling1.line: Commander, if you continue to squander your talents, then one day...

feeling2.line: Hmm, you’re curious about the little one...? Very well, perhaps I will give you a demonstration when I get the chance.

feeling3.line: My sisters always give me lots of candy whenever they see me. I, I suppose I can share them with you, Commander...

feeling4.line: I’m not... good with the dark. I, Kitakaze, shall slowly follow behind you!

feeling5.line: *yawn*.... I am getting a bit sleepy... and the Commander probably won’t ignore that... Indeed, the Commander would probably carry me back to bed... My intuition is seldom wrong... Hehe...

home.line: Good work, Commander. Please leave the rest of the work to me. I shall not disappoint you.

hp_warning.line: It’s not wise to swim against the current... but we have no choice now!

login.line: Commander, you’ve come. I am currently training this little one. Indeed, I must teach it to stand like a general.

lose.line: Impossible... h-how did I miscalculate...?

mail.line: Let’s check the mail. I have a feeling that something good has happened...!

main1.line: My Akizuki-class sisters have always taken good care of me. I, Kitakaze, swear to meet their expectations, and will work hard to protect everyone.

main2.line: I prefer strategizing and leading from the rear over fighting in the frontlines... B-but I’m perfectly capable of fighting head on.

main3.line: True power comes from the strength of one’s convictions. It would behoove you to not underestimate my abilities!

mission.line: Shape up, Commander. You can’t afford to just leave these missions sitting there.

mission_complete.line: Effort is rewarded in kind. Given how hard you’ve worked, Commander, your rewards won’t be disappointing.

profile.line: Lead ship of the Super Akizuki-class... That is I, Kitakaze. During the war, I was not able to display my prowess upon the battlefield, but it is not too late to do so here. Bear witness to my agility as well as the strengths of my armaments.

propose.line: My mind is at peace whenever I am by your side, Commander... so can I always keep you company? Can we pinky swear on it then? My sisters told me... that this is enough to form a vow with a person of integrity.

skill.line: My single strike shall seal your fate!

touch.line: Being small has its advantages... Heheh. For example, don’t even try to hit me in a game of dodgeball!

touch2.line: Hmm... The responsibility of cleaning up your conduct weighs heavily upon me, but... please cease your crass behavior.

unlock.line: Indeed, the preparations are complete... Now that I, Kitakaze, shall be assisting you with your operational command, you can now sleep more soundly at night, Commander. Heheh!

upgrade.line: Even after gaining power, I, Kitakaze, shall keep a clear head.

win_mvp.line: A single victory is nothing to be proud of. Let us prepare for the next battle.

gift_prefer.line: I graciously accept your kind gesture. Don't worry – I'll repay you.

detail.line: Takoyaki! Grilled squid! ...Mmm... they even have yakisoba! Commander, help me hold onto some of this... Ah! I want that too!

home.line: Archery and goldfish scooping... these activities are nothing before my skills. Commander, I'm pretty awesome, aren't I!

login.line: The little ones are getting restless. Let us make haste, Commander. The festival will not conquer itself.

main1.line: As long as you predict the movements of the goldfish in advance, there is nothing difficult about this game.

main2.line: Since it's a holiday, we can afford to take it easy today... But starting tomorrow, we'll have to redouble our efforts! Got it, Commander?

main3.line: Commander, since you've been kind enough to explore the festival with me, I'll share some of my food with you. Would you like some candied apple? Or how about some taiyaki?

touch.line: Heheh... Did you want to challenge me at one of these game stalls? Very well, bring it on!

unlock.line: All the preparations are now complete... Commander, let us sally forth and conquer these festival grounds! ...But before that, can we get something to eat first?

battle.line: Heheh, behold the elegance with which I run circles around my enemies.

detail.line: Commander, do you wish to assist me in my disappearing act? I, I do not enjoy being in that dark box, alone...

home.line: If you are getting bored backstage, how about playing a game of pop-up pirate with me? Heh heh, Kitakaze does not intend on losing!

login.line: Commander, you've come at just the right time! Want to help me catch all these doves that are flying around? *sigh*... Why did they decide to act up all of a sudden?

lose.line: C-crap... Now everyone will see through my tricks...

main1.line: I am well versed with this magic box! You put a person inside, and then it is totally fine to chop it to pieces! Commander, hop inside and let us give it a try! ...Hm? That's not quite right?

main2.line: Hanazuki, please select one of these cards... Um, these are just regular poker cards, so there's no need to be so nervous...

main3.line: Magic tricks with doves are a dime a dozen. I wonder if there's anything else small enough for me to use in my performance... Oh, I got it! Commander, I'm going to see if Suzutsuki will let me borrow Pooky!

touch.line: Know of any new magic tricks, Commander? Hurry up and tell me!

touch2.line: Wait, hold on! I'm not hiding anything over there! I bet you're doing this on purpose!

unlock.line: Mm, preparations complete. If I keep it up, the production will surely be a great success. The doves have been on their best behavior too. Commander, what do you think about Kitakaze's magic show?

win_mvp.line: Very well! Let us celebrate by pulling some party poppers!

battle.line: I am to lead the fleet...? I shall not make any promises, but... I will do what I can!

couple_encourage1.line: Miss Deutschland, if you wouldn't mind showing a bit of humility...

couple_encourage2.line: I still can't compare with you, Kongou.

couple_encourage3.line: Kitakaze, don't get lost now, okay?

detail.line: I need more experience if I'm to keep up with the others... So please give me something to do. Hehehe.

expedition.line: The girls you sent out on commission have returned. Would you like me to inspect the rewards for you? Commander?

feeling1.line: Commander, I'm worried about you... You can do better, can't you?

feeling2.line: I still have trouble finding my way around... Pardon me, Commander, do you think you could find time to accompany me on my patrols...?

feeling3.line: I'd like to get to know the other Sakura girls, and the others besides. What do you think of holding a mixer...? I could provide... the refreshments! Hehehe.

feeling4.line: You know what, Commander? The most delightful thing in the world is a happy smile... All the smiles, and of course your smile, Commander, I will protect them all.

feeling5.line: Commander, are you tired? Hehehe. Then come here and lie down. Let Azuma clean your ears... Hmm, after a shoulder massage, I think.

home.line: Welcome home. Commander, I have tea, snacks... and a massage chair here for you. Why not take a load off?

hp_warning.line: A little wound like this, it's nothing...!

login.line: Shall we begin the day's work? Do not worry, I will be right here with you the whole time.

lose.line: We lost... How will I tell the Commander...?

mail.line: I got the mail. Please look it over.

main1.line: This defense power will definitely be useful in battle!

main2.line: My guns are very precise...? Thank you for saying so. I think it's more the result of training than any natural talent. Hehehe.

main3.line: Commander, is there something you would like from me?

mission.line: Is it a very difficult mission? I can help.

mission_complete.line: So many mission rewards... Commander, you're fantastic.

profile.line: I am Large Cruiser Azuma. I was designed to lead torpedo squadrons into night battles, but I never saw any actual combat. I'm quite good at commanding night battles, but torpedoes are another story... Ahahaha...

propose.line: Now that I understand your feelings, Commander, I will offer you all that I am, body and soul... Phew... Saying that out loud is as embarrassing as I thought it would be. Hehehe.

touch.line: Oh? You want to touch me? Or would you like me to touch you? You'll have to come out and say it.

touch2.line: Commander? There's a time and a place...

unlock.line: Large cruiser, Azuma, reporting for duty. As a special prototype ship, there are many things that I am still unfamiliar with... However, I will lay down my life to protect you, Commander. It would please me greatly if you would place your trust in me. Hehe~

upgrade.line: Hehe, that's it~

win_mvp.line: This was the result of everyone's hard work. I was merely part of the team.

gift_prefer.line: Getting such a nice gift from you has put a big smile on my face. Hehehe...

detail.line: E-even if it's for a picture, holding this pose all this time is not easy...

feeling5.line: Are you tired, Commander? Hehe, with all this carousing it's only natural that you'd get worn out. Now then, rest your head on Azuma's bosom for a while.

home.line: Commander, would you mind giving me a moment of your time? Only for a little bit. I'd just like to know what it feels like to monopolize you for a while... Hehehe, I'm only joking.

login.line: Commander, the Spring Festival is a busy, exciting time. But do take care not to catch a cold when you're out having fun.

main1.line: I understand these "Tangyuan" soup balls have some association with "unity" or "gathering" in the language of the Dragon Empery, but if I eat the tangyuan, doesn't that mean I've broken the unity?

main2.line: Our friends are drawing that "Fu" character everywhere, so I went ahead and tried my hand. I think I did alright... Ahahaha...

main3.line: Do you need help with the decorations in your office? I'd like to give decorating a try.

touch.line: Having you here, Commander, makes me feel at ease.

touch2.line: Don't do that! At least, don't do it right now...!

unlock.line: Commander? Oh, I haven't quite finished changing. My hair still needs work... Sorry, would you mind waiting a bit longer?

detail.line: You want me to try scolding you...? Okay... Ahem. Commander, you've seen something you shouldn't have. Go ahead and fess up – what was it? Oh... Did I misunderstand what you wanted?

feeling5.line: Hmm... It just feels off to be your guidance counselor. You're our Commander, after all, but maybe if you played a different role... Aha! Heheh, it isn't quite an occupation, but what if you role-played as... my groom?

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. What do you want to do, who do you want to be? Tell me with your words... or your body...

login.line: Have you submitted all of your documents? If anything is missing, I'll help you revise them. Just the two of us...

main1.line: I can't imagine you getting tutored. Maybe tutoring others... But I wouldn't be here in that scenario, would I?

main2.line: You're the reason that the port is so undisciplined, you know. Do you understand that? Heehee!

main3.line: Here you go... You like getting stepped on a little in your role-play, don't you? Ah, so I still need to improve my skills... Hm? You think I don't need to learn that?

mission.line: Are you having trouble with your missions? Heehee, don't be shy. Tell me all about it.

touch.line: That was a sign that you want to be touched, wasn't it?

touch2.line: Let's see, is there anyone outside... Phew, okay. Come on, Commander~ There's nobody around but us♡

unlock.line: Graduation is approaching, and that means it's time for career counseling. Do you want to be a great general who wins with impossible tactics, or a leader beloved by all the port? Which will it be, Commander? Or... Heehee, I already know your plan.

win_mvp.line: You really are a star pupil, Commander. Heehee!

detail.line: I learned some new cooking techniques from Hiei today. Commander, do look forward to tomorrow's lunch. Hehe~

feeling5.line: For me, happiness means spending our days together, taking each day slowly, one step at a time... Of course I'm quite happy right now~ How about you, Commander? Does having me by your side... make you happy as well?

home.line: You must be tired from your sortie. Please sit down and allow me to massage your shoulders. Mm, is this pressure to your liking?

login.line: Welcome back, Commander. Be at ease, for I will always remain by your side~

main1.line: Though I am rather confident about my sturdiness, I'll proceed cautiously so that you won't have to worry about me.

main2.line: Commander, please have some tea! Haha, this is something I've learned after hours of practice with Kongou~

main3.line: Please look after me, through both fair weather and harsh storms. I will always remain at your side and heed your every call~

touch.line: Now then, if you've had your fun, I do believe it's now my turn? Hehe, just kidding~

touch2.line: Commander, you're quite the flirt.... *blushes*

unlock.line: I must be dreaming, to be able to don this white veil... Haha, though, what's more important is our life together afterwards! Commander, please look forward to the rich fruit of my bridal training~

battle.line: Let us play a requiem! Resound, o hatred, fear, and despair—!

couple_encourage1.line: You should let me pamper you once in a while.

couple_encourage2.line: Perhaps you're unable to display your full power with me in charge?

detail.line: My child, if you desire absolute victory, you must maintain absolute rationality.

expedition.line: We must properly praise the girls who have returned from their commissions.

feeling1.line: I wonder if you’re properly repenting yet...?

feeling2.line: I never should have come to exist in this world... But since I am here, there must be a higher principle behind it...

feeling3.line: Things such as courage have no value on the battlefield. Only those who approach Laplace’s demon shall approach victory.

feeling4.line: I do prefer this to fighting. Here, my child. Open your mouth~ ahhn~

feeling5.line: Please dote upon me more. Yes, more... more...!

headtouch.line: Trying to get my attention, my child? Heehee.

home.line: Welcome back. Whether it’s good news or bad news, I’d be glad to hear you out.

hp_warning.line: I shall persevere yet.

login.line: The performers can wait no longer! Hurry, let us raise the curtains of battle!

lose.line: Please await our next performance...

mail.line: Shall I sing the contents of this message for you?

main1.line: All those emotions that you’ve bottled up through all those conflicts... Listen to my concert, and let it all out.

main2.line: My appearance upon the battlefield gives off an air of cruelty? Hehe... I’ll take that as a compliment.

main3.line: Even should you anger me, I’ll forgive you as long as you properly apologize.

mission.line: My child, no matter what it is that you desire, I can help you obtain it.

mission_complete.line: Now then, what kind of reward would you like?

profile.line: I am Friedrich der Große, prototype H-class battleship of the Iron Blood Navy. Come, my child... If you are unable to sleep, allow me to play you a lullaby.

propose.line: From now on, I shall share everything with you - your sorrow, your joy, your pain, and your pleasure. My child, I will always, always welcome you into my embrace...

touch.line: If you are ever afraid, come hide behind my back.

touch2.line: Just like a baby... how sweet.

unlock.line: You've returned to my side once more, my child. Tell me, what is it that you wish for? Wealth? Glory? Or perhaps eternal youth?

upgrade.line: I feel as if I can bring out even more beautiful music.

win_mvp.line: What a pity. The encore had only just begun...

gift_prefer.line: I like this.

feeling5_ex.line: Is this enough to satisfy you? Heehee, I thought not... Share with me all of your little whims and desires. My bosom welcomes all of them...

home_ex.line: Flowers, music, and an embrace... Does this triumph satisfy you, my child?

login_ex.line: Let's begin the prelude to this new day together.

main4_ex.line: In great music, logic and passion must complement one another... Which part do you prefer, my sweet child?

main5_ex.line: Be more self-indulgent with me, if you'd like. I save rage for my enemies alone.

main6_ex.line: Wealth and youth are both enticing, yes, but they are both fleeting, if elegant, illusions... My child, you are my one and only priceless treasure.

touch_ex.line: What troubles you, my child? Do you need some love?

touch2_ex.line: Heehee... You're getting better at this. You pluck exactly the right strings to bring me pleasure...

battle.line: Turn into nothingness, along with the symphony of the void!

detail.line: Mankind's ambitions know no limits. Indeed, just like these riggings of mine... they strive to expand, to become more powerful... to command more cannons, and to seize greater glory...

headtouch.line: Shouldn't I be the one doing this to you instead, my child?

home.line: Welcome back. I've prepared a beverage for you. Come warm yourself as I read the report to you.

login.line: Aren't you cold standing over there? Come to me, my child.

main1.line: Sakura Empire's classical "gagaku" is said to elicit profound and mysterious emotions... I'm quite curious about it.

main2.line: The release of repressed emotions can be both medicine and poison. The effect depends on how well you can control your state of being.

main3.line: My child, could you help me with putting on this outfit?

touch.line: The sensation of this embrace is the warmth of human contact... Do you understand, my child?

touch2.line: Do you like it here, my child? Hehehe~

unlock.line: I see, so this is a "kimono" from the Sakura Empire. Exquisitely crafted, comfortable to the touch, and elegantly designed... How to wear it? ...My child, what are you talking about?

feeling5.line: Hmm? You want another? ...Say it outright, and put your desires in the open. I'll give you everything you want, and more.

headtouch.line: You really like this hairstyle, don't you, my child?

home.line: You look tired. Come, come. Lie down with me and rest.

login.line: Heehee... Will you come and visit me every night until the end of summer, my dear child?

main1.line: Do you want cherries? ...Heehee, I'm so glad you're honest, my child. As a reward... I'll feed you, just like this.

main2.line: Don't be afraid of spoiling my mood or angering me. Just tell me what you desire – it's my duty to satisfy that.

main3.line: Sometimes, it's good to give our rational mind a break. My only desire... is to pamper you in my arms on this beautiful summer night, my child.

touch.line: Do you wish to feel my warmth? But of course, my dear child.

touch2.line: Heehee... It's my job to sate your intellectual thirst...

unlock.line: Welcome, my child. What do you desire tonight? That which ripples in my cup? This sweet, red fruit? Or to sate the desires sleeping deep, deep in your heart?

detail.line: How soft and delicate this silk lingerie is... Heehee. If you like it, then feel it for yourself, my child.

feeling5.line: What do I wish for? Simply for my sweet child to live a happy and fulfilling life, where in my arms, all of your dreams come true... Heehee. I think you've helped me realize my wish.

headtouch.line: Your reward isn't here, heehee...

home.line: Welcome back, my child. Soon, you will have your own red envelope... Go on. Reach out your hand, if you dare.

login.line: I hear cheery music playing outside... Hehe, come, my child. Let's share in the mirth together.

main1.line: What's in the envelope? One could say... it's your deepest, most heartfelt desire.

main2.line: Do you like the decorations tonight? Hehe, then isn't there something you should say? Something other than "thank you," of course.

main3.line: Ah... Let's play a beautiful serenade together on this night, my child.

touch.line: You'd like to savor the process of being rewarded this time? Heehee, fine by me...

touch2.line: Yes, that's the spot... Let us celebrate your growth together, my sweet child.

unlock.line: I've heard that in the Dragon Empery, it is customary to give out red envelopes on special occasions... Come hither, my child. Allow me to give you a special gift for this priceless moment—

detail.line: Ah... Even knowing what great accomplishments you've achieved, you're still my dear, sweet child. I'll happily spoil you any time you like...

feeling5.line: My love for you is boundless, and it only grows with each passing day. My child, if you have any requests, speak – I am all too eager to please.

headtouch.line: Is my hair a mess, my child?

home.line: I'd like to sing you a lullaby, but you're still full of energy. For now, I suppose I should satisfy that ambition of yours...

login.line: What will you explore today, my child? And how will you put it into practice?

main1.line: Once you're inside, you are to strip. If you feel the cold, then come snuggle in my arms... Here is the warmest of ports for you, my child.

main2.line: I'll follow your pace and lead you along the way...

main3.line: Only by maintaining rationality in moments of deep desire can we truly attain bliss. Immerse yourself in my teachings, my child.

touch.line: You're doing well, but you're capable of more.

touch2.line: Mm... Not bad, my child...

unlock.line: My child, I am honored to have guided you through this long night, leading you to greater maturity. Now, come and savor this eve's fruits until dawn comes, as a gift for your profound growth...

detail.line: What I hope to get from you? Hehe... For me, the most important thing in the world... what I hope for the most - is you, my child.

feeling5.line: My child, I will accept you unconditionally, and lay low anything that attempts to stand in your way. Come, allow me to pamper you more. Yes, more... more... give me more...

home.line: You can leave the report for later. Let me see your face, my child... Hehe, there's nothing amiss... Is there anything you'd like to talk to me about, my child?

login.line: What would you like to listen to today, my child?

main1.line: Is there something giving you difficulty? Please tell me about it. I shall take care of everything for you.

main2.line: Save your cold rationality for your enemies on the battlefield. Before me, however, you need not hold back. Just indulge yourself to your heart's desire, my child.

main3.line: If you are tired, lie down right here... I will bring you pleasant dreams... Good, sweet child... I'll always be watching over you.

touch.line: Do you wish to touch your beloved more intimately? Come closer, my dear child.

touch2.line: What a selfish child... But no matter, I shall accept you unconditionally.

unlock.line: Ahh, the dreamlike beauty of this variation... let us write down this movement so that it may continue forever, my sweet child.

battle.line: Targets identified. Commencing destruction.

detail.line: Analyzing armaments... Condition: satisfactory. Gascogne is able to execute orders.

expedition.line: Attention: confirmation required for commission team's return.

feeling1.line: Gascogne is a weapon and a warship. No other definitions are applicable.

feeling2.line: Numerous requests for Gascogne's participation in activities without strategic significance received from members of the fleet. Requesting Master's assessment.

feeling3.line: Phenomena known as "emotions" and "impulses" occur when interacting with members of the fleet. Requesting instructions for achieving satisfactory interaction.

feeling4.line: "Emotions" generated from physical contact were analyzed and interpreted as "comfort" and "happiness." Concluding that this holds strategic significance if this is Master's intention.

feeling5.line: Phenomena known as "worries" and "hopes" were observed and successfully classified during routine "emotion" cache analysis. System can be updated with permissions to access and act upon "emotions" if Master so wishes. Thank you, Master.

home.line: A glass of armagnac has been prepared.

hp_warning.line: Combat execution systems failing, requesting support.

login.line: Identification complete. Welcome back, Master.

lose.line: Failure is intolerable. Proposal: improve Gascogne's capabilities, or terminate system.

mail.line: Attention: confirmation required for new mail.

main1.line: "Raise the corners of your lips"... Unable to determine significance of said action.

main2.line: Analysis complete. Master identified to be in a state of "slacking off." State evaluated as an impediment to productivity.

main3.line: "Do whatever you want"... Analysis of strategic significance of order deemed impossible.

main4.line: Discrepancy detected in the frequency of "smiles" recorded between members of the fleet, Gascogne's recollection, and expression identification database.

mission.line: Attention: confirmation required for incomplete missions.

mission_complete.line: Attention: confirmation required for mission rewards.

profile.line: Gascogne, Richelieu-class battleship number 4, construction canceled due to wartime conditions. Purpose: engage in battle and destroy Master's enemies.

propose.line: I now understand the emotion known as love. It is the throbbing of one's heart; the gratitude, longing, warmth, and light one feels for a person who does not seek recompense. This ring is the greatest gift I could ask for. I love you, Master.

skill.line: Armaments activated. Engaging at maximum output.

touch.line: Awaiting Master's orders.

touch2.line: Body temperature abnormality detected. Requesting thorough physical examination.

unlock.line: Gascogne activation process complete. Directive assigned: secure liberty and victory for Master. Gascogne commencing active service.

upgrade.line: Ability enhancements... Confirmed.

win_mvp.line: Report: destruction of targets confirmed. Combat mission complete.

gift_prefer.line: Positive effect on current functions confirmed.

detail_ex.line: Analyzing armaments... Condition: satisfactory. Please inform me if you have any orders, Master.

expedition_ex.line: Attention: confirmation required for commission team's return. Whew...

feeling5_ex.line: I've studied many emotions, worries, and hopes during my time in this fleet... Now I finally understand what you expect of me, Master. Thank you so, so much, Master...

home_ex.line: Here is a glass of armagnac, if you'd like.

login_ex.line: Identification complete. Welcome back, Master!

main1_ex.line: "Raise the corners of your lips"... Executing order. L-like this...? I may be doing it wrong...

main2_ex.line: Analysis complete. Master is in a state of "slacking off." Slacking off is not good.

main3_ex.line: "Do whatever you want"... Master, how am I meant to do "whatever"...?

main4_ex.line: Discrepancy detected between the information in my core and the members of the fleet. Why does everyone smile?

mail_ex.line: Attention: confirmation required for new mail. A-ahem!

mission_ex.line: Attention: confirmation required for incomplete missions. Master...?

mission_complete_ex.line: Attention: confirmation required for mission rewards. Wow...!

touch_ex.line: I'm waiting for any order you may have, Master.

touch2_ex.line: Body temperature abnormality detected. Master, what's happening to me...?

upgrade_ex.line: Ability enhancements confirmed... Nice!

detail.line: Permission to inspect Gascogne granted.

home.line: Gascogne has procured water and energizing edibles. Requesting confirmation of Master's need of aforementioned items.

login.line: Welcome back, Master. Gascogne is currently executing routine database definition update of the phrase "doing whatever."

main1.line: Analyzed and compared wind speeds, temperature, and weather readings with mean values of previously recorded data. Assessment: navigation at sea is unaffected.

main2.line: Contact with unharmful lifeform detected. Requesting instructions for satisfactory interaction.

main3.line: "Let's go for a swim" – Instructions received. Need for swim ring detected. ...Assertion that swim ring is "unnecessary" to swim contradicts existing information in database.

touch.line: Unable to determine strategic purpose of Master's gaze.

touch2.line: Master, Gascogne has detected body temperature abnormality during self-diagnosis operation.

unlock.line: Gascogne uniform change complete. Directive assigned: have fun on the beach with Master. Requesting detailed instructions for how to "have fun on the beach."

detail_ex.line: Permission to inspect me...? R-right now...?

home_ex.line: I have prepared us some water and food... Would you like some, Master?

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Master. I'm attempting to do "whatever I want"...

main1_ex.line: The summer winds... Master, is this what "relaxation" feels like...?

main2_ex.line: This crab seems to be saying "hello, I'm a crab!" ...Does what I said work as a "joke"?

main3_ex.line: "Let's go for a swim" – I'll go get a swimg ring... Master, are you sure I "don't need one"?

touch_ex.line: Your gaze makes me feel odd, Master...

touch2_ex.line: I'm sorry, Master... My body feels strangely warm...

unlock_ex.line: Gascogne uniform change complete. Directive assigned: have fun on the beach with Master. Master, what things do you do to "have fun on the beach"...?

detail.line: Gascogne's is in excellent condition. At the current pace, an estimated 135 hours of additional locomotion may be performed. Master, you need only give the order when you wish to rest. Do not worry about Gascogne.

home.line: Need for hydration and elegance of travel confirmed. Master, please have some sake.

login.line: Master, requesting directions for new destination. If navigation is necessary, Gascogne can gather data in advance and plan a suitable route.

main1.line: From the expression "traveling is better with company," it was deemed necessary to fill the roles of scout, guard, and data logger. Detecting... a slight difference in Master's interpretation of the phrase.

main2.line: Hypothesis: This clothing prepared for Gascogne puts greater emphasis on form than mobility. Master, do you similarly desire Gascogne's appearance over function?

main3.line: Assessment: The act of providing food to the fish in the pond is deemed meaningful in terms of "enjoyment." Master, ahh. Standing by for you to provide food to Gascogne... No?

touch.line: Do you require Gascogne's navigation, Master?

touch2.line: Abnormal increase in body temperature detected... Cause: clothing trapping too much heat?

unlock.line: Mode change to "traveling with Master" complete. Travel navigation verified. Master, requesting new destination or observation target.

home_ex.line: Something to rehydrate with and enjoy the charm of the journey by... Master, would you like some sake?

login_ex.line: Master, where are we heading now? If you need guidance, I can go gather data and propose an optimal route.

main1_ex.line: It's said that "traveling is better with company." Am I doing a good job as your scout, escort, and memory-keeper on this trip?

main2_ex.line: My outfit focuses more on looking pretty than being easy to move in, right? Is that because you... want me to look pretty, Master?

main3_ex.line: Feeding the fish in the pond is... pretty fun, I think. Master, ahh. Y-yeah. I want to be fed, too... Are these two things that different?

touch_ex.line: Master, can I guide you?

touch2_ex.line: Abnormal increase in body temperature detected... I-is it because of my thick clothes?

battle.line: What'll it be for dinner today? A plate of torpedoes, or a bowl of cannonfire?

couple_encourage1.line: Don't try too hard, or you'll put people off!

couple_encourage2.line: Yaaay! Can I floof you, please?

couple_encourage3.line: Yaaay! Victory is mine!

couple_encourage4.line: I wanna learn more about being a maid!

couple_encourage5.line: Yaaay! It's time to partyyyy!

detail.line: The reason I adore you is because animals take the first person they see to be their lover... Uhh, I mean, their parent! Not that that's got to do with anything! You're my owner just because, and I love you just because! It's as simple as that!

expedition.line: A commission team's back! Let's head over there and give 'em something to play with!

feeling1.line: Hrmph... Why'd the first love of my life have to be such a disappointment?

feeling2.line: Where've you been, Owner? If you went to do fun stuff without inviting me then I'm gonna be a pouty tabby!

feeling3.line: Hey, Owner! I was playing with this Sakura Empire girl earlier, and I got to touch her cat ears! REAL cat ears! Aren't you jealous? ...What? You did that ages ago? Hrmph, well there goes my brief moment of triumph!

feeling4.line: Is there a chance you'll get fed up with my displays of affection, Owner? If so, I need to double down to make sure that never happens! Lemme give you a hug~♡

feeling5.line: If it weren't for you, I'd never have materialized in this incredible world, never made so many adorable friends, and worst of all, I never would have gotten to experience being in love with you, Owner! You're just perfect, y'know that~? Cuddly wuddly~ I love you so, so much~♡

headtouch.line: My kitty ears are a detachable hair accessory! You try 'em on too, Owner! Just for a quick moment, please, c'mon!

home.line: Weeelcome back, Owner! Are you okay? Gave the baddies a good beating? Didn't develop a crush on anyone else? Alrighty, then everything's all good!

hp_warning.line: Meowch! It hurts, but I'm not about to let my owner down!

login.line: Owneeeeer! Glomp! Squeeze! Cuddle! Sniff! What, I'm "overenthusiastic?" Well, that's just how excited I get when I see you, Owner~♡

lose.line: Why don't we slink away before they notice?

mail.line: The mail's here! I wanna see what's inside! Pretty pleaseeee?

main1.line: Hey, Owner, know any funny stories about the Royal Navy? Or any other faction, that's fine! I wanna learn stuff!

main2.line: I'm not a cat, okay? I might be as cuddly as a kitten, but I'm not an actual cat!

main3.line: Oh, Master, would you care for some tea~? Hehehe, that was my Royal Maid impression! How was it, Owner?

mission.line: There's no mission we can't accomplish with our combined pawers, Owner!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Don't you think these tasks are a little too easy for us?

profile.line: I'm Cheshire, a heavy cruiser from the Royal Navy! Until I met you, I was just a stray in the sea of people's imagination! Which is to say, both my body and soul belong to you, Owner! Squeeeze~♡

propose.line: Now that you've made it clear how precious I am to you, I need to respond by saying, "I love you, Owner!" a hundred times or more! Starting right now! Stay right where you are until I'm finished! Here we go! I love you, Owner!!!

touch.line: Ahah~♡ What is it, Owner? Come on, I know you want something just from looking at your face~

touch2.line: No more surprise touchies! At least tell me when you're gonna do it!

unlock.line: Meeeoooow! I haven't slept like that in forever! Hrm? Are you the one who woke me from my sleep? Woohoo, that makes you my owner! "Why?" Because I've totally fallen for you, duh!

upgrade.line: Thank you, Owner!

win_mvp.line: We won! See that, Owner? We wooooon! Meoww~!

gift_prefer.line: Yaaay! How'd you know I wanted this so badly, Owner?

feeling5_ex.line: Oh, Owner~! Anywhere you wanna go today? Anything particular you want for dinner? Maybe there's something you wanna say? Ask me, and I'll tell you: I wanna go wherever you're going, I wanna have dinner with and most importantly, I love you, Owner~♡

headtouch_ex.line: I got my hands on a new set of ears! Try 'em on for size, Owner! Aww, don't be like that! You'd look adorable in them!

home_ex.line: Weeelcome back, Owner! Are you okay? Did you have any lovey-dovey thoughts about me? Don't be shy to say it, I want to know!

login_ex.line: Owneeeeeer! Glomp! Squeeze! Cuddle! Sniff! Alright, that should do it for now! Cuddling you has become a part of my daily routine at this point♡

main2_ex.line: Me, spacing out? Nuh-uh! ...Well, I guess I do sometimes when I think about you, my perfect Owner~♡

main3_ex.line: Do you want tea or some juice, Owner? I personally like the orange juice they sell in vending machines! ...H-hey, just because I like premade stuff doesn't mean I'm lazy!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete! Total walk in the park for the two of us!

touch2_ex.line: Owneeeer! Hm? No, I didn't need anything, why? Can't I just touch you outta nowhere if I feel like it?

detail.line: Don't think I didn't notice you earlier, Owner! You left to play with someone while I wasn't looking, didn't you? Not that I mind, really! But you could've at least let me known first!

home.line: Wow, there are so many cuties here besides me! But, heheh, I'm the top cat when it comes to being cute and sexy! Isn't that right, Owner?

login.line: Are you feeling good, Owner? Yay, then it's time to start our seaside date!

main1.line: There's only one reclining chair? So what~ We'll just share it, silly Owner~ I'm pawsitively fine with doing it that way♡

main2.line: I'm all thirsty! Time to chuggy-chug a nice, cool drink! ...Mmhh! I feel like a new person!

main3.line: Fishing? Nuh-uh, I don't wanna. Time spent fishing could be time spent playing games with you, Owner!

touch.line: Need to lie down, Owner? Okey-dokey! Which headrest do you want: my thighs, or my soft tummy? Hehehe♡

unlock.line: Cheer up, Owner! Jeez, why are you so bummed out when we're at the beach... Because it's just a normal playdate instead of a romantic date? What's the difference anyway? C'mon, let's go head down to where the others are~!

detail.line: Welcome, welcome, Owner~ If you've got any requests, don't be shy, don't hesitate, I'll try my best and sing a song that's really great~♡

expedition.line: The girls just came back from that commission! I wonder if Drake was with them?

home.line: Hey Owner, what do you think of everyone's dresses? Are there any outfits you want to see me in? ...I look gorgeous in my current one? Squeeee! I love you, Owneeeeer~♡

login.line: Owneeeeeer! ...Oopsies, that was improper of me! I'm dressed like a refined Dragon Empery lady, so I need to act the part!

main1.line: My beloved Owner~♡ Squeeze, cuddle, sniiiiff~ I love being with you so much~♡

main2.line: Sexy cleavage, trendy fashion, and obligatory kitty ears: the perfect package of cuteness~ How do you like it, Owner?

main3.line: Relax and get cozy, Owner~ Now's not the time for work, it's time to hang out with me!

mission_complete.line: Mission complete! Let's claim those rewards right meow, Owner~

touch.line: Is there something I can do for you, Owner?

touch2.line: I'm always okay with getting intimate with you, Owner~

unlock.line: I'll sing a song for you, Owner~ Ahem... Wait, I'm not sure I know any Dragon Empery songs, actually...

win_mvp.line: Nicely commanded, Owner!

detail.line: If I were a princess, I bet you'd come to my house, sat atop a white horse and ready to pick me up~ Right, Owner?

home.line: Owner, could you lift my dress's train for me? It'll drag along the ground otherwise... Aww, thank you~♪

login.line: We'd better get going soon, Owner! My horse here is starting to get restless~

main1.line: Think we'll meet any magical creatures out in this forest, Owner? You know... Like fairies? I once read a nursery tale about those!

main2.line: Owner! Lookie! I found a twelve-sided snowflake! Aww, it melted...

main3.line: Offer you my hand...? I don't get it. I'm happy just to take your hand and cuddle like we always do! Rubrub~ Squeeze~

touch.line: Myeh-heh♪ Your eyes are just glued to me, aren't they, Owner? Ahem... "You may feast your eyes; gaze all you wish"~♪

touch2.line: You're silly, Owner~ You know what I think about surprise touchies~

unlock.line: "Owner~ I've come to take you to the ball~" ...That's exactly what you were going to do? Eh, doesn't matter who does it~ All that matters is we'll be there together~♪

battle.line: I'll pull a shell out of this hat and it's gonna hurt for you!

detail.line: Owner! Did you know rabbits will get sick if they're lonely? I might not be a rabbit, but I also hate being lonely! So to keep your favourite Cheshire happy, you'll need to give her a steady supply of hugs!

expedition.line: The commission team is back? I hope they brought the souvenirs I ordered for you!

feeling5.line: Owner, is there anything you wish for? I can make it happen with my magic! Hm? You just wanna be with me forever? Oh gosh! An unexpected profession of love! You know, you don't need to wish for that – I'll make it come true either way! That's just what you do when you love someone more than anyone else in the whole world!

headtouch.line: Owner, my hat's gonna fall off if you keep headpatting me! There are other places you can touch me, you know!

home.line: Way to go, Owner! Do you wanna see me do a little hopping dance? Or maybe a magic trick instead?

hp_warning.line: Owie... Maybe my doves will be of some use to you, Owner?

login.line: Owneeer! Squeee! Cuddle! Fluff! Sniff! Hey, how does it feel to hug me? I bet it feels even better than usual!

mail.line: I used a magic trick to hide your letter inside this card! Ahaha, I'm just joking with you!

main1.line: Are you tired after the party, Owner? You should lie down next to me! And rest your head on my thighs!

main2.line: Watch closely, Owner! I'm going to perform a stunning magic trick! Tadah! I made a Cheshire appear, and she really loves her Owner!

main3.line: Here comes a trick that reveals how much I love you! Abracadabra... Did you see that? It said I love you as much as physically possible!

main4.line: Owner, stick your hand in my hat! Hm? You feel something soft inside? I'm sure that's just the rabbit in my hat♡

mission.line: Owner, you still have missions to do! Are there any that Cheshire the Magician can help with?

mission_complete.line: After you've claimed those mission rewards, do you wanna go watch the fireworks with me?

touch.line: Owneeer! Hm? Why are you blushing all of a sudden? Has that spark inside you rekindled, hmm?

touch2.line: Oh, Owner. I know exactly what's going through your head! And I'm perfectly fine with it♡

unlock.line: Owneeer! Lookie! You'll be spending the night with a magician – me! What's the matter? Are you already head over paws for my new look? Don't think I didn't notice how you can't take your eyes off me!

upgrade.line: I learned a new magic trick! I'll show it to you later!

win_mvp.line: Mission complete! Owner, did you like my fireworks?

detail.line: Oh no! It's sooo windy! Owner, hold on to me tightly or else the wind will pick me up and blow me away!

feeling5.line: From now on, you're going to share your smiles, your worries, and everything else with me! My heart has belonged to you since the moment I was born! I love you so much, Owner!

headtouch.line: Hey, Owner! Look at my cat-eared veil! It's sooo cute!

home.line: Owner, if you won't come over to me, I'll come and jump straight into your arms instead! You have three seconds! Three, two... I can't wait any longer! Get ready to catch me!

login.line: Owneeer! Come to me! I've been waiting for this moment for so, soo long!

main1.line: Owneeer! Don't I look like I came right out of a painting? I'm just like a princess out of a fairy tale!

main2.line: I want your full attention for the rest of the day, Owner!

main3.line: I'm so happy I'm worried I might be dreaming... Owner, give me an extra-sweet kiss to prove this is real!

touch.line: This bouquet is for me, not for you, Owner! If you like it that much, just be patient and I'll give you a whole field's worth of flowers later!

touch2.line: Eek! You're taking things too fast, Owner! We'll have plenty of time for ourselves later, y'know!

unlock.line: Owneeer! Look, look! I've got my wedding dress on! Isn't it frilly and floaty and just so cute? I'll bet you love me so much right now you can't think straight! Heehee♡

battle.line: Alright, let's do this with fanfare!

couple_encourage1.line: Let's see who's more useful!

detail.line: All great odysseys must begin somewhere, but true glory only awaits those who reach their destination... That's why you ought to stay your course until the very end!

expedition.line: Instead of collecting supplies like this, wouldn't it be better to just raid the enemy for... Actually, never mind.

feeling1.line: I am willing to turn a blind eye to a few accidents, but if you keep doing this intentionally, don't expect any mercy from me.

feeling2.line: Everything goes on the battlefield. Whether you fight fair-and-square or use backhanded methods, it matters not. History is written by the victors.

feeling3.line: Oh right, Commander. Did you have any interest in navigation... or rather, adventure? I've been recruiting mates. If you're interested, let's go look for treasure or uninhabited islands or something!

feeling4.line: Sure, it's great to travel together and all, but aren't all these places too close by? Port, the surrounding areas, and the nearby ocean... Sigh. Honestly, going to these places doesn't make me excited at all. Next time, I'm taking you somewhere farther away.

feeling5.line: I see. So what you're telling me is that it's not the place that matters, but that if I'm with you, anywhere is fine? ... Haha... W-Wait... are you saying...

home.line: Nice job, Commander. How would you like some fresh... grapes? Hehe, come on~ don't drop 'em!

hp_warning.line: Ugh, they got me!

login.line: You've finally come. What should we start with today? It's great to think about battle plans and all, but how about sending me on a sortie first?

lose.line: How humiliating... I'll get you back for this! Just you wait!

mail.line: Here, a letter for you. Anybody find information on some treasure?

main1.line: Basically, ships arm themselves with armor and equipment—in other words, with artillery and torpedoes. Meanwhile, humans arm themselves with courage and intelligence—in other words, with perception and wisdom.

main2.line: While I don't hate customs and ceremony, I do prefer the simpler things.

main3.line: The dew-kissed fruit of the morning makes for the best juice. Don't you agree?

mission.line: Doing mundane tasks is totally not my style. Um... Why don't we check the rewards first?

mission_complete.line: Can't complain about the bounty, but I just feel like there's "something" missing.

profile.line: I'm the Royal Navy heavy cruiser, Drake. If you weren't aware of my existence before, I'll make sure you know now by showing you the power of my 9.2 inch guns!

propose.line: Don't you think it's strange too? This feeling that's not quite 'having my heart stolen' or 'feeling vexed,' but more just... 'feeling embarrassed'? ...Gosh, it's all your fault that I'm not acting like myself! ... But I don't quite hate this feeling either... Well? Do you get what I mean?

skill.line: You won't find any mercy here!

touch.line: I tend to get along better with people who are straightforward. If there's something you want to say to me, say it clearly.

touch2.line: Huuh? You sure have some guts.

unlock.line: So you're the Commander? Seems you've got some backbone. I'm the Royal Navy heavy cruiser, Drake, and I'll be joining your fleet. Just making sure, you will deploy me, right?

upgrade.line: Now that's the kind of sound I want to hear from my main guns! Ahahaha!

win_mvp.line: Victory always leaves you feeling nice and refreshed!

gift_prefer.line: Aha. Now this is nice!

feeling5_ex.line: Hm, I see. This is what it feels like to be loved by someone you love. Not wanting to snatch someone away or wanting to monopolize them, but feeling excited and safe... It feels a bit strange...
