main1_ex.line: I mean, yes, of course I wanted to improve my artillery and torpedoes, get thicker plating, and improve my engines—but it's too expensive to do so.

main3_ex.line: How'd you like some lime juice? Yes, I do think fresh juice is the best, and you're gonna need to get used to it when you're sailing the high seas. Hehe~

touch2_ex.line: Hey... What do you think you're doing while the sun's still up...

detail.line: Artificial waves? Hmm, this might be more fun than I thought. Time to show off my swimming skills!

home.line: Good exercise followed by some exquisitely cool watermelon, man, it's just the best! Hey, you'd better get over here and have a bite, or I'll finish this whole thing by myself!

login.line: I heard this is a nice place to swim. Imagine my surprise to learn it wasn't a beach, but an outdoor pool... Still, I guess if we're just killing time, this is as good a place as any...

main1.line: C-could you stop staring at me like that? You're starting to weird me out...

main2.line: Hahah, seems like this manjuu needs some more practice if it's struggling with these meager waves!

main3.line: *sigh*... I'm not feeling satisfied yet. Guess I'll go for another swim...

touch.line: Ooh, my shoulders were starting to get a little stiff. You're not half-bad, eh~

unlock.line: Phew... Swimming like this doesn't feel all that refreshing... Hey, how about you stop staring and come join me?

battle.line: Don't get in my way.

couple_encourage1.line: Witness the true power of the Iron Blood!

detail.line: Achievements? ...Let's start racking them up today.

expedition.line: The girls who went on commissions are returning. I'll be leaving my seat for a bit.

feeling1.line: To think that my first commander would be this pathetic... How depressing.

feeling2.line: Because I was born into this world, I shall accomplish something. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to face those who designed me.

feeling3.line: If I am lacking in actual battle experience, there is nothing to do but humbly accumulate more. Commander, I won't mince words - please send me out on more battles.

feeling4.line: At one point I fought to prove myself. However, I now fight for your sake. I want to prove to everyone else that you are a sufficiently reliable person.

feeling5.line: Commander, I recognize you as the first and last commander I swear my loyalty to... But that's not all. You are the only one I've ever thought I wanted to get closer to.

home.line: My equipment needs maintenance, too.

hp_warning.line: Ugh, to think that my equipment wouldn't work...?!

login.line: Make sure that the wait was worth my time, Commander.

lose.line: Hm. I'll consider this as valuable practical experience.

mail.line: There's new mail. There's no way you've forgotten, right?

main1.line: What do you think you're doing! Adding milk to coffee is nothing short of blasphemy! The same goes for sugar!!!

main2.line: I can't believe it... though this room is so large, it doesn't even have a coffee maker...!

main3.line: If only I were constructed in the Great War instead of being incarnated in this form, I wonder how much I would have been able to do... I guess thinking about it doesn't help.

mission.line: Are you going to neglect all the missions?

mission_complete.line: How long... are you planning on ignoring the mission rewards?

profile.line: Light cruiser, Mainz. There were plans for me to succeed the Admiral Hipper class, but due to circumstances, I've incarnated in this form. You get the rest without me telling you, right?

propose.line: My existence is no longer just about battle. My life and fate have already been tied to yours. My beloved Commander, I henceforth pledge my heart to you for the rest of eternity.

touch.line: What's wrong? Do you want me to comfort you?

touch2.line: Perfect. I can finish testing my guns by firing them at you.

unlock.line: Light cruiser, Mainz. You'll be my first Commander. Hmph. Don't you dare disappoint me.

upgrade.line: Hm. Let's test this out in a real battle.

win_mvp.line: An expected outcome, given that I am here.

gift_prefer.line: I didn't expect to receive something like this... This has made me see you in a new light.

battle_ex.line: Für den Kommandant!

detail_ex.line: Commander, are you satisfied with my battle record? I see, that's good.

login_ex.line: Here's some fresh coffee. I've made it to your taste.

main1_ex.line: Commander, I've acquired some coffee beans. Allow me to make you some fresh coffee. I'd like for you to experience the joy of coffee for yourself.

main3_ex.line: I'm grateful that I was able to incarnate into this era. To tell you the truth, it's because I have such a wonderful Commander like you.

mail_ex.line: You've got new mail. Leave the rest to me.

mission_ex.line: Commander, I beg you, please don't forget about the missions after your break.

mission_complete_ex.line: I'll be going to get the mission rewards...

touch_ex.line: Commander, I'm right here by your side. And I always will be.

touch2_ex.line: *cough*, Commander, please hold yourself back!

detail.line: Blücher tried to wear her rigging to the bath, but Eugen and I managed to stop her. Seems like Hipper didn't want to get in with us, though...

home.line: Where did you go, Commander? Tiring yourself out now would defeat the whole point of relaxing.

login.line: I wouldn't have minded waiting longer. After all, I know you're not the type to forget a promise.

lose.line: I guess I got too comfortable...

mail.line: You have new mail. I told them to leave it in your office, so we can check it later.

main1.line: Nngh... It's hard to tie this sash tight enough. But if it's too loose...

main2.line: They didn't let me bring a coffee machine into the bathhouse, but... Heh, I did get to set it up outside. Black, of course.

main3.line: The mirror? I'd assume it's fogged up from the steam. ...Look at my reflection, you say? What do you... Oh. *blushes*

mission.line: A mission, huh? ...Let's put it off for now. It'll still be there after we take a break.

mission_complete.line: Finished your missions already? Then that gives us more time to kick back.

touch.line: You've done well, Commander. It's time to take a break.

touch2.line: W-wait! Don't do that, or else...!

unlock.line: Ah! Changed already? Just wait a minute... No, you don't have to leave. I'm almost done.

detail.line: Do you have any plans later today? If not, feel very free to stay with me.

feeling5.line: The Dragon Empery New Year is a day for family gatherings. I think it's a lovely thing, but I want to take this opportunity to tell you... that you are more important to me than anyone else. That our fates are bound tightly. Wherever you go, that is my home.

headtouch.line: How does it, umm... feel?

home.line: Have you been working this whole time? Goodness. Get over here and relax already.

login.line: Phew... Want me to scooch over for you?

main1.line: Tea and black coffee... Entirely different flavors, but many shared aspects. For example, traditional tea doesn't include sugar or milk.

main2.line: I think Hipper was interested in this dress. She was staring an awful lot... Should I have one made for her, too?

main3.line: It is a little cramped, but if we try hard enough, we could both sleep here. So... Want to lie down with me?

mission_complete.line: Your mission rewards... Bah, they can wait. You're on break right now, after all!

touch.line: My shoe fell off? When in the world...

touch2.line: H-hold on! Does it have to be right now...?

unlock.line: Commander, come join me in rest. ...Hm? I look unusually relaxed? This is a rare break, and I don't plan to waste it by being stuffy.

battle.line: Flee while you still can.

detail.line: I don't understand. Why are all the people at this base so at ease?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Excellent, exactly as was planned.

feeling1.line: I am not even disappointed, I simply wonder how someone as lousy as you became a commander in the first place.

feeling2.line: Names and titles are no proof of strength, that much is true. But that is fine. As time passes, you learn how futile your concerns are.

feeling3.line: Mourn for my fallen comrades? If I were to stop and mourn for every lost soul, I would never win the war.

feeling4.line: We make a fine pair, both in the office and the war room. But that can backfire, as I may end up becoming reliant on you...

feeling5.line: I do not approve of being reliant on someone. Excessive intimacy is a hindrance in war, clouding one's judgment and forming obstacles to one's plans... Ah, I can't believe what I'm saying...

home.line: Commander, we are in all-out war; we cannot afford to rest.

hp_warning.line: Carry out emergency damage control plan!

login.line: Excellent, you're back. Have you finished work our next plan yet, Commander?

lose.line: Impossible... My plan should have been flawless...!

mail.line: Mail has arrived. Could it be new intelligence?

main1.line: One day, I hope to meet the Scharnhorst sisters myself.

main2.line: Sometimes, things don't go as planned. You must think carefully before committing yourself to anything, Commander.

main3.line: Don't blame others over things that are out of their control. Nobody can predict the future.

mission.line: You have missions. Leaving them unfinished would be a foolish choice.

mission_complete.line: Mission successful. Let us get started on the next one, Commander.

profile.line: I am the battleship Odin. I existed only within the realm of the Iron Blood navy's imagination. Destiny has brought me here to serve under you and assist in the realization of your goals.

propose.line: Understood. I shall continue to provide assistance for you, whenever– Hey, wait a minute... Th-this isn't what you said would happen! ...No, that's not to say I oppose this! I just wasn't... mentally prepared... What I'm getting at is: give me a moment to think!

skill.line: You wasted your last chance to turn back!

touch.line: Yes? Has there been a change of plans?

touch2.line: Y-you will hear from me at the court martial!

unlock.line: Are you the one who summoned me here? I am Odin. I hereby take up post as your tactician.

upgrade.line: With strength, one can reduce the number of irregularities in a plan.

win_mvp.line: Victory was ours since before the battle began.

gift_prefer.line: Wait a second... I don't remember telling you what I like. How did you know?

detail_ex.line: I finally understand now. Everyone is at ease because they have faith in you, Commander. It all makes sense.

feeling5_ex.line: To tell the truth, I blanked out the moment you presented this ring to me. But now, my mind is clear. Whatever obstacles we will come to face, I vow to take them on together with you.

home_ex.line: You're not a machine capable of working around the clock. Rest if you need to. I will hold the fort in the meanwhile.

login_ex.line: Excellent, you're back. Shall we begin on our plans for today, Commander?

main2_ex.line: Though I object to sudden changes, there are times when one must revise their plans. But rest assured, my pledge to you is set in stone.

main3_ex.line: Someone made a mistake, did they? If it was excusable, then offer them a pardon. It's meaningless to scold someone over nothing significant.

touch2_ex.line: Not again! Would you stop it with this unsolicited behavior?!

detail.line: I don't understand. Why are all the people at this base so at ease? ...No, it is simply I who is always trying too hard.

home.line: To fight is to put one's whole being into something, be that firing volleys on the battlefield or turning a blank canvas into a masterpiece.

login.line: It is good to see you again. You ought to dedicate your days off to your own hobbies, Commander.

main1.line: Gneisenau, enjoyment of the arts will always elude you if you only think in statistics. You stand to learn from Scharnhorst in that regard.

main2.line: Lord Tirpitz, whereabouts is Lord Bismarck? Forsooth, 'tis reassuring to know that thou knoweth. I shan't inquire further.

main3.line: Plum trees and snow... This is an unfamiliar, but picturesque sight that I will likely never forget.

touch2.line: Stop it! I am trying to focus here!

unlock.line: I thought I would never have time to pursue the fine arts, and yet here I am now. Your thoughts, Commander? Eastern as this calligraphy may be, does it not suit the connotations of my name?

battle.line: Devote thyself not to the fleet― for that is my solemn charge.

couple_encourage1.line: Let us open our eyes to this colorful world.

couple_encourage2.line: Let us harken, for the world speaks.

detail.line: Whether your ambitions leads you into the wilderness of unparalleled achievements, the lofty spires of world domination, or the gardens of peaceful sanctuary, command me as would best serve your will.

expedition.line: The birds' clarion call... It seems that our comrades have returned to us.

feeling1.line: The hope you brought was but a false light. Why, Commander, must you torment me so?

feeling2.line: This world is the surface of a calm lake— Disturbances may mar the waters with ripples, but peace must return in time.

feeling3.line: Trees bury their roots deep into the ground to avoid being blown away, and fish swim upstream to propagate their kind. Though they know they are fated to return to nothingness, living things defy their circumstances to the best of their ability.

feeling4.line: Commander, there is no way for you to wear the rigging—armor, main guns, and torpedoes—that is required to defend the fleet. As I am a ship, I will take on the mission to protect you.

feeling5.line: If those who are powerless resist fate, those with power cannot stand by and do nothing. Commander, your radiance, warmth, and affection—in order to protect all of this, I offer up my body and swear my love.

home.line: Immerse yourself in the liberating quintessence of wine, for the mind requires reprieve. Man is naught without repose.

hp_warning.line: These scars will become my aegis.

login.line: Your orders, Commander. Whatever your will may be, I shall usher into reality.

lose.line: Our true destination still awaits.

mail.line: A notice has arrived. Is it a joyous one, or is it a tragic one? Is it a desirable one, or a hateful one?

main1.line: Commander, art thou pondering the meaning of life? Or perhaps...

main2.line: The ebb and flow of tides are natural phenomena, and so are the flowing fates of humankind.

main3.line: "Live, together with the fleet." Understood. I have received my newest directive from the Commander.

mission.line: The falcon that spreads not its wings cannot reach the sky. The ship that rows not its oars cannot reach the other shore.

mission_complete.line: Only for the gardener whose blood nurtures the soil can the iris bloom in triumphant beauty.

profile.line: Never have I received orders, nor have I ever accomplished anything. I am merely a blank slate—existing simply to become the delectable champagne presented to thee, the victor.

propose.line: Even if words stop existing, I will still listen to your voice. Even if the world loses its radiance, I will still look into your eyes. There is nothing in this world that can erase your existence from my heart. The warmth I've received from you, I shall repay with my eternal protection... These are my true feelings.

skill.line: Sleep in the blue depths of the ocean...

touch.line: The warmth and sensation of being touched... How exceedingly difficult to forget.

touch2.line: Though your transgression may be slight, such conduct may turn others away from you.

unlock.line: I am the personification of Champagne, part of the Iris Libre. Commander, please give me an order—a reason to exist.

upgrade.line: Even the most polished blade must eventually rot. That is to say, there is no point in chasing power.

win_mvp.line: I ensure that missions sown shall bear rich fruit.

gift_prefer.line: Too overwhelming is this joy – I must express my gratitude.

detail.line: Reliving one's childhood by enjoying games is one way to enjoy festivities. That being the case, I lack knowledge of the rules designated for these games...

headtouch.line: Hm...? Did you want to know about my dreams...?

home.line: Please enlighten me. The significance of this festive garb, and the things I must do.

login.line: What I desire on the first day of the new year... a peaceful night's sleep, and a rainbow-colored dream that reflects my wishes.

main1.line: Mountains, birds, fruits. All wonderful signs of a dream in which spring blooms forth.

main2.line: Our connected memories spread out, like freshly-fallen powder snow, as our affected emotions are as if blown by the spring breeze. ...May these peaceful festivities spread much joy.

main3.line: The Cardinal's favorite book was one recommended by me. Humans and ships alike desire to satisfy their curiosity...

touch2.line: Animals attempt to break their fetters in order to satiate their desires, whereas humans challenge taboos to satiate their curiosity.

unlock.line: It is not against the teachings to halt one's pursuit of destiny and to surrender to the warm draft of festivities. It is mankind's prerogative to seek out auspicious portents.

battle.line: I fight for the Commander's sake—That is my credo.

detail.line: Praise be this vow. Love, faithfulness, entrusted duty, ordained creed—I must be one who protects the happiness of all.

expedition.line: What I am telling you are the honeyed words of a lover—let us prepare to greet those who have returned together.

home.line: A decision must be made. The baptism of innocent lost spirits, the flavor of filling fertility, or the indulgence of a lover's tryst?

login.line: Feel, perceive. The beating of our connected hearts, the trembling of our damp lips.

lose.line: A vow mustn't be broken. My protection is eternal.

mail.line: A message is received. Is it joyful or sorrowful news? Triumphant or regretful? The answers lay in your reply, Commander.

main1.line: Life is fleeting. The hulls of shipgirls are transient. It is our inescapable fate to love momentary bliss.

main2.line: It is the duty of Champagne to fill your cup. That means keeping you punctual and rested in equal measure...

main3.line: Hymns passed down cannot fool the heart. I will celebrate your great deeds and offer you love eternal.

touch.line: Your warmth, heartbeat, touch, and more seem meant to tempt me into rapture...

touch2.line: Even knowing eternal love, one desires momentary pleasure. I know that it falls to me to see your wishes granted, Commander...

unlock.line: An ode of gratitude for the venerable Iris, echoing tones condensing to pure prayer. Seek blessings not in public worship, but in humanity's true triumph: our everlasting bonds.

win_mvp.line: Unlike the fleeting bubbles dancing in the air, this victory will be remembered for all time.

battle.line: It's the bad guys... Teacher, everyone... Let's go together!

couple_encourage1.line: Balty... Hooray!

couple_encourage2.line: Wichita... Very cool!

couple_encourage3.line: Bremmy... Mhm!

detail.line: "Teacher" is better than "Commander"... Anchorage likes "Teacher"... Teacher, I like you lots!

expedition.line: "Commissions"...? Where is everyone...? Anchorage wants to know... Is that okay?

feeling1.line: Patpat. Teacher, it's okay, don't cry... Anchorage... won't cry either... Smile like this, okay?

feeling2.line: So many strangers... Teacher, Anchorage is scared...

feeling3.line: Teacher~! I'll give you this bunny rabbit! ...Here!

feeling4.line: Teacher is a special person to me... Anchorage loves Teacher very much! Anchorage is also a special person to Teacher? Yay!

feeling5.line: Teacher... Will you be together with Anchorage? ...Yay! Anchorage with Teacher, girl with her prince... Together, forever...

headtouch.line: You like... my hair? Lemme touch Teacher's too...

home.line: Teacher, where are you...? Anchorage hates being alone...

hp_warning.line: Owie... It hurts...

login.line: Teacher~ Anchorage has been waiting for you...

lose.line: Oh no, I lost... Bad guys are scary...

mail.line: "Mail"... It's too hard, I can't read it... Teacher, do you know what it says?

main1.line: Put on the jacket... Take off the jacket... Put it back on... Ehehe~

main2.line: In this picture, the girl, the prince... are very comfy... I like it!

main3.line: Teacher, are you busy...? Can you stay by Anchorage's side? ...Yay!

mission.line: "Mission... incomplete?" Anchorage wants to help...!

mission_complete.line: "Mission... complete?" Teacher, that's great!

profile.line: Anchorage is... a Union "Heavy Cruiser"...? Baltimore and the others are my friends! You're my best friend though, Teacher...!

propose.line: A promise...? Pinky promise! ...A "ring"? You'll put it on my finger? Yay! Anchorage also made a ring! Teacher, gimme your hand!

touch.line: Anchorage likes Teacher's warm touch... Does Teacher like it too?

touch2.line: Squishy squish... Teacher, do you like it...?

unlock.line: Com...mander? No... Teacher? Teachy-teacher. I'm Anchorage. Woohoo! Teacher! My favoritest person! Teacheeer!

upgrade.line: Anchorage... will become stronger!

win_mvp.line: Yay, I won! Anchorage is a good girl...!

gift_prefer.line: Anchorage loves it... Yeah!

detail_ex.line: Teacher... Anchorage will read you... my new picture book! "Once upon a time..." Huh? Umm, I don't understand this next part...

expedition_ex.line: Anchorage knows where everyone is! Teacher told me. Thank you, Teacher...

feeling5_ex.line: Anchorage loves... Teacher's smile! I'll do my best... and protect it! So you can smile forever and ever... with Anchorage!

headtouch_ex.line: Anchorage loves... getting petted! More, Teacher...

home_ex.line: Teacher... Take Anchorage next time! I don't want to be alone... away from you!

login_ex.line: Teacher...! Anchorage was waiting... I missed you so, so much...

lose_ex.line: The enemy is scary... But Teacher is here. I'm not afraid...!

main4_ex.line: Teacher... Jacket on? Jacket... off? Which is better?

main5_ex.line: In my picture books, the prince... holds hands with the girl... and hugs her. We should do that, too...!

main6_ex.line: Teacher, are you tired...? Anchorage can help...! You can rely on me... Yeah!

main7_ex.line: Anchorage will now... roll up my sleeves! And then... hold hands with Teacher!

mail_ex.line: I don't understand "mail"... Teacher, teach me! I'll write... mail for you, too!

touch_ex.line: Do you want a hug, Teacher? Anchorage will hug you... reeeally tight!

touch2_ex.line: Teacher... Your touch feels... good! I like it...!

upgrade_ex.line: Teacher, look! I'm even better now! Hehe...

win_mvp_ex.line: I won...! Anchorage is amazing! But Teacher is the most amazing!

battle.line: Anchorage... Swim good, so you don't sink...!

detail.line: You're teaching Anchorage... Yeah... You're Teacher, not Commander! Anchorage loves Teacher!

expedition.line: Com-mish-shuns... We have to wait until everyone's back, right?

feeling5.line: Teacher is Anchorage's Commander... But Anchorage likes Teacher. Can you be my Teacher... forever? Anchorage and Teacher...♪

home.line: Teacher, where are you...? I can't swim on my own... Oh! Teacher! Ehehe♪

login.line: Mm... Um, Teacher...? Is Anchorage doing it right? Kick like this... I-I think I'm sinking again..

mail.line: Don't let the mail fall in the water... Mmm... There!

main1.line: Teacher, can you teach me even in my dreams...? Ehehe.

main2.line: Baltimore's so good at swimming...! Can Anchorage learn to swim like that? Ehehe, if Teacher teaches me, then maybe...

main3.line: The shark is so slippery... I'll do my best not to fall off! Yeah!

touch.line: You're all wet... Teacher, are you okay...?

touch2.line: Teacher, do you like touching...?

unlock.line: Mm... There... Teacher? Is Anchorage doing it right? Is Anchorage... swimming? Thank goodness... Falling into the water would be bad, right...?

win_mvp.line: Anchorage did it! Anchorage is doing good...!

expedition.line: Anchorage didn't go on the commission trip... I want to go next time...

feeling5.line: Anchorage is happy no matter what we do together! ...Close my eyes? Okay, but why... (*kiss*) Teacher... I love you! Let's be together forever...

headtouch.line: Pat pat...? That feels good... Anchorage likes it...

home.line: Teacher, welcome back... A boat ride? Just you and me...? Okay! Let's go see the moon...!

login.line: Anchorage was so lonely waiting for you... Hug me, teacher... The moon? Wow... We're gazing at the moon together...!

lose.line: I lost... But... I'll do my best...! Because I'm together with Teacher... Heehee♪

mail.line: Mail... It's too hard for me... You understand mail, Teacher? Wow...

main1.line: The wind feels good... Teacher, do you want to try? ...Hm? This is dangerous...? Okay... Anchorage will be careful!

main2.line: Teacher, look...! The moon and the lights are all bright and pretty...! Anchorage is, too...? Hehehe... Anchorage loves the moon and the lights, too! And... Teacher, too!

main3.line: The boat is all rocking and swaying... Spending time with you is so fun... I love it...!

main4.line: ...Pictures? Pose? Like this...? You think it's cute...? I do, too!

mission_complete.line: The mission is complete! Teacher, can we play now...? A boat ride, and looking at the moon...? Yay...!

touch.line: Touch, touch... Anchorage wants to touch you, too...

touch2.line: Do you... like this, Teacher? This... "pose"? I don't get it... But if you like it, then Anchorage likes it, too!

unlock.line: Teacher... How are Anchorage's new clothes? Do you like them...? Yeah, I do, too!

detail.line: Teacher, what milk do you like? Strawberry? Mango...? Hmm... I can't read this... What does it say, Teacher?

feeling5.line: Anchorage wants to drink... the milk Teacher drank! Mmm... Delicious! Thanks, Teacher! Hehe... Drinking milk together is so much fun!

headtouch.line: Yeah... After I finish the milk... Anchorage will go beddy-bye!

home.line: Teacher, welcome back... Anchorage wants milk now... Can we have milk?

login.line: You can't sleep either...? Want milk? Drink it... with Anchorage!

mail.line: Can't see... Anchorage will turn on the lights!

main1.line: Teacher... What milk flavor do you like? Anchorage likes... Strawberry!

main2.line: Anchorage's clothes fell...! I pulled them up... and they fell again! Hehe...

main3.line: Brush my teeth after...? Anchorage will remember... Yeah!

main4.line: Anchorage wrote a note! It's on the... re-fridge-erator... So I won't forget what Teacher told me!

touch.line: Can Anchorage... drink it on the couch? Hehe!

touch2.line: Hm? Teacher... Wanna touch? My clothes are big... You can reach in if you want...

unlock.line: Teacher found me...! Anchorage can't sleep... I wanna drink sweet milk... Please?

detail.line: Teacher... Am I pretty? Ehehe, can we hold hands? Thanks, Teacher...!

feeling5.line: Teacher, the fireworks are over... But Anchorage's love for you won't! I love you! More than anyone else, ever!

headtouch.line: Pretty flowers... I like them! Do you, Teacher...?

home.line: Fireworks... Let's go play, Teacher! You can light... Anchorage's fireworks!

login.line: Teacher... It's pretty here! Let's take a walk... before Mr. Sun goes down!

lose.line: The fireworks are gone... Teacher, why?

mail.line: Teacher... Here's your mail! And flowers, too!

main1.line: Teacher... Look! Heart-shaped fireworks... for you!

main2.line: Teacher... Mr. Sun is so shiny and pretty. Just like... my fireworks! And like you and me!

main3.line: Walk... Hold Anchorage's hand, Teacher! The beach is so soft... I better try not to fall!

main4.line: Today made me happy...! I'll remember it forever! You do too, Teacher...!

touch.line: Rub, rub... That feels good... But the fireworks are hot... Be careful, Teacher!

touch2.line: Fluffy dress... Anchorage, fluffy... Do you like, Teacher?

unlock.line: Teacher... Anchorage loves you! Our oath... is special! We'll be together... forever!

win_mvp.line: Fireworks... for victory! Hip, hip, hooray!

battle.line: Show me the fool that dares challenge the mighty Hakuryuu!

couple_encourage1.line: Hmm, I don't think we're going to get along...

detail.line: My room's a bit messy, you say? So what? There's no problem as long as I can find everything I need.

expedition.line: Did the commission fleet come back while I was sidetracked? Oh, you're going to go greet them? See you in a bit.

feeling1.line: Scum. Stay away from me.

feeling2.line: Praise me if I do well. Berate me if I do poorly. That's just how work goes. There's no need to concern yourself over me.

feeling3.line: Not too bad. You might actually be able to keep pace with me... Hmph. But if you become complacent or regress, I'll cast you aside faster than anyone else.

feeling4.line: Umm, have you seen my katana...? I swear I left it here, but it's nowhere to be found... Ahem! A-a-anyways, if I don't find it soon, um... it's a really big deal, so please help me...!

feeling5.line: Now that you've seen my secret, I can no longer afford to let you out of my sight! Hmph, from now on, we shall do everything together! ...Of course that includes going outside to play... W-wait, this kind of feels like I'm getting taken advantage of...!

headtouch.line: How dare you pat me without permission. Have you no fear of being cut down?

home.line: M-my katana... Phew... Ahh, I really don't feel complete without it. ...Hey, why are you still here? Do you really have the free time to stand around in a daze?

hp_warning.line: How could the great Hakuryuu be damaged?!

login.line: So you've come. Color me surprised. I assumed you had overslept, but that seems to not be the case.

lose.line: L-let's get out of here! ....H-has anyone seen my katana?!

mail.line: A new missive? ...Oh, it's not a duel challenge. Boring.

main1.line: It is great to have access to such a wide variety of sparring opponents here... Friends? Hmph, just having one or two is sufficient.

main2.line: My katana is my soul. Should it leave my side, I... Never mind, forget I said anything.

main3.line: I had the opportunity to roll some rice balls during my free time. You may have them if you're hungry.

mission.line: Missions? I have no desire to waste my time on such trifling chores. I'll leave that to you.

mission_complete.line: See, I knew you had it in you. The ability to handle trifling chores is quite commendable.

profile.line: I am Hakuryuu, aircraft carrier of the Sakura Empire. Let any who dares question my might face me head-on. I shall teach them the meaning of overwhelming power.

propose.line: You think I'd just sit there and listen to your sentimental... M-my katana?! When'd you get your hands on that?! Give it back! Please, I'll do anything you say! ...Fine, I admit defeat... Ughh, but... this somehow doesn't feel all that bad...

touch.line: What is it? If you require something of me, speak your mind.

touch2.line: What, are you trying to imitate me? ...Hey, knock it off already!

unlock.line: So, this brat is supposed to be the commander? My name is Hakuryuu. Listen well – try to control me, and you will make a laughingstock of yourself. Remember this!

upgrade.line: Hmph. The distance between me and the rest grows ever greater.

win_mvp.line: Hmph! They sent lowly scum to try to stop the mighty Hakuryuu? How laughable!

gift_prefer.line: Since you put so much thought into this, I'll take it.

detail_ex.line: What a pain... Cleaning is such a chore... Hey, Commander, since you're here, mind helping me tidy up?

expedition_ex.line: Wh-what is it? Oh, the commission fleet is back? ...W, wait, don't pull on me! At least let me grab my katana... Ahem. Anyway, let's get going.

headtouch_ex.line: Wh-what are you doing?! Stop! Please stop that already!

home_ex.line: Y-yes?! I'm here! P-please don't eat me...?! D-don't sneak up on me when I don't have my weapon...

login_ex.line: Oh, it's you. What are we going to do today– G-give my katana back! Y-you're training me to get used to not having it...? Whyyy?!

main1_ex.line: If it's about that fight earlier, we could've just slugged it out. What's the point of dragging the issue back to the dinner table? Ugh...

main2_ex.line: I think I should leave this backup sword with you... I mean, just in case... Just in case I drop mine, it'll be a huge help to have you around...

main3_ex.line: It's time to make rice balls! You should have some too! Do I love white rice so much because of my name?! ...What are you, stupid?

touch2_ex.line: F-fine, it's not like I can beat you anyway... Hyaah?!

detail.line: Thanks to my little friends here, the kitchen is nice and tidy. Well, not that I mind if things are a little messy. Ahaha!

home.line: *grumble*... Oh, hey you, perfect timing! C'mere and help me think up some new recipes!

login.line: Uhhh, oh no... This tingling, anxious feeling... Eek? Oh, my katana... Thanks for that... Ahem! Commander, let's hurry up and get to work!

mail.line: A new letter? ...No way, are we getting challenged to a cooking duel?

main1.line: Huh? You got a problem with the great Hakuryuu's cooking, you scallywag? ...Oh, you ran out of sashimi? Got it. I'll serve you right up.

main2.line: Huh? My blade isn't cut out for kitchen work? You, stop that snickering this instant! Your jaw's gonna hit the floor when you see my magnificent bladework!

main3.line: Oi, you plan on watching all day or are you gonna come help me? Knowing you, I'm sure you've got what it takes!

mission.line: Did another order come in just now? Heh. I'll take care of it.

mission_complete.line: All done with your missions? Good timing, I just finished prepping the order.

touch.line: NOBODY TOUCHES THE KATANA!! ...Oh, sorry. Got a little carried away there. Did I scare you?

touch2.line: Do you want this blade of mine to turn you into fine filets?

unlock.line: All righty, one freshly-sliced plate of sashimi coming right up! ...Huh? I'm coming across too aggressive? Even after I went through all this trouble for you, you still have something to nitpick about? ...Well, whatever. Enjoy your meal!

detail.line: Now this is fancy, even for a banquet venue. Heh... You already know those drunkards are going to ruin the place. Whole lot of wasted effort, don't you think?

expedition.line: Our commission team is back? Bring them here. I'll play a piece for you and them.

home.line: Wh-wh-where did my katana go?! I can't play music like this... H-hmph! You're bold, trying to take advantage of my moment of weakness! Well, I won't fall victim to your schemes!

login.line: Heh, how'd you like that piece? Oh, you're so awed by my skill that you're speechless, huh? Yeah?

main1.line: F-forget about my katana! Just focus on the song I'm playing! Got it?!

main2.line: What? I'm being too loud? Hmph, you're just as much of an unrefined ruffian as I thought. We may fight on the battlefield often, but never forget to improve your tastes!

main3.line: Think I'd like a drink... Tch, we don't have any proper appetizers to go with booze, do we? Fine. I'm going out shopping.

touch.line: ♪~ Try and guess what song that was. ...No, it was not improvised!

touch2.line: My katana isn't there, either! ...That's not why you touched me?!

unlock.line: Katana... at the ready. Hmph, you again? Never expected you to know anything about music, the way you've been out there conquering the waves with us this whole time. Come then, let me test how good your tastes are with this song!

battle.line: I will cut them all down with one swing!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned, eh? Heheh, let's go show them my blade!

feeling5.line: A katana isn't just a weapon – it is a warrior's very heart. That should tell you why all the girls at port treasure their own weapons so much. If you ever get the opportunity to forge a sword... heh, your first one will be all mine!

home.line: Wipe off the oil, apply whetstone powder... Just as a sword needs maintenance, you need regular rest. Quit your complaining and take a break!

login.line: What's the matter? Intimidated by my raw aura? Hahaha, you won't be taking my katana from me today!

lose.line: Where's my katana... Huh? You brought it for me? Th-thank you...

main1.line: My katana is right here in my hands – you're too late to hide it from me! ...You weren't going to? As if I'd believe that now!

main2.line: The dragon carving, my name engraved into it... Truly, this was made just for me. Heh, I must thank you!

main3.line: Tamahagane must be hammered hundreds of times to forge a mighty blade. Don't forget your daily exercise! ...You think it's okay to take today off because you're halfway there? I-is that how it works?

mission.line: Any missions I can test my weapon on? ...Find one myself? But you're the one receiving the assignments, not me!

mission_complete.line: The rewards... too valuable to waste, huh? Tch. I'll go find a hay bale, or something.

touch.line: Hmm? If you want to touch it, then go ahead... Ack! You almost tricked me, damn it!

touch2.line: Again, you can't have it... H-hey, that was no fair!

unlock.line: Hahahaha! Now THIS is a sword worthy of my hands! Perfect blade, perfect hilt, perfect cut – only a master of their craft could make such a beauty! Come on, let's see what this blade can do!

battle.line: Achoo! Tch... I only need my katana!

detail.line: It's not like me to tidy up? Hmph! What fool would make a mess of their room a short few days after moving in?! My katana? Where... Where is it?!

feeling5.line: Hmph. If that's what you want... I'm even LESS likely to wear it! I'll go naked before I... Achoo?! You're scared I'll catch a cold? Why didn't you say that sooner?!

home.line: The room feels cramped? You clearly don't see the value of this sunlight! It is a bit rough in the summer, yes, but it's just fine if you can handle that!

login.line: Are you here to tease me again? I told you, I'm not wearing it! No matter how much you want to see it... G-give my katana back! Fiiine, I'll wear it!

lose.line: Tch... No wonder I felt weak!

main1.line: Achoo?! Ugh... I think my room is too cold. I-I'd rather turn off the AC or whatever than wear THAT!

main2.line: My katana's right here! Heh, those kinds of tricks don't work on me anymore! ...Yeah, you got a problem with the room being too small to hide it?! Is that the whole reason you're here?!

main3.line: A true warrior cares not for appearances. Cut down your enemy and win the day – that's what matters. You must understand this, surely.

touch.line: Now that you mention it, the size really does... Did you get my measurements perfectly just by looking?

touch2.line: D-don't grab out of nowhere!

unlock.line: Y-you! How dare you make me wear... "I thought it would look good on you, and your current outfit is too breezy"?! What nonsense! I can wear whatever I want in my room! ...Achoo?!

battle.line: I shall tear you asunder! Ahahahaha!

couple_encourage1.line: If you would, do mind your manners.

couple_encourage2.line: We shall drink later, but now, we must fight.

detail.line: My serpents have a tendency for violence, so be aware of the risk should you dare to touch me, Commander.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. How long must your subordinates wait for you to acknowledge them, hmm?

feeling1.line: You are undisciplined trash not worthy of my compassion.

feeling2.line: My interests in life? Hahaha! Fighting worthy foes, savoring good beer, gazing at the stormy seas, and... What? Are you grasping at straws just to get my attention?

feeling3.line: I'm going for a drink, and you shall accompany me, Commander. Get as drunk as you wish. I'll overlook whatever silly things you say while under the influence.

feeling4.line: I don't mind your efforts to win my interest, but must you stare holes through me? Hehe. I suppose you're more daring when drunk... W-wait, you aren't drunk?!

feeling5.line: You're in over your head if you thought you could drink one named after the god of the sea under the table. What's the matter? Can't move a muscle? Then I've proven my– Eek!

headtouch.line: ...What?!

home.line: You wish to rest, do you? I'm afraid the heap of soon-due paperwork on your desk won't allow it.

hp_warning.line: Caught on to me, have you...

login.line: Who might it be that just stepped through those doors? ...Oh, it's you. Best of luck with your work, then.

lose.line: Nobody, and I mean NOBODY denies me my victory! I shall return with a vengeance!

mail.line: A letter has arrived from afar. Read it, would you?

main1.line: Insufficiently motivated, are we? A dinner with copious amounts of beer can fix that.

main2.line: You like gazing at seas in tempest too, do you? Hahaha. A sea is at its truest when a storm rages through it.

main3.line: ...What? You have that look on your face like I'm distracting you.

mission.line: I see we still have unfinished missions. Do them now, and I shall refrain from dismissing you as incapable.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. I suppose you are at least qualified for your position.

profile.line: I am Ägir, named after the very same mythological ruler of the sea. Though, compared to a god who smote adversaries with storms and crashing waves, my way of dealing with my enemies is much more subdued. Ahahaha.

propose.line: A symbol of our marriage? You must adore having proof of the ties that bind you to me. Prepare to double down, then. I'll find something that binds you to me. Physically... Hahaha! You shall see what I mean.

skill.line: Ahahahahaha! Be engulfed by my maelstrom!

touch.line: Would you like it... if I came a bit closer?

touch2.line: You're brave, I'll give you that... What?! Twice in a row?!

unlock.line: Well met. I am large cruiser Ägir. Your will is my command. Hehehe... Now let's find out what you can accomplish with my arsenal of talents.

upgrade.line: Prosit. The occasion warrants a toast. Mmh!

win_mvp.line: Those fools were but splashes of water beneath my bow. Hahaha... Ahahahahaha!

gift_prefer.line: You understand me better than I thought. I'm impressed.

detail_ex.line: It feels like my little dragon has behaved well lately. Did you do something to it? ...Its owner has simply mellowed out? W-watch your tongue!

feeling5_ex.line: Isn't it time you conceded victory to me? I have completely and utterly dominated you, have I not? Your eyes and your racing heart do not lie. Heehee... Eek! H-hold it! I will never be conquered by the likes of you!

headtouch_ex.line: Hey! Why are you enjoying this so much?

home_ex.line: In light of your efforts, I will do your task for you. Sit over there and have a rest. Heehee.

login_ex.line: You're finally here. I've compiled a task schedule for you, so give it a look. What? Is there an issue?

main4_ex.line: While I do enjoy the parties where we drink to our hearts' content... they just aren't the same without you. Be sure to be there next time.

main5_ex.line: Just as the seas are stormy at times, they are calm at others. Calm like me in this moment, enjoying a relaxing lull... And you're here. That's positive, I suppose.

main6_ex.line: Staring as intently as you are will distract anyone, even me! At least save it until work is finished! Ugh! Did I make a secretarial error in that document or what?!

touch_ex.line: Oh? Mind yourself, lest the stormy seas swallow you.

touch2_ex.line: Again?! Th-that's my...!

upgrade_ex.line: Cheers, Commander! Ahh!

win_mvp_ex.line: Did you see that? THAT is the divine might of the deeps! Ahahahaha!

detail.line: Do you expect ME to do your paperwork? Who do you take me for – a desk jockey? ...Besides, you're taking it for granted that I'm cut out for the task!

expedition.line: A commission is done. I hope you're not considering sending ME out to meet the team...

home.line: I estimated you'd be back around this time, so I prepared tea and a snack. My work here is done... right?

login.line: You again. Ahem... Good morning, Mast– Never mind, I'm not doing it!

main1.line: Damned manjuu... You're in my way! Move! What do you think you'll achieve by being stuck under me?

main2.line: Would one call cleaning a part of the banquet preparations? The hall will be a mess by end of it anyway, so why bother?

main3.line: Damn you, August... I do NOT take kindly to being treated as a maid! ...Are you even listening?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Now go claim the rewards.

touch.line: ...Hwuh?!

touch2.line: What the–?! I'll have you know I never volunteered for this position!

unlock.line: Hmph. They think being a maid is so difficult, do they? I could do this with my eyes clo– What?! H-how long have YOU been here?!

detail.line: I heard the Dragon Empery regards their namesake dragon as sacred... Then why is its sign merely the 5th ordinal in their zodiac?

expedition.line: That commission is done. Now go. Those girls deserve some appreciation for working on a holiday.

headtouch.line: Don't you touch my horn ornaments without my permission!

home.line: Even lords of the sea need to rest. Why don't you sit down and enjoy the soothing aroma in the air?

login.line: You're back. Heheh, missed me, did you? Or are you just tired?

main1.line: How does one hold a brush? Like this? Or like... this? Ugh... I refuse to believe you don't know the proper technique. Stop gawking and come show me!

main2.line: So that's what their dragon dance is like... When I first heard of it, I thought they would use a dragon-like rigging, similar to what we have in the Iron Blood.

main3.line: Brünhilde, is this bowl an Empery antique of yours? I must admit, the workmanship is remarkable. Hmph, I suppose you do have a refined taste.

mission.line: All these missions leave you with no time to enjoy the holiday... That is unacceptable. Hmph, I'll assist you with them.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. You may now concentrate on celebrating.

touch.line: Go on a stroll together, you say? I could do that... But first, put my heels on my feet, would you?

touch2.line: Wha–?! You made me spill ink everywhere! I, I'll clean it up myself!

unlock.line: New decorations, new outfits, and countless preparations to make... Lunar New Year is quite the busy time of year. Go on, see to your duties. I'm well aware how essential you are to this holiday's smooth operation. Just don't keep me waiting all day. Heehee.

detail.line: Come on, get over here and help me with– Eek! Wh-why are you touching me there?! Eek!

expedition.line: Commission rewards have arrived. Are you going to examine the haul?

feeling5.line: Are you really content to merely stand and watch after I calmed the raging seas for you? Ugh... I had a hunch... Just this once, I permit you to do as you please with me.

headtouch.line: Hm? What are you doing?

home.line: Tired? Do you want to sit upon this couch? Hah, I don't mind giving it up for... Hm? Where have my shoes gone?

login.line: The seas have calmed, and no one can disturb us here. You should enjoy this moment of respite to its fullest.

main1.line: Oh? You want to have a drink with me? You're forthcoming, for once... Probiotic yogurt? Because it's good for your health? Come on, you must have something better than that!

main2.line: It's warming up in here. Perhaps I should take off my jacket... O-oh, you're taking yours off, too?

main3.line: You want to sit next to me, do you? There's too little room for the both of us to... Hey!

mission.line: Are you really hell-bent on doing missions during your break time? I'll give you a hand, so get them done quickly.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Now let us pour some drinks and get comfortable! Oh... A shame we only have drinks suited for children.

touch.line: Wish to borrow my jacket?

touch2.line: Again?! You don't need to keep doing this just because we're alone...

unlock.line: Well, I'm pleasantly surprised. A comfortable seat, high-quality beverages, and a nice private room... Hm? Are you going to stand there the whole day? Don't just stare at me like that...

battle.line: Bow before me!

couple_encourage1.line: You seem like you'd know a thing or two about magic.

couple_encourage2.line: Your strength is worthy of admiration.

couple_encourage3.line: Show me the face of the Finale.

detail.line: Yes, resist me. I look forward to seeing your reaction when you realize that all your struggling has been for naught.

expedition.line: Your commission team underlings have returned. You know what to do now, yes?

feeling1.line: I have nothing to say to those who cannot fight.

feeling2.line: To indulge in the sweet sap of sloth, or to swallow the bitter medicine of hard work? The choice is yours alone to make, Commander.

feeling3.line: Zeppelin and I both know what you are. An insignificant insect, trying to defy your destiny. Having said that... I believe a soul like you isn't meant to blindly accept their destiny.

feeling4.line: I enshackled you precisely so you'd want to rebel and make me submit to you. Why, you ask? Because I've been drawn to you all along. Now show me that fearsome potential that sleeps within you.

feeling5.line: People cannot say no to their hearts. Much like I cannot refute my love for you, you cannot deny your feelings for me. That is the link that binds us together.

headtouch.line: Are you... disobeying me?

home.line: I bid you welcome back, Commander. Well fought. I await the day you work up the courage to challenge me.

hp_warning.line: Tis too soon to start mourning for me.

login.line: Quiet, you... Your arrival has merely made my aide a little wary. Pay it no mind.

lose.line: For every victor, there must also be a loser...

mail.line: There's a letter for you. I command you to read it at once.

main1.line: What does being my familiar entail? You shall learn in due time.

main2.line: You're awfully quiet... Have you given up already? Obedience does not amuse me.

main3.line: I can read you like an open book when you stare at me, Commander.

mission.line: I can't imagine you'll falter in the face of such simple trials. Or "missions," as you call them.

mission_complete.line: "Mission" complete. Congratulations. Another small step towards that alluring, dangerous climax.

profile.line: Tis I, August von Parseval, Iron Blood aircraft carrier. I am but a vessel, but I am also the chains that bind you. Remember this, my familiar. Or should I say, "Commander?"

propose.line: So you seized the chance to subjugate me first. Yes, you are at your brightest when you kick and scream in the cage known as love. Allow yourself to be bound to me and amuse me for all eternity... Darling.

touch.line: What do you seek to learn from the Unhulde?

touch2.line: You let your urges take control of you... Fine. Revel in the bliss of your inevitable, pathetic defeat.

unlock.line: You've finally come, my familiar... Pardon, my "commander." I am the Unhulde, August von Parseval. 'Tis a pleasure to meet you.

upgrade.line: Improving the base principles.

win_mvp.line: I've achieved the victory you desired. It wasn't so hard.

gift_prefer.line: I have to thank you for putting a smile on my face.

detail_ex.line: Do I seem gentler than usual? Maybe so. When I saw that look on your face, I couldn't help but want to be a little sweeter to you.

feeling5_ex.line: An eternal vow has tied our souls and our destinies together, never to be unbound. Struggle as you might, the fetters of love will only entwine ever tighter.

headtouch_ex.line: Today... I'd like to be the kind of Unhulde who isn't so bothered by a few head pats.

home_ex.line: Right on schedule. You know not to keep the Unhulde waiting.

login_ex.line: So you've come, Commander. My aide has long since noticed your presence – but this time, she's not the restless one.

main4_ex.line: Come and embrace me until I'm satisfied. Or else... you may be subjected to my more "magical" methods.

main5_ex.line: Oh? Instead of running away, you're coming right to me for a hug? I can't wait to see what surprises you have in store...

main6_ex.line: I like it when your eyes are focused on me. Ah... I'm not asking you to look at me – I'm DEMANDING it, my dear.

touch_ex.line: Are you ready to receive my teachings, Commander?

touch2_ex.line: Would it make this more fun if I struggled? Okay... Let's take turns trying it.

battle.line: Keep on struggling through this ceaseless dream.

detail.line: Order me around as you please. A lowly maid deserves no pity or modesty from her defiant conqueror.

headtouch.line: Mgh... Yes, do whatever you please...

home.line: Welcome back, "Master." You may give me any order you desire... Anything you want...

login.line: There you are, my familiar... and "Master." I'm curious to see how you'll attempt to defy and make use of me today.

lose.line: I suppose my unfamiliarity with this role is to blame.

mail.line: Check... your mail...

main1.line: You will never subjugate me if you get complacent in your temporary position. You desire permanence, but we shall inevitably return to the status quo.

main2.line: I know your disposition, Master. Simply watching from a distance does not satisfy you.

main3.line: You did not conquer me. I simply chose to "lose" to you. Hehehe~♡

touch.line: Yes, "Master"...?

touch2.line: Yes, use your maid to satisfy all your desires, "Master."

unlock.line: My hair is a mess... There we go. No, I don't need a hand. I am here to serve you in this fleeting dream of yours. Enjoy it while it lasts. Hehehe.

upgrade.line: This new power is no dream.

win_mvp.line: This is the victory you wished for, "Master." Hehehe.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed? Then it's time to issue your next orders.

feeling5.line: This shirt? Why, yes, it's the same one that you wore yesterday. What of it? Isn't it only to be expected that you as my familiar offer me a nightly tribute?

headtouch.line: Oh? It's "unbecoming" of me to style my hair with my own hands? Then you shall do it for me, my familiar.

home.line: Welcome back. Though I'm not getting changed just yet, do not take this as laziness on my part. Remember that you are in no position to order me around.

login.line: Here you are, my fitting familiar, amidst the bright sunlight... Now, allow the Unhulde to enjoy her moment. Naturally, you have no right to object.

mail.line: Heehee... Surely you have the time to at least open a letter.

main1.line: While I do not personally grant you this sunlight and moment of reprieve, I allow you to enjoy it beside me.

main2.line: What are your plans for the day? You may as well try to resist me and amuse me when you eventually submit.

main3.line: You know that I can read your mind when you stare at me, and yet you continue doing it... What, I wonder, has caught your eye?

mission.line: You should have completed that mission and returned sooner, Commander.

mission_complete.line: Of course. This is your reward, my familiar. Is there anything else you wish for?

touch.line: Will you try to pass this off as a "massage"?

touch2.line: *sigh*... Are you raring to struggle again, as you did yesterday?

unlock.line: You've come, my familiar. I wondered when you'd awake from your... Hm? A little nicer than usual? Yes, because even I have my moments of placidness. Would you prefer that I was more harsh to you?

detail.line: The moonlight glitters on the water's surface, and even the final ripple peters out into a lull. Take my hand. The Unhulde's ceremony is about to begin.

feeling5.line: You have done well tonight, my familiar. The lights of this secret garden will shine for you for all eternity, and I shall wait for you here on each night that the stars twinkle. Do not keep me waiting too long.

home.line: I knew you would return. Heehee... Not even you can escape the Unhulde's clutches.

login.line: You revealed yourself at the appropriate time. Such an obedient little familiar... Now that the banquet's guests of honor are here, the stars have begun to shine for you.

main1.line: Have you forgotten? In order to dance with the Unhulde, you must first make the appropriate preparations. It seems my familiar is a touch impatient.

main2.line: My dress is beautiful, you say? Shouldn't those eyes of yours be focusing on something more valuable than my attire? Heehee.

main3.line: I am satisfied with you tonight. You may have this dance as a reward... I ask that you decide when it ends.

mission.line: The ceremony cannot continue until you are finished with your "missions."

touch.line: You will put more tension into those arms and hold me tightly... that's right. Very good.

touch2.line: Do what you will in the Unhulde's garden. It won't make a difference.

unlock.line: Welcome to the Unhulde's secret garden, my familiar. I have prepared this night banquet for you alone. Now then... if you would please step forth.

battle.line: Soldiers, weigh anchor! For the glory of Sardegna!

couple_encourage1.line: A leader who second-guesses herself is no leader at all.

couple_encourage2.line: For the glory of the Empire!

detail.line: I don't mind you acting as my own Rustichello. In fact, I adore having someone who chronicles my life. Oh, but please do omit my mistakes!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Take it from me, you really ought to venture out with them to see the sights of the world more often.

feeling1.line: If not for your position, I would've sent you away to... Never you mind. Hmph!

feeling2.line: Oh? You're approaching me? Instead of keeping me at arm's length, you wish to get to know me? Then by all means... Hehehe!

feeling3.line: You possess insight and views superior to those of commonplace boors. But, as it stands, you could use some more... well, ambition.

feeling4.line: You command a whole fleet of ships, and you don't even try to use them to spread the Empire's– I mean, your own glory? It truly baffles me.

feeling5.line: You! What is the deal with you? I never said you should "spread the glory of Marco Polo's name!" You... You... You're too ambitious for your own good!

headtouch.line: I've been meaning to ask... Why do you always behave so childishly?

home.line: I believe the secretary should have the power to issue commands. Only while you're away, of course.

hp_warning.line: Danger is an opportunity! Have at you!

login.line: So you've come prepared to sacrifice a portion of your time on this mortal coil in the name of productivity? Magnificent!

lose.line: You wretches... I will inflict this humiliation back at you a hundred times over!

mail.line: A letter of surrender from our enemies? Then allow me to establish our terms.

main1.line: All things of value are bound to fall into someone's hands, sooner or later. Better it be yours than someone else's.

main2.line: The golden Dragon Empery... I have countless stories of it to share if you'll only lend me an ear!

main3.line: Looking at the map... This port is unbelievably small. Has the thought of expanding it never crossed your mind?

mission.line: New missions? Be magnificent and get them done in a jiffy, okay? Chop-chop.

mission_complete.line: You've finished those chores? Magnificent! Now we can focus on more important matters.

profile.line: I am Marco Polo, Sardegnian battleship. Compare me with Veneto if you so wish, but just for the record: I could do her job much better. Ohohoho!

propose.line: A woman with great aspirations doesn't let commitments bind her. But... for you, I'll make an exception. And don't you dare vanish on me until your ambitions are realized!

touch.line: For what have I been summoned?

touch2.line: Tsk! Such boorish behavior...

unlock.line: I hope you know what you're in for, now that you've awoken me. Hehehe... You look to be a commander of valor and culture. Magnificent! I am Marco Polo. Now, come! Our first order of business is to spread the Sardegna Empire's glory through the world!

upgrade.line: The greater one's strength, the more privileges one is entitled to. You know this, yes? Magnificent!

win_mvp.line: They're surrendering already? So... We won? What pathetic adversaries we have.

gift_prefer.line: I graciously accept this sincere gift of yours. Heheheh!

detail_ex.line: You wish to add a new chapter to the life story of Marco Polo? Magnificent. So, what will you write? You simply must include my ambition, of course... but you might wish to add something about our ordinary days of love as well!

feeling5_ex.line: It was always my dream to conquer all I laid my eyes upon. However, I have now found a magnificent dream that will bring me even greater satisfaction. That's right. It is to carve the name of Marco Polo onto everything you do and accomplish!

headtouch_ex.line: Does this please you? Very well. Do as you wish.

home_ex.line: I organized today's work while you were absent. And now let's finish them together! For this is the responsibility we share!

login_ex.line: Come, Commander, let us achieve magnificent things together in our sugar-sweet days. I can hardly wait to begin!

main4_ex.line: Your talents are wasted on that trifling paperwork! The real battlefield is not here, but out there! We really need to be applying our efforts to formulating expansion and changing the game!

main5_ex.line: My domain is your domain, and my status is your status. In other words, they are the result of our combined efforts! How magnificent!

main6_ex.line: How strange... I haven't had a single response to the collaboration plan I put out. Did I overestimate their efficiency?

touch_ex.line: Have you thought of a way to achieve our ambitions? Not yet? Hehehe... What perfect timing, for I have an idea to share right now!

touch2_ex.line: You know, no matter how much time passes, you always – Mngh?!

detail.line: I've been told many desire to be in a position where they can give you hands-on assistance – like a maid does. Which is to say: I am envied by everyone around me. Hehehe, hehehehe~

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Someone must receive them, but who?

home.line: Where, oh where is my master who refuses to delegate work to a maid? Here, I've taken these duties upon myself in your stead.

login.line: Hm-hm~♪ Have you no orders for your maid? You're hardly the authoritative master I'd imagined.

mail.line: I've left your letter right over there. It's as easy to reach as possibly can be.

main1.line: Interested to learn a trick, Anchorage? Watch this card... Tadah! It's gone! Oh, silly Commander. A magician never reveals her secrets.

main2.line: I wonder how many maids our port has... And of them, how many are assigned to the Commander's office and personal quarters... Stop it, Marco! There's no point in pondering that question!

main3.line: Is it not a maid's duty to issue a slap on the wrist when her master procrastinates? Hehehe! How magnificent that you understand!

mission.line: You've been given new missions. Fascinating how announcing that is part of a maid's duties...

touch.line: Routine tasks, making meals, greeting guests, filing paperwork, hatching plans, doing battle... I can perform anything you require!

touch2.line: Hwaaah?!

unlock.line: Me? Serve as your maid? Oho! That's more like it, Commander! How magnificent and ambitious of you! ...Only temporarily? And you're content with that?

win_mvp.line: Acting on the Commander's behalf, I raise a toast to this victory!

detail.line: How strange... The box's hidden door won't open. Keep your composure, Marco Polo. You can't afford to show any weakness... Just strike a pose before the Commander realizes there's something amiss! Nrk! My arm's gone to sleep!

feeling5.line: That's quite some nerve you have. You know my objective is not as simple as it seems, yet you still chose to approach. I'm going to find it even harder to let you go than ever before!

headtouch.line: I-I'm in the middle of my performance! What about my hat? There's nothing hidden underneath it!

home.line: Come, Commander, forget about any hidden doors and focus on my show. Perhaps if you watch carefully from right up close, you might be able to see through the trick.

login.line: What do you think? There's nothing to it, even when I'm stuck inside a box and immobile. Now, will you engage in this thrilling challenge with me?

main1.line: Time to perform a miracle... Heehee! Well, Commander, did my perfect finale blow you away?

main2.line: Mmgh! Nnngh! A problem with the stage? That's impossible – I'm Marco Polo! This interval is the perfect thing to add a little excitement to my performance! I have everything under control!

main3.line: This is an intriguing outfit, don't you think? Oh? It suits me, does it? Say, why are you looking at me like that?

touch.line: It's just a little trick. You have nothing to be afraid of... Now, hurry up and come in!

touch2.line: Now that you have dared to come this close, I... I won't let you get away!

unlock.line: Welcome to Marco Polo's magic show! Make sure you watch closely, Commander, and pay attention! Don't get too engrossed in the entertainment, now! Ooohohoho!

win_mvp.line: Did you see that? My magnificent performance!

battle.line: We have ample intelligence and ammunition. Time to put some fear into those unprepared buffoons!

detail.line: The only subjects worthy of my study are the ones that are utterly incomprehensible to mundane minds. Hmm... The solution to this one can't possibly be as simple as it looks. Heheh... I already have an idea. Let's start the experiment right away!

expedition.line: Commander, the commission has been completed. I'll go pick the team's brains!

feeling1.line: I thought I could learn so much from you, but it looks like I'll have to be the teacher now. *sigh*...

feeling2.line: Ahem... Commander, did you need me for something? Otherwise, I don't know why you'd be staring so much... Yes, I know – I watch you in my peripheral vision. So? Do you want to learn something, or do you think that my earnest work is worth learning from?

feeling3.line: Commander, let's go read in the library today. Ugh, you have work? Hmm... Then I'll bring a book here! I can study anywhere as long as you're there with me!

feeling4.line: This is such a weird feeling... My heart won't stop pounding. Could this be... love's ultimate puzzle?! Have you encountered this puzzle, too, Commander?

feeling5.line: Commander, do you remember that puzzle I mentioned? Well... I think I've figured out the solution! Heheh, I'll show you the most beautiful mathematical proof. Just you watch!

headtouch.line: Mreow?! Hands off my headband, please!

home.line: Commander, work-life balance matters. Get some rest. I already know what needs to be done, so rest assured – I'll handle it.

hp_warning.line: So this is real combat... It's a lot harder than my simulations!

login.line: Your work documents are ready. Start whenever you feel like. Heheh... It was no big deal. I just considered what I would want if I were in your shoes – Oh? It looks like double your usual work? That can't be... I thought I'd reduced it...

lose.line: I lost? Well, that removes one suboptimal path... Let's run it back!

mail.line: New correspondence has come for you. I'll go get it – it's hardly fair to waste your study time on trivial matters.

main1.line: Ahem... I have more than one method at my disposal to solve this. See here? This presents a totally new perspective. Huh? You've found a logical flaw? That can't be... I checked this so many times! Commander, think harder before you offer a conclusion!

main2.line: *sigh*... I've explained this three times. How can people still not understand it? How do they plan to pass the exam... Huh? Do I look smug right now? H-heh...

main3.line: They were doing research in this story, but they left it unfinished! Commander, we need to follow up on this! Right now! To the laboratory we go! Even if it blows up, this is vital!

main4.line: Wow... The port library has so many more books than I imagined... Huh? This one is clearly on the wrong shelf... Heheh, I've studied collections management. Time to put my knowledge to practice!

mission.line: A new mission? Fantastic! Let's keep our brains limber and agile!

mission_complete.line: The process of completing a mission involves the acquisition and application of knowledge... Is this how you learn, Commander?

profile.line: I'm Vittorio Cuniberti of the Sardegna Empire. My passion is researching pioneering subjects. Of course, if you need my knowledge put into practice, I'm more than happy to oblige.

propose.line: Commander... Love is such a difficult puzzle to solve. Heheh, I'VE already found the perfect solution, but I can't just share it with you... All you need to know is that you, yourself, are the solution. Because from now on, you'll take my hand and lead the way... won't you?

skill.line: Now you'll see what raw knowledge can do!

touch.line: Hmm... Meow?! Geez, you scared me! ...Oh?! I just had a flash of inspiration!

touch2.line: I-I-I have a question! The optimal sequence of romantic development should mean that the next step is... Argh, what was it? Why can't I remember?!

unlock.line: Good day to you, Commander. I am Vittorio Cuniberti, a Sardegnian destroyer. It's a pleasure. From now on... Hmm? You're hankering for an academic discussion? I'd be delighted! Tell me, what should we discuss? If mew want... I-I mean, ahem!

upgrade.line: Heheh. Yet more knowledge for me.

win_mvp.line: Heheh... A textbook victory.

gift_prefer.line: I've never seen this before! Fascinating!

detail_ex.line: Commander, I'm here to help you work! Hup... There, this is a good spot... Hm? Why am I sitting in your lap? To better assist you, of course. Now I can scrub your face for you, and more!

expedition_ex.line: Commander, the commission team just got back. Let's go see if they made any new discoveries!

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, are you ever going to ask how I solved love's ultimate puzzle? Heheh, give me a hug, and I might just tell... Eep?! Y-you're bridal carrying me?! We're in public! But in this position, it's easy to do this... Mwah! This was the ultimate solution... that I wanted to share with you.

headtouch_ex.line: You made a total mess of my hair! Geez, you'd better fix this before I go to the library!

home_ex.line: Welcome back! While you were gone, I encountered eleven unexpected issues in my experiments, and I found it difficult to focus on studying... Did I miss a more complex issue – the issue of missing you, perhaps?

login_ex.line: Finally... Finally, I can calculate your daily workload with perfect precision! How did I do it? Heheh, consider it a logic puzzle... Ahem! Promise me a reward, and I'll tell you. What will it be, Commander?

lose_ex.line: ...I've already found our failing. Come, Commander. We must analyze it!

main5_ex.line: So many people have been coming to me with questions lately, even some of the top ones... Does this mean they actually like my explanations? Hmm... I like it, heheh.

main6_ex.line: Critical thinking and self-reflection will help develop good study habits! Once I've conquered this subject, you can rely on me for everything, Commander. Heheheh...!

main7_ex.line: Hmm... Cooking is harder than I thought. Oil keeps splashing onto my clothes, and the pots and pans are so easy to get burned on... Was home ec always this difficult?

main8_ex.line: Commander, I finally learned how to make cupcakes! Tadaaa! Don't they look good? ...Huh? You can't look away from your work right now? Then what if I hand-fed you... like this! Mreow?! Y-you bit my finger!

mail_ex.line: I'll go get your mail. Along the way, I'll try to figure out this tricky problem...

mission_ex.line: You've got new missions again! More tasks mean more brain activity, which enhances learning... I see. Work exists to help us learn more! It all makes sense now!

mission_complete_ex.line: Your work efficiency is skyrocketing! Did you learn a new methodology? Teach me!

touch_ex.line: Staaare... I'm analyzing you right now. Heheh, I could study you for a lifetime and never get bored!

touch2_ex.line: I'm even starting to understand this touchy-feely stuff a little... Check out my solution to this one, Commander...!

upgrade_ex.line: Behold the power of knowledge!

win_mvp_ex.line: Heheh! Victory was the expected outcome.

detail.line: Purr, purr... Purr, purr... This is how cats get their owners' attention. When they do that, their owner needs to scratch under their chin... Then, they'll be happy!

feeling5.line: Commander, I've cracked the code of feline courtship! Heheh, showing their bellies is just one way. See... Hyah?! My bra strap slid off?! D-don't look! Look, and I'll bite! Grrr, chomp!

headtouch.line: Mreow?! You should know that cats' ears aren't to be touched so flippantly!

home.line: Zzz... Mmnh... Commander, welcome back... Huh?! I-I wasn't sleeping! Cats only ACTUALLY sleep for four to five hours a day – the rest of the time, they're just dozing!

login.line: Commander, I think I'm starting to understand how cats feel... Why, I'm practically dying to bat at that cat toy. Kitties must feel the same way, don't you think?!

main1.line: Commander, I'll get bored if you just keep waving around the same toy all day. Can you pick a new toy? I have yarn, and... Huh? What's with this belt? Do cats like belts?

main2.line: I'm the one who spilled the milk. Cats like to do that, so... Oh! Can I play with it more?

main3.line: Geez, Commander... I understand it's easy to get distracted by how cute those cats are, but we're in the middle of important research! You should be focusing on me!

main4.line: Why did I lick my glove? Because it's where you just touched. This is how a cat learns her owner's scent.

touch.line: Hyah?! C-Commander! Do NOT touch my tail without permission! I'll bite!

touch2.line: Commander, where did you learn to do that? I-it feels nice...

unlock.line: To study an animal's habits, you must first learn and imitate... B-basically, what I'm doing is imitating how cats do things! Don't read into this!

battle.line: I shall take you on.

detail.line: A pleasure to see you today. I hope to spend another wonderful day with you today, dear Commander. Mhm, quite the reason to rejoice.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Let us rejoice now, dear Commander.

feeling1.line: Rejoice, dear Commander, for you can still turn to me for help now.

feeling2.line: You may rely on me more, Commander. After all, my duty is to help you help everyone.

feeling3.line: I don't know too much about the Royal Maid Corps. Since I support you just as they do, there should not be much difference in our positions. Do you agree, dear Commander?

feeling4.line: Rejoice, dear Commander, for I shall be assisting the Royal Maids today. ...With the assistance of my colleagues, I shall be able to support you to an even greater capacity –a reason to rejoice indeed.

feeling5.line: Commander, are there any wishes you'd like to have fulfilled today? I am no longer here just to support you. Should you desire, I shall assist you, serve you, and of course, love you... Rejoice, dear Commander, for there is nothing I will not do for your sake.

headtouch.line: Your hand feels most pleasing upon my head. Thank you.

home.line: Rejoice, dear Commander—I have come to bring you a full-course Sardegnian meal. ...It's too heavy, you say?

hp_warning.line: I'm ashamed to show you my unsightly side...

login.line: Rejoice, dear Commander, for this morning is most refreshing. How shall we start our day?

lose.line: So this is the taste of defeat, Commander. How repugnant.

mail.line: Rejoice, dear Commander, for new mail has arrived.

main1.line: Oh, do be careful now... Miss Edinburgh, it seems that the rumors of your clumsiness were... not greatly exaggerated.

main2.line: Did you need some papers disposed of. *BOOM* ...There you go. Rejoice, for I have turned your troubles into a pile of ash!

main3.line: Having trouble focusing on your work? Well, I suppose I could tell you a fairy tale. A long, long time ago...

mission.line: A new mission has arrived, Commander. Allow me to– Hmm? You're going to do it yourself?

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards are here. Let's open it—it'll be destroyed if I fire a shell at it? Understood.

profile.line: I am the blueprint ship Plymouth, an alternate branch of the Edinburgh class. I give my thanks to you for manifesting me in this port. Please, use me as you see fit.

propose.line: Rejoice, dear Commander! Starting today, I shall become your exclusive-use shipgirl! By exclusive, I mean special... Basically, I've become someone special to you, so can I stop looking after you today and just rejoice for myself? Heehee~

touch.line: You'd like to hear me sing? Then, please tell me what you'd like to hear—if it's something I don't already know, I'm willing to learn.

touch2.line: Yes, do as you please with me. As long as it makes you rejoice, dear Commander.

unlock.line: I offer my greetings to you who has manifested me, Commander. I am the blueprint ship, Plymouth. Starting here and now, I stand ready to execute your every order. May you rejoice in our blessed encounter.

upgrade.line: Strength flows through me. Rejoice, dear Commander, for I have become "easier to use."

win_mvp.line: Victory is ours. Rejoice, dear Commander.

gift_prefer.line: I want you to be pleased, Commander, because you've made me very happy.

battle_ex.line: What would you have me do, dear Commander?

detail_ex.line: A pleasure to see you today. As you can see, I am currently partaking in a tea party with my esteemed colleagues. Why don't you join us? Let's find you a seat... How about in my lap?

home_ex.line: Commander, how do the refreshments look? I made a light snack set for you today. Well then, please help yourself!

login_ex.line: Rejoice, dear Commander, for today is yet another wonderful day. Please feel free to ask anything of me.

main4_ex.line: "Please leave everything to me, Master." ...How was my impression of Belfast? Hehehe.

main5_ex.line: Commander, while you look for those documents, why don't I tell you a story? That might help you focus.

main6_ex.line: How about reading a book for a change of pace? I don't mind lending you something from my personal collection. Mhm, please rejoice.

mission_complete_ex.line: The mission rewards are right here. Other than carrying them back, is there anything else I can help with?

touch_ex.line: Hmmhm~♪ Please make your next song request! Ask anything of me.!

touch2_ex.line: You don't need to hold back, dear Commander.

win_mvp_ex.line: Was this victory worthy of rejoicing? If not, I shall seek out another foe.

battle.line: This is rather embarrassing, but...

detail.line: Are you satisfied after seeing me in my swimsuit? If you'd like to see me in another outfit, just give me your order. W-whether it's a maid outfit, or a bunny girl outfit... as long as it makes you rejoice...?

home.line: Good work on your mission. Is there anything you'd like me to get for you, dear Commander? Since we're at the pool, how about... some toys, some fruits, and some wine? How does that sound?

login.line: Rejoice, dear Commander, the sun's rays shine as splendidly as usual — which means, it's a perfect day for a soak in the pool.

main1.line: Dear Commander, if you are feeling restless, might I recommend taking a dip with me in the refreshing water?

main2.line: You want some song suggestions? Well, if you're fine with the kind of screamo Miss Ulrich has been showing me, then... Oh, I don't need to sing it for you?

main3.line: Will you be swimming? Then let me make the pool larger... Excuse me, would you mind getting out of range of my main battery? Oh... Dearie me.
