mission_complete.line: The mission rewards have arrived. Rejoice, dear Commander.

touch.line: Sure, let's laze around together.

touch2.line: Revel in me. Rejoice to your heart's content, dear Commander.

unlock.line: Rejoice, Commander. I have no doubt that this refreshing sensation will bring you the utmost satisfaction. Come, let us enjoy this experience together.

win_mvp.line: Be it the cooling waves or the taste of victory, please indulge as much as you'd like, dear Commander.

feeling5.line: You can ask me for anything. I can adjust your pillow, or I can let you listen to my heartbeat... Whatever you may need. I love you, after all.

headtouch.line: Is my warmth soothing? If my face isn't enough, I can let you try other places, too.

home.line: Well done on your mission. I'll perform a special full-body physical for you now, so please lie down.

login.line: Commander, it's almost time for your physical. I hope this outfit I picked out will help you relax.

main1.line: Is the bed uncomfortable to lie on? Wait just a moment... Okay, I've disposed of all beds of that model. Instead, you may use me as your bed. I'll hold you tight so you can sleep well.

main2.line: Are you nervous about your physical? I can offer you some special, relaxing care to help you. Please enjoy...

main3.line: Ah! Commander, your heart is racing. Lie down and let me examine you, okay?

touch.line: I came running as soon as I heard your voice. I'll take your temperature now.

touch2.line: Please do whatever you'd like, until you're satisfied. It's good for the body and the mind.

unlock.line: Rejoice, Commander – I will be assisting you with your physical. If you feel any discomfort at all, please let me know at once.

battle.line: Victory will be mine!

couple_encourage1.line: That dummkopf is mine, you hear?!

detail.line: Tuning my rigging should just take a little... Whoa, calm down! Heed my damn command! ...You! Stop gawking and help me! It's only the obvious thing to do!

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I wonder what tributes they've brought me.

feeling1.line: Get out of my sight. You're an eyesore.

feeling2.line: You should be thankful that someone such as myself would even deign to call a complete nobody like you "Commander."

feeling3.line: Hmph. I've taken a slight interest in you since I can see a smidge of potential within you. Then again, that much should be obvious given that I call you "Commander."

feeling4.line: You belong to no one but me, Prinz Rupprecht. That should be obvious, seeing as how I have acknowledged you as "Commander." Do you have a problem with being mine? Too bad – you've never had and never will have the right to object!

feeling5.line: You don't want to be mine? You have some nerve, you impudent cretin. You are mine, full stop. I don't give a damn what anyone else says! You belong to me, and that's that!

headtouch.line: Blep!

home.line: Look who's back. I suppose you have your moments as the Commander♪

hp_warning.line: How?! But, I'm the strongest...!

login.line: You're late! What excuse do you have to keep ME waiting? Do you WANT me to send you packing?

lose.line: You're horribly mistaken if you think you'll get away with this!

mail.line: A letter... Nothing I'd care about, it seems.

main1.line: A tea party? Who went and decided I have to spend my time on that? If anything, YOU should be spending time with ME♪

main2.line: ...Oh, this sweet candy? I got it from a destroyer. And no, you can't have any.

main3.line: You can't even do this no-brainer work? And you seriously call yourself the Commander? ...Things would be better if I had your position.

mission.line: Missions, eh... Do them yourself. I'm above all that busywork.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards! I've claimed them in my na– What the hell! This is just a list!

profile.line: I'm Prinz Rupprecht, Iron Blood blueprint ship. It's my way or the highway. Hmph, obviously I get to act high and mighty because I AM high and mighty. I don't HAVE to follow your orders, they are merely suggestions to me!

propose.line: Marriage? What are you talking about? This is an act of insolence on your part, one-sidedly hoping I'll exchange vows with you. Obviously, it's my choice whether to accept or refuse... If you want my hand so badly, cry and plead for it one more time! And don't try to run away!

skill.line: Hahahaha! I'll squash you like bugs!

touch.line: What's that you're staring at? Hand it over. I want to see it for myself.

touch2.line: Eek! Don't touch me!

unlock.line: Ooh, so you're the self-proclaimed Commander, huh... Hmph! Commander of what, exactly? From now on, I shall be the one issuing commands around here! Now, hurry along~♪

upgrade.line: It's the obvious choice, because I am the strongest♪

win_mvp.line: Me being the MVP is such an obvious outcome I don't even feel happy about it.

gift_prefer.line: What a sweet tribute. It's mine now!

battle_ex.line: Hahaha! Let them have it!

detail_ex.line: Just how weak are you if this little thing is too heavy for you? ...Heehee, I'll admit, your weakness is endearing♪ H-hey, don't go away! I'm sorry I said that, just stay with me!

expedition_ex.line: The commission team is back♪ ...Now get out there and receive them!

feeling5_ex.line: You'll obviously do anything I tell you to since you belong to me, right? Because I've been shockingly nice by calling you "Commander," accepting your ring, and even going on dates with you! Now take my hand!

home_ex.line: Head out and thank the girls? You go do it, then come right back. You're my property, so don't wander off without my permission.

login_ex.line: You actually came out to see me – that's nice. Now get back to your chair and work harder♪

main4_ex.line: Forget going to some random girl's tea party – You should host one just for me. Obviously I deserve it for all my work as your secretary!

main5_ex.line: I think I'll go part hunting in Bismarck's workshop... "Don't?" Excuse me, whose side are you on?!

main6_ex.line: You've done well, now enjoy some time off... I was just talking to myself. I don't care if you– Actually! Since you belong to me, you must take a break with me... Impudent little...! Stop working at once, you hear me?!

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission rewards are here. Let's not forget what's yours is mine.

touch_ex.line: Yes? ...Don't call me over only to ignore me!

touch2_ex.line: Wh-what?! Um... (*blushes*)

win_mvp_ex.line: I'm the MVP♪ ...Look at me when I speak. Hey, I'm talking to YOU! Look at me and tell me how great I am!

detail.line: You are mine, and that means everything you make is mine as well! Nom! ...What'd you call this candied fruit thing? "Tanghulu"? It's sour yet sweet, and surprisingly tasty...

feeling5.line: You belong to me, which obviously means you have a duty to amuse me! Understood, simpleton? You're to give me a full tour of the port's Spring Festival makeover! Hold my hand and show me around! That's your job!

home.line: They've changed my port so drastically I don't know what's what anymore... I should've stayed home since the Commander's away... Whuah?! C-Commander?!

login.line: So for the Spring Festival, a carp is needed as decoration, which then turns into a dragon... Doesn't make any sense to me. Besides, how in the world is a fish supposed to turn into... Whuah?! What the heck was that?!

lose.line: They... beat us? They beat ME?! There's no way...

main1.line: Ägir mentioned a lion that dances in the air – I want to check it out... If I SAY it flies, then it FLIES, okay?! And you're going with me, obviously!

main2.line: A red envelope? Are you that strapped for cash even though you run this place? ...Hm? You're giving it to me? I don't want it! Blep!

main3.line: Here's what happens to idiots who don't pay attention to me! Hahaha! That's right, run in fear from my firecrackers!

touch.line: Where did that cretin bumble off to... Hyeep?! D-don't just sneak up on me out of the blue!

touch2.line: D-don't you dare blame it on my dress!

unlock.line: Woah, so this is the Dragon Empery's "Spring Festival" that I've heard so much about. But, why are they celebrating it in the middle of winter? And you, Commander – why are you helping with such a grandiose... Whuah?! What was that noise?!

win_mvp.line: Hmph! There's your victory! You'll obviously reward me for my efforts, yes?

expedition.line: Oh, the commission team is back. Someone should receive them... b-but that can wait, can't it?

feeling5.line: Hmph! I can have all kinds of fun right here! I can swim in the pool, watch the fireworks, think about all the fun we're gonna have... F-forget that last one!

home.line: I waited for you here this whole time. Why didn't I just ride something by myself? *whispering* Because I didn't wanna get lost... Shush, I said nothing! I waited here because I WANTED to!

login.line: First, you're coming with me to check out all the night attractions, then we'll go somewhere quiet, and then... Go on, come up with a route plan♪

main1.line: You belong to me, so this amusement park also belongs to me! That obviously means I get to ride any attraction whenever I want! ...So, which one do you wanna go on?

main2.line: The fireworks are nice to look at, but we could've done so much else if you'd come sooner... Blep!

main3.line: I'm feeling kind of hungry... Speaking of which, do these stalls charge money? Can't YOU get food for free if you ask for it?

mission.line: New missions... Will you stick around if I help with them?

mission_complete.line: Go get the mission rewards already! They belong to me, so obviously you should be quick♪

touch.line: Ahahaha! Take this! *splash splash*

touch2.line: Wh-what do you think you're doing?!

unlock.line: You're late! I've been waiting ages for you! ...We never agreed to meet tonight? If I say we did, then we did! Anyway, you should feel bad! That's obvious!

win_mvp.line: I did it! Heheh, did you see that? You must have! ...See what? Me mopping the floor with them, duh!

battle.line: Everyone, follow me!

detail.line: Commander, if there's anything on your mind, just lay 'em on me! Let's not beat around the bush.

expedition.line: Oh, it looks like our friends are back from their commission! Perfect timing, Commander, let's throw a welcoming banquet!

feeling1.line: A soldier's failure dooms one, but a general's failure dooms the whole army. You're the Commander, so get your act together already!

feeling2.line: If you're not busy, want to step out for a chat? Haha, there's nothing to be embarrassed about. The best way to get to know someone is to have a nice, long chat with them, right?

feeling3.line: What do you do on your days off? I... like going out with my friends, I guess. Get some good food and drinks. It's a great change of pace! Oh right, since we have free time today, let's go do that right now!

feeling4.line: Commander, c'mon, let's get going! Go where, you say? Lemme think... Oh yeah, how about looking for some enemies to beat the crap out of? It's dangerous? Hah, not when I'm by your side!

feeling5.line: I've been thinking, Commander. You should totally become mine. We'll go through heaven and hell together, get drunk off glory and riches together, and if you're ever in danger, I'll be there to protect you. Now that's what you call a whirlwind romance! Ahaha!

home.line: You must be tired from all that running around, right? Want me to help you relax? I can draw the bathwater for you, or give you a massage... You in?

hp_warning.line: If you think you've got what it takes, come at me!

login.line: Mornin', Commander. Need help with anything today? There's no need to be shy - just say the word!

lose.line: Retreat now – I'll handle things over here!

mail.line: I picked up the mail for you on the way here. Hurry up and take a look!

main1.line: Commander, want to cap off work with a bit of wine? Of course, you're free to drink something else. Gotta treat yourself right after a day of hard work, right?

main2.line: Hai Tien's always sayin' stuff like "you are what you eat," but she's always guzzling down those chilis like it's nobody's business. If you ask me, the best food is whatever fills your belly.

main3.line: Chen Hai's out there doing divinations on the cosmos before she makes her move, but I'm the complete opposite. Hit first, ask questions later! Hahaha!

mission.line: Another job, huh? Just leave it to me. I'll have everything sorted out for you.

mission_complete.line: Well done! I'll hand out the rewards, so you just worry about getting rested up.

profile.line: The name's Harbin, light cruiser from the Dragon Empery. What, didn't expect to see me here? Ahaha, well, life is full of surprises. In any case, I don't plan on letting you down, and neither do my guns!

propose.line: Looks like you've already made up your mind. But, this venue isn't lively enough... Let's find an auspicious day and invite all our friends over for a huge banquet. I'm gonna invite everyone, so you better yell my name out to the world!

touch.line: If you have time to burn, wanna see one of my comedy skits? Hahaha, I've got quite a few little hobbies outside of fightin'.

touch2.line: Oho? You've got guts. Real punchable guts.

unlock.line: The name's Harbin, Dragon Empery light cruiser. You're the Commander of this joint? Hrmm... I like the look in your eyes, and your bod's not half-bad either... Good stuff! From now on, you're rollin' with me!

upgrade.line: Hahaha! I'm itchin' for a fight!

win_mvp.line: Hmph, absolutely pathetic. Not even worthy of being my playthings.

gift_prefer.line: You're too kind. You're gonna make me blush! Hahahah!

battle_ex.line: I'll take up the front!

detail_ex.line: Commander, looks like work's not going too well right now – so, I brought some wine over. C'mon, tell me everything that's on your mind, alright?

expedition_ex.line: The commission team is back. Let's take a look... Alrighty! I've got everything I need to make some tasty snacks!

feeling5_ex.line: I heard that a "date" is a great way for two people to learn more about each other. Well, you choose the restaurant then, and I'll cover the bill. Let's treat ourselves to some kick-ass food and liquor! ...That's not it? Did I misunderstand something? I thought that's what it said in one of those novels...

home_ex.line: Welcome back. I made a reservation with the place you love going to, so let's head over once you're done. Ah, right, why don't you cool down in the shower first?

login_ex.line: Mornin', Commander. Did you eat already? Hmm? My arm's too close to you? Pfft, who cares? We're already an item, right?

lose_ex.line: Heh... Even if I fall here, you're not laying a finger on my friends!

main4_ex.line: I've been hearing for the longest time about how there are a handful of girls here who can hold their liquor. Turns out, it wasn't just empty talk... Commander, you've gotta bring me to the next drinking party!

main5_ex.line: I dropped by the Sardegnian dorms last time, and color me surprised when they showed me to a massive outdoor bath! They even invited me to bathe with them... Damn, that was awesome~

main6_ex.line: If only you also had rigging like me, I'd totally look forward to fighting alongside you. But since you're defenseless, you've no choice but to stay behind me for protection! Ahaha!

mission_ex.line: We've got another job coming up. Why not treat it as some light exercise? You'll get rusty if you sit at your desk all day.

mission_complete_ex.line: Another job done. The two of us make an unstoppable duo. Let's keep up the pace and pick up the rewards as well.

touch2_ex.line: Even a girl like me has her charms, huh? Hahaha!

win_mvp_ex.line: A crushing victory! Let's celebrate with a banquet when we get back home!

detail.line: It's cool. If you wanna look, go right ahead! I got this swimsuit just because I wanted you to see me in it, after all!

expedition.line: The commission team just got back. How about we invite them along? The more, the merrier!

home.line: Take a hot bath, and you wanna stay in there a bit longer. Go in the ocean, and you wanna start swimming. See what I mean? When people go places, it changes the way they feel.

login.line: Commander, you've got some damn nerve makin' me wait... Hah! Hahaha! Got you! Long as you're here, I don't care!

main1.line: Are those the Four Unbreakables over there? Looks like they're buildin' a sand castle together... How about we make one of our own?

main2.line: They say if you hold french fries on the beach, seagulls flock you. We brought french fries, right? Wanna give it a try?!

main3.line: Look, I reserved this whole beach to be alone with you so that... Huh? The other girls will see? Damn... You've got it rough, bud.

mission_complete.line: Mission rewards, huh? Aw damn, they gave us frozen watermelon! Now there's a stroke of luck. I was just thinkin' of how to cool down!

touch.line: Ooh, you wanna wrestle in the water? I'm not goin' easy on you! Take this!

touch2.line: Look at you, goin' for it out in the open... Yikes.

unlock.line: Pheeew! I just love blue skies and a fair ocean breeze. Since you're already here, Commander, set aside all the boring paperwork and business stuff, and come enjoy the waves!

detail.line: Commander? What's up? Let me buy you something you want! Can't believe you're being so modest with me, of all people... You see my credit card here? Use it as much as you want!

expedition.line: The commission team's back. Go see 'em! ...Hm? You want me to come, too? Then let's get going right now!

feeling5.line: Heyo, Commander. Are you enjoying the luxuries of the cruise I bought us? Hahaha, hey, it's no big deal. If there's anything else you want, or if someone starts trouble with you, come to me! That's what love is all about, right?

home.line: Someone's looking chipper. You been having fun out there? Oh, if you saw something you like, tell me. I'll buy it for you!

login.line: Finally here, eh? I've been waiting for ages! Was I bored? Nah. I had a lot of fun thinkin' about how I could cook you... Ahahaha! I'm just kidding!

main1.line: Commander, you haven't tried a salt and milk bath yet, have you? No idea what I'm talking about, huh? I'll do it for you next time I wash your back!

main2.line: Money doesn't magically appear when you're born, and you can't take it with you when you die. What I'm saying is, use it while you can. If I can make you happy, then that's enough return on investment for me!

main3.line: Hahaha, wanna go play poker? Yeah, fine by me! I'll deal and get you a few free wins!

mission.line: Do you have new missions? Man, and I was just getting comfy... Nah. If you've got work to do, then let me help. Let's get it done quick!

mission_complete.line: Finished your missions? Great work! Wanna spar a bit after you rest?

touch.line: Did my button come out? Is that a problem? ...Okay, if it bothers you that much, can you fix it for me?

touch2.line: Hah! I'm amazed you can do that in broad daylight. You wanna get cooked, friend?

unlock.line: Hey, there you are. Remember what I said about the two of us being partners in crime? Well, actions speak louder than words, so I reserved this whole cruise for just the two of us. Whaddya say? Sound good, partner?

upgrade.line: Hahaha, as long as you're happy, I'm happy!

win_mvp.line: That all you got? Next time, bring someone a little stronger!

battle.line: I'll take up the front!

detail.line: By the way, d'you reckon I'm any different right now compared to my usual self? For example... a little more feminine, or something?

expedition.line: The commission team is back. Let's take a look... Alrighty! I've got everything I need to make some tasty snacks!

feeling5.line: I heard that a "date" is a great way for two people to learn more about each other. Well, you choose the restaurant then, and I'll cover the bill. Let's treat ourselves to some kick-ass food and liquor! ...That's not it? Did I misunderstand something? I thought that's what it said in one of those novels...

home.line: Geesh, just seeing you beaten and battered by the elements like that has me feeling bad for you, even if you don't think much of it. Hurry on in and take a warm shower, alright?

login.line: About to start on today's work? If you need any help, feel free to ask. We're practically family at this point, so whatever happens, we'll deal with it together.

lose.line: Heh... Even if I fall here, you're not laying a finger on my friends!

main1.line: Even the most passionate romances eventually become tamed by time... No, no! That simply can't be! Commander, for our next anniversary, let's do something crazy!

main2.line: Commander, I know we promised to go through hell and high water together, but I don't want to put you through hardships. What if you get hurt? ...Ugh, emotions really are so complicated.

main3.line: What kind of food are you in the mood for? I'll take you out to somewhere nice tomorrow! You're my lover now, so how could I let you dine on anything but the finest? Ahaha!

mission.line: We've got another job coming up. Why not treat it as some light exercise? You'll get rusty if you sit at your desk all day.

mission_complete.line: Another job done. The two of us make an unstoppable duo. Let's keep up the pace and pick up the rewards as well.

touch.line: If you want me to stay here with you, know that I'm not going anywhere.

touch2.line: Oho? If you're this enthusiastic, I suppose I'll take you up on it~

unlock.line: Sorry to keep you waiting, Commander. So, how's my new look? It's got me a bit embarrassed... But, well, all that matters is that you like it.

win_mvp.line: A crushing victory! Let's celebrate with a banquet when we get back home!

battle.line: Sometimes, you have to get your hands dirty.

detail.line: You're not just here to chat, are you? If you've got something important to say, spit it out. Just don't expect me to respond right away because I'm busy.

expedition.line: Commission complete. That's all she wrote. Nothing special.

feeling1.line: I'm actually curious as to how someone can keep failing over and over. You are an awful outlier.

feeling2.line: I sleep in my lab on most nights. There are some places to lie down, and for dinner you can always just order home delivery. Why don't you stay sometime, Commander?

feeling3.line: Ah! ...Another blackout. Yeah, it's a problem with my lab, not the port itself. All my tinkering has made the power really unstable. Just make yourself at home and wait for the lights to come back.

feeling4.line: You're more courageous than I took you for, Commander. What do I mean? Well, you know just how risky it is to be alone with me in this place... don't you?

feeling5.line: I'll be frank with you. I find you fairly... no, VERY fascinating, Commander. You're the one who leads the shipgirls at this port. It's not often someone gets the chance to closely examine you from the inside and out, wouldn't you say? Heehee♡

home.line: Back safe and sound, I see. Here's the after-action report with all the data sorted out. I'll leave the debriefing to you.

hp_warning.line: You're making this harder than it needs to be...!

login.line: Oh, so you're a real workhorse. Suppose I'll really have to apply myself as your secretary then.

lose.line: Tsk... I hate writing self-improvement reviews...

mail.line: Letter for you, Commander. Be sure to give it a read.

main1.line: Ugh... Wish there was some vodka in here... Your office is so much stricter than my lab when it comes to rules and the like.

main2.line: I'm curious – based on what criteria do you choose a secretary? Surely it's not just good looks? ...But if it is, don't be afraid to admit it♡

main3.line: I'd appreciate it if you'd let me handle data analysis in addition to office work. Work is boring, but I can stick to it longer when it involves something I'm good at.

mission.line: Here are some mission instructions for you. I can do overtime if it's for science, but I'd rather not for this type of work.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Maybe I'll get to return to my lab early today...

profile.line: I'm blueprint ship Chkalov, Project 71B aircraft carrier. I'll do a good job as long as you pay me, and if I ever ask for something, you can expect something in return. I hope we can have a mutually beneficial relationship.

propose.line: A ring, huh... So you'll be indebted to me if I accept it – is that right? Then I'll gladly take it. Sharing a special relationship with you works out nicely... because it makes it easier to examine your mind and body♡

touch.line: What's up? Want me to get you some coffee?

touch2.line: Need to vent some stress, do you? Heehee♡

unlock.line: Introductions? Fine, fine... I'm Chkalov, Northern Parliament blueprint ship. That good enough? Let's get back to work then; it's a better use of time for both of us, right?

upgrade.line: Well, that's one way of doing it.

win_mvp.line: Done already? Then, let's get moving. We're not getting paid to stand around.

gift_prefer.line: A gift? Don't get mad if I use this for an experiment, ok?

detail_ex.line: "How can your dear Miss Chkalov help, Commander?" ...Boo, you're no fun. I just thought I'd change the mood a bit since I know you're just here to chat.

expedition_ex.line: The commission team is back. With info on that date spot I had them check out, to boot. Heehee.

feeling5_ex.line: *yaaawn*... Commander? How long have you been up? Forgive me, I really went wild last night... It's fine if you don't remember. I don't really either... *yawn*... Your combat gear... It's really nice... Heehee... Zzz...

home_ex.line: Seems you made it home with no injuries. Externally, anyway... How do you feel? Do you feel you have a headache or any stomach pains? ...No? Then all is good.

login_ex.line: I've been waiting for you. Today's schedule includes office work, your examination, and... I think that's it. Want to go for lunch once we're done?

main4_ex.line: ...Mmm! I love starting the morning with vodka. Want a shot, Commander? Heehee, it actually works out very well for me if you get wasted.

main5_ex.line: Hey, you're not making any progress with your work. Don't hesitate to tell me if I'm distracting you. Heehee♡

main6_ex.line: *sigh*... Another request from Kronshtadt. What is it with her? Always demanding stuff from people – unlike you.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. Here's hoping you'll finish your work soon enough.

touch_ex.line: Ah, how about we go on a rejuvenating walk?

touch2_ex.line: You're excited, I see♡

win_mvp_ex.line: A juicy bonus, or an opportunity to examine you from head to toe... I'm fine with either one, Commander. Heehee.

detail.line: I like the sea breeze, but the sun is a bit much for me. Life in the lab makes you sensitive to sunlight, you see. On that note, try not to spend TOO much time in your office, Commander.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Oh, looks like they're running over to their friends. Shouldn't you go see them, Commander?

home.line: You look like you had a blast back there. I recommend getting some rest.

login.line: Hanging out, basking in the sunset's glow together... It's pretty nice, wouldn't you say?

main1.line: I've pinned down your swimsuit preferences after tracking your eyes and analyzing your phrasing when asked for feedback. Heehee.

main2.line: Still hard at work? You're hardly treating this like a vacation day. No, no, I know it's for the sake of all of us. You can expect a little something from me later.

main3.line: Seeing Northern Parliament girls take off their winter coats and put on skimpy swimwear must be a real treat. For you, that is.

mission.line: I hope inspiration will hit me as we go through these missions.

touch.line: I feel this occasion calls for a bottle of vodka.

touch2.line: "Come and give Ms. Chkalov a hug!" Heehee♡

unlock.line: Oh? What made you come over here instead of heading down to the beach? Surely you didn't ditch your friends on a hard-earned day off just to see me? But, I don't mind. It's called a day off because you get to decide how to spend your time.

win_mvp.line: Will you let me examine your body later, as a reward? No?

battle.line: You're up against a star today!

couple_encourage1.line: Heheh☆ Yoohoo!

detail.line: Guess who! ...Correct! High five for your BFF! Hehe.

expedition.line: Yoohoo, the commission team's back! Go thank them properly, okay? And thank ME for reminding you, too!

feeling1.line: Hmm... Even I can't help you if you keep that up...

feeling2.line: Yoohoo, Commander! It's important to keep up your spirits, so let's go to the amusement park and ride some roller coasters! I hear it's a great way to relieve stress.

feeling3.line: Yoohoo! I'm here to help you get through your overtime work! Guess what I brought you... Ooh, does it smell burnt? That's right – I made cookies to look like you! They look just like you apart from the whole "burnt to a crisp" thing, right?

feeling4.line: Yoohoo! I finished all the work you gave me. Do you know what you're supposed to do next? Huh? You DON'T? Then repeat after me: "Dmitri is the cutest! Dmitri is the awesomest!"

feeling5.line: Hey, Commander? I'm not as popular as I used to be, so... I'm leaving, and I'm never coming back– Ah?! C-Commander? C-cut it out, I was just messing with you! Wait, where are you taking me?!

headtouch.line: Whoa! You can just take my hat off if you want, you know. Like this... Huh? Come on, back to petting!

home.line: Yoohoo! Looks like I greeted you first again. If you need anything, leave it to me, okay? I'll have it done as perfectly as can be.

hp_warning.line: Ack! Things are getting a little hairy.

login.line: Yoohoo! Look at that, we meet again! I kept your seat warm for you. Aren't you happy?

lose.line: O-oof... Don't worry, Dmitri. People won't hate you over one loss!

mail.line: Yoohoo! Reminder from the super-popular Dmitri: you've got new mail, so read it soon!

main1.line: Yoohoo, Commander! Guess what snack I brought today! Tadaaa – it's a super-rich chocolate cake! It's a perfect refreshment for a long day's work! I bought it for you, so eat up!

main2.line: Commandeeer! Have you noticed anything different about me today? Haha, that's right! I didn't say yoohoo this time! Would I be just as popular this way, you think?

main3.line: Yoohoo, Commander! Is anything on your mind? Talk to me, if you need to. After all... the whole reason I'm here is to help you!

main4.line: Yoohoo, Commander! Everyone says you're the most popular person at port. You've gotta have some kind of secret, right? Huh? You don't? Well, I'm gonna wait here until you give me pointers!

mission.line: You're going to let me handle this new mission, right? Right? Riiiiight?

mission_complete.line: Yoohoo, mission's done! A big win for the Commander – and for me, by extension!

profile.line: Yoohoo! I'm Dmitri Donskoi, and I'm a blueprint ship of the Northern Parliament! You know, I'm actually a super-popular star. Haha, I saw that smile! You can tell, can't you?

propose.line: Finally... Finally, the day has come! I knew you cared about me, Commander! You LOVE me! Hehe... And I love and care about you a lot, too! I... super-love you, okay? Can you... prove your love to me now?

skill.line: You'd better be happy to meet me! Smile, or you're gonna get it!

touch.line: Ah! Hey, Commander, how can I be even more popular? Got any advice for me?

touch2.line: Whoa! You're unusually bold. I like that!

unlock.line: Yoohoo, Commander! I've been looking ALL over for you! Whaaat? YOU were looking for ME, too? Pssh, whatever – anyway, you must be so happy to meet me, right? Heheh, it's written all over your face!

upgrade.line: Yoohoo! More proof that I'm your favorite, huh?

win_mvp.line: See that? They realized they were up against a star, so they let me win!

gift_prefer.line: Oh, wow. This is like my favorite thing! You know me so well, Commander.

detail_ex.line: Oh, wow! Are you covering my eyes to make me guess something? Hm? Keep my eyes closed and hold out my arms? Did you get me a gift, or... Hyah?! Y-you actually wanted to ambush me with a kiss... Hmph! Well, I'M gonna kiss YOU, too!

expedition_ex.line: Yoohoo! Our commission team has returned! Let's go say hi to them, quick!

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, I wanna be with you forever. I'm never leaving your side! You won't leave me either, right? Heheh, no matter where you run, I'm gonna come find you! Hehe♥

headtouch_ex.line: Hehe... Your petting technique is just the best.

home_ex.line: Yoohoo, your favorite girl's here to greet you again! What's next on the agenda? It's gotta be "spending time with Dmitri," right? Riiiight?

login_ex.line: Yoohoo! Cheers to another day with my beloved Commander! I kept your seat warm, as usual... Hmm? Why am I not moving? Because I'm waiting for a hug, of course!

lose_ex.line: That was just an oopsie! Commander, let's practice a little more for next time!

main5_ex.line: Yoohoo! Tonight's special feature iiis... an all-night movie party! After our movies, we can watch the sunrise! Whaddya think? My plan's just the best, isn't it?!

main6_ex.line: Commander! Hehe, did that scare you? That's what you get for working all night and neglecting me!

main7_ex.line: Commander, tickle attack! Heheh, this is actually a stress-relieving massage I learned! Rub, rub... Huh? Hahaha... H-hey, that tickles... Hahaha!

main8_ex.line: Ahem! Dearest Commander, it's sooo hot in this coat. Why don't you help me... Pfft, what's with that look on your face? Whoa, HEY! My coat!

mail_ex.line: Ooh, new mail. Do you ever find any love letters from me in there?

mission_ex.line: Whoa, new missions again? Heheh, if you need any help, just call Dmitri!

mission_complete_ex.line: Yoohoo! You really finished all those missions. Do you want a reward from me after all that hard work?

touch_ex.line: Yoohoo! Got you, Commander! Now teach me how to be more popular, or I'm never letting go!

touch2_ex.line: Commander! Close your eyes. This time, I'm coming at you!

upgrade_ex.line: Oh, yay! I knew you loved me, Commander!

win_mvp_ex.line: Commander! Let's hear a cheer for your beloved Dmitri!

detail.line: You wanna bake cookies? Is that the whole reason you came here? Nuh-uh! Your personal bunny is right here, Commander... What other snacks do you need?

feeling5.line: This room is all ours now, Commander~ I know you just love me to bits in this outfit, don't you? Heheh♪ In that case... Why don't we take things one step further?

headtouch.line: What's up? Did my bunny ears get messed up? ...Huh?! They weren't, but they are NOW because you touched me? Well, you'd better keep going and give me more headpats!

home.line: Yoohoo! Tired from all that traveling, Commander? You look beat. How about a massage and a lullaby, courtesy of Dmitri? They're guaranteed to get you dreaming in no time!

login.line: If you're not happy with this room, I can get you into another one! ...You are? Okay, then this is our secret hideout now! Get ready to enjoy my special service, Commander♪

main1.line: Yoohoo! Congrats on winning the jackpot in the Bunny Dmitri Lottery, Commander! As for your prize... Tadaaa! You get 999 nights of being put to bed by me! The number doesn't really matter – I'll just do it whenever you want.

main2.line: Ding-dong, it's time for my animal role-play survey! What do you like, Commander? My bunny impression, or my bear impression? Answer carefully, now. Bunnies go "squeak!", and bears go "roar!" ...Pretty good, right?

main3.line: Yoohoo, Commander. Do you know what this pose means? "On the hunt"? Well, you are... Correct! Can you guess who my prey is? Hehehe~ It's you, of course!

touch.line: You really like my outfit, don't you, Commander? Hehe, I can see right through you!

touch2.line: Commander, bunnies bite when they get mad... Ah! I'm not saying you can't touch me. I'm saying you can't LEAVE!

unlock.line: Yoohoo! Welcome, Commander! How do you like your room? Does it make your heart flutter? Hehe, we've got all kinds of services – I can put you to bed with a massage, or do whatever animal role-play you're into... Bunny Dmitri's here to make all your dreams come true!

battle.line: Go forward with the Saintess of Victory's everlasting blessings.

detail.line: Phew... Oh my, I do believe our Champion has arrived. Why yes, I'm perfectly fine. I was just struck with inspiration for a new paean and simply must put pen to paper.

expedition.line: Our friends have returned to us from their odyssey. I wonder what kind of stories they brought back with them?

feeling1.line: Your tale ought not to end here. Please regather yourself and press onward.

feeling2.line: O Champion, I've heard a great many tales about you from many different people. Now, how goes the tale you narrate through your own eyes? How I wish to find out.

feeling3.line: The oracles of legend were said to be able to foretell the fates of humans. Even though I don't have that power, I've read your story up close, and believe that you have what it takes to become a true Champion.

feeling4.line: The bards of legend were said to travel the world, singing paeans of their champions. The paean I compose for your tale shall also be sung across the world one day.

feeling5.line: The champions of legend accomplished feats that transcended time, but all mortals will succumb to fatigue. Should you ever feel tired, please make sure to rest. I shall nourish you with my finest song and verse.

headtouch.line: Oh? Is this intended to bring me succor...?

home.line: Our Champion returns triumphantly... I feel the inspiration for a new paean coming~

hp_warning.line: There's no need for haste. We have plenty of time still~

login.line: O Champion, what tales of heroism will you weave into the annals of history today?

lose.line: Setbacks are a necessary component of any champion's tale.

mail.line: New mail has arrived.

main1.line: Why not stop to smell the roses on your odyssey forward? Take heed of nature's marvels and friends who cherish you – there are still many things here worthy of your attention.

main2.line: Every life is a wonderful story – be it an epic akin to a turbulent storm, or a lullaby as calming as the gentle sea breeze. Everything is embraced by the land and the sea, and committed to memory.

main3.line: What's my favorite type of tea? Umm, whatever you'd like. As for desserts... Well, I'm fine with just about anything...

mission.line: There's no need for haste, Champion. Keep it slow and steady, just as you always do.

mission_complete.line: The mission rewards aren't going anywhere. There's no need for haste - we can always check them later.

profile.line: I am large cruiser Brest, born upon Iris Libre's hallowed ground. I love hearing all the tales spanning land and sea, and spreading my own tales through song and poem. I look forward to hearing the tales you are bound to weave, Champion.

propose.line: To think that I, as a singer, would become part of my Champion's tale... What an unexpected plot twist. Heehee~ O Champion, shall we join hands and weave the paean to a more joyous tomorrow?

touch.line: Hmm...? Did you need my advice, Champion?

touch2.line: Oh my... I suppose every champion's tale has indiscretions such as these~

unlock.line: Are you our Champion? I am Brest of Iris Libre. Now that fate has brought us together, may our journey be blessed.

upgrade.line: A more harmonious timbre.

win_mvp.line: And thus, a new passage is inscribed in our Champion's paean––

gift_prefer.line: You'd give me such a precious item? I'm flattered, really.

battle_ex.line: Let us write a new chapter in our Champion's tale.

detail_ex.line: By the way, the champions of legend usually take on a heroine as well. Or multiple, if you're into that. If you really can't decide, we can always improvise... Oh? My, oh my...

headtouch_ex.line: Have you had your fill? Then, why don't we try reversing roles?

home_ex.line: Our Champion returns home victorious once again... Hehe, you are a champion, after all.

login_ex.line: Would you like to listen to the paean I improvised for you?

main4_ex.line: Oh my, such delicate yet emotional lines. Thanks to you, Champagne, I've come up with so many new verses.

main5_ex.line: It's not good to overwork yourself, Champion. A quill made to write too much will snap. A mind made to think too much will become clouded. Gascogne's "Work Module" made to operate too much will overheat.

main6_ex.line: No matter what sceneries lie ahead of us, let us bear witness to them together. Not only as the weaver of the Champion's future-spanning tale, but also as your beloved companion who always stays by your side.

main7_ex.line: The days pass, the seasons change. The flow of time grinds all things to dust – except one. Only true love can weather this trial, and continue to shine proudly through the song of life.

touch_ex.line: You may consult me for anything, Champion.

touch2_ex.line: Does the Champion... crave my comforts? Hehe~

win_mvp_ex.line: I shall be the Parnassian who sings your tales of heroism, Champion.

detail.line: The secret to enriching the mind is traveling and broadening your horizons—be it contemplating nature's beauty or visiting historical locales~

expedition.line: The tide tells a tale... Ah, Champion, so the commission company has returned.

home.line: Tales of adventure in the briny blue... This could make for an entertaining piece, Champion.

login.line: Gazing from a ship's deck leaves me wanting. Just imagine the fathomless secrets that lay beneath these waves.

mail.line: The tide brings new mail. There... This ought to keep it dry.

main1.line: Champion, there is much that I wish to tell Richelieu and the others about these ruins. May I spin a hymn here and now?

main2.line: An adventuring party? I would be happy to serve as your sage... Worry not. You are more than valorous enough to lead the vanguard, Champion.

main3.line: We must protect these seas, including the most dangerous places—even if they have their own faults, much like my beloved Champion. Heehee!

mission.line: Might we be blessed with a quest to delve into these ruins?

touch.line: How I'd love to take such pretty coral home with me, but perhaps it is best left as a memory.

touch2.line: My, my... What's come over you?

unlock.line: "I devote this paean to thee, Champion of seas blue and free." There, the song is completed. But we've come all this way... Shall we continue our adventure through these undersea ruins, Champion?

detail.line: Those of the Empery often quote, "A woman dresses herself for the one who delights in her." In other words, we try to be beautiful for the one we love... Right now, that would be an apt description for me.

feeling5.line: With zither and lyric, let us weave a song of this night. Of a brief yet wonderful time, of a minstrel who desires her own part in the tale... To be forever remembered by her champion.

headtouch.line: Should I style my hair in a Dragon Empery fashion, as well?

home.line: O Champion, you've been hard at work. Come to me and enjoy a moment's respite.

login.line: The window's view of the moon, the fragrance of the stove... A perfect environment in which to pen poetry.

main1.line: O Champion, do you think the red floral makeup suits me more? Good. Then I'll keep applying this one...

main2.line: The way you paint my face now reminds me of lovers in old folktales.

main3.line: O Champion, please come closer. You may find the scenery tonight is unique enough to warrant a moment's rest.

touch.line: O Champion, do you wish to sit next to me? Here is a cushion... Oh? You want me to be your cushion?

touch2.line: Heehee... O Champion, put out the candles first.

unlock.line: O Champion, what manner of floral makeup would look best upon my brow? Or, could I perhaps... call upon you to apply it for me? ♪

battle.line: Prepare yourself. A storm is approaching.

couple_encourage1.line: So, what kind of impossible challenge do you have for me this time?

detail.line: Brewing storms, unseen reefs, lurking enemies... A messenger's path is fraught with obstacles. But no matter how many times I am impeded or injured, I will see my duty through to the end... because the delivery of messages is always paramount.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Please see the list of rewards. I've already cross-checked everything in advance.

feeling1.line: It'd be more efficient for me to work alone.

feeling2.line: Commander, it's getting late. You should go to bed. ...Don't make that face at me. I don't want a certain someone getting sick tomorrow and making it more work for me.

feeling3.line: Huh, didn't expect someone to stick with me through the entirety of this awful shift... So, got any plans after this? ...I was going to go to this one place. Wanna tag along?

feeling4.line: Work always sucks, but for whatever reason, things aren't so bad with you around. I'm even starting to enjoy it a bit... See what you've done? You've made me develop unnecessary feelings towards work...

feeling5.line: I-it's not like I was following you or anything, nor do I know where you're going... We just happened to bump into each other, and now that we're here, it's my job to keep a close eye on you... So, you'd better not get too far away from me.

headtouch.line: ...You're praising me? ...Several of my comrades wanted to express their gratitude? It's no big deal. All I did was incidentally take out some threats while doing my job.

home.line: I'll compile the action report, so please submit all the data to me by the end of the workday.

hp_warning.line: Now you've got my attention.

login.line: Messenger Orage, reporting for duty. Work sucks, but someone has to do it. In any case, do your best, Commander.

lose.line: Remember how this feels, then adapt. Next time, we must become stronger.

mail.line: There's a message for you, Commander. Make sure you read it. Oh, no need to thank me. I'm simply doing my job.

main1.line: The difficulty level of this new game I bought is fairly average. There are monsters and traps everywhere, your character dies in one hit, and you have to start from the beginning if you make a mistake, but it's easily clearable once you've learned the patterns. In fact, it only took me 2,315 tries.

main2.line: The Holy See's approval process is pretty efficient, but it can't keep up with my pace. If they trimmed down the paperwork, I wouldn't have to do as much overtime.

main3.line: ...I should take some time off to hang out with my friends? I think I'll pass. I'd rather stew in my own thoughts than deal with all that noise.

main4.line: Hello? ...The port's drainage is blocked? I'll send someone to fix it... There's a cat stuck in the tree? Tell it to stay put. I'll send someone over right away... The restaurant's still losing money? Yes, I know, I've already sent the business improvement plan.

mission.line: ...Work is work. It's always been dry and annoying. But now they're even demanding "professionalism"? ...Well, I guess someone has to do it. Move over, I'll lend you a hand.

mission_complete.line: Time to clock out. So, how do you feel? It's like a weight has been lifted off your shoulders, huh?

profile.line: Introduce myself? What a hassle... I am Orage, destroyer from Iris Libre, and messenger of the Holy See. Please feel to consult me for anything related to intel gathering, communications, and messenger duties.

propose.line: Yes, I accept... I thought up sixteen different ways of confessing to you, but in the end, you still beat me to the punch... Ugh, what was all that agonizing even for...?

touch.line: ...Oh. The instructions are all in my head. Search all you want, but you won't find anything on me.

touch2.line: Is this... some form of entertainment between tasks...? Well, I guess I don't mind.

unlock.line: Orage, messenger of Iris Libre, reporting for duty. So, are there any troublesome missives for me to deliver? Just give me the destination, and I'll make sure it gets there no matter what. It's my job, after all.

upgrade.line: This power... should help us weather the storm.

win_mvp.line: News of your victory shall spread from east to west, your name rising above the masses.

gift_prefer.line: I wonder how I should return the favor... Urgh, what a pain... Just tell me what you want, Commander. Anything is fine.

feeling5_ex.line: I want more of you. I want more of your love... Hey, if I hold you tight like this... would you give me your everything?

headtouch_ex.line: Is it break time already? Huh, work seems to fly by these days for whatever reason...

home_ex.line: ...You're not hurt, are you? If you don't absolutely have to go, send me out instead. You don't have to leap into danger yourself every time...

login_ex.line: Thanks to you, I'm able to endure this boring job... Now that you've seen how hard I'm working, how about a stroll with me afterwards?

main5_ex.line: Ahem... Yaaay! I just cleared a no-damage hardcore run, the fastest time in the whole port! (I was loud enough for the Commander to hear me for sure, right...?)

main6_ex.line: ...Remember to stay hydrated. (If I show my considerate side like this, then the Commander is sure to feel warm and fuzzy all day!)

main7_ex.line: Here, I made some food for you. (I secretly learned how to make fried rice the other day... If you like it, I'll make it for you every day.)

main8_ex.line: ...You'll be out for business for a few days, so you want me to behave myself? ...That's your way of saying hello to me? ...Well, whatever. Have fun. Doesn't bother me at all... (Ohmygod it bothers me so much...)

touch_ex.line: ...... (Commander's trying to get my attention... Am I about to be asked out on a date?! Umm... what's the best way of saying yes...?!)

touch2_ex.line: *sigh*... If you're going to touch me, you might as well use both hands... It'll be more efficient that way...

battle.line: The advantage is ours! Strike!

detail.line: ...I'm not sleeping, I'm just letting my brain rest a while. While, yes, I did leave the door wide open, you should at least knock before you enter next time, Commander.

expedition.line: Confirming the commission team has returned. I'll go collect the goods.

feeling1.line: Your commanding ability has been evaluated... Simply following your orders is detrimental.

feeling2.line: I've determined that establishing mutual trust between us is beneficial to my battlefield performance. So, without further ado, allow me to check your schedule... Hm? Is information-gathering not customary when getting to know someone?

feeling3.line: Your individual tastes and interests... That's a good perspective. I'll ask my acquaintances for basic info later... For now, open your mouth. I made borscht, and this will help me determine your tastes. Come on, say "ahh."

feeling4.line: Though calling it a "date" is a misnomer, a date does present a great opportunity to learn your habits and savoir-faire. Here is your schedule for today. Give it a quick read, then we'll get started.

feeling5.line: I trust you, Commander, and I want to become intimately familiar with you. However, I'm unable to fully determine your feelings towards me due to my own ineptness... Do you trust me the way I trust you? Do you, as others would say, love me?

headtouch.line: ...Hm? What are you doing?

home.line: Welcome back, now have a breather. After-action review? Ah, right, you went on a sortie. Would it have been better if I'd joined you?

hp_warning.line: The operation is going awry... What is this?!

login.line: Ah, Commander. Pardon me for starting work without you. Pay me no mind and begin with your own tasks.

lose.line: Combat appraisal complete. I shall maintain momentum while resuming formation, then launch a counterattack.

mail.line: Confirming that a letter has arrived. Take a look.

main1.line: Save the small talk for after work. I'm concentrating on my secretary duties, so don't disturb me.

main2.line: It doesn't help to always look back on the past – keep moving forward, and don't stop. Even when you want to self-reflect, you must adapt to developments as they happen.

main3.line: On occasion, I neglect your will and prioritize the here and now on the battlefield. While you are the Commander, sometimes you have to let your soldiers handle things – the sooner you accept this, the better.

main4.line: (Kearsarge is sitting upright on the couch with her eyes closed. Is she asleep, or...?)

mission.line: Confirming there are unfinished missions. If you won't do them, I'll remove them from your schedule as I see fit. You sure you want that?

mission_complete.line: Confirming that rewards have come in. I'll go collect them.

profile.line: I'm Kearsarge, Eagle Union blueprint ship given form. My design was a hybrid between battleship and aircraft carrier, giving me the ability to deal with almost any situation or battlefield. I hope you'll put my strength to good use, Commander.

propose.line: Confirming vitals all green. Hm? Oh, don't worry, I simply snuck a vital sensor onto you – a return gift for this ring you gave me. It's necessary to keep a regular check on your health, and to know when to come running when you need help. Makes sense, no?

touch.line: Yes, I know you're here. What do you need?

touch2.line: How much intent is in this act you're committing?

unlock.line: Activation sequence complete. I am aviation battleship Kearsarge, Hybrid Idealization X given flesh and blood. Henceforth, I will serve you at this port. So, which division do I belong to, and what's my mission?

upgrade.line: Performance and fleet potential increase confirmed. Keep it up.

win_mvp.line: Combat appraisal complete. Moving on to the next stage of the operation.

gift_prefer.line: Your taste is commendable. Sorry – I should thank you first.

detail_ex.line: Vitals check done. All signs clear. I can't guess why else you'd visit, so... You just felt like it? Heheh, what an irrational reason, but that sounds like you alright.

expedition_ex.line: Confirming the commission team has returned. Hate to rain on your parade, but have you prepared gifts for the girls?

feeling5_ex.line: *smooch*... Yep. You're the same as always, and I'm in love with you. Is that all you wanted to confirm? I thought you would... as my friends have put it, "do what your heart yearns for." Are you really not going to do that?

home_ex.line: How did the sortie go, Commander? I know I don't need to worry about you, but disasters can always happen. Want me to check your vitals?

login_ex.line: This time, you go ahead and set the pace. Don't worry about me, just do whatever feels natural to you. I like it better that way.

main5_ex.line: What is it? Why'd you put your pen down? Your vitals all look fine to me, so... You're just taking a break? Sorry, I didn't mean to heckle you...

main6_ex.line: Still not finished? Okay, I'll order takeaway. That way I can stay with you until tomorrow if need be– Oh, it won't take that long?

main7_ex.line: I put my full trust in your ability to lead. Whenever you want to change targets, change course, use and change equipment, or give me tactical advice, just say the word.

main8_ex.line: (Kearsarge's breathing is faintly audible. Is she meditating again, or is she just sleeping?)

mission_complete_ex.line: Confirming arrival and receipt of rewards. I don't want to dampen your celebration, but... you should go pick up your stuff.

touch_ex.line: ...Commander. If you're going to play a prank on someone, you should make sure they're asleep first.

touch2_ex.line: If you want this, be my guest. I respect your will, and I've reached the conclusion that I'm fine with it, too.

win_mvp_ex.line: Combat appraisal complete... I'm the MVP? It's not like you to get excited about the usual. N-no, I don't mean you can't do that, just...

detail.line: This pole is a prop to assist with my performance and is installed with a contact circuit to replenish my energy. It's multifunctional and very convenient to... Oh, I shouldn't be explaining this right now.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. We'll continue after you've welcomed the girls back.

home.line: Confirming activation of energy circuit. I can move more now. You should recharge your batteries as well, Commander. Just give me your order.

login.line: Eagle Union bunny girl Kearsarge will charm you tonight. Don't worry, I can keep dancing as long as you're watching my– Oh. I don't recommend staying up all night for it.

lose.line: Combat appraisal complete. Energy consumption exceeds estimated values. Commander, provide additional energy via contact circuit.

main1.line: Confirming rise in vital signs. Heart rate, pulse, body temperature, and... Ahem. Is this what is called a "state of arousal"?

main2.line: This pole was originally installed to suit your needs in all kinds of scenarios. Naturally, this performance will go perfectly... Heh.

main3.line: ...Oh. Right, I'm still in the middle of my pop-up store performance. Have you been watching me, Commander?

main4.line: Let me show you some moves New Jersey taught me. I even made a few original modifications, based on the data from your reactions.

main5.line: (Kearsarge's breathing is faintly audible. Is she meditating again, or is she just pondering what to do for her next performance?)

mission.line: Confirming there are unfinished missions... but right now, you're meant to enjoy my performance. The missions can wait.

mission_complete.line: Confirming that mission rewards have arrived. Would you mind getting it yourself, Commander?

touch.line: Mhh... Is that better?

touch2.line: Confirming activation of contact circuit... Oh, um, you could increase the contact area for greater efficiency...

unlock.line: I am now the Hybrid Idealization given flesh and blood wearing a suit designed with my performance for you in mind. I am ready to receive orders at any time.

win_mvp.line: Combat appraisal complete. Energy consumption is within normal values. Commander, continue with the operation.

detail.line: While these clothes are less flexible than my suit, based on the data I've collected on your preferences, this outfit is the most appropriate under this circumstance. Your expression, likewise, says as much.

expedition.line: A commission has been completed. Don't forget to bring a treat to thank the team for their hard work.

feeling5.line: Today, I recorded large amounts of data about you and further deepened my understanding of love. While this feeling is hard to quantify, I do look forward to spending more time with you over this new year. Not only for logging and analysis purposes, but also to... revel in the happiness of being with you.

headtouch.line: ...Is this kind of contact equivalent to a blessing? Oh, never mind. Keep doing it.

home.line: Vitals are within normal parameters. Presumption: Your sortie went well. Proceeding to preparation of nourishment following completion of current task.

login.line: Oh, Commander... Sorry, please stand by for a moment. I need to readjust the fitting of my shoewear.

mail.line: Confirming the arrival of a new letter. You've received a large influx of seasonal greetings. Should I prepare a reply template for you?

main1.line: I've logged an ample amount of data on dumpling recipes. Shall I make some for you? ...Good cooking takes more than simply knowing the recipe?

main2.line: New Year's wishes? Mine is as follows: I wish to log more data of you and get to know you better. This answer should be within your expectations.

main3.line: I've heard that the size of a red envelope corresponds to the closeness between the giver and receiver... Oh, no, I wasn't trying to coax you into giving me one. Not at all.

main4.line: (You feel a weight on your shoulder and hear the sound of soft snoring. Kearsarge has a small smile on her lips. She must have logged a lot of data which makes her happy today.)

mission.line: Confirming the presence of unfinished missions. While it is a holiday, you must still carry out your duty. I am always ready to aid you.

mission_complete.line: Confirming the arrival of mission rewards. Don't worry about me – let me accompany you on your supply retrieval.

touch.line: Oh. Thank you, Commander. I'd like it if you could prop me up for just a moment.

touch2.line: Mmh... Analyzing your tastes has proven... very worthwhile...

unlock.line: This suit is a fusion of tradition and modernity. Your feedback would be appreciated... but first, a small issue must be dealt with. May I request your assistance in the matter, Commander?

battle.line: "Ryuujin no hougeki wo kurae––"

couple_encourage1.line: Keep a tight grip on that katana of yours. Heehee~

couple_encourage2.line: Do you hate green peppers that much...?

detail.line: Now then, set yourself free. This is your port– in other words, our home is now synonymous with the Dragon God's domain. Well, setting all that aside, just take it easy around me. There's no need for the formalities.

expedition.line: A military commission? I see. For the purpose of bringing me an offering, I presume?

feeling1.line: Ever wonder what it would be like to get on a dragon's bad side? Surely you're not going to go out of your way to satisfy that curiosity... right?

feeling2.line: How you conduct yourself and the attitude you exhibit towards me can only be one of two options– either you fear and revere me as the Dragon God lest I bring disaster upon you, or you trust and rely upon me, Shimanto, as shipgirl and Commander. The choice is yours; it matters not which you pick.

feeling3.line: You still seem somewhat reserved around me. If you do not change your ways, then I have no choice but to treat you with greater dignity as well– (*gurgle*)... Th-that wasn't my stomach growling... it, it was the rumbling of thunder!

feeling4.line: Yes, that's right! You can chat with me and enjoy snacks with me as normal! Even if I am the Dragon God, right now, I'm just a regular friend who you can shoot the breeze with! And if you want, I can even go on a date with you! ...Umm, hey. I was totally serious about that, okay?

feeling5.line: I'm here to go on a date with you today, Commander, so there's no need to get hung up about that Dragon God thing. Come on, show me the ropes. This is my first time doing something like this, so I wouldn't be able to put on airs even if I wanted to– Heehee, you're getting a bit better at dealing with me, aren't you?

headtouch.line: Hmm...?

home.line: Well done out there, Commander. Did you have a good fight? Oh, it's not like I had anything to do with it, so there's no need for that respectful tone.

hp_warning.line: Upon those who would lay hands on my scales, punishment descends––

login.line: Ahem. Commander, speak your wish to me. ...Hm? Why aren't you saying it? Do you want to give your secretary a day off?

lose.line: I've got a lot more bad vibes on me than I expected... Urgh...

mail.line: Mail? Will someone drop by to deliver it...?

main1.line: What kind of offerings do I prefer? If you insist on knowing, your favorite snack will suffice... Err, ahem. I meant, anything will do.

main2.line: You're not done with work yet, right? There's not much left, so keep at it. If you slack off, you might invite a curse upon yourself~

main3.line: I can somewhat relate with the Guardian Fox's frustrations. Things are a lot better thanks to you, but being revered all the time can be kind of tiring... It's kind of embarrassing to be called the Dragon God all the time.

main4.line: Perfect, all done. Oh, this isn't an ordinary paper airplane– it's a shikigami plane. Uhh, but, right now, it pretty much is just a paper airplane, just as you said... Mhm...

mission.line: Duties are to be fulfilled. Go forth and do your utmost, Commander.

mission_complete.line: All done with the mission? I see. Well done, then.

profile.line: I am the Sakura Empire light cruiser, Shimanto. As a blueprint ship that embodies wishes given form and the unsealed dragon of lore, I shall hereby lend my assistance to your fleet, Commander– Oh, umm... You know, you're welcome to call me by my title of Dragon God...?

propose.line: Should we exchange vows, then an inseparable bond would form between us– indeed, this is both a blessing and a curse. Are you fine with that? ...I see. Heehee. In that case, what should we do next? A kiss? A hug? Or maybe...

skill.line: Shikigami serpent, unleash your divine might!

touch.line: Got a prayer you want the Dragon God to hear? Want me to make it rain?

touch2.line: Hmm... I wonder if this warrants a curse...

unlock.line: Release the Seal of Denial; open your eyes and worship the great Dragon God– Heehee, don't worry about it. I am Shimanto, a fantasy given form through wishes embodied. Commander, don't be too hard on me, 'kay?

upgrade.line: Can you make me even stronger? Then I suppose I shall use this power without reservation~

win_mvp.line: Worship me! Fear the raging Dragon God's storm! ...Ahaha, my shikigami have reverted back to soggy pieces of paper...

gift_prefer.line: The Dragon God loves this. Hehehe!

battle_ex.line: "Ryuu ga waga teki wo"... Haha, I'll stop now.

detail_ex.line: Let's set the work aside and take it easy for now. Not many people come by these parts, and even if they do, all you gotta do is say that you were praying to the Dragon God~

expedition_ex.line: The commission team seems to have returned. Heehee, the Dragon God sees all~

feeling5_ex.line: Yeah, yeah. Just like that. No need for reservation, no need to be polite. You're the head honcho here, so feel free to be yourself. I will always be your Shimanto, your personal Dragon God.

headtouch_ex.line: People are in awe of me because I have these growing out of my head... Probably...?

home_ex.line: Well fought, Commander. Now then, got any souvenirs for me? Hehe, it doesn't have to be an offering of snacks for the Dragon God. An interesting tale or two will suffice.

login_ex.line: Now then, make your wish. My power belongs to you– Wait, hold on a sec! If you want me to grant THAT wish, you'll have to double my snack allowance!

main5_ex.line: Don't you think the sun's been a bit too strong lately? ...Heehee, I guess that's where I come in. Shall I call down a bit of rain for you?

main6_ex.line: Tired? I guess that's bound to happen eventually. Wanna scroll through Juustagram 'til you feel better?

main7_ex.line: Whose katana is this...? Oh. Mm, mm. I see, I see... I think I'll have that girl offer me a whole bunch of snacks. Ehehe~

mission_ex.line: I suppose I don't mind helping you with your mission. After all, the great Dragon God is but a secretary now~

mission_complete_ex.line: Oh, done already...? And here I was finally trying to make myself useful... I mean, uh, yes, well done!

touch_ex.line: Do you require my power? Very well, I'd be more than glad to assist you.

touch2_ex.line: You wish for even more wondrous blessings from the Dragon God~? I guess I can do that~

win_mvp_ex.line: Maybe I should call down a celebratory rainstorm? Heehee, just joking.

detail.line: I heard that this outfit is worn when providing a certain kind of "service," but what exactly does this entail? Even the great Dragon God finds herself ignorant of some worldly things, and your guidance would be most appreciated~ Teehee~

expedition.line: The commission fleet is back? Do we have enough refreshments? Shall I have Azuma and the others bring some more over?

feeling5.line: How wonderfully well-behaved you are, *pat, pat*... Enjoy the aroma of the tea, feel the warmth and softness of the Dragon God's thighs, and be whisked away into the land of sweet slumber~ Heehee. That's right, you don't need to worry about a thing~

home.line: You've done well. Would you like a cup of tea first, or would you prefer to lie down? Either way, I've made things nice and comfy for you~

login.line: Pheeew~ Hehe, isn't this cuppa a thing of beauty? Don't worry too much about etiquette or whatever. Just drink it while it's hot.

main1.line: They say fresh tea is as nectar... So what do you think? Isn't the Dragon God's tea amazing? When things are offered to me, it isn't just for show, you know.

main2.line: Now then, prostrate yourself! (whispers) Wonderful. Isn't it nice and warm over here~? I don't mind if we keep staying like this~

main3.line: Fwoo, fwoo... Here, that should do the trick. Huh? I accidentally made it boiling hot? Sorry, it's hard to control the temperature like this... Is that not the issue?

touch.line: What do you seek from the Dragon God?

touch2.line: I see, I see... So THIS is the kind of "service" they were talking about? Heehee~

unlock.line: You couldn't have picked a better time to come. Allow me to treat you to a cup of the Dragon God's benevolence– Uhh, I'll go boil some water right now, so sit tight. After you finish the tea, shall we kick back and relax awhile?

win_mvp.line: Be it boiling tea or fighting, there's nothing the Dragon God can't do.

detail.line: Mmhh. Nature's fresh air beats everything else... How come, you ask? I suppose you don't always have incense burning in your office, so the difference isn't obvious to you... If anything, your office smells like coffee, I suppose?

expedition.line: Seems the commission team is back! Why, yes, this stream connects to the sea, so I can tell. Heehee♪

feeling5.line: It's not training, just practicing hygiene? Well, I guess you have a point, but it's been that way since the start, and there's my desire for you to always stay in good health... Yes, that's it! It's the Dragon God's blessing of gratitude♪

home.line: Lounge in nature's waters, draw upon the Dragon God's blessing to cleanse the karma of war... Ahem. Wh-what I'm saying is: Let's have a good time.

login.line: Cleanse yourself like the mountain hermit, purge evil with pure water, become one with Mizuho's nature and purify your heart – this is a teaching of gratitude from the Dragon God♪

main1.line: Hm-hmm-hm♪ Come into the water, Commander. You don't wanna waste this opportunity to have as much as we can, do you?

main2.line: You thought this kind of training would be done under a waterfall? Uh, well... I don't really like waterfall training. It's painful.

main3.line: Take Mizuho's aura within you, and let its clouds nourish you – that's one way of doing it if you're interested... Really? You are?

mission.line: Commander, there are missions left to do. I'm sure they'll be a cinch now that you've cleansed yourself.

mission_complete.line: We could set the mission rewards afloat for the others downstream to collect. Too far-fetched?

touch.line: Eek! Now you've done it! Better get ready, because I'm going to make it rain above you!

touch2.line: Th-this is not what self-training is about...

unlock.line: Well, Commander, are you ready? I'm going to teach you the Dragon God's sacred training method. First, you scoop up some water, like... Achoo! Th-that one didn't count!

detail.line: You want me to raise the room's humidity a bit? Excuse me, have you forgotten who I am? Offer me two rice crackers, THEN I'll give you my blessing♪

expedition.line: Should we go and greet the returning commission team? We can go back to relaxing after that.

feeling5.line: It feels kind of odd, us just being alone like this. I get all cozy and don't feel like doing anything, but I also get antsy, like I just have to do something... You get what I mean? Sorry – I know I invited you to come and relax and all...

home.line: Good work on that sortie. It was sunny the whole journey back, right? Heheh. You should be grateful for the Dragon God's good weather blessing♪

login.line: The Dragon God is unfamiliar with this stuff, so you'll have to teach me all about it. Hey... Heehee, how was that?

main1.line: Heheh. I could use the Dragon God's power to change into loungewear whenever I want. Why don't I do it now? W-would you believe me if I said it's just too much work?

main2.line: There's tea if you're thirsty. Want me to blow on it to cool it down? I guarantee I won't misjudge how much force to use this time♪

main3.line: Maybe it's time to lay out the futon... Oh, I know it's early, I just wanna laze around on top of it. Heheh. Will you help?

mission_complete.line: You can collect your mission rewards now. What will you do first? Inspect them, or praise the Dragon God's magnificence?

touch.line: *slap slap*... Heheh, you must love this tail massage from the Dragon God♪

touch2.line: S-so that's where this is going... *blushes*

unlock.line: Whew... So refreshing. Nothing beats lounging around indoors after a bath. Commander, there's plenty of time before dinner, so how about we... do something to kill the time?

battle.line: Fail to show me my due respect, and I shall make you suffer.

detail.line: I enjoy apples, especially the kind that's been chopped up into nice little bite-sized pieces. Yes, yes, just like that– Ahhn~ Mmgh~ Want some as well, Commander?

expedition.line: The commission rewards have been collected and counted. So, how do you plan to repay me for using up my time and energy?

feeling1.line: How boring- you're nothing more than dust on the windowsill. Ah, forget it, I'm not interested in you anymore. Hurry up and blow away in the wind already.

feeling2.line: Humans are nothing more than uppity beasts. I shall make you understand this, and you will kneel before me and wag your tail. Heehee~♪

feeling3.line: Hmm, are you still not giving in to your urges? Do you have that much self-control, or are you just impotent? ... (Having that said, this degree of stubbornness is unusual... Am I doing something wrong? Or am I just not doing enough...?)

feeling4.line: (Now that I think things through, the Commander's actually a pretty good person... Wait, what am I thinking? If I acknowledge the Commander, it's all over for me... But...) Hmm? What is it? And how exactly are my personal thoughts any of your business?

feeling5.line: *sigh*... I admit defeat. Not only did I fail to get you to kneel before me, I almost ended up acknowledging you. But... that only frees me up to go after you with any means necessary. Kneel before me, or become mine. I won't back down until you break.

headtouch.line: You deemed it appropriate for someone of your position to touch my forehead? Well, I suppose I'll take pity on your ignorance and forgive you.

home.line: An acceptable job on your sortie. I suppose I wouldn't mind poking and prodding at the sensitive spots on your frail body– Ahaha, I wonder how soon you'll cry for mercy~♪

hp_warning.line: S-stop staring and use that rotten brain of yours to figure something out!

login.line: Did you miss me that badly? Heehee. Surely you didn't come all the way here just for some piddling chores?

lose.line: Th-there were a multitude of unforeseeable variables that contributed to this defeat... Ahem! If you understand, then I'll leave the rest to you!

mail.line: You can't even get your own mail without me? Well, I suppose that's fine. I won't even ask you for repayment this one time.

main1.line: It's gonna be sunny tomorrow? Welp, that sucks. One fewer excuse to keep the Commander by my side.

main2.line: Hmm? Did you say something? Can't hear you. Come a bit closer, and enunciate more~

main3.line: (Hmm... Busy working again? ...There has to be some way of getting you to pay attention to me...) Hmm? Did you need something? I'm just minding my own business over here~?

mission.line: Too much stuff on your plate? Sigh, I suppose I can help this pitiful, impotent Commander. But, I do expect you to return this favor, okay?

mission_complete.line: Ohh? You actually managed to do your job. I suppose you aren't completely impotent, then. That earns you a few extra points of affection from me, Commander~♪

profile.line: I am Felix Schultz, Iron Blood blueprint ship. Oh, you crave my power? Easy. Just use that rotten brain of yours to please me. You should be grateful I'm even willing to allow you to worship me instead of forcing you to submit unconditionally.

propose.line: How beautiful... this feeling of being acknowledged and accepted. It is a thousand times better than forcing trash to kneel before me... Why didn't I realize this sooner? Tell me~ ...Commander, let's fall deeper and deeper into the abyss together, just the two of us~♪

touch.line: Got the hots for me? Sure, feast those beady little eyes of yours on me, as much as you want~ Heehee, I wonder how long you'll be able to keep ogling me~

touch2.line: Are you finally admitting that you have the same cranial capacity as a chimp? Heehee~♪

unlock.line: My, if it isn't the Commander. Good day. Though the fact that I've been summoned here by a human is a feat in itself, you will find that trying to bind me thusly is a foolish, Sisyphean endeavor. Indeed, I, Felix Schultz, shall make you kneel before me.

upgrade.line: Eheh~ That put me in a pretty good mood.

win_mvp.line: These worthless bottom-feeders thought they could defeat me? Heehee.

gift_prefer.line: You know just how to make me happy!

battle_ex.line: I'll go mop them up, Commander~

detail_ex.line: Want an apple? Here you go– Oh, gimme a sec– *chomp*~ Okay, here you go~

expedition_ex.line: The commission fleet has returned. Shall we go greet them? Naturally, the two of us will hold hands as we go, heehee~

feeling5_ex.line: Commander, despite the profundity of our relationship, why are you still so indifferent towards me... Urgh, I can't just sit around until you get eaten up by one of those big sister types... You know what, I don't care what happens next...!

headtouch_ex.line: Just a headpat? And you're satisfied with only that? Well, I'M not satisfied at all.

home_ex.line: If you missed me so badly, use those noodly arms and wobbly back of yours to carry me. That way, the two of us will always be together~♪

login_ex.line: Ahhh, you've finally returned. What will your first order be for me? ..."Get off the desk"? Heehee~♪

lose_ex.line: Would you be upset with me if I said I lost on purpose?

main4_ex.line: (Look at you, so hard at work again. Why are you putting yourself through that even though I'm here...?) H-huh?! Wh-why are you trying to chat me up all of a sudden?

main5_ex.line: The things on my feet keep poking you? It's said that certain things practically become a part of you once you've grown accustomed to them. I don't think you're any exception in this regard, Commander. Heehee~

mail_ex.line: You've got new mail... but each one will cost you one kiss. Pretty good deal, right~?

mission_ex.line: Eheh~ Shower me with praise or I won't help with your mission~♪

mission_complete_ex.line: Eheh~ Wag your tail or I won't fetch the rewards for you~♪

touch_ex.line: (Are you finally going to put your hands all over me?) ......Hmm? Um... You're not going to do anything? *sigh*...

touch2_ex.line: Ahhn~♥ I love it when you give in to your primal urges like this~

win_mvp_ex.line: Worms should know better than to get between me and the Commander.

battle.line: Rise and shine, Commander. It's time to stamp out some pests.

detail.line: *munch*~ In any case, Commander, you were fortunate to have come here alone. If you brought friends with you, none of this would've happened. But, you also wouldn't be all tangled up with me either... Want an apple~? Mmmfgh~♡

expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned. It's time for our walk, Commander~♪
