feeling5.line: Heehee. You know, Commander, you really are defenseless. Do you really think everyone's as well-behaved as Bismarck's bunch? Though, looks like you're in no position to answer me... Oh well. I guess I'll just have to use this opportunity to say this as much as I can– "I love you~♥"

home.line: Yes, that's right~ Doesn't it feel so much better to not have to think about anything? The two of us can slack off as much as we want here. If you're tired, you can relax however you want. If you're thirsty... then slurp it all down. You know what I mean, don't you~?

login.line: Oho, you're still trying to talk~? But, it must be so hard for you, with how your tongue's already tied up like that~ Maybe I should just shut you up altogether–– *smooooch*

lose.line: Heehee. Commander, I'm so looking forward to how you're going to... "correct" me after you get back on your feet~♪

mail.line: You've got new mail. Now then, where shall I leave the kiss mark?

main1.line: What did I make you drink? What if I told you it was just regular iced tea? Think as hard as you can, with that ever-so-brilliant brain of yours turned to mush~

main2.line: You can't move? And your head's all hazy? Why of course. (*croons*) I, Felix Schultz, did this to you.

main3.line: You want me on my knees, serving you with upturned eyes? Don't you think that's a bit too pervy? Not that I mind, though~

mission.line: I'll help out with your work, so let's keep what happened here between the two of us~

mission_complete.line: What am I going to make you do in return for fetching the mission rewards? ...Ahaha, so you do remember after all~♪

touch.line: So you go all numb when I touch you here? You're unexpectedly sensitive, Commander~

touch2.line: C'mon, there's a loooot more stuff I still want to do with you~♥

unlock.line: My, my. I'm quite surprised you're still able to stay awake. As expected of the Commander– even a dose of Felix Schultz's special concoction isn't enough to put you under... but that ends here. It's your fault for peeping on me slacking off in the first place, so be nice and obedient and succumb to me already~♪

win_mvp.line: So despite your current condition, you're still able to command~? As a reward, I'll let you have a bit more to drink. Mmffgh~

battle.line: Courage was your beginning, and it shall also be your end.

couple_encourage1.line: You smell of danger.

detail.line: My wings? My tail? Do they really enthrall you that much? The inner workings of your mind elude me sometimes, Contract Binder.

expedition.line: Commission goods have arrived? Have someone else handle it. Doing everything by yourself is a waste of your limited time.

feeling1.line: So be it. Our contract is now null and void. And one day, you will taste undiminished retaliation for your actions.

feeling2.line: You wish to speak? Here I thought you were avoiding me out of fear... Very well. This is as good an opportunity as any to learn more about you.

feeling3.line: So my summoning wasn't an officiated ordeal. It seems, then, that this was done by you as an individual with desires... Yes, it's fine to admit it. This way, I can be not just a shipgirl under your command, but Hindenburg, an individual.

feeling4.line: You can try to manipulate a demon, but it's an undeniable possibility that the tables will turn on you. If you want the answer, seek it. I'll be waiting for you at the end of the line... No, I'm not daring you into anything. As the contract binder, this is your choice alone to make.

feeling5.line: How delightful you've made it this far, Contract Binder. How you did it is unimportant – all that matters is the end result, namely that you are now in my possession. Dismayed? Kneeling on the ground surely isn't THAT bad.

headtouch.line: My horns? Admire them all you want. Try to touch them, however, and I'm sure you already know what will happen.

home.line: Your last battle is still on your mind, no? Were the foes interesting? Or was my performance perhaps unsatisfactory?

hp_warning.line: Seems I got a little overeager... Well played.

login.line: Forever toiling away for the sake of peace... Contract Binder, is this the fate you chose?

lose.line: Gritty adversaries we have. Come our next audience, please don't disappoint me again.

mail.line: Read your letter sooner rather than later, Contract Binder. I shouldn't have to point this out to you.

main1.line: Incidentally, what binds you and other shipgirls together? Is it trust? Money? ...Well, that's interesting.

main2.line: Life here is so staggeringly boring. Contract Binder, relieve my boredom or I'll do it myself with your body.

main3.line: Get me something to drink? How considerate of you to ask. I'll have coffee. Not too bitter, thanks.

mission.line: Do what you must do, Contract Binder... I'm referring to your missions.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. I don't remember making a contract with a human who grows excited over measly rewards, and yet here you are.

profile.line: I am Iron Blood cruiser Hindenburg. Shipgirls such as I are apparently known as "blueprint ships"... a title I couldn't care less about. As long as you prove your might and don't bore me, I will obey the contract we've made.

propose.line: Our current contract isn't enough for you, and you want to take it even further? How cocksure you've become, Contract Binder... I shall grant your wish and give you what you desire. That is, if your body and soul are ready for the indulgence that is to come.

touch.line: Speak now, before my interest in you goes away.

touch2.line: I'm tempted to pound some decency into that body of yours, Contract Binder.

unlock.line: Was it you who summoned me? You, a human, are my "Commander"? Very well. I'll temporarily allow this contract between shipgirl and human.

upgrade.line: Don't forget to pursue your own growth, Contract Binder.

win_mvp.line: Pain is the best teacher for the wretched.

gift_prefer.line: This is quite nice.

detail_ex.line: If you're really going to keep staring at my tail, I will use it to restrain you. You'd probably enjoy that anyway... Unless you're saying I've misjudged your character?

feeling5_ex.line: What is it? Thinking of rescinding your earlier decision? Since the moment you surrendered your leader privileges, your opinions as a person have had no weight. You understand what this means, yes, Contract Binder?

headtouch_ex.line: If there's no stopping you... Fine, just this once.

home_ex.line: Regardless of how your last battle went, now you can relax. Focus on what's in front of you.

login_ex.line: I've been waiting ages for you. Don't tell me you WANTED to incur my wrath and make me discipline you?

lose_ex.line: It's time to retreat, Contract Binder. The shame of running away matters little compared to personal safety.

main4_ex.line: I've never before felt such pleasure as I do by your side... If anything, YOU may genuinely possess a devilish power to seduce others.

main5_ex.line: Maybe I should spend some time teaching other shipgirls who truly belongs at your side... Get along, you say? Very well. Only out of respect for you, Contract Binder.

main6_ex.line: Tastes like bitter mud water... Is this supposed to be coffee?

mail_ex.line: A letter for you. Take it... Yes, I gave you it with my tail rather than my hands. And what of it?

mission_ex.line: Do what you must do, Contract Binder... You cannot afford to let distractions get between yours and my time.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. I suppose I should give you a reward... Do you want one?

touch_ex.line: If you have something to say, out with it. You already know what's going to happen if you get on my nerves.

touch2_ex.line: If you've forgotten how to plead for forgiveness, I'll just have to make you remember, Contract Binder.

win_mvp_ex.line: Supposing I were to grant your wish, what would you then do for me in return?

battle.line: Heehee. This game will be a boring one.

detail.line: Heehee. Your fearless, unhesitant gaze tells me you must really like this outfit.

feeling5.line: You are a funny one, Contract Binder. You act, you react, and you struggle... Enough already. I will take the lead and eat you up. Don't you worry – I will ensure you have sweet dreams...♡

headtouch.line: You touched my horn, Contract Binder... You meant to touch my bunny ears, you say? Again with the lame excuses... Just hold still and accept your punishment♡

home.line: A precarious battle, was it? Heehee, Contract Binder, you should know that you'll find greater pleasure in an evenly-matched back-and-forth than a one-sided stomp.

hp_warning.line: This card here... can turn everything around.

login.line: You're late, Contract Binder. I had a little to drink in your absence... Heehee. A few sips would never intoxicate me. Don't believe me? Watch me walk over to... Oof. It seems I've stumbled and bumped into you.

lose.line: You are sorely mistaken if you think I'm going to retreat.

main1.line: Won't you drink, too, Contract Binder? Right here. Heehee. Come over♡

main2.line: This card? You dropped it earlier when you were shuffling the deck. Use your hand and take it yourself.

main3.line: Drunk, you say? Hmph. I'm certainly not. I don't get drunk when I'm with you... Now, go on, show me what you're really like when you're at your wit's end♡

mission.line: Missions, missions... You can surely finish those in no time, Contract Binder.

mission_complete.line: Wine, cards, chips – everything is here. Resume the game.

touch.line: Heehee. Why so stressed? The game isn't over yet.

touch2.line: Are you satisfied now? Mmh♡ ...Don't celebrate prematurely. If you want to seize the lead, now is the time... Heehee. This game will not end until I've grown bored of it♡

unlock.line: It's just the two of us now, Contract Binder. Come – play a game with me and immerse yourself in the pleasures this place offers. The loser of this game, of course, must accept a punishment tonight♡

win_mvp.line: It's time to engross yourself in our little game, Contract Binder.

detail.line: The Dance of Control lures the heart and lays one's desires bare, Contract Binder. That means if you're weak of will... you will fall for me immediately.

feeling5.line: Has my dance already seized control of you, Contract Binder? Heehee. It'd be a shame for our game to end so easily. I never said I'd only dance for you once... did I?

headtouch.line: Heheh. You want me to bow? Do remember: I'm the one on top right now.

home.line: Heh. You missed all sorts of "views." If you'll obediently accept your punishment, then I will give you one more chance.

login.line: You're early, Contract Binder. I'm still warming up. Oh, are you unable to endure the wait?

main1.line: Has watching me made you thirsty? Heehee. There's water right beside you, yet you haven't even had a sip. Are you saying you want me to quench your thirst?

main2.line: The look in your eyes pleases me, Contract Binder, but I'm still only warming up. For the next part, you'll use your body to aid with my dance.

main3.line: Oh? Still not ready to admit defeat, I see. Then I'd better go all-out for you, Contract Binder♥

touch.line: Heh. You touched me. If you don't want to lose, you'd better keep it in as best you can.

touch2.line: You've been roundly defeated, Contract Binder... Next, I will take control of you and amuse myself to my heart's content♡

unlock.line: Contract Binder, have you heard of a thing called "the Dance of Control"? Heehee – yes. What do you say to a little "game" between us? Whoever is defeated... loses everything.

battle.line: For victory, and for the Commander!

couple_encourage1.line: Those emotions... Are they all because of the Commander?

detail.line: What is it that I wish to do? To obey Your orders, and fulfill Your wishes– such is the duty of us shipgirls, and such is my desire. Nothing else beyond that matters.

expedition.line: A new commission has been completed. May I check on the supplies?

feeling1.line: It is the duty of Your ships to be commanded and to obey. This, I understand. Do not worry.

feeling2.line: Commander, what orders do You have for me today? If there is nothing for me to do, please allow me to wait nearby.

feeling3.line: You wish to go out with me? Very well. Allow me to equip the proper rigging... Hmm? There's no need for that? What, then, will we be doing? Just... playing outside? I see. If that is Your wish, then I shall accompany you, body and soul.

feeling4.line: If You are going to "play" today, I shall accompany You at all times– Hmm? Do I wish to "play" as well? I do not understand. If "playing" makes one feel better, there is no reason to object to it... Actually, would it be fine for me to "play" with You?

feeling5.line: You want me to do what I want, not just obey You? But, Commander... whether it's "playing," or making me feel better, all of that is only possible when I am at Your side, when I am serving You... I wish to remain with You. That is not blind obedience, but rather my true desire.

headtouch.line: What purpose... does this serve?

home.line: Congratulations on your triumphant return. Hmm? I knew not when You would return, thus have I been waiting here.

hp_warning.line: My situation is less important than that of the enemy.

login.line: Commander, please bestow upon me Your orders for today. I shall give body and soul to see Your will done.

lose.line: The defeated are deserving of their judgment. Please administer punishment upon me as You see fit.

mail.line: It is my fault for not bringing You the mail in a timely manner so that You may check it... I am very sorry.

main1.line: Commandments and doctrines alike... are of little concern to me. All there is for me to do is obey Your orders.

main2.line: You want me to... spread my wings like one of the birds outside? ...What do you mean by this? Are You asking me to offer you a treasure from far away?

main3.line: My associates have been saying that they wish to become "friends" with me. What exactly is the nature of this "friend" relationship? Commander, do You also have "friends"...?

mission.line: A new mission? Allow me to handle it. ...Hm? Commander, will you be coming along as well? Understood.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. If I have fallen short in any area, please give me Your guidance and any punishment I deserve.

profile.line: Alsace-class battleship? The origin... of the shipgirl Flandre? I don't quite understand... My body, and the power hidden within it, serve no other purpose than to fulfill my sacred duties. You are the only being to who I submit, and thus, I can only become that which You desire.

propose.line: You want me to do as I desire, even if it means leaving Your side? But, the fact that You've given this to me means that You don't really want me to leave... If that is what You desire, then I... I shall not do as You wish. I do not wish to leave Your side, Commander. If possible, I want to be with You forever...

touch.line: As You will, Commander.

touch2.line: I understand. This is the sacred duty of "consummation" expected of all secretary ships... Am I wrong?

unlock.line: Your will be done, Commander. I am battleship Flandre, Your ship, Your subordinate, Your servant. Bestow upon me Your orders.

upgrade.line: I humbly accept Your favor.

win_mvp.line: The proper thing to do after victory is... to celebrate? And in doing so, I am to make a "V" with my fingers?

gift_prefer.line: Is it really right for me to have this...?

battle_ex.line: For victory, and for the one I love!

detail_ex.line: What else do I want to do...? Is there anything the two of us can do other than "play"? If I want to try doing everything, will you be okay with that...?

expedition_ex.line: A new commission has just been completed. I shall now go greet my companions. Commander, if you have time to spare, do you think we could...

feeling5_ex.line: You want me to tell you everything I want to do, and everything I don't want to do...? Very well, I promise. In that case, could you tell me what you want, Commander? I want to learn more about you, and experience more things with you...

headtouch_ex.line: That feels so good...

home_ex.line: I've been waiting for you all this time. I've wanted to see you... even if for no particular reason...

hp_warning_ex.line: I can't let things end here, the Commander is waiting for me...!

login_ex.line: Commander, what are you going to do today? I promised to try to help you today...

lose_ex.line: I have become soft and weak. Commander, I was afraid I'd never see you again, so I ran away... I'm so sorry...

main4_ex.line: My free will, and the things I hold dear to me... Yes, I wish to give more of myself for you, and for this port. That is my will.

main5_ex.line: You wish for me to be the bird that flies freely, not one that is confined to a cage... Even if that bird wishes to remain at your side, you can allow that, right?

main6_ex.line: Playing with friends makes me feel good. But it's a different kind of good feeling compared to when I'm playing with you... The "good feeling" I get from you is special...

mail_ex.line: Commander, I've come to deliver the mail. Is it okay that I'm a bit late...?

mission_ex.line: Commander, can you leave this mission to me? You look rather tired, so please rest up for now.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. If you think I did a good job, then... could you please praise me?

skill_ex.line: I won't let you have your way...!

touch_ex.line: So warm... I want to keep holding on to your hand, now and forever...

touch2_ex.line: I shall offer you all that I am. That is my will, Commander...

win_mvp_ex.line: I am victorious. If it is not too much to ask, Commander, I would like a reward from you...

battle.line: For victory! And for my master, the Commander!

detail.line: Wipe down the Commander's desk... Wipe down the table. Wipe down the Commander's statue... Aaand wipe down the Commander... Heheh...

expedition.line: The commission is complete. I'll make treats for the team right away.

feeling5.line: My sacred mission today is service, so I will exhaust all of my power to serve you, Commander. ...You think a pop-up doesn't require so much effort? Even if it wasn't a pop-up, it is my heartfelt desire to serve you with all my heart and soul. Is that so bad...?

headtouch.line: Do you still like me... even though I can't perform my sacred mission...?

home.line: Commander, here's your... Eep?! Thank you, Commander. I hate to cause you trouble so soon after your return... This isn't too much of a bother, you say...?

login.line: I was given a sacred mission to help in the pop-up restaurant, but I've gone and caused trouble for you and everyone else... Commander, how must I pray to make up for this...?

lose.line: Commander, umm... Your kindness only makes me feel more and more guilty...

mail.line: Commander, your mail, umm... No, it's not wet!

main1.line: Ah! When I finish cleaning, I should feed the birds in your office... Commander, the birds and I are very happy.

main2.line: To carry out the Commander's orders, I need not just strength, but the skill known as service. This is another valuable lesson.

main3.line: You'd like to clean with me? Commander, I couldn't trouble you like that... *sniffle* Here I go, racking up yet another sin...

mission.line: Commander, might you entrust me with your missions...? I'm eager to serve...

touch.line: Commander...?

touch2.line: Commander, may I... serve you, so to speak...?

unlock.line: *sniffle*... Oh, Commander, what have I done...? I was supposed to serve You, and now I've committed a grave sin of messing everything up... Where did I go wrong...?

win_mvp.line: My holy mission to serve may be beyond me, but I can still fight...!

battle.line: I shall relieve you of your existences. Heehee.

couple_encourage1.line: Won't you give me a taste of the Empery's cooking?

couple_encourage2.line: What are you going to do – give the Commander a physical exam?

detail.line: I've heard that eating too much spicy food or sweets will ruin your skin. I eat those quite a lot, but I can't spot any differences in the mirror, so... could you be a sweetheart and examine my skin for me? Yes, come closer and look thoroughly.

expedition.line: Let me help you verify the goods. Rest assured, I'd never make a mistake with such an important task.

feeling1.line: Commander, such an ambiguous approach makes you unsuited to be a leader.

feeling2.line: I want to stroll along the pier, though I'm quite unfamiliar with the place... Would you mind coming along with me?

feeling3.line: Mmh... Delicious... Why am I eating pineapple pizza, you wonder? Good question... An even better question: why was there pineapple pizza lying on my desk? Was it your dinner for tonight? My apologies. I'll have someone bring in a new one at once.

feeling4.line: Would you care for a stroll by the beachside? Don't worry about my attire, sweetie. If I get wet, so be it, and I don't care for looking formal and the like. The breeze, the sunshine, and being by your side... those are more important to me.

feeling5.line: This wreath is for you, Commander. Heehee. I've read in a poem that wreaths represent love. Only now after making one do I finally understand why... Do you mind? Lovely, then let me put it on for you!

headtouch.line: I've heard that patting another's head improves their sense of direction. Be a dear and keep doing it, would you? Heehee.

home.line: Congratulations on your mission, Commander. I've made you tea and snacks to... That's odd. Where did I put them?

hp_warning.line: This is more likely to fool them, you see...

login.line: Commander? I happen to pass by on my stroll, you see. Now that you're here, care to join me?

lose.line: All ships, fall back. I shall keep the foe preoccupied.

mail.line: There's a letter for you, Commander. I'm rather curious about this gorgeous envelope it's arrived in...

main1.line: How about we stop and go on a stroll, hmm? The breeze is lovely, the sun is shining, the seagulls are singing... I want to take it all in with you.

main2.line: Would you like to talk about something? It could be culture, art, history, or even... Oh, you want to talk about ME? Heehee.

main3.line: Oh... My apologies. My mind wandered for a minute. Do you want me to bring these papers to the archive? Okay... and where is the archive?

main4.line: I like to think of myself as a woman who likes traveling, rather than one with a poor sense of direction. It's the joy of going to new places and seeing new sights... Care to experience it with me?

mission.line: Allow me to help you with this unfinished missio– Oh, I don't usually do tasks like this. Let me try it.

mission_complete.line: Mission completed. Have I served you well, dear?

profile.line: I am Napoli, heavy cruiser of the Sardegna Empire. The reason for my creation does not warrant being recorded. I ask for your undivided trust, Commander. Give me that, and I shall grant you victory, glory, and all else you desire.

propose.line: I'm afraid this ring won't do much to better my sense of direction. Take my hand and hold me tight, Commander. Do that, and I'll never get lost again.

touch.line: Hm? This behavior of yours is rather uncouth. Save it for when we're alone, okay?

touch2.line: Hmm? Are you fond of touching these? Why? Please, I'd love to hear it. Heehee.

unlock.line: I am Napoli. It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I've longed for this union since I was awoken. Indeed, may this encounter of ours brighten up your day as it has mine.

upgrade.line: I implore you to wield my strength with finesse.

win_mvp.line: Such exemplary commanding – impressive. You must teach me your ways, Commander.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you, Commander. I'll keep it by my side at all times.

detail_ex.line: I don't want to catch those eyes of yours staring at any other girl, Commander. You'll make her get as lost in your heart as I have. We can't have that, because you're mine.

expedition_ex.line: Let us head out and greet the commission team together.

feeling5_ex.line: I've thought of a myriad of metaphors for my love for you. A lighthouse out at sea, a guiding star... None of them quite hit home, though. Perhaps I ought to forego such things and just express my unadulterated feelings... I love you. I will always be with you.

headtouch_ex.line: Hm? Yes, I was thinking of you, too.

home_ex.line: Have a seat and get comfortable, Commander. I've made you tea and sweets. Indeed – your favorite ones. I've committed them to memory.

login_ex.line: You're here, Commander. Yes, I didn't get lost today. I suppose what I should say is... I'm waiting for you to invite me on a stroll.

lose_ex.line: This is far from over.

main5_ex.line: I've got the hang of paperwork by now, Commander. You can stop bothering other girls with it and leave it all to me.

main6_ex.line: Diplomats often dance at balls as part of their work, so allow me to teach you some moves. Yes, place your hands like this... Feel free to place them further down, even.

main7_ex.line: What's that? You're studying intel on the enemy? I don't see why you'd concern yourself with such a thing. Can't you just beat them down with overwhelming force?

main8_ex.line: Commander? Oh, it seems my stroll has unexpectedly brought me to your room... Perhaps you could say that's part of the fun of traveling, heehee. What do you think?

mail_ex.line: Would you share the contents of this letter with me? I'm rather... scratch that, just a little curious.

mission_ex.line: Don't worry about those missions. I'll handle them.

mission_complete_ex.line: Mission complete. I daresay I've grown quite good at this.

touch_ex.line: I've heard that massages are good for the skin. Incidentally, may I... borrow your hands for a bit?

touch2_ex.line: I've been taking good care of these as well, by the way!

upgrade_ex.line: Whatever foes or obstacles come between us, I shall eliminate them all.

win_mvp_ex.line: My strategy went rather well. It was all thanks to your teachings, Commander.

detail.line: What are you looking for, Commander? ...There is a card missing? Hmm. Perhaps it is under me. You're free to come closer and look for it if you wish. Heehee.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Worry not, I can come with you – I don't wish to leave your side already.

feeling5.line: While I know little of card game rules, I know the role and the meaning of the cards. The four seasons, night and day, fortune, riches... The card you hold, the red heart, is the symbol of love. Did you know that? Heehee♡

headtouch.line: Being touched in this manner is rather refreshing... Kindly do it more, Commander.

home.line: I've never before had a beverage like this. Its mouthfeel is quite good. Would you care to give it a taste? ...Hm? It will make my head spin, you say? Is that really so?

login.line: Won't you come here and teach me how to play cards, like you promised? I think I should be able to handle it.

main1.line: I arrived early since I did not lose my way. Whilst waiting for you, I got thirsty, so I had this to drink. Alas, what you see now is the effect it had on me...

main2.line: What type of game do I want to study? Are there even games just the two of us can play? If not, you may pick any game of your choosing.

main3.line: Perhaps if I close my eyes, I'll draw better cards... Hm? I can do whatever I want since you promise you won't cheat, you say? Heehee. I trust you, Commander.

main4.line: This is my next card... Hm? Am I playing it wrong? Did I break the rules, then? If so, can I expect a punishment?

mission.line: You have unfinished missions, Commander. I shall help you with... Hm? You worry that I'll make mistakes? Heehee. I promise I won't.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. I don't see any errors – do you? Heehee. Good... Hm? I'm still a tad unsteady, so would you mind carrying me back home?

touch.line: You'll help me get up? Thank you. Although, I would like to practice with you a little more.

touch2.line: Oh, here's that card that went missing... Mmh... Could you take it for me, Commander?

unlock.line: Commander... Apologies for appearing before you like this. I'll try to get up right at once... Agh... I'm still so dizzy...

battle.line: Equipment functionality: green. Prepare for battle.

couple_encourage1.line: Let's talk technology when you have the time.

detail.line: My suit is made with the latest airtight materials and sports both exceptional insulation and flexibility... Why are you staring so much? Do you want a suit of your own?

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. I'll inspect their equipment.

feeling1.line: I need to concentrate on my work. Please don't bother me.

feeling2.line: I updated my program based on your commanding habits in battle. Take me for a spin and write me your feedback after. I'll further adjust it sometime later.

feeling3.line: Two hours remaining until the latest patch finishes installing. Go get yourself some rest, Commander. Oh, and thanks for helping with that test earlier. You're worried about whether or not I'm fitting in here, aren't you? I appreciate it. I'll be sure to make a support device that suits you perfectly.

feeling4.line: My cables have a myriad of different uses. Some can do photography and transfer data, and some react to a rise in my heartbeat, body temperature, and emotion by coiling themselves around you. As for that last part, the reason behind that warrants further research.

feeling5.line: Commander, I sent you an encoded message and... What? You already decoded it? That was amazingly fast... Hm? You want me to read it out for you? Well... "Commander, I love..." Ugh, please don't make me say it out loud!

headtouch.line: These aren't cat ears – they're auxiliary measuring instruments.

home.line: Welcome back. Please hold still while I perform an inspection on the equipment used in the last battle.

hp_warning.line: Equipment damage... Still functional!

login.line: Program inspection: complete. Go ahead with your work, Commander. Let me know if you have any questions.

lose.line: Critical equipment error. Requesting return to port for repairs.

mail.line: I ran a smart sorter on your letters, Commander. Don't forget to read them.

main1.line: If nothing else needs an inspection, I'll head back to my workshop now. Send me a message if you get any questions.

main2.line: Equipment status: green. I'm relieved it's been well-maintained... Hm? You're wondering how I'm doing? I'm fine, I guess. Thanks for asking.

main3.line: "Tails"? Calling my cables that sounds pretty funny, actually... Got any more ideas like that?

main4.line: You want to learn the basics of gear inspection? Sure. Let's start by taking this and– Please don't touch the connectooooor! It's a d-delicate instrument...

mission.line: You have unfinished missions. Would you like my technical support?

mission_complete.line: Doesn't it feel great to complete missions efficiently? Seems my mission assistance system is working well.

profile.line: I'm Admiral Nakhimov of the Northern Parliament. In the sea of the digital I was born, and to your side I came to aid you. While I have my flaws, I hope I can be of great help to you.

propose.line: What is this, Commander? Some kind of... part for a machine? What? A pledge of your love? Oh, forgive me... I understand now. You already know my answer – "I do." Now put it on my... Oh no, what are my tails doing?! Cut it out! Let the Commeownder go!

skill.line: Aircraft status: ready to take off! Commence attack!

touch.line: My little cables have quite delicate connectors. I'd rather you refrained from touching them.

touch2.line: Mmh... Mrreow! ...*gasp*! I think you just misheard me.

unlock.line: Northern Parliament aircraft carrier, Admiral Nakhimov. Are you the Commander? Standing by for further instructions.

upgrade.line: Program efficiency has been raised.

win_mvp.line: Test of new equipment: successful. Further adjustments necessary.

gift_prefer.line: Thanks. I like it, so I'll cherish it.

detail_ex.line: This is my workshop. Pretty dull place, don't you think? Hm? Teach you how to use my tools and gear? Sure. I'll teach you everything from A to Z.

expedition_ex.line: I'm working on an auto-confirm function for incoming commission goods. Hope it'll save you some time.

feeling5_ex.line: Have a look at this code, Commander. I came up with it myself and even put it in the startup sequence of your support device... You've already deciphered it? Yeah, you've got it right. Print. "I love you, Commander. I never want to be without you."

headtouch_ex.line: If you do like these "cat ears"... I'll just keep them on.

home_ex.line: Welcome back. Take a seat and get comfor– Oh, my cables are coiling around you again... I'll sever the connection and do an equipment inspection.

login_ex.line: Program inspection: complete. You can start working now, Commander. Wait, before you do that, will you... pat my head? Thanks. Meow♡

lose_ex.line: I'll need your help with the troubleshooting later, Commander.

main5_ex.line: Machine fault inspection: complete. Anything I can help you with, Commander? If not, I'll sit right here and leave you to your devices.

main6_ex.line: You want me to wear fluffy clothes? THAT came out of nowhere... but if you want that, then I'll find something to wear after work.

main7_ex.line: I've given you admin permissions for all the machines in my workshop. Oh, and keep an eye out for those red alerts.

main8_ex.line: Hey, why do you carry around medicine containing... catnip? Are you sick? Uhh, don't get any closer... *sniff sniff*... Your fingers smell so good... Meeeow♡

mail_ex.line: Remember to claim your mail, Commander. I optimized the function and took away all the legwork.

mission_ex.line: You didn't receive any mission notifications? Sounds like the feature needs some tweaking. Until it's fixed, I'll be the one notifying you.

mission_complete_ex.line: Efficient as always. That's what I like to see, Commander.

touch_ex.line: I improved my machine's durability while I gave it an upgrade. You can touch it now if you want.

touch2_ex.line: That's good... Meeeow! ...*gasp*! Pl-please don't do that when everyone can see us... *blushes*

win_mvp_ex.line: Test of new equipment: successful. Perfect synergy with the Commander's strategy achieved.

detail.line: Are these... records? Frankly, I don't get the appeal of an outfit with no functionality or utility... I suppose you don't mind it, though?

expedition.line: Commission team is back. I don't think I'm dressed to perform a machine inspection, though...

feeling5.line: I'm currently deleting some sloppy photos I took with my remote control before you came. My pose and expression were just too stiff... Don't delete them? You think it's cute when I'm nervous and shy? In that case... I'll put them behind a password so only you can view them.

headtouch.line: Yes, I've adjusted the design and color of my cat ears to match my outfit.

home.line: I could inspect your gear if you... Just focus on the photoshoot? Alright, I will.

login.line: Good timing, Commander. We just got done shooting and I'm wondering if you have any suggestions... Try to smile more naturally? I'll give it a shot.

lose.line: I'm just not good with cameras...

main1.line: The human eye and the camera lens view the same thing differently. By which I mean: Focus on the camera, not me, Commander.

main2.line: Relax and take deep breaths with you? Okay. *huff*... *puff*... *huff*...

main3.line: The lighting broke? I'll fix it. Don't worry, it won't impact the photoshoot. Heck, if anything, fixing it will help me relax.

main4.line: Drink some water and take a break, huh? Sure. Wait... What's that smell? Is this tea made with catnip? Commander, I... Mgh... Ah... Meow♡

touch.line: Straighten out a bit? What, like this? Okay, this is embarrassing stuff...

touch2.line: Right in front of the camera?! B-but I... Ah... Mreow...♡

unlock.line: What are you doing on the set, Commander? Here to check on the progress? But won't this spoil your first impression of the final cut? Well, the video is made for you anyways, so consider this a preview.

win_mvp.line: Was my smile good? Nice. Appreciate you giving me direction.

detail.line: ...Oh. I'm trying to create a saxaul pattern using code for a keepsake. What do you think?

headtouch.line: Whoa... Was my hat about to blow off? Thanks.

login.line: Commander, there's a vacant spot over there, so could you plant another saxaul there? ...You're not worn out, are you? Let me hold your planting tools for you.

main1.line: I've never done desert afforestation work before. It's a bit tiring, but it's also fun, and above all, it's worth the effort.

main2.line: You need to hydrate, Commander. You're likely to catch heatstroke in places like these. Here, you can borrow my sun hat.

main3.line: It's hard to walk in all this sand... Could you hold my hand, Commander?

main4.line: What is it, Commander? Is there sand on my face? Hey, wait, don't just stroke my chin like– Okay... Meow!

mission_complete.line: Saxaul planting is done. I can't wait to see how they look fully grown.

touch.line: Sunscreen? I've never used it much... You'll spread it on for me? Hmm. Alright.

touch2.line: Right here? Mgh... Mreeeow!

unlock.line: Commander, come here and plant a saxaul... Oh, I look like I'm enjoying this a lot? Yeah. It's because I don't get to do much outdoor work, since I'm always stuck in my workshop, poring over data and equipment. Also, you're here with me.

win_mvp.line: You finished planting over there, Commander? I've still got a bit to go, so give me a minute... Alright. You're in good condition and have energy to spare, so... would you mind? Thanks.

detail.line: Since this outfit is meant to cheer you on, I put emphasis on its functionality. What functionality, you ask? Ah, well... whatever is most "practical" for you, I suppose?

expedition.line: Commission goods have arrived. My full-auto inspection program is already running, so all you need to do is have a look.

feeling5.line: Look at this, Commander. It's how the next race is going to run. Think it's good? Well, I made a program that can calculate your most optimal route, which I reckon will be useful for– Y-you're bringing the catnip so close... and yourself...

headtouch.line: Always aching to touch my ears, huh? Mrreow♡

home.line: Ahh... Great job, Commander... Take a photo? Okay, I'll get ready right now. Just snap it whenever you want.

login.line: Whew... Welcome back, Commander. I'm finished inspecting your car. It's good and ready to exit the pit whenever you want.

lose.line: Mechanical failure... I'd better get back to my main job.

main1.line: It's tough to do both cheerleading and maintenance, but it does mean I get to spend twice as much time with you, so I'm happy.

main2.line: Opening a bottle is a good capstone to a blood-pumping race. I should probably... Hm? You thought it was vodka?

main3.line: A pose that'll cheer you on more effectively... Like this? Did that make your heart skip a beat?

main4.line: Ahh... The smell of oil can't cover up the smell of catnip... *sniff sniff*... Mrreow♡

touch.line: The fabric may not be as delicate as my connectors, but it's still delicate, you know...?

touch2.line: Ahh, mmgh... Your scent, it's making me... Mrreow...

unlock.line: Placing: first. Congratulations on your victory, Commander. I'm glad if my cheerleading played a part... My mechanical skills also played a part, you say? True. Then I guess I'm pretty glad.

win_mvp.line: Test of new equipment: successful. I'll install it in your car next time, Commander.

battle.line: It's work time right now... Time to get serious!

couple_encourage1.line: I smell family...

detail.line: That look in your eyes tells me you want to be a member of my family. ...W-wait a second. At least let me finish reading this...

expedition.line: The commission team worked hard today. They even finished their work before nightfall.

feeling1.line: Excuse me?! I can hardly believe that you're this lazy! Fix your work ethic before you try joining my family!

feeling2.line: As reward for finishing your work, I bequeath you with the most delicious blood: cherry juice! It's good, Commander. Give it a try.

feeling3.line: Vampire curses are really only a thing in novels. I think it's a fun idea, but I don't actually want you to be cursed... O-of course, I would gladly protect you if you were! So... You can come a little closer, you know?

feeling4.line: I'll keep trying hard, doing my job, fighting, and scattering all obstacles before you to become the perfect lord. Until then... Heehee, don't take those needy eyes off of me♪

feeling5.line: Heheh, look at this novel I've been reading lately. It's a romance story about a vampire and her servant. They get to be together in the end... What do you think, Commander? Ready to play the part of a servant embraced by their vampire lord?

headtouch.line: Be careful. You wouldn't want to be devoured by my cursed power.

home.line: I picked you out for your abilities, so don't expect me to be impressed by one victory. Here's your work list for today. Begin your next battle – the battle against paperwork!

hp_warning.line: I can't work under these conditions...

login.line: You kept me waiting, Commander. How can you sleep so soundly when your work's piled up this much... Hurry and get to work!

lose.line: Huh?! I-I LOST?!

mail.line: Commander, you have mail. Don't forget to read it.

main1.line: My rigging, Dora, is my most loyal servant. Say hello, Commander.

main2.line: Become a member of my family, and you'll gain immortality. Imagine how productive you'll be! ...I-I'm kidding.

main3.line: Living in the dark, yearning for the light. That is our creed, that is our – wh-why are you laughing?! I'm trying to explain my backstory here!

main4.line: I'll join you for all your work, night or day. Heheh, I'm a Daywalker, if you remember my backstory!

mission.line: Commander. You haven't finished your work yet.

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. Here are the fruits of your work.

profile.line: I'm Halford, Fletcher-class shipgirl with the Eagle Union. The 127th lord of a bloodline who rides upon the night sea... Huh? You think I said 126th when I introduced myself? But... No, I'd never blunder like... I-it's probably because you make me so damn nervous!

propose.line: I-is this... a contract that binds us forever? Then my final task for the day must be... yes, to respond to your eternal vow. As this lord's servant, you will be by my side forever!

skill.line: Indolents, be judged by the night!

touch.line: Aww, sharing your umbrella with me? Heehee, of course. That's another part of your job as my family.

touch2.line: Huh?! D-do you want my blood that badly...?

unlock.line: My name is Halford. I am the 126th lord of the Fletcher-class bloodline, an extraordinarily hard worker... Ahem. Commander of legend, do you wish to join my family?

upgrade.line: Limitless power roils inside me... Let's get to work already!

win_mvp.line: Heheh, this is my true power! Bear witness, indolents!

gift_prefer.line: You did your homework, huh? Thanks.

detail_ex.line: Are you curious about my outfit? Heheheh, this is a one-of-a-kind, made-to-order, vampire-themed outfit! I bought it as a little treat for all my hard work!

expedition_ex.line: Yeah, yeah. I'll go see the commission team with you.

feeling5_ex.line: Do you like the setting of this novel? If you do, I could buy you a made-to-order outfit themed after it. I'd match, of course, heheh. Oh, I hope you don't think servants have the right to say no? Heehee♪

headtouch_ex.line: Only you get to do this, dear servant...

home_ex.line: Servant of mine, are you tired? Heheheh, very well... Rest right here. I'll do your work for you♪

login_ex.line: My dear servant, before we get to work, I want to share this novel I've been reading. "I Was Reborn as a Being of the Night, so I Built a Workaholic Empire!" Doesn't the title make it sound so interesting?

lose_ex.line: Th-this is a real blunder... I don't want you to see me like this.

main5_ex.line: Do you feel like your work's gotten easier since you became my servant? Hmm... Oh, fine, I get it. I'll help you.

main6_ex.line: Feeling that bloodlust? I chilled some freshly-squeezed cherry juice. It's delicious♪

main7_ex.line: Servant, have you seen that new book I bought? ...Huh? It was in your room?

main8_ex.line: "With great power comes great workloads." That's my motto. Don't worry. I'm way stronger than you, so you can leave it all to me.

mail_ex.line: There's mail for you. How about I read it out to you?

mission_ex.line: Leave those unfinished missions to me.

mission_complete_ex.line: Work complete. Well done. Want to replenish your energy with my blood?

touch_ex.line: Do you want more... blood?

touch2_ex.line: Huh?! D-did you just bite me?

upgrade_ex.line: Servant, do you feel my power gradually returning to me? ...Yes! You're supposed to say YES when someone asks you that!

win_mvp_ex.line: For your sake, I'll never stop winning.

detail.line: Does this look good on me...? If it does, I'll think of a way to incorporate it into my backstory... Hmm. Like a vampire lord who morphs into a rabbit on rare occasions...?

expedition.line: Our commission team has returned. I'll go check on... Mm. No, my job is to chat with you for now.

feeling5.line: If there's one good thing about this job, I guess it's that I get to hang out with you. We're both so busy all the time, so it's hard to get quality time. I-I want to get to know you better, after all...

headtouch.line: Beware you are not absorbed by, uh... the forbidden power of the rabbit lord?

home.line: Want to order a drink? It's not my job, really, but with great power comes great responsibility. I won't feel comfortable until I put in some proper work.

login.line: My job today is to be by your side and treat you to conversation. Is this really good enough, though? Seems like easy work for the lord of a proud, storied lineage.

main1.line: I made plushies to resemble Dora. No matter the field, I take my work seriously.

main2.line: We don't have any iced cherry juice, but the other drinks are good. Want a recommendation?♪

main3.line: Akashi said she'd hold a "Special Family Team-Building Exercise" if I chatted with you. It's honestly so easy that I'm getting suspicious...

main4.line: Here's a soft cushion for you. We're hanging out for once, so don't think about work for now. I'll help you deal with it when the time comes♪

touch.line: Everyone in my family has smooth skin. Naturally♪

touch2.line: Huh?! Th-this isn't part of my job, right...?

unlock.line: "Welcome, dear guest♪ Right this way~ I'm happy to join you for a treat and chat♪" ...It was good? Well, obviously. I take my work very seriously!

battle.line: My desire is to overcome all hardship.

couple_encourage1.line: I'd love another book rec after this battle's over.

detail.line: Without the power to restrain myself, how can I hold a weapon and claim that I am able to protect others? I don't want to be a good-for-nothing who leans purely on a title – I wish to be true to myself and worthy of the title of knight.

expedition.line: Our friends return after a successful commission. Shall I join you in welcoming them?

feeling1.line: If thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

feeling2.line: Le bon chevalier... I like this name very much. Commander, to be known as "the good knight" is the utmost honor, in my opinion.

feeling3.line: When I was choosing a weapon, I opted for this greatsword. I wasn't confident that my shield could protect everyone, so I decided that my body should serve as that shield if needs must.

feeling4.line: The more time we spend together, the stronger I believe in my own wishes and morals. Before I knew it, you became one of the forces driving me forward...

feeling5.line: Every victory and achievement, I dedicate to you. You are every answer I seek, the rock that my heart leans on... Such insolent wishes I have. God, forgive me...

headtouch.line: I'm right here, Commander.

home.line: Battles are trials given by the Iris. Overcome the trial, and you will prove that you've grown once more.

hp_warning.line: A worthy opponent!

login.line: Commander, pray begin today's work. I will wait here until it's complete.

lose.line: My shield may break, but my sword and I are still intact!

mail.line: Here's your mail. Check it soon, lest you forget.

main1.line: In war, there's a line that you mustn't cross. When you go too far, it's not war. It's just slaughter.

main2.line: I am but a single, ordinary knight. I have neither status nor achievements. Even if you take away my spurs and my sword belt, even if I'm called worthless, it doesn't change that I'm a knight.

main3.line: The light of peace is more valuable than any medal of honor. I take my sword in hand and face the endless trials of chivalry in order to see people's smiles.

mission.line: Missions are but another part of the trial. I will accompany you until they're completed.

mission_complete.line: Good work, Commander. Do you need help listing and storing your mission rewards?

profile.line: I am Bayard. Though I was given life in a fleeting dream, I remember the expectations placed upon my name. However, my name is not what makes me who I am now – it is because I am a knight that I cherish the name I've been given.

propose.line: My feelings for you can no longer be restrained. All I can offer you now is my eternal, undying love... May this ring serve as proof. As for the kiss that seals it... This is my first, so please don't tease me for being unskilled...

touch.line: What is the meaning of this?

touch2.line: Commander, I urge discretion...

unlock.line: I am Bayard, but a simple chevalier chosen by the Iris. You are the Commander who will lead me, I presume? ...No, I need no explanation. When I saw your face, I knew that you were the one I must follow.

upgrade.line: This power is meant to lead us on the righteous path.

win_mvp.line: The battle has ended, Commander. If only that could be the end of the war...

gift_prefer.line: Umm, sorry... I'm so happy that I'm not sure what to say.

battle_ex.line: In the Commander's name, I will annihilate you.

detail_ex.line: A true knight is not made by title, honor, or status. Anyone who has a knight's spirit may be called a knight.

expedition_ex.line: I finished receiving the mission rewards. Here's a list of what we received... Umm? Is there something on my face?

feeling5_ex.line: In my time with you, I've learned to confront my own emotions. I shouldn't suppress my love. So now, I'm letting you see my... shameful, unsightly side. Please... hold me tight, and give me your warmth.

headtouch_ex.line: Is this a reward? For... me?

home_ex.line: Welcome home. As a reward for overcoming your trials... (Bayard gives you a warm hug.)

login_ex.line: Before you start work today, allow me to set ten minutes aside to get you into the right mental space.

main4_ex.line: Someday, we won't need weapons anymore. Knights will no longer be necessary. But that's the kind of future I want.

main5_ex.line: If one's purpose for fighting is to annihilate, to destroy, then it's my duty to stand in opposition.

main6_ex.line: I want to be fair, tolerant, humble, and pious. If my money is better suited to enriching others' lives... If my fame and honor could be used to touch others... Then I'm just fine giving all of that up.

mission_ex.line: Let's tackle this mission together. You don't need to worry about the workload.

mission_complete_ex.line: Commander, I suggest taking a short break before you gather your rewards.

touch_ex.line: Let me just close my eyes and stay by your side...

touch2_ex.line: You've dragged me into the abyss of desire, too, I see...

win_mvp_ex.line: Commander, the battle is over. Let's cross this sea of sorrows and return home.

detail.line: Akashi tells me that only training can yield growth. But if it means maintaining this posture for long periods of time, then this is difficult training indeed... Hmm? My hands are supposed to be on both sides of my head?

expedition.line: The commission was completed while I trained. Time flies when I have your encouraging gaze upon me.

feeling5.line: I'm not only training to be a better knight. It is also important to make my loved ones happy... such as by wearing an outfit you like and letting you see me in a perfectly trained posture. Commander... I pray that you still love me like this.

headtouch.line: Is this... a reward for my diligence?

home.line: Welcome back. Oh, you'd like to see the results of my training? Unfortunately, umm... I'm not exactly ready...

login.line: Commander, about your work today... Well, would you be able to focus on supervising my training for today?

main1.line: I will serve you as a worthy knight would, maintaining my humility and piousness all the while.

main2.line: Staying balanced, back straight, holding my fingers as such... How's this? Are you satisfied with the results of my training?

main3.line: Did I startle you...? I see. I dazzled you, didn't I? Then my training was worthwhile, heehee.

mission.line: C-Commander... Don't worry about me. Just take care of your missions. I'll train hard in your absence.

mission_complete.line: Have you completed your missions? I'm sorry... I may not be able to help inspect the rewards for a while to come.

touch.line: C-Commander, it's getting hard to stay balanced...

touch2.line: Is this an additional trial? Then please proceed.

unlock.line: Welcome, Commander. ...You really don't know what I'm doing? So there are things even you don't know. This is a new means of training knights, you see. Expect ever greater exploits from me.

battle.line: All ships, to your positions. The Commander's deployment strategy will lead us to victory!

couple_encourage1.line: You have such great control of your power. I should learn from you.

couple_encourage2.line: Lady Nagato, please... Don't charge too far forward!

couple_encourage3.line: Lady Musashi, I'm in perfect fighting form. I await your orders.

couple_encourage4.line: Lady Akagi... Uncontrolled fire won't ONLY hurt the enemy.

detail.line: (Each season comes with new flowers. If I change the flower arrangements with the seasons, that should put the Commander in a good mood... Yeah, let's do that!)

expedition.line: Commander, the commission is completed. I'll excuse myself and head out to handle the necessary proceedings.

feeling1.line: Revered Commander, what service do you desire today?

feeling2.line: Commander, I reorganized the bookshelf using a few bookends and made some bookmarks with natural materials. I hope you like it.

feeling3.line: Commander, I lit some incense. Hopefully it'll soothe your mind a little. As for your physical fatigue... I'd be happy to give you a full-body massage.

feeling4.line: Now that I think about it, there's a fundamental difference between me and maids. Maids would struggle to stay with their master forever, owing to the limitations of status... but I am no maid, so I don't have to worry about that!

feeling5.line: "In the morning time, the dianthus I espy. I wish they were you." Commander, here's today's flower arrangement. I hope you enjoy the haiku I wrote while preparing it.

headtouch.line: Heehee... Do you like the feeling of my hair touching your fingertips, Commander?

home.line: Commander, congratulations on another successful voyage. Change into some fresh clothes, enjoy a cup of matcha I brewed for you, and relax. Heehee.

hp_warning.line: Releasing anchors!

login.line: I already tidied up your desk for you. Start your day with a fresh office and a fresh mind.

lose.line: I'm sorry, Commander. It's all my fault... Allow me to cover you while you retreat.

mail.line: Mail bearing your name has come. I'll leave it on your desk.

main1.line: ...You think my service is on par with the Maid Corps? Heehee, thank you, but I'm confident I can do much better than them.

main2.line: I made this hair accessory. If you like it... shall I make a matching necklace for you?

main3.line: Commander, do you like this bell's chime? Understood. Come closer, and I'll shake it gently by your ear...

mission.line: New missions have arrived. I've already classified them, so take a look!

mission_complete.line: Commander, we've completed another mission. Here's the reward manifest, if you'd please give it a lookover.

profile.line: I am battleship Daisen of the Sakura Empire. For safety's sake, I seal a portion of my power with two anchor ropes. Even in battle, I've always held back. Please rest assured – when I can fully control this power, I will give you all that I am.

propose.line: This isn't a dream? You really feel the same way... Of course. On my oath, I, Daisen, will toil ever more for your sake from now on. If I'm lacking at all... I hope you'll not spare me the rod, my dear Commander♪

touch.line: Are you curious about my anchor ropes, Commander? You won't be anchored just by touching them, so feel free.

touch2.line: C-could you at least lock the door first...

unlock.line: It's a pleasure to meet you, Commander. I'm unworthy of this opportunity I've been given to serve you. I'll endeavor to satisfy you to the fullest – please, do not hesitate to ask me for anything.

upgrade.line: My power grows... I'll have to be more careful when I anchor from now on.

win_mvp.line: Under your command, the fleet has seized another victory both elegant and brilliant. I have the utmost respect for you.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you very much. I promise to treasure this gift, Commander.

detail_ex.line: Hmm, my hair's getting a little frizzy. That probably isn't very pleasant to the Commander's touch, so I should take better care... Huh? Commander?! Y-you didn't hear anything, did you?

expedition_ex.line: Commander, might I suggest we go out to port and get some exercise together? Heehee, the commission team is back, safe and sound.

feeling5_ex.line: Heehee. You chose to respond to my feelings directly instead of with poetry, so allow me to do the same. Commander, I love you very much♡

headtouch_ex.line: Commander, you don't need to be so gentle... I can handle a rougher touch.

home_ex.line: "Your absence so long, deep in the mountains' embrace. Do I wait or go?" Welcome home, my beloved Commander.

login_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. I checked your office supplies, picked a new blend of incense, and made tea and snacks for you. May your work day start comfortably.

lose_ex.line: Releasing anchors! Commander, I'll handle enemy pursuers. Reform our forces at once. This fight isn't over yet!

main4_ex.line: Your files are about to get blown away? Anchors... There. Now they won't be going anywhere.

main5_ex.line: Lately, I've gained better control over my power. Is it the power of our oath that caused this, or is it your own power?

main6_ex.line: Commander, if you want to relax and have your ears cleaned, let me know any time. Heehee, of course – you can lay your head right in my lap♪

mail_ex.line: I brought your mail for you. I offer you prayers as well, naturally.

mission_ex.line: Your organized list of missions is right here. Also, I made dianthus-themed sticky notes. Check both of them out~

mission_complete_ex.line: Commander, here's your mission reward list, and here's a batch of celebratory treats I made.

touch_ex.line: Where's my tail, you ask? Hmm... It's hard to describe. If you're so curious, why don't you search for it yourself? By feel, of course.

touch2_ex.line: Heehee... Dear sweet Commander, my anchor ropes can tie down many more things than you might think.

upgrade_ex.line: I grow even stronger... Heehee. That means I can serve you better than ever before.

win_mvp_ex.line: Another impressive victory, Commander. Thank you for all your work. Shall we celebrate with tea, in favor of alcohol?

detail.line: These are actually just decorative props. What really helps is... heehee, my desire to protect you, of course.

expedition.line: I hear the girls who were working on that commission. Commander, shouldn't you go and greet them?

feeling5.line: I'm most delighted that you heard my prayer and chose to accept my service. Allow me to perform a short ceremony to improve our bond even more. It will require your wholehearted devotion as well, but I hope you're willing to help♡

headtouch.line: Hmm? You're impressed that my hair is still in place while I'm lying down? Oh, my.

home.line: You've had a long day. Why not lie down next to me and take a break? You could even lean on me... I'd be happy to hold you.

login.line: Commander, may I ask for your help cleaning up the decorations later?

mail.line: Based on that sound... You must have just received mail. Hmm? I have good hearing? Heehee, I am a bunny, after all.

main1.line: Are you surprised? Oh, I'm sorry for my lack of forethought. I just wanted to use this opportunity to improve your prayer experience...

main2.line: It really was an effort to decorate this set. These are all just props, but I thought they might make the prayer a tiny bit more effective.

main3.line: What did I pray for? Heehee, it's quite simple. I prayed to live a happy, normal life with you, Commander.

mission.line: I see. You came running despite having missions waiting for you... I'm sorry, but that poses a bit of a problem for me as well.

mission_complete.line: Another mission completed. As impressive as ever, Commander~ Heehee, now you can focus on enjoying my service.

touch.line: Oh, Commander. You'll help me clean up now?

touch2.line: Where is my tail hiding? Heehee, well, it wouldn't be very hidden if I told you.

unlock.line: Oh, Commander! You're here earlier than I expected. Ah, I finally get to serve you in this specially made attire, stuffed full of such fantasy and dreams... I'm ever so honored.

battle.line: An inevitable conflict awaits...

detail.line: These are... some simple trinkets I wove together. I was planning to give them away, but if anything catches your eye, please feel free to take it.

expedition.line: Your worldly duties are calling to you. Go now; do not keep the girls in the commission team waiting.

feeling1.line: Every meeting is the confluence of fate... but should the threads of fate be too feeble, such is all it amounts to...

feeling2.line: Clear your mind, and your heart will naturally make room for serenity to dwell. If you are weary, why not take a seat and try meditating like me? Yes, let's first regulate our breathing... inhale... exhale...

feeling3.line: What brings you here again? Do you seek a moment of purity, or perhaps... did you simply feel like listening to the ramblings of a bored one?

feeling4.line: ...Found you~ Heehee, did I surprise you? No matter how far you are, I can find everything about you simply by following the threads~♥

feeling5.line: How many threads did I attach to you today? If you get the answer wrong, I'll tie you up in a corner where even the moonlight cannot reach... and then, and then... Ahhhn~♥

headtouch.line: Ahhh, yes~ Touch me more... Engrave your warmth upon me~♡

home.line: You certainly took your sweet time, my dear Commander... Since you've kept me waiting so long, I shall not release you from the long night ahead, not even for a moment~♡

hp_warning.line: Let go of all wants and desires, and you shall become unbreakable...

login.line: Long have I trained in the cavern, but never could I have imagined such a place to exist in the worldly realm... Commander, please allow me to seek your guidance once again today.

lose.line: Fortune and misfortune are predetermined. Follow the flow of karma, and you shall not go astray.

mail.line: Letters are like an autumnal breeze passing by. Give them a glance, then let them go.

main1.line: These threads are an extension of my eyes, ears, and senses... It is the very connection between the two of us. Through it, I can feel your every heartbeat... as if I could grasp it.

main2.line: As the sun must set westward, so too does time flow onward, slowly and inexorably. Should your mind ever be in turmoil, Commander, take a look at the moss resting upon this stone. Take it slow and don't rush.

main3.line: Commander, there's a scent on you that I don't recognize... This is... most troubling indeed... Ehehehe...

main4.line: I spin threads in my spare time, though not for any practical purpose. I just don't want my fingers to be idle.

mission.line: Commander, if you are negligent in your duties, that would certainly get in the way of the nights we share... And you wouldn't want that, would you?

mission_complete.line: Great is the feat performed with neither showmanship nor boasting... Well done indeed~

profile.line: I am Takahashi, a light cruiser of the Sakura Empire. You may think of me as a serene and unburdened recluse. When night falls, however... Heehee, have you seen a "demon" that craves affection?♥

propose.line: Alas, my beloved Commander... You have witnessed the desires I try to suppress, as well as the passionate love I drown in... yet you still wish to step into the "nest" of my heart? If that is what you truly desire... then I shall never let go of you again. Ehehehe~♥

skill.line: All things are transient; through karma, find form –

touch.line: Eheheh, it's as if you're testing me... Do you want to be entrapped so badly?

touch2.line: My, my~ You've learned how to be proactive... Ehehe... I'll have to spend this entire night repaying the favor~♥

unlock.line: *yawn*... My, are you the Commander? I wonder, was it a mere coincidence or the web of fate that brought us together... Heheh~♪

upgrade.line: My threads... have grown stronger~♪

win_mvp.line: Let go of worldly attachments. Dwell not on gains and losses, and celebrate victory.

gift_prefer.line: My, my. I'll have to keep this close at hand~♪

feeling5_ex.line: Now matter how much affection others may have towards you, I want you to only have eyes for me. Indeed, you are my implacable obsession, the nectar that quenches my thirst... I want your gaze and your warmth to snuff out my breath~♥

headtouch_ex.line: Ahh... it's like I'm in paradise... let me indulge in this moment a bit longer~♡

home_ex.line: Welcome back to the nest~ Now then, let my threads clean away some of this worldly dust that has gotten stuck onto you... little by little, until you become mine alone~♥

login_ex.line: While you were away, I decorated your office with my threads.... Heehee, don't worry. It's only what is needed to build our nest. When I miss you, however, the threads might get a little anxious...♡

main5_ex.line: I have never revealed the location of the cavern in which I cultivated my skills to anyone else... but if you wish to leave the worldly realm behind, I can guide you there, and we can find peace together.

main6_ex.line: Mmfh... If I leave my scent on your arm, up to your neck... then, my very being will be etched upon your body~

main7_ex.line: Gift-giving is the act of forging bonds. Nest-building is the act of weaving destiny. And I have already sewn my very being into threads, threads that have woven their way into the gaps of your life... In other words, we are now bound by unbreakable karmic ties~♪

main8_ex.line: Ehehe... Just a little more, and it'll soon be finished... A perfect nest for the two of us, drenched in love-soaked threads~♥

touch_ex.line: The place you just touched... throbs with pain and pleasure alike... Ahahaha~♥

touch2_ex.line: Ahh, what an intoxicating aroma... I simply can't resist the urge to taste you~♥

battle.line: Come. Let's enjoy the view of our panicked foes.

couple_encourage1.line: Quite the impressive dragon.

couple_encourage2.line: Another dragon...?!

detail.line: I am a dragon – a dragon of steel roused from my long slumber. Even if I am temporarily trapped in this soft body, in your heart I am always the apex of existence, am I not? Ahahahah~♪

expedition.line: Instruction manual #4 says... Ooh, who cares about that?! Behold that glittery loot in the port! Let us go get a look at it, Dragonspeaker!

feeling1.line: ...Even so, I shall protect you. Just as you stood guard over me as I slumbered...

feeling2.line: You are special to me, Dragonspeaker. But remember, not all dragons fall in love with the first person they lay eyes on... 'Tis but a coincidence that I have special feelings for you.

feeling3.line: In my long, lonesome existence, the welkin was my sole companion... But now, there is a mortal life I fret over. It is not a bad feeling at all, though.

feeling4.line: Be wary, Dragonspeaker. My dragon's eye can spot the storm looming ahead... If you must march to the frontlines, my wings will be your shield.

feeling5.line: Dragonspeaker, you are now as mighty as I am. Even if I am no more, you must conquer the welkin on your own... Mm? Why are there tears running down my cheeks...? I know you will never leave me. Do these tears run out of... instinct?

headtouch.line: Heheh, this is a genuine dragon's horn. A mere brush from it is enough to tear your clothes apart... Just like this~♪

home.line: You should rest after a hard day of work. Won't you roost under my iron wings? That way, I can rest easy within your heart, too.

hp_warning.line: A dragon never falls!

login.line: This vessel is quite adequate... It is capable of flight, suited for combat... and well-equipped to taste the world's delicacies♪ What delectable sweets shall you present me with today, Dragonspeaker?

lose.line: They got us... But I shan't forget how this enemy dared tarnish these skies.

mail.line: Instruction manual #3 says... follow these steps to accept mail... Done. This whole work thing is easy-peasy!

main1.line: I would do anything for a piece of Bienenstich. Come, Dragonspeaker♪ What will you ask for in return?

main2.line: August's dragon is quite impressive in its own right, but my wings are much larger and more magnificent, are they not? Who's the mightier dragon, you ask? What an adorable question. Ahaha!

main3.line: Ow! ...I burned my tongue trying to breathe fire the other day. Dragonspeaker, let me cool my tongue on your cheek, okay?

main4.line: Wait, you say that these... tiny, funny-looking, adorable creatures in the gallery are dragons too? They're my kin?!

mission.line: Instruction manual #1 says...a timer for unfinished tasks? Oh, it went off... 'tis quite effective, I must say.

mission_complete.line: Instruction manual #2 says... upon mission completion, register the results into the database... Hmm. This machine is quite easy to use.

profile.line: I am Max Immelmann, Aircraft Carrier of the Iron Blood, Ancient Dragon of Steel, and Immortal Monarch of the Welkin... Th-that's too long? You may simply call me by name, then. This is a special reward and privilege I extend to you and you alone, Dragonspeaker.

propose.line: An oath? Why even bring it up when I've already resolved to share eternity with you... Have I not forever remained in your heart since the moment of my awakening, Dragonspeaker? Keep in your mind that I will remain in your heart... forever.

skill.line: A dragon's flame scorches even the firmament!

touch.line: You want to be warmed up? Perhaps I should breathe fire on you... Ahaha♪ Just kidding~♪ Now, come closer...

touch2.line: Dragonspeaker... You have some rather unconventional hobbies~♪

unlock.line: Ahh... How long it has been. The mortal-usurped welkin... I, Max Immelmann, master of steel and sky, have awakened. ...Hm? Were you the one who roused me from my slumber? Heh... Then, I shall bestow the title of Dragonspeaker upon you. Let us conquer the realm above the clouds together.

upgrade.line: Come. We take flight!

win_mvp.line: To celebrate my victory... I shall stretch my wings into the firmament. Won't you join me, Dragonspeaker?

gift_prefer.line: Thank you. But it would be better if you became my present, too♪

feeling5_ex.line: Come to think of it... A great dragon roused from its long slumber is the one who needs care and pampering. Won't you give some care and affection tonight... Dragonspeaker?♪

headtouch_ex.line: Which piece of clothing should I slice up this time~?

home_ex.line: Welcome back. Here, take this. These flowers are a token of my feelings... They're different from the last ones I gave you? Well of course. It's a surprise! It wouldn't be a surprise if they're the same~

login_ex.line: Your breath, body temperature, heartbeat... Dragonspeaker, you truly mesmerize me. May I lie on top of you? Can I give you a little nibble? Don't worry, I'll be careful. I wouldn't want to break you, after all~♪

main5_ex.line: Want me to help you out with anything? All it'll cost you is one kiss. Ahaha~♪

main6_ex.line: Before I met you, I never thought being alone was a particularly painful thing... Dragonspeaker, you changed me. So, please don't leave me alone too much, okay? Please and thank you~♪

main7_ex.line: Hmph... this book says that it's customary to say "I love you" every day and give roses to humans you love... "Old-fashioned," you say? I think it's quite romantic.

main8_ex.line: Steel wings and a fiery breath are not enough to conquer the skies. A variety of supportive equipment is also required, including that coffee machine of yours... In other words, I've learned how to use everything~♪ Now then, how about trying some of the coffee I brewed?

touch_ex.line: Oh? Have you finally grasped the importance of doing things one step at a time?

touch2_ex.line: ...Grab me from behind. Hurry~♥

win_mvp_ex.line: The Dragonspeaker and Max Immelmann – Let our names resound across these skies!

battle.line: You shall not sully my sealanes.

detail.line: The ruby's brilliance, like the sunlight shimmering across the sea at dawn, brings serenity to a travel-weary heart. I hope that I can be that warm presence for you as well.

expedition.line: The commission team has returned. Shall we go check in on them? After all, cargo can only truly exert its power when delivered to the rightful hands at the rightful place.

feeling1.line: It's okay, there's no need to worry. You've already done what you can...

feeling2.line: Commander, if you ever need anything, please do not hesitate to come see me. My door will always be open for you... There's no need to hold back.

feeling3.line: You've been coming to see me quite a lot lately. So, what can I get for you today? A healing ruby? Or perhaps... a nice and quiet place to help you gather your thoughts?

feeling4.line: Commander... Lately, whenever I'm with you, I find myself wishing you'd stay a bit longer... And whenever you leave, I can't help but wonder when you'll be back... Do you think I'm being a bit greedy?

feeling5.line: Should you want a friend, a lover, or a mother... Heehee~ I'll be whatever you want and support you whenever you need.

headtouch.line: You need some comfort? Aww, come here and let me give you a big hug~

home.line: No matter how turbulent the waves surrounding you might be, I shall bring you serenity with this ruby's brilliance.

hp_warning.line: It'll take more than some choppy waters to defeat me.

login.line: Commander, try touching this ruby... Let the gem's brilliance envelop you and wash away your worries and fatigue.

lose.line: Fret not. No sealane is devoid of storms.

mail.line: You've got a message. Should I read it for you? I have plenty of free time~

main1.line: The usual blend, I take it? Heehee... If you're tired, feel free to rest. You don't need to say anything at all. I'll be right here... by your side. After all, all we need is company sometimes.

main2.line: Commander, you hold the ruby's most wondrous brilliance in the palm of your hand. Has its healing aura... made you feel any better at all?

main3.line: The whisper of the wind, the din of heavy machinery, the murmur of the waves... All these sounds can be heard from here, blending together into a melody most familiar to me.

main4.line: Every gemstone has its own "tone." Our incantations connect us to them through the power of sound.

mission.line: You still have unfinished work? Don't worry. If you're tired, just take a break. You can always pick up where you left off later. I'll be with you, as long as it takes.

mission_complete.line: You've finished your mission, yes? Now, allow me to handle the rest. I shall turn these numbers on a list into an indelible page in your story.

profile.line: I am battleship Valparaíso, your everlasting harbor in the storm. Whenever you need support, a place to rest, or someone to confide in... Come to me. I will always be here for you.

propose.line: Commander, I'm so glad you chose me. From now on, no matter where you go, what you do, relying on me or on your own... I will always respect your decisions and walk by your side.

touch.line: Hm? What would you like from me? Something warm to drink? A hug? ...Or perhaps, you'd like to hear more about this ruby?

touch2.line: Mgh... It's okay, you don't need to say another word. You're welcome to do whatever you want~

unlock.line: I am Valparaíso, the Ruby of Pedrería, matron of these distant sealanes. Having directed countless shipments of cargo to their rightful place, I, too, have found mine – here, by your side.

upgrade.line: Like a breakwater shielding a harbor, my protection has grown even stronger. Let me protect you from the perilous waves.

win_mvp.line: All victories flow unto their rightful place.

gift_prefer.line: This is... for me? Then, I shall return your feelings with this ruby.

feeling5_ex.line: A harbor is a cycle of greetings and partings. Cargo and ships come and go, yet there was never a moment where I thought something would stay with me forever – until I met you.

headtouch_ex.line: Yes, I'm right here with you.

home_ex.line: Welcome back, Commander. Just lean against me and rest awhile – Shh, don't be in such in a hurry. Just come closer... yes, a bit more, just like that... Make yourself at ease. I'll always be here for you.

login_ex.line: Commander, whenever you open this door, I shall always be waiting for you – this is a harbor you can always dock in.

main5_ex.line: Commander, let me see your hand. Now... close your eyes, and follow my chant... Let your burdens melt away. Feel the pulsating ruby in your heart.

main6_ex.line: I've started to develop a habit – every time I hear footsteps, I can't help but wonder if it's you...

main7_ex.line: The ore goes to the factory, the fur goes to the frigid north... Every shipment has a place where it belongs. I'm simply helping them find the way.

main8_ex.line: Commander, will you listen to my song? In this song, I am a dream that offers you solace, the one always awaiting your return, and a presence who will always keep you in her thoughts.

touch_ex.line: The ruby will sulk if you simply give it a few pats every now and then, you know~?

touch2_ex.line: Ahhn... Is this ruby... that fascinating to you?

win_mvp_ex.line: Victory is ours. May I celebrate this moment in your warm embrace?

battle.line: Time for a little clean up, wouldn't you say?

detail.line: I modified this violin case to store weapons and gadgets, which means I am well-equipped to handle almost any scenario. Although, I prefer to deal with situations before they turn ugly. That's more efficient and professional.
