expedition.line: The commission fleet has returned, and I have finished inspecting the rewards. I shall now give you a detailed report.

feeling1.line: Should something be causing you difficulties, Commander, I ask that you confide in me.

feeling2.line: It is enough for me to work by your side as your secretary, and to protect you with my body and weapons.

feeling3.line: Champagne must be opened at the perfect temperature according to the years it has been aged. Why yes, I am highly detail-oriented. It allows me to close the distance between us, Commander.

feeling4.line: Just relax and leave everything to me... I've always wanted to say that.

feeling5.line: The time I spent with you has become my most precious treasure in this world. Commander, I shall continue to serve by your side in my own way until the very end of my mission.

headtouch.line: P-please... do be gentle with me...

home.line: Welcome back, Commander. Would you care for a martini? Shaken, of course.

hp_warning.line: It's time to finish this...

login.line: I am a professional, and I ask that you rely on me. I am capable of fulfilling my duties to your satisfaction, whether they be organising your daily schedule or "dealing with" any mission targets...

lose.line: I'm sorry... I've troubled you with my incompetence...

mail.line: There is post for you, Commander. Shall I summarise the contents for you?

main1.line: The most unassuming of items can prove highly effective in the hands of a pro. Even if it's something as simple as a pencil.

main2.line: Frozen meals are quick to prepare and eat. Perfect for when you need to rush out on an important mission.

main3.line: It's not a "strange sound" – it's the melody of my violin. As for the intonation... As long as I look like a professional player, it's enough.

main4.line: I've watched so many spy films. Each and every one of them was an absolute masterpiece. They can be unrealistic at times, but even those scenes are informative.

mission.line: You still have missions to complete, Commander. Or shall I deal with them for you?

mission_complete.line: Mission complete. The target has been silenced.

profile.line: Sorry to keep you waiting. I am the Royal battlecruiser, Duncan. I shall assist you with any... "jobs" that might need doing. You're curious about my violin? It is a necessary part of my disguise... just like in the movies.

propose.line: A vortex of emotion rages within my chest... I have no doubt that this means I'm longing for you... Would you allow me to unleash all the overflowing love I feel upon you right now?

touch.line: Yes, Commander? Awaiting your orders.

touch2.line: No visible third parties are in our surrounding area, Commander. We are clear to proceed.

unlock.line: Royal battlecruiser Duncan, reporting for duty, Commander. I would gladly take on any task you require, from dispatching dangers outside to supporting you with paperwork and admin inside. Please allow me to be your adviser.

upgrade.line: I need more firepower. Lots of firepower.

win_mvp.line: It seems the enemy tends to overestimate their own strength.

gift_prefer.line: Thank you. I shall return the favour in kind, so please look forward to it.

feeling5_ex.line: I shan't waste a single minute, a single second, of my life as long as we are together. Allow me to devote my whole self to serve, protect, and love you.

headtouch_ex.line: Are you going to assign me a mission? If not, then please continue...

home_ex.line: Please do as I say and return to the safe house to rest. I shall stay up and be by your side.

login_ex.line: No matter how long we are apart, know this: I shall always be waiting for your return.

main5_ex.line: Completing my missions too quickly means I cannot spend as much time by your side. And yet, it isn't right that I prolong them unnecessarily either... I must find the perfect pace.

main6_ex.line: I have never looked at you from this angle before, Commander... Ahem. Do you have any plans after today's mission? Would you like to go and see a film with me?

main7_ex.line: There is a delicious curry among the meal pouches we received recently. Would you like to have some with me?

main8_ex.line: If crime would give me wings to reach you, I would – Oh, don't do that? Alright.

mission_ex.line: I have assembled a list of missions, Commander. Could you make a decision as to where to start?

touch_ex.line: Do you have instructions for me? Please whisper them into my ear so they don't leak.

touch2_ex.line: You have transmitted to me both your feelings and your warmth. I shall respond with my own...
